trait.name: Double Deception
entries: The 'rakshasa' is wearing a sophisticated yet mundane rakshasa disguise, cloaked in an illusory humanoid appearance that it may activate or deactivate as a Bonus Action.
A creature that can see through the illusion may discern this fact with a {@dc 18} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check.

trait.name: Incendiary Failsafe
entries: If the 'rakshasa' is killed, its corpse bursts into flames. Unless they are extinguished, the corpse becomes unrecognizable after {@dice 1d4} rounds.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The 'rakshasa' uses its Shouted Command twice, one of which it may replace with a use of its Craven Retreat.

action.name: Shouted Command
entries: One creature the rakshasa can see within 60 feet may use its reaction to move up to half its speed and make a melee attack.

action.name: Craven Retreat
entries: The 'rakshasa' drops {@condition prone}, then may {@action Dash} or {@action Disengage}.

action.name: Sow Chaos (1/Day)
entries: The 'rakshasa' hurls a container of volatile alchemical substances up to 30 feet to a point it can see, where it bursts and fills a 20 foot radius with sickly yellow fumes.
Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute (Save Ends at end of turn)
While {@condition poisoned} in this way, a creature can't distinguish friend from foe, and must use its reaction to make a melee attack against any creature that enters its reach.

reaction.name: Feign Death
entries: When the 'rakshasa' takes any damage, it can appear to die, falling {@condition prone} and slowing its heart rate.
A creature may discern that it is still alive as an action with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check.

trait.name: Vicious Attack
entries: If the aarakocra is flying and dives at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a melee weapon attack, the attack scores a critical on an 19 or 20.

trait.name: Brittle Bones
entries: If the aarakocra starts its turn {@condition grappled}, it takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) bludgeoning damage and has disadvantage on attack rolls until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The aarakocra doesn't provoke {@action opportunity attack||Opportunity Attacks} when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The aarakocra makes three attacks with its shocking claw.

action.name: Shocking Claw
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d8}) slashing damage. On a critical hit, the target is {@condition stunned} until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Fury of the Storm {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature within 120 ft. that is flying is pushed up to 15 ft. in a direction of the aarakocra's choice. Then, each creature in a 10 ft. radius, 100 ft. high cylinder within 120 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 4d10}) lightning damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Take Flight
entries: As a reaction to taking damage from a melee attack, the aarakocra moves up to half its fly speed without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

trait.name: Vicious Attack
entries: If the aarakocra is flying and dives at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a melee weapon attack, the attack scores a critical on an 19 or 20.

trait.name: Brittle Bones
entries: If the aarakocra starts its turn {@condition grappled}, it takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) bludgeoning damage and has disadvantage on attack rolls until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The aarakocra makes three attacks with its flight lance.

action.name: Flight Lance
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d12 + 3}) slashing damage. On a critical hit, the target is knocked {@condition prone} if it is a medium or smaller creature.

reaction.name: Take Flight
entries: As a reaction to taking damage from a melee attack, the aarakocra moves up to half its fly speed without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The aboleth can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Probing Telepathy
entries: If a creature communicates telepathically with the aboleth, the aboleth learns, in broad terms, the creature's greatest desires.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The aboleth makes four tentacle attacks.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and the target must make a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or become diseased. A diseased creature can only breathe water and can't regain hit points while outside of water. After 1 minute, a diseased creature's skin begins to turn slimy and translucent. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more gains vulnerability to the next source of bludgeoning damage it takes in the next minute.

action.name: Tentacle Whirlwind {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature in a 15 foot radius around the aboleth must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 35 ({@damage 10d6}) bludgeoning damage and be shoved 20 feet back, or take half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Reactive Camoflauge (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 50 hit points, the aboleth becomes {@condition invisible} to creatures more than 30 feet away from it. This invisibility lasts for 1 hour, or until the aboleth regains any hit points.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The aboleth can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Defensive Telepathy
entries: A creature that attempts to harm the hatchling must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by the hatchling for the next minute. A creature {@condition charmed} by the hatchling has disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws.

action.name: Weaken Mind
entries: One creature within 30 ft. that the hatchling can see must make a {@dc 14} Charisma saving throw. On a failure, the target must roll a {@dice d4} and subtract it from the total of the next saving throw it makes before the end of the hatchling's next turn.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The aboleth can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Mucous Cloud
entries: While underwater, the area in a 10 foot radius around the Aboleth counts as difficult terrain for non-aberrations.

trait.name: Probing Telepathy

entries: One creature {@condition charmed} by the aboleth makes a weapon attack or casts a cantrip, targeting a creature of the Aboleth's choice.

action.name: Dominate (concentration) {@recharge 5}
entries: 30 ft. range, targets 1 creature the aboleth can see. The target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be magically {@condition charmed} and under the aboleth's control. Whenever the {@condition charmed} target takes damage, the target can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on a success.

trait.name: Mindtaker Resilience (3/Day)
entries: If the aboleth fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. When it does, each creature dominated by the aboleth may make a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw at advantage, freeing itself on a success.

entries: The aboleth makes four tentacle attacks. It may replace up to two of these with its Compel or Dominate abilities.

A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is additionally {@condition stunned} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Enslave {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature {@condition charmed} by the aboleth must succeed on a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw or take 110 ({@damage 20d10}) psychic damage, or half as much on a success. If this damage reduces the {@condition charmed} creature to 0 hit points, it gains 110 ({@dice 20d10}) hit points and the aboleth no longer requires Concentration to Dominate it.

legendary.name: Compel

legendary.name: Mental Fog (Costs 2 Actions)

variant.name: Note: Aboleth Servitor Template
entries: The aboleth servitor template can be applied to any creature without proficiency in Wisdom saving throws. An aboleth servitor has:

items.name: Creature Type
entries: The creature's type changes to aberration.

items.name: Swim Speed
entries: The creature gains a swim speed equal to its movement speed.

items.name: Water Breathing
entries: The creature gains the ability to breathe water and loses the ability to breathe air.

items.name: Vulnerability
entries: The creature gains Vulnerability to Bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Heat-Strained
entries: If the yeti takes 10 or more fire damage from a single source, attacks against it are made with advantage until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Snow-Stoic
entries: The yeti has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in snowy terrain. If the yeti allows itself to be covered in snow while remaining motionless for 24 hours, it becomes undetectable except by magic until it moves or is uncovered.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the yeti may spend half of its movement to attempt a {@dc 18} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the yet. While climbing on the yeti, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the yeti, and the yeti has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The yeti makes two attacks with its Crushing Grasp.

action.name: Crushing Grasp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 18}).
A creature already {@condition grappled} in this way takes an additional 9 ({@damage 2d8}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Burial Slam
entries: The yeti slams a creature {@condition grappled} by it into the ground, releasing it. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or take 52 ({@damage 8d12}) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.

If the ground is comprised of packed snow or ice, a creature that fails this save is additionally buried 5 feet beneath the surface (escape {@dc 18}). While buried, a creature is {@condition blinded}, {@condition restrained}, and can't speak or breathe.

trait.name: Ossifying Gaze
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the basilisk that can see it (or its reflection) must make a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature magically begins to turn to stone and is {@condition restrained} until the beginning of its next turn.
At the beginning of its turn, a creature that isn't Surprised can avert its gaze, treating the basilisk as {@condition invisible} until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The basilisk can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a 5-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The marilith has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The basilisk makes three attacks with its Claw Swipe, one of which it may replace with its Stonecrushing Bite or its Petrify.

action.name: Stonecrushing Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage.
If the target is {@condition petrified}, it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or lose a limb of its choice.

action.name: Claw Swipe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) slashing damage.
On a critical hit, the target is knocked {@condition prone}, and must immediately make a saving throw against the basilisk's Ossifying Gaze.

action.name: Petrify
entries: One creature affected by the basilisk's ossifying gaze must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition petrified} until cured with a Greater Restoration or similar magic.

reaction.name: Darting Snap
entries: As a reaction to a creature that is averting its eyes missing the basilisk with a melee attack, the basilisk may make a bite attack against the attacker.

monster.name: Abyssal Chicken
languages: telepathy 60 ft. (Works Only With Creatures That Understand Abyssal)

trait.name: Bad Flier
entries: The chicken falls at the end of a turn if it's airborne and the only thing holding it aloft is its flying speed.

action.name: Fanged Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Razor Talon
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) slashing damage.
Then, if the target is {@condition unconscious}, the chicken can lay a barbed egg in the wound this turn as a Bonus Action.

reaction.name: Henpeck
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of it receives magical healing, the abyssal chicken can make a Fanged Bite attack against it.

variant.name: Note: Abyssal Chicken Eggs
entries: Abyssal chicken eggs are highly prized by those looking to keep them as pets or familiars, often going for as much as 100 gp on the open market. Ordinarily removing one of the barbed eggs from a wound is a relatively simple matter, and can be accomplished with a successful {@dc 12} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check, destroying the egg in the process.

Retrieving the egg intact, however, is a much more difficult process, and requires removing a portion of the flesh the egg is embedded in with a successful {@dc 20} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check, dealing 10 ({@damage 3d6}) slashing damage to the host on a success or failure.

trait.name: Demonic Hunger
entries: If the ghoul uses its Ghoulish Bite on a corpse, it gains resistance to all damage and advantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Snatcher
entries: If the ghoul has a creature {@condition grappled}, it can {@action Dash} as a Bonus Action.

trait.name: Diseased Blood
entries: A creature that deals piercing or slashing damage to the ghoul with a melee attack must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or contract Ghoul Fever.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ghoul makes two attacks, one of which may be with its ghoulish bite.

action.name: Ghoulish Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}6 ({@dice 1d6 + 3}) piercing plus 5 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} until the end of the ghoul's next turn.

action.name: Wretched Grasp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}). On a critical hit, the target is additionally knocked {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Thrash
entries: When a creature {@condition grappled} by it begins to cast a spell, the ghoul can force the creature to succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or have the spell fail.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The scavenger has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: Death Shriek
entries: When the scavenger drops to 0 hit points, each other scavenger within 15 ft. can make a melee attack as a reaction.

action.name: Engulfing Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}).

A Medium or smaller creature that isn't {@condition grappled} by another scavenger has its head engulfed in the scavenger's mouth; while {@condition grappled} in this way the creature is {@condition blinded} and {@condition choking|confc|choking}.

action.name: Frenzied Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) slashing damage, and each other scavenger within 30 feet can use its reaction to move up to 10 feet toward the target.

action.name: Worry
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by both the scavenger and at least one of the scavenger's allies must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or fall {@condition prone} and take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) piercing damage, or take half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Adapt Resistance
entries: When the scavenger takes damage of a type it doesn't have resistance against, it can gain resistance to that damage type until the beginning of its next turn.

monster.name: Abyssal Thrall

walk.condition: The speeds it possessed in life

languages: understands Abyssal but can't speak it

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the thrall takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the thrall takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

trait.name: Bound Thrall
entries: Whenever it attempts to attack the creature that raised it or one of that creature's allies, the thrall must make a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the thrall is {@condition charmed} by its target for the next hour and must choose a new target or lose the attack.

action.name: Rip and Tear (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}8 slashing damage.

reaction.name: Blood-Crazed Advance
entries: When a creature within 30 feet takes any piercing or slashing damage, the thrall can move up to half its speed directly toward the creature.

trait.name: Liar's Guile
entries: The adaru can detect lies told by creatures within 30 feet of it by scent.

trait.name: Vent Evil
entries: The pores in an adaru's carapace constantly vent an vile miasma that warps the minds of all it touches. A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the adaru must make a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw.

On a failed save, a creature is {@condition poisoned} and {@condition frightened} until the beginning of its next turn if it is non-evil, or {@condition charmed} and under the adaru's control for the same duration if it is evil.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The adaru has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The adaru makes two attacks with its Skittering Coils, one of which it may replace with its Dripping Mandibles or the {@action Dodge} action.

action.name: Dripping Mandibles
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@dice 2d6 + 3}) piercing plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Skittering Coils
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}).
While {@condition grappled} in this way, a creature is {@condition restrained} and must immediately answer any question asked of it.

reaction.name: Devour Lies
entries: When a creature {@condition grappled} by the adaru tells a lie, the adaru can attach its sucking organ to the creature's face.

The creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw or take 16 ({@damage 3d10}) necrotic damage and lose any proficiency it has in {@skill Deception} until restored by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

trait.name: Treasure Sense
entries: The dragon turtle can pinpoint, by scent, the location of precious or magical metals, stones, and crafted objects within 300 ft.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the dragon turtle may spend half its movement to attempt a {@dc 17} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the dragon turtle. While climbing on the dragon turtle, a creature has advantage on melee attacks made against the dragon turtle, and the dragon turtle has disadvantage on attacks made against the creature.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the dragon turtle fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon turtle makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}25 ({@damage 3d12 + 6}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 18}).

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d10 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 ft. away.

action.name: Steam Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon turtle exhales scalding steam in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw, taking 35 ({@damage 10d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Being underwater doesn't grant resistance against this damage. The affected area becomes heavily obscured until the end of the dragon turtle's next turn.

reaction.name: Retract Head
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a ranged attack, the dragon turtle gains resistance to the attack's damage.

reaction.name: Bloodied Agitation
entries: As a reaction to taking damage while below 106 hit points, the turtle dragon rolls to recharge its breath weapon.

legendary.name: Dive
entries: The dragon turtle moves up to half its speed. If it is submerged, each creature climbing on it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or fall off.

legendary.name: Hull Breach
entries: The dragon turtle scrapes its shell against the hull of a boat or ship. A vehicle 10 ft. in length or less capsizes immediately. A vehicle greater than 10 ft. in length suffers a hull breach and begins to fill with water, capsizing after 30 minutes if the breach is not repaired. Each successive breach halves the remaining time. A breach can be repaired as an action with a successful {@dc 16} Woodworking Tools ability check.

legendary.name: Rock Boat (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon turtle rocks a boat or ship within 10 ft. Each unsecured creature on the vehicle's deck is pushed 15 ft. in the same direction. If this movement would eject a creature from the vehicle, it makes a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw, catching itself on the edge on a success. A creature hanging from the edge of a ship is considered {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The dragon can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Forcebreaker
entries: The dragon can destroy an adjacent creation of magical force, such as that produced by Wall of Force or Forcecage, by spending 10 feet of movement.

trait.name: Crushing Field
entries: The area in a 30 foot radius around the dragon is difficult terrain for creatures with a Strength score lower than 17.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d10 + 7}) piercing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) force damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d8 + 7}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 20}).

action.name: Breath Weapons {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.

action.name: Shattergem Breath
entries: The dragon breathes forth a hail of luminous crystals in a 60-foot line that is 5 feet wide. The area becomes difficult terrain, and each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw or take 28 ({@damage 8d6}) slashing damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Singularity Breath
entries: The dragon creates a shining bead of gravitational force in its mouth, then releases the energy in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw.

On a failed save, the creature takes 45 ({@damage 10d8}) force damage, and its speed becomes 0 until the start of the dragon's next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage, and its speed isn't reduced.

bonus.name: Psionic Empowerment
entries: The dragon produces one of the following effects:

items.name: Psychokinetic Hurl
entries: One creature the dragon can see within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw or be flung up to 20 feet in a direction of the dragon's choice and take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Mind-Blind
entries: The dragon becomes {@condition invisible} to one creature it can see until the beginning of its next turn.

items.name: Psychic Step
entries: The dragon teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of a creature that it can telepathically communicate with.

reaction.name: Psychoport Inversion
entries: As a reaction when a creature teleports to or away from a space the dragon can see, the dragon forces it to succeed on a {@dc 20} Charisma saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 4d10}) force damage and immediately teleport back.

reaction.name: Bloodied Breath (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 115 hit points, the dragon immediately recharges and uses one of its breath weapons.

legendary.name: Psionic Empowerment
entries: The dragon uses its Psionic Empowerment.

legendary.name: Gravity Collapse
entries: Each creature within 30 feet of a line of gems created by the dragon's breath must succeed on a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 15 feet toward it by the most direct route.

legendary.name: Detonate Gems (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: One line of gems created by the dragon's breath detonates in a chained explosion of force. Each creature within 15 feet of the line must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or take 33 ({@damage 6d10}) force damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Brittle Exoskeleton
entries: If the ankheg takes 10 or more bludgeoning damage from a single source, its AC is reduced to 11 until it completes a Short or Long Rest.

trait.name: Burrowing Terror
entries: If the ankheg starts its turn buried underground, it has advantage on all attack rolls until the end of its turn.

action.name: Fleshmelter Mandibles
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) slashing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) acid damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}).
While {@condition grappled} in this way, a creature takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) acid damage at the end of each of its turns.

action.name: Spined Claw Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d4}) piercing damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.
On a critical hit, the target must succeed on {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone} and {@condition stunned} until the end of the ankheg's next turn.

action.name: Acid Drench {@recharge}
entries: If the ankheg has no creature {@condition grappled}, it spits steaming acid in a 30 foot long, 5 foot wide line. Each creature in that line must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) acid damage, or half as much on a success.
If the ankheg has a creature {@condition grappled}, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or take 17 ({@damage 5d6}) acid damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Seething Vitriol (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to taking 10 or more fire damage in a turn, the ankheg immediately recharges its Acid Drench.

trait.name: Unequaled Cruelty
entries: When the black dragon reduces a creature to 0 hit points, each {@condition frightened} creature that can see it must use its reaction, if available, to move its speed directly away from it.

trait.name: Sensitivity Aura
entries: Attacks against creatures within 10 feet of the dragon that do not have resistance or immunity to acid damage score a critical on an 18-20.

trait.name: Bloodbathed Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw while a{@condition bleeding|confc|bleeding} or {@condition unconscious} creature is within 30 feet of it, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three attacks, one of which can be with its Steelrot Bite, and uses its Frightful Presence.

action.name: Steelrot Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@dice 2d10 + 6}) piercing plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) acid damage.
On a critical hit, one weapon or piece of armor of Uncommon or lesser rarity that the target is wearing or wielding is destroyed (target's choice).

action.name: Subduing Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) slashing damage.
Instead of dealing damage, the dragon can knock the target {@condition prone} and grapple it (escape {@dc 19}).

action.name: Tailbarb Stab
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) piercing damage and the target begins {@condition bleeding|confc|bleeding} ({@dice 1d10}).
Any hit against a {@condition prone} creature with this attack becomes a critical.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of the dragon's choice within 120 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the beginning of the dragon's next turn, becoming immune to this effect for the next 24 hours on a success.

action.name: Hacked-Tar Sputum (Recharges when the dragon uses its Flesh-Melting Breath)
entries: The dragon hacks up a glob of spent acid and dead flesh at a point it can see within 60 feet, where it splashes in a 10 foot radius, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or be drenched in sticky sludge (remove {@dc 18}).

A sludge-drenched creature is {@condition blinded}, has its movement reduced by half, and is protected from decay if it dies, extending the time limit of effects that would raise the target from the dead by up to a year.

action.name: Flesh-Melting Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon spews a jet of caustic acid in a 60-foot long, 5-foot wide line, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or take 54 ({@damage 12d8}) acid damage, or half as much damage on a success.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more suffers a Vitriolic Disfigurement until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic. A creature killed by this damage disintegrates.

reaction.name: Bloodied Breath (1/Day
entries: When the dragon is reduced below 136 hit points, it can roll to recharge its Flesh-Melting Breath, then immediately use it, if available.

reaction.name: Cruel Jest
entries: When a creature smaller than the dragon leaves its reach, the dragon can force it to make a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw.
On a failure, the target is dragged up to 10 feet toward the dragon and the dragon regains its reaction.

legendary.name: Mire Dive
entries: The dragon moves up to half its speed. If it ends this movement submerged in murky water, it can attempt to {@action Hide}.

legendary.name: Drooling Torment
entries: Acid drips from the dragon's jaws toward a creature {@condition grappled} by it, dealing 9 ({@damage 2d8}) acid damage to the creature.
The target can use its reaction to attempt to escape the grapple, avoiding the damage on a success.

legendary.name: Peel Nerve (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon makes a Subduing Claw attack.
If this attack hits a creature {@condition grappled} by the dragon, the target has one spell affect on it end, or gains vulnerability to acid damage until it regains any hit points if it cannot.

trait.name: Skyfire Splendor

trait.name: Rising Charge
entries: When the dragon rolls to recharge its Scourgebolt Breath, each creature within 10 feet of it takes lightning damage equal to the number rolled.

trait.name: Reserved Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. Its save DCs are reduced by 1 for each expended use of this ability.

action.name: Scourgebolt Breath {@recharge 5}

reaction.name: Battle of Wits

reaction.name: Bloodied Breath (1/Day
entries: When the dragon is reduced below 144 hit points, it can roll to recharge its Scourgebolt Breath, then immediately use it, if available.

If it fails to do so, the creature has disadvantage on the next attack or saving throw it makes in the next minute.

legendary.name: False Wall

action.name: Derealization Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon exhales an shimmering aurora of existential crises in a 60 ft. cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw, taking 56 ({@damage 16d6}) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more becomes convinced that it is an illusion. An affected creature cannot concentrate on spells, loses {@status concentration} if it was holding it, and makes a {@dc 19} Intelligence saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A creature that targets itself with an attack or spell immediately ends this effect.

reaction.name: Disorienting Lurch
entries: As a reaction to succeeding on a saving throw, the dragon may force any number of creatures within 60 feet to succeed on a {@dc 19} Charisma saving throw or be teleported 20 feet in a direction of the dragon's choice. Then, if the dragon is at least partially obscured, it may attempt to {@action Hide} as part of this reaction.

reaction.name: Out of Nowhere
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack while its Displacement is active, the dragon makes a tendril attack. If it hits, it may immediately us its Hurl ability as part of this reaction, and its Displacement trait is disabled until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Bloodied Breath (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 126 HP, the dragon immediately recharges and uses its Derealization Breath.

legendary.name: Slink
entries: The dragon moves up to half its speed without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

legendary.name: Hurl
entries: The dragon throws a creature it has {@condition grappled} up to 30 feet. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) bludgeoning damage, in addition to any damage from falling.

legendary.name: Slam (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon lifts a {@condition grappled} creature up and slams it into the ground, releasing the grapple. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) bludgeoning damage and be unable to stand on its following turn, or take half as much damage on a success.

trait.name: Magnanimous
entries: When a hostile creature the dragon can see falls {@condition prone}, the dragon treats its as friendly until the creature stands, deals damage to the dragon, or forces the dragon to make a saving throw.

trait.name: Searing Vortex
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 30 ft. of the dragon must succeed on a {@dc 21} Strength saving throw or be pulled 10 ft. toward the dragon. A creature that ends this movement within 5 ft. of the dragon takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 2d10 + 8}) piercing damage plus 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage).

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d6 + 8}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}).

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d8 + 8}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away from the dragon.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of the dragon's choice that is within 120 feet of the dragon and aware of it must succeed on a {@dc 21} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the dragon's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Slithering Fire Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon exhales fire in an 60-foot line that is 5 feet wide and can make as many as three turns of up to 90 degrees at any point along its length. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw, taking 66 ({@damage 12d10}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Weakening Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon exhales gas in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw or have disadvantage on Strength-based attack rolls, Strength checks, and Strength saving throws for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

reaction.name: You Dare Touch Me?
entries: As a reaction to a creature hitting it with a melee attack, the dragon forces the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 ft. away and knocked {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Bloodied Breath (1/Day.)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 129 hit points, the dragon immediately recharges and uses one of its breath weapons.

legendary.name: Lead the Foolish
entries: One creature that the dragon can see within 60 ft. must make a {@dc 21} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature has advantage on attacks that target a creature of the gold dragon's choice, and disadvantage on attacks that do not target that creature.

legendary.name: Mine By Right!
entries: One creature within 5 ft. of the dragon must succeed on a {@dc 21} Strength saving throw or have one magic item it is wielding wrenched from its grasp by the dragon.

legendary.name: Bow Before Me! (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Each creature within 10 ft. of the dragon must succeed on a {@dc 21} Wisdom or fall {@condition prone} and be unable to stand for the next minute. This effect ends early if the affected creature deals damage to the dragon or forces it to make a saving throw.

trait.name: Forestborn
entries: The dragon's movement is not impeded by natural or magical foliage, and while in a wooded area can attempt to {@action Hide} while only Lightly Obscured.

trait.name: Slithering Shadow
entries: The first time each turn that the dragon is missed with an attack, it can move up to 10 feet without provoking {@action opportunity attack||opportunity attacks}.

trait.name: Fuming Wounds
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 15 feet of the dragon takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage, or 7 ({@dice 2d6}) if it has fewer than half its hit points.

trait.name: Greenleech Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, plants within 30 feet of it wither and shrivel away.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes two attacks, one of which can be with its Venomtongue Bite, and uses its Frightful Presence.

action.name: Venomtongue Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@dice 2d10 + 6}) piercing plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage.
If the target is resistant or immune to poison damage, it must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or lose its resistance or immunity to poison damage for the next minute.

action.name: Hooked Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) slashing damage.
Instead of dealing damage, the dragon may grapple the target (escape {@dc 19}).

action.name: Lash Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of the dragon's choice within 120 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the beginning of the dragon's next turn, becoming immune to this effect for the next 24 hours on a success.

action.name: Rampant Growth
entries: The dragon calls a burst of barbed vines forth from the earth in a 20 foot radius centered on a point it can see within 60 feet, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 16}).
Until the dragon uses this ability again, the area is difficult terrain, and a creature that moves into or within the area takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) piercing damage for every 5 feet it travels.

action.name: Lungripper Miasma Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon exhales a poisonous cloud in a 60-foot cone.
Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or take 42 ({@damage 12d6}) poison damage, or half as much damage on a success.
A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is {@condition blinded} and {@condition choking|confc|choking} until the end of the dragon's next turn.

reaction.name: Adapt Camouflage
entries: When a creature more than 30 feet from the dragon hits it with a ranged attack, it can alter its patterning to match its surroundings.
Until it moves, the dragon becomes {@condition invisible} to creatures more than 30 feet away from it.

reaction.name: Vindictive Snap
entries: When a creature affected by the green dragon's Lungripper Miasma Breath takes fewer than 22 damage from it, the dragon can move up to 30 feet toward the creature and make a Venomtongue Bite attack against it.

reaction.name: Bloodied Breath (1/Day
entries: When the dragon is reduced below 133 hit points, it can roll to recharge its Lungripper Miasma Breath, then immediately use it, if available.

legendary.name: Spit Venom
entries: The dragon spits a gob of concentrated venom at a creature it can see within 30 feet, forcing it to succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Poison damage and be {@condition blinded} until it clears its eyes as a Bonus Action.

legendary.name: Silent Snatch
entries: The dragon moves up to 30 feet, then can grapple one creature (escape {@dc 19}) it is hidden from and force it to make a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw.
On a failure, the target is {@condition stunned} and hidden from its allies until the beginning of the dragon's next turn, and the dragon remains hidden from each other creature.

legendary.name: Slink Away (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon moves up to 30 feet. If it ends this movement at least 30 feet from any hostile creature, it may immediately attempt to {@action Hide}.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The kruthik has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the kruthik's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The kruthik can burrow through solid rock at half its burrowing speed and leaves a 2 1/2-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

trait.name: Gnashing Horde
entries: Any creature other than a kruthic that starts its turn adjacent to one or more kruthiks takes 1 piercing damage per adjacent kruthik.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The kruthik makes two stab attacks or two spike attacks.

action.name: Stab
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Spike
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage and 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage and the target's movement speed is halved until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The Oblex can move through a space as small as 1 inch without squeezing or slowing down.

trait.name: Aversion to Fire
entries: If the oblex takes fire damage, it has disadvantage on the next attack it makes before the end of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The oblex makes one pseudopod attack and uses its eat memories ability.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage plus 5 ({@damage 2d4}) psychic damage.

action.name: Eat Memories
entries: The oblex targets one creature it can see within 5 feet of it. The target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) psychic damage and become memory drained until it finishes a short or long rest. While memory drained, the target does not add its proficiency bonus to attack rolls and cannot cast spells of the highest level it knows. When an oblex causes a target to become memory drained, the oblex learns all the languages the target knows and gains all its proficiencies, except any saving throw proficiencies.

bonus.name: Sulphureous Impersonation
entries: The oblex may reduce its max HP by 5 and produces an outgrowth with 5 HP that appears at any point within 15 feet of it or one of its outgrowths, copying the appearance and manner of any being it has eaten the memories of. Damage dealt to the outgrowths is not dealt to the main oblex body, but for all other purposes the oblex is the outgrowths and occupies their space. The outgrowths are tethered to the main body by a thin strand of translucent slime that can extend up to 500 feet away.

reaction.name: Secret Mouth
entries: When a creature misses an outgrowth of the oblex with a melee attack, it may use its reaction to make a pseudopod attack against the attacker.

trait.name: Quick Squeeze
entries: The dragon may move through any space larger than its skull without squeezing.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The dragon can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Extinguishing Aura
entries: The dragon is surrounded by an aura of light-eating microbes. At the beginning of the dragon's turn, each light source within 30 ft. diminishes one level; from bright light to dim light, or from dim light to darkness.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) piercing damage plus 5 ({@damage 1d10}) poison damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}).

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away from the dragon.

action.name: Breath Weapons {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.

action.name: Nightmare Spore Breath
entries: The dragon exhales a cloud of spores in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 33 ({@damage 6d10}) psychic damage and is covered in spores until a creature takes an action to remove them. While covered in these spores, a creature is {@condition frightened}.

action.name: Stone Tomb Breath
entries: The dragon exhales a burst of stone-softening magic in a 60-foot cone, turning the ground in the area into difficult terrain for the next minute. A creature that begins its turn on the ground in the area must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 16}) as it begins to sink into the stone.
A creature already affected by this ability that fails the saving throw sinks entirely beneath the surface, and is {@condition blinded} and cannot speak or breathe until it escapes.

reaction.name: Phantasmagoria
entries: As a reaction when a {@condition frightened} creature fails a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check to detect it, the dragon forces the creature to succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or move up to half its speed and make a melee attack against a creature of the dragon's choice.

reaction.name: Bloodied Breath (1/Day
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 85 hit points, the dragon immediately recharges and uses one of its breath weapons.

legendary.name: Awful Scuttle
entries: The dragon moves up to half its climb speed. If it ends this movement out of sight of any hostile creatures, it may attempt a Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check to hide.

legendary.name: Acrid Spore Burst
entries: One creature that is covered in spores from the dragon's breath weapon takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) acid damage as the spores rupture and slough off in a caustic spray.

legendary.name: Hysterical Blindness
entries: One creature the dragon can see within 60 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or lose its {@sense darkvision} for the next minute.

trait.name: Vainglorious Strength
entries: If the dragon succeeds on a Strength saving throw, the next attack it makes before the end of its next turn has advantage.
If the dragon fails a Strength saving throw, it has disadvantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws for the next minute.

trait.name: Whorlflare Landing
entries: The first time each turn that the dragon lands on a solid surface after descending at least 20 feet, each creature within 20 feet of it is pushed up to 5 feet away and begins {@condition burning|confc|burning} ({@dice 1d10}).

trait.name: Flamegorge Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, each flame within 30 feet of it is extinguished.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Searing Bite, and uses its Frightful Presence.

action.name: Searing Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@dice 2d10 + 8}) piercing plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Irongouge Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d6 + 8}) slashing damage.
Instead of dealing damage, the dragon may grapple the target (escape {@dc 22}).

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of the dragon's choice within 120 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the beginning of the dragon's next turn, becoming immune to this effect for the next 24 hours on a success.

action.name: Slagflame Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon exhales rippling flames in a 60-foot cone, turning each surface in the area to molten slag.
Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 22} Dexterity or take 56 ({@damage 16d6}) fire damage, or half as much on a success.
For the next minute, the ground in the area becomes difficult terrain, and a creature that ends its turn on the ground in the area takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Stoke Malice (1/Day)
entries: The dragon breathes evil life into an an area of slag or magma within 60 feet, creating two {@creature magmin pyroclast|confc|Magmin Pyroclasts} that emerge from the ground into unoccupied spaces in the area.

reaction.name: Billowing Wings
entries: When the dragon takes 30 or more damage from a single source, it may shroud itself in smoke, heavily obscuring the area in a 20 foot radius until the end of its next turn, then immediately move up to half its speed.

reaction.name: Bloodied Breath (1/Day.)
entries: When the dragon is reduced below 156 hit points, it can roll to recharge its Slagflame Breath, then immediately use it, if available.

legendary.name: Lunging Swipe
entries: The dragon moves up to 20 feet, then makes an attack with its Irongouge Claws.

legendary.name: Leaping Flames
entries: The dragon causes the flames surrounding a burning creature or object it can see within 90 feet to flare and leap to a creature within 30 feet of them.
The creature must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or take 11 ({@damage 2d10}) fire damage and begin {@condition burning|confc|burning} ({@dice 1d10}).

legendary.name: Tail Sweep (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon sweeps its tail in a 15 foot cone, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a {@dc 22} Dexterity saving throw or take 17 ({@damage 5d6}) bludgeoning damage and be pushed up to 10 feet away from the dragon.

trait.name: Heated Body
entries: A creature that touches the remorhaz or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}40 ({@damage 6d10 + 7}) piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage. If the target is a creature, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the remorhaz can't bite another target.

action.name: Swallow
entries: The remorhaz makes one bite attack against a Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, that creature takes the bite's damage and is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the remorhaz, and it takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) acid damage at the start of each of the remorhaz's turns.

If the remorhaz takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the remorhaz must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall {@condition prone} in a space within 10 feet of the remorhaz. If the remorhaz dies, a swallowed creature is no longer {@condition restrained} by it and can escape from the corpse using 15 feet of movement, exiting {@condition prone}.

action.name: Terror From the Deep (1/Day)
entries: The Remorhaz moves up to its burrow speed, then bursts from underground thrashing in a flurry of debris. Each creature in a 15 foot radius must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 35 ({@damage 10d6}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}, or half damage on a success.

immune.special: one other type determined by the dragon's former type

entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Shadow Form
entries: The shadow dragon's traits change depending on lighting.
In darkness, the dragon treats all creatures as unarmored (an unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier.)
In dim light or darkness it can hide as a bonus action without obscurement, submerging itself in pools of shadow.
In bright light, attacks against the dragon have advantage.

action.name: Shadow Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon exhales writhing shadow in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw, taking 63 ({@damage 18d6}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature with a shadow reduced to 0 by this damage falls into its shadow, and its shadow climbs into the material plane to replace it, with the following attributes:
The creature's shadow has the same statistics and abilities as the creature and has one hit point. It acts on the dragon's initiative and is under the dragon's control.
The creature remains conscious, but may only target its shadow with spells and abilities.
A creature can wrestle the shadow back into the shadow realm with a successful {@dc 16} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. If it does, the creature returns to the material plane with one hit point.
If the creature's shadow receives any healing, the shadow is banished to the shadow realm. The creature returns to the material plane with one hit point.
If the creature's shadow dies, the creature is lost forever to the realm of shadow.

reaction.name: Snuff (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 128 HP, the dragon extinguishes all lights within 60 ft.

reaction.name: Shadow Glide (Dim Light Only)
entries: As a reaction to taking damage of a type it is resistant to, the wraith may teleport up to 60 feet and turn {@condition invisible} until the end of its next turn, or until it makes an attack.

legendary.name: Snatch
entries: The dragon makes a claw attack against a creature that it is hidden from. If the attack hits, the target is {@condition grappled}, {@condition stunned}, and hidden from its allies until the beginning of its next turn. This attack does not automatically reveal the dragon's position.

legendary.name: Shadow Tether
entries: One creature within 60 ft. that the dragon can see must make a {@dc 19} Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the next time the dragon takes damage in the next minute, it takes half as much damage and the target takes the same amount.

legendary.name: Waken Shadows
entries: One creature within 60 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or be {@condition grappled} and {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 19}) as its shadow lunges to grip it. A creature is freed if it is in bright light.

trait.name: Ice Walk
entries: The dragon can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.

trait.name: Freezing Blood
entries: Whenever the silver dragon takes piercing or slashing damage, it raises its AC cumulatively by 1 until the beginning of its next turn, or until it takes any fire damage.

trait.name: Flattery Vulnerability
entries: When subjected to flattery by a medium or smaller creature, the dragon must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by the creature until it takes hostile action against the dragon or its allies. A dragon that succeeds on this save becomes immune to flattery from that creature for the next minute.

A creature that fails this save by 5 or more must use its action to doff its armor or shield.

reaction.name: Bloodied Breath (1/Day)

legendary.name: Shield the Weak

If it ends that movement within 10 feet of a friendly creature, the creature gains +3 to its AC and has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn, or until it moves further away.

legendary.name: Face Me!
entries: One creature within 30 feet is compelled to meet the dragon in melee combat. An affected creature that attempts to target the dragon with an attack or harmful spell from more than 10 feet away on its following turn must first make a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature loses the attack or spell.

legendary.name: Cryostasis
entries: One creature that died within the last minute returns to life with 0 hit points and automatically stabilizes.

trait.name: Iconoclast
entries: The dragon may spend 5 ft. of movement to free itself from any restraints.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The dragon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
