entries: The dragon can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d10 + 6}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}).

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 ft. away from the dragon.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of the dragon's choice that is within 120 feet of the dragon and aware of it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the dragon's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Breath Weapons {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.

action.name: Toxic Breath
entries: The dragon exhales a poisonous cloud in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for the next minute. A {@condition poisoned} creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success or taking 21 ({@damage 8d6}) poison damage on a failure.

action.name: Acid Trench Breath
entries: The dragon exhales acid in a 60-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw, taking 45 ({@damage 10d8}) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Additionally, rock and earth in the area are disolved to a depth of 10 ft.

reaction.name: Bloodied Breath (1/day
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 87 HP, the dragon immediately recharges and uses one of its breath weapons.

reaction.name: Bat Away
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the dragon forces the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or have one object it is holding knocked out of its hands and 15 ft. away.

legendary.name: Corrective Confinement
entries: One creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 16}) until the end of the dragon's next turn as bonds of magical force leap to confine it.

legendary.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon beats its wings. Each creature within 15 feet of the dragon must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}. The dragon can then fly up to half its flying speed.

legendary.name: Free the Oppressed (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: One creature within 60 ft. is freed from all restraints and cured of any poison or disease, then must make a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature regards the dragon as a trusted ally and all other creatures as enemies for the next minute. An affected creature repeats this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

trait.name: Tundraborn
entries: The dragon ignores negative effects from moving over terrain composed of ice or snow, and has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition blinded}.

trait.name: Heavy Chill
entries: A creature that begins its turn within 15 feet of the dragon has disadvantage on each attack it makes on its turn beyond the first, unless it is resistant or immune to cold damage.
A creature can lose one unexpended hit die to ignore this effect until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Frostblessed Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw against an effect that does not deal fire damage, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three Barbed Claw attacks, one of which it can replace with its Bitter Bite or Icecarve Tail, and uses its Frightful Presence.

action.name: Bitter Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@dice 2d10 + 6}) piercing plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) cold damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 19}).
A creature {@condition grappled} in this way has disadvantage on saving throws against the dragon's Winterglass Breath.

action.name: Barbed Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) slashing damage.
If the target is Huge or smaller, the dragon can knock the target {@condition prone} instead of dealing damage.

action.name: Icecarve Tail
entries: The dragon sweeps its tail, flinging a spray of ice and snow in a 15 foot cone.

Each creature in the area is pushed 5 feet away and must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) cold damage and be {@condition blinded} until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of the dragon's choice within 120 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the beginning of the dragon's next turn, becoming immune to this effect for the next 24 hours on a success.

action.name: Raise Hackles
entries: The dragon extends its spined frill and a deep, booming rumble ripples through the air around it in a 20 foot radius.

Each creature in the area that is immune to the dragon's Frightful Presence or the {@condition frightened} condition must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or lose that immunity for the next minute.

action.name: Winterglass Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon exhales an icy blast in a 60-foot cone, covering the area in ice and forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or take 36 ({@damage 8d8}) cold damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 10 or more contracts Frostbite.
A creature that moves more than 10 feet through the area in a turn must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Sudden Pounce
entries: When a creature the dragon can see within 80 feet moves at least 15 feet away from it or fails an attempt to {@action Hide} from it, the dragon can leap up to 80 feet directly toward the creature and make a Barbed Claw attack against it.

reaction.name: Bloodied Breath (1/Day
entries: When the dragon is reduced below 122 hit points, it can roll to recharge its Winterglass Breath, then immediately use it, if available.

legendary.name: Terrorize
entries: One creature the dragon can see within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to move its speed directly away from the dragon, or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) psychic damage if it can't.

legendary.name: Ice Tomb
entries: The dragon breathes a layer of dense, translucent ice that encrusts a {@condition prone} creature within 10 feet, forcing it to succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or gain 15 temporary hit points, or half as many on a success.

A creature that has any of these temporary hit points is {@condition restrained} and loses two unexpended hit dice at the end of each of its turns, or gains a point of {@condition exhaustion} if it can't.

legendary.name: Uttercold (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon draws on its deepest reserves. Until the end of its next turn, cold damage the dragon deals ignores damage resistance, and it can reroll any of the damage dice of its Winterglass Breath once, taking the second result.

trait.name: Deteriorating Form
entries: Absent its innate draconic magics, mere necromancy is unable to sustain the zombie for long. Whenever the zombie makes an attack, it loses 5 hit points. Whenever the zombie uses its breath weapon, it loses 20 hit points.

trait.name: Putrid Stench
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the zombie must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The zombie makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Festering Bite.

action.name: Festering Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@dice 3d10 + 5}) piercing plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Rotgrasp Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 18}).

action.name: Gore Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon exudes a torrent of its own liquefied viscera in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or take 18 ({@dice 4d8}) bludgeoning plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage and be knocked {@condition prone}, or take half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Perilous Thrash
entries: When the zombie misses with a melee attack, it may permanently suffer one of the following effects of its choice that it has not yet suffered. If it does, it rerolls the attack with advantage:

items.name: Torn Wing
entries: While flying, the zombie must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw at the end of each of its turns or fall {@condition prone}.

items.name: Broken Limb
entries: The zombie makes one fewer attack with its multiattack after this turn.

items.name: Dislocated Jaw
entries: The zombie cannot use its Festering Bite after this turn.

trait.name: Air Form
entries: The elemental can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and can move through any gap large enough for air to pass through without squeezing.

trait.name: Updraft
entries: A Medium or smaller creature that starts its turn in the elemental's space must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or begin {@condition levitating|confc|levitating} until the beginning of its next turn.
When the elemental moves, each {@condition levitating|confc|levitating} creature in its space is moved with it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The elemental makes two attacks with its Buffeting Slam.

action.name: Buffeting Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage. This attack has advantage against a levitating or flying target.

action.name: Whirlwind Fling {@recharge 4}
entries: Each creature in the elemental's space must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or take 15 ({@damage 3d8 + 2}) bludgeoning damage and be flung up 20 feet away in a random direction and knocked {@condition prone}, or take half as much damage on a success.

A thrown target that strikes a creature or solid object takes an additional 7 ({@damage 2d6}) bludgeoning damage. A creature struck by a thrown target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Abrupt Ejection
entries: When a creature {@condition levitating|confc|levitating} in the elemental's space hits it with an attack, the elemental can move up to half its speed, then push the creature up to 10 feet.

trait.name: Weightless
entries: Whenever the myrmidon takes damage, it is pushed 10 feet away from the source of the damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The myrmiddon makes three melee attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its Updraft, if available.

action.name: Iron War Fan
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) bludgeoning or slashing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away. This attack has advantage against a levitating or flying creature.

action.name: Updraft {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be levitated 5 ft. off the ground for the next minute. A creature may repeat this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

reaction.name: Elemental Riposte
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack, the myrmidon unleashes a burst of air. The attacker must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be pushed 15 feet away and knocked {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Current-Dancer
entries: As a reaction to a creature being pushed out of its range, the myrmidon may move up to 15 ft. towards the creature and make a melee attack against it.

trait.name: Weightless
entries: Whenever the mephit takes damage, it is pushed 10 feet away from the source of the damage.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a burst of air. Each creature within 5 feet of it must then succeed on a {@dc 9} Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away and knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Gust
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 10} Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away.
This attack has advantage against a levitating or flying creature.

action.name: Updraft {@recharge}
entries: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or begin to Levitate until the end of the mephit's next turn.

reaction.name: Current-Dancer
entries: When a creature is pushed out of the mephit's reach, the mephit can move up to 10 feet towards the attacker and make a Gust attack against it.

trait.name: Authority of the Eight-Fold Seal
entries: While Akaribo has any temporary hit points, attacks against her made by fiends and undead have disadvantage.

trait.name: Harbinger of Strife
entries: When the daitengu or another creature within 30 feet makes an attack, it adds {@dice 1d4} to the result.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Akaribo makes two attacks with her Eight-Laws Blade.

action.name: Eight-Laws Blade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@dice 1d4 + 1}) bludgeoning plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) psychic damage.
On a miss, or if this attack targets an empty space, Akaribo can gain 10 cumulative temporary hit points that last for a minute, to a maximum of 30.

bonus.name: Purifying Departure
entries: Akaribo points her fan, sending forth a wave of pure authority in a 30 foot cone.
Each fiend and undead in the area must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be pushed up to 15 feet away, or twice as far if Akaribo has at least 15 temporary hit points.

bonus.name: Investiture of the Heavy Seal {@recharge 5}
entries: Akaribo stomps, bringing down a concussive blast of spiritual force around her.

Each creature of her choice within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 17} Charisma saving throw or take force damage equal to Akaribo's current temporary hit points and be knocked {@condition prone}, or take half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Unshakeable Clarity
entries: When Akaribo is missed with a melee attack, she can move up to 5 feet and make an attack with her Eight-Laws Blade against an empty space.

trait.name: Ghoulish Host
entries: If Akamura takes any radiant damage, he cannot make more than one attack on his following turn.

trait.name: Damned Crew
entries: If Akamura's captain is destroyed, he gains one point of {@condition exhaustion} at the end of each of his turns.

trait.name: Lashed to the Wheel
entries: If Akamura is knocked {@condition prone}, he must use an Action, in addition to half his movement, to stand up.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Akamura uses his Grasping Tongue and makes two melee attacks, one of which may be with his gnashing bite.

action.name: Gnashing Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., targets one {@condition grappled} creature. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Wheel Thrash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

action.name: Grasping Tongue
entries: One Large or smaller creature within 20 feet must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 15 feet towards Akamura.

reaction.name: Vengeful Leap
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a ranged attack, Akamura leaps up to 20 feet directly towards the attacker.

A creature whose space he lands in must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}, or be pushed to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

trait.name: Defensive Huddle
entries: While within 5 feet of one or more Large or larger friendly creatures, attacks against the penguin are made at disadvantage.
If a friendly creature within 5 feet of the penguin that is larger than it succeeds on a saving throw, it may prevent the penguin from taking any damage.

trait.name: Awkward Waddle
entries: If the penguin walks more than 10 feet on its turn, it falls {@condition prone} at the end of its turn.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The penguin can hold its breath for up to 1 hour.

action.name: Hooked Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d10 + 2}) piercing damage.
If the target is Medium or smaller, the penguin may grapple it instead of dealing damage (escape {@dc 12}).

action.name: Flipper Whack
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d8 + 2}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.
If this attack was made at advantage, the target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Detect the Unspeakable
entries: The penguin snakes its tongue out and tastes the air, learning the number and direction of aberrations within 500 feet.
Until the end of its next turn, aberrations within 30 feet of the penguin cannot be hidden from it, and gain no benefit from being {@condition invisible} to it.

reaction.name: Belly Slide
entries: As a reaction when the penguin falls {@condition prone}, it may slide up to 20 feet across level ground or up to 40 feet across downward-sloped ground.

trait.name: Pariah Crystal
entries: If it has a pariah crystal with minds remaining, a destroyed alhoon gains a new body in {@dice 1d10} days, regaining all its hit points and becoming active again, and its pariah crystal loses one of the minds it contains. The new body appears within 5 feet of the phylactery.

trait.name: Impossible Angles
entries: The space in a 5 ft. radius around the alhoon is difficult terrain for non-aberrations, as the alhoon's presence warps it into incomprehensible geometries, additionally causing the following effects:

A non-aberration creature that starts its turn in the area, or enters it for the first time on a turn, must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or take {@damage 1d10} psychic damage and be {@condition poisoned} until the beginning of its next turn.
Ranged attacks made by non-aberrations that pass through the area are made at disadvantage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The alhoon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Legendary Resistances (1/Day)
entries: If the alhoon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The alhoon makes two attacks, one of which it may replace with a spell of 1st level or above.

action.name: Icy Tentacles
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}15 ({@dice 2d10 + 4}) psychic plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) cold damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}).
A creature that starts its turn {@condition grappled} by the alhoon must succeed on a {@dc 16} Intelligence saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Nerve Rot Bolt
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 60 ft., one creature. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d8}) necrotic damage plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) psychic damage.

action.name: Extract Brain
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition incapacitated} humanoid {@condition grappled} by the alhoon. {@h}The target takes 55 ({@damage 10d10}) piercing damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the alhoon begins to extract and devour the target's brain. At the beginning of the alhoon's next turn if the target is still {@condition unconscious} and {@condition grappled}, the target dies and the alhoon gains 40 temporary hit points.

action.name: Mind Blast {@recharge 5}
entries: The alhoon magically emits psychic energy in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 15} Intelligence saving throw or take 36 ({@damage 8d8 + 4}) psychic damage and be {@condition stunned} until the end of the alhoon's next turn.

action.name: Force Rift (3rd Level Spell)
entries: The alhoon wrenches gravity in a line extending from itself. Each creature in a 60 ft. line that is 5 ft. wide must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or take 27 ({@damage 5d10}) force damage and be knocked {@condition prone}, or take half as much damage on a success. A creature that fails by 5 or more is additionally pushed 15 ft. away.

action.name: Fold Space (4th Level Spell)
entries: The alhoon teleports to an unoccupied location it can see within 30 feet. Each creature within 15 ft. of the space it departed must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 10 ft. toward the space it departed and take 16 ({@damage 3d10}) psychic damage.

action.name: Dominate (5th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: One creature within 30 ft. that the alhoon can see must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be magically {@condition charmed} and under the alhoon's telepathic control. Whenever the {@condition charmed} target takes damage, the target can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Blood to Vitriol (1/Day, 6th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: One creature within 60 ft. the alhoon can see must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} for 1 minute. A {@condition stunned} creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, taking 22 ({@damage 5d8}) acid damage on a failure, or ending the effect on a success.

reaction.name: Shield (1st level spell)
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with an attack, the alhoon may add 5 to its AC until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Counterspell (3rd level spell)
entries: As a reaction to seeing a creature cast a spell within 60 feet, the alhoon may make an Intelligence check with DC equal to 10 plus the spell's level, negating the spell on a success. If the spell is 3rd level or below, the alhoon succeeds automatically.

monster.name: Alkada
languages: understands Common but can't speak it.

trait.name: Suction Feet
entries: The alkada can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check. While doing so, it makes a loud popping noise with each step.

trait.name: Slippery Mind
entries: The alkada is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts.

trait.name: Death Throes
entries: When the alkada dies, beams of psionic energy lance out in every direction. Each creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 12} Intelligence saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 4d10}) psychic damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The alkada makes 9 attacks with its noodle hooks.

action.name: Noodle Hooks
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 1} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d8 - 1}) piercing damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 9}).
If a creature escapes this grapple, the alkada loses 5 ({@dice 2d4}) hit points and makes one fewer attack with its multiattack until it completes a Short or Long Rest.

action.name: Flap Arms
entries: The alkada frantically flaps its arms, generating a small field of antimagic around itself. Until the beginning of its next turn, the alkada can't be affected or detected by spells or magical effects.

reaction.name: Flailing Magic
entries: As a reaction to taking damage while not flapping its arms, the alkada forces each creature within 10 ft. of it to roll on the Wild Magic Surge table (PHB p. 104)

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The alkilith can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the alkilith is mionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary slime or fungus.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The alkilith has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The alkilith makes three melee attacks.

action.name: Polluting Touch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 1 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d6 + 4}) acid damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}).

action.name: Living Portal (Concentration)
entries: The alkilith begins to channel the essence of the Abyss through its body, becoming a portal to a distant corner of the Abyss.

If the alkilith is still {@status concentration||concentrating} at the beginning of its next turn, a demon with maximum hit points equal to or less than the alkilith's current hit points is summoned to the nearest unoccupied space, and the alkilith loses half its current hit points.

action.name: Fume {@recharge 5}
entries: The area in a 15 ft. radius around the alkilith becomes heavily obscured until the beginning of its next turn as it exudes toxic fumes. A creature that starts its turn in the area must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or take 27 ({@damage 6d8}) poison damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Foment Madness
entries: When the alkilith loses {@status concentration} as a result of being hit with a melee attack, the alkilith can force the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or have its proficiency bonus reduced by one for the next minute.

monster.name: Allip
languages: The languages it knew in life

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The allip can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Depths of Madness
entries: A creature that attempts to read the allip's mind has disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws for the next minute.

trait.name: Spectral Weapons
entries: The allip's attacks treat all creatures as unarmored (an unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier.)

action.name: Maddening Touch
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 4d6 + 2}) psychic damage and the target's Wisdom score is reduced by 2 ({@dice 1d4}) for the next minute, to a minimum of 1.
A creature whose Wisdom score is reduced to 1 in this way becomes hostile to all living creatures, including itself, until it recovers.

action.name: Whispers of Madness {@recharge 5}
entries: Each non-fiend, non-undead creature within 30 feet must make a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature uses its reaction to move up half its speed toward and make a melee attack against a living creature in range.

reaction.name: Shadow Glide
entries: When the allip takes damage of a type it is resistant to, it can teleport up to 60 feet to a location it can see and turns {@condition invisible} until the end of its next turn, or until it makes an attack.

trait.name: Magic Vulnerability
entries: The almiraj has disadvantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects. Charm effects that target the almiraj have a duration of Until Dispelled.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage. On a critical hit, the target is knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Horn
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage. A creature killed by this damage turns to stone.

action.name: Disrupt Hex (1/Day)
entries: The almiraj ends a spell or magical effect of 2nd level or below affecting a creature within 5 ft.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the Alraune remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a large flower.

trait.name: Loam Scent
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 120 feet of the Alraune must make a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature can do nothing but use its movement to safely approach the Alraune. While within 5 feet of the Alraune, the creature uses its action to begin digging itself a shallow grave, or climbs into an open grave and lies {@condition prone}. A creature repeats this save whenever it takes damage, ending the effect on a success. A creature that passes this save is immune to the alraune's Loam Scent for the next 24 hours.

trait.name: Flammable
entries: If the alraune takes fire damage, it catches fire. Until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the alraune takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage at the start of each of the its turns. While on fire, the alraune's melee attacks deal an additional 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The alraune makes four vine lash attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its Dig Grave or Draining Tomb if its Enticing Lure is active.

action.name: Vine Lash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}).

action.name: Dig Grave
entries: The alraune magically excavates a 10 ft. deep, 5 ft. wide column of earth within 10 ft. of it. A creature standing in the area must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or fall in. A creature may climb out as an action with a successful {@dc 12} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.

action.name: Draining Tomb {@recharge 5}

bonus.name: Enticing Lure
entries: The alraune produces an outgrowth that appears within 5 feet of its central flower, appearing as a humanoid creature. For all purposes the alraune is the outgrowth and occupies its space. The outgrowth is tethered to the main body by vines that spread along the ground and extend up to 30 feet. The Alraune can have only a single outgrowth active at a time, and can destroy its outgrowth as a bonus action.

entries: The dragon can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Crushing Field

action.name: Bite

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The vampire regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has fed today, has at least 1 hit point, and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the vampire takes radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Vampire Weaknesses
entries: The vampire has the following flaws:

items.name: Forbiddance
entries: The vampire can't enter a residence without an invitation from one of the occupants.

items.name: Harmed by Running Water
entries: The vampire takes 20 acid damage if it ends its turn in running water.

items.name: Stake to the Heart
entries: If a piercing weapon made of wood is driven into the vampire's heart while the vampire is {@condition incapacitated} in its resting place, the vampire is killed.

items.name: Destroyed by Sunlight
entries: A vampire that starts its turn in sunlight may take only the {@action Dash} action. A vampire that ends its turn in sunlight is destroyed.

items.name: Blood-Starved
entries: A vampire spawn that has not fed on humanoid blood in the last 24 hours cannot use its multiattack, and does not regenerate.

trait.name: Evasion
entries: When the vampire makes a Dexterity saving throw, it takes no damage on a success, and half damage if it fails.

trait.name: Cunnning Action

action.name: Multiattack

action.name: Claws

action.name: Shortbow

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, one creature the vampire has advantage against or that is adjacent to an ally of the vampire's. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

If the creature expends a hit die in this way, the vampire spawn gains resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage from weapons that aren't wooden until the beginning of its next turn. If the creature is unable to, it drops to 0 hit points.

reaction.name: Uncanny Dodge
entries: As a reaction to being hit with an attack, the vampire reduces the attack's damage by half.

reaction.name: Skirmisher

trait.name: Blessed and Chosen

They act on the anathema's initiative, have AC 17 and 1 HP, and can't take actions other than to dash. If any remain alive after 24 hours, one reforms into a new body for the anathema, regaining all its hit points and becoming active again.

action.name: Claw

action.name: Constrict
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 15 ft., one Large or smaller creature. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) acid damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained} and takes 16 ({@damage 3d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) acid damage at the start of each of its turns, and the anathema can't constrict another target.

action.name: Flurry of Bites
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}27 ({@damage 6d6 + 6}) piercing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage.

entries: One target creature within 10 feet must make a {@dc 17} Constitution Saving Throw. On a failed save, the target takes 55 ({@damage 10d10}) necrotic damage, or half as much on a success. If the target is a Yuan Ti, it makes the saving throw with disadvantage.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of the dracolich's choice within 120 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn).
On a successful saving throw or when the effect ends for it, a creature becomes immune to this effect for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Entangling Breath (Recharges when the dracolich uses its Miasma Breath)
entries: The dracolich exhales a flurry of blackened seeds in a 90-foot cone, causing barbed vines to burst from the earth. Each creature in the area when it appears must make a {@dc 22} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained}.

Until the dracolich uses this ability again, the area is difficult terrain and whenever a creature moves into or within the area, it takes 18 ({@damage 4d8}) piercing damage for every 5 feet it travels.

action.name: Miasma Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dracolich exhales a poisonous cloud in a 90-foot cone that lasts until th ened of its next turn, heavily obscuring the area.

A creature in the area when it appears or that ends its turn in the area must succeed on a {@dc 22} Constitution saving throw or take 77 ({@damage 22d6}) poison damage, or half as much damage on a success. A creature that fails this save by 5 or falls immediately {@condition prone}, retching.

reaction.name: Adapt Camouflage
entries: When the dracolich is hit with a ranged attack, it can cloak itself in illusory magics to match its surroundings.
Until the end of its next turn, the dracolich becomes {@condition invisible} to creatures more than 30 feet away from it.

reaction.name: Savage
entries: When a creature the dracolich can see within 20 feet resists or negates a source of poison damage, the dracolich can move up to half its speed toward and make a bite attack against the creature.

reaction.name: Murderous Glare (1/Day
entries: When the dracolich is reduced below 100 hit points, the dracolich unleashes a torrent of negative energy at a creature it can see within 60 feet. If the creature has fewer than 100 hit points, it dies.

legendary.name: Blinding Spit
entries: One creature within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the end of the dracolich's next turn.

legendary.name: Snatch
entries: The dracolich moves up to 15 feet and makes a Paralyzing Claw attack against a creature that it is hidden from. If the attack hits, the target is {@condition grappled}, {@condition stunned}, and hidden from its allies until the beginning of its next turn. If the dracolich was hidden, this attack does not automatically reveal its position.

legendary.name: Slink Away (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dracolich moves up to half its fly speed. {@action opportunity attack||Attacks of opportunity} provoked by this movement are made at disadvantage. If it ends this movement in cover, it may immediately attempt to hide.

trait.name: Forestborn
entries: The dragon's movement is not impeded by natural or magical foliage, and while in a wooded area can attempt to {@action Hide} while only Lightly Obscured.

trait.name: Slithering Shadow
entries: The first time each turn that the dragon is missed with an attack, it can move up to 10 feet without provoking {@action opportunity attack||opportunity attacks}.

trait.name: Poison Wounds
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 15 feet of the dragon takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage, or 14 ({@dice 4d6}) if the creature has fewer than half its hit points.

trait.name: Greenleech Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, plants within 30 feet of it wither and shrivel away.

action.name: Multiattack

If the target is resistant or immune to poison damage, it must succeed on a {@dc 23} Constitution saving throw or lose its resistance or immunity to poison damage for the next minute.

entries: When the dragon is reduced below 228 hit points, it can roll to recharge its Lungripper Miasma Breath, then immediately use it, if available.

legendary.name: Spit Venom

legendary.name: Silent Snatch
entries: The dragon moves up to 30 feet, then can grapple one creature (escape {@dc 22}) it is hidden from and force it to make a {@dc 23} Constitution saving throw.
On a failure, the target is {@condition stunned} and hidden from its allies until the beginning of the dragon's next turn, and the dragon remains hidden from each other creature.

legendary.name: Slink Away (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon moves up to 30 feet. If it ends this movement at least 30 feet from any hostile creature, it may immediately attempt to {@action Hide}.

trait.name: Quick Squeeze
entries: The dragon may move through any space larger than its skull without squeezing.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The dragon can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Extinguishing Aura
entries: The dragon is surrounded by an aura of light-eating microbes. At the beginning of the dragon's turn, each light source within 60 ft. diminishes one level; from bright light to dim light, or from dim light to darkness.

While covered in these spores, a creature is {@condition frightened}.

action.name: Stone Tomb Breath
entries: The dragon exhales a burst of stone-softening magic in a 90-foot cone, turning the ground in the area into difficult terrain for the next minute. A creature that begins its turn on the ground in the area must succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 19}) as it begins to sink into the stone.
A creature already affected by this ability that fails the saving throw sinks entirely beneath the surface, and is {@condition blinded} and cannot speak or breathe until it escapes.

reaction.name: Phantasmagoria
entries: As a reaction when a {@condition frightened} creature fails a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check to detect it, the dragon forces the creature to succeed on a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw or move up to half its speed and make a melee attack against a creature of the dragon's choice.

entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 100 hit points, the dragon immediately recharges and uses one of its breath weapons.

legendary.name: Awful Scuttle

legendary.name: Acrid Spore Burst

legendary.name: Hysterical Blindness
entries: One creature the dragon can see within 60 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw or lose its {@sense darkvision} for the next minute.

trait.name: Searing Aura
entries: When a creature without fire resistance or immunity starts its turn within 10 feet of the dracolich, it catches fire and begins {@condition burning|confc|burning} ({@dice 1d10}).

trait.name: Soul Vessel
entries: If it has a phylactery, a destroyed dracolich's soul returns to its phylactery. If a phylactery containing a dracolich's soul is placed upon a dragon's corpse for {@dice 1d10} days, the dracolich's soul inhabits the new body.

action.name: Breath of Dying Flames (Recharges when the dracolich uses its Necrofire Wake)
entries: The dracolich breathes malicious intent into all flames in a 90-foot cone, extinguishing them and summoning a {@creature belker|confc|Belker} that lasts for a minute and acts on initiative count 20 in the space of each creature in the area that was on fire.

action.name: Necrofire Wake {@recharge 5}
entries: The dracolich moves up to its fly speed, and a 15-foot wide section of the ground it passes over erupts in a wall of black flames that lasts until the end of the dracolich's next turn as it strafes with its breath.

A creature that starts its turn in the wall's area or enters it for the first time on a turn must succeed on a {@dc 24} Dexterity saving throw or take 91 ({@damage 26d6}) fire damage, or half as much damage on a success.
A creature in the wall that would receive any healing instead takes an equal amount of necrotic damage.

reaction.name: Wilting Glare
entries: When the dracolich is hit with an attack, it can force the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of the dracolich's next turn.

reaction.name: Billowing Wings
entries: When the dracolich takes 30 or more damage from a single source, it may shroud itself in smoke, heavily obscuring the area in a 40 foot radius until the end of its next turn, then immediately move up to half its speed.

legendary.name: Manipulate Flames
entries: One creature within 90 feet of the dracolich and within 30 feet of a flame must succeed on a {@dc 24} Dexterity saving throw or take 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage and catch fire. Until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the creature takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

legendary.name: Inhale (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dracolich rolls to recharge its necrofire wake.

legendary.name: Tail Sweep (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Each creature within 15 feet of the dracolich must succeed on a {@dc 24} Dexterity saving throw or take 16 ({@damage 2d6 + 9}) bludgeoning damage, be knocked {@condition prone}, and pushed up to 15 feet away from the dracolich.

trait.name: Vainglorious Strength
entries: If the dragon succeeds on a Strength saving throw, the next attack it makes before the end of its next turn has advantage.
If the dragon fails a Strength saving throw, it has disadvantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws for the next minute.

trait.name: Whorlflare Landing
entries: The first time each turn that the dragon lands on a solid surface after descending at least 20 feet, each creature within 20 feet of it is pushed up to 10 feet away and begins {@condition burning|confc|burning} ({@dice 1d10}).

trait.name: Tunneler

If the remorhaz dies, a swallowed creature is no longer {@condition restrained} by it and can escape from the corpse using 15 feet of movement, exiting {@condition prone}.

action.name: Terror From the Deep {@recharge 5}

Each creature in a 15 foot radius must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or take 35 ({@damage 10d6}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}, or half damage on a success. As a bonus action, the remorhaz may make a bite attack against a creature that failed this save.

reaction.name: Inner Fire

If the creature's shadow dies, the creature is lost forever to the realm of shadow.
