entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d6 + 7}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 18}).

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d6 + 7}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away from the dragon.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of the dragon's choice that is within 120 feet of the dragon and aware of it must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the dragon's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Breath Weapons {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.

action.name: Toxic Breath
entries: The dragon exhales a poisonous cloud in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for the next minute. A {@condition poisoned} creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success or taking 35 ({@damage 10d6}) poison damage on a failure.

action.name: Acid Trench Breath
entries: The dragon exhales acid in a 90-foot line that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw, taking 54 ({@damage 12d8}) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Additionally, rock and earth in the area are disolved to a depth of 15 ft.

reaction.name: Bloodied Breath (1/day
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 117 HP, the dragon immediately recharges and uses one of its breath weapons.

reaction.name: Bat Away
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the dragon forces the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or have one object it is holding knocked out of its hands and 20 ft. away.

legendary.name: Corrective Confinement
entries: One creature within 60 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 18}) until the end of the dragon's next turn as bonds of magical force leap to confine it.

legendary.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon beats its wings. Each creature within 15 feet of the dragon must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 2d6 + 7}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}. The dragon can then fly up to half its flying speed.

legendary.name: Free the Oppressed (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: One creature within 60 ft. is freed from all restraints and cured of any poison or disease, then must make a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature regards the dragon as a trusted ally and all other creatures as enemies for the next minute. An affected creature repeats this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

trait.name: Ice Walk
entries: The dracolich can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.

trait.name: Black Ice Aura
entries: The area in a 10 foot radius around the dracolich is difficult terrain. A creature that enters it for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there must succeed on a {@dc 22} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Soul Vessel
entries: If it has a phylactery, a destroyed dracolich's soul returns to its phylactery. If a phylactery containing a dracolich's soul is placed upon a dragon's corpse for {@dice 1d10} days, the dracolich's soul inhabits the new body.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the dracolich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dracolich uses its Frightful Presence and makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 2d10 + 8}) piercing damage plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Paralyzing Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d6 + 8}) slashing damage. If the target is {@condition stunned}, it must make a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition paralyzed} until the end of the dracolich's turn.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d6 + 8}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 15 feet away from the dracolich.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of the dracolich's choice within 120 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn).
On a successful saving throw or when the effect ends for it, a creature becomes immune to this effect for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Ice Tomb Breath (Recharges when the dracolich uses its Blizzard Breath)
entries: The dracolich exhales a burst of ice in a 90-foot cone that clings to living creatures, sapping their vitality. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 22} Strength saving throw or gain 45 ({@dice 10d8}) temporary hit points.

While it has any of these temporary hit points, a creature is {@condition restrained} and must make a {@dc 22} Constitution saving throw at the beginning of each of its turns. On a failed save, a creature loses two unexpended hit dice, or drops to 0 hit points if it cannot.

action.name: Blizzard Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dracolich exhales a blast of ice and thrashing winds in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 22} Constitution saving throw, taking 72 ({@damage 16d8}) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Until the end of the dracolich's next turn, the area is difficult terrain and heavily obscured.

reaction.name: Sudden Pounce
entries: When a creature within 80 feet of the dracolich ends its turn further away from the dracolich than it started, the dracolich can move up to its speed toward the creature and make a claw attack against it.
If the target is {@condition frightened}, it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of the dracolich's next turn.

reaction.name: Consume Vitality
entries: When the dracolich succeeds on a saving throw against a spell, it can force the spellcaster to make a {@dc 16} Constitution Saving Throw.

On a failed save, the spell caster loses two unexpended hit dice and the dracolich regains 18 ({@dice 1d20 + 8}) hit points for each hit die lost this way. If the spell caster can't expend any hit dice, it instead drops to 0 hit points.

legendary.name: Raise Hackles
entries: One creature within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or lose any immunity it has to the dracolich's Frightful Presence or the {@condition frightened} condition.

legendary.name: Terrorize
entries: One {@condition frightened} creature within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) psychic damage. On the creature's next turn, it must use its full movement to run away from the dracolich.

legendary.name: Uttercold
entries: The dracolich draws on its deepest reserves. Until the end of its next turn, cold damage the dracolich deals ignores damage resistance, and the dracolich loses one of its legendary resistances.

trait.name: Tundraborn
entries: The dragon ignores negative effects from moving over terrain composed of ice or snow, and has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition blinded}.

trait.name: Heavy Chill
entries: A creature that begins its turn within 25 feet of the dragon has disadvantage on each attack it makes on its turn beyond the first, unless it is resistant or immune to cold damage.
A creature can lose one unexpended hit die to ignore this effect until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Frostblessed Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw against an effect that does not deal fire damage, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three Barbed Claw attacks, one of which it can replace with its Bitter Bite or Icecarve Tail, and uses its Frightful Presence.

action.name: Bitter Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@dice 2d10 + 8}) piercing plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) cold damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 22}).
A creature {@condition grappled} in this way has disadvantage on saving throws against the dragon's Winterglass Breath.

action.name: Barbed Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d6 + 8}) slashing damage and the target is knocked {@condition prone} if it is Gargantuan or smaller.

action.name: Icecarve Tail
entries: The dragon sweeps its tail, flinging a spray of ice and snow in a 30 foot cone.

Each creature in the area is pushed 5 feet away and must succeed on a {@dc 22} Dexterity saving throw or take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) cold damage and be {@condition blinded} until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of the dragon's choice within 120 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the beginning of the dragon's next turn, becoming immune to this effect for the next 24 hours on a success.

action.name: Raise Hackles
entries: The dragon extends its spined frill and a deep, booming rumble ripples through the air around it in a 30 foot radius.

Each creature in the area that is immune to the dragon's Frightful Presence or the {@condition frightened} condition must succeed on a {@dc 22} Wisdom saving throw or lose that immunity for the next minute.

action.name: Winterglass Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon exhales an icy blast in a 90-foot cone, covering the area in ice and forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a {@dc 22} Constitution saving throw or take 72 ({@damage 16d8}) cold damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 10 or more contracts Frostbite.
A creature that moves more than 10 feet through the area in a turn must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Sudden Pounce
entries: When a creature the dragon can see within 80 feet moves at least 15 feet away from it or fails an attempt to {@action Hide} from it, the dragon can leap up to 80 feet directly toward the creature and make a Barbed Claw attack against it.

reaction.name: Bloodied Breath (1/Day
entries: When the dragon is reduced below 196 hit points, it can roll to recharge its Winterglass Breath, then immediately use it, if available.

legendary.name: Terrorize
entries: One creature the dragon can see within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to move its speed directly away from the dragon, or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) psychic damage if it can't.

legendary.name: Ice Tomb
entries: The dragon breathes a layer of dense, translucent ice that encrusts a {@condition prone} creature within 10 feet, forcing it to succeed on a {@dc 22} Strength saving throw or gain 20 temporary hit points, or half as many on a success.

A creature that has any of these temporary hit points is {@condition restrained} and loses three unexpended hit dice at the end of each of its turns, or gains a point of {@condition exhaustion} if it can't.

legendary.name: Uttercold (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon draws on its deepest reserves. Until the end of its next turn, cold damage the dragon deals ignores damage resistance, and it can reroll any of the damage dice of its Winterglass Breath once, taking the second result.

trait.name: Deteriorating Form
entries: Absent its innate draconic magics, mere necromancy is unable to sustain the zombie for long. Whenever the zombie makes an attack, it loses 5 hit points. Whenever the zombie uses its breath weapon, it loses 20 hit points.

trait.name: Putrid Stench
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the zombie must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The zombie makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Festering Bite.

action.name: Festering Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@dice 3d10 + 7}) piercing plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Rotgrasp Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d6 + 7}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 20}).

action.name: Gore Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon exudes a torrent of its own liquefied viscera in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or take 27 ({@dice 6d8}) bludgeoning plus 21 ({@damage 6d6}) poison damage and be knocked {@condition prone}, or take half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Perilous Thrash
entries: When the zombie misses with a melee attack, it may permanently suffer one of the following effects of its choice that it has not yet suffered. If it does, it rerolls the attack with advantage:

items.name: Torn Wing
entries: While flying, the zombie must succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw at the end of each of its turns or fall {@condition prone}.

items.name: Broken Limb
entries: The zombie makes one fewer attack with its multiattack after this turn.

items.name: Dislocated Jaw
entries: The zombie cannot use its Festering Bite after this turn.

trait.name: Sphinx's Laws
entries: At the beginning of each of its turns in combat, the sphinx sets two of the following rules in secret, which last until the beginning of its next turn. A creature within 60 feet that violates the rule must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or take 11 ({@damage 2d10}) psychic damage and be {@condition stunned} until the end of the sphinx's next turn. The sphinx is bound by its own rules.
A creature may make no more than one attack per turn.
A creature may not cast spells of 1st-3rd level.
A creature may not cast spells of 4th-6th level.
A creature may not target a creature more than 30 ft away from it with an attack or spell.
A creature may not benefit from flanking.

trait.name: Inscrutable
entries: The sphinx is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) checks made to ascertain the sphinx's intentions or sincerity have disadvantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sphinx makes two claw attacks and casts a spell with a casting time of 1 action.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) slashing damage.

action.name: Mighty Pounce
entries: The sphinx leaps up to 30 ft. and makes a claw attack. If the attack hits, the target is knocked {@condition prone} and takes an additional 55 ({@damage 10d10}) force damage.

action.name: Dispel Magic (3rd level spell)
entries: One spell effect within 60 ft. of 3rd level or lower ends. The sphinx may make a Wisdom check to dispel a higher level spell effect with DC equal to 10 + the spell effect's level.

action.name: Lightning Bolt (3rd level spell)
entries: Each creature in a 120 ft. long, 5 ft. wide line must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or take 28 ({@damage 8d6}) lightning damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Banishment (4th level spell, concentration)
entries: One creature the sphinx can see within 60 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 18} Charisma saving throw or be banished to a harmless demiplane for one minute. While banished, the creature is {@condition incapacitated} and repeats this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Flame Strike (5th level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature in a 10 ft. radius, 40 ft. cylinder centered on a point within 60 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or take 14 ({@dice 4d6}) fire and 14 ({@damage 4d6}) radiant damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Absorb Elements (1st level spell)
entries: As a reaction to taking either Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage, the sphinx gains resistance to the triggering damage type until the start of its next turn. Its next claw attack deals an additional 3 ({@damage 1d6}) damage of the triggering type.

legendary.name: Claw
entries: The sphinx makes a claw attack.

legendary.name: Leap
entries: The sphinx moves up to half its speed without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

legendary.name: Roar (3/Day, Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The sphinx emits a magical roar. Each time it roars before finishing a long rest, the roar is louder and the effect is different, as detailed below. Each creature within 500 feet of the sphinx and able to hear the roar must make a saving throw.

items.name: First Roar
entries: Each creature that fails a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw is {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. A {@condition frightened} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

items.name: Second Roar
entries: Each creature that fails a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw is knocked {@condition prone} and {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. A {@condition frightened} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

items.name: Third Roar
entries: Each creature makes a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 44 ({@damage 8d10}) thunder damage, is knocked {@condition prone}, and is {@condition deafened} for the next minute. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage.

trait.name: Festering Presence
entries: If the angel has at least 105 HP, a creature that starts its turn within 15 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be infected with {@disease festering necrosis|ConfC}.

trait.name: Parasitic Presence
entries: If the angel has 105 HP or fewer, it regains 10 hit points at the beginning of its turn for each corpse and each creature within 60 feet infected with {@disease festering necrosis|ConfC}.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The angel has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The angel makes two melee attacks, one of which it may replace with its foul unraveling, if available.

action.name: Rotting Touch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d6 + 6}) slashing damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) necrotic damage. This attack scores a critical on a 16-20 against a creature with fewer than 100 hit points.

action.name: Foul Unraveling {@recharge 5}
entries: The angel lashes out with tendrils of vile corruption, making a rotting touch attack against each creature within 15 feet On a hit, a creature is dragged up to 10 feet towards the angel and {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}) and {@condition restrained} until the end of the angel's turn.

reaction.name: Wave of Decay (1/Day)
entries: When the angel is reduced below 105 hit points, it unleashes a wave of negative energy. Each creature within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or take 27 ({@damage 6d8}) necrotic damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Tide of Numbers
entries: When the mob moves, each creature in the mob's space must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or be moved with it.

trait.name: Crushing Bodies
entries: A {@condition prone} creature that starts its turn in the mob's space must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or have its movement reduced to 0 until the end of its turn.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The mob can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the mob can move through any opening large enough for a medium creature. The mob can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

action.name: Improvised Weapons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 0 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 6d4 + 2}) bludgeoning damage. If the mob has more than half of its hit points, the target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Trample
entries: Each {@condition prone} creature in the mob's space takes 1 bludgeoning damage for each 5 hit points the mob has.

trait.name: Animated Object
entries: If the armor is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as {@spell Dispel Magic}, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the armor remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal suit of armor.

trait.name: Clattering Collapse
entries: When the armor takes or deals a critical hit, it falls {@condition prone} in a heap and is {@condition stunned} until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The armor makes two attacks with its Lurching Slam.

action.name: Lurching Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage.
Instead of dealing damage, the armor can grapple the target (escape {@dc 12}).

action.name: Twist Limbs
entries: One creature that is wearing or {@condition grappled} by the armor must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 3d8}) bludgeoning damage and be {@condition restrained} until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Animated Object
entries: If the bed is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as {@spell Dispel Magic}, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the bed remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal bed.

trait.name: Inviting Form
entries: Medium or smaller creatures can freely enter and move through the bed's space.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bed makes three attacks with its Curtain Tendril, one of which it can replace with a use of its Headboard Smash or Swallow Sleeper.

action.name: Curtain Tendril
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target is dragged up to 5 feet toward the bed.

action.name: Headboard Smash
entries: Each other creature in the bed's space must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is additionally {@condition dazed|confc|dazed} until the end of the bed's next turn.

action.name: Swallow Sleeper
entries: One {@condition dazed|confc|dazed} or {@condition incapacitated} creature that is {@condition grappled} by the bed is drawn into its mattress and {@condition swallowed|confc|swallowed} (escape {@dc 15}).
The {@condition swallowed|confc|swallowed} creature takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) bludgeoning damage at the beginning of each of the bed's turns.

reaction.name: Shin Scoop
entries: When a creature enters a space within 5 feet of the bed, the bed can force it to succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or tumble onto the bed and be {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}).

trait.name: Animated Object
entries: If the book is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as {@spell Dispel Magic}, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the book remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal book.

action.name: Heavy Thwack
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

action.name: Release Spell
entries: The book releases a spell trapped in its pages, choosing new targets for it and using its own spellcasting ability (Spell Attack Bonus +2, Spell Save {@dc 10}).

reaction.name: Trap Spell (Recharges when the book uses its Release Spell)
entries: When the book is targeted with a spell of 1st level or below, it can make a Constitution saving throw against the spell caster's Save DC.
On a success, the spell is negated and trapped within the book's pages, and the book takes 1 force damage at the beginning of each of its turns until it uses its Release Spell.

trait.name: Animated Object
entries: If the broom is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as {@spell Dispel Magic}, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the broom remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal broom.

action.name: Bristled Bash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Sweep Leg
entries: The broom forces one Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet to succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Dust Up
entries: The broom furiously sweeps a dust-covered surface within 5 feet, kicking up a thick cloud in a 5 foot radius that Lightly Obscures the area and lasts for a minute, or until cleared by a strong breeze.

reaction.name: Splintry Snap
entries: When the broom is hit with a melee attack, it can allow that attack to score a critical.

If it does, the broom snaps in half, splitting into two {@creature animated broom|confc|Animated Brooms} that each have hit points equal to half the original broom's, act on its initiative, and can't use this reaction or regain hit points.

trait.name: Animated Object
entries: If the candelabrum is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as {@spell Dispel Magic}, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the candelabrum remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal candelabrum.

trait.name: Snuff Out
entries: If the candelabrum is subjected to strong wind, doused in water, or a creature blows on it as a bonus action, the candelabrum must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or have its flames extinguished.
Until it hits a target with its Sconce Flare, the candelabrum's attacks have disadvantage and it can't use its Set Flame.

action.name: Sconce Flare
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) fire damage.
A {@condition blinded}, {@condition incapacitated}, or Surprised creature hit with this attack begins {@condition burning|confc|burning} ({@dice 1d10}, Save Ends at end of turn)

action.name: Fling Wax
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 30 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) fire damage.

action.name: Set Flame
entries: The candelabrum sets a space within 5 feet of it aflame for the next minute.

A creature that starts its turn in the space or enters it for the first time on a turn must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Animated Object
entries: If the carriage is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as {@spell Dispel Magic}, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the carriage remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal carriage.

trait.name: Selective Passage
entries: When a creature attempts to exit the carriage, the carriage can force it to succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or suffer one of the following effects:
The creature is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}) until the beginning of its next turn.
The creature is pushed up to 15 feet away.

action.name: Collect Passenger
entries: The carriage lurches to grasp a creature within 5 feet, forcing it to succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be drawn into the carriage.

action.name: Doomride Rush
entries: The carriage moves up to its speed in a straight line, and can move through the space of any Large or smaller creature.

Each creature whose space the carriage enters in this way must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}, or move to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

reaction.name: Spiteful Crash
entries: When the carriage moves within 5 feet of a wall or similar solid, vertical surface, it can take 3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage for each 10 feet it moved directly toward that surface this turn.
If it does, each creature in the carriage must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or take an equal amount of damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Animated Object
entries: If the cauldron is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as {@spell Dispel Magic}, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the cauldron remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal cauldron.

trait.name: Boiling Brew
entries: The cauldron gains 1 level of heat whenever it takes any fire damage, to a maximum of 4, gaining the following cumulative effects.

trait.name: 1. Quivering
entries: The cauldron's attacks deal an additional 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage for each level of heat it has.

trait.name: 2. Simmering
entries: The cauldron can use its Fire Up as a Bonus Action.

trait.name: 3. Rolling
entries: The cauldron's fly speed is increased by 5 feet for each level of heat it has.

trait.name: 4. Superheated
entries: Any attack that hits the cauldron becomes a critical.

action.name: Blistering Bash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@dice 2d8 + 3}) bludgeoning plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Fire Up
entries: The cauldron's Boiling Brew grows 1 level hotter.

reaction.name: Scalding Slosh (Simmering or hotter)
entries: When the cauldron is hit with a melee attack, it can force one creature within 5 feet other than the attacker to make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw.
On a failure, the target takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage for each level of heat the cauldron has.

trait.name: Animated Object
entries: If the chandelier is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as {@spell Dispel Magic}, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the chandelier remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal chandelier.

trait.name: Mooring Chain
entries: A 40 foot long chain dangles beneath the chandelier.

A creature grasping the chain is considered {@condition attached|confc|attached} to the chandelier, and can spend half its movement to make a contested Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check, dragging the chandelier up to 30 feet toward it on a success.

action.name: Crystal Shard Volley
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 40 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 5d6 + 4}) piercing damage.
On a miss, the chandelier can make a second attack against a creature directly behind the first target.

action.name: Chain Fling
entries: One creature that is grasping the chandelier's Mooring Chain must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) bludgeoning damage and be flung up to 30 feet.

reaction.name: Crystalline Drop
entries: When a creature enters a space directly beneath the chandelier, the chandelier can crash down onto it, forcing each creature whose space it lands in to make a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw.
On a failure, the creature takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage for each 10 feet the chandelier fell and is knocked {@condition prone}, and the chandelier takes no damage from falling.
On a success, a creature moves to the nearest unoccupied space.

trait.name: Animated Object
entries: If the iron is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as {@spell Dispel Magic}, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the iron remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal iron.

trait.name: Steam Off
entries: If the iron takes any cold damage while its Heat Up is active, it exudes a cloud of steam in a 5 foot radius, Heavily Obscuring the area until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Flatiron Smash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) bludgeoning damage.
If the target is not wearing armor, the iron can become {@condition attached|confc|attached} to it (remove {@dc 12}).

reaction.name: Heat Up
entries: If the iron would take any fire damage, it can reduce that damage to 0 and begin to glow a dull red, gaining the following effects for the next minute, or until it takes any cold damage:
The iron's attacks deal an additional 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage.
A creature that grapples the iron or hits it with an unarmed attack takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage.
A creature that starts its turn grappling the iron or with the iron {@condition attached|confc|attached} to it takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage.

trait.name: Animated Object
entries: If the rack is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as {@spell Dispel Magic}, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the rack remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal coat rack.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The coat rack makes four attacks with its Oakhook Chain-Punch, one of which it can replace with a use of its Coat Call.

action.name: Oakhook Chain-Punch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage.
A creature hit with three or more of these attacks in a turn must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Coat Call
entries: The rack regains an expended use of its Coatflare Whirl, then each creature within 30 feet that is wearing a coat, cloak, hat, or mantle must make a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw.
On a failure, one such item the creature is wearing flies to the rack and becomes {@condition attached|confc|attached} to it (remove {@dc 12}).

action.name: Coatflare Whirl (1/Day)
entries: The rack spins, flinging clinging hats and cloaks at up to four creatures within 10 feet of it and forcing.
Each target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or be {@condition blinded} (Save Ends at beginning of turn).
This effect ends early if the rack uses its Coat Call.

reaction.name: Base Trip
entries: When a creature leaves the rack's reach, it can force the creature to succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Animated Object
entries: If the cookstove is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as {@spell Dispel Magic}, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the cookstove remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal cookstove.

trait.name: Iron Arsenal
entries: At the beginning of each of the cookstove's turns, its flung cookware returns to it.

A creature grasping a piece of cookware can make a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw to prevent its return, reducing the number of attacks the cookstove can make with its Multiattack this turn by one on a success.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cookstove makes three attacks with its Hurl Cookware, one of which it can replace with a use of its Burner Flare.

action.name: Hurl Cookware
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 7} to hit, range 30 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.
If the cookstove used its Burner Flare this turn, this attack deals an additional 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Burner Flare
entries: The cookstove's burners roar with flame, forcing each creature within 5 feet of it to succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage, or half as much on a success.

bonus.name: Blackiron Scoot
entries: The cookstove moves up to 5 feet, and can enter the space of any Medium or smaller creature with this movement, pushing it 5 feet directly away.
A creature that would be pushed into a solid surface in this way instead takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage and is {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 15}) until the cookstove moves.

trait.name: Animated Object
entries: If the cupboard is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as {@spell Dispel Magic}, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the cupboard remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal cupboard.

trait.name: Delicate Contents
entries: If the cupboard is knocked {@condition prone}, it takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) slashing damage and makes 1 fewer attack with its multiattack until it regains all of its hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cupboard makes three attacks with its Fling Porcelain, one of which it can replace with a use of its Scraping Slide.

action.name: Fling Porcelain
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.
On a miss, the target takes 1 slashing damage.

action.name: Scraping Slide
entries: The cupboard moves up to 15 feet in a straight line and can move through the space of any Medium or smaller creature in this way.
Each creature whose space it enters in this way must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or take 4 ({@damage 1d8}) bludgeoning damage and be pushed up to 15 feet away.
On a success, a target takes half as much damage the cupboard's movement ends.

trait.name: Animated Object
entries: If the door is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as {@spell Dispel Magic}, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the door remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal door.

trait.name: Hinged Prison
entries: The door is ordinarily affixed to a doorway, and cannot move or be moved from its space.
At the beginning of any turn when the door does not have all of its hit points, it can make a {@dc 10} Strength saving throw, freeing itself on a success.

action.name: Sudden Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage, plus one additional effect:
The target is {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 13}) until the door moves or makes another attack.
The target is pushed up to 10 feet away.

action.name: Hardwood Endurance
entries: The door braces itself, gaining resistance to damage from ranged weapon attacks until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Knock Back
entries: When a creature hits the door with a melee attack while the door is affixed to a doorway, the door can make a Sudden Slam attack against it.

reaction.name: Knob Shock (1/Day)
entries: When a creature attempts to open or unlock the door, the door can force it to succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) lightning damage and be pushed up to 10 feet away.

trait.name: Animated Object
entries: If the duster is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as {@spell Dispel Magic}, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the duster remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal feather duster.

action.name: Handle Bash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Insistent Tickle
entries: The duster tickles a creature within 5 feet, forcing it to succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or lose {@status concentration}, if it was holding it, and make a melee attack against a random creature in its reach.

reaction.name: Stuff Face
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of the duster casts a spell, the duster can force it to succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or begin {@condition choking|confc|choking} until the end of its next turn.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more has its spell fail, additionally.

trait.name: Animated Object
entries: If the clock is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as {@spell Dispel Magic}, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the clock remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal clock.

trait.name: Cog Jam
entries: A creature {@condition swallowed|confc|swallowed} by the clock can attempt to jam its gears with a successful {@dc 10} Dexterity (Thieves' Tools) check, Stunning it until the end of the clock's next turn on a success.

action.name: Pendulum Slice
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target {@condition swallowed|confc|swallowed} by the clock. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) slashing damage.
On a miss, the clock can make a second attack with this weapon against the same target.

action.name: Crushing Leap
entries: The clock jumps up to 10 feet, and can land in the space of any Medium or smaller creature.

Each creature whose space it lands in must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) bludgeoning damage, be knocked {@condition prone}, and be {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 13}) until the clock moves.
On a success, a target takes half as much damage and is pushed to the nearest unoccupied space.

reaction.name: Open Wide
entries: When a Medium or smaller creature misses the clock with a melee attack, the clock can force it to succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition swallowed|confc|swallowed} by the clock (escape {@dc 16}).

trait.name: Animated Object
entries: If the kettle is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as {@spell Dispel Magic}, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the kettle remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal kettle.

action.name: Heavy Crash
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) bludgeoning damage, plus an additional 1 fire damage for each remaining use of its Scalding Splash.

action.name: Screaming Whistle
entries: The kettle produces an ear-splitting whistle, forcing each creature within 30 feet that can hear it to succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition deafened} and lose {@status concentration}, if it was holding it.

reaction.name: Scalding Splash (3/Day)
entries: When the kettle takes any non-cold damage, it can fling boiling water toward a creature within 5 feet, dealing 2 ({@damage 1d4}) fire damage to it.
The teapot regains all uses of this ability whenever it takes any fire damage.

trait.name: Animated Object
entries: If the pillow is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as {@spell Dispel Magic}, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the pillow remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal pillow.

trait.name: Feather Burst
entries: When the pillow is reduced to 0 hit points, it explodes in a shower of feathers, heavily obscuring the area in a 5 foot radius until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Cushioned Collision
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 0} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}The target is pushed up to 5 feet away.

action.name: Smothering Clutch
entries: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a {@dc 8} Strength saving throw or have the pillow become {@condition attached|confc|attached} to it (remove {@dc 8}, Save Ends at end of turn).
A creature the pillow is {@condition attached|confc|attached} to has resistance to bludgeoning damage, is {@condition blinded}, and is {@condition choking|confc|choking}.

trait.name: Animated Object
entries: If the portrait is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as {@spell Dispel Magic}, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the portrait remains silent and motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal portrait.

trait.name: Whispering Walls
entries: The portrait can hear each other animated portrait in the same building as though it was within 5 feet of them.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The portrait makes two attacks with its Spinning Frame Strike, one of which it can replace with its Inchoate Shriek.

action.name: Spinning Frame Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target that isn't {@condition restrained} by the portrait. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) bludgeoning damage.
If the portrait has a creature {@condition restrained} with its Sacrificial Embrace, the {@condition restrained} creature is {@condition dazed|confc|dazed} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Inchoate Shriek
entries: One creature within 15 feet that can hear the portrait must make a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw.

On a failure, the creature is {@condition frightened} until the end of the portrait's next turn. While the creature is {@condition frightened} in this way, the portrait's attacks against it have advantage.

action.name: Sacrificial Embrace
entries: The portrait attempts to impale itself upon a creature within 5 feet, forcing the target to make a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw.
On a failure, the target takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) bludgeoning damage and is {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 12}), and the portrait takes an equal amount of piercing damage.
The portrait maintains this restraint even if it is {@condition incapacitated} or killed.

trait.name: Animated Object
entries: If the head is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as {@spell Dispel Magic}, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the head remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal trophy head.

trait.name: Unguarded Rear
entries: Whenever the head makes a melee attack, up to one creature within 5 feet other than its target may use its reaction to make an {@action Opportunity Attack} against the head.

action.name: Snarling Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d10 + 2}) piercing damage.
The head can make this attack as a Bonus Action against a {@condition prone} target.

action.name: Toppling Assault {@recharge 4}
entries: The head moves up to its fly speed, then plunges downward, forcing up to one creature whose space it lands in to make a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw.
On a failure, the target takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) bludgeoning damage and is knocked {@condition prone}, and the head takes no damage.
On a success, the target moves to the nearest unoccupied space and the head takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Animated Object
entries: If the wardrobe is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as {@spell Dispel Magic}, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the wardrobe remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal wardrobe.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wardrobe makes two attacks with its Questing-Garment Grasp.

action.name: Questing-Garment Grasp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}).
A target already {@condition grappled} by the wardrobe that is hit with this attack must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be {@condition swallowed|confc|swallowed} (escape {@dc 14}).

action.name: Wardrobe Change
entries: One creature {@condition swallowed|confc|swallowed} by the wardrobe takes 18 ({@damage 4d8}) bludgeoning damage, then must make a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw.
On a failure, the wardrobe removes any armor or clothing the creature is wearing and replaces it with a different set of clothing, then expels the creature.

trait.name: Burrowing Terror
entries: If the ankheg starts its turn buried underground, it has advantage on all attack rolls until the end of its turn.

trait.name: Clutchmother
entries: When the ankheg dies, 10 {@creature ankheg nymph|confc|Ankheg Nymphs} that act on its turn burst from its corpse at the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ankheg makes two attacks with its Spined Claw Strike, one of which it may replace with its Fleshmelter Mandibles or its Burial Store.

action.name: Fleshmelter Mandibles
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) acid damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}).
While {@condition grappled} in this way, a creature takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) acid damage at the end of each of its turns.

action.name: Spined Claw Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage plus 5 ({@damage 2d4}) piercing damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.
On a critical hit, the target must succeed on {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone} and {@condition stunned} until the end of the ankheg's next turn.

action.name: Burial Store
entries: The ankheg rapidly excavates a 5 foot deep hole, shoves a creature it has {@condition grappled} in it, then buries it (escape {@dc 16}). While buried, a creature is {@condition blinded}, {@condition restrained}, and can't speak or breathe.

action.name: Acid Drench {@recharge 5}
entries: The ankheg spits steaming acid in a 40 foot long, 10 foot wide line. Each creature in that line must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) acid damage, or half as much on a success. A creature {@condition grappled} by the Ankheg fails this save automatically.

reaction.name: Seething Vitriol
entries: As a reaction to taking 10 or more fire damage in a turn, the ankheg immediately recharges its Acid Drench.

monster.name: Ankheg Mockery Drone
languages: Speaks common but doesn't understand it

trait.name: Flesh Suit
entries: The mockery drone is ensconced in a perfect disguise of flesh, indistinguishable from a normal humanoid. While disguised, the ankheg Scything Barbs and Brittle exoskeleton traits are inactive, its AC is 11, and it cannot use its Spiral Constriction. It may emerge from its disguise as a Bonus Action on its turn.

trait.name: Brittle Exoskeleton
entries: If the ankheg takes 10 or more bludgeoning damage from a single source, its AC is reduced by 3, to a minimum of 11, until it completes a Short or Long Rest.

trait.name: Scything Barbs
entries: Whenever the ankheg moves into a space for the first time on a turn, each creature within 5 feet of it takes 5 slashing damage.

action.name: Acid Spit
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 8} to hit, range 30 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d8}) acid damage.

action.name: Spiral Constriction
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}The ankheg enters the target's space and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}).
While it has a target {@condition grappled} in this way, the ankheg's speed is 0 and whenever it takes damage, the {@condition grappled} creature takes an equal amount of slashing damage.

action.name: Terrifying Chatter
entries: The ankheg cheefully speaks an incomprehensible stream of inane and nonsensical chatter. Each creature that is {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell that can hear it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or lose {@status concentration}.

reaction.name: Punishing Barbs
entries: As a reaction to a creature failing at an attempt to escape its grapple, the ankheg forces it to succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) piercing damage and be {@condition stunned} until the end of the ankheg's next turn, or take half as much damage on a success.

monster.name: Ankheg Mockery Monarch
languages: Any language spoken by a creature it has eaten

trait.name: Burrowing Terror
entries: If the ankheg starts its turn buried underground, it has advantage on all attack rolls until the end of its turn.

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The ankheg can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The ankheg has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Regurgitative Reflex (3/Day)
entries: If the ankheg would fail a saving throw while it has at least one creature swallowed, it may choose to succeed instead. If it does, it immediately regurgitates each swallowed creature.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ankheg makes three attacks with its Sickle-Claw Strike, one of which it may replace with its Cavernous Maw or a use of its Acid Nectar, if available.

action.name: Cavernous Maw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) acid damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}).

action.name: Sickle-Claw Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) slashing damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.
Each other creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

action.name: Acid Nectar {@recharge 5}
entries: The ankheg releases any creatures it has {@condition grappled} and regurgitates a glob of resinous, honey-like nectar in a 30 foot cone.

The area becomes difficult terrain, and a non-ankheg creature that starts its turn in the area or enters it for the first time on a turn takes 36 ({@damage 8d8}) acid damage, then must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition restrained} until the beginning of its next turn (escape {@dc 17}).

bonus.name: Swallow Whole
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the ankheg must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or be swallowed. While swallowed, the creature is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, and its attacks bypass the ankheg's resistances.
If the ankheg takes 40 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the ankheg regurgitates all swallowed creatures, which fall {@condition prone} in an unoccupied space within 10 feet.

bonus.name: Mockery Drone Spawning
entries: Each creature swallowed by the ankheg must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) acid damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature killed by this damage has its skull and spine disolved and replaced with a {@creature ankheg mockery drone|confc|Ankheg Mockery Drone}, then is immediately regurgitated by the ankheg.

reaction.name: Seething Vitriol
entries: As a reaction to taking 10 or more fire damage in a turn, the ankheg immediately recharges its Acid Nectar.

reaction.name: Spell Turning
entries: As a reaction to succeeding on a saving throw against a spell that targets only it, the ankheg avoids all effects from the spell and instead causes the spell to target the caster.

trait.name: Half-Formed Exoskeleton
entries: Attacks with weapons that deal bludgeoning damage are made at advantage against the ankheg.

trait.name: Acid Burst
entries: When the ankheg is killed, each creature within 5 feet of it takes 1 acid damage.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the ankheg takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the ankheg takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

action.name: Gnawing Mass (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 damage.
If at least three ankhegs contributed to this group attack and the target is wearing leather or cloth armor, it takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers.

trait.name: Scute Armor
entries: Creatures cannot benefit from flanking the ankylosaurus unless it is {@condition prone}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ankylosaurus makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its tail club. It can't make both attacks against the same target.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) piercing damage. This attack deals an additional 4 ({@damage 1d8}) piercing damage to a {@condition prone} creature.

action.name: Tail Club
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}26 ({@damage 5d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, the target is pushed 10 feet away, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. A Large or larger creature that fails this save by 5 or more is unable to stand until it completes a short or long rest.

reaction.name: Flatten
entries: As a reaction to taking 10 or more damage from a single source, the ankylosaurus presses its body to the ground, protecting its soft underbelly. Until the beginning of its next turn, the Anklyosaurus adds 3 to its AC.

resist.note: from attacks with weapons that aren't named

trait.name: Fey Magic Resistance
entries: The hag has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects imposed by a creature that does not know its name.

trait.name: Skinktaker Mimicry
entries: The hag can mimic the voice or appearance of any humanoid it has skinned. A creature can discern the nature of these illusions with a successful {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check.

trait.name: Corruptor Coven
entries: Children within 10 miles of a coven of annis hags are slowly incited to misbehave in ever-escalating ways, up to and including things like destruction of food stores, killing pets and livestock, arson, and even murder.
Additionally, a fog settles in the area that never lifts. Creatures other than the annis hag in the area are blind beyond a 30 ft. radius.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The annis makes three attacks: one with her teeth of iron and two with her corkscrew claws.

action.name: Teeth of Iron
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) slashing damage. This attack deals an additional 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage against a {@condition prone} creature.

action.name: Corkscrew Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) slashing damage and the hag may grapple the target (escape {@dc 16}). While the hag has a creature {@condition grappled} in this way, it cannot use its multiattack.

action.name: Crushing Hug
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the hag must make a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 39 ({@damage 6d12}) bludgeoning damage, falls {@condition prone}, and cannot stand on its following turn. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more cannot stand until it completes a short or long rest. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage.

reaction.name: Grisly Display
entries: As a reaction when the hag kills a creature with a melee attack, the hag rips the creature's skin off in a single piece. Each creature that can see the display must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom save or be {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn. While {@condition frightened} in this way, a creature uses its movement and action to dash in a random direction.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The anteater has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Bristle-Tail Shade
entries: The anteater has advantage on saving throws against effects that deal radiant damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: If the anteater is standing with its Threatening Pose, it makes two attacks with its Earthgouge Claws.

action.name: Earthgouge Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) slashing damage.
This attack is made at disadvantage against any creature not {@condition grappled} by the anteater.

action.name: Sticky Tongue Pluck
entries: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or have one item it is carrying that weighs 1 lb or less stolen by the anteater.

action.name: Threatening Pose
entries: The anteater rears on its hind legs and spreads its arms. Until the anteater lowers itself as a bonus action or falls {@condition prone}, its speed is reduced to 0.

reaction.name: Clumsy Tumble
entries: As a reaction when a creature hits the anteater with a melee attack, the anteater forces the creature to reroll the attack, taking the second result, then falls {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Delicate Wings
entries: If Anthyria takes any fire damage, her fly speed is reduced by 10 feet until she completes a Short or Long Rest.

trait.name: Doctrine of the Mean
entries: Whenever Anthyria makes a saving throw, she can treat the result rolled as a 10. If this reduces the actual result rolled, Anthyria gains 5 ({@dice 1d10}) temporary hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Anthyria makes two attacks with her Divalian Starblade, one of which she can replace with a use of her Coursing Lights.

action.name: Divalian Starblade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@dice 1d6 + 3}) slashing plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) radiant damage.
On a hit or miss, two motes of raw magic fly from the blade, each of which inexorably strikes a creature Anthyria can see within 60 feet, dealing 7 ({@damage 2d6}) force damage.

action.name: Coursing Lights
entries: Beams of roving light dash through a 30 foot radius area centered on a point Anthyria can see within 100 feet, lingering briefly on each creature they touch.
Each hidden creature in the area is revealed, and attacks against creatures in the area are made at advantage until the beginning of her next turn.

action.name: Peace of Night's Air (3rd Level Spell) {@recharge 5}
entries: Anthyria sends forth a gust of cool, sweet air in a 30 foot line that is 5 feet wide.
Each creature in the area gains 10 temporary hit points, then must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or gain disadvantage on attacks for as long as it has any of these temporary hit points.

action.name: Moonfall's Echo (1/Day, 5th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: An enormous, illusory moon appears high above Anthyria, brightly illuminating a 60 foot radius area centered on a point she can see within 150 feet.

At the beginning of her next turn, it crashes to the ground. Each creature in the illuminated area must succeed on a {@dc 16} Intelligence saving throw or take 14 ({@dice 4d6}) radiant plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) thunder damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Take Flight
entries: When Anthyria is hit with a melee attack, she can move up to half her fly speed without provoking {@action opportunity attack||opportunity attacks}.

reaction.name: Mothdream Dust
entries: When Anthyria is hit with a melee attack, she can shed soporific scales from her wings.
The attacker must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or fall asleep for the next minute, or until a creature wakes it as an action or by dealing damage to it.

trait.name: Thunderous Stride
entries: If the apatosaurus moves on its turn, the ground within 15 ft. of it becomes difficult terrain for all other creatures until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the apatosaurus fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The apatosaurus makes three attacks, one of which may be with its head whip.

action.name: Stomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage. This attack deals an additional 9 ({@damage 2d8}) bludgeoning damage to a {@condition prone} creature.

action.name: Head Whip
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 20 ft., 1 target. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d10 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of the Apatosaurus' next turn.

action.name: Tail Sweep {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature in a 30 ft. cone must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or take 28 ({@damage 8d6}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}, or half as much on a success. A creature that fails by 5 or more cannot stand, speak, or breathe on its following turn.

trait.name: Reckless
entries: At the start of its turn, the ape can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls it makes during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Juggernaut Leap
entries: The ape's long jump is up to 30 feet and its high jump is up to 20 feet when it has a running start. If the ape jumps at least 20 feet, it may land in the space of any medium or smaller creature. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. On a successful save, is instead pushed 5 feet out of the ape's space into an unoccupied space of the creature's choice.

action.name: Multiattack

action.name: Bite

action.name: Rock

trait.name: Venal Nature

trait.name: Spell Trader

action.name: Multiattack

action.name: Arcane Insight
entries: One creature within 60 ft. must make a {@dc 17} Charisma Saving Throw. On a failure, the Arcanaloth discovers what spells the target has prepared and what unexpended spell slots they have.

action.name: Magic Barrage
entries: The arcanaloth unleashes a swarm of magical missiles that strike a creature within 120 feet, dealing 27 ({@damage 5d8 + 5}) force damage. A creature may halve this damage with the {@spell Shield} spell.

action.name: Steal Spell {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature within 60 feet must make a {@dc 17} Charisma save. On a failed save, the Arcanaloth casts a spell the creature has prepared, expending one of the creature's spell slots to do so. For the next minute, the creature cannot cast that spell.

action.name: Claws

action.name: Invisibility (2nd level spell)

reaction.name: Trickster's Escape

reaction.name: Shield (1st level spell)
entries: As a reaction to being hit with an attack, the Arcanaloth increases its AC by 5, including against the triggering attack, until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Counterspell (3rd level spell)
entries: As a reaction to seeing a creature within 60 feet cast a spell, the yugoloth may attempt to disrupt it, making an Intelligence ability check with DC equal to 10+ the spells level. This check succeeds automatically if the spell is 3rd level or below.

action.name: Dimension Door (4th Level Spell)

action.name: Immolation (5th level Spell, Concentration)

action.name: Disintegrate (1/Day, 6th Level Spell)

reaction.name: Shield (1st Level Spell)
entries: When the lich is targeted with an attack, it can add +5 to its AC until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Counterspell (3rd Level Spell)

reaction.name: Murderous Glare (1/Day, 9th Level Spell.)

reaction.name: Hallowed Balance (1/Day, 9th Level Spell)

variant.name: Note: Spells as Abilities
entries: I don't think a stat block should ever require you to reference another book/document, so I've chosen to turn all spells into spell-like abilities, at least in presentation. I've included spell levels for all spells of 1st level or higher for the purposes of counterspelling.

A spellcaster will typically not need every one of their spell slots for a 3-6 round combat, so many have fewer here. They also won't need a bunch of RP spells prepared for a combat encounter, which is what stat blocks are for after all. Minute resource tracking is for players. The DM has too much going on to have to worry about that.

languages: Thieves' cant plus any two languages

reaction.name: Crush

reaction.name: Toxic Sap
entries: When the assassin vine takes any piercing or slashing damage, it can exude a toxic sap, dealing 9 ({@damage 2d8}) poison damage to each creature {@condition grappled} by it.

trait.name: Astral Brace
entries: The dreadnought cannot be banished or teleported out of the Astral Plane.
A creature that hits the dreadnought with a melee weapon attack is pushed 15 feet away from it, unless it is grappling or {@condition attached|confc|attached} to the dreadnought.

trait.name: Giant Stature
entries: Attacks made against the dreadnought by a creature {@condition attached|confc|attached} to it have advantage, and the dreadnought has disadvantage on attacks it makes against creatures {@condition attached|confc|attached} to it.

trait.name: Keeper of the Gate (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
entries: If the dreadnought is reduced to 0 hit points, it doesn't die or fall {@condition unconscious}. Instead, it resets to 210 hit points and opens its eye wide, revealing the endless, star-filled void within.

For the next hour, a creature that deals 25 or more damage to the dreadnought with a melee weapon attack can make a {@dc 22} Strength check, gouging out the dreadnought's eye and Blinding it on a success.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the dreadnought fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dreadnought makes two attacks, one of which can be with its Timeless Maw.

action.name: Timeless Maw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}61 ({@damage 8d12 + 9}) piercing damage.
Instead of dealing damage, the dreadnought can force the target to succeed on a {@dc 24} Strength saving throw or be drawn into the dreadnought's donjon.
On a success, the target can prop the dreadnought's mouth open for a moment, allowing up to one creature within the donjon to use its reaction to escape.

action.name: Cordcutter Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}36 ({@damage 5d10 + 9}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 24}).
On a critical hit, a target affected by the {@spell Astral Projection} spell must succeed on a {@dc 24} Constitution saving throw or die.

reaction.name: Spell Rupture
entries: When a creature the dreadnought can see within 120 feet casts a spell, the dreadnought can scatter the magic, forcing the creature to make a {@dc 19} saving throw using its spellcasting attribute.

On a failure, the spell fails and its magical force explodes in a 15 foot radius centered on a point between the creature and the dreadnought, dealing 11 ({@damage 2d10}) force damage to each creature in the area.

legendary.name: Conduit Shift

Each creature in the 10 foot wide space it passes through must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity, Intelligence, or Charisma saving throw (target's choice) or be teleported to one of the planes the conduit connects to.

languages: telepathy (can communicate with any creature on the same plane of existence)

trait.name: Tentacles from Beyond
entries: Each creature that the kraken can see is treated as within its reach as space stretches and warps before its attacks.

trait.name: Incomprehensible Horror
entries: A creature that can see the kraken and is not afflicted with any sort of madness or reduction to its Wisdom score is {@condition frightened}.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the kraken fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

entries: When the kraken is reduced to 0 hit points, it does not die or fall {@condition unconscious}. Instead, the kraken chews a hole through reality and teleports to the far realm at the beginning of its following turn.
A creature that starts its turn within 500 feet of this screaming wound in space must succeed on a {@dc 23} Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to make a melee attack against itself or its ship.

action.name: Tentacle Lash

A creature reduced to 1 Wisdom in this way is {@condition charmed} by the kraken and hostile to all other creatures, though it endeavors to conceal this fact if possible.

entries: The kraken warps space, twisting until the kraken entirely envelops a 100 foot radius sphere centered on a point it can see within 50 feet, surrounding it in a blanket of black eyes and roiling flesh.

A creature in the sphere cannot leave by any means short of a Wish, its attacks bypass the kraken's damage resistances, and it takes 33 ({@damage 6d10}) psychic damage at the start of each of the kraken's turns.
A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage must succeed on a {@dc 23} Charisma saving throw or have its mind lost to the Far Realm until restored by a Wish or equivalent magic.
