entries: Creatures within 30 ft. of the atropal make death saving throws at disadvantage. A creature in the area with no unexpended hit dice that rolls a 1 on a death saving throw fades out of existence and cannot be returned to life by any means other than a {@spell Wish} spell.

trait.name: Quelling Aura
entries: The area in a 1 mile radius around the atropal is warded from the influence of the divine. Deities cannot sense or communicate with creatures in the area, divine interventions in the area fail except on a roll of 00, and cleric and paladin spell slots count as one level lower in the area.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: The atropal can't be affected or detected by spells of 1st level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Anti-Life Nature
entries: If the atropal would receive magical healing, it instead must succeed a Constitution saving throw against the spellcaster's save DC or take an equal amount of radiant damage. If the atropal takes any radiant damage, attacks made against the atropal have advantage until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The atropal makes two attacks with its life suppressing touch.

action.name: Life Suppressing Touch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}26 ({@damage 4d10 + 4}) necrotic damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or have its hit point maximum reduced to its current hit points until it completes a short or long rest.

action.name: Wretched Squall
entries: Each living creature within 60 ft. of the atropal must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) thunder damage and be {@condition deafened} until the end of its next turn.
A creature that fails by 5 or more is additionally unable to perform the verbal components of spells until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Necrotizing Beam {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature in a 90 ft. long, 10 ft. wide line from the atropal must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or take 55 ({@damage 10d10}) necrotic damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature that fails by 5 or more loses {@dice 1d10} unexpended hit dice, then drops to 0 hit points if it has no unexpended hit dice remaining.

legendary.name: Shroud of Death
entries: One creature the atropal can see within 60 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 18} Charisma saving throw or be cursed for the next minute. Whenever the cursed creature takes damage, it takes an additional 5 ({@damage 1d10}) necrotic damage. This curse ends early if the target receives magical healing.

legendary.name: The Dead Yet Live
entries: One undead creature within 30 ft. that was destroyed since the end of the atropal's last turn returns to undeath with 22 ({@dice 4d10}) hit points.

legendary.name: Atropos Burst (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The atropal releases a burst of negative energy centered on a dead or {@condition unconscious} creature within 60 ft. Each living creature within 15 ft. of the target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or take 11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Aura of Unmaking
entries: Creatures within 30 ft. of the atropal that make death saving throws roll three dice and take the lowest result. A creature in the area with no unexpended hit dice that rolls a 1 on a death saving throw fades out of existence and cannot be returned to life by any means other than a {@spell Wish} spell.

trait.name: Quelling Aura
entries: The area in a 1 mile radius around the atropal is warded from the influence of the divine. Deities cannot sense or communicate with creatures in the area, divine interventions in the area fail except on a roll of 00, and cleric and paladin spell slots count as two levels lower in the area.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: The atropal can't be affected or detected by spells of 2nd level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the atropal may spend half of its movement to attempt a {@dc 18} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the atropal. While climbing on the atropal, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the atropal.

trait.name: Anti-Life Nature
entries: If the atropal would receive magical healing, it instead must succeed a Constitution saving throw against the spellcaster's save DC or take an equal amount of radiant damage. If the atropal takes any radiant damage, attacks made against the atropal have advantage until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Implacable (5/Day)
entries: If the atropal fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The atropal makes two attacks with its life suppressing touch, one of which it may replace with its end magic or its death gaze.

action.name: Life Suppressing Touch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}38 ({@damage 6d10 + 5}) necrotic damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw or have its hit point maximum reduced to its current hit points until it completes a short or long rest.
This attack is made at advantage against a creature climbing on the atropal.

action.name: End Magic
entries: One creature within 60 ft. that the atropal can see must make a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the atropal ends each spell and magical effect affecting the creature, each spell it is {@status concentration||concentrating} on, and destroys one nonartifact magical item the creature is carrying.

action.name: Death Gaze
entries: One creature within 120 ft. that the atropal can see must succeed on a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw or drop to 0 hit points. A creature under the effects of Protection from Evil and Good or Death Ward has advantage on this saving throw.

action.name: Necrotizing Beam {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature in a 300 ft. long, 15 ft. wide line from the atropal must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw or take 105 ({@damage 10d10 + 50}) necrotic damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature that fails by 5 or more loses {@dice 1d20} unexpended hit dice, then drops to 0 hit points if it has no unexpended hit dice remaining.

reaction.name: Spawn Godling (2/Day)
entries: When the atropal takes 100 or more damage in a single turn, a piece of it rips off and rapidly grows into a

legendary.name: Shroud of Death
entries: One creature the atropal can see within 60 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 21} Charisma saving throw or be cursed for the next minute. Whenever the cursed creature takes damage, it takes an additional 11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage. This curse ends early if the target receives magical healing.

legendary.name: The Dead Yet Live
entries: One undead creature within 30 ft. that was destroyed since the end of the atropal's last turn returns to undeath with 33 ({@dice 6d10}) hit points.

legendary.name: Atropos Burst (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The atropal releases a burst of negative energy centered on a dead or {@condition unconscious} creature within 60 ft. Each living creature within 15 ft. of the target must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 4d10}) necrotic damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Foe-Climber
entries: The primate may spend half its movement to force a Medium or larger creature within 5 feet to make a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the primate climbs onto the creature.
While climbing on a creature, the primate moves with it and the creature has disadvantage on attack rolls that target the primate.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The primate has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the primate's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The primate makes two attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Whirling Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage.
On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or drop one item it is holding.

reaction.name: Topple
entries: As a reaction when a creature it is climbing on misses it with an attack, the primate forces the creature to succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Screeching Alert
entries: As a reaction when the primate detects a creature that is attempting to hide, it calls out a screeching bark.

Each allied creature within 60 feet that can hear the primate gains immunity to the Surprised condition until the end of the primate's next turn, and may use its reaction to attempt a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check to detect the hidden creature.

resist.note: damage from weapons that aren't named

trait.name: Eyes of Endless Night
entries: While she is not {@condition blinded}, Auril knows the location of each creature within 1000 feet of her.
If Auril takes any radiant damage, she must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the end of her next turn.

trait.name: Divine Rejuvination
entries: When Auril drops to 0 hit points, her body crystalizes to glistening ice which shatters in an instant, the shards hanging in air as more ice joins them to form her second Form, which appears in her space. Her initiative doesn't change.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Auril has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day in This Form)
entries: If Auril fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Auril makes two attacks with her Merciless Claws and uses either her Unrelenting Gaze or Frostfog Apparition.

action.name: Merciless Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@dice 2d8 + 3}) slashing plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) cold damage.
If this attack was made at advantage, the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone} and unable to stand on its following turn.

action.name: Sleet Deluge (2nd Level Spell)
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 13} to hit, range 90 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@dice 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) cold damage.

action.name: Unrelenting Gaze
entries: Auril fixes her inscrutable gaze upon a creature she can see within 60 feet. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of Auril's next turn. If the creature was already {@condition frightened}, it is instead {@condition paralyzed} until the end of her next turn.

action.name: Frostfog Apparition (2nd Level Spell)
entries: Auril's form shimmers and dissolves into a haze of freezing fog, coalescing and reappearing at a point she can see within 30 feet of where she disappeared.

action.name: Glacial Hiss {@recharge 5}
entries: Auril lets forth a piercing hiss in a 30 foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or take 13 ({@dice 3d8}) thunder plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) cold damage, then gain a number of temporary hit points equal to the cold damage taken. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and gains no temporary hit points.
While a creature has any of these these temporary hit points, it is {@condition restrained} and cannot be stabilized.

reaction.name: Freeze Breath
entries: As a reaction when a creature Auril can see within 60 feet attempts to cast a spell, Auril forces the creature to make a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw.
On a failed save, the creature must use a spell slot of one level higher to cast the spell, or have the spell fail.

reaction.name: Crone's Vengeance (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 100 hit points, Auril teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space she can see and makes two attacks with her Merciless Claws at advantage.

legendary.name: Cloak of Feathers
entries: Auril moves up to half her fly speed. {@action opportunity attack||Attacks of opportunity} provoked by this movement are made at disadvantage.

legendary.name: Winter's Tribute (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: One creature Auril can see within 60 feet must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) cold damage. The creature may sacrifice any number of unexpended hit dice or spell slots, preventing 5 of this damage per hit die or spell level expended.
A creature who takes no damage from this ability has advantage on saving throws imposed by Auril until the end of her next turn.

legendary.name: Unrelenting Gaze (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Auril uses her Unrelenting Gaze.

resist.note: damage from weapons that aren't named

trait.name: Rimeclad
entries: If Auril takes any fire damage, her AC is reduced by 1 until the beginning of her next turn.

trait.name: Divine Rejuvination
entries: When Auril drops to 0 hit points, her body turns to slush and sloughs away, revealing her Third Form, which appears in her space. Her initiative doesn't change.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Auril has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day in This Form)
entries: If Auril fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Auril makes two melee attacks, each of which she may replace with her Ensoul Ice.

action.name: Frostkiss, Ice Morningstar
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@dice 3d8 + 4}) slashing plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) cold damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away.
On a missed attack, the weapon shatters, dealing 5 ({@damage 2d4}) cold damage to the target and each creature within 5 feet of it.

action.name: Ensoul Ice
entries: Auril breaks an icicle from her body and hurls it to an unoccupied space she can see within 20 feet, where it transforms into an

action.name: Glacial Spire
entries: Auril calls forth a 10 foot spike of ice from the ground in a space she can see within 90 feet. A creature in that space must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take 10 ({@dice 3d6}) piercing plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) cold damage.

action.name: Gale of the Long Night (6th Level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: Auril sends forth a blast of cold and clinging darkness in a 60 foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or take 27 ({@damage 8d8}) cold damage and be {@condition blinded} until the end of Auril's next turn, or take half as much damage on a success.
A creature may expend three spell levels worth of spell slots or three unexpended hit dice to gain advantage on this saving throw.

reaction.name: Frozen Palisade
entries: As a reaction to a creature entering her reach, Auril uses her Glacial Spire, targeting the creature's space. If the creature fails its save, its movement is reduced to 0 until the end of its turn.

reaction.name: Revoke Souls (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 105 hit points, Auril causes any number of Ice Mephits under her control to explode. Instead of their normal Death Burst, each creature within 20 feet of at least one mephit destroyed in this way must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 3d8}) piercing damage, or half as much a success.

legendary.name: Ice Growth
entries: Auril gains 5 temporary hit points or extrudes a new Frostkiss, Ice Morningstar to replace a shattered one.

legendary.name: Winter's Stillness
entries: One creature Auril can see within 30 feet gains 5 temporary hit points. While a creature has any of these temporary hit points, its movement speed is reduced by 10 feet and it can't expend any resources that return on a Short or Long Rest.

legendary.name: Icefall Charge (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Auril moves up to her speed and makes a melee attack at advantage. If the attack hits, the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

resist.note: damage from weapons that aren't named

trait.name: Divine Resurrection
entries: When Auril drops to 0 hit points, her crystalline form shatters and her divine spark flares, then fades. Each creature that can see her within 60 feet must succeed on a {@dc 21} Charisma saving throw or drop to 0 hit points and be {@condition blinded} until it completes a Long Rest.
At the next winter solstice, Auril reappears at full health in a cold, remote location of her choice.

trait.name: Unearthly Cold
entries: Auril's attacks and abilities ignore other creatures' resistance or immunity to cold.

trait.name: Frigid Aura
entries: At the start of each of her turns, each creature within 10 feet of her must expend 2 unexpended hit die, or gain a point of {@condition exhaustion} if it cannot.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Auril has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day in This Form)
entries: If Auril fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Auril uses her Polar Ray twice.

action.name: Polar Ray
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 13} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) cold damage.

action.name: Dazzling Gleam {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature within 20 feet that can see Auril must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw or take 11 ({@damage 2d10}) radiant damage and be {@condition blinded} for the next minute. A {@condition blinded} creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

reaction.name: Spell Refraction
entries: As a reaction when she is forced to make saving throw against a spell, Auril may cast a copy of it, using the original caster's save DC. The original spell takes effect first.

reaction.name: Divine Brilliance (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 94 hit points, Auril makes a Polar Ray attack against each creature of her choice within range.

legendary.name: Polar Ray
entries: Auril uses her Polar Ray.

legendary.name: Impenetrable Facing
entries: Auril chooses one creature she can see. Until the end of her next turn, Auril reduces any piercing or slashing damage dealt to her by that creature by 10.

legendary.name: Winter's Triumph
entries: Auril draws a torrent of icy winds to herself. Each creature within 60 feet of her must succeed on a {@dc 21} Strength saving throw or be pulled 5 feet toward her for each expended hit die it has.

trait.name: Stampede
entries: When the aurochs moves, each adjacent aurochs may use its reaction to move with it. If one or more aurochs do so, the aurochs has advantage on attack rolls this turn.

trait.name: Trampling Charge
entries: If the aurochs moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. If the target is {@condition prone}, the aurochs can make one attack with its hooves against it as a bonus action.

trait.name: Reckless Follow-Through
entries: At the start of its turn, the aurochs can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn. If it misses with an attack this turn, it is {@condition stunned} until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Gore
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d10 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Hooves
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Treasure Sense
entries: The aurumvorax can pinpoint, by scent, the location of precious metals and stones, such as coins and gems, within 60 ft. of it.

trait.name: Ornery
entries: The aurumvorax does not die or fall {@condition unconscious} due to dropping to 0 HP if it was attacked by a hostile creature since the end of its previous turn. If the badger starts its turn with 0 HP without having been attacked since the end of its previous turn, it dies.

trait.name: Incredible Density
entries: The aurumvorax has advantage on attempts to shove creatures, and on Strength and Dexterity saving throws made against effects that would shove it or knock it {@condition prone}. The aurumvorax may grapple or shove creatures up to three sizes larger than it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The aurumvorax makes five attacks: one with its locking jaws and four with its scrabbling claws. It may replace any of its claw attacks with a Shove attempt.

action.name: Locking Jaws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled}. Until this grapple ends, the aurumvorax can bite only the {@condition grappled} creature and has advantage on attack rolls to do so.

action.name: Scrabbling Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) piercing damage. If this attack is made at advantage, it does an additional 2 ({@damage 1d4}) damage.

variant.name: Note: Treasure Beasts
entries: The corpse of an aurumvorax contains roughly 150-200 lbs of gold that may be smelted from it, for a total value of 3,000-4,000 gp. Its hide can be used as a component in crafting Armor of Fire Resistance.

hp.special: Half the hit point maximum of its summoner.

trait.name: Inevitable
entries: The avatar knows the exact positon of its creator, and can't be hidden from by any means.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The avatar can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Creeping Return
entries: When the avatar is reduced to 0 hit points it does not die or fall {@condition unconscious}. Instead, it loses the ability to take actions and silently leaves. Whenever its summoner attempts to rest while it has no unexpended hit dice, roll a {@dice D 100}. On a roll of 5 or below, the avatar is summoned once more.

action.name: Touch of the Inevitable
entries: One creature within 5 feet has its Charisma score reduced by 3 ({@dice 1d6}) for the next minute, then the avatar teleports at least 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.
A creature that has its Charisma score reduced to 0 in this way dies and can't be restored to life by any means.

trait.name: Godlike Resistance
entries: If Tiamat fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead. If she does, she regains two fewer legendary action on her following turn.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: Unless she wishes to be affected, Tiamat is immune to spells of 6th level or lower. She has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Titanic Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to Tiamat may spend 30 feet of movement to attempt a {@dc 18} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto tiamat. While climbing on Tiamat, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against her, and she can make no more than one bite attack against that creature each turn.

trait.name: Multitrack Machinations
entries: Tiamat may concentrate on up to five spells simultaneously. She regains one fewer legendary action at the beginning of her turn for each spell she is {@status concentration||concentrating} on beyond the first. If she fails a {@status concentration} check, she loses {@status concentration} on all spells she is {@status concentration||concentrating} on.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Tiamat can use her Maddening Presence. She then makes five attacks: four with her bite and one with her tail. She may replace all of her bite attacks with a use of her worry ability.

action.name: Paragon Breath
entries: Tiamat exhales elemental energy in a 300-foot cone, or 300 foot long, 15 foot wide line (Tiamat's choice). Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 26} Dexterity or Constitution saving throw (Tiamat's choice), taking 91 ({@damage 26d6}) damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The damage type is either Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison (Tiamat's choice).

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 19} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}24 ({@damage 4d6 + 10}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled}. While a head grapples a target, the head can attack only that target.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 19} to hit, reach 25 ft., one target. {@h}28 ({@damage 4d8 + 10}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 25 feet away and knocked {@condition prone}. Each creature within 20 feet of the target must succeed on a {@dc 26} Dexterity saving throw or take half as much damage, be pushed back 10 feet and be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Worry
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by at least two of Tiamat's heads must succeed on a {@dc 23} Constitution throw or take 110 ({@damage 20d10}) piercing damage, or half as much on a success. A creature makes this save at disadvantage if it is {@condition grappled} by three or more of Tiamat's heads. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage is ripped in half and dies.

action.name: Maddening Presence
entries: Each creature of Tiamat's choice that is within 240 feet of Tiamat and aware of her must succeed on a DC: 26 Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. While {@condition frightened} in this way, a creature takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) psychic damage at the start of each of its turns, and must use its turn to either dash away or attempt to hide. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Tiamat's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

legendary.name: Bite
entries: Tiamat makes a bite attack.

legendary.name: Wing Attack
entries: Tiamat beats her wings. Each creature within 30 feet of her must succeed on a {@dc 26} Dexterity saving throw or take 17 ({@damage 2d6 + 10}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}. Tiamat can then fly up to half its flying speed

legendary.name: Breath Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Tiamat uses her Paragon Breath ability.

legendary.name: Wish (9th level spell, Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Tiamat casts any spell of 8th level or below.

monster.name: Awakened Shrub
languages: One language known by its creator

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the shrub remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal shrub.

trait.name: Rooted
entries: The shrub makes saving throws and ability checks to resist being forced to move or be knocked {@condition prone} at advantage. If the shrub is forced to move or knocked {@condition prone}, it loses 3 ({@dice 1d6}) hit points.

action.name: Rake
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 1} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 ({@damage 1d4 - 1}) slashing damage.

action.name: Throw Rock
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 1} to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. {@h}1 ({@damage 1d4 - 1}) bludgeoning damage. If the shrub was hidden, this attack does not reveal its position.

action.name: Rustle
entries: The shrub rustles as though something were moving around inside it. Creatures within 30 ft. that can hear it have disadvantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks made to perceive any creature other than the shrub until the end of its next turn.

monster.name: Awakened Tree
languages: One language known by its creator

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the tree remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal tree.

trait.name: Wooden Body
entries: If the tree takes fire damage, it catches fire. Until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the tree takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage at the start of each of the tree's turns, and all attacks against the tree are made at advantage. While on fire, the tree's melee attacks deal an additional 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage.

trait.name: Rooted
entries: The tree makes saving throws and ability checks to resist being forced to move or be knocked {@condition prone} at advantage. If the tree is forced to move or knocked {@condition prone}, it loses 19 ({@dice 3d12}) hit points.

action.name: Branch Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Hurl Rock
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Writhing Roots {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature within 15 ft. of the tree must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The axe beak has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the axe beak's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Burst of Speed {@recharge}
entries: The axe beak may dash as a bonus action.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) slashing damage. This attack deals an additional 4 ({@damage 1d8}) damage to a {@condition prone} target.

action.name: Kick
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d6 + 2}) piercing damage. On a critical hit, the target is knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Heated Body
entries: A creature that touches the azer or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it catches fire; until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the creature takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

trait.name: Illumination
entries: The azer sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet.

action.name: Stoking Warhammer
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage, plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage if the target is on fire.

action.name: Chains of Fire (5-6)
entries: Each creature that is on fire within 15 feet of the azer must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} until the end of the Azer's next turn.

trait.name: Shadow Clones
entries: Whenever the babau teleports, it leaves behind a copy of itself with the following traits:
The clone has 1 hit point and dies at the end of the babau's next turn.
When the clone dies, each creature within 5 feet of it takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) acid damage.
When the babau moves, one of its clones can move the same distance.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The babau makes two attacks with its Flickering Claw, one of which it may replace with a use of its Murderous Abduction, if available.

action.name: Flickering Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) slashing damage and the babau teleports up to 10 feet.
The babau can have this attack originate from one of its clones or from itself.

action.name: Murderous Abduction {@recharge 5}
entries: The babau and up to one creature within 5 feet of it each teleport up to 30 feet in the same direction.
An unwilling and conscious creature can make a {@dc 13} Charisma saving throw, resisting the effect on a success.

reaction.name: Weakening Glare
entries: When the babau is targeted with a melee attack, the babau can force the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or have the attack's damage reduced by half.

trait.name: Shadow Clones
entries: Whenever the babau or one of its clones teleports, it leaves behind a clone of itself with the following traits:
The clone has 1 hit point and dies at the end of the babau's next turn.
When the clone dies, each creature within 5 feet of it takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) acid damage.
When the babau moves, one of its clones can move the same distance.

trait.name: Spread Spirit (2/Day)
entries: If the babau fails a saving throw while it has two or more shadow clones active, it can choose to succeed instead.
If it does, each of those shadow clones dies.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The babau makes two attacks with its Flickering Claw, each of which it can replace Murderous Abduction, if available.

action.name: Flickering Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) slashing damage and the babau (or the attacking clone) teleports up to 10 feet.
The babau can have this attack originate from one of its clones or from itself.

action.name: Murderous Abduction {@recharge 5}
entries: The babau and up to one creature within 5 feet of it each teleport up to 30 feet in the same direction.
An unwilling and conscious creature can make a {@dc 14} Charisma saving throw, resisting the effect on a success.

reaction.name: Weakening Glare
entries: When the babau is targeted with a melee attack, the babau can force the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or have the attack's damage reduced by half.

legendary.name: Wispdash
entries: The babau teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 20 feet.

legendary.name: Clone Command
entries: The babau impels one of its shadow clones can move up to 20 feet and make a Flickering Claw attack.

legendary.name: Rend Magic (Costs 2 Actions, 3rd Level Spell)
entries: The controller of one spell or magical effect the babau can see within 60 feet must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or have the spell or effect end.

trait.name: Reckless
entries: At the start of its turn, the baboon can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls it makes during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The baboon has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the baboon's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Juggernaut Leap
entries: The baboon's long jump is up to 30 feet and its high jump is up to 20 feet when it has a running start. If the baboon jumps at least 20 feet, it may land in the space of any medium or smaller creature. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. On a successful save, is instead pushed 5 feet out of the baboon's space into an unoccupied space of the creature's choice.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d6}) piercing damage.

action.name: Screeching Bark
entries: Each creature within 100 ft. that can hear, but not see the baboon must make a {@dc 10} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} for the next minute. A creature may repeat this save at the end of its turn, ending the effect on a success.

trait.name: Retract Head
entries: As a Bonus Action, the kyoka may retract its limbs and head into its shell and end its turn. Until the beginning of its next turn, the kyoka's AC is increased to 18 and it can't take reactions.

trait.name: Laborious Rocking
entries: When the kyoka attempts to stand from {@condition prone}, it must make a {@dc 20} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check in addition to spending half its movement, remaining {@condition prone} on a failure.

action.name: Jagged Nip
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 0} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target wielding a weapon made of wood or other organic material. {@h}The kyoka attaches to the weapon.

While attached, attacks with the weapon are made at disadvantage and the kyoka is dragged with the weapon until it releases its bite as a Bonus Action. A creature may attempt to remove the kyoka as an action with a {@dc 8} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.

action.name: Obstinate Plant
entries: Until the beginning of its next turn, the kyoka gains advantage on Strength checks and saving throws, and a Medium or Large creature that attempts to move through its space must succeed on {@dc 11} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The badger has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Ornery
entries: The badger does not die or fall {@condition unconscious} due to dropping to 0 HP if it was attacked by a hostile creature since the end of its previous turn. If the badger starts its turn with 0 HP without having been attacked since the end of its previous turn, it dies.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}({@dice 1d1}) piercing damage.

variant.name: Note: Rules Reminder
entries: A wildshaped druid reverts to its normal form when it drops to 0 hit points.

monster.name: Baelnorn
languages: Common plus up to five other languages

trait.name: Norn Rejuvenation
entries: If the baelnorn is destroyed, one of its descendants may perform a ritual in which they invite the baelnorn's spirit to assume their body. The descendant remains for a time as a passenger in its former body, and may pass into death at will at any point.

trait.name: Entangling Aura
entries: A creature that hits the lich with a melee attack must succeed on a {@dc 21} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 21}) until the end of the lich's next turn as vines burst forth from the nearest surface to entangle it.

trait.name: Water Walk
entries: The baelnorn can walk across any liquid surface as if it was solid ground.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the baelnorn fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The baelnorn uses its Lignify and makes three attacks with its Wraithblade, one of which it may replace with a use of its Forced Growth or Splinterburst.

action.name: Wraithblade
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}24 ({@damage 4d8 + 6}) necrotic damage. This attack treats the target as unarmored (An unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier).

action.name: Lignify (5th Level Spell)
entries: One creature within 120 feet the baelnorn can see must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw or have its flesh begin to turn to wood, gaining the Plant type in addition to its other creature types, plus one additional effect of the baelnorn's choice until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic:
The creature's movement speed is reduced by half and it cannot fly.
The creature can't take bonus actions or reactions.
The creature gains vulnerability to fire damage.
The creature takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) fire damage whenever it deals fire damage.

action.name: Forced Growth {@recharge 5}
entries: The lich causes a tree 15 feet across and up to 100 feet tall to burst forth from the ground at a point it can see within 120 feet.
Each creature in the tree's space when it appears and each flying creature within 20 feet of it must make a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw, moving to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

On a failed save, a creature takes 22 ({@damage 4d10}) bludgeoning damage and is launched to the tree's top. A creature that failed this save by 5 or fewer may use its reaction to grasp a branch and avoid falling.

action.name: Splinterburst (Recharges when the baelnorn uses its Forced Growth)
entries: One tree the baelnorn can see within 60 feet explodes in a hail of massive splinters.
Each creature within 15 feet of the tree must succeed on a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw or take 27 ({@damage 6d8}) piercing damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Briar Shield
entries: When the baelnorn is targeted with an attack, it can conjure a barrier of thorny vines, gaining 20 temporary hit points that last until the beginning of its next turn.
While it has any of these temporary hit points, a creature that hits it with a melee attack takes 5 piercing damage.

reaction.name: Withering Wail (1/Day, 9th Level Spell)
entries: When the baelnorn is reduced below 112 hit points, it can sing out a cruel and keening note.
Each plant within 60 feet withers and blackens, and each plant creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw or drop to 0 hit points.

legendary.name: Zephyr Step
entries: The baelnorn gains a fly speed equal to its movement speed until the beginning of its next turn and moves up to half its speed.

legendary.name: Hollowheart Harvest
entries: One plant creature or elf the baelnorn can see within 5 feet loses up to 3 unexpended hit dice. The baelnorn regains {@dice 1d8} hit points for each hit die lost in this way.

legendary.name: Deadwood Awakening (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The baelnorn reanimates the wooden portion of a weapon or shield it can see, transforming it into a {@creature vine blight|confc|Vine Blight} that acts on the baelnorn's turn under its control.
If the weapon was magical, it transforms back after the vine blight is destroyed, and cannot be affected by this ability again.

legendary.name: Wraithstorm Charge (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The baelnorn moves up to its speed without provoking {@action opportunity attack||opportunity attacks} and makes two attacks with its Wraithblade.
It may pass through solid objects and creatures with this movement.

monster.name: Baigujing
languages: The languages it knew in life

trait.name: Voice of Two Mouths
entries: When the baigujing speaks a lie, each creature not {@condition charmed} by the baigujing instead hears its surface thoughts.

action.name: Sainted Drain
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature {@h}18 ({@damage 4d6 + 4}) necrotic damage.
A cleric or paladin hit with this attack must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or lose two unexpended hit dice, or drop to 0 hit points if it can't.

action.name: Bitter Offering
entries: The baigujing hands a piece of food to a creature within 5 feet.

A creature {@condition charmed} by the baigujing cannot voluntarily relinquish the food and must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw at the beginning of each of its turns or eat it, taking 28 ({@damage 8d6}) poison damage.
If the food is dropped, it transforms into a {@creature Ruby-Headed Centipede|ConfC} under the baigujing's control.

action.name: Bones of Jade, Flesh of Snow (Concentration)
entries: The baigujing takes on a humanoid form that lasts until it deals any damage.
While transformed, humanoid creatures not proficient in {@skill Insight} are {@condition charmed} by the baigujing.

reaction.name: False Death
entries: When the baigujing takes any damage while transformed with its Bones of Jade, Flesh of Snow, it can abandon its body, leaving behind a corpse.
The baigujing immediately reforms in an unoccupied space of its choice within 500 feet.

trait.name: Soundless Stalk
entries: The bakeneko counts as Hidden from any creature that cannot see it.

trait.name: Gnaw Through
entries: The bakeneko can burrow a Small hole through one foot of nonmagical wood, stone, or steel in ten minutes.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bakeneko makes two attacks with its Secret Needles, one of which it can replace with a use of its Stumbling Dance.

action.name: Secret Needles
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) piercing or slashing damage.
This attack has advantage against a Surprised target, or one the bakeneko started its turn Hidden from.

action.name: Stumbling Dance (Cat Form Only, Concentration)
entries: Spectral flames wreath the bakeneko's tail.
Whenever the bakeneko leaves a creature's reach, it can force that creature to succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or begin {@condition burning|confc|burning} ({@dice 1d10}).

bonus.name: Death-Puppet Spring
entries: The bakeneko leaps up to 10 feet without provoking {@action opportunity attack||opportunity attacks}.

Each humanoid corpse that has been dead fewer than 49 days that the bakeneko leaps over in this way immediately rises as a {@creature horde ghoul|confc|Horde Ghoul} that acts on the bakeneko's turn and under its control.

bonus.name: Change Shape
entries: The bakeneko assumes the form of a Medium or smaller humanoid creature it has touched, or returns to its Small cat form. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its cat form if it dies.

trait.name: Dead Magic Grip
entries: A creature {@condition grappled} by the balhannoth that attempts to cast a spell with a casting time of one Action must first roll a {@dice d20}. On an 11 or higher, the spell doesn't take effect until the creature's next turn, and the creature must use its action on that turn to complete the spell.

trait.name: Superior Camouflage
entries: The balhannoth is {@condition invisible} to creatures more than 10 feet away from it. It may attempt to hide without cover.

trait.name: False Hope
entries: The landscape in a 500 ft. radius around the balhannoth warps to fit ideas of safety and security it gleans from passing creatures through telepathic eavesdropping.
The balhannoth cannot create functional or moving objects in this way, and close inspection of objects created in this way reveals them to be facsimiles.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
entries: If the balhannoth fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The balhannoth makes a bite attack and up to two tentacle attacks, or it makes up to four tentacle attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}25 ({@damage 4d10 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}) and is moved up to 5 feet toward the balhannoth. Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the balhannoth can't use this tentacle against other targets. The balhannoth has four tentacles.

legendary.name: Drain Magic
entries: Each creature {@condition grappled} by the balhannoth must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitiution saving throw or lose its highest level unexpended spell slot. The balhannoth gains 4 ({@dice 1d8}) temporary hit points for each spell level expended this way.

legendary.name: Teleport
entries: The balhannoth magically teleports, along with each creature it has {@condition grappled}, up to 30 ft. to an unoccupied space.

legendary.name: Bite (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The balhannoth makes a bite attack against a creature it has {@condition grappled}.

trait.name: Death Throes
entries: When the balor dies, it explodes, and each creature within 30 feet of it must make a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw, taking 70 ({@damage 20d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Blazing Gaze
entries: When a creature that the balor can see and that can see the balor's eyes starts its turn within 15 feet of it, it catches fire. Until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the creature takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid this effect at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the balor until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the balor may spend half of its movement to attempt a {@dc 22} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the balor. While climbing on the balor, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the balor, and the balor has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

trait.name: Limited Magic Resistance
entries: The balor has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects. On saving throws against magical effects that would Blind it, the balor has disadvantage, instead of advantage.

trait.name: Legendary Resistances (3/Day)
entries: If the balor fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The balor makes two melee attacks with different weapons, one of which it may replace with a use of its Teleport.

action.name: Headripper Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 15} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}27 ({@damage 3d12 + 8}) piercing damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be decapitated.

action.name: Lightning Blade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 15} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d8 + 8}) slashing damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) lightning damage. On a critical hit with this attack, the balor rolls damage dice three times, instead of twice.
Each other creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a {@dc 23} Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

action.name: Burning Lash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 15} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}43 ({@damage 10d6 + 8}) fire damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 25 feet toward the balor.
For each roll of 6 on the damage dice, this attack deals an additional {@damage d6} fire damage.

action.name: Teleport (7th Level Spell)
entries: The balor and each creature climbing on it magically teleport up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

reaction.name: Brutal Display
entries: When a friendly creature within 30 feet misses with an attack, the balor can make an attack against it with its Burning Lash.
Each other demon within 30 feet gains advantage on the first attack it makes on its following turn.

legendary.name: Meteor Stride
entries: The balor moves up to half its fly speed, then drops to the ground. Each creature in the space where it lands is pushed to the nearest unoccupied space and must succeed on a {@dc 23} Dexterity saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 3d8}) bludgeoning damage.

legendary.name: Wrathful Devotion (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The balor lets out a teeth-rattling roar of challenge. Each creature of the balor's choice within 30 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 21} Wisdom saving throw or be unable to target creatures other than the balor with attacks or harmful spells until the beginning of the balor's next turn.

legendary.name: Inspire Bloodlust (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The balor teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see and makes an attack.
Each demon within 120 feet of the balor that can see it may use its reaction to move up to half its speed directly toward the attack's target.

trait.name: Death Throes
entries: When the balor dies, it explodes, and each creature within 30 feet of it must make a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw, taking 70 ({@damage 20d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Blazing Gaze
entries: When a creature that the balor can see and that can see the balor's eyes starts its turn within 15 feet of it, it catches fire. Until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the creature takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid this effect at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the balor until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the balor may spend half of its movement to attempt a {@dc 22} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the balor. While climbing on the balor, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the balor, and the balor has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

trait.name: Limited Magic Resistance
entries: The balor has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects. On saving throws against magical effects that would Blind it, the balor has disadvantage, instead of advantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The balor makes two attacks: one with its lightning blade and one with its burning lash. It may replace one of its attacks with a use of its Teleport.

action.name: Lightning Blade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d8 + 8}) slashing damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) lightning damage. On a critical hit with this attack, the balor rolls damage dice three times, instead of twice.
Each other creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a {@dc 22} Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

action.name: Burning Lash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}43 ({@damage 10d6 + 8}) fire damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 25 feet toward the balor.
For each roll of 6 on the damage dice, this attack deals an additional {@damage d6} fire damage.

action.name: Teleport (7th Level Spell)
entries: The balor and each creature climbing on it magically teleport up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

monster.name: Banderhobb Abductor
languages: Common and the languages of its creator but cant speak

trait.name: Resonant Connection
entries: If the banderhobb has even a tiny piece of a creature or an object in its possession, such as a lock of hair or a splinter of wood, it knows the most direct route to that creature or object if it is within 1 mile of the banderhobb.

trait.name: Shadow Diver
entries: The banderhobb treats areas of dim light or darkness as arbitrarily deep, interconnected pools of water. It can be faintly seen and targeted while submerged in these shadow-pools, though other creatures cannot ordinarily pass into them unless carried by a banderhobb.

trait.name: Extradimensional Gullet
entries: Creatures swallowed by the banderhobb are teleported to a demiplane roughly 10 ft. in diameter with walls that appear to be covered in giant humanoid faces made of the banderhob's flesh; it has following attributes:
A creature that starts its turn in the demiplane takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage.

The walls of the demiplane have AC 20 and 30 hit points. If ruptured, each creature in the demiplane appears within 10 ft. of the banderhob. If the banderhobb is submerged in a shadow pool, the creatures appear at the surface of the nearest entrance.
If ruptured, the banderhobb's gullet is restored on a short or long rest.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 5d6 + 5}) piercing damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape DC: 15) if it is a Large or smaller creature. Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the banderhobb can't use its bite attack or tongue attack on another target.

action.name: Tongue
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage, and the target must make a DC: 15 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the target is pulled to a space within 5 feet of the banderhobb, which can use a bonus action to make a bite attack against the target.

action.name: Swallow
entries: The banderhobb makes a bite attack against a Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. The swallowed creature is teleported to the banderhobb's extradimensional gullet.

monster.name: Banderhobb Filch
languages: Common and the languages of its creator but cant speak

trait.name: Resonant Connection
entries: If the banderhobb has even a tiny piece of a creature or an object in its possession, such as a lock of hair or a splinter of wood, it knows the most direct route to that creature or object if it is within 1 mile of the banderhobb.

trait.name: Shadow Diver
entries: The banderhobb treats areas of dim light or darkness as arbitrarily deep, interconnected pools of water. It can be faintly seen and targeted while submerged in these shadow-pools, though other creatures cannot ordinarily pass into them unless carried by a banderhobb.

trait.name: Shadow Squeezer
entries: As a bonus action, the banderhobb may attempt a {@dc 13} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check to squeeze through a shadow between 1 inch and 2 ft. in diameter, using its Shadow Diver trait. If it fails by fewer than 5, it is still able to squeeze through, but leaves its People Sack behind.

trait.name: People Sack
entries: The banderhobb carries a magical burlap sack with the following properties:
The sack is an extradimensional space that can hold up to 4 Medium creatures. The weight and appearance of the sack are not affected by the creatures in it.
A creature that starts its turn in the sack must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or fall asleep until a creature takes an action to wake it.

The sack has AC 15, 20 hit points, and vulnerability to slashing damage. If ruptured, each creature in the sack appears within 5 ft. of the banderhobb. If the banderhobb is submerged in a shadow pool, the creatures appear at the surface of the nearest entrance.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The banderhobb makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled}.

action.name: Into the Sack!
entries: One creature the banderhobb is grappling or hidden from must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or be thrown into the banderhobb's People Sack.

trait.name: Thieves' Bravado
entries: While the bandit has more allies than enemies within 30 feet, it has advantage on attacks and Wisdom saving throws. While it has fewer allies than enemies within 30 feet, it has disadvantage on attacks and Wisdom saving throws.

trait.name: Pocket Sand
entries: When the bandit misses with a melee attack it may hurl sand at the same target as a bonus action. The target must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the end of the bandit's next turn.

action.name: Cutpurse Dagger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) piercing damage. On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a {@dc 11} Dexterity Saving Throw or have an item that is worn or carried, but not wielded, stolen.

action.name: Light Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 3} to hit, range 80 ft./320 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Outlaw's Bravado
entries: While the bandit has more allies than enemies within 30 feet, it has advantage on attacks and Wisdom saving throws.
While it has fewer allies than enemies within 30 feet, it has disadvantage on attacks and Wisdom saving throws.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the bandit takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the bandit takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

action.name: Whistling Bolts (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 3} to hit, range 80 ft., one target. {@h}2 piercing damage.

action.name: Desperate Feint
entries: The bandit forces one creature within 5 feet to use its reaction, if available, to make a melee attack with disadvantage against it.
If the attack misses, the creature falls {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Outlaw's Bravado
entries: While the bandit has more allies than enemies within 30 feet, it has advantage on attacks and Wisdom saving throws.
While it has fewer allies than enemies within 30 feet, it has disadvantage on attacks and Wisdom saving throws.

trait.name: Hostage-Taker

entries: Up to three friendly humanoid creatures within 60 feet that can hear the bandit may each use their reaction to make a ranged weapon attack, move up to half their speed, or attempt to {@action Hide}.

monster.name: Banshee
languages: Any languages it knew in life

trait.name: Ill Omen
entries: When initiative is rolled, the banshee forces one creature it can see to succeed on {@dc 13} Charisma saving throw or be cursed. While cursed in this way, a creature subtracts {@dice 1d8} from the result of any Wisdom saving throws it makes.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The banshee can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Weightless
entries: Whenever the banshee takes damage, it is pushed 10 feet away from the damage's source.

trait.name: Spectral Weapons
entries: The banshee's attacks treat all creatures as unarmored (an unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier.)

trait.name: Unfinished Business
entries: When the banshee is reduced to 0 hit points, it does not die or fall {@condition unconscious}. Instead, it loses the ability to take actions, though it can still communicate. After 24 hours, the banshee recovers all of its hit points. While at 0 hit points, the banshee can be destroyed any of the following ways:
Resolving its unifinished business.
Subjecting it to the same conditions that killed it.
Performing funeral rites for it with the {@spell Ceremony|XGE} spell.

action.name: Corrupting Touch
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 4d6 + 1}) necrotic damage and plants within 10 feet of the target wither and die.

action.name: Horrifying Visage
entries: Each non-undead creature within 60 feet of the banshee that can see her must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} for 1 minute (Save Ends at end of Turn), or become immune to this effect for 24 hours on a success.
A creature that fails this save by 5 or more has its face twist into a permanent rictus of terror until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

reaction.name: Wail (1/Day)
entries: Wail (1/Day, Concentration). When the banshee is reduced below 41 hit points while not in sunlight, it releases a ceaseless, mournful wail for the next minute.
A living creature that starts its turn within 30 feet that can hear her takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) psychic damage.
A living creature that ends its turn within 30 feet that can hear her is reduced to 0 hit points.

trait.name: Reckless Follow-Through
entries: At the beginning of Baphomet's turn, they can gain advantage on all melee attacks until the beginning of their next turn.
If one of these attacks misses, Baphomet falls {@condition prone} and is {@condition stunned} until the beginning of their next turn.

trait.name: Giant Stature
entries: A creature within 5 feet of Baphomet may spend half of its movement to attempt to climb onto them with a successful {@dc 18} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. Attacks made against Baphomet by a creature climbing on them have advantage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Baphomet has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Bestial Juggernaut
entries: At the beginning of Baphomet's turn, each effect that would Incapacitate them, immobilize them, or alter their form ends. If Baphomet is forced to make an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma saving throw, attacks against them have advantage until the beginning of their next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Baphomet makes three melee attacks, one of which may be with their Gore. If Baphomet has fewer than 262 hit points, they may make any of their attacks with their Gore.

action.name: Gore
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 17} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}29 ({@damage 3d12 + 10}) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 25} Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away and knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Hooves
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 17} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 2d10 + 10}) bludgeoning damage. This attack deals an additional 11 ({@damage 2d10}) damage to a {@condition prone} creature.

action.name: Heartcleaver
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 17} to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. {@h}24 ({@damage 3d8 + 10}) slashing damage. On a critical hit, the target suffers one additional effect selected at random:

items.name: 1. Curse of Brutality
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 22} Charisma saving throw or be cursed. While cursed, a creature's appearance becomes partialy bestial, and the creature cannot cast spells of 5th level or above.

items.name: 2. Crush Bones
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 25} Constitution saving throw or suffer disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws that use Strength until it completes a long rest.

items.name: 3. Cleave Limb
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 25} Constitution saving throw or [lose a limb](https://homebrewery.naturalcrit.com/share/uDYpiTxHncTE) (target's choice).

items.name: 4. Bisect
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 25} Constitution saving throw or die.

action.name: Desecration Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: Baphomet disgorges a torrent of unholy, bilious water in a 90 foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 23} Constitution saving throw, taking 45 ({@dice 10d8}) poison plus 45 ({@damage 10d8}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
The area becomes desecrated for the next hour. A non-fiend creature that starts its turn in the area takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) psychic damage.

reaction.name: Gouging Toss
entries: When a creature moves within 10 feet of them, Baphomet forces the creature to succeed on a {@dc 25} Strength saving throw or take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) piercing damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Bloodied Bellow (1/Day)
entries: When Baphomet is reduced below 262 hit points for the first time, they let out an anguished bellow.

Each other creature within 60 feet takes 36 ({@damage 8d8}) thunder damage, or half as much if behind cover, and must succeed on a {@dc 23} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Plummet
entries: One flying creature that Baphomet can see within 120 feet must succeed on a {@dc 22} Strength saving throw or fall {@condition prone}. If the creature would take damage from falling as a result of this, it takes twice as much damage.

legendary.name: Raise Labyrinth
entries: Baphomet raises two contiguous 20 foot by 20 foot stone panels from the ground within 300 feet. As long as a pathway from one side of the wall to the other exists that Baphomet could traverse, the wall does not impede Baphomet's vision or movement.
Each panel can be damaged and breached (AC 20; 30 HP; immunity to poison and psychic damage), and crumbles if Baphomet moves through it.

legendary.name: Thrashing Horns (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Up to two creatures on opposite sides of Baphomet must each succeed on a {@dc 25} Dexterity saving throw or take 35 ({@damage 8d8}) piercing damage and be pushed 10 feet away, or take half as much damage on a success.
