reaction.name: Stranglespore Puff (1/Day)
entries: When the basidirond makes an attack with its Cap Slam, it can release a puff of sooty black spores.
The attack's target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be unable to speak or breathe until the end of the basidirond's next turn.

trait.name: Keen Hearing
entries: The bat has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 0} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 piercing damage.

action.name: Echolocation
entries: If the bat is not {@condition deafened}, it gains one of the following benefits until the end of its next turn:

items.name: Low Frequency
entries: The bat gains {@sense Blindsight} to a range of 60 feet.

items.name: High Frequency
entries: The bat has advantage on melee attack rolls. Whenever the bat uses its Chaotic Swerve and the triggering attack misses it, the bat regains its reaction.

reaction.name: Chaotic Swerve
entries: As a reaction when the bat is targeted with an attack, it may move 5 feet directly toward the nearest creature and impose disadvantage on the attack roll.
Then, if one or more creatures are within 5 feet of it, the bat must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Ritual Combat
entries: The warrior conceives of combat in several distinct stages, and will not escalate to a stage before failing to resolve the fight with each previous stage, unless its opponents do so first.
1. {@skill Intimidation}; Shows of Strength and Martial Prowess.
2. Unarmed Combat, Striking Nonlethally
3. Armed Combat, Striking Nonlethally
4. Armed Combat, Striking Lethally
5. Armed Combat, Striking Lethally, Giving No Quarter

trait.name: Commanding Presence
entries: Enemies within 5 ft. of the warrior have disadvantage on attacks that target creatures other than it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The warrior makes two attacks.

action.name: Loaded Claw Grips
entries: Melee Weapon {@action Attack}. {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}).

action.name: Crushing Hold
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the warrior must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 36 ({@dice 8d8}) hit points, or half as much on a success.
A creature that would be reduced to 0 hit points in this way may use its reaction to surrender. If it does, it is {@condition frightened} for the next minute.

action.name: Bluff Charge {@recharge 5}
entries: The warrior moves up to its speed towards a creature. Each creature within 10 ft. of where it ends this movement must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of the warrior's next turn.
If no creature fails this save, the warrior may make a melee attack against a creature in its reach as part of this action.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

trait.name: Devil's Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the devil's {@sense darkvision}.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Steadfast
entries: Allied creatures within 10 feet of the devil can't be {@condition frightened} and have +1 AC.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The devil makes two attacks: one with its beard and one with its glaive.

action.name: Beard
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. While {@condition poisoned} in this way, the target can't regain hit points. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Wounding Glaive
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) slashing damage. If this attack was made at advantage, the target suffers an infernal wound. A wounded creature loses 5 ({@dice 1d10}) hit points at the end of its turn for each wound it has. This effect ends when the target receives magical healing, or when a creature uses its action to stanch the wounds with a successful {@dc 12} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check.

reaction.name: Follow Up
entries: As a reaction to a devil of CR 4 or greater hitting a creature within 10 feet of the bearded devil with an attack, the bearded devil may make a glaive attack against the same creature at advantage.

reaction.name: Battle Frenzy
entries: As a reaction to starting its turn below 26 hit points, the bearded devil may go into a frenzy. Until the end of its next turn, the devil has resistance to all damage and makes attacks at advantage.

monster.name: Bebilith Charblood
languages: understands Abyssal but does not speak

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The bebilith can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Scent Paragon
entries: The bebilith can track the approximate location, by scent, of each creature in a 5 mile radius. A creature that does not mask its scent has disadvantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide from the bebilith.

trait.name: Final Curse
entries: A creature that reduces the bebilith to 0 hit points must succeed on a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw or be cursed. While cursed in this way, the creature is unaffected by any magic that would return it to life.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The bebilith has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bebilith makes one attack with its Fusevenom Bite and two attacks with its Rending Forelegs, one of which it may replace with a use of its Soulchar Web, if available.

action.name: Fusevenom Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute.
The {@condition poisoned} creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success, or taking 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage on a failure.

A creature that dies while {@condition poisoned} in this way explodes. Each creature within 10 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or take 16 ({@damage 3d10}) force damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Rending Forelegs
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) slashing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.
If the target is wearing nonmagical armor, it takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers. Armor reduced to an AC of 10 is destroyed.

action.name: Soulchar Web {@recharge 5}
entries: The bebilith launches webbing in a 15 foot radius centered on a point it can see within 60 feet, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition restrained} by webbing (escape {@dc 17}).

A creature {@condition restrained} in this way takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage at the start of each of its turns. A creature that teleports out of the web takes 22 ({@damage 4d10}) force damage and must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of the bebilith's next turn.
The webbing can be attacked and destroyed (AC 15; 10 HP; immunity to bludgeoning, fire, poison, and psychic damage)

bonus.name: Soulchar Bind
entries: One {@condition prone} creature within 15 feet of the bebilith must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or be wrapped in its webbing and {@condition restrained}. (escape {@dc 18}).

If the target is Large or smaller, the bebilith may then attach the creature to its back as part of this action. A creature {@condition restrained} in this way takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The bebilith can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Death Throes
entries: When the bebilith is reduced to 0 hit points it explodes in a flash of uncontrolled energy. Each creature within 5 feet it takes 5 force damage and is pushed 5 feet away.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the bebilith takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the bebilith takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

action.name: Anchoring Bite (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}7 piercing damage.
For the next minute, if the target would teleport any distance, it instead teleports half as far.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The bebilith can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Scent Paragon
entries: The bebilith can track the approximate location, by scent, of each creature in a 5 mile radius. A creature that does not mask its scent has disadvantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide from the bebilith.

trait.name: Final Curse
entries: A creature that reduces the bebilith to 0 hit points must succeed on a {@dc 21} Charisma saving throw or be cursed. While cursed in this way, the creature is unaffected by any magic that would return it to life.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The bebilith has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the bebilith fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bebilith makes four attacks, one of which may be with its Fusevenom Bite, or makes one attack and uses its Soulchar Web, if available.

action.name: Fusevenom Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 15} to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. {@h}30 ({@damage 4d10 + 8}) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute.
A creature {@condition poisoned} in this way repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success, or taking 11 ({@damage 2d10}) force damage on a failure.

A creature that dies while {@condition poisoned} in this way explodes. Each creature within 15 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 4d10}) force damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Rending Forelegs
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 15} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}26 ({@damage 4d8 + 8}) slashing damage, and the target and each other creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 23} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.
If the target is wearing nonmagical armor, it takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers. Armor reduced to an AC of 10 is destroyed.

action.name: Soulchar Web {@recharge 5}
entries: The bebilith launches webbing in a 20 foot radius centered on a point it can see within 60 feet. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 21}).

A creature {@condition restrained} in this way takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage at the start of each of its turns. A creature that teleports out of the web takes 22 ({@damage 4d10}) force damage and must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of the bebilith's next turn.
The webbing can be attacked and destroyed (AC 15; 20 HP; immunity to bludgeoning, fire, poison, and psychic damage)

bonus.name: Soulchar Bind
entries: One {@condition prone} creature within 15 feet of the bebilith must succeed on a {@dc 21} Strength saving throw or be wrapped in its webbing and {@condition restrained}. (escape {@dc 21}).

If the target is Huge or smaller, the bebilith may then attach the creature to its back as part of this action. A creature {@condition restrained} in this way takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

bonus.name: Rattling Hiss
entries: The bebilith lets out a fearsome hiss at a creature it can see within 30 feet. The target must succeed on {@dc 21} Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to move half its speed directly away from the bebilith and be {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Titanic Shift
entries: The bebilith moves up to half its speed. Each Medium or larger creature whose space it moves through with this movement must succeed on a {@dc 23} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

legendary.name: Sap and Sicken
entries: One creature {@condition restrained} in the bebilith's webs must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw or lose any resistance or immunity to Poison damage or the {@condition poisoned} condition that it has for the next minute.

legendary.name: Blinding Bristles
entries: The bebilith ejects some of its barbed bristles, forcing one creature within 15 feet to succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) piercing damage and be {@condition blinded} until it takes an action to clear its eyes.

legendary.name: Leaping Strike (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The bebilith jumps up to 60 feet and makes a Rending Forelegs attack.

trait.name: Stiffening Foam
entries: Whenever the egg takes bludgeoning damage, its speed is reduced by 5 feet for the next minute.
If the egg's speed is reduced to 0 in this way, the devilish spirit possessing it is exorcised and it transforms into an ordinary egg.

trait.name: Devilish Intolerance
entries: The egg cannot voluntarily cross a line of salt.
If a creature uses its bonus action to cast salt on the egg, the egg subtracts {@dice 1d4} from the first saving throw it makes before the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Sloshing Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d6 + 1}) bludgeoning damage and the egg is pushed 10 feet directly away from the target.

action.name: Egg Wash
entries: The egg flings a translucent glob at a creature it can see within 30 feet, forcing it to succeed on a {@dc 11} Dexterity saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 4d4}) bludgeoning damage and be encased in a glossy bubble.
For the next minute, ranged attacks made by or against the encased creature are at disadvantage. The bubble pops if the creature takes or deals any damage, ending the effect.

trait.name: Lighting Reflexes
entries: The behir does not roll initiative. Instead, it takes its turn on both initiative count 20 and initiative count 10.

trait.name: Sparking Wounds
entries: If the behir has fewer than 84 hit points, a creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the behir takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) lightning damage.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the behir may spend half of its movement to attempt a {@dc 18} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the behir. While climbing on the behir, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the behir.

trait.name: Restless
entries: If the behir ends its turn without moving at least 25 feet, attacks against it are made at advantage until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@dice 3d10 + 6}) piercing plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) lightning damage.

action.name: Constrict
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one Large or smaller creature. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d10 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}) and {@condition restrained} until the grapple ends.

action.name: Lightning Breath {@recharge}
entries: The behir exhales a line of lightning that is 20 feet long and 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw, taking 55 ({@damage 10d10}) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Swallow
entries: The behir makes one bite attack against a Medium or smaller target it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the target is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the behir, it takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) acid damage at the start of each of the behir's turns, and its attacks bypass the behir's resistances. A behir can have only one creature swallowed at a time.

If the behir takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the behir must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls {@condition prone} in a space within 10 feet of the behir. If the behir dies, a swallowed creature is no longer {@condition restrained} by it and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Stormsteed
entries: A creature mounted on the behir may choose to act on the behir's initiative, rather than its own.

trait.name: Sparking Wounds
entries: If the behir has fewer than 53 hit points, a creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the behir takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) lightning damage.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the behir may spend half of its movement to attempt a {@dc 18} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the behir. While climbing on the behir, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the behir.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The behir makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d10 + 6}) piercing damage.

action.name: Constrict
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one Large or smaller creature. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d10 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}).

action.name: Lightning Breath {@recharge}
entries: The behir exhales a line of lightning that is 20 feet long and 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw, taking 33 ({@damage 6d10}) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reaction.name: Rip-Claw Retort
entries: As a reaction to being hit with an {@action opportunity attack||attack of opportunity}, the behir forces the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) slashing damage.

monster.name: Beholder Zombie
languages: understands Deep Speech and Undercommon but can't speak

trait.name: Undead Fortitude
entries: If the beholder starts its turn with 0 hit points, it makes a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw, unless it was dealt radiant damage or a critical hit since the end of its last turn.
On a success, the beholder regains 1 hit point. A zombie with 0 hit points is killed instantly if it is attacked.

trait.name: Rotting Eyestalks
entries: Attacks that deal slashing damage score a critical hit on an 18-20 against the beholder.
When the beholder is dealt a critical hit, the beholder must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or lose the use of an eye ray of the attacker's choice.

action.name: Befouling Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@dice 3d6 + 2}) piercing plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Moan of the Undreaming {@recharge}
entries: A fetid gasp escapes the beholder's mouth, carried from beyond this world.

Each creature within 20 feet that can hear it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or take 9 ({@dice 2d8}) necrotic plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) psychic damage and be {@condition frightened} until the end of the beholder's next turn.

reaction.name: What Dreams May Come
entries: When the beholder is forced to make an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma saving throw, it may create a

reaction.name: Clouded Rays
entries: When a creature the beholder can see ends its movement within 30 feet of the beholder, the beholder forces it to succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or suffer one of the following effects:

items.name: 1. Wasting Ray
entries: The target's Dexterity score is reduced by a cumulative 7 ({@dice 2d6}), to a minimum of 1 (Save Ends at end of turn). A creature reduced to 1 Dexterity in this way is {@condition paralyzed}.

items.name: 2. Flickering Panic Ray
entries: The target is {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn. While {@condition blinded} in this way, a creature cannot distinguish friend from foe.

items.name: 3. Stumbling Ray
entries: The target takes 18 ({@damage 4d8}) necrotic damage and falls {@condition prone}.

items.name: 4. Flaying Ray
entries: A portion of the target's skin begins to disintegrate, taking 16 ({@damage 3d10}) force damage. A creature reduced to 0 hit points in this way gains vulnerability to all damage until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

trait.name: Smoke Form
entries: As a Bonus Action, the belker may disperse into a large cloud of smoke, or coalesce back to its true elemental form.

While in this form, the belker can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, can move through any opening that air can pass through without squeezing, and has resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks.

trait.name: Asphyxiant Presence (Smoke Form Only)
entries: A creature in the belker's space is {@condition blinded} and cannot breathe.

action.name: Multiattack (Elemental Form Only)
entries: The belker makes two attacks with its smoke claws.

action.name: Smoke Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@dice 3d8 + 4}) slashing plus 5 ({@damage 1d10}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Tear Lungs (Concentration, Smoke Form Only)
entries: One creature in the belker's space must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or have a claw of smoke form in its lungs and begin tearing at them, dealing 13 ({@damage 3d8}) slashing damage to the creature at the start of each of its turns for the next minute.
An affected creature may repeat this save as an action, coughing the claw out on a success.

action.name: Sedative Fume (Smoke Form Only) {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature in the belker's space must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or fall asleep for the next minute. A creature wakes up early if it takes damage or another creature uses its action to wake it.

trait.name: Read Bones
entries: By carefully examining the bones of a creature, the berbalang can extract any secrets it knew in life.

trait.name: Dream Travel
entries: While the berbalang sleeps, its spirit leaves its body. In spirit form, the berbalang has the same statistics, except that its attacks deal psychic damage instead of any other type and it can teleport to another plane as an action. If the berbalang dies in spirit form, its body dies.

trait.name: Weak Flier
entries: While grappling a creature larger than size Small, the berbalang cannot fly unless the creature is also {@condition grappled} by one of its duplicates.

action.name: Bonegnaw Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Charisma saving throw or reveal one of its secrets to the berbalang.

action.name: Grasping Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}).

action.name: Absorb Duplicate
entries: The berbalang absorbs one of its duplicates, destroying it and gaining 20 Temporary hit points.

action.name: Detonate Duplicate
entries: The berbalang detonates one of its duplicates. Each creature within 15 ft. of the duplicate must succeed on a {@dc 13} Intelligence saving throw or take 11 ({@damage 2d10}) psychic damage.

bonus.name: Duplicate Self (Original Only)
entries: If the berbalang has at least 20 hit points, the berbalang creates a duplicate of itself, reducing its current hit points by 1/4. The duplicate has hit points equal to those lost in its creation, and acts on the berbalang's initiative.

trait.name: Honorable Fealty
entries: While within 30 feet of a friendly humanoid creature of a CR at least 5 higher than its own, the okamian has advantage on attack rolls and Wisdom saving throws.

trait.name: Soul of Iron (3/Day)
entries: If Berengar fails a saving throw against being {@condition charmed}, {@condition frightened}, or {@condition incapacitated}, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Gerwalt makes three melee attacks, one of which he may replace with a use of his Ape Command or his Bulwark Charge, if available.

action.name: Sainted Montante
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@dice 2d10 + 4}) slashing plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) radiant damage. This attack deals an additional 9 ({@damage 2d8}) radiant damage to a creature native to different plane of existence.

action.name: Shield Bash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away.

action.name: Simian Command
entries: Berengar calls out one of the following commands:

items.name: "Away!"
entries: Berengar points at a creature within 60 feet. Up to two friendly attack primates within 20 feet of it that can hear Berengar may each use their reaction to move up to half their speed towards it and make a melee attack.

items.name: "To Me!"
entries: Up to two friendly attack primates within 60 feet that can hear Berengar may each use their reaction to attempt to grapple a creature within their reach, then move up to half their speed toward Berengar.

action.name: Bulwark Charge {@recharge 5}
entries: Berengar raises his shield and moves up to his speed in straight line, and may move through the space of any Medium or smaller creature. Each creature in his path must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}, moving to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

reaction.name: Retributive Bash
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, Berengar makes an attack with his shield bash.

reaction.name: Reject Quarter
entries: As a reaction when a friendly creature Berengar can see within 30 feet makes a saving throw against being {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}, Berengar gives the creature advantage on the saving throw.
If the creature fails the saving throw, it treats Berengar as hostile for as long as it remains {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}.

trait.name: Graystaff Magic
entries: The hag carries a graystaff, a length of gray wood that is a focus for her inner power. She can ride the staff as if it were a broom of flying. If the staff is lost or destroyed, the hag cannot use its rime burst and must craft another, which takes a year and a day. Only a bheur hag can use a graystaff.

trait.name: Ice Walk
entries: The hag can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost her extra moment.

trait.name: Sapping Cold
entries: Each time a creature hits the bheur hag with a melee attack, it must expend one unexpended hit die. If it cannot, it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end its next turn.

trait.name: Wintergiver Coven
entries: The area within 50 miles of a coven of bheur hags drops 1 degree every hour until it reaches 10 degrees below the lowest natural winter temperature of the area. Creatures in the area without cold resistance or immunity subtract {@dice 1d4} from the result of saving throws they make.

action.name: Rime Burst (Greystaff only)
entries: The hag sends forth an icy blast in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw, taking 18 ({@damage 4d8}) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The area becomes difficult terrain, and a creature that starts its turn in it or enters the area for the first time on a turn must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

action.name: Maddening Feast
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5ft., one incacitated or dead target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) piercing damage and 36 ({@damage 8d8}) cold damage. Each creature of the hag's choice that can see it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} for a minute. A {@condition frightened} creature repeats this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Curse of Paranoia
entries: One {@condition frightened} creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 14} Charisma saving throw or be cursed. A cursed creature cannot target friendly creatures with spells. If the cursed creature is targeted with a spell by a friendly creature, it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be unaffected by the spell.

reaction.name: Feed on Greed
entries: As a reaction to a creature within 60 ft. targeting itself with a spell, the bhuer hag changes the spell's target to itself.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

trait.name: Devil's Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the abishai's {@sense darkvision}.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The abishai has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Shadow Stealth
entries: While in dim light or darkness, the abishai can take the {@action Hide} action as a bonus action.

trait.name: Creeping Darkness
entries: The abishai continously drains the light from the area around it. At the beginning of its turn, each source of bright light within 30 ft. becomes a source of dim light, each source of dim light is extinguished, and each area of darkness becomes magical darkness.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The abishai makes three attacks: two with its scimitar and one with its bite.

action.name: Scimitar
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) slashing damage. On a critical hit, the target drops one item of the abishai's choice that it is holding.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) piercing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) acid damage.

reaction.name: Dragonspawn Exhultation
entries: As a reaction to a friendly dragon within 30 ft. using its breath weapon, the abishai may move up to half its speed and make a bite attack.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The bear has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Concussive Strength
entries: A creature knocked {@condition prone} by the bear must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be unable to stand on its following turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bear makes two claw attacks. If both attacks hit the same medium or smaller creature, it is knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage. This attack does an additional 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage to a {@condition prone} creature.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) slashing damage.

action.name: Blustery Charge {@recharge}
entries: The bear moves up to its speed towards a creature. Each creature within 5 ft. of where it ends this movement must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of the bear's next turn.
If no creature fails this save, the bear is {@condition frightened} of each creature that passed it until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Unequaled Cruelty
entries: When the black dragon reduces a creature to 0 hit points, each {@condition frightened} creature that can see it must use its reaction, if available, to move its speed directly away from it.

trait.name: Sensitivity Aura
entries: Attacks against creatures within 10 feet of the dragon that do not have resistance or immunity to acid damage score a critical on an 19-20.

trait.name: Bloodbathed Resistance (1/Day)
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw while a{@condition bleeding|confc|bleeding} or {@condition unconscious} creature is within 30 feet of it, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes two attacks, one of which can be with its Steelrot Bite.

action.name: Steelrot Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@dice 2d10 + 5}) piercing plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) acid damage.
On a critical hit, one nonmagical weapon or piece of armor that the target is wearing or wielding is destroyed (target's choice).

action.name: Subduing Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) slashing damage.
Instead of dealing damage, the dragon can knock the target {@condition prone} or grapple it (escape {@dc 17}).

action.name: Tailbarb Stab
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) piercing damage and the target begins {@condition bleeding|confc|bleeding} ({@dice 1d10}).
Any hit against a {@condition prone} creature with this attack becomes a critical.

action.name: Hacked-Tar Sputum (Recharges when the dragon uses its Flesh-Melting Breath)
entries: The dragon hacks up a glob of spent acid and dead flesh at a point it can see within 60 feet, where it splashes in a 5 foot radius, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or be drenched in sticky sludge (remove {@dc 16}).

A sludge-drenched creature is {@condition blinded}, has its movement reduced by half, and is protected from decay if it dies, extending the time limit of effects that would raise the target from the dead by up to a year.

action.name: Flesh-Melting Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon spews a jet of caustic acid in a 60-foot long, 5-foot wide line, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 49 ({@damage 11d8}) acid damage, or half as much damage on a success.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more suffers a Vitriolic Disfigurement until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

reaction.name: Cruel Jest
entries: When a creature smaller than the dragon leaves its reach, the dragon can force it to make a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw.
On a failure, the target is dragged up to 10 feet toward the dragon and the dragon regains its reaction.

reaction.name: Swipe
entries: When a flying creature enters its reach, the dragon can make a Subduing Claw attack against it.

legendary.name: Mire Dive
entries: The dragon moves up to half its speed. If it ends this movement submerged in murky water, it can attempt to {@action Hide}.

legendary.name: Drooling Torment
entries: Acid drips from the dragon's jaws toward a creature {@condition grappled} by it, dealing 9 ({@damage 2d8}) acid damage to the creature.
The target can use its reaction to attempt to escape the grapple, avoiding the damage on a success.

trait.name: Sensitivity Aura

entries: The dragon spews a jet of caustic acid in a 15-foot long, 5-foot wide line, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a {@dc 11} Dexterity saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 5d8}) acid damage, or half as much damage on a success.

trait.name: Blood Scent
entries: The drake can pinpoint, by scent, the location of any creature within 120 ft. that does not have all of its hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The drake attacks twice, once with its bite and once with its tail.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) acid damage. Instead of dealing damage, the drake can grapple the target (escape {@dc 13}).

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 ft. away.

action.name: Acid Spit
entries: One creature within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Acid damage, or half as much on a success. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more has disadvantage on attack rolls while in sunlight for the next minute.

reaction.name: Bluff Strike
entries: As a reaction to a creature entering the drake's reach, it may force the creature to succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be forced to immediately move 10 ft. away from the drake, if it can.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The pudding can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Corrosive Form
entries: A creature that touches the pudding or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) acid damage. Any nonmagical weapon made of metal or wood that hits the pudding corrodes. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to -5, the weapon is destroyed.
Nonmagical ammunition made of metal or wood that hits the pudding is destroyed after dealing damage.
The pudding can eat through 2-inch-thick, nonmagical wood or metal in 1 round.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The pudding can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) acid damage. In addition, nonmagical armor worn by the target is partly dissolved and takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers. The armor is destroyed if the penalty reduces its AC to 10.

action.name: Predigest {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature within 15 ft. must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 27 ({@damage 6d8}) acid damage and for the next minute does not reset failed death saving throws when it gains hit points or becomes stable. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage.

reaction.name: Split
entries: When a pudding that is Medium or larger is subjected to fire, lightning, slashing, or piercing damage, it splits into two new puddings if it has at least 10 hit points. Each new pudding has hit points equal to half the original pudding's, rounded down. New puddings are one size smaller than the original pudding.

trait.name: Web-Dweller
entries: The widow can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty.
While in contact with a web, the widow knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

action.name: Venomous Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature. {@h}1 poison damage and the target subtracts {@dice 1d4} from the next Constitution saving throw it makes in the next minute.

action.name: Invade Attire
entries: The widow attempts to enter the clothing or armor of a humanoid creature in its space, forcing it to succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or have the widow become {@condition attached|confc|attached} to it (remove {@dc 12}).

While {@condition attached|confc|attached} in this way, the widow has full cover against outside effects, and the target has disadvantage on saving throws to maintain {@status concentration} or resist being {@condition frightened}.

reaction.name: Crushed Vengeance
entries: When the widow is reduced to 0 hit points by a melee attack, it can make a Venomous Bite attack with advantage against the attacker.

trait.name: Fear Eater
entries: The blackguard scores a critical hit on a roll of 17-20 on attacks made against a creature that is {@condition frightened}.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The blackguard has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The blackguard uses its Fearsome Gaze and makes three glaive attacks, one of which it may replace with a Blackguard's Challenge, if available.

action.name: Glaive
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Blackguard's Challenge {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature within 60 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be forced to meet the blackguard in melee combat. On its following turn, the creature must use its full movement to move directly toward the blackguard.

action.name: Fearsome Gaze
entries: One creature within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. The {@condition frightened} target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

reaction.name: Counterattack
entries: The blackguard adds 3 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. If this causes the attack to miss, the blackguard may make a glaive attack as part of this reaction.

trait.name: Forsworn Oaths
entries: Whenever the blackguard makes a saving throw against a spell with a divine source, it takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) psychic damage and gains a bonus to its saving throw equal to the damage taken.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The blackguard makes three attacks with its Treacherous Blade, one of which it may replace with its Raise the False Lord's Banner.

action.name: Treacherous Blade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage.
This attack deals an additional 3 ({@damage 1d6}) slashing damage to a creature {@condition flanked|confc|flanked} by the blackguard.

action.name: Fearsome Gaze
entries: One creature the blackguard can see within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn).

action.name: Raise the False Lord's Banner {@recharge 4}
entries: The blackguard hoists its banner high.
Each friendly creature within 30 feet that can see it gains advantage on the first melee attack or Strength saving throw it makes before the beginning of the blackguard's next turn.

reaction.name: Blackguard's Challenge
entries: When a {@condition frightened} creature targets the blackguard with a ranged attack or spell, the blackguard can force it to move its remaining speed directly toward the blackguard.

entries: The blackguard scores a critical hit on a roll of 17-20 on attacks made against a creature that is {@condition frightened}.

entries: The blackguard makes an attack with its Blooded Glaive against each other creature within 10 feet of it.

This attack has advantage against a target more than 5 feet away from the blackguard.

action.name: Spiked Gauntlet
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@dice 2d6 + 5}) bludgeoning plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) necrotic damage and the target is pushed up to 5 feet away.

bonus.name: Greaved Stomp
entries: The blackguard deals 5 bludgeoning damage to a {@condition prone} creature within 5 feet.

reaction.name: Blackguard's Challenge
entries: When a {@condition frightened} creature targets the blackguard with a ranged attack or spell, the blackguard can force it to move its remaining speed directly toward the blackguard.

reaction.name: Crack Bones
entries: When the blackguard scores a critical hit with a melee attack, it can force the target to succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or suffer a lingering wound.
Until it completes a Long Rest, the target takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) bludgeoning damage whenever it stands from {@condition prone} or is pushed.

trait.name: Terror Dive
entries: If the blackwing is flying and dives at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a melee weapon attack, the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of the blackwing's next turn.

trait.name: Empty Bones
entries: If the blackwing takes 15 or more bludgeoning damage from a single source, it must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or lose its fly speed until it completes a Short or Long rest.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The blackwing makes two attacks with its Abductor Talons, one of which it may replace with its Throatripper Beak or Wail of Despair, if available.

action.name: Throatripper Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@dice 2d8 + 4}) slashing plus 11 ({@damage 1d10}) necrotic damage.

If the target is {@condition grappled}, it additionally begins to bleed profusely. At the end of each of its turns, the target loses 4 ({@dice 1d8}) hit points and must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw, with advantage if it received any magical healing since the end of its last turn, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Abductor Talons
entries: Talons. {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}). The blackwing may make this attack as a Bonus Action against a {@condition frightened} creature.

action.name: Wail of Despair {@recharge 5}
entries: The blackwing lets out a terrible cry. Each living creature within 60 feet that can hear it has disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws it makes before the end of the blackwing's next turn.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a Bonus Action, the mimic can polymorph into a Small bladed weapon or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: False Appearance (Weapon Form Only)
entries: While the mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary weapon. Attacks made with the mimic deal an additional 3 ({@damage 1d6}) acid damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mimic makes two attacks with its Corrosive Slash, one of which it may replace with a use of its Gnaw Palm or Tumbling Advance.

action.name: Gnaw Palm
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 0 ft., one target that is holding the mimic. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) acid damage.

action.name: Corrosive Slash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) slashing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) acid damage.

action.name: Tumbling Advance
entries: The mimic moves up to its speed, tumbling end-over-end. Until the beginning of its next turn, melee attacks are made at disadvantage against it, and a creature that misses the mimic with a melee attack takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) slashing damage.

reaction.name: Adhesive Grip
entries: As a reaction when a creature holding the mimic attempts to drop it, the mimic adheres to it.
As an action, the creature may attempt a {@dc 14} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check, dropping the mimic on a success.

reaction.name: Wobbling Riposte
entries: As a reaction when a creature misses with a melee attack that uses the mimic as a weapon, the mimic makes a Corrosive Slash attack against it.

trait.name: Web-Dweller
entries: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty.
While in contact with a web, the spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spider makes three attacks, one of which can be with its Iron Bite.

action.name: Iron Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage.
Instead of dealing damage, the spider can force the target to succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or have one nonmagical weapon or shield it is wielding wrenched from its grasp and devoured.

action.name: Blade-leg Slash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) slashing damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.
On a critical hit, the target is pushed 10 feet away and knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Defensive Posture
entries: The spider rears up in a defensive posture, slashing at the air. Until the beginning of the spider's next turn, the spider regains its reaction at the end of each turn.

action.name: Vicious Skewer
entries: The spider rapidly stabs its legs toward a {@condition prone} creature within 5 feet.
The target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 28 ({@damage 8d6}) piercing damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage immediately fails a death saving throw.

reaction.name: Fend Off
entries: When a creature enters its reach, the spider can make a Blade-Leg Slash attack against it.

monster.name: Blazing Bones
languages: understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Bonesense
entries: The skeleton can pinpoint, by scent, the location of any creature with bones within 20 feet of it, and does not suffer disadvantage for attacking a creature with bones that it cannot see.

trait.name: Burning Aura
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 5 ft. of the blazing bones or hits it with a melee attack takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage.

trait.name: Regrow Nerves
entries: If the blazing bones would receive any magical healing, it receives no healing, and instead gains disadvantage on attack rolls for the next minute.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The blazing bones makes two attacks with its blazing claw.

action.name: Blazing Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@dice 1d6 + 3}) slashing plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Hurled Flame
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 30 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d10 + 3}) fire damage and the creature catches flame; until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the creature takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

reaction.name: Hate the Living
entries: When a creature the skeleton can see reduces an undead ally of the skeleton's to 0 hit points, the skeleton can move up to 10 feet towards the creature.

monster.name: Blink Dog
languages: understands Sylvan but can't speak it

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The dog has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The dog has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the dog's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) piercing damage.

action.name: Teleport {@recharge 4}
entries: The dog magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 40 feet to an unoccupied space it can see, then makes a bite attack at advantage.

monster.name: Blink Dog Mistleaper
languages: understands Sylvan but can't speak it

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The dog has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The dog has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the dog's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dog makes two bite attacks. It may replace one with a use of its teleport.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d6 + 2}) piercing damage. This attack deals an additional 7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage to a {@condition prone} creature.

action.name: Teleport
entries: The dog magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 40 feet to an unoccupied space it can see, then makes a bite attack at advantage. If this attack hits, the creature must make a {@dc 12} strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The amniote can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Coagulate
entries: If the amniote takes any cold damage, is affected by healing magic, or gains any temporary hit points it coagulates until the end of its next turn. While coagulated, the amniote may not use its amorphous trait, has its movement speed reduced by 10, and it deals an additional 3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage with its melee attacks.

trait.name: Blood Siphon
entries: Whenever one or more creatures {@condition grappled} by the amniote take any necrotic damage, the amniote gains an equal number of temporary hit points. If it gains temporary hit points while it already has temporary hit points, the amniote adds them together, to a maximum of 30.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The amniote makes four attacks with its rupturing tendrils.

action.name: Rupturing Tendrils
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target is dragged up to 10 ft. toward the amniote and {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}). A creature {@condition grappled} by the amniote takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) necrotic damage at the end of each of its turns.

action.name: Blood Call {@recharge 5}
entries: Up to two creatures {@condition grappled} by the ooze must each succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 4d10}) necrotic damage as its blood wells up from its pores and orifices, or half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Split
entries: When the amniote starts its turn with at least 20 temporary hit points, it loses all temporary hit points and spawns a new

reaction.name: Engulf
