reaction.name: Tag
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack, the boggle teleports up to 20 ft. away. The attacker must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or use all its remaining movement to move toward the boggle.

trait.name: Dimensional Windows
entries: Once per turn, the boggle may use a bonus action to teleport up to 15 ft. to a location it can see, or to make a Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check against a creature up to 50 ft. away that it can see.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The boggle makes two claw attacks, one of which it may replace with the {@action Dodge} action if it does not have a creature {@condition grappled}.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 1} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d6 - 1}) slashing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the boggle can grapple the target (escape {@dc 9}).

action.name: Neck Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition grappled} target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Got Your Eyes
entries: One {@condition grappled} creature must succeed on a {@dc 9} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} for as long as the boggle maintains the grapple.

reaction.name: Slippery Grab
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack, the boggle attempts to grapple the attacker.

reaction.name: Face Rip
entries: As a reaction to a creature escaping its grapple, the boggle deals 2 ({@damage 1d4}) damage to the creature and teleports up to 15 ft. away.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

trait.name: Devil's Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the devil's {@sense darkvision}.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Compel Obedience
entries: When the bone devil damages an ally with an attack, it may end one effect causing the creature to be {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}. If this damage reduces the creature to 0 HP, creatures of the bone devil's choice within 30 feet each have advantage on attacks and saving throws until the end of the bone devil's next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The devil makes three attacks: two with its claws and one with its sting.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) slashing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the bone devil can knock the target {@condition prone} or grapple it (escape {@dc 16}).

action.name: Sting
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) acid damage. The next time the target is hit with an attack, it has vulnerability to all that attack's damage.

reaction.name: Stop Resisting!
entries: As a reaction to a creature failing an attempt to escape its grapple, the bone devil may make a sting attack against it.

monster.name: Bone Golem
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: The golem can't be affected or detected by spells of 1st level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes five attacks with its Bone Spur Strike, each of which it may replace with its Osseous Grasp or Creeping Bone, if available.

action.name: Bone Spur Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Osseous Grasp
entries: The golem leaps up to 20 feet and may move into the space of any Medium or smaller creature. Each creature whose space the golem lands in must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}).

action.name: Creeping Bone {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature {@condition grappled} by the golem must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or gain 11 ({@dice 2d10}) cumulative temporary hit points as plates of bone begin to grow over its skin.
While a creature has any of these temporary hit points, it is {@condition restrained}. While a creature has 30 or more of these temporary hit points, it is {@condition petrified}.

reaction.name: Splintering Vengeance
entries: When the golem takes 20 or more damage from a single source, it can make an attack with its Bone Spur Strike, afterwards making one fewer attack whenever it uses its multiattack.

trait.name: Multiple Heads
entries: The hydra has five heads. While it has more than one head, the hydra has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition blinded}, {@condition charmed}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition frightened}, {@condition stunned}, and knocked {@condition unconscious}.

Whenever the hydra takes 25 or more damage from a single source, it loses a head. If none of this damage was bludgeoning damage, a {@creature squirming skull|confc|Squirming Skull} that acts on the hydra's turn appears in the nearest unoccupied space to it.

trait.name: Bonesense
entries: The head can pinpoint, by scent, the location of any creature with bones within 20 feet, and does not suffer disadvantage for attacking a creature with bones that it can't see.

trait.name: Reactive Heads
entries: For each head the hydra has beyond one, it gets an extra reaction that can be used only for {@action opportunity attack||opportunity attacks}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hydra makes as many Snapping Skull attacks as it has heads.

action.name: Snapping Skull
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}).
The hydra cannot use this attack if it has no heads.

action.name: Skeletal Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}24 ({@damage 3d12 + 5}) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of the hydra's next turn.

action.name: Worry
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by at least two of the hydra's heads must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution throw or take 55 ({@damage 10d10}) piercing damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature makes this save with disadvantage if it is {@condition grappled} by three or more heads.

trait.name: Fear Eater
entries: The bone knight scores a critical hit on a roll of 18-20 on attacks made against a creature that is {@condition frightened}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bone knight uses its Fearsome Gaze and makes two attacks.

action.name: Greatsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Fearsome Gaze
entries: One creature within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Shake Bones {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or have its skeleton rattle within its flesh, taking 35 ({@dice 10d6}) points of bludgeoning damage and moving up to 5 feet in a direction of the bone knight's choice on a failure, or take half damage on a success.
An {@condition unconscious} creature that fails this save dies. At the beginning of its next turn, its skeleton tears itself out of the creature's body, acting on the creature's initiative.

reaction.name: Turn The Living (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 77 hit points, the bone knight forces each living creature within 30 feet to succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} of the bone knight for the next minute. While {@condition frightened} in this way, a creature must use its action to dash away from the bone knight, and repeats this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

trait.name: Fear Eater
entries: The bone knight scores a critical hit on a roll of 18-20 on attacks made against a creature that is {@condition frightened}.

trait.name: Master of the Pallid Banner
entries: While within 60 feet of the knight, friendly skeletons and zombies have advantage on attack rolls and on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bone knight uses its Fearsome Gaze and makes two attacks.

action.name: Pike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Fearsome Gaze
entries: One creature within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Grave Command {@recharge 5}
entries: Up to four friendly skeletons or zombies within 60 ft. may each use their reaction to make an attack. If the attack hits, it deals an additional 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage.

reaction.name: Brace
entries: As a reaction to a creature entering its reach, the bone knight forces the creature to succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or be unable to move closer to the bone knight this turn.

trait.name: Fear Eater
entries: The naga scores a critical hit on a roll of 15-20 on attacks made against a creature that is {@condition frightened}.

action.name: Cursed Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Charisma saving throw or be cursed. While cursed, the creature has disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws to resist fear effects. A cursed creature may repeat this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

reaction.name: Death Rattle
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee weapon attack, the naga lets loose an echoing rattle that causes living creatures to reflect on their own mortality. Each non-undead creature within 5 feet of the naga must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of the naga's next turn.

trait.name: Partially Amorphous
entries: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 foot wide, though it must squeeze to do so.

trait.name: Rolling Graveyard
entries: If the bone ooze takes at least 15 necrotic damage from a single source, the ooze and each creature engulfed by it lose 10 ({@dice 3d6}) hit points as the skeletons within it briefly reanimate and thrash around.
If the ooze is killed by this damage, {@dice 1d8} skeletons reanimate and erupt from the ooze, appearing in the nearest unoccupied space.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ooze makes three pseudopod attacks, one of which it may replace with its Engulf.

action.name: Osteokinetic Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@dice 4d6 + 7}) bludgeoning plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) acid damage. A target with bones is dragged 10 ft. toward the ooze.

action.name: Engulf
entries: Up to two creatures creatures within 5 ft. must each succeed on a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw or be dragged into the ooze's space and {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 20}). While {@condition grappled} in this way, a creature is {@condition blinded} and takes 18 ({@damage 4d8}) acid damage at the beginning of each of the ooze's turns.

action.name: Bone Meld {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature {@condition grappled} in the ooze must make a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 45 ({@damage 10d8}) slashing damage and has its Constitution score reduced by 5 ({@dice 2d4}) until restored by Greater Restoration or similar magic as some of its bones are drawn out through its skin, or takes no damage and half as much reduction on a success. A creature killed by this damage has its skeleton torn out and its flesh ejected from the ooze.

monster.name: Boneclaw

resist.note: while in dim light or darkness

languages: The languages it knew in life

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: While its master lives, a destroyed boneclaw gains a new body in {@dice 1d10} hours, with all its hit points. The new body appears within 1 mile of the boneclaw's master.

trait.name: Shadow Stealth
entries: While in dim light or darkness, the boneclaw can take the {@action Hide} action as a Bonus Action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The boneclaw makes two attacks with its Ghastly Claws, each of which it may replace with a use of its Douse or Shadowsink, if available.

action.name: Ghastly Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d10 + 4}) piercing damage and the target is pulled up to 10 feet toward the boneclaw and {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}).

action.name: Douse
entries: The boneclaw reduces a source of Bright Light you can see within 60 feet to Dim Light, or extinguishes a source of Dim Light it can see in the area. If the boneclaw is hidden, this action does not reveal its position.

action.name: Shadowsink {@recharge 5}
entries: If the boneclaw is in Dim Light or Darkness, the shadows around it deepen to a pure black and it sinks through to the world of shadow, emerging at another location in Dim Light or Darkness within 60 feet.

Each creature within 5 feet of the boneclaw must succeed on a {@dc 14} Charisma saving throw or be drawn through this passage behind it, taking 32 ({@damage 5d12}) necrotic damage and emerging in the nearest unoccupied space to the boneclaw. A {@condition grappled} creature makes this saving throw at disadvantage.

monster.name: Boneclaw Night Terror

resist.note: while in dim light or darkness

languages: The languages it knew in life

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: While its master lives, a destroyed boneclaw gains a new body in {@dice 1d10} hours, with all its hit points. The new body appears within 1 mile of the boneclaw's master.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The boneclaw can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Shadow Stealth
entries: While in Dim Light or Darkness, the boneclaw can take the {@action Hide} action as a Bonus Action.

trait.name: Shadewarded (3/Day)
entries: If the boneclaw fails a saving throw while in Dim Light or Darkness, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The boneclaw makes two attacks with its Ghastly Claws, each of which it may replace with a use of its Douse or Shadowsink, if available.

action.name: Ghastly Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d10 + 5}) piercing damage and the target is pulled up to 10 feet toward the boneclaw and {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 18}).

action.name: Douse
entries: The boneclaw reduces a source of Bright Light it can see within 60 feet to Dim Light, or extinguishes a source of Dim Light it can see in the area.
If the boneclaw is hidden, this action does not reveal its position.

action.name: Shadowsink {@recharge 5}
entries: If the boneclaw is in Dim Light or Darkness, the shadows around it deepen to a pure black and it sinks through to the world of shadow, emerging at another location in Dim Light or Darkness within 60 feet.

Each creature within 5 feet of the boneclaw must succeed on a {@dc 16} Charisma saving throw or be drawn through this passage behind it, taking 32 ({@damage 5d12}) necrotic damage and emerging in the nearest unoccupied space to the boneclaw. A {@condition grappled} creature makes this saving throw at disadvantage.

reaction.name: Shadow Snatch
entries: When a creature the boneclaw is hidden from enters its reach, the boneclaw can make an attack with its Ghastly Claws against it.

If the attack hits, the target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of the boneclaw's next turn and Hidden from any creature the boneclaw is hidden from. If the boneclaw is hidden, this attack does not reveal its location.

legendary.name: Douse
entries: The boneclaw uses its Douse ability. It may take this Legendary Action even while {@condition incapacitated}.

legendary.name: Change Orientation
entries: The boneclaw changes the orientation of gravity toward an surface it can see within 30 feet for itself and for any creatures {@condition grappled} by it.

legendary.name: Claw Skewer
entries: If the boneclaw is not in bright light, it extends a finger through the nearby shadows. One creature the boneclaw can see within 15 feet of an area of dim light or darkness must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 11 ({@damage 2d10}) piercing damage. If the boneclaw is hidden, this action does not reveal its position.

monster.name: Bonecrusher Skeleton
languages: understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Bonesense
entries: The skeleton can pinpoint, by scent, the location of any creature with bones within 20 feet of it, and does not suffer disadvantage for attacking a creature with bones that it cannot see.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the skeleton may spend half of its movement to attempt a {@dc 13} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the skeleton. While climbing on the skeleton, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the skeleton, and the skeleton has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The skeleton makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Crushing Maul
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.
Each other creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

action.name: Claw Snatch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}).

action.name: Ragdoll Smash {@recharge 5}
entries: The skeleton repeatedly slams a {@condition grappled} creature into the ground, forcing it to succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or take 36 ({@damage 8d8}) bludgeoning damage and be {@condition stunned} until the end of the skeleton's next turn, or take half as much damage on a success.

trait.name: Bone-Scent Ravening
entries: While within 30 ft. of a living creature with bones, the bonedrinker may {@action Dash} as a Bonus Action, and melee attacks made against it by creatures it is not grappling are made at advantage.

trait.name: Weeping Sores
entries: The bonedrinker is covered in sores that weep a clear fluid, and develops more for each day it goes without feeding.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bonedrinker makes two melee attacks, one of which may be with its bonesoftening bite or its drink bones.

action.name: Bonsoftening Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition grappled} target. {@h}6 ({@dice 1d6 + 3}) piercing plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or have its bones soften for the next minute, reducing the creature's speed by half.

action.name: Tentacles
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}). The bonedrinker has two tentacles, each of which may grapple a single creature.

action.name: Drink Bones
entries: One creature with softened bones and {@condition grappled} by the bonedrinker must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or have its Constitution score reduced by 5 ({@dice 2d4}). A creature that has its Constitution reduced to 0 in this way collapses into a pile of loose flesh and dies.

trait.name: Damage Transfer
entries: While it is wrapped around a creature, the boneless takes only half the damage dealt to it by creatures it is not grappling, and the creature {@condition grappled} by the boneless takes the other half.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The boneless can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

action.name: Clinging Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) bludgeoning damage and the boneless wraps itself around the target (escape {@dc 11}). While the boneless is wrapped around it, a creature cannot speak or breathe, and the boneless moves with the target.

action.name: Throttle
entries: One creature the boneless is wrapped around must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or have the air driven from its lungs and begin to suffocate.

monster.name: Boneshard Skeleton
languages: understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Bonesense
entries: The skeleton can pinpoint, by scent, the location of any creature with bones within 20 feet of it, and does not suffer disadvantage for attacking a creature with bones that it cannot see.

trait.name: Rattle
entries: A creature that hits the skeleton with a melee attack that deals bludgeoning damage must succeed a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn as it feels its own skeleton twitch slightly.

trait.name: Marrowseal
entries: If the skeleton would receive any magical healing, it receives no healing, and instead loses the ability to use its Boneshard for the next minute.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The skeleton makes two attacks with its bound blades, one of which it may replace with a use of its Boneshard.

action.name: Bound Blades
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Boneshard
entries: One creature the skeleton can see within 20 ft. must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, the target takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage and has its movement speed reduced by 5 ft. until a creature takes an action to remove the shard, or takes half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Boneshard Burst
entries: When the skeleton is reduced to 0 hit points, it can use its Boneshard targeting each creature within 10 feet of it before being destroyed.

reaction.name: Hate the Living
entries: When a creature the skeleton can see reduces an undead ally of the skeleton's to 0 hit points, the skeleton can move up to 10 feet towards the creature.

trait.name: Hermetic Seal
entries: The boondaburra is immune to Poison damage from airborne toxins, and has resistance to cold and fire damage from effects that target an area.

trait.name: Ungainly
entries: The boondaburra can stand from {@condition prone} only while it is within 5 feet of one or more allies, and must use all of its movement to do so.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The boondaburra makes two attacks with its Harpoon Cannon, each of which it can replace with a use of its Reel In.

action.name: Harpoon Cannon
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 40 ft., one target. Hit 13 ({@damage 3d8}) piercing damage and the harpoon lodges in the target (remove {@dc 12}).

items.name: Medium or Smaller Target
entries: Until the harpoon is removed, the target can't move away from the boondaburra.

items.name: Large or Larger Target
entries: Until the harpoon is removed, whenever the target moves away from the boondaburra, the boondaburra is dragged with it.

action.name: Reel In
entries: One creature that has one or more of the boondaburra's harpoons lodged in it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) piercing damage and be dragged up to 10 feet toward the boondaburra.
On a success, the creature takes half as much damage and the harpoon is removed.

trait.name: Hermetic Seal
entries: The boondaburra is immune to Poison damage from airborne toxins, and has resistance to cold and fire damage from effects that target an area.

trait.name: Ungainly
entries: The boondaburra can stand from {@condition prone} only while it is within 5 feet of one or more allies, and must use all of its movement to do so.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The boondaburra makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Hullbreaker Drill
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage.
If the boondaburra hits a target twice with this attack in one turn, the target takes an additional 9 ({@damage 2d8}) piercing damage.

action.name: Iron Clamp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}).

trait.name: Hermetic Seal
entries: The boondaburra is immune to Poison damage from airborne toxins, and has resistance to cold and fire damage from effects that target an area.

trait.name: Ungainly
entries: The boondaburra can stand from {@condition prone} only while it is within 5 feet of one or more allies, and must use all of its movement to do so.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The boondaburra makes two melee attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Dinner Bell.

action.name: Serrated Blade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) slashing damage and the target begins bleeding, losing 2 ({@dice 1d4}) hit points at the beginning of each of its turns.
The bleeding creature makes a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
The effect ends early if the creature receives any magical healing.

action.name: Iron Clamp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}).

action.name: Dinner Bell
entries: The boondaburra creates a rhythmic knocking noise, drawing the attention of nearby sea creatures.
Each aquatic beast within 500 feet learns the number and direction of bleeding creatures within 30 feet of the boondaburra.

trait.name: Zig-Zag
entries: The first time each turn that a creature ends its movement within 5 feet of the squirrel, it may move up to 10 feet without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

trait.name: Gliding Membranes
entries: The squirrel glides 10 feet at no movement cost to it for every 5 feet that it falls.

trait.name: Skittish
entries: A creature within 30 feet of the squirrel that is hidden from it must make a new stealth check at the beginning of each of its turns to remain hidden from it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The squirrel makes two attacks with its Skullcracker Bite.

action.name: Skullcracker Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the squirrel may grapple the target (escape {@dc 12}), stuffing the creature's head in its mouth.
This attack deals an additional 5 ({@damage 2d4}) bludgeoning damage to creature {@condition grappled} in this way.

action.name: Scolding Alarm
entries: The squirrel chirps forth a complex alarm signal. Each creature that the squirrel can see ceases to be hidden from any creature that can hear the squirrel.

reaction.name: Break Fall
entries: As a reaction when the squirrel passes within 5 feet of a climbable vertical surface while falling, it climbs onto the surface, arresting its fall and taking no damage.

trait.name: Ductile Carapace
entries: Whenever the sandwalker takes any bludgeoning damage, its AC is reduced by 1, to a minimum of 11, until it completes a Short or Long Rest.

trait.name: Sonic Symbiote
entries: The sandwalker doesn't have Actions of its own or roll initiative. Instead, a friendly lemurian within 15 feet of it may use its Actions and Reactions, if the sandwalker can hear it. A lemurian outside of the sandwalker may not use its multiattack.
A lemurian pilot within 5 feet may spend half its movement to enter the sandwalker, if it is unoccupied.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sandwalker makes three attacks with its Seizer Claw, one of which it may replace with a use of its Crusher Claw or its Paralytic Drip.

action.name: Seizer Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d10 + 5}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}) and dragged up to 5 feet towards the sandwalker.

action.name: Crusher Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one {@condition grappled} target. {@h}32 ({@damage 6d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or suffer disadvantage on attack rolls that use Strength until it completes a Short or Long rest.

action.name: Paralytic Drip
entries: The sandwalker drips a paralytic venom onto a creature {@condition grappled} by it. Roll {@dice 4d8}. If this exceeds the {@condition grappled} creature's current hit points, the creature is {@condition paralyzed} for the next hour, or until it takes any damage.

reaction.name: Jetting Jink
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with a ranged attack, the sandwalker imposes disadvantage on the attack and moves up to half its speed.
It cannot end this movement closer to the attacker than it began.

trait.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d10 + 2}) piercing damage.

trait.name: This Reminds Me...
entries: The dragon begins telling a story that lasts until the end of its next turn. While the dragon is telling a story, it cannot use its breath weapons, and a creature that can hear the dragon and attempts to target the dragon with an attack or harmful spell must first make a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature must choose a new target or lose the attack or spell.

trait.name: Breath Weapons {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.

trait.name: Breath of Lingering Flames
entries: The dragon exhales fire in an 20-foot line that is 5 feet wide and persists until the end of its next turn. Each creature that starts its turn in that line, or enters it for the first time on a turn, must succeed on a {@dc 11} Dexterity saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage, or half as much on a successful save.

trait.name: Breath of Deepening Sleep
entries: The dragon exhales sleep gas in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or fall {@condition unconscious} for 1 minute and gain 7 ({@dice 2d6}) temporary hit points, or 14 ({@dice 2d6}) temporary hit points if it failed the save by 5 or more. This effect ends for a creature if it loses any non-temporary hit points.

reaction.name: I Wasn't Finished!
entries: As a reaction to a creature hitting the dragon with a melee attack while the dragon is telling a story, the dragon ends the story and uses one of its breath weapons, if available.

trait.name: Sun-Soaked
entries: In bright sunlight, the treant gleams as though made of precious metals, reflecting glaring light in a 10 foot radius.
A creature that starts its turn in the area must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the treant may spend half of its movement to attempt a {@dc 16} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the treant. While climbing on the treant, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the treant, and the treant has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The treant makes two attacks with its Earthshaking Slam, one of which it may replace with a use of its Sundrip.

action.name: Earthshaking Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Sundrip
entries: One creature within 20 feet of the treant must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or be coated in a drop of sunsap. Until a creature takes an action to remove it, the creature takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) radiant damage at the beginning of each of its turns.

action.name: Grasping Roots {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature within 15 feet of the treant must succceed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or take 19 ({@damage 3d12}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone} and {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 16}) until the end of the treant's next turn. A creature that was already {@condition prone} makes this save at disadvantage.

reaction.name: Kindled Lifeblood
entries: When the treant takes any fire or radiant damage, it can use its Sundrip.

trait.name: Trampling Charge
entries: If the gorgon moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Reckless Follow-Through
entries: At the start of its turn, the gorgon can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn. If it misses with an attack this turn, it is {@condition stunned} until the beginning of the gorgon's next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gorgon makes two attacks, one of which may be with its searing gore, and uses its Brazen Blossom, if available.

action.name: Searing Gore
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@dice 2d12 + 6}) piercing plus 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage.

action.name: Carp's Tongue Hooves
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d10 + 6}) slashing damage.
The gorgon may make this attack as a Bonus Action against a {@condition prone} creature.

action.name: Thrashing Horns
entries: Two creatures on opposite sides of the gorgon must each succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or take 32 ({@damage 5d12}) piercing damage and be pushed 10 feet away, or take half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Brazen Blossom {@recharge 5}
entries: The plates of the gorgon's armored flesh unfold and part, revealing its fiery core, reducing its AC to 10, and giving it Vulnerability to cold damage until it uses its Abductor Grasp.

reaction.name: Abductor Grasp
entries: As a reaction when a creature within 40 feet hits it with an attack while its Brazen Blossom is active, the gorgon moves up to its speed toward the creature. If it ends this movement within 5 feet of the creature, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or be dragged into and {@condition restrained} within the gorgon (escape {@dc 18}).

A creature {@condition restrained} within the gorgon takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) fire damage at the end of each of its turns. Whenever the gorgon takes cold damage, a sealed creature may attempt to escape as a reaction.

reaction.name: Snort Flame
entries: As a reaction when the gorgon succeeds on a saving throw, it snorts flame in a 15 foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed ona {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take 11 ({@damage 2d10}) fire damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Innate Invisibility
entries: The breathdrinker is {@condition invisible}. If fine particles are scattered in its space, this trait is disabled for the next minute, or until it uses its Expel Debris.

trait.name: Breath Tracker
entries: The breathdrinker can detect, by scent, the direction and distance to each creature on the same plane of existence that has been affected by its Breath Siphon.

action.name: Breath Siphon
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}An {@condition invisible} tether of breath ties the creature to the breathdrinker.
Until the breathdrinker uses this ability again or the creature moves more than 40 feet away from it, the target is {@condition dazed|confc|dazed}.

action.name: Wind Scythe
entries: The stalker sends forth a plane of pressurized air in a 15 foot cone, cutting cleanly through each Medium or smaller unattended nonmagical object in the area.
Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 28 ({@damage 8d6}) slashing damage and be pushed up to 15 feet away, or take half as much damage on a success.

bonus.name: Breath Mimicry (Concentration)
entries: The breathdrinker wrenches air from the lungs of a creature affected by its Breath Siphon, forcing it to succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or begin {@condition suffocating|confc|suffocating}.
While using this ability, the breathdrinker appears as a misty, red-eyed duplicate of its target, and cannot benefit from Invisibility.

bonus.name: Expel Debris
entries: The breathdrinker purges itself of particles suspended in its form, then can attempt to {@action Hide}.

trait.name: Troll Healing
entries: The troll regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the troll takes 10 or more acid or fire damage from a single source, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Budding
entries: When the troll suffers a critical hit that deals piercing or slashing damage, one of its limbs is severed, giving it disadvantage on attack rolls and Dexterity saving throws.

At the end of each of its turns, the troll makes a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw. On a success, this condition ends, and the severed piece grows into a {@creature troll budling|confc|Troll Budling}. The severed limb is destroyed if it takes acid or fire damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The troll makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw Bash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away and knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Reckless Thrash {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature within 10 feet of the troll must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}. Until the beginning of its next turn, attacks that target the troll are made at advantage.

trait.name: Reserved Capacity
entries: While the yuanyang has more than half of its hit points, it can move up to half its speed and make a single weapon attack on its turn while {@condition incapacitated} or {@condition unconscious}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Bright Expanse makes two attacks with his Four Harmonies Staff, one of which he can replace with a use of his Shell's Embrace or Divine Candle.

action.name: Four Harmonies Staff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@dice 1d8 + 4}) bludgeoning plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) force damage.

action.name: Shell's Embrace (2nd Level Spell)
entries: Bright expanse conjures a scintillating shell of magic around a creature he can see within 30 feet, causing it to gain 20 temporary hit points.

While a creature has any of these temporary hit points, it is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, stabilizes automatically if reduced to 0 hit points, and can use its Bonus Action to lose all its remaining temporary hit points.

action.name: Divine Candle (4th Level Spell)
entries: Bright Expanse's staff flares briefly with a radiance that shines through solid objects in a 20 foot radius, revealing each condition and magical effect affecting a creature in the area.
Each {@condition invisible} creature in the area becomes visible, and cannot become {@condition invisible} again until the end of Bright Expanse's next turn.
Each magically disguised or shapechanged creature in the area has its creature type revealed.

action.name: Trustbond (4th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: Bright Expanse forges a magical bond with a creature he can see within 60 feet with an Intelligence score of 7 or lower.

For the next hour, the creature is friendly toward Bright Expanse, it can't be {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}, and whenever it would take any damage, it takes no damage and he takes that damage instead.

action.name: Thermostasis (1/Day, 5th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: A gentle, temperate breeze whirls around Bright Expanse in a 15 foot radius for the next minute, clearing any toxic gasses from the air, melting any ice, and extinguishing any flames in the area.
Each creature in the area has resistance to cold and fire damage, and advantage on saving throws against airborne poisons.

action.name: Restore Equilibrium (1/Day, 7th Level Spell)
entries: Bright Expanse touches a creature, ending each spell of 3rd level or below and each condition affecting it, and setting the creature's current hit points to half its hit point maximum.
An unwilling creature can make a {@dc 16} Charisma saving throw, avoiding the effect on a success.

reaction.name: Cloudcatch (3rd Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: When a creature or object Bright Expanse can see within 120 feet begins to fall or makes a Strength saving throw, he can conjure a cushion of air to support it, producing the following effects:
The target gains a 10 foot fly speed and does not fall if unsupported.
The target takes half as much damage on a failed Strength saving throw, and no damage on a successful one.

reaction.name: Concordant Harmony
entries: When Bright Expanse hits a creature with his Four Harmonies Staff, he can cause it to ring with the target's natural harmonics.
Until the end of his next turn, the target has vulnerability to force damage dealt by his Four Harmonies Staff.

trait.name: Thunderous Stride
entries: If the brontosaurus moves on its turn, the ground within 10 feet of it becomes difficult terrain for all other creatures until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the brontosaurus fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The brontosaurus attacks twice with its stomp, one of which it may replace with a use of its Tail Sweep, if available.

action.name: Stomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage. This attack deals an additional 9 ({@damage 2d8}) bludgeoning damage to a {@condition prone} creature.

action.name: Tail Sweep {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature in a 20 ft. cone must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The dragon can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Battle Analyst
entries: The dragon has advantage on saving throws against any spells or abilities it has been affected by in the last 24 hours.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Breath Weapons {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.

action.name: Arcing Helix Breath
entries: The dragon exhales lightning in a 40-foot line that is 5 feet wide and may make a turn of up to 90 degrees whenever it passes over a creature or metal object. Each creature in that line must make a DC {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw, taking 16 ({@damage 3d10}) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Repulsion Breath
entries: The dragon exhales repulsion energy in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is pushed 30 feet away from the dragon. A creature wearing metal armor makes this saving throw at disadvantage.

trait.name: Concussive Strength
entries: A creature knocked {@condition prone} by the bear must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be unable to stand on its following turn.

trait.name: Rear Up
entries: The bear may use 30 ft. of its movement to stand upright until the end of its turn. While standing, the bear has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks and attacks made with its claws, and cannot attack with its bite.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bear makes two claw attacks. If both attacks hit the same medium or smaller creature, it is knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage. This attack does an additional 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage to a {@condition prone} creature.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Bluff Charge {@recharge 5}
entries: The bear moves up to its speed towards a creature. Each creature within 10 ft. of where it ends this movement must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of the bear's next turn.
If no creature fails this save, the bear may make a claw attack against a creature in range as part of this action.

monster.name: Brown Rkto, Beast of the Three Maidens

trait.name: Name of the Bear
entries: Rkto knows the type and location of each creature that has heard her name in the last 24 hours. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by Rkto learns her name.
Those wishing to avoid using her name often refer to her as "The Brown One", "Honey-Eater", or "Ur-Mother".

trait.name: Final Curse
entries: A creature that kills Rkto with an attack is cursed until a grand funeral has been held for her. While cursed, a creature makes Death saving throws at disadvantage. If this curse is removed by other means, Rkto immediately returns to life with half of her hit points.

trait.name: You Will Know Her (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
entries: When Rkto is reduced to 0 hit points, she doesn't die or fall {@condition unconscious}. Instead, she gains 162 temporary hit points and each other creature within 60 feet loses immunity to the {@condition frightened} condition.

For the next hour, a {@condition prone} creature that knows Rkto's name and that starts its turn within 30 feet of her is {@condition frightened} until the beginning of its next turn and takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) psychic damage.

trait.name: Legendary Resistances (3/Day)
entries: If Rkto fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Rkto makes three attacks, one of which may be with her bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}25 ({@damage 4d8 + 7}) piercing damage. This attack does an additional 9 ({@damage 2d8}) damage to a {@condition prone} creature.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 4d6 + 7}) slashing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.
A creature that fails this save by 5 or more cannot stand on its following turn.

action.name: Hail of Splinters {@recharge 5}
entries: Rkto rakes her claws against a tree within her reach. Each creature in a 30 foot cone must succeed on a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw or take 42 ({@damage 12d6}) piercing damage, or half as much on a success. If the tree is Huge or smaller, it is destroyed.

reaction.name: Run Down
entries: As a reaction to a hostile creature Rkto can see ending its movement at least 20 feet further from her than it started, Rkto moves up to her speed towards the creature.
If Rkto ends this movement within 5 feet of the creature, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

legendary.name: Rear Up
entries: Rkto stands upright until the end of her next turn. While standing, Rkto has advantage on attacks made with her claws, and ranged attacks against her are made at advantage.

legendary.name: Bluff Charge
entries: Rkto moves up to her speed towards a creature. Each creature within 10 feet of where she ends this movement must succeed on a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to move half its speed away from her.

legendary.name: Ground Slap (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Rkto makes a claw attack. If no creature is in her reach, each creature within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

legendary.name: Endure (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Rkto gains resistance to every damage type but Psychic until the end of her next turn.

trait.name: Instinctive Hibernation
entries: Whenever the scavver takes cold damage, if it has fewer than 10 hit points remaining it falls asleep for the next minute.

trait.name: Electrosensitive
entries: If the scavver takes any lightning damage, it has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Swallowing Reflex
entries: A creature may throw an object into the scavver's mouth with a successful improvised attack roll against the scavver's AC. If it does, the scavver swallows the object, counting as a willing creature for any effects of the swallowed object.

action.name: Gulp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the scavver (escape {@dc 13}).

While swallowed, a creature is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the scavver, and takes 13 ({@damage 3d8}) poison damage at the start of each of the scavver's turns.

action.name: Broadside Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

reaction.name: Vent Gullet
entries: As a reaction when a creature it has swallowed escapes, the scavver vents the poisonous gas from its gullet. Each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) poison damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Home Defender
entries: Whenever a creature passes through a threshold in a home that contains one or more brownies, the brownie can force the creature to succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or suffer one of the following effects:

items.name: Triptwine
entries: The creature takes 2 ({@damage 1d4}) bludgeoning damage and is knocked {@condition prone}.

items.name: Fingerstinger
entries: The creature takes 2 ({@damage 1d4}) poison damage and drops one object it is carrying.

items.name: Pepperpouch
entries: The creature is {@condition blinded} and unable to speak or breathe until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Corner of Your Eye
entries: The brownie is {@condition invisible} to creatures with less than 20 Passive {@skill Perception}. Whenever it is hit with an attack, this trait is disabled for the next minute, or until it is missed with an attack.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The brownie has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The brownie makes two attacks, each of which it can replace with its Brownie's Cunning.

action.name: Toe-Stubber
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 bludgeoning damage. On a critical hit, the target is knocked {@condition prone} if it is Medium or smaller and has its movement speed reduced by 10 for the next minute.

action.name: Rubber Sling
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Brownie's Cunning
entries: The brownie makes a Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) or Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check.

reaction.name: Trick Shot
entries: As a reaction when a creature the brownie can see within 30 feet drops an object, the brownie makes an attack with its rubber sling against an AC of 20. On a hit, the dropped object is pushed 15 feet in a direction of the brownie's choice.

trait.name: Predatory Eye
entries: The bugbear has advantage on attack rolls against creatures with no adjacent allies.

trait.name: Surprise Attack
entries: If the bugbear surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage from the attack.

action.name: Morningstar
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d8 + 2}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Javelin
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Predatory Eye
entries: The bugbear has advantage on attack rolls against creatures with no adjacent allies.

trait.name: Surprise Attack
entries: If the bugbear surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage from the attack.

action.name: Skullthumper
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage. If this attack was made with advantage, the target must make a {@dc 13} Constitution Saving Throw or be knocked {@condition prone} and unable to stand on its next turn.

action.name: Hand Axe
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Predatory Eye
entries: The bugbear has advantage on attack rolls against creatures with no adjacent allies.

trait.name: Surprise Attack
entries: If the bugbear surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage from the attack.

trait.name: Raid Leader
entries: Friendly bugbears witin 30 ft. may use the raid leader's attack bonus instead of their own.

trait.name: Birdcall Coordination
entries: The bugbear and its allies can communicate simple ideas over up to 120 ft. without alerting enemies to their presence. On the first turn of combat, each bugbear within 60 ft of the chieftian may act on the highest initiative rolled among them, rather than on their own.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bugbear makes two attacks with its machete and uses its fade away, if available.

action.name: Machete
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage. If this attack was made with advantage, the target begins to bleed. At the beginning of each of its turns, an affected creature must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw, losing {@dice 1d4} hit points on a failure, or ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Fade Away {@recharge 5}
entries: Up to three friendly bugbears within 60 may each use their reactions to move up to half their speed and take the {@action Hide} action.

trait.name: Predatory Eye
entries: The bugbear has advantage on attack rolls against creatures with no adjacent allies.

trait.name: Surprise Attack
entries: If the bugbear surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage from the attack.

trait.name: Skilled Ambusher
entries: The bugbear can attempt to hide without concealment in natural environments as long as it has 1 minute to prepare.

action.name: Garotte
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}). While {@condition grappled} in this way, a creature is unable to speak or breathe. If the attack was made at advantage, the target immediately begins to suffocate.

action.name: Throttle
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the bugbear must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or take 28 ({@damage 8d6}) slashing damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Predatory Eye
entries: The bugbear has advantage on attack rolls against creatures with no adjacent allies.

trait.name: Surprise Attack
entries: If the bugbear surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage from the attack.

trait.name: Indistinct
entries: The thicket shura does not reveal its position automatically when it is hidden and makes a ranged attack. Instead, a creature must discover its position by succeeding on a {@dc 16} {@skill Perception} (Wisdom) check as an action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bugbear makes two attacks with its bolas.

action.name: Bolas
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage. If the attack was made at advantage, the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity Saving Throw or have its movement speed halved until it takes an action to remove the bolas.

trait.name: Predatory Eye
entries: The bugbear has advantage on attack rolls against creatures with no adjacent allies.

trait.name: Surprise Attack
entries: If the bugbear surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage from the attack.

trait.name: Trapdoor Tunneler
entries: The bugbear leaves a 5-ft.-diameter tunnel in its wake while burrowing. Over the course of an hour, the bugbear can construct a trapdoor of vegetation and debris that makes an opening up to 5 ft. across indistinguishable from natural terrain. Creatures using the tunnels to hide gain advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bugbear makes two attacks with its skullthumper.

action.name: Skullthumper
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage. If this attack was made with advantage, the target must make a {@dc 15} Constitution Saving Throw or be knocked {@condition prone} and unable to stand on its next turn.

action.name: Collapse Tunnel (1/Day)
entries: The bugbear causes up to 20 ft. of a 5 ft. diameter tunnel within 20 ft. to collapse. Creatures inside the collapsed portion are {@condition blinded}, {@condition restrained}, and cannot speak or breathe. As an action, a creature may attempt a {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check, clearing 5 ft. of the collapse and freeing any creatures in the cleared area on a success.

trait.name: Earthsteed
entries: The bulette can form a magical bond to a creature over the course of a long rest, which lasts until it uses this ability again.
A bonded creature can ride the bulette while it burrows, and while riding gains {@sense tremorsense} out to a range of 30 feet. A creature riding a burrowing bulette cannot speak or breathe.

trait.name: Shock Attack
entries: If the bulette starts its turn underground, creatures without {@sense tremorsense} may not take reactions on its turn while within 5 feet of it.

action.name: Snapping Maw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d10 + 3}) piercing damage.
The bulette may make this attack as a bonus action against a {@condition prone} creature.

trait.name: Bonefin Display
entries: While burrowing just beneath the surface, the bulette's bony dorsal fin is visible and can be targeted.

A creature that can see three or more fins protruding above the surface in this way at the start of its turn must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Shock Attack
entries: If the bulette starts its turn underground, creatures without {@sense tremorsense} may not take reactions on its turn while within 5 feet of it.

trait.name: Invisible
entries: The caligrosto is {@condition invisible}. To creatures that ignore the effects of its invisibility, a weapon possessed by the caligrosto appears to be seething with coils of lightning-flecked mist.

trait.name: Blade Haunting
entries: A blade {@condition possessed|confc|possessed} by the caligrosto grows in power, cumulatively gaining the following traits as the caligrosto consumes hit dice lost to its abilities, and resetting to 0 hit dice at dawn:

items.name: 0 Hit Dice
entries: As an action, the weapon's wielder may lose two unexpended hit dice, feeding the blade.

items.name: 2 Hit Dice
entries: The weapon deals an additional {@damage 1d6} fire damage and scores a critical on a 19-20.

items.name: 4 Hit Dice
entries: The weapon's wielder gains 10 temporary hit points whenever it reduces a creature to 0 hit points.

items.name: 6 Hit Dice
entries: While {@condition incapacitated}, the weapon's wielder ignores the effects of being {@condition incapacitated} and acts under the caligrosto's control.

items.name: 8 Hit Dice
entries: On each of the caligrosto's turns, it may move the blade up to the caligrosto's fly speed and make two attacks with it ({@hit 7} to hit, +4 to damage rolls).

trait.name: Masked Nature
entries: While the caligrosto is possessing a weapon, its creature type can't be detected by spells or magical effects.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The caligrosto can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

action.name: Lifeblood Empowerment
entries: One creature within 5 feet of the caligrosto must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 3d8}) necrotic damage and lose two unexpended hit dice, or drop to 0 hit points if it cannot.

action.name: Spawn Blood Echo (1/Day)

While wielded by a Blood Echo, the effects of the caligrosto's Blade Haunting are represented in the Blood Echo's stat block and are not cumulative with it.

action.name: Blade Possession (1/Day)

If the weapon is magical, the caligrosto must immediately succeed on a {@dc 20} Charisma saving throw or be expelled from the weapon. Once expelled from a weapon, the caligrosto can't enter that weapon again.

reaction.name: Brutal Triumph

entries: When the caller is hit with a melee attack, it can move up to half its speed without provoking {@action opportunity attack||opportunity attacks}.

reaction.name: Draw Forth
entries: When a creature within 30 feet fails a death save, the caller can use its Soul Calling, targeting that creature.

trait.name: Fiendish Blessing
entries: The AC of the cambion includes its Charisma bonus.

trait.name: Liar's Insight
entries: The cambion knows if it hears a lie.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cambion makes two melee attacks or uses its Fire Ray twice. It may replace one of its attacks with a use of its Soulscorch, if available.

action.name: Spear
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage and 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Hellfire Ray
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 7} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Soulscorch {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature within 60 feet that the cambion can see must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) necrotic damage and begin to burn, or half damage on a success. A burning creature repeats this saving throw at the end of their turn, taking 10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage on a failure, or ending the condition on a success.

action.name: Fiendish Charm
entries: One humanoid the cambion can see within 30 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be magically {@condition charmed} for 1 day. The {@condition charmed} target obeys the cambion's spoken commands. If the target suffers any harm from the cambion or another creature or receives a suicidal command from the cambion, the target can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful, or if the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the cambion's Fiendish Charm for the next 24 hours.

reaction.name: Hellish Rebuke (1st level spell)
entries: As a reaction to being damaged by a creature, the cambion may force the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or take 11 ({@damage 2d10}) fire damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Dimensional Lock
entries: Other creatures can't teleport to or from a space within 60 feet of the canoloth. Any attempt to do so is wasted. Creatures in the area have resistance to Force damage.

trait.name: Outsize Strength
entries: While grappling, dragging, or being ridden by another creature, the canoloth is considered to be Large.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The canoloth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Barbed Tongue
entries: A creature that starts its turn {@condition grappled} by the canoloth takes 13 ({@damage 2d12}) piercing damage. The tongue can be attacked (AC 20; 10 hit points). Destroying the tongue deals no damage to the canoloth, which can extrude more tongue on its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The canoloth makes two attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}25 ({@damage 6d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Tongue
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d12 + 4}) piercing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}), and is {@condition restrained} until the grapple ends. The canoloth can grapple one target at a time with its tongue.

reaction.name: Reel
entries: As a reaction to a creature damaging its tongue or failing an attempt to escape its grapple, the canoloth may force a creature {@condition grappled} by it to succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone} and pulled 30 feet towards the canoloth.

trait.name: Ghoulish Host
entries: If the captain takes any radiant damage, he cannot make more than one attack on its following turn.

trait.name: Part of the Crew
entries: When a member of the captain's crew that the captain can see is destroyed, the captain makes a {@dc 10} Charisma saving throw. On a success, the crew member regains 1 hit point.

trait.name: Slippery
entries: The captain doesn't provoke {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity} when he leaves an opponent's reach, and has advantage on checks made to avoid or escape from grapples or restraint.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The captain makes two melee attacks, one of which may be with his festering bite.

action.name: Festering Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., targets one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) piercing damage and 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Cutlass
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage. On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or drop one item is is holding.

action.name: Boarding Action {@recharge 5}
entries: Up to four members of the captain's crew that he can see may each use their reactions to move up to their speed and make a {@dc 10} {@skill Acrobatics} check.
On a success, the crew member may make a melee attack as part of this reaction.

reaction.name: Dashing Riposte
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack, the captain moves up to half his speed without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity} and makes a melee attack.

reaction.name: Drop Limb
entries: As a reaction to taking 6 or more damage, the captain drops one of his limbs, reducing the damage taken to 5.
A hanzaki that drops an arm makes one fewer attack with its multiattack. A hanzaki that drops a leg reduces its maximum speed by half.

trait.name: Underfoot
entries: The capuchin can take the {@action Dodge} or {@action Hide} action as a bonus action if it is within 5 feet of at least two Medium or larger hostile creatures, even if it is not obscured.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 0} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 ({@damage 1d6 - 2}) piercing damage.

monster.name: Caramel Weird
languages: understands Ignan and Terran but doesn't speak

trait.name: Invisible in Caramel
entries: The caramel weird is {@condition invisible} while fully immersed in caramel.

trait.name: Rising Heat
entries: If the caramel weird takes any fire damage, it boils and darkens.
For the next minute, the caramel weird cannot benefit from invisibility and its melee attacks deal an additional 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Molten Tendril
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}).
If the caramel weird takes any cold damage, this tendril freezes and shatters, releasing any creature {@condition grappled} by it.

action.name: Scald Skin {@recharge}
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the weird must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Sticky Seal
entries: When a creature the caramel weird can see within 15 feet begins to cast a spell, it sloshes a gob of sticky sugar into the creature's mouth.

For the next minute, whenever the target casts a spell it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw with DC equal to 10 + the spell's level or have the spell fail. On a successful saving throw, the effect ends.

trait.name: Calming Presence
entries: Each creature within 5 ft. of the carbuncle has advantage on saving throws to maintain {@status concentration} or to resist an effect that would Frighten it.

trait.name: Head Gem
entries: The carbuncle has a worthless translucent horny growth in its forehead that resembles a large ruby or garnet. A creature that pries it off with a successful {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or contract {@disease leprosy|ConfC}.

action.name: Disarming Lick
entries: One creature within 5 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by the carbuncle until the end of its next turn, or until the creature is hit with an attack. Attack rolls against a creature {@condition charmed} in this way are made at advantage.

reaction.name: End Life
entries: As a reaction to a creature targeting the carbuncle with an attack or harmful spell, the carbuncle keels over and dies. The attacker may choose a new target.

reaction.name: Feign Death
entries: As a reaction to a creature targeting the carbuncle with an attack or harmful spell, the carbuncle keels over and appears to die. A creature may attempt a {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) or Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check as a Bonus Action to determine it is faking. The attacker may choose a new target.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The carrion crawler has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The carrion crawler can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Consume
entries: If the carrion crawler has a creature {@condition grappled}, the carrion crawler can make a predigest attack as a bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The carrion crawler makes two attacks with its tentacles.

action.name: Tentacles
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) poison damage, the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the carrion crawler can't use its tentacles against another target.

action.name: Predigest
entries: One {@condition grappled} creature must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. While {@condition poisoned} in this way, attackers score a critical hit against the {@condition poisoned} creature on a roll of 11-20. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the poison on itself on a success.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Bite Down
entries: As a reaction to being hit with an attack by a creature it does not have {@condition grappled}, the carrion crawler makes a bite attack against a creature it has {@condition grappled}.

trait.name: Righting Reflex
entries: The cat takes no fall damage if it falls from a height of 30 ft. or greater.

trait.name: Pounce
entries: If the cat moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 6} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 0} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 slashing damage.

reaction.name: Cruel Jest
entries: As a reaction when a Tiny creature attempts to leave the cat's reach, the cat may force it to make a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Stench
entries: Any creature other than a catoblepas that starts its turn within 10 feet of the catoblepas must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the start of the creature's next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the stench of any catoblepas for 1 hour.

trait.name: Harbinger of Tragedy
entries: A creature that sees a catoblepas must succeed on a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw or be {@condition cursed|confc|cursed}, becoming immune to this curse for the next 24 hours on a success. A creature cursed in this way dies after two failed death Saving Throws, rather than three.

action.name: Whipneck Gore
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}26 ({@damage 5d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed 10 ft. away.

action.name: Tail Club
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 5d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is unable to stand or swim for the next minute.

action.name: Final Glance {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or suffer vulnerability to all damage for the next minute. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more instead suffers vulnerability to all damage until it completes a long rest.

trait.name: Stench
entries: Any creature other than a catoblepas that starts its turn within 10 feet of the catoblepas must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the start of the creature's next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the stench of any catoblepas for 1 hour.

trait.name: Harbinger of Tragedy
entries: A creature that sees a catoblepas must succeed on a {@dc 16} Charisma saving throw or be {@condition cursed|confc|cursed}, becoming immmune to this curse for the next 24 hours on a success. A creature cursed in this way dies after two failed death Saving Throws, rather than three.

trait.name: Inevitable Call
entries: At the beginning of each of the catoblepas' turns, each creature within 100 ft. that does not have all of its hit points is dragged 15 ft. toward it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Catoblepas makes two melee attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its Final Glance, if available.

action.name: Whipneck Gore
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}28 ({@damage 5d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed 10 ft. away.

action.name: Tail Club
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 5d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is unable to stand or swim for the next minute.

action.name: Final Glance {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or suffer vulnerability to all damage for the next minute. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more instead suffers vulnerability to all damage until it completes a long rest.

reaction.name: Withering Gaze (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 82 hit points, the catoblepas forces one creature it can see within 30 feet to make a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw, taking 36 ({@damage 8d8}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The target dies if reduced to 0 hit points by this ray.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Flammable Blood
entries: If the cave fisher takes fire damage while below 30 hit points, it catches fire; until someone takes an action to douse the fire, it takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage at the start of each of its turns, and deals an additional 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage with its melee attacks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cave fisher makes two melee attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hits: 10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d8 + 2}) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. A {@condition poisoned} creature repeats this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Adhesive Filament
entries: The cave fisher extrudes a sticky filament up to 60 ft. A creature that touches this filament is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}). The filament can be attacked (AC 15; 5 hit points; immunity to poison and psychic damage), but a weapon that fails to sever it becomes stuck to it, requiring an action and a successful {@dc 13} Strength check to pull free. Destroying the filament causes no damage to the cave fisher, which can extrude a replacement filament on its next turn.

action.name: Reel
entries: One Medium or smaller creature {@condition grappled} by the cave fisher's filament becomes {@condition restrained} must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 60 ft. toward the cave fisher.

reaction.name: Angler's Set
entries: As a reaction to a creature becoming {@condition grappled} by or failing an attempt to escape its filament, the cave fisher uses its Reel.

trait.name: Aberrant Quickness
entries: The choker may dash as a bonus action while it has a creature {@condition grappled}.

trait.name: Boneless
entries: The choker can move through and occupy a space as narrow as 4 inches wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Camouflage
entries: The choker is {@condition invisible} to creatures more than 30 feet away from it.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The choker can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
