entries: The choker makes two barbed tentacle attacks.

action.name: Barbed Tentacle
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, can't speak or breathe, and the choker can't grapple another target.

action.name: Throttle
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the choker must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) bludgeoning damage, lose its held breath, and begin to suffocate.

trait.name: Bolting Reflex
entries: When initiative is rolled, the celestial charger moves up to half its speed away from the nearest enemy without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

A creature riding the celestial charger may attempt a {@dc 14} Wisdom ({@skill Animal Handling}) check to instead control the direction of this movement, with disadvantage if the horse has taken any damage.

trait.name: Trampling Charge
entries: If the celestial charger moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with a hooves attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Zephyr Footing
entries: The celestial charger ignores difficult terrain and can move across any solid or liquid surface. On its turn, the celestial charger has a fly speed equal to its movement speed.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The celestial charger makes two attacks with its hooves.

action.name: Hooves
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 10 ft. away.

reaction.name: Quick Kick
entries: When a creature makes an attack against the celestial charger that benefits from flanking it, the celestial charger can make an Hooves attack against the attacker.

trait.name: Poison Vulnerability
entries: The centaur has disadvantage on saving throws against drunkenness and the {@condition poisoned} condition.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the centaur moves at least 20 ft. before attacking, its attacks are made at advantage.

action.name: Pike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) piercing damage. If this attack was made at advantage, the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Hooves
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage. The centaur may make this attack as a bonus action against a {@condition prone} creature.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Quick Kick
entries: As a reaction to a creature making an attack against the centaur that benefits from flanking it, the centaur makes a hooves attack.

trait.name: Poison Vulnerability
entries: The centaur has disadvantage on saving throws against drunkenness and the {@condition poisoned} condition.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the centaur moves at least 20 ft. before attacking, its attacks are made at advantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The centaur attacks three times with its longbow, or makes one melee attack and takes the disengage action.

action.name: Bastard Sword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d10 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Hooves
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage. The centaur may make this attack as a bonus action against a {@condition prone} creature.

action.name: Centaur Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 7} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage. If this attack was made at advantage, the target is pushed back 5 ft.

reaction.name: Quick Kick
entries: As a reaction to a creature making an attack against the centaur that benefits from flanking it, the centaur makes a hooves attack.

variant.name: Note: Centaur Longbow
entries: The centaur longbow can be wielded by ordinary humanoids, but requires a Strength of 15 and can only be fired while mounted, due to its size.

trait.name: Trampling Charge
entries: If the centrosaurus moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with a goring horns attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Bony Frill
entries: While the centrosaurus is not {@condition flanked|confc|flanked}, it has resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage dealt by melee attacks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The centrosaurus makes up to two attacks; one with its gore and one with its stomp, if available.

action.name: Goring Horns
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) piercing damage and the target is pushed 5 ft. away.

action.name: Stomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition prone} creature. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

reaction.name: Dominance Display
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a ranged attack by a creature within 30 ft., the centrosaurus shakes its horn. The attacker may use its reaction to drop {@condition prone}; if the creature does not, or if it stands before the end of its turn, the centrosaurus may move up to 30 ft. towards it and make a gore attack.

resist.special: weapon attacks not made from inside it

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The worm can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

trait.name: Earth Quaker
entries: When the worm burrows 30 feet or fewer below the surface, 10 foot wide, 10 foot deep fissures open at the surface above where it passes. Creatures in the space where a fissure opens must succeed on a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone} in the trench. On a success, a creature may use its reaction to move up to 10 feet to avoid falling in.

trait.name: Worm Keening
entries: At the beginning of the worm's turn, each creature within 30 feet of the worm takes 18 ({@damage 4d8}) thunder damage and is {@condition deafened}. Structures in the area instead take maximum damage.

trait.name: Shock Sensitivity
entries: If the worm, or the ground within 30 feet of it is subjected to lightning damage, it cannot use its Terror From the Deep or Swallow Earth actions on its next turn, and must use all of its movement to surface.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the worm fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The worm attacks twice with its Spit Bile.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 15} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}31 ({@damage 4d10 + 9}) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the worm. A swallowed creature is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the worm.

If the worm takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the worm must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall {@condition prone} in a space within 10 feet of the worm. If the worm dies, a swallowed creature is no longer {@condition restrained} by it and can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting {@condition prone}.

action.name: Spit Bile
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 30 ft., one target. {@h}27 ({@damage 6d8}) acid damage. Additionally on a hit, if the target is wearing nonmagical armor, it takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers. Armor reduced to an AC of 10 is destroyed.

action.name: Swallow Earth
entries: While burrowing no more than 20 feet beneath the surface, the worm begins to swallow the earth above it. A 5 foot radius pit appears on the surface above the worm; each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw or fall in and have the worm immediately make a bite attack against it, or move to the nearest adjacent space on a success.

action.name: Terror From the Deep {@recharge 5}
entries: The worm moves up to its burrow speed, then bursts from underground thrashing in a flurry of debris. Each creature in a 15 foot radius must succeed on a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw or take 35 ({@damage 10d6}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}, or half damage on a success. As a bonus action, the worm may make a bite attack against a creature that failed this saving throw.

legendary.name: Writhing Dive
entries: The century worm moves up to half its burrow speed. Each creature that makes an {@action opportunity attack||attack of opportunity} provoked by this movement must succeed on a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw or fall into the tunnel left in its wake.

legendary.name: Bile Surge (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Each creature swallowed by the century worm must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 5d8}) acid damage. On the worm's following turn, attacks it makes with its Spit Bile are at advantage.

legendary.name: Wriggling Progeny (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Each creature swallowed by the century worm must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or have its Constitution modifier reduced by {@dice 1d6}, to a minimum of 1. A creature that has its Constitution modifier reduced to 1 in this way takes 28 ({@damage 8d6}) piercing damage and has a century worm larva burrow into its body and attach to its spine, then is ejected from the century worm.
While it has a larva burrowed in it, a creature is {@condition charmed} by the worm and must use its action to dash each turn until it finds soft earth in which to dig a hole and bury itself alive.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The cerebrilith has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Thought-Taster
entries: If the cerebrilith runs its tongue across a creature's exposed brain, it learns each of that creature's deepest secrets.

trait.name: Independent Lobes
entries: The cerebrilith can concentrate on up to four separate effects simultaneously. If it fails a saving throw to maintain {@status concentration}, it loses {@status concentration} on each effect it is {@status concentration||concentrating} on.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cerebrilith attacks four times with its Brainrake Claws, one of which it may replace with a use of its Searing Probe or Thought Mine.

action.name: Brainrake Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) slashing damage. A creature killed by this damage has the upper part of its skull removed.

action.name: Searing Probe (Concentration)
entries: The cerebrilith viciously delves into a creature's mind, telepathically relaying its secret weaknesses to the cerebrilith's allies.

One creature the cerebrilith can see within 60 feet must make a {@dc 19} Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, attacks made against the creature score a critical on an 17-20 for the next minute.

action.name: Thought Mine (Concentration)
entries: The cerebrilith sets a bomb of psionic energy in the mind of a creature it can see within 120 feet, forcing it to make a {@dc 19} Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, the first time in the next minute that the creature casts a spell of 1st level or above or uses a psionic ability, it takes 44 ({@damage 8d10}) psychic damage.

action.name: Desecration Stride (6th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: For the next minute, whenever the cerebrilith takes damage it may teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. Each other creature within 10 feet of that space takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Plane Shift (7th level spell, 1/Day)
entries: The cerebrilith and up to eight willing creatures within 10 feet of it teleport to another plane of existence.

bonus.name: Multilobe Psionics
entries: The cerebrilith gains one of the following benefits for as long as it maintains {@status concentration} on it:

items.name: Thought Backup
entries: The cerebrilith has advantage on saving throws to maintain {@status concentration}.

items.name: Shadow in the Weave
entries: A creature other than the cerebrilith that casts a spell of 1st level or higher while within 30 feet of the cerebrilith must succeed on a {@dc 18} Charisma saving throw or take 3 ({@damage 1d6}) psychic damage per level of the spell.

items.name: Mindslice
entries: The cerebrilith's melee attacks have a reach of 60 feet and deal psychic damage instead of any other type.

items.name: Psionic Mirage
entries: Attacks made against the cerebrilith from more than 30 feet away are made at disadvantage.

monster.name: Cerunnos, Master of the Wild Hunt

immune.note: damage from weapons that aren't named

trait.name: Woad-Clad
entries: Ranged attacks against Cerunnos made from more than 30 feet away hit only on a critical. If Cerunnos is drenched in holy water, this trait is suspended until he completes a Short or Long Rest.

trait.name: Moonlit Raed
entries: While lit by moonlight, the first time each turn Cerunnos leaves a creature's sight that creature must succeed on a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw or lose all clear memories of him, recalling him only as a dim and distant dream.

trait.name: Archfey Resilience
entries: Cerunnos succeeds automatically on saving throws against spells and magical effects imposed by a creature that does not know his name, and has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If Cerunnos would fail a saving throw, he may choose to succeed.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Cerunnos makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Dubh Smàladh, the Smoldering Cloud
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d8 + 7}) piercing damage and Cerunnos adds an additional effect of his choice:
The target takes an additional 14 ({@damage 4d6}) lighting damage.
The target must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or be levitated up to 30 feet into the air until the beginning of Cerunnos' next turn.
The target must succeed on a {@dc 20} Charisma saving throw or switch places with a willing creature within 60 feet of it that Cerunnos can see.

action.name: Wild Terror {@recharge 5}
entries: Cerunnos lets loose a wild cry that plants the frantic terror of a hounded beast. Each creature of his choice that can see or hear him must succeed on a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened}. A {@condition frightened} creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is polymorphed into a {@creature deer|MM|Hart} for as long as it remains {@condition frightened}, or until it takes any damage.

reaction.name: Flush Quarry
entries: As a reaction when a creature fails at an attempt to {@action Hide} from Cerunnos, Cerunnos uses his Scouring Moonfire targeting it, if available.

reaction.name: Horn of the Wild Hunt (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 179 hit points, Cerunnos blows the Horn of the Wild hunt, summoning five {@creature hound of the wild hunt|confc|Hounds of the Wild Hunt} that act on his initiative to unoccupied spaces he can see.

legendary.name: Scouring Moonfire
entries: One creature illuminated by moonlight that cerunnos can see must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) radiant damage. A flying or levitating creature makes this save at disadvantage.

legendary.name: Blood Hunt
entries: Up to two of Cerunnos' hound allies, or up to one of his non-hound allies, may use its reaction to move up to half its speed and make a melee weapon attack.

legendary.name: Invective of the Thrice-Cursed (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: One creature within 30 feet that Cerunnos can see must succeed on a {@dc 20} Charisma saving throw or have its Wisdom score reduced by {@dice 1d4} until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic, to a minimum of 1.
A creature that dies with its Wisdom score reduced to 1 in this way is claimed as a rider of The Wild Hunt, and cannot be revived by any means short of a {@spell Wish} spell.

trait.name: Careening Flight
entries: When the beetle begins flying, it must choose a direction to fly in, and must use all of its movement on each of its turns to fly in that direction until it lands or collides with a creature or object.

trait.name: Spiracle Breathing
entries: The beetle has disadvantage on Constitution saving throws against inhaled toxins.

action.name: Oaksplitter Mandibles
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}).

action.name: Tactical Collision
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the beetle falls {@condition prone}.

action.name: Behemoth Lift
entries: The beetle attempts to grasp a Gargantuan or smaller creature with its horns and flip it, forcing the target to succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.
A creature {@condition grappled} by the beetle makes this saving throw with disadvantage, and is freed from the grapple on a failed saving throw.

reaction.name: Redeploy Wings
entries: When the beetle begins to fall, it can make a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw. On a success, the beetle falls only 10 feet before catching itself in the air.

trait.name: Spying Eye
entries: The otyugh has advantage on checks made to hide while submerged in filth.

trait.name: Horrid Stench
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the Otyugh must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The otyugh makes three attacks, one of which may be with its diseased bite.

action.name: Diseased Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or contract {@disease filth fever|ConfC}.

action.name: Spined Tentacle
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}). The otyugh has two tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.

action.name: Tentacle Slam {@recharge 5}
entries: The otyugh slams up to two creatures {@condition grappled} by it into each other or a solid surface. Each creature must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 3d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage and be {@condition stunned} until the end of the otyugh's next turn, or take half as much damage on a success.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Living Chains
entries: The chain devil has two chains, though it can control up to five through its Animate Chains ability. Each chain can be attacked (AC 20; 20 HP; immunity to poison psychic damage). Destroying a chain deals no damage to the devil.

trait.name: Unnerving Mask
entries: Beneath its chains and wounds, the devil always appears to be a deceased individual that has some significance to the observer. A creature that starts its turn within 30 ft. of the devil must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or subtract {@dice 1d4} from attack rolls it makes against the devil until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The devil uses its Animate Chains, then makes a number of attacks equal to the number of chains it currently has.

action.name: Chain
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage and the target suffers an additional effect of the devil's choice.

items.name: Barbed
entries: The target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}) in place. While {@condition grappled} in this way, the target is {@condition restrained} and takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) piercing damage at the start of each of its turns.

items.name: Bladed
entries: The target takes an additional 7 ({@damage 2d6}) slashing damage.

items.name: Weighted
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or take 3 ({@dice 1d6}) bludgeoning damgage and be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Animate Chains
entries: One chain the devil can see within 60 feet of it magically sprouts razor-edged barbs and animates under the devil's control for the next minute, provided that the chains aren't being worn or carried. Whenever the devil uses its multiattack, it may move each chain under its control up to 15 ft. and make an attack from its location (included in the multiattack).

reaction.name: Battle Dance
entries: As a reaction to being hit with an {@action opportunity attack||attack of opportunity}, the devil makes a chain attack.

reaction.name: Chains of Vengeance (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 86 hit points, the chain devil makes two chain attacks.

trait.name: Chill Dormancy
entries: If the basidirond would take any cold damage, it instead takes no damage and falls {@condition unconscious} until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The basidirond makes three attacks with its Bore-Stem Spike, one of which it may replace with a use of its Cap Slam.

action.name: Bore-Stem Spike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d10 + 5}) piercing damage.
A {@condition prone} target takes an additional 5 ({@damage 1d10}) piercing damage and is {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 16}) until the basidirond moves.

action.name: Cap Slam
entries: The basidirond lurches forward, slamming its cap into a creature within 5 feet. The target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Absorb Vitality
entries: One creature {@condition restrained} by the basidirond's Boring Stems must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or lose 5 ({@dice 2d4}) unexpended hit dice, or drop to 0 hit points if it cannot. The basidirond regains 5 hit points for each hit die lost in this way.

reaction.name: Stranglespore Gout {@recharge 5}
entries: When the basidirond uses its Cap Slam, it can scatter sooty black spores in a 30 foot cone extending from the target.
Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be unable to speak or breathe until the end of the basidirond's next turn.

monster.name: Chameleonic Pseudodragon
languages: but communicates only in images and ideas.

trait.name: Scent-Reading
entries: The pseudodragon has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check to determine the mental state of creatures it can smell.

trait.name: Shifting Scales
entries: As a Bonus Action, the pseudodragon may magically match its appearance to its surroundings, becoming {@condition invisible} to creatures more than 10 feet away from it until it moves or makes an attack.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The pseudodragon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Slinking Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.
Before or after making this attack, the pseudodragon may move up to 5 feet without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

action.name: Drowsy Sting
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for the next minute.

A creature {@condition poisoned} in this way repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success, or falling asleep until the beginning of its next turn on a failure. A creature wakes early if it takes any damage, or if a creature uses an action to shake it awake.

trait.name: Weightless Careening
entries: Whenever the living spell takes damage of a type is not resistant to, it is pushed 30 feet away from the damage's source.
If the living spell collides with a solid object or surface, it bounces.

trait.name: Living Magic
entries: If the living spell is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as {@spell Dispel Magic}, it must make a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC.
On a failure, the living spell is {@condition stunned} (Save Ends at end of turn).

action.name: Chaos Ram
entries: The living spell rockets up to 20 feet directly toward a creature it can see within 25 feet, then forces it to make a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw.
On a failed save, the target takes 13 ({@damage 3d8}) damage of a randomly selected type:
1. Acid
2. Cold
3. Fire
4. Lightning
5. Poison
6. Thunder

reaction.name: Collision Flare
entries: When the living spell is pushed into a solid wall, surface, or creature, it must use its Chaos Ram if its reaction is available, targeting the nearest creature in range.

trait.name: Spying Eye
entries: The otyugh has advantage on checks made to hide while submerged in filth.

trait.name: Horrid Stench
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the Otyugh must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Rotting Grip
entries: A creature {@condition grappled} by the otyugh that receives magical healing must expend a hit die or take 5 ({@damage 1d10}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The otyugh makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Maw of Decay
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@dice 2d10 + 5}) piercing plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or contract a disease of the otyugh's choice.
{@disease charnel lung|ConfC}
{@disease festering necrosis|ConfC}
{@disease filth fever|ConfC}

action.name: Spined Tentacle
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@dice 1d10 + 5}) bludgeoning plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}). The otyugh has two tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.

action.name: Tentacle Slam {@recharge 5}
entries: The otyugh slams up to two creatures {@condition grappled} by it into each other or a solid surface. Each creature must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 5d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage and be {@condition stunned} until the end of the otyugh's next turn, or take half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Body Shield
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with an attack while grappling one or more creatures, the otyugh adds +4 to its AC. If the attack misses, the attacker makes a new attack roll, targeting the {@condition grappled} creature instead.

reaction.name: Charnel Frenzy (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 125 hit points, the otyugh releases each creature it is grappling and makes four tentacle attacks that do not grapple on a hit.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The chasme can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the chasme takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the chasme takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

action.name: Plaguebearer Bites (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}4 piercing damage plus 2 necrotic damage.
If at least two other chasmes attacked with it, the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be afflicted with {@disease fading ague|ConfC}.

reaction.name: Droning Chorus
entries: When a creature the chasme can see within 30 feet makes a saving throw against another chasme's Drone, the chasme can force it to subtract one from its result.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The chasme can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Drone
entries: The chasme produces a horrid magical droning sound. A non-chasme creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of one or more chasmes that can hear them must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or deal only half damage with weapon attacks until the end of its next turn.
A creature that fails this save by 5 or more falls asleep until it takes damage or another creature takes an action to wake it.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The chasme has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Proboscis
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}16 ({@damage 4d6 + 2}) piercing damage plus 24 ({@damage 7d6}) necrotic damage.
On a critical hit, the target is {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Dream Desecration
entries: One sleeping creature the Chasme can see within 15 feet takes 14 ({@dice 4d6}) nonlethal psychic damage, then must make on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save, this damage does not wake the creature from its sleep, and the chasme discovers one fact which the creature wishes to keep hidden from it.

action.name: Demonic Abduction
entries: One demon of CR 5 or lower that the chasme has seen in the last 10 days must succeed on a {@dc 14} Charisma saving throw or teleport to switch positions with the chasme.
A creature that succeeds on this save is immune to the effect for 24 hours.

trait.name: Contact Reading
entries: A creature that misses ChengHan with a melee attack has disadvantage on attacks made against him until the creature hits him with a melee attack or moves at least 10 feet away from him.

trait.name: Slight-Bodied
entries: Whenever ChengHan is hit with a melee attack, he is pushed 5 feet away from the attacker.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: ChengHan makes two melee attacks, one of which may be with his sky kick.

action.name: Hooked Wind Blade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@dice 2d6 + 4}) and the target is pushed 5 ft. in a direction of ChengHan's choice.

action.name: Swordbreaker Flickmace
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Sky Kick
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.
On a critical hit, the target is launched 10 feet into the air and must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of ChengHan's next turn.

reaction.name: Chambered Kick
entries: As a reaction when a creature enters his reach, ChengHan makes an attack against it at advantage with his sky kick.

reaction.name: Snap Blade
entries: As a reaction when a creature misses him with a nonmagical weapon attack that deals piercing or slashing damage, ChengHan breaks the blade, reducing its damage die to {@dice 1d4}.

monster.name: Chicken Tree
languages: telepathy 60 ft. (Works Only With Creatures That Understand Abyssal)

trait.name: Boiling Blood
entries: Whenever the tree takes any slashing damage, the tree and one creature of its choice within 10 feet each take 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tree makes two attacks with its Meaty Slam, each of which it may replace with a use of its Spawn Chicken.

action.name: Meaty Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. {@h}21 ({@damage 4d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.
A creature that fails by 5 or more is instead {@condition stunned} until the end of the tree's next turn.

action.name: Spawn Chicken
entries: The tree loses 5 hit points as one of the fleshy sacs that hang from the its branches tears open in a shower of blood and amniotic fluid, spawning an {@creature abyssal chicken|confc|Abyssal Chicken} in the tree's space that acts on initiative count 0.

action.name: Hurl Sac {@recharge 5}
entries: The tree hurls a sac of putrefied demonflesh at a point within 60 feet, where it showers the area in a 10 foot radius in foul gore.
Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or take 17 ({@damage 5d6}) poison damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Horrid Scream
entries: When the chicken tree takes 15 or more damage from a single source, a garbled, squawking scream issues forth from its wounds.
Each abyssal chicken within 60 feet that can hear the tree may make a Razor Talon attack on its following turn as a Bonus Action.

trait.name: Chillborne Aura
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 10 ft. of one or more chillborn zombies takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) cold damage for each chillborn zombie within 10 ft. of it.

trait.name: Supercooled
entries: If the zombie takes any bludgeoning damage, after taking damage it gains vulnerability to bludgeoning damage until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The zombie makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Ice Reaper Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@dice 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) cold damage and the target's movement speed is reduced by 10 until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Flash Freeze {@recharge}
entries: When a creature within 5 feet has its movement speed reduced to 0, the zombie can force it to succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} until the end of the zombie's next turn.

monster.name: Chimera
languages: understands Draconic but can't speak it

trait.name: Three Heads
entries: The chimera has three reactions each round. Whenever it takes 20 or more damage from a single source it must make a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or lose one of its reactions.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chimera makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws. When its fire breath is available, it can use the breath in place of its bite.

action.name: Gnashing Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage plus 5 ({@damage 1d8}) fire damage

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage and the target is knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Fire Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon head exhales fire in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 31 ({@damage 7d8}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reaction.name: Headbutt
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the chimera may force the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) bludgeoning damage and be {@condition stunned} until the end of the chimera's next turn.

reaction.name: Rake
entries: As a reaction to a creature entering its reach, the chimera may make a claws attack against it.

reaction.name: Roar
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a ranged attack, the chimera may let out a terrifying roar. Each creature within 60 feet that can hear it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} of the chimera until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Web-Dweller
entries: The chitine can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty. While in contact with a web, the chitine knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

trait.name: Swarmer
entries: If at least two other friendly chitine are within 10 ft., the chitine may attempt to Grapple or Shove a creature as a bonus action.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the chitine has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chitine makes two attacks with its daggers.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Bind {@recharge 5}
entries: One {@condition grappled} and {@condition prone} creature within 5 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} in place by webbing (escape {@dc 14}). A creature that succeeds by 5 or more is no longer {@condition grappled} and may use its reaction to stand.

reaction.name: Shank
entries: As a reaction to a creature {@condition grappled} by the chitine missing it with an attack, the chitine uses its multiattack.

trait.name: Web-Dweller
entries: The chitine can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty. While in contact with a web, the chitine knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the chitine has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Pitfall
entries: Over the course of an hour, the chitine can construct a covering of web and debris that makes a pit up to 20 feet across indistinguishable from natural terrain. The first time a creature not able to safely traverse webs steps on it, the covering collapses and the creature falls.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chitine makes two attacks.

action.name: Web Shot
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d10 + 3}) bludgeoning damage and the target's movement is reduced by 10 until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Wall of Webs
entries: The chitine raises an opaque wall of webs on a solid surface it can see within 60 feet of it. The wall is 5 ft. thick and up to 15 ft. long and 15 ft. high. When the wall appears, each creature in its space is pushed to a side of its choice.

Each 15 foot section of wall can be damaged and breached (AC 5; 20 HP; vulnerability to fire damage; immunity to poison and psychic damage). A creature that hits the web with a melee attack must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 13}).

reaction.name: Web Labyrinth
entries: As a reaction to a creature ending its movement within 30 ft. of the chitine, the chitine uses its Wall of Webs ability.

trait.name: Web-Dweller
entries: The choldrith can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty. While in contact with a web, the choldrith knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the choldrith has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The choldrith makes four melee attacks.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hits: 5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage. A {@condition grappled} or {@condition restrained} target takes an additional 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage.

action.name: Legs
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hits: 7 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}).

action.name: Web
entries: The choldrith launches webbing in a 10 foot radius cetered on a point within 60 feet. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition restrained} by webbing (escape {@dc 16}). The webbing can also be attacked and destroyed (AC 10; HP 15; vulnerability to fire damage; immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage).

action.name: Black Rain (3rd level spell) {@recharge 5}
entries: Inky black poison rains down in a 20 ft. radius centered on a point within 120 ft. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Poison damage, or half as much on a success. Lights in the area are extinguished.

action.name: Creeping Ruin (1/Day, 5th level spell)
entries: A mass of tiny spiders begins to swarm around the choldrith in a 15 ft radius. A hostile creature that starts its turn in the area or enters it for the first time on a turn must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or take 10 poison damage, or half as much on a success. The spell lasts 8 hours, or until it has dealt a total of 100 damage.

bonus.name: Bind
entries: The choldrith uses its webbing to restrain a {@condition grappled} or {@condition prone} target (escape {@dc 15}).

reaction.name: The Queen's Will (1st level spell)
entries: As a reaction to seeing a friendly chitine or drow within 60 ft. miss with an attack or fail a saving throw, the choldrith deals 5 ({@damage 1d10}) psychic damage to it. The target may reroll the attack or saving throw.

reaction.name: Lolth's Favor (1/Day, 3rd level spell)
entries: As a reaction to seeing a friendly chitine or drow within 60 feet die, the choldrith causes the friendly creature to explode in a torrent of venomous spiders. Each creature within 15 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or take 14 ({@dice 4d6}) piercing plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage.

trait.name: Web-Dweller
entries: The choldrith can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty. While in contact with a web, the choldrith knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the choldrith has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The choldrith makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hits: 5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage. A {@condition grappled} or {@condition restrained} target takes an additional 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage.

action.name: Legs
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hits: 7 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}).

action.name: Web
entries: The choldrith launches webbing in a 10 foot radius centered on a point within 60 feet. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition restrained} by webbing (escape {@dc 13}). The webbing can also be attacked and destroyed (AC 10; 5 HP; vulnerability to fire damage; immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage).

action.name: Black Rain (3rd level spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: Inky black poison rains down in a 20 ft. radius centered on a point within 120 ft. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Poison damage, or half as much on a success. Lights in the area are extinguished.

bonus.name: Bind
entries: The choldrith uses its webbing to restrain a {@condition grappled} or {@condition prone} target (escape {@dc 12}).

reaction.name: The Queen's Will
entries: As a reaction to seeing a friendly chitine or drow within 60 ft. miss with an attack or fail a saving throw, the choldrith deals 5 ({@damage 1d10}) psychic damage to it. The target may reroll the attack or saving throw.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The imp can use its action to polymorph into a beast form that resembles a rat (speed 20 ft.), a raven (20 ft., fly 60 ft.), or a spider (20 ft., climb 20 ft.), or back into its true form. Its statistics are the same in each form, except for the speed changes noted. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Devil's Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the imp's {@sense darkvision}.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The imp has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Sting (Bite in Beast Form)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage, and the target must make a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw, taking 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Choleric Imbalance {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 12} Charisma saving throw or be {@condition cursed|confc|cursed}. Whenever a cursed creature takes damage, it must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or use its action on each turn for the next minute to make a melee attack against the last creature to damage it, or to dash towards it. The creature may repeat this Wisdom save at the end of each of its turns, regaining control over itself on a success.

action.name: Invisibility
entries: The imp magically turns {@condition invisible} until it attacks or until its {@status concentration} ends (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). Any equipment the imp wears or carries is {@condition invisible} with it.

trait.name: Ward of the White Kingdom
entries: The chosen adds 1 to its AC for each undead creature under its control within 5 feet.
Whenever an attack misses the chosen, the attacker may choose for the attack to instead target an undead creature in its reach.

trait.name: Eternal Tide
entries: At the beginning of the chosen's turn, it can return {@dice 1d4} ghouls or ghasts within 60 feet that died since the end of the chosen's last turn to undeath with 1 hit point.

trait.name: Reclaim Anima (2/Day)
entries: If the chosen fails a saving throw, it can drain the animating force from one undead creature it controls to succeed instead, reducing the creature to 0 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chosen makes two attacks with its Death's Beckon and uses its Breath of Thanatos or Drown in Blood, if available.

action.name: Death's Beckon (1st Level Spell)
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 60 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage.

If this damage reduces a humanoid target to 0 hit points, a rift to Thanatos appears in the earth beneath it, disgorging a {@creature horde ghoul|confc|Horde Ghoul} in the nearest unoccupied space that acts on the chosen's initiative and under its control.

action.name: Breath of Thanatos (3rd Level Spell)
entries: The ground beneath a creature the chosen can see within 60 feet cracks, spewing forth a hissing jet of putrid fumes.
The creature must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or take 16 ({@dice 3d10}) necrotic plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage, or take half as much on a success.
A creature killed by this damage is dragged through a planar rift to Thanatos.

action.name: Drown in Blood (4th Level Spell, Concentration) {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature the chosen can see within 60 feet must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) necrotic damage and begin {@condition choking|confc|choking} as blood wells up in its mouth and lungs (Save Ends at end of turn).

action.name: Sanguine Cyclone (1/Day, 5th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: The chosen conjures forth a raging whirlwind of blood in a 15 foot radius centered on a point it can see within 150 feet that lasts for a minute.

The area is difficult terrain, and a living creature that starts its turn in the area must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or lose one unexpended hit die, or drop to 0 hit points if it cannot.
Whenever a creature loses a hit die in this way, the whirlwind's radius grows by 5 feet, then each creature in its area takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) slashing damage.

reaction.name: Open the Corpsevaults (1/Day)
entries: When the chosen is reduced below 115 hit points, it carves a planar rift into the earth at its feet, dragging forth 5

legendary.name: Death's Beckon
entries: The chosen makes an attack with its Death's Beckon.

legendary.name: Impel the Horde
entries: Each undead creature within 30 feet of the chosen may use its reaction to move up to half its speed.

legendary.name: Call the Blood
entries: One creature the chosen can see within 120 feet must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or be dragged up to 30 feet directly toward a spell effect the chosen is {@status concentration||concentrating} on.

trait.name: Cruel Mercy
entries: Once on each of its turns when the chosen deals damage to a creature, after dealing damage it can grant the creature temporary hit points equal to the damage dealt.
While a creature has any of these temporary hit points, it is {@condition charmed} by the chosen.

trait.name: Hedonic Resilience (2/Day)
entries: When the chosen fails a saving throw, it can gain 25 temporary hit points.
While it has any of these temporary hit points, the chosen has advantage on all saving throws and resistance to all damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chosen makes three attacks with its Demonic Lash.

action.name: Demonic Lash (2nd Level Spell)
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@dice 2d4}) slashing plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.
A target hit by two or more of these attacks in a turn must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of the chosen's next turn.

action.name: Psychic Lance (3rd Level Spell)
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 90 ft., one target. {@h}28 ({@damage 8d6}) psychic damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away.
The chosen may have this attack originate from a creature {@condition charmed} by it, using that creature's senses.

action.name: Gift of Transcendent Pleasure (5th Level Spell) {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature the chosen can see within 60 feet cannot take reactions and is suffused in an aura of pure rapturous delight for the next minute.

At the beginning of each of the creature's turns, it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or voluntarily fail all other saving throws until the beginning of its next turn. On a success, the effect ends.

bonus.name: Erode Will
entries: One creature {@condition charmed} by the chosen must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to move up to half its speed and make an attack or cast a cantrip under the chosen's control.

legendary.name: Needling Imperative
entries: The chosen moves up to half its speed, then whispers a command to a {@condition charmed} creature within 5 feet.
For the next minute or until the creature is reduced to 0 hit points, it takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) psychic damage the first time each turn that it disobeys the command.

legendary.name: Soulbound Swap (2nd Level Spell)
entries: The chosen and up to one Medium creature within 60 feet that is {@condition charmed} by or friendly to it teleport to trade places with one another.

legendary.name: Psychic Lance (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The chosen makes an attack with its Psychic Lance.

monster.name: Chosen of the Lord of Beasts

trait.name: Fear-Scent Tracker
entries: The chosen can detect, by smell, the number and direction of each creature within 1000 feet of them that is not immune to the {@condition frightened} condition, and cannot be surprised by such creatures.

trait.name: Juggernaut Rampage
entries: If the chosen first moves 10 feet directly toward it, they may move through any nonmagical wall or object as through it were difficult terrain, shattering a 5 foot section of it in a spray of shrapnel.
Then, each creature within 5 feet of where the chosen emerges takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) bludgeoning damage and is pushed up to 5 feet away.

trait.name: Unbridled Fury (3/Day)
entries: If the chosen fails a saving throw while they are not {@condition grappled}, they can choose to succeed instead.
Then, if the chosen is {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell, they may roll a {@dice d6}, regaining a use of this ability on a 5-6.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chosen makes two attacks with its Spellfury Fist, one of which it may replace with a use of its Spontaneous Combustion, if available.

action.name: Spellfury Fist
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d10 + 5}) force damage plus one additional effect of the chosen's choice:

items.name: Bestial Grip
entries: The target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 18}).

items.name: Wound Spirit
entries: The target takes an additional 11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage.

items.name: Impact Vice
entries: The target is pushed up to 10 feet away, then takes an additional 13 ({@damage 3d8}) bludgeoning damage if this movement was stopped by a solid surface.

items.name: Shake Earth
entries: The chosen and each creature within 10 feet of it take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) thunder damage.

action.name: Spontaneous Combustion (4th Level Spell, Concentration) {@recharge 5}
entries: The chosen forces a creature they can see within 40 feet to succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) fire damage and ignite.
Until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls and takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage at the beginning of each of its turns.

bonus.name: Exultation of Blood (2nd Level Spell)
entries: The chosen gains 5 temporary hit points for each creature it hit with an attack this turn. While it has any of these temporary hit points, the chosen's attacks are made at advantage.

reaction.name: Smash Through Reality (1/Day, 8th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: As a reaction when the chosen scores a critical hit, it banishes the target to a blood-drenched arena in a labyrinthine demiplane facing a

The target may escape either by Incapacitating the bulezau, or by navigating the labyrinth as an action with a successful {@dc 18} Intelligence check. When the creature escapes, it reappears in the nearest space to where it departed.

legendary.name: Relentless Pursuit
entries: The chosen moves up to half its speed toward the nearest enemy and makes a melee attack against it.

legendary.name: Winding Slam
entries: The chosen smashes a {@condition grappled} creature into the ground, forcing it to make a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw.
On a failed save, the creature takes 18 ({@damage 4d8}) bludgeoning damage, is knocked {@condition prone}, and its space becomes difficult terrain.
A creature that fails this save by 10 or more can't speak or breathe until the end of the chosen's next turn.

legendary.name: Roar of Challenge
entries: One creature the chosen can see within 60 feet must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to move its speed directly toward the chosen.
If it ends this movement within 5 feet of the chosen, the creature may immediately make a melee attack against it.

trait.name: Strength from Sickness
entries: While it is {@condition poisoned}, the chosen's attacks have advantage instead of disadvantage.

trait.name: Rot-Carrier
entries: A creature that fails a saving throw by 5 or more against an effect the chosen controls cannot benefit from resistance or immunity to poison damage or from immunity to the {@condition poisoned} condition for the next hour.

trait.name: Wretched Resilience (2/Day)
entries: If the chosen fails a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, it can choose to succeed instead.
If it does, the chosen loses any remaining legendary actions, is {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn, and falls {@condition prone} as it retches up the wasted magic.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chosen makes two attacks with its Cultivator's Touch, each of which it may replace with a use of its Spore Wind, and uses its Sprouting Doom or Pallid Rooting, if available.

action.name: Cultivator's Touch
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) poison damage.
A {@condition poisoned} creature hit with this attack becomes {@condition paralyzed} until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Spore Wind
entries: One creature the chosen can see within 60 feet must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or take 19 ({@damage 3d12}) poison damage and be {@condition poisoned} until the end of the chosen's next turn.

action.name: Sprouting Doom (3rd Level Spell)
entries: A roiling growth of multifarious fungus that lasts for a minute bursts forth in a 5 foot radius centered on a point the chosen can see within 120 feet.

The area is difficult terrain for nonplant creatures, and a nonplant creature that starts its turn in the area takes 20 poison damage. This effect ends if the area is dealt 20 or more fire or radiant damage from a single source.

action.name: Pallid Rooting (4th Level Spell, Concentration) {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature the chosen can see within 60 feet must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn).

Whenever a creature {@condition poisoned} in this way fails a saving throw to end the effect at the end of its turn, it takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) piercing damage and is {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 18}) until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Endurance of the Mother's Faithful (1/Day, 6th Level Spell)
entries: The chosen releases a burst of reanimating spores in a 30 foot radius from each area created by its Sprouting Doom.
Each creature in one or more of these areas that died in the last minute is restored to life with 15 hit points and is {@condition poisoned} for the next 24 hours.

bonus.name: Fungal Delirium
entries: One creature the chosen can see that is {@condition poisoned} or infected with a disease must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to move up to half its speed in a direction of the chosen's choice.

bonus.name: Corpseleech (1st Level Spell)
entries: Mycelia tendrils snake from the chosen to drain the vitality from a corpse or creature with 0 hit points within 5 feet.

The chosen gains 9 ({@dice 2d8}) temporary hit points, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or fail two death saving throws, or one on a success. A corpse targeted with this ability desiccates to dust.

legendary.name: Cultivator's Touch
entries: The chosen makes an attack with its Cultivator's Touch.

legendary.name: Sporeflight
entries: The chosen transforms into a cloud of spores and moves up to its speed without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

It can move through the spaces of other creatures with this movement, and each creature the chosen moves through must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of the chosen's next turn.

legendary.name: Growing Hunger
entries: The chosen chooses a creature it can see within 120 feet.
Up to two plant or undead creatures within 30 feet of it may each use their reaction to move up to its speed toward that creature or make a melee attack against it.

trait.name: Kiss of Lolth
entries: The chosen's spells ignore resistance or immunity to poison damage and immunity to the {@condition poisoned} condition.

trait.name: Venomous Dweomer
entries: The first time each turn that a creature fails a saving throw against a spell or magical effect the chosen controls, the chosen can deal 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage to it.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The chosen can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Ruthless Resistance (2/Day)
entries: If the chosen fails a saving throw, it can force a friendly creature within 30 feet to succeed on a {@dc 17} Charisma saving throw or suffer the effects of the saving throw in the chosen's stead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chosen makes two attacks with its Darkfire Bolt, each of which it may replace with a use of its Envenomed Touch.

action.name: Darkfire Bolt (2nd Level Spell)
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 9} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d10}) fire damage, and the target is wreathed in writhing shadows for the next minute.
Whenever the creature is hit with an attack, it takes an additional 3 ({@damage 1d6}) necrotic damage. This effect ends early if the target is illuminated by Bright Light.

action.name: Envenomed Touch
entries: The chosen touches a creature within 5 feet, dealing 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage to it and forcing it to succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn). (+{@dice 1d6} per level at higher levels).

action.name: Lolth's Favor
entries: One willing drow, spiderkind, or demon the chosen can see within 60 feet immediately dies, exploding in a torrent of venomous spiders.
Each creature within 15 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or take 14 ({@dice 4d6}) piercing plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Maddening Shadows (4th Level Spell, Concentration) {@recharge 5}
entries: Whispering darkness boils forth in a 20 foot radius from a point the chosen can see within 60 feet, extinguishing all lights in the area.

A creature other than the chosen that starts its turn in the area must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) psychic damage and be {@condition frightened} until the beginning of its next turn.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more falls {@condition prone}, additionally.

reaction.name: Bask in Her Esteem
entries: When the chosen kills one or more friendly creatures, it can gain 10 temporary hit points per friendly creature killed in this way.
If it does, attacks against the chosen are made at advantage until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Chasten Failure
entries: When a friendly humanoid creature misses the chosen with an attack, the chosen can force it to succeed on a {@dc 17} Charisma saving throw or transform into a

legendary.name: Darkfire Bolt
entries: The chosen uses its Darkfire Bolt.

legendary.name: Skulking Shift
entries: The chosen moves up to half its speed. If it is not illuminated by Bright Light, this movement does not provoke {@action opportunity attack||opportunity attacks}.

legendary.name: Grasp of Shadows
entries: A spindly limb of coalesced darkness spears out from a space of dim light or darkness within 60 feet of the chosen.
One creature within 15 feet of that space must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or be dragged up to 15 feet towards it.

trait.name: Frozen Moment
entries: The living spell can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and can move through any space that air can pass through without squeezing. Its space is heavily obscured.
The living spell and each creature wholly within its space can't deal or be dealt non-force damage by sources outside the living spell's space.

trait.name: Living Magic
entries: If the living spell is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as {@spell Dispel Magic}, it must make a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC.
On a failure, the living spell is {@condition stunned} (Save Ends at end of turn).

action.name: Grasp of Time
entries: Each creature in the living spell's space must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}).
A creature {@condition grappled} in this way can make no more than one attack on each of its turns.
At the beginning of each of the living spell's turns, each creature {@condition grappled} in this way ages 10% of its natural lifespan until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

reaction.name: Hasty Expulsion
entries: When a creature leaves the living spell's space, the living spell can flood it with sped time, forcing it to make a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw.
On a failure, the creature takes 33 ({@damage 6d10}) force damage, is launched up to 30 feet away and knocked {@condition prone}.
It can take an additional action this turn, and at the end of this turn becomes {@condition stunned} until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Timeline Swapper
entries: At the beginning of each of its turns, the slaad teleports to an unoccupied space within 5 feet and all conditions on it end.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The slaad has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Chaotic Resilience
entries: The slaad has resistance to the damage type of the last source of damage it received.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The slaad makes three attacks, one of which may be with its havoc bite, and uses its 4-Dimensional Leap.

action.name: Havoc Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@dice 2d8 + 5}) piercing plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage. Additionally on a hit, the first 10 ft. of movement the target takes on its following turn is made in a random direction.

action.name: Chronoclaws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) force damage and the target must make a {@dc 19} Charisma saving throw or have its Charisma score reduced by {@dice 1d4} for the next minute.

A creature that has its Charisma score reduced to 0 in this way takes 99 ({@damage 18d10}) psychic damage and has this reduction end as it replaced with a nearly identical version of itself from the nearest adjacent timeline.

action.name: 4-Dimensional Leap
entries: The slaad leaps up to 20 ft. in up to two different directions simultaneously, splitting in the air into an original and a copy and landing in two different spaces. The copy cannot take actions, and disintegrates at the beginning of the slaad's next turn or if it takes any damage.

Each creature in a space where the slaad landed must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or take 7 ({@dice 2d6}) bludgeoning plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) force damage and be knocked {@condition prone}. On a successful save, the creature is pushed to the nearest unoccupied space.

action.name: Pandemoniac Ideal (Concentration)
entries: The slaad creates the image of an object, creature, or pheneomenon no larger than a 30-foot cube. It seems real to all senses, though a successful {@dc 16} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check reveals its illusory nature. The slaad may interact with the illusion physically as though it were real.

As a Bonus Action on each of its turns, the slaad can move the illusion up to 30 ft. and force one creature within 5 ft. of it to succeed on a {@dc 19} Intelligence saving throw or take 39 ({@damage 6d12}) damage of a type appropriate to the illusion. A creature that has investigated the illusion makes this save with advantage.

action.name: Time Croak {@recharge 5}
entries: The slaadi lets out a horrible, atonal croak that propels nearby creatures into the future. The slaad and each other creature within 20 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 19} Charisma saving throw or disappear, reappearing at the end of the slaad's next turn.

action.name: Plane Shift (1/Day)
entries: The slaad and any number of slaadi adjacent to it teleport to a different plane of existence.

reaction.name: Timeclone Freakout
entries: As a reaction when reduced below 111 hit points, the slaad pulls versions of itself from adjacent timelines into this one. Up to three copies of the slaad appear in the nearest unoccupied spaces to the slaad.
Each copy uses the original's stastistics, except it cannot use its multiattack and disintegrates if it is hit by an attack or fails a saving throw.

monster.name: Chuul
languages: understands Deep Speech but can't speak

trait.name: Sense Magic
entries: The chuul senses magic within 120 feet of it. It can't be surprised by creatures carrying magic items.

trait.name: Brittle Shell
entries: If the chuul takes 15 or more bludgeoning damage from a single source, its AC is reduced to 13 until it completes a Short or Long Rest.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chuul makes two attacks: one with its seizer claw and one with its crusher claw, then uses it tentacles, if available.

action.name: Seizer Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}) and dragged up to 5 feet towards the chuul. The chuul can grapple only a single target at a time.

action.name: Crusher Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or suffer disadvantage on attack rolls that use Strength until it completes a short or long rest.

action.name: Tentacles
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the chuul must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature is {@condition poisoned} and attacks against it score a critical on a 15-20 until the end of the chuul's next turn.

reaction.name: Psychic Static (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 46 hit points, the chuul forces each creature within 10 ft. to succeed on a {@dc 13} Intelligence saving throw or take 11 ({@damage 2d10}) psychic damage. A creature with telepathy makes this saving throw at disadvantage.

monster.name: Chuul Juggernaut
languages: understands Deep Speech but can't speak

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the chuul may spend half of its movement to attempt a {@dc 18} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the chuul. While climbing on the chuul, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the giant, and the chuul has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

trait.name: Sense Magic
entries: The chuul senses magic within 120 feet of it. It can't be surprised by creatures carrying magic items.

trait.name: Brittle Shell
entries: If the chuul takes 20 or more bludgeoning damage from a single source, its AC is reduced to 14 until it completes a Short or Long Rest.

trait.name: Psychic Awakening
entries: A non-telepathic creature wtihin 5 ft. of the chuul that takes any psychic damage must succeed on a {@dc 15} Intelligence saving throw or take an additional 22 ({@damage 4d10}) psychic damage and gain Telepathy 30 ft.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chuul makes three attacks: one of which may be with each of its claws, then uses its tentacles, if available.

action.name: Seizer Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d8 + 6}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 18}) and dragged up to 10 feet towards the chuul. The chuul can grapple only a single target at a time.

action.name: Crusher Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}24 ({@damage 4d8 + 6}) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or suffer disadvantage on attack rolls that use Strength until it completes a short or long rest.

action.name: Psychic Lure
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 60 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d10 + 3}) pyschic damage and the target is pulled 30 ft. toward the chuul. A creature climbing on the chuul must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or fall off.

action.name: Tentacles
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the chuul must make a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature is {@condition poisoned} and attacks against it score a critical on a 15-20 until the end of the chuul's next turn.

reaction.name: Psychic Groan (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 110 hit points, the chuul forces each creature within 20 ft. it to succeed on a {@dc 15} Intelligence saving throw or take 33 ({@damage 6d10}) psychic damage. A creature with telepathy makes this saving throw at disadvantage.

trait.name: Web-Dweller
entries: The chwidencha can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty. While in contact with a web, the chwidencha knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

trait.name: Burrowing Ambusher
entries: The chwidencha has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide while at least partially buried in loam or dark soil.

trait.name: Fruitless Devotion
entries: If a creature the chwidencha can see uses its action to brandish a holy symbol of Lolth, the chwidencha must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} and {@condition frightened} by it until the beginning of the creature's next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chwidencha makes six attacks, or makes two attacks and uses its Nettling Bristles, if available.

action.name: Leg Barbs
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, the Chwidencha may grapple the target.

action.name: Scuttling Overrun
entries: The chwidencha moves up to half its speed, and may move through the space of any Large or smaller creature. A creature whose space it enters for the first time on a turn must succeeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or fall {@condition prone} and be {@condition frightened} for the next minute.

While {@condition frightened} in this way, a creature can stand from {@condition prone} only as an action, and repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Nettling Bristles {@recharge 5}
entries: The chwidencha scrapes off some of its barbed bristles, ejecting them in a 15 foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) piercing damage and be {@condition blinded} until it takes an action to clear its eyes, or take half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Buried Horror
entries: AWhen a creature the chwidencha is hidden from enters its reach, the chwidencha can use its Scuttling Overrun or make four attacks with its Leg Barbs.

trait.name: Extinguishing Presence
entries: Flames in a 15 foot radius around the cinderspawn are extinguished as they enter or appear in the area. Spells that deal fire damage that affect the area or pass through it deal half as much damage.

trait.name: Rekindle
entries: When the cinderspawn reduces a living humanoid or elemental creature to 0 hit points, it makes a {@dc 20} Charisma saving throw. On a success, the cinderspawn transforms into a Fire Elemental, retaining its current hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cinderspawn makes two attacks with its steal warmth.

action.name: Steal Warmth
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@dice 1d8 + 4}) cold plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage and the creature's movement is reduced by 10 until the beginning of the cinderspawn's next turn.

action.name: Snuff Out {@recharge 5}
entries: One living creature within 5 feet must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or drop to 0 hit points.

reaction.name: Gout of Ash
entries: When the cinderspawn takes any cold damage, it can release a gout of ash.
Each creature within 10 feet must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or take 11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage and be {@condition blinded} until the end of the Cinderspawn's next turn.

trait.name: Filter Feeder
entries: A body of water in which a cistern fiend resides is extraordinarily clean and free of impurities.

trait.name: Translucent Body
entries: While submerged, the cistern fiend has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks.
While out of water, attacks that deal piercing damage score a critical against it on a 19-20. On a critical hit, one swallowed creature is freed.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fiend makes three attacks with its filtration tendrils; one of which it may replace with a use of either its bite or its filter blood ability.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d10 + 5}) piercing damage. If the target is {@condition grappled}, it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or be swallowed.
A swallowed creature is {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 17}), and takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage at the start of each of the fiend's turns.

action.name: Filtration Tendrils
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}).

action.name: Filter Blood
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the fiend must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or have its Constitution score reduced by 4 ({@dice 1d8}) as the fiend's filtration tendrils burrow into its body and turn its blood to water. The target dies if this reduces its Constitution to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest.

reaction.name: Bluff Strike
entries: As a reaction to a creature entering the fiend's reach, it may force the creature to succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be forced to immediately move 10 ft. away from the fiend, if it can.

monster.name: Clay Golem

immune.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

languages: understands The Languages Of Its Creator but can't speak

trait.name: Acid Neutralization
entries: Whenever the golem is subjected to acid damage, its form becomes brittle and it loses its immunity to nonmagical weaponry until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Clay Body
entries: Whenever the golem takes at least 25 points of fire damage in a turn, its speed is reduced by 10 and its AC is increased by 2 until it completes a short or long rest. If its speed is reduced to 0 in this way, it loses all damage immunities and gains vulnerability to bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: The golem can't be affected or detected by spells of 2nd level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Shed Layer
entries: When the golem is reduced below 67 hit points, it sheds its outer layer, freeing itself of all debilitating conditions. For the next minute, the golem can use its slam attack as a bonus action and gains a +2 bonus to its AC.

trait.name: Words of the Creator
entries: Immediately before the golem takes an action, a description of that action appears on the surface of its body in a language known to its creator. A creature that can read this language and can see the golem may use its reaction to halve one source of damage dealt by the golem this turn.
