A creature may use its action to write a word in the same language on the golem's surface. If the word describes an action, the golem must take that action on its following turn. If the word describes a condition, the golem must succeed on a {@dc 10} Wisdom saving throw or be afflicted with that condition until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes two slam attacks. If both attacks hit the same Large or smaller creature, the creature is knocked {@condition prone} and cannot stand on its following turn.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away. This attack deals an additional 11 ({@damage 2d10}) damage against a {@condition prone} creature.

action.name: Juggernaut Charge {@recharge 5}
entries: The golem attempts to shove a creature. If it succeeds, it may make another shove attempt against the same target, and continue doing so until it fails or runs out of movement. The target then takes 16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) bludgeoning damage for each 5 feet it was pushed.

reaction.name: Grip of Clay
entries: When the golem is hit with a melee weapon attack, it can cause the weapon to stick to it.
A creature can wrench the weapon free as an action or bonus action with a successful {@dc 16} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.

action.name: Multiattack (4/Day)
entries: The Cleric makes two Maul attacks, one of which it may replace with a spell.

action.name: Maul
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Spirit Guardians (1/Day, 3rd level spell, concentration.)
entries: Range self, 15 ft radius, affects creatures of the Cleric's choice. An affected creature's speed is halved in the area, {@dc 15} WIS save when the creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there. {@damage 3d8} radiant damage on a failure, 1/2 damage on success.

action.name: Aid (1/Day, 2nd level spell)
entries: Up to three creatures within 30 feet each gain 5 temp HP.

action.name: Bless (1/Day, 1st level spell, concentration)
entries: 30 ft range, 3 targets. Whenever a target makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target can roll a {@dice d4} and add the number rolled to the attack roll or saving throw.

reaction.name: Guided Strike (2/Day)
entries: When the cleric misses an attack, it may choose to add 10 to the attack roll.

trait.name: War Caster
entries: The Cleric has advantage on saving throws to maintain {@status concentration}.

action.name: Multiattack (5/Day)
entries: The Cleric makes two Maul attacks, one of which it may replace with a spell.

action.name: Maul, +1
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + {@dice 1d8} + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Heal (1/Day, 6th level spell.)
entries: 60 ft range, 1 target. Target creature regains 70 HP.

action.name: Spirit Guardians (1/Day, 5th level spell, concentration.)

An affected creature's speed is halved in the area, {@dc 17} WIS save when the creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there. {@damage 5d8} radiant damage on a failure, 1/2 damage on success.

entries: Up to three creatures within 30 feet each gain 15 temp HP.

action.name: Hold Person (1/Day, 2nd level spell, concentration)
entries: 60 ft range, 1 target, {@dc 13} WIS save. On a failed save, the target is {@condition paralyzed} for 1 minute. Target repeats the save at the end of its turn, ending the effect on a success.

entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 2d6 + {@dice 2d8} + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Mass Heal (1/Day, 9th level spell.)
entries: 60 ft range. Restore 700 HP split between any number of targets in range.

action.name: Holy Aura (1/Day, 8th level spell, concentration.)
entries: Range self, 30 foot radius. Friendly creatures have advantage on all saving throws, and other creatures have disadvantage on attack rolls against them until the spell ends.

action.name: Plane Shift (1/Day, 7th level spell.)
entries: 10 ft range, 9 targets. The cleric and 8 allies in range teleport to a different plane.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The climbdog has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: Born Companion
entries: Creatures friendly to the climbdog that can see it add {@dice 1d4} to saving throws against being {@condition frightened}.

trait.name: Plummeting Strike
entries: If the climbdog falls at least 10 feet and lands in another creature's space, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone} and take {@damage 1d6} bludgeoning damage for each 10 feet the climbdog fell, or move to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The climbdog makes two attacks with its Snarling bite and takes the {@action Help} action, if available.

action.name: Snarling Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the climbdog can grapple the target (escape {@dc 14}).

action.name: Worry
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by both the climbdog and at least one of the climbdog's allies must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or fall {@condition prone} and take 17 ({@damage 5d6}) piercing damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Disperse Shock
entries: As a reaction when the climbdog or a creature riding it would take any fall damage, the climbdog reduces that damage to 0.

trait.name: Damage Transfer
entries: While grappling a creature, the cloaker takes only half the damage dealt to it (rounded down), and that creature takes the other half.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the cloaker remains motionless without its underside exposed, it is indistinguishable from a dark leather cloak.

trait.name: Light Sensitivity
entries: While in bright light, the cloaker has disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight and can't use its Phantasms ability.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cloaker makes two attacks, one of which may be with its enveloping bite.

action.name: Enveloping Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}). While {@condition grappled}, the target is {@condition blinded} and can't breathe, and the cloaker has advantage on attacks against it and cannot bite another target. If this attack was made with advantage, the creature loses its breath if it was holding it.

action.name: Tail Lash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) slashing damage.

reaction.name: Phantasms
entries: As a reaction to being hit with an attack or harmful spell, the cloaker rolls a {@dice D 20}. On a roll of 11-20, the attack or spell hits an illusory echo of the cloaker instead.

reaction.name: Moan (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 39 hit points, the cloaker forces each non-aberration creature within 60 feet that can hear it to succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} until the end of the cloaker's next turn.

trait.name: Damage Transfer
entries: While grappling a creature, the cloaker takes only half the damage dealt to it (rounded down), and that creature takes the other half.

trait.name: Light Sensitivity
entries: While in bright light, the cloaker has disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight and can't use its Phantasms ability.

trait.name: Unceasing Moan
entries: While the cloaker has fewer than 61 hit points, it continuously releases an unsettling, breathless moan. Each non-aberration creature within 10 ft. of the cloaker subtracts {@dice 1d4} from any attack rolls it makes.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cloaker makes four attacks, one of which may be with its enveloping bite.

action.name: Enveloping Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}). While {@condition grappled}, the target is {@condition blinded} and can't breathe, and the cloaker has advantage on attacks against it and cannot bite another target. If this attack was made with advantage, the creature loses its breath if it was holding it.

action.name: Tail Lash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) slashing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the cloaker may push the target 5 ft. away.

reaction.name: Phantasms
entries: As a reaction to being hit with an attack or harmful spell, the cloaker rolls a {@dice D 20}. On a roll of 11-20, the attack or spell hits an illusory echo of the cloaker instead.

reaction.name: Terrifying Moan (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 61 hit points, the cloaker may force each non-aberration creature within 60 feet that can hear it to succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to move half its speed directly away from the cloaker.

monster.name: Clockwork Caretaker
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Electricity Absorption
entries: Whenever the caretaker is subjected to electricity damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the electricity damage dealt.

trait.name: Nonslip
entries: The caretaker has advantage on saving throws that would force it to move or knock it {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The caretaker's weapon attacks are magical.

action.name: Oil Spray
entries: Slick oil covers the ground in a 30-foot cone and turns it into difficult terrain until cleared. When the oil appears, each creature standing in its area must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}. A creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there must also succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

action.name: Adhesive Spray
entries: Sticky gunk covers the ground in a 30-foot cone and turns it into difficult terrain. When the gunk appears, each creature standing in its area must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 13}).

action.name: Pressure Wash
entries: High pressure water blasts in a 30-foot line, dousing any flames in its path. A creature in the path must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) bludgeoning damage and be pushed 10 feet away on a failure, or suffer half damage on a success.

monster.name: Clockwork Golem
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Electricity Absorption
entries: Whenever the golem is subjected to electricity damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the electricity damage dealt.

trait.name: Geared Construction
entries: When subjected to the {@spell Grease} spell or a similar effect, the Clockwork Golem gains the effects of the {@spell Haste} spell for the next minute. It loses these effects early if it takes cold or acid damage. If it takes fire damage while under this effect, it catches fire, taking {@damage 1d6} fire damage at the start of each of its turns until the flames are extinguished.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Nonslip
entries: The golem has advantage on saving throws that would force it to move or knock it {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes two grind attacks.

action.name: Grind
entries: The Clockwork Golem attempts to grapple an opponent. On a success, it suffers {@damage 2d10 + 7} slashing damage as razor-sharp gears and blades emerge from its body to grind and slice its foe.

action.name: Axe Sweep
entries: {@hit 11} to hit. Targets each creature within 15 feet of the golem (make a separate attack roll for each). {@damage 2d10 + 7} damage and the target must make a {@dc 16} Strength Save or be shoved 10 feet back. If it misses one of these attacks, all subsequent attacks it makes this turn are made at disadvantage.

action.name: Wall of Gears
entries: The clockwork golem folds into a whirling wall of grinding gears, composed of 4 10x10-ft segments. Anyone passing through or starting their turn in the wall takes {@dice 8d6} points of slashing damage. If the wall appears in a creature's space, that creature can attempt a {@dc 16} Dexterity save to leap to one side and avoid the damage entirely. The clockwork golem can take no actions while in this form except to resume its normal form as a bonus action. A clockwork golem's AC and immunities remain the same while it is in this form. A creature {@condition grappled} by the golem stays {@condition grappled} by it in this form.

trait.name: Struggling Flight
entries: The chicken falls 10 feet at the end of each of its turns if it's airborne and the only thing holding it aloft is its fly speed.

trait.name: Ephemeral Head
entries: If the chicken takes 5 or more slashing damage from a single source, its head turns to mist and disperses until the start of its next turn. The chicken must immediately use its reaction to move its full speed in a random direction or until it hits a solid object.
While its head is missing, the chicken is {@condition blinded} and it can't use its Floaty Peck action.

action.name: Floaty Peck
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be levitated 10 feet into the air until the end of its next turn.
An affected creature can move only by pushing or pulling against a fixed object or surface within reach (such as a wall or a ceiling), which allows it to move as if it were climbing.

action.name: Lay Egg (1/Day)
entries: With a mighty squawk, the chicken abruptly lays a cloud egg. One creature directly beneath the chicken must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) bludgeoning damage and be {@condition stunned} until the end of the chicken's next turn.
If the egg falls more than 5 feet and no creature fails this saving throw, the egg breaks.

bonus.name: Cloud Bath (1/Day)
entries: The chicken ruffles its feathers and shakes vigorously, absorbing air and moisture from its surroundings until it becomes nearly spherical.

The chicken gains 11 temporary hit points and its head is restored if it was missing. While it has any of these temporary hit points, the chicken has resistance to bludgeoning and slashing damage, and cannot use its fly speed.

trait.name: Current Sense
entries: The giant's vision is not obscured by fog or clouds.

trait.name: Cloudwalk
entries: The giant can walk or jump on air, leaving a visible path of solidified clouds in its wake as it moves that remains for 1 minute before dispersing. If the giant is knocked {@condition prone} or pushed off of this path, it falls as normal.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the giant may spend half of its movement to attempt a {@dc 20} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the giant. While climbing on the giant, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the giant, and the giant has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

trait.name: Topple
entries: As an action, a creature climbing on the giant may attempt a {@dc 20} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check to topple it. On a success the giant is knocked {@condition prone} and must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant makes two melee attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its harden air ability.

action.name: Snatch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d8 + 8}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 20}).

action.name: Hurl Creature (Requires a Grappled creature)
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 12} to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. {@h}30 ({@damage 4d10 + 8}) bludgeoning damage. On a hit or miss, the thrown creature takes the attack's damage.

action.name: Shake
entries: The giant turns a creature it has {@condition grappled} upside down and shakes it vigorously. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or take 44 ({@damage 8d8 + 8}) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature that fails by 5 or more is {@condition stunned} until the end of the giant's next turn and drops any money or items it is carrying but not wielding.

action.name: Harden Air
entries: The cloud giant condenses the air in an unoccupied 5 ft. cube it can see within 60 ft., turning it the consistency of stone. If suspended, the cube drops. A creature underneath it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 36 ({@damage 8d8}) bludgeoning damage.

reaction.name: Bleed Fog
entries: As a reaction to taking 20 or more damage from a single source, the cloud giant may shroud itself in fog, becoming heavily obscured until the end of its next turn or until it moves.

trait.name: Current Sense
entries: The giant's vision is not obscured by fog or clouds.

entries: The giant can walk or jump on air, leaving a visible path of solidified clouds in its wake as it moves that remains for 1 minute before dispersing. If the giant is knocked {@condition prone} or pushed off of this path, it falls as normal.

On a success the giant is knocked {@condition prone} in an unoccupied adjacent space and must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant makes two melee attacks and uses its Change Face ability.

action.name: Morningstar
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}26 ({@damage 4d8 + 8}) bludgeoning damage and the creature is pushed 10 feet away.

A creature that is levitating takes an additional 5 ({@damage 1d8}) bludgeoning damage and is instead pushed up to 30 feet. Each other creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

action.name: Snatch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d8 + 8}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 20}).

action.name: Change Face
entries: The giant changes its mask, gaining one of the following effects of its choice until it uses this ability again. The giant may take this action even while {@condition incapacitated}.

items.name: Contempt
entries: If the giant would take half damage due to succeeding on a saving throw, it instead takes no damage.

items.name: Pity
entries: The giant gains advantage on Charisma checks. Any creature who targets the giant with an attack or a harmful spell must first make a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw.

items.name: Disgust
entries: The giant gains immunity to any effect that would incapacitate it, and ends all such effects currently affecting it.

items.name: Impatience
entries: The giant doubles its movement speed and has advantage on Dexterity saving throws.

items.name: Wrath
entries: The giant makes melee attacks at advantage.

reaction.name: Bleed Fog
entries: As a reaction to taking 20 or more damage from a single source, the cloud giant may shroud itself in fog, becoming heavily obscured until the end of its next turn or until it moves.

legendary.name: Treacherous Footing
entries: The giant alters the properties of the surface a creature is standing on within 30 feet. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving or fall {@condition prone} in an adjacent space.
A creature standing on a surface made of clouds or air that fails by 10 or more instead falls through.

legendary.name: Illusory Double
entries: The giant creates an illusory double of itself in an unoccupied space it can see within 60 ft. that echoes the giant's voice and mimics its movements and actions

legendary.name: Hazy Transposition
entries: One creature within 60 ft. teleports to exchange positions with the cloud giant or one of its illusory doubles. An unwilling creature makes a {@dc 19} Charisma saving throw, resisting the effect on a success.

legendary.name: Create Wealth (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: One creature the giant can see within 30 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 19} Charisma saving throw or have half the currency it is carrying teleported up to 500 feet in a direction of the giant's choice.
This affects even currency carried in extradimensional spaces, such as a Bag of Holding.

trait.name: Current Sense
entries: The giant's vision is not obscured by fog or clouds.

trait.name: Cloudwalk
entries: The giant can walk or jump on air, leaving a visible path of solidified clouds in its wake as it moves that remains for 1 minute before dispersing. If the giant is knocked {@condition prone} or pushed off of this path, it falls as normal.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the giant may spend half of its movement to attempt a {@dc 20} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the giant. While climbing on the giant, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the giant, and the giant has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

trait.name: Topple
entries: As an action, a creature climbing on the giant may attempt a {@dc 20} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check to topple it. On a success the giant is knocked {@condition prone} in an unoccupied adjacent space and must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant uses its harden air ability twice, one of which it may replace with its impenetrable mists.

action.name: Harden Air
entries: The cloud giant condenses the air in an unoccupied 5 ft. cube it can see within 60 ft., turning it the consistency of stone. If suspended, the cube drops. A creature underneath it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 36 ({@damage 8d8}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Impenetrable Mists
entries: The cloud giant creates a 20 ft. wide opaque wall of solid fog on a solid surface it can see within 60 feet of it. The wall is 1 foot thick and up to 20 feet long and 20 feet high. When the wall appears, creatures in its space are pushed to a side of their choice. The giant may pass through the wall without resistance.
The wall can be damaged and breached; each 20-foot section has AC 5, 20 hit points, and vulnerability to thunder damage.

action.name: Cloud Burst Stomp {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature in a 30 foot cone must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or take 33 ({@damage 6d10}) thunder damage and be levitated 10 feet in the air until the end of the giant's next turn. An affected creature that cannot fly can move only by pushing or pulling against a fixed object or surface within reach (such as a wall or a ceiling), which allows it to move as if it were climbing.

reaction.name: Bleed Fog
entries: As a reaction to taking 20 or more damage from a single source, the cloud giant may shroud itself in fog, becoming heavily obscured until the end of its next turn or until it moves.

reaction.name: Gale Breath
entries: As a reaction to taking damage, the cloud giant exhales a torrent of air. Each creature in a 30 ft. cone must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or be pushed 15 ft. away, or 30 ft. away if the creature is flying or levitating.

reaction.name: Animate Fog (1/Day, Concentration)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 94 hit points, the giant creates a [Hungry Fog](https://homebrewery.naturalcrit.com/share/1fq4OrkhR_4XoI4--2y6a4ofuN1ooVisBeEIA9AXOybho) in the nearest unoccupied space that lasts for a minute, acts on the giant's initiative, and follows the giant's mental commands.

trait.name: Current Sense
entries: The giant's vision is not obscured by fog or clouds.

trait.name: Cloudwalk
entries: The giant can walk or jump on air, leaving a visible path of solidified clouds in its wake as it moves that remains for 1 minute before dispersing. If the giant is knocked {@condition prone} or pushed off of this path, it falls as normal.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the giant may spend half of its movement to attempt a {@dc 20} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the giant. While climbing on the giant, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the giant, and the giant has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

trait.name: Topple
entries: As an action, a creature climbing on the giant may attempt a {@dc 20} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check to topple it. On a success the giant is knocked {@condition prone} in an unoccupied adjacent space and must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant makes three melee attacks, each of which it may replace with a use of its misty ephemera ability.

action.name: Filigree Greatscepter
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d8 + 8}) bludgeoning damage and the creature is pushed 10 feet away. A creature that is levitating takes an additional 5 ({@damage 1d8}) bludgeoning damage and is instead pushed up to 30 feet.

action.name: Misty Ephemera
entries: The giant creates a construct of light and air in the image of some creature, object, or other visible phenomena that occupies a space no larger than a 20-ft. cube centered on a point within 60 ft. that the giant can see, and lasts for a minute.

The construct moves and produces sound naturally, and seems to resist any spells or magical effects. Any physical interaction with the construct disperses it, then up to one Large or smaller creature within 5 ft. of it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be levitated 10 ft. off the ground until the end of the giant's following turn.

action.name: Runefog Vortex {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature the giant can see within 30 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, a creature loses all temporary hit points and each spell effect affecting it. The giant gains all temporary hit points and spell effects lost in this way.

reaction.name: Bleed Fog
entries: As a reaction to taking 20 or more damage from a single source, the cloud giant may shroud itself in fog, becoming heavily obscured until the end of its next turn or until it moves.

reaction.name: Shift Fortunes
entries: As a reaction to a creature it can see within 60 ft. making an attack roll or skill check, the giant causes a minor unpredictable event to intercede, imposing its choice of advantage or disadvantage on the roll.

trait.name: Air Form
entries: The melozoa can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and can move through any gap large enough for air to pass through without squeezing.

trait.name: Zephyr Tendrils
entries: The area within 10 feet of the melozoa counts as difficult terrain for creatures of its choice.
A creature that begins its turn in the area must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}) until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Cutting Jet
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage and the melozoa is pushed up to 10 feet from the target.

action.name: Skyhook Launch
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the elemental is flung up to 40 feet upward.
A creature that collides with a ceiling or other solid surface takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) bludgeoning damage and can make a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw, clinging to the surface on a success.

trait.name: Grim Portent
entries: A creature that sees or hears the coach-a-bower for the first time must succeed on a {@dc 13} Charisma savin throw or gain a Doom Counter that lasts for a minute. If the creature drops to 0 hit points, it immediately fails one Death Save for each Doom Counter it has.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The coach-a-bower uses its careening charge twice, one of which it may replace with its Chiming of the Hollow Vault, if available.

action.name: Careening Charge
entries: The coach-a-bower moves up to 20 feet in a straight line and can move through the space of any creature smaller than Huge.

The first time it enters a creature's space during this move, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) bludgeoning damage and be pushed ahead of the coach-a-bower for the rest of this move, or move to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

action.name: Chiming of the Hollow Vault {@recharge 5}
entries: Each living creature with zero hit points within 60 feet of the cart must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or begin to levitate until it regains any hit points. A creature levitating in this way moves 10 feet toward the coach-a-bower at the beginning of each of the creature's turns.
If it ends this movement in the coach-a-bower's space, the creature is sealed into a coffin in coach and {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 14}).
If the coach-a-bower already has a creature {@condition restrained} in this way, the effect instead ends, draping the creature's body across the coffin and increasing the escape DC by 2 instead.

reaction.name: Douse in Blood
entries: As a reaction when a creature attempts to hit the coach-a-bower with a melee attack, a bucketful of blood is flung from the shadowy interior of the coach.

The attacker must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or have its attack miss and suffer disadvantage on the next saving throw it makes against being {@condition frightened} in the next minute.

monster.name: Coal-Eyed Moch, Beast of the Heartcleft

trait.name: Ploughing Charge
entries: If Moch moves at least 20 feet in a straight line, he may move through the space of any huge or smaller creature.
A creature whose space the boar enters in this way must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}, or move to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

trait.name: Bristle Armor
entries: If Moch takes 20 or more fire damage from a single source, he loses his resistance to Bludgeoning and Slashing damage until he completes a Short or Long rest.

trait.name: A Worthy Trophy
entries: When Moch is killed, each hostile creature within 60 feet must make {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature feels compelled to claim primary responsibility for the kill, and regards each other creature that failed this save as hostile for the next hour, or until only one among them remains conscious.

trait.name: Rage that Sears the Leaves (Mythic Trait, recharges after a Short or Long rest)
entries: When Moch is reduced to 0 hit points, he doesn't die or fall {@condition unconscious}. Instead, he resets to 161 hit points and crackling lightning begins to spill from his mouth. For the next hour, a creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of him takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) lightning damage.

trait.name: Legendary Resistances (3/Day)
entries: If Moch fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Moch makes three attacks, one of which may be with his Trample.

action.name: Whiteiron Tusks
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 4d6 + 5}) slashing damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away.

action.name: Trample
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition prone} creature. {@h}27 ({@damage 4d10 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

reaction.name: Sprouting Wake
entries: When a creature enters an area of difficult terrain created by his Rooting Rush, Moch can magically cause a growth of ensnaring vines to sprout.
The creature must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 18}) until the end of Moch's next turn.

reaction.name: Foaming Defiance
entries: When he would be reduced to 0 hit points, Moch can make a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw. On a success, he is instead reduced to 1 hit point.
If triggered by piercing damage or a critical hit, this saving throw is made with disadvantage.

legendary.name: Catch Breath
entries: Moch gains 9 ({@dice 2d8}) temporary hit points and regains his reaction.

legendary.name: Sharpen Tusks
entries: Moch sharpens his lower tusks against his upper tusks. The next attack Moch makes with his tusks scores a critical on a 15-20.

legendary.name: Rooting Rush (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Moch moves up to half his speed, dragging his tusks through the ground, then flings them forward, spraying earth in a 15 foot cone.
Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}, or take half as much damage on a success.
The ground that Moch passes over with this movement becomes difficult terrain.

trait.name: Clumsy Flier
entries: The cockatrice falls at the end of a turn if it's airborne and the only thing holding it aloft is its flying speed. Attacks it makes while airborne are made at disadvantage.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw against being magically {@condition petrified}. On a failed save, the creature begins to turn to stone and is {@condition restrained} until the end of the cockatrice's next turn. If the target was already {@condition restrained} in this way, on a failed save it is instead {@condition petrified} for 24 hours.

reaction.name: Buffetting Wings
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the cockatrice may force the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 11} Dexterity saving throw or take 4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}. The cockatrice may then move up to half its speed as part of this reaction.

trait.name: Chemoreception
entries: While submerged in a body of water, the crab can detect the presence and location of creatures in that water within 60 ft.

trait.name: Pinch
entries: When the crab takes the {@action Help} action to grant an attack advantage against a target within 5 ft. that is Concentrating, the target must make a {@dc 11} Concentration check.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, the crab may grapple the target (escape {@dc 11})

action.name: Crush
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the crab must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) bludgeoning damage and suffer disadvantage on attack rolls that use Strength until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Scuttle
entries: As a reaction to being forced to make a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the crab moves up to 5 ft. If this movement puts the crab out of range or area of the spell or magical effect, the crab is unaffected.

trait.name: Duck and Leap
entries: When the guanghan takes the {@action Dodge} action, it may jump up to 10 feet whenever it is missed with a melee attack.

trait.name: Violence Unleashed
entries: Coiled Strike regains his reaction whenever he takes 20 or more damage from a single source.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Coiled Strike makes two melee attacks, one of which he may replace with the {@action Dodge} action.

action.name: Blinding Slice
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) slashing damage.
Creatures with a Dexterity score of 18 or lower cannot take reactions in response to this attack.

action.name: Reckless Thrust
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) slashing damage.
This attack scores a critical hit on a 16-20. On a miss, up to one creature within 5 feet may make an {@action Attack} of Opportunity against Coiled Strike.

action.name: Overwhelming Assault {@recharge 5}
entries: Coiled Strike makes four melee attacks. Until the beginning of his next turn, attacks against him are made at advantage.

reaction.name: Deft Deflection
entries: As a reaction when he is hit with an attack, Coiled Strike adds 4 to his AC against that attack.

reaction.name: Exploit Opening
entries: As a reaction when he is missed with a melee attack, Coiled Strike makes two melee attacks against the attacker.

trait.name: Thawing Permafrost
entries: If the walker takes any fire damage, it must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or lose its damage resistances and gain the ability to {@action Dash} as a Bonus Action for the next minute.

trait.name: Blinding Light
entries: The walker sheds bright light in a 20 foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet.
As a bonus action, the walker can force one creature in its bright light to succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the end of the walker's next turn.

trait.name: Icy Doom
entries: A creature killed by the walker freezes for 9 days, during which time it can't be thawed, animated or raised from the dead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The walker makes two slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d8 + 2}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) cold damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}).

action.name: Cold Ray {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature within 60 feet that the walker can see must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or take 49 ({@damage 9d10}) cold damage, or half as much on a success. A {@condition grappled} creature makes this save at disadvantage.

reaction.name: Chill Weapon
entries: When the walker is hit by a melee attack with a metal weapon, it can force the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) cold damage and drop its weapon.
If the creature attempts to pick the weapon up this turn, it must repeat this saving throw.

trait.name: Composite Construct
entries: The tsukumogami is comprised of several parts, each animated by its own spirit that takes an action on its own initiative, instead of rolling.

trait.name: Invulnerable Titan
entries: If the tsukumogami would take fewer than 15 damage from a single source, it instead takes no damage.

A creature that deals 15 or more damage to the tsukumogami from a single source may force it to make a Constitution saving throw with DC equal to the damage dealt. On a failed save, one part of the creature's choice becomes damaged.

trait.name: Facing
entries: The tsukumogami is always considered to be facing in a particular direction. Melee attacks it makes against creatures not in the direction it is facing are made at disadvantage.

trait.name: Titanic Stature
entries: A creature within 5 feet of one of the tsukumogami's parts may spend half its movement to attempt to climb onto it, or to move between two connected parts, with a successful {@dc 16} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.
Attacks made against the tsukumogami by a creature climbing on one of its damaged parts are made at advantage.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: The tsukumogami can't be affected or detected by spells of 1st level or below unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

action.name: Propagandize
entries: The head loudly emanates inspiring music and propaganda. Each friendly creature within 60 feet of it gains advantage on Wisdom saving throws until the beginning of the head's next turn.

action.name: Blare Orders
entries: If the head is not damaged, up to six friendly creatures within 60 feet may each use their reactions to make a melee attack.

action.name: Emergency Repairs
entries: The tsukumogami gains 15 temporary hit points and makes a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw. On a success, one of its damaged parts ceases to be damaged.

action.name: Annihilation Beam
entries: The tsukumogami rolls a {@dice d6} to charge its Annihilation Beam. On a 5-6, the beam successfully charges.

At the beginning of the tskukumogami's head's next turn, if its chest is not damaged the beam fires in a 100 foot line that is 10 feet wide and wholly within a 100 foot cone centered on the tsukumogami's current facing.

Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 22} Dexterity saving throw or take 44 ({@dice 8d10}) force plus 33 ({@damage 6d10}) radiant damage, or half as much on a success. Each object in the area that isn't worn or carried and each creature killed by this damage is vaporized.

action.name: Gunbai Sweep
entries: The tsukumogami sweeps its fan, sending forth a gust of wind in a 30 foot cone from a point on its front facing. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 22} Strength saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) bludgeoning damage and be pushed up to 15 feet away.
A creature has advantage on this saving throw if the tsukumogami's Arms are damaged.

action.name: Gunbai Judgement
entries: If the tsukumogami's Arms are not damaged, it raises its fan, indicating approval of a creature's battlefield heroism.
One other creature the tsukumogami can see within 120 feet that reduced an enemy to 0 hit points in the last minute gains 15 temporary hit points.
While it has any of these temporary hit points, the creature has advantage on melee attacks and cannot be {@condition frightened}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: If the tsukumogami's Waist is not damaged, it makes two attacks with its Spinning Masks, each of which it may replace with a use of its Move Titan.

action.name: Spinning Masks
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 19} to hit, reach 10 ft., two targets not climbing on the tsukumogami's Arms or Head. {@h}19 ({@damage 2d10 + 8}) piercing damage.
If the tsukumogami's Waist is not damaged, a creature hit by this attack takes an additional {@dice 1d10} points of either acid, cold, fire, or lightning damage (tsukumogami's choice).

action.name: Move Titan
entries: The tsukumogami flies up to 20 feet, or turns up to 90 degrees.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The dog has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: Born Companion
entries: Creatures friendly to the dog that can see it add {@dice 1d4} to saving throws against being {@condition frightened}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dog makes one bite attack and takes the {@action Help} action, if available.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Intimidating Bark
entries: The dog snarls and barks defiantly at a creature it can see. If the creature has an Intelligence score of 4 or lower, it must succeed on a {@dc 10} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of the dog's next turn.

trait.name: Aura of Terror
entries: A sleeping creature that starts its turn within 30 ft. of the feyr is accosted by its deepest fears, and takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) psychic damage. This damage does not wake a sleeping creature. A creature reduced to 0 hit points in this way gains 1 hit point and rises on its turn under the feyr's control.
A creature under the feyr's control makes a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a succeess.

trait.name: Light Sensitivity
entries: While the feyr is illuminated with bright light, attacks against the it are made at advantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The feyr makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Gnashing Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d10 + 6}) piercing damage. This attack deals an additional 5 ({@damage 1d10}) psyschic damage to a {@condition frightened} creature.

action.name: Tendril Lash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) slashing damage.

action.name: Torment Gaze {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature in a line that is 30 ft. long and 5 ft. wide must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or take 11 ({@damage 2d10}) psychic damage and be {@condition frightened} for the next minute, or take half as much damage on a success. A {@condition frightened} creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

reaction.name: Insubstantiate
entries: As a reaction to taking 15 or more damage from a single source, the feyr disappears into the border ethereal. At the beginning of its its next turn, the feyr teleports back into the material plane within 30 ft. of where it departed.

trait.name: Damage Transfer
entries: While attached to a creature, the raggamoffyn takes only half the damage dealt to it (rounded down), and that creature takes the other half.

trait.name: Lurching Puppeteer
entries: At the end of each of its turns, the raggamoffyn can force one creature it is attached to to make a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature uses its reaction to move up to half its speed and make a melee attack under the raggamoffyn's control.

action.name: Clinging Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage and the raggamoffyn wraps around the creature, attaching itself to it (escape {@dc 12}).

action.name: Refit
entries: One creature the raggamoffyn is attached to must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or have its Wisdom score reduced by 5 ({@dice 2d4}), to a minimum of 1, until the raggamoffyn is removed.
A creature reduced below 10 Wisdom in this way has disadvantage on Strength checks and saving throws. A creature reduced to 1 Wisdom in this way acts under the raggamoffyn's telepathic control.

reaction.name: Wrest the Wrapped
entries: As a reaction when a creature it is attached to makes an attack or casts a spell, the raggamoffyn forces it to succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or have the raggamoffyn choose the attack or spell's target.

trait.name: Power of the Mob
entries: When making Strength ({@skill Athletics}) checks and Wisdom saving throws to avoid being {@condition frightened}, the commoner rolls an additional {@dice d20} for each other commoner adjacent to it and takes the highest result rolled.

action.name: Improvised Weapon
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d4}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Trample
entries: Target {@condition prone} creature within 5 feet of the commoner takes 1 bludgeoning damage for each commoner adjacent to the target.

trait.name: Liminal Straddle
entries: Whenever the conjurer takes damage, roll a {@dice D 20}. On a 14-20, the conjurer disappears into the ethereal plane, reappearing at the beginning of its next turn in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of where it departed.

trait.name: Animated Arsenal
entries: At the beginning of each of its turns, the conjurer animates up to two unattended Small objects it can see within 30 feet under its control, to a maximum of four. Each object has a fly speed of 30 ft. and can be attacked (AC 16; 20 hit points).

trait.name: Imbuer's Knack
entries: Objects animated by the conjurer use its statistics for making saving throws, and take no damage on a successful Dexterity saving throw.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The conjurer moves each of its animated objects up to 30 feet and makes an animated assault attack with it.

action.name: Animated Assault
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d10 + 3}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Effects Betrayal (3rd Level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature of the conjurer's choice in a 20 foot radius centered on a point the conjurer can see within 120 feet must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or suffer one effect of the conjurer's choice.
One object it is wearing or carrying makes an animated assault attack against it.
One object it is wearing or carrying is flung up to 30 feet in a direction of the conjurer's choice.
The creature suffers disadvantage on attack rolls made with one object it is wearing or carrying until the beginning of the conjurer's next turn.

reaction.name: Interposed Object
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with an attack or harmful spell while within 15 feet of one of its animated objects, the conjurer moves the object up to 10 feet towards it and causes the object to become the new target of the attack.

reaction.name: Bloodied Betrayal (3rd Level Spell, 1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 46 hit points the arsenalist immediately recharges and uses its Effects Betrayal.

trait.name: Liminal Straddle
entries: Whenever the conjurer takes damage, roll a {@dice D 20}. On a 14-20, the conjurer disappears into the ethereal plane, reappearing at the beginning of its next turn in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of where it departed.

trait.name: Name-Bearer
entries: A demon summoned by the conjurer that attempts to take hostile action against it must first succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the fiend must choose a new target or lose the action.

trait.name: Chaos Shutter (3/Day)
entries: If the conjurer fails a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, it can choose to succeed instead.
If it does, each summoned creature under its control is pulled 15 feet towards the nearest Summoning Circle. A creature drawn into the circle in this way is destroyed.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The conjurer makes two attacks with its abyssal lash.

action.name: Abyssal Lash
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@dice 4d6}) fire plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) poison damage. A fiend hit by this attack cannot move closer to the conjurer on its following turn.

action.name: Portal to Horror
entries: One creature the conjurer can see within 60 feet must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or be dragged 30 feet toward one of the conjurer's summoning circles. A creature that ends this movement within 5 feet of the circle takes 14 ({@dice 4d6}) fire plus 22 ({@damage 4d10}) psychic damage.

action.name: Fiendish Shuffle (5th Level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each fiend within 60 feet of the conjurer must succeed on a {@dc 18} Charisma saving throw or be teleported up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space the conjurer can see.

reaction.name: Conjure Demon (6th Level Spell, 1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 79 hit points, the conjurer summons a demon from one of its summoning circles of a maximum CR based on the number of active summoning circles the conjurer has:
1 Summoming Circle: CR 5
2 Summoning Circles: CR 7
3+ Summoning Circles: CR 9

legendary.name: Planar Detritus (1st Level Spell)
entries: The conjurer rains down a mass of planar junk that forms a barrier (10 ft. wide; 5 ft. high; 5 ft. thick) in an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet The wall provides partial cover to creatures sheltering behind it, and counts as difficult terrain for creatures climbing over it.

legendary.name: Baleful Transpositon (3rd Level Spell)
entries: One creature the conjurer can see within 90 feet must succeed on a {@dc 18} Charisma saving throw or be teleported up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space the conjurer can see.

legendary.name: Summoning Circle (7th Level Spell, 4/Day, Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The conjurer magically engraves a circle of glyphs on the ground around it that lasts for a minute.

At the end of each of the conjurer's turns, an {@creature abyssal scavenger|confc|Abyssal Scavenger} that acts on initiative count 0 appears in the circle. If the conjurer has no active summoning circles, each creature summoned through one of them disappears.

trait.name: Liminal Straddle
entries: Whenever the conjurer takes damage, roll a {@dice D 20}. On a 14-20, the conjurer disappears into the ethereal plane, reappearing at the beginning of its next turn in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of where it departed.

trait.name: Essence Warder
entries: Elementals within 30 feet of the conjurer add +1 to their AC and saving throws, and have resistance to Acid, Cold, Fire, and Lightning damage.

trait.name: Chaos Shutter (3/Day)
entries: If the conjurer fails a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, it can choose to succeed instead.
If it does, each summoned creature under its control is pulled 15 feet towards the nearest Summoning Circle. A creature drawn into the circle in this way is destroyed.

action.name: Acid Dart
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 120 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) acid damage.

action.name: Chaos Sphere (3rd Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: A 5 foot diameter sphere of elemental energy appears in an unoccupied space the conjurer can see within 60 feet and lasts for a minute. The sphere's damage type can be the conjurer's choice of Acid, Cold, Fire, or Lightning.
A creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the sphere must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 4d10}) damage of the chosen type, or half as much on a success.
As a Bonus Action, the conjurer may move its chaos sphere up to 30 feet and change its damage type to the conjurer's choice of Acid, Cold, Fire, or Lightning.

action.name: Elemental Shuffle (5th Level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each friendly elemental within 60 feet of the conjurer may use its reaction to teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space the elemental can see.

reaction.name: Conjure Elemental (5th Level Spell, 1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 79 hit points, the conjurer summons an elemental from one of its summoning circles of a maximum CR based on the number of active summoning circles the conjurer has:
1 Summoming Circle: CR 2
2 Summoning Circles: CR 5
3 Summoning Circles: CR 7

legendary.name: Planar Detritus (1st Level Spell)
entries: The conjurer rains down a mass of planar junk that forms a barrier (10 ft. wide; 5 ft. high; 5 ft. thick) in an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet The wall provides partial cover to creatures sheltering behind it, and counts as difficult terrain for creatures climbing over it.

legendary.name: Baleful Transpositon (3rd Level Spell)
entries: One creature the conjurer can see within 90 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 16} Charisma saving throw or be teleported up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space the conjurer can see.

legendary.name: Summoning Circle (7th Level Spell, 3/Day, Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The conjurer magically engraves a circle of glyphs on the ground around it that lasts for a minute.

At the end of each of the conjurer's turns, a {@creature mephit|confc|Mephit} of the conjurer's choice that acts on initiative count 0 and under its control appears in the circle. If the conjurer has no active summoning circles, each creature summoned through one of them disappears.

trait.name: Liminal Straddle
entries: Whenever the conjurer takes damage, roll a {@dice D 20}. On a 14-20, the conjurer disappears into the ethereal plane, reappearing at the beginning of its next turn in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of where it departed.

trait.name: Open Mind
entries: Aberrations and creatures with telepathic abilities within 120 feet may use the conjurer's senses and attack bonus in place of their own.

trait.name: Final Iteration (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
entries: When the conjurer is reduced to 0 hit points, it doesn't die or fall {@condition unconscious}. Instead, it gains 130 temporary hit points, becomes size Large as chitinous growths sprout from its body, gains a climb speed equal to its movement speed, and takes a second action on each of its turns.

trait.name: Chaos Shutter (3/Day)
entries: If the conjurer fails a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, it can choose to succeed instead.
If it does, each summoned creature under its control is pulled 15 feet towards the nearest Summoning Circle. A creature drawn into the circle in this way is destroyed.

action.name: Touch of Madness
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 4d10}) psychic damage and the target's Charisma score is reduced by {@dice 1d4} to a minimum of 1 until it completes a Short or Long Rest.

A creature that has its Charisma score reduced to 1 in this way becomes a {@creature gibbering mouther|confc|pseudonatural creature} and is {@condition charmed} by the conjurer until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

action.name: Draw of the Far Realm (3rd level Spell)
entries: Each creature within 60 feet of one of the conjurer's Doorways to Madness must succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or be dragged 15 feet towards the nearest one.

action.name: Aberrant Shuffle (5th Level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each friendly aberration within 60 feet of the conjurer may use its reaction to teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space the aberration can see.

reaction.name: Follow the Worms (7th Level Spell, 1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 66 temporary hit points while its mythic trait is active, the conjurer summons an aberration that rolls its own initiative from one of its Doorways to Madness of a maximum CR based on the number of active doorways the conjurer has:
1 Doorway: CR 9
2 Doorways: CR 11
3 Doorways: CR 13
4+ Doorways: CR 15

legendary.name: Planar Detritus (1st Level Spell)
entries: The conjurer rains down a mass of planar junk that forms a barrier (10 ft. wide; 5 ft. high; 5 ft. thick) in an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet The wall provides partial cover to creatures sheltering behind it, and counts as difficult terrain for creatures climbing over it.

legendary.name: Baleful Transpositon (3rd Level Spell)
entries: One creature the conjurer can see within 90 feet must succeed on a {@dc 19} Charisma saving throw or be teleported up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space the conjurer can see.

legendary.name: Doorway to Madness (8th Level Spell, 5/day, Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The conjurer opens an ethereal doorway in an unoccupied space within 5 feet it that lasts for a minute.

At the beginning of each of the conjurer's turns, a {@creature carrion crawler|confc|Carrion Crawler} that acts on the conjurer's initiative and under its control appears in the doorway. If the conjurer has no active doorways, each creature summoned through one of them disappears.

A non-aberration creature that is not immune to fear that starts its turn within 15 feet of one or more doorways must succeed on a {@dc 19} Intelligence saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 4d10}) psychic damage.

trait.name: Camouflage
entries: The snake has advantage on stealth checks if it is more than 30 feet from any hostile creature.

trait.name: Cold Blooded
entries: If the snake takes any cold damage, its speed is reduced by 10 until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Braille
entries: The snake's eyes are covered by transparent scales that protect them from harm. It has disadvantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight, and advantage on saving throws to avoid being {@condition blinded}.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Constrict
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained} and the snake can't attack another target.

reaction.name: Crush
entries: As a reaction to a creature the snake has {@condition grappled} with its Constrict ability speaking or casting a spell with a verbal component, the snake crushes the air out of its lungs. The creature cannot breathe until the grapple ends and immediately begins to suffocate.

trait.name: Outshine the Eager
entries: At initiative count 20, the dragon may force one creature within 60 ft. that it can see to make a {@dc 11} Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the dragon trades initiatives with it.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d10 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Breath Weapons {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.

action.name: Aqua Regia Breath
entries: The dragon exhales acid in an 20-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a {@dc 11} Dexterity saving throw, taking 18 ({@damage 4d8}) acid damage and losing 20% of the gold and platinum it is carrying on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Unattended gold and platinum in the area dissolves entirely.

action.name: Slowing Breath
entries: The dragon exhales gas in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature can't use reactions, its speed is halved, and it can't make more than one attack on its turn. In addition, the creature can use either an action or a bonus action on its turn, but not both. These effects last for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself with a successful save.

variant.name: Note: Aqua Regia
entries: Aqua regia is a mix of hydrochloric acid and nitric acid that is notable for its ability to dissolve gold and platinum, while leaving silver intact. Real aqua regia does dissolve copper, but I think it's much more on-theme for a copper dragon to keep all its copper and silver in a big, easily plunderable pile, while its gold and platinum is kept dissolved in massive pools of fuming acid. If you've got a chemist in your group who's a stickler for that kind of thing, just call it Alkahest Breath instead.

variant.name: Recovering the Treasure
entries: A creature proficient in alchemy tools may use them to attempt a {@dc 15} ability check over the course of a work day, precipitating {@dice 2d10} x 100gp worth of gold dust out of the acid on a success. A creature may attempt this check any number of times, though the total amount of gold recovered in this way is limited by the amount originally disolved in the acid. A creature that fails this check by 5 or more exhausts their supply of reagents and must acquire a new kit to attempt it again.

trait.name: Dousing Weakness
entries: If the wisp takes 10 or more cold damage from a single source, it must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or lose its reaction.

trait.name: Variable Illumination
entries: The wisp sheds bright light in a 5- to 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional number of feet equal to the chosen radius. The wisp can alter the radius as a Bonus Action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wisp attacks twice with its Ghostflame Ignition.

action.name: Ghostflame Ignition
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}The creature is wreathed in ghostly flames and begins {@condition burning|confc|burning} ({@dice 2d6} fire plus {@dice 1d10} necrotic).

action.name: Lure
entries: One creature that can see the wisp must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by the wisp until the end of the wisp's next turn. While {@condition charmed} in this way, a creature must use all of its movement to approach the wisp.

reaction.name: Ghostflare
entries: When the wisp is missed with a melee attack, it can make an attack with its Ghostflame Ignition.

reaction.name: Reignite
entries: When the wisp reduced to 0 hit points, before falling {@condition unconscious} it can force one burning creature it can see within 30 feet to make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw.

On a failed save, the creature loses two unexpended hit dice or drops to 0 hit points if it cannot, and the wisp teleports to the nearest unoccupied space to the creature and regains all of its hit points.

trait.name: Corpses
entries: When first encountered, a corpse flower contains the corpses of {@dice 1d6 + 3} humanoids. A corpse flower can hold the remains of up to nine dead humanoids. At the beginning of each of its turns, the corpse flower gains temporary hit points equal to the number of corpses it contains.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The corpse flower can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Stench of Death
entries: Each creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the corpse flower or of a zombie under its control must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the beginning of its next turn. While {@condition poisoned} in this way, the creature's movement speed is halved and attacks against the creature are made at advantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The corpse flower makes three tentacle attacks.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage and 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}).

action.name: Harvest
entries: The corpse flower stuffs a {@condition grappled} creature into itself. A living creature in the corpse flower is {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 16}), and takes 55 ({@damage 10d10}) necrotic damage at the beginning of each of the corpse flower's turns. Corpses in the corpse flower can be used with its corpses trait.

reaction.name: Disgorge Zombie
entries: As a reaction to taking damage of a type that isn't fire or radiant, the corpse flower disgorges one of its corpses, which rises immediately as a zombie under the corpse flower's control in an unoccupied space within 10 ft., and acts on initiative count 0.

trait.name: Undead Fortitude
entries: If the corpse starts its turn with 0 hit points, it makes a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw, unless it took radiant damage or a critical hit since its last turn. On a success, the corpse gains 1 hit point. A zombie with 0 hit points is killed instantly if it is attacked.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The corpse makes two attacks with its Grasp of the Dead, one of which it may replace with a use of its Predigest.

action.name: Grasp of the Dead
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Mote of Corruption
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d10 + 3}) necrotic damage and the creature must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or take an additional 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage and be {@condition poisoned} until the end of the corpse's next turn.

action.name: Predigest {@recharge 5}
entries: The corpse vomits acidic slime in a 20 foot cone. Each creature in that cone must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) acid damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Rupture
entries: When the corpse drops to 0 hit points, it may use its reaction to use its Predigest, if available, before falling {@condition unconscious}.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Desecrating Presence
entries: Creatures of the devil's choice within 30 ft. of it subtract {@dice 1d4} from any saving throws they make.

trait.name: Retractable Claws
entries: As a bonus action, the devil may extend or reduce the reach of its claws by 5 ft., to a maximum of 15 ft.

trait.name: Befuddling Haze
entries: Creatures within 30 ft. of the devil have disadvantage on {@skill Insight}, {@skill Investigation}, and {@skill Perception} ability checks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The devil makes three attacks, each of which it may replace with a use of its corrupting imprecation.

action.name: Torment Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) slashing damage and 14 ({@damage 4d6}) psychic damage.

action.name: Corrupting Imprecation
entries: One creature within 120 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 18} Charisma saving throw or suffer a Curse of Corruption for the next minute. At the beginning of each of a cursed creature's turns, it must succeed on a {@dc 18} Intelligence saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) psychic damage, ending the effect on a success.

legendary.name: Desperate Measures
entries: One friendly devil or dominated creature within 30 ft. may use its reaction to make a melee attack against a creature in range. If the corruption devil has fewer than 169 hit points, each friendly devil and dominated creature in range may instead use its reaction to make a melee attack.

legendary.name: Sway the Corrupt
entries: One creature within 60 ft. that is afflicted with a Curse of Corruption must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or act under the devil's control until the end of its following turn.

legendary.name: Doom the Corrupt (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: One creature within 60 ft. that is afflicted with a Curse of Corruption must succeed on a {@dc 18} Charisma saving throw or have its Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores each reduced by {@dice 1d4}, to a minimum of 1, until it completes a short or long rest.

trait.name: Gushing Collapse
entries: When the cube is reduced to 0 hit points, its membrane ruptures, spilling forth a torrent of cytoplasm.
Each creature within 15 feet of the cube takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) acid damage and is pushed up to 20 feet away.

trait.name: Rippling Reserves
entries: If the cube has fewer than 107 hit points, it can take two Bonus Actions on each of its turns.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cube makes two attacks with its Snaking Pseudopod, one of which it can replace with a use of its Waste Jet.

action.name: Snaking Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pulled up to 5 feet toward the cube.
Then, if the creature is Large or smaller and within 5 feet of the cube it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or be {@condition swallowed|confc|swallowed} (escape {@dc 17}).
A creature {@condition swallowed|confc|swallowed} by the cube takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) acid damage at the beginning of each of the cube's turns.

action.name: Waste Jet
entries: A jet of indigestible detritus spurt from the cube in a 20 foot line that is 5 feet wide.

Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or take 18 ({@dice 4d8}) bludgeoning plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) acid damage and be pushed up to 20 feet away, or take half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Neurophage Intrusion {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature {@condition swallowed|confc|swallowed} by the cube must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) acid damage and be infected with Jelly-Brains.

bonus.name: Cyst Armor
entries: The cube hardens its exterior membrane, gaining 20 temporary hit points. While the cube has any of these temporary hit points, it gains the following effects:
Creatures not {@condition swallowed|confc|swallowed} by the cube treat its AC as 21.
The cube cannot Swallow creatures, move, or use Reactions.
The escape DC for creatures {@condition swallowed|confc|swallowed} by the cube increases to 21.

bonus.name: Cytoplasm Bulge
entries: The cube targets a 30 foot cone extending from itself, {@status concentration||concentrating} its mass on that side, and ends its turn.
At the beginning of its next turn, the cube can make a Snaking Pseudopod attack against each creature in the cone.

reaction.name: Wobbly Dispersion
entries: When the cube is hit with an attack by a creature not {@condition swallowed|confc|swallowed} by it, it can make a Constitution saving throw with DC equal to the attack's damage, reducing the attack's damage to 1 on a success.

reaction.name: Vacuole Encasement
entries: When a creature fails an attempt to free a creature {@condition swallowed|confc|swallowed} by the cube by 5 or more, the cube can Swallow it.

reaction.name: Jelly-Brains
entries: The creature suffers debilitating headaches, bouts of blurred vision, and difficulty speaking as microscopic gelatinous cubes trawl over the surface of its brain, slowly smoothing and resurfacing it.

Whenever the creature would be reduced to 0 HP by acid damage, it instead takes no acid damage and has its Intelligence score reduced by {@dice 1d8}, to a minimum of 1, until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic.
A creature that has its Intelligence score reduced to 1 in this way gains the Gelatinous Endosymbiote template until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

reaction.name: Gelatinous Endosymbiote Template
entries: A gelatinous endosymbiote is a creature adapted to living inside an acidic ooze. It retains its statistics, except as described below:

items.name: Abilities
entries: The creature's Intelligence score becomes 1.

items.name: Damage Immunities
entries: The creature has immunity to acid damage dealt by oozes.

items.name: Ooze-Friend
entries: The creature is {@condition charmed} by all oozes and other gelatinous endosymbiotes, and it is hostile to all other creatures.

items.name: Free-Flowing
entries: The creature is not {@condition restrained} or {@condition choking|confc|choking} while {@condition swallowed|confc|swallowed} by an ooze.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The couatl's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The couatl has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Dream Traveler
entries: The couatl can appear in the dreams of any creature it is familiar with. While in a creature's dream, the couatl may appear however it wishes, can communicate with the creature, and can free it from any poison, disease, or curse it is afflicted with.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a bonus action, the couatl may transform into a humanoid or beast, or back into its true form. Its statistics are the same in any form, and it reverts to its true form if it dies. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (the couatl's choice).

trait.name: Leaf on the Wind
entries: The first time each turn that a creature ends its movement adjacent to the couatl, the couatl may move up to 15 feet. {@action opportunity attack||Opportunity attacks} that it provokes with this movement are made at disadvantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The couatl attacks once with its bite and once with its constrict.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned}. While {@condition poisoned} in this way, the target perceives its reality as though in a dream, and the target deals only half damage with weapon attacks. The target may repeat this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. When the effect ends, the target retains no memory of events that transpired while it was {@condition poisoned}.

action.name: Constrict
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the couatl can't constrict another target.
