While {@condition poisoned} in this way, the target perceives its reality as though in a dream, has a fly speed of 60 feet, and deals only half damage with weapon attacks. The target may repeat this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. When the effect ends, the target retains no memory of events that transpired while it was {@condition poisoned}.

action.name: Constrict
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one Large or smaller creature. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the couatl can't constrict another target.

action.name: Crack the Sky {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature within 120 feet of the couatl, and up to three creatures within 30 feet of the first target, must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 5d8}) radiant damage and 22 ({@damage 5d8}) lighting damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Stampede
entries: When the cow moves, each adjacent cow may use its reaction to move with it. If one or more cows do so, the cow has advantage on attack rolls this turn.

trait.name: Trample
entries: If the cow moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Gore
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Amplify Charge
entries: If the conduit would take any lightning damage, it instead takes no damage and gains advantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Field-Bound Flight
entries: While it is within 40 feet of a solid surface, the conduit has a fly speed equal to its movement speed.

trait.name: Return Path
entries: When the conduit misses with an attack, it is dragged up to 10 feet directly toward the nearest solid surface.
If it ends this movement within 10 feet of the surface, the conduit falls {@condition prone} and is {@condition stunned} until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The conduit makes four attacks with its Fulgur Arc.

action.name: Fulgur Arc
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 40 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d8}) lightning damage and the target is dragged up to 10 feet toward the conduit.
This attack has advantage if it targets the closest creature wearing metal armor or wielding a metal weapon.

action.name: Electroskewer Impalement (Concentration)
entries: A searing bolt spears toward a creature the conduit can see within 30 feet, drawing it into the air.

The target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or take 35 ({@damage 10d6}) lightning damage and begin {@condition levitating|confc|levitating} 10 feet into the air until the end of the conduit's next turn, or until the conduit moves more than 30 feet away from it.
Whenever the {@condition levitating|confc|levitating} creature takes any lightning damage, it takes an additional 11 ({@damage 2d10}) force damage.

action.name: The Sky Alight {@recharge 5}
entries: The conduit makes 3 ({@dice 1d4 + 1}) attacks with its Fulgur Arc against each creature within 15 feet of it.

reaction.name: Plasma Flash
entries: When the conduit fails a saving throw to maintain {@status concentration} on its Electroskewer Impalement, it can ionize the air around it.
Each other creature within 30 feet that can see the conduit must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Nondetection
entries: The cat cannot be targeted or detected by any divination magic or perceived through magical scrying sensors.

trait.name: Righting Reflex
entries: The cat takes no fall damage if it falls from a height of 30 ft. or greater.

trait.name: Pounce
entries: If the cat moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. If the target is {@condition prone}, the cat can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The cat has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) slashing damage.

reaction.name: Spell Turning
entries: As a reaction to succeeding on a saving throw against a spell of 7th level or lower that targets only it, the cat avoids all effects from the spell and instead causes the spell to target the caster.

reaction.name: Bat Away
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the cat forces the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or have one object it is holding knocked out of its hands and 15 ft. away.

trait.name: Psychic Conflict
entries: As a Bonus Action, a telepathic creature may issue a command to the cranium rat, making a contested Intelligence check against it. The creature that fails this check acts under the other's control on its following turn.

trait.name: Psionic Empowerment
entries: As a Bonus Action, the rat gains one of the following benefits until it uses this ability again.

items.name: Avoid Notice
entries: The rat becomes {@condition invisible} to creatures without proficiency in {@skill Perception}.

items.name: Cerebral Glow
entries: The rat's exposed brain begins to glow softly, casting dim Light in a 10 foot radius. A creature illuminated by only this glow subtracts {@dice 1d4} from any Wisdom saving throws it makes.

action.name: Chittering Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 0} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 piercing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be infected with Devouring Cogniphage.

action.name: Invade Attire
entries: The rat attempts to enter the clothing or armor of a humanoid creature in its space, forcing it to make a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw.

On a failed save, the rat becomes {@condition attached|confc|attached} to the creature (Save Ends at end of turn). While {@condition attached|confc|attached} in this way, the rat has full cover against outside effects, and the target has disadvantage on the first attack it makes each turn.

trait.name: Binding Seals
entries: Whenever the apocalypse takes 20 or more fire damage from a single source, it may attempt a {@dc 25} Charisma saving throw. On a success, its bursts its binding seals. The apocalypse loses its vulnerability to fire damage, its attacks are made at advantage, and it loses 11 ({@dice 2d10}) hit points whenever it makes an attack.

trait.name: Titanic Scale
entries: A creature adjacent to the malukant may spend its full movement to attempt a {@dc 15} Dexterity ({@skill Athletics}) or Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the apocalypse's tentacles. A creature may attempt the same check to climb from the apocalypse's tentacles to its body, or from its body to its head.

items.name: Tentacles
entries: While climbing on the apocalypse's tentacles, a creature has advantage on attacks against it. Whenever the apocalypse makes an attack or uses its Rotting Tentacle Sweep, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or fall off.

items.name: Body
entries: While climbing on the apocalypse's body, a creature has advantage on attacks against it, and can't be affected by the apocalypse's Rotting Tentacle Sweep.

items.name: Head
entries: While climbing on the apocalypse's head, a creature has advantage on attacks against it, can't be affected by the apocalypse's Rotting Tentacle Sweep, and its attacks against the apocalypse score a critical on an 18-20.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The apocalypse has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the apocalypse fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The apocalypse makes two attacks, each of which it may replace with a use of its Rotting Tentacle Sweep or its Despairing Glare.

action.name: Crushing Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 3d10 + 7}) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or be pushed 15 feet away and knocked {@condition prone}.
Each other creature within 10 feet of the target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage be pushed 10 feet away.

action.name: Hurl Creature (Requires a Grappled creature)
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 11} to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d10 + 7}) bludgeoning damage. On a hit or miss, the thrown creature takes the attack's damage.

action.name: Rotting Tentacle Sweep
entries: Each creature in a 30 foot cone must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or take 11 ({@damage 2d10}) bludgeoning damage and be {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 19}). A creature that ends its turn {@condition grappled} in this way must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or contract Mummy Rot.
A creature that succeeds on this save by 5 or more may use its reaction to attempt to climb onto the apocalypse's tentacles.

action.name: Despairing Glare
entries: The apocalypse inflicts a portion of its anguish and resentment upon a creature it can see within 120 feet. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or take 27 ({@damage 6d8}) psychic damage and subtract {@dice 1d6} from the next saving throw it makes in the next minute.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more falls {@condition prone} and cannot stand, and repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Breath of Ages {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature in a 60 foot cone must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or lose {@dice 1d10} unexpended hit dice, or gain a point of {@condition exhaustion} and age 11 ({@dice 2d10}) years if it cannot. The aging effect can be reversed with a {@spell Greater Restoration} spell.

trait.name: Murderous Intent
entries: The claw may pick up and wield unattended weapons and improvised weapons without the Heavy or Two-Handed trait. It is proficient with all such weapons.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) bludgeoning or slashing damage (claw's choice).

action.name: Grab
entries: One Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet must succeed on a {@dc 11} Strength saving throw or have the claw become {@condition attached|confc|attached} to it (remove {@dc 11}).
When a creature the claw is {@condition attached|confc|attached} to in this way makes an attack roll, it rolls a {@dice d4} and subtracts it from the total.

action.name: Squick
entries: One creature the claw is {@condition attached|confc|attached} to must make a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save, the creature is {@condition frightened} of the claw until the end of the claw's next turn, and must use its action to try to kill or remove the claw.

reaction.name: Skittering Shift
entries: When the claw targeted with an attack while grabbing a creature, it may move up to 5 feet.
If this movement makes it an invalid target for the attack, the attack instead targets the creature the claw was grabbing.

trait.name: Amplify Charge
entries: If the hellion would take any lightning damage, it instead takes no damage and gains advantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hellion makes two attacks with its Furtive Zap.

action.name: Furtive Zap
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 2d4}) lightning damage.
Before or after making this attack, the hellion can teleport up to 10 feet.

action.name: Haywire Charge {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature within 5 feet of the hellion must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) lightning damage and use its reaction, if available, to make a melee attack against a random target in its reach.
A Construct that fails this saving throw is additionally {@condition possessed|confc|possessed} by the hellion until the end of the construct's next turn.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a Bonus Action, the mimic can polymorph into a Small creature or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: False Appearance (Creature Form Only)
entries: While the mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary creature.

action.name: Outsize Maw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) acid damage and the mimic attaches itself to the creature (remove {@dc 13}).

action.name: Puppy Eyes (Creature Form Only)
entries: The mimic gazes endearingly at a humanoid creature within 30 feet that can see it. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or use its action to pet the mimic on its following turn.
A creature that knows the mimic's true nature makes this save at advantage.

action.name: Invade Space (Amorphous Form Only)
entries: One humanoid creature the mimic is attached to must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or have the mimic enter its clothing or armor.

While the mimic is in the creature's attire, it has three quarters cover against outside effects, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls and Dexterity saving throws, and an attack that misses the mimic makes a new attack roll, targeting the creature.
At the end of each of its turns, the affected creature makes a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw, dislodging the mimic in the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

reaction.name: Secret Mouth
entries: As a reaction when a creature misses the mimic with a melee attack or attempts to touch it, the mimic makes a Outsize Maw attack against it.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The crocodile can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the crocodile remains motionless in water, it has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks when trying to pass itself off as a log.

trait.name: Poison Sensitivity
entries: If the crocodile has a creature {@condition grappled} and takes 5 or more Poison damage from a single source, it immediately releases its grapple.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d10 + 2}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the crocodile can't bite another target.

action.name: Death Roll {@recharge}
entries: A creature {@condition grappled} by the crocodile must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) slashing damage and be {@condition stunned} until the end of the crocodile's next turn, or half as much damage on a success. A creature reduced to 0 HP by this ability loses a limb (crocodile's choice). The crocodile may not use this ability if it is {@condition grappled}.

trait.name: Perfect Transparency
entries: If the cube has not moved or taken an action in the last minute and has no creatures {@condition swallowed|confc|swallowed}, it is {@condition invisible} to creatures with a Passive {@skill Perception} lower than 16.
A Medium or smaller creature that attempts to enter the cube's space is {@condition swallowed|confc|swallowed} by it.

trait.name: Rolling Cube
entries: The cube moves only by rolling in 10 foot increments in cardinal directions, and can enter the space of any Medium or smaller creature.

A creature whose space the cube enters takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) bludgeoning damage, then is pushed 10 feet away if possible, or knocked {@condition prone} and {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 14}) until the cube moves if it can't be.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cube makes two attacks with its Spined Axopod, one of which it can replace with a use of its Split Valves.

action.name: Spined Axopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d6 + 3}) piercing damage.
This attack has advantage against a target with a Passive {@skill Perception} lower than 16.

action.name: Split Valves
entries: The cube's armor splits as it attempts to absorb a creature {@condition restrained} beneath it.

The creature must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be {@condition swallowed|confc|swallowed} (escape {@dc 14}). On a successful saving throw, the creature can make an {@action opportunity attack} against the cube.
A creature {@condition swallowed|confc|swallowed} by the cube takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) acid damage at the beginning of each of the cube's turns.

reaction.name: Crushing Clunk
entries: When the cube takes 10 or more damage from an attack, it can move exactly 10 feet directly away from the attacker, if possible.

trait.name: Chemoreception
entries: While submerged in a body of water, the servitor can detect the presence and location of creatures in that water within 60 feet.

trait.name: Pinch
entries: When the servitor takes the {@action Help} action to grant an attack advantage against a target within 5 feet that is Concentrating, the target must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or lose {@status concentration}.

action.name: Graspers
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}The servitor attaches itself to the target (remove {@dc 11}).
A creature's swim speed is reduced by 5 for each servitor attached to it.

action.name: Echo Cannon
entries: If it is submerged in water, the servitor sends a brief pressure wave forth. One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or take 3 ({@damage 1d6}) thunder damage.

reaction.name: Scuttle
entries: As a reaction to being forced to make a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the servitor moves up to half its speed. If this movement puts the servitor out of range or area of the spell or magical effect, the servitor is unaffected.

monster.name: Crypt-Back Cauchemar

immune.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

languages: understands Common and Infernal but can't speak

trait.name: Embrace of Flames
entries: A creature riding the cauchemar has resistance to fire damage.

trait.name: Bearer of the Dead
entries: The cauchemar may carry any number of dead and undead creatures without difficulty. A dead creature the cauchemar touches is drawn onto its back and {@condition grappled} there (escape {@dc 18}).

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
entries: If the cauchemar fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cauchemar makes three attacks with its Hellshod Hooves, one of which it may replace with a use of its Viperous Bite or Burning Trail, if available.

action.name: Viperous Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) piercing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage.

Unless it is first magically revived, a creature killed by this damage returns as a {@creature questing revenant|confc|Questing Revenant} at the next new moon, and is consumed with thoughts of vengeance toward a creature that recently wronged it.

action.name: Hellshod Hooves
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away.

action.name: Burning Trail {@recharge 5}
entries: The cauchemar moves up to 60 feet in a straight line, leaving a trail of hellfire behind it. Each creature in its path must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}, moving to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.
Until the beginning of the cauchemar's next turn, a creature that starts its turn in the affected area or enters it for the first time on a turn takes 16 ({@damage 3d10}) fire damage.

action.name: Hellfire Revival
entries: The cauchemar wreaths one of the corpses carried on its back in necromantic flames, burning away its flesh and animating it for the next minute as a
The cauchemar can have up to three corpses animated in this way at a time.

action.name: Haunting Squeal (Recharges when the cauchemar uses its Ember-Way Break)
entries: The cauchemar rears up and lets out a hollow squeal, conjuring forth a tide of vengeful spirits.

Each creature within 60 feet of a portal created by the cauchemar's Ember-Way Break must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 5d8}) necrotic damage and be dragged up to 15 feet toward the nearest such portal.

Each creature dragged into a portal's space in this way is carried through to the Ethereal Plane and ages {@dice 1d4 x 10}% of its natural lifespan until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

reaction.name: Fleshmad Frenzy
entries: When the nightmare reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a Viperous Bite attack, it can make another Viperous Bite attack against the same target.

reaction.name: Burn Out
entries: When the cauchemar is reduced to 0 hit points, before falling {@condition unconscious} it begins to shake and squeal, its flesh cracking with flame.

At the beginning of the cauchemar's next turn, it dies and explodes. Each creature within 20 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or take 21 ({@dice 6d6}) fire plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) necrotic damage.
The cauchemar can take one legendary action, choosing from the options below.

legendary.name: Brimstone Fume
entries: Foul wisps of ash and shadow spill from the cauchemar's flesh, creating a 15 foot radius area of magical darkness centered on it that lasts until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Snort Flame
entries: The cauchemar snorts a gout of flame in a 15 foot cone, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.

legendary.name: Ember-Way Break
entries: The cauchemar moves up to half its speed, then may lunge against the barrier between the Ethereal and Material plane, taking 11 ({@damage 2d10}) force damage and tearing open a ragged portal large enough for it to pass through that seals itself shut after a minute.

trait.name: Rocky Camouflage
entries: The dragon may attempt to hide in rocky terrain without being obscured.

trait.name: Lifechannel Aura
entries: At the beginning of each of the dragon's turns, each creature within 5 feet of it gains 5 temporary hit points. While a creature has any of these temporary hit points, it regains the maximum number of hit points possible from any healing.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d10 + 2}) piercing damage plus 2 ({@damage 1d4}) radiant damage.

action.name: Breath Weapons {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.

action.name: Breath of Life Overflowing
entries: The dragon exhales a burst of pure life energy in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw, taking 9 ({@damage 2d8}) radiant damage and regaining 2 ({@dice 1d4}) expended hit dice on a failure, or taking half as much damage on a success.

Then, if the creature has no unexpended hit dice, it incandesces, losing each of its unexpended hit dice, rolling a number of d8s equal to the number of hit dice lost in this way, and taking additional radiant damage equal to the result.

action.name: Breath of Inner Dawn
entries: The dragon blows a mighty breath in a 15 foot long, 5 foot wide line that stokes a blinding glow within all it touches.

The dragon and each creature and object in the area begins to emit sunlight in a 30 foot radius for the next minute, and a creature without resistance to radiant damage that targets an affected creature with an attack or spell must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the beginning of its next turn.

bonus.name: Psionic Empowerment
entries: The dragon produces one of the following effects:

items.name: Whirling Gust
entries: One creature that the dragon can see within 60 feet must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or be spun about with dizzying force. The next attack that creature makes before the beginning of the dragon's next turn is at disadvantage.

items.name: Prevailing Winds
entries: One creature that the dragon can see within 60 feet has its speed increased or decreased by 10 until the beginning of the dragon's next turn.

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The bulette can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a 5-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

trait.name: Shock Attack
entries: If the bulette starts its turn underground, creatures without {@sense tremorsense} may not take reactions on its turn while within 5 feet of it.

trait.name: Corrundum Plating
entries: The bulette's armor is imbued with hardened crystaline sheets, making it nearly impervious to edged weapons.
Whenever it takes bludgeoning damage, the bulette must succeed on a Constitution saving throw with DC equal to the damage dealt or lose its damage resistances until it completes a long rest.

action.name: Sparkling Maw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}31 ({@damage 4d12 + 5}) piercing damage. If the target is carrying a source of bright light, it takes 9 ({@dice 2d8}) additional radiant damage.
The bulette may make this attack as a bonus action against a {@condition prone} creature.

action.name: Erupt {@recharge 5}
entries: The bulette moves up to its burrow speed directly upward, bursting from underground in a thrashing flurry of debris, pushing each creature in its space to the nearest unoccupied space.

Then, each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}, or take half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Deadly Leap (1/Day)
entries: The bulette leaps up to 30 feet and can land in the space of any Medium or smaller creature.

Each creature whose space the bulette lands in must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength or Dexterity saving throw (target's choice) or take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}, or take half as much damage and be pushed to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

trait.name: Solipsistic
entries: The fanatic may treat illusions that it and its allies create as real.

trait.name: Dark Grace
entries: If the fanatic would take half damage due to succeeding on a saving throw while in dim light or darkness, it takes no damage instead.

trait.name: Devil's Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the fanatic's {@sense darkvision}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fanatic makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Ritual Dagger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage. On a critical hit, one extraplanar ally within 60 ft. gains 21 ({@dice 6d6}) temporary hit points. While it has these, the ally has advantage on attack rolls.

action.name: Umbral Binding
entries: One creature within 60 ft. that is engulfed in magical darkness must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or have its movement reduced by 10 ft. until the end of its next turn. A creature whose movement is reduced to 0 in this way is {@condition paralyzed}.

reaction.name: Shroud of Night (3rd level spell, concentration)
entries: As a reaction to seeing an friendly creature within 60 ft. reduced to 0 hit points, the fanatic causes the creature's body to burst into a 20 ft. radius cloud of magical darkness that lasts for 1 minute.

trait.name: Delectable Flesh
entries: When the fanatic dies, each undead creature within 15 feet of it may move up to 10 feet towards it and take a bite of its flesh, gaining 5 temporary hit points.
While it has any of these temporary hit points, a creature may make one melee weapon attack as a bonus action on each of its turns.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fanatic makes two attacks with its Black Iron scepter, one of which it may replace with a use of its Necroserum Syringe.

action.name: Black Iron Scepter
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Necroserum Syringe (3/Day)
entries: The fanatic injects a baleful concoction into a {@condition grappled}, {@condition restrained}, or {@condition incapacitated} creature within 5 feet.
The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn).

While {@condition poisoned} in this way, a creature takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) necrotic damage at the beginning of each of its turns, and upon dying immediately arises as a {@creature horde ghoul|confc|Horde Ghoul} under the fanatic's control.

action.name: Dedication of Blood (3rd Level Spell) {@recharge 5}
entries: The fanatic makes a melee weapon attack, dealing an additional 16 ({@damage 3d10}) necrotic damage on a hit.
If this damage kills a creature, up to one friendly fiend or undead creature within 30 feet may use its reaction to gain 15 temporary hit points or make a melee weapon attack.

trait.name: Leviathan's Anchor
entries: Whenever the fanatic hits a creature that is submerged in water but does not have a swim speed with an attack, the target is dragged 5 ft. deeper underwater.

trait.name: Brinewarded
entries: Aquatic creatures with an Intelligence score of 3 or less are indifferent to the fanatic.

trait.name: Curse of Buoyancy
entries: A creature that reduces the fanatic to 0 hit points must make a {@dc 12} Charisma saving throw or be cursed. A cursed creature that is submerged in water ascends 20 ft. at the beginning of each of its turns if it is holding its breath.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fanatic makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Ritual Dagger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage. On a critical hit, one friendly aquatic creature within 60 ft. gains 21 ({@dice 6d6}) temporary hit points. While it has these temporary hit points, the creature has advantage on attack rolls.

action.name: Call of the Deep
entries: One creature within 60 ft. that is holding its breath must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or lose one minute of held breath. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more loses any spell or magical effect that allows it to breathe water.

monster.name: Cult Fanatic of the Grand Indulger

trait.name: Painfog Censer
entries: Whenever a creature within 15 feet of three or more creatures with this trait takes any non-psychic damage, it takes an additional 2 psychic damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fanatic makes two melee attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Glyph of Unshackled Sensation, if available.

action.name: Painter's Flail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) slashing damage and the target begins {@condition bleeding|confc|bleeding} ({@dice 1d4}).
If the target was already{@condition bleeding|confc|bleeding}, its blood splatters to form an abyssal glyph spread across an unoccupied space within 5 feet.
The glyph is destroyed if it takes any damage or a creature enters its space.

action.name: Glyph of Unshackled Sensation (1/Day)
entries: The fanatic touches a bloodglyph created with its Painter's Flail, causing it to pulse with unholy power.
For the next minute, creatures within 15 feet of the glyph have disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws and vulnerability to psychic damage.

reaction.name: Desperate Appetites
entries: When the fanatic takes any psychic damage, it can regain a use of its Glyph of Unshackled Sensation.

reaction.name: The True Face of Pain
entries: When a creature within 30 feet of the fanatic destroys a bloodglyph created with its Painter's Flail by entering its space, the fanatic can force the creature to make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw.
On a failed save, the creature takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) psychic damage and is {@condition stunned} until the end of the fanatic's next turn.

monster.name: Cult Fanatic of the Lord of Beasts

trait.name: Beastlord's Ire
entries: While within 5 feet of two or more hostile creatures, the fanatic has advantage on saving throws against any effect that would incapacitate or restrain it.

trait.name: Feed the Pack
entries: Attacks made by beasts or monstrosities against a creature {@condition grappled} by the fanatic are made at advantage

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fanatic makes two attacks with its Horned Bident.

action.name: Horned Bident
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

action.name: Quicken Heart (1st Level Spell)
entries: One creature the fanatic can see within 30 feet must make a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save, the creature is {@condition frightened} until the end of the fanatic's next turn and must use its reaction to move half its speed directly away from the fanatic, if possible.
On a success, the target may use its reaction to make a melee attack.

bonus.name: Exultation of Blood (2nd Level Spell)
entries: The fanatic gains 5 temporary hit points for each creature it hit with an attack this turn. While it has any of these temporary hit points, the fanatic's attacks are made at advantage.

monster.name: Cult Fanatic of the Rot Mother

trait.name: Strength from Sickness
entries: While it is {@condition poisoned}, the fanatic's attacks have advantage instead of disadvantage.

action.name: Spore Censer Flail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage.
On a hit or miss, the target takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage.

entries: The darkling makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Shoddy Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage. If this attack was made at advantage, it deals an additional extra 10 ({@damage 3d6}) piercing damage. On a natural 1, the blade breaks and becomes unusable.

bonus.name: Absorb Light
entries: The light level within 30 ft. of the darkling has its degree of brightness decreased by one, from Bright Light to Dim Light, from Dim Light to Darkness, or from Darkness to Magical Darkness. The Darkling takes 5 ({@damage 2d4}) radiant damage.

bonus.name: Shadow Hex
entries: Baleful shadows cling to one creature within 60 ft. that the darkling can see. Whenever the target takes damage, it takes an additional 3 ({@damage 1d6}) necrotic damage. This effect ends if the cursed creature is illuminated with Bright Light.

trait.name: Echolocation
entries: The darkmantle can't use its {@sense blindsight} while {@condition deafened}.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the darkmantle remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a cave formation such as a stalactite or stalagmite.

action.name: Crush
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}). While {@condition grappled}, the target is {@condition blinded} and can't breathe breathe, and the darkmantle has advantage on attacks against it and cannot bite another target. If this attack was made with advantage, the creature loses its breath if it was holding it.

reaction.name: Darkness Aura (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to taking damage, the darkmantle exudes a 15-foot radius of magical darkness that moves with it, and spreads around corners. The darkness lasts until the next time the darkmantle takes damage.

from: 18 if in dim light or darkness

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The darkweaver can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Shadow Slip
entries: As a Bonus Action, the darkweaver teleports up to 30 ft. to a location it can see that is not brightly illuminated.

trait.name: Shadow Strands
entries: The dark weaver is surrounded in a 30 ft. radius by a tangle of slithering, web-like strands of shadowstuff, gaining the following benefits:
Other creatures cannot see more than 10 ft. through the area.
Light cannot extend more than 10 ft. through the area.
The area is difficult terrain for any creature trying to move away from the darkweaver.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The darkweaver makes six melee attacks.

action.name: Tentacle Rake
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hits: 11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}). While {@condition grappled} in this way, a creature in Dim Light or Darkness is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}.

action.name: Consume Vigor
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the darkweaver must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitition saving throw or have its Constitution score reduced by 5 ({@dice 2d4}) for the next minute. The target dies if this reduces its Constittuion to 0.
Additionally on a failure, the radius of the darkweaver's shadow strands trait expands by 5 ft. for the next minute.

trait.name: Duck and Leap
entries: When the guanghan takes the {@action Dodge} action, it may jump up to 10 feet whenever it is missed with a melee attack.

trait.name: Courtly Grace
entries: If the guanghan would make a Dexterity saving throw, it may choose to instead make a Charisma ({@skill Performance}) check against the same DC.

action.name: Offer Tea
entries: Dawn Clouds presents a cup of tea to a creature within 5 feet, which must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or accept it.
For the next minute, while it holds the cup a creature is {@condition charmed} by Dawn Clouds and cannot willingly relinquish the cup.
A creature may end this effect as a bonus action by quickly drinking the tea, taking {@damage 1d4} fire damage.

action.name: Exhort Propriety
entries: Dawn Clouds firmly reminds a creature within 30 feet that can hear her of what propriety demands. If the creature is wielding a weapon, it must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to sheath it.

trait.name: Hemmoraging Cone
entries: The death kiss's eye creates a field that draws out a creature's blood through its wounds, in a 150-foot cone. At the start of each of its turns, the death kiss decides which way the cone faces. Each creature that does not have all of its hit points that starts its turn in the area loses 5 ({@dice 2d4}) hit points and makes death saving throws at disadvantage.

trait.name: Lightning Blood
entries: Whenever the death kiss takes piercing or slashing damage, each other creature within 5 ft. takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) lightning damage. A creature that that takes this damage while wearing metal armor can't take reactions until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Tendrils
entries: When the death kiss is dealt a critical hit, the death kiss must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or make one fewer attack with its multiattack until it completes a long rest.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The death kiss has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Th Death Kiss makes six attacks with its feeding tendrils. If more than one of them target a single creature, attacks beyond the first are made at advantage.

action.name: Feeding Tendril
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}). The death kiss has ten tendrils, each of which may grapple a single creature. A creature {@condition grappled} by two or more tendrils is {@condition restrained}.

action.name: Thin Blood
entries: Each creature {@condition grappled} by the deathkiss must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or one lose one unexpended hit die for each tendril grappling it, or half as many on a success, and the death kiss gains 10 temporary hit points for each hit die expended in this way. A creature that cannot instead drops to 0 hit points.

action.name: Corrupted Blood Infusion
entries: One creature with zero unexpended hit die {@condition grappled} by the death kiss must make a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature gains 55 ({@dice 10d10}) temporary hit points. While it has these temporary hit points, a creature has immunity to lightning damage, remains conscious even if at 0 hit points, and acts under the death kiss' control. A creature that succeeds on this save instead takes 27 ({@damage 5d10}) lightning damage.

reaction.name: Blood Rejection
entries: As a reaction to being forced to make a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the death kiss changes the effect's target to a creature it is grappling. If it does, the death kiss releases the creature from each tendril grappling it, and the creature gains 11 ({@dice 2d10}) temporary hit points.

trait.name: Soul Bound in Steel
entries: The death knight's soul resides in its weapon. While it wields its weapon, it has resistance to all damage but force and radiant. If it is disarmed, its movement speed is halved and it can't take reactions.
If its weapon is intact, a destroyed Death Knight gains a new body in {@dice 1d10} days, regaining all its hit points and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of the weapon.

trait.name: Fear Eater
entries: The death knight scores a critical hit on a roll of 17-20 on attacks made against a creature that is {@condition frightened}.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The death knight has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The death knight uses its Fearsome Gaze and makes two melee attacks, then can use its Slaying Smite, if available.

action.name: Soulblade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) slashing damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) necrotic damage. A creature killed by this damage has its soul absorbed into the blade, and cannot be revived while the blade is intact.

action.name: Fearsome Gaze
entries: One creature the death knight can see within 60 feet must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of the death knight's next turn.

action.name: Slaying Smite (5th Level Spell, Concentration) {@recharge 5}
entries: The death knight wreaths its blade in deathly energies. The next time the death knight hits with an attack, the attack deals an additional
36 ({@damage 8d8}) necrotic damage. If the attack reduces a creature below 20 hit points, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or die.

action.name: Hellfire Orb (1/Day, 7th Level Spell)
entries: The death knight hurls a magical ball of fire that explodes at a point it can see within 120 feet of it. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) fire damage and 21 ({@damage 6d6}) necrotic damage and be knocked {@condition prone}, or take half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Counterattack
entries: When the death knight is targeted with a melee attack, it can add 6 to its AC against that attack.
If this causes the attack to miss, the death knight can make a melee attack as part of this reaction.

reaction.name: Overpower
entries: When the death knight misses a creature with a melee attack, it can reroll its attack.
If this causes the attack to hit, the target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone} and be unable to stand on its following turn.

legendary.name: No Escape
entries: One creature the death knight can see must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or be dragged up to 20 feet toward it. A flying creature that fails this save by 5 or more falls {@condition prone}.

legendary.name: Still Arcana
entries: Each creature the death knight can see that is {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell affecting it must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or lose {@status concentration}. The death knight may take this action even while {@condition incapacitated}.

legendary.name: Gauntlet Strike
entries: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away and knocked {@condition prone}.

legendary.name: Battle Rush (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The death knight moves up to half its speed. If it takes any damage during this movement, it regains its reaction.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The slaad can use its action to polymorph itself or another slaad into a Small or Medium humanoid, or back into its true form. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The slaad has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Chaotic Resilience
entries: The slaad has resistance to the damage type of the last source of damage it received.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The slaad makes three attacks, one of which may be with its havoc bite. It may replace any number of these attacks with uses of its Mighty Leap or Death Croak, if available.

action.name: Havoc Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@dice 2d8 + 5}) piercing plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage. Additionally on a hit, the first 10 ft. of movement the target takes on its following turn is made in a random direction.

action.name: Entropic Touch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@dice 2d6 + 5}) force plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage. A creature killed by this damage disintigrates.

action.name: Mighty Leap
entries: The slaad leaps up to 20 ft., and can land in the space of any Medium or smaller creature. Each of those creatures must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take 7 ({@dice 2d6}) bludgeoning plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage and be knocked {@condition prone}. On a successful save, the creature is pushed to the nearest unoccupied space.

action.name: Pandemoniac Ideal (Concentration)
entries: The slaad creates the image of an object, creature, or pheneomenon no larger than a 30-foot cube. It seems real to all senses, though a successful {@dc 16} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check reveals its illusory nature. The slaad may interact with the illusion physically as though it were real.

As a Bonus Action on each of its turns, the slaad can move the illusion up to 30 ft. and force one creature within 5 ft. of it to succeed on a {@dc 16} Intelligence saving throw or take 26 ({@damage 4d12}) damage of a type appropriate to the illusion. A creature that has investigated the illusion makes this save with advantage.

action.name: Death Croak {@recharge 5}
entries: The slaadi lets out a horrible, atonal croak that destabilizes matter around it. Until the end of the slaad's next turn, a non-slaad creature that ends its turn within 20 ft. of the slaad takes 22 ({@damage 4d10}) force damage.

action.name: Plane Shift (1/Day)
entries: The slaad and any number of slaadi adjacent to it teleport to a different plane of existence.

trait.name: Negative Energy Cone
entries: The death tyrant's central eye emits an {@condition invisible}, magical 150-foot cone of negative energy. At the start of each of its turns, the tyrant decides which way the cone faces and whether the cone is active.

Any creature in that area can't regain hit points. Any humanoid that dies there becomes a zombie under the tyrant's command. The dead humanoid retains its place in the initiative order and animates at the start of its next turn, provided that its body hasn't been completely destroyed.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The death tyrant has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Many Eyes (3/Day)
entries: If the death tyrant fails a saving throw against an effect that would blind or incapacitate it, it may choose to succeed instead. The death tyrant takes one fewer legendary action each turn for each time it has used this ability.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) piercing damage.

action.name: Eye Rays
entries: The death tyrant shoots three of the following magical eye rays at random (reroll duplicates), choosing one to three targets it can see within 120 ft. of it:

action.name: 1. Decay Ray (Luminescent Green)
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or have its maximum hit points reduced to its current hit points until it completes a long rest.

action.name: 2. Compulsion Ray (Wispy Red)
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or take 33 ({@damage 6d10}) psychic damage and be unable to voluntarily leave the death tyrant's eye cone until the end of its next turn.

action.name: 3. Terror Ray (Wavy Purple.)
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} for the next minute. The creature repeats this save at end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success or taking 22 ({@damage 4d10}) psychic damage on a failure.

action.name: 4. Dispel Ray (Pale Silver)
entries: The death tyrant ends one spell affecting the target.

action.name: 5. Seizure Ray (Mottled Green)
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for the next minute. While {@condition poisoned} in this way, whenever the creature casts a spell it is {@condition stunned} until the beginning of its next turn. A {@condition poisoned} creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: 6. Blood Ray (Sludgy Crimson)
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or become susceptible to bleeding for the next minute. Whenever the afflicted character takes damage, it begins bleeding, losing 10 hit points at the start of each of its turns. The creature stops bleeding when magically healed, or with a successful {@dc 17} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check, but retains its susceptibility. This can be applied to the same creature multiple times, with its effects applied cumulatively.

action.name: 7. Etherealness Ray (Diaphanous White)
entries: The targeted creature must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target is shunted partially into the ethereal plane, gaining a 30 ft. fly speed and dealing half as much damage with attacks that use Strength for the next minute, or until the death tyrant uses this ability again.

action.name: 8. Enchaining Ray (Gleaming Blue-Grey)
entries: The targeted creature must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 16}) as chains of seething shadow envelop its body. A creature in bright light may attempt to escape as a bonus action.

action.name: 9. Doom Ray (Shivering Marroon)
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Charisma saving throw or be cursed. While cursed, the creature acquires a Doom counter each time it takes necrotic damage. If the creature drops to 0 hit points while cursed, it immediately fails one Death Save for each Doom counter it has.

action.name: 10. Death Ray (Streaky Black)
entries: The targeted creature must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take 44 ({@damage 8d10}) necrotic damage. The target dies if the ray reduces it to 0 hit points.

legendary.name: Eye Ray
entries: The death tyrant uses one random eye ray.

legendary.name: Death Ray (Costs 3 actions)
entries: The death tyrant uses its Death Ray.

trait.name: Corpse Drainer
entries: If the sporocyte starts its turn within 5 feet of one or more dead or {@condition unconscious} creatures, it gains 5 ({@dice 1d10}) temporary hit points and each creature in the area takes an equal amount of necrotic damage. On a roll of 10, a random corpse within 5 feet of the sporocyte dissolves.

action.name: Rotting Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage immediately fails a Death saving throw.

action.name: Unfurl Mycelia
entries: The sporocyte spreads a carpet of mycelia over the ground within 5 feet of it. square centered on itself.

While unfurled, the sporocyte's movement speed is 0, the affected area is difficult terrain, and if the sporocyte would gain temporary hit points, it instead gains twice as many temporary hit points. The sporocyte may retract its mycelia as a bonus action.

reaction.name: Spore Gout (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the sporocyte releases a torrent of spores in a 15 foot cone.
Each nonplant creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage and be infected with {@disease burrow-diver mycosis|ConfC}.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The deathleaper can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The deathleaper makes two attacks, one of which can be with its Drip-Fang Bite, and uses its Death Leap, if available.

action.name: Drip-Fang Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}8 ({@dice 1d8 + 4}) piercing plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) poison damage.
This attack scores a critical on a 19-20 against a {@condition stunned} creature.

action.name: Grasping Legs
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}).
A Large or larger creature {@condition grappled} by the deathleaper has disadvantage on attacks that target it.

action.name: Death Leap {@recharge 5}
entries: The deathleaper jumps up to 120 feet, and can land in the space of up to one Huge or smaller creature.
A creature whose space the deathleaper lands in must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone} and {@condition stunned} until the beginning of its next turn.
On a successful saving throw, the deathleaper instead lands in the nearest unoccupied space.

bonus.name: Silk Anchor
entries: The deathleaper plants a trailing anchor of silk in its space, which lasts until it uses this ability again, moves more than 40 feet from its anchor, or its anchor is destroyed (AC 10, 5 HP).
While it is beneath its anchor, the deathleaper falls only when it chooses to and can use its climb speed to climb directly down from or back up toward the anchor.

monster.name: Deathlock Wight

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

languages: The languages it knew in life

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the wight has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight. A wight that takes radiant damage can't use its Soul Harvest on its following turn.

trait.name: Turning Defiance
entries: The wight and any undead within 30 feet of it have advantage on saving throws against effects that turn undead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wight makes two attacks.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Grave Bolt
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 6} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d10 + 3}) necrotic damage and the target is afflicted with clinging shadows for the next minute, reducing any sources of bright light within 5 feet of it to dim light.

action.name: Soul Harvest {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature affected by the wight's grave bolt must make a {@dc 14} Constitution save or be forced to expend two of its hit dice. If the creature can't, it instead drops to 0 hit points. The wight gains {@dice 1d8} temporary hit points for each hit die expended this way.

action.name: Gravechurn (1/Day)
entries: Up to six humanoid corpses within 30 feet of the wight rise as

trait.name: Beneficent Presence
entries: If the angel has at least 103 hit points, a creature in the angel's debt that starts its turn within 60 feet of the angel must succeed on a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by the angel until the beginning of its next turn. A creature passes this save automatically if the angel attacked it in the last minute.

trait.name: Exacting Presence
entries: If the angel has 102 hit points or fewer, a creature {@condition frightened} by the angels Visions of Death is additionally {@condition paralyzed}.

trait.name: Debt Keeper
entries: A creature that is indebted to the angel is psychically connected to it. The angel can telepathically communicate with it over any distance and can choose to perceive through its senses. Once per day, the angel can force an indebted creature to reroll an attack, skill check, or saving throw, taking the second result.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The angel has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Shed Asset (3/Day)
entries: If the angel fails a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, it can choose to shift the effect to a creature in its debt within 30 feet. If it does, that creature is freed from the angel's debt.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The angel makes three melee attacks, one of which it may replace with its Visions of Death, if available, and uses its Debt to the Deathless.

action.name: Golden Scythe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) bludgeoning damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) necrotic damage.
On a critical hit, the target loses 2 ({@dice 1d4}) unexpended hit dice, or drops to 0 hit points and loses an extremity if it cannot.

action.name: Debt to the Deathless
entries: One creature within 30 feet that is in the angel's debt loses 11 ({@dice 2d10}) hit points, and the angel gains that many temporary hit points.

action.name: Visions of Death {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature within 60 feet that the angel can see must make a {@dc 19} Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is {@condition blinded} and {@condition frightened} until the end of the angel's next turn as it begins to vividly hallucinate its own gruesome death at the angel's hands.

action.name: Touch of Life (3/Day)
entries: The angel touches a living creature or one that has been dead no longer than ten days. The creature returns to life in the angel's debt if it was dead, then regains hit points equal to half its maximum.

reaction.name: Offer Relief
entries: When another creature it can see within 30 feet fails a saving throw, the angel grants it the ability to choose to reroll the saving throw, taking the second result. A creature that does so is indebted to the angel.

reaction.name: Recall Obligations
entries: When a creature in the angel's debt that the angel can see casts a spell, the angel forces the creature to expend an additional spell slot of any level. If the creature cannot, the spell fails.

trait.name: Shuffling Gait
entries: The decaton's walking speed is reduced to 0 while in difficult terrain.

trait.name: Clockwork Repetition
entries: The decaton may choose to treat any {@dice d20} roll as a 10, instead of rolling.

trait.name: Perfect Synchrony
entries: If the decaton is within 30 feet of a nonaton, it uses the nonaton's attack bonus instead of its own. If the nonaton is using a octon's attack bonus, the decaton uses that instead, and so on.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The decaton makes three attacks with its Flailing Tubes, one of which it may replace with a use of its Oil Joints.

action.name: Flailing Tubes
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}8 bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Oil Joints
entries: One friendly modron within 10 feet gains 10 temporary hit points that last for 10 minutes. While it has any of these temporary hit points, a modron has vulnerability to fire damage and can make a melee attack as a bonus action.

action.name: Pruning Cull
entries: The decaton destroys one friendly pentadrone it can see, then restores each modron that transformed as a result to full health.

reaction.name: Gas Up
entries: As a reaction when it is hit with a melee attack, the decaton fills itself with a buoyant gas, immediately rising 10 feet directly upward.

reaction.name: Upgrade
entries: As a reaction to seeing a nonaton within 60 feet die or transform, the decaton may transform into a nonaton, retaining its current hit points. No more than one decaton may take this reaction.

monster.name: Decrepit Skeleton
languages: understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the skeleton takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the skeleton takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

trait.name: Bone Dust Burst
entries: When the skeleton dies, it explodes in a cloud of dust, heavily obscuring the area in a 5 ft. radius around itself for the next minute, or until cleared away by a strong wind.

action.name: Rusted Blade (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 slashing damage. On a roll of 1, the blade breaks and becomes unusable.

reaction.name: Hate the Living
entries: When a creature the skeleton can see reduces an undead ally of the skeleton's to 0 hit points, the skeleton can move up to 10 feet towards the creature.

trait.name: Keen Hearing
entries: The bat has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing.

trait.name: Hematophage
entries: While a creature {@condition poisoned} by its Bloodletting Bite is within 5 feet of it, the bat may lap up its spilled blood as a Bonus Action, gaining 5 temporary hit points.

action.name: Bloodletting Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for the next minute.
A creature {@condition poisoned} in this way repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success or losing 5 ({@dice 2d4}) hit points on a failure.

action.name: Echolocation
entries: If the bat is not {@condition deafened}, it gains one of the following benefits until the end of its next turn:

items.name: Low Frequency
entries: The bat gains {@sense Blindsight} to a range of 60 feet.

items.name: High Frequency
entries: The bat has advantage on melee attack rolls. Whenever the bat uses its Chaotic Swerve and the triggering attack misses it, the bat regains its reaction.

reaction.name: Chaotic Swerve
entries: As a reaction when the bat is targeted with an attack, it may move 5 feet directly toward the nearest creature and impose disadvantage on the attack roll.
Then, if one or more creatures are within 5 feet of it, the bat and each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The scion can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Psionic Empowerment
entries: As a Bonus Action, the scion gains one of the following benefits until it uses this ability again.

items.name: Customary Guise (Concentration)
entries: The scion transforms into a semblance of its pre-transformation humanoid appearance. This ability ends early if it makes an attack with its Tentacle Lash, or uses its Flare Mouth.

items.name: Electroacuity
entries: Living creatures within 20 feet of the scion cannot be hidden from it, and creatures submerged in the same water as the scion have disadvantage on attacks that target it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The scion may use its Flare Mouth if available, then makes two attacks, one of which may be with its Facelatch Bite.

action.name: Facelatch Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) piercing damage.

If the target is Medium or smaller and the scion used its Flare Mouth this turn, the scion may grapple the creature instead of dealing damage (escape {@dc 14}). While {@condition grappled} in this way, the target is {@condition blinded} and can't speak or breathe.

action.name: Drowner's Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) piercing damage and the target is pushed 5 feet in a direction of the scion's choice.

action.name: Flare Mouth {@recharge 5}
entries: The scion suddenly flares its mouth open in a gaping display. Each creature within 10 feet of the scion must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of the scion's next turn.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The scion can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Psionic Empowerment
entries: As a Bonus Action, the scion gains one of the following benefits until it uses this ability again.

items.name: Customary Guise (Concentration)
entries: The scion transforms into a semblance of its pre-transformation humanoid appearance. This ability ends early if it makes an attack with its Tentacle Lash, or uses its Flare Mouth.

items.name: Electroacuity
entries: Living creatures within 20 feet of the scion cannot be hidden from it, and creatures submerged in the same water as the scion have disadvantage on attacks that target it.

items.name: Call of the Deep
entries: Whenever the scion hits a creature that is holding its breath with an attack, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or stop holding its breath.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The scion may use its Flare Mouth if available, then makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Facelatch Bite.

action.name: Facelatch Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) piercing damage.

If the target is Medium or smaller and the scion used its Flare Mouth this turn, the scion may grapple the creature instead of dealing damage (escape {@dc 15}). While {@condition grappled} in this way, the target is {@condition blinded} and can't speak or breathe.

action.name: Drowner's Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage and the target is pushed 5 feet in a direction of the scion's choice.

action.name: Tentacle Sparklash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@dice 1d6 + 4}) bludgeoning plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) lightning damage.

action.name: Flare Mouth {@recharge 5}
entries: The scion suddenly flares its mouth open in a gaping display. Each creature within 10 feet of the scion must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of the scion's next turn.

reaction.name: Pelagic Screech (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction when the scion is reduced below 64 hit points while submerged, it emits a telepathically encoded scream that echoes through the sea.
Each other creature within 300 feet that is submerged in the same body of water must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of the scion's next turn.
The scion's master learns any information that the scion has learned since the last time they communicated.

trait.name: Illumination
entries: The beetle sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet.

trait.name: Spiracle Breathing
entries: The beetle has disadvantage on Constitution saving throws against inhaled toxins.

action.name: Mandible Snip
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 1} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d6 - 1}) slashing damage.

action.name: Blistering Secretion
entries: The beetle secretes a toxic oil and rubs it over its shell. For the next minute, any creature that grapples the beetle or hits it with a melee attack is coated in the oil.
Until a creature clears the oil as an action, whenever the coated creature takes piercing or slashing damage it takes an additional 1 poison damage.

reaction.name: Synchronous Flash
entries: When the beetle or a friendly creature it can see within 30 feet is targeted with an attack, the beetle can briefly intensify its natural glow in a searing flash.
The attacker subtracts 1 from its attack roll for each beetle that took this reaction.

monster.name: Defacer

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

languages: The languages it knew in life

trait.name: Earth Glide
entries: The defacer can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the defacer doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

trait.name: Frightful Keening
entries: The faces that whirl around a defacer's featureless head constantly wail and scream, a terrible sound that travels through solid rock and stone as easily as air. Creatures within 300 ft. of the defacer that can hear it have disadvantage on saving throws against being {@condition frightened}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The defacer makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Claw of Horrid Countenance
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 4d6 + 3}) slashing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Charisma saving throw or have its face replaced with the screaming, ghostly face of one of the defacer's previous victims. Until the end of the defacer's next turn, the target cannot see, speak, or breathe.

action.name: Steal Face {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution save or take 44 ({@damage 8d10}) necrotic damage, or half as much on a success. A creature reduced to 0 HP by this damage has its face stolen, as its features melt off and slide away leaving only blank flesh behind until the defacer is slain. A faceless creature can still breath and speak, though it is difficult to tell how.

reaction.name: Screaming Chorus
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the defacer forces the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of the defacer's next turn.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The deinonychus has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the deinonychus's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Leaping Pounce
entries: The deinonychus's long jump is up to 40 feet and its high jump is up to 20 feet, with or without a running start. If the deinonychus jumps at least 20 ft. then hits a creature with a claw attack, the target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Foe-Climber
entries: If the deinonychus hits a Large or larger creature with a claw attack, instead of grappling it climbs on to the creature. While climbing on a creature, the creature has disadvantage on attack rolls that target the deinonychus.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The deinonychus makes two attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Sawing Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) slashing damage. This attack scores a critical on an 18-20 against a {@condition prone} creature.

action.name: Terrible Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}).

monster.name: Demilich Ascetic
languages: Common plus up to five other languages

trait.name: Avoidance
entries: If the demilich is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

trait.name: Paralyzing Aura
entries: A creature that damages the demilich with a melee attack must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} until the end of the demilich's next turn, or until the creature takes damage.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the demilich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The demilich uses its Baleful Telekinesis four times.

action.name: Baleful Telekinesis
entries: One creature within 60 feet that the demilich can see must succeed on a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw or be moved 30 feet. If this movement carries the creature into a wall or other solid surface, the target takes 33 ({@damage 6d10}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Wrench Heart (7th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: One creature within 60 feet that the demilich can see feels a spectral hand sink into its chest and grip its heart. At the beginning of each of the creature's turns it takes 45 ({@damage 10d8}) necrotic damage and must succeed on a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Disintegrate (6th Level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature within 60 feet must succeed on a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw or take 80 ({@damage 10d6 + 45}) force damage, or half as much on a success. If this damage reduces a creature to 0 hit points, they are disintegrated.

reaction.name: Shield (1st Level Spell)
entries: When the demilich is targeted with an attack, it may add 5 to its AC until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Spelldrain Cackle
entries: When a creature the demilich can see within 60 feet casts a spell, the demilich forces the spellcaster to succeed on a {@dc 20} Charisma saving throw or have the spell fail, then lose its highest level unexpended spell slot.

reaction.name: Howl (1/Day)
entries: When the demilich is reduced below 154 hit points, it emits a bloodcurdling howl.
Each creature within 30 feet that can hear the howl must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or drop to 0 hit points.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more immediately fails two death saving throws.

legendary.name: Life Drain
entries: One creature within 10 feet must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or lose a number of unexpended hit dice equal to the amount it failed by. A creature that cannot instead drops to 0 hit points.

legendary.name: Chatter
entries: Each creature within 30 feet that is {@status concentration||concentrating} and can hear the demilich must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or lose {@status concentration}.

legendary.name: Choking Dust
entries: The area within 10 feet of the demilich becomes heavily obscured until the end of its next turn. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or be unable to speak or breathe until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Wither
entries: One creature within 60 feet that the demilich can see takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage.

trait.name: Avoidance
entries: If the demilich is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

trait.name: Weightless Careening
entries: Whenever the demilich takes damage from a source it is not resistant to, it is pushed 30 feet away from the source. If it hits a wall or object, it bounces.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the demilich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Life Drain
entries: The demilich targets up to three creatures that it can see within 10 feet of it. Each target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or lose a number of unexpended hit dice equal to the amount it failed by. A creature that cannot instead drops to 0 hit points.

action.name: Howl {@recharge 5}
entries: The demilich emits a bloodcurdling howl. Each creature within 30 feet that can hear the howl must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or drop to 0 hit points. On a successful save, the creature is {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Mindlost Cackle
entries: When the demilich succeeds on a saving throw against a spell, it can force the spellcaster to succeed on a {@dc 18} Charisma saving throw or lose its highest level unexpended spell slot.

legendary.name: Chatter
entries: Each creature within 30 feet that is {@status concentration||concentrating} and can hear the demilich must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or lose {@status concentration}.

legendary.name: Choking Dust
entries: The area within 10 feet of the demilich becomes heavily obscured until the end of its next turn. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or be unable to speak or breathe until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Wither
entries: One creature within 60 feet that the demilich can see takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage.

trait.name: Double Actions
entries: Demogorgon rolls initiative twice, and acts on each of them. If his mythic trait is active, he acts only on his lowest initiative.

trait.name: Giant Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to Demogorgon may spend half of its movement to attempt to climb onto him with a successful {@dc 17} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. A creature climbing on Demogorgon has advantage on melee attacks against him.

trait.name: Indecision Weakness
entries: While three or more enemies are within his reach, Demogorgon has disadvantage on attack rolls and attack rolls against him have advantage.

trait.name: Engineered Resistance
entries: Demogorgon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects, and has resistance to damage from spells of 3rd level or below.

trait.name: Shed Weakness (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
entries: When Demogorgon is reduced to 0 hit points, he doesn't die or fall {@condition unconscious}. Instead, he resets to 336 hit points and tears off one of his heads, losing his Indecision Weakness and Gaze of Aarneul, and gaining a second action on each of his turns.

trait.name: Legendary Resistances (5/Day)
entries: If Demogorgon fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Demogorgon makes two melee attacks, one of which he may replace with either his Gaze of Hethradiah or Gaze of Aameul, if available.

action.name: Tentacle Thrash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 17} to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. {@h}35 ({@damage 4d12 + 9}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 25}). A creature that starts its turn {@condition grappled} in this way must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw or be infected with Doll-Joint Malacia.

action.name: Forked Tail Drain
