entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 17} to hit, reach 20 ft., one creature. {@h}27 ({@damage 4d8 + 9}) slashing damage and the target loses two unexpended hit dice, or takes an additional 18 ({@damage 4d8}) necrotic damage if it can't.

action.name: Gaze of Hethradiah
entries: One creature that Demogorgon can see within 120 feet must make a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, attacks against the creature score a critical on an 18-20 until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Gaze of Aameul (Recharges when Demogorgon uses his Gaze of Hethradiah)
entries: One creature that Demogorgon can see within 120 feet must succeed on a {@dc 21} Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to take an action of Demogorgon's choice.

action.name: Into the Spiraling Depths (8th Level Spell, Concentration, Recharge 6)
entries: An enormous spectral maw breaches forth through a planar rift. Each creature in a 15 foot radius centered on a point Demogorgon can see must succeed on a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw or take 36 ({@damage 8d8}) piercing damage and be abducted to the depths of Abysm.

An abducted creature makes a {@dc 21} Charisma saving throw at the end of each of its turns, returning to the nearest unoccupied space to where it departed on a success or taking 22 ({@damage 4d10}) acid damage on a failure. A creature killed by this damage does not return.

reaction.name: Body Shield
entries: When Demogorgon is targeted with an attack while grappling one or more creatures, he can add +4 to its AC against the triggering attack.
If the attack misses, the attacker makes a new attack roll, targeting a {@condition grappled} creature instead.

legendary.name: Fling
entries: Demogorgon flings a creature {@condition grappled} by him at a creature or surface within 40 feet. The thrown creature takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) bludgeoning damage.
If the creature was thrown at another creature, the target must succeed on a {@dc 25} Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage.

legendary.name: Teleport
entries: Demogorgon teleports up to 30 feet to a location he can see, along with each creature he is grappling and each creature that is climbing on him.

legendary.name: Deep Father's Mastery
entries: One friendly creature within 60 feet that has a swim speed may use its reaction to move up to half its speed and make an attack.

mythic.name: Unshackled Brutality (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Demogorgon makes a melee attack with advantage and can roll to recharge his Into the Spiraling Depths.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the derro has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Scuttling Advance
entries: The derro can crawl at its full movement speed, and does not suffer disadvantage on attack rolls as a result of being {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The derro has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Hooked Spear
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d6}) piercing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, the derro can choose to deal no damage and knock it {@condition prone}.

action.name: Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Uncanny Fixation (1/Day)
entries: The derro chooses one hostile creature it can see at random. For the next hour or until the creature dies, the derro has advantage on attack rolls and Wisdom-based checks directed at the creature, and disadvantage on attack rolls that target any other creature.

reaction.name: Mad Lunge
entries: As a reaction to missing with a melee attack, the derro may add 5 to its attack roll. If it does, the target may make an {@action opportunity attack||attack of opportunity} against the derro.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the derro has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Madness Unleashed
entries: While the derro has fewer than 43 hit points, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and its melee attacks deal an additional 7 ({@damage 2d6}) psychic damage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The derro has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The derro makes three attacks with its ear-taker blade, or two attacks with its repeating hand crossbow.

action.name: Ear-Taker Blade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) slashing damage. This attack scores a critical on an 18-20 against a {@condition prone} creature.

action.name: Repeating Hand Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

bonus.name: Uncanny Fixation (1/Day)
entries: The derro chooses one hostile creature it can see at random. For the next hour or until the creature dies, the derro has advantage on attack rolls and Wisdom-based checks directed at the creature, and disadvantage on attack rolls that target any other creature.

reaction.name: Mad Lunge
entries: As a reaction to missing with a melee attack, the derro may add 5 to its attack roll. If it does, the target may make an {@action opportunity attack||attack of opportunity} against the derro.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the derro has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The derro has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The derro makes three attacks with its barbed lash.

action.name: Barbed Lash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) slashing damage and the target is moved 5 ft. in a direction of the savant's choice.

action.name: Mental Scourge (3rd Level Spell)
entries: One creature the derro can see within 60 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 15} Intelligence saving throw or take 28 ({@damage 8d6}) psychic damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature that fails by 5 or more has its movement controlled by the derro on its following turn. The creature can take its action before or after moving.

action.name: Window to Madness (4th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: The derro creates an 10 ft. by 10 ft. illusory portal to the far realm in an unoccupied space within 60 ft. that lasts for a minute. Each non-derro creature within 30 ft. of the portal that can see it takes {@damage 1d4} psychic damage at the start of each of its turns. A creature that starts its turn within the area of the portal itself must succeed on a {@dc 15} Intelligence saving throw or take 36 ({@damage 8d8}) psychic damage and be {@condition stunned} until the beginning of its next turn.

bonus.name: Draw of The Far Realm
entries: Each creature within 60 ft. of the derro's Window to Madness must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be drawn 10 ft. towards it.

bonus.name: Searing Focus
entries: The derro gives one creature within 60 ft. that it can see disadvantage on the next saving throw it makes this turn. The derro takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) psychic damage.

bonus.name: Uncanny Fixation (1/Day)
entries: The derro chooses one hostile creature it can see at random. For the next hour or until the creature dies, the derro has advantage on attack rolls and Wisdom-based checks directed at the creature, and disadvantage on attack rolls that target any other creature.

reaction.name: Refuge in Madness
entries: As a reaction to being forced to make an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma saving throw, the savant may gain advantage on the saving throw. If it does, it cannot cast spells on its following turn.

trait.name: Cursed Thirst
entries: Water recedes from the desiccator as though magnetically repelled, and is destroyed if the dessicator touches it. If the desiccator begins its turn fully submerged in water, it explodes in a hail of jagged salts.
Each creature within 15 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 11} Dexterity saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) slashing damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Parch the Weak
entries: The desiccator's attacks score a critical on an 18-20 against a creature with a Constitution score of 10 or lower.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The desiccator makes two attacks with its crumbling touch.

action.name: Crumbling Touch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) necrotic damage. A creature killed by this attack crumbles to dust.
On a critical hit, the target gains a point of {@condition exhaustion} that lasts for a minute.

action.name: Desiccation Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The desiccator inhales, draining the moisture from a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or have its Constitution score reduced by 1 until it completes a Short or Long Rest.
A creature with its Constitution score reduced in this way that would receive any healing instead receives half as much and repeats this save, ending the effect on a success.

reaction.name: Ragged Panting
entries: When the dessicator takes any fire damage, it falls {@condition prone} and rolls to recharge its Desiccation Breath.

monster.name: Destrachan Far Voice
languages: understands common but does not speak it

trait.name: Mimicry
entries: The destrachan can mimic any sounds it has heard, including voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The destrachan makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Sawing Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage. This attack scores a critical on an 18-20 against a {@condition prone} creature.

action.name: Terrible Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}).

action.name: Destructive Harmonics {@recharge 5}
entries: The destrachan blasts sonic energy in a 30 ft. cone, choosing one of the following effects. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or suffer the chosen effect.

items.name: Flesh
entries: Each creature in the area takes 36 ({@damage 8d8}) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

items.name: Nerves
entries: Each creature in the area falls {@condition unconscious} for 1 hour. An {@condition unconscious} creature wakes early if it takes any damage, or if another creature wakes it as an action.

items.name: Metal
entries: Each creature wearing metal armor has its movement speed halved until the beginning of its next turn. Each creature that is carrying a metal weapon drops it.

items.name: Stone
entries: Stone surfaces in the area fracture, collapsing tunnels, walls, and bridges.

monster.name: Destrachan Worm Ripper
languages: understands common but does not speak it

trait.name: Mimicry
entries: The destrachan can mimic any sounds it has heard, including voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check.

trait.name: Foe-Climber
entries: If the destrachan hits a Huge or larger creature with a claw attack, instead of grappling it climbs on to the creature. While climbing on a creature, the creature has disadvantage on attack rolls that target the destrachan.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The destrachan makes two attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Sawing Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) slashing damage. This attack scores a critical on an 18-20 against a {@condition prone} creature.

action.name: Terrible Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}).

action.name: Destructive Harmonics {@recharge 5}
entries: The destrachan blasts sonic energy in a 20 ft. cone, choosing one of the following effects. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or suffer the chosen effect.

items.name: Flesh
entries: Each creature in the area takes 27 ({@damage 6d8}) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

items.name: Nerves
entries: Each creature in the area falls {@condition prone} and cannot stand on its following turn.

trait.name: Creeping Refuse
entries: Ranged attacks made against the sporocyte from more than 15 feet away are made at disadvantage.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The sporocyte can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Stinging Spines
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Membranous Expansion
entries: The sporocyte fills its internal air sacks, inflating itself and regaining the use of its Spore Gout.
The next attack made against the detrivore before the beginning of its next turn is made at advantage.

reaction.name: Sudden Drop
entries: As a reaction when a creature passes directly beneath the sporocyte, the sporocyte falls from the surface it was climbing on, and the creature must make a {@dc 11} Dexterity saving throw.
On a failed save, the sporocyte grapples the creature (escape {@dc 11}) and takes no fall damage. On a success, the creature moves into the nearest unoccupied space.

reaction.name: Spore Gout (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the sporocyte releases a torrent of spores in a 15 foot cone.
Each nonplant creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage and be infected with {@disease burrow-diver mycosis|ConfC}.

trait.name: Angelic Weapons
entries: The angel's weapons are manifestations of its innate divine magic, and appear only as the angel is attacking with them.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The deva has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Numinous Presence
entries: If the angel has at least 69 HP, a creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the angel must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be unable to take hostile action against the angel until the beginning of its next turn. A creature passes this save automatically if it took damage from the angel since the end of its last turn.

trait.name: Wrathful Presence
entries: If the angel has 68 HP or fewer, a creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the angel must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} of the angel until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a bonus action, the deva may transform into a humanoid or beast, or back into its true form. Its statistics are the same in any form, and it reverts to its true form if it dies. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (the deva's choice).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The deva makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Luminous Mace
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) radiant damage.

action.name: Healing Touch (3/Day)
entries: The deva touches another creature. The target magically regains 20 ({@dice 4d8 + 2}) hit points and is freed from any curse, disease, poison, blindness, or deafness. If the target is a corpse that died in the last 10 days, it is restored to life.

reaction.name: Shielding Wings
entries: As a reaction to an ally being hit with an attack, the deva may move up to half its speed. If it ends this movement within 5 feet of the targeted creature, the creature's AC is increased by 2 (including against the triggering attack) and the deva's AC is decreased by 2 until the end of the deva's next turn.

reaction.name: Radiant Retribution
entries: As a reaction to being hit with an attack, the deva may force the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be forced to expend each unexpended hit die it has, rolling each of them and taking radiant damage equal to the total rolled.

trait.name: Eternal Tide
entries: At the beginning of the devoted's turn, it can return one ghoul or ghast within 60 feet that died since the end of the devoted's last turn to undeath with 1 hit point.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The devoted makes two attacks with its Death's Beckon, one of which it may replace with its Breath of Thanatos, if available.

action.name: Death's Beckon (1st Level Spell)
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 60 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage.

If this damage reduces a humanoid target to 0 hit points, a rift to Thanatos appears in the earth beneath it, disgorging a {@creature horde ghoul|confc|Horde Ghoul} in the nearest unoccupied space that acts on the devoted's initiative and under its control.

action.name: Breath of Thanatos (3rd Level Spell) {@recharge 5}
entries: The ground beneath a creature the devoted can see within 60 feet cracks, spewing forth a hissing jet of putrid fumes.
The creature must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or take 16 ({@dice 3d10}) necrotic plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage, or take half as much on a success.
A creature killed by this damage is dragged through a planar rift to Thanatos.

reaction.name: Beacon of Hunger
entries: When a creature the devoted can see within 60 feet takes any necrotic damage, the devoted can suffuse it in seething negative energies.
Until the beginning of the devoted's next turn, attacks made by undead creatures against the target have advantage.

trait.name: Cruel Mercy
entries: Once on each of its turns when the devoted deals damage to a creature, after dealing damage it can grant the creature temporary hit points equal to the damage dealt.
While a creature has any of these temporary hit points, it is {@condition charmed} by the devoted.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The devoted makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Night's Caress.

action.name: Demonic Lash (2nd Level Spell)
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@dice 2d4}) slashing plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.
A target hit by two or more of these attacks in a turn must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of the devoted's next turn.

action.name: Night's Caress (3rd Level Spell)
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}The target falls asleep for the next minute.
A sleeping creature wakes early if a creature takes an action to shake it awake, or if it takes any damage.

bonus.name: Erode Will
entries: One creature {@condition charmed} by the devoted must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to move up to half its speed and make an attack or cast a cantrip under the devoted's control.

bonus.name: Needling Imperative
entries: The devoted moves up to half its speed, then whispers a command to a {@condition charmed} creature within 5 feet.
For the next minute or until the creature is reduced to 0 hit points, it takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) psychic damage the first time each turn that it disobeys the command.

monster.name: Devoted of the Lord of Beasts

trait.name: Unbridled Fury (2/Day)
entries: If the devoted fails a saving throw while they are not {@condition grappled}, they can choose to succeed instead.
Then, if the devoted is {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell, they may roll a {@dice d6}, regaining a use of this ability on a 5-6.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The devoted makes two attacks with their Spellfury Fist, one of which they may replace with a use of their Awaken Fury, if available.

action.name: Spellfury Fist
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) force damage plus one additional effect of the chosen's choice:

items.name: Bestial Grip
entries: The target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}).

items.name: Impact Vice
entries: The target is pushed up to 10 feet away, then takes an additional 13 ({@damage 3d8}) bludgeoning damage if this movement was stopped by a solid surface.

action.name: Awaken Fury (3rd Level Spell, Concentration) {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature the devoted can see within 60 feet must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or become hostile to all creatures for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn).
A beast or monstrosity makes this saving throw at disadvantage.

bonus.name: Exultation of Blood (2nd Level Spell)
entries: The devoted gains 5 temporary hit points for each creature it hit with an attack this turn. While it has any of these temporary hit points, the devoted's attacks are made at advantage.

trait.name: Strength from Sickness
entries: While it is {@condition poisoned}, the devoted's attacks have advantage instead of disadvantage.

trait.name: Rot-Carrier
entries: A creature that fails a saving throw by 5 or more against an effect the devoted controls cannot benefit from resistance or immunity to poison damage or from immunity to the {@condition poisoned} condition for the next hour.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The devoted makes two attacks with its Cultivator's Touch, each of which it may replace with a use of its Spore Wind.

action.name: Cultivator's Touch
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) poison damage.
A {@condition poisoned} creature hit with this attack becomes {@condition paralyzed} until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Spore Wind
entries: One creature the devoted can see within 60 feet must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 2d12}) poison damage and be {@condition poisoned} until the end of the devoted's next turn.

action.name: Pallid Rooting (4th Level Spell, Concentration) {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature the devoted can see within 60 feet must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn).

Whenever a creature {@condition poisoned} in this way fails a saving throw to end this effect at the end of its turn, it takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) piercing damage and is {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 14}) until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Test of Ambition
entries: If the devoted kills a Chosen of the Spider Queen, it immediately becomes a

trait.name: Kiss of Lolth
entries: The devoted's spells ignore resistance or immunity to poison damage and immunity to the {@condition poisoned} condition.

trait.name: Venomous Dweomer
entries: The first time each turn that a creature fails a saving throw against a spell or magical effect the devoted controls, the devoted can deal 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage to it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The devoted makes two attacks with its Darkfire Bolt, each of which it may replace with a use of its Envenomed Touch.

action.name: Darkfire Bolt (2nd Level Spell)
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 7} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d10}) fire damage, and the target is wreathed in writhing shadows for the next minute.
Whenever the creature is hit with an attack, it takes an additional 3 ({@damage 1d6}) necrotic damage. This effect ends early if the target is illuminated by Bright Light.

action.name: Envenomed Touch (2nd Level Spell)
entries: The devoted touches a creature within 5 feet, dealing 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage to it and forcing it to succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn).

action.name: Lolth's Favor (3rd Level Spell) {@recharge 5}
entries: One willing drow, spiderkind, or demon the devoted can see within 60 feet immediately dies, exploding in a torrent of venomous spiders.
Each creature within 15 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 14 ({@dice 4d6}) piercing plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Corpsechurn Incubator
entries: At the start of the devourer's turn, each creature {@condition restrained} in its Ribcage Embrace takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage. A humanoid creature with at least 5 hit dice that dies while {@condition restrained} in this way rises immediately as an

trait.name: Avatar of Hunger
entries: At the end of the devourer's turn, up to three undead creatures of CR 5 or below that it passed within 5 feet of it on its turn may use their reactions to move up to half their speed toward the nearest creature and make a melee attack.

trait.name: Death's Aid
entries: When the devourer fails a saving throw, it may kill any number of friendly undead creatures of CR 5 or below it can see within 60 feet. It adds +2 to its saving throw for each creature killed in this way.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The devourer makes two melee attacks, one of which it may replace with its Ribcage Embrace, if available.

action.name: Rotclaw Grasp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) slashing damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) necrotic damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}). This attack scores a critical on an 18-20 against a creature with fewer than 50 hit points.

action.name: Ribcage Embrace
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by either the devourer or a ghoul within 5 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) piercing damage and be shoved into the devourer's ribcage and {@condition restrained} there (escape {@dc 18}).
Each other creature {@condition restrained} in the devourer's ribcage may use its reaction to attempt to escape, succeeding automatically if it is undead.

action.name: Raise the Horde {@recharge 5}
entries: Each humanoid corpse within 60 feet of the devourer that has been dead for no longer than 1 year rises as a {@creature horde ghoul|confc|Horde Ghoul} that acts directly after the devourer.

reaction.name: Blasphemous Abrogation
entries: When a creature the devourer can see within 60 feet casts a spell or produces a magical effect with a divine source, the devourer forces that creature to make a {@dc 16} Charisma saving throw.
On a failure, the spell or effect is negated and the creature takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) necrotic damage.

reaction.name: Favored of the Deathlord (1/Day)
entries: When the devourer is reduced below 90 hit points, the devourer may reduce any number of friendly undead it can see within 60 feet to 0 hit points, regaining hit points equal to the total hit points lost in this way.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The dhergoloth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Confusing Anatomy
entries: A creature gains no benefit from flanking the dhergoloth. If the dhergoloth falls {@condition prone}, it must spend its action to stand up.

trait.name: Gyroscopic
entries: If the dhergoloth makes four or more claw attacks in a turn, it has advantage on Strength ({@skill Athletics}) checks until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Venal Nature
entries: The yugoloth is always willing to accept a bribe rather than fight. A dhergoloth will usually accept a rate of its challenge rating times 25 gp, or half as much from a creature proficient in {@skill Intimidation}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dhergoloth makes three flailing claw attacks, plus an additional flailing claw attack for each successive turn it uses this ability, to a maximum of six. If it makes five or more flailing claw attacks in a turn, it also uses its Shriek.

action.name: Flailing Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Shriek
entries: Each creature within 15 feet of the Dhergoloth must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} of it until the end of the Dhergoloth's next turn.

action.name: Teleport (3rd level spell)
entries: The dhergoloth magically teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

reaction.name: Dark Escape
entries: As a reaction to taking 20 or more damage from a single source, the Dhergoloth may shroud itself in a 20 foot radius cloud of magical darkness until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Crystaline Armor
entries: Whenever the xorn takes 15 or more acid or bludgeoning damage from a single source, its AC is reduced by 2, to a minimum of 19, until it completes a Short or Long Rest.

trait.name: Flesh-Sickened
entries: While it has a dead or {@condition unconscious} creature {@condition grappled} in its Dorsal Maw, the xorn is {@condition poisoned}.

trait.name: Treasure Sense
entries: The xorn can pinpoint, by scent, the location of precious or magical metals and stones within 60 feet of it.

trait.name: Earth Glide
entries: The xorn can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone without disturbing the material it moves through.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The xorn makes three attacks with its Scrabbling Claws.

action.name: Scrabbling Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) slashing damage.
A creature hit by two or more of these attacks in a turn must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or drop one object it is carrying.

action.name: Dorsal Maw
entries: The xorn emerges into the space of a creature within 5 feet it is burrowing beneath, forcing it to succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}), or move into the nearest unoccupied space on a success.
A creature {@condition grappled} in this way takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) piercing damage at the beginning of each of the xorn's turns.

bonus.name: Devour Weapon
entries: The xorn eats one weapon within 5 feet of it that isn't worn or carried, gaining 13 ({@dice 3d8}) temporary hit points.
While the xorn has any of these temporary hit points, its attacks deal an additional die of damage and gain any magical effects the weapon had.

bonus.name: Strip Armor
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} in the xorn's Dorsal Maw must make a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw.
On a failed save, one piece of nonmagical metal armor the creature is wearing takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers as part of it is torn away.

reaction.name: Sink into Stone (1/Day)
entries: When the xorn is reduced below 70 hit points, it may move up to half its burrow speed.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The anteater has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Bristle-Tail Shade
entries: The anteater has advantage on saving throws against effects that deal radiant damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The anteater makes two attacks with its Balled Claw Fist.
If the anteater is using its Threatening Pose, it may instead make two attacks with its Earthgouge Claws.

action.name: Balled Claw Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Earthgouge Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) slashing damage.
This attack is made at disadvantage against any creature not {@condition grappled} by the anteater.

action.name: Sticky Tongue Pluck
entries: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or have one item it is carrying that weighs 1 lb or less stolen by the anteater.

action.name: Threatening Pose
entries: The anteater rears on its hind legs and spreads its arms. Until the anteater lowers itself as a bonus action or falls {@condition prone}, its speed is reduced to 0.

reaction.name: Clumsy Tumble
entries: As a reaction when a creature hits the anteater with a melee attack, the anteater forces the creature to reroll the attack, taking the second result, then falls {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Perilous Hug
entries: As a reaction when a creature makes a melee attack against the anteater while the anteater is using its Threatening Pose, the anteater forces the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}).

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The badger has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Ornery
entries: The badger does not die or fall {@condition unconscious} due to dropping to 0 HP if it was attacked by a hostile creature since the end of its previous turn. If the badger starts its turn with 0 HP without having been attacked since the end of its previous turn, it dies.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d6 + 1}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Boneless
entries: The squid can move through a space as narrow as 1 feet wide without squeezing.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The squid makes two attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Poison Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition grappled} target. {@h}13 ({@dice 2d8 + 4}) piercing plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage.
If the target has an exoskeleton or shell, it must succeed on a {@dc 12} Contitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the until the end of the squid's next turn.

action.name: Tentacles
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}). If the squid has only one creature {@condition grappled}, the creature is {@condition restrained}.

reaction.name: Ink Cloud (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 38 hit points while underwater, the squid exudes a 20-foot-radius cloud of ink around itself. The area is heavily obscured for 1 minute, although a significant current can disperse the ink.
As part of this reaction, the squid may move up to half its speed without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

trait.name: Chemoreception
entries: While submerged in a body of water, the crab can detect the presence and location of creatures in that water within 60 ft.

trait.name: Brittle Shell
entries: If the crab takes 10 or more bludgeoning damage from a single source, its AC is reduced to 14 until it completes a short or long rest.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The crab makes two attacks with its claws.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}).

action.name: Crush
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the crab must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or take 17 ({@damage 5d6}) bludgeoning damage and suffer disadvantage on attack rolls that use Strength until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Scuttle
entries: As a reaction to being forced to make a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the crab moves up to half its speed. If this movement puts the crab out of range or area of the spell or magical effect, the crab is unaffected.

trait.name: Psychic Conflict
entries: As a Bonus Action, a telepathic creature may issue a command to the cranium rat, making a contested Intelligence check against it. The creature that fails this check acts under the other's control on its following turn.

trait.name: Psionic Empowerment
entries: As a Bonus Action, the rat gains one of the following benefits until it uses this ability again.

items.name: Mindslice
entries: The rat's melee attacks have a reach of 60 feet and deal psychic damage instead of any other type.

items.name: Cerebral Glow
entries: The rat's exposed brain begins to glow softly, casting dim Light in a 20 foot radius. A creature illuminated by only this glow subtracts {@dice 1d4} from any Wisdom saving throws it makes.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The rat makes two attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Chittering Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be infected with Devouring Cogniphage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) slashing damage.
A creature hit by this attack twice in a turn must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

monster.name: Dire Eagle
languages: understands Common And Auran but can't speak

trait.name: Keen Sight
entries: The eagle has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Dive Attack
entries: If the eagle is flying and dives at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a melee weapon attack, the attack scores a critical on an 19, or 20.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The eagle makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its talons.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) slashing damage. On a critical hit, the target is {@condition blinded} until the end of the eagle's next turn.

trait.name: Ornery
entries: The goat does not die or fall {@condition unconscious} due to dropping to 0 HP if it was attacked by a hostile creature since the end of its previous turn. If the goat starts its turn with 0 HP without having been attacked since the end of its previous turn, it dies.

trait.name: Pushy
entries: If the goat moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a ram attack on the same turn, the target is pushed 10 ft. away. If it is pushed into a wall or other solid surface, the creature takes an additional 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage.

trait.name: Sure-Footed
entries: The goat has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws made against effects that would knock it {@condition prone}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The goat attacks once with its bite and once with its ram.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Ram
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Keen Sight
entries: The hawk has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Air Superiority
entries: If the hawk descended at least 60 ft. this turn, it may {@action Dash} or {@action Disengage} as a Bonus Action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hawk makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its talons.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) slashing damage. If the target is Small or smaller, it is {@condition grappled} and (escape {@dc 14}).

trait.name: Righting Reflex
entries: The cat takes no fall damage if it falls from a height of 30 ft. or greater.

trait.name: Stalking Pounce
entries: If the cat is hidden from each hostile creature, it may {@action Dash} as a Bonus Action. If the cat hits a creature with a claw attack on the same turn, the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage. The cat may make this attack as a Bonus Action against a {@condition prone} target.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage.

reaction.name: Bat Away
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the cat forces the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or have one object it is holding knocked out of its hands and 15 ft. away.

reaction.name: Cruel Jest
entries: As a reaction when a Medium or smaller creature attempts to leave the cat's reach, the cat may force it to make a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or be dragged 5 feet back towards the cat. If the creature fails this save by 5 or more, this ability does not use the cat's reaction.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The lion has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the lion's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Stalking Pounce
entries: If the lion is hidden from each hostile creature, it may {@action Dash} as a Bonus Action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lion makes two melee attacks, one of which may be with its throat-ripper bite.

action.name: Throat-Ripper Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}). A creature already {@condition grappled} by the lion takes an additional 9 ({@damage 2d8}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) slashing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

bonus.name: Daunting Roar {@recharge 5}
entries: As a Bonus Action, the lion lets out a menacing roar. Each hostile creature within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} of the lion until the end of the lion's next turn.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: While out of water, the octopus can hold its breath for 1 hour.

trait.name: Underwater Camouflage
entries: The octopus has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks and {@skill Deception} (Charisma) checks made to impersonate natural terrain or another aquatic creature.

trait.name: Boneless
entries: The octopus can move through a space as narrow as 1 feet wide without squeezing.

action.name: Tentacles
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}). If the octopus has only one creature {@condition grappled}, the creature is {@condition restrained}.

action.name: Fling
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the octopus is thrown up to 20 feet. If a thrown target strikes a solid surface, the target takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage.

action.name: Blanket (underwater only) {@recharge}
entries: Each creature in a 10 ft. radius sphere must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition grappled} and pulled up to 5 ft. toward the octopus. A creature without a swim speed makes this save at disadvantage.

reaction.name: Ink Cloud (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 26 hit points while underwater, the octopus exudes a 20-foot-radius cloud of ink around itself. The area is heavily obscured for 1 minute, although a significant current can disperse the ink. After releasing the ink, the octopus can use the {@action Dash} or {@action Hide} action as a bonus action.

trait.name: Keen Sight
entries: The owl has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Raking Flyby
entries: The owl does not provoke {@action opportunity attack||Opportunity Attacks} from creatures that it started its turn hidden from.

trait.name: Silent Flight
entries: While flying in dim light or darkness, the owl can take the {@action Hide} action as a Bonus Action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The owl makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its talons.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) slashing damage. On a critical hit, the target is {@condition grappled} and {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 13}).

trait.name: Sleek Coat Insulation
entries: While the platypus has more than half of his hit points, it has resistance to cold and fire damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The platypus makes two different melee attacks.

action.name: Bill Snap
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Leg Hook
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}).

action.name: Paddle-Tail Smack
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d8 + 2}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

reaction.name: Crural Spur {@recharge 5}
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack by a creature it has {@condition grappled}, the platypus forces the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} until the beginning of the attacker's next turn.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The raccoon has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Rabid
entries: The raccoon has advantage on Charisma ({@skill Deception}) checks made to appear friendly. It may add its {@skill Deception} bonus to Initiative rolls.

trait.name: Nosy
entries: The racoon may use its natural weapons as Thieves Tools, and is considered proficient with them.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The raccoon makes two claw attacks. If both attacks hit the same Medium or smaller target, the target is knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d12 + 3}) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or be infected with {@disease lyssavirus|ConfC}.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) slashing damage.

reaction.name: Bat Away
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the racoon forces the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or have one object it is holding knocked out of its hands and 15 ft. away.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The rat has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Quick Squeeze
entries: The rat may move through any space larger than its skull without squeezing.

trait.name: Gnaw Through
entries: The rat can burrow a small hole through one foot of nonmagical wood in ten minutes, or through one foot of stone or soft metal in one hour.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The rat has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the rat's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The rat makes two claw attacks. If both attacks hit the same target, the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or be infected with {@disease filth fever|ConfC}.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) slashing damage.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The toad can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The toad's long jump is up to 10 ft. and its high jump is up to 5 ft., with or without a running start.

trait.name: Poisonous
entries: A creature that hits the toad with a melee attack using Natural Weapons takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) poison damage. If this damage reduces the toad to 0 hit points, the attacker must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d10 + 2}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the toad can't bite another target.

action.name: Tongue
entries: One Large or smaller creature within 20 ft must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 15 ft towards the toad, which can use a bonus action to make a bite attack against it.

action.name: Swallow
entries: The toad makes one bite attack against a Medium or smaller target it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. The swallowed target is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the frog, and it takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) acid damage at the start of each of the frog's turns. The frog can have only one target swallowed at a time. If the frog dies, a swallowed creature is no longer {@condition restrained} by it and can escape from the corpse using 5 feet of movement, exiting {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Double Actions
entries: The troll rolls initiative twice, and acts on each of them.

trait.name: Troll Healing
entries: The troll regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the troll takes 10 or more acid or fire damage from a single source, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Rapid Budding
entries: When the troll suffers a critical hit that does not deal fire or acid damage, one of its limbs is severed, giving it disadvantage on attack rolls and Dexterity saving throws.

At the end of each of its turns, the troll makes a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw. On a success, this condition ends, and the severed piece grows into a {@creature troll budling|confc|Troll Budling}. The severed limb is destroyed if it takes acid or fire damage.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the troll may spend half of its movement to attempt a {@dc 19} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the troll. While climbing on the troll, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the troll, and the troll has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The troll makes two attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) piercing damage. This attack deals an additional 9 ({@damage 2d8}) damage to a {@condition prone} creature.

action.name: Claw Bash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d6 + 6}) slashing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away and knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Reckless Whirlwind {@recharge}
entries: Each creature climbing on the troll must succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or fall off, then each creature within 10 feet of the troll that is not climbing on it must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or take 33 ({@damage 6d10}) slashing damage and be knocked {@condition prone}. Until the beginning of its next turn, attacks that target the troll are made at advantage.

reaction.name: Secret Arm
entries: As a reaction when a creature attempts to leave its reach, the troll extends a hidden arm from one of its mouths. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition grappled} until the beginning of the troll's next turn.

trait.name: Inflexible
entries: The turtle cannot attack a creature that is grappling or riding it.

trait.name: Retract Head
entries: As a Bonus Action, the turtle may retract its limbs and head into its shell and end its turn. Until the beginning of its next turn, the tortoise's AC is increased to 19 and it can't take reactions.

trait.name: Cold Blooded
entries: If the turtle takes any cold damage, its speed is reduced by 10 until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Clamping Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}).
A creature that attempts to escape this grapple takes 5 ({@damage 2d4}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Snap
entries: As a reaction when a creature fails an attempt to grapple it, the turtle makes a Clamping Bite attack against the creature.

trait.name: Web-Dweller
entries: The widow can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty.
While in contact with a web, the widow knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

action.name: Paralyzing Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}7 ({@dice 1d8 + 3}) piercing plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) poison damage.

A creature reduced to 0 hit points in this way stabilizes automatically, and becomes {@condition poisoned} for the next hour. While {@condition poisoned} in this way, a creature is {@condition paralyzed}.

action.name: Grasping Legs
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}).

action.name: Tangleweb Launch {@recharge 5}
entries: The widow launches webbing in a 10 foot radius centered on a point it can see within 60 feet.

Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 13}). The webbing can be destroyed (AC 10; 5 HP; vulnerability to fire damage; immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage).

bonus.name: Web Bind
entries: The widow attempts to wrap a {@condition grappled} or {@condition prone} creature within 5 feet in webbing, forcing it to succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 13}).
If the target is Medium or smaller, the widow can attach the creature to its back as part of this action.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The wolf has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The wolf has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the wolf's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Predatory Bearing
entries: A creature that starts its turn with no adjacent allies and that can see the wolf must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) piercing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the wolf can grapple the target (escape {@dc 13}). If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Worry
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by both the wolf and at least one of the wolf's allies must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or take 24 ({@damage 7d6}) piercing damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Pounce
entries: If the worg moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. If the target is {@condition prone}, the worg can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

trait.name: Baying Pack
entries: A group of two or more worgs has disadvantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks.

trait.name: Predatory Bearing
entries: A creature that starts its turn with no adjacent allies and that can see the worg must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The worg makes two claw attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the worg can grapple the target (escape {@dc 14}).

action.name: Worry
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by both the worg and at least one of the worg's allies must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or take 35 ({@damage 10d6}) piercing damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Deflection Cone
entries: The director's central eye creates an area of telekinetic deflection. A creature that makes a ranged attack that passes through the cone subtracts {@dice 1d4} from its attack roll.

trait.name: Eyestalks
entries: When the director is dealt a critical hit, the director must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or lose the use of an eye ray of the attacker's choice that it has seen the director use.

trait.name: Vermin Master
entries: While attached to a creature, the director moves with the attached creature, and acts on the attached creature's initiative, instead of its own.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The director makes two melee attacks, one of which may be with its bite, or uses two of its its eye rays, chosen at random (reroll duplicates).

action.name: Vicious Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Verminbond Barbs
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the director attaches itself to the target (escape {@dc 15}). The director may attach itself to only a single creature at a time.

At the beginning of each of its turns, a creature the director is attached to must make a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature acts under the director's control until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Eye Rays
entries: The director shoots one of its eye rays, choosing a target it can see within 120 ft.:

items.name: 1. Searing Ray
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) fire damage.

items.name: 2. Rotting Ray
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 4d10}) necrotic damage, plus an additional 11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage if it has fewer than half its hit points.

items.name: 3. Freezing Ray
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) cold damage and have its speed reduced by 5 ft. until the end of its next turn.

items.name: 4. Shocking Ray
entries: The target and each other creature within 5 ft. of it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 19 ({@damage 3d12}) lightning damage.

items.name: 5. Dimensional Lock Ray
entries: The targeted creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 16 ({@damage 3d10}) force damage. Whenever the creature teleports before the end of the director's next turn, it takes an additional 16 ({@damage 3d10}) force damage.

items.name: 6. Translocation Ray
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw or be teleported up to 30 ft. to an unoccupied space the director can see.

reaction.name: Bleed for Your Master
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with an attack, the director forces its mount to succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or become the new target of the attack.

trait.name: Magic Sense
entries: The disenchanter can pinpoint, by scent, the location of each magic item and active spell within 60 feet of it.

trait.name: Swaying Stride
entries: If the disenchanter moves at least 30 ft. in a straight line on its turn, it may {@action Dodge} as a Bonus Action this turn.

trait.name: Translucent Scales
entries: Attacks that deal radiant damage are made at advantage against the disenchanter.

action.name: Plodding Stomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d10 + 4}) bludgeoning damage. A {@condition prone} creature takes an additional 11 ({@damage 2d10}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Tail Club
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}26 ({@damage 5d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.
A creature that fails by 5 or more cannot stand or breathe until the end of the disenchanter's next turn.

action.name: Prehensile Tongue
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target creature or object. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}), and each spell affecting the target ends. Spells cast by a creature {@condition grappled} in this way fail.

action.name: Disenchant
entries: The disenchanter begins to consume the magic of one magic item of Very Rare or lesser quality that is held by the disenchanter or a creature it has {@condition grappled}. If the disenchanter is still holding the object or creature at the beginning of its next turn, the item is destroyed.

trait.name: Canopy Stalker
entries: The coeurl has advantage on checks made to hide from creatures whose eyeline it is above.

trait.name: Teleportation Weakness
entries: The coeurl takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) psychic damage whenever a creature teleports within 30 feet of it

trait.name: Feline Fluidity
entries: The coeurl can squeeze through any space larger than its skull.

trait.name: Displacement
entries: While the coeurl is not {@condition grappled} or {@condition incapacitated} and it has not been hit with an attack since the end of its last turn, it has the following effects:
Attacks against it are made at disadvantage.
When making a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the coeurl treats any unmodified roll of a 11-20 as a success, and takes no damage on a successful save.

trait.name: Legendary Resistances (2/Day)
entries: If the coeurl fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The coeurl makes four attacks, one of which may be with its Spinal Bite.

action.name: Spinal Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d8 + 4}) piercing damage.
Any hit with this attack against a target that is both {@condition prone} and {@condition grappled} becomes a critical.

action.name: Hexapod Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage.
A target hit with two or more of these attacks in a turn is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}).

action.name: Tendril Pads
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or have one melee weapon it is wielding wrenched from its grasp.
If the coeurl is wielding weapons in both its tentacles, it can't use this attack.

action.name: Displacement Expansion (1/Day, Concentration)
entries: The coeurl's eyes flash with green light as it warps the light around it, creating several shifting, warped duplicates of each creature and object in the area.
For the next minute, creatures within 30 feet of the coeurl that rely on sight have disadvantage on checks and saving throws that use Wisdom.
A creature that attempts to move into or through the area for the first time on a turn must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

bonus.name: Stolen Weapon
entries: The coeurl makes an attack with a stolen weapon wielded in its tentacles, using the weapon's statistics ({@hit 9} to hit, +4 to damage).

bonus.name: Terrorize
entries: The coeurl reveals itself to any number of creatures it can see within 30 feet that it is hidden from.
Each of those creatures must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of the coeurl's next turn.

bonus.name: Devour Id
entries: One {@condition frightened} or {@condition unconscious} creature within 5 feet of the coeurl must succeed on a {@dc 15} Intelligence saving throw or take 27 ({@damage 6d8}) psychic damage and gain immunity to the {@condition frightened} condition for the next minute.

reaction.name: Slinking Retreat
entries: As a reaction to a creature ending its movement within 5 feet of the coeurl, the coeurl moves up to half its speed without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

legendary.name: Lithe Pounce
entries: The coeurl leaps up to 20 feet, then may force one creature within 5 feet of it to succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

legendary.name: Shadowy Vault
entries: The coeurl leaps up to 20 feet. If it ends this movement in dim light or darkness, it may immediately attempt to hide, and may do so without obscurement.

legendary.name: False Retreat
entries: The coeurl magically produces an illusion of it leaping up to 20, then makes an attack with its Hexapod Claws against a creature in range, or two attacks if the target attempted to make an {@action opportunity attack||attack of opportunity} against the illusion.

trait.name: Canopy Stalker
entries: The kitten has advantage on checks made to hide from creatures whose eyeline it is above.

trait.name: Teleportation Weakness
entries: The displacer beast is {@condition stunned} until the end of it is next turn whenever a creature teleports within 30 feet of it.

trait.name: Minor Displacement
entries: The kitten magically disrupts the light around it, making it appear slightly blurry.
Checks to determine what the kitten is carrying in its mouth or tentacles are made at disadvantage.

action.name: Hexapod Biscuits
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 10 ft., one {@condition prone} or willing target. {@h}10 ({@damage 3d6}) piercing damage.

action.name: Tendril Pad Swipe
entries: One creature the kitten can see within 5 feet must succeed on a {@dc 11} Dexterity saving throw or have one object weighing 1 pound or less that it is carrying stolen by the kitten.

action.name: Distracting Blink
entries: The kitten affixes its gaze on a creature it can see within 15 feet and slowly blinks.
The creature must succeed on a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw or be unable to take reactions until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Strained Displacement
entries: As a reaction when the kitten is hit with an {@action opportunity attack||attack of opportunity}, it causes the attack to miss then falls {@condition unconscious} until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Canopy Stalker
entries: The displacer beast has advantage on checks made to hide from creatures whose eyeline it is above.

trait.name: Teleportation Weakness
entries: The displacer beast takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) psychic damage whenever a creature teleports within 30 feet of it.

trait.name: Displacement
entries: While the displacer beast is not {@condition grappled} or {@condition incapacitated} and it has not been hit with an attack since the end of its last turn, it has the following effects:
Attacks against it are made at disadvantage.
When making a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the displacer beast treats any unmodified roll of a 11-20 as a success, and takes no damage on a successful save.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The displacer beast makes four attacks, one of which may be with its Spinal Bite.

Any hit with this attack against a target that is both {@condition prone} and {@condition grappled} becomes a critical.

action.name: Hexapod Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) slashing damage.
A {@condition prone} target hit with two or more of these attacks in a turn is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}).

action.name: Tendril Pads
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) piercing damage.

bonus.name: Shadow Stealth
entries: If the displacer beast is in dim light or darkness, it attempts to {@action Hide}.

bonus.name: Lithe Pounce
entries: The displacer beast leaps up to 15 feet, then may force one creature within 5 feet of it to succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Slinking Retreat
entries: As a reaction to a creature ending its movement within 5 feet of the displacer beast, the displacer beast moves up to half its speed without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

entries: The displacer beast has advantage on checks made to hide from creatures whose eyeline it is above.
