entries: The displacer beast takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) psychic damage whenever a creature teleports within 30 feet of it.

trait.name: Displacement
entries: While the displacer beast is not {@condition grappled} or {@condition incapacitated} and it has not been hit with an attack since the end of its last turn, it has the following effects:
Attacks against it are made at disadvantage.
When making a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the displacer beast treats any unmodified roll of a 11-20 as a success, and takes no damage on a successful save.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The displacer beast makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Spinal Bite.

action.name: Spinal Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage.
Any hit with this attack against a target that is both {@condition prone} and {@condition grappled} becomes a critical.

action.name: Hexapod Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) slashing damage.
A {@condition prone} target hit with two or more of these attacks in a turn is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}).

action.name: Tendril Pads
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) piercing damage.

bonus.name: Shadow Stealth
entries: If the displacer beast is in dim light or darkness, it attempts to {@action Hide}.

bonus.name: Lithe Pounce
entries: The displacer beast leaps up to 15 feet, then may force one creature within 5 feet of it to succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Capricious Jest
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the dragon and attempts to move must first make a {@dc 12} Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, the dragon controls its movement this turn.

trait.name: Displacement
entries: The dragon has an illusory double that mirrors its movements imperfectly, causing attack rolls against it to have disadvantage. If it is hit by an attack, this trait is disrupted until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes two attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d10 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Tendril
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Derealization Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon exhales an shimmering aurora of existential crises in a 15 ft cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw, taking 21 ({@damage 6d6}) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more becomes convinced that it is an illusion. An affected creature cannot concentrate on spells, loses {@status concentration} if it was holding it, and makes a {@dc 12} Intelligence saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A creature that targets itself with an attack or spell immediately ends this effect.

reaction.name: Slink
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack, the dragon moves up to half its speed without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

trait.name: Elemental Demise
entries: If the djinni dies, its body disintegrates into a warm breeze, leaving behind only equipment the djinni was wearing or carrying.

trait.name: Turbulent Currents
entries: Ranged attacks against the djinni from more than 30 ft. away are made at disadvantage.

trait.name: Whirlwind
entries: The djinni is surrounded by a 5 foot radius whirlwind that extends thirty feet below and above it. When a creature starts its turn in the area, the djinni may force it to make a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or be carried aloft, rising up to 30 feet. While floating in this way, the creature is {@condition restrained} and moves with the whirlwind. A creature may repeat this save as an action, escaping the whirlwind on a success.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The djinni makes three scimitar attacks and uses its airburst.

action.name: Scimitar
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) thunder damage.

action.name: Airburst
entries: Each creature in the djinni's whirlwind must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) thunder damage and be pushed 10 feet in a direction of the djinn's choice.

reaction.name: Gaseous Essence
entries: As a reaction to being hit with an attack, the djinni halves the attack's damage.

trait.name: Evasion
entries: If the dolgaunt is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the dolgaunt instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails. It can't use this trait if it's {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Coordinated Advance
entries: The dolgaunt acts on initiative count 10, instead of rolling initiative. Creatures with this trait share a turn, taking their actions and movement in any order.

trait.name: Drillmaster
entries: Friendly hobgoblins within 30 feet of the dolgaunt use its attack bonus, rather than their own.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dolgaunt makes four melee attacks.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}). The dolgaunt has two tentacles that can each grapple a single target.

action.name: Unarmed Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) bludgeoning damage. On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned}.

action.name: Vitality Leech
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by a tentacle of the dolgaunt must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or have its Constitution score reduced by {@dice 1d6} for the next minute. The dolgaunt gains 5 temporary hit points for each point the creature's Constitution was reduced by.

trait.name: Two Heads
entries: The dolgrim has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks and on saving throws against being {@condition blinded}, {@condition charmed}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition frightened}, {@condition stunned}, and knocked {@condition unconscious}.

trait.name: Double Actions
entries: The dolgrim rolls initiative twice, and acts on each of them.

trait.name: Nimble Escape
entries: The dolgrim can take the {@action Disengage} or {@action Hide} action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

action.name: Mace
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Flail {@recharge}
entries: The dolgrim makes three weapon attacks at disadvantage.

reaction.name: Slippery
entries: If an attack misses the dolgrim, it can move up to 5 feet as a reaction without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

trait.name: Keen Hearing
entries: The bat has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing.

trait.name: Light-Averse
entries: The bat has disadvantage on attacks targeting any creature carrying a source of Bright Light.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bat makes two attacks with its Barbtail Lash, one of which it may replace with a use of its Bite or its Echolocation.

action.name: Vicious Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage. This attack scores a critical on a 19-20.

action.name: Barbtail Lash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Echolocation
entries: If the bat is not {@condition deafened}, it gains one of the following benefits until the end of its next turn:

items.name: Low Frequency
entries: The bat gains {@sense Blindsight} to a range of 60 feet.

items.name: High Frequency
entries: The bat has advantage on melee attack rolls. Whenever the bat uses its Chaotic Swerve and the triggering attack misses it, the bat regains its reaction.

items.name: Sonic Assault
entries: At the end of the bat's turn, each nonbat creature within 30 feet that can hear it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition deafened} until the end of the bat's next turn and lose {@status concentration}, if it was {@status concentration||concentrating}.

reaction.name: Chaotic Swerve
entries: As a reaction when the bat is targeted with an attack, it may move 10 feet directly toward the nearest creature that is not riding it and impose disadvantage on the attack roll.

Then, if one or more creatures that are not riding it are within 5 feet of the bat, the bat and each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

monster.name: Doomsphere
languages: The languages it knew in life

trait.name: Spirit Levitation Cone
entries: The doomsphere's central eye creates an area of spirit levitation in a 150-foot cone. A creature that starts its turn in the area is wreathed in luminous vapors, and must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be levitated 5 ft. off the ground. At the start of each of its turns, the doomsphere decides which way the cone faces and whether the cone is active.

trait.name: Ethereal Sight
entries: The doomsphere can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The doomsphere can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Spectral Weapons
entries: The doomsphere's attacks treat all creatures as unarmored (an unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier.)

trait.name: Turn Resistance
entries: The doomsphere has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}24 ({@damage 4d10 + 2}) psychic damage and the creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw or age a number of years equal to the damage taken.

action.name: Eye Rays
entries: The doomsphere shoots two of the following magical eye rays at random, choosing one target it can see within 120 ft. of it:

items.name: 1. Etherealness Ray (Concentration)
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Charisma saving throw or be shunted into the Ethereal plane. An unwilling creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, returning to the space it left, or the nearest unoccupied space, on a success.

items.name: 2. Grave Chill Ray
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 27 ({@damage 6d8}) cold damage and be unaffected by magical healing until the end of the doomsphere's next turn.

items.name: 3. Necrotic Suffusion Ray
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 33 ({@damage 6d10}) necrotic damage and lose one unexpended hit die, if it can. A corpse targeted with this ray rises as a Wight at the beginning of the doomsphere's next turn.

items.name: 4. Killing Thought Ray
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the target is {@condition frightened} for the next minute. A {@condition frightened} creature repeats this saving throw at the beginning of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success, or using its reaction to make a melee attack against itself on a failure.

items.name: 5. Boneshatter Ray
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or have one of its bones break. Until the target completes a long rest, it takes 10 ({@damage 2d6}) slashing damage whenever it moves more than half of its speed in a turn, and whenever it makes more than a single attack in a turn.

items.name: 6. Possession Ray
entries: The target must make a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the target is possessed by the doomsphere for the next minute. The doomsphere disappears into the creature and controls it for the duration. A possessed creature repeats this save whenever it takes damage, ending the effect on a success.

reaction.name: Drifting Apparition
entries: When the doomsphere is hit with a melee attack, it can move up to half its speed without provoking {@action opportunity attack||opportunity attacks}.

reaction.name: Eternal Malice (1/Day)
entries: When the doomsphere is reduced below 87 hit points, it can use its Possession Ray.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The doppelganger can use its action to polymorph into a Small or Medium humanoid it has seen, or back into its true form. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Ambusher
entries: The doppelganger has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has surprised.

trait.name: Surprise Attack
entries: If the doppelganger surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 10 ({@damage 3d6}) damage from the attack.

trait.name: Mind Reader
entries: The doppelganger can magically read the surface thoughts of creatures within 60 feet of it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The doppelganger makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

reaction.name: Uncanny Mimicry
entries: As a reaction to seeing a creature taking an action, the doppelganger may memorize that action. On its next turn, it may take that action. If the action included a weapon, the doppelganger grows an appendage to mimic it. If the action was to cast a spell, the doppelganger cast it innately without a spell slot, using the mimicked creature's attack bonus and save DC.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The doppelganger can use its action to polymorph into a Small or Medium humanoid it has seen, or back into its true form. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Ambusher
entries: The doppelganger has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has surprised.

trait.name: Exploit Weakness
entries: Attack rolls the doppelganger makes with advantage deal an extra 10 ({@damage 3d6}) damage.

trait.name: Mind Reader
entries: The doppelganger can magically read the surface thoughts of creatures within 60 feet of it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The doppelganger makes two slam attacks and uses its perfect replica ability.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Perfect Replica
entries: A creature within 5 feet of the doppelganger must make a {@dc 15} Constitution Saving Throw. On a failure, the creature is {@condition stunned} until the end of the doppelganger's next turn, and the doppleganger takes on its appearance. While the doppelganger is adjacent to a {@condition stunned} creature whose appearance it is mimicking, attack rolls directed at it have a 50% chance of hitting the copied creature instead. A creature that fails this save becomes immune to the effect for 24 hours.

action.name: Cloud Mind (concentration)
entries: The doppelganger becomes {@condition invisible} to creatures within 15 feet of it for the next hour, or until it makes an attack or casts a spell.

reaction.name: Uncanny Mimicry
entries: As a reaction to seeing a creature taking an action, the doppleganger may memorize that action. On its next turn, it may take that action. If the action included a weapon, the doppleganger grows an appendage to mimic it. If the action was to cast a spell, the doppleganger can cast it innately without a spell slot, using the mimicked creature's attack bonus and save DC.

trait.name: Candifying Gaze
entries: When a creature that can see Dr. Blongata's eyes starts its turn within 30 feet of her, she can force it to succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or gain 10 temporary hit points as crystalline candy begins to grow over its skin. While it has any of these temporary hit points, a creature is {@condition restrained}.
Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn, treating Dr. Blongata as {@condition invisible} until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Soluble Form
entries: If Dr. Blongata is doused in at least one gallon of water, she takes 5 ({@damage 2d4}) acid damage at the beginning of each of her turns until a creature brushes the water off as an action.

trait.name: Researcher's Resistance (1/Day)
entries: If Dr. Blongata fails a saving throw while within 15 feet of one of her experimental candy tanks, she may choose to succeed instead. If she does, the tank is damaged and immediately releases its contents.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Dr. Blongata makes two attacks with her Taffy Garotte or Lollipop Shurikens, one of which she may replace with a use of her Sugarshift Seal.

action.name: Taffy Garotte
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage.
On a critical hit, the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}). While {@condition grappled} in this way, a creature cannot speak or breathe.

action.name: Lollipop Shurikens
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 7} to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Sugarsift Seal
entries: Dr. Blongata sprinkles a dusting of magic sugar on a creature within 5 feet that has any temporary hit points from her Candifying Gaze, causing the rock candy encrusting the creature to expand.
The creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition petrified} for as long as it has any of those temporary hit points.

action.name: Gummysnake Bite Flurry {@recharge 5}
entries: Dr. Blongata lashes out at a creature within 5 feet with her gummysnake hair, injecting intolerably sour venom. The creature must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw.
On a failure, the creature takes 26 ({@damage 8d8}) acid damage and its mouth puckers up, making it unable to speak until the end of Dr. Blongata's next turn.
On a successful saving throw, a creature takes half as much damage and suffers no other effects.

reaction.name: Compel Gaze
entries: When a creature that is averting its eyes misses Dr. Blongata with a melee attack, she can force it to stop averting its eyes and immediately make a saving throw against her Candifying Gaze.

legendary.name: Sucker Hail
entries: Dr. Blongata makes up to three attacks with her Lollipop Shurikens, each of which must target a different creature.

legendary.name: Cutthroat Shift
entries: Dr. Blongata moves up to half her speed. Then, if each hostile creature within 30 feet of her is averting its gaze, she may attempt to hide.

legendary.name: Release Experiment
entries: Dr. Blongata magically activates the emergency release valve on an experimental candy tank she can see within 30 feet, releasing its contents immediately.

legendary.name: Experimental Candy Tanks
entries: As an action, a creature within 5 feet of a tank may activate its emergency release valve, releasing its contents in a 15 foot radius.

items.name: Shrinking Syrup
entries: A creature that starts its turn in the area or enters it for the first time on a turn must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or shrink to size Tiny until the end of its next turn. While shrunken, the creature's melee, ranged, and spell attacks deal half as much damage.

items.name: Explosion-Flavored Gumballs
entries: The area becomes difficult terrain. For each 5 feet a creature moves through the area, it takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) thunder damage as gumballs pop explosively beneath its feet.

items.name: Ultramint Sports Drink
entries: This ice-blue sports drink boils away nearly-instantaneously on contact with the air, leaving a painfully minty scent behind. When the area appears, each creature in it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) cold damage, or half as much on a success.

items.name: Bloodvine Licorice
entries: Questing tendrils of crimson licorice emerge from the tank's vents, lashing about. A creature that starts its turn in the area or enters it for the first time on a turn must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.

items.name: Self-Marshing Mallow
entries: A rapidly expanding pillow of white marshmallow inflates. Each creature in the area is pushed up to 20 feet away. A creature pushed into a solid surface in this way takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) bludgeoning damage.

monster.name: Dracohydra
languages: understands draconic but can't speak it

trait.name: Multiple Heads
entries: The dracohydra has five heads. While it has more than one head, the dracohydra has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition blinded}, {@condition charmed}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition frightened}, {@condition stunned}, and knocked {@condition unconscious}.

Whenever the dracohydra takes 25 or more damage in a single turn, one of its heads dies. If all its heads die, the dracohydra dies. A creature can attempt to avoid harming the heads, bypassing this trait. If it does, the dracohydra has resistance to any damage it deals.

At the beginning of its turn, the dracohydra makes a {@dc 13} Constitution save for each head that died since the beginning of its last turn. On a success, it grows two new heads. It makes one of these saving throws at disadvantage for each source of fire damage it took since its last turn. The dracohydra regains 10 hit points for each head regrown in this way.

trait.name: Reactive Heads
entries: For each head the dracohydra has beyond one, it gets an extra reaction that can be used only for {@action opportunity attack||opportunity attacks}.

trait.name: Wakeful
entries: While the dracohydra sleeps, at least one of its heads is awake.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dracohydra makes as many bite attacks as it has heads. If it is grappling a creature at the start of its turn, it may replace one of its bite attacks with a swallow.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d10 + 5}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}). While a head grapples a target, the head can attack only that target.

action.name: Swallow
entries: The dracohydra makes one bite attack against a Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, that creature takes the bite's damage and is swallowed, and the grapple ends.

While swallowed, the creature is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained} in the dracohydra's craw, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the dracohydra, and it takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) acid damage at the start of each of the dracohydra's turns. One swallowed creature is freed whenever the hydra loses a head.

action.name: Worry
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by at least two of the dracohydra's heads must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution throw or take 66 ({@damage 12d10}) piercing damage, or half as much on a success. A creature makes this save at disadvantage if it is {@condition grappled} by three or more heads.

action.name: Prismatic Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dracohydra exhales elemental energy in a number of 60-foot long, 5-foot wide lines equal to the number of heads that it has. Each creature in one or more lines must make a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw.

On a failed save, the creature takes 28 ({@damage 8d6}) damage of a type chosen by the dracohydra; acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison; plus an additional 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage of another type for each line it is in beyond the first. On a success, a creature takes half as much damage.

reaction.name: Shed Head
entries: As a reaction when the dracohydra fails a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the dracohydra may choose to succeed. If it does, one of its heads dies and tears away from the main body.

trait.name: Butting Rush
entries: If the dracorex moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target, attacks it makes against that target this turn are at advantage.

action.name: Flank Ram
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) slashing damage. If this attack was made at advantage, it deals an additional 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage.

action.name: Bully Charge {@recharge}
entries: The dracorex attempts to shove a creature. If it succeeds, it may make another shove attempt against the same target, and continue doing so until it fails or runs out of movement. The target then takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) damage for each 5 feet it was pushed.

trait.name: Web-Dweller
entries: The draegloth can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty.
While in contact with a web, the draegloth knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

trait.name: Brutal Grace
entries: If the draegloth takes the {@action Dash} or {@action Dodge} action, until the end of the turn it may make a melee attack against any creature that makes an {@action opportunity attack} against it.

trait.name: Light-Enraged
entries: The first attack the draegloth makes each turn while in Bright Light has advantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The draegloth makes four attacks with its Savage Claws, one of which it may replace with a use of its Flaying Scream or Snap Limb, if available.

action.name: Savage Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d10 + 6}) slashing damage.
If this attack was made with advantage, the target suffers one additional effect:
The target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 18}).
The target is pushed 10 feet away.
The target is knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Snap Limb {@recharge 4}
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition grappled} creature. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and the target must make a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw.
On a failed save, the creature takes an additional 18 ({@damage 4d8}) bludgeoning damage and loses the use of a limb of its choice until it completes a Long Rest.

action.name: Flaying Scream (3rd Level Spell)
entries: The draegloth's eyes blaze with abyssal flame as it holds a {@condition grappled} creature aloft and screams at it.

Each light the creature is carrying is doused, then the creature must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or take 10 ({@dice 3d6}) fire plus 27 ({@damage 6d8}) thunder damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature killed by this damage has its skin peeled off and blown away in a spray of gore.

action.name: Maddening Shadows (4th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: Whispering darkness boils forth in a 20 foot radius from a point the draegloth can see within 60 feet, extinguishing all lights in the area.

A creature other than the draegloth that starts its turn in the area must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) psychic damage and be {@condition frightened} until the beginning of its next turn.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more falls {@condition prone}, additionally.

bonus.name: Web Grab
entries: One creature the draegloth can see within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or be dragged up to 30 feet toward the draegloth.

bonus.name: Exultation of Blood (2nd Level Spell)
entries: The draegloth gains 5 temporary hit points for each creature it hit with an attack this turn. While it has any of these temporary hit points, the draegloth's attacks have advantage.

trait.name: Brutal Grace
entries: If the draegloth takes the {@action Dash} or {@action Dodge} action, until the end of the turn it may make a melee attack against any creature that makes an {@action opportunity attack} against it.

trait.name: Light-Enraged
entries: The first attack the draegloth makes each turn while in Bright Light has advantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The draegloth makes three attacks with its Savage Claws.

action.name: Savage Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) slashing damage.
If this attack was made with advantage, the target suffers one additional effect:
The target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}).
The target is pushed 5 feet away.
The target is knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Glyph of Light's Bane (2nd Level Spell)
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the draegloth must succeed on a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage and be {@condition cursed|confc|cursed} for the next minute.
While cursed in this way, the creature takes 7 ({@dice 2d6}) fire plus 5 ({@damage 1d10}) necrotic damage whenever it ends its turn illuminated by Bright Light

action.name: Flaying Scream (3rd Level Spell) {@recharge 5}
entries: The draegloth's eyes blaze with abyssal flame as it holds a {@condition grappled} creature aloft and screams at it.

Each light the creature is carrying is doused, then the creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 10 ({@dice 3d6}) fire plus 27 ({@damage 6d8}) thunder damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature killed by this damage has its skin peeled off and blown away in a spray of gore.

trait.name: Bolting Reflex
entries: When initiative is rolled, the horse may move up to half its speed away from the nearest enemy without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.
A creature riding the horse may attempt a {@dc 14} Wisdom ({@skill Animal Handling}) check to instead control the direction of this movement, with disadvantage if the horse has taken any damage.

trait.name: Docile
entries: If the horse has all of its hit points, its attacks are made at disadvantage.

action.name: Hooves
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 ft. away.

reaction.name: Quick Kick
entries: When a creature makes an attack against the horse that benefits from flanking it, the horse can make an Hooves attack against the attacker.

trait.name: Slender Body
entries: The dragon eel may move through any space large enough for a Large creature without squeezing.

trait.name: Surface Nerves
entries: If the dragon eel takes 30 or more bludgeoning damage in a turn, it is {@condition stunned} until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Gargantuan Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the dragon eel may spend its full movement to attempt a {@dc 20} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the dragon eel. While climbing on the dragon eel, a creature has advantage on melee attacks made against it.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the dragon eel fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon eel makes three wriggling ram attacks, one of which it may replace with its gulping bite or stunning shock.

action.name: Massive Gulp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}26 ({@damage 3d12 + 7}) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw or be swallowed.

While swallowed, the target's attacks bypass the dragon eel's resistances and it takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the dragon eel's turns. If the dragon eel takes 50 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the dragon eel regurgitates all swallowed creatures, which fall {@condition prone} in the nearest unoccupied space.

action.name: Wriggling Ram
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d6 + 7}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 10 ft. away. Before or after making this attack, the dragon eel may move up to a quarter of its speed.

action.name: Stunning Shock
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}27 ({@damage 6d8}) lightning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Broadcast Current (underwater only) {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon eel briefly electrifies the water in a 20 ft. radius around itself. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw, taking 36 ({@damage 8d8}) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of the dragon eel's next turn.

reaction.name: Thrash
entries: As a reaction to failing a saving throw, the dragon eel forces each creature within 15 ft. to succeed on a {@dc 20} Strenght saving throw or be pushed 15 ft. away.

reaction.name: Bloodied Current (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 149 hit points, the dragon immediately recharges and uses its Broadcast Current.

legendary.name: Dive
entries: The dragon eel moves up to half its speed. If it is submerged, each creature climbing on it must succeed on a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw or fall off.

legendary.name: Suction Feeding
entries: One creature within 20 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 20 ft. toward the dragon eel. A creature that fails by 5 or more is immediately swallowed.

legendary.name: Coil Up (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon eel rolls to recharge its broadcast current, reducing its movement on its following turn to 0. If the dragon eel uses its broadcast current on its following turn, its range is doubled and its damage is increased by 18 ({@dice 4d8}).

legendary.name: Rock Boat (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon eel rocks a boat or ship within 10 ft. Each unsecured creature on the vehicle's deck is pushed 15 ft. in the same direction. If this movement would eject a creature from the vehicle, it makes a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw, catching itself on the edge on a success. A creature hanging from the edge of a ship is considered {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a Bonus Action, the mimic can polymorph into a Large dragon or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Gas Bladders
entries: Whenever the mimic takes any piercing damage, its fly speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.
If its fly speed is reduced to 0 in this way, the mimic becomes size Medium and makes one fewer attack with its Multiattack until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: False Appearance (Dragon Form Only)
entries: While the mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary dragon.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mimic makes three Clawed Pseudopod attacks, one of which it may replace with its Outsize Maw or Gurgling Roar.

action.name: Outsize Maw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) acid damage.
This attack is made at advantage against a {@condition grappled} creature.

action.name: Clawed Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}).

action.name: Gurgling Roar
entries: Each creature within 30 feet that can hear the mimic must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn.
A creature that knows the mimics true nature has advantage on this saving throw.

action.name: Acid Glob {@recharge 5}
entries: The mimic spits forth a piece of itself at a point it can see within 30 feet. The mimic loses 10 hit points, and each creature within 5 feet of that point must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or take 36 ({@damage 8d8}) acid damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Secret Mouth
entries: As a reaction when a creature misses the mimic with a melee attack or attempts to touch it, the mimic makes a Outsize Maw attack against it.

trait.name: One with Earth
entries: The dragon can burrow through earth, wood, and stone without disturbing the material it moves through.

trait.name: Living Landslide
entries: The dragon can occupy another creature's space and vice versa. The first time the dragon enters a creature's space on a turn, the creature takes 19 ({@damage 3d12}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Jaws of the Middle Realm
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 19} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}65 ({@damage 10d10 + 10}) piercing damage and the target must make three {@dc 27} Constitution saving throws, taking 26 ({@damage 4d12}) bludgeoning damage for each failed save, >
A creature killed by this damage is crushed into a tiny diamond.

action.name: Cataclysm Swipe
entries: The dragon swipes its claw and a shockwave tears forth through the earth below it in a 300 foot line that is 15 feet wide.

The area becomes difficult terrain, each structure in the area is destroyed, and each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 27} saving throw or take 33 ({@dice 6d10}) force plus 36 ({@damage 8d8}) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Divine Meteor
entries: A meteor appears in the sky and begins to descend over a 60-foot radius area centered on a point the dragon can see.

At the beginning of the dragon's next turn, the meteor lands. Each creature in the area takes 45 ({@dice 10d8}) bludgeoning, 35 ({@dice 10d6}) fire, and 33 ({@damage 6d10}) radiant damage, or half as much if it was underground.

action.name: Breath of Earth's Fury
entries: The dragon exhales a torrent of earth and stone in a 300-foot cone. Each creature in that area takes 52 ({@damage 8d12}) bludgeoning damage and must make a {@dc 27} Strength saving throw.

On a failed save, the creature is pushed 30 feet away, knocked {@condition prone}, and {@condition restrained} under 10 feet of debris. A buried creature may be dug out and freed with a successful {@dc 18} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.

action.name: Breath of Earth's Nourishment
entries: The dragon exhales a luminous, revitalizing mist in a 300-foot cone. The dragon and each creature in the area gain the benefit of a short rest.

Each plant creature in the area gains the benefits of a long rest, and increases its size category by 1 for the next minute. While enlarged in this way, the plant's attacks deal an additional die of damage.

reaction.name: Twin Rivers of the Earth (1/Day.)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 411 hit points, the dragon immediately uses both of its breath weapons, targeting the same area.

legendary.name: Cataclysm Swipe
entries: The dragon uses its Cataclysm Swipe.

legendary.name: Granite Embrace
entries: One creature the dragon can see must succeed on a {@dc 27} Dexterity saving throw or be encased in a thick layer of solid stone, gaining 50 temporary hit points.
While a creature has any of these temporary hit points, it has vulnerability to bludgeoning and thunder damage, can't speak or breath, is {@condition blinded}, and is {@condition restrained}.

legendary.name: Wish (9th level spell)
entries: The dragon casts any spell of 8th level or below.

trait.name: Treasure Sense
entries: The dragon turtle can pinpoint, by scent, the location of precious or magical metals, stones, and crafted objects within 300 ft.

trait.name: Troubled Waters
entries: The seas within 1 mile of a dragon turtle are choppy and full of unpredictable currents, increasing the difficulty of ability checks made to navigate them by 5.

trait.name: Gargantuan Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the dragon turtle may spend its full movement to attempt a {@dc 20} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the dragon turtle. While climbing on the dragon turtle, a creature has advantage on melee attacks made against the dragon turtle, and the dragon turtle has disadvantage on attacks made against the creature.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the dragon turtle fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon turtle makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}26 ({@damage 3d12 + 7}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d8 + 7}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 21}) and {@condition restrained}. Each other creature within 10 feet of the target must succeed on a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 3d10 + 7}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 10 ft. away.

action.name: Steam Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon turtle exhales scalding steam in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw, taking 52 ({@damage 15d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Being underwater doesn't grant resistance against this damage. The affected area becomes heavily obscured until the end of the dragon turtle's next turn.

reaction.name: Retract Head
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a ranged attack, the dragon turtle gains resistance to the attack's damage.

reaction.name: Bloodied Breath (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 172 hit points, the dragon immediately recharges and uses its Steam Breath.

legendary.name: Dive
entries: The dragon turtle moves up to half its speed. If it is submerged, each creature climbing on it must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or fall off.

legendary.name: Hull Breach
entries: The dragon turtle scrapes its shell against the hull of a boat or ship. A vehicle 20 ft. in length or less capsizes immediately. A vehicle greater than 20 ft. in length suffers a hull breach and begins to fill with water, capsizing after 30 minutes if the breach is not repaired. Each successive breach halves the remaining time. A breach can be repaired as an action with a successful {@dc 18} Woodworking Tools ability check.

legendary.name: Rock Boat (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon turtle rocks a boat or ship within 15 ft. Each unsecured creature on the vehicle's deck is pushed 15 ft. in the same direction. If this movement would eject a creature from the vehicle, it makes a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw, catching itself on the edge on a success. A creature hanging from the edge of a ship is considered {@condition prone}.

monster.name: Dragonbone Golem
languages: understands Draconic and the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Brittle Body
entries: Attacks that deal bludgeoning damage score a critical against the golem on an 18-20. When a critical hit is scored against the golem, the golem suffers one additional effect of the attacker's choice:
The golem's movement speed is reduced by 20.
The golem has disadvantage on attacks made with its Splinterfang Bite.
The save DC of the dragon's Tailbarb Swipe is reduced to 12.
The golem makes one fewer attack with its multiattack.
The golem loses a use of its Pinion Cage.

trait.name: Fear Aura
entries: Each creature of the golem's choice that starts its turn within 20 feet of the golem must make a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw unless the golem is

{@condition incapacitated}. On a failed save, the creature is {@condition frightened} until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature is immune to this golem's Fear Aura for the next 24 hours.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: The golem can't be affected or detected by spells of 2nd level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Splinterfang Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) piercing damage. On a hit or miss, the target and each creature within 5 ft. of it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take 11 ({@damage 2d10}) piercing damage.

action.name: Rending Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) piercing damage. This attack scores a critical hit on a roll of 18-20 against a creature that is {@condition frightened}.

action.name: Tailbarb Swipe {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature in a 15 ft cone must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone} and take 18 ({@dice 6d8}) bludgeoning plus 21 ({@damage 6d6}) slashing damage, or take half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Pinion Cage (2/Day)
entries: When a creature falls {@condition prone} within 10 feet of it, the golem can detach one of its wings, stabbing the bones of it into the ground around the creature and restraining it in place (escape {@dc 17}).
The bones can be attacked (AC 17; 20 HP; immunity to poison and psychic damage).

resist.special: one type determined by the dragonborn's ancestry

trait.name: Honor-Bonded
entries: The dragonborn has disadvantage on attacks that target a creature that has not hit the dragonborn with an attack in the last minute.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragonborn makes two attacks with its Vengeful Blade, one of which it may replace with a use of its Pommel Strike.

action.name: Vengeful Blade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) slashing damage.
This attack is made at advantage against a creature that dealt damage to the dragonborn since the end of its last turn.

action.name: Pommel Strike
entries: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or take 5 ({@damage 2d4}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Dragon's Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragonborn exhales elemental fury in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) damage of a type determined by the dragonborn's ancestry, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with a melee attack, the dragonborn adds 2 to its AC against that attack.

reaction.name: Valorous Intercession
entries: As a reaction to a creature within 5 feet of it being hit with an attack, the dragonborn changes the attack's target to itself.

resist.special: one type determined by the dragonborn's ancestry

trait.name: Honor-Bonded
entries: The dragonborn has disadvantage on attacks that target a creature that has not hit the dragonborn with an attack in the last minute.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragonborn uses its Forebear's Claw twice, one of which it may replace with a use of its Dragonwreath.

action.name: Forebear's Claw (2nd Level Spell)
entries: The dragonborn sweeps a massive spectral claw in a 15 foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 3d8}) slashing damage and be pushed up to 10 feet away, or take half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Dragonwreath (Concentration, 5th Level Spell)
entries: The dragonborn wreaths a weapon it touches in elemental energy for the next hour. Until this spell ends, attacks made with this weapon deal an additional 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage of a type of the dragonborn's choice.

action.name: Dragon's Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragonborn exhales elemental fury in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) damage of a type determined by the dragonborn's ancestry, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Titan's Roar (1/Day, 4th Level Spell)
entries: The dragonborn lets forth a magically amplified roar in a 30 foot cone. Each creature in the area takes 18 ({@damage 4d8}) thunder damage and must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of the dragonborn's next turn.

reaction.name: Safeguard
entries: As a reaction when another creature within 20 feet of it is hit with an attack, the dragonborn ensconces the creature in a barrier of magical energy, granting it resistance to that attack's damage.

reaction.name: Bolster Fury (2nd Level Spell)
entries: As a reaction when a creature casts a spell or produces an effect that deals damage in a cone within 30 feet of the dragonborn, the dragonborn magically augments it, adding one of the following effects.

items.name: Elemental Blending
entries: The effect deals an additional 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage of a type of the dragonborn's choice.

items.name: Breath Shaping
entries: One creature in the effect's area gains advantage on the effect's saving throw.

items.name: Energy Torrent
entries: The effect's size increases by 10 feet.

resist.special: one type determined by the dragonborn's ancestry

trait.name: Honor-Bonded
entries: The dragonborn has disadvantage on attacks that target a creature that has not hit the dragonborn with an attack in the last minute.

trait.name: Cavalier
entries: While mounted, the dragonborn acts on its mount's initiative, rather than rolling its own, and it has advantage on attack rolls against creatures smaller than its mount.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragonborn makes two attacks with its Dragonknight's Poleaxe.

action.name: Dragonknight's Poleaxe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) slashing or bludgeoning damage, plus one additional effect of the dragonborn's choice:

items.name: Cleaving Strike
entries: One other creature within the dragonborn's reach must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

items.name: Hook Rider
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be dismounted (if it is mounted) and knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Dragon's Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragonborn exhales elemental fury in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) damage of a type determined by the dragonborn's ancestry, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Trade Blows
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack, the dragonborn allows the attacker to reroll its attack, then makes makes a melee attack against the attacker.

reaction.name: Valorous Intercession
entries: As a reaction to a creature within 5 feet of it being hit with an attack, the dragonborn changes the attack's target to itself.

resist.special: one type determined by the dragonborn's ancestry

trait.name: Honor-Bonded
entries: The dragonborn has disadvantage on attacks that target a creature that has not hit the dragonborn with an attack in the last minute.

trait.name: Tip of the Spear
entries: While the dragonborn is within 10 feet of at least three hostile creatures, it has advantage on all saving throws.

trait.name: Battle Beacon
entries: Whenever the dragonborn hits a creature with a melee attack, up to one friendly creature within 30 feet that can see the dragonborn may use its reaction to move up to half its speed or make a melee attack.

trait.name: Cohort Resistance (1/Day)
entries: If the dragonborn fails a saving throw while within 30 feet of three or more allied creatures, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragonborn makes three attacks with its Runefang Jaegerstock.

action.name: Runefang Jaegerstock
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) piercing damage, plus additional damage equal to the amount the attack roll exceeded the target's AC by.

action.name: Dragon's Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragonborn exhales elemental fury in a 20-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or take 35 ({@damage 10d6}) damage of a type determined by the dragonborn's ancestry, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Sudden Feint
entries: As a reaction when the dragonborn misses with a melee attack, it makes another melee attack at advantage.

reaction.name: Valorous Intercession
entries: As a reaction to a creature within 5 feet of it being hit with an attack, the dragonborn changes the attack's target to itself.

legendary.name: Inexorable Advance
entries: The dragonborn moves up to half its speed. Before and after moving, the dragonborn may force up to one creature within 5 feet to succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away.

legendary.name: Challenging Blow
entries: The dragonborn makes a melee attack. If the attack hits, the target has disadvantage on attacks that target a creature other than the dragonborn until the beginning of the dragonborn's next turn.

monster.name: Dragonflesh Golem
languages: understands Draconic and the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Lightning Absorption
entries: Whenever the golem is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt.

trait.name: Clumsy Flier
entries: The golem falls at the end of a turn if it is airborne and the only thing holding it aloft is its flying speed. Attacks it makes while airborne are made at disadvantage

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Nested-Jaw Bite or its Tail Bash.

action.name: Nested-Jaw Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@dice 2d10 + 6}) piercing plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) poison damage.

action.name: Claw Swipe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d10 + 6}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 18}).

action.name: Tail Bash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

action.name: Explosive Breath (1/Day)
entries: The golem exhales an explosive mixture of elements in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw, taking 28 ({@dice 8d6}) fire and 27 ({@damage 6d8}) thunder damage and being pushed 30 ft. away on a failed save, or take half as much damage on a successful one.
The golem's jaw splits and breaks, imposing disadvantage on attack rolls made with its bite.

reaction.name: Wing Thrash {@recharge 5}
entries: When the golem takes any necrotic damage, it can force each creature within 10 feet of it to succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Desiccation Weakness
entries: Whenever the millipede takes any fire or necrotic damage, it gains a point of {@condition exhaustion}.

trait.name: Thousand-Legged Writhe
entries: The millipede ignores the effects of difficult terrain, and has advantage on checks and saving throws against any effect that would reduce its speed.

action.name: Crawling Clutch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}The target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}).
If the target is Large or larger, the millipede can become {@condition attached|confc|attached} to the target (remove {@dc 12}) instead of grappling it.

action.name: Pincushion Lurch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) piercing damage.
This attack has advantage if it targets a creature the millipede is grappling or attached to.

reaction.name: Detach Bristles
entries: When a creature hits the millipede with a melee weapon attack, it can detach a clump of its entangling bristles.
The attacker must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or have disadvantage on attacks that use that weapon until a creature uses an action to clear them.

trait.name: Glory-Destined
entries: If the drakkoth would be reduced to 0 hit points by damage not from a melee attack, it is instead reduced to 1 hit point.

trait.name: Drakkoth Rage
entries: Whenever the drakkoth deals damage to a creature with a melee attack, it gains 10 temporary hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The drakkoth makes two attacks, then may use its Spit Venom or Tail Thagomizer, if available.

action.name: Tempest-Kissed Spear
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}13 ({@dice 2d8 + 4}) piercing plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) lightning damage.

action.name: Spit Venom
entries: One creature the drakkoth can see within 20 feet must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage and be {@condition poisoned} until the beginning of the drakkoth's next turn.

action.name: Tail Thagomizer {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature of the drakkoth's choice within 5 feet that it did not make an attack against this turn must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) piercing damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Countercharge
entries: As a reaction when a Medium or smaller creature ends its movement within 5 feet of the drakkoth, the drakkoth forces it to succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone} and be {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}) as the drakkoth moves into its space.

reaction.name: Clad in Fury (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction when the drakkoth takes damage from a magical effect that affects more than one creature, the drakkoth prevents half the damage that would be dealt each creature of its choice by the effect, and takes additional damage equal to the damage prevented.

trait.name: Glory-Destined
entries: If the drakkoth would be reduced to 0 hit points by damage not from a melee attack, it is instead reduced to 1 hit point.

trait.name: Treacherous Winds
entries: A flying creature that ends its movement within 80 feet of one or more drakkoths must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or fall {@condition prone}, or be pushed 30 feet downward if it is immune to the {@condition prone} condition

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The drakkoth makes three attacks, then may use its Spit Venom or Tail Thagomizer, if available.

action.name: Wingripper Bow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 9} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) piercing damage and the targets fly speed, if it has one, is reduced by 10 for the next minute.

action.name: Spit Venom
entries: One creature the drakkoth can see within 20 feet must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage and be {@condition poisoned} until the beginning of the drakkoth's next turn.

action.name: Tail Thagomizer {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature of the drakkoth's choice within 5 feet that it did not make an attack against this turn must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) piercing damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Crack the Sky (1/Day, 5th Level Spell)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 119 hit points, the drakkoth magically rends the sky, calling down a bone-shaking wave of thunderous sound.

Each creature within 300 feet of the drakkoth must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or take 27 ({@damage 6d8}) thunder damage and be knocked {@condition prone}, or take half as much damage on a success. A flying creature makes this save at disadvantage.

trait.name: Form of Madness
entries: A non-obyrith creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the draudnu and can see it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until it takes any piercing or slashing damage, as it feels something living swelling within it.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The draudnu has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Flesh Hooks
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@dice 3d8 + 4}) piercing plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) acid damage.

On a hit, the draudnu may lose 10 hit points and detach its head, pinning the target to an adjacent surface and Restraining it (escape {@dc 15}). While its head is detached, the draudnu is {@condition blinded}.
The head is an object and can be attacked (AC 15, 15 HP), and once detached the draudnu can't use this attack again until it regrows its head.

action.name: Infested Birth (3/Day)
entries: One of the draudnu's pustules bursts in a spray of acid, then releases 3 ({@dice 1d4 + 1}) {@creature ekolid nymph|confc|Ekolid Nymphs} that act on the draudnu's initiative.
Up to one creature within 5 feet of the draudnu must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) acid damage.

bonus.name: Mindfire Gaze
entries: One creature {@condition restrained} by the draudnu's head must succeed on a {@dc 14} Intelligence saving throw or take 11 ({@damage 2d10}) psychic damage, or half as much on a success.

bonus.name: Regrow Head
entries: If the draudnu has no head, it grows a new one, gaining 10 temporary hit points.

monster.name: Dread
languages: understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Unliving Warrior
entries: The dread has proficiency with all weapons.

trait.name: Habitual Height
entries: The dread can fly only so long as it is within 5 ft. of a solid surface.

trait.name: Bonesense
entries: The dread can pinpoint, by scent, the location of any creature with bones within 20 ft. of it, and does not suffer disadvantage for attacking a creature with bones that it cannot see.

action.name: Dread Grasp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) bludgeoning damage and the creature is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}).

A creature {@condition grappled} in this way cannot speak or breathe, and must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw at the start of each of its turns or be {@condition frightened} until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Throttle
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the dread must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 2d8}) bludgeoning damage and lose its breath, if it was holding it, or take half as much damage on a failure.

reaction.name: Wrest Weapon
entries: When it is missed with a melee weapon attack by a creature it has {@condition grappled}, the dread can force the creature to make a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw.
On a failure, the grapple ends and the dread pulls the attacker's weapon from from its hands.

trait.name: Twilight Haunt
entries: At dawn, if the drelb is outside the Plane of Negative Energy it is banished there until the next dusk.

trait.name: False Undeath
entries: Spells and magical effects that reveal creature type detect the drelb as undead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The drelb makes two attacks with its Bloodless Fists.

action.name: Bloodless Fists
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Nether Chill {@recharge 5}

When it takes damage of one of those types, it can use its reaction to gain immunity to that type of damage, including against the triggering damage, after which the spell ends.

action.name: Wall of Stone (1/Day, 5th level spell, concentration)
entries: 120 ft range. The druid summons a wall 6 inches thick and composed of ten 10-foot- by-10-foot panels.

bonus.name: Earth Elemental Form (1/Day)
entries: The druid gains 126 temp HP. As long as it has this temp HP, it is an earth elemental, it can't cast spells, it has a 30 ft burrow speed, and its AC is 17.

trait.name: Nymph Magic Resistance
entries: On solstices and equinoxes, the dryad may add its Charisma bonus to saving throws against any spell or magical effect that targets only it.

trait.name: Speak with Beasts and Plants
entries: The dryad can communicate with beasts and plants as if they shared a language.

trait.name: Tree Stride
entries: Once on her turn, the dryad can use 10 feet of her movement to step magically into one living tree within her reach and emerge from a second living tree within 60 feet of the first tree, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the second tree. Both trees must be Large or bigger.

trait.name: Fervent Protectors
entries: While a creature that is {@condition charmed} by the dryad is within 5 feet of it, attacks against the dryad have disadvantage.

action.name: Club
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage. If the target has no adjacent allies, this attack is made at advantage and deals an additional 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage.

action.name: Soporific Fragrance (Concentration)
entries: One humanoid creature within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be magically {@condition charmed}. While {@condition charmed}, the creature moves towards the dryad by the most direct path. Each time the target takes damage, it may repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Entreat
entries: One creature {@condition charmed} by the dryad moves up to its speed and makes an attack against a target of its choice.

action.name: Briar Cage {@recharge 5}
entries: The Dryad creates a 15 ft radius hemisphere of thorny vines within 60 feet, 1 ft thick. A creature whose space is intersected by the thorns when they appear must succeed on a {@dc 15} dexterity save or be {@condition restrained}, moving to a side of its choice on a success. A creature may push through the vines by spending 20 feet of movement and taking 18 ({@damage 4d8}) slashing damage. The vines are an object that can be damaged and thus breached. They have AC 12 and 30 hit points, and are vulnerable to fire damage.

reaction.name: Thorny Retort
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the dryad may cause the attacker's weapon to sprout thorns, dealing {@damage 1d8} piercing damage to the attacker. The attacker must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or drop their weapon. If the attacker picks up its weapon this turn, the dryad may immediately make a club attack against it.

trait.name: Dream Invader
entries: The quori may spend half its movement to enter the dreams of an adjacent {@condition unconscious} creature. While invading the creature's dreams, the quori has total cover from outside effects and can leave the creature's dream as a bonus action, appearing in an adjacent space.
Whenever it takes damage or a creature uses an action to shake it, the creature may attempt a {@dc 18} Charisma saving throw, waking and expelling the quori on a success.

trait.name: Blackfury
entries: A creature that enters a barbarian rage or similar mental state within 60 ft. of the quori must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or gain vulnerability to psychic damage for as long as its rage lasts.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The quori uses its gaze of rage and flame twice, one of which it may replace with a use of either its gaze of sight and shadow or its gaze of gate and key.

action.name: Gaze of Rage and Flame
entries: One creature the quori can see within 60 ft. must make a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage for each point it failed the save by, then must use its reaction to move up to half its speed toward a creature of the quori's choice and make an attack against it.

action.name: Gaze of Gate and Key
entries: One willing creature the quori can see within 60 ft. teleports up to 30 ft. to an unoccupied space space the quori can see within 5 ft. of another creature.

action.name: Gaze of Sight and Shadow (Concentration)
entries: One creature the quori can see within 60 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} for the next minute
While {@condition frightened} in this way, the quori has complete control over what the creature sees. This effect ends early if the creature ends its turn more than 60 ft. away from the quori.

action.name: Waking Nightmare
entries: The quori attempts to take control of an {@condition unconscious} creature whose dreams it is invading.

The creature takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) psychic damage, then must succeed on a {@dc 18} Charisma saving throw or gain temporary hit points equal to its maximum hit points and rise under the quori's control. While the creature has these temporary hit points, it automatically fails Charisma saving throws.

trait.name: Duergar Resilience
entries: The duergar has advantage on saving throws against spells, psionic abilities and illusions.

trait.name: Haywire
entries: Attacks that deal lightning damage are made at advantage against the duergar. When the duergar takes lightning damage, it must use its reaction to make a melee attack against a randomly selected creature in its reach.

trait.name: Entombed in Steel
entries: Critical hits scored against the duergar roll their damage dice three times and add them together, rather than twice.

trait.name: Psionic Empowerment
entries: As a bonus action, the duergar gains one of the following benefits until the beginning of its next turn.

items.name: Telekinetic Leap
entries: The duergar's standing long jump and standing high jump both become equal to its movement speed.

items.name: Impulsion
entries: The duergar's speed is doubled.

items.name: Gravity Draw
entries: Whenever the duergar uses its crushing stomp, each creature within 30 ft. is pulled 5 ft. towards it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The duergar makes four melee attacks, each of which it may replace with a use of its Flame Jet.

action.name: Iron Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a successful {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or be thrown up to 30 feet away in a straight line. The target lands {@condition prone} and then takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage for each 10 ft. it was pushed.

action.name: Crushing Stomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage. This attack deals an additional 9 ({@damage 2d8}) damage to a {@condition prone} creature.

action.name: Flame jet
entries: The duergar spews flames in a line 100 feet long and 5 feet wide. Each creature in the line must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw, taking 13 ({@damage 3d8}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Self-Destruct (1/Day)
entries: The duergar begins to spark and smoke as it overloads its psychic engine. At the beginning of its next turn it explodes. Each creature within 40 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 54 ({@damage 12d8}) fire damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Psychic Feedback
entries: As a reaction to being targeted by a spell or magical effect by a creature it can see within 20 ft., the duergar forces the creature to succeed on a {@dc 14} Intelligence saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) psychic damage. If the creature fails by 5 or more, the spell fails.

reaction.name: Telekinetic Lensing
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a ranged attack, the duergar causes it to target another creature within 10 feet.

entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, the duergar may grapple the target.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The duergar makes two melee attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its Spur Steeder.

action.name: Nadziak Cavalry Pick
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d6 + 2}) piercing damage. This attack is made at advantage against a creature wearing heavy armor.

action.name: Steed-Mounted Ballistae

The first time it enters a creature's space, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or take 4 ({@damage 1d8}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.

entries: While riding a creature, the dullahan acts on its mount's initiative, rather than rolling its own, and it scores a critical hit on a roll of 17-20 on attacks made against a creature that is {@condition frightened}.

trait.name: Repelled by Gold
entries: The dullahan has disadvantage on attacks that target a creature brandishing a gold object.
If a creature flings gold toward it, the dullahan must succeed on {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to move up to half its speed away from the creature.

trait.name: Portended Resilience (3/Day)
entries: If the dullahan fails a saving throw on the night of a solstice, equinox, or feast-day, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dullahan makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Headtaker Blade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@dice 2d8 + 4}) slashing plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage. On a critical hit, the target is nonlethally decapitated and has its head roll 20 feet in a random direction.

A decapitated creature is {@condition blinded} and has its movement speed reduced by half while more than 5 feet from its head, and can reattach its head as an Action. A creature that remains headless for a minute dies.

action.name: Spine Whip
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) slashing damage. On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or lose an eye if it can see the dullahan.

action.name: Fearsome Gaze
entries: Each creature that can see the dullahan must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the beginning of the dullahan's next turn. A creature with one or more Doom Counters makes this save at disadvantage.

action.name: Plane Shift (7th level spell, 1/Day)
entries: The dullahan and its mount teleport to another plane of existence.

reaction.name: Wrathful Parry
entries: As a reaction when it is targeted with an attack, the dullahan adds 4 to its AC against that attack. If the attack misses and the dullahan has fewer than half its hit points, the dullahan may make a melee attack as part of this reaction.

reaction.name: Headless Wail (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction when the dullahan is reduced below 106 hit points, the dullahan releases an echoing shriek from its headless stump. Each creature that can hear it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or drop anything it's holding and be {@condition frightened} until the end of the dullahan's next turn.

legendary.name: Spine Whip
entries: The dullahan makes an attack with its spine whip.

legendary.name: Go Where the Devil Drives
entries: The dullahan or its mount moves up to its speed in a straight line, telekinetically flinging aside all obstacles before it to clear its path.

A creature in its path makes a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw, taking 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage and being pushed to the nearest unoccupied space out of the dullahan's path on a success, or halting the dullahan's passage on a success.

legendary.name: Speak Name (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dullahan speaks the name of a creature within 30 feet. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw or gain a Doom Counter that lasts a minute. If the creature drops to 0 hit points, it immediately fails one Death Save for each Doom Counter it has.
A creature with three or more Doom Counters that is killed by the dullahan can't be restored to life by any means short of a {@spell Wish} spell.

trait.name: Clockwork Repetition

trait.name: Perfect Synchrony

action.name: Multiattack
