On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or drop each object it is holding and be unable to use its hands until the end of the duodrone's next turn.

action.name: Deft Binding
entries: The modron quickly binds an {@condition incapacitated} creature it can see within 5 feet in a lattice of intricate knots. The creature is {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 12}).
A creature that is not {@condition restrained} succeeds automatically on checks made to free the {@condition restrained} creature.

action.name: Break Time (1/Day)
entries: The duodrone regains all of its hit points, and falls {@condition unconscious} until the beginning of its next turn, or until it takes any damage.

reaction.name: Upgrade
entries: As a reaction to seeing a tridrone within 60 feet die or transform, the duodrone may transform into a tridrone, retaining its current hit points. No more than one duodrone may take this reaction.

trait.name: Weightless
entries: Whenever the myrmidon takes damage, it is pushed 10 feet away from the source of the damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The myrmiddon makes three melee attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its Clinging Dust, if available.

action.name: Sweeping Stiletto
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d4 + 4}) slashing damage. If this attack is made at advantage, it deals an additional 3 ({@damage 1d6}) damage.

action.name: Clinging Dust {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature within 10 feet must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or be outlined in pale, clinging dust. Until a creature takes an action to clear it, attacks against the affected creature are made at advantage, and the affected creature or object can't benefit from being {@condition invisible}.

reaction.name: Elemental Riposte
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack, the myrmidon unleashes a burst of dust. The attacker must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the end of the Myrmiddon's next turn. If the myrmidon is doused in water (at least one gallon), this trait ceases to function for the next minute.

reaction.name: Explosive
entries: As a reaction to taking fire damage, the dust myrmidon may force each creature within 10 feet to succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage and be knocked {@condition prone}, or half as much damage on a success.

trait.name: Weightless
entries: Whenever the mephit takes damage, it is pushed 10 feet away from the source of the damage.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a burst of dust in a 5 foot radius. Each creature in the area succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn).
If the mephit is doused in water (at least one gallon), this trait ceases to function for the next minute.

action.name: Scrabbling Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) slashing damage. If this attack is made at advantage, it deals an additional 3 ({@damage 1d6}) damage.

action.name: Clinging Dust {@recharge}
entries: One creature within 10 feet must succeed on a {@dc 11} Dexterity saving throw or be coated in pale, clinging dust.
Until a creature takes an action to clear it, attacks against the affected creature are made at advantage, and the affected creature or object can't benefit from being {@condition invisible}.

reaction.name: Explosive Ignition
entries: WHen the mephit takes any fire damage, it can force each creature within 10 feet to succeed on a {@dc 11} Dexterity saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage and be knocked {@condition prone}, or half as much damage on a success.

trait.name: Dwarven Resilience
entries: The dwarf has advantage on saving throws against poison.

trait.name: Impassable
entries: Hostile creatures treat the area within 5 feet of the dwarf as difficult terrain.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dwarf makes two attacks with its Steelclad Fist.

action.name: Steelclad Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.
On a critical hit, the target is knocked {@condition prone} and {@condition stunned} until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Chargebreaker Greatshield
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

action.name: Pound Shield
entries: The dwarf pounds its armored fist into its shield, gaining 5 temporary hit points that last until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Shield Song
entries: As a reaction when a anvileer within 30 feet uses its Pound Shield, the dwarf may use its Pound Shield.

reaction.name: Grumbling Thrust
entries: As a reaction when a creature is pushed into the dwarf's reach, the dwarf makes a Chargebreaker Greatshield attack against it.

A dwarven merchant caravan is in a panic after a cask of their Grand Reserve ale was stolen while traveling through a human trading post. Though the merchant is taking great care to performatively decry and swear vengeance upon the thief, privately they are seeking some seedy underworld sorts to seek out and rescue the thief from their own foolishness, as even a strong whiff of the Grand Reserve can be fatal to humans.

trait.name: Dwarven Resilience
entries: The dwarf has advantage on saving throws against poison.

trait.name: Spirit-Bearer
entries: If the dwarf takes 10 or more fire damage from a single source, it catches fire.
Until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the dwarf takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage at the beginning of each of its turns.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dwarf makes two attacks with its Dreg-Soaked Mallet, one of which it may replace with a use of its Spile Tap, if available.

action.name: Dreg-Soaked Mallet
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target {@h}12 ({@dice 2d8 + 3}) bludgeoning plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Drink to Victory!
entries: The brewmaster shares out a cask of its Grand Reserve, the fumes of which are mightily toxic to non-dwarves.
Each friendly dwarf within 5 feet of the brewmaster gains 10 temporary hit points that last for an hour.
Each nondwarf within 5 feet of the brewmaster must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of the brewmaster's next turn.

action.name: Spile Tap {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) piercing damage and have a barbed keg tap hammered into it.

A creature loses 5 ({@dice 2d4}) hit points at the end of each of its turns for each tap embedded in it. As an action, a creature may attempt a {@dc 14} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check, removing a tap on a success.

trait.name: Dwarven Resilience
entries: The dwarf has advantage on saving throws against poison.

trait.name: Grudgeledger
entries: Each dwarf within 30 feet has advantage on attacks that target a creature recorded in the grudgekeeper's grudgeledger.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dwarf makes two attacks with its Ledger Strike.

action.name: Ledger Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target {@h}11 ({@dice 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) radiant damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

action.name: Watchful Eye
entries: The dwarf glares warily around. Until the beginning of its next turn, the dwarf regains its reaction at the beginning of each turn.

action.name: Recite the Ancient Grudges {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature recorded in the grudgekeeper's grudgeledger within 30 feet that can hear the grudgekeeper must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of the grudgekeeper's next turn.
A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is instead {@condition paralyzed} for the same duration.

reaction.name: Mark the Wrong!
entries: As a reaction when a creature the grudgekeeper can see within 60 feet takes any hostile action against a dwarf, the grudgekeeper makes a note, adding the creature's crime and likeness to its grudgeledger.

reaction.name: Right the Wrong!
entries: As a reaction when a creature the grudgekeeper can see within 60 feet that is recorded in the grudgekeeper's grudgeledger is hit with a melee attack, the grudgekeeper removes the creature from the grudgeledger and the creature takes an additional 18 ({@damage 4d8}) radiant damage.

trait.name: Dwarven Resilience
entries: The dwarf has advantage on saving throws against poison.

trait.name: World-Worn
entries: The dwarf cannot be {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened} by any creature less than a century old.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dwarf makes two attacks with its Deepstone Hammer.

action.name: Deepstone Hammer
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target {@h}13 ({@damage 3d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

action.name: Dweomerbreaker Strike
entries: The dwarf makes a melee attack at advantage. On a hit, the target loses any effect that provides a temporary magical enhancement to its AC and any temporary hit points, before taking damage.

reaction.name: Stubborn Defiance
entries: As a reaction when it succeeds on a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the dwarf uses its Dweomerbreaker Strike.

trait.name: Dwarven Resilience
entries: The dwarf has advantage on saving throws against poison.

trait.name: Runewarded
entries: The dwarf has resistance to damage dealt by a creature more than 15 feet away from it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dwarf makes three attacks with its Foeborer Awl, one of which it may replace with a use of its Complete Rune.

action.name: Foeborer Awl
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target {@h}7 ({@dice 1d6 + 4}) slashing plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage and the target gains one runemark that lasts for a minute.

action.name: Complete Rune (5th Level Spell)
entries: One creature the dwarf can see within 30 feet that has at least three runemarks takes 22 ({@damage 4d10}) radiant damage, then must succeed on a {@dc 17} Charisma saving throw or lose all runemarks and be cursed, gaining one effect of the dwarf's choice:

items.name: Rune of Weakness
entries: The creature has disadvantage on attack rolls that use Strength.

items.name: Rune of Dishonor
entries: Whenever the creature takes 20 or more damage from a single source, it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn.

items.name: Rune of Ignominy
entries: Each other creature has advantage on saving throws against spells the creature casts.

action.name: Iron Within, Iron Without (3rd Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: Until the beginning of the runescribe's next turn, each other dwarf within 30 feet of it gains resistance to all damage.

reaction.name: Venerate the Ancestors (4th Level Spell)
entries: As a reaction when a friendly dwarf the runescribe can see dies, the runescribe thunderously recites that dwarf's name and lineage.

Each other dwarf within 10 feet of the fallen dwarf gains 15 temporary hit points. While a creature has any of these temporary hit points, its melee attacks deal an additional 9 ({@damage 2d8}) thunder damage.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the dwarf takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the dwarf takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

trait.name: Armor-Miner
entries: The dwarf's attacks score a critical on a 18-20 against {@condition prone} targets.

action.name: Digging Bar (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 piercing damage. This attack deals an additional 2 damage on a critical hit.

action.name: Set Blasting Charge (1/Day)
entries: The dwarf places a blasting charge in an unoccupied space within 5 feet. At the beginning of the dwarf's next turn, the charge explodes, dealing 4 fire damage to each creature within 5 feet of it.
A creature that attempts to move or disarm the blasting charge must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check or have the charge immediately explode.

trait.name: Lip Reader
entries: The dybbuk cannot hear, but understands statements spoken by a creature it can see whose mouth is not hidden.

trait.name: Dybbuk Box
entries: The dybbuk is bound to a holy artifact; a sealed container (AC 10, 15 HP, Immunity to Poison and Psychic Damage) that contains its power.
If the artifact is destroyed, the dybbuk transforms into a {@creature Dybbuk (Unbound)|ConfC}.

action.name: Disturbing Behavior
entries: The dybbuk makes a creature under its control do something unnatural, such as levitate, vomit blood, twist its head all the way around, or cause a quadruped to move as a biped.
Each nonfiend creature within 30 feet that can see it must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of the dybbuk's next turn.

action.name: Corpse Dominion (1/Day)
entries: One corpse of either a humanoid or beast of CR 4 or lower within 500 feet of the box rises and acts under the dybbuk's control for the next hour.
A corpse animated in this way gains the appearance of life, retains the statistics it had in life, and can't voluntarily harm a humanoid creature.

trait.name: Imperceptible Glow
entries: While in Bright Light, the dybbuk can attempt to {@action Hide} as a Bonus Action, and may do so without obscurement.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The dybbuk can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Spectral Weapons
entries: The dybbuk's attacks treat all creatures as unarmored (an unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier.)

action.name: Touch of Nightmares
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d8 + 2}) psychic damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Intelligence saving throw or be {@condition frightened} for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn) as it hallucinates being beset by tiny cackling horrors.
The dybbuk may make this attack as a Bonus Action and with a reach of 60 feet against any creature {@condition frightened} in this way.

action.name: Corpse Possession (1/Day)
entries: The dybbuk Possesses a beast or humanoid corpse in its space, transforming it into a
When it does, the dybbuk may choose for the creature to gain the appearance of life, which lasts until it makes an attack. This Possession ends early if the Deadite is completely destroyed.

bonus.name: Evil Gust
entries: One creature the dybbuk can see within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone} and dragged up to 30 feet in a direction of the dybbuk's choice.

trait.name: Abyssal Endurance
entries: The deadite cannot be killed while it is {@condition possessed|confc|possessed}. If the deadite begins its turn with 0 hit points, it makes a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw, regaining 20 hit points on a success.

trait.name: Dismembering Weakness
entries: If the deadite takes any damage while at zero hit points, one of its body parts is severed.

The deadite's speed is reduced by 10 feet and it makes one fewer attack with its multiattack for each part severed in this way. If the deadite's speed is reduced to 0, it is {@condition incapacitated}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The deadite makes five attacks with its Wild Swipes, one of which it may replace with its Reattach Limb.

action.name: Wild Swipes
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) slashing damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

action.name: Reattach Limb
entries: The deadite reattaches one of its severed body parts within 5 feet to itself.

bonus.name: Blood Geyser
entries: The deadite emits a geyser of black blood in a 15 foot cone from its mouth or one of its wounds.
Each creature in the area is pushed 5 feet away and must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the end of the deadite's next turn.

bonus.name: Telepathic Lunge
entries: One of the deadite's severed body parts flies up to 15 feet. Then, if it is in a creature's space, the body part becomes {@condition attached|confc|attached} to it (remove {@dc 15}).

If the body part was already {@condition attached|confc|attached} to a creature, instead the creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or take 6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and be dragged up to 15 feet by the body part.

trait.name: Dweomersense Antennae
entries: Eacles can pinpoint, by scent, any magic items or active spells within 120 feet of her, and has advantage on Dexterity saving throws against spells and other magic effects.

trait.name: Moth Bond (1/Day)
entries: While riding Imperialis, Eacles acts on her mount's initiative, rather than rolling her own. If she would fail a saving throw against an incapacitating effect while within 30 feet of Imperialis, Imperialis suffers the effect in her stead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Eacles makes two attacks with her moontrapped stave, one of which she may replace with a use of her Mutation Chant.

action.name: Moontrapped Stave
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@dice 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) radiant damage.

action.name: Blinding Globe
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 6} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}27 ({@damage 6d8}) radiant damage and the targets head is trapped in a globe of solid moonlight, which shatters when hit. For the next minute or until the creature is hit with an attack, the creature is {@condition blinded} and emits bright light in a 30 ft. radius.

action.name: Mutation Chant
entries: Eacles begins a chant that speeds the mutations caused by {@disease pestilent lepidopterism|ConfC}. Each infected creature within 60 feet must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or have its Charisma score reduced by {@dice 1d4}, to a minimum of 1. A creature that has its Charisma score reduced to 1 in this way is enclosed in a magical cocoon, and hatches on its following turn exhibiting cosmetic mutations and {@condition charmed} by Eacles until the disease is cured.

action.name: Pestilent Humors {@recharge 5}
entries: Eacles releases a parasitic miasma that slithers forth in a 30 foot cone before dissipating. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) poison damage and contract {@disease pestilent lepidopterism|ConfC}, or take half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Rider's Jink
entries: As a reaction to Eacles or a moth she is mounted on being hit with a ranged attack while at least 10 feet in the air, Eacles halves the attack's damage.

reaction.name: Mothdream Dust
entries: As a reaction when she is hit with a melee attack, Eacles sheds soporific scales from her wings. The attacker must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or fall asleep for the next minute, or until a creature wakes it as an action or by dealing damage to it.

trait.name: Keen Sight
entries: The eagle has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Dive Attack
entries: If the eagle is flying and dives at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a melee weapon attack, the attack scores a critical on an 19, or 20.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) slashing damage. On a critical hit, the target is {@condition blinded} until the end of the eagle's next turn.

trait.name: Ritual Combat
entries: The warrior conceives of combat in several distinct stages, and will not escalate to a stage before failing to resolve the fight with each previous stage, unless its opponents do so first.
1. {@skill Intimidation}; Shows of Strength and Martial Prowess.
2. Unarmed Combat, Striking Nonlethally
3. Armed Combat, Striking Nonlethally
4. Armed Combat, Striking Lethally
5. Armed Combat, Striking Lethally, Giving No Quarter

trait.name: Light-Footed
entries: The warrior has a fly speed equal to its walk speed on its turn. Whenever a creature misses the warrior with a melee attack, it may move up to 5 feet.

trait.name: Snatcher
entries: If the warrior has a creature {@condition grappled}, it may dash as a Bonus Action, and {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity} are made against it at disadvantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The warrior makes two attacks.

action.name: Unarmed Attack
entries: Melee Weapon {@action Attack}. {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) bludgeoning damage. This attack is made at advantage against a {@condition grappled} creature.

action.name: Hooked Blades
entries: Melee Weapon {@action Attack}. {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@dice 2d6 + 4}) slashing.

action.name: Sling
entries: Ranged Weapon {@action Attack}. {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) bludgeoning damage. On a criticial hit, the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of the warrior's next turn.

action.name: Submission Hold
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the warrior must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or lose 13 ({@dice 3d8}) hit points, or half as much on a success.
A creature that would be reduced to 0 hit points in this way may use its reaction to surrender. If it does, it is {@condition frightened} for the next minute.

trait.name: Earth Glide
entries: The elemental can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone without disturbing the material it moves through.

trait.name: Weathering Weakness
entries: If the elemental is doused in water or takes any acid damage, the next attack that hits it ignores its damage resistances.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The elemental makes two attacks with its Boulder-Fist Slam.

action.name: Boulder-Fist Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.
A Medium or smaller creature hit with this attack must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Shatter Earth {@recharge 5}
entries: The elemental strikes the earth, sending forth a violent shockwave in a 30 foot cone.

The area becomes difficult terrain, and each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 19 ({@damage 3d12}) bludgeoning damage and fall {@condition prone}, or half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Eternal Impression
entries: When the elemental scores a critical hit with its Boulder-Fist Slam against a {@condition prone} target, it can press the creature into a solid surface beneath it.
The target is {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 16}) as the surface conforms to its body. The restraining material can be broken (AC 17, 15 HP), freeing the creature.

trait.name: Earthen Form
entries: If the myrmidon is doused in water (at least one gallon), it loses its damage resistances until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The myrmiddon makes three melee attacks, one of which it may replace with its Earthbreak, if available.

action.name: Chained Hammer
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 ft. away. This attack deals an additional 3 ({@damage 1d6}) damage to a {@condition prone} creature.

action.name: Earthbreak {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature in a 15 foot cone must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 2d12}) bludgeoning damage and fall {@condition prone}, or half as much damage on a success. The affected area becomes difficult terrain.

reaction.name: Elemental Riposte
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack, the myrmidon sends forth a burst of earth. The attacker must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone} and unable to stand this turn.
