entries: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a burst of earth. Each creature within 5 feet of it must then succeed on a {@dc 11} Dexterity saving throw or take 5 ({@damage 2d4}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}. If the mephit is doused in water (at least one gallon), this trait ceases to function for the next minute.

action.name: Dirty Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) slashing damage. This attack deals an additional 3 ({@damage 1d6}) damage to a {@condition prone} creature.

action.name: Earthbreak {@recharge}
entries: Each creature in a 15 foot cone must succeed on a {@dc 11} Dexterity saving throw or take 6 ({@damage 1d12}) bludgeoning damage and fall {@condition prone}, or half as much damage on a success. The affected area becomes difficult terrain.

reaction.name: Durable
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with a weapon attack, the mephit may gain resistance to that attack's damage. If the mephit is doused in water (at least one gallon), this trait ceases to function for the next minute.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

trait.name: Flesh-Sickened
entries: While it has a dead or {@condition unconscious} creature {@condition grappled} in its Dorsal Maw, the xorn is {@condition poisoned}.

trait.name: Treasure Sense
entries: The xorn can pinpoint, by scent, the location of precious or magical metals and stones within 60 feet of it.

trait.name: Earth Glide
entries: The xorn can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone without disturbing the material it moves through.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The xorn makes three attacks with its Scrabbling Claws, one of which it may replace with a use of its Devour Weapon.

action.name: Scrabbling Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) slashing damage.
A creature hit by two or more of these attacks in a turn must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or drop one object it is carrying.

action.name: Dorsal Maw
entries: The xorn emerges into the space of a creature within 5 feet it is burrowing beneath, forcing it to succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}), or move into the nearest unoccupied space on a success.
A creature {@condition grappled} in this way takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) piercing damage at the beginning of each of the xorn's turns.

action.name: Devour Weapon
entries: The xorn eats one weapon within 5 feet of it that isn't worn or carried, gaining 13 ({@dice 3d8}) temporary hit points.
While the xorn has any of these temporary hit points, its attacks deal an additional die of damage and gain any magical effects the weapon had.

reaction.name: Sink into Stone (1/Day)
entries: When the xorn is reduced below 36 hit points, it may move up to half its burrow speed.

trait.name: Carpet of Thorns
entries: Each creature of the battlebriar's choice that is not riding it treats the area within 5 ft. of the battlebriar as difficult terrain, and takes 5 ({@damage 2d4}) damage for each 5 ft. the creature moves through that area.

trait.name: Enraged By Fire
entries: If the battlebriar takes any fire damage, it must succeed on a {@dc 10} Wisdom saving throw or be unable to distinguish friend from foe until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Swathe of Carnage
entries: The battlebriar may move through the space of any Large or smaller creature without penalty. When the battlebriar enters a creature's space for the first time on a turn, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The battlebriar makes three attacks, one of which may be either with its goring tusks or replaced with a use of its thorngrasp tongue.

action.name: Goring Tusks
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Spined Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) slashing damage.

action.name: Thorngrasp Tongue
entries: One Large or smaller creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) piercing damage and be pulled up to 25 ft. towards the battlebriar.

action.name: Thorn Burst {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature in a 30 ft. cone must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 27 ({@damage 6d8}) piercing damage and have its movement speed reduced by 5 until a creature takes an action to remove the embedded thorns, or take half as much damage on a success.

resist.note: from attacks not made with stone weapons

trait.name: Dust Form
entries: The earthrazer can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there, and can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. The interior of the earthrazer is heavily obscured.

trait.name: Hacking Expulsion
entries: At the beginning of the earthrazer's turn, each creature within 10 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 20 feet away and {@condition blinded} until the beginning of the earthrazer's next turn.

trait.name: Steel to Stone
entries: Any nonmagical weapon made of metal that hits the earthrazer turns to stone after dealing damage. A creature with a strength score lower than 19 has disadvantage on attacks made with it, and on a roll of 1 the weapon shatters.

trait.name: Earth-Sickened
entries: While touching a solid surface of earth or stone, the earthrazer gains vulnerability to each damage type to which it is not resistant or immune.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The earthrazer uses its Choking Sweep twice, one of which it may replace with its Decay to Dust or its Dust Burial, if available.

action.name: Choking Sweep
entries: Each creature in a 20 foot cone extending from the earthrazer must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or take 13 ({@dice 3d8}) slashing plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage.
Until the end of the earthrazer's next turn, the affected area becomes heavily obscured and difficult terrain, and creatures in the area can't speak or breathe.

action.name: Decay to Dust
entries: One creature within 30 feet must make a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, one piece of nonmagical armor the creature is wearing crumbles to dust, one spell affecting the creature ends, and it loses all temporary hit points. If a creature with 0 hit points fails this save, it dies and turns to dust.

action.name: Dust Burial {@recharge 5}
entries: The earthrazer turns the ground to dust in a 10 foot radius, 40 foot deep cylinder extending from a point it can see within 60 feet.

A creature that starts its turn in the area must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or sink 5 feet into the earth and be {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 18}). A creature {@condition restrained} in this way is {@condition blinded} and can't speak or breathe, and sinks an additional 5 feet into the dust at the end of each of its turns.
A creature that is not {@condition restrained} may move through the dust at half its swim speed.

reaction.name: Wheezing Draw
entries: As a reaction to taking 20 or more damage from a single source, the earthrazer draws in a labored, wheezing breath. Each creature within 60 feet must succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or be drawn up to 30 feet toward the earthrazer.

trait.name: Elemental Demise
entries: If the efreeti dies, its body disintegrates in a flash of fire and puff of smoke, leaving behind only equipment the efreeti was wearing or carrying.

trait.name: Flamestrider
entries: Once on each of its turns, the efreet may spend 5 feet of movement to teleport from one space within 5 feet of an open flame to another such space within 30 feet.

trait.name: Blazing Soul
entries: A creature that is {@condition burning|confc|burning} and within 10 feet of one or more efreets takes an additional 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage the first time each turn that it takes fire damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The efreeti makes two attacks with either its Scimitar or its Hurl Flame.

action.name: Scimitar
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Hurl Flame
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 7} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 5d6}) fire damage. Surfaces targeted with this attack ignite.

action.name: Blazing Barrier {@recharge 5}
entries: The efreet raises a 20 foot high wall of flames in a 60 foot line that is 5 feet wide from a solid surface it can see within 60 feet, which lasts for a minute.

A creature that starts its turn in the area or enters it for the first time on a turn must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 23 ({@damage 5d8}) fire damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Plane Shift (1/Day)
entries: The efreet and up to eight other willing or {@condition incapacitated} creatures teleport to a location it is familiar with on this or another plane.

reaction.name: Fiery Shield
entries: When the efreet is targeted with a melee attack, it can retort with a gout of flame. The triggering attack has disadvantage, and the attacker begins {@condition burning|confc|burning} ({@dice 1d10}).

trait.name: Elemental Demise
entries: If the efreeti dies, its body disintegrates in a flash of fire and puff of smoke, leaving behind only equipment the efreeti was wearing or carrying.

trait.name: Flamestrider
entries: Once on each of its turns, the efreet may spend 5 feet of movement to teleport from one space within 5 feet of an open flame to another such space within 30 feet.

trait.name: Blazing Soul
entries: A creature that is {@condition burning|confc|burning} and within 10 feet of one or more efreets takes an additional 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage the first time each turn that it takes fire damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The efreet attacks once with its ignition fist and uses its Curse of Smoldering Embers, if available.

action.name: Ignition Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d8 + 7}) bludgeoning damage and the target begins {@condition burning|confc|burning} ({@dice 1d10}).

If the target was already {@condition burning|confc|burning}, an explosion of flame flares out from it in a 10 foot radius. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take 35 ({@damage 10d6}) fire damage and be knocked {@condition prone}, or take half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Curse of Smoldering Embers {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature within 60 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 17} Charisma saving throw or be cursed. While cursed in this way, a creature has vulnerability to the first source of fire damage it takes each minute, and ignites whenever it takes fire damage.

action.name: Plane Shift (1/Day)
entries: The efreet and up to eight other willing or {@condition incapacitated} creatures teleport to a location it is familiar with on this or another plane.

reaction.name: Fiery Shield
entries: When the efreet is targeted with a melee attack, it can retort with a gout of flame. The triggering attack has disadvantage, and the attacker begins {@condition burning|confc|burning} ({@dice 1d10}).

trait.name: Elemental Demise
entries: If the efreeti dies, its body disintegrates in a flash of fire and puff of smoke, leaving behind only equipment the efreeti was wearing or carrying.

trait.name: Flamestrider
entries: Once on each of its turns, the efreet may spend 5 feet of movement to teleport from one space within 5 feet of an open flame to another such space within 30 feet.

trait.name: Blazing Soul
entries: A creature that is {@condition burning|confc|burning} and within 10 feet of one or more efreets takes an additional 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage the first time each turn that it takes fire damage.

action.name: Dancing Fireblade
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit 13 ({@dice 2d6 + 6}) slashing and 14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage.
If this attack hits, the efreet may make an additional Dancing Fireblade attack, targeting another creature within 20 feet of the previous target.
Attacks beyond the first one originate from the previous target, though the efreet must use its own senses. The blade returns to the efreet's hand at the end of its turn.

action.name: Whirling Strike
entries: Each creature within 10 feet of the efreet must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 13 ({@dice 2d6 + 6}) slashing and 14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage and be pushed 5 feet away, or take half as much damage on a success.
A creature that fails by 5 or more is not pushed away, and is instead knocked {@condition prone} and begins {@condition burning|confc|burning} ({@dice 1d10}).

action.name: Plane Shift (1/Day)
entries: The efreet and up to eight other willing or {@condition incapacitated} creatures teleport to a location it is familiar with on this or another plane.

reaction.name: Fiery Shield
entries: When the efreet is targeted with a melee attack, it can retort with a gout of flame. The triggering attack has disadvantage, and the attacker begins {@condition burning|confc|burning} ({@dice 1d10}).

trait.name: Elemental Demise
entries: If the efreeti dies, its body disintegrates in a flash of fire and puff of smoke, leaving behind only equipment the efreeti was wearing or carrying.

trait.name: Flamestrider
entries: Once on each of its turns, the efreet may spend 5 feet of movement to teleport from one space within 5 feet of an open flame to another such space within 30 feet.

trait.name: Blazing Soul
entries: A creature that is {@condition burning|confc|burning} and within 10 feet of one or more efreets takes an additional 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage the first time each turn that it takes fire damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The efreet uses its Flameclaw Summoning twice, then may make a Flameclaw Strike attack with each of its summoned claws.

action.name: Flameclaw Summoning
entries: The efreet summons a claw of flames in an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet (AC 20, 1 HP, Immunity to fire damage), which lasts for a minute before dissipating.
Then, the efreet may move each such claw summoned by it up to 15 feet.

action.name: Flameclaw Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 6d6}) fire damage, plus one additional effect of the efreet's choice:
The target catches fire. Until someone takes an action to extinguish it, the creature takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.
The target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away.
The target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength or Dexterity saving throw (target's choice) or be {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 19}) by the flameclaw.

action.name: Plane Shift (1/Day)
entries: The efreet and up to eight other willing or {@condition incapacitated} creatures teleport to a location it is familiar with on this or another plane.

reaction.name: Fiery Shield
entries: When the efreet is targeted with a melee attack, it can retort with a gout of flame. The triggering attack has disadvantage, and the attacker begins {@condition burning|confc|burning} ({@dice 1d10}).

trait.name: Form of Madness
entries: A non-obyrith creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the ekolid and can see it must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or automatically fail Intelligence checks and saving throws to maintain Concentration, as it feels parasites squirming within its flesh.
A creature may repeat this saving throw as an Action, ending the effect and becoming immune to it for 24 hours on a success.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The ekolid has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ekolid makes five attacks with its Stinging Flurry.

action.name: Stinging Flurry
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 1} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Exultant Chitter {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature within 30 feet that can hear the ekolid and is infected with Ekolid Parasitism takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage, then must make a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw.
On a failed save, the disease ends for the creature and it spawns an {@creature ekolid nymph|confc|Ekolid Nymph} in its space.

bonus.name: Implant Egg
entries: One creature the ekolid hit with its Stinging Flurry this turn must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be infected with Ekolid Parasitism.
A target hit with three or more Stinging Flurry attacks this turn makes this saving throw with disadvantage.

bonus.name: Screeching Choir
entries: The ekolid lets out a discordant wail. Each creature within 30 feet that can hear it and is Concentrating must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or lose Concentration.

trait.name: Wound Intrusion
entries: A creature that starts its turn in the space of one or more ekolid nymphs must make a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw.
On a failed saving throw, the creature takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) piercing damage and is infected with Ekolid Parasitism, and one ekolid nymph in its space is removed from play.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the ekolid takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the ekolid takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

action.name: Lacerating Collision (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 0} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 piercing damage.
This attack is made with advantage if each creature that contributed to it moved at least 20 feet this turn.

action.name: Cannibalize
entries: The ekolid kills and devours a Small or smaller creature with the Minion trait in its space.
Then, if the ekolid has killed two or more creatures this way in the last minute, it may form a cocoon around itself, increasing its AC to 18 until the beginning of its next turn.
At the beginning of its next turn, the ekolid emerges from its cocoon transformed as an {@creature ekolid carnifex|confc|Ekolid Carnifex} with full hit points.

trait.name: Serpentine Neck
entries: The elasmosaurus can move up to 20 feet into any space large enough for a Medium creature without squeezing.

trait.name: Countershading
entries: The elasmosaurus has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide from creatures above it in open water.

action.name: Cage-Mouth Bite
entries: One creature within 20 feet of the elasmosaurus must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take 16 ({@damage 3d6 + 6}) piercing damage and be {@condition grappled} and {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 17}), or take half as much damage on a success.

Whenever the elasmosaurus uses this ability, each creature already {@condition grappled} in its mouth is dragged to the nearest unoccupied space to the target, then may use its reaction to attempt to escape.

action.name: Dark Water Ambush
entries: The elasmosaurus moves up to its speed in a straight line towards a creature it is hidden from and uses its Cage-Mouth Bite against it.

If the attack hits, the target takes an additional 10 ({@damage 3d6}) piercing damage and must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of the plesiosaurus' next turn.

action.name: Sediment Churn {@recharge 5}
entries: The elasmosaurus dives up to its speed straight down and attempts to {@action Hide}.

If it ends this movement within 10 feet of the bed of the body of water it is submerged in, it kicks up a cloud of murky sediment, heavily obscuring the area in a 20 foot radius around itself that lasts until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Darting Snap
entries: When a creature enters its reach (20 foot radius), the elasmosaurus can use its Cage-Mouth Bite against it, then move up to 10 feet.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The pudding can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Corrosive Form
entries: A creature that touches the pudding or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) acid damage. Any nonmagical weapon made of metal or wood that hits the pudding corrodes. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to -5, the weapon is destroyed.
Nonmagical ammunition made of metal or wood that hits the pudding is destroyed after dealing damage.
The pudding can eat through 2-inch-thick, nonmagical wood or metal in 1 round.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The pudding can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack (Huge size only)
entries: The pudding makes two pseudopod attacks, one of which it may replace with its Predigest, if available.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage plus 27 ({@damage 6d8}) acid damage. In addition, nonmagical armor worn by the target is partly dissolved and takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers. The armor is destroyed if the penalty reduces its AC to 10.

action.name: Engulf (Huge size only)
entries: The pudding attempts to drag up to two medium or smaller creatures within 5 ft. into its space. Each must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or be dragged into the pudding's space and {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}). While {@condition grappled} in this way, a creature is {@condition blinded} and takes 27 ({@damage 6d8}) acid damage at the start of each of the pudding's turns. If the pudding splits, all {@condition grappled} creatures are freed from it.

action.name: Predigest {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature within 15 ft. must make a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 36 ({@damage 8d8}) acid damage and for the next minute does not reset failed death saving throws when it gains hit points or becomes stable. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage.

reaction.name: Adapt
entries: As a reaction to taking damage, the black pudding adds that damage type to the set of damage types that trigger its split ability for the next minute.

reaction.name: Split
entries: When a pudding that is Medium or larger is subjected to fire, lightning, slashing, or piercing damage, it splits into two new puddings if it has at least 10 hit points. Each new pudding has hit points equal to half the original pudding's, rounded down. New puddings are one size smaller than the original pudding.

trait.name: Non-Euclidian
entries: The space in a 15 foot radius around the elder brain is difficult terrain, as the elder brain's presence warps it into incomprehensible geometries.

trait.name: Tendrils
entries: The elder brain can have up to six tendrils at a time. Each tendril can be attacked (AC 10; 10 hit points), or destroyed by forcing the tethered creature to move more than 30 feet from the elder brain. Destroying a tendril deals no damage to the elder brain, which can extrude a replacement tendril as part of an attack.

trait.name: Exposed Brain
entries: The elder brain has a telepathic field that grants it resistace to all damage but psychic, which it must concentrate on as though {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell. If it loses {@status concentration}, until the beginning of its next turn it loses its damage resistances.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The elder brain has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the elder brain fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Synaptic Tendril
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 30 ft., one creature. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d8}) psychic damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be tethered by it.

A creature tethered to the elder brain is unable to move more than 30 feet away from it, is {@condition dominated|confc|dominated} by the elder brain, and has its Wisdom score reduced by {@dice 1d8}, to a minimum of 1, until it is released.

A creature that has its Wisdom score reduced to 1 in this way remains {@condition dominated|confc|dominated} after the tether is removed, but may make a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving whenever it takes damage, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Mind Blast {@recharge 5}
entries: The elder brain radiates a blast of psychic energy in a 60-foot cone. Each creature of the elder brain's choice in that area must succeed on a {@dc 18} Intelligence saving throw or take 32 ({@damage 5d10 + 5}) psychic damage and have its proficiency bonus reduced to 0 for 1 minute (Save Ends at end of turn).

action.name: Plane Shift (7th level spell, 1/Day)
entries: The elder brain teleports to another plane of existence.

reaction.name: Die For Your Master
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with an attack or spell, the elder brain may force a creature within 15 feet that it has under its control to use its reaction to move up to half its speed toward the elder brain, becoming the new target of the attack or spell if it ends this movement adjacent to the elder brain.

reaction.name: Psychic Keen (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 106 hit points, the elder brain lets out a telepathic wail. Each creature within 60 ft. with a proficiency bonus of 0 must succeed on a {@dc 18} Intelligence saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of the elder brain's next turn.

legendary.name: Form Psychic Link
entries: One {@condition incapacitated} creature within 5 miles must succeed on a {@dc 18} Charisma saving throw or have the elder brain form a psychic link to it. This link ends if the creature leaves the radius, or with a Remove Curse or similar magic. While linked, the elder brain can see through the creature's eyes and read its surface thoughts.

legendary.name: Mind Master
entries: The elder brain causes any number of creatures it has a psychic link to use their reactions to move up to 15 ft. in the same direction. A creature directed to move into damaging terrain may first attempt a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw, ending the link and taking 10 ({@damage 3d6}) psychic damage on a success.

legendary.name: Break Concentration
entries: One creature the elder brain has a psychic link to loses {@status concentration} on a spell it has cast.

legendary.name: Tendril (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The elder brain makes a synaptic tendril attack.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The Oblex can move through a space as small as 1 inch without squeezing or slowing down.

trait.name: Aversion to Fire
entries: If the oblex takes fire damage, it has disadvantage on the next attack it makes before the end of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The oblex makes two pseudopod attacks and uses its eat memories ability. It may replace its eat memories with either its synaptic feedback ability or its insightful manipulation ability.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 4d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) psychic damage.

action.name: Eat Memories
entries: The oblex targets one creature it can see within 5 feet of it. The target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or take 44 ({@damage 8d10}) psychic damage and become memory drained until it finishes a short or long rest. While memory drained, the target does not add its proficiency bonus to attack rolls or saving throws and cannot cast spells of the highest level it knows. When an oblex causes a target to become memory drained, the oblex learns all the languages the target knows and gains all its proficiencies, except any saving throw proficiencies.

action.name: Synaptic Feedback (2nd level spell, concentration)
entries: One memory drained creature within 60 feet must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed}. At the end of its turn, the target can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Insightful Manipulation (5th level spell, concentration)
entries: One creature within 60 feet must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or be magically {@condition charmed} and under the oblex's control. At the end of its turn, and whenever the {@condition charmed} target takes damage, the target can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on a success. A memory drained creature makes this save at disadvantage.

action.name: Dimension Door
entries: The oblex teleports up to 500 feet away, along with all of its outgrowths.

bonus.name: Sulphureous Impersonation
entries: The oblex may reduce its max HP by 10 and produces an outgrowth with 10 HP that appears at any point within 15 feet of it or one of its outgrowths, copying the appearance and manner of any being it has eaten the memories of. Damage dealt to the outgrowths is not dealt to the main oblex body, but for all other purposes the oblex is the outgrowths and occupies their space. The outgrowths are tethered to the main body by a thin strand of translucent slime that can extend up to 500 feet away.

reaction.name: Secret Mouth
entries: When a creature misses an outgrowth of the oblex with a melee attack, it may use its reaction to make a pseudopod attack against the attacker.

variant.name: Note: Oblex Tactics
entries: The Oblex is a man-behind-the-curtain sort of mastermind. If your players didn't seek it out, the main body should never even be present and available for them to attack. If its main body is ever found, its first and only priority should be escaping with dimension door while plopping out clones to distract the party.

trait.name: Spacial Distortion Cone
entries: The elder orb's central eye creates an area of spacial distortion in a 150 ft. cone. A creature attempting a ranged attack that passes through the cone must succeed on a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw or have its attack immediately redirected to another target of the elder orb's choice that shifts its trajectory no more than 90 degrees. Melee attacks made from within the cone have disadvantage.

trait.name: Eyestalks
entries: When the elder orb is dealt a critical hit, the elder orb must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or lose the use of an eye ray of the attacker's choice that it has seen the elder orb use.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The elder orb has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Many Eyes (4/Day)
entries: If the elder orb fails a saving throw against an effect that would Blind or incapacitate it, it may choose to succeed instead. The elder orb takes one fewer legendary actions each turn for each time it has used this ability.

action.name: Eye Rays
entries: The elder orb shoots three of the following magical eye rays at random (reroll duplicates), choosing one to three targets it can see within 120 ft. of it:

action.name: 1. Gravity Shift Ray (Opalescent White)
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or fall 100 ft. in a direction of the elder orb's choice as gravity shifts for it until the end of the elder orb's next turn.

action.name: 2. Psychic Blast Ray (Swirling Red)
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Intelligence saving throw or take 33 ({@damage 6d10}) psychic damage and have its Intelligence score reduced by {@dice 1d6} until it completes a Short or Long Rest, or take half as much damage on a success. A creature is {@condition stunned} if reduced to 0 Intelligence until it regains at least one point of Intelligence.

action.name: 3. Mind Killer Ray (Wavy Purple.)
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} for the next minute, or until the elder orb uses this ability again. The creature repeats this save at end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success or taking 27 ({@damage 5d10}) psychic damage on a failure.

action.name: 4. Dispel Ray (Pale Silver)
entries: The elder orb ends one spell affecting the target.

action.name: 5. Melt Flesh Ray (Mottled Green)
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or have its current and maximum hit points reduced by 22 ({@dice 4d10}) and its flesh begin to melt, giving it disadvantage on Charisma-based skill checks until cured by a Greater Restoration or similar magic.

action.name: 6. Blood Ray (Sludgy Crimson)
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or become susceptible to bleeding for the next minute. Whenever the afflicted character takes damage, they begin bleeding, losing 10 hit points at the start of each of their turns. The creature stops bleeding when magically healed, or with a successful {@dc 19} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check, but retain their susceptibility. This can be applied to the same creature multiple times, with its effects applied cumulatively.

action.name: 7. Slowing Ray (Sickly Yellow)
entries: The target must make a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target's speed is halved for 1 minute. In addition, the creature can't take reactions, and it can take either an action or a bonus action on its turn, not both. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: 8. Entomb Ray (Jagged Blue)
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} as the floor beneath it begins to churn and grasping stony hands reach out to drag it down. A creature that fails this saving throw repeats it at the end of its next turn, freeing itself and ending the effect on a success. On a second failure, the creature is buried alive. A buried creature is freed when it or another creature succeeds on a {@dc 19} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check to drag it out as an action.

action.name: 9. Betrayal Ray (Blotchy Gray)
entries: The target must make a {@dc 19} Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, a shadowy simulacra of the target is created in an unoccupied space adjacent to it. The simulacra acts on the target's initiative directly after it and has the same statistics and abilities as the target, except that it has 15 maximum hit points. If a character's shadow simulacra reduces it to zero hit points with a melee attack, it gains control of the creature's body.

action.name: 10. Death Ray (Streaky Black)
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or take 55 ({@damage 10d10}) necrotic damage. The target dies if the ray reduces it to 0 hit points.

legendary.name: Eye Ray
entries: The elder orb uses one random eye ray.

legendary.name: Ray Burst (Costs 3 actions)
entries: The elder orb focuses all of its eye rays into its distortion cone, scattering them all at random. Each other creature within 120 ft. is targeted with a random eye ray (rerolling duplicates), but with the save DC reduced to 14. Until the beginning of the elder orb's next turn, creatures have advantage on the Wisdom saving throw imposed by the beholder's distortion cone.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The tempest deals double damage to objects and structures.

trait.name: Air Form
entries: The tempest may enter a creature's space and stop there. A huge or smaller creature whose space the tempest passes through is sucked into its maelstrom.

trait.name: Grab the Wind
entries: The tempest is divided into 5 sections: Head, forewings, midwings, rearwings, and Maelstrom.

items.name: Maelstrom
entries: A creature that starts its turn in the maelstrom takes 14 ({@dice 4d6}) bludgeoning and 7 ({@damage 2d6}) thunder damage.

items.name: Damage Resistant
entries: The maelstrom is immune to all damage, and the wings are resistant to all damage.

items.name: Movement
entries: A creature can make a {@dc 19} Strength ({@skill Athletics}), Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}), Intelligence ({@skill Nature}), or Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check and spend all of its movement to move one section closer to the head. A creature that succeeds by 5 or more instead advances two sections. A creature that fails by 5 or more loses its grip and falls.

items.name: Gaining Advantage
entries: If the wings take 20 or more damage from a single source (after reductions), the tempest contracts and thrashes, giving all creatures advantage on checks made to move along its length until the tempest's next turn. A creature with a fly speed has advantage on checks to navigate the tempest.

items.name: Falling
entries: A creature that loses its grip falls toward the maelstrom. It may make a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw for each section it falls past, catching itself there on a success.

trait.name: Living Storm
entries: Strong winds swirl in the area covered by the storm. The winds impose disadvantage on ranged attack rolls made from further than 30 feet, or one section, away. Ranged attack rolls made from more than 60 feet, or two sections away, miss automaticially.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The tempest doesn't provoke {@action opportunity attack||opportunity attacks} when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If the tempest fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tempest uses its thunderous wingbeat twice.

action.name: Thunderous Wingbeat
entries: Creatures in one section of the tempest's body other than the maelstrom or head must make a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or take 23 ({@damage 5d8}) thunder damage. A creature that fails this save by five or more loses its grip and falls toward the maelstrom.

action.name: Sheet Lightning {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature in or adjacent to the tempest must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or take 27 ({@damage 6d8}) lightning damage, or half as much on a success. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more drops what its holding. Nonmetal objects fall to the maelstrom, metal objects have a 50% chance to fall to the maelstrom and a 50% chance to drop out of it.

action.name: The Living Wind (1/Day)
entries: The tempest summons two {@creature air elemental|confc|Air Elementals} that appear at its head and act on initiative count 20. The elementals disperse when the tempest dies.

action.name: Screaming Ascent. (1/Day)
entries: Each creature in the tempest must succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 4d10}) thunder damage and lose its grip and begin to fall toward the maelstrom

action.name: Galvanic Ruin (1/Day)
entries: The tempest releases a blast of lightning and wind in a line that is 1 mile long and 20 feet wide. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or take 88 ({@damage 16d10}) damage, or half as much on a failure. A creature behind full cover makes this Saving Throw at advantage, takes half damage on a failure, or 1/4 damage on a success. Objects and structures take double damage from this ability.

action.name: Shed Refuse
entries: If the tempest is below 100 HP, it may attempt to eject one creature from its body. One creature in a section other than the head must make a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or be lauched 30 feet away from the tempest into open air.

reaction.name: Crackling Rebuke
entries: When a creature deals 20 or more damage to the tempest's head with a melee attack, the tempest may use its reaction to force the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 4d10}) lightning damage as electricity erupts from the wound.

trait.name: Far Realm Parasite
entries: The lich's body harbors a far realm parasite which safeguards its consciousness. If the lich is {@condition incapacitated}, the parasite can be extracted with a successful {@dc 16} Strength ({@skill Medicine}) check, at which point it can be attacked and damaged (AC 14; 50 HP).
If the lich starts its turn with 0 hit points, its body implodes and the parasite Plane Shifts (7th Level Spell) to the Far Realm, creating a new body for the lich in {@dice 1d10} days.

trait.name: Impossible Angles
entries: The space in a 10 foot radius around the lich is difficult terrain for non-aberrations, as the lich's presence warps it into incomprehensible geometries, additionally causing the following effects:

A non-aberration creature that starts its turn in the area, or enters it for the first time on a turn, must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or take {@damage 1d10} psychic damage and be {@condition poisoned} until the beginning of its next turn.
Ranged attacks made by non-aberrations that pass through the area are made at disadvantage.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the lich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lich uses its Touch of the Far Realm twice, one of which it may replace with a use of its Unspeakable {@skill Insight} or Fold Space.

action.name: Touch of the Far Realm
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d8}) necrotic damage and the creature's Wisdom score is reduced by {@dice 1d4}, to a minimum of 1, until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

action.name: Fold Space (3rd Level Spell)
entries: The lich teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see, then each creature within 10 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of the lich's next turn.

action.name: Unspeakable Insight (3rd Level Spell)
entries: One creature within 120 feet that the lich can see must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or gain 20 temporary hit points.

While a creature has any of these temporary hit points, its Intelligence score increased by 5, to a maximum of 25. At the end of its turn, a creature loses all of these temporary hit points and takes psychic damage equal to twice the temporary hit points lost.

action.name: Foetid Fusation (8th Level Spell, Concentration) {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature within 60 feet of the lich's choice must make a {@dc 17} Charisma saving throw. Each creature that failed has its initiative reduced to 0, then teleports to an unoccupied space that the lich can see within 60 feet.
The lich may teleport any two creatures that failed this save into the same space, fusing them together into a single malformed body for the next minute.

While fused, creatures act on the same turn, and only one of them may use movement, use a bonus action, or take reactions in a turn. Whenever one of them takes damage, the other takes the same damage. One of the fused creatures may repeat this saving throw at the end of its turn, ending the effect and moving to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

reaction.name: Psychic Rebound (3rd Level Spell)
entries: When the lich takes damage from an attack, it can force the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 17} Intelligence saving throw or take an equal amount of psychic damage.

reaction.name: Batrachian Metamorphosis (1/Day, 9th Level Spell)
entries: When the lich is reduced below 83 hit points, it can force one creature it can see within 30 feet to make a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw.

On a failed save, the creature's flesh begins to roll in upon itself as the creature's body slowly turns itself inside out, gaining vulnerability to all damage and disadvantage on all attacks and saving throws.

An affected creature makes a {@dc 17} Charisma saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect after three successes, or transforming into a {@creature gibbering mouther|confc} under the DM's control after three failures until cured by a {@spell Wish} spell or similar magic.

legendary.name: Fold Space
entries: The lich uses its Fold Space.

legendary.name: Unbearable Glimpse
entries: One creature within 10 feet of the lich must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to move its full speed directly away from it.

legendary.name: Detestable Clarion (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The lich telepathically broadcasts a discordant melody that brings reality into unbearable focus. Each creature within 120 feet with a Wisdom score lower than 10 must use its reaction to make a melee attack against itself.

trait.name: Trample
entries: If the elephant first moves at least 20 feet on its turn, it may make a stomp attack against a {@condition prone} creature as a bonus action.

trait.name: Spear Maddened
entries: Whenever the elephant takes damage from a spear, glaive, pike, or similar long, bladed weapon, it must make a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save the elephant attacks the nearest creature it can see on its following turn.

action.name: Gore
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d8 + 6}) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Stomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition prone} creature. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d10 + 6}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the elk moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with an antler rush attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Springing Grace
entries: The elk's high jump is up to 10 ft., or up to 15 ft. with a running start. It may treat any surface at least 1 inch across as solid ground to jump off of.

action.name: Antler Rush
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is pushed 5 ft. away.

action.name: Rearing Kick
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition prone} creature. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Unearthly Scream {@recharge}
entries: The elk releases a haunting sound. Each creature within 60 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be unable to take hostile action on its following turn.

reaction.name: Elusive Sidle
entries: As a reaction to a creature ending its movement within 5 ft. of the elk, the elk moves up to half its speed in any direction other than directly away from the creature without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

trait.name: Ritual Combat
entries: The warrior conceives of combat in several distinct stages, and will not escalate to a stage before failing to resolve the fight with each previous stage, unless its opponents do so first.
1. {@skill Intimidation}; Shows of Strength and Martial Prowess.
2. Unarmed Combat, Striking Nonlethally
3. Armed Combat, Striking Nonlethally
4. Armed Combat, Striking Lethally
5. Armed Combat, Striking Lethally, Giving No Quarter

trait.name: Pathfinder
entries: The warrior and its allies within 30 ft. are not slowed by difficult terrain.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the totem warrior moves at least 20 ft. in a straight line and then his a creature with a melee attack on the same turn the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or fall {@condition prone} and take an additional 9 ({@damage 2d8}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Unarmed Attack
entries: Melee Weapon {@action Attack}. {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) bludgeoning damage. This attack is made at advantage against a {@condition grappled} creature.

action.name: Bone Trident
entries: Melee Weapon {@action Attack}. {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) piercing damage and the target is pushed 5 ft. away.

action.name: Submission Hold
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the warrior must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or lose 9 ({@dice 2d8}) hit points, or half as much on a success.
A creature that would be reduced to 0 hit points in this way may use its reaction to surrender. If it does, it is {@condition frightened} for the next minute.

reaction.name: Skirmisher
entries: As a reaction when an enemy creature ends its movement within 5 ft. of the warrior, the warrior moves up to half its speed.

trait.name: Sage's Escape
entries: When elminster drops to 0 hit points or dies, his body, mind, and soul separate and each independently teleport to a hidden refuge in a secluded demiplane, where they recombine and are immediately restored to 1 hit point.

trait.name: Mystic Clarity
entries: If Elminster has at least 115 hit points, his attacks score a critical on an 18-20.

trait.name: Weave Anchor
entries: Antimagic fields have no effect within 120 ft. of Elminster. His spells and magic items created by him cannot be dispelled, disabled or destroyed by any spell. He requires no verbal or somatic components to cast spells, and makes saving throws to maintain {@status concentration} at advantage.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: Elminster can't be affected or detected by spells of 2nd level or lower unless he wishes to be. He has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If Elminster fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Elminster makes two attacks, each of which he may replace with a use of his spellfire barrage.

action.name: Thunderstrike Longsword
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 15} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}22 ({@dice 4d8 + 7}) slashing plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) thunder damage and the target is pushed 10 ft. away. If elminster strikes a construct of force with this attack, the construct's creator must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or have it shatter.

action.name: Silverfire Barrage
entries: Elminster unleashes a swarm of magical missiles that strike a creature within 120 feet, dealing 27 ({@damage 5d8 + 5}) force damage. A creature may halve this damage with the {@spell Shield} spell.

action.name: Sculpt the Weave
entries: Elminster casts any spell of 5th level or below.

action.name: Silverfire Nova {@recharge 5}
entries: Elminster channels raw, unfiltered magic directly from the weave into a concentrated sphere and hurls it, where it explodes in a 60 ft. radius centered on a point within 300 feet. Each nonmagical object and surface that is not worn or carried disintegrates, leaving a circular crater. Each creature in the area regains all of its expended spell slots, then must succeed on a {@dc 23} Dexterity saving throw or take 88 ({@damage 16d10}) force damage, or half as much on a success. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage disintegrates.

action.name: Shapechange (1/Day, 9th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: Elminster changes his form into that of any creature of his CR 20 or lower, adopting the new form's statistics, other than its hit points, retaining his own traits and actions, and gaining temporary hit points equal to the new form's maximum hit points. When he loses these temporary hit points, he reverts to his normal human form.

reaction.name: Reactive Metamagic
entries: As a reaction to dealing damage of a type a target is resistant to, elminster changes the damage type to his choice of acid, fire, cold, lightning, or thunder.

reaction.name: Sage's Spelltweak (6th Level Spell)
entries: As a reaction to seeing a creature cast a spell within 60 feet, Elminster may make an Intelligence check with DC equal to 10 plus the spell's level, gaining control of the spell and choosing a new target for the spell on a success. If the spell requires {@status concentration}, Elminster must concentrate to maintain it.

reaction.name: Desperate Wish (1/Day, 9th Level Spell.)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 115 hit points, elminster casts any spell of 8th level or below.

legendary.name: Temporal Undoing
entries: If Elminster has not used this ability since the end of his previous turn, he teleports to the location he started his previous turn and gains 50 temporary hit points. If the space is occupied, he instead teleports to the nearest unoccupied space and takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage.

legendary.name: Staff of Spheres (4th Level Spell)
entries: Elminster conjures up to four spheres of silvery ablative magic that orbit him, to a maximum of four, increasing his AC by 5 while any of them remain. Whenever he is missed with an attack, one of the spheres is destroyed.

legendary.name: Burning Arc (Costs 2 Actions, 5th Level Spell)
entries: Each creature in a 30 ft. cone must succeed on a {@dc 23} Dexterity saving throw or take 27 ({@damage 6d8}) fire damage, or half as much on a success.

legendary.name: Worldwalk Gate (Costs 2 Actions, 9th Level Spell)
entries: Elminster opens a 15 ft. wide portal to another plane of existence centered on a point he can see within 30 ft. that lasts for one minute.

trait.name: Dampening Shroud
entries: While it is not {@condition prone}, the embrac has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical or psionic effects.

trait.name: Feeding Tentacles
entries: The embrac has 8 tentacles, each of which can attacked (AC 16; 10 hit points; immunity to poison and psychic damage). Whenever a tendril is destroyed, the embrac takes 5 damage. If the embrac has four or fewer tentacles, it has disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws.

trait.name: Non-Euclidian
entries: The space in a 5 foot radius around the embrac is difficult terrain for non-aberrations, as the embrac's presence warps it into incomprehensible geometries.

trait.name: Psionic Empowerment
entries: As a Bonus Action, the embrac gains one of the following benefits until the beginning of its next turn.

items.name: Id Torment
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the embrac is beset by crippling indecision. Whenever the creature takes an Action, Bonus Action, or Reaction, it takes 13 ({@damage 2d12}) psychic damage. This damage cannot reduce a creature below 1 hit point.

items.name: Concealing Amorphia
entries: Ranged attacks against the embrac are made at disadvantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The embrac makes up to five attacks, one of which may be with its bite. If the embrac makes more tentacle attacks than it has tentacles, it must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

action.name: Shredding Mouthparts
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition grappled} creature. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Hooked Tentacles
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage. Instead of dealing damage the embrac may grapple the target (escape {@dc 14}).

action.name: Regenerate
entries: The embrac regenerates all of its tentacles, then must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Ego-Rot Spray (1/Day)
entries: Each creature in a 30 ft. cone must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for the next minute. A {@condition poisoned} creature cannot concentrate, and repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, taking 13 ({@damage 2d12}) psychic damage on a failure or ending the effect on a success.

reaction.name: Tentacle Barrier
entries: As a reaction to being forced to make a Dexterity saving throw, the embrac may gain resistance to the effect's damage. If it does, {@dice 1d4 - 1} of its tentacles are destroyed.

trait.name: Defensive Huddle
entries: While within 5 feet of one or more Small or larger friendly creatures, attacks against the penguin are made at disadvantage.
If a friendly creature within 5 feet of the penguin that is larger than it succeeds on a saving throw, it may prevent the penguin from taking any damage.

trait.name: Awkward Waddle
entries: If the penguin walks more than 10 feet on its turn, it falls {@condition prone} at the end of its turn.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The penguin can hold its breath for up to 30 minutes.

action.name: Hooked Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 piercing damage.
If the target is Tiny or smaller, the penguin may grapple it instead of dealing damage.

reaction.name: Belly Slide
entries: As a reaction when the penguin falls {@condition prone}, it may slide up to 10 feet across level ground or up to 30 feet across downward-sloped ground.

trait.name: Cherished Sovereign
entries: Whenever the empress is targeted with an attack, up to one creature within 5 feet of her may use its reaction to switch places with her, becoming the new target of the attack.

trait.name: Courtly Grace
entries: If the guanghan would make a Dexterity saving throw, it may choose to instead make a Charisma ({@skill Performance}) check against the same DC.

action.name: Voice of the Empire
entries: The empress speaks a command imbued with all the authority of her station.

If a creature within 30 feet of her acts against that command before the beginning of her next turn, up to three creatures friendly to the empress may use their reactions to move up to half their speed toward the creature and attempt to grapple it.

action.name: Scold
entries: The empress speaks a fiery admonishment to a creature that can hear her within 30 feet, which must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or take 5 ({@dice 2d4}) nonlethal psychic damage and fall {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Clear Throat
entries: As a reaction when a creature she can see begins to speak or cast a spell with a verbal component, the empress indicates that she is about to speak.
Each guanghan within 30 feet that can hear her must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be unable to speak until the end of her next turn.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the empyrean fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The empyrean has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Empyrean uses its Shift Mood ability and makes three attacks with its maul or bolt in any combination.

action.name: Maul
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 17} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}45 ({@damage 10d6 + 10}) bludgeoning damage plus an additional {@damage 1d6} bludgeoning damage for each 10 feet the empyrean fell this turn. The target must succeed on a {@dc 23} Strength saving throw or be pushed 15 feet away and knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Bolt
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 15} to hit, range 600 ft., one target. {@h}42 ({@damage 12d6}) damage of one of the following types (empyrean's choice): acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, radiant, or thunder. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of the empyrean's next turn. A {@condition blinded} creature has disadvantage on this saving throw.

action.name: Shift Mood
entries: The Empyrean adopts one of the following moods. It may not choose the same one twice until it has selected all of them.

items.name: Impatient:
entries: Creatures within 30 feet of the Empyrean have their movement speed doubled and advantage on Dexterity saving throws. The Empyrean makes an additional attack when it uses its multiattack.

items.name: Fearful:
entries: Creatures within 30 feet of the empyrean must make a {@dc 23} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of the Empyrean's next turn. As part of this action, the Empyrean may attempt to teleport to another plane of existence (7th level spell).

items.name: Joyous:
entries: Creatures within 30 feet of the empyrean are unaffected by difficult terrain, and have a fly speed equal to their movement speed. The empyrean adds its Charisma modifier its damage rolls.

items.name: Lonely:
entries: Creatures within 100 feet of the empyrean are dragged 100 feet closer to it. The Empyrean has vulnerability to psychic damage.

items.name: Melancholic:
entries: Creatures within 30 feet of the empyrean have their movement speed halved and have disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws. The empyrean's attacks deal an addition {@damage 2d6} psychic damage this turn.

items.name: Peaceful:
entries: Creatures within 30 feet of the empyrean who targets another creature with an attack or a harmful spell must first make a {@dc 23} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the attack or spell fails.

items.name: Regretful:
entries: Creatures within 30 feet are healed for {@dice 20d8} hit points and freed of all debilitating effects.

items.name: Wrathful:
entries: Creatures within 30 feet of the empyrean lose {@status concentration} on spells and make all attack rolls at advantage. The Empyrean gains resistance to all damage until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Legendary Reactions
entries: The Empyrean may make a legendary reaction whenever its conditions are met, without using its reaction.

reaction.name: Psychic Instability
entries: Whenever the Empyrean takes psychic damage, it uses its Shift Mood ability.

reaction.name: Magnetic Presence
entries: Whenever the Empyrean takes 20 or more damage from a single ranged attack, it may force the attacker to make a {@dc 23} Strength saving throw or be dragged 30 feet towards it.

reaction.name: Brilliant Flash
entries: Whenever the Empyrean takes 20 or more damage from a single melee attack, it may force the attacker to make a {@dc 23} Consitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Familiar Face
entries: The enchanter does not provoke {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}, and appears familiar and friendly to any creature that has not seen the enchanter make an attack or cast a hostile spell in the last hour.

trait.name: Apotropaic Wards
entries: The enchanter has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects from a source affected by one or more of its Cursemarks.

trait.name: Cursemarked Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the enchanter fails a saving throw, it can remove a cursemark from a creature it can see within 30 feet to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The enchanter makes two attacks with its Memory Drain, each of which it may replace with a use of its Gaze of Malice.

action.name: Memory Drain (5th Level Spell)
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) psychic damage and the target must make a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save, the target has its Proficiency Bonus reduced by 1 for the next minute. A creature that has its bonus reduced to 0 in this way loses its memories of the last 24 hours.

action.name: Gaze of Malice (Cantrip)
entries: One creature the cursemonger can see within 60 feet takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) psychic damage and gains a Cursemark that lasts for a minute.

action.name: Invoke Curse (5th Level Spell)
entries: One creature with at least three of the enchanter's Cursemarks must succeed on a {@dc 16} Charisma saving throw or lose all Cursemarks and suffer one of the following curses.

items.name: Curse of Ruinous Wasting
entries: The creature cannot regain hit points beyond half its maximum from resting, and any healing magic that targets the creature has its effect reduced by half.

items.name: Curse of Compounding Misfortunes
entries: Whenever the creature fails a saving throw, it has disadvantage on the next saving throw it makes in the next minute.

items.name: Curse of Tangled Mind
entries: Whenever the creature casts a spell, it must expend an additional spell slot of any level or have the spell fail.

reaction.name: Cursemonger's Deflection (2nd Level Spell)
entries: As a reaction when the enchanter succeeds on a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, it causes a creature affected by one of its cursemarks that it can see to suffer any effects of the spell in its stead.

legendary.name: Gaze of Malice
entries: The enchanter uses its Gaze of Malice.

legendary.name: Suppress Enchantment (3rd Level Spell)
entries: One magic item the cursemonger can see ceases to function for the next minute.

legendary.name: Curse-Doll Puppetry (2nd Level Spell)
entries: One creature affected by at least one of the enchanter's cursemarks must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or move up to its speed toward and make a melee attack against a creature of the enchanter's choice.
A creature with three or more cursemarks makes this saving throw at disadvantage.

trait.name: Familiar Face
entries: The enchanter does not provoke {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}, and appears familiar and friendly to any creature that has not seen the enchanter make an attack or cast a hostile spell in the last hour.

trait.name: Frenzied Impulse
entries: Attacks made by and against creatures {@condition charmed} by the enchanter are made at advantage.

trait.name: Enchanted Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the enchanter fails a saving throw, it may choose to succeed instead. If it does, one randomly selected creature {@condition charmed} by it is freed from the effect.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The enchanter makes two attacks with its Memory Drain, one of which it may replace with a use of its Compel Conflict.

action.name: Memory Drain (5th Level Spell)
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@dice 2d10}) nonlethal psychic damage and the target must make a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save, the target has its Proficiency Bonus reduced by 1 for the next minute. A creature that has its bonus reduced to 0 in this way loses its memories of the last 24 hours.

action.name: Compel Conlflict (4th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: Two creatures the enchanter can see within 60 feet must each make a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save, each creature is {@condition charmed} by the enchanter until the end of the enchanter's next turn and must use its reaction to move up to half its speed toward the other.

If both creatures failed this save, they become hostile to each other for the next minute. An affected creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Erode Ego
entries: One creature the enchanter can see that is {@condition charmed} by it must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or take 44 ({@dice 8d10}) nonlethal psychic damage, or half as much on a success.

If this damage reduces a creature to 0 hit points, it immediately gains an equal number of temporary hit points. While a creature has any of these temporary hit points, it is {@condition charmed} by the enchanter and acts under the enchanter's control.

reaction.name: Entreat the Masses
entries: As a reaction when the enchanter is hit with an attack, it forces up to three creatures it can see within 60 feet to use their reaction to make a weapon attack or cast a damaging cantrip targeting the attacker.
A creature not {@condition charmed} by the enchanter may make a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw, resisting the effect on a success.

legendary.name: Infectious Charm (1st Level Spell)

action.name: Memory Drain (5th Level Spell)
