Its statistics are the same in each form, except for the speed changes noted. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Devil's Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the imp's {@sense darkvision}.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The imp has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Euphoric Sting (Bite in Beast Form)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned}. While {@condition poisoned} in this way, the target becomes indifferent to hostile creatures. A {@condition poisoned} creature may repeat this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Invisibility
entries: The imp magically turns {@condition invisible} until it attacks or until its {@status concentration} ends (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). Any equipment the imp wears or carries is {@condition invisible} with it.

trait.name: Reserved Capacity
entries: While the yuanyang has more than half of its hit points, it can move up to half its speed and make a single weapon attack on its turn while {@condition incapacitated} or {@condition unconscious}.

trait.name: Standard-Bearer
entries: While Evergreen is not {@condition frightened} or {@condition incapacitated}, each other friendly creature within 30 feet that can see him has advantage on Wisdom saving throws.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Evergreen makes three melee attacks, one of which can be with his Swallowtail Lance.

action.name: Swallowtail Lance
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) piercing damage.
On a critical hit against a Medium or smaller mounted target, the target is knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Silent Grove Blade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage plus one additional effect of Evergreen's choice:

items.name: Boring Roots
entries: The next attack Evergreen makes against the same target this turn has advantage.

items.name: Weaving Breeze
entries: The target can't make {@action opportunity attack||opportunity attacks} this turn.

items.name: Falling Branch
entries: The target takes an additional 3 ({@damage 1d6}) slashing damage.

reaction.name: Keep in Measure
entries: At the end of a turn when Evergreen is mounted and a creature he can see moved out of his reach, Evergreen's mount can move up to half its speed toward that creature.

reaction.name: Unflinching Drive
entries: When a creature makes a melee attack against Evergreen, he can reduce his AC by 1 against that attack.
If the attack misses, Evergreen can make a Silent Grove Sword attack with advantage.

trait.name: Ascended Flesh (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
entries: When the exarch is reduced to 0 hit points, up to four ghouls within 20 feet of it may move up to 15 feet toward it and take a bite of its flesh, then each ghoul that did so transforms into an
At the beginning of the exarch's next turn it returns to life with 180 hit points, its creature type becomes undead, and it gains vulnerability to radiant damage.

trait.name: Ward of the White Kingdom
entries: The exarch adds 1 to its AC for each undead creature under its control within 5 feet.
Whenever an attack misses the exarch, the attacker may choose for the attack to instead target an undead creature in its reach.

trait.name: Eternal Tide
entries: At the beginning of the exarch's turn, it can return {@dice 2d4} ghouls or ghasts within 60 feet that died since the end of the exarch's last turn to undeath with 1 hit point.

trait.name: Reclaim Anima (3/Day)
entries: If the exarch fails a saving throw, it can drain the animating force from one undead creature it controls to succeed instead, reducing the creature to 0 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The exarch makes 3 attacks with its Death's Beckon, one of which it may replace with a use of its Breath of Thanatos or Drown in Blood.

action.name: Death's Beckon (2nd Level Spell)
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 60 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d10}) necrotic damage.

If this damage reduces a humanoid target to 0 hit points, a rift appears in the earth beneath it, disgorging a {@creature horde ghoul|confc|Horde Ghoul} in the nearest unoccupied space that acts on the exarch's initiative and under its control.

action.name: Breath of Thanatos (3rd Level Spell)
entries: The ground beneath a creature the exarch can see within 60 feet cracks, spewing forth a hissing jet of putrid fumes.
The creature must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or take 16 ({@dice 3d10}) necrotic plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage, or take half as much on a success.
A creature killed by this damage is dragged through a planar rift to Thanatos.

action.name: Drown in Blood (4th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: One creature the exarch can see within 60 feet must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) necrotic damage and begin {@condition choking|confc|choking} as blood wells up in its mouth and lungs (Save Ends at end of turn).

action.name: Doomed Sleep of Moil (7th Level Spell, Concentration) {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature the exarch can see within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or fall asleep for the next minute.

While asleep in this way, the creature takes 22 ({@damage 4d10}) necrotic damage at the beginning of each of its turns, and may repeat this saving throw whenever it takes damage or when a creature attempts to wake it as an action, ending the effect on a success.
A creature illuminated by Bright Light has advantage on this saving throw.

action.name: Curse of Living Bones (1/Day, 8th Level Spell)
entries: One creature the exarch can see must succeed on a {@dc 20} Charisma saving throw or be {@condition cursed|confc|cursed}.

A creature {@condition cursed|confc|cursed} in this way has its skeleton animated within it, and must succeed on a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw at the start of each of its turns or have its movement controlled by its skeleton until the beginning of its next turn.
If the creature dies while cursed in this way, a {@creature skeletal liberator|confc} tears free of its flesh at the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Open the Corpsevaults (2/Day)
entries: When the exarch is reduced below 91 hit points, it carves a planar rift into the earth at its feet, dragging forth 5

legendary.name: Death's Beckon
entries: The exarch makes an attack with its Death's Beckon.

legendary.name: Impel the Horde
entries: Each undead creature within 40 feet of the exarch may use its reaction to move up to half its speed.

legendary.name: Into the Graveways (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The exarch sinks into the ground and disappears, emerging from an area of loose dirt within 60 feet of the space it departed at the beginning of its next turn.

mythic.name: Death-Scent Bestowal
entries: One creature the exarch can see within 60 feet must succeed on a {@dc 20} Charisma saving throw or be {@condition cursed|confc|cursed}.

Whenever the {@condition cursed|confc|cursed} creature takes 15 or more necrotic damage from a single source, attacks made against it by undead creatures have advantage until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Called by Desire
entries: The exarch learns the deepest unfulfilled wish of any creature that affects it with a spell or magical effect, and can telepathically communicate with those creatures over any distance.

trait.name: Cruel Mercy
entries: Once on each of its turns when the exarch deals damage to a creature, after dealing damage it can grant the creature temporary hit points equal to the damage dealt.
While a creature has any of these temporary hit points, it is {@condition charmed} by the exarch.

trait.name: Hedonic Resilience (3/Day)
entries: When the exarch fails a saving throw, it can gain 25 temporary hit points.
While it has any of these temporary hit points, the exarch has advantage on all saving throws and resistance to all damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The exarch two attacks with its Psychic Lance, one of which it can replace with a use of its Gift of Writhing Pain or Gift of Transcendent Pleasure, if available.

action.name: Psychic Lance (3rd Level Spell)
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 90 ft., one target. {@h}28 ({@damage 8d6}) psychic damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away.
The exarch may have this attack originate from a creature {@condition charmed} by it, using that creature's senses.

action.name: Gift of Writhing Pain (5th Level Spell) (Recharges when the exarch uses its Gift of Transcendent Pleasure)
entries: One creature the exarch can see within 60 feet falls {@condition prone} and is wracked with agony for the next minute.

At the beginning of each of the creature's turns, it must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw or take 16 ({@damage 3d10}) psychic damage and be unable to stand until the beginning of its next turn, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Gift of Transcendent Pleasure (5th Level Spell) {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature the exarch can see within 60 feet cannot take reactions and is suffused in an aura of pure rapturous delight for the next minute.

At the beginning of each of the creature's turns, it must succeed on a {@dc 21} Wisdom saving throw or voluntarily fail all other saving throws until the beginning of its next turn. On a success, the effect ends.

bonus.name: Erode Will
entries: One creature that is {@condition charmed} by the exarch must succeed on a {@dc 21} Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to move up to half its speed and make an attack or cast a cantrip under the exarch's control.

bonus.name: Agonizing Inversion
entries: One creature that the exarch can see within 60 feet loses any temporary hit points that it has, then it and each other creature within 15 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 21} Intelligence saving throw or take psychic damage equal to the temporary hit points lost.

legendary.name: Needling Imperative
entries: The exarch moves up to half its speed, then whispers a command to a {@condition charmed} creature within 5 feet.
For the next minute or until the creature is reduced to 0 hit points, it takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) psychic damage the first time each turn that it disobeys the command.

legendary.name: Soulbound Swap (2nd Level Spell)
entries: The exarch and up to one Medium creature within 60 feet that is {@condition charmed} by or friendly to it teleport to trade places with one another.

legendary.name: Psychic Lance (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The exarch makes an attack with its Psychic Lance.

legendary.name: Revel in Sensation (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The exarch makes a saving throw to end one ongoing effect on it that ends on a successful saving throw.

monster.name: Exarch of the Lord of Beasts

trait.name: Fear-Scent Tracker
entries: The exarch can detect, by smell, the number and direction of each creature within 1000 feet of them that is not immune to the {@condition frightened} condition, and cannot be surprised by such creatures.

trait.name: Juggernaut Rampage
entries: If the exarch first moves 10 feet directly toward it, they may move through any nonmagical wall or object as through it were difficult terrain, shattering a 5 foot section of it in a spray of shrapnel.
Then, each creature within 5 feet of where the exarch emerges takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) bludgeoning damage and is pushed up to 5 feet away.

trait.name: Defiance at the Gates (1/Day, Mythic Trait)
entries: When the exarch is reduced to 0 hit points, it doesn't die or fall {@condition unconscious}. Instead, it resets to 195 hit points.
The exarch gains resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage, and its attacks score a critical on a 19-20. After 1 minute, the exarch dies.

trait.name: Unbridled Fury (3/Day)
entries: If the exarch fails a saving throw while they are not {@condition grappled}, they can choose to succeed instead.
Then, if the exarch is {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell, they may roll a {@dice d6}, regaining a use of this ability on a 5-6.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The exarch makes two attacks with its Spellfury Fist, one of which it may replace with a use of its Flaying Scream or Spontaneous Combustion.

action.name: Spellfury Fist
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d10 + 6}) force damage plus one additional effect of the exarch's choice:

items.name: Bestial Grip
entries: The target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 21}).

items.name: Wound Spirit
entries: The target takes an additional 11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage.

items.name: Impact Vice
entries: The target is pushed up to 10 feet away, then takes an additional 13 ({@damage 3d8}) bludgeoning damage if this movement was stopped by a solid surface.

items.name: Shake Earth
entries: The exarch and each creature within 10 feet of it take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) thunder damage.

action.name: Flaying Scream (3rd Level Spell)
entries: The exarch's eyes blaze with abyssal flame as they hold a {@condition grappled} creature aloft and scream at it.

Each light the creature is carrying is doused, then the creature must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw or take 10 ({@dice 3d6}) fire plus 27 ({@damage 6d8}) thunder damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature killed by this damage has its skin peeled off and blown away in a spray of gore.

action.name: Spontaneous Combustion (4th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: The exarch forces a creature they can see within 40 feet to succeed on a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw or take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) fire damage and ignite.
Until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls and takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage at the beginning of each of its turns.

reaction.name: Smash Through Reality (8th Level Spell, Concentration) (Recharges when the exarch's mythic trait becomes active)
entries: As a reaction when the exarch scores a critical hit, it banishes the target to a blood-drenched arena in a labyrinthine demiplane facing a

The target may escape either by Incapacitating the bulezau, or by navigating the labyrinth as an action with a successful {@dc 21} Intelligence check. When the creature escapes, it reappears in the nearest space to where it departed.

legendary.name: Relentless Pursuit
entries: The exarch moves up to half its speed toward the nearest enemy and makes a melee attack against it.

legendary.name: Winding Slam
entries: The exarch smashes a {@condition grappled} creature into the ground, forcing it to make a {@dc 21} Strength saving throw.
On a failed save, the creature takes 27 ({@damage 6d8}) bludgeoning damage, is knocked {@condition prone}, and its space becomes difficult terrain.
A creture that fails this save by 10 or more can't speak or breathe until the end of the exarch's next turn.

legendary.name: Roar of Challenge
entries: One creature the exarch can see within 60 feet must succeed on a {@dc 21} Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to move its speed directly toward the exarch.
If it ends this movement within 5 feet of the exarch, the creature may immediately make a melee attack against it.

mythic.name: Frothing Charge (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The exarch moves up to its speed and makes one melee attack at advantage for each expended use of its Unbridled Fury. {@action opportunity attack||Attacks of Opportunity} provoked by this movement are made at advantage.

trait.name: Strength from Sickness
entries: While it is {@condition poisoned}, the exarch's attacks have advantage instead of disadvantage.

trait.name: Rot-Carrier
entries: A creature that fails a saving throw by 5 or more against an effect the exarch controls cannot benefit from resistance or immunity to poison damage or from immunity to the {@condition poisoned} condition for the next hour.

trait.name: Aura of Delirium
entries: A {@condition poisoned} creature that starts its turn within 20 feet of the exarch must succeed on a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to move up to half its speed in a direction of the exarch's choice.

trait.name: Wretched Resilience (3/Day)
entries: If the exarch fails a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, it can choose to succeed instead.
If it does, the exarch loses any remaining legendary actions, is {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn, and falls {@condition prone} as it retches up the wasted magic.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The exarch makes three attacks with its Cultivator's Touch, each of which it may replace with a use of its Spore Wind, and uses its Sprouting Doom, Pallid Rooting or Filth Harvest, if available.

action.name: Cultivator's Touch
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) poison damage.
A {@condition poisoned} creature hit with this attack becomes {@condition paralyzed} until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Spore Wind
entries: One creature the exarch can see within 60 feet must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or take 19 ({@damage 3d12}) poison damage and be {@condition poisoned} until the end of the exarch's next turn.

action.name: Sprouting Doom (3rd Level Spell)
entries: A roiling growth of multifarious fungus that lasts for a minute bursts forth in a 5 foot radius centered on a point the exarch can see within 120 feet.

The area is difficult terrain for nonplant creatures, and a nonplant creature that starts its turn in the area takes 20 poison damage. This effect ends if the area is dealt 20 or more fire or radiant damage from a single source.

action.name: Pallid Rooting (3rd Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: One creature the exarch can see within 60 feet must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn).

Whenever a creature {@condition poisoned} in this way fails a saving throw to end the effect at the end of its turn, it takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) piercing damage and is {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 19}) until the end of its next turn on a failure.

action.name: Filth Harvest (5th Level Spell) {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature the exarch can see within 30 feet that is {@condition paralyzed} {@condition poisoned}, or infected with a disease must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or take 44 ({@damage 8d10}) necrotic damage.
The exarch gains temporary hit points equal to the half the damage dealt.

reaction.name: Inexorable Growths
entries: When a creature the exarch can see within 120 feet dies, it can use its Sprouting Doom, targeting an area centered on the creature.

reaction.name: Endurance of the Mother's Faithful (1/Day, 6th Level Spell)
entries: When the exarch is reduced below 191 hit points, it releases a burst of reanimating spores in a 30 foot radius from each area created by its Sprouting Doom.
Each creature in one or more of these areas that died in the last minute is restored to life with 15 hit points and is {@condition poisoned} for the next 24 hours.

legendary.name: Cultivator's Touch
entries: The exarch makes an attack with its Cultivator's Touch

legendary.name: Sporeflight
entries: The exarch transforms into a cloud of spores and moves up to its speed without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

It can move through the spaces of other creatures with this movement, and each creature the exarch moves through must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Growing Hunger
entries: The exarch chooses a creature it can see within 120 feet.
Up to two plant or undead creatures within 30 feet of it may each use their reaction to move up to its speed toward that creature or make a melee attack against it.

trait.name: Kiss of Lolth
entries: The exarch's spells ignore resistance or immunity to poison damage and immunity to the {@condition poisoned} condition.

trait.name: Venomous Dweomer
entries: The first time each turn that a creature fails a saving throw against a spell or magical effect the exarch controls, the exarch can deal 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage to it.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The exarch can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Ruthless Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If the exarch fails a saving throw, it can force a friendly creature within 30 feet to succeed on a {@dc 21} Charisma saving throw or suffer the effects of the saving throw in their stead.

trait.name: Abyssal Ascension (1/Day, Mythic Trait)
entries: When the exarch is reduced to 0 hit points, it doesn't die or fall {@condition unconscious}. Instead, it resets to 246 hit points and eight spindly legs burst from its back.
The exarch's type becomes fiend (demon), its speed is doubled, and it becomes immune to any effect that would reduce its speed.
If the exarch ends its turn outside the Abyss, it must succeed on a {@dc 21} Charisma saving throw or be summoned to the depths of the Demonweb Pits.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The exarch makes two attacks with its Darkfire Bolt, each of which it may replace with a use of its Envenomed Touch.

action.name: Darkfire Bolt (3rd Level Spell)
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 13} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d10}) fire damage, and the target is wreathed in writhing shadows for the next minute.
Whenever the creature is hit with an attack, it takes an additional 3 ({@damage 1d6}) necrotic damage. This effect ends early if the target is illuminated by Bright Light.

action.name: Envenomed Touch (4th Level Spell)
entries: The exarch touches a creature within 5 feet, dealing 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage to it and forcing it to succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn).

action.name: Aura of Creeping Ruin (6th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: A mass of tiny spiders swarms around the exarch in a 25 foot radius. When a creature starts its turn in the area or enters it for the first time on a turn, the exarch can force it to succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw or take 10 poison damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Poison Thoughts (6th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: One {@condition poisoned} creature that the exarch can see within 60 feet has the {@condition poisoned} condition end for it, then must succeed on a {@dc 21} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition dominated|confc|dominated} by the exarch for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn)

reaction.name: Bask in Her Esteem
entries: When the exarch kills one or more friendly creatures, it can gain 10 temporary hit points per friendly creature killed in this way.
If it does, attacks against the exarch are made at advantage until the beginning of their next turn.

reaction.name: Chasten Failure
entries: When a friendly humanoid creature misses the exarch with an attack, the exarch can force it to succeed on a {@dc 21} Charisma saving throw or transform into a

reaction.name: Strands of the Demonweave (5th Level Spell)
entries: When a creature they can see within 60 feet casts a spell, the exarch weaves a portion of the expended magic into threads of binding silk.
Any damage dealt by the spell is reduced by half, and the spell's caster must succeed on a {@dc 21} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 21}) until it takes any damage.

legendary.name: Darkfire Bolt
entries: The exarch uses its Darkfire Bolt.

legendary.name: Skulking Shift
entries: The exarch moves up to half its speed. If it is not illuminated by Bright Light, this movement does not provoke {@action opportunity attack||opportunity attacks}.

legendary.name: Lolth's Favor (Costs 2 Actions, 3rd Level Spell)
entries: One willing drow, spiderkind, or demon the exarch can see within 60 feet immediately dies, exploding in a torrent of venomous spiders.
Each creature within 15 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw or take 14 ({@dice 4d6}) piercing plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage, or half as much on a success.

mythic.name: Body's Betrayal {@recharge 4}
entries: One creature {@condition poisoned} by the exarch takes 35 ({@damage 10d6}) poison damage and falls {@condition prone}, then must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution save or be {@condition stunned} until the end of its next turn.

mythic.name: Spindly Thrust
entries: The exarch stabs its spindly legs towards a creature within 15 feet. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw or take 27 ({@damage 6d8}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Keeper of the Ashen Covenant
entries: If a humanoid creature that the eye can see within 60 feet would die, it instead regains half its maximum hit points, its creature type becomes undead, and it acts under the eye's control.

trait.name: Deathpact
entries: When a living creature makes a deal with the eye, the eye may seal it with powerful necrotic magics. The first time that either creature acts in a manner directly counter to the terms of the deal, it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or die.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The eye makes two attacks with its Flameharrow's Touch and uses either its Eye of Fear or Eye of Flame.

action.name: Flameharrow's Touch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) slashing damage.
If the target was {@condition frightened}, it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or act under the eye's control on its following turn.

action.name: Eye of Fear
entries: One creature the eye can see within 90 feet must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or take 27 ({@damage 6d8}) psychic damage and be {@condition frightened} until the end of the eye's next turn.
While {@condition frightened} in this way, a creature's movement speed is halved and it has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.

action.name: Eye of Flame
entries: One creature the eye can see within 90 feet must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take 21 ({@dice 6d6}) fire plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage and be {@condition burning|confc|burning} ({@dice 1d10}).
If the target was {@condition frightened}, each creature within 10 feet of it must make this saving throw.

reaction.name: Invocation of the Bloodlord (2nd Level Spell)
entries: When a friendly creature drops to 0 hit points, the eye can prevent it from falling {@condition unconscious} until the end of the target's next turn.

reaction.name: Deadfire Escape (5th Level Spell, 1/Day)
entries: When the eye is reduced to 0 hit points, before falling {@condition unconscious}, it can teleport to Thanatos.
Each creature within 10 feet of the space the eye departed must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage.

trait.name: Stunning Strobe Cone
entries: At the beginning of each of the eye's turns, each creature in a 30 ft. cone must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the beginning of the eye's next turn. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is instead {@condition stunned} until the beginning of the eye's next turn.

trait.name: Eyestalks
entries: When the eye is dealt a critical hit, the eye must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or lose the use of an eye ray of the attacker's choice that it has seen the eye use.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The eye has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Many Eyes (2/Day)
entries: If the eye fails a saving throw against an effect that would blind it, it may choose to succeed instead. The eye takes one fewer legendary actions each turn for each time it has used this ability.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The eye makes two attacks with its claws.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}).

action.name: Crushing Bite
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the eye must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or take 36 ({@damage 8d8}) bludgeoning damage and suffer disadvantage on attack rolls that use Strength until it completes a short or long rest.

action.name: Project Illusion
entries: The eye creates an illusory image in a 100 ft. cube that lasts for 24 hours and may include creatures, structures, and terrain. The eye's vision is not obscured by the illusion. The illusion ends early if the eye uses a legendary action or moves more than 120 ft. away from it.

legendary.name: Glacial Shard Ray
entries: One creature the eye can see within 60 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or be take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) cold damage and have its speed reduced by 10 until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Paralyzing Ray
entries: One creature the eye can see within 60 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} until the end of the eye's next turn.

legendary.name: Abyssal Mirage (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The eye fills the water around it with an illusory effect of its choice. Until the beginning of its next turn, attacks against the eye are made at disadvantage.

variant.name: Note: Shifting the Balance
entries: Minions can be a lot to manage with a high-complexity monster like the beholder. You can tweak the difficulty of a beholder fight in two key ways without needing to alter the stat block or add more creatures:
Make its lair more hazardous and generally unfriendly to people bound by gravity. Give it traps it can fling the PCs into, awkward geometry, high-up hidey-holes to seek cover in.

Have it choose targets after rolling the eye rays. Part of the fun of a beholder fight is the anticipation after being targeted but before the ray is rolled, and the gambling element of occasionally getting a save you are good at. However, it can be worth giving that up in exchange for the increased challenge and more mastermind-y flavor that comes with always targeting saves your players are bad at.

trait.name: Antimagic Cone
entries: The eye tyrant's central eye creates an area of antimagic, as in the {@spell antimagic field} spell, in a 150-foot cone. At the start of each of its turns, the eye tyrant decides which way the cone faces and whether the cone is active. The area works against the eye tyrant's own eye rays.

trait.name: Eyestalks
entries: When the eye tyrant is dealt a critical hit, the eye tyrant must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or lose the use of an eye ray of the attacker's choice that it has seen the eye tyrant use.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The eye tyrant has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Many Eyes (3/Day)
entries: If the eye tyrant fails a saving throw against an effect that would blind it, it may choose to succeed instead. The eye tyrant takes one fewer legendary actions each turn for each time it has used this ability.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) piercing damage.

action.name: Eye Rays
entries: The eye tyrant shoots three of the following magical eye rays at random (reroll duplicates), choosing one to three targets it can see within 120 ft. of it:

items.name: 1. Charm Ray
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by the eye tyrant for 1 hour, or until the eye tyrant harms the creature.

items.name: 2. Paralyzing Ray
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

items.name: 3. Fear Ray
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

items.name: 4. Slowing Ray
entries: The target must make a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target's speed is halved for 1 minute. In addition, the creature can't take reactions, and it can take either an action or a bonus action on its turn, not both. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

items.name: 5. Enervation Ray
entries: The target must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw, taking 18 ({@damage 4d8}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

items.name: 6. Telekinetic Ray
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be moved up to 30 ft. in a direction of the eye tyrant's choice. It is {@condition restrained} by the ray's telekinetic grip until the start of the eye tyrant's next turn or until the eye tyrant is {@condition incapacitated}.

items.name: 7. Sleep Ray
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or fall asleep and remain {@condition unconscious} for 1 minute. The target awakens if it takes damage or another creature takes an action to wake it. This ray has no effect on constructs and undead.

items.name: 8. Petrification Ray
entries: The target must make a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature begins to turn to stone and is {@condition restrained}. It must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a success, the effect ends. On a failure, the creature is {@condition petrified} until freed by the {@spell greater restoration} spell or other magic.

items.name: 9. Disintegration Ray
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or take 27 ({@damage 6d8}) force damage. If this damage reduces the creature to 0 hit points, its body becomes a pile of fine gray dust.

items.name: 10. Death Ray
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or take 27 ({@damage 5d10}) necrotic damage. The target dies if the ray reduces it to 0 hit points.

If the target is a Large or smaller nonmagical object or creation of magical force, it is disintegrated without a saving throw. If the target is a Huge or larger object or creation of magical force, this ray disintegrates a 10-foot cube of it.

legendary.name: Eye Ray
entries: The eye tyrant uses one random eye ray.

trait.name: Defensive Huddle
entries: While within 5 feet of one or more friendly creatures, attacks against the penguin are made at disadvantage.
If a friendly creature within 5 feet of the penguin that is larger than it succeeds on a saving throw, it may prevent the penguin from taking any damage.

trait.name: Awkward Waddle
entries: If the penguin walks more than 10 feet on its turn, it falls {@condition prone} at the end of its turn.

action.name: Gift Rock
entries: The penguin offers a creature within 5 feet a rock. If the creature has an Intelligence score of 5 or higher, it must succeed on a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw or accept the rock.
While holding the rock, a creature cannot use the hand holding the rock for anything else, and may cast the rock aside as a bonus action.

reaction.name: Belly Slide
entries: As a reaction when the penguin falls {@condition prone}, it may slide up to 10 feet across level ground or up to 30 feet across downward-sloped ground.

trait.name: Ethereal Sight
entries: The phantom can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane.

trait.name: Harmonic Alignment
entries: When the phantom is created, its creator attunes its natural frequencies to one of Chaos, Law, Good, or Evil.
While within 30 feet of a Faithful Phantom of a different alignment, the phantom is immune to all damage other than Force.

action.name: Aligned Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 force damage. This attack can target creatures in the Border Ethereal

action.name: Opposition Conduit
entries: Opposing energies lash between the phantom and another Faithful Phantom within 30 feet of it in a 5 foot wide line.

Each creature in the area that shares an alignment with one or more of the phantoms must succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 19}) until the beginning of the phantom's next turn.

trait.name: Returning Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a small creature.
At the beginning of the swarmes turn, it and each other undead creature in the swarm's space regains 5 hit points.

action.name: Sweeping Mass
entries: The swarm moves up to half its speed. Each creature whose space it moves through takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage and must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or fall {@condition prone} if it is Medium or smaller.

action.name: Wave of Fear {@recharge 5}
entries: Each living creature within 20 feet that can see the swarm must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of the swarm's next turn.
A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is additionally {@condition stunned} until the end of the swarm's next turn.

reaction.name: Fill Mouth
entries: When a creature in the swarm's space attempts to speak or otherwise opens its mouth, dozens of moths pour into its mouth. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or begin {@condition choking|confc|choking} until it clears them as an action.

trait.name: Third Eye Insight
entries: The feilan has advantage on Wisdom checks made to determine a creature's relative strength, depth of reserves, and killing intent.

trait.name: Bolting Reflex
entries: When initiative is rolled, the feilan may move up to half its speed away from the nearest enemy without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

trait.name: Feather Step
entries: The feilan's high jump is up to 15 ft., or up to 30 ft. with a running start. It may treat any surface, including leaves or falling snow, as solid ground.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
entries: If the feilan fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The feilan makes two melee attacks, one of which may be with its horn-crowned head whip.

action.name: Horn-Crowned Head Whip
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 5d6 + 5}) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone} and {@condition stunned} until the end of the feilan's next turn.

action.name: Hooves
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage. A {@condition prone} target takes an additional 9 ({@damage 2d8}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Falling Slam {@recharge 5}
entries: The feilan leaps up to 30 ft. in the air, then falls to the ground. Each creature in the space where he lands must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone} and take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) bludgeoning damage for each 10 ft. that the feilan fell, or take half as much and be pushed into the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

reaction.name: Elusive Sidle
entries: As a reaction to a creature ending its movement within 5 feet of the feilan, it may move up to half its speed in any direction other than directly away from the creature without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

reaction.name: Quick Kick
entries: As a reaction to a creature making an attack against the feilan that benefits from flanking it, the feilan makes an attack with its hooves.

legendary.name: Zephyrburst
entries: Each creature within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be pushed 30 feet away. A creature that fails by 5 or more is knocked {@condition prone}, additionally.

legendary.name: Dancing Gale
entries: One creature the feilan can see within 60 feet must make three {@dc 14} Strength saving throws. For each saving throw the creature fails, its is pushed 10 feet in a direction of the feilan's choice and takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) bludgeoning damage.

legendary.name: Breathless Windspout
entries: One creature the feilan can see within 60 feet must make a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is carried 30 feet into the air and suspended there until the end of the feilan's next turn. While suspended in this way, a creature is {@condition restrained} and can't speak or breathe.

variant.name: Note: Beast Core
entries: The feilan's body contains a core of its concentrated magical essence. This core may be extracted intact from its corpse with a successful {@dc 14} Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check and may be used to empower the crafting of magical items, or consumed to permanently increase the number of hit dice a creature has by one.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The wyvern doesn't provoke {@action opportunity attack||opportunity attacks} when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Delicate Membrane
entries: If the wyvern takes 10 or more slashing or piercing damage in a turn, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or have its fly speed reduced to 0 until it completes a Short or Long Rest.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wyvern makes two attacks: one with its rending bite and one with its stinger. While flying, it can use its claws in place of one other attack.

action.name: Rending Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) piercing damage. If the target is wearing leather or cloth armor, it takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers. Armor reduced to an AC of 10 is destroyed.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) slashing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Necrovenom Stinger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) piercing damage. The target must make a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for the next minute. While {@condition poisoned} in this way, a creature takes 14 ({@dice 4d6}) poison plus 16 ({@damage 3d10}) necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns. A {@condition poisoned} creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Pestilent Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature in a 30 foot cone must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be infected with {@disease festering necrosis|ConfC}.

reaction.name: Jink
entries: When the wyvern is hit with a ranged attack while flying, it can reduce the attack's damage by half.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the creature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

trait.name: Axe-Mad
entries: As a Bonus Action, the axe-mad can move up to its speed toward a plant or plant creature that it can see.

trait.name: Bark-Breaker
entries: If the axe mad moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a logging axe attack on the same turn, the attack ignores the target's damage resistances.

action.name: Logging Axe (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 slashing damage. This attack deals an an additional 1 slashing damage to a {@condition prone} target.

reaction.name: Savage Demise
entries: When the axe-mad drops to 0 hit points, it may use its reaction to make a single attack before falling {@condition unconscious}.

trait.name: Respirator
entries: The blightcaster is immune to damage from inhaled toxins while it wears its respirator. If the blightcaster suffers a critical hit, its respirator breaks.

trait.name: Gnome Cunning
entries: The blightcaster has advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

action.name: Sprayer Bash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 ft. away.

action.name: Blight Torrent {@recharge 5}
entries: The blightcaster spews a toxic, defoliating fog from its hand sprayer in a 30 ft. cone that heavily obscures its area and lasts until the end of the blightcaster's next turn. Nonmagical plants in the area wither and die.

A creature that starts its turn in the area or enters it for the first time on a turn must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or take 27 ({@damage 6d8}) necrotic damage, or half as much on a success.
A plant creature makes this saving throw with disadvantage, and takes maximum damage on a failed save.

action.name: Pump
entries: The blightcaster rolls to recharge its Blight Torrent.

trait.name: Juggernaut
entries: The branchbreaker may attempt to shove a creature as a Bonus Action. If it moves 20 feet before attempting to shove a creature, the branchbreaker has advantage on the contested check, and on a success the target is knocked {@condition prone} and pushed 10 feet back.

trait.name: Spell Resistant Hide
entries: The branchbreaker has resistance to damage from spells of third level or below.

action.name: Polesaw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) bludgeoning damage. This attack is made at disadvantage gainst a creature within 5 ft.

action.name: Juggernaut Charge {@recharge 5}
entries: The branchbreaker attempts to shove a creature. If it succeeds, it may make another shove attempt against the same target, and continue doing so until it fails or runs out of movement. The target then takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) damage for each 5 feet it was pushed.

trait.name: High Tolerance
entries: If the pharmacist is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Constitution saving throw to take only half damage, the pharmacist instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

trait.name: Gnome Cunning
entries: The gnome has advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The pharmacist makes two attacks, either of which it may replace with a use of its Ignite Weapon.

action.name: Rifle Bash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Dart Rifle
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 7} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}The target suffers one effect of the pharmacist's choice.

items.name: Stimulant Dart
entries: The target gains advantage on all melee attack rolls and attack rolls against it have advantage until the end of the pharmacist's next turn.

items.name: Motivator Dart
entries: The target becomes immune to the {@condition frightened} and {@condition charmed} conditions for the next minute.

items.name: Blight Dart
entries: The target takes 9 ({@dice 2d8}) poison and 11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage.

items.name: Strikebreaker Dart (Recharge 5-6)
entries: If the target dies in the next minute, it explodes. Each creature within 20 ft. of it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 14 ({@dice 4d6}) poison and 14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Ignite Weapon
entries: The pharmacist smears a volitile grease on the weapon of one creature within 5 ft., which then ignites. For the next minute, melee attacks made with the weapon deal an additional 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage.

trait.name: Two Heads
entries: The wagedriver has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks and on saving throws against being {@condition blinded}, {@condition charmed}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition frightened}, {@condition stunned}, and knocked {@condition unconscious}.

trait.name: Double Actions
entries: The wagedriver rolls initiative twice, and acts on each of them.

trait.name: Coercive
entries: While the wagedriver is conscious, allied creatures that can see it will not flee or surrender.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ettin uses its Rage song and makes one melee attack.

action.name: Weighted Lash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@dice 1d8 + 5}) slashing plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Work Song
entries: Until the end of the wagedriver's next turn, melee weapon attacks made by all creatures within 30 feet deal an additional 4 ({@damage 1d8}) damage.
Whenever a creature affected by the work song rolls a {@hit 1} to hit with an attack, the attacker makes a new attack roll, targeting itself.

reaction.name: Kick Away
entries: As a reaction to a creature ending its movement within 5 feet of the forces, the wagedriver forces it to succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away and lose {@status concentration}, if it was holding it.

reaction.name: Lead From the Rear
entries: As a reaction to being hit with an attack, the wagedriver causes the attack to instead hit an allied creature within 5 ft.

trait.name: Multiple Heads
entries: The hydra has five heads. While it has more than one head, the hydra has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition blinded}, {@condition charmed}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition frightened}, {@condition stunned}, and knocked {@condition unconscious}.

Whenever the hydra takes 25 or more damage in a single turn, one of its heads dies. If all its heads die, the hydra dies. A creature can attempt to avoid harming the heads, bypassing this trait. If it does, the hydra has resistance to any damage it deals.

At the beginning of its turn, the hydra makes a {@dc 12} Constitution save for each head that died since the beginning of its last turn. On a success, it grows two new heads. It makes one of these saving throws at disadvantage for each source of fire damage it took since its last turn. The hydra regains 10 hit points for each head regrown in this way.

trait.name: Reactive Heads
entries: For each head the hydra has beyond one, it gets an extra reaction that can be used only for {@action opportunity attack||opportunity attacks}.

trait.name: Wakeful
entries: While the hydra sleeps, at least one of its heads is awake.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hydra makes as many bite attacks as it has heads. If it is grappling a creature at the start of its turn, it may replace one of its bite attacks with a swallow.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d10 + 5}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}). While a head grapples a target, the head can attack only that target.

action.name: Swallow
entries: The hydra makes one bite attack against a Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, that creature takes the bite's damage and is swallowed, and the grapple ends.

While swallowed, the creature is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained} in the hydra's craw, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the hydra, and it takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) acid damage at the start of each of the hydra's turns. One swallowed creature is freed whenever the hydra loses a head.

action.name: Worry {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by at least two of the hydra's heads must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution throw or take 55 ({@damage 10d10}) piercing damage, or half as much on a success. A creature makes this save at disadvantage if it is {@condition grappled} by three or more heads.

reaction.name: Shed Head
entries: As a reaction when the hydra fails a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the hydra may choose to succeed. If it does, one of its heads dies and tears away from the main body.

trait.name: Third Eye Insight
entries: Feng has advantage on Wisdom checks made to determine a creature's relative strength, depth of reserves, and killing intent.

trait.name: Regain Equilibrium
entries: When Feng takes the {@action Dodge} action, he regains hit dice up to half of his maximum.

trait.name: Inexorable Current
entries: Whenever Feng is missed with a melee attack, he may move the attacker 5 feet in any direction.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Feng fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Feng makes three attacks with his flowing fist.

action.name: Flowing Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) cold damage, and Feng may expend two hit dice to add one additional effect to the attack.

items.name: Breaking the Water's Surface
entries: The target's AC is reduced by 2 until the beginning of its next turn.

items.name: Freezing Tide
entries: The target is pushed 10 feet away, and its movement speed is reduced by 10 until the end of its next turn.

items.name: Reflecting Splash
entries: Feng mirrors his strike with a kick. One creature within 5 ft. other than his target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take the attack's damage.

items.name: Crushing Stone
entries: The target takes an additional 9 ({@damage 2d8}) bludgeoning damage, or 13 ({@damage 3d8}) bludgeoning damage if it is positioned between Feng and a solid object, such as a wall.

action.name: Avalanche Strike (Costs 6 Hit Dice)
entries: Feng strikes with a crushing blow that draws all heat from air around the target, encasing it in a shell of ice. One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or gain 36 ({@dice 8d8}) temporary hit points.

As long as a creature has any of these temporary hit points, it is {@condition restrained}, {@condition blinded}, and has vulnerability to fire damage. A creature that starts its turn with any of these temporary hit points must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be forced to expend two hit dice. If it cannot, it drops to 0 HP.

reaction.name: Pressure Circuit
entries: As a reaction when he is hit with a melee attack, Feng halves the attack's damage and gains two hit dice that last until the end of his next turn.

legendary.name: Flowing Fist
entries: Feng makes an attack with his flowing fist.

legendary.name: Centering Breath
entries: Feng regains his reaction.

legendary.name: River's Embrace
entries: Feng moves up to half his speed towards a creature he can see. If he ends this movement within 5 ft. of the creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or be {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}) and {@condition restrained} until the end of Feng's next turn.

trait.name: Corrosion Weakness
entries: If the ferrolith takes 10 or more acid damage from a single source, it loses its resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The ferrolith has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ferrolith makes three attacks with its Adamantine Claws, one of which it may replace with a use of its Compel.

action.name: Adamantine Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d8 + 4}) slashing damage. This attack scores a critical on an 18-20.

action.name: Compel
entries: One creature {@condition charmed} by the ferrolith must use its reaction to move up to half its speed and make a weapon attack.

action.name: Enticing Charm (Concentration)
entries: One humanoid the ferrolith can see within 30 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be magically {@condition charmed} and under the ferrolith's control.

The {@condition charmed} creature repeats this saving throw whenever it takes damage, ending the effect on a success. When the ferrolith's charm ends on a creature, the creature takes 44 ({@damage 8d10}) psychic damage and is immune to this effect for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Razor Barrage {@recharge 5}
entries: The ferrolith flings razor-sharp flakes of rust from its wings in a 30 foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 45 ({@damage 10d8}) slashing damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Grounding Weakness
entries: If the wisp makes an attack while within 15 feet of a metal object speared into the ground (such as a dagger), it must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw or be dissipated into the earth and destroyed.

trait.name: Variable Illumination
entries: The wisp sheds bright light in a 5- to 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional number of feet equal to the chosen radius. The wisp can alter the radius as a Bonus Action.

action.name: Sparkjump
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d8}) lightning damage and the wisp teleports up to 15 feet to a location it can see.
If the wisp ends this movement within 5 feet of a creature it has not attacked this turn, it may make an attack against it as part of this action.

action.name: Lure
entries: One creature that can see the wisp must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by the wisp until the end of the wisp's next turn. While {@condition charmed} in this way, a creature must use all of its movement to approach the wisp.

reaction.name: Draw Blood
entries: When a creature within 15 feet fails a death saving throw, the wisp can force the creature to succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or lose one unexpended hit die.
When the wisp uses its Sparkjump, it may teleport an additional 5 feet for each hit die it has drained this way in the last minute.

trait.name: Dread Revels
entries: The fey'ri has advantage on attack rolls against creatures that are {@condition frightened}.

trait.name: Demonblooded
entries: The fey'ri has advantage on saving throws against effects that deal Cold, Fire, or Lightning damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fey'ri makes three attacks with its Demonic Lash, one of which it may replace with a use of its Bloodflame Spear, if available.

action.name: Demonic Lash (2nd Level Spell)
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@dice 2d4}) slashing plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.
A target hit by two or more of these attacks in a turn must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of the fey'ri's next turn.

action.name: Bloodflame Spear (3rd Level Spell, Recharge 5-6, Spell)
entries: The fey'ri dashes up to 15 feet in a straight line, then a line of solid fire extends from its palm in a 15 foot line that is 5 feet wide.

Each creature in the line must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or take 10 ({@dice 3d6}) fire plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) piercing damage and be pushed 15 feet away, or take half as much damage on a successs.
If the fey'ri has fewer than half its hit points, each affected creature subtracts {@dice 1d4} from the result of its saving throw.

action.name: Sanguine Cyclone (1/Day, 5th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: The fey'ri conjures forth a raging whirlwind of blood in a 15 foot radius centered on a point it can see within 150 feet that lasts for a minute.

The area is difficult terrain, and a creature that starts its turn in the area must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or lose one unexpended hit die, or drop to 0 hit points if it cannot.
Whenever a creature loses a hit die in this way, the whirlwind's radius grows by 5 feet, then each creature in its area takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) slashing damage.

trait.name: Dread Revels
entries: The fey'ri has advantage on attack rolls against creatures that are {@condition frightened}.

trait.name: Demonblooded
entries: The fey'ri has advantage on saving throws against effects that deal Cold, Fire, or Lightning damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fey'ri makes two attacks.

action.name: Bladehoof Kick
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) piercing damage.
This attack scores a critical on an 18-20 against a {@condition prone} creature, or one the fey'ri's Wicked Warhook is attached to.

action.name: Wicked Warhook
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) piercing damage and the hook attaches to the target (remove {@dc 14}).

While the hook is attached to a creature, the fey'ri cannot make attacks with this weapon, may spend 10 feet of its movement drag the creature up to 5 feet toward it, and may detach the hook as a Bonus Action.
The attached creature cannot move away from the fey'ri, and takes 2 piercing damage for every 5 feet it is dragged in this way.

action.name: Rain of Fire (2nd Level Spell) {@recharge 5}
entries: Three bolts of fire flare from the sky, each exploding in a 5 foot radius centered on a point within 90 feet that the fey'ri can see.

Each flammable object in the area ignites, and each creature not beneath cover in the area of one or more of the explosions must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage.

reaction.name: Jink
entries: As a reaction when the fey'ri is hit with a ranged attack while at least 10 feet in the air, the fey'ri halves the attack's damage.

trait.name: Dread Revels
entries: The fey'ri has advantage on attack rolls against creatures that are {@condition frightened}.

trait.name: Demonblooded
entries: The fey'ri has advantage on saving throws against effects that deal Cold, Fire, or Lightning damage.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the fe'ri takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the fe'ri takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

action.name: Thorned Dagger (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 piercing damage.

action.name: Contaminated Volley (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 8} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}5 piercing plus 2 poison damage.
If three or more fey'ri contributed to this attack, the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or contract {@disease walking sepsis|ConfC}.

action.name: Ecstatic Cull
entries: The fey'ri makes a Thorned Dagger attack against a friendly creature with fewer than 25 hit points.

On a hit, the target dies and each creature of the fey'ri's choice within 30 feet that can see it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of the fey'ri's next turn.

trait.name: Dread Revels
entries: The fey'ri has advantage on attack rolls against creatures that are {@condition frightened}.

trait.name: Demonblooded
entries: The fey'ri has advantage on saving throws against effects that deal Cold, Fire, or Lightning damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fey'ri makes two attacks with its Fleshbond Spike, one of which it may replace with a use of its Skin Dance, if available.

action.name: Fleshbond Spike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage and the spike embeds in the creature and bonds to its flesh.

Whenever the creature takes an action or bonus action, it takes 1 piercing damage for each spike embedded in it. A creature may remove one of these spines as an action, taking 5 slashing damage for each spike removed.

action.name: Disfigure (2nd Level Spell)
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) necrotic damage and the creature must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw.

On a failed save, the creature takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) slashing damage as a handprint of skin peels off of it, suffering disadvantage on Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) checks until cured by Lesser Restoration or similar magic.

action.name: Skin Dance (4th Level Spell) {@recharge 5}
entries: The fey'ri assumes the appearance of a humanoid creature it can see within 60 feet, then teleports to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of it.

While the fey'ri is within 5 feet of the creature it is mimicking, a creature with a Passive {@skill Insight} of 14 or lower that attempts to target one of them with an attack or spell instead selects one of them at random as the target.

trait.name: Aberrant Quickness
entries: The choker may dash as a bonus action while it has a creature {@condition grappled}.

trait.name: Boneless
entries: The choker can move through and occupy a space as narrow as 4 inches wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Camouflage
entries: The choker is {@condition invisible} to creatures more than 30 feet away from it.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The choker can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The choker makes two barbed tentacle attacks and uses its vine fetter.

action.name: Barbed Tentacle
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, can't speak or breathe, and the choker can't use this tentacle on another target. The choker has two tentacles.

action.name: Vine Fetter
entries: One creature within 30 ft. of the choker must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 14}) in place as vines loop around its extremeties.

action.name: Throttle
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the choker must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) bludgeoning damage, lose its held breath, and begin to suffocate.

reaction.name: Body Shield
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with an attack while grappling a creature, the choker adds +2 to its AC. If the attack misses, the attacker makes a new attack roll, targeting the {@condition grappled} creature instead.

trait.name: Web-Dweller
entries: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty.
While in contact with a web, the spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spider makes two attacks, one of which can be with its Lurchvenom Bite.

action.name: Lurchvenom Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn).

While {@condition poisoned} in this way, a creature takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) poison damage at the beginning of each of its turns, then teleports up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space the spider can see.

action.name: Spit Venom
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 30/60 ft., one creature. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d8}) poison damage and the target teleports up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space the spider can see.

action.name: Grasping Legs
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}).

reaction.name: Anticipatory Strike
entries: When a creature teleports to a space within 5 feet of the spider, the spider can make a Grasping Legs attack with advantage against the creature.

reaction.name: Vanishing Dodge
entries: When a creature hits the spider with an attack, the spider can make a Dexterity check with DC equal to the attack roll.
On a success, the spider teleports up to 15 feet and the attack misses.

trait.name: Chemoreception
entries: While submerged in a body of water, the crab can detect the presence and location of creatures in that water within 60 ft.

trait.name: Pinch
entries: When the crab takes the {@action Help} action to grant an attack advantage against a target within 5 ft. that is Concentrating, the target must make a {@dc 10} Concentration check.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 ({@damage 1d1}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Wave
entries: The crab raises its claw, waving it to attract attention. Each creature that can see the crab subtracts 2 ({@dice 1d4}) from Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that it makes to perceive creatures other than the crab on its following turn.

reaction.name: Scuttle
entries: As a reaction to being forced to make a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the crab moves up to 5 ft. If this movement puts the crab out of range or area of the spell or magical effect, the crab is unaffected.

trait.name: Dweomersense Antennae
entries: The hunter can pinpoint, by scent, any magic items or active spells within 120 feet of it, and has advantage on Dexterity saving throws against spells and other magic effects.

trait.name: Cryptic Camouflage

action.name: Hydraulic Evisceration {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take 15 ({@damage 6d4}) piercing damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Jink

reaction.name: Mothdream Dust

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The imp can use its action to polymorph into a beast form that resembles a rat (speed 20 ft.), a raven (20 ft., fly 60 ft.), or a spider (20 ft., climb 20 ft.), or back into its true form. Its statistics are the same in each form, except for the speed changes noted. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Devil's Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the imp's {@sense darkvision}.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The imp has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Sting (Bite in Beast Form)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage, and the target must make a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw, taking 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Diabolical Stench {@recharge 5}
entries: The imp emits an {@condition invisible} cloud of sickening gas. Creatures within 5 feet of the imp must make a {@dc 11} or be {@condition poisoned}. While {@condition poisoned} in this way, it takes {@damage 1d6} poison damage at the start of each of its turns. A {@condition poisoned} creature may repeat this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success, or may end the effect early by using its action to retch.

action.name: Invisibility
entries: The imp magically turns {@condition invisible} until it attacks or until its {@status concentration} ends (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). Any equipment the imp wears or carries is {@condition invisible} with it.

trait.name: Air-Hungry
entries: If the elemental takes any cold damage or is doused in a non-flammable substance, its flames diminish.
Until the end of its next turn, the elemental can't take reactions, and its traits and abilities do not inflict the {@condition burning|confc|burning} condition.

trait.name: Fire Incarnate
entries: The elemental can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing, and can move through and stop in the space of other creatures.
A creature who has the elemental enter its space for the first time in a turn takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage and begins {@condition burning|confc|burning} ({@dice 1d10}).

action.name: Stoke
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d10 + 3}) fire damage.
A {@condition burning|confc|burning} target takes an additional 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage.

action.name: Seethe
entries: The elemental's flames darken and roil. The first time the elemental takes any non-cold damage before the beginning of its next turn, flame bursts forth from it in a 15 foot radius.
Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or take 11 ({@damage 2d10}) fire damage and be pushed up to 5 feet away, or take half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Flashover (1/Day)
entries: When the elemental is reduced below 52 hit points, it can cause each creature and flammable object within 20 feet of it to begin {@condition burning|confc|burning} ({@dice 1d10}).
A creature or object in the area that is already {@condition burning|confc|burning} instead takes 16 ({@damage 3d10}) fire damage.

trait.name: Fire Step
entries: Surfaces the myrmidon moves over ignite and burn for 1 minute. A creature that starts its turn in a burning area, or enters it for the first time on a turn, takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage.

trait.name: Wind-Whipped
entries: {@action opportunity attack||Attacks of opportunity} against the myrmidon are made at disadvantage. If an {@action opportunity attack||attack of opportunity} misses it, the attacker is pulled 5 feet towards the myrmidon.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The myrmiddon makes three melee attacks, one of which it may replace with its Burning Steel, if available.

action.name: Molten Lash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) slashing damage and 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage. If the target is wearing metal armor, it takes an additional 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Burning Steel {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature in a 15 ft. cone that is wielding a metal weapon takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) damage and must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or drop its weapon in an adjacent space.

reaction.name: Elemental Riposte
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack, the myrmidon unleashes a burst of fire. The attacker must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or catch fire; until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the creature takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the giant may spend half of its movement to attempt a {@dc 19} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the giant. While climbing on the giant, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the giant, and the giant has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

trait.name: Inner Fire
entries: A creature without fire resistance or immunity that touches the giant or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it catches fire; until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the creature takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

trait.name: Dampen Flames
entries: If the giant takes any cold damage, its Inner Fire trait is disabled until the beginning of its next turn, and the next attack made against it is made at advantage.

A creature that passes this save may use its reaction to move 5 feet, taking no damage if it ends this movement outside the affected area.
