entries: Each friendly giant within 20 ft. gains 10 temporary hit points.

trait.name: Fire Step
entries: Surfaces the mephit moves over ignite and burn for 1 minute. A creature that starts its turn in a burning area, or enters a burning area for the first time on a turn, takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a burst of fire. Each creature within 15 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw or begin {@condition burning|confc|burning} ({@dice 1d10}).

action.name: Glowing Touch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) fire damage. If the target is wearing metal armor, it takes an additional 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Burning Steel {@recharge}
entries: Each creature in a 15 foot cone that is wielding a metal weapon takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) damage and must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or drop its weapon in an adjacent space.

reaction.name: Wind-Whipped
entries: When a creature makes an {@action opportunity attack} against it, the mephit can impose disadvantage on the attack. If the attack misses, the attacker is dragged up to 5 feet behind the mephit.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The firenewt can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Cold Blooded
entries: If the firenewt takes cold damage, it cannot make more than one attack on its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The firenewt makes two attacks with its scimitar.

action.name: Scimitar
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) slashing damage.

action.name: Regrow Limb
entries: The firenewt regrows one missing limb, which bursts out in a gout of scalding steam. The firenewt regains the use of its limb, and each creature in a 15 ft. cone must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage and be unable to speak or breathe until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Drop Limb
entries: As a reaction to taking 6 or more damage, the firenewt drops one of its limbs, reducing the damage taken to 5. A firenewt that drops an arm loses the use of either its scimitar or shield. A firenewt that drops a leg reduces its maximum speed by half.

trait.name: Flail Tentacles
entries: The flail snail has five flail tentacles. Whenever the snail takes 10 or more damage from a single source, one of its tentacles dies. If the snail has no tentacles remaining, it retracts into its shell and begins to wail loudly.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The flail snail makes as many flail tentacle attacks as it has flail tentacles, then uses its Shift Harmonics.

action.name: Flail Tentacle
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage. If this attack misses by 5 or more, the target may use its reaction to make a single melee attack against the snail.

action.name: Shift Harmonics
entries: The snail shifts the swirling patterns of its shell, adopting one of the following effects until the beginning of its next turn.

items.name: Resistance
entries: The snail has advantage on saving throws against spells.

items.name: Diffraction
entries: Spell attacks made against the snail have disadvantage.

items.name: Reflection
entries: If the snail is missed with a spell attack, the spell is reflected back at its caster.

reaction.name: Shell Defense
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a ranged weapon attack, the snail withdraws into its shell, gaining a +4 bonus to AC until the beginning of its next turn. It cannot attack while withdrawn.

trait.name: Flail Tentacles
entries: The flail snail has five flail tentacles. Whenever the snail takes 10 or more damage from a single source, one of its tentacles dies. If the snail has no tentacles remaining, it retracts into its shell and begins to wail loudly.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The flail snail makes as many flail tentacle attacks as it has flail tentacles, then uses its Shift Harmonics.

action.name: Flail Tentacle
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage. If this attack misses by 5 or more, the target may use its reaction to make a single melee attack against the snail.

action.name: Shift Harmonics
entries: The snail shifts the swirling patterns of its shell, adopting two of the following effects until the beginning of its next turn.

items.name: Resistance
entries: The snail has advantage on saving throws against spells.

items.name: Diffraction
entries: Spell attacks made against the snail have disadvantage.

items.name: Reflection
entries: If the snail is missed with a spell attack, the spell is reflected back at its caster.

items.name: Refraction
entries: If the snail succeeds on a saving throw against a spell, the spell's energy is converted into a magical explosion. Each creature within 30 ft. of the snail must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take {@damage 1d6} force damage per level of the spell, or half as much on a success.

items.name: Absorption
entries: If the snail is targeted with a spell, it gains 10 ({@dice 3d6}) temporary hit points.

reaction.name: Shell Defense
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a ranged weapon attack, the snail withdraws into its shell, gaining a +4 bonus to AC until the beginning of its next turn. It cannot attack while withdrawn.

trait.name: Illumination
entries: The flameskull sheds either dim light in a 15-foot radius, or bright light in a 15-foot radius and dim light for an additional 15 feet. It can switch between the options as an action.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If the flameskull is destroyed, it regains all its hit points in 1 hour unless holy water is sprinkled on its remains or a {@spell Dispel Magic} or {@spell Remove Curse} spell is cast on them.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The flameskull has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Spontaneous Combustion (4th Level Spell)
entries: One creature within 40 feet that the flameskull can see must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) fire damage and ignite.
Until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls and takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage at the end of each of its turns.

action.name: Fireburst (1st level Spell)
entries: One burning creature within 20 feet erupts in an explosion of flame. Each creature within 20 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage.

reaction.name: Screaming Flame (1st Level Spell)
entries: When the flameskull is targeted with a melee attack, it screams a gout of flame at the attacker, forcing it to succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage and make its attack with disadvantage.

monster.name: Flesh Golem
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Aversion to Fire
entries: If the golem takes fire damage, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Wounded Fury
entries: While it has 20 hit points or fewer, the golem has advantage on attack rolls and its melee attacks deal an additional 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage.

trait.name: Lightning Absorption
entries: Whenever the golem is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt.

trait.name: Resilient Animus
entries: If the golem would take 9 or fewer Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage from a single source, it instead takes no damage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes two slam attacks, one of which it may replace with a hurl.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}).

action.name: Throttle
entries: One {@condition grappled} creature must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 27 ({@damage 6d8}) bludgeoning damage and be unable to speak or breathe until the end of the golem's next turn.

action.name: Hurl
entries: The golem hurls a {@condition grappled} creature up to 20 feet. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity Saving Throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}. On a successful save, the creature takes half damage and isn't knocked {@condition prone}.

monster.name: Flesh Golem Assimilator
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Graft-Host
entries: For each additional limb attached with its Claim Flesh ability, the golem's speed is reduced by 5. The golems limbs, if removed and attached to another creature within 1 minute, will magically attach to that creature.

trait.name: Lightning Absorption
entries: Whenever the golem is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Resilient Animus
entries: If the golem would take 12 or fewer damage from a single source, it instead takes no damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes three attacks with its Slam, one of which it may replace with a Throttle or Hurl.
It makes an additional attack with its Wild Flailing for each limb attached with its Claim Flesh ability.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@dice 2d10 + 5}) bludgeoning plus 11 ({@damage 3d10}) necrotic damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}).

action.name: Wild Flailing
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d4 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Throttle
entries: One {@condition grappled} creature must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or take 27 ({@damage 6d8}) bludgeoning damage and be unable to speak or breathe until the end of the golem's next turn.

action.name: Hurl
entries: The golem hurls a {@condition grappled} creature up to 30 feet. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity Saving Throw or take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Claim Flesh {@recharge 5}
entries: The golem attempts to tear a limb from a living creature and attach it to its own body. One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or take 66 ({@damage 12d10}) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature that failed this save and is reduced to 0 hit points in this way has one of its limbs torn off and magically attached to the golem.

trait.name: Innocent Heart
entries: Walter's infant corpse lies at the center of the flesh mound, crying and afraid. Walter is part of the flesh mound, but has the following properties:
A creature with at least 15 Passive {@skill Perception}, or a creature engulfed by the flesh mound, can discern his location.
Attacks against Walter are made at disadvantage.
Attacks against Walter deal double damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shambling mound makes two slam attacks. If both attacks hit a Medium or smaller target, the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}).

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Boring Tendrils
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the mound must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw as the shambling mound attempts to bore roots through its flesh. On a failed save, the creature takes 18 ({@damage 4d8}) necrotic damage, and its HP maximum is reduced by the same amount.

action.name: Engulf
entries: The shambling mound engulfs a Medium or smaller creature {@condition grappled} by it. The engulfed target is {@condition restrained}, and unable to breathe, and it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw at the start of each of the mound's turns or take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage. If the mound moves, the engulfed target moves with it. The mound can have only one creature engulfed at a time.

reaction.name: Grasping Hide
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the flesh mound can force the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be {@condition grappled}.

trait.name: Snatcher
entries: If the ghoul has a creature {@condition grappled}, it may {@action Dash} as a Bonus Action.

trait.name: Diseased Blood
entries: A creature that deals piercing or slashing damage to the ghoul with a melee attack must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or contract Ghoul Fever.

action.name: Fleshripper Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}4 ({@dice 1d6 + 1}) piercing plus 5 ({@damage 1d10}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Death Grip
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}). A creature that ends its turn {@condition grappled} in this way must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Advanced Telepathy
entries: The flumph can perceive the content of any telepathic communication used within 60 feet of it, and it can't be surprised by creatures with any form of telepathy.

trait.name: Prone Deficiency
entries: If the flumph is knocked {@condition prone}, it must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition incapacitated}. At the end of each of its turns, the flumph can repeat this save, righting itself and ending the {@condition incapacitated} condition if it succeeds.

trait.name: Indifferent Aura
entries: A creature that attempts to look at the flump must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or be compelled to avert its gaze. A creature that fails this save becomes indifferent to the flumph's presence for the next minute, and retains no memory of the actions the flumph takes while the creature is affected.

action.name: Spiny Drop
entries: One creature that the Flumph is flying over must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn. While {@condition poisoned} in this way, the creature takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) acid damage at the start of its turn. A creature that passes the saving throw by 5 or more knocks the flumph {@condition prone} in an adjacent space.

action.name: Stench Spray (1/Day)
entries: Each creature in a 15-foot cone originating from the flumph must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw or be coated in a foul-smelling liquid. A coated creature exudes a horrible stench for {@dice 1d4} hours. A creature can remove the stench on itself by using a short rest to bathe in water, alcohol, or vinegar.

trait.name: Mimicry
entries: The monkey man mimic the sounds of humanoid speech, albeit poorly.

trait.name: Lackey
entries: The monkey can follow simple instructions, such as going to a speciic location and fetching, delivering, or surveiling something.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The monkey has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the monkey's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d6}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Cold Blooded
entries: If the snake takes any cold damage, its speed is reduced by 10 until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Braille
entries: The snake's eyes are covered by transparent scales that protect them from harm. It has disadvantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight, and advantage on saving throws to avoid being {@condition blinded}.

trait.name: Gliding Flyby
entries: The snake may disengage as a bonus action. If it does, it cannot use its fly speed to gain altitude until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 3d4}) poison damage.

reaction.name: Bluff Strike
entries: As a reaction to a creature entering the snake's reach while it is not flying, the snake may force the creature to succeed on a {@dc 10} Wisdom saving throw or be forced to immediately move 10 ft. away from the snake, if it can.

trait.name: Gliding Membranes
entries: The squirrel glides 10 feet at no movement cost to it for every 5 feet that it falls.

trait.name: Skittish
entries: A creature within 30 feet of the squirrel that is hidden from it must make a new stealth check at the beginning of each of its turns to remain hidden from it.

action.name: Scolding Alarm
entries: The squirrel chirps forth a complex alarm signal. Each creature that the squirrel can see ceases to be hidden from any creature that can hear the squirrel.

reaction.name: Break Fall
entries: As a reaction when the squirrel passes within 5 feet of a climbable vertical surface while falling, it climbs onto the surface, arresting its fall and taking no damage.

trait.name: Animated Object
entries: If the sword is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as {@spell Dispel Magic}, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the sword remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal sword.

action.name: Drill-Thrust
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage.
This attack scores a critical on a 19-20.

action.name: Twirling Flourish
entries: One creature within 5 feet must make a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or have one object it is wielding flung up to 15 feet away.

action.name: Whirligig Rush
entries: The sword begins to spin wildly and moves up to half its speed. {@action opportunity attack||Attacks of opportunity} provoked by this movement have disadvantage.
Until the beginning of its next turn, a creature that misses the sword with a melee attack takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) slashing damage.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: The sword adds +2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it.

trait.name: Evil Eye
entries: When a creature that can see the fomorian starts its turn within 30 feet of the fomorian, the fomorian can force it to make a {@dc 14} Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the creature subtracts {@dice 1d4} from any attacks or saving throws it makes until the beginning of its next turn. Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If it does so, it can't see the fomorian until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the giant may spend half of its movement to attempt a {@dc 17} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the giant. While climbing on the giant, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the giant, and the giant has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fomorian makes two greatclub attacks. It may replace one gratclub attack with a use of its Share Curse ability.

action.name: Greatclub
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away. Creatures within 5 feet of the target must make a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw, taking half the attack's damage on a failed save.

action.name: Giant Bolas
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 9} to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} and {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 14}).

action.name: Share Curse {@recharge 5}
entries: The fomorian magically forces a creature affected by its evil eye to make a {@dc 14} Charisma saving throw. The creature takes 27 ({@damage 6d8}) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is also cursed with magical deformities. While deformed, the creature has its speed halved and has disadvantage on ability checks, saving throws, and attacks based on Strength or Dexterity.

reaction.name: Wrack
entries: As a reaction being hit with an attack by a creature affected by its evil eye, the fomorian may force the attacker to make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or take {@damage 4d6} psychic damage and be {@condition stunned} until the end of the Fomorian's next turn.

trait.name: Spiracle Breathing
entries: The formian has disadvantage on Constitution saving throws against inhaled toxins.

trait.name: Hive Mind
entries: Formians within 50 miles of their queen are in constant communication. If one is aware of a particular danger, they all are.

trait.name: Brittle Exoskeleton
entries: If the formian takes 15 or more bludgeoning damage from a single source, its AC is reduced to 14 until it completes a short or long rest.

trait.name: Death Throes
entries: When the formian dies, it explodes in a burst of acid. Each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) acid damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The formian makes two attacks, one of which may be with its mandibles.

action.name: Mandibles
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}13 ({@dice 2d8 + 4}) piercing plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage. This attack scores a critical on a 19-20 against a {@condition grappled} creature.

action.name: Grasping Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}). A creature {@condition grappled} by both claws is {@condition restrained}.

action.name: Acid Spray {@recharge 5}
entries: The formian sprays acid in a 15 ft. cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 36 ({@damage 8d8}) acid damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Hive Frenzy
entries: When another formian within 60 feet is reduced to 0 hit points, the formian can move up to 10 feet toward it.

entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d6 + 1}) piercing damage.

action.name: Seek Weakness
entries: The observer forces a creature within 30 ft. that it can see to succeed on a {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill Deception}) check or grant all formians advantage on attacks that target it until the end of the oberver's next turn.

action.name: Evaluate Remains
entries: The observer dissects the corpse of a formian that was killed by a weapon attack in the last minute. The formian gains resistance to damage from that weapon for the next hour, or until it uses this ability again.

reaction.name: Critical Observation
entries: As a reaction to a friendly formian it can see succeeding on a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the formian marks the event.
For the next 24 hours, each formian that shares a queen with the observer has advantage on saving throws against that spell or magical effect.

entries: The formian has disadvantage on Constitution saving throws against inhaled toxins.

entries: The formian makes three melee attacks, one of which may either be with its mandibles or sting.

action.name: Mandibles
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Drillmark Spear
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage. A creature hit twice by this attack in a turn must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

action.name: Sting
entries: One {@condition prone} creature within 5 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or take 17 ({@damage 5d6}) poison damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Drillmark Spear
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage. A creature hit twice by this attack in a turn must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

action.name: Tail Spines
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 100/200 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage and the spine embeds in the target's flesh. The target's speed is reduced by 5 ft. for each spine embedded in it.

As an action, a creature may remove all of the spines embedded in it, either by making a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check, or by taking 4 ({@damage 1d8}) slashing damage per spine removed.

reaction.name: Hive Frenzy

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the formian takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the formian takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

trait.name: Hive Mind
entries: Formians within 50 miles of their queen are in constant communication. If one is aware of a particular danger, they all are.

action.name: Mandibles (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}2 piercing damage.

action.name: Make Whole
entries: The formian repairs a single breach in a structure or vehicle no more than 3 ft. across, filling the space with its body. While using this ability, the formian is {@condition restrained}.

reaction.name: Hive Frenzy
entries: When another formian within 60 feet is reduced to 0 hit points, the formian can move up to 10 feet toward it.

trait.name: Shroud of the Hidden Hand (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
entries: When Fraz-Urb'luu is reduced to 0 hit points, he doesn't die or fall {@condition unconscious}. Instead, he resets to 200 hit points.

For the next hour, he becomes {@condition invisible} to creatures affected by his Lying Eyes trait and he can summon up to three creatures of CR 6 or below with his Illusory Fiend ability, instead of one.

trait.name: Lying Eyes
entries: Each creature within 60 feet of Fraz-Urb'luu that lacks Trusight can see only what he chooses for it to see.
He cannot use this ability to obscure or otherwise conceal himself while his mythic trait is not active.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Fraz-Urb'luu has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Ephemeral Resistance (4/Day)
entries: When Fraz-Urb'luu is targeted with a spell or magical effect, he can choose to teleport to an unoccupied space he can see within 30 feet, revealing his previous position to be an illusory trick.
If he does, he suffers no effects from the spell or magical effect.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Fraz-Urb'luu makes two attacks with his Phantasmal Fist, one of which he may replace with his Tail Thrash or a use of his Deceptive Charm.

action.name: Phantasmal Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 30 ft., one creature. {@h}23 ({@dice 3d8 + 9}) bludgeoning plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) psychic damage and Fraz-Urb'luu teleports to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the target.

action.name: Tail Thrash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. {@h}28 ({@dice 3d12 + 9}) bludgeoning plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) psychic damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 24} Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 15 feet away and knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Deceptive Charm
entries: One creature Fraz-Urb'luu can see within 60 feet must succeed on a {@dc 22} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by him for the next minute, or until it takes any damage.

action.name: Twisting Havoc {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature of Fraz-Urb'luu's choice affected by his Lying Eyes trait must succeed on a {@dc 22} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition charmed} by Fraz-Urb'luu and hostile to each other creature that failed this save until the end of his next turn.

reaction.name: Cruel Conciliation
entries: When Fraz-Urb-Luu is missed with an attack, he can use his Deceptive Charm against the attacker.

legendary.name: Phantasmal Fist
entries: Fraz-Urb'luu makes an attack with his Phantasmal Fist.

legendary.name: Corrupt Memories
entries: One {@condition charmed} creature Fraz-Urb'luu can see within 60 feet must succeed on a {@dc 22} Wisdom saving throw or have its Charisma score reduced by 4 ({@dice 1d8}), to a minimum of 1, for as long as it remains {@condition charmed}.

A creature that has its Charisma score reduced to 1 in this way believes itself to be a demon in Fraz-Urb'luu's service and remains {@condition charmed} until freed by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

legendary.name: Illusory Fiend (Concentration)
entries: Fraz-Urb'luu shapes the raw energies of the Abyss into a semi-real demon of CR 6 or lower in an unoccupied space he can see within 60 feet.
The demon acts on initiative count 0 under Fraz-Urb'luu's control, and is destroyed if it begins its turn more than 60 feet away from him, or if he loses {@status concentration}.

mythic.name: Disjunctive Touch
entries: Fraz-Urb'luu ends one spell or destroys one magic item of Very Rare or lesser rarity within 5 feet.
A creature wielding the magic item can make a {@dc 24} Dexterity saving throw, preventing its destruction on a success.

mythic.name: Hollow the Heart (Costs 2 Actions, 1/Day)
entries: Fraz-Urb'luu plunges his claw into the chest of a creature within 10 feet, forcing it to make a {@dc 23} Constitution saving throw.

On a failed save, Fraz-Urb'luu rips the creature's still-beating heart from its chest. The creature becomes {@condition dominated|confc|dominated} by Fraz-Urb'luu and dies if it ceases to be {@condition dominated|confc|dominated} by him.
On a successful save, the creature instead takes 55 ({@damage 10d10}) piercing damage. A creature with no heart succeeds automatically on this saving throw.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The frog can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The frog's long jump is up to 10 ft. and its high jump is up to 5 ft., with or without a running start.

reaction.name: Jumpy
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with a melee attack, the frog may impose disadvantage on the attack. If the attack misses, the frog may jump up to 10 ft. without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The froghemoth can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Shock Susceptibility
entries: If the froghemoth takes lightning damage, it suffers several effects until the end of its next turn: its speed is halved, it takes a -2 penality to AC and Dexterity saving throws, it can't use reactions or Multiattack, and on its turn, it can use either an action or a bonus action, not both.

trait.name: Toxic Secretions
entries: A creature that makes an attack that benefits from flanking the froghemoth must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or suffer 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The froghemoth makes two attacks with its tentacles and one with its bite. It can replace its bite with a use of its Tongue or Lob Mucous

action.name: Tentacle
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}) if it is a Huge or smaller creature. Until the grapple ends, the froghemoth can't use this tentacle on another target. The froghemoth has four tentacles.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d10 + 6}) piercing damage, and the target is swallowed if it is a Medium or smaller creature. A swallowed creature is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the froghemoth, and takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) acid damage at the start of each of the froghemoth's turns. The froghemoth's gullet can hold up to two creatures at a time. If the froghemoth takes 20 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the froghemoth must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls {@condition prone} in a space within 10 feet of the froghemoth. If the froghemoth dies, a swallowed creature is no longer {@condition restrained} by it and can escape from the corpse using 10 feet of movement, exiting {@condition prone}.

action.name: Tongue
entries: The froghemoth targets one Medium or smaller creature that it can see within 20 feet of it. The target must make a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the target is pulled into an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the froghemoth, and the froghemoth can make a bite attack against it as a bonus action.

action.name: Lob Mucous
entries: The froghemoth expels a large glob of mucous, covering a 20-foot radius area within 60 feet. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity Saving Throw or suffer several effects until the end of its next turn: its speed is halved, it takes a -2 penality to AC and Dexterity saving throws, it can't use reactions or Multiattack, and on its turn, it can use either an action or a bonus action, not both. A creature in the froghemoth's gullet when it uses this ability may attempt a {@dc 16} {@skill Athletics} or {@skill Acrobatics} check. On a success, the creature is launched out with mucous and must immediately save against it.

reaction.name: Fling
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack by a {@condition grappled} creature, the froghemoth may throw the creature up to 40 feet away. The creature must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Reel
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a ranged attack by a {@condition grappled} creature, the froghemoth may pull the creature up to 20 feet straight towards it.

reaction.name: Slam
entries: As a reaction to a creature casting a spell that targets the froghemoth, the froghemoth may lift the creature and slam it into the ground. The creature must make a {@dc 16} constitution saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 3d8}) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success. If the creature was {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell, it makes its save to maintain {@status concentration} at disadvantage.

trait.name: Keen Sight and Smell
entries: The owlbear has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight or smell.

trait.name: Cryptic Plumage
entries: While it remains motionless, the owlbear is indistinguishable from a large tree branch by creatures more than 30 ft. away.

trait.name: Concussive Strength
entries: A creature knocked {@condition prone} by the owlbear must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be unable to stand on its following turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The owlbear makes three attacks, one of which may be with its beak. A medium or smaller creature hit with two claw attacks in a turn is knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Frogmouth Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}).

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage and the target is pushed 5 ft. away.

action.name: Swallow Whole
entries: One medium or smaller creature {@condition grappled} in the owlbear's beak must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be swallowed.

While swallowed, the creature is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 16}), and takes 18 ({@damage 4d8}) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the owlbear's turns. While it has a creature swallowed, the owlbear's speed is halved.

reaction.name: Roaring Screech
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 56 hit points, the owlbear lets out an ear-piercing screech.

Each creature within 10 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be disoriented, making attacks at disadvantage until the end of its next turn. Additionally, a creature that fails this save falls {@condition prone} if it misses with a melee attack on its following turn.

trait.name: Ice Walk
entries: The giant can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the giant may spend half of its movement to attempt a {@dc 17} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the giant. While climbing on the giant, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the giant, and the giant has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The frost giant makes two attacks with its icy greataxe or its handaxes.

action.name: Icy Greataxe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}27 ({@damage 6d6 + 6}) cold damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away.
Each other creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

action.name: Handaxe
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 40/120 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 4d6 + 6}) slashing damage.

action.name: Cleaving Sweep
entries: Each creature in a 15 foot radius that isn't climbing on the giant must make a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take 26 ({@damage 4d12}) slashing damage and be pushed 10 feet away. A creature may fall {@condition prone} as a reaction to gain advantage on this save.

reaction.name: Icy Retort
entries: As a reaction to being attacked by a creature within 15 feet of it, the frost giant may force the attacker to make a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the attacker gains 10 ({@dice 3d6}) temporary hit points that last for one minute. While a creature has these temporary hit points, it is {@condition restrained} and has vulnerability to fire damage.

trait.name: Double Actions
entries: The giant rolls initiative twice, and acts on each of them.

trait.name: Ice Walk
entries: The giant can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The giant regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the giant takes 10 or more acid or fire damage from a single source, this trait doesn't function at the start of the giant's next turn. The giant dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the giant may spend half of its movement to attempt a {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the giant. While climbing on the giant, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the giant, and the giant has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

action.name: Glacierbreaker Greataxe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}33 ({@damage 4d12 + 7}) slashing damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away.
Each other creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

action.name: Mutant Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}25 ({@damage 4d8 + 7}) cold damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 19}). A creature that starts its turn {@condition grappled} in this way takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) cold damage. On a critical hit, the giant's arm shears off at the shoulder, retaining its grip against the target.

The arm is an object and can be destroyed (AC 15, HP 15). If the giant is missing an arm, attacks against it are made at advantage, it cannot make attacks with its Mutant Fist, and makes a {@dc 25} Constitution saving throw at the beginning of each of its turns, growing a new arm on a success.

action.name: Hurl Greataxe
entries: The frost giant flings its axe in a rotating arc. Each creature in a 60 foot line that is 10 feet wide must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving thow or take 19 ({@damage 3d12}) slashing damage and be knocked {@condition prone}, or take half as much on a success.

action.name: Vaprak's Rage {@recharge}
entries: The giant makes a mutant fist attack at advantage. If the attack hits, it is a critical.

reaction.name: Icy Retort

entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 120 ft., one target. {@h}49 ({@damage 10d8 + 4}) cold damage and the target's speed is halved until the end of the frost giant's next turn.

entries: The giant gains 25 temporary HP. While the giant has these temporary hit points, it has vulnerability to fire damage and a creature within 5 ft. that hits the giant with a melee attack takes 25 cold damage.

action.name: Wall of Ice (1/Day, 6th level spell)

entries: When initiative is rolled, the jarl and each friendly giant within 60 ft. may move up to its speed.

Each other creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

action.name: Hurl Iceberg
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 12} to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. {@h}29 ({@dice 4d10 + 7}) bludgeoning plus 27 ({@damage 6d8}) cold damage and the target is knocked {@condition prone}. Each other creature within 10 feet of the target must succeed on a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

action.name: Pillar of Ice
entries: The Jarl raises a 20 ft. high, 10 ft. across pillar of ice from a point it can see within 60 ft. A creature in the pillar's space when it appears must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take 36 ({@damage 8d8}) cold damage and be lifted by the pillar. The pillar has AC 12, 30 hit points, and vulnerability to fire damage.

action.name: Freezing Fog Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The giant exhales a gout of freezing fog in a 20-foot radius centered on itself. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw, taking 45 ({@damage 10d8}) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The area becomes heavily obscured for the next minute, or until cleared away by a strong wind.

legendary.name: Grip of Winter
entries: Swirling ice and snow descends in a 10 ft. radius centered on a point within 60 ft. for the next minute. A creature that starts its turn in the area or enters it for the first time on a turn takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) cold damage and has its movement reduced by half.

legendary.name: Eyes of the Storm
entries: The giant or one friendly creature within 30 ft. that it can see gains the ability to see unimpeded through fog and snow until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Sliding Cleave
entries: If the giant is not {@condition prone}, it falls {@condition prone}, slides 30 ft., and makes a melee attack. Large or smaller creatures in its path are pushed into the nearest unoccupied space.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant makes two attacks with its twisted ivory warhorn, one of which it may replace with a use of its compose verse ability.

action.name: Twisted Ivory Warhorn
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 ft. away.
Each other creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

action.name: Compose Verse
entries: The frost giant declaims a verse of battle-poetry. Up to two friendly frost giants within 30 ft. that can hear it may use their reaction to make a melee attack.

action.name: Recite Refrain {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature that understands Jotunise and can hear the giant within 30 ft. gains 10 temporary hit points. While a creature has these temporary hit points, its attacks score a critical on a 19-20.

reaction.name: Frosthunder Sounding (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 81 hit points, the giant sounds its warhorn, releasing a blast of sound and cold in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw, taking 27 ({@damage 6d8}) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

The ground in the area sprouts icy spikes, becoming difficult terrain for the next minute. When a Large or smaller creature moves into or within the area, it takes 5 ({@damage 2d4}) piercing damage for every 5 feet it travels.

trait.name: Ice Walk
entries: The witch can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.

trait.name: Biting Cold
entries: A creature that takes any cold damage while within 10 feet of one or more frost witches takes an additional 4 ({@damage 1d8}) cold damage for each frost witch within 10 feet of it.

trait.name: Frozen Magic
entries: If the frost witch takes any fire damage, it must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or be unable to cast spells until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The witch makes two attacks with its hoarfrost cudgel, one of which it may replace with a use of its Snow Blindness.

action.name: Hoarfrost Cudgel
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) bludgeoning damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) cold damage.

action.name: Snow Blindness (3rd Level Spell)
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 7} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 5d8}) cold damage and the target is blind beyond a 15 foot radius until the end of the witch's next turn.

action.name: Icy Blast (5th Level Spell) {@recharge 5}
entries: The witch sends forth a tide of flash-freezing water in a 30 foot line that is ten feet wide, turning the area into difficult terrain. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 27 ({@damage 6d8}) Cold damage, or half as much on a success. A creature that fails by 5 or more is {@condition restrained} by ice until the end of the witch's next turn (escape {@dc 15}).

reaction.name: Freeze Weapon (1st Level Spell)
entries: As a reaction to being hit by a melee attack with a metal weapon, the witch forces the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) cold damage and drop its weapon. If the creature attempts to pick the weapon up this turn, it must repeat the save.

reaction.name: Armor of Winter (1/Day, 5th Level Spell)
entries: As a reaction when the witch is reduced below 59 hit points, the witch gains 59 temporary hit points as crystals of jagged ice spiderweb across its body in shapes hinting at murals of death and dormancy.
While it has these temporary hit points, the witch has vulnerability to fire damage and a creature that hits the witch with a melee attack takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) cold damage.

monster.name: Frostlich
languages: Common plus up to five other languages

trait.name: Cryonic Return
entries: If the frostlich is destroyed, its spirit possesses the corpse of a humanoid creature trapped in its Glacier Tomb after {@dice 1d10} days, consuming the creature's soul in the process.

trait.name: Ice Walk
entries: The frostlich can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.

trait.name: Black Ice Aura
entries: The area in a 10 foot radius around the frostlich is difficult terrain. A creature that enters it for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the lich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The frostlich uses its Ice Needle Hail twice, one of which it may replace with a use of its Bleak Aurora or Glacier Tomb, if available.

action.name: Frostbite Touch
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}35 ({@damage 10d6}) cold damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or be afflicted with Frostbite.

action.name: Ice Needle Hail (4th Level Spell)
entries: Needles of glittering ice rain down in a 10 foot-radius, 40 foot-tall cylinder centered on a point the frostlich can see within 120 feet.
Each creature in the area takes 10 cold damage, then must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) piercing damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Bleak Aurora (5th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: Dull, shifting lights fill the air in a 40 foot radius centered on a point within 120 feet the frostlich can see, flaring brightly when they contact magic.

Ranged attacks that pass through the area are made at disadvantage, and a creature that casts a spell in the area must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Glacier Tomb (7th Level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature within 30 feet that the frostlich can see must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or gain 40 temporary hit points as translucent ice begins to encase it, or half as much on a success.
While a creature has any of these temporary hit points, it suffers the following effects:
It is {@condition restrained} and has vulnerability to fire damage.
It cannot speak or breathe.
It cannot rest or die.

It must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns or have its Strength and Dexterity scores reduced by 7 ({@dice 2d6}), to a minimum of one, until it is released.

reaction.name: Numbing Torpor
entries: When the frostlich is hit by a melee attack with a metal weapon, it can force the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or drop its weapon.
If the attacker picks up the weapon this turn, the frostlich can make a melee attack against it.

reaction.name: Freeze the Blood (1/Day, 9th Level Spell)
entries: When the frostlich is reduced below 107 hit points, it can force one creature it can see within 60 feet to succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or take 5 ({@dice 2d4}) points of {@condition exhaustion}, or half as many on a success.

legendary.name: Polar Burst
entries: Each creature within 10 feet of the frostlich must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 3d8}) cold damage and be pushed up to 10 feet away.

legendary.name: Sapping Cold
entries: One creature the frostlich can see must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or be unable to gain advantage on any roll for the next minute.

legendary.name: Bitter Stride (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The frostlich teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see and makes an attack with its Frostbite Touch.

trait.name: Knife Swarm
entries: The living spell can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and can move through any space that air can pass through without squeezing.
A creature that starts its turn in the living spell's space must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take 5 ({@damage 2d4}) slashing damage.

trait.name: Living Magic
entries: If the living spell is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as {@spell Dispel Magic}, it must make a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC.
On a failure, the living spell is {@condition stunned} (Save Ends at end of turn).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The living spell makes two attacks with its Ice Knife Slice, one of which it can replace with a use of its Cold Menace, if available.

action.name: Ice Knife Slice
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 feet, one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Cold Menace {@recharge 5}
entries: The living spell holds perfectly still, vibrating with barely {@condition restrained} menace.

Until the beginning of the living spell's next turn, when the living spell sees a creature within 60 feet move or take an action, it can use its reaction to make two Ice Knife Slice attacks against it.

reaction.name: Spiteful Shatter
entries: When the living spell makes an attack with its Ice Knife Slice, it can lose 5 hit points.
If it does, the target and each other creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) cold damage.

trait.name: Feather Step
entries: Fujinbo's high jump is up to 15 feet, or up to 30 feet with a running start. She may treat any surface, including leaves or falling snow, as solid ground.

trait.name: Harbinger of Strife
entries: When the daitengu or another creature within 30 feet makes an attack, it adds {@dice 1d4} to the result.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Fujinbo makes three attacks with her Serpent's Tongue Windspear, or makes one attack and uses her Rain of Stones, if available.

action.name: Serpent's Tongue Windspear
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@dice 2d8 + 4}) slashing plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Rain of Stones {@recharge 5}
entries: Fujinbo sweeps her spear, unleashing a gale that carries aloft a torrent of stones and grit in a 30 foot cone.

Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) bludgeoning damage and be {@condition blinded} until the end of Fujinbo's next turn, or take half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Disarming Gust
entries: As a reaction when a creature enters her reach, Fujino forces the creature to succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or have one object is carrying flung up to 15 feet away.

reaction.name: Twist Breath
entries: As a reaction when a creature Fujinbo can hear speaks a command or casts a spell, Fujinbo forces the creature to succeed on a {@dc 17} Charisma saving throw or have its words twist in its mouth, producing one of the following effects.
The command is changed to one of Fujinbo's choice.
The creature instead casts a different spell of the same level of Fujinbo's choice, with the same targets.

legendary.name: Soaring Leap
entries: Fujinbo jumps up 30 feet. {@action opportunity attack||Attacks of opportunity} provoked by this movement are made at disadvantage.

legendary.name: Trap Wind
entries: Fujinbo gathers air, compressing it in the tip of her spear. The next time she hits a creature with a melee attack, the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 30 feet away.

legendary.name: Cloud Aegis
entries: Fujinbo gains 11 ({@dice 2d10}) temporary hit points. While she has these, a creature that hits her with a melee attack must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away.

trait.name: Sickening Aura
entries: Whenever the lich is hit with an attack, each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of the creature's next turn. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is infected with Brittle Lung.

trait.name: Spore Seeding
entries: When the lich is destroyed, it begins to release spores. Unless the lich's body and the surrounding area are cleansed with fire or acid within the next minute, the spores drift far and wide, taking root in a fresh corpse and raising it as a new body for the lich after {@dice 1d10} days.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the lich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lich makes two attacks and uses its Sprouting Doom.

action.name: Horrid Growth
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}21 ({@damage 6d6}) poison damage and fungal growths root the creature in place, grappling it to the nearest surface (escape {@dc 19}).

action.name: Demonrot Barbs
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 60 ft., one creature. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d8}) piercing damage and the target suffers one effect of the lich's choice:
The creature loses any resistance or immunity to Poison damage or the {@condition poisoned} condition for the next minute.
One spell effect on the creature ends.
The creature has disadvantage on the next Constitution saving throw it makes in the next minute.

action.name: Sprouting Doom
entries: A roiling growth of multifarious fungus that lasts for a minute bursts forth in a 5 foot radius centered on a point the lich can see within 120 feet.

The area is difficult terrain for nonplant creatures, and a nonplant creature that starts its turn in the area takes 20 poison damage. This effect ends if the area is dealt 20 or more fire or radiant damage from a single source.

action.name: Sudden Wasting {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature within 5 feet of the lich may expend any number of hit dice to heal itself (without adding its Constitution modifier), then the lich may force it to succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or take 88 ({@damage 16d10}) necrotic damage, or half as much on a success.
If the target is killed by this damage, its flesh rots away into a putrid slurry, and the lich immediately uses its Sprouting Doom centered on the creature's corpse.

reaction.name: Mycellia Snare
entries: When a creature ends its turn within 15 feet of an area affected by Sprouting Doom, the lich can force it to succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or fall {@condition prone} and be dragged up to 15 feet towards the area.

reaction.name: Brainrot (1/Day)
entries: When the lich is reduced below 94 hit points, it can force one creature it can see within 60 feet to make a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw.
On a failed save, the creature becomes hostile to all creatures for the next minute, then dies. This effect can be removed by any effect that cures disease.

legendary.name: Horrid Growth
entries: The lich uses its Horrid Growth against a creature in its reach, or against one it can see in an area affected by Sprouting Doom.

legendary.name: Parasitic Ruin
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the lich's Horrid Growth takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage. A creature that takes 15 or more damage from a use of this ability becomes {@condition restrained} for as long as it remains {@condition grappled}.

legendary.name: Sporeflight (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The lich transforms into a cloud of spores and moves up to its speed without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.
It can pass through the spaces of other creatures with this movement, and each creature the lich moves through must make a saving throw against its Sickening Aura.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a Bonus Action, the mimic can polymorph into a Large object or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: False Appearance (Object Form Only)
entries: While the mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary object.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mimic makes two Psuedopod attacks, one of which it may replace with its Ravening Maw or its Engulf ability.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}).

action.name: Ravening Maw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) acid damage.
This attack is made at advantage against a creature {@condition grappled} by the mimic.

action.name: Engulf
entries: One Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be engulfed in the mimic's space. A {@condition grappled} creature makes this save at disadvantage.
While engulfed, a creature is {@condition blinded} and takes 18 ({@damage 4d8}) acid damage at the start of each of the mimic's turns.

reaction.name: Adhesive Secretion
entries: As a reaction when a creature touches the mimic or hits it with an unarmed attack, the mimic grapples the creature (escape {@dc 15}).

reaction.name: Blinding Spray
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 68 hit points, the mimic launches a spray of blinding acid. Each creature within 20 feet must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) acid damage and be {@condition blinded} until the end of the mimic's next turn.

walk.condition: (30 ft. when rolling 60 ft. rolling downhill)

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the galeb duhr remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal boulder.

trait.name: Rolling Charge
entries: If the galeb duhr rolls at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a slam attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Clang!
entries: A creature that misses the galeb duhr with an {@action opportunity attack||attack of opportunity} must make a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be disarmed and have its weapon flung 15 feet in a random direction.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Shockwave {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature in a 30 ft. cone must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 19 ({@damage 3d12}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}, or half as much damage on a success. Additionally, the affected area become difficult terrain.

reaction.name: Animated Boulders
entries: As a reaction to a creature that is within 30 feet of a mundane boulder hitting the galeb duhr with an attack, the galeb duhr may cause the boulder to move up to 30 feet and make a slam attack against the attacker, using the galeb duhr's statistics.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks not made with silvered weapons

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: Garash regains 20 hit points at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 hit point.

trait.name: Sleek Coat Insulation
entries: While Garash has more than half of his hit points, he has resistance to cold and fire damage.

trait.name: Vampire Weaknesses
entries: Garash has the following flaws:

items.name: Forbiddance
entries: Garash can't pass through a doorway to a room that contains empty shoes pointed toward the doorway.

items.name: Burned by Salt
entries: If Garash has salt cast on him, he takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage and cannot regain hit points until the end of its next turn.

items.name: Sickened by Sea Parsley
entries: If Garash consumes sea parsley or is struck by a weapon coated in it, he must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of his following turn.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Garash fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Garash makes three melee attacks, one of which may be with his exsanguinating bite.

action.name: Exsanguinating Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage and the target loses 2 unexpended hit dice, or drops to 0 hit points if it cannot.

action.name: Leg Hook
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}).

action.name: Crural Spur
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition grappled} creature. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Tide of Shades {@recharge 5}
entries: Garash unleashes a torrent of tormented spirits in a 30 foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on {@dc 16} Charisma saving throw or be possessed, acting under Garash's control until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Echoing Chuckle
entries: As a reaction when he succeeds on a saving throw against a spell, Garash disappears with an echoing chuckle, reappearing at the end of the turn in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the spellcaster.

reaction.name: Flair for the Dramatic (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to taking damage that would reduce him to 0 hit points, Garash reduces that damage to zero and immediately takes a full turn.

legendary.name: Shadow Jaunt
entries: Garash turns briefly to shadow and moves up to 30 feet, releasing any creatures he has {@condition grappled}. He has resistance to damage dealt by any attacks provoked by this movement.

legendary.name: Crural Spur
entries: Garash makes an attack with his crural spur.

legendary.name: Leg Hook (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Garash makes an attack with his leg hook.

legendary.name: Enveloping Cloak (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by Garash must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or be unable to speak or breathe for as long as it remains {@condition grappled}.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the gargoyle remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an inanimate statue.

trait.name: Brittle Body
entries: If the gargoyle takes 10 or more bludgeoning damage from a single source, it can no longer use its multiattack until it completes a short or long rest. If it takes 10 or more bludgeoning damage from a single source a second time, it loses its fly speed until it completes a short or long rest.

trait.name: Clumsy Flier
entries: The gargoyle falls at the end of a turn if it's airborne and the only thing holding it aloft is its flying speed. Attacks it makes while airborne are made at disadvantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gargoyle makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 3d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) slashing damage.

trait.name: Abyssal Inspiration
entries: On its turn, Gasbide may take an additional bonus action for each demonic shrine within 100 feet of him, to a maximum of three total bonus actions.
Each shrine is an object that can be attacked (AC 18; 10 HP; immunity to poison and psychic damage).

trait.name: Sun Sickness
entries: While in sunlight, Gasbide has disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws. Gasbide dies if it spends more than 1 hour in direct sunlight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Gasbide makes two attacks with its Toxic Touch, one of which it may replace with a use of its Manatrap Spores, if available.

action.name: Toxic Touch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@dice 2d4 + 1}) bludgeoning plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage. This attack is made with advantage against a {@condition poisoned} target.

action.name: Rhizome Bindings
entries: One creature Gasbide can see within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}) as pallid tendrils burst from the earth beneath it.
While Gasbide has any temporary hit points, it may use this ability as a bonus action.

action.name: Manatrap Spores {@recharge 5}
entries: Gasbide flares its gills and shudders, filling the air in a 20 foot radius around it with faintly luminous spores that last for a minute.

A creature that starts its turn in the area or enters it for the first time on a turn must make a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature loses its lowest level unexpended spell slot, and Gasbide gains 5 temporary hit points.

bonus.name: Invocation of the Rot Mother
entries: Until the beginning of Gasbide's next turn its melee attacks deal an additional 5 ({@damage 1d10}) necrotic damage to any creature that is {@condition poisoned} or infected with {@disease charnel lung|ConfC}.

bonus.name: Invocation of the Deep Father
entries: One creature Gasbide can see must make a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, attacks against that creature score a critical on an 18-20 until the beginning of Gasbide's next turn.

bonus.name: Invocation of the Formless One
entries: Until the beginning of his next turn, Gasbide gains advantage on Strength and Constitution saving throws, and suffers no effects on a successful Strength or Constitution saving throw.

reaction.name: Ruinous Foundation (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction when Gasbide is reduced below 69 hit points, it causes the ground within 20 feet of it to crack and churn, venting foul vapors as the fungal roots beneath are warped and corrupted.

The area becomes difficult terrain, each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for the next minute. A {@condition poisoned} creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

trait.name: Bone Titan
entries: A creature adjacent to the gashadokuro may spend half its movement to attempt to climb onto the gashadokuro's legs, or to climb between any two connected segments, with a successful {@dc 17} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.

items.name: Legs
entries: Whenever the gashadokuro moves on its turn, each creature climbing on its legs must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or fall off.

items.name: Arms
entries: Whenever the gashadokuro uses its Claw Sweep, each creature climbing on its arms must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or fall off.

items.name: Ribs
entries: A creature climbing on the gashadokuro's ribs has advantage on melee attacks against the gashadokuro.

items.name: Skull
entries: A creature climbing on the gashadokuro's skull has advantage on melee attacks against the gashadokuro. If a creature on the gashadokuro's head scores a critical hit against it, the gashadokuro falls {@condition prone} and takes 35 ({@damage 8d6}) bludgeoning damage at the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Sustained by Rage
entries: The gashadokuro does not die or fall {@condition unconscious} when reduced to 0 hit points.
Instead, it falls {@condition prone} at the end of its next turn, cannot stand, and deals half as much damage with its attacks and abilities.
Whenever the gashadokuro takes any radiant damage or starts its turn in sunlight, it loses one unexpended hit die, or dies if it cannot.

trait.name: Ravenous Resistance (Costs 3 Hit Dice)
entries: If the gashadokuro fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Clattering Snap (Costs 2 Hit Dice)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 15 ft., one {@condition grappled} target. {@h}The target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be decapitated.
On a successful saving throw, the target takes 64 ({@damage 10d10 + 9}) slashing damage.

action.name: Titanclaw Sweep (Costs 2 Hit Dice)
entries: The gashadokuro sweeps its bony claws in a 30 foot cone. Each creature in the area that is not climbing on the gashadokuro must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take 30 ({@damage 6d6 + 9}) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.
The gashadokuro may additionally grapple up one creature that failed this saving throw (escape {@dc 17}). Each other creature that fails this saving throw is pushed up to 15 feet away.
A creature that succeeds on this saving throw by 5 or more can use its reaction to climb onto the gashadokuro's arms.

reaction.name: Crush of Bones
entries: When a creature climbing on the gashadokuro's ribs deals damage to it, the gashadokuro can force it to succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take 28 ({@damage 8d6}) bludgeoning damage and be {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 17}) until the end of its next turn.
The gashadokuro can take one legendary action, choosing from the options below.

legendary.name: Roadstalker's Chatter (Concentration)
entries: The gashadokuro becomes {@condition invisible} to creatures more than 15 feet away from it until it takes another action.
A creature the gashadokuro can see hears a sourceless clatter of bone on bone whenever the gashadokuro moves.

legendary.name: Mekurabe Gaze (Concentration)
entries: The gashadokuro fixes its hollow gaze upon a creature that can see it within 60 feet, which can choose to either meet the gashadokuro's gaze or look away.
A creature that looks away takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) psychic damage, is {@condition frightened}, and has its speed reduced to 0 until the end of its next turn.

A creature that meets the gashadokuro's gaze must Concentrate on doing so, and while {@status concentration||concentrating} has advantage on saving throws against the gashadokuro's abilities. If the creature loses {@status concentration} before the gashadokuro does, its eyes blacken and it is {@condition blinded} until cured by Remove Curse or similar magic.

trait.name: Careening Slosh
entries: If the Gau Ding moves at least 20 ft. in a straight line, then moves in an opposed direction, it begins to slosh. Until the end of its turn, each creature that it passes within 5 ft. of must succeed on a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw or take 9 ({@dice 2d8}) fire and 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage.

trait.name: Dinner Bell
entries: A creature that misses the gau ding with a melee weapon attack is overcome with visions of itself being torn apart by hungry dogs. The attacker must succeed on a DC Wisdom saving throw or take 11 ({@damage 2d10}) psychic damage and be {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Cauldron
entries: The top of the gau ding is a boiling cauldron of bones and broth. A creature that starts its turn in the cauldron takes 22 ({@dice 5d8}) fire and 22 ({@damage 5d8}) necrotic damage. A creature killed by this damage can be disgorged as a wight under the cauldron's control. When encountered, the gau ding has 7 ({@dice 2d4 + 2}) corpses in its cauldron.

trait.name: Affection Weakness
entries: As bonus action, a creature that did not attack the gau ding this turn may attempt a {@dc 20} {@skill Animal Handling} check. On a success, the Gau Ding must succeed on a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} for the next minute by the creature, or until the creature deals damage to it.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: The gau ding can't be affected or detected by spells of 3rd level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Spiritlinked Resistance
entries: If the gau ding fails a saving throw, it may consume one of the corpses contained within it to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gau ding makes two attacks with its snatching claws.

action.name: Snatching Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 15} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 1d12 + 8}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (Escape {@dc 23}). The gau ding has two arms capable of grappling.

action.name: Snapping Jaws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 15} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d8 + 8}) piercing damage. On a critical hit, the gau ding bites off a hand or foot of the target.

action.name: Bay
entries: The gau ding lets out a terrifying polyphonic howl as flames burst from its mouths and eyes and its cauldron bubbles and sputters. Each creature within 120 ft. that can hear it must succeed on a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} of the gau ding for the next minute and drop what it's holding. A {@condition frightened} creature repeats this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Disgorge Animus {@recharge 5}
entries: Roll a {@dice d20}. on a 1-10, the gau ding births a {@creature wight|confc|Wight} from its cauldron. On an 11-17, it births a {@creature deathlock wight|confc|Deathlock Wight}. On an 18-20, it births a {@creature slaughter wight|confc|Slaughter Wight}.

reaction.name: Bones for the Broth
entries: As a reaction to being missed with an {@action opportunity attack||attack of opportunity} by a {@condition frightened} creature, the gau ding makes a snatch attack against the attacker.

reaction.name: Bloodied Birth
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 238 hit points, the Gau Ding immediately recharges and uses its Disgorge Animus twice.

legendary.name: Into the Pot!
entries: The gau ding tosses one creature {@condition grappled} by its Snatching Claws into its cauldron.

legendary.name: Spirit Breath
entries: Each creature in a 30 ft. cone must succeed on a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw or be {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 20}) by long, many-jointed spectral arms that extend from nearby surfaces. A flying creature has advantage on this saving throw. A creature that starts its turn {@condition grappled} in this way takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Psychic damage.

legendary.name: Body Breath
entries: The gau ding emits a torrent of slimy, half-dissolved flesh from one of its mouths. Each creature in a 30 ft. cone must succeed on a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw or be pushed 15 ft. away and take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) bludgeoning damage. The area becomes difficult terrain, and a creature that starts its turn in the area or enters it for the first time on a turn must succeed on a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Rattle
entries: A creature that hits the gaunt with a melee attack that deals bludgeoning damage must succeed a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn as it feels its own skeleton twitch slightly.

trait.name: Trampling Charge
entries: If the gaunt moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with a hooves attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Hooves
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage. The gaunt may make this attack as a bonus action against a {@condition prone} creature.

action.name: Grave Chill
entries: Each creature within 10 feet that is not riding the gaunt must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or suffer one of the following effects of the gaunt's choice until the end of the gaunt's next turn.

items.name: Leaden Steps
entries: The target's speed is reduced by 10 feet.

items.name: Numbed Fingers
entries: The first attack the target makes before the end of the gaunt's following turn is made at disadvantage. If the attack misses, the creature drops its weapon if it is wielding one.

items.name: Chattering Teeth
