entries: If the creature casts a spell with a casting time of 1 action, the spell does not take effect until the end of the gaunt's next turn.

reaction.name: Quick Kick
entries: When a creature makes an attack against the gaunt that benefits from flanking it, the gaunt can make an Hooves attack against the attacker.

monster.name: Gazer
languages: but can poorly mimic any language it has heard.

trait.name: Flighty
entries: An {@condition incapacitated} gazer subjected to the Find Familiar ritual is transformed into a familiar spirit. Its alignment changes to match that of its new master.
If a gazer made into a familiar in this way fails an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma saving throw, it regains its original alignment.

trait.name: Born Fink
entries: Each beholder within a 5 mile radius hears and sees everything the gazer sees.

action.name: Eye Rays
entries: The gazer shoots two of the following magical eye rays at random (reroll duplicates), choosing one or two targets it can see within 60 feet of it:

items.name: Dazing Ray
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} until the end of the gazer's next turn. While {@condition charmed}, a creature's speed is halved and it has disadvantage on attack rolls.

items.name: Fear Ray
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of the gazer's next turn.

items.name: Cold Ray
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) cold damage.

items.name: Telekinetic Ray
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or be pushed 30 ft. away from the gazer.

trait.name: Perfect Transparency
entries: If the cub has not moved or taken an action in the last minute and has no objects {@condition swallowed|confc|swallowed}, it is {@condition invisible} to creatures with a Passive {@skill Perception} lower than 13.

action.name: Membranous Extension
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 0} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}The cub presses itself against the target.
At the end of the target's next turn, it takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) acid damage if it is within 5 feet of the cub.

action.name: Engulf Object
entries: The cub Swallows a Tiny object within 5 feet that is unattended or carried by an {@condition incapacitated} creature.

A creature can retrieve the {@condition swallowed|confc|swallowed} object as an Action with a successful {@dc 10} Constitution ({@skill Athletics}) check, taking 3 ({@damage 1d6}) acid damage on a success or failure.

reaction.name: Suction Bond
entries: When a creature would leave the cub's reach, the cub can become {@condition attached|confc|attached} to the creature (remove {@dc 10}) until the beginning of the cub's next turn.

trait.name: Perfect Transparency
entries: If the cube has not moved or taken an action in the last minute and has no creatures {@condition swallowed|confc|swallowed}, it is {@condition invisible} to creatures with a Passive {@skill Perception} lower than 15.
A Medium or smaller creature that attempts to enter the cube's space is {@condition swallowed|confc|swallowed} by it.

trait.name: Gushing Collapse
entries: When the cube is reduced to 0 hit points, its membrane ruptures, spilling forth a torrent of cytoplasm.
Each creature within 5 feet of the cube takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) acid damage and is pushed up to 10 feet away.

action.name: Glistening Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d8 + 2}) bludgeoning damage.
This attack has advantage against a target with a Passive {@skill Perception} lower than 15.

action.name: Quivering Lurch {@recharge 5}
entries: The cube lunges up to 15 feet, and can enter the space of any Medium or smaller creature.

Each creature whose space the cube enters in this way must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or be {@condition swallowed|confc|swallowed} (escape {@dc 12}), or move to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.
A creature {@condition swallowed|confc|swallowed} by the cube takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) acid damage at the beginning of each of the cube's turns.

reaction.name: Wobbly Dispersion
entries: When the cube is hit with an attack by a creature not {@condition swallowed|confc|swallowed} by it, it can make a Constitution saving throw with DC equal to the attack's damage, reducing the attack's damage to 1 on a success.

reaction.name: Vacuole Encasement
entries: When a creature fails an attempt to free a creature {@condition swallowed|confc|swallowed} by the cube by 5 or more, the cube can Swallow it.

trait.name: Earth Glide
entries: The geoderm can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone without disturbing the material it moves through.

trait.name: Weathering Weakness
entries: If the geoderm is doused in water or takes any acid damage, the next attack that hits it ignores its damage resistances.

action.name: Jagged Crash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage and the target must choose one of the following:
The target is pushed 5 feet away.
The target takes an additional 4 ({@damage 1d8}) slashing damage.

action.name: Gleamvein Absorption
entries: The geoderm attempts to absorb a spell effect within 5 feet of it, making a Constitution saving throw against a DC equal to 10 plus the spell's level.
On a success, the spell ends and the geoderm's melee attacks have advantage for the next minute.
On a failure, the geoderm explodes in a spray of shrapnel, dealing 7 ({@damage 2d6}) slashing damage to each creature within 10 feet of it.

trait.name: Boulder Guise
entries: While fully withdrawn into its shell, the geonid can't see and is indistinguishable from a small boulder.

trait.name: Stone Tell
entries: When the geonid touches a stone, it learns the number and type of creatures that have passed within 10 feet of it in the past 24 hours.

action.name: Furtive Snatch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}The target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 11}).
While it has a creature {@condition grappled} in this way, the geonid can't target another creature with attacks or abilities.
If the target was already {@condition grappled} by the geonid, the geonid may instead steal one object it is carrying but not wielding.

action.name: Grinding Mouthstones
entries: One creature {@condition restrained} by the geonid's Drag In ability must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or take 5 ({@damage 2d4}) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.

bonus.name: Crush Toes
entries: The geonid lurches its shell heavily onto a creature {@condition grappled} by it, forcing it to succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or take 3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.

bonus.name: Drag In
entries: The geonid attempts to drag a {@condition prone} creature {@condition grappled} by it partially into its shell, forcing it to succeed on a {@dc 11} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 11}).

A Small or smaller creature that fails this saving throw is dragged fully into the shell, and while {@condition restrained} in this way is {@condition blinded}, makes checks to escape at disadvantage, and the geonid has vulnerability to damage dealt by it.

trait.name: Honorable Fealty
entries: While within 30 feet of a friendly humanoid creature of a CR at least 5 higher than its own, the okamian has advantage on attack rolls and Wisdom saving throws.

trait.name: War-Mage's Subterfuge
entries: Gerlonus' spells can't be countered by creatures more than 30 feet away.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Gerlonus makes two attacks with his Crackling Witchblade, each of which he may replace with a use of his Burning Bolt.

action.name: Crackling Witchblade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@dice 2d8 + 4}) slashing plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) lightning damage.
If it is raining, this attack deals an additional 7 ({@damage 2d6}) lightning damage.

action.name: Burning Bolt (2nd Level Spell)
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 7} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage and the target catches fire. Until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the target takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

action.name: Battle-Sanctuary (3rd Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: Gerlonus surrounds himself in a 30 foot radius sphere of dancing air currents that lasts for an hour. Ranged attacks made from outside the area that target creatures or objects within it are made at disadvantage.

action.name: Flooding Torrent (5th Level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: Gerlonus sends forth a torrent of water from his staff. Each creature in a 30 foot cone must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or take 27 ({@damage 6d8}) bludgeoning damage and be pushed 20 feet away, or take half as much damage and be pushed 10 feet on a success.

reaction.name: Torrential Retort
entries: As a reaction when he is hit with a melee attack while it is raining, Gerlonus forces the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be pushed 15 feet away and knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Cyclospore Anima
entries: At the beginning of each of the sporocyte's turns, one creature the sporocyte can see within 60 feet gains 11 ({@dice 2d10}) temporary hit points.
While it has any of these temporary hit points, a creature has disadvantage on Constitution and Death saving throws.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sporocyte makes two attacks with its fecund touch.

action.name: Fecund Touch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage, and the target has disadvantage on the next Constitution saving throw it makes before the end of the sporocyte's next turn.

action.name: Pallid Rooting
entries: One creature the sporocyte can see within 60 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for the next minute.

A creature {@condition poisoned} in this way repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success or taking 28 ({@damage 8d6}) piercing damage and being {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 15}) until the end of its next turn on a failure.

reaction.name: Spore Gout (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the sporocyte releases a torrent of spores in a 15 foot cone.
Each nonplant creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage and be infected with {@disease burrow-diver mycosis|ConfC}.

trait.name: Honorable Fealty
entries: While within 30 feet of a friendly humanoid creature of a CR at least 5 higher than its own, the okamian has advantage on attack rolls and Wisdom saving throws.

trait.name: Master of the Black Legend
entries: While a creature is {@condition frightened} by Gerwalt, it is also {@condition frightened} by each of her allies.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Gerwalt makes two attacks with her Cruciform Dirks.

action.name: Cruciform Dirks
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@dice 2d8 + 4}) slashing plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage.
On a critical hit, if the target is wearing armor gerwalt slices one of the armor's fasteners, reducing the target's AC by 2 until it takes a short or long rest to repair its armor.

action.name: Terror Strike {@recharge 5}
entries: Gerwalt makes a single melee attack. If the attack hits, it is a critical, and each creature of Gerwalt's choice within 15 feet must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the beginning of her next turn.

reaction.name: Feign Death
entries: As a reaction to taking damage, Gerwalt appears to die, falling {@condition prone} and slowing his heart rate. A creature may detect that he is still alive with a successful {@dc 16} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check.

trait.name: Sleek Coat Insulation
entries: While Gesi has more than half of his hit points, he has resistance to cold and fire damage.

trait.name: Skid-Shot Stance
entries: If Gesi would be knocked {@condition prone} by an effect, he may instead choose to be pushed 10 feet away from the effect's source.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Gesi makes two melee attacks, one of which may be with his Cannon Ram.

action.name: Cannon Ram
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away and knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Paddle-Tail Smack
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

action.name: Load Shot
entries: Gesi loads a 9-pound shot into his cannon's breach and sets a fresh fuse.

action.name: Light Fuse (Recharges when Gesi uses his Load Shot)
entries: Gesi lights his cannon's fuse, which begins to spark and smoke. At the beginning of his next turn, the cannon fires, hitting everything in a 100 foot line that is 5 feet wide and knocking Uri {@condition prone}.

Each creature in the area is knocked {@condition prone} and must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 44 ({@damage 8d10}) bludgeoning damage. A creature adds +1 to its saving throw for each piece of cover the cannonball passed through before reaching it.

reaction.name: Coordinated Reload
entries: As a reaction when a cannonball from Uri's Buck Shot lands in his space while his cannon's fuse is not lit, Gesi uses his Load Shot.

trait.name: Stench
entries: Any creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the ghast must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the start of its next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the ghast's Stench for 24 hours.

trait.name: Turning Defiance
entries: The ghast and any ghouls within 30 feet of it have advantage on saving throws against effects that turn undead.

trait.name: Dead Blood Burst
entries: When the ghast dies, each creature within 10 feet must make a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage and contract Ghoul Fever.

action.name: Fleshripper Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}12 ({@dice 2d8 + 3}) piercing plus 5 ({@damage 1d10}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Death Grip
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}). A creature that ends its turn {@condition grappled} in this way must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Tear Apart {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the ghast and at least one of its allies must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 5d8}) slashing damage, or half as much on a success. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage immediately fails a death save.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The ghost can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Spectral Weapons
entries: The ghost's attacks treat all creatures as unarmored (an unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier.)

trait.name: Agonizing Attachment
entries: Whenever 100 gp or more of its horde is destroyed in a turn, the ghost takes 25 psychic damage.

trait.name: Creeping Whisper
entries: The ghost is {@condition invisible}. Whenever it takes an action other than its Telekinetic Thrash, it becomes visible for 1 minute.

trait.name: Hordebound
entries: If the ghost is destroyed while its horde contains less treasure than it did at the moment of its original death, the ghost returns to undeath and regains all of its hit points after 9 ({@dice 2d8}) hours, appearing within 60 feet of its horde.
If the ghost's horde is restored to its original value, the ghost curls up atop the horde and vanishes, along with its horde.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ghost makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Spectral Bite.

action.name: Spectral Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}30 ({@damage 6d8 + 3}) cold damage damage and the target's speed is halved until the start of the dragon's next turn.

action.name: Covetous Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) necrotic damage and the target must make a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw.

On a failure, the ghost snatches one magic item or coinpouch the creature is carrying and flings it up to 30 feet towards the ghost's horde. If the ghost's Hoard Possession is active, it gains 10 temporary hit points.

action.name: Telekinetic Thrash (Recharges when the ghost uses its Terrormist Breath)
entries: Each creature within 20 feet must succeed on a {@dc 21} Strength saving throw or take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) bludgeoning damage, be pushed up to 20 feet in a direction of the ghost's choice, and be knocked {@condition prone}. On a success, a creature takes half as much damage.

action.name: Terrormist Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon exhales a cloud of shifting mists that heavily obscures the area in a 90-foot cone for the next minute, until cleared away by a strong wind, or until it uses this ability again.

A living creature that starts its turn in the area, or enters it for the first time on a turn must make a {@dc 21} Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 40 ({@damage 9d8}) cold damage and is {@condition frightened} until the beginning of its next turn as terrifying hallucinations overcome it, or takes half as much damage on a success. A creature that fails by 5 or more has its speed reduced to 0 until the beginning of its next turn.
A living creature that ends its turn in the area ages by 10% of its natural lifespan until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

reaction.name: Hoard Possession (1/Day)
entries: When the ghost is reduced below 163 hit points, the ghost draws its hoard into itself, forming a body of treasure. For the next minute, the ghost gains the following effects:
The ghost loses its Spectral Weapons and Agonizing Attachment traits.
All damage dealt to the ghost becomes psychic damage, instead of any other type.
The ghost's melee attacks are made at advantage, and deal an additional 13 ({@damage 3d8}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Omenfog Harbinger
entries: Air within 1,000 is filled with a freezing and malevolent fog, Heavily Obscuring all vision beyond a range of 30 feet.
Creatures in the fog subtract {@dice 1d4} from saving throws they make against being {@condition frightened} or against effects that deal cold damage.

trait.name: Ghostfire Wreath
entries: The ship is cloaked in dim, blue flames, and is visible as a faint glow from up to 120 feet away, even when Heavily Obscured by fog or water.

trait.name: Liquid Grave
entries: {@condition frightened} creatures within 120 feet of the ship must Concentrate to hold their breath.

trait.name: Sunlit Decay
entries: While illuminated by sunlight, the ghost ship loses its damage resistances and damage threshold, and can't take reactions.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ship makes two attacks, one of which can be with its Dread Ram.

action.name: Dread Ram
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 ft., one Large or larger target. {@h}The target must succeed on a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw or take 88 ({@damage 16d10}) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.
If this does not reduce the target to 0 hit points, the ship takes half the attack's damage.

action.name: Hangman's Rigging
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}The target is {@condition grappled} and suspended 10 feet above the ship's deck (escape {@dc 20}) until the rope is cut (AC 10, 5 hit point).
A creature {@condition grappled} in this way is {@condition choking|confc|choking} and takes 17 ({@damage 5d6}) bludgeoning damage at the beginning of each of its turns.

action.name: Encrusted Cannonade (Above Water Only)
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}44 ({@damage 8d10}) bludgeoning damage.
Whenever the ship misses with this attack, it gains a cumulative {@hit 1} to hit with this attack for the next minute, to a total maximum bonus of +12.

action.name: Bleakrime Gust {@recharge 4}
entries: The ship and each creature on it turn briefly to mist, then the ship moves up to its speed without provoking {@action opportunity attack||opportunity attacks}.

Each living creature it moves through in this way must succeed on a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw or take 18 ({@dice 4d8}) cold plus 16 ({@damage 3d10}) psychic damage and be {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn, or take half as much damage on a success.
A creature can't be reduced below 1 hit point by this damage.

action.name: 9 Fathoms Tread (1/Day)
entries: The ship binds itself to a vehicle directly above it within 60 feet, Cursing it until the vehicle moves more than 60 feet away from it.

At the beginning of each of its turns, the {@condition cursed|confc|cursed} vehicle must succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or have the ship control its movement until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Leaden Plunge
entries: When the ship is targeted with an attack, it can dive 30 feet directly downward, adding +5 to its AC against the triggering attack.
If it does, the ship can't take actions on its following turn.

monster.name: Ghostly Legionnaire
languages: the languages it knew in life

trait.name: Echo of History
entries: The legionnaire's attacks treat all creatures as unarmored. If a creature correctly identifies and speaks the legionnaire's origin, it loses this trait and its damage immunities until the next dawn.

trait.name: Soul Link
entries: When initiative is rolled, each legionnaire that rolls initiative pools its hit points into a single sum. Damage to a legionnaire deducts from that total. When the shared sum of hit points reaches zero, each legionnaire that pooled its hit points dies.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The legionnaire makes two attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its terror grip.

action.name: Spectral Blade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@dice 1d8 + 4}) slashing plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Terror Grip
entries: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) psychic damage and be {@condition frightened} until the beginning of the legionnaire's next turn. A creature {@condition frightened} in this way has disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws.

action.name: Battle Visions (1/Day)
entries: One creature within 5 feet must make a DC
15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed saving throw, a creature becomes indifferent to undead creatures and hostile to all living creatures as it hallucinates a long-forgotten battlefield.

The creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, taking 9 ({@damage 2d8}) psychic damage on a failure or ending the effect on a success. A creature that succeeds on this save has advantage on Intelligence ({@skill History}) checks to determine the legionnaire's origin.

trait.name: Demonic Hunger
entries: If the ghoul uses its Ghoulish Bite on a corpse, it gains resistance to all damage and advantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Snatcher
entries: If the ghoul has a creature {@condition grappled}, it may {@action Dash} as a Bonus Action.

trait.name: Diseased Blood
entries: A creature that deals piercing or slashing damage to the ghoul with a melee attack must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or contract Ghoul Fever.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ghoul makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Ghoulish Bite.

action.name: Ghoulish Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}11 ({@dice 2d6 + 4}) piercing plus 5 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} until the end of the ghoul's next turn.

action.name: Wretched Grasp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}). On a critical hit, the target is additionally knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Call to Feast
entries: The ghoul targets one creature it can see within 30 feet. Each creature within 5 feet of the target may use its reaction to make a melee attack against it.

action.name: Litany of Flesh Devoured {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature of the ghoul's choice within 30 feet that can hear it must make a {@dc 14} Charisma saving throw.

On a failed save, the next time that creature takes damage before the end of the ghoul's next turn, it takes the same amount of psychic damage. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more takes a point of {@condition exhaustion}, additionally.

reaction.name: Thrash
entries: When a creature {@condition grappled} by it begins to cast a spell, the ghoul can force the creature to succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or have the spell fail.

reaction.name: Uneasy Grave
entries: When a friendly ghoul the adept of Orcus can see dies within 60 feet, the adept of Orcus can reanimate it as a {@creature horde ghoul|confc|Horde Ghoul}.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the ghour moves at least 10 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 ({@damage 2d8}) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away and knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Desecrated Aura
entries: A creature that attempts to cast divine magic (such as a Cleric or Paladin spell) within 15 ft. of the ghour takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) psychic damage and is {@condition poisoned} until the end of the creature's following turn.

trait.name: Ferocity
entries: When the ghour is reduced to 0 hit points, it may use its multiattack before falling {@condition unconscious}.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The ghour has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Legendary Resistances (3/Day)
entries: If the ghour fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ghour makes three melee attacks, one of which it may replace with Baphomet's Rage.

action.name: Cleaving Greataxe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}24 ({@damage 3d12 + 5}) slashing damage. If this damage reduces a creature to 0 Hit Points, any excess damage can be applied to another creature within reach that has an AC equal to or below the initial attack roll.

action.name: Gore
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Baphomet's Rage
entries: One creature within 60 ft. that the ghour can see must make a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature must use its reaction to move up to 20 feet in a direction of the ghour's choice. If it ends this movement within 5 ft. of one or more creatures, it must make a melee attack against one of them.

action.name: Sickening Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature in a 10 ft. wide, 30 ft. long line must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or take 45 ({@damage 10d8}) Poison damage and be {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn, or half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Gouging Toss
entries: As a reaction to a creature moving within 5 ft. of it, the ghour forces the creature to succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) piercing damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Maddened Roar (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 137 hit points, the ghour lets out an earsplitting scream. Each creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of the ghour's next turn and {@condition deafened} for the next minute.

trait.name: Spiracle Breathing
entries: The ant has disadvantage on Constitution saving throws against inhaled toxins.

trait.name: Chemical Communication
entries: Each other ant within 120 ft. is aware of the number and type of creatures that the ant can see.

trait.name: In the Presence of the Queen
entries: Each other ant within 30 ft. has advantage on attack rolls and Wisdom saving throws.

action.name: Mandibles
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) piercing damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) poison damage.

action.name: Queen's Command
entries: Up to two friendly ants within 60 ft. may each move up to 20 ft. and make a melee attack.

action.name: Pheromonic Control {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature within 15 ft. of the queen must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by the queen for the next minute.
A {@condition charmed} creature repeates this saving throw at the end of its turns and whenever it takes damage, ending the effect on a success.

reaction.name: Call To Arms (3/Day)
entries: As a reaction to taking damage, the queen calls two soldier ants to burrow up from the earth, each appearing in an unoccupied space the queen can see within 60 ft.

trait.name: Reckless
entries: At the start of its turn, the ape can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls it makes during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Juggernaut Leap
entries: The ape's long jump is up to 40 feet and its high jump is up to 20 feet when it has a running start. If the ape jumps at least 20 feet, it may land in the space of any large or smaller creature. Each of those creatures must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. On a successful save, is instead pushed 5 feet out of the ape's space into an unoccupied space of the creature's choice.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ape makes two fist attacks.

action.name: Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d10 + 6}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}25 ({@damage 3d12 + 6}) piercing damage. This attack deals an additional 21 ({@damage 6d6}) damage to a {@condition grappled} creature.

action.name: Hurl
entries: The ape hurls a huge or smaller {@condition grappled} creature up to 40 feet. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}. On a successful save, the creature takes half damage and isn't knocked {@condition prone}. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Rock
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 9} to hit, range 50/100 ft., one target. {@h}30 ({@damage 7d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The axe beak has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the axe beak's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Vicious
entries: The axe beak scores a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

trait.name: Burst of Speed {@recharge 5}
entries: The axe beak may dash as a bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The axe beak makes one attack with its beak and two with its kick.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d10 + 5}) slashing damage. A {@condition prone} creature takes an additional 4 ({@damage 1d8}) damage to a {@condition prone} target.

action.name: Kick
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) piercing damage. On a critical hit, the target is knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The badger has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Ornery
entries: The badger does not die or fall {@condition unconscious} due to dropping to 0 HP if it was attacked by a hostile creature since the end of its previous turn. If the badger starts its turn with 0 HP without having been attacked since the end of its previous turn, it dies.

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The badger can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The badger attacks once with its bite and once with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 3d4 + 4}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Keen Hearing
entries: The bat has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing.

trait.name: Spirit Vapors
entries: The bat's breath is a heavy mist that settles across the ground beneath it. Creatures within 15 feet of the bat cannot benefit from invisibility.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bat makes two melee attacks and uses its Echolocation.

action.name: Vicious Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) piercing damage. This attack scores a critical on a 19-20.

action.name: Claw Rake
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}). This attack is made at advantage against a flying creature.

action.name: Echolocation
entries: If the bat is not {@condition deafened}, it gains one of the following benefits until the end of its next turn:

items.name: High Frequency
entries: The bat has advantage on melee attack rolls. Whenever the bat uses its Chaotic Swerve and the triggering attack misses it, the bat regains its reaction.

items.name: Sonic Assault
entries: At the end of the bat's turn, each nonbat creature within 30 feet that can hear it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition deafened} until the end of the bat's next turn and lose {@status concentration}, if it was {@status concentration||concentrating}.

reaction.name: Chaotic Swerve
entries: As a reaction when the bat is targeted with an attack, it may move 10 feet directly toward the nearest creature that is not riding it and impose disadvantage on the attack roll.

Then, if one or more creatures that are not riding it are within 5 feet of the bat, the bat and each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Concussive Strength
entries: A creature knocked {@condition prone} by the bear must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be unable to stand on its following turn.

trait.name: Rear Up
entries: The bear may use 30 ft. of its movement to stand upright until the end of its turn. While standing, the bear has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks and attacks made with its claws, and cannot attack with its bite.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bear makes three claw attacks, one of which it may replace with its bite or a use of its bluff charge, if available.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d8 + 6}) piercing damage. This attack does an additional 9 ({@damage 2d8}) damage to a {@condition prone} creature.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d6 + 6}) slashing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Bluff Charge {@recharge 5}
entries: The bear moves up to its speed towards a creature. Each creature within 10 ft. of where it ends this movement must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or fall {@condition prone} and be {@condition frightened} until the end of the bear's next turn.

reaction.name: Run Down
entries: As a reaction to a hostile creature the bear can see ending its movement at least 20 ft. further from the bear than it started, the bear moves up to its speed towards the creature.
If the bear ends this movement within 5 ft. of the creature, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Earth Scenting
entries: The boar has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell. It can sense the type, number, and direction of underground plants and animals within 25 feet of it.

trait.name: Ploughing Charge
entries: If the boar moves at least 20 feet in a straight line, it may move through the space of any huge or smaller creature.
A creature whose space the boar enters in this way must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}, or move to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The boar makes two attacks, one of which may be with its Trample.

action.name: Tusks
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) slashing damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

action.name: Trample
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition prone} creature. {@h}27 ({@damage 4d10 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Rooting Rush {@recharge 5}
entries: The boar moves up to half its speed, dragging its tusks through the ground, then flings them forward, spraying earth in a 15 foot cone.
Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}, or take half as much damage on a success.
The ground that the boar passes over with this movement becomes difficult terrain.

reaction.name: Foaming Defiance
entries: When the boar would be reduced to 0 hit points, it can make a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw. On a success, the boar is instead reduced to 1 hit point.
If triggered by piercing damage or a critical hit, this saving throw is made with disadvantage.

trait.name: Trampling Charge
entries: If the bull moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. If the target is {@condition prone}, the bull can make one attack with its hooves against it as a bonus action.

trait.name: Reckless Follow-Through
entries: At the start of its turn, the bull can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn. If it misses with an attack this turn, it is {@condition stunned} until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Gore
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}26 ({@damage 3d12 + 7}) piercing damage.

action.name: Hooves
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d10 + 7}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Thrashing Horns
entries: Two creatures on opposite sides of the bull must each succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or take 26 ({@damage 4d12}) piercing damage and be pushed 10 feet away, or half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Gouging Toss
entries: As a reaction to a creature moving within 5 ft. of it, the bull forces the creature to succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 3d8}) piercing damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Cold Blooded
entries: If the cobra takes any cold damage, its speed is reduced by 10 until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Braille
entries: The cobra's eyes are covered by transparent scales that protect them from harm. It has disadvantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight, and advantage on saving throws to avoid being {@condition blinded}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cobra makes two attacks; one with its bite and one with its constrict. It may either of its attacks with a use of its Threat Display, if available.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d6 + 6}) piercing damage and 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Constrict
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d10 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}).

action.name: Threat Display {@recharge 5}
entries: The snake raises upright, puffs up, and hisses. Until the beginning of its next turn, it may make a bite attack as a reaction to a creature entering its reach. If this attack misses, the cobra regains its reaction.

reaction.name: Crush
entries: As a reaction to a creature the cobra has {@condition grappled} with its Constrict ability speaking or casting a spell with a verbal component, the cobra crushes the air out of its lungs. The creature cannot breathe until the grapple ends and immediately begins to suffocate.

reaction.name: Bluff Strike
entries: As a reaction to a creature entering the cobra's reach, it may force the creature to succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be forced to immediately move 10 ft. away from the cobra, if it can.

trait.name: Water Camouflage
entries: The snake has advantage on stealth checks while submerged.

trait.name: Cold Blooded
entries: If the snake takes 5 or more Cold damage in a turn, its speed is reduced by 10 until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Braille
entries: The snake's eyes are covered by transparent scales that protect them from harm. It has disadvantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight, and advantage on saving throws to avoid being {@condition blinded}.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Constrict
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}13 ({@dice 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damag and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained} and the snake can't attack another target.

reaction.name: Crush
entries: As a reaction to a creature the snake has {@condition grappled} with its Constrict ability speaking or casting a spell with a verbal component, the snake crushes the air out of its lungs. The creature cannot breathe until the grapple ends and immediately begins to suffocate.

trait.name: Chemoreception
entries: While submerged in a body of water, the crab can detect the presence and location of creatures in that water within 60 ft.

trait.name: Brittle Shell
entries: If the crab takes 20 or more bludgeoning damage from a single source, its AC is reduced to 14 until it completes a short or long rest.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The crab makes two attacks with its claws.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d10 + 5}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}).

action.name: Crush
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the crab must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or take 45 ({@damage 10d8}) bludgeoning damage and suffer disadvantage on attack rolls that use Strength until it completes a short or long rest.

reaction.name: Scuttle
entries: As a reaction to being forced to make a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the crab moves up to half its speed. If this movement puts the crab out of range or area of the spell or magical effect, the crab is unaffected.

monster.name: Giant Crawling Claw
languages: understands Common and Giant but can't speak

trait.name: Delicate Joints
entries: If the claw takes 10 or more bludgeoning damage from a single source, it must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or fall {@condition prone} and release any creatures it has {@condition grappled}.

action.name: Giant Flick
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d12 + 3}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

action.name: Grasping Pounce
entries: The claw leaps toward a Medium or smaller creature within 20 feet and attempts to grasp it. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone} and {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}).

action.name: Crush
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the claw must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 3d8}) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Scuttle
entries: When the claw would make a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, it can move up to 10 feet.
If this movement puts the claw out of range or area of the spell or magical effect, the claw is unaffected.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The crocodile can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

trait.name: Poison Sensitivity
entries: If the crocodile has a creature {@condition grappled} and takes 5 or more Poison damage from a single source, it immediately releases its grapple.

trait.name: Grapple Vulnerability
entries: The crocodile can be {@condition grappled} by a creature up to two sizes smaller than it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The crocodile makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d10 + 5}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the crocodile can't bite another target.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target not {@condition grappled} by the crocodile. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Death Roll {@recharge}
entries: A creature {@condition grappled} by the crocodile must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or take 36 ({@damage 8d8}) slashing damage and be {@condition stunned} until the end of the crocodile's next turn, or half as much damage on a success. A creature reduced to 0 HP by this ability loses a limb (crocodile's choice). The crocodile may not use this ability if it is {@condition grappled}. nbsp;

monster.name: Giant Eagle
languages: understands Common And Auran but can't speak

trait.name: Keen Sight
entries: The eagle has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Dive Attack
entries: If the eagle is flying and dives at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a melee weapon attack, the attack scores a critical on an 19, or 20.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The eagle makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its talons.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) slashing damage. On a critical hit, the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}).

monster.name: Giant Elk
languages: and Sylvan but can't speak them

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the elk moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with an antler rush attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Springing Grace
entries: The elk's high jump is up to 15 ft., or up to 30 ft. with a running start. It may treat any surface at least 1 inch across as solid ground to jump off of.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The elk makes two melee attacks, one of which it may replace with its Unearthly Scream, if available.

action.name: Antler Rush
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) piercing damage and the target is pushed 10 ft. away.

action.name: Rearing Kick
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition prone} creature. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d8 + 4}) slashing damage. A {@condition prone} target takes an additional 9 ({@damage 2d8}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Unearthly Scream {@recharge 5}
entries: The elk releases a haunting sound. Each creature within 60 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be unable to take hostile action on its following turn.

reaction.name: Elusive Sidle
entries: As a reaction to a creature ending its movement within 5 ft. of the elk, the elk moves up to half its speed in any direction other than directly away from the creature without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The frog can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The frog's long jump is up to 40 feet and its high jump is up to 20 feet, with or without a running start.

trait.name: Poisonous
entries: A creature that hits the frog with a melee attack using Natural Weapons takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) poison damage. If this damage reduces the frog to 0 hit points, the attacker must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 3d12 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and 22 ({@damage 4d10}) poison damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the frog can't bite another target.

action.name: Tongue
entries: One Huge or smaller creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 25 ft towards the frog, which can use a bonus action to make a bite attack against it.

action.name: Swallow
entries: The frog makes one bite attack against a Large or smaller target it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. The swallowed target is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the frog, and it takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) acid damage at the start of each of the frog's turns. If the frog dies, a swallowed creature can escape from the corpse using 5 feet of movement, exiting {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Jumpy
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with a melee attack, the frog may impose disadvantage on the attack. If the attack misses, the frog may jump up to 40 ft. without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

trait.name: Ornery
entries: The goat does not die or fall {@condition unconscious} due to dropping to 0 HP if it was attacked by a hostile creature since the end of its previous turn. If the goat starts its turn with 0 HP without having been attacked since the end of its previous turn, it dies.

trait.name: Pushy
entries: If the goat moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a ram attack on the same turn, the target is pushed 15 ft. away. If it is pushed into a wall or other solid surface, the creature takes an additional 10 ({@damage 3d6}) damage.

trait.name: Sure-Footed
entries: The goat has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws made against effects that would knock it {@condition prone}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The goat attacks once with its bite and once with its ram.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Ram
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Keen Sight
entries: The hawk has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Air Superiority
entries: If the hawk descended at least 60 ft. this turn, it may {@action Dash} or {@action Disengage} as a Bonus Action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hawk makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its talons.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) slashing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}).

trait.name: Rampage
entries: When the hyena reduces a creature to 0 hit points on its turn, the hyena can take a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make a bite attack.

trait.name: Opportunist
entries: The hyena has advantage on attack rolls against a creature unless that creature hit it with a melee attack since the end of the hyena's last turn.

action.name: Latching Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}33 ({@damage 4d12 + 7}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the hyena can't bite another target.

action.name: Crush Bones
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the hyena takes 52 ({@damage 8d12}) piercing damage and must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or suffer disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws that use Strength until it completes a short or long rest.

reaction.name: Giggling Retreat
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the hyena moves up to 10 ft. without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}, emitting an unsettling laugh. The attacker must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be unable to move closer to the hyena this turn.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The lizard can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Cold Blooded
entries: If the monitor takes 10 or more Cold damage, its speed is reduced by 10 until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Poison Sensitivity
entries: If the monitor has a creature {@condition grappled} and takes 10 or more Poison damage, it immediately releases its grapple.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lizard makes two attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}).

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) slashing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Tail Thrash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target the lizarad isn't grappling. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d12 + 5}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away from the lizard. Each other creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage and be pushed 10 feet away.

reaction.name: Drop Tail (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being hit with an attack, the lizard reduces the attack's damage to 0.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: While out of water, the octopus can hold its breath for 1 hour.

trait.name: Underwater Camouflage
entries: The octopus has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks and {@skill Deception} (Charisma) checks made to impersonate natural terrain or another aquatic creature.

trait.name: Boneless
entries: The octopus can move through a space as narrow as 1 feet wide without squeezing.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The octopus makes two tentacle attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its fling

action.name: Tentacles
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}.

action.name: Fling
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the octopus is thrown up to 30 feet. If a thrown target strikes a solid surface, the target takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage.

action.name: Blanket (underwater only) {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature in a 15 ft. radius sphere must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition grappled} and pulled up to 5 ft. toward the octopus. Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}. A creature without a swim speed makes this save at disadvantage.

reaction.name: Ink Cloud (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 55 hit points while underwater, the octopus exudes a 20-foot-radius cloud of ink around itself. The area is heavily obscured for 1 minute, although a significant current can disperse the ink. After releasing the ink, the octopus can use the {@action Dash} or {@action Hide} action as a bonus action.

trait.name: Keen Sight
entries: The owl has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Raking Flyby
entries: The owl does not provoke {@action opportunity attack||Opportunity Attacks} from creatures that it started its turn hidden from.

trait.name: Silent Flight
entries: While flying in dim light or darkness, the owl can take the {@action Hide} action as a Bonus Action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The owl makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its talons.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) slashing damage. On a critical hit, the target is {@condition grappled} and {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 16}).

trait.name: Defensive Huddle
entries: While within 5 feet of one or more Huge or larger friendly creatures, attacks against the penguin are made at disadvantage.
If a friendly creature within 5 feet of the penguin that is larger than it succeeds on a saving throw, it may prevent the penguin from taking any damage.

trait.name: Awkward Waddle
entries: If the penguin walks more than 10 feet on its turn, it falls {@condition prone} at the end of its turn.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The penguin can hold its breath for up to 8 hours.

action.name: Muliattack
entries: The penguin makes two attacks, one of which may be with its Hooked Beak.

action.name: Hooked Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d10 + 4}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}).

action.name: Flipper Whack
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be pushed 5 feet away and knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Spined Gullet Shake
entries: The penguin throws its head back and shakes it, shedding accumulated salt.

If the penguin has a creature {@condition grappled} in its Hooked Beak, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or take 27 ({@damage 6d8}) piercing damage and be {@condition swallowed|confc|swallowed} (escape {@dc 15}).

reaction.name: Bergshaker Belly Slide
entries: As a reaction when the penguin falls {@condition prone}, it may slide up to 20 feet across level ground or up to 40 feet across downward-sloped ground.

Each creature in its path must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, moving to the nearest unoccupied space on a success or taking 9 ({@damage 2d8}) bludgeoning damage and being knocked {@condition prone} on a failure.

trait.name: Spiracle Breathing
entries: The ant has disadvantage on Constitution saving throws against inhaled toxins.

trait.name: Chemical Communication
entries: Each other ant within 120 ft. is aware of the number and type of creatures that the ant can see.

trait.name: Shield-Head
entries: The ant grants half cover against ranged attacks to creatures behind it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ant makes two attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its lower head ability.

action.name: Mandibles
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Headbutt {@recharge 5}
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage and the target musts succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Lower Head
entries: The ant lowers its head, increasing its AC by 2 until the beginning of its following turn. Each hostile must spend two feet of movement for every foot it moves through the ant's reach.

reaction.name: Hive Frenzy
entries: When another ant within 60 feet is reduced to 0 hit points, the ant can move up to 10 feet toward it.

trait.name: Sleek Coat Insulation
entries: While the platypus has more than half of his hit points, it has resistance to cold and fire damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The platypus makes two different melee attacks.

action.name: Bill Snap
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Leg Hook
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}).

action.name: Paddle-Tail Smack
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away.

reaction.name: Crural Spur {@recharge 5}
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack by a creature it has {@condition grappled}, the platypus forces the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage and be {@condition paralyzed} until the beginning of the attacker's next turn.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The rat has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Quick Squeeze
entries: The rat may move through any space larger than its skull without squeezing.

trait.name: Gnaw Through
entries: The rat can burrow a medium hole through one foot of nonmagical wood in one minute, or through one foot of stone or soft metal in ten minutes.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The rat has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the rat's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The rat makes two claw attacks. If both attacks hit the same target, the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or be infected with {@disease filth fever|ConfC}.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}).

trait.name: Slowed Metabolism
entries: The scorpion can survive up to a year without food or water, and up to two weeks without oxygen before suffering any ill effects.

trait.name: Heat Spasms
entries: Whenever the scorpion takes 10 or more fire damage from a single source, it makes a tail stinger attack against a random creature within reach.

trait.name: Brittle Barb
entries: If the scorpion is dealt a critical hit with a weapon that deals bludgeoning damage, it can't make attacks with its Tail Stinger until it completes a Short or Long rest.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The scorpion makes three melee attacks, up to one of which may be with its its Tail Stinger.

action.name: Grasping Pincers
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}).

action.name: Tail Stinger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@dice 2d10 + 5}) piercing plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be infected with {@disease wandering eye neurotoxemia|ConfC}.

action.name: Acid Spew {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the scorpion must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 36 ({@damage 8d8}) acid damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Twisting Tail
entries: As a reaction when a creature grapples the scorpion, the scorpion makes an attack with its tail stinger against the creature.

reaction.name: Chittering Feint
entries: As a reaction when the scorpion misses a creature with a Tail Stinger attack, it may reroll the attack with disadvantage.

trait.name: Test Bite
entries: If the shark starts its turn with no hostile creatures within 5 ft. of it, it may {@action Dash} or {@action Disengage} as a bonus action this turn.

trait.name: Blood Frenzy
entries: The shark has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

trait.name: Electrosensitive
entries: If the shark takes lightning damage, it has disadvantage on attacks on its following turn.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d10 + 6}) piercing damage and the target begins to bleed. At the beginning of each of its turns, the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or lose 5 ({@dice 2d4}) hit points, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Ram {@recharge 5}
entries: The shark moves at least 20 feet in a straight line towards a creature that does not have all its hit points and makes a bite attack against it. If the attack hits, the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of the shark's next turn.

reaction.name: Circle
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 64 hit points, the shark moves up to half its speed without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}. Each creature of its choice within 50 ft. that has fewer than 20 hit points must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Spiracle Breathing
entries: The ant has disadvantage on Constitution saving throws against inhaled toxins.

trait.name: Chemical Communication
entries: Each other ant within 120 ft. is aware of the number and type of creatures that the ant can see.

trait.name: Death Throes
entries: When the ant dies, it explodes in a burst of acid. Each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) acid damage.

action.name: Mandibles
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Acid Spray {@recharge 5}
entries: The ant sprays acid in a 15 ft. cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw take 13 ({@damage 3d8}) acid damage.

reaction.name: Hive Frenzy
entries: When another ant within 60 feet is reduced to 0 hit points, the ant can move up to 10 feet toward it.

trait.name: Web-Dweller
entries: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty.
While in contact with a web, the spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spider makes two attacks, one of which can be with its Paralyzing Bite.

action.name: Paralyzing Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}14 ({@dice 2d8 + 5}) piercing plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) poison damage.

A creature reduced to 0 hit points in this way stabilizes automatically, and becomes {@condition poisoned} for the next hour. While {@condition poisoned} in this way, a creature is {@condition paralyzed}.

action.name: Grasping Legs
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}).

bonus.name: Web Bind
entries: The spider attempts to wrap a {@condition grappled} or {@condition prone} creature within 5 feet in webbing, forcing it to succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 16}).
If the target is Large or smaller, the spider can attach the creature to its back as part of this action.

bonus.name: Tangleweb Launch {@recharge 5}
entries: The spider launches webbing in a 10 foot radius centered on a point it can see within 60 feet.

Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 16}). The webbing can be destroyed (AC 15; 15 HP; vulnerability to fire damage; immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage).

trait.name: Bioluminescent Strobe
entries: Whenever the squid takes 15 or more damage from a single source, each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the end of the squid's next turn. If the squid is in total Darkness, this radius is instead 15 feet.

trait.name: Boneless
entries: The squid can move through a space as narrow as 1 feet wide without squeezing.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The squid makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Poison Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition grappled} target. {@h}19 ({@dice 3d8 + 6}) piercing plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage.
If the target has an exoskeleton or shell, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Contitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the until the end of the squid's next turn.

action.name: Tentacles
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}). If the squid has only one creature {@condition grappled}, the creature is {@condition restrained}.

reaction.name: Ink Cloud (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 64 hit points while underwater, the squid exudes a 20-foot-radius cloud of ink around itself. The area is heavily obscured for 1 minute, although a significant current can disperse the ink.
As part of this reaction, the squid may move up to half its speed without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

trait.name: Bottom Camouflage
entries: While motionless at the bottom of a waterway, the turtle has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to blend in with its environment.

trait.name: Retract Head
entries: As a Bonus Action, the turtle may retract its limbs and head into its shell and end its turn. Until the beginning of its next turn, the tortoise's AC is increased to 20 and it can't take reactions.

trait.name: Cold Blooded
entries: If the turtle takes 10 or more cold damage from a single source, its speed is reduced by 10 until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Clamping Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}24 ({@damage 3d12 + 5}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} and {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 15}).
A creature that attempts to escape this grapple takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage.

action.name: Tongue Lure
entries: The turtle shifts a shiny organ at the tip of its tongue slightly. Each creature within 30 feet that the turtle is hidden from notices what looks like something metallic partially buried in the silt.

reaction.name: Snap
entries: As a reaction when a creature fails an attempt to grapple it or grab its tongue, the turtle makes a Clamping Bite attack against the creature.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the ant takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the ant takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

trait.name: Spiracle Breathing
entries: The ant has disadvantage on Constitution saving throws against inhaled toxins.

trait.name: Chemical Communication
entries: Each other ant within 120 feet is aware of the number and type of creatures that the ant can see.

action.name: Mandibles (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}2 piercing damage.

reaction.name: Hive Frenzy
entries: When another ant within 60 feet is reduced to 0 hit points, the ant can move up to 10 feet toward it.

trait.name: Aberrant Ground
entries: The ground within 10 feet of the abomination is doughlike difficult terrain. A creature in this area must spend half its movement to exit the area.

trait.name: Gibbering
entries: The abomination babbles incoherently while it can see any creature and isn't {@condition incapacitated}. A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of one or more gibberers and can hear the gibbering makes a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature must take the {@action Attack} action this turn. A creature that fails by 5 or more chooses targets at random among the creatures it can reach with its movement, itself included.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gibbering abomination makes two attacks with its slavering bite or uses its gibbering feast twice, and uses its blinding spittle, if available.

action.name: Slavering Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}20 ({@damage 5d6 + 3}) piercing damage. A target killed by this damage is absorbed into the abomination.

action.name: Gibbering Feast
entries: One creature the mouther can see within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 10} Charisma saving throw or take 20 ({@damage 5d6 + 3}) piercing damage as unnatural mouths grow from their body and bite them, after which they fall off and rot away immediately.

action.name: Blinding Spittle {@recharge 5}
entries: The mouther spits a chemical glob at a point it can see within 15 feet of it. The glob explodes in a blinding flash of light on impact. Each creature within 5 feet of the flash must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the end of the mouther's next turn.

reaction.name: Desperate Shrieking
entries: As a reaction to taking damage, the mouther lets out a human-sounding cry of pain. The next attack made against it before the beginning of its next turn is made with disadvantage.

reaction.name: Tentacle Delve
entries: As a reaction to a creature within 10 ft. casting a spell with a verbal component, the abomination forces it to succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or have a tentacle invade its mouth. A creature with a tentacle in its mouth is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}), can't speak or breath, and at the end of each of its turns forgets one language or spell that it knows of its choice, until restored by Greater Restoration or similar magic.
While it has a creature {@condition grappled} in this way, the mouther may speak the languages that the creature knows and cast the spells that the creature knows, using the creature's spell slots.

trait.name: Aberrant Ground
entries: The ground within 10 feet of the mouther is doughlike difficult terrain. A creature in this area must spend half its movement to exit the area.

trait.name: Gibbering
entries: The mouther babbles incoherently while it can see any creature and isn't {@condition incapacitated}. A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of one or more gibberers and can hear the gibbering makes a {@dc 10} Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature must take the {@action Attack} action this turn. A creature that fails by 5 or more chooses targets at random among the creatures it can reach with its movement.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gibbering mouther makes one lunging bite attack and uses its blinding spittle, if available. It may replace its bite attack with its gibbering feast ability.

action.name: Lunging Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}17 ({@damage 5d6}) piercing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it must succeed on a {@dc 10} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. If the target is killed by this damage, it is absorbed into the mouther.

action.name: Gibbering Feast
entries: One creature the mouther can see within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 10} Charisma saving throw or take 17 ({@damage 5d6}) piercing damage as unnatural mouths grow from their body and bite them, after which they fall off and rot away immediately.

action.name: Blinding Spittle {@recharge 5}
entries: The mouther spits a chemical glob at a point it can see within 15 feet of it. The glob explodes in a blinding flash of light on impact. Each creature within 5 feet of the flash must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the end of the mouther's next turn.

reaction.name: Desperate Shrieking
entries: As a reaction to taking damage, the mouther lets out a human-sounding cry of pain. The next attack made against it before the beginning of its next turn is made with disadvantage.

variant.name: Note: Gibbering Beast Template
entries: You can use a gibbering beast template to represent any monster that has been absorbed into a gibbering mouther. A gibbering beast has:

items.name: Save DC
entries: The save DC for the creature's new abilities equals 8 + the creature's Wisdom modifier + the creature's Proficiency Bonus

items.name: Aberrant Ground
entries: The ground in a 10-foot radius around the beast is doughlike difficult terrain. Each creature that starts its turn in that area must succeed on a Strength saving throw or have its speed reduced to 0 until the start of its next turn. A creature in this area rolls Charisma and Wisdom saving throws at disadvantage.

items.name: Gibbering
entries: The mouther babbles incoherently while it can see any creature and isn't {@condition incapacitated}. Each creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the mouther and can hear the gibbering makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature must take the {@action Attack} action this turn. A creature that fails by 5 or more chooses targets at random among the creatures it can reach with its movement.

variant.name: Note: Pseudonatural Creature Template
entries: You can use this template to represent creatures warped by the strange energies of the Far Realm. A pseudonatural creature has:

items.name: Tentacles
