entries: The creature sprouts tentacles that are natural weapons. They deal bludgeoning damage equal to {@dice 1d10} + the creature's Strength modifier.

items.name: Amorphous
entries: The creature can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

items.name: Blindsight
entries: The creature has {@sense blindsight} out to 10 ft.

items.name: Charisma
entries: The creature has disadvantage on Charisma-based ability checks, and on saving throws against any effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Aberrant Ground
entries: The ground within 10 feet of the orb is doughlike difficult terrain. A creature in this area must spend half its movement to exit the area.

trait.name: Gibbering
entries: The orb babbles incoherently while it can see any creature and isn't {@condition incapacitated}. A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of one or more gibberers and can hear the gibbering makes a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature must take the {@action Attack} action this turn. A creature that fails by 5 or more chooses targets at random among the creatures it can reach with its movement, itself included.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gibbering orb makes three attacks with its slavering bite.

action.name: Slavering Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. {@h}20 ({@damage 5d6 + 3}) piercing damage and the target is dragged up to 5 ft. toward the orb. A target killed by this damage is absorbed into the orb.

action.name: Eye Rays
entries: The orb chooses one of the following effects, targeting a creature within 60 ft.

items.name: 1. Sprouting Gift Ray
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Charisma saving throw or sprout an additional mouth from an exposed point on its body. While a creature has this mouth, creatures within 10 ft. of the target are subject to the orb's gibbering, and whenever the orb uses its multiattack it makes an additional slavering bite attack with the mouth. The mouth can be destroyed (AC 17, 10 HP), but any damage dealt to the mouth is also dealt to the creature it is growing from.

items.name: 2. Pseudonaturalize Ray
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Charisma saving throw or have its form distort and lose cohesion, giving the creature disadvantage on attack rolls and on saving throws against any effect that would alter its form. The creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. If the creature fails three of these Saving Throws, it becomes a psuedonatural creature (see Pseudonatural Creature Template)

items.name: 3. Orbital Ray
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or be levitated 10 ft. off the ground for the next minute. At the end of each of a levitating creature's turns, it may repeat this saving throw, ending the effect on a success or moving 20 ft. clockwise around the orb on a failure.

items.name: 4. Impostor Ray
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw or be unattuned from any magic items they are attuned to. A creature that fails by 5 or more is {@condition charmed} by the orb and believes that it is a body-snatching imposter from the far realm until the end of its next turn.

items.name: 5. Bonewarping Ray
entries: The target must make a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, for the next minute the creature takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) piercing damage whenever it takes an action.

items.name: 6. Far Sojurn Ray (Concentration)
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Charisma saving throw or be banished to the far realm for the next minute. While there, a creature is {@condition incapacitated} and repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success or taking 26 ({@dice 4d12}) slashing plus 26 ({@damage 4d12}) psychic damage on a failure. A creature that dies in the far realm returns with its body horiffically warped and distorted.

reaction.name: Legendary Reactions
entries: The orb may make a legendary reaction whenever its conditions are met, without using its reaction.

reaction.name: Merciless Eyes
entries: As a reaction to a creature ending its turn within 60 ft. of the orb, the orb targets it with a randomly chosen Eye Ray.

reaction.name: Desperate Spawning
entries: As a reaction when the orb is targeted with a spell or magical effect, the orb may spawn a gibbering mouther with 25 hit points in the nearest unoccupied space. The mouther becomes the new target of the spell or effect, and the orb loses 25 hit points.

reaction.name: Tentacle Delve
entries: As a reaction to a creature within 15 ft. casting a spell with a verbal component, the abomination forces it to succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or have a tentacle invade its mouth. A creature with a tentacle in its mouth is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}), can't speak or breath, and at the end of each of its turns forgets one language or spell that it knows of its choice, until restored by Greater Restoration or similar magic.
While it has a creature {@condition grappled} in this way, the orb may speak the languages that the creature knows and cast the spells that the creature knows, using the creature's spell slots.

trait.name: Honourable Fealty
entries: While the giff is within 60 feet of a giff of higher CR, it may reroll up to two damage dice on each of its turns. If it does so, it must use the new roll.

trait.name: Null Hide
entries: The giff has resistance to damage from spells of second level or below. It cannot use or be targeted by magic items.

trait.name: Danger Close
entries: The Giff lives for the music of battle. It has resistance to damage from magical or nonmagical effects that affect a sphere or cube. If the giff fails a saving throw against such an effect, its next attack is made at advantage.

action.name: Cavalry Saber
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Flintlock Pistols
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d10 + 2}) piercing damage. The giff has a brace of eight pistols, each of which may fire once before requiring a short rest to fire again.

action.name: Pack More Powder!
entries: The giff overstuffs its musket with powder. The next shot the giff fires with it deals 6 ({@damage 1d12}) additional damage, to a maximum of 13 ({@damage 2d12}) additional damage.

action.name: Musket {@recharge 4}
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 40/120 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d12 + 2}) piercing damage. If this attack deals 20 or more damage, the wielder takes half as much damage as fire damage.

action.name: Juggernaut Charge
entries: The giff attempts to shove a creature. If it succeeds, it may make another shove attempt against the same target, and continue doing so until it fails or runs out of movement. The target then takes {@damage 1d8} damage for each 10 feet it was pushed.

trait.name: Honourable Fealty
entries: While the giff is within 60 feet of a giff of higher CR, it may reroll up to two damage dice on each of its turns. If it does so, it must use the new roll.

trait.name: Null Hide
entries: The giff has resistance to damage from spells of third level or below. It cannot use or be targeted by magic items.

trait.name: Danger Close
entries: The Giff lives for the music of battle. It has resistance to damage from magical or nonmagical effects that affect a sphere or cube. If the giff fails a saving throw against such an effect, its next attack is made at advantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Giff uses its Impact Grenade twice. It may replace one of these with a use of its Juggernaut Charge.

action.name: Impact Grenade
entries: The giff throws a grenade up to 60 feet. Each creature within 15 feet of the grenade's detonation must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that succeeds on this save by 5 or more and has a free hand may use its reaction to catch the grenade, preventing its detonation. A giff leftenant typically carries eight grenades at a time.

action.name: Juggernaut Charge
entries: The giff attempts to shove a creature. If it succeeds, it may make another shove attempt against the same target, and continue doing so until it fails or runs out of movement. The target then takes {@damage 1d8} damage for each 5 feet it was pushed.

reaction.name: Aim, You Buffoons!
entries: As a reaction to seeing a friendly creature miss with an attack, the Giff berates its allies. Each friendly creature that can hear it gains advantage on the next attack it makes before the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The hikiga's long jump is up to 30 feet and its high jump is up to 20 feet, with or without a running start.

trait.name: Onibi Bond
entries: Whenever Ginchiyo casts a spell, he may treat an onibi servant of his as the spell's source, and have it concentrate on the spell in his stead. He must still use his own senses to target, however.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Ginchiyo uses his Onibi command twice, one of which he may replace with use of his Ghostfire Flare, Anchor Spirit, or Snip Bindings.

action.name: Empower Onibi
entries: One onibi under Ginchiyo's control may use its reaction to move up to half its speed and make two melee attacks.

action.name: Ghostfire Flare (2nd Level Spell)
entries: Up to two creatures Ginchiyo can see within 30 feet each must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 7 ({@dice 2d6}) fire plus 5 ({@damage 1d10}) necrotic damage as pale flames erupt beneath them.

action.name: Anchor Spirit (2nd Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: Tozen forces a creature he can see within 60 feet to succeed on a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw or be bound to an {@condition invisible} spiritual anchor in its space that lasts for a minute.
At the end of each of that creature's turns, it takes {@damage 1d6} psychic damage for each 5 feet away from that anchor that it ends its turn.

action.name: Snip Bindings (3rd Level Spell)
entries: Ginchiyo snips carefully away at the threads of magic binding a magical effect or creation within 5 feet of him into being, altering its effects in one of the following ways:
If the effect or creation deals damage, it deals two fewer dice of damage.
If the effect or creation has a radius or range, its radius or range is decreased by 10 feet.
If the effect or creation can move or be moved by its creator, the distance it can move or be moved is decreased by 10 feet.
If the effect or creation has a duration, its duration is reduced by half.

action.name: Living Exorcism (5th Level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: Ginchiyo touches a creature and attempts to empty its body of spirits. The creature and each other spirit inhabiting its body must succeed on a {@dc 16} Charisma saving throw or have its disembodied spirit expelled into the nearest unoccupied space.
While disembodied, a creature's spirit gains a fly speed equal to its movement speed and cannot deal damage, but otherwise uses its statistics.

A body not inhabited by its native spirit may be {@condition possessed|confc|possessed} by any disembodied spirit as an action, rising and acting under that creature's control. If the body is already {@condition possessed|confc|possessed}, a disembodied spirit in the body's space may attempt to take the place of the possessing spirit with a contested Charisma check.

action.name: Slam

The creatures must each succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution Saving Throw or take 22 ({@damage 4d10}) bludgeoning damage and be {@condition stunned} until the end of the girallon's next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition stunned}.

The creature must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or take 28 ({@damage 8d6}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}. On a successful save, the creature takes half damage and isn't knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Tidal Stride (2nd Level Spell)

action.name: Likeness of the Clam God (5th Level Spell, Concentration)

When it appears, each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 18}), moving to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

action.name: Sudden Sea (7th Level Spell, Recharge 5-6)

entries: As a reaction to being hit with a ranged attack, the goblin causes the attack to instead hit another goblin within 5 ft.

trait.name: Nimble Escape
entries: The goblin can take the {@action Disengage} or {@action Hide} action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

trait.name: The Goblin Crown
entries: The goblin king is whichever goblin is currently wearing the goblin crown. If the goblin king is killed or {@condition incapacitated}, any goblin within 5 ft. may crown itself as a bonus action. When a new goblin becomes king, each other goblin within 60 ft. has advantage on attacks and saving throws until the end of its next turn.
A goblin that becomes king gains proficiency in persuasion and can use the To Battle! action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The goblin makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Scepter
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: To Battle!
entries: The goblin attempts a {@dc 10} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check. On a success, up to three friendly goblins within 30 ft. may each use their reaction to make an attack.

reaction.name: Slippery
entries: If an attack misses the goblin, it can move up to 5 feet as a reaction without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

trait.name: Nimble Escape
entries: The goblin can take the {@action Disengage} or {@action Hide} action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

trait.name: Skulker
entries: The Skulker's attacks deal an additional 2 damage for each friendly goblin adjacent to its target.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Light Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Slippery
entries: If an attack misses the goblin, it can move up to 5 feet as a reaction without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

trait.name: Underfoot
entries: The goblin taunter can take the {@action Dodge} action as a bonus action if it is within 5 feet of at least two enemies.

trait.name: Attention Grabbing
entries: A creature struck by the goblin must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on all attack rolls against targets other than the goblin until the end of the creature's next turn.

action.name: Whip
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) slashing damage.

reaction.name: Slippery
entries: If an attack misses the goblin, it can move up to 5 feet as a reaction without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

trait.name: Smoke Torpor
entries: If the wasp starts its turn in a cloud of smoke or similar vapor, its speed is reduced by half and it is {@condition incapacitated} until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wasp makes two attacks one of which can be with its Hedgeclipper Mandibles.

action.name: Hedgeclipper Mandibles
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) piercing damage.
This attack deals an additional 5 ({@damage 1d10}) piercing damage on a critical hit.

action.name: Parasitic Sting
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage plus 5 ({@damage 2d4}) poison damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn).
A goblinoid creature that fails this saving throw contracts Goblin Wasp Parasitism and is {@condition paralyzed} for as long as it remains {@condition poisoned}.

reaction.name: Jink
entries: When the wasp is hit with a ranged attack while it is at least 10 feet in the air, the wasp can halve the attack's damage.

reaction.name: Pheromonal Vengeance
entries: When the wasp is hit with a melee attack, it can cover the attacker in a fine pheromonal mist.
Until the target takes a Short Rest to clean itself, each wasp within 500 feet of it can pinpoint its location by scent and has advantage on attacks that target it.

trait.name: Smoke Torpor
entries: If the swarm starts its turn in a cloud of smoke or similar vapor, its speed is reduced by half and it is {@condition incapacitated} until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Apiphobia Aura
entries: A creature that starts its turn in the swarm's space must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or use all of its movement to move in a straight line before taking an action.
If this movement is arrested by a solid object or surface, the creature falls {@condition prone} and ends its turn.

trait.name: Rancorous Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Medium wasp. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.
A creature takes 1 piercing and 1 poison damage for each 5 feet it moves through the swarm's space.

action.name: Venomshock Flurry
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 0 ft., each creature in the swarm's space. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d6 + 4}) piercing damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) poison damage, or 11 ({@dice 2d6 + 4}) piercing plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) poison damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.
A creature that takes 10 or more poison damage in this way must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn).
A goblinoid creature that fails this saving throw contracts Goblin Wasp Parasitism and is {@condition paralyzed} for as long as it remains {@condition poisoned}.

reaction.name: Pheromonal Vengeance
entries: When the swarm is hit with a melee attack, it can cover the attacker in a fine pheromonal mist.
Until the target takes a Short Rest to clean itself, each wasp within 500 feet of it can pinpoint its location by scent and has advantage on attacks that target it.

trait.name: Nimble Escape
entries: The goblin can take the {@action Disengage} or {@action Hide} action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The goblin makes up to three melee attacks. Each attack after the first is made at disadvantage.

action.name: Heavy Flail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage. On a natural 1, the goblin falls {@condition prone}.

action.name: Whirl {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature within 15 feet of the goblin must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Hazardous
entries: As a reaction to a creature entering its reach, the goblin must make a melee attack against it.

trait.name: Nimble Escape
entries: The goblin can take the {@action Disengage} or {@action Hide} action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

trait.name: Cavalier
entries: The goblin has advantage on melee attacks while it is riding a creature.

trait.name: Mount-Breaker
entries: The goblin may mount any medium or larger creature by spending half its movement. An unwilling creature may prevent this with a successful {@dc 12} Dexterity Saving Throw. A mounted creature may repeat this save as an action to attempt to unseat the goblin.

action.name: Vicious Javelin
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage. On a critical hit, this weapon deals an additional 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage.

reaction.name: Grabby
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack by a medium or larger creature, the goblin attempts to mount the attacker.

trait.name: Apex Tunneler
entries: The bulette can burrow through solid rock or metal at half its burrow speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.
The bulette may spend half its movement to shatter a Wall of Force or similar creation of magical force within 5 feet of it.

trait.name: Shock Attack
entries: If the bulette starts its turn underground, creatures without {@sense tremorsense} may not take reactions on its turn while within 5 feet of it.

trait.name: Godflesh Devourer
entries: The bulette has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects with a divine origin, such as those cast by clerics or paladins.

trait.name: Legendary Resistances (2/Day)
entries: If the bulette fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Godeater Maw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}39 ({@dice 5d12 + 7}) piercing plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) force damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 20}).
The bulette may make this attack as a bonus action against a {@condition prone} creature.

action.name: Seismic Scrutiny
entries: The bulette directs its mind's eye toward a 30 foot radius location on the Astral, Ethereal, or Material plane, learning the number and type of creatures in the area.
The earth in the area begins to shake, and each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw or fall {@condition prone} and be unable to stand on its following turn.

action.name: Planequake Eruption (Recharges when the bulette uses its Seismic Scrutiny)
entries: The bulette chews a hole that remains open until the beginning of its next turn to a location chosen with its Seismic Scrutiny, bursting forth in a spray of shattered fragments of reality.

Each creature within 30 feet of the bulette when it emerges is pushed up to 15 feet away, then each creature still within 30 feet of it must succeed {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or take 18 ({@dice 4d8}) thunder plus 22 ({@damage 4d10}) force damage, or half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Deadly Leap {@recharge 5}
entries: The bulette leaps up to 30 feet and can land in the space of any Large or smaller creature.

Each creature whose space the bulette lands in must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength or Dexterity saving throw (target's choice) or take 28 ({@damage 8d6}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}, or take half as much damage and be pushed to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

reaction.name: Dweomersense
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with a spell of 4th level or above, the bulette may move up to its burrow speed. If it is no longer a valid target for the spell, the spell caster must choose a new target or lose the spell.

legendary.name: Earthen Dive
entries: The bulette moves up to half its burrow speed directly downward.

legendary.name: Gather Strength
entries: The earth within 5 feet of the bulette becomes difficult terrain and the bulette gains 20 temporary hit points.
While it has any of these temporary hit points, the bulette's attacks are made at advantage.

legendary.name: Lateral Rend (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The bulette shakes a {@condition grappled} creature back and forth, forcing it to succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or take 26 ({@damage 4d12}) slashing damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is {@condition stunned} until the end of the bulette's next turn.

trait.name: Magnanimous
entries: When a hostile creature the dragon can see falls {@condition prone}, the dragon treats its as friendly until the creature stands, deals damage to the dragon, or forces the dragon to make a saving throw.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Breath Weapons {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.

action.name: Slithering Fire Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon exhales fire in an 15-foot line that is 5 feet wide and can make one turn of up to 90 degrees at any point along its length. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 ({@damage 4d10}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Weakening Breath
entries: The dragon exhales gas in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or have disadvantage on Strength-based attack rolls, Strength checks, and Strength saving throws for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The grung's long jump is up to 25 feet and its high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

trait.name: Toe Pads
entries: The grung can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, if it uses both hands and feet to climb.

trait.name: Poisonous Skin
entries: A creature that comes into contact with the grung's skin must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned}. While {@condition poisoned} in this way, Poison effects on the creature only end on a successful save. A {@condition poisoned} creature repeats this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The grung makes three attacks, one of which it may replace with its Aposematic Terror.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage plus 5 ({@damage 2d4}) poison damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be affected by the grung's Poisonous Skin.

action.name: Bonebreaker Macana
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage. This attack scores a critical on an 17-20 if it targets a {@condition poisoned} creature. On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or suffer an effect of the grung's choice until it completes a Long Rest.

items.name: Fractured Wrist
entries: The creature has disadvantage on attack rolls that use Strength or Dexterity.

items.name: Fractured Ankle
entries: The target's movement speed is halved.

items.name: Fractured Ribs
entries: The target loses 5 ({@dice 2d4}) hit points if it makes more than one attack in a turn.

action.name: Aposematic Terror
entries: One creature within 30 ft. that can see the grung and is not immune to the {@condition poisoned} condition must make a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is {@condition frightened} and must use all of its movement on its following turn to move away from the grung.

action.name: Become Grung {@recharge 5}
entries: One {@condition poisoned} creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or perceive itself transforming into a grung. As long as the creature remains {@condition poisoned}, it is {@condition charmed} by all grungs and hostile to all non-grungs.

reaction.name: Spring Away
entries: As a reaction to being missed with an attack, the grung moves up to its speed without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

trait.name: Lattice Decay
entries: If the vessel takes any fire damage, it gains vulnerability to force and psychic damage until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Soul-Moved
entries: While it is not {@condition possessed|confc|possessed}, the vessel is {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Giant Stature
entries: Attacks made against the vessel by a creature {@condition attached|confc|attached} to it have advantage, and the vessel has disadvantage on attacks it makes against creatures {@condition attached|confc|attached} to it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vessel makes two attacks with its Gilt-Ram Fist, one of which it can replace with its Golden Flare.

action.name: Gilt-Ram Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d8 + 7}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.
Each other creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

action.name: Golden Flare (3rd Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: A pillar of searing golden radiance envelops a creature the vessel can see within 30 feet, projecting Bright Light in a 15 foot radius until the beginning of the vessel's next turn.

At the beginning of the vessel's next turn, the light flares and each creature illuminated by it must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or take 14 ({@dice 4d6}) radiant plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Soulflame Vent {@recharge 5}
entries: The vessel takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) psychic damage as sun-bright soul vapors hiss from its vents.
Each other creature within 15 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or take 27 ({@dice 6d8}) radiant plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) psychic damage, or half as much on a success.

bonus.name: Stonequake Leap
entries: The vessel leaps up to 20 feet, then each other creature within 5 feet of it must make a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw.
On a failure, the creature takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) bludgeoning damage and is pushed up to 5 feet away.

bonus.name: Soulmire (2nd Level Spell)
entries: The vessel shakes loose the soul of a creature it hit with a melee attack this turn, disrupting the target's control over its body.
The target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition dazed|confc|dazed} until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Hammershot Piston
entries: When the vessel hits a Large or smaller creature that is standing on a solid surface with a Gilt-Ram Fist attack, it can make an additional Gilt-Ram Fist attack against the same target.
On a hit, the target is knocked {@condition prone} and any nonmagical earth, stone, or wood that the target is standing on is destroyed to a depth of 5 feet.

trait.name: Lattice Decay
entries: If the vessel takes any fire damage, it gains vulnerability to force and psychic damage until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vessel makes three attacks with its Gilded Fist, one of which it can replace with a use of its Golden Flare.

action.name: Gilded Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.
On a critical hit, the target is pushed 5 feet away and knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Golden Flare (3rd Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: A pillar of searing golden radiance envelops a creature the vessel can see within 30 feet, projecting Bright Light in a 15 foot radius until the beginning of the vessel's next turn.

At the beginning of the cloister's next turn, the light flares and each creature illuminated by it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or take 14 ({@dice 4d6}) radiant plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage, or half as much on a success.

bonus.name: Heavy Leap
entries: The vessel leaps up to 20 feet, then can force up to one creature within 5 feet of where it lands to make a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw.
On a failure, the creature takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) bludgeoning damage and is pushed up to 5 feet away.

bonus.name: Soulmire (2nd Level Spell)
entries: The vessel shakes loose the soul of a creature it hit with a melee attack this turn, disrupting the target's control over its body.
The target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition dazed|confc|dazed} until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Soul Imprint
entries: If the vessel takes any psychic damage, each non-minion golden vessel within 15 feet of it takes the same damage.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the vessel takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the vessel takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

action.name: Decrepit Assault (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 bludgeoning damage.
If three or more dross contributed to this attack, the target takes an additional 5 slashing damage and one of the dross dies.

action.name: Part Out
entries: The vessel tears itself apart and dies, donating its still-functional parts to its allies.
Up to two non-minion golden vessels within 5 feet can each use their reaction to regain 5 hit points.

trait.name: Soul Vessel
entries: A living creature killed within 30 feet of one or more Golden Vessel Palimpsests must make a {@dc 20} Charisma saving throw.

On a failure, the creature's spirit {@condition possessed|confc|possesses} one of them at random. The possessed vessel becomes a {@creature golden vessel cloister|confc|Golden Vessel Cloister} for as long as it remains {@condition possessed|confc|possessed}, retaining its current hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vessel makes two attacks with its Gilded Fist.

action.name: Gilded Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage.
On a critical hit, the target is pushed 5 feet away and knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Air Lens (2nd Level Spell)
entries: The vessel manipulates a source of bright light it can see within 60 feet, briefly condensing its radiance into a 15 foot long, 5 foot wide beam that extends from it.

Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 3d8}) radiant damage and be {@condition blinded} until the beginning of its next turn, or take half as much damage on a success.

bonus.name: Heavy Leap
entries: The vessel leaps up to 20 feet, then can force up to one creature within 5 feet of where it lands to make a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw.
On a failure, the creature takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) bludgeoning damage and is pushed up to 5 feet away.

trait.name: Web-Dweller
entries: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty.
While in contact with a web, the spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

action.name: Fanged Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Defensive Posture
entries: The spider rears up in a defensive posture. Until the beginning of its next turn, a creature that attempts to enter the spider's reach must first make a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save, the creature is {@condition frightened} until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Nettling Bristles {@recharge 5}
entries: The spider scrapes off some of its barbed bristles, ejecting them at a creature within 15 feet.

The target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage and be {@condition blinded} until it takes an action to clear its eyes, or take half as much damage on a success.

bonus.name: Leaping Tackle
entries: The spider jumps up to 15 feet and can land in the space of any Medium or smaller creature that is {@condition frightened}.
A creature whose space the spider lands in must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.
On a successful saving throw, the spider instead lands in the nearest unoccupied space.

trait.name: Deceptive Neck
entries: When a creature the heron can see scores a critical against it, roll a {@dice d20}. On an 11-20, the critical becomes a miss.

trait.name: Mudstrider
entries: The heron ignores negative effects from moving over terrain composed of mud or shallow water.

action.name: Dagger-Sharp Bill
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Taloned Pin
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition prone} target. {@h}The target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}) until the heron moves.

action.name: Chest Slam
entries: The heron collides with a Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet, forcing it to succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Rasped Bark (1/Day)
entries: The heron croaks out a dreadful sound. Each creature within 30 feet that can hear, but not see the heron must succeed on a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the beginning of the Heron's next turn.

bonus.name: Extend Neck
entries: The heron extends its neck, raising up to its full height and making a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check to detect any hidden creatures nearby.

trait.name: Form of Madness
entries: A non-obyrith creature that starts its turn within 120 feet of the golothoma and can see it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or believe itself to be the shadow of a greater creature cast from a distant realm.

The affected creature is {@condition frightened} while in Bright Light or Darkness and can repeat this saving throw as an Action, ending the effect and becoming immune to it for 24 hours on a success.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The golothoma has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golothoma makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Corrosive Tar Strike.

action.name: Perforating Barbs
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d6 + 7}) piercing damage.

action.name: Corrosive Tar Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d8 + 7}) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away and covered in acidic sludge.
Until a creature takes an action to remove it, the target's movement is reduced by half and it takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) acid damage at the beginning of each of its turns.

bonus.name: Flatten Reality (3rd Level Spell, Concentration, Recharge 5-6)
entries: A line of distorted space, 150 feet long and 5 feet wide, extends from the golothoma's eye.

Until the end of the golothoma's next turn, each creature in the area counts as being within 5 feet of each other creature in the area, and may teleport to any unoccupied space in the area as a Bonus Action.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Grasping Chains
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 15 ft. of the devil must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dextertiy saving throw or be {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}) until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Torturer
entries: A creature that fails a saving throw imposed by the devil may use its reaction to reveal a deep secret or weakness. If it does, it may reroll that saving throw, taking the second result.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The devil makes three attacks with its gorechain flail.

action.name: Gorechain Flail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 5d6 + 5}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}). On a critical hit, the target is knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Flay Living
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the devil must make a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 55 ({@dice 10d10}) and begins to bleed, or takes half as much damage on a success. A bleeding creature repeats this saving throw at the beginning of each of its turns, losing 5 ({@dice 1d10}) hit points on a failure or ending the effect on a success.

reaction.name: Gorechain Takeover
entries: As a reaction to a creature {@condition grappled} by it making an attack or casting a spell, the devil changes the target of the attack to another valid target in range of its choice.

reaction.name: Chains of Vengeance (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 116 hit points, the chain devil makes two chain attacks.

trait.name: Impossible Size
entries: The goristro occupies a 60 foot square area of ground and is 200 feet tall. It can occupy the space of any creature smaller than Gargantuan.

trait.name: Thick Skull
entries: While the goristro is not {@condition prone}, it is immune to the effects of any mind-affecting spells or abilities not controlled by a creature on its head.

trait.name: Living Siege
entries: The goristro has palisaded fortifications built into its back, shoulders, and head, sufficient to serve as a fighting platform for up to 40 medium creatures.

A creature adjacent to the goristro may spend 30 feet of movement to attempt a {@dc 18} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the goristro's legs. A creature may attempt the same check to climb from the goristro's legs to its back, or from its back to its head.

items.name: Legs
entries: While climbing on the goristro's legs, a creature must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw whenever the goristro uses its Stride or fall off.

items.name: Waist
entries: While climbing on the goristro's waist, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the goristro.

items.name: Back
entries: While climbing on the goristro's back, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the goristro and the goristro cannot target it.

items.name: Head
entries: While climbing on the goristro's head, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the goristro and on saving throws against its abilities. If a creature on the goristro's head scores a critical hit against it, the goristro falls {@condition prone} at the end of its next turn.

trait.name: The Bigger They Are...
entries: If the goristro falls {@condition prone}, it takes 70 ({@damage 20d6}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Panicked Fury
entries: While the goristro is {@condition frightened}, attacks against it are made at advantage and it cannot distinguish friend from foe.

trait.name: Limited Magic Resistance
entries: The goristro has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects that deal non-psychic damage.

action.name: Crater Fist
entries: The goristro swings its armored fist, striking a 10 foot radius centered on a point within 60 feet. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw, taking 65 ({@damage 10d10 + 10}) bludgeoning damage on a failure or moving to the nearest space outside the area on a success.
A creature may use its reaction to gain advantage on this saving throw.

action.name: Mountain Hurl
entries: The goristro hurls a Gargantuan building or similar object up to 300 feet at a point it can see. At the beginning of the goristro's next turn, it lands.

Each creature within 15 feet of that point is knocked {@condition prone}, and must succeed on a {@dc 26} Dexterity saving throw or take 49 ({@damage 6d12 + 10}) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success. A creature riding on the object has advantage on this saving throw.
A creature with at least 15 Passive {@skill Perception} knows precisely where the strike will land.

action.name: Titanic Stride
entries: The goristro takes a single step, moving up to 60 feet, or standing from {@condition prone} and moving up to 30 feet. Each creature within 10 feet of where it ends this movement that is not climbing on it must succeed on a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw or take 26 ({@damage 3d10 + 10}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Earthbreaker Leap {@recharge 5}
entries: The goristro leaps high into the sky. At the beginning of its next turn, it lands {@condition prone} in a space within 120 feet.

Each creature climbing on it must succeed on a {@dc 26} Strength saving throw or fall off, then each creature within 30 feet of it that is not climbing on it must succeed on a {@dc 26} Dexterity saving throw or take 34 ({@dice 8d10}) bludgeoning plus 35 ({@damage 10d6}) fire damage, be pushed up to 30 feet away, and be knocked {@condition prone}, or take half as much damage on a success.

legendary.name: Stride
entries: The goristro uses its Titanic Stride.

legendary.name: Brush Off
entries: The goristro attempts to dislodge a creature climbing on it. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw or take 32 ({@damage 5d12}) bludgeoning damage and be pushed up to 30 feet away.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the goristro may spend half of its movement to attempt a {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the goristro. While climbing on the goristro, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the goristro, and the goristro has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

trait.name: Hard Faller
entries: The goristro has vulnerability to damage from falling. While the goristro is within 5 feet of a precipice at least 10 feet high, it has disadvantage on saving throws against effects that would Frighten it.

trait.name: Panicked Fury
entries: While the goristro is {@condition frightened}, attacks against it are made at advantage and it cannot distinguish friend from foe.

trait.name: Limited Magic Resistance
entries: The goristro has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects that deal non-psychic damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The goristro makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Ravenous Bite, and uses its Goring Charge, if available.

action.name: Ravenous Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}26 ({@damage 3d12 + 7}) piercing damage. On a critical hit, the goristro gains resistance to all damage until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Wrecking Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d8 + 7}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away.
This attack deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Hoof Stomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 3d10 + 7}) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 21} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Goring Charge {@recharge 5}
entries: The goristro moves up to 40 feet in a straight line and can move through the space of any creature smaller than Large.

The first time it enters a creature's space during this move, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 21} Strength saving throw or take 33 ({@damage 6d10}) piercing damage and be pushed ahead of the goristro for the rest of this move, or move to the nearest unoccupied space outside the goristro's path on a success.

reaction.name: Sadistic Stomp
entries: When a {@condition prone} creature within 5 feet of it regains any hit points, the goristro can make a Hoof Stomp attack against it.

reaction.name: See Red (1/Day)
entries: When the goristro is reduced below 156 hit points, the goristro can immediately recharge and use its Goring Charge.

trait.name: Sky Scenting
entries: Gorthok has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell, and can sense the type, number, and direction of flying creatures within 1 mile.

trait.name: Giant Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to Gorthok may spend half of its movement to attempt a {@dc 16} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check, climbing onto Gorthok on a success. While climbing on Gorthok, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against Gorthok and Gorthok has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

trait.name: Stark-Light Charge
entries: Whenever a creature within 500 feet of Gorthok takes any lightning damage, Gorthok can teleport to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of it.
If Gorthok teleported at least 20 feet in this way, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Vengeance of the Tempest
entries: When Gorthok is killed, each creature within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw or be {@condition cursed|confc|cursed} until Gorthok is returned to life.
Whenever a creature {@condition cursed|confc|cursed} in this way takes any lightning damage, it takes an additional 4 ({@damage 1d8}) thunder damage.
A creature that magically removes this curse takes 27 ({@damage 6d8}) lightning damage, then must succeed on a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw or suffer the same curse.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
entries: If Gorthok fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Gorthok makes two melee attacks, one of which he can replace with a use of his Stormlord's Fury.

action.name: Crackling Tusks
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@dice 2d6 + 5}) slashing plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) lightning damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away.

action.name: Thunder-Hoof Trample
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition prone} creature. {@h}14 ({@dice 2d8 + 5}) bludgeoning plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) thunder damage.

action.name: Stormlord's Fury
entries: Gorthok rears up, calling down a bolt of lightning from the heavens toward a creature he can see within 120 feet.
The target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) lightning damage, or half as much on a success.
If Gorthok has fewer than 64 hit points, this ability can target a second creature within 15 feet of the first target.

action.name: Rooting Rush {@recharge 5}
entries: Gorthok moves up to half his speed, dragging his tusks through the ground, then flings them forward, spraying debris in a 15 foot cone.
Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}, or take half as much damage on a success.
The ground that Gorthok passes over with this movement becomes difficult terrain.

reaction.name: Squall-Call Squeal (1/Day)
entries: When Gorthok is reduced below 64 hit points, he hurls a deafening squeal skyward, immediately calling down a heavy deluge in a 1 mile radius.
For the next hour, each creature in the area subtracts {@dice 1d4} from any saving throws it makes against effects that deal lightning damage.

reaction.name: Foaming Defiance
entries: When he would be reduced to 0 hit points, Gorthok can make a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw. On a success, he is instead reduced to 1 hit point.
If triggered by piercing damage or a critical hit, this saving throw is made at disadvantage.

legendary.name: On Howling Winds
entries: One creature Gorthok can see within 60 feet must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 20 feet in a direction of Gorthok's choice.
If the creature ends this movement in the air, it does not fall until the end of its next turn, or until it takes any damage.

legendary.name: Tear Down the World
entries: Gorthok leaps up to 20 feet, crashing into an unoccupied space and sending out a thunderous pulse in a 15 foot radius.

Each nonmagical wall in the area is destroyed, and each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 4 ({@damage 1d8}) thunder damage and be pushed up to 10 feet away.

trait.name: Eye Hunter
entries: The gouger's melee attacks score a critical on an 17-20 against any creature with more than one eye, or on a 15-20 against any creature with more than two eyes.

trait.name: Antimagic Cone
entries: The gouger's central eye creates an area of antimagic, as in the {@spell antimagic field} spell, in a 150-foot cone. At the start of each of its turns, the gouger decides which way the cone faces and whether the cone is active.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gouger makes two attacks with its barbed tongue gouge, one of which it may replace with its staggering lash, if available.

action.name: Barbed Tongue Gouge
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 15 ft. {@h}17 ({@damage 4d6 + 3}) piercing damage. On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more permanently loses an eye.

action.name: Staggering Lash {@recharge 5}
entries: The gouger whips its tongue in a 15 ft. cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) slashing damage and fall {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Earth Scenting
entries: The boar has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell. It can sense the type, number, and direction of underground plants and animals within 25 feet of it.

trait.name: Ploughing Charge
entries: If the boar moves at least 20 feet in a straight line, it may move through the space of any Large or smaller creature.
A creature whose space the boar enters in this way must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}, or move to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

action.name: Tusks
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) slashing damage. A {@condition prone} creature takes an additonal 7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage.

action.name: Rooting Rush {@recharge}
entries: The boar moves up to half its speed, dragging its tusks through the ground, then flings them forward, spraying earth in a 15 foot cone.
Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}, or take half as much damage on a success.
The ground that the boar passes over with this movement becomes difficult terrain.

reaction.name: Foaming Defiance
entries: When the boar would be reduced to 0 hit points, it can make a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw. On a success, the boar is instead reduced to 1 hit point.
If triggered by piercing damage or a critical hit, this saving throw is made with disadvantage.

resist.note: from attacks with weapons that aren't named

trait.name: Fey Magic Resistance
entries: The hag has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects imposed by a creature that does not know its name.

trait.name: Skinktaker Mimicry
entries: The hag can mimic the voice or appearance of any humanoid it has skinned. A creature can discern the nature of these illusions with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check.

trait.name: Corruptor Coven
entries: Children within 10 miles of a coven of annis hags are slowly incited to misbehave in ever-escalating ways, up to and including things like destruction of food stores, killing pets and livestock, arson, and even murder.
Additionally, a fog settles in the area that never lifts. Creatures other than the annis hag in the area are blind beyond a 30 ft. radius.

trait.name: Eyes of Black
entries: A creature the hag can see must spend 1 extra foot for every foot it moves away from the hag.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The annis makes three attacks: one with her teeth of iron and two with her corkscrew claws.

action.name: Teeth of Iron
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d6 + 7}) slashing damage. This attack deals an additional 10 ({@damage 3d6}) damage against a {@condition prone} creature.

action.name: Corkscrew Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d8 + 7}) slashing damage and the hag may grapple the target (escape {@dc 19}). While the hag has a creature {@condition grappled} in this way, it cannot use its multiattack.

action.name: Crushing Hug
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the hag must make a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 65 ({@damage 10d12}) bludgeoning damage, falls {@condition prone}, and cannot stand on its following turn. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more cannot stand until it completes a short or long rest. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage.

reaction.name: Grisly Display
entries: As a reaction when the hag kills a creature with a melee attack, the hag rips the creature's skin off in a single piece. Each creature that can see the display must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom save or be {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn. While {@condition frightened} in this way, a creature uses its movement and action to dash in a random direction.

reaction.name: Swallow Magic
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with a spell of fifth level or below, the hag snaps at the spell with her iron teeth, disrupting it. On her following turn, the annis hag's attacks are made at advantage and deal force damage, instead of any other type.

resist.note: from attacks with weapons that aren't named

trait.name: Graystaff Magic
entries: The hag carries a graystaff, a length of gray wood that is a focus for her inner power. She can ride the staff as if it were a broom of flying. If the staff is lost or destroyed, the hag cannot use its rime burst and must craft another, which takes a year and a day. Only a bheur hag can use a graystaff.

trait.name: Ice Walk
entries: The hag can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost her extra moment.

trait.name: Sapping Cold
entries: Each time a creature hits the bheur hag with a melee attack, it must expend one unexpended hit die. If it cannot, it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end its next turn.

trait.name: Embrittle
entries: On a roll of 1 with a melee attack agains the hag, a weapon that isn't named shatters in the wielder's hands, dealing 3 ({@damage 1d6}) slashing damage.

trait.name: Wintergiver Coven
entries: The area within 50 miles of a coven of bheur hags drops 1 degree every hour until it reaches 10 degrees below the lowest natural winter temperature of the area. Creatures in the area without cold resistance or immunity subtract {@dice 1d4} from the result of saving throws they make.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hag uses its Rime Burst or Maddening Feast. Then, if one or more creatures within 30 ft. are {@condition frightened}, it may use its Onset of Desperation or Curse of Paranoia.

action.name: Rime Burst (Greystaff only)
entries: The hag sends forth an icy blast in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw, taking 18 ({@damage 4d8}) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The area becomes difficult terrain, and a creature that starts its turn in it or enters the area for the first time on a turn must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

action.name: Maddening Feast
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5ft., one incacitated or dead target. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d10 + 4}) piercing damage and 36 ({@damage 8d8}) cold damage. Each creature of the hag's choice that can see it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} for a minute. A {@condition frightened} creature repeats this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Onset of Desperation
entries: One {@condition frightened} creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by the hag for the same duration. While {@condition charmed} in this way, the creature uses its action to feed on the nearest beast or humanoid corpse it can see within 30 ft., or to attack the nearest living humanoid or beast it can see if there are no corpses in range.

action.name: Curse of Paranoia
entries: Each {@condition frightened} creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 17} Charisma saving throw or be cursed. A cursed creature cannot target friendly creatures with spells. If the cursed creature is targeted with a spell by a friendly creature, it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be unaffected by the spell.

reaction.name: Feed on Greed
entries: As a reaction to a creature within 60 ft. targeting itself with a spell, the bhuer hag changes the spell's target to itself.

reaction.name: Chill the Weave
entries: As a reaction to a creature within 60 ft targeting the hag with a spell, the hag forces the caster to expend an additional spell slot of the same or higher level. If it cannot, the hag chooses a new target for the spell.

resist.note: from attacks with weapons that aren't named

trait.name: Fey Magic Resistance
entries: The hag has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects imposed by a creature that does not know its name.

trait.name: Swampwalk
entries: The hag is unaffected by difficult terrain caused by swampy terrain or vegetation.

trait.name: Illusory Mimicry
entries: The hag can mimic the voice or appearance of any animal or humanoid it has killed. A creature can discern the nature of these illusions with a successful {@dc 16} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check.

trait.name: Glimmer of Hope
entries: Whenever one or more creatures the hag can see within 30 ft. succeed on a saving throw against a spell the hag controls, the hag gains 11 ({@dice 2d10}) temporary hit points.

trait.name: Earthdrinker Coven
entries: The earth within 10 miles of a coven of green hags gradually softens and becomes waterlogged over the course of a week. The roots of food crops begin to rot away, livestock sicken, and the area becomes difficult terrain.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hag makes two melee attacks, one of which she may replace with either her Hurl to Earth or her Grasping Muck.

action.name: Swampgift Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) slashing damage and the creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw or be cursed.
While cursed, a creature glows with a pale blue light, attracts biting insects, and swamp-dwelling creatures have advantage on attack rolls against the cursed creature.

action.name: Hurl to Earth
entries: One creature within 60 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw or be teleported 60 ft. in the air and knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Grasping Muck
entries: One creature within 60 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 15}) as it begins to sink into the earth. A {@condition prone} creature has disadvantage on this saving throw. A creature already affected by this ability is additionally {@condition blinded} and unable to speak or breathe as it sinks fully beneath the surface.

action.name: Stagnant Miasma {@recharge 5}
entries: The ground in a 10 ft. radius within 60 ft. begins to bubble, exuding a cloud of toxic gas that remains for a minute, or until cleared with a strong breeze. A creature that starts its turn in the cloud must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 5d8}) poison damage.

action.name: Invisible Passage (Concentration)
entries: The hag magically turns {@condition invisible} until she attacks or casts a spell. While {@condition invisible}, she leaves no physical evidence of her passage, so she can be tracked only by magic.

reaction.name: Poisoned Cup
entries: As a reaction to a creature she can see within 30 ft. receiving a source of magical healing, the hag fouls the magic. The creature receives no healing and instead takes an equal amount of necrotic damage.

reaction.name: Hope to Despair
entries: When a creature that the hag can see within 30 ft. makes a saving throw against a spell the hag (or a member of her coven) cast, she may expend all temporary hit points from her Glimmer of Hope ability and subtract the number expended from the creature's saving throw.

monster.name: Grandmother Moru, Beast of the Veiled Pass

immune.note: from attacks with weapons that aren't named

trait.name: Dread Will
entries: A creature that can see Grandmother and is not immune to the {@condition frightened} condition treats all movement towards her as though over difficult terrain.

trait.name: Dweller in the Web of Night
entries: Grandmother can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty.
She knows the exact location and type of any creature in contact with a web and of any creature that is {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell.

trait.name: With Hunger Like Death (Mythic Trait, recharges after a Short or Long rest)
entries: When Grandmother is reduced to 0 hit points, she doesn't die or fall {@condition unconscious}. Instead, she resets to 262 hit points.
For the next hour, whenever Grandmother kills a spiderkind creature with her Stilling Bite, she regains 30 hit points and a Legendary Resistance.

trait.name: Legendary Resistances (3/Day)
entries: If Grandmother fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Grandmother makes four attacks, one of which may be with her Stilling Bite.

action.name: Stilling Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}19 ({@dice 3d8 + 6}) piercing plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) poison damage and the target must make {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw.

On a failed save, the target is {@condition poisoned} for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn), and is {@condition incapacitated} while {@condition poisoned} if it is not illuminated by Bright Light.

action.name: Loathly Legs
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 4d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 21} Strength saving throw or suffer one additional effect:
The creature is knocked {@condition prone} and {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 21}) until Grandmother moves.
The target drops one object it is carrying and is pushed up to 10 feet away.

bonus.name: Web Bind
entries: Grandmother attempts to wrap a {@condition grappled} or {@condition prone} creature within 15 feet in webbing, forcing it to succeed on a {@dc 21} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 21}).
If the target is Large or smaller, Grandmother can attach the creature to her back as part of this action.

bonus.name: Dread Snare
entries: One creature Grandmother can see within 60 feet must succeed on a {@dc 21} Strength saving throw or be dragged up to 30 feet toward her.

bonus.name: Darkwrought Vapors {@recharge 5}
entries: A smothering blackness issues forth in a 40 foot radius from vents at the back of Grandmother's head.

Until the end of her next turn, light sources in the area have the area they illuminate reduced by half, and a creature that starts its turn in the area must succeed on a {@dc 21} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} and {@condition choking|confc|choking} until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Tangle the Weave
entries: When Grandmother is targeted with a spell, she can cause the spell to leave a tangle of blackened silk in a 5 foot wide line in the air behind it.

Attacks that pass through the web have disadvantage, and a creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn must succeed on a {@dc 21} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 21}).
Each 5 foot section of the line can be attacked (AC 20, 15 HP, resistance to all but fire and magical slashing damage).

legendary.name: Loathly Lurch
entries: Grandmother moves up to half her speed and can make an attack with her Loathly Legs.

legendary.name: Devour Light
entries: Grandmother extinguishes a light source she can see within 15 feet of her or one of her webs, then she gains 15 temporary hit points.
If the light source is produced by a spell of 3rd level or above (or equivalent magic), this ability fails.

legendary.name: Nameless Progeny
entries: {@dice 1d4}

mythic.name: Stilling Bite
entries: Grandmother makes an attack with her Stilling Bite.

mythic.name: Fatal Despair
entries: One creature {@condition restrained} by Grandmother's black webs must succeed on a {@dc 21} Wisdom saving throw or lose its will to survive.
The creature becomes immune to the {@condition frightened} condition for the next minute and can't voluntarily move away from Grandmother, attempt to escape from restraints, or heal itself.

resist.note: from weapons that aren't either silvered or named.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The hag has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Illusory Mimicry
entries: The hag can mimic the voice or appearance of any animal or humanoid it knows the name of. A creature can discern the nature of this illusion with a successful {@dc 18} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check.

trait.name: Debt Keeper
entries: A creature that is indebted to the hag is psychically connected to it. The hag can telepathically communicate with it over any distance and can choose to perceive through its senses. Once per day, the hag can force an indebted creature to reroll an attack, ability check, or saving throw, taking the second result.

trait.name: Soultaker Coven
entries: Humanoid creatures within 100 miles of a coven of night hags feel drawn to the coven's location in times of desperation. While part of a coven, the hag's hellish portal does not close when a creature falls into it.

trait.name: Soporific Gaze
entries: When a creature that can see the hag's eyes starts its turn within 30 feet of the hag, the hag can force it to succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or fall asleep until it takes any damage, or until another creature uses its action to wake it. A creature that succeeds on this saving throw is immune to the effect for the next 24 hours.

Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the hag until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again.

trait.name: Legendary Soultaker (3/Day)
entries: If the hag fails a saving throw, it can choose to release one of the souls it has trapped in its soul bag. If it does, it succeeds instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hag makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Fiendish Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 18}). While {@condition grappled} in this way, the creature has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.

action.name: Hellish Portal (concentration) {@recharge 5}
entries: The hag opens a rift to a hellish demplane, 10 ft. long and 5 ft. wide, on a surface within 60 ft. A creature standing in the rift's space when it appears or that enters it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dextery saving throw or fall {@condition prone} in an unoccupied space adjacent to the rift. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more falls in. If one or more creatures fall into the rift, the rift closes.

A creature that falls into the rift takes 31 ({@damage 9d6}) psychic damage, 31 ({@damage 9d6}) fire damage, and ages 31 ({@dice 9d6}) years, and is {@condition incapacitated} until the beginning of its next turn, when it reappears in the space it left. The aging Effect can be reversed with a {@spell Greater Restoration} spell.

action.name: Etherealness
entries: The hag magically enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa.

action.name: Nightmare Haunting (1/Day)
entries: While on the Ethereal Plane, the hag magically touches a sleeping humanoid on the Material Plane, afflicting it with dreadful nightmares. If this contact persists for an hour, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or gain no benefit from its rest, and its hit point maximum is reduced by 10 ({@dice 2d10}).

If this effect reduces the target's hit point maximum to 0, the target dies, and if the target was indebted to the hag, its soul is trapped in the hag's soul bag. The reduction to the target's hit point maximum lasts until removed by the {@spell greater restoration} spell or similar magic.

A creature that is wearing a silver protective talsiman, or one that has had a Protection From Good And Evil spell cast on it in the last 8 hours makes this save at advantage. A creature that succeeds on this saving throw by 5 or more awakes, dragging the hag into the waking world with it. The hag appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the target, and cannot use its Etherealness ability for the next minute.

reaction.name: Offer Bargain
entries: As a reaction to a creature it can see failing a saving throw, the hag grants it the ability to choose to succeed instead. A creature that does is Indebted to the hag.

reaction.name: True Magic
entries: As a reaction to a creature it can see wihthin 60 ft. casting a spell, the hag disrupts the magic. The spell fails, and the spell caster takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage per level of the spell and must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned}.

resist.note: from attacks with weapons that aren't named

trait.name: Fey Magic Resistance
entries: The hag has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects imposed by a creature that does not know its name.

trait.name: Elusive
entries: The hag may {@action Disengage} or {@action Hide} as a Bonus Action while submerged in water.

trait.name: Illusory Mimicry
entries: The hag can perfectly mimic the voice or appearance of any animal or humanoid affected by its Steal Voice.

trait.name: Shipbreaker Coven
entries: The sea within 10 miles of a coven of sea hags is filled with dangerous riptides, jagged reefs, and vicious storms that raise with little warning. Creatures on a ship or shore have disadvantage on ability checks made to spot or assess these dangers.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hag makes two attacks with her rotflesh claw, one of which she may replace with a use of her sargassum grasp.

action.name: Rotflesh Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) slashing damage and an illusory corruption begins to spread rapidly from the wound, giving the appearance of rotting, waterlogged flesh.
The creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of the hag's next turn.

action.name: Sargassum Grasp
entries: One creature the hag can see within 30 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 15}) as seaweed cocoons it. While {@condition restrained} in this way, a creature sinks 15 ft. at the beginning of each of its turns.
The seaweed can also be attacked and destroyed (AC 10; HP 15; immunity to bludgeoning and psychic damage).

action.name: Stolen Spell
entries: The sea hag casts a spell known by a creature affected by its steal voice, using the creature's spell slots.

action.name: Steal Voice (Concentration)
entries: One creature within 30 ft. of the hag must succeed on a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw or be unable to speak. If a creature fails this saving throw voluntarily, the hag does not require {@status concentration} to maintain the effect.

reaction.name: Courage to Dread
entries: As a reaction to a creature succeeding on a saving throw against its rotflesh claw, the hag makes the illusion real, dealing 27 ({@damage 6d8}) necrotic damage to the creature. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage immediately fails a death saving throw.

reaction.name: Death Gaze (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 90 hit points, the hag attempts to send a creature into a delirious panic. The creature must make a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw. A {@condition frightened} creature makes the initial saving throw at disadvatage.

A creature that fails this saving throw is {@condition frightened} and {@condition stunned} for the next minute, and repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more drops to 0 hit points.

monster.name: Gravedigger Minion
languages: understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Bonesense
entries: The gravedigger can pinpoint, by scent, the location of any creature with bones within 20 ft. of it, and does not suffer disadvantage for attacking a creature with bones that it cannot see.

trait.name: Rattle
entries: A creature that hits the gravedigger with a melee attack that deals bludgeoning damage must succeed a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn as it feels its own skeleton twitch slightly.

action.name: Shovel Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage. On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned}.

action.name: Gravebreaker Pick
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage. On a critical hit, the armor bonus provided by any nonmagical shield the creature is wielding is reduced by 1.

action.name: Leaping Strike {@recharge 5}
entries: The gravedigger leaps up to 20 feet and makes an attack at advantage. If the attack misses, the gravedigger falls {@condition prone} and ends its turn.

reaction.name: Stay Down
entries: As a reaction when a creature with 0 hit points regains hit points within 5 feet of the gravedigger, the gravedigger makes a melee attack against it.

trait.name: Undead Fortitude
entries: If the gravehound starts its turn with 0 hit points, it makes a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw, unless it took radiant damage or a critical hit since its last turn. On a success, the zombie gains 1 hit point. A zombie with 0 hit points is killed instantly if it is attacked.

action.name: {@disease lockjaw|ConfC} Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@dice 1d4 + 2}) piercing plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) necrotic damage damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}).

action.name: Worry
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by both the gravehound and at least one of the gravehound's allies must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or fall {@condition prone} and take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) piercing damage, or take half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Rotted Baying
entries: The gravehound begins a frantic, distorted barking that attracts undead in a 500 ft. radius to its current location. It may continue baying each turn as a Bonus Action. When the gravehound stops baying, undead with an intelligence score of 6 or lower stop approaching it.

reaction.name: Jaws of Death
entries: When the gravehound is reduced to 0 hit points, it can make an attack with its {@disease lockjaw|ConfC} Bite. if this attack hits, the gravehound maintains this grapple even while dead or {@condition unconscious}.

trait.name: Spirit Tether
entries: The gravesnag begins life tied to the manitou that created it with a faintly perceptible tether of spectral energy, which is {@condition invisible} to any creature with a Passive {@skill Perception} of 19 or lower.
