If the gravesnag begins its turn more than 30 feet away from its creator or if the tether is targeted with {@spell Dispel Magic} or a similar effect, the tether snaps and gravesnag is {@condition incapacitated} for 1 hour, and is freed from the manitou's control.

trait.name: Slithering Vines
entries: The gravesnag may enter and move through the space of any creature or any space wide enough for a single vine without squeezing.

action.name: Strangleroot Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.
If this attack was made with advantage, the gravesnag can immediately use its Tangled Lunge against the same target.

action.name: Tangled Lunge
entries: The gravesnag lurches up to 15 feet, then can force one creature in its space to succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 15}).
A creature {@condition restrained} by two or more gravenags is additionally {@condition choking|confc|choking}.
A creature {@condition restrained} by three or more gravesnags is {@condition blinded} and has total cover from outside effects.

action.name: Rending Twist
entries: One creature that is {@condition grappled} or {@condition restrained} by both the gravesnag and at least one other creature or effect must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 27 ({@damage 6d8}) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature killed by this damage is torn in half.

trait.name: Shape Memory
entries: If the ooze takes any lightning damage, it is {@condition paralyzed} until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

action.name: Shifting Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d6 + 1}) acid damage plus one effect of the ooze's choice:

items.name: Soften Armor
entries: One piece of nonmagical metal armor the target is wearing softens and sags, offering no AC bonus until the end of the ooze's next turn.

items.name: Soften Weapon
entries: One nonmagical metal weapon the target is wielding becomes springy and pliable, counting as an Improvised weapon until the end of the ooze's next turn.

action.name: Chaos Meld
entries: One creature within 5 feet that is wearing or wielding an item affected by the ooze's Shifting Pseudopod must make a {@dc 11} Dexterity saving throw.
On a failed save, the item liquefies and the ooze absorbs it, gaining 5 temporary hit points. While it has any of these temporary hit points, the ooze's AC is increased to 16.

action.name: Cryptic Mimicry
entries: The ooze mimics the texture of nearby surfaces, becoming indistinguishable from them until it moves or is illuminated by a source of Bright Light within 10 feet of it.

trait.name: Shape Memory
entries: If the ooze takes any lightning damage, it is {@condition paralyzed} until the beginning of its next turn and each creature {@condition swallowed|confc|swallowed} by it is expelled into the nearest unoccupied space.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: False Floor
entries: When a creature steps onto the ooze or fails an attempt to free a creature {@condition grappled} by the ooze, the ooze can grapple it (escape {@dc 14}).
A creature that fails an attempt to escape this grapple has disadvantage on its next attempt to escape.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ooze makes two attacks with its Shifting Pseudopod.

action.name: Shifting Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@dice 2d6 + 4}) acid plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) bludgeoning damage and the target suffers one effect of the ooze's choice:

items.name: Soften Armor
entries: One piece of nonmagical metal armor the target is wearing softens and sags, offering no AC bonus until the end of the ooze's next turn.

items.name: Soften Weapon
entries: One nonmagical metal weapon the target is wielding becomes springy and pliable, counting as an Improvised Weapon until the end of the ooze's next turn.

action.name: Chaos Meld
entries: Each creature within 10 feet of the ooze that is wearing or wielding an item affected by the ooze's Shifting Pseudopod must make a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw.
On a failed save, the item liquefies and the ooze absorbs it, gaining 5 temporary hit points per item absorbed. While it has any of these temporary hit points, the ooze's AC is increased to 16.

action.name: Cryptic Mimicry
entries: The ooze mimics the texture and hue of nearby surfaces, becoming indistinguishable from them until it moves or is illuminated by a source of Bright Light within 10 feet of it.

reaction.name: Inexorable Draw
entries: When a creature {@condition grappled} by the ooze takes an action, the ooze can draw it deeper in, restraining it for as long as it remains {@condition grappled}.

If the creature was already {@condition restrained}, it is instead {@condition swallowed|confc|swallowed} by the ooze and begins {@condition choking|confc|choking} for as long as it remains {@condition grappled}.

reaction.name: Vengeful Conduit
entries: When the quagmire takes any lightning damage, before being {@condition paralyzed} by its Shape Memory trait it can deal an equal amount of lightning damage to each creature {@condition grappled} by it.

trait.name: Imprint
entries: A creature native to the gray render's territory may attempt a {@dc 25} Wisdom ({@skill Animal Handling}) check to befriend the gray render. On a critical success, the gray render imprints on the creature, treating it as a family member to be nurtured and protected.

trait.name: Keen Sight and Smell
entries: The gray render has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight or smell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gray render makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

action.name: Dismembering Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d12 + 4}) piercing damage. This attack does an additional 17 ({@damage 3d12}) damage to a {@condition prone} creature. If this attack deals more than half the target's hit points, the target must succeed a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or lose a limb and drop to 0 hit points.

action.name: Rending Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d8 + 4}) slashing damage and the target must make a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone} and unable to stand until the end of the gray render's next turn. On a critical hit, nonmagical leather armor the target is wearing is destroyed.

reaction.name: Bloody Rampage
entries: As a reaction to taking 20 or more damage from a single source, the gray render lets out an enraged bellow, adding one claw attack to its multiattack, cumulatively, for the next minute.

trait.name: Six-Fingered Subversion
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of Graz'zt that is {@condition charmed} by a creature other than him is instead {@condition charmed} by him for the same duration.

trait.name: Seductive Guile
entries: A creature that fails a saving throw against a spell or ability Graz'zt controls can choose to succeed instead. If it does, the creature gains 30 temporary hit points.

While a creature has any of these temporary hit points, it is {@condition dominated|confc|dominated} by Graz'zt, and cannot benefit from immunity to the {@condition charmed} or {@condition dominated|confc|dominated} condition.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Graz'zt has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Legendary Resistances (5/Day)
entries: If Graz'zt fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Graz'zt makes two attacks with Bitter Bastard and uses either his Gift of Writhing Pain or Gift of Transcendent Pleasure.

action.name: Bitter Bastard
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}19 ({@dice 3d8 + 6}) slashing and an arc of acid splashes forth in a 15 foot cone centered on the target, dealing 9 ({@damage 2d8}) acid damage to each creature in the area.

action.name: Gift of Writhing Pain (5th Level Spell)
entries: One creature Graz'zt can see within 60 feet falls {@condition prone} and is wracked with agony for the next minute.

At the beginning of each of the creature's turns, it must succeed on a {@dc 23} Constitution saving throw or take 16 ({@damage 3d10}) psychic damage and be unable to stand until the beginning of its next turn, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Gift of Transcendent Pleasure (5th Level Spell)
entries: One creature Graz'zt can see within 60 is suffused in an aura of pure rapturous delight for the next minute.

At the beginning of each of the creature's turns, it must succeed on a {@dc 23} Wisdom saving throw or voluntarily fail all other saving throws and be unable to take reactions until the beginning of its next turn. On a success, the effect ends.

action.name: Annihilating Despair (Concentration, Recharges when Graz'zt uses his Ambrosial Ecstasy)
entries: One creature Graz'zt can see within 60 feet becomes {@condition invisible} to him for the next minute.
At the beginning of each of the creature's turns, it must succeed on a {@dc 23} Wisdom saving throw or take 77 ({@damage 14d10}) psychic damage.
If a creature is killed by this damage, each of its allies must succeed on a {@dc 23} Wisdom saving throw or lose all memory of them until restored by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

action.name: Ambrosial Ecstasy {@recharge 5}
entries: Graz'zt gently touches a creature within 5 feet and shares with it a fragment of his power, forcing it to succeed on a {@dc 23} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition cursed|confc|cursed}.

A creature cursed in this way adds {@dice 1d4} to any attack roll or saving throw it makes while {@condition charmed} or {@condition dominated|confc|dominated} by Graz'zt, and subtracts {@dice 1d4} from any such roll made while not {@condition charmed} or {@condition dominated|confc|dominated} by him.
A creature that has this curse removed by any means other than a {@spell Wish} spell takes 22 ({@damage 4d10}) psychic damage whenever it completes a Long Rest.

reaction.name: Exploit Opening
entries: When he is missed with a melee attack, Graz'zt can move up to 10 feet and make an attack with Bitter Bastard.

reaction.name: Covetous Intercession (3rd Level Spell)
entries: When a creature {@condition charmed} or {@condition dominated|confc|dominated} by him is targeted with an attack, Graz'zt can teleport to switch places with the target, and Graz'zt becomes the new target of the attack.

legendary.name: Beguiling Invitation
entries: One creature Graz'zt can see within 60 feet can use its reaction to move up to its speed, then takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) psychic damage for each 5 feet away from him it ends this movement.

legendary.name: Devour Magic
entries: Graz'zt ends one spell or magical effect within 60 feet, then gains disadvantage on the next saving throw he makes in the next minute against magic controlled by that spell's caster.

legendary.name: Mercurial Strike (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Graz'zt teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of a creature he can see, then makes two melee attacks against it.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The dragon can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Forcebreaker
entries: The dragon can destroy an adjacent creation of magical force, such as that produced by Wall of Force or Forcecage, by spending 10 feet of movement.

trait.name: Crushing Field
entries: The area in a 30 foot radius around the dragon is difficult terrain for creatures with a Strength score lower than 21.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 17} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 2d10 + 9}) piercing damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) force damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 17} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d6 + 9}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 25}) and {@condition restrained}. Each other creature within 10 feet of the target must succeed on a {@dc 24} Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 17} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d8 + 9}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 20 ft. away from the dragon. Each other creature within 10 feet of the target must succeed on a {@dc 24} Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage and be pushed 10 feet away.

action.name: Breath Weapons {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.

action.name: Shattergem Breath
entries: The dragon breathes forth a hail of luminous crystals in a 300-foot line that is 15 feet wide. The area becomes difficult terrain, and each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 24} Dexterity saving throw or take 42 ({@damage 12d6}) slashing damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Singularity Breath
entries: The dragon creates a shining bead of gravitational force in its mouth, then releases the energy in a 300-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 23} Strength saving throw.

On a failed save, the creature takes 81 ({@damage 18d8}) force damage, and its speed becomes 0 until the start of the dragon's next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage, and its speed isn't reduced.

bonus.name: Psionic Empowerment
entries: The dragon produces one of the following effects:

items.name: Psychokinetic Hurl
entries: One creature the dragon can see within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 23} Strength saving throw or be flung up to 40 feet in a direction of the dragon's choice and take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Mind-Blind
entries: The dragon becomes {@condition invisible} to one creature it can telepathically communicate with until the beginning of its next turn.

items.name: Metabolic Overdrive
entries: The dragon gains advantage on Dexterity and Constitution saving throws until the beginning of its next turn.

items.name: Psychic Step
entries: The dragon teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of a creature that it can telepathically communicate with.

reaction.name: Psychoport Inversion
entries: As a reaction when a creature teleports to or away from a space the dragon can see, the dragon forces it to succeed on a {@dc 24} Charisma saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 4d10}) force damage and immediately teleport back.

reaction.name: Bloodied Breath (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 327 hit points, the dragon immediately recharges and uses one of its breath weapons.

legendary.name: Psionic Empowerment
entries: The dragon uses its Psionic Empowerment.

legendary.name: Gravity Collapse
entries: Each creature within 30 feet of a line of gems created by the dragon's breath must succeed on a {@dc 24} Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 15 feet toward it by the most direct route.

legendary.name: Detonate Gems (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: One line of gems created by the dragon's breath detonates in a chained explosion of force. Each creature within 15 feet of the line must succeed on a {@dc 24} Constitution saving throw or take 55 ({@damage 10d10}) force damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Unequaled Cruelty
entries: When the black dragon reduces a creature to 0 hit points, each {@condition frightened} creature that can see it must use its reaction, if available, to move its speed directly away from it.

trait.name: Sensitivity Aura
entries: Attacks against creatures within 15 feet of the dragon that do not have resistance or immunity to acid damage score a critical on an 18-20.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three attacks, one of which can be with its Steelrot Bite, and uses its Frightful Presence.

action.name: Steelrot Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 17} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@dice 2d10 + 9}) piercing plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) acid damage.
On a critical hit, one weapon or piece of armor of Very Rare or lesser rarity that the target is wearing or wielding is destroyed (target's choice).

action.name: Subduing Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 17} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d6 + 9}) slashing damage and the target is knocked {@condition prone} and {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 21}).
Each other creature within 10 feet of the target must succeed on a {@dc 25} Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

action.name: Tailbarb Stab
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 17} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d6 + 9}) piercing damage and the target begins {@condition bleeding|confc|bleeding} ({@dice 1d10}).
Any hit against a {@condition prone} creature with this attack becomes a critical.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of the dragon's choice within 300 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 21} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the beginning of the dragon's next turn, becoming immune to this effect for the next 24 hours on a success.

action.name: Hacked-Tar Sputum (Recharges when the dragon uses its Flesh-Melting Breath)
entries: The dragon hacks up a glob of spent acid and dead flesh at a point it can see within 300 feet, where it splashes in a 20 foot radius, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a {@dc 24} Dexterity saving throw or be drenched in sticky sludge (remove {@dc 24}).

A sludge-drenched creature is {@condition blinded}, has its movement reduced by half, and is protected from decay if it dies, extending the time limit of effects that would raise the target from the dead by up to a year.

action.name: Flesh-Melting Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon spews a jet of caustic acid in a 300-foot long, 15-foot wide line, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a {@dc 24} Dexterity saving throw or take 99 ({@damage 22d8}) acid damage, or half as much damage on a success.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more suffers a Vitriolic Disfigurement until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic. A creature killed by this damage disintegrates.

reaction.name: Cruel Jest
entries: When a creature smaller than the dragon leaves its reach, the dragon can force it to make a {@dc 25} Dexterity saving throw.
On a failure, the target is dragged up to 10 feet toward the dragon and the dragon regains its reaction.

reaction.name: Bloodied Breath (1/Day
entries: When the dragon is reduced below 303 hit points, it can roll to recharge its Flesh-Melting Breath, then immediately use it, if available.

legendary.name: Mire Dive
entries: The dragon moves up to half its speed. If it ends this movement submerged in murky water, it can attempt to {@action Hide}.

legendary.name: Peel Nerve
entries: The dragon makes a Subduing Claw attack.
If this attack hits a creature {@condition grappled} by the dragon, the target has one spell affect on it end, or gains vulnerability to acid damage until it regains any hit points if it cannot.

legendary.name: Drooling Torment
entries: Acid drips from the dragon's jaws toward a creature {@condition grappled} by it, dealing 9 ({@damage 2d8}) acid damage to the creature.
The target can use its reaction to attempt to escape the grapple, avoiding the damage on a success.

trait.name: Skyfire Splendor
entries: While the dragon is flying, it has advantage on Dexterity saving throws and {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity} made against it have disadvantage.

trait.name: Rising Charge
entries: When the dragon rolls to recharge its Scourgebolt Breath, each creature within 15 feet of it takes lightning damage equal to three times the number rolled.

trait.name: Reserved Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. Its save DCs are reduced by 1 for each expended use of this ability.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three attacks, one of which can be with its Sparking Bite, and uses its Frightful Presence.

action.name: Cavernous Maw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 18} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}26 ({@dice 3d10 + 10}) piercing plus 16 ({@damage 3d10}) lightning damage.

If the target was {@condition grappled}, the dragon may force it to succeed on a {@dc 26} Strength saving throw or be {@condition swallowed|confc|swallowed}. While swallowed in this way, a creature takes 22 ({@damage 4d10}) lightning damage at the beginning of each of the dragon's turns.
If a creature inside the dragon deals 50 or more damage to the dragon in a turn, the dragon immediately regurgitates each creature swallowed by it.

action.name: Sandhoned Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 18} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d6 + 10}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 26}).
Each other creature within 10 feet of the target must succeed on a {@dc 26} Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

action.name: Ridgetail Sweep
entries: The dragon sweeps its tail in a 30 foot cone, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a {@dc 26} Dexterity saving throw or take 28 ({@damage 8d6}) bludgeoning damage and be pushed up to 20 feet away from the dragon, or take half as much damage and be pushed up to half as far on a success.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of the dragon's choice within 120 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 22} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the beginning of the dragon's next turn, becoming immune to this effect for the next 24 hours on a success.

action.name: Shattered Heavens Roar (Concentration)
entries: The dragon roars a challenge to the sky above, carving a rift through which boiling thunderclouds spill.
At the beginning of the dragon's next turn, a cascade of lightning bolts arc down, striking up to four creatures the dragon can see within 300 feet that are not beneath full cover.
Each target must succeed on a {@dc 22} Dexterity saving throw or take 44 ({@damage 8d10}) lightning damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Scourgebolt Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: A stream of crackling energy issues forth from the dragon's mouth in a 300 foot long, 15 foot wide line, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a {@dc 25} Dexterity saving throw or take 110 ({@damage 20d10}) lightning damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is {@condition paralyzed} until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Rampant Growth
entries: The dragon calls a burst of barbed vines forth from the earth in a 30 foot radius centered on a point it can see within 60 feet, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a {@dc 21} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 21}).
Until the dragon uses this ability again, the area is difficult terrain, and a creature that moves into or within the area takes 18 ({@damage 4d8}) piercing damage for every 5 feet it travels.

action.name: Lungripper Miasma Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon exhales a poisonous cloud in a 300-foot cone.
Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 24} Constitution saving throw or take 98 ({@damage 28d6}) poison damage, or half as much damage on a success.
A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is {@condition blinded} and {@condition choking|confc|choking} until the end of the dragon's next turn.

reaction.name: Vindictive Snap
entries: When a creature affected by the green dragon's Lungripper Miasma Breath takes fewer than 50 damage from it, the dragon can move up to 30 feet toward the creature and make a Venomtongue Bite attack against it.

reaction.name: Bloodied Breath (1/Day
entries: When the dragon is reduced below 277 hit points, it can roll to recharge its Lungripper Miasma Breath, then immediately use it, if available.

legendary.name: Spit Venom
entries: The dragon spits a gob of concentrated venom at a creature it can see within 30 feet, forcing it to succeed on a {@dc 24} Constitution saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Poison damage and be {@condition blinded} until it clears its eyes as a Bonus Action.

legendary.name: Silent Snatch
entries: The dragon moves up to 30 feet, then can grapple one creature (escape {@dc 25}) it is hidden from and force it to make a {@dc 25} Constitution saving throw.
On a failure, the target is {@condition stunned} and hidden from its allies until the beginning of the dragon's next turn, and the dragon remains hidden from each other creature.

legendary.name: Slink Away (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon moves up to 30 feet. If it ends this movement at least 30 feet from any hostile creature, it may immediately attempt to {@action Hide}.

trait.name: Quick Squeeze
entries: The dragon may move through any space larger than its skull without squeezing.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The dragon can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Extinguishing Aura
entries: The dragon is surrounded by an aura of light-eating microbes. At the beginning of the dragon's turn, each light source within 120 ft. diminishes one level; from bright light to dim light, or from dim light to darkness.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d10 + 7}) piercing damage plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) poison damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d6 + 7}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 22}) and {@condition restrained}. Each other creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d8 + 7}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 20 feet away from the dragon. Each other creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a {@dc 22} Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage and be pushed 10 feet away.

action.name: Breath Weapons {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.

action.name: Nightmare Spore Breath
entries: The dragon exhales a cloud of spores in a 300-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 21} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 77 ({@damage 14d10}) psychic damage and is covered in spores until a creature takes an action to remove them. While covered in these spores, a creature is {@condition frightened}.

action.name: Stone Tomb Breath
entries: The dragon exhales a burst of stone-softening magic in a 300-foot cone, turning the ground in the area into difficult terrain for the next minute. A creature that begins its turn on the ground in the area must succeed on a {@dc 21} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 21}) as it begins to sink into the stone.
A creature already affected by this ability that fails the saving throw sinks entirely beneath the surface, and is {@condition blinded} and cannot speak or breathe until it escapes.

reaction.name: Phantasmagoria
entries: As a reaction when a {@condition frightened} creature fails a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check to detect it, the dragon forces the creature to succeed on a {@dc 21} Wisdom saving throw or move up to half its speed and make a melee attack against a creature of the dragon's choice.

reaction.name: Bloodied Breath (1/Day
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 166 hit points, the dragon immediately recharges and uses one of its breath weapons.

legendary.name: Awful Scuttle
entries: The dragon moves up to half its climb speed. If it ends this movement out of sight of any hostile creatures, it may attempt a Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check to hide.

legendary.name: Acrid Spore Burst
entries: One creature that is covered in spores from the dragon's breath weapon takes 27 ({@damage 6d8}) acid damage as the spores rupture and slough off in a caustic spray.

legendary.name: Hysterical Blindness
entries: One creature the dragon can see within 60 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 21} Wisdom saving throw or lose its {@sense darkvision} for the next minute.

trait.name: Vainglorious Strength
entries: If the dragon succeeds on a Strength saving throw, the next attack it makes before the end of its next turn has advantage.
If the dragon fails a Strength saving throw, it has disadvantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws for the next minute.

trait.name: Whorlflare Landing
entries: The first time each turn that the dragon lands on a solid surface after descending at least 20 feet, each creature within 30 feet of it is pushed up to 10 feet away and begins {@condition burning|confc|burning} ({@dice 1d10}).

trait.name: Flamegorge Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, each flame within 30 feet of it is extinguished.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Searing Bite, and uses its Frightful Presence.

action.name: Cavernous Maw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 18} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}26 ({@dice 3d10 + 10}) piercing plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) fire damage.

If the target was {@condition grappled}, the dragon may force it to succeed on a {@dc 26} Strength saving throw or be {@condition swallowed|confc|swallowed}. While swallowed in this way, a creature takes 22 ({@damage 4d10}) fire damage at the beginning of each of the dragon's turns.
If a creature inside the dragon deals 50 or more damage to the dragon in a turn, the dragon immediately regurgitates each creature swallowed by it.

action.name: Irongouge Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 18} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d6 + 10}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 26}).
Each other creature within 10 feet of the target must succeed on a {@dc 26} Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

action.name: Phalanx-Tail Sweep
entries: The dragon sweeps its tail in a 30 foot cone, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a {@dc 26} Dexterity saving throw or take 28 ({@damage 8d6}) bludgeoning damage and be pushed up to 20 feet away from the dragon, or take half as much damage and be pushed half as far on a success.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of the dragon's choice within 120 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 23} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the beginning of the dragon's next turn, becoming immune to this effect for the next 24 hours on a success.

action.name: Slagflame Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon exhales rippling flames in a 300-foot cone, turning each surface in the area to molten slag.
Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 26} Dexterity or take 105 ({@damage 30d6}) fire damage, or half as much on a success.
For the next minute, the ground in the area becomes difficult terrain, and a creature that ends its turn on the ground in the area takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Stoke Malice (1/Day)
entries: The dragon breathes evil life into an an area of slag or magma within 300 feet, creating three {@creature magmin pyroclast|confc|Magmin Pyroclasts} that emerge from the ground into unoccupied spaces in the area.

reaction.name: Billowing Wings
entries: When the dragon takes 30 or more damage from a single source, it may shroud itself in smoke, heavily obscuring the area in a 60 foot radius until the end of its next turn, then immediately move up to half its speed.

reaction.name: Bloodied Breath (1/Day.)
entries: When the dragon is reduced below 369 hit points, it can roll to recharge its Slagflame Breath, then immediately use it, if available.

legendary.name: Lunging Swipe
entries: The dragon moves up to 20 feet, then makes an attack with its Irongouge Claws.

legendary.name: Leaping Flames
entries: The dragon causes the flames surrounding a burning creature or object it can see within 90 feet to flare and leap to a creature within 30 feet of them.
The creature must succeed on a {@dc 23} Dexterity saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 4d10}) fire damage and begin {@condition burning|confc|burning} ({@dice 1d10}).

legendary.name: Burn Away
entries: One {@condition burning|confc|burning} creature the dragon can see within 90 feet must succeed on a {@dc 23} Charisma saving throw or have the lowest level spell affecting it end, then the creature takes 16 ({@damage 3d10}) fire damage if no spell is currently affecting it.

legendary.name: Inhale Cinders (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon may end the {@condition burning|confc|burning} condition on one creature within 15 feet of it. If it does, the dragon rolls to recharge its Slagflame Breath.

immune.special: one other type determined by the dragon's former type

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Shadow Form
entries: The shadow dragon's traits change depending on lighting.
In darkness, the dragon treats all creatures as unarmored (an unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier.)
In dim light or darkness it can hide as a bonus action without obscurement, submerging itself in pools of shadow.
In bright light, attacks against the dragon have advantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail. If the dragon is bright light, it may replace its tail attack with two claw attacks.

entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 18} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 2d10 + 10}) piercing damage plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 18} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d6 + 10}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 22}) and {@condition restrained}. Each other creature within 10 feet of the target must succeed on a {@dc 22} Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 18} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d6 + 10}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 20 feet away from the dragon. Each other creature within 10 feet of the target must succeed on a {@dc 22} Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage and be pushed 10 feet away.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of the dragon's choice that is within 120 feet of the dragon and aware of it must succeed on a {@dc 22} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the dragon's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Shadow Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon exhales writhing shadow in a 300-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 26} Constitution saving throw, taking 105 ({@damage 30d6}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature with a shadow reduced to 0 by this damage falls into its shadow, and its shadow climbs into the material plane to replace it, with the following attributes:
The creature's shadow has the same statistics and abilities as the creature and has one hit point. It acts on the dragon's initiative and is under the dragon's control.
The creature remains conscious, but may only target its shadow with spells and abilities.
A creature can wrestle the shadow back into the shadow realm with a successful {@dc 18} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. If it does, the creature returns to the material plane with one hit point.
If the creature's shadow receives any healing, the shadow is banished to the shadow realm. The creature returns to the material plane with one hit point.
If the creature's shadow dies, the creature is lost forever to the realm of shadow.

reaction.name: Snuff (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 369 HP, the dragon extinguishes all lights within 300 ft.

reaction.name: Shadow Glide (Dim Light Only)
entries: As a reaction to taking damage of a type it is resistant to, the wraith may teleport up to 60 feet and turn {@condition invisible} until the end of its next turn, or until it makes an attack.

legendary.name: Snatch
entries: The dragon makes a claw attack against a creature that it is hidden from. If the attack hits, the target is {@condition grappled}, {@condition stunned}, and hidden from its allies until the beginning of its next turn. This attack does not automatically reveal the dragon's position.

legendary.name: Shadow Tether
entries: One creature within 60 ft. that the dragon can see must make a {@dc 22} Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the next time the dragon takes damage in the next minute, it takes half as much damage and the target takes the same amount.

legendary.name: Waken Shadows
entries: One creature within 60 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 22} Strength saving throw or be {@condition grappled} and {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 22}) as its shadow lunges to grip it. A creature is freed if it is in bright light.

trait.name: Ice Walk
entries: The dragon can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.

trait.name: Freezing Blood
entries: Whenever the silver dragon takes piercing or slashing damage, it raises its AC cumulatively by 1 until the beginning of its next turn, or until it takes at least 15 points of fire damage.

trait.name: Flattery Vulnerability
entries: When subjected to flattery by a medium or smaller creature, the dragon must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or behave as though {@condition charmed} by the creature until it takes hostile action against the dragon or its allies. A dragon that succeeds on this save becomes immune to flattery from that creature for the next minute.

Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 25} Constitution saving throw, taking 108 ({@damage 24d8}) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The area becomes difficult terrain, and a creature that starts its turn in it or enters the area for the first time on a turn must succeed on a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

action.name: Hypothermic Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon exhales a burst of chilling gas. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 25} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature is {@condition paralyzed} outside of its own turn, and repeats this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more must use its action to doff its armor or shield.

reaction.name: Freeze Spell
entries: As a reaction to seeing a creature cast a spell within 60 feet, the dragon chills the magic, preventing the spell from taking effect until the beginning of the spellcaster's next turn.

reaction.name: Raking Riposte
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack, the dragon makes a claw attack.

reaction.name: Bloodied Breath (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 251 HP, the dragon immediately recharges and uses its Freezing Breath.

legendary.name: Shield the Weak
entries: The dragon moves up to half its speed without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}. If it ends that movement within 15 feet of a friendly creature, the creature gains +5 to its AC and has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn, or until it moves further away.

legendary.name: Face Me!
entries: One creature within 30 feet is compelled to meet the dragon in melee combat. An affected creature that attempts to target the dragon with an attack or harmful spell from more than 10 feet away on its following turn must first make a {@dc 22} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature loses the attack or spell.

legendary.name: Uttercold
entries: The dragon draws on its deepest reserves. Until the end of its next turn, cold damage the dragon deals ignores damage resistance, and the dragon loses one of its legendary resistances.

legendary.name: Cryostasis
entries: One creature that died within the last minute returns to life with 0 hit points and automatically stabilizes.

trait.name: Iconoclast
entries: The dragon may spend 5 ft. of movement to destroy a construct of magical force within 5 ft. If it does, the dragon takes 21 ({@damage 4d10}) force damage.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: The dragon can't be affected or detected by spells of 4th level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

action.name: Acid Trench Breath
entries: The dragon exhales acid in a 300-foot line that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw, taking 72 ({@damage 16d8}) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Additionally, rock and earth in the area are disolved to a depth of 20 ft.

entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 149 HP, the dragon immediately recharges and uses one of its breath weapons.

reaction.name: Bat Away
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the dragon forces the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or have one object it is holding knocked out of its hands and 20 ft. away.

legendary.name: Corrective Confinement
entries: One creature within 60 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 19}) until the end of the dragon's next turn as bonds of magical force leap to confine it.

legendary.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon beats its wings. Each creature within 15 feet of the dragon must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 2d6 + 8}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}. The dragon can then fly up to half its flying speed.

legendary.name: Free the Oppressed (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: One creature within 60 ft. is freed from all restraints and cured of any poison or disease, then must make a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature regards the dragon as a trusted ally and all other creatures as enemies for the next minute. An affected creature repeats this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

trait.name: Tundraborn
entries: The dragon ignores negative effects from moving over terrain composed of ice or snow, and has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition blinded}.

trait.name: Heavy Chill
entries: A creature that begins its turn within 30 feet of the dragon has disadvantage on each attack it makes on its turn beyond the first, unless it is resistant or immune to cold damage.
A creature can lose two unexpended hit dice to ignore this effect until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Frostblessed Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw against an effect that does not deal fire damage, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes four Barbed Claw attacks, one of which it can replace with its Bitter Bite or Icecarve Tail, and uses either its Frightful Presence or Raise Hackles.

action.name: Bitter Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 17} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@dice 2d10 + 9}) piercing plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) cold damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 25}).
A creature {@condition grappled} in this way has disadvantage on saving throws against the dragon's Winterglass Breath.

action.name: Barbed Claw

Each other creature within 10 feet of the target must succeed on a {@dc 25} Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

action.name: Icecarve Tail
entries: The dragon sweeps its tail, flinging a wave of ice and snow in a 30 foot cone.

Each creature in the area is pushed up to 10 feet away and must succeed on a {@dc 25} Dexterity saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 3d8}) cold damage and be {@condition blinded} until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Frightful Presence

action.name: Raise Hackles
entries: The dragon extends its spined frill and a deep, booming rumble ripples through the air around it in a 60 foot radius.

Each creature in the area that is immune to the dragon's Frightful Presence or the {@condition frightened} condition must succeed on a {@dc 25} Wisdom saving throw or lose that immunity for the next minute.

action.name: Winterglass Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon exhales a blast of frigid air in a 300-foot cone, covering the area in ice and forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a {@dc 25} Constitution saving throw or take 90 ({@damage 20d8}) cold damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 10 or more contracts Frostbite.
A creature that moves more than 10 feet through the area in a turn must succeed on a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Sudden Pounce
entries: When a creature the dragon can see within 120 feet moves at least 15 feet away from it or fails an attempt to {@action Hide} from it, the dragon can leap up to 120 feet directly toward the creature and make a Barbed Claw attack against it.

reaction.name: Bloodied Breath (1/Day
entries: When the dragon is reduced below 263 hit points, it can roll to recharge its Winterglass Breath, then immediately use it, if available.

legendary.name: Terrorize

legendary.name: Ice Tomb
entries: The dragon breathes a layer of dense, translucent ice that encrusts a {@condition prone} creature within 20 feet, forcing it to succeed on a {@dc 25} Strength saving throw or gain 25 temporary hit points, or half as many on a success.

A creature that has any of these temporary hit points is {@condition restrained} and loses three unexpended hit dice at the end of each of its turns, or gains a point of {@condition exhaustion} if it can't.

legendary.name: Uttercold
entries: The dragon draws on its deepest reserves, intensifying its natural cold.
Until the end of its next turn, cold damage the dragon deals ignores damage resistance, and it can reroll any of the damage dice of its Winterglass Breath once, taking the second result.

legendary.name: Ploughing Pivot (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon moves up to 15 feet and uses its Icecarve Tail.

trait.name: Deteriorating Form
entries: Absent its innate draconic magics, mere necromancy is unable to sustain the zombie for long. Whenever the zombie makes an attack, it loses 10 hit points. Whenever the zombie uses its breath weapon, it loses 40 hit points.

trait.name: Putrid Stench
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the zombie must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Ponderous Strikes
entries: Whenever a creature succeeds on a Dexterity saving throw to avoid taking damage from one of the zombie's attacks, it may use its reaction to attempt to climb onto the zombie.

trait.name: Gargantuan Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the zombie may spend its full movement to attempt a {@dc 22} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the zombie. While climbing on the zombie, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the zombie, and the zombie has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The zombie makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Festering Bite.

action.name: Gore Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon exudes a torrent of its own liquefied viscera in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 21} Strength saving throw or take 36 ({@dice 8d8}) bludgeoning plus 27 ({@damage 8d6}) poison damage and be knocked {@condition prone}, or take half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Perilous Thrash
entries: When the zombie misses with a melee attack, it may permanently suffer one of the following effects of its choice that it has not yet suffered. If it does, it rerolls the attack with advantage:

items.name: Torn Wing
entries: While flying, the zombie must succeed on a {@dc 21} Strength saving throw at the end of each of its turns or fall {@condition prone}.

items.name: Broken Limb
entries: The zombie makes one fewer attack with its multiattack after this turn.

items.name: Dislocated Jaw
entries: The zombie cannot use its Festering Bite after this turn.

items.name: Severed Tail
entries: The zombie cannot use its Decayed Tail after this turn, and it drops its severed tail in the nearest unoccupied space. The tail is an improvised heavy weapon that can be wielded by a creature with at least 19 Strength and deals {@damage 2d12} + STR bludgeoning damage on a hit.

trait.name: Three Heads
entries: The chimera has three reactions each round. Whenever it takes 20 or more damage from a single source it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or lose one of its reactions.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the chimera fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chimera makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws. When its fire breath is available, it can use the breath in place of its bite.

action.name: Gnashing Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) piercing damage plus 5 ({@damage 1d8}) fire damage

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) slashing damage and the target is knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Fire Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon head exhales fire in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw, taking 45 ({@damage 10d8}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reaction.name: Headbutt
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the chimera may force the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 3d8}) bludgeoning damage and be {@condition stunned} until the end of the chimera's next turn.

reaction.name: Rake
entries: As a reaction to a creature entering its reach, the chimera may make a claws attack against it. If the attack hits, the target is knocked {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Roar
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a ranged attack, the chimera may let out a terrifying roar. Each creature within 60 feet that can hear it must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} of the chimera until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Claw Attack
entries: The chimera makes a claw attack.

legendary.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The chimera beats its wings. Each creature within 10 feet of the chimera must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}. The dragon can then fly up to half its flying speed.

trait.name: Aura of Terror
entries: A sleeping creature that starts its turn within 30 ft. of the feyr is accosted by its deepest fears, and takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) psychic damage. This damage does not wake a sleeping creature. A creature reduced to 0 hit points in this way gains 1 hit point and rises on its turn under the feyr's control.
A creature under the feyr's control makes a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a succeess.

trait.name: Light Sensitivity
entries: While the feyr is illuminated with bright light, attacks against the it are made at advantage.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the feyr fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The feyr makes three melee attacks, one of which it may replace with The First Unknown, if available.

action.name: Gnashing Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d10 + 6}) piercing damage. This attack deals an additional 5 ({@damage 1d10}) psyschic damage to a {@condition frightened} creature.

action.name: Tendril Lash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) slashing damage.

action.name: Torment Gaze
entries: Each creature in a line that is 60 ft. long and 5 ft. wide must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away and take 44 ({@damage 8d10}) psychic damage, or take half as much damage on as success. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more falls asleep for the next minute, additionally.
A creature wakes up early if it takes damage or another creature uses its action to wake it.

action.name: The First Unknown {@recharge 5}
entries: The feyr creates a 10-ft radius sphere of magical darkness that lasts until the end of its next turn. Creatures in the affected areas must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the darkness is dispelled. While {@condition frightened} in this way, a creature is {@condition paralyzed}.

reaction.name: Insubstantiate
entries: As a reaction to taking 20 or more damage from a single source, the feyr disappears into the border ethereal and loses one of its legendary resistances if it has any. At the beginning of its its next turn, the feyr teleports back into the material plane within 30 ft. of where it departed.

reaction.name: Deepest Dark (1/Day.)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 133 hit points, the feyr immediately recharges and uses The First Unknown.

legendary.name: Eye of Keeping
entries: One creature under the Feyr's control gains 7 ({@dice 2d6}) temporary hit points. While it has these temporary hit points, a creature has disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws.

legendary.name: Eye of Revelation
entries: One creature within 60 ft. that the feyr can see must succeed on a {@dc 17} Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the target has disadvantage on the next Wisdom saving throw it makes in the next minute.

legendary.name: To Ashes
entries: The feyr fouls the magic around a creature. The next time in the next turn that the creature would receive magical healing, the creature receives no healing and instead takes an equal amount of necrotic damage.

trait.name: Devil's Sight

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The abishai has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Mind Reader
entries: At the beginning of the abishai's turn, one creature it can see within 120 ft. must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the Abishai is aware of its thoughts, and treats its AC as 4 higher against that creature's attacks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The abishai makes two melee attacks and uses its Incite Panic.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 11 ({@damage 2d10}) poison damage and become {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. While {@condition poisoned} in this way, a creature cannot see the abishai. The {@condition poisoned} target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success

action.name: Incite Panic
entries: One creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of the Abishai's next turn. While {@condition frightened} in this way, a creature selects targets at random.

reaction.name: Dragonspawn Exhultation
entries: As a reaction to a friendly dragon within 30 ft. using its breath weapon, the abishai may move up to half its speed and make a bite attack.

reaction.name: Convincing Cry
entries: As a reaction to a creature hitting it with a melee attack, the abishai may compel one creature affected by its Incite Panic to move up to half its speed. If it ends this speed within 5 ft. of the attacker, the {@condition frightened} creature makes a melee attack against it.

trait.name: Forestborn
entries: The dragon's movement is not impeded by natural or magical foliage, and while in a wooded area can attempt to {@action Hide} while only Lightly Obscured.

trait.name: Slithering Shadow
entries: The first time each turn that the dragon is missed with an attack, it can move up to 10 feet without provoking {@action opportunity attack||opportunity attacks}.

trait.name: Fuming Wounds
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 15 feet of the dragon takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage if it has fewer than half its hit points.

trait.name: Greenleech Resistance (1/Day)

action.name: Multiattack

If the target is resistant to poison damage, it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or lose its resistance to poison damage for the next minute.

action.name: Hooked Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) slashing damage.
Instead of dealing damage, the dragon can grapple the target (escape {@dc 17}).

action.name: Lash Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 5 feet away.

action.name: Rampant Growth
entries: The dragon calls a burst of barbed vines forth from the earth in a 15 foot radius centered on a point it can see within 60 feet, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 15}).
Until the dragon uses this ability again, the area is difficult terrain, and a creature that moves into or within the area takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) piercing damage for every 5 feet it travels.

action.name: Lungripper Miasma Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon exhales a poisonous cloud in a 60-foot cone.
Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or take 38 ({@damage 11d6}) poison damage, or half as much damage on a success.
A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is {@condition blinded} and {@condition choking|confc|choking} until the end of the dragon's next turn.

reaction.name: Adapt Camouflage

reaction.name: Vindictive Snap

legendary.name: Spit Venom

legendary.name: Silent Snatch

entries: The grung's long jump is up to 25 feet and its high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

trait.name: Toe Pads
entries: The grung can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, if it uses both hands and feet to climb.

trait.name: Poisonous Skin
entries: A creature that comes into contact with the grung's skin must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn. While {@condition poisoned} in this way, the creature's movement speed is halved.

action.name: Javelin
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage plus 5 ({@damage 2d4}) poison damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be affected by the grung's Poisonous Skin.

reaction.name: Spring Away
entries: As a reaction to being missed with an attack, the grung moves up to its speed without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

trait.name: Blood Scent
entries: The drake can pinpoint, by scent, the location of any creature within 120 ft. that does not have all of its hit points.

trait.name: Fuming Blood
entries: Whenever the drake takes slashing or piercing damage, its blood reacts with the air to form a poisonous gas. Until the beginning of its next turn, a creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the drake takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poisond damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The drake attacks twice, once with its bite and once with its tail.

reaction.name: Bluff Strike
entries: As a reaction to a creature entering the drake's reach, it may force the creature to succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be forced to immediately move 10 ft. away from the drake, if it can.

trait.name: Fey Magic Resistance
entries: The hag has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects imposed by a creature that does not know its name.

trait.name: Swampwalk
entries: The hag is unaffected by difficult terrain caused by swampy terrain or vegetation.

trait.name: Illusory Mimicry
entries: The hag can mimic the voice or appearance of any animal or humanoid it has killed. A creature can discern the nature of these illusions with a successful {@dc 14} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check.

trait.name: Glimmer of Hope
entries: Whenever one or more creatures the hag can see within 30 ft. succeed on a saving throw against a spell the hag controls, the hag gains 5 ({@dice 1d10}) temporary hit points.

trait.name: Earthdrinker Coven
entries: The earth within 10 miles of a coven of green hags gradually softens and becomes waterlogged over the course of a week. The roots of food crops begin to rot away, livestock sicken, and the area becomes difficult terrain.

action.name: Swampgift Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) slashing damage and the creature must succeed on a {@dc 13} Charisma saving throw or be cursed.
While cursed, a creature glows with a pale blue light, attracts biting insects, and swamp-dwelling creatures have advantage on attack rolls against the cursed creature.

action.name: Hurl to Earth
entries: One creature within 60 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 13} Charisma saving throw or be teleported 60 ft. in the air and knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Grasping Muck
entries: One creature within 60 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 13}) as it begins to sink into the earth. A {@condition prone} creature has disadvantage on this saving throw.

action.name: Stagnant Miasma {@recharge 5}
entries: The ground in a 10 ft. radius within 60 ft. begins to bubble, exuding a cloud of toxic gas that remains for a minute, or until cleared with a strong breeze. A creature that starts its turn in the cloud must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 3d8}) poison damage.

reaction.name: Hope to Despair
entries: When a creature that the hag can see within 30 ft. makes a saving throw against a spell the hag (or a member of her coven) cast, she may expend all temporary hit points from her Glimmer of Hope ability and subtract the number expended from the creature's saving throw.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The slaad can use its action to polymorph itself or another slaad into a Small or Medium humanoid, or back into its true form. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The slaad has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Chaotic Resilience
entries: The slaad has resistance to the damage type of the last source of damage it received.

trait.name: Disordered Transposition
entries: At the beginning of the slaad's turn, a randomly selected creature within 60 ft. is teleported up to 30 ft. to a location of the slaad's choice that the slaad can see.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The slaad makes three melee attacks, up to two of which it may replace with uses of its chaos flame.

action.name: Pandemoniac Ephemera (Concentration)
