entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition grappled} target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) piercing damage and 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Psychic Storm (Concentration)
entries: The grell creates a 10 ft. radius area of psychic instability within range that lasts for 1 minute. A creature in the area moves in a random direction for each 5 feet they attempt to move. Creatures in the area are immune to the telepathic effects of any grell.

reaction.name: Existential Crisis
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack, the grell forces the attacker to make a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target is {@condition paralyzed} until the beginning of its next turn as it is overwhelmed with confusion and despair at its inability to make sense of the universe.

trait.name: Deceptive Neck
entries: When a creature the heron can see scores a critical against it, roll a {@dice d20}. On an 11-20, the critical becomes a miss.

trait.name: Mudstrider
entries: The heron ignores negative effects from moving over terrain composed of mud or shallow water.

action.name: Clacking Snap
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 0} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 piercing damage.

action.name: Rasped Bark (1/Day)
entries: The heron croaks out a dreadful sound. Each creature within 30 feet that can hear, but not see the heron must succeed on a {@dc 10} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the beginning of the Heron's next turn.

bonus.name: Extend Neck
entries: The heron extends its neck, raising up to its full height and making a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check to detect any hidden creatures nearby.

trait.name: Instinctive Hibernation
entries: Whenever the scavver takes cold damage, if it has fewer than 10 hit points remaining it falls asleep for the next minute.

trait.name: Electrosensitive
entries: If the scavver takes any lightning damage, it has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Poor Memory
entries: The scavver cannot clearly recollect events that happened more than 6 seconds ago

action.name: Frenzied Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage. This attack is made at advantage against a creature that is missing any of its hit points.

reaction.name: Regroup
entries: As a reaction when it is reduced below 10 hit points, the scavver moves up to its speed away from the source of the damage without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The slaad can use its action to polymorph itself or another slaad into a Small or Medium humanoid, or back into its true form. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The slaad has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Chaotic Resilience
entries: The slaad has resistance to the damage type of the last source of damage it received.

trait.name: Rift Mage
entries: The slaad has a small private pocket dimension, which it can enter or exit as an Action. When the slaad exits its pocket dimension, it appears in the unoccupied space nearest to where it departed. When the slaad dies, the contents of its pocket dimension explode from its chest.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The slaad makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite, and uses its Pandemoniac Ideal. It may replace up to two of its attacks with uses of its Junkdrop.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Knuckle Rap
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or drop one object it is holding.

action.name: Junkdrop
entries: The slaad opens a small portal over a creature's head, showering it with planar detritus. One creature the slaad can see within 60 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 5d8}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}, or take half as much on a success.

action.name: Pandemoniac Ephemera (Concentration)
entries: The slaad creates the image of an object or creature no larger than a 30-foot cube. It seems real to all senses, though a successful {@dc 16} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check reveals its illusory nature. The slaad may interact with the illusion physically as though it were real.

action.name: Uncontrolled Burst {@recharge 5}
entries: Each other creature within 20 ft. of the slaad must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 28 ({@damage 8d6}) fire damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Portal Catch
entries: As a reaction when a creature within 30 ft. drops an object, the slaad briefly opens a tiny dimensional rift, causing the object to fall into its private pocket dimension.

reaction.name: Insubstantiate
entries: As a reaction to taking 15 or more damage from a single source, the slaad disintigrates into a shower of fine particles, reforming at any point within 10 ft. of where it disappeared from at the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Stone Camouflage
entries: The grick has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

trait.name: Perpetually Ravenous
entries: While the grick has an {@condition incapacitated} creature {@condition grappled}, it may make a beak attack against that creature as a bonus action. It may drag a medium or smaller {@condition incapacitated} creature without expending additional movement.

action.name: Tentacles
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 3d6 + 2}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled}.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Thrash
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the grick must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) bludgeoning damage and be {@condition stunned} until the end of the grick's next turn, or half as much damage on a success.

trait.name: Keen Sight
entries: The griffon has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Gold Seeder
entries: The bones of fallen griffons have a spontaneous tendency to transmute tiny flecks of the surrounding material to gold. This process is too slow to be exploited directly, but ancient griffon nests are often ready sources of gold ore.

trait.name: Diving Overrun
entries: If the griffon is flying and dives at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a melee weapon attack, the target must make a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The griffon makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its claws.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the griffon can grapple the target (escape {@dc 14}).

monster.name: Grimlock
senses: the grimlock can't use its blindsight while deafened and unable to smell.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The grimlock has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: Stone Camouflage
entries: The grimlock has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

trait.name: Redundant Organs
entries: Any critical hit against the grimlock becomes a regular hit.

action.name: Spiked Bone Club
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) piercing damage.This attack has advantage against a creature that relies on {@sense darkvision} to see.

trait.name: Water Form
entries: The griptide can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.
Large or smaller air-breathing creatures in the griptide's space are {@condition choking|confc|choking}.

trait.name: Creeping Freeze
entries: If the griptide takes any cold damage, it partially freezes; until the end of its next turn, damage dealt to the griptide ignores its damage resistances and its speeds are reduced to 10 feet.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The griptide makes four attacks with its Hands of the Deep, or makes one attack and uses its Scouring Tide.

action.name: Hands of the Deep
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}).
The griptide can grapple any number of creatures in this way.

action.name: Scouring Tide
entries: The griptide sends a wave of sand and debris tumbling forth in a 30 foot cone, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) slashing damage and be pushed up to 20 feet away, or take half as much damage on a success.
A creature released from the griptide's grapple as a result of failing this saving throw takes an additional 9 ({@damage 2d8}) bludgeoning damage.

bonus.name: Drag Out
entries: Each creature {@condition grappled} by the griptide must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or be dragged up to 20 feet toward the griptide's center.

bonus.name: Pressure Spike
entries: A pulse of intense pressure ripples through the griptide, forcing each other creature in its space to succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) thunder damage.

monster.name: Grisgol

immune.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Final Curse
entries: A creature that reduces the grisgol to 0 hit points must succeed on a {@dc 17} Charisma saving throw or be cursed.

While cursed, a creature becomes obsessed with the idea that the wrappings of the grisgol to contain an important secret, if only they can be properly pieced together, and has its Intelligence score reduced by one each week until the curse is removed.
If the grisgol takes 40 or more fire damage from a single source, this trait ceases to function until the grisgol is repaired.

trait.name: Imprisoned Lich
entries: The grisgol is animated by life force drained form a defeated lich's phylactery, preventing the lich from returning to life. If the grisgol is defeated and the phylactery is not destroyed, the lich gains a new body in {@dice 1d10} days.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The grisgol has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The grisgol makes two attacks with its Wilting Touch.

action.name: Wilting Touch
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}31 ({@damage 5d10 + 4}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Vent Magic
entries: The grisgol vents raw weave in a 15 foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 5d8}) force damage and roll on the Wild Magic Table (PHB p. 103), or take half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Erratic Fireball (5th Level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: The grisgol chooses a direction, launching a fireball that explodes in a 20 foot radius centered on a point 35 ({@dice 2d6 * 5}) feet away from the grisgol.
Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take 35 ({@damage 10d6}) fire damage and be knocked {@condition prone}, or take half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Mindwrack Binding (8th Level Spell, 1/Day)
entries: Each creature of the grisgol's choice within 30 feet must succeed on {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} until the end of the grisgol's next turn.

reaction.name: Containment Breach
entries: When the grisgol succeeds on a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, it can use its Vent Magic.

reaction.name: Mycotoxin Dust
entries: When the grisgol is hit with a melee attack that deals bludgeoning or slashing damage, the grisgol can force the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or contract Mind Fog.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the treant remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal tree.

trait.name: Rootspeech
entries: While in its home forest, the treant knows the number, type, and approximate location of each creature within 10 miles of it.

trait.name: Giant Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the treant may spend half of its movement to attempt a {@dc 18} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check, climbing onto it on a success. A creature climbing on the treant has advantage on melee attacks against the treant, and the treant has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

trait.name: Wooden Body
entries: If the treant takes any fire damage, it and each creature climbing on it begin {@condition burning|confc|burning} ({@dice 1d10}).
While it is {@condition burning|confc|burning}, attacks against the treant are made at advantage, the treant's melee attacks deal an additional 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage.

action.name: Sweeping Grasp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 18}).
Each other creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage and be pushed up to 5 feet away.

action.name: Earthshaking Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Hurl Stone (Requires a stone or other large object)
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 10} to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. {@h}28 ({@damage 4d10 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and the target is knocked {@condition prone}.

bonus.name: Hurl Creature (Requires a Grappled creature)
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 10} to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d10 + 6}) bludgeoning damage. On a hit or miss, the thrown creature takes the attack's damage.

bonus.name: Grasping Roots {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature within 15 feet of the treant must succceed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or take 19 ({@damage 3d12}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone} and {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 18}) until the end of the treant's next turn. A creature that was already {@condition prone} makes this save at disadvantage.

reaction.name: Forest Allies
entries: When a creature within 10 feet of a mundane tree hits the treant with a ranged attack, the treant can magically impel the tree to make an Earthshaking Slam attack against the attacker, using the treant's statistics.

trait.name: Duck and Leap
entries: When the guanghan takes the {@action Dodge} action, it may jump up to 10 feet whenever it is missed with a melee attack.

trait.name: Rooftop Striker
entries: The guanghan takes no damage from falls of 20 feet or less. If the guanghan falls at least 10 feet, the next attack it makes this turn scores a critical hit on a 16-20.

trait.name: Veil-Piercer
entries: The guanghan has advantage on skill checks and saving throws made to resist or identify illusions.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The guanghan makes two attacks with its Fish-Belly Dao, one of which it may replace with the {@action Dodge} or {@action Hide} action.

action.name: Fish-Belly Dao
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@dice 2d6 + 4}) slashing plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Wugu Worm Vessel (1/Day)
entries: The guanghan coats its blade in the poisonous ichor of a worm created through foul sorcery. The next time it hits a creature with a melee attack in the next minute, the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for the next minute.

A creature {@condition poisoned} in this way cannot spend any resources that it recovers on a short or long rest, and repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

reaction.name: Underhanded Strike
entries: As a reaction when a creature within 5 feet of the guanghan is missed with a melee attack by one of the guanhan's allies, the guanghan makes a melee attack.

trait.name: Guanghan Mask
entries: If the onibi is {@condition grappled}, {@condition restrained}, or {@condition incapacitated}, a creature within 5 feet of the onibi may remove its mask as an action with a successful {@dc 14} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.
If its mask is removed, the onibi transforms into an uncontrolled {@creature will-o'-wisp|confc|Will-o-Wisp} with all of its hit points.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: The onibi can't be affected or detected by cantrips unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

action.name: Giant Silver Shears
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@dice 1d6 + 3}) slashing plus 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage.
On a critical hit, the onibi may end one spell or magical effect affecting the target of 3rd level of below.

action.name: Trigger Traps
entries: The onibi moves up to its speed and gains advantage on saving throws it makes until the end of its turn.

{@action opportunity attack||Attacks of opportunity} provoked by this movement are made at disadvantage, and any creature that could make an {@action opportunity attack||attack of opportunity} provoked by this movement must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or do so.

reaction.name: Skittish Leap
entries: When a creature ends its movement within 5 feet of the onibi, the onibi can leap up to 15 feet directly away from it without provoking {@action opportunity attack||opportunity attacks}.

trait.name: Strike to Subdue
entries: The guard's attacks are nonlethal.

action.name: Truncheon
entries: Melee Weapon {@action Attack}. {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Authoritative Command
entries: The guard speaks a command of up to three words to a creature within 30 feet. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 10} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn. While {@condition frightened} in this way, it can't take actions other than to dash or to follow the command.

action.name: Whistle
entries: The guard produces a series of loud coded whistles that communicate basic details to all friendly guards within 500 feet.

trait.name: Strike to Subdue
entries: The guard's attacks are nonlethal.

trait.name: Antimage Training
entries: Friendly guards within 30 feet have advantage on saving throws against spells. If the guard would take half damage from succeeding on a saving throw against a spell, it takes no damage instead.

trait.name: Muffling Grapple
entries: A creature {@condition grappled} by the guard cannot perform the somatic components of spells.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The guard makes two attacks with its truncheon, either of which it may replace with a grapple or shove attempt.

action.name: Truncheon
entries: Melee Weapon {@action Attack}. {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Authoritative Command
entries: The guard speaks a command of up to three words to a creature within 30 feet. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 10} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn. While {@condition frightened} in this way, it can't take actions other than to dash or to follow the command.

action.name: Whistle
entries: The guard produces a series of loud coded whistles that communicate basic details to all friendly guards within 500 feet.

trait.name: Strike to Subdue
entries: The guard's attacks are nonlethal.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The guard makes two attacks with its truncheon and uses its Voice of Commmand.

action.name: Truncheon
entries: Melee Weapon {@action Attack}. {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Voice of Command
entries: The guard speaks a command of up to three words. Each creature of the guard's choice within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn. While {@condition frightened} in this way, it can't take actions other than to dash or to follow the command.

action.name: Whistle
entries: The guard produces a series of loud coded whistles that communicate basic details to all friendly guards within 500 feet.

trait.name: Strike to Subdue
entries: The guard's attacks are nonlethal.

trait.name: Rapid Assessment
entries: The guard rolls initiative at advantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The guard makes three attacks with its poleaxe, one of which it may replace with a stunning slam, if available.

action.name: Poleaxe
entries: Melee Weapon {@action Attack}. {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) bludgeoning damage. This attack deals an additional 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage if made with advantage.

action.name: Stunning Slam {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature within 10 feet must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of the guard's next turn and knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Authoritative Command
entries: The guard speaks a command of up to three words to a creature within 30 feet. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn. While {@condition frightened} in this way, it can't take actions other than to dash or to follow the command.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If it dies, the naga returns to life in {@dice 1d6} days and regains all its hit points. Only a {@spell wish} spell can prevent this trait from functioning.

action.name: Discorporating Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage and 45 ({@damage 10d8}) poison damage. The target must then succeed on a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw or become partly incorporeal, dealing half as much damage with weapon attacks that use Strength or Dexterity. A creature may repeat this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Spit Venom
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 15/30 ft., one creature. {@h}27 ({@damage 6d8}) poison damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or gain vulnerability to the next source of poison damage it is subjected to in the next minute.

action.name: Searing Tide {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point within 60 must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage and 14 ({@damage 4d6}) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Spell effects of 5th level or below in the affected area are dispelled.

reaction.name: Banishing Retort
entries: As a reaction to taking 20 or more damage from a single attack or spell, the naga may force the attacker to make a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw or be banished to a harmless demiplane and {@condition incapacitated} for one minute. An affected creature repeats this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

trait.name: Unholy Strength
entries: While {@condition restrained}, the cackle-fiend has its Strength and Dexterity scores reduced by 1, to a minimum of 1, for each holy talisman draped over it.

trait.name: Sadistic Fixation
entries: The cackle-fiend's attacks deal no additional damage on a critical hit. Instead, on a critical hit the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or lose a limb of the target's choice.

action.name: Rending Thrash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d8 + 7}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 15 feet away.
A creature killed by this damage is rent limb from limb.

action.name: Madness Overflowing {@recharge 5}
entries: Erratic bolts of crackling fire leap from the mouth and eyes of the fiend in a 15 foot cone.

Each creature in the area must succeed on {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or take 7 ({@dice 2d6}) fire plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) lightning damage and be {@condition frightened} until the end of the cackle-fiend's next turn.

trait.name: Lurking Presence
entries: Unless it is encircled with salt, the guecubu is {@condition invisible}, immune to any damage dealt by a creature that cannot see it, and can't be {@condition grappled} or forced to move.

trait.name: Guecubu Weaknesses
entries: The guecubu has the following weaknesses.

items.name: Salt-Warded
entries: The guecubu cannot cross a line of salt unless it is {@condition attached|confc|attached} to or Possessing another creature.

items.name: Blessing-Burned
entries: When a creature the guecubu is possessing is targeted by a spell with a divine source, the creature and the guecubu each take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) radiant damage.

items.name: Mirror-Trapped
entries: A guecubu that is forced to move into the space of a Medium or larger mirror must succeed on a {@dc 20} Charisma saving throw or be imprisoned in the mirror until the mirror is broken.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The guecubu can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The guecubu makes three attacks with its Frenetic Claw.

action.name: Frenetic Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature that can see the guecubu. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) slashing damage.
On a critical hit, the target is {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Clutch Back
entries: One humanoid creature in the guecubu's space must succeed on a {@dc 14} Charisma saving throw or have the Guecubu become {@condition attached|confc|attached} to it. On a successful save, the creature becomes immune to this ability for 24 hours.

While the guecubu is {@condition attached|confc|attached} to a creature, it can mimic that creature's voice, and that creature can't see the guecubu by any means. If a creature the guecubu is attached to teleports, the guecubu teleports with it.

action.name: Profane Sleep
entries: One Sleeping creature the guecubu is attached to must make a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature ignores the effects of being {@condition incapacitated} and acts under the Guecubu's control for the next hour.
When the creature wakes or on a successful save, the creature becomes immune to this ability for 24 hours.

reaction.name: Cruelty's Reward
entries: As a reaction when a creature the guecubu is attached to commits an act of cruelty, the guecubu increases the creature's Strength by 1, to a maximum of 25.

Then, if the creature has a Strength score higher than 22, it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Charisma saving throw or become {@condition possessed|confc|possessed} by the Guecubu and transform into a {@creature guecubu cackle-fiend|confc|Guecubu Cackle-Fiend} until the guecubu is expelled.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The gulon has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Concussive Strength
entries: A creature knocked {@condition prone} by the gulon cannot stand on its following turn.

trait.name: Opportunistic Feeder
entries: The gulon scores a critical on a 16-20 against a {@condition prone} creature.

trait.name: Quick Squeeze
entries: The gulon may move through any space larger than its skull without squeezing.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gulon makes one attack with its bite and two with its claws.

action.name: Ravenous Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d12 + 3}) piercing damage. On a critical hit, the gulon gains 25 temporary HP. While it has this temporary HP, its speed is 15 ft. and it can't use its Multiattack.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) slashing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Disgorge
entries: Each creature in a 15 ft. cone must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage, or half as much on a success. If the gulon had any temporary hit points, it loses them and this ability does an additional 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage to a creature that fails its save.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the gulthias tree may spend half of its movement to attempt a {@dc 19} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the treant. While climbing on the gulthias tree, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the it.

trait.name: Wooden Body
entries: If the gulthias tree takes fire damage, it catches fire. Until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the gulthias tree and all creatures climbing on it take 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage at the start of each of the treant's turns, and all attacks against the gulthias tree are made at advantage. While on fire, the gulthias tree's melee attacks deal an additional 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gulthias tree makes two attacks with its earthshaking slam, one of which it may replace with a use of its Vile Birth or Grasping Roots, if availale.

action.name: Earthshaking Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d8 + 7}) bludgeoning damage and the target is knocked {@condition prone}. Each other creature within 5 feet of the target must make a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw, taking half the attack's damage and falling {@condition prone} on a failed save.

action.name: Vile Birth
entries: The Gulthias Tree spawns 3 ({@dice 1d4 + 1}) Twig Blights that appear within 5 ft. of it.

action.name: Grasping Roots {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature within 15 feet of the treant must succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or take 20 ({@damage 3d12}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}, {@condition grappled} and {@condition restrained} until the end of the gulthias tree's next turn (escape {@dc 19}). A creature that was already {@condition prone} makes this save at disadvantage.

legendary.name: Stakes From The Earth
entries: Wooden stakes rise from the earth in two 5-ft. radius areas. The areas become difficult terrain, and when a creature moves into or within the area, it takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage for every 5 feet it travels.

legendary.name: Frightful Keening
entries: Blood oozes from the gulthias tree as it releases a low keening moan. Each creature of the tree's choice in a 120 ft. radius must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of the gulthias tree's next turn. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more ages {@dice 1d20} years.

legendary.name: Blood Drain (costs 2 actions)
entries: Black tendrils worm out of the tree's roots, piercing into flesh. Each creature that is {@condition prone} and within 50 ft. of the tree must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage and be forced to expend two of its hit dice. If the creature can't, it instead drops to 0 HP. The Tree gains 5 temporary hit points for each hit die expended this way. A creature that dies this way rises the next day as a vampire spawn.

trait.name: Baying Pack
entries: A group of two or more worgs has disadvantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks.

trait.name: Predatory Bearing
entries: A creature that starts its turn with no adjacent allies and that can see the gulvoorg must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Crushing Weight
entries: The gulvoorg may enter the space of a {@condition prone} creature. A {@condition prone} creature that starts its turn in the gulvoorg's space must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or take 5 ({@damage 1d10}) bludgeoning damage and be unable to stand this turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The worg makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d6 + 6}) piercing damage and the target is knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}28 ({@damage 4d10 + 6}) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the gulvoorg can't bite another target.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away from the gulvoorg.

action.name: Worry
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by both the gulvoorg and at least one of the gulvoorg's Large or larger allies must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or take 49 ({@damage 14d6}) piercing damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Bouncy
entries: If the owlbear would take any fall damage, it instead takes half as much, and may jump up to 20 feet at the start of its next turn as a bonus action.

trait.name: Concussive Strength
entries: A creature knocked {@condition prone} by the owlbear must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be unable to stand on its following turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The owlbear makes two attacks, one of which may be with its beak.

action.name: Gummy Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage.
This attack does an additional 4 ({@damage 1d8}) damage to a {@condition prone} creature.

action.name: Gummy Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) slashing damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.
A creature that takes 10 or more damage from this attack is knocked {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Rippling Jiggle
entries: When the owlbear takes any bludgeoning damage, it can force one creature within 5 feet of it to make a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw.
On a failed save, the owlbear gains resistance to the triggering damage, and the target takes an equal amount of bludgeoning damage and is pushed up to 10 feet away.

trait.name: Bouncy
entries: If the worker would take any fall damage, it instead takes half as much, and may jump up to 20 feet at the start of its next turn as a bonus action.

trait.name: Acidic Immune System
entries: The worker has advantage on saving throws to resist being {@condition poisoned} or infected with a disease.

action.name: Makeshift Weapon
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60, one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Gummy Unity
entries: The worker touches a gummybear within 5 feet that was reduced to 0 hit points since the end of the worker's last turn, briefly sticking to and melding with it. The worker loses 5 hit points, and the target regains 1 hit point.

bonus.name: Sour Cloud (1/Day)
entries: The worker emits prickly sour particles in a 10-foot-radius.
Each other creature in the area that needs to breathe must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Featureless Anatomy (1/Day)
entries: When a creature it can see hits the worker with a critical hit, the worker can change it into a normal hit, then fall {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Damage Transfer
entries: While attached to a creature, the gutterspite takes only half the damage dealt to it (rounded down), and that creature takes the other half.

trait.name: Glitterglass Core
entries: A creature that hits the gutterspite or a creature it is attached to with a melee attack cannot benefit from Invisibility for the next 24 hours, or until rendered clean by magical means.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gutterspite makes two attacks with its Clinging Slam, each of which it may replace with a use of its Refit.

action.name: Clinging Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one Large or smaller creature. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage and the gutterpite wraps around the creature, attaching itself to it (escape {@dc 14}).

action.name: Refit
entries: One creature the gutterpite is attached to must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or have its Wisdom score reduced by 5 ({@dice 2d4}), to a minimum of 1, until the gutterpite is removed.
A creature reduced below 10 Wisdom in this way has disadvantage on Strength checks and saving throws. A creature reduced to 1 Wisdom in this way acts under the gutterpite's telepathic control.

reaction.name: Glitterburst
entries: As a reaction when a creature hits it with a melee attack, the gutterspite expels a puff of glitter, forcing the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the end of the gutterspite's next turn.

trait.name: Sphinx's Laws
entries: At the beginning of each of its turns in combat, the sphinx sets two of the following rules in secret, which last until the beginning of its next turn. A creature within 60 feet that violates the rule must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or take 5 ({@damage 1d10}) psychic damage and be {@condition stunned} until the end of the sphinx's next turn. The sphinx is bound by its own rules.
A creature may make no more than one attack per turn.
A creature may not cast spells of 1st-3rd level.
A creature may not cast spells of 4th-6th level.
A creature may not target a creature more than 30 ft away from it with an attack or spell.
A creature may not benefit from flanking.

trait.name: Inscrutable
entries: The sphinx is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) checks made to ascertain the sphinx's intentions or sincerity have disadvantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sphinx makes two claw attacks and casts a spell with a casting time of 1 action.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Mighty Pounce
entries: The sphinx leaps up to 30 ft. and makes a claw attack. If the attack hits, the target is knocked {@condition prone} and takes an additional 27 ({@damage 5d10}) force damage.

action.name: Blindness (2nd level spell)
entries: One creature the sphinx can see within 60 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} for a minute. A {@condition blinded} creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Dispel Magic (3rd level spell)
entries: One spell effect within 60 ft. of 3rd level or lower ends. The sphinx may make an Intelligence check to dispel a higher level spell effect with DC equal to 10 + the spell effect's level.

action.name: Fire Shield (4th level spell, concentration)
entries: The sphinx is wreathed in a mantle of flames, granting the sphinx resistance to its choice of fire or cold damage for the next ten minutes. Whenever a creature within 5 ft. hits the sphinx with a melee attack, the attacker takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) damage of the selected type.

action.name: Synaptic Static (5th level Spell, 1/day)
entries: Each creature in a 20 ft. radius centered on a point within 120 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 16} Intelligence saving throw or take 28 ({@damage 8d6}) psychic damage, or half as much on a success.

After a failed save, a target has muddled thoughts for 1 minute. During that time, it rolls a {@dice d6} and subtracts the number rolled from all its attack rolls and ability checks, as well as its Constitution saving throws to maintain {@status concentration}. The target can make an Intelligence saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

reaction.name: Shield (1st level spell)
entries: As a reaction to being hit with an attack, the sphinx increases its AC by 5 until the beginning of its next turn, including against the triggering attack

legendary.name: Claw
entries: The sphinx makes a claw attack.

legendary.name: Teleport (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The sphinx moves up to half its speed without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

legendary.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The sphinx casts a spell it knows.

trait.name: Booming Crest
entries: The hadrosaur can communicate simple ideas such as "Danger" or "Food" to each creature within 5 miles that understands it, using low-frequency sounds produced in its crest.

trait.name: Bird Hipped
entries: At the beginning of its turn, the Hadrosaur may rear up on two legs until the end of its turn. If it does, it can dash as a bonus acton this turn, and cannot use its multiattack.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hadrosaur makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Stomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage. This attack deals an additional 4 ({@damage 1d8}) bludgeoning damage to a {@condition prone} creature.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Protean Shapechanger
entries: As a Bonus Action, the hagunemnon can polymorph into a Huge hybrid of any two creatures of CR 10 or below, gaining the speeds, resistances, immunities, traits, and actions of the chosen creatures, in addition to its own.
Its statistics are otherwise the same in any form, and it uses its own attack bonus and save DC, rather than that of the chosen form.

trait.name: Formless Chaos
entries: If the hagunemnon ends its turn without using its Protean Shapechanger trait, or if it uses its Protean Shapechanger trait to adopt the forms of one or more creatures it has used in the last minute, the hagunemnon must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Reversion Weakness
entries: The hagunemnon has no true form and cannot be forced to revert to it. If it would be forced to its true form, it instead must succeed on a {@dc 20} Intelligence saving throw or take 55 ({@damage 10d10}) psychic damage.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the hagunemnon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Hagunemnon takes two actions other than this one (Other multiattacks count as different actions).

action.name: Chaotic Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}39 ({@damage 5d12 + 7}) damage of a type chosen by the hagunemnon.

action.name: Destabilize Form
entries: One creature within 15 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 20} Charisma saving throw or have its Constitution score reduced by {@dice 1d4} until it completes a Short or Long Rest. A creature reduced to 0 Constitution in this way dies, its body collapsing into a mass of clear fluid.

trait.name: Web-Dweller
entries: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty.
While in contact with a web, the spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

action.name: Fanged Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature. {@h}1 piercing damage.

action.name: Defensive Posture
entries: The spider rears up in a defensive posture. Until the beginning of its next turn, a creature that attempts to enter its space must first make a {@dc 6} Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save, the creature is {@condition frightened} until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Urticating Hairs (1/Day)
entries: The spider scrapes off some of its barbed bristles and flings them toward a creature within 5 feet.
The target must succeed on a {@dc 9} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn) or until it takes an action to clear its eyes.

reaction.name: Crushed Vengeance
entries: When the spider is reduced to 0 hit points by a melee attack, it can make a Fanged Bite attack with advantage against the attacker.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If Halaster dies in Undermountain, he revives after {@dice 1d10} days, with all his hit points and any missing body parts restored. His new body appears in a random safe location in Undermountain.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Halaster has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Sharpen Focus (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
entries: When Halaster is reduced to 0 hit points, he doesn't die or fall {@condition unconscious}. Instead, he resets to 212 hit points.
For the next minute, Halaster gains two additional legendary actions on each of his turns and has advantage on saving throws to maintain {@status concentration}.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If Halaster fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Halaster makes three attacks with his Twisting Drakebolt, each of which he may replace with a use of his Flying Portal or Half-Forgotten Spell.

action.name: Twisting Drakebolt
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 14} to hit, range 100 ft., one creature. {@h}14 ({@dice 4d6}) piercing plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage.
This attack ignores half and three-quarters cover, and can target creature behind full cover.

action.name: Flying Portal (6th Level Spell)
entries: Halaster creates a 10 foot wide flat portal that lasts for a minute in an unoccupied space he can see within 60 feet. Any creature or ranged attack that enters one of these portals emerges from another of Halaster's choice.

action.name: Half Forgotten Spell
entries: Roll a {@dice d20}, subtracting 1 for each legendary resistance that Halaster has expended. Halaster casts the corresponding spell on the Half-Forgotten Spells table.
On a result of 0 or lower, nothing happens. On a result of 20, he may choose any spell on the list to cast.

action.name: Blast with Madness (9th Level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: Halaster opens his mind and releases a fragment of the eldritch knowledge imprisoned there, becoming a window to the Far Realm for a fraction of an instant.

Each creature within 30 feet that can see or hear Halaster must succeed on a {@dc 22} Intelligence saving throw or take 63 ({@damage 6d20}) psychic damage and have its proficiency bonus reduced by 2 until it completes a Short or Long rest, or take half as much damage on a success.
A creature that has its proficiency bonus reduced to 0 in this way is afflicted with an effect from the Indefinite Madness table (DMG p. 258) until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

reaction.name: Delay Spell (5th Level Spell)
entries: As a reaction when a creature Halaster can see casts a spell, Halaster delays the spell's effect until the end of his next turn.
The spell's caster must maintain {@status concentration} on the spell until then or have the spell fail.

reaction.name: Emergency Clone (9th Level Spell, Recharges when Halaster's Mythic Trait Activates)
entries: As a reaction when Halaster is targeted with an attack or spell, he creates an imperfect copy of himself in an unoccupied space within 5 feet that becomes the new target of the attack or spell.
The copy rolls its own initiative, has 100 hit points, and doesn't have legendary actions or resistances, but otherwise uses his statistics.
At the beginning of each of his turns, Halaster must succeed on a {@dc 22} Wisdom saving throw or become mutually hostile with the copy until the beginning of his next turn.

legendary.name: Smoke Bomb!
entries: Halaster sends a burst of illusory smoke roiling forth from his feet, heavily obscuring the area in a 5 foot radius until the beginning of his next turn, then moves up to half his speed.

legendary.name: Move Portal (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Halaster moves one of the portals created with his Flying Portal up to 30 feet. Each creature whose space the portal moves through is teleported to the nearest unoccupied space to another Flying Portal of Halaster's choice.
An unwilling creature may make a {@dc 22} Dexterity saving throw, resisting the effect on a success.

legendary.name: Half-Forgotten Spell
entries: Halaster uses his Half-Forgotten Spell ability.

mythic.name: Hasten Spell
entries: Halaster reduces the duration of an active spell effect within 30 feet by {@dice 1d4} minutes. If this reduces the effect's duration to 0, the effect ends.

mythic.name: One of the Classics! (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Halaster casts any spell of 6th level or below.

trait.name: Stouthearted
entries: While it is {@condition frightened}, the halfling may move toward the source of its fear.

trait.name: Generous Host
entries: A creature that has eaten any of the halfling's cooking in the last hour has disadvantage on attacks that target it.

trait.name: Buzgut
entries: If the halfling would gain temporary hit points while it has existing temporary hit points, it gains additional temporary hit points equal to its previous total.
The halfling cannot gain more than 25 temporary hit points in this way.

trait.name: Well-Fed Resistance (2/Day)
entries: If the halfling fails a saving throw while it has at least 10 temporary hit points, it can choose to succeed instead.
If it does, it loses half of its temporary hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The halfling makes two attacks with its Stew-Paddle Whop, each of which it may replace with a use of its Battlefeast.

action.name: Stew-Paddle Whop
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@dice 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Battlefeast
entries: The halfling feeds a bite of food to a willing creature within 5 feet, granting it 10 temporary hit points.
While the creature has any of these temporary hit points, it gains one effect of the halfling's choice.

items.name: Dodgy Jammer
entries: The creature's AC is increased by 2.

items.name: Meaty Hoggan
entries: The creature's melee attacks deal an additional die of damage.

items.name: Gazy Pie
entries: The creature may attempt to detect hidden creatures as a bonus action.

items.name: Revel Bun
entries: The creature regains its reaction at the beginning of each other creature's turn.

action.name: Gruzzling Gust {@recharge 5}
entries: The halfling fans forth a delicious breeze in a 30 foot cone, stoking the appetites of all who can smell it.
Each creature in the area with any temporary hit points may use its reaction to make a melee attack.

Each creature in the area without any temporary hit points must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) psychic damage and deal half as much damage with attacks that use Strength until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Try This
entries: When a creature misses the halfling with a melee attack, the halfling can use its Battlefeast, targeting the attacker.

reaction.name: Lucky Break.
entries: When the halfling fails a Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution saving throw, it may roll one additional die, taking the second result.
If the new result succeeds, the halfling takes no damage from the effect.

legendary.name: Whop
entries: The halfling makes an attack with its Stew-Paddle Whop.

legendary.name: Eat Up
entries: The halfling moves up to 10 feet and uses its Battlefeast.

trait.name: Stouthearted
entries: While it is {@condition frightened}, the halfling may move toward the source of its fear.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The halfling makes two attacks with its Smoke Ring.

action.name: Smoke Ring
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 6} to hit, range 30 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage.
This attack has disadvantage while the halfling is outdoors.

action.name: Shared Fortune (2nd level spell, Concentration)
entries: The halfling chooses one friendly creature and one hostile creature it can see, blessing each of them with good luck.
For the next minute, attacks that target one of those creatures always miss on a roll of 1-10.

action.name: Stoke Feud (4th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: Two creatures the halfling can see within 60 feet must each succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or treat the other as hostile for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn).
A creature that succeeds on this saving throw may end the effect on the other creature as an action.

action.name: Belch Smoke {@recharge 5}
entries: The halfling belches a cloud of smoke in the face of a creature within 5 feet, forcing it to succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} and {@condition poisoned} until the end of the halfling's next turn.
A creature that fails this save by 5 or more enters an uncontrollable coughing fit and is {@condition incapacitated} until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Lucky Break
entries: When the halfling fails a Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution saving throw, it may roll one additional die, taking the second result.
If the new result succeeds, the halfling takes no damage from the effect.

trait.name: Stouthearted
entries: While it is {@condition frightened}, the halfling may move toward the source of its fear.

trait.name: Sneakthief's Prowl
entries: The halfling can treat any Medium or larger creature as half cover, and can hide without obscurement from creatures within 5 feet of it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The halfling makes three attacks with its Shearblade, one of which it may replace with a use of its Boldfaced Sneakery.

action.name: Shearblade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage and the target begins {@condition bleeding|confc|bleeding} ({@dice 1d4}, Save Ends at end of turn).

action.name: Leadkiss Sling
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition stunned} until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Boldfaced Sneakery
entries: The halfling takes the {@action Hide} action, then up to one creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check or have the halfling take one item it is carrying but not wielding.
If the item requires attunement, the halfling may immediately attune to it.

reaction.name: Shadowed Steps
entries: When a Medium or larger creature within 5 feet of the halfling that the halfling is hidden from moves, the halfling may mirror its movements until the end of the turn.
The halfling may not move more than its speed in this way.

reaction.name: Lucky Break.
entries: When the halfling fails a Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution saving throw, it may roll one additional die, taking the second result.
If the new result succeeds, the halfling takes no damage from the effect.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the halfling takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the halfling takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

trait.name: Stouthearted
entries: While it is {@condition frightened}, the halfling may move toward the source of its fear.

action.name: Shepherd's Sling (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}4 piercing damage.
If three or more halflings contributed to this attack, the target cannot take reactions this turn.

trait.name: Stouthearted
entries: While it is {@condition frightened}, the halfling may move toward the source of its fear.

trait.name: Provincial Guard
entries: While it is within 10 miles of its birthplace, the halfling's attacks against creatures not born in the area have advantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The halfling makes two attacks with its Buldrystave, one of which it may replace with a use of its Stubborn Disbelief.

action.name: Buldrystave
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage.
On a critical hit, the target takes an additional 4 ({@damage 1d8}) thunder damage and is pushed up to 10 feet away.

action.name: Scrappy Scowl
entries: The halfling hunkers down, adopting a practiced scowl.
Until the end of its next turn, the halfling's movement speed is reduced to 0, and it may make an attack with its Buldrystave against any creature that enters its reach for the first time on a turn.

action.name: Stubborn Disbelief (Concentration)
entries: The halfling treats one creature or object it can see as {@condition invisible} for the next minute.

While {@status concentration||concentrating} on this ability, the halfling cannot be {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened} by the target, and gains immunity to psychic damage dealt by the target.

reaction.name: Lucky Break.
entries: When the halfling fails a Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution saving throw, it may roll one additional die, taking the second result.
If the new result succeeds, the halfling takes no damage from the effect.

trait.name: Stouthearted
entries: While it is {@condition frightened}, the halfling may move toward the source of its fear.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The halfling makes three attacks with its Pummel, one of which it may replace with a use of its Plucky Rummage or Kneecap Lunge, if available.

action.name: Pummel
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) bludgeoning damage and attacks the halfling makes against the target have advantage until the end of the turn.

action.name: Plucky Rummage
entries: One {@condition prone} creature within 5 feet of the halfling must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or have the halfling take one item it is carrying but not wielding.
Until the end of its next turn, the halfling may use the item as though it were attuned to it.

action.name: Kneecap Lunge {@recharge 5}
