entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) bludgeoning damage.
If this attack deals maximum damage, the target is pushed up to 5 feet away.

action.name: Reckless Blast (Recharges when Hazi uses his Pack Cannon)
entries: Hazi fires his Blunder-Cannon, spraying shrapnel in a 20 foot cone.
Each creature in the area that is not {@condition prone} or behind cover must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or take 5 ({@damage 2d4}) piercing damage, or half as much on a success.

bonus.name: Bare Teeth
entries: Hazi screeches and bares his teeth, forcing a creature he can see within 10 feet to succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of his next turn.

bonus.name: Pack Cannon
entries: Hazi loads his blunderbuss with one or more Tiny objects within 5 feet. As part of this action, Hazi may attempt a {@skill Sleight of Hand} check to steal a Tiny object from a creature within 5 feet.

trait.name: Desiccation Weakness
entries: Whenever the gigapede takes any fire or necrotic damage, it gains a point of {@condition exhaustion}.

trait.name: Hundred-Legged Writhe
entries: The gigapede ignores the effects of difficult terrain, and has advantage on attacks made against a creature that it is {@condition attached|confc|attached} to, grappling, or {@condition grappled} by.

trait.name: Reflexive Molt (1/Day)
entries: When the gigapede fails a saving throw against an effect that does not deal damage, it can choose to succeed by rapidly shedding its exoskeleton, disgorging its soft inner body through its mouth into the nearest unoccupied space.
The exoskeleton can be attacked and destroyed (AC 16; 30 HP; vulnerability to fire damage)
Until it completes a Long Rest or uses its Devour Chitin, the gigapede gains vulnerability to all damage and its AC is reduced to 14.

action.name: Mandible Slice
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d6 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Fleshgripper Toxicognaths
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}).
If the target is Huge or larger, the gigapede can become {@condition attached|confc|attached} to the target (remove {@dc 16}) instead of grappling it.

action.name: Devour Chitin
entries: The gigapede gorges itself upon its shed exoskeleton, consuming it and regaining a use of its Reflexive Molt.
It cannot take this action while it is grappling or attached to a creature.

bonus.name: Heartstopper Venom
entries: The gigapede pumps venom into a creature it is grappling or {@condition attached|confc|attached} to, forcing it to succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) poison damage, or half as much on a success.
Then, if the creature has 20 or fewer hit points, it drops to 0 hit points.

bonus.name: Caudal Grip
entries: The gigapede anchors itself with its pincer-like rear legs and coils up, gaining the following effects until the end of its next turn:
The gigapede's speed is reduced to 0.
The gigapede has advantage on ability checks and saving throws that use Strength.
The gigapede's melee attacks have a reach of 30 feet and advantage.

reaction.name: Skittering Thrash
entries: When the gigapede is hit with a ranged attack, it can move up to half its speed directly toward the attacker.
{@action opportunity attack||Opportunity attacks} provoked by this movement have disadvantage.

trait.name: Three-Legged
entries: The helhest cannot take the {@action Dash} action.

trait.name: Trampling Charge
entries: If the helhest moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with a hooves attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Septic Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target subtracts {@dice 1d4} from the next Constitution saving throw it makes before the end of the helhest's next turn.

action.name: Hooves
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage. The helhest may make this attack as a bonus action against a {@condition prone} creature.

action.name: Inevitable Call {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature within 60 ft. that does not have all of its hit points must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be dragged 20 ft. towards the helhest.

reaction.name: Quick Kick
entries: When a creature makes an attack against the helhest that benefits from flanking it, the helhest can make an Hooves attack against the attacker.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The wolf has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The hell hound has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the hell hound's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Predatory Bearing
entries: A creature that starts its turn with no adjacent allies and that can see the hell hound must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}). If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Worry
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by both the hell hound and at least one of the hell hound's allies must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or take 24 ({@damage 7d6}) piercing damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Fire Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The hell hound exhales fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 ({@damage 6d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monster.name: Helmed Horror

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: The helmed horror can't be affected or detected by spells of 2nd level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The helmed horror makes two longsword attacks, one of which it may replace with a cleaving sweep if available.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Cleaving Sweep {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature in a 5 foot radius must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or take 11 ({@damage 2d10}) slashing damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Disarming Swipe
entries: As a reaction to a creature missing it with an attack, the helmed horror may force the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or drop its weapon and have it flung 15 feet in a random direction.

trait.name: Careening Flight
entries: When the beetle begins flying, it must choose a direction to fly in, and must use all of its movement on each of its turns to fly in that direction until it lands or collides with a creature or object.

trait.name: Spiracle Breathing
entries: The beetle has disadvantage on Constitution saving throws against inhaled toxins.

action.name: Huffy Pinch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 1} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}1 piercing damage and the beetle becomes {@condition attached|confc|attached} to the target (remove {@dc 9}).

action.name: Heroic Lift
entries: The beetle attempts to grasp a Medium or smaller creature with its horns and flip it, forcing the target to succeed on a {@dc 9} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Redeploy Wings
entries: When the beetle begins to fall, it can make a {@dc 10} Strength saving throw. On a success, the beetle falls only 5 feet before catching itself in the air.

trait.name: Clockwork Repetition
entries: The septon may choose to treat any {@dice d20} roll as a 10, instead of rolling.

trait.name: Perfect Synchrony
entries: If the hexton is within 30 feet of a quinton, it uses the quinton's attack bonus instead of its own. If the quinton is using a quarton's attack bonus, the hexton uses that instead, and so on.

trait.name: Lockstep
entries: The hexton may spend 5 feet of its movement to move any number of modrons under its command within 60 feet 5 feet in the same direction.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hexton makes two attacks with its Grip of Utmost Law.

action.name: Grip of Utmost Law
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escpae {@dc 18}).
While {@condition grappled} in this way, a non-lawful creature takes 10 necrotic plus 10 radiant damage at the start of each of its turns.

action.name: Rain of Gears (6th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: The hexton conjures a Huge flying gear factory that lasts for a minute in an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet.

When it casts this spell and at the beginning of each of the hexton's turns, it may move the factory up to 30 feet. A each creature that starts its turn beneath the factory must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take 30 bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Heximate (8th Level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: The hexton bombards a creature it can see within 60 feet with the pure force of cosmic Law, forcing each particle of its being into a rigid and baleful alignment.

The creature must succeed on a {@dc 17} Charisma saving throw or have its hit point total set to 1/6 of its hit point maximum, or to 5/6 of its hit point maximum on a success. A construct succeeds automatically on this saving throw.

reaction.name: Upgrade
entries: As a reaction to seeing a quinton within 60 feet die or transform, the hexton may transform into a quinton, retaining its current hit points. No more than one hexton may take this reaction.

trait.name: Lickspittle
entries: The hezrou follows the most recent verbal command it received since the beginning of its last turn.
If the command was given by a non-demon, the hezrou can make a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw, suspending this effect until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the hezrou takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the hezrou takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

action.name: Frenzied Snaps (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 piercing damage.
If three or more hezrou contributed to this attack, the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or fall {@condition prone} and take an additional 4 piercing damage.

trait.name: Deafened
entries: The hezrou is permanently {@condition deafened}. If cured by Lesser Restoration or similar magic, it loses this trait and gains the Lickspittle trait.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The hezrou has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hezrou makes three attacks with its Chaos Slam, one of which it may replace with a use of its Guard Me! or its Get in Line!

action.name: Chaos Slam
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@dice 2d8 + 5}) bludgeoning plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) force damage, then the hezrou and each creature within 10 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Guard Me!
entries: Until the beginning of its next turn, while it is next to another hezrou attacks against the hollerer are made at disadvantage.

action.name: Get in Line!
entries: Each other hezrou within 30 feet that can hear the hollerer must make a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw.
On a failure, the hezrou's initiative is reduced by 5 if it is higher than the hollerer's.

reaction.name: Sickening Ichor
entries: When the hezrou takes any piercing or slashing damage, it can magically cause a noxious gas to boil out from its spilt blood. Each creature within 10 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of the hezrou's next turn.
If the hezrou has fewer than 73 hit points, a creature that fails this saving throw must use its reaction to move 10 feet directly away from it.

trait.name: Lickspittle
entries: The hezrou follows the most recent verbal command it received since the beginning of its last turn.
If the command was given by a non-demon, the hezrou may make a {@dc 10} Wisdom saving throw to negate this effect until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The hezrou has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hezrou makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Shrouding Snap.

action.name: Shrouding Snap
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) piercing damage.
If this attack reduces a creature to 0 hit points, the hezrou may use its reaction to belch forth a cloud of Magical Darkness in a 10 foot radius around itself that lasts for a minute.

action.name: Gloomletter Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage, or 13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) necrotic damage if the hezrou is in Magical Darkness.

reaction.name: Sickening Ichor
entries: When the hezrou takes any piercing or slashing damage, it can magically cause a noxious gas to boil out from its spilt blood. Each creature within 10 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of the hezrou's next turn.
If the hezrou has fewer than 69 hit points, a creature that fails this saving throw must use its reaction to move 10 feet directly away from it.

trait.name: Blinding Flock
entries: A creature within 5 feet of three or more hostile yosuzume has disadvantage on attacks and Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks.

trait.name: Yugiri Justice Squadron
entries: At the beginning of its turn, the yosuzume gains 5 temporary hit points for each other friendly creature within 30 feet that is {@status concentration||concentrating} on a Heroic Pose.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Hiina makes three attacks with her Fluttering Thrust, one of which she can replace with a use of her Special Technique: Night Blind! or her Heroic Pose.

action.name: Fluttering Thrust
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.
Before or after making this attack, Hiina can move up to 5 feet without provoking {@action opportunity attack||opportunity attacks}.

action.name: Special Technique: Night Blind!
entries: Hiina attempts to shroud a creature's head in its own garments.
One creature within 5 feet that is wearing clothing or a helmet must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until it takes an action to disentangle itself.

action.name: Heroic Pose (Concentration)
entries: Hiina displays her heroic agility with an extended pose. Until she moves or is knocked {@condition prone}, Hiina gains advantage on Dexterity saving throws and can't be {@condition frightened}.

reaction.name: Playful Bet
entries: When Hiina or a friendly creature she can see within 30 feet misses with a melee attack, Hiina can call out a friendly challenge.
Until the attack's target takes any damage, the first attack made against it each turn by Hiina or one of her allies has advantage.

trait.name: Easily Confused
entries: While at least three hostile creatures are within 5 feet of the giant, all attacks against it are made at advantage. While at least two creatures are speaking to the giant, it has disadvantage on Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) checks made to detect deception.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the giant may spend half of its movement to attempt a {@dc 16} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the giant. While climbing on the giant, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the giant, and the giant has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hill giant makes two tree trunk attacks. It may replace one tree trunk attack with a use of its brutal shove ability.

action.name: Tree Trunk
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage and be pushed 5 feet away.
Each other creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

action.name: Rock
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 8} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}28 ({@damage 4d10 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Body Slam
entries: The Hill Giant expends all of its remaining movement and throws itself {@condition prone} in a 15 foot square centered on a point within 25 ft. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}, or take half as much damage on a success.

A creature that is climbing on the giant has disadvantage on the saving throw. A creature that succeeds may use its reaction to move up to ten feet, taking no damage if it ends this movement outside the affected area.

action.name: Brutal Shove {@recharge 5}
entries: Up to two creatures within 10 feet of the giant and within 15 feet of each other must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or take 20 ({@damage 3d12}) bludgeoning damage and be pushed 10 feet away. A creature may fall {@condition prone} as a reaction to gain advantage on this save.

reaction.name: Kick Away
entries: As a reaction to a creature ending its movement within 5 feet of the giant, the giant forces it to succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}, pushed 10 feet away, and lose {@status concentration} if it was holding it.

trait.name: Easily Confused
entries: While at least three hostile creatures are within 5 feet of the giant, all attacks against it are made at advantage. While at least two creatures are speaking to the giant, it has disadvantage on Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) checks made to detect deception.

trait.name: Rock-Sack
entries: The giant carries a sack with twelve good throwing rocks in it.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the giant may spend half of its movement to attempt a {@dc 16} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the giant. While climbing on the giant, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the giant, and the giant has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hill giant makes two attacks with its earthen wave.

action.name: Earthen Wave
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 4d10}) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 ft. away.

action.name: Rock
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 8} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}33 ({@damage 5d10 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.
Each other creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

action.name: Runecut Stomp {@recharge 5}
entries: The hill giant stomps a rune into the earth, sending the earth churning in a 30 ft. cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) bludgeoning damage and fall {@condition prone}, or half as much damage on a success.

The area becomes difficult terrain. At DM discretion, this ability may cause an avalanche, in which case its damage is maximized and creatures that fail the save are additionally {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 15}) as they are buried alive by loose material.

reaction.name: Kick Away
entries: As a reaction to a creature ending its movement within 5 feet of the giant, the giant forces it to succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}, pushed 10 feet away, and lose {@status concentration} if it was holding it.

trait.name: Easily Confused
entries: While at least three hostile creatures are within 5 feet of the giant, all attacks against it are made at advantage. While at least two creatures are speaking to the giant, it has disadvantage on Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) checks made to detect deception.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the giant may spend half of its movement to attempt a {@dc 16} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the giant. While climbing on the giant, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the giant, and the giant has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

trait.name: Runescribed Cauldron
entries: The giant carries a 15 ft. across magic cauldron that can fill with water and heat on command. A creature that enters the caudron for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) fire damage. A creature may exit the cauldron by spending half its movement, landing {@condition prone} in an unoccupied adjacent space of its choice.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hill giant makes two melee attacks, up to one of which may be with its sample bite.

action.name: Sample Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one {@condition grappled} target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) piercing damage and the giant has advantage on saving throws against spells cast by the creature until the beginning of the giant's next turn.

action.name: Hog Splitter
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) slashing damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away. A creature killed by this weapon is split in half.

action.name: Snatch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}).

reaction.name: Kick Away
entries: As a reaction to a creature ending its movement within 5 feet of the giant, the giant forces it to succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}, pushed 10 feet away, and lose {@status concentration} if it was holding it.

reaction.name: Into the Cauldron!
entries: As a reaction to being hit with an attack by a {@condition grappled} creature while within 30 ft. of its cauldron, the hill giant tosses the creature.
The creature must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw, falling into the cauldron on a failed save or taking 10 ({@damage 3d6}) bludgeoning damage on a successful one.

monster.name: Hill Giant Master of the Feast

trait.name: Easily Confused
entries: While at least three hostile creatures are within 5 feet of the giant, all attacks against it are made at advantage. While at least two creatures are speaking to the giant, it has disadvantage on Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) checks made to detect deception.

trait.name: Gargantuan Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the giant may spend its full movement to attempt a {@dc 18} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the giant. While climbing on the giant, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the giant, and the giant has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

trait.name: Ordning of Plenty
entries: When initiative is rolled, each friendly giant within 60 ft. gains 11 ({@dice 2d10}) temporary hit points. While a giant has these temporary hit points, it has immunity to poison and to being {@condition frightened}, and makes Wisdom saving throws at advantage.

action.name: Dwarf-Driver Club
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or be pushed 20 ft. away, or half as far on a success.

action.name: Snatch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 18}).

action.name: Hurl Creature (Requires a Grappled creature)
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 10} to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d10 + 6}) bludgeoning damage. On a hit or miss, the thrown creature takes the attack's damage.

action.name: Savor
entries: The giant slowly chews. Each creature in its mouth must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or take 35 ({@damage 10d6}) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Call to the Feast {@recharge 5}
entries: Up to four hill giants within 60 ft. may each use their reaction to make a bite attack using the Master of the Feast's attack bonus, dealing 14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) piercing damage on a hit.

legendary.name: Snatch
entries: The giant makes a snatch attack.

legendary.name: Stuff
entries: One Large or smaller creature {@condition grappled} by the giant must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or be stuffed into the hill giant's mouth and {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 18}).

legendary.name: Earthshaker Charge (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The giant moves up to 30 feet in a straight line and can move through the space of any creature smaller than Gargantuan. Each creature within 30 ft. of where it begins or ends this movement must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. A creature whose space the giant passes through has disadvantage on this saving throw.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The anteater has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Bristle-Tail Shade
entries: The anteater has advantage on saving throws against effects that deal radiant damage.

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The anteater can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The anteater makes two attacks with its Balled Claw Fist, or makes three attacks with its Vacuum Tongue Flick.
If the anteater is using its Threatening Pose, it may instead make two attacks with its Earthgouge Claws.

action.name: Balled Claw Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.
On a hit or miss, the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

action.name: Stonecutter Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d10 + 5}) slashing damage.
This attack is made at disadvantage against any creature not {@condition grappled} by the anteater.

action.name: Vacuum Tongue Flick
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d4 + 5}) slashing damage and the target is pulled up to 10 feet toward the anteater.
The target gains no benefit from cover or obscurement against this attack, so long as an uninterrupted path exists between it and the anteater.

action.name: Bristled Sweep
entries: The anteater sweeps its tail in a 15 foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) bludgeoning damage and be pushed up to 15 feet away.

bonus.name: Threatening Pose
entries: The anteater rears on its hind legs and spreads its arms. Until the anteater lowers itself as a bonus action or falls {@condition prone}, its speed is reduced to 0.

bonus.name: Suck Up
entries: Each Small or smaller creature within 10 feet of the anteater that it hit with its Vacuum Tongue Flick this turn must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be {@condition swallowed|confc|swallowed} (escape {@dc 16}).
A creature swallowed in this way takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) bludgeoning damage at the beginning of each of the anteater's turns.

reaction.name: Clumsy Tumble
entries: As a reaction when a creature hits the anteater with a melee attack, the anteater forces the creature to reroll the attack, taking the second result, then falls {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Perilous Hug
entries: As a reaction when a creature makes a melee attack against the anteater while the anteater is using its Threatening Pose, the anteater forces the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}).

trait.name: Keen Sight
entries: The hippogriff has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The hippogriff has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the hippogriff's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Vicious Dive
entries: If the hippogriff is flying and dives at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a melee weapon attack, the attack deals an extra 4 ({@damage 1d6}) damage to the target.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hippogriff makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its claws.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) slashing damage.

trait.name: Waking Dream Cone
entries: The hive mother's central eye creates an area of dreamlike unreality in a 150 ft. cone. A creature that starts its turn in the cone gains a 20 ft. fly speed and subtracts {@dice 1d4} from Dexterity and Wisdom saving throws it makes before the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Eyestalks
entries: When the hive mother is dealt a critical hit, the hive mother must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or lose the use of an eye ray of the attacker's choice that it has seen the hive mother use.

trait.name: Beholderkin Sovereign
entries: A beholderkin of CR 20 or lower that starts its turn within 5 miles of the hive mother must succeed on a {@dc 21} Wisdom saving throw or be magically {@condition charmed} by the hive mother and placed under its control. The hive mother hears and sees anything that a beholderkin under its control does.
At the beginning of each of its turns, each creature under the hive mother's control loses any legendary actions it has, and the hive mother gains an equal number of legendary actions.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The hive mother has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Distributed Nervous System (4/Day)
entries: If the hive mother fails a saving throw, it may choose to succeed instead. The hive mother takes one fewer legendary actions each turn for each time it has used this ability.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}39 ({@damage 6d10 + 6}) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed and {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 21}) inside the hive mother. A swallowed creature takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) acid damage at the start of each of the hive mother's turns, and its attacks bypass the hive mother's damage resistances.

action.name: Eye Rays
entries: The hive mother shoots one of the following magical eye rays, choosing one target it can see within 120 ft. of it:

items.name: 1. Disjunction Ray
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw or have each spell affecting it end, and have each of its non-artifact magical items become nonmagical and inert for the next minute.

items.name: 2. Sprouting Gift Ray
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 21} Charisma saving throw or sprout an eyestalk from an exposed point on its body. While a creature has an eyestalk on its body, it has disadvantage on attacks against the hive mother, and the hive mother can see everything it sees. The eyestalk can be destroyed (AC 20, 10 HP), but any damage dealt to the eyestalk is also dealt to the creature it is growing from.

items.name: 3. Searing Slice Ray
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw or take 88 ({@damage 16d10}) radiant damage. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more loses a limb (target's choice).

items.name: 4. Death Ray
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw or take 66 ({@damage 12d10}) necrotic damage. The target dies if the ray reduces it to 0 hit points.

items.name: 5. Disintegration Ray
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw or take 54 ({@damage 12d8}) force damage. If this damage reduces a creature to 0 hit points, its body becomes a pile of fine gray dust.

items.name: 6. Far Sojurn Ray (Concentration)
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 21} Charisma saving throw or be banished to the far realm for the next minute. While there, a creature is {@condition incapacitated} and repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success or taking 26 ({@dice 4d12}) slashing plus 26 ({@damage 4d12}) psychic damage on a failure. legendary.name: Telekinetic Shove

legendary.name: Eye Ray (Costs 2 Actions)

legendary.name: Regenerate (Costs 3 Actions)

entries: A creature that starts its turn within 120 feet of three or more hounds of the wild hunt that can hear them subtracts {@dice 1d4} from saving throws it makes agains being {@condition frightened}.

action.name: Snarling Bite (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 piercing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the hound can grapple the target (escape {@dc 16}).

action.name: Worry (Group Action)
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by both the hound and at least one of the hound's allies must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or fall {@condition prone} and take 12 damage per creature grappling it.

action.name: Harry
entries: One {@condition frightened} creature within 5 feet must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to move its speed directly away from the hound.

reaction.name: Planelock Howl (Group Reaction)
entries: As a reaction when a creature it can see attempts to teleport, the hound begins to howl forcing the creature to succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or have its teleportation fail.
Up to four other hounds may join this reaction, increasing the DC by 1 for each additional hound.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a Bonus Action, the mimic can polymorph into a Gargantuan vehicle or structure or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: False Appearance (Vehicle or Structure Form Only)
entries: While the mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary vehicle or structure.

trait.name: Grappler
entries: The mimic has advantage on attack rolls against any creature {@condition grappled} by it.

trait.name: Explorable
entries: The mimic may allow other creatures to enter or exit its space without hinderance. It may suspend this property as a bonus action.

If the mimic takes 30 or more damge in a turn, each creature trapped inside it may use its reaction to attempt a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw, escaping into an unoccupied adjacent space on a success.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the mimic fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mimic makes five Psuedopod attacks, one of which it may replace with its Ravening Maw. It makes one fewer attack for each mimic under its control.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, the mimic may grapple the target (escape {@dc 19}).

action.name: Ravening Maw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target not in the mimic's space. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d8 + 6}) piercing damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) acid damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw or be pulled into the mimic's space.

action.name: Digest {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature in the mimic's space must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or take 45 ({@damage 10d8}) acid damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Bloodied Roil (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 174 hit points, the mimic writhes and shakes. Each creature in the mimic's space must succeed on a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw or fall {@condition prone} and be {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 19}) in place.

legendary.name: Blinding Spray
entries: One creature within 20 ft. of the mimic must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the end of the mimic's next turn.

legendary.name: Slam Door
entries: The mimic raises a barrier between two interior portions of its body, seperating creatures on either side of it from each other. The barrier is an object and can be destroyed (AC 17; 20 HP; Immunity to Acid damge)

legendary.name: Absorb Vestige
entries: The mimic absorbs a friendly ooze in its space, gaining 30 temporary hit points. The ooze is destroyed.

legendary.name: Spawn Mimic (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Part of the mimic splits off, becoming an {@creature object mimic|confc|Object Mimic} under the house hunter mimic's control for the next hour, after which it withers and dies. The house hunter mimic loses 30 hit points.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The Howler has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The Howler has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the Howler's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Quill Defense
entries: Any creature that strikes a howler with a non-reach melee weapon, unarmed strike, or natural weapon takes {@dice 1d4} points of piercing damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The howler makes two attacks with its rending bite.

action.name: Rending Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) piercing damage, plus 22 ({@damage 4d10}) psychic damage if the target is {@condition frightened}. This attack ignores damage resistance.

action.name: Cursed Quills
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) piercing damage, and the target must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity save or a cursed quill breaks off in its flesh, causing the target to subtract {@dice 1d4} from the result whenever it makes an attack or save. The quills may be removed as an action with a successful {@dc 16} medicine check, or by taking an additional {@damage 1d6} damage per quill removed.

action.name: Mind-Breaking Howl {@recharge}
entries: The howler emits a keening howl in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area that isn't {@condition deafened} must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of the howler's next turn. While a creature is {@condition frightened} in this way, its speed is halved, and it is {@condition incapacitated}. A target that successfully saves is immune to the Mind-Breaking Howl of all howlers for the next 24 hours.

reaction.name: Present Quills
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the howler may make an attack with its cursed quills.

trait.name: Revealed by Moonlight
entries: The huecuva appears as it did in life, though any clothes it wears darken to black over the course of a day. The touch of moonlight strips away its flesh, revealing its true undead nature.
While in moonlight, the huecuva loses its damage immunities and gains vulnerability to Bludgeoning damage from Magical Attacks.

trait.name: Profaner of Blessings
entries: Whenever a living creature within 30 feet of one or more huecuvas would add a bonus to its attack or saving throw due to a spell or magical effect, it instead subtracts that amount.

trait.name: Turning Resistance
entries: The huecuva has advantage on saving throws against effects that turn undead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The huecuva makes two melee attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its Mocking Benediction.

action.name: Bony Gouge
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@dice 2d8 + 4}) piercing plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be infected with Huecuva Blight.

action.name: Mocking Benediction (Concentration)
entries: Up to three creatures the huecuva can see receive its blessing, adding {@dice 1d4} to attack rolls and saving throws they make for the next minute. An unwilling creature makes a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw, resisting the effect on a success.
Whenever a creature affected by this blessing fails a saving throw, it takes {@damage 1d10} necrotic damage.

action.name: Litany of Forsaken Vows {@recharge 5}
entries: The huecuva begins a wretched chant that corrupts a mortal's connection to the divine. Each creature of the huecuva's choice within 30 feet that can hear it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw or be cursed.

Whenever the cursed creature receives magical healing, it gains the same amount of temporary hit points. While it has any of these temporary hit points, the creature is hostile to all living creatures.

trait.name: Ra Magic Resistance
entries: The huldra has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects. While she is {@condition grappled} by the tail, this trait is suspended.

trait.name: Hollow Back
entries: The huldra has vulnerability to fire damage dealt by a creature that is flanking it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The huldra makes two melee attacks, one of which it may replace with its Huntersbane Breath, if available.

action.name: Hammerblow Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.
A creature that fails by 5 or more is {@condition stunned} until the end of the huldra's next turn.

action.name: Hurl Boulder
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 7} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d10 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Huntersbane Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The huldra exhales a mighty wind in a 15 ft. cone. Each creature in the area is pushed 10 ft. away and must make a {@dc 14} Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, a creature subtracts {@dice 1d4} from any attack rolls it makes until the next dawn.

reaction.name: Bend Iron
entries: As a reaction to being missed with an attack made with a nonmagical metal weapon, the huldra catches and bends the weapon, applying a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to -5, the weapon is destroyed.

trait.name: Ra Magic Resistance
entries: The huldra has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects. While she is {@condition grappled} by the tail, this trait is suspended.

trait.name: Blessings of the Treewarden
entries: The huldra's blessing may be gained by treating her with respect and deference, and by strictly following any and all rules set by her. A creature loses the huldra's blessing if she perceives a violation, however minor, of her rules. A creature with the huldra's favor gains the following benefits until it leaves her home forest:

items.name: Warded Rest
entries: A blessed creature will wake if approached by a hostile creature.

items.name: Kinmarked
entries: Giants friendly to the huldra treat a blessed creature as a trusted ally.

items.name: The Forest's Aid
entries: A blessed creature has advantage on {@skill Survival} (Wisdom) checks made to navigate, hunt, fish or forage.

trait.name: Hollow Back
entries: The huldra has vulnerability to fire damage dealt by a creature that is flanking it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The huldra makes two attacks, one of which it may replace with its Huntersbane Breath, if available.

action.name: Hammerblow Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 4d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.
A creature that fails by 5 or more is {@condition stunned} until the end of the huldra's next turn.

action.name: Hurl Boulder
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 8} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d10 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Huntersbane Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The huldra exhales a mighty wind in a 15 ft. cone. Each creature in the area is pushed 10 ft. away and must make a {@dc 14} Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, a creature subtracts {@dice 1d4} from any attack rolls it makes until the next dawn.

reaction.name: Headbutt
entries: As a reaction to being it with a melee attack by a creature within 5 ft. the huldra forces the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone} and {@condition stunned} until the end of the huldra's next turn.

reaction.name: Bend Iron
entries: As a reaction to being missed with an attack made with a nonmagical metal weapon, the huldra catches and bends the weapon, applying a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to -5, the weapon is destroyed.

monster.name: Hundred-Year Jiangshi

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't peachwood

languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak them

trait.name: Hopping Movement
entries: When initiative is rolled, the jiangshi selects a cardinal direction to face.
The jiangshi may move only in the direction it is facing, and may spend 5 feet of movement to turn up to 90 degrees or to stand from {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Graceless Rigor
entries: If the jiangshi is hit with a melee attack from a direction it is not facing, it is pushed 5 feet away and must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Breath Sight
entries: A creature that is holding its breath may attempt to hide from the jiangshi without obscurement.

trait.name: Flammable
entries: If the jiangshi takes any fire damage, it begins {@condition burning|confc|burning} ({@dice 1d10}).
While it is {@condition burning|confc|burning}, the jiangshi's melee attacks deal an additional 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The jiangshi makes three attacks, one of which it can replace with a use of its Drain Vitality.

action.name: Crooked Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature in the direction the jiangshi is facing. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) slashing damage plus one of the following effects:
The target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 18}).
The target is pushed up to 10 feet away.
The target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Drain Vitality
entries: The jiangshi draws the life force out from the forehead of a creature {@condition grappled} by it.
The creature takes 22 ({@damage 5d8}) necrotic damage, then must succeed on a {@dc 16} Charisma saving throw or lose three unexpended hit dice, or drop to 0 hit points if it cannot.
Until the end of its next turn, the jiangshi gains a 40 foot fly speed and can turn without spending movement.

action.name: Grave Breath
entries: The jiangshi's long, prehensile tongue slithers into the mouth of an {@condition unconscious} creature within 5 feet and a foul green vapor pours down it, forcing the creature to succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition cursed|confc|cursed}.

A creature {@condition cursed|confc|cursed} in this way is {@condition poisoned}, and at each dusk must succeed on a {@dc 16} Charisma saving throw or die and immediately rise as a {@creature rogue jiangshi|confc|Rogue Jiangshi} under the DM's control.

reaction.name: Whip Around
entries: When a creature the jiangshi is not facing misses it with a melee attack, the jiangshi turns to face it and makes a Crooked Claws attack.

reaction.name: Parch
entries: When a creature the jiangshi can see within 30 feet attempts to use an item made of liquid (such as holy water or a potion), or casts a spell that produces liquid (such as Acid Splash) the jiangshi turns the liquid to dust, negating its effects.

legendary.name: Hop
entries: The jiangshi moves up to 5 feet, turns up to 90 degrees, or stands from {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Enveloping Fog
entries: The fog can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and can move through any space that air can pass through without squeezing.

A living creature that starts its turn in the fog must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or suffer disadvantage on attack rolls and have its movement speed halved until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Wind Vulnerability
entries: If exposed to strong winds, the fog must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be dispersed and disappear reappearing in a space within 15 feet feet of where it was dispersed at the end of its next turn.

action.name: Numbing Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 1} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 ({@dice 1d6} + -2) bludgeoning damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) necrotic damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

action.name: Necrotic Pulse
entries: Each creature within 10 ft. of the fog must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 4d10}) necrotic damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Fill Lungs
entries: One creature in the fog's space must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw be unable to speak or breathe for the next minute.

The creature may end this effect as an action with a successful {@dc 15} Constitution ({@skill Medicine}) check to cough the fog out, or another creature may remove the fog with a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check.

action.name: Swirling Visages {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature that can see the fog must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by the fog until the end of the fog's next turn.
While {@condition charmed} in this way, a creature must use all of its movement to approach the fog by the most direct route.

reaction.name: Dweomer Feast
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of it casts a spell of 1st level or above, the fog can force the spell caster to succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or lose its highest level unexpended spell slot.
If the target loses a spell slot of 5th level or higher in this way, the fog may immediately use its Necrotic Pulse.

trait.name: Deceptive Neck
entries: When a creature the bird can see scores a critical against it, roll a {@dice d20}. On an 11-20, the critical becomes a miss.

trait.name: Mudstrider
entries: The bird ignores negative effects from moving over terrain composed of mud or shallow water.

action.name: Perforating Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Chest Slam
entries: The bird slams into a creature within 5 feet, forcing it to succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Death Blow (Recharges when the bird uses its Extend Neck)
entries: The bird strikes a {@condition prone} creature with blinding speed, making a Perforating Beak attack against it.
If the attack hits, it scores a critical.

bonus.name: Extend Neck
entries: The bird extends its neck, raising up to its full height and making a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check to detect any hidden creatures nearby.

bonus.name: Taloned Pin
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition prone} target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}) until the bird moves.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The hydroloth can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The hydroloth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Adaptive Combat
entries: The hydroloth treats its AC as 20 against attacks made by creatures affected by its Steal Memories.

trait.name: Secure Memory
entries: The hydroloth is immune to the waters of the River Styx as well as any effect that would steal or modify its memories or detect or read its thoughts.

trait.name: Venal Nature
entries: The yugoloth is always willing to accept a bribe rather than fight. A yugoloth will usually accept a rate of its challenge rating times 25 gp.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hydroloth attacks twice with its claws and uses its Steal Memories, if available. It may replace either or both of its claw attacks with its Deepest Fears or Teleport abilities.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) slashing damage and 14 ({@damage 4d6}) psychic damage.

action.name: Deepest Fears
entries: One creature affected by the hydroloth's Steal Memories has a manifestation of its deepest fears appear to it for the next minute. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 16} Intelligence saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Psychic damage and be {@condition frightened} for the duration. A creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success or taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) psychic damage on a failure.

action.name: Steal Memories {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature the hydroloth can see within 60 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Intelligence saving throw or have its proficiency bonus reduced by 1 until it completes a long rest. A creature that has its proficiency bonus reduced to 0 in this way can't speak or cast spells.

action.name: Teleport (3rd level spell)
entries: The hydroloth magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

reaction.name: Shared Mind
entries: As a reaction to failing an Intelligence or Wisdom saving throw, the hydroloth may force a creature within 60 feet that is affected by its Steal Memory to succeed on a {@dc 16} Intelligence saving throw or suffer the triggering saving throw's effects as well.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

trait.name: Devil's Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the devil's {@sense darkvision}.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Ice Strider
entries: The devil can tunnel through ice without slowing. The devil is not slowed by difficult terrain due to ice or snow. If it starts its turn in difficult terrain caused by ice or snow, the devil may dash as a bonus action.

trait.name: Layered Carapace
entries: The Ice Devil can't take more than 30 damage in a single turn. If it takes 30 damage in a single turn, its AC takes a cumulative minus 2 penalty until it completes a long rest.

trait.name: Crippling Cold
entries: The devil is surrounded by an 15 ft. radius aura of magical cold. When a creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) cold damage, or half as much damage on a success. If the Ice Devil does not move on its turn, the affected area is covered in slick ice and becomes difficult terrain. If the devil takes fire damage, this trait ceases to function until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The devil makes three attacks with its spear and uses its Ice Wall twice. If all three of its attacks hit the same creature, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} until the end of the devil's next turn.

action.name: Barbed Spear
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) slashing damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) cold damage.

action.name: Ice Wall
entries: The devil magically forms an opaque wall of ice on a solid surface it can see within 60 feet of it. The wall is 1 foot thick and up to 10 feet long and 10 feet high. When the wall appears, creatures in its space are pushed to a side of their choice.
The wall can be damaged and breached; each 10-foot section has AC 5, 30 hit points, vulnerability to fire damage, and immunity to acid, cold, necrotic, poison, and psychic damage.

action.name: Freezing Tomb {@recharge 5}
entries: The devil sends out a burst of cold in a 60-foot cone that clings to living creatures, sapping their vitality. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw. On a failure, a creature gains 27 ({@dice 6d8}) temporary HP. As long as it has this temporary HP, the creature is {@condition restrained}, {@condition blinded}, and has vulnerability to fire damage. A creature that starts its turn with any of this temporary HP must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be forced to expend a hit die. If it cannot, it drops to 0 HP.

reaction.name: Cold Snap
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with a ranged attack or harmful spell, the ice devil uses its Ice Wall ability. If the devil is no longer a valid target, the attack or spell fails.

from: natural armor) (18 while below full hp

trait.name: Chip Away
entries: The myrmidon is encased in a brittle icy shell. When the myrmidon is reduced below its maximum hit points, its AC is reduced by 4.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The myrmiddon makes three melee attacks, one of which it may replace with its Encase in Frost.

action.name: Chilling Hooksword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) cold damage and the target's movement speed is reduced by 5 until the end of its next turn. A creature whose movement speed is reduced to 0 in this way must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Encase in Frost {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature within 10 feet must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or gain 5 ({@dice 2d4}) temporary hit points. While it has these temporary hit points, the creature has vulnerability to fire damage and is {@condition restrained}.

reaction.name: Elemental Riposte
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack, the myrmidon unleashes a burst of clinging ice. The attacker must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 3d4}) cold damage and have its movement speed reduced by 20 until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Icy Gust
entries: As a reaction to a creature hitting the myrmidon with a melee attack, the myrmidon may make a melee attack against the attacker. If the attack hits, the creature is pushed back 5 feet.

trait.name: Chip Away
entries: If the mephit is missing any of its hit points, its AC is reduced to 11.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a burst of ice in a 5 foot radius. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 9} Dexterity saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 3d4}) cold damage and have its movement speed reduced by 20 until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Chilling Touch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) cold damage and the target's movmeent speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.
A creature whose movement speed is reduced to 0 in this way must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Encase in Frost {@recharge}
entries: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a {@dc 9} Strength saving throw or gain 5 ({@dice 2d4}) temporary hit points.
While it has any of these temporary hit points, the creature is {@condition restrained}.

reaction.name: Icy Gust
entries: When the mephit is hit with a melee attack, it can make a Chilling Touch attack against the attacker. On a hit, the target is pushed 5 feet away.

variant.name: Note: Rules Reminder
entries: Effects don't stack with themselves. The speed reduction from Chilling Touch can ony be applied once to a given creature, even if it is hit by multiple mephits.

trait.name: Web-Dweller
entries: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty.
While in contact with a web, the spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

action.name: Sapping Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}7 ({@dice 1d8 + 3}) piercing plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) poison damage.
For the next minute, whenever the target takes any cold damage it takes 4 ({@dice 1d8}) additional cold damage.

action.name: Grasping Legs
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}).

action.name: Frostsilk Globule
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 30/60 ft., one creature. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d8}) cold damage and the globule sticks to the target (remove {@dc 13}).
For each such globule stuck to it, a creature's movement speed is reduced by 10 and it takes 1 cold damage at the beginning of each of its turns.
If the creature takes any fire damage, each globule stuck to it melts away.

bonus.name: Cold Shock {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the spider must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or take 4 ({@damage 1d8}) cold damage per frostweb globule stuck to it.
A creature that takes 10 or more cold damage in this way is additionally {@condition paralyzed} until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Freezing Flesh
entries: A creature not resistant or immune to cold damage that starts its turn within 10 feet of the ice troll has its movement speed reduced by 10 until the beginning of its next turn.

If the ice troll starts its turn at least partially submerged in water, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 15}) as a mass of clinging ice forms around it.

trait.name: Brittle Joints
entries: When the troll suffers a critical hit that deals bludgeoning damage, one of its limbs breaks off, giving it disadvantage on attack rolls and Dexterity saving throws.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The troll makes two frostbite claw attacks, one of which it may replace with its bite or Cryoheal, if available.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) cold damage.

action.name: Frostbite Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) cold damage and the target has disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the troll's next turn.

action.name: Cryoheal (Requires Water) {@recharge 5}
entries: The troll packs its wounds with nearby snow, ice, or water, which freezes into a semblance of its flesh. The troll regains 30 hit points, may reattach one of its lost limbs, and gains vulnerability to fire damage until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Rimestrike Retaliation
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack the troll makes an attack with its Frostbite Claw against the attacker. If the attack hits, the target is knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Pariah Crystal
entries: If it has a pariah crystal with minds remaining, a destroyed illithilich gains a new body in {@dice 1d10} days, regaining all its hit points and becoming active again, and its pariah crystal loses one of the minds it contains. The new body appears within 5 feet of the phylactery.

trait.name: Impossible Angles
entries: The space in a 10 ft. radius around the illithilich is difficult terrain for non-aberrations, as the illithilich's presence warps it into incomprehensible geometries, additionally causing the following effects:

A non-aberration creature that starts its turn in the area, or enters it for the first time on a turn, must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or take {@damage 1d10} psychic damage and be {@condition poisoned} until the beginning of its next turn.
Ranged attacks made by non-aberrations that pass through the area are made at disadvantage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The illithilich has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Legendary Resistances (3/Day)
entries: If the illithilich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Icy Tentacles
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}15 ({@dice 2d10 + 4}) psychic plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) cold damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}).
A creature that starts its turn {@condition grappled} by the illithilich must succeed on a {@dc 16} Intelligence saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Nerve Rot Bolt
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 60 ft., one creature. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d8}) necrotic damage plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) psychic damage.

action.name: Extract Brain
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition incapacitated} humanoid {@condition grappled} by the alhoon. {@h}The target takes 55 ({@damage 10d10}) piercing damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the alhoon begins to extract and devour the target's brain. At the beginning of the illithilich's next turn if the target is still {@condition unconscious} and {@condition grappled}, the target dies and the illithilich gains 40 temporary hit points.

action.name: Dominate (5th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: One creature within 30 ft. that the alhoon can see must succeed on a {@dc 21} Wisdom saving throw or be magically {@condition charmed} and under the illithilich's telepathic control. Whenever the {@condition charmed} target takes damage, the target can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Blood to Vitriol (6th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: One creature within 60 ft. the alhoon can see must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} for 1 minute. A {@condition stunned} creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, taking 22 ({@damage 5d8}) acid damage on a failure, or ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Mind Blast Overcharge {@recharge 5}
entries: The illithilich magically emits psychic energy in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 21} Intelligence saving throw or take 76 ({@damage 8d8 + 40}) psychic damage and be {@condition stunned} until the end of the illithilich's next turn, or half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Shield (1st level spell)
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with an attack, the illithilich may add 5 to its AC until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Counterspell (3rd level spell)
entries: As a reaction to seeing a creature cast a spell within 60 feet, the illithilich may make an Intelligence check with DC equal to 10 plus the spell's level, negating the spell on a success. If the spell is 3rd level or below, the illithilich succeeds automatically.

reaction.name: Psychic Annihilation (1/Day, 9th Level Spell)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 111 hit points, the illithilich forces one creature it can see within 60 ft. to succeed on a {@dc 21} Intelligence saving throw or have its head explode, killing it instantly. On a successful save, the creature instead takes 66 ({@damage 12d10}) psychic damage.

legendary.name: Icy Tentacles
entries: The illithilich makes an attack with its icy tentacles.

legendary.name: Nerve Rot Bolt
entries: The illithilich makes an attack with its nerve rot bolt.

legendary.name: Fold Space (Costs 2 Actions, 4th Level Spell)
entries: The alhoon teleports to an unoccupied location it can see within 30 feet. Each creature within 15 ft. of the space it departed must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 10 ft. toward the space it departed and take 16 ({@damage 3d10}) psychic damage.

trait.name: Unstable Fusion
entries: If the immolith takes 20 or more damage from a single source, it must make a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw.
On a failure, it dies and explodes. Each creature within 15 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) fire damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The immolith makes four attacks with its Searing Slash, one of which it may replace with a use of its Manifest Soul or Cursed Flare, if available.

action.name: Searing Slash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}7 ({@dice 2d6}) fire plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Manifest Soul
entries: The immolith manifests a charred appendage from its body, mirroring that of a creature consumed by its Fuel for the Fire in the last minute, and makes a melee attack using that creature's statistics.

action.name: Cursed Flare (Recharges when the immolith uses its Fuel for the Fire)
entries: Each creature within 15 feet of the immolith must succeed on a {@dc 16} Charisma saving throw or be {@condition cursed|confc|cursed}. A creature cursed in this way loses any Resistance to fire damage, and takes an additional 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage whenever it takes fire damage.

reaction.name: Fuel for the Fire
entries: When a demon within 30 feet is destroyed, the immolith can force it to make a {@dc 16} Charisma saving throw.
On a failed save, the creature's spirit is absorbed into the immolith and the immolith gains 20 temporary hit points.

trait.name: Light-Attracted
entries: If Imperialis starts her turn within 30 feet of a source of bright light, she must succeed on a {@dc 10} Wisdom saving throw or be unable to voluntarily move away from the light until the beginning of her next turn.

trait.name: Erratic Flight
entries: While Imperialis is flying, attacks against her and any creatures riding her are made at disadvantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Imperialis makes two attacks, one of which may be with its barbed proboscis.

action.name: Barbed Proboscis
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. {@h}22 ({@damage 4d8 + 4}) slashing damage and Imperialis learns what types of flowers the creature has most recently been near.

action.name: Clinging Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}).

action.name: Pollinating Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d10 + 4}) piercing damage. On a hit or miss, the target and each other creature within 5 feet of it are coated in a fine pollen. A creature covered in this pollen gains no benefit from being {@condition invisible} until a creature uses an action to clear it.

reaction.name: Chaotic Swoop
entries: As a reaction when missed with an attack, Imperialis flies up to 15 feet in a random direction perpendicular to the ground.

reaction.name: Cry For Peace (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 43 HP, Imperialis releases a haunting sound and begins to glow softly for the next minute.
A creature that can see the glow and attempts to attack Imperialis must first make a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving. On a failed save, the attacker must choose a different target or lose the attack.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a bonus action, the incubus transforms into a Small or Medium humanoid without a fly speed, or back to its true fiendish form. Its statistics are otherwise the same in each form. It reverts to its humanoid form if it dies.

trait.name: Crushing Terror
entries: A creature that starts its turn {@condition prone} and in the incubus' space takes 11 ({@dice 2d10}) nonlethal psychic damage and cannot speak, breathe or stand until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Night's Caress (3rd Level Spell)
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}The target falls asleep for the next minute.
A sleeping creature wakes early if a creature takes an action to shake it awake, or if it takes any damage.

action.name: Sink Into Earth (3rd Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: One creature the incubus can see within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 14} Intelligence saving throw or fall {@condition prone} and be {@condition blinded} for the next minute.
If the creature stands from {@condition prone}, the effect ends and the creature takes 22 ({@damage 4d10}) psychic damage.

action.name: Steal Dreams (4th Level Spell)
entries: One {@condition unconscious} or {@condition blinded} creature within 5 feet must make a {@dc 14} Intelligence saving throw.
On a failed save, the incubus learns one closely held secret of the creature's, and the creature takes 33 ({@dice 6d10}) nonlethal psychic damage.

A creature reduced to 0 hit points in this way is {@condition cursed|confc|cursed}. A creature cursed in this way cannot gain levels or otherwise advance through experience. When this curse ends, the creature gains any levels prevented by the curse.

action.name: Etherealness
entries: The incubus enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a bonus action, the incubus transforms into a Small or Medium humanoid without a fly speed, or back to its true fiendish form. Its statistics are otherwise the same in each form. It reverts to its humanoid form if it dies.

trait.name: Crushing Terror
entries: A creature that starts its turn {@condition prone} and in the incubus' space takes 11 ({@dice 2d10}) nonlethal psychic damage and cannot speak, breathe or stand until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The incubus makes two attacks with its Night's Caress, one of which it may replace with a use of its Waking Dream or Incubate Fears, if available.

action.name: Night's Caress (3rd Level Spell)
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}The target falls asleep for the next minute.
A sleeping creature wakes early if a creature takes an action to shake it awake, or if it takes any damage.

action.name: Waking Dream (4th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: One {@condition unconscious} creature within 5 feet must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or rise under the incubus' control for the next hour, or until it regains consciousness, and can perceive and take actions as though conscious for the duration.
Whenever the creature would wake, the incubus may make a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw. On a success, the creature remains {@condition unconscious}.

action.name: Incubate Fears (5th Level Spell) {@recharge 5}
entries: The incubus draws forth and congeals the fears of a {@condition frightened} or {@condition unconscious} creature within 5 feet, conjuring a Living Nightmare that lasts a minute in an unoccupied space within 10 feet.

action.name: Etherealness
entries: The incubus enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa.

trait.name: Duck and Leap
entries: When the guanghan takes the {@action Dodge} action, it may jump up to 10 feet whenever it is missed with a melee attack.

trait.name: The Unmatched Blade
entries: While her blade is drawn, Indigo Jade adds +5 to her AC.

trait.name: Swordmaster's Respite
entries: Indigo Jade regains her reaction whenever she is missed with an attack.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Indigo Jade makes four attacks with her Blinding Slice, one of which she may replace with her Winding Kick or the {@action Dodge} action.

action.name: Blinding Slice
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) slashing damage and the target is pushed up to 5 feet away.
Creatures with a Dexterity score of 18 or lower cannot take reactions in response to this attack.

action.name: Winding Kick
entries: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 15 feet away and knocked {@condition prone}.
A creature that fails this save by 5 or more additionally cannot speak, breathe, or stand until the beginning of her next turn.

bonus.name: Recenter
entries: Indigo Jade gains 10 temporary hit points, and may immediately repeat any saving throw against an ongoing effect, ending the effect on a success. She may take this action even while {@condition incapacitated}.

bonus.name: Sheathe Blade {@recharge 5}
entries: Indigo Jade sheaths her blade and ends her turn. Each creature she hit with an attack this turn must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or lose 22 ({@dice 4d10}) hit points as its wounds open.

reaction.name: Spring Away
entries: As a reaction when Indigo Jade makes a Dexterity saving throw, she jumps up to 15 feet.
If she ends this movement outside the area effect or range of the spell, she is unaffected by it.

reaction.name: Twirling Disarm
entries: As a reaction when Indigo Jade is missed with a melee attack, she forces the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or have one item is carrying flung up to 15 feet away.

reaction.name: Punishing Kick
entries: As a reaction when a creature within 15 feet of Indigo Jade begins to cast a spell, she moves up to 10 feet towards it and uses her Winding Kick.

reaction.name: Perfect Deflection
entries: As a reaction to being hit with an attack, Indigo Jade adds 1 to her AC against that attack.
If this causes the attack to miss, she may make a Blinding Slice attack as part of this reaction.

trait.name: Web-Dweller
entries: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty.
While in contact with a web, the spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

trait.name: Molten Body
entries: If the spider takes any cold damage, it is {@condition petrified} and its AC becomes 18 until the end of its next turn.

While it is not {@condition petrified}, any nonmagical weapon made of metal that hits the spider melts and warps. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spider makes two attacks, one of which may be with its Searfang Bite.

action.name: Searfang Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d8 + 2}) piercing damage and the target begins {@condition burning|confc|burning} ({@dice 1d10}).

action.name: Eruption Kick
