entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hits: 5 ({@dice 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away.
A creature the target is pushed into takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage and is pushed up to 5 feet away.

action.name: Molten Web Trail {@recharge 5}
entries: The spider drags its spinnarets accross the ground, leaving a carpet of magmatic webbing in any space it leaves until the end of its turn.

For the next minute, a creature that begins its turn in one of those spaces or enters it for the first time on a turn must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or take 11 ({@damage 2d10}) fire damage and be {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 12}) until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Web-Dweller
entries: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty.
While in contact with a web, the spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

trait.name: Molten Body
entries: If the spider takes any cold damage, it must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition petrified} and have its AC become 22 until the end of its next turn.

While it is not {@condition petrified}, any nonmagical weapon made of metal that hits the spider melts and warps. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls.

trait.name: Volcanic Flare
entries: When the spider takes 15 or more non-cold damage from a single source while it is not {@condition petrified}, waves of heat pulse outward from its body, dealing 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage to each creature within 10 feet of it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spider makes two attacks, one of which may be with its Bloodboil Bite.

action.name: Bloodboil Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}13 ({@dice 2d8 + 4}) piercing plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn).
While {@condition poisoned} in this way, a creature is also {@condition burning|confc|burning} 11 ({@dice 2d10}).

action.name: Eruption Kick
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hits: 11 ({@dice 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage and the target is pushed up to 15 feet away.
A creature the target is pushed into takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage and is pushed up to 10 feet away.

bonus.name: Molten Web Trail
entries: The spider drags its spinnarets accross the ground, leaving a carpet of magmatic webbing in any space it leaves until the end of its turn.

For the next minute, a creature that begins its turn in one of those spaces or enters it for the first time on a turn must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 11 ({@damage 2d10}) fire damage and be {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 16}) until the beginning of its next turn.

bonus.name: Devour Webs
entries: The spider gathers and consumes all of the molten webbing within 5 feet of it, gaining 5 temporary hit points per 5 foot square of webbing consumed.
While it has any of these temporary hit points, the spider has advantage on Constitution saving throws.

monster.name: Intellect Devourer
languages: understands Deep Speech but can't speak

trait.name: Mindsense
entries: The intellect devourer is aware of the presence of creatures within 300 feet of it that have an Intelligence of 3 or higher. It knows the relative distance and direction of each creature, regardless of physical barriers. Creatures under the effects of magic that protects the mind cannot be detected by the intellect devourer.

trait.name: Exposed Brain
entries: The intellect devourer has a telepathic field that grants it resistace to all damage but psychic, which it must concentrate on as though {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell. If it loses {@status concentration}, until the beginning of its next turn it loses its damage resistances and gains vulnerability to all damage but psychic.

action.name: Trepanation Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) slashing damage. This attack deals an additional 21 ({@damage 6d6}) damage to an {@condition incapacitated} target and bores a small hole in its skull.

action.name: Rend Mind
entries: The intellect devourer chooses one creature it can see within 30 feet of it that has an Intelligence of 3 or higher The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Intelligence saving throw or take 16 ({@damage 3d10}) psychic damage. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more has its Intelligence score reduced to 0 and is {@condition stunned}. The target may repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Displace Brain
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target with a hole in its skull. {@h}The creature is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}) and {@condition blinded} as the intellect devourer latches onto it. If the intellect devourer begins its turn grappling a creature in this way, it forces its way into the creature's skull, consumes and displaces the creature's brain, and takes full control of its body.

While inside the creature's skull, the intellect devourer has total cover against attacks and other effects outside of the host. The intellect devourer retains its Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, as well as its comprehension of language, its telepathy, and its traits. Otherwise, it inherits the target's statistics, memories and knowledge, including spells and languages. If the host body drops to 0 hit points, the intellect devourer must leave the host. It can also be magically forced from the host's body by means of a {@spell protection from evil and good} spell being cast on the host.

reaction.name: Scuttle
entries: As a reaction to being subjected to an effect that allows it to make a saving throw to take only half damage, the intellect devourer may move up to half its speed. If it ends this movement outside the effect's area, range, or line-of-sight, the intellect devourer takes no damage.

monster.name: Invisible Stalker
languages: understands Common but doesn't speak it

trait.name: Innate Invisibility
entries: The stalker is {@condition invisible}. If fine particles are scattered in its space, this trait is disabled for the next minute, or until it uses its Expel Debris.

trait.name: Faultless Tracker
entries: The stalker can detect, by scent, the direction and distance to its summoner and to the target named as part of the spell to summon it, as long as each of those creatures are on the same plane of existence.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The stalker makes two attacks with its Seal Throat, each of which it can replace with a use of its Hammer Lungs or Sudden Gust, if available.

action.name: Seal Throat
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}).
While {@condition grappled} in this way, a creature is {@condition choking|confc|choking}.

action.name: Hammer Lungs
entries: The stalker attempts to smash the air from the lungs of a {@condition choking|confc|choking} creature within 5 feet that is holding its breath.

The target takes 18 ({@damage 4d8}) bludgeoning damage, then must succeed on {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or lose its held breath and immediately begin {@condition suffocating|confc|suffocating}.

action.name: Sudden Gust {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 30 feet in a direction of the stalker's choice.
A creature the stalker is Hidden from makes this saving throw with disadvantage.

reaction.name: Expel Debris
entries: When the stalker is reduced below 53 hit points, it can purge itself of particles suspended in its form, then can attempt to {@action Hide}.

trait.name: Silver Tongue
entries: Ireena has advantage on Charisma based skill checks to interact with guards or other figures of authority.

trait.name: Moment's Respite
entries: As part of a short rest, Ireena may prepare and share out a fortifying tea, granting all who drink it 6 ({@dice 1d8 + 2}) temporary hit points.

action.name: Rapier
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage. On a critical hit, the target must suceed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or drop one item it is holding.

action.name: Combat Medicine (1/Short Rest)
entries: One adjacent creature with 0 hit points gains 1 hit point.

reaction.name: Valiant Shove
entries: As a reaction to a creature within 5 ft hitting a creature other than Ireena with an attack, Ireena forces the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 10} Strength saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Bon Mot
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack, Ireena makes a cutting remark. The attacker must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or suffer disadvantage on attack rolls that target Ireena until the end of the attacker's next turn.

monster.name: Iron Golem

immune.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

languages: understands The Languages Of Its Creator but can't speak

trait.name: Fire Absorption
entries: Whenever the golem is subjected to fire damage, it's body softens and it loses its immunity to nonmagical weaponry until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Intricate Machinery
entries: Whenever the golem is subjected to lightning damage, its speed is halved and it cannot use its multiattack until the end of its next turn. If it suffers this effect three turns in a row, this trait is disabled for the next minute, and the golem can make a melee attack as a bonus action for the duration.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: The golem can't be affected or detected by spells of 2nd level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Armor Breach
entries: While the golem has fewer than 106 hit points, it continuously leaks poison gas. It cannot use its poison breath, and a creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the golem must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 5d8}) poison damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d8 + 7}) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Iron Seax
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d10 + 7}) slashing damage. This attack deals an additional 11 ({@damage 2d10}) damage to a {@condition prone} target.

action.name: Spinning Cleave
entries: Each creature in a 10 ft. radius must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or take 16 ({@damage 3d10}) slashing damage and be pushed 10 feet away.

action.name: Poison Breath {@recharge}
entries: The golem exhales poisonous gas in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw, taking 45 ({@damage 10d8}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Trampling Charge
entries: If the gorgon moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Reckless Follow-Through
entries: At the start of its turn, the gorgon can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn. If it misses with an attack this turn, it is {@condition stunned} until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Gore
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d12 + 5}) piercing damage.
A {@condition petrified} target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or shatter.

action.name: White-Iron Hooves
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.
The gorgon may make this attack as a Bonus Action against a {@condition prone} creature.

action.name: Thrashing Horns
entries: Two creatures on opposite sides of the gorgon must each succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 19 ({@damage 3d12}) piercing damage and be pushed 10 feet away, or take half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Petrifying Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The gorgon exhales petrifying gas in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is {@condition restrained} until the end of the gorgon's next turn.

A creature that fails this save by 5 or more must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn, ending the effect on a success. On a failure, the target is {@condition petrified} until freed by the {@spell Greater Restoration} spell or other similar magic.

trait.name: Delaminating Shell
entries: Whenever the beetle takes damage, it can reduce that damage to 1.
If it does, the AC provided by its Natural Armor is reduced by 1 until it completes a Short or Long Rest.

trait.name: Spiracle Breathing
entries: The beetle has disadvantage on Constitution saving throws against inhaled toxins.

action.name: Tarsal Grip
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 0} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}The beetle becomes {@condition attached|confc|attached} to the target (remove {@dc 8}).

action.name: Distracting Thump
entries: The beetle rapidly knocks its abdomen against a creature it is climbing on, which can use its reaction to attempt to remove the beetle (remove {@dc 8}).
If the creature does not remove the beetle, attacks against the creature have advantage until the beginning of the creature's next turn.

reaction.name: Feign Death
entries: When a creature misses the beetle with an attack, the beetle can fall {@condition prone} and appear to die.

trait.name: Slowed Metabolism
entries: The scorpion can survive up to a year without food or water, and up to two weeks without oxygen before suffering any ill effects.

trait.name: Heat Spasms
entries: Whenever the scorpion takes 10 or more fire damage from a single source, it makes a tail stinger attack against a random creature within reach.

trait.name: Brittle Barb
entries: If the scorpion is dealt a critical hit with a weapon that deals bludgeoning damage, it can't make attacks with its Tail Stinger until it completes a Short or Long rest.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The scorpion makes three melee attacks, up to one of which may be with its its Tail Stinger.

action.name: Grasping Pincers
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}).

action.name: Tail Stinger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 10 ft., one {@condition grappled} or {@condition incapacitated} creature. {@h}7 ({@dice 1d10 + 2}) piercing plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be infected with {@disease wandering eye neurotoxemia|ConfC}.

reaction.name: Twisting Tail
entries: As a reaction when a creature grapples the scorpion, the scorpion makes an attack with its tail stinger against the creature.

trait.name: Dolorous Aura
entries: The area in a 1 mile radius around the treant is dull and drained of color and vibrancy. A creature that completes a Short or Long Rest in the area must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or gain a point of {@condition exhaustion}.

trait.name: Bladeridge Bark
entries: A creature that climbs onto the treant or makes a saving throw to avoid falling off takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) slashing damage.

trait.name: Locust-Thorn Limbs
entries: The treant has four limbs (AC 20; 40 HP), each of which can grapple a single creature. Destroying a limb deals no damage to the treant, which regrows all lost limbs when it completes a long rest.

trait.name: Giant Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the treant may spend half of its movement to attempt a {@dc 18} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check, climbing onto it on a success. A creature climbing on the treant has advantage on melee attacks against the treant, and the treant has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The treant makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Bladeridge Bite.

action.name: Bladeridge Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one {@condition grappled} target. {@h}25 ({@damage 3d12 + 6}) piercing damage. and the target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or be {@condition swallowed|confc|swallowed} (escape {@dc 18}).

A creature {@condition swallowed|confc|swallowed} in this way takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) slashing damage whenever it takes an action, and may attempt to escape as a reaction whenever the treant uses this attack.

action.name: Locust-Thorn Whip
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 18}).
A creature {@condition grappled} in this way loses 5 hit points and is dragged up to 30 feet toward the treant at the start of each of its turns.

bonus.name: Ironplum Bushel Fling
entries: The treant hurls a cluster of ironplums at a point it can see within 60 feet, rolling a {@dice d4} to determine the effect:

items.name: 1. Unripe
entries: The ironplums scatter in a 15 foot cone emanating from the point of impact. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.

items.name: 2-3. Ripe
entries: The ironplums shatter explosively in a 15 foot radius spray of shrapnel. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or take 7 ({@dice 2d6}) fire plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) piercing damage.

items.name: 4. Overripe
entries: The ironplums burst, exuding a foul stench reminiscent of carrion in a 15 foot radius. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of the treant's next turn.

trait.name: Blinding Flock
entries: A creature within 5 feet of three or more hostile yosuzume has disadvantage on attacks and Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks.

trait.name: Yugiri Justice Squadron
entries: At the beginning of its turn, the yosuzume gains 5 temporary hit points for each other friendly creature within 30 feet that is {@status concentration||concentrating} on a Heroic Pose.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Ishi makes three attacks with her Downy Strike, one of which she can replace with a use of her Special Technique: Puff Up! or her Heroic Pose.

action.name: Downy Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) bludgeoning damage.
Instead of dealing damage, Ishi can push the creature up to 5 feet or steal a Tiny item from the creature that it is not wearing or wielding.

action.name: Special Technique: Puff Up!
entries: Ishi ruffles her feathers menacingly; until the end of her next turn, she counts as size Medium, has resistance to bludgeoning damage, and her melee attacks deal an additional {@damage 1d4} bludgeoning damage on a hit.

action.name: Heroic Pose (Concentration)
entries: Ishi displays her heroic stability with an extended pose. Until she moves or is knocked {@condition prone}, Ishi gains advantage on Strength saving throws and can't be {@condition frightened}.

reaction.name: Special Technique: Tag In!
entries: When Ishi enters a creature's reach, she can prevent it from making {@action opportunity attack||opportunity attacks} against creatures other than her until the beginning of her next turn.

monster.name: Isimir, Scream of the Frozen World

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If the isimir fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Earth Shaking Movement
entries: Whenever the isimir moves at least 10 feet, the ground in a 60 foot radius becomes difficult terrain for other creatures until the beginning of its next turn. Structures in the area collapse. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Titanic Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the isimir and equipped with ice climbing gear may spend 30 feet of movement to attempt a {@dc 18} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the isimir's legs. A creature may attempt the same check to climb from the isimir's legs to its waist, waist to torso, or from its torso to its head.

items.name: Legs
entries: While climbing on the isimir's legs, a creature must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw at the start of its turn or fall off.

items.name: Waist
entries: While climbing on the isimir's waist, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the isimir.

items.name: Torso
entries: While climbing on the isimir's torso, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the isimir and on saving throws against its abilities.

items.name: Head
entries: While climbing on the isimir's head, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the isimir and on saving throws against its abilities. If a creature on the isimir's head scores a critical hit against it, the isimir falls {@condition prone} at the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Ponderous
entries: The isimir moves only when it uses its stride action.

trait.name: Hoarfrost Aura
entries: A creature that ends its turn within 300 ft. of the isimir must succeed on a {@dc 21} Strength saving throw or gain 36 ({@dice 8d8}) temporary hit points. A creature that moved at least 20 ft. on its turn makes this save at advantage. While it has these hit points, a creature is {@condition restrained} and gains vulnerability to bludgeoning and fire damage. A creature killed by bludgeoning or thunder damage in this area shatters, destroying its body.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The isimir makes two attacks with its stride, one of which it may replace with its Blade of the Cold Mountain or its Brush off.

action.name: Stride
entries: The isimir takes a single step, moving up to its movement speed. Each creature within 10 ft. of where it ends this movement must succeed on a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw or take 26 ({@damage 3d10 + 10}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}, or half as much on a success. A {@condition prone} creature has disadvantage on this save.

action.name: Blade of the Cold Mountain
entries: The isimir begins to swing its blade, targeting a 100 ft. long, 20 ft. wide line within 100 ft. At the beginning of its next turn, the strike lands, and each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw or take 66 ({@damage 12d10}) bludgeoning damage and 45 ({@damage 10d8}) cold damage, or half as much on a success. A creature with at least 15 Passive {@skill Perception} knows precisely where the strike will land.

action.name: Brush Off
entries: The isimir attempts to dislodge a creature climbing on it. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw or take 32 ({@damage 5d12}) bludgeoning damage and be pushed 30 ft. away.

reaction.name: Bone-Shattering Scream (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 267 hit points, the isimir emits a titanic scream in a 600-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw, taking 63 ({@damage 14d8}) thunder damage and 63 ({@damage 14d8}) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is permanently {@condition deafened}.

legendary.name: Inhale
entries: The isimir takes a breath in. Creatures in a 120 ft. cone must succeed on a {@dc 21} Strength saving throw or be pulled 30 ft. towards the isimir.

legendary.name: Exhale
entries: The isimir lets a breath out. Creatures in a 120 ft. cone must succeed a {@dc 21} Strength saving throw or take 36 ({@damage 8d8}) cold damage and be pushed 30 ft. away from the isimir, or half as much damage on a success. The isimir may use this ability only if it used its Inhale on the previous turn.

trait.name: Silver Tongue
entries: Ismark has advantage on Charisma based skill checks to interact with guards or other figures of authority.

trait.name: Duelist's Eye
entries: Ismark can make two reactions each round, as long as he is not {@condition flanked|confc|flanked}. He may not make more than one reaction in response to a single trigger.

action.name: Broadsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d10 + 2}) slashing damage.

reaction.name: Chivalrous Parry
entries: As a reaction to Ismark or an adjacent creature being targeted with a melee attack, Ismark adds 2 to the target's AC against that attack.

reaction.name: Bon Mot
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack, Ismark makes a cutting remark. The attacker must succeed on a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw or suffer disadvantage on attack rolls that target Ismark until the end of the attacker's next turn.

trait.name: Confounding Circling
entries: While adjacent to two or more ixzan, a creature has disadvantage on {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity} that target one of them.

trait.name: Segmented Brain
entries: The ixzan may continue to make {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity} with its whiptail barb for up to a minute after being {@condition incapacitated} or killed.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ixzan makes two attacks, one of which may be with its Frenzied Bite.

action.name: Frenzied Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) piercing damage and up to one other ixzan may use its reaction to make a frenzied bite attack against the same target.

action.name: Whiptail Harpoon
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@dice 1d8 + 3}) piercing plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage and the target is pulled 5 feet toward the ixzan.

action.name: Pelagic Lance
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 4} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d10 + 2}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

action.name: Rain of Death {@recharge 5}
entries: The ixzan makes six attacks with its pelagic lance.

reaction.name: Silt-Out
entries: When it is reduced below 53 hit points while within 10 feet of a sea or lake bed, the ixzan can kick up a cloud of silt around itself, heavily obscuring the area in a 15-foot radius until the end of its next turn.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The jackalwere can use its action to polymorph into a specific Medium human or a jackal-humanoid hybrid, or back into its true form (that of a Small jackal). Other than its size, its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The jackalwere has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The jackalwere has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the jackalwere's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Sleep Gaze
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of one or more jackalweres that can see it must succeed on a {@dc 10} Wisdom saving throw or fall asleep for the next minute. A creature wakes early if it takes damage, or if another creature uses its action to wake it.

Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the jackalwere until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Vicious Scimitar
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) slashing damage. On a critical hit, this attack deals an additional 7 damage.

trait.name: Floating Conveyance
entries: Jahanbaz is carried by a Large floating vehicle powered by zarshak gas (AC 16; 115 HP, Immunity to psychic and poison damage).
The vehicle has a 20 foot fly (hover) speed and grants its pilot half cover against ranged attacks.

trait.name: Gas-Warped
entries: If the lamplighter would take 15 or fewer poison damage from a single source, it instead takes no poison damage.
If it would take more than 15 poison damage from a single source, it instead takes twice that much Poison damage.

action.name: Guildmaster's Command
entries: Up to three other lamplighters that Jahanbaz can see may each use their reactions to move up to half their speed or make an attack.

action.name: Stranglegas (3rd Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: Gas swirls around the head of one creature Jahanbaz can see within 60 feet for the next minute.

At the beginning of each of the creature's turns, it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or fall {@condition unconscious} until it takes any damage, or until a creature wakes it as an action.

action.name: Wave of Soot (4th Level Spell)
entries: Up to three open flames that Jahanbaz can see within 60 feet each expel a burst of soot in a 15 foot cone. Each creature in one or more of the areas must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} and unable to speak or breathe until the end of Jahanbaz's next turn.

action.name: Barrow Geyser (5th Level Spell)
entries: Jahanbaz opens a 5 foot radius rift in the ground that expels pressurized extraplanar gas to a height of 40 feet for the next minute.

Each creature in the area when it appears, and any creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn, must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or be launched 40 feet above the rift, then immediately falls in an unoccupied space of its choice within 15 feet of the rift.
The gas ignites if it touches an open flame, dealing 14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage to any creature that makes a saving throw against the geyser.

bonus.name: Vehicle Actions
entries: If Jahabaz is in his floating conveyance, he may activate one of its actions on each of his turns as a bonus action.

bonus.name: Wobbling Knop Bash
entries: One creature within 5 feet of the vehicle must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.

bonus.name: Wax Cascade
entries: Each creature directly beneath the vehicle must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage and be coated in molten wax (escape {@dc 17}).
A creature coated in wax that has not taken any fire damage since the end of its last turn is {@condition restrained}.

bonus.name: Twin Labra Flamestream {@recharge 5}
entries: Two 20 foot long, 5 foot wide streams of flame extend from the vehicle until the end of its pilot's next turn.

A creature that starts its turn in one or more of the areas or enters one for the first time on its turn must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage, or half as much on a success.
If this ability recharges while still active, the pilot may immediately use this ability again as a reaction.

trait.name: Matched Materials
entries: A leech that has been attached to a surface for at least 24 hours is indistinguishable from the surface around it to creatures more than 30 feet away.

trait.name: Spelljammer Overload
entries: If the leech is reduced to 0 hit points while attached to a ship with a spelljamming helm, a creature attached to that helm must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} for 1 minute.

action.name: Spiked Tentacle
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Latch
entries: The leech attaches itself to a ship's hull in its space, dealing 2 ({@damage 1d4}) piercing damage to the ship (ignoring the ship's damage threshold). This damage can't be repaired until the leech is scraped off the hull. As an action, an adjacent creature can attempt a {@dc 18} Strength check to try to scrape it off.

reaction.name: Spell Skimmer
entries: As a reaction when a vessel it is attached to accelerates to cruising speed, the leech forces the spelljammer to succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or lose its lowest level unexpended spell slot.

reaction.name: Magical Discharge (1/Day)
entries: When it takes damage, the leech can discharge a bolt of stolen magical energy. One creature the leech can see within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) force damage for each spell level absorbed with the leech's Spell Skimmer ability in the last day.

trait.name: Bladed Berg
entries: If the jarrlak takes 15 or more fire damage from a single source, its Icicle Gore does half as much piercing damage until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Freezing Flesh
entries: If the jarrlak is doused in water, it gains 10 temporary hit points. While it has any of these temporary hit points, the jarrlak is {@condition restrained}.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The jarrlak has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The jarrlak makes three attacks with its Icicle Gore, one of which it may replace with a use of its Frostshatter Bite or Frozen Death, if available.

action.name: Frostshatter Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}32 ({@damage 4d12 + 6}) piercing damage.
A target affected by the jarrlak's Frozen Death drops to 0 hit points, then must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or shatter into pieces and die.

action.name: Icicle Gore
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@dice 4d6 + 6}) piercing plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) cold damage.

action.name: Frozen Death {@recharge 4}
entries: One creature the Jarrlak can see within 15 feet must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition petrified} as it freezes solid (Save Ends at end of turn).
This effect ends early if the creature takes any fire damage.

reaction.name: Glacial Eruption (1/Day)
entries: When the jarrlak is reduced below 111 hit points, it can raise a contiguous wall of ice composed of up to six 20 foot by 20 foot, 5 foot thick panels, bursting forth from the earth within 100 feet of it.
When the wall appears, each creature in the wall's space is pushed to a side of its choice. Each panel of the wall is an object and can be attacked (AC 5, 50 HP, vulnerability to fire damage).

trait.name: Chemoreception
entries: While submerged in a body of water, the servitor can detect the presence and location of creatures in that water within 60 feet.

trait.name: Drifting Hazard
entries: Whenever the servitor takes damage, it is pushed 10 feet away from the source of the damage.
A creature that the servitor is pushed into must immediately save against its Stinging Tendrils.

action.name: Stinging Tendrils
entries: The jellyfish brushes its tendrils against a creature within 5 feet, discharging hundreds of microscopic, venom-coated needles into it.

The creature must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or take 5 ({@damage 2d4}) poison damage. A creature that fails by 5 or more is {@condition paralyzed} until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Resonance Bell
entries: As a reaction when a creature within 30 feet of the servitor makes a saving throw against a lemurian's song, the servitor amplifies the song, forcing the creature to subtract {@dice 1d4} from its rolled result.

monster.name: Jiangshi

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't peachwood

languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak them

trait.name: Jiangshi Weaknesses
entries: The jiangshi has the following flaws:

items.name: Breath Sight
entries: A creature that is holding its breath may attempt to hide from the jiangshi without being obsucred.

items.name: Fear of Mirrors
entries: The jiangshi must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn if its sees its reflection.

items.name: Pinned Talisman
entries: If a holy talisman is affixed to the jiangshi's forehead with a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check, the jiangshi must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} until the seal is removed or it takes damage.

items.name: Flammable
entries: If the jiangshi takes fire damage, it catches fire. Until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the jiangshi takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage at the start of each of the jiangshi's turns, and its attacks deal an additional 4 ({@damage 1d8}) fire damage.

trait.name: Hopping Movement
entries: The jiangshi is always facing a single direction, and must spend 5 feet of movement to change its facing. Additionally, it may spend 5 ft. of movement to stand from {@condition prone}. The jiangshi's reach extends only in the direction it is facing.

trait.name: Graceless
entries: If the jiangshi is struck with a melee attack from a direction it is not facing, it is pushed 5 feet away and must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The jiangshi has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The jiangshi makes three attacks, one of which can be a bite attack.

action.name: Claw Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft. in the direction it is facing, one creature. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, and the jiangshi adds one of the following effects:
The target is {@condition grappled}.
The target is pushed 10 ft. away.
The target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Ki Draining Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition prone}, {@condition grappled}, or {@condition incapacitated} creature. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage plus 17 ({@damage 5d6}) necrotic damage. The target must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. On a failure the target is forced to expend two hit dice, or drop to 0 HP if it cannot, and the jiangshi gains 17 ({@dice 5d6}) temporary hit points.
While it has these temporary hit points, the jiangshi has 20 AC, advantage on Dexterity saving throws, and a speed of 60 ft.

reaction.name: Whip Around
entries: As a reaction to being missed with an attack by a creature it is not facing, the jiangshi turns to face it and makes a claw attack.

monster.name: Jiangshi Sealbonded

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't peachwood

languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak them

trait.name: Breath Sight
entries: A creature that is holding its breath may attempt to hide from the jiangshi without being obsucred.

trait.name: Flammable
entries: If the jiangshi takes fire damage, it catches fire. Until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the jiangshi takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage at the start of each of the jiangshi's turns, and its attacks deal an additional 4 ({@damage 1d8}) fire damage.

trait.name: Hopping Movement
entries: The jiangshi is always facing a single direction, and must spend 5 feet of movement to change its facing. Additionally, it may spend 5 ft. of movement to stand from {@condition prone}. The jiangshi's reach extends only in the direction it is facing.

trait.name: Graceless
entries: If the jiangshi is struck with a melee attack from a direction it is not facing, it is pushed 5 feet away and must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The jiangshi makes two attacks, one of which can be a bite attack.

action.name: Claw Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. in the direction it is facing, one creature. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) bludgeoning damage, and the jiangshi adds one of the following effects:
The target is {@condition grappled}.
The target is pushed 10 ft. away.
The target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Ki Draining Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition prone}, {@condition grappled}, or {@condition incapacitated} creature. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage.

reaction.name: Whip Around
entries: As a reaction to being missed with an attack by a creature it is not facing, the jiangshi turns to face it and makes a claw attack.

trait.name: Regain Equilibrium
entries: When Jirobo takes the {@action Dodge} action, he regains hit dice up to half of his maximum.

trait.name: Harbinger of Strife
entries: When the daitengu or another creature within 30 feet makes an attack, it adds {@dice 1d4} to the result.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Jirobo makes two attacks, one of which may be with his Supreme Slash.

action.name: Sacred Pillar Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@dice 2d8 + 5}) bludgeoning plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) force damage.
Additionally on a hit, Jirobo can expend two hit dice to add one additional effect:

items.name: Thunder Wakes the Stones
entries: Jirobo moves Onimaru up to 30 feet. If it ends this movement in Jirobo's space, Onimaru regains 20 hit points.

items.name: Spirits Flee at Dawn
entries: Each creature of Jirobo's choice within 10 feet of him takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) thunder damage and is pushed up to 10 feet away.

items.name: Closing Gates' Grip
entries: The target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}). While {@condition grappled} in this way, a creature has vulnerability to bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Supreme Slash (While wielding Onimaru)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@dice 2d10 + 5}) slashing plus 22 ({@damage 4d10}) force damage.
Any hit with this weapon against a fiend becomes a critical.

action.name: Summit's Weight Descends (Costs 4 Hit Dice)
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by Jirobo is knocked {@condition prone} and must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} in place (escape {@dc 17}) as its Qi is bound to the deepest stones of the earth.
A creature {@condition restrained} in this way takes 21 ({@dice 6d6}) bludgeoning plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) thunder damage at the beginning of each of its turns.

trait.name: Aura of Spite
entries: Whenever the jovoc takes damage, each non-jovoc creature within 10 feet of it takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) psychic damage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The jovoc has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The jovoc makes three attacks with its Crimson Claws.

action.name: Crimson Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@dice 1d4 + 3}) piercing plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage.
Instead of dealing damage, the jovoc may grapple the target.
If this attack targets a jovoc, it hits automatically.

action.name: Charflesh Immolation
entries: The jovoc sets itself on fire. Until a creature takes an action to douse it, at the beginning of each of its turns the jovoc and each creature {@condition grappled} by it takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage.

reaction.name: Fake Out
entries: As a reaction when the jovoc leaves a creature's reach without being hit with an {@action Attack} of Opportunity, the jovoc moves up to 10 feet toward the creature and makes an attack against it.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: Juiblex can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Corrosive Horror
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 20 feet of Juiblex has the attack bonus of any metal or organic nonartifact weapons it is wielding and the AC bonus of any metal or organic nonartifact armor it is wearing reduced by a permanent and cumulative 1.

trait.name: Heart of Chaos
entries: Melee attacks made by creatures {@condition grappled} by Juiblex ignore its damage resistances and score a critical on a 16-20.

trait.name: Alter Form
entries: At the end of each of its turns, Juiblex can choose a shape for its body. Its new form may be centered on any space its previous form occupied:

items.name: Fetid Pool
entries: Juiblex becomes a 30 foot radius shallow pool of slime that can enter and occupy the space of any other creature, and frees each creature {@condition grappled} by it. A creature that starts its turn in Juiblex's space takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) acid damage.

items.name: Flowing Prison
entries: Juiblex becomes a 15 foot diameter vortex, then each creature in Juiblex's space must succeed on a {@dc 22} Strength saving throw or be {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 22}) in Juiblex's space, or pushed into the nearest unoccupied space on a success. Creatures {@condition grappled} by Juiblex are {@condition choking|confc|choking} and take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) acid damage at the start of each of Juiblex's turns.

items.name: Towering Slime
entries: Juiblex becomes a 10 foot diameter tower that is up to 40 feet tall. Melee attacks it makes have a reach of 40 feet and deal an additional 11 ({@damage 2d10}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Juiblex has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Legendary Resistances (5/Day)
entries: If Juiblex fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Juiblex makes three melee attacks.

action.name: Corrosive Grasp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 20 ft., one creature. {@h}18 ({@dice 2d10 + 7}) bludgeoning plus 27 ({@damage 6d8}) acid damage and the creature is dragged up to 10 feet toward Juiblex's center, or is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 22}) if it can't be.

action.name: Heaving Mass
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}40 ({@damage 6d10 + 7}) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 22} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Caustic Jet {@recharge 5}
entries: Juiblex expels a jet of slime in a 90 foot long, 10 foot wide line. Each creature in the area is pushed 15 feet away and must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw or take 95 ({@damage 10d8 + 50}) acid damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Blinding Excretion
entries: When Juiblex is hit with a melee attack, it can force the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the end of Juiblex's next turn.

reaction.name: Birth Scion
entries: When Juiblex takes 50 or more damage in a turn, it can create an Ooze Scion that acts on Juiblex's initiative in an unoccupied space within 15 feet.

reaction.name: Foul Spawning (1/Day)
entries: When Juiblex is reduced below 304 hit points, it can create six Ooze Scions that act on Juiblex's initiative in unoccupied spaces within 15 feet.

legendary.name: Assimilate
entries: Each creature {@condition grappled} by Juiblex must succeed on a {@dc 20} Intelligence saving throw or have its Proficiency Bonus reduced by 1 until it completes a Short or Long Rest, and have Juiblex learn one secret the creature wishes to keep hidden.
If the creature was an ooze scion, it dies and Juiblex gains temporary hit points equal to the ooze scion's current hit points.

legendary.name: Seething Vitriol
entries: Juiblex loses 11 ({@dice 1d20}) hit points and rolls to recharge its Caustic Jet.

legendary.name: Stolen Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Juiblex casts a spell of 6th level or below with a casting time of 1 action known by a creature affected by its Assimilate in the last minute.

legendary.name: Wheels Within Wheels (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: If Juiblex has not taken a turn this round, it takes its turn. If it does, it does not take a turn on its initative this round.

trait.name: Moon-Eater
entries: The bakunawa and each creature riding or climbing on it are immune to radiant damage. While illuminated by moonlight, the bakunawa has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bakunawa makes three melee attacks, one of which may be with its luminous bite.

action.name: Luminous Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@dice 1d8 + 3}) piercing plus 5 ({@damage 1d10}) radiant damage.

action.name: Wriggling Ram
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage. Before or after making this attack, the bakunawa may move up to a quarter of its speed.

reaction.name: Thrash
entries: As a reaction to failing a saving throw, the bakunawa forces each creature within 15 feet to succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be pushed 15 feet away.

trait.name: Confounding Circling
entries: While adjacent to two or more ixitxachitl, a creature has disadvantage on {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity} that target one of them.

trait.name: Segmented Brain
entries: The ixitxachitl may continue to make {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity} with its whiptail barb for up to a minute after being {@condition incapacitated} or killed.

action.name: Sluggish Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage and the target's movement is reduced by 5 until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Whiptail Barb
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage.

trait.name: Dream Invader
entries: The quori may spend half its movement to enter the dreams of an adjacent {@condition unconscious} creature. While invading the creature's dreams, the quori has total cover from outside effects and can leave the creature's dream as a bonus action, appearing in an adjacent space.
Whenever it takes damage or a creature uses an action to shake it, the creature may attempt a {@dc 21} Charisma saving throw, waking and expelling the quori on a success.

trait.name: Swarm of Eyes (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
entries: When the quori is reduced to 0 hit points, it doesn't die or fall {@condition unconscious}.
Instead, it resets to 161 hit points and gains the following benefits until it completes a short or long rest:
The quori's attacks treat all creatures as unarmored (an unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier)
The quori can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
The quori gains resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

trait.name: Revise Reality (3/Day)
entries: If the quori fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If the saving throw was against a spell, the spell caster regains the expended spell slot.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The quori makes two attacks with its soul binding, or four attacks with its Night Ripper.

action.name: Soul Binding
entries: {@atk m} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}27 ({@damage 5d10}) necrotic damage. A creature reduced to 0 hit points from this attack dies and has its soul imprisoned in one of the quori's eyes.
The target can't be revived by any means short of a {@spell wish} spell until the quori is destroyed.

action.name: Night Ripper
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 13} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}the target gains 12 ({@dice 1d10 + 7}) cumulative temporary hit points.
A creature with at least 10 of these temporary hit points has its movement speed reduced by half. A creature with at least 20 of these temporary hit points is {@condition unconscious}.

action.name: Bind Eyes
entries: One creature the quori can see within 60 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 21} Charisma saving throw or be cursed, plunging it into a permanent illusory reality as the quori takes complete control over what the creature sees.

action.name: Devour Dreams {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature whose dreams the quori is invading must succeed on a {@dc 21} Intelligence saving throw or take 155 ({@damage 10d10 + 100}) psychic damage.

legendary.name: Flickering Psychoport
entries: The quori teleports up to 30 ft. to an unoccupied space it can see within 5 ft. of a creature.

legendary.name: Waking Nightmare
entries: The quori attempts to take control of an {@condition unconscious} creature whose dreams it is invading.

The creature takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) psychic damage, then must succeed on a {@dc 21} Charisma saving throw or gain temporary hit points equal to half its maximum hit points and rise under the quori's control. While the creature has these temporary hit points, it automatically fails Charisma saving throws.

legendary.name: Mind Seed (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: One {@condition unconscious} creature within 60 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 21} Charisma saving throw or be cursed as one of the quori's spectral eyes worms through its flesh and embeds itself deep within.

The quori sees and hears everthing that the cursed creature does, and whenever the cursed creature takes a long rest the quori may cause the creature to sleepwalk under the quori's control until it wakes.

trait.name: Mirror Dweller
entries: The nerra may spend half its movement to pass through a Medium or larger reflective surface within 5 feet, entering or exiting an extradimensional mirrorspace resembling the space reflected in the surface.
If a mirrored surface containing the nerra ceases to be reflective, the nerra is expelled into the nearest unoccupied space.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The nerra makes four attacks with its Glessine Greatblade, one of which it may replace with a use of its Liquimetal Encasement.

action.name: Glessine Greatblade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d10 + 5}) slashing damage.

On a critical hit, the blade shatters, dealing 10 ({@damage 3d6}) slashing damage to the target and each other creature within 5 feet of it. The nerra can extrude a new blade as a Bonus Action on its turn.

action.name: Liquimetal Encasement
entries: The nerra enters the space of a creature within 5 feet and engulfs it (escape {@dc 18}). An unwilling creature may make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw, resisting the effect on a success.
An engulfed creature can't have an AC lower than 20, takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) poison damage at the end of each of its turns, and has its movement speed reduced by half.
While it has a creature engulfed, the nerra moves with the creature, can't make attacks, and may exit the creature's space as a Bonus Action.

reaction.name: Mercurial Double
entries: As a reaction when a creature makes an attack against a creature within 5 feet of the nerra, the nerra warps its body and the light around it, changing the target to itself.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the angler remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a clump of kelp.

trait.name: Lodewarp Aura
entries: The angler distorts magnetic fields in a 500 foot radius around it, imposing disadvantage on any checks made to navigate using a compass and on Ranged Weapon Attacks that use metal projectiles in the area.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The angler makes three attacks with its Dredge Fronds.

action.name: Dredge Fronds
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pulled into the angler's space.
A creature in the angler's space moves with it, and may spend 15 feet of movement and take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage to push its way out, escaping into the nearest unoccupied space.

action.name: Holdfast Latch
entries: The angler anchors itself to a vehicle within 5 feet of it, becoming {@condition attached|confc|attached} to it (remove {@dc 17}). While the angler is attached to it, a vehicle cannot move more than 10 feet in a turn.

bonus.name: Inflate Bladders
entries: The angler briefly inflates the spined pneumatocysts lining its fronds, immediately rising up to 20 feet towards the water's surface if it is submerged.

Each creature in its space must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or take 9 ({@dice 2d8}) piercing plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage and be {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 17}) until the beginning of the angler's next turn.
If the angler is {@condition attached|confc|attached} to a vehicle, it lists wildly, pushing each unsecured creature and object up to 15 feet towards the vehicle's edge.

bonus.name: Explosive Regrowth {@recharge 5}
entries: The angler grows several new fronds, regaining 30 hit points.

reaction.name: Still Seas (3rd Level Spell)
entries: As a reaction when the angler would make a saving throw against a wave, current, or similar aquatic phenomenon, the angler magically disperses the effect, rendering it harmless.

reaction.name: Scatter Magic (4th Level Spell)
entries: As a reaction when the angler would make a saving throw against a spell that targets only it, the angler causes the spell to additionally target each creature within 10 feet of it.
The spell's Save DC is reduced by 1 for each additional creature the spell targets in this way.

monster.name: Kender Vampire
languages: the languages it knew in life

trait.name: Spirit Form
entries: As an Action, the vampire can send its spirit forth from its body. While in this form, the vampire is {@condition invisible}, can pass through creatures and objects, can't make attacks, and dies if it takes any radiant damage or is hit with its own hoopak.

When it drops to 0 hit points or is {@condition turned|confc|turned}, the vampire assumes this form instead of suffering any other effects. At dusk, if the spirit is in its coffin, the spirit gains a new body and its old body turns to ash.

trait.name: Vampire Weaknesses
entries: The vampire has the following flaws:

items.name: Charmed by Hospitality
entries: While in the home of a creature that invited it in, the vampire can take no hostile action.

items.name: Theft Compulsion
entries: If the vampire thinks itself hidden, it is compelled to steal whatever unique and portable trinkets it sees. If it is carrying more than 100 lbs of stolen goods, its movement is reduced by 10 and its attacks are made at disadvantage.

items.name: Stiff Joints
entries: The vampire has disadvantage on saving throws to resist being knocked {@condition prone}, and must spend its full movement to stand from {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The vampire has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vampire makes three attacks, one of which it can replace with its Telekinetic Thrash, if available.

action.name: Spirit-Drain Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}).

A creature that starts its turn {@condition grappled} in this way must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or lose two unexpended hit dice, or be {@condition paralyzed} until the beginning of its next turn if it cannot.

action.name: Unholy Hoopak
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120, one creature. {@h}13 ({@dice 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning plus 5 ({@damage 1d10}) necrotic damage. This attack has advantage against a Large or larger creature.

action.name: Telekinetic Thrash {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature of the vampire's choice within 20 feet must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}, or take half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Decay Weapon
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a nonmagical melee weapon attack, the vampire forces the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or have its weapon crumble to dust.

reaction.name: Hideous Laughter
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 76 hit points, the vampire throws back its head and lets out a disturbing cackle. Each creature within 30 feet that can hear the vampire must make a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature believes the vampire to be an illusion, and believes one of its allies to be the true vampire in disguise. An affected creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

monster.name: Kenku
languages: understands Auran and Common but speaks only through the use of its Mimicry trait

trait.name: Ambusher
entries: In the first round of a combat, the kenku has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it surprised.

trait.name: Mimicry
entries: The kenku can mimic any sounds it has heard, including voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful {@dc 14} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check.

trait.name: Flock Tactics
entries: While adjacent to two or more kenku, a creature has disadvantage on attacks that target one of them.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Shortbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

monster.name: Kenku Gouger
languages: understands Auran and Common but speaks only through the use of its Mimicry trait

trait.name: Ambusher
entries: In the first round of a combat, the kenku has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it surprised.

trait.name: Mimicry
entries: The kenku can mimic any sounds it has heard, including voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful {@dc 14} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check.

trait.name: Flock Tactics
entries: While adjacent to two or more kenku, a creature has disadvantage on attacks that target one of them.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The kenku makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Icepick
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage. If this attack was made at advantage, the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Vicious Kick
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage. On a critical hit, the target suffers a bleeding wound. A wounded creature loses 3 ({@dice 1d6}) hit points at the end of its turn. This effect ends when the target receives magical healing, or when a creature uses its action to stanch the wound with a successful {@dc 12} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check.

reaction.name: Harass
entries: As a reaction to a creature in range missing an ally of the kenku's with a melee attack, the kenku makes a vicious kick attack against the attacker.

monster.name: Kenku Shingler
languages: understands Auran and Common but speaks only through the use of its Mimicry trait

trait.name: Ambusher
entries: In the first round of a combat, the kenku has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it surprised.

trait.name: Mimicry
entries: The kenku can mimic any sounds it has heard, including voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful {@dc 14} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check.

trait.name: Flock Tactics
entries: While adjacent to two or more kenku, a creature has disadvantage on attacks that target one of them.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The kenku makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Sharpened Shingle
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage. This attack scores a critical on a 17-20 against a creature at lower elevation than the kenku.

action.name: Thrashing Lunge {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature within 5 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) slashing damage and be pushed 15 ft away, or take half as much damage on a success.
A creature that succeeds by 5 or more takes no damage and may use its reaction to make an attack against the kenku.

reaction.name: Harass
entries: As a reaction to a creature in range missing an ally of the kenku's with a melee attack, the kenku makes a sharpened shingle attack against the attacker.

trait.name: Keeper of the Black Lore
entries: Kerzit's spirit is bound to the Tome of the Black Heart. If he is destroyed, whenever a creature dies within 30 feet of the tome he may make a {@dc 20} Charisma saving throw.

On a success, a rift forms in the creature's body and Kerzit tears forth from it in a new body with half his hit points. For the next minute, Kerzit can't use Legendary Resistances or Legendary Actions.

trait.name: Quick Squeeze
entries: Kerzit may move through any space larger than his skull without squeezing.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Kerzit has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Legendary Resistances (3/Day)
entries: If Kerzit fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Kerzit makes three attacks, one of which may be with his Black-Toothed Bite.

action.name: Black-Toothed Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d8 + 6}) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or be infecting with Aldinach's Vile Wasting.

action.name: Wormlash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 20} Strengh saving throw or be pulled up to 5 feet towards Kerzit and {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 20}).

action.name: Chitinous Blades
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) slashing damage.

action.name: Halving Draw {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by both of Kerzit's Wormlashes must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or take 65 ({@damage 10d12}) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage dies and is ripped in two.

bonus.name: Rending Flurry
entries: Kerzit makes two attacks with his Chitinous Blades against a creature {@condition grappled} by him. If both attacks hit, the creature begins {@condition bleeding|confc|bleeding} ({@dice 2d10}).

bonus.name: Blightning Strike (3rd Level Spell)
entries: One creature Kerzit can see within 120 feet must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or take 14 ({@dice 4d6}) lightning plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage is unaffected by the first source of healing it recives before the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Maddened Slaver
entries: When Kerzit ends his turn without reducing a creature to 0 hit points, he can work himself into a fury, building up a frothing, foul smelling slaver around his jaws.
Until the end of his next turn, Kerzit's melee attacks have advantage and his speed is doubled.

legendary.name: Weirding Glint (Concentration)
entries: Kerzit creates an illusory terrain feature that fits within a 15 foot radius centered on a point he can see within 60 feet.
The terrain lasts for a minute, and Kerzit may interact with the illusion as though it were real. A creature other than Kerzit physically interacting with the terrain reveals it to be an illusion.

legendary.name: Ignite Dweomer
entries: One creature kerzit can see that is {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell must succeed on a {@dc 18} Charisma saving throw or burst into flames and begin {@condition burning|confc|burning} ({@dice 1d10}).

legendary.name: Brutal Charge (Cost 2 Actions)
entries: Kerzit moves up to his speed in a straight line, and may move through the space of any Medium or smaller creature.

A creature whose space Kerzit enters for the first time on a turn in this way must succeed on a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 3d8}) bludgeoning damage and be pushed up to 15 feet away and knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Icon of Peace
entries: If the ki-rin has at least 135 hit points, a creature that targets the ki-rin with an attack or harmful spell must first make a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature must choose a new target or lose the attack or spell.
While it has at least 135 hit points, the kirin will not use its breath weapon.

trait.name: Weightless Step
entries: Whenever the ki-rin takes damage, it is pushed 10 feet away from the source of the damage.

trait.name: Divine Awareness
entries: The ki-rin knows if it hears a lie.

trait.name: Harbinger of Bounty
entries: A good-aligned creature that sees a ki-rin is blessed. For the next 24 hours, the creature maximizes any magical healing it receives and automatically succeeds on Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) checks to forage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ki-rin uses its numinous command twice.

action.name: Numinous Command
entries: The ki-rin speaks a word of divine power. One creature within 60 ft. that can hear it must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or suffer one effect of the ki-rin's choice.

items.name: Desist
entries: The creature flings one object of the ki-rin's choice that it is holding 30 ft. in a random direction.

items.name: Reflect
entries: The creature takes 38 ({@damage 7d10}) psychic damage as it is confronted with every harm it has ever done through negligence or ill intent. The damage can't reduce the target's hit points below 1.

items.name: Repent
entries: The creature falls {@condition prone} and cannot stand. An affected creature repeats this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A creature makes this save with advantage if it uses its action to make an honest apology.

action.name: Divine Fury Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The ki-rin exhales holy fire in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area of neutral or evil alignment must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw, taking 36 ({@dice 8d8}) fire and 36 ({@damage 8d8}) radiant damage on a failure, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary.name: Ascendant Breeze
entries: The ki-rin grants one creature within 60 ft. that it can see a fly speed equal to its movement speed that lasts for the next hour, or until the creature moves more than 60 ft. away.

legendary.name: Swords to Plowshares
entries: One weapon within 60 ft. that deals slashing or piercing damage magically blunts. For the next minute, the weapon deals bludgeoning damage instead of any other type and loses the finesse property.

legendary.name: Tranquility
entries: The ki-rin ends one magical on it that would incapacitate or immobilize it. It may use this ability while {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Icon of Peace
entries: If the ki-rin has at least 26 hit points, a creature that targets the ki-rin with an attack or harmful spell must first make a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature must choose a new target or lose the attack or spell.
While it has at least 26 hit points, the kirin will not use its breath weapon.

trait.name: Weightless Step
entries: Whenever the ki-rin takes damage, it is pushed 10 feet away from the source of the damage.

action.name: Numinous Command
entries: The ki-rin speaks a word of divine power. One creature within 30 ft. that can hear it must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or suffer one effect of the ki-rin's choice.

items.name: Desist
entries: The creature drops one object of the ki-rin's choice.

items.name: Reflect
entries: The creature takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) psychic damage as it is confronted with every harm it has ever done through negligence or ill intent. The damage can't reduce the target's hit points below 1.

items.name: Repent
entries: The creature falls {@condition prone} and cannot stand on its following turn.

action.name: Divine Fury Breath {@recharge}
entries: The ki-rin exhales holy fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area of neutral or evil alignment must make a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw, taking 9 ({@dice 2d8}) fire and 9 ({@damage 2d8}) radiant damage on a failure, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reaction.name: Harbinger of Bounty (3/Day)
entries: As a reaction to seeing a creature within 60 ft. receive magical healing, the ki-rin causes the healing to be maximized.

trait.name: Non-Euclidian
entries: The space in a 5 foot radius around the kigrid is difficult terrain for non-aberrations, as the kigrid's presence warps it into incomprehensible geometries.

trait.name: Psionic Empowerment
entries: As a Bonus Action, the kigrid gains one of the following benefits until the beginning of its next turn.

items.name: Frenzy
entries: The kigrid's attacks deal an additional 9 ({@damage 2d8}) damage.

items.name: Concealing Amorphia
entries: Ranged attacks against the kigrid are made at disadvantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The kigrid makes two attacks, one of which may be with its locking bite.

action.name: Locking Bite
