If the kopru targets only a single creature with this ability, the target has disadvantage on the saving throw.

trait.name: Hair Transmutation
entries: If the korred's hair is cut while it is alive, the cut hair transforms into the material it was cut with.

trait.name: Suspension Weakness
entries: In place of a melee attack, a creature that is grappling the korred may attempt a {@dc 19} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check to lift it off the ground. While suspended off the ground, at the start of each of its turns the korred must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Cudgeleer's Reel
entries: Whenever a creature moves out of the korred's reach while it is not {@condition prone}, the korred may move into the space vacated by the creature.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The korred makes two attack with its dancing cudgel, one of which it may replace with a use of its cudgeleer's jig, if available.

action.name: Dancing Cudgel
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage and the target must make a {@dc 13} Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, for the next minute whenever the korred moves, the creature moves with it.
This effect ends early if the creature is more than 5 ft. from the korred, or if the creature ends its turn {@condition prone}.

action.name: Cudgeleer's Jig {@recharge 5}
entries: The korred makes a melee attack against each creature in its reach. Each creature hit by one of these attacks moves up to 10 ft. in a direction of the korred's choice.

bonus.name: Change Orientation
entries: If it is underground, the korred changes the orientation of gravity toward an earthen or stone surface within 30 ft. for itself, and for any creatures either grappling it or affected by its dancing cudgel.

trait.name: Hair Transmutation
entries: If the korred's hair is cut while it is alive, the cut hair transforms into the material it was cut with.

trait.name: Suspension Weakness
entries: In place of a melee attack, a creature that is grappling the korred may attempt a {@dc 19} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check to lift it off the ground. While suspended off the ground, at the start of each of its turns the korred must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The korred makes two attack with its iron shears, one of which it may replace with a use of its iron braid, if available.

action.name: Iron Shears
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}24 ({@damage 4d8 + 6}) slashing damage. On a critical hit, the target shrinks by 1 ft. until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

action.name: Iron Braid
entries: One creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or suffer one effect of the korred's choice.
The target is {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 17}). While the korred has a creature {@condition restrained} in this way, the korred cannot use its iron braid.
The target falls {@condition prone}. If it is grappling a creature, the target releases its grapple.
The target is pulled up to 20 ft. toward the korred.

bonus.name: Change Orientation
entries: If it is underground, the korred changes the orientation of gravity toward an earthen or stone surface within 30 ft. for itself, and for any creatures {@condition grappled} by it.

trait.name: Feather Step
entries: Kotenbo's high jump is up to 15 feet, or up to 30 feet with a running start. She may treat any surface, including leaves or falling snow, as solid ground.

trait.name: Harbinger of Strife
entries: When the daitengu or another creature within 30 feet makes an attack, it adds {@dice 1d4} to the result.

trait.name: Confounding Masks
entries: A creature that deals a critical hit to Kotenbo for the first time in a day has that critical hit become a miss.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Kotenbo makes two attacks with her Toesmasher Kine and uses her Crawling Snare, if available

action.name: Toesmasher Kine
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

action.name: Crawling Snare {@recharge 5}
entries: Kotenbo places a loop of knotted silk cord in an unoccupied space within 5 feet.
A creature that enters or starts its turn in the snare's space must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition grappled} in place (escape {@dc 15}) as the cord snakes around it.
Whenever a creature within 30 feet of a snare casts a spell, Kotenbo may have the snare sprout spindly legs and crawl 10 feet toward that creature.

reaction.name: Vent Flame
entries: As a reaction when Kotenbo is forced to make a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, Kotenbo gains advantage on the save and vents a gout of flame from her mask's horns, dealing 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage to each other Medium or larger creature within 5 feet of her.

monster.name: Kraken Priest

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The priest can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Brinewarded
entries: Aquatic creatures with an Intelligence score of 3 or less are indifferent to the priest.

trait.name: Kraken Host (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
entries: When the priest is reduced to 0 hit points, it doesn't die or fall {@condition unconscious}. Instead, it resets to 90 hit points and explosively sprouts eight bloody tentacles from its back, becoming size Large and gaining a climb speed equal to its movement speed.

action.name: Thunderous Touch (3rd level spell)
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}27 ({@damage 5d10}) thunder damage and the target is pushed 15 ft. away. A creature pushed into a wood or plaster wall less than a foot thick is pushed through the wall.

action.name: Whelm (2nd level spell)
entries: A wave of water crashes out from the priest. Each creature in a 30 ft. long, 10 ft. wide line must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 3d8}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}, or take half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Call The Storm (3rd Level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: The priest chooses three points within 60 ft. Each creature within 5 ft. of one or more of those points must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take 11 ({@damage 2d10}) lightning damage, or half as much on a success.

legendary.name: Briny Dissolution
entries: The priest dissolves into a puddle of water, reforming at a location it can see within 20 ft.

legendary.name: Voice of Eons
entries: The priest telepathic utters a thunderous imprecation. One creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is knocked {@condition prone}, additionally.

mythicHeader: If the priest's mythic trait is active, it may use the options below as legendary actions for one hour after using its kraken host ability.

mythic.name: Tentacle Lash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}).

mythic.name: Fling
entries: One {@condition grappled} creature is flung up to 30 ft. and knocked {@condition prone}. If the creature hits a solid surface, it takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Terror of the Bells
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of Krampus that can hear him must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the beginning of its next turn.
A creature that succeeds on this saving throw by 5 or more becomes immune to this effect until the next Winter Solstice.

trait.name: Brandy Weakness
entries: A creature that offers strong liquor to Krampus as an action can force him to make a Wisdom saving throw against the creature's Passive {@skill Persuasion}.
On a failure, Krampus is {@condition charmed} by that creature until the end of his next turn, and uses his reaction, if available, to drink the liquor.
Krampus subtracts 1 from his attack rolls and save DC for each drink consumed this way since the last dawn.

trait.name: Waning Return
entries: If Krampus is slain, he returns to life with a new body at the next Winter Solstice, in the coldest unoccupied space within 100 miles of where he was killed.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Krampus makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Birch-Rute Swat
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@dice 2d8 + 5}) slashing plus 5 ({@damage 1d10}) psychic damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away.
This attack has advantage against a {@condition frightened} target.

action.name: Snatch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@dice 1d10 + 5}) bludgeoning plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) cold damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}).

reaction.name: Punish Impishness
entries: When a {@condition frightened} creature within 30 feet of Krampus takes any hostile action, he can move up to his speed toward and make an attack against it with his Birch-Rute Swat.

legendary.name: Hopping Chase
entries: Each creature {@condition frightened} of Krampus can move up to half its speed directly away from him.
Then, Krampus can move up to half his speed without provoking {@action opportunity attack||opportunity attacks} and make a Snatch attack.

legendary.name: Into the Basket!
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by Krampus must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or be thrown into his basket.

legendary.name: Claim Gifts (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Krampus' lolling tongue snakes around a non-artifact magic item worn or wielded by a creature he can see within 10 feet, forcing the creature to make a {@dc 17} Charisma saving throw.
On a failure, the item turns to nonmagical coal for the next hour if the creature is Lawful Good-aligned, and for the next year-and-a-day otherwise.

trait.name: Ferocious Opportunist
entries: The krenshar may use its Multiattack when making {@action opportunity attack||opportunity attacks}.

trait.name: Tempered Skull
entries: While its skull is exposed and it is within 5 feet of only a single hostile creature, the krenshar has resistance to piercing and slashing damage dealt by that creature.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The krenshar makes two melee attacks, one of which may be with its Throat-Ripper bite.

action.name: Throat-Ripper Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}).
If the target was already {@condition grappled} by the krenshar, it takes an additional 4 ({@damage 1d8}) piercing damage.

action.name: Clawed Swipe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) slashing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

bonus.name: Retract Face
entries: The krenshar peels back its face, revealing the musculature and hardened bone beneath for the next minute.
Each creature within 5 feet of the krenshar must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to move half its speed directly away from the krenshar.

action.name: Gnaw to the Bone {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature that is both {@condition prone} and {@condition grappled} by the krenshar must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or take 44 ({@damage 8d10}) piercing damage and have its speed reduced by half until it completes a Short or Long Rest, or take half as much damage on a success.

Each creature within 5 feet of the krenshar must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to move half its speed directly away from the krenshar.

bonus.name: Unnerving Yowl
entries: Until the beginning of the krenshar's next turn, creatures within 30 feet that can hear it have disadvantage on saving throws against any other krenshar's Retract Face ability.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the krenshar takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the krenshar takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

action.name: Snapping Throng (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 piercing damage.
On a hit or miss, the target may move up to 5 feet without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity} from krenshar harriers.

entries: The krenshar peels back its face, revealing the musculature and hardened bone beneath for the next minute.
One creature within 5 feet of the krenshar must succeed on a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to move half its speed directly away from the krenshar.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The kruthik has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the kruthik's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The kruthik can burrow through solid rock at half its burrowing speed and leaves a 2 1/2-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

trait.name: Gnashing Horde
entries: Any non-kruthik creature that starts its turn adjacent to one or more kruthiks takes 1 piercing damage per adjacent kruthik.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The kruthik makes two stab attacks or two spike attacks.

action.name: Stab
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Spike
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage and 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage and the target's movement speed is halved until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Agitate The Swarm
entries: For the next turn, the gnashing horde ability of kruthiks within 60 feet deals an additional {@damage 1d4} piercing damage per adjacent kruthik.

action.name: Acid Spray {@recharge 5}
entries: The kruthik sprays acid in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 ({@damage 4d10}) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The kuo-toa can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Empowered Denial
entries: If the kuo-toa would make a saving throw, it may make a Wisdom saving throw of the same DC instead. On a successful save, the kuo-toa suffers no harmful effects.

trait.name: Unhinged Credulity
entries: A creature within 60 feet of at least three kuo-toa may cast a spell it knows with a successful Charisma ({@skill Deception}) or Charisma ({@skill Performance}) check, rather than a spell slot. The DC equals 20 plus the spell's level.

trait.name: Wriggly
entries: The kuo-toa can spend 5 feet of movement to attempt to escape from nonmagical restraints.

action.name: Gut Hook
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) slashing damage and the target begins {@condition bleeding|confc|bleeding} ({@dice 1d4}, Save Ends at end of turn).

reaction.name: Slippery
entries: As a reaction to being missed by a melee attack, the kuo-toa can move up to 10 feet without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

variant.name: Variant: Insane Credulity
entries: If you really want things to pop off, you can reduce the threshold to cast a spell to 15+Spell Level, and change the restriction to "Spells of a level the caster has slots for". This probably won't break anything, but it will prompt questions about why a talented liar has not yet conquered the world (unless, of course, one has).

A creature can use its action to make a {@dc 13} Strength check to free itself or another creature in a net, ending the effect on a success. Dealing 5 slashing damage to the net (AC 10) frees the target without harming it and destroys the net.

A creature that succeeds by 5 or more instead disarms the kuo-toa.

reaction.name: Sticky Shield
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a melee weapon attack, the kuo-toa uses its sticky shield to catch the weapon. The attacker must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw, or the weapon becomes stuck to the kuo-toa's shield. A creature may free its weapon as an action or bonus action with a successful {@dc 11} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.

entries: If the kuo-toa fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

reaction.name: Electrocyte Discharge

reaction.name: Benthic Escape (1/Day)

legendary.name: Barrel Through

If the target is wielding a nonmagical weapon made of wood or other organic material, instead of dealing damage the kyoka may bite the weapon, giving it a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to hit as the kyoka bites part of it off.

action.name: Push Onward
entries: Until the end of its turn, the kyoka may move through the space of any Large or smaller creature. A creature whose space the kyoka enters is pushed to an unoccupied space of its choice within 5 feet.

action.name: Obstinate Plant
entries: Until the beginning of its next turn, the kyoka gains advantage on Strength checks and saving throws, and a Gargantuan creature that attempts to move through its space must succeed on {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Hardened Exoskeleton
entries: If the kython takes both cold and fire damage in the same turn, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or drop to 0 hit points as its exoskeleton shatters.

trait.name: Acid Blood
entries: A creature that touches the kython or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) acid damage. Any nonmagical weapon that hits the kython corrodes. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to -5, the weapon is destroyed.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The kython can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The kython makes five attacks, one of which may be with its pharyngeal jaws.

action.name: Pharyngeal Jaws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d12 + 3}) piercing damage and the kython immediately makes a second bite attack against the same target.

action.name: Rending Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) slashing damage. This attack scores a critical on a 19-20. Instead of dealing damage, the kython may grapple the target (escape {@dc 14}).

reaction.name: Smell Fear
entries: As a reaction to a creature within 60 ft. falling {@condition prone} or failing a saving throw against being {@condition frightened}, the kython moves up to half its speed towards the creature.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the kython takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the kython takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

trait.name: Piling Mass
entries: A creature's speed is reduced by 5 feet for each broodling attached to it. As an action, a creature may make a Strength saving throw with DC equal to 8 plus the number of attached broodlings. On a success, each attached broodling falls {@condition prone} in the nearest unoccupied space.

action.name: Leaping Bites (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 piercing damage and each of the broodlings that contributed to this attack becomes {@condition attached|confc|attached} to the target (remove {@dc 11}).

action.name: Tail Thrash (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target the broodling is {@condition attached|confc|attached} to. {@h}3 bludgeoning damage and the target is knocked {@condition prone}.

After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to -5, the weapon is destroyed.

action.name: Impale
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the kython must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or take 55 ({@damage 10d10}) piercing damage, or half as much on a success.

If the creature is reduced to 0 hit points by this damage, each of its allies that can see it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of the kython's next turn.

trait.name: Fragile Exoskeleton
entries: If the kython takes 10 or more bludgeoning damage from a single source, its AC is reduced to 14 until it completes a Short or Long Rest.

trait.name: Acid Blood

After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to -5, the weapon is destroyed.

action.name: Fleshtearer Jaws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d12 + 2}) piercing damage. A {@condition prone} or {@condition poisoned} creature takes an additional 7 ({@damage 2d6}) slashing damage.

action.name: Tail Barb
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@dice 1d4 + 2}) piercing plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage and the kython may detach its tail barb.

If it does, the kython cannot use this attack again until it completes a Short or Long rest, and the creature must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until a creature takes an action to remove the barb.

action.name: Rip and Tear {@recharge 5}
entries: The kython makes three Fleashtearer Jaws attacks against a {@condition prone} or {@condition poisoned} creature within 5 ft.

reaction.name: Smell Fear
entries: As a reaction to a creature within 60 ft. falling {@condition prone} or failing a saving throw against being {@condition frightened}, the kython moves up to half its speed towards the creature.

trait.name: Snatcher
entries: If the ghoul has a creature {@condition grappled}, it may {@action Dash} as a Bonus Action.

trait.name: Diseased Blood
entries: A creature that deals piercing or slashing damage to the ghoul with a melee attack must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or contract Ghoul Fever.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ghoul makes two attacks, one of which may be with its fleshripper bite.

action.name: Fleshripper Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}5 ({@dice 1d6 + 2}) piercing plus 5 ({@damage 1d10}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Sodden Grip
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}).

action.name: Pry Mouth
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the ghoul must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) bludgeoning damage and lose its breath, if it were holding it, or take half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Murky Dive
entries: As a reaction when the ghoul takes damage while submerged, it moves up to half its swim speed and attempts to hide.

trait.name: Form of Madness
entries: A non-obyrith creature that starts its turn within 120 feet of the laghathti and can see it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be convinced that is memories have been stolen and replaced.
An affected creature can't count as a willing or friendly target for any spell or magical effect, and can repeat this save as an action, ending the effect on a success.

trait.name: Weight of Memory
entries: If the laghathti starts its turn outside the waters of the Styx, it must succeed on a {@dc 10} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until it returns to the waters.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The laghathti has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The laghathti makes four attacks with its Spined Tentacles, one of which it may replace with either its Devour Memories or Regurgitate Memories.

action.name: Spined Tentacles
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d6 + 7}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}).

action.name: Devour Memories
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the laghathti must succeed on a {@dc 16} Intelligence saving throw or have its proficiency bonus reduced by {@dice 1d4} until it completes a Short or Long Rest.
A creature that has its proficiency bonus reduced to 0 in this way loses all biographical memories and can't benefit from any feat until restored by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

action.name: Regurgitate Memories (Recharges when the laghathti uses its Devour Memories)
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the laghathti must succeed on a {@dc 16} Intelligence saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) psychic damage, be {@condition stunned} until the end of the laghathti's next turn, and gain disadvantage on Intelligence saving throws for the next minute.

reaction.name: Screeching Wail (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 106 hit points, the laghathti lets out an agonized telepathic wail that is echoed by the voices of each creature {@condition grappled} by it.

Each creature {@condition grappled} by the laghathti must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or lose {@status concentration} and its breath, if it was holding either, and be {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Engineered Synchronicity
entries: The lakshu acts on initiative count 20, instead of rolling initiative. Creatures with this trait share a turn, taking their actions and movement in any order.

trait.name: Blade-Dancer's Focus
entries: On its turn, the Lakshu has resistance to all damage and can't be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lakshu makes three attacks with its Ceremonial Blade.

action.name: Ceremonial Blade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) slashing damage.

action.name: Balanced Carnage {@recharge 5}
entries: Whenever the Lakshu moves at least 5 feet this turn, it may make a melee attack against a creature it has not yet targeted this turn with an attack.

reaction.name: Restore Order
entries: When a creature within 30 feet of the lakshu begins {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell, the lakshu can move up to half its speed towards that creature and make an attack against it.

reaction.name: Grab Blade
entries: When the lakshu is hit with a melee weapon attack, it can take an additional 4 ({@damage 1d8}) damage of the attack's type and force the attacker to make a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw.
On a failure, the Lakshu grabs the weapon, and the creature is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}) and can't make attacks with that weapon until it escapes or relinquishes the weapon.

trait.name: Engineered Synchronicity
entries: The lakshu acts on initiative count 20, instead of rolling initiative. Creatures with this trait share a turn, taking their actions and movement in any order.

trait.name: Shakti Morph
entries: As a Bonus Action, the lakshu may activate its shakti, a special talisman, which transforms into one of the following forms around the lakshu:

items.name: Vehicle
entries: The lakshu gains a fly speed of 50 feet (hover) and a Damage Threshold of 10.

items.name: Powered Armor
entries: The lakshu gains an AC of 20, and its attacks gain a reach of 10 feet and deal an additional 9 ({@damage 2d8}) force damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lakshu makes three attacks with its Ceremonial Blade.

action.name: Ceremonial Blade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) slashing damage.

action.name: Laser Vision (Battleform only) {@recharge 5}
entries: The lakshu emits a searing beam of light from its eyes in a 60 foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or take 77 ({@damage 14d10}) radiant damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Tandem Battleform (1/Day)
entries: The lakshu and at least three other lakshu with active shaktis within 15 feet fuse together for the next minute, granting the lakshu the following effects for the duration:
The lakshu's attacks have a reach of 15 feet, are made at advantage, and deal an additional 18 ({@damage 4d8}) force damage for each other lakshu fused with it.
The lakshu gains both effects of its shakti.
The lakshu and each lakshu fused with it share a pool of hit points, which is divided evenly between them when the effect ends.
When this effect ends, each fused lakshu appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the lakshu.

trait.name: Nymph Magic Resistance
entries: On solstices and equinoxes, the lampad may add its Charisma bonus to saving throws against any spell or magical effect that targets only it.

trait.name: In Deepest Dark
entries: The light of the lampad's torch illuminates cavern pathways and passages that are otherwise {@condition invisible} or untraversable. A creature that dies while illuminated by the lampad's torch is protected from decay indefinitely.

trait.name: Blessed Death
entries: When the lampad dies, creatures of the lampad's choice within 30 ft. gain resistance to all damage for the next hour.

action.name: Torch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}25 ({@damage 6d6 + 4}) fire damage and the target has disadvantage on attacks against the lampad on its following turn. This attack deals an additional 14 ({@damage 4d6}) necrotic damage to a creature that has died.

action.name: Shifting Stone
entries: The Lampad opens a 20 ft. long, 5 ft. wide, 30 ft. deep chasm that is wholely within 60 ft. Each creature in the area when it appears must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or fall in, or move to a side of its choice on a success.

action.name: Dancing Shadows
entries: Each creature of the lampad's choice within 60 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or have its movement controlled by the lampad on its following turn. A {@condition frightened} creature makes this saving throw at disadvantage.

reaction.name: Weep for the Ill-Fated
entries: As a reaction to being hit with an attack by a creature that can see it, the lampad begins to weep unsettlingly. The attacker must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} for the next minute. A {@condition frightened} creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
