A {@condition frightened} creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

reaction.name: Quake (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 94 hit points, the lampad causes an earthquake to begin, which continues for the next minute or until the lampad dies.

While the earthquake continues, each other creature that starts its turn underground and within 60 ft of the lampad must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or be struck by falling debris, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) bludgeoning damage. The affected area is difficult terrain for the duration.

trait.name: Surfacing Suit
entries: The pari takes any piercing or slashing damage, its suit begins to leak flammable gas into the surrounding air.
This leaking gas flares brightly if the pari takes any fire damage from another source, dealing 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage to the pari and each creature within 5 feet of it.

trait.name: Buoyant
entries: The pari has disadvantage on Strength saving throws, but has resistance to any damage dealt by an effect that forces it to make one.
If the pari would be forced to move any distance, it is instead moved half as far.

action.name: Searing Lantern
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Confounding Hiss
entries: The pari extends a tendril of narcotic gas from its suit. One creature within 10 feet must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn.
While {@condition poisoned} in this way, a creature cannot take reactions and at the beginning of its turn must use half its movement to move in a random direction.

action.name: Wax Patch
entries: The pari seals shut a leaking suit or pipe within 5 feet with a plug of softened wax, preventing it from leaking further.

reaction.name: Inflated Expansion
entries: As a reaction when a creature ends its movement within 5 feet of the pari while its suit is not leaking, the pari becomes size Large until the beginning of its next turn.
After it expands, each creature within 5 feet of it is pushed 10 feet away and must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Protective Uniform
entries: The lamplighter has advantage on saving throws against breathable poisons and against fire damage.

trait.name: Trip Hazard
entries: A Medium creature pushed into the lamplighter's space must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone} in the nearest unoccupied space, resisting being pushed on a successful save.

action.name: Cautious Prod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 bludgeoning damage.
After making this attack and before any other effects can be triggered, the lamplighter may move up to 5 feet.

action.name: Set Flame
entries: The lamplighter carefully sets a space within 5 feet of it aflame for the next minute.

A creature that starts its turn in the space or enters it for the first time on a turn must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Go Limp
entries: As a reaction when the lamplighter is forced to make a Dexterity saving throw against an effect that affects an area, it falls {@condition prone} and is pushed up to 10 feet from the effect's center.
If this pushes it outside the effect's area, the lamplighter takes no damage on a successful saving throw

trait.name: Protective Uniform
entries: The lamplighter has advantage on saving throws against breathable poisons and against fire damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lamplighter makes two attacks with its Lighting Stick, one of which it may replace with a use of its Percussive Maintenance.

action.name: Lighting Stick
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@dice 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage.
A creature hit with this attack twice in a turn must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 5 feet away.

action.name: Percussive Maintenance
entries: The lamplighter makes a melee attack with its Lighting Stick against a construct or vehicle within its reach.
On a hit, if the construct or vehicle is affected by a condition that ends on a successful saving throw, it immediately repeats that saving throw at advantage.

bonus.name: Snuff
entries: The lamplighter douses one burning creature or space within 10 feet of it.

bonus.name: Helmet Plume Overburn (1/Day)
entries: The lamplighter bends over and prompts a gout of flame from its helmet. One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or ignite.
Until a creature douses it as an action, the creature takes {@damage 1d10} fire damage at the beginning of each of its turns.

trait.name: Peaceful Illumination
entries: The archon sheds bright sunlight in a 30-foot radius and dim light in an additional 30 feet. Creatures illuminated by it have advantage on Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) checks made to deescalate conflict.

action.name: Celestial Aid
entries: Up to three creatures within 60 ft. each gain 10 temporary hit points. While a creature has any of those temporary hit points, its vision is not impeded by ordinary or magical darkness.

action.name: Light the Path
entries: One creature within 60 ft. sees the shortest and most direct physical route to their current destination illuminated before them for the next eight hours, if such a route exists.

action.name: Plane Shift (1/Day, 7th Level Spell)
entries: The archon teleports to a location it is familiar with on this or another plane.

reaction.name: Oppressive Radiance
entries: As a reaction to being hit with an attack or harmful spell, the archon fires a beam of holy light at the attacker or spell caster. The target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 4d10}) radiant damage, or half as much on a success. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is {@condition blinded} until the end of the archon's next turn.

reaction.name: Using Lantern Archons In Your Game
entries: A lantern archon might be how you characterize a cleric casting Find the Path, or might appear to guide one through a hidden or treacherous passage. One could appear to a cleric at a time of great portent, perhaps after rolling a nat 20 on a death save.

trait.name: Aura of Terror
entries: A sleeping creature that starts its turn within 30 ft. of the feyr is accosted by its deepest fears, and takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) psychic damage. This damage does not wake a sleeping creature. A creature reduced to 0 hit points in this way gains 1 hit point and rises on its turn under the feyr's control.
A creature under the feyr's control makes a {@dc 9} Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a succeess.

trait.name: Light Sensitivity
entries: While the feyr is illuminated with bright light, attacks against the it are made at advantage.

action.name: Lulling Gaze
entries: One creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 9} Wisdom saving throw or take 5 ({@damage 1d10}) psychic damage and be {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more falls asleep for the next minute.
A creature wakes up early if it takes damage or another creature uses its action to wake it.

immune.note: from nonmagical attacks made with metal weapons.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the lava child dies, it explodes in a burst of fire and magma. Each creature within 10 feet of it must make a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Flammable objects that aren't being worn or carried in that area are ignited.

trait.name: Metal Immunity
entries: The lava child can move through metal without hindrance, and it has advantage on attack rolls against any creature wearing metal armor or using a metal shield.

trait.name: Molten Body
entries: If the lava child takes any cold damage, it must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition petrified}. Any nonmagical weapon made of metal that hits the lava child melts and warps. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lava child makes two attacks: one with its Furnace Grin and one with its obsidian claws.

action.name: Furnace Grin Gape
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) fire damage and the creature must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of the lava child's next turn.

action.name: Obsidian Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) slashing damage and the target ignites. Until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls and takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage at the end of each of its turns.

action.name: Swallow Whole
entries: The lava child begins to swallow a Medium or smaller creature that is {@condition incapacitated}. At the beginning of the lava child's next turn, the target is swallowed and incinerated, and the lava child regains all hit points. This action is disrupted if the lava child takes any cold damage.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a Bonus Action, the lamia can take on the illusory appearance of any Small or Medium humanoid.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lamia makes two attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its beguiling touch.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d10 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Cursewright Dagger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage and the target is magically {@condition cursed|confc|cursed} for 1 hour. Until the curse ends, the target has disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws and all Ability Checks.

action.name: Beguiling Touch
entries: One creature the lamia can see within 5 feet must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or have its Wisdom score reduced by 3 ({@dice 1d6}) until it completes a Short or Long rest, to a minimum of 1.
A creature that has its wisdom score reduced to 1 with this ability is {@condition charmed} by the lamia.

reaction.name: Torn Loyalty
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with a spell or attack, the lamia may force a creature within 5 feet that is cursed by it to make a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature becomes the new target of the spell or attack.

trait.name: Mimicry
entries: The leucrotta can mimic animal sounds and humanoid voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful {@dc 14} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check.

trait.name: Rampage
entries: When the leucrotta reduces a creature to 0 hit points on its turn, the leucrotta can take a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make a bite attack.

trait.name: Hit-and-Run
entries: If the leucrotta ends its turn more than 30 ft. from any hostile creature, it may take the {@action Dodge} action as a bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The leucrotta makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its hooves.

action.name: Jagged Steel Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or suffer a bleeding wound. At the beginning of each of its turns, a bleeding creature loses 2 ({@dice 1d4}) hit points, then repeats this saving throw, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Hooves
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the creature can't make {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity} this turn.

reaction.name: Disquieting Cackle
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the leucrotta moves up to 20 ft. without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}, emitting an unsettling laugh. The attacker must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be unable to move closer to the leucrotta this turn.

trait.name: Shapechanging Mimic
entries: As a bonus action, the leucrotta can Polymorph into any Medium or Large beast, or back to its true form. Its statistics are the same in each form.
It can mimic animal sounds and humanoid voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful {@dc 14} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check.

trait.name: Man-Taker
entries: A creature that mounts the leucrotta must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by the leucrotta for as long as it is mounted, and the leucrotta can't target the creature with attacks. While {@condition charmed}, a creature is unable to voluntarily dismount.

trait.name: Rampage
entries: When the leucrotta reduces a creature to 0 hit points on its turn, the leucrotta can take a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make a bite attack.

trait.name: Hit-and-Run
entries: If the leucrotta ends its turn more than 30 ft. from any hostile creature, it may take the {@action Dodge} action as a bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The leucrotta makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its hooves.

action.name: Jagged Steel Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or suffer a bleeding wound. At the beginning of each of its turns, a bleeding creature loses 5 ({@dice 2d4}) hit points, then repeats this saving throw, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Hooves
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the creature can't make {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity} this turn.

action.name: Buck
entries: The leucrotta throws a creature that is mounting it from its back, knocking it {@condition prone}. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of the leucrotta's next turn.

reaction.name: Disquieting Cackle
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the leucrotta moves up to 20 ft. without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}, emitting an unsettling laugh. The attacker must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be unable to move closer to the leucrotta this turn.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If the leviathan fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Partial Freeze
entries: If the leviathan takes cold damage, the leviathan partially freezes; until the end of its next turn, its speeds are reduced by 20 feet and its normally {@condition invisible} vital organs are revealed. Attacks made from inside the leviathan against it have advantage until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The leviathan deals double damage to objects and structures (included in Tidal Wave).

trait.name: Water Form
entries: The leviathan can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Slow to Wrath
entries: When the Leviathan is reduced below 100 HP, it gains a fourth legendary action and immediately regains all spent actions.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The leviathan makes two attacks: one with its whelming slam and one with either its evoke essence, brine, or tidal wave abilities, if available.

action.name: Whelming Slam
entries: Creatures in a 20 foot radius within 20 feet must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or take 15 ({@damage 1d10 + 10}) bludgeoning damage and be {@condition grappled} in the leviathan's space (escape {@dc 18}). Until this grapple ends, the target is unable to breathe unless it can breathe water and moves with the leviathan. If the leviathan moved at least 100 feet before using this ability, it deals an additional 11 ({@damage 2d10}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Evoke Essence
entries: Each creature within 60 feet of the leveiathan must make a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or have their lungs fill with water. If the creature cannot breathe water, it cannot speak or breathe and begins to drown. A creature may take its action to cough and retch up water, ending the effect.

action.name: Brine {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature that is drowning must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or have the water ripped from its lungs, taking 36 ({@damage 8d8}) bludgeoning damage. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is forced to expend {@dice 1d4} unexpended hit dice. If it cannot, the creature drops to 0 HP.

action.name: Tidal Wave {@recharge}
entries: While submerged, the leviathan magically creates a wall of water centered on itself. The wall is up 250 feet long, up to 250 feet high, and up to 50 feet thick. When the wall appears, all other creatures within its area must each make a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw. A creature takes 33 ({@damage 6d10}) bludgeoning damage and is pushed 50 feet away on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The leviathan may affect creatures inside of it with this ability.

legendary.name: Undertow
entries: One creature within 60 feet must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or be dragged up to 60 feet toward and into the leviathan, {@condition grappled} and {@condition restrained} per its Whelming Slam ability. The leviathan then rolls to recharge its Tidal Wave, if applicable.

legendary.name: Waterspout
entries: One creature within 120 feet must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or be launched 60 feet into the air by a watery tornado. It remains there until the end of its next turn, when it drops.

legendary.name: Jet Breath (Costs 2 Actions.)
entries: The Leviathan spews a line of seawater 10 feet wide and 120 feet long. Creatures in the area must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) bludgeoning damage and be pushed 15 feet away. The leviathan may choose to eject a creature that is inside of it with this ability, launching it up to 60 feet away.

legendary.name: Wash Away (Costs 4 Actions)
entries: The leviathan creates an enormous 100 foot radius whirlpool that lasts for a minute. Each creature that starts its turn in the whirlpool has one spell or magical effect of its choice dispelled, and must make a strength saving throw or be drawn 30 feet towards the whirlpool's center. Creatures in the leviathan are immune to this effect.

immune.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

trait.name: Lord of the Fifth
entries: Devils under Levistus' control are immune to Cold damage, and can burrow through ice at half their movement speed.

trait.name: Curse of the Vault
entries: At the beginning of each of his turns, Levistus gains 20 cumulative temporary hit points as thick ice magcially begins to grow outward from him.
His speed is reduced by 5 feet for each 5 of these temporary hit points he has, and he is {@condition restrained} and can't cast spells or concentrate while his speed is reduced to 0 in this way.

trait.name: Prince of Betrayal
entries: Levistus has advantage on attacks against a creature within 5 feet of one of its allies.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Levistus has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Duelist's Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If Levistus fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead. He subtracts 1 from his AC and attack rolls for each expended use of this ability.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Levistus makes two melee attacks, one of which he may replace with a use of his Iced Earth.

action.name: Frost-Fair Épée
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 15} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d8}) piercing damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) cold damage.
If this attack was made at advantage, the target must succeed on a {@dc 23} Strength saving throw or be pushed 5 feet away and suffer one additional effect of Levistus' choice.

items.name: Bladebeat
entries: The creature's AC is reduced by 2 until the beginning of its next turn.

items.name: Stacatto Remise
entries: The creature takes an an additional 13 ({@damage 3d8}) piercing damage.

items.name: Second Intent
entries: The next attack Levistus makes against the same target before the beginning of his next turn is made at advantage.

action.name: Iced Earth (3rd Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: Crystals of slick ice spread across the ground at Levistus' feet. Whenever another creature is hit with a melee attack within 5 feet of Levistus, it must succeed on a {@dc 23} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

action.name: Flesh to Ice (5th Level Spell)
entries: One creature Levistus can see within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 23} Constitution saving throw or take 36 ({@damage 8d8}) cold damage, or half as much on a success. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage transforms into a statue of glittering ice until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

action.name: Freeze the Blood (9th Level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: Levistus forces one creature he can see within 60 feet to succeed on a {@dc 23} Constitution saving throw or take 5 ({@dice 2d4}) points of {@condition exhaustion}, or half as many on a success.

reaction.name: Passata Sotto
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with a melee attack while he has no temporary hit points, Levistus imposes disadvantage on the strike as he dives beneath it.
If the attack misses, he may make an attack at advantage as part of this reaction.

reaction.name: Spell Parry
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with a spell, Levistus makes a melee attack roll against the spell caster's Save DC. On a success, Levistus chooses a new target within 15 feet of him for the spell.

reaction.name: Bloodied Vigor (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 274 hit points, Levistus gains two additional Legendary Actions on each of his turns for the next minute.

legendary.name: Graceful Advance
entries: Levistus moves up to half his speed. {@action opportunity attack||Attacks of opportunity} provoked by this movement are made at disadvantage.

legendary.name: Offer Aid
entries: One creature with 0 hit points within 5 feet of Levistus regains 20 hit points as he helps it stand from {@condition prone}, and must succeed on a {@dc 23} Wisdom saving throw or act under his control until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Induce Paranoia
entries: One creature Levistus can see within 60 feet must make a {@dc 23} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature cannot be the willing target of a spell or magical effect until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Spirited Exchange (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Levistus makes two attacks with his Frost-Fair Épée. If any of these attacks miss, up to one creature may use its reaction to make a melee attack against him.

legendary.name: Suppress Curse (Costs 2 Actions, Concentration)
entries: Levistus suppresses the effect of one spell or magical effect within 30 feet for as long as he maintains {@status concentration}.

monster.name: Leywing Pseudodragon
languages: but communicates only in images and ideas.

trait.name: Scent-Reading
entries: The pseudodragon has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check to determine the mental state of creatures it can smell.

trait.name: Dweomer-Attuned
entries: Spells of 3rd level or below with a duration of at least 1 minute that target only the pseudodragon instead have a duration of Until Dispelled.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The pseudodragon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Slinking Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.
Before or after making this attack, the pseudodragon may move up to 5 feet without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

action.name: Drowsy Sting
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for the next minute.

A creature {@condition poisoned} in this way repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success, or falling asleep until the beginning of its next turn on a failure. A creature wakes early if it takes any damage, or if a creature uses an action to shake it awake.

trait.name: Revealing Radiance
entries: The myrmidon sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet. Creatures in the radius of bright light cannot benefit from invisibility.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The myrmiddon makes three melee attacks, one of which it may replace with its Sunstrike, if available.

action.name: Illuminating Flail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) radiant damage and the next attack roll made against this target in the next minute is made at advantage.

action.name: Sunstrike {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature in a 5 ft. radius centered on a point within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 7 ({@dice 2d6}) fire and 7 ({@damage 2d6}) radiant damage. A creature that is averting its eyes has disadvantage on this save.

reaction.name: Elemental Riposte
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack, the myrmidon unleashes a burst of light. The attacker must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) radiant damage and be {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn. A creature that averts its eyes at the beginning of its turn succeed automatically on this save.

trait.name: Revealing Radiance
entries: The mephit sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet. Creatures in the radius of bright light cannot benefit from Invisibility.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a burst of light in a 15 foot radius. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or take 3 ({@damage 1d6}) radiant damage and be {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn.

A creature may avert its eyes at the beginning of its turn, treating the mephit as {@condition invisible} until the beginning of its next turn. If it does, the creature succeeds automatically on this saving throw.

action.name: Illuminating Touch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) radiant damage and the next attack made against the target before the end of the mephit's next turn is made with advantage.

action.name: Sunstrike
entries: Each creature in a 5 foot radius centered on a point within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 11} Dexterity saving throw or take 3 ({@dice 1d6}) fire and 3 ({@damage 1d6}) radiant damage. A creature that is averting its eyes has disadvantage on this saving throw.

reaction.name: Dazzling Flash
entries: When a creature hits the mephit with a melee attack, the mephit can emit a bright flash, dazzling the creature.
Until the end of the mephit's next turn, the attacker treats the mephit as {@condition invisible}.

trait.name: Amplify Charge
entries: If the elemental would take any lightning damage, it instead takes no damage and gains advantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Spark Gap
entries: When the elemental is hit with an attack, it teleports up to 10 feet directly toward the largest metal object within 60 feet.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The elemental makes two attacks with its Thrumming Sparkbolt.

action.name: Thrumming Sparkbolt
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) lightning damage.
This attack has advantage if it targets the closest creature wearing metal armor or wielding a metal weapon.

action.name: Static Field {@recharge 5}
entries: The elemental charges the air in a 20 foot radius centered on a point it can see within 60 feet, raising the hair of creatures in the area on end.

The first time a creature in the area takes lightning damage before the end of the elemental's next turn, each other creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage.

reaction.name: Arc Flash
entries: When a creature wearing metal armor leaves an area affected by the elemental's Static Field, the elemental can force it to succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 15 feet toward the field's center and knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Electrified
entries: A creature that hits the myrmidon with a melee attack can't take reactions until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The myrmiddon makes three melee attacks, one of which it may replace with its Charge Weapon, if available.

action.name: Static Longspear
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) lightning damage and the target has disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

action.name: Charge Weapon {@recharge 5}
entries: The myrmidon charges a weapon that isn't held or carried with electricity. The next creature to touch the weapon must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) lightning damage and be {@condition stunned} until the end of the myrmidon's following turn.

reaction.name: Elemental Riposte
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack, the myrmido unleashes a burst of lightning. The attacker must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) lightning damage. A creature wearing metal armor makes this save at disadvantage.

reaction.name: Numbing Sparks
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the myrmidon may force the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Lightning damage and drop one object it is holding and be unable to pick up dropped objects until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Electrified
entries: A creature that hits the mephit with a melee attack can't take reactions until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a burst of lightning in a 10 foot radius.
Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 11} Dexterity saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) lightning damage. A creature wearing metal armor makes this saving throw with disadvantage.

action.name: Static Shock
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) lightning damage and the target has disadvantage on the next attack it makes before the end of its next turn.

action.name: Charge Weapon {@recharge}
entries: The mephit charges a weapon within 5 feet that isn't held or carried with electricity.

The first creature to touch the weapon in the next minute must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) lightning damage and be {@condition stunned} until the end of the mephit's following turn.

reaction.name: Numbing Sparks
entries: When the mephit is hit with a melee attack, it can force the attacker to make a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw.

On a failed save, the target takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) lightning damage, drops one object of the mephit's choice that it is wielding, and is unable to pick the dropped object up until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a Bonus Action, the lilim can take on the illusory appearance of any Small or Medium humanoid.

trait.name: Scornful Gaze
entries: If a creature makes eye contact with the lilim, the lilim learns, in broad terms, the creature's greatest doubts, fears, and insecurities.

trait.name: Light-Blinded
entries: If the lilim takes radiant damage, it must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Sinnuous Escape
entries: When the lilim is reduced to 0 hit points, it does not die or fall {@condition unconscious}. Instead, it loses the ability to take actions other than to {@action Dash}. If it takes damage from a source it cannot see while at 0 hit points, it is killed.

trait.name: Beguiling Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the lilim fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, each creature affected by its Beguiling touch regains half of its lost Wisdom, rounded up.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lilim makes two attacks, one of which may be with its barbed tongue.

action.name: Draining Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d6 + 6}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 19}).

action.name: Barbed Tongue
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition grappled} creature. {@h}15 ({@dice 2d8 + 6}) slashing plus 22 ({@damage 4d10}) psychic damage and the target is magically {@condition cursed|confc|cursed} for 1 hour. Until the curse ends, the target has disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws.

action.name: Plague Chant (6th Level Spell)
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 90 ft., one target. Hit 28 ({@damage 8d6}) necrotic damage. If this attack hits, the plague chant leaps to another creature within 15 feet of the previous target. The lilim makes a new attack roll against the new target, which could cause this ability to leap again. Each creature can be targeted no more than once with each casting of this spell.

action.name: Torment of Scarabs (7th Level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: The lilim sends forth a wave of flesh eating scarabs in a 30 ft. cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or take 45 ({@damage 10d8}) piercing damage and be knocked {@condition prone}, or take half as much damage on a success. A creature with 0 hit points that fails this saving throw is reduced to bones.

reaction.name: Torn Loyalty
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with a spell or attack, the lilim may force a creature within 5 feet that is cursed by it to make a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature becomes the new target of the spell or attack.

reaction.name: Claim Thrall
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 128 hit points, the lilim uses her Entrancing Sigh ability. A creature that fails this saving throw by 10 or more remains under her control for the next 24 hours.
The lilim can take three legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

legendary.name: Life Drain
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the lilim must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitutiton saving throw or be forced to expend a hit die. If the creature does, the lilim gains 8 ({@dice 1d8 + 4}) temporary hit points. If it cannot, the creature instead drops to 0 hit points.

legendary.name: Passing Grasp
entries: The lilim moves up to half its speed and makes an attack with its draining claws.

legendary.name: Beguiling Touch
entries: One creature the lilim can see within 5 feet must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or have its Wisdom score reduced by 3 ({@dice 1d6}) until it completes a Short or Long rest, to a minimum of 1.

legendary.name: Entrancing Sigh (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: One creature the lilim can see within 60 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by the lilim until the end of its next turn. A creature that fails by 5 or more additionally follows the lilim's verbal directions until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a Bonus Action, the lilitu transforms into a Small or Medium humanoid, or back to her true fiendish form. Her statistics are the same in each form.

trait.name: Curseborn
entries: If the lilitu is targeted with a {@spell Remove Curse} spell, she takes 22 ({@damage 4d10}) psychic damage and attacks against her are made at advantage until the start of her next turn.

trait.name: Hate Beyond Death
entries: If the lilitu is destroyed and the community cursed by her remains, her spirit lingers and is eventually reborn as a child conceived in that community. After 13 ({@dice 3d8}) years, she regains her full demonic statistics and abilities.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The lilitu has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Legendary Resistances (3/Day)
entries: If the lilitu fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lilitu makes three attacks, each of which she may replace with a use of her Frenzied Compulsion or Heretical Brand.

action.name: Ashen Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@dice 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away.

action.name: Tendrils of Anguish
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@dice 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) psychic damage and the target is dragged up to 5 feet toward the lilitu.

action.name: Frenzied Compulsion
entries: One creature that can hear the lilitu and is {@condition charmed} by her may use its reaction to move up to half its speed and make a weapon attack with advantage.
If it does not, the creature instead takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) psychic damage.

action.name: Heretical Brand
entries: One creature within 5 feet that is {@condition charmed} by the lilitu takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage, then must succeed on a {@dc 19} Charisma saving throw or be {@condition cursed|confc|cursed}.

While {@condition cursed|confc|cursed} in this way, a creature's alignment becomes Chaotic Evil, it is {@condition dominated|confc|dominated} by the lilitu, and it has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage dealt by nonmagical weapons.
The creature repeats this saving throw whenever it regains hit points, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Seal of Misery (7th Level Spell) {@recharge 5}
entries: The lilitu raises an opaque barrier of crimson light enclosing a 20 foot radius sphere centered on a point she can see within 60 feet.

For the next hour, a creature that moves or is moved out of the area must succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or take 27 ({@damage 5d10}) necrotic damage and be pushed up to 20 feet toward the area's center, or take half as much damage on a success.
If the sphere contains only a single creature that is not {@condition incapacitated}, the effect ends.

action.name: Corruptive Emblem (1/Day, 8th Level Spell)
entries: The lilitu imbues an object with evil power that radiates palpably in a 30 foot radius.

A creature with a Wisdom score of 13 or lower that starts its turn in the area and can see the object is {@condition charmed} by the lilitu until it takes any damage, or until the object is moved or destroyed (AC 20, 20 HP; Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage).
Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid this effect. If it does, it treats the object and each creature within 10 feet of it as {@condition invisible}.

legendary.name: Frenzied Compulsion
entries: The lilitu uses her Frenzied Compulsion.

legendary.name: Whisperstride
entries: The lilitu moves up to half her speed, then one creature within 5 feet of her must succeed on a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by her until the end of the creature's next turn.

legendary.name: Drown in Blood (Costs 2 Actions, 4th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: Blood wells up in the mouth and lungs of a creature the lilitu can see within 60 feet.
The target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) necrotic damage and begin {@condition choking|confc|choking} for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn).

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The lion has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the lion's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Stalking Pounce
entries: If the lion is hidden from each hostile creature, it may {@action Dash} as a Bonus Action. If the lion hits a creature with a claw attack on the same turn, the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage. The lion may make this attack as a Bonus Action against a {@condition prone} target.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) slashing damage.

bonus.name: Daunting Roar (1/Day)
entries: As a Bonus Action, the lion lets out a menacing roar. Each hostile creature within 15 feet must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} of the lion until the end of the lion's next turn.

trait.name: Countershading
entries: The liopleurodon has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide from creatures above it in open water.

trait.name: Outsize Head
entries: When the liopleurodon hits a Huge or larger creature with a bite attack, it may use its Bucking Thrash as a Bonus Action, if available.

action.name: Shellcrusher Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}33 ({@damage 4d12 + 7}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}).
Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the liopleurodon can't bite another target. This attack is made at advantage against a creature wearing Medium or Heavy armor.

action.name: Dark Water Ambush
entries: The liopleurodon moves up to its speed in a straight line towards a creature it is hidden from and makes an attack against it with its Shellcrusher Bite.

If the attack hits, the target takes an additional 13 ({@damage 2d12}) piercing damage and must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of the plesiosaurus' next turn.

action.name: Bucking Thrash {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the liopleurodon must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or take 55 ({@damage 10d10}) slashing damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature that fails this save by 10 or more has a limb of its choice torn off and is released from the grapple, then drops to 0 hit points.

reaction.name: Circle (1/Day)
entries: When the liopleurodon is reduced below 64 hit points, it can move up to half its speed without provoking {@action opportunity attack||opportunity attacks}.

Then, each creature of its choice within 50 feet that has fewer than 20 hit points must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of the liopleurodon's next turn.

trait.name: Antilife Form
entries: The living spell can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and can move through any space that air can pass through without squeezing.
If the living spell or a creature in its space would regain any hit points, it regains no hit points, and the living spell instead loses an equal amount of hit points.

trait.name: Living Magic
entries: If the living spell is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as {@spell Dispel Magic}, it must make a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC.
On a failure, the living spell is {@condition stunned} (Save Ends at end of turn).

action.name: Touch of Blasphemy
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 5d8}) necrotic damage.
Any hit with this attack against a good-alligned cleric, paladin, or celestial becomes a critical.

action.name: Banish Divinity
entries: The living spell targets a spell or magical effect with a divine source within 5 feet of it, lashing at the effect's controller with magical feedback.
The effect's controller takes 13 ({@damage 3d8}) necrotic damage, then must succeed on a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw or have the effect end.

action.name: Necromantic Deluge {@recharge 5}
entries: The living spell crashes into a living, non-construct creature within 5 feet, suffusing it with death-energies.
The target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 36 ({@damage 8d8}) necrotic damage, or half as much on a success.
A plant creature or magical plant targeted with this effect makes the saving throw with disadvantage, and the effect deals maximum damage to it.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the nightmare takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the nightmare takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

trait.name: Fear-Born
entries: The nightmare is immune to any damage dealt by a {@condition frightened} creature.

action.name: Rend Psyche (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 psychic damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of the nightmare's next turn.

If at least three nightmares contributed to this attack, a creature that fails this saving throw is instead {@condition frightened} for the next minute, and repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

trait.name: Camouflage
entries: The lizard has advantage on stealth checks if it is more than 30 feet from any hostile creature.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The lizard can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Adapt Coloration
entries: The anole become {@condition invisible} to creatures without proficiency in {@skill Perception} until it moves or takes any other action.

reaction.name: Drop Tail (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being hit with an attack, the lizard reduces the attack's damage to 0.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The lizardfolk can hold its breath for 15 minutes. It has advantage on checks made to hide while submerged.

trait.name: Cold Blooded
entries: If the lizardfolk takes cold damage, it cannot make more than one attack on its next turn.

trait.name: Feral Bite
entries: If the lizardfolk has fewer than 25 hit points, it may make a bite attack as a bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lizardfolk makes two attacks: one with its javelin and one with its shield.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Javelin
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Spiked Shield
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The lizardfolk can hold its breath for 15 minutes. It has advantage on checks made to hide while submerged.

trait.name: Cold Blooded
entries: If the lizardfolk takes cold damage, it cannot make more than one attack on its next turn.

trait.name: Feral Bite
entries: If the lizardfolk has fewer than 46 hit points, it may make a bite attack as a bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lizardfolk makes two attacks: one with its pike and one with its shield. It may use its Swamp Tangle in place of its pike, if available.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Hooked Pike
entries: Melee: {@hit 4} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d10 + 2}) slashing damage. If the target is mounted, it is dragged from its mount and takes an additional 3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Swamp Tangle (concentration) {@recharge 5}
entries: The lizardfolk creates a 20 foot radius of verdant, swampy growth that thrives on spilled blood for the next minute. Whenever a hostile creature takes piercing or slashing damage in the area, it takes a cumulative minus 10 penalty to its movement speed until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Spiked Shield
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Mire Grasp
entries: As a reaction to a creature affected by the lizardfolk's Swamp Tangle having its movement speed reduced to 0, the lizardfolk may force the affected creature to succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 13}) by grasping vegetation.

trait.name: Desiccation Weakness
entries: Whenever the millipede takes any fire or necrotic damage, it gains a point of {@condition exhaustion}.

trait.name: Thousand-Legged Writhe
entries: The millipede ignores the effects of difficult terrain, and has advantage on checks and saving throws against any effect that would reduce its speed.

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The millipede can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a 5-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

action.name: Detrivore Jaw-Lip
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) piercing damage.
If the target is undead or took any necrotic damage since the end of the millipede's last turn, this attack deals maximum damage.

action.name: Crawling Clutch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}The target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}).
If the target is Huge or larger, the millipede can become {@condition attached|confc|attached} to the target (remove {@dc 12}) instead of grappling it.

action.name: Ozopore Secretion (1/Day)
entries: The millipede secretes a toxic oil that coats its body.

For the next minute, a creature that hits the millipede with a melee attack or starts its turn in the millipede's space must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or take 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage and be {@condition poisoned} until the beginning of its next turn.

bonus.name: Armored Coil
entries: The millipede coils into a tight spiral, gaining the following effects until it uses an action to uncurl:
The millipede's AC is increased to 17.
The millipede's speed is reduced to 0.
Any creature {@condition grappled} by the millipede is also {@condition restrained}.

trait.name: Ethereal Body
entries: The lock lurker's stinger and vital organs extend into the ethereal plane, where they are normally hidden. A creature that can see {@condition invisible} creatures, or one that can see into the etheral plane, can see the full creature.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the lock lurker's legs are folded in, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary coin.

trait.name: Creeping Vermin
entries: The lock lurker can enter the space of any small or larger creature and climb onto it. While doing so, the lock lurker moves with the creature.

action.name: Oral Disk Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Hidden Stinger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 piercing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for the next minute. A {@condition poisoned} creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success or being {@condition paralyzed} until the beginning of its next turn on a failure.
This attack is made at advantage against any creature that cannot see the stinger.

reaction.name: Scuttle
entries: As a reaction to being forced to make a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the lock lurker moves up to 5 ft. If this movement puts the lock lurker out of range or area of the spell or magical effect, the lock lurker is unaffected.

trait.name: Ironflake Aura
entries: The marauder is surrounded by a cloud of razor-sharp metal flakes. Another creature that moves within 10 feet of the marauder takes 5 ({@damage 2d4}) slashing damage for each 5 feet it moves.

trait.name: Weathering Weakness
entries: If the marauder is doused in water or takes any acid damage, the next attack that hits it ignores its damage resistances.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The marauder makes three attacks with its Dipole Smash, each of which it can replace with a use of its Razor Sweep, if available.

action.name: Dipole Smash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away.
If the target is wearing metal armor, before making this attack the marauder can drag the creature up to 15 feet toward it.

action.name: Razor Sweep (2/Day)
entries: A torrent of metal flakes sweeeps forth from the marauder in a 20 foot cone, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) slashing damage and begin {@condition bleeding|confc|bleeding} ({@dice 1d4}).

bonus.name: Lodestone's Claim
entries: Each Small or smaller metal object within 20 feet is magnetically dragged into the marauder's space and becomes {@condition attached|confc|attached} to it (Remove {@dc 18}).
Each creature in the area can make a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw, preventing objects it is carrying from being affected on a success.

bonus.name: Churn Grindfield
entries: The elemental magnetically shreds a nonmagical metal object {@condition attached|confc|attached} to it, regaining one expended use of its Razor Sweep.

trait.name: Nexus of the Great Web
entries: Lolth knows the location, identity, and current hit points of any creature in contact with a spider's web, and cannot be Surprised.
She can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: By the Dark Mother's Design
entries: Lolth does not roll initiative. Instead, if she has not yet taken a turn this round, Lolth may take her turn directly after any other creature's turn.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Lolth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Legendary Resistances (5/Day)
entries: If Lolth fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Lolth makes three attacks with her Impaling Legs, one of which she may replace with a use of her Kiss of Lolth or Insidious Embrace.

action.name: Kiss of Lolth
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 15} to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. {@h}26 ({@damage 3d12 + 7}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition cursed|confc|cursed}.

While {@condition cursed|confc|cursed} in this way, a creature is {@condition poisoned}, loses any immunity to the {@condition poisoned} condition or poison damage, and takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) poison damage at the end of each of its turns.
This curse is suppressed for 24 hours by any effect that cures the {@condition poisoned} condition.

action.name: Impaling Legs
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 15} to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d8 + 7}) piercing damage and Lolth may either grapple the target (escape {@dc 23}) or push it 10 feet away.
A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage immediately fails a death saving throw.

action.name: Insidious Embrace
entries: One creature within 15 feet of Lolth must succeed on a {@dc 23} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 23}) in a cocoon of silk.

While {@condition restrained} in this way, a creature is {@condition blinded} and has its Charisma score reduced by 5 ({@dice 2d4}) at the end of each of its turns, which lasts until it escapes. A creature that has its Charisma score reduced to 0 in this way immediately emerges as a {@creature chwidencha|confc|Chwidencha} under Lolth's control.

action.name: Darkfire Abyss (9th Level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: A burst of black fire erupts in a 15 foot radius centered on a point Lolth can see within 120 feet, leaving behind an area of magical darkness that lasts until dispelled.
Each light in the area is extinguished, and each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 23} Dexterity saving throw or take 70 ({@damage 20d6}) fire damage, or half as much on a success.

At the beginning of each of Lolth's turns, if a source of Bright Light is within 15 feet of the area its radius expands by 5 feet, then each light in the area is extinguished and creature in the area takes 17 ({@damage 5d6}) fire damage.

reaction.name: Strands of the Demonweave (5th Level Spell)
entries: When a creature she can see within 60 feet casts a spell, Lolth can weave a portion of the expended magic into threads of binding silk.
Any damage dealt by the spell is reduced by half, and the spell's caster must succeed on a {@dc 23} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 23}) until it takes any damage.

reaction.name: Compelled Betrayal
entries: When Lolth is targeted with a ranged attack, she causes the attack to swerve and instead target a creature in the attack's range affected by her Kiss of Lolth.

legendary.name: Bounding Strike
entries: Lolth leaps up to 20 feet to an unoccupied space, then makes a Impaling Legs attack.

legendary.name: Bide Time
entries: Lolth moves up to half her speed and gains 20 temporary hit points.

legendary.name: Lolth's Fickle Favor (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: One friendly creature Lolth can see can use its reaction to move up to its speed and make an attack. If the attack misses, the creature explodes in a torrent of venomous spiders.
Each creature within 15 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 23} Constitution saving throw or take 10 ({@dice 3d6}) piercing plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage, or half as much on a success.

legendary.name: Spider's Embrace (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Lolth teleports up to 40 feet to an unoccupied space she can see, then forces one creature within 5 feet to make a {@dc 23} Strength saving throw.
On a failed save, the creature is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 23}) and Lolth makes an attack against it with her kiss of Lolth.

monster.name: Ludmilla Vilisevic
languages: the languages it knew in life

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The vampire regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has fed today, has at least 1 hit point, and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the vampire takes radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Vampire Weaknesses
entries: The vampire has the following flaws:

items.name: Forbiddance
entries: The vampire can't enter a residence without an invitation from one of the occupants.

items.name: Harmed by Running Water
entries: The vampire takes 20 acid damage if it ends its turn in running water.

items.name: Stake to the Heart
entries: If a piercing weapon made of wood is driven into the vampire's heart while the vampire is {@condition incapacitated} in its resting place, the vampire is killed.

items.name: Destroyed by Sunlight
entries: A vampire that starts its turn in sunlight may take only the {@action Dash} action. A vampire that ends its turn in sunlight is destroyed.

items.name: Blood-Starved
entries: A vampire spawn that has not fed on humanoid blood in the last 24 hours cannot use its multiattack, and does not regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vampire makes two attacks, one of which can be a bite attack.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) slashing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the vampire can grapple the target (escape {@dc 13}).

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one willing creature, or a creature that is {@condition grappled} by the vampire, {@condition incapacitated}, or {@condition restrained}. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be forced to expend a hit die.

If the creature expends a hit die in this way, the vampire spawn gains resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage from weapons that aren't wooden until the beginning of its next turn. If the creature is unable to, it drops to 0 hit points.

action.name: Fireball (1/Day, 3rd level spell)
entries: 120 ft range, 20 ft radius sphere, {@dc 15} DEX save. On a failed save, the target takes 28 ({@damage 8d6}) fire damage, or half damage on a success.

action.name: Hold Person (1/Day, 2nd level spell, concentration)
entries: 60 ft range, 1 target, {@dc 15} WIS save. On a failed save, the target is {@condition paralyzed} for 1 minute. One creature has disadvantage on its first save against this spell. The targets repeat the save at the end of their turn, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Invisibility (1/Day, 2nd level spell, concentration)
entries: The vampire turns {@condition invisible} for the next hour, or until it casts another spell.

bonus.name: Misty Step (2/Day, 2nd level spell)
entries: The vampire teleports 30 feet to a location it can see.

reaction.name: Shield (4/Day, 1st level spell)
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with an attack, the vampire may add 5 to its AC until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Counterspell (1/Day, 3rd level spell)
entries: As a reaction to a creature within 60 ft. casting a spell, the vampire attempts to disrupt it. If the spell is 3rd level or below, it fails. If the spell is higher than 3rd level, the vampire must succeed on an Intelligence check with DC equal to 10 plus the spell's level.

monster.name: Mad Wraith

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

languages: The languages it knew in life

trait.name: Radiance Sensitivity
entries: If the wraith takes radiant damage, it loses its damage resistances and it is temporarily made corporeal until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Maddening Whispers
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 15 feet of one or more mad wraiths takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) psychic damage and subtracts {@dice 1d4} from Wisdom saving throws it makes before the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The wraith can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wraith makes two attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its invisibility.

action.name: Touch of Madness
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) psychic damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be forced to take the attack action targeting a creature it can see on its following turn.

action.name: Invisibility (Concentration)
entries: the wraith becomes {@condition invisible} until it makes an attack.

action.name: Create Wraith
entries: The wraith targets a humanoid within 10 feet of it that has been dead for no longer than 1 minute and died violently. The target's spirit rises as a Wisp Wraith under the wraith's control.

reaction.name: Shadow Glide
entries: When the wraith takes damage of a type it is resistant to, it can teleport up to 60 feet and turn {@condition invisible} until the end of its next turn, or until it makes an attack.

trait.name: Stone Glide
entries: The maedar can burrow through magical or nonmagical stone. While doing so, the maedar doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

trait.name: Curative Touch
entries: A creature touched or attacked by the maedar is cured of petrification.

action.name: Shattering Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}25 ({@damage 6d6 + 4}) bludgoning damage.

This attack deals an additional 14 ({@damage 4d6}) damage bludgeoning damage to a {@condition restrained} or {@condition petrified} creature. A {@condition petrified} creature reduced to 0 hit points in this way shatters and dies.

action.name: Hands from Stone
entries: While the maedar is burrowing through stone, it may reach out and grab a creature within 5 feet.
The target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}).
While grappling a creature in this way, the maedar's speed is 0 and it has three-quarters cover.

reaction.name: Mighty Shove
entries: When a creature misses the maedar with a melee attack, the maedar can force the creature to succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet and fall {@condition prone}.
If the creature ends this movement within 10 feet of a medusa it was averting its eyes from, the creature must immediately save against the medusa's gaze.

trait.name: Aura Sight
entries: The swarm treats each creature within 60 feet that has unexpended spell slots or magical items as though it can see them clearly.

action.name: Spellripper Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 0 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) piercing damage and the mageripper becomes {@condition attached|confc|attached} to the target (remove {@dc 14}).
If the mageripper has any temporary hit points, this attack deals an additional 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage.

bonus.name: Devour Magic
entries: One creature the mageripper is {@condition attached|confc|attached} to space must succeed on a {@dc 11} Charisma saving throw or lose its lowest level unexpended spell slot.
The mageripper gains temporary hit points equal to 5 times the total of spell levels lost in this way.

trait.name: Siphon Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature or object's space and vice versa, and can pass through any space large enough for a Tiny mageripper. The swarm can't regain hit points.
At the beginning of each of the swarm's turns, it can end each spell of 7th level or below affecting each target in its space.

trait.name: Aura Sight
entries: The swarm treats each creature within 60 feet that has unexpended spell slots or magical items as though it can see them clearly.

action.name: Spellripper Plague
entries: Each creature in the swarm's space must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 18 ({@dice 4d8}) piercing plus 16 ({@damage 3d10}) force damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Ruin the Weave (Half hit points or more)
entries: The swarm unmoors the very root of magic, wounding it in a 20 foot radius.
The swarm and each creature within 20 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 4d10}) force damage.
For the next hour, spells cast in the area have their damage, range, radius, and number of affected targets reduced by half (rounded up).

bonus.name: Devour Magic
entries: Each other creature in the swarm's space must succeed on a {@dc 14} Charisma saving throw or lose its highest level unexpended spell slot.
The swarm gains temporary hit points equal to 5 times the total of spell levels lost in this way.

bonus.name: Budding Spawn
entries: The swarm loses any temporary hit points it has, then spawns a {@creature mageripper swarm|confc|Mageripper Swarm} in its space with current hit points equal to the temporary hit points lost.

trait.name: Siphon Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature or object's space and vice versa, and can pass through any space large enough for a Tiny mageripper. The swarm can't regain hit points.
At the beginning of each of the swarm's turns, it can end one spell of 3rd level or below affecting a target in its space.

trait.name: Aura Sight
entries: The swarm treats each creature within 60 feet that has unexpended spell slots or magical items as though it can see them clearly.

action.name: Spellripper Bites
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 0 ft., one target. {@h}24 ({@damage 8d4 + 4}) piercing damage, or 14 ({@damage 4d4 + 4}) piercing damage if the swarm has fewer than half its hit points.
If the swarm has any temporary hit points, this attack deals an additional 16 ({@damage 3d10}) force damage.

action.name: Gnaw at the Weave
entries: The swarm chews at the very root of magic, wounding it in a 20 foot radius.
For the next hour, spells cast in the area have their range, radius, and number of affected targets reduced by half (rounded up).

bonus.name: Devour Magic
entries: Each other creature in the swarm's space must succeed on a {@dc 12} Charisma saving throw or lose its highest level unexpended spell slot.
The swarm gains temporary hit points equal to 5 times the total of spell levels lost in this way.

bonus.name: Budding Spawn
entries: The swarm loses any temporary hit points it has, then spawns another {@creature mageripper swarm|confc|Mageripper Swarm} in its space with current hit points equal to the temporary hit points lost.

monster.name: Mageslayer Assassin
languages: Thieves' cant plus any two languages

trait.name: Evasion
entries: If the assassin is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the assassin instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: The asssassin can't be affected or detected by spells of 2nd level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Cunning Action
entries: The assassin can take the {@action Dash}, {@action Disengage} or {@action Hide} action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The assassin makes two longblade sica attacks.

action.name: Longblade Sica
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) piercing damage and 28 ({@damage 8d6}) poison damage. Attacks with this weapon ignore any AC benefit granted by a shield.

action.name: Light Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 9} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) piercing damage and 28 ({@damage 8d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Study Mark
entries: The assassin examines the vulnerabilities of a creature it is hidden from. The assassin's critical range for attacks made against the target increases by 3 for the next minute, to a minimum of 11. As a reaction, the target may attempt a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check to spot the assassin.

action.name: Behead
entries: The assassin removes the head from a corpse within 5 ft. to prevent its resurrection.

reaction.name: Uncanny Dodge
entries: As a reaction to being hit with an attack by an attacker that it can see, the assassin halves the attack's damage against it.

reaction.name: Spell Denial
entries: As a reaction to a creature within 5 ft. attempting to cast a spell, the assassin makes a melee attack against it. If the attack hits, the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or have the spell fail.

monster.name: Magesteel Lenser
languages: understands The languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Dweomercore Engine
entries: The lenser is {@condition stunned} while it has no Charge Counters. At the beginning of each of its turns, the lenser gains one Charge Counter if it has no Charge Counters.

trait.name: Haywire Short
entries: Whenever the lenser takes 10 or more bludgeoning damage from a single source, it takes an additional 1 lightning damage for each Charge Counter it has, then loses each of its Charge Counters.

action.name: Searing Lance
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d8}) radiant damage.
This attack can target one additional target directly behind the first target for each Charge Counter the lenser has.

action.name: Collapse Ceiling (Costs 1 Charge Counter)
entries: The lenser uses its cutting beams to carve a 15 foot line into a ceiling it can see within 60 feet, causing a rain of rubble.

Each creature directly beneath the line must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}, or take half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Cutting Sweep (Costs 3 Charge Counters)
entries: The lenser sweeps its cutting beams in a 60 foot cone, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 3d8}) radiant damage, or take half as much damage on a success.

entries: If the meenlock takes 10 or more bludgeoning damage from a single source, its AC is reduced to 13 until it completes a long rest.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The meenlock makes two melee attacks and uses its shadow teleport.

action.name: Dousing Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}). Any lights the target is carrying are extinguished.

action.name: Shadow Teleport
entries: The meenlock and up to one creature it is grappling teleport up to 15 ft. to an unoccupied space of dim light or darkness that it can see.

action.name: Whispers in the Dark {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature the meenlock can see must succeed on a {@dc 11} Charisma saving throw or be {@condition cursed|confc|cursed} for the next minute. While {@condition cursed|confc|cursed} in this way, a creature has disadvantage on saving throws against being {@condition frightened}, and while in Bright Light is blind beyond the radius of that Bright Bight.

reaction.name: Chitter
entries: As a reaction to being missed with an attack by a creature that is {@condition frightened} of it, the meenlock forces the creature to succeed on a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} until the end of the meenlock's next turn.

trait.name: Mirror Dweller
entries: The nerra may spend half its movement to pass through a Medium or larger reflective surface within 5 feet, entering or exiting an extradimensional mirrorspace resembling the space reflected in the surface.
If a mirrored surface containing the nerra ceases to be reflective, the nerra is expelled into the nearest unoccupied space.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the nerra takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the nerra takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

action.name: Razor Claws (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 slashing damage. If at least two other meerak nerras attacked with it, the target begins {@condition bleeding|confc|bleeding} ({@dice 2d6}).

bonus.name: Mirror Step
entries: The nerra teleports up to thirty feet to an unoccupied space it can see within 5 feet of a reflective surface.
If the nerra is inside a mirrorspace, it instead may teleport into another mirrorspace reflected by a surface it can see within 30 feet.

trait.name: Cold Blooded
entries: If the monitor takes 5 or more Cold damage, its speed is reduced by 10 until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Poison Sensitivity
entries: If the monitor has a creature {@condition grappled} and takes 5 or more Poison damage, it immediately releases its grapple.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}).

action.name: Claws

action.name: Tail Thrash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target the monitor isn't grappling. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage. On a hit or miss, if the monitor has a creature {@condition grappled}, the creature takes 2 ({@damage 1d4}) piercing damage.

Its statistics are the same in each form, except for the speed changes noted. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Devil's Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the imp's {@sense darkvision}.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The imp has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Sting (Bite in Beast Form)

action.name: Melancholic Imbalance {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of the imp's next turn. This effect ends early if the affected creature takes damage.

action.name: Invisibility
entries: The imp magically turns {@condition invisible} until it attacks or until its {@status concentration} ends (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). Any equipment the imp wears or carries is {@condition invisible} with it.

trait.name: Water Dancer
entries: The lemurian does not provoke {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity} from creatures without a swim speed.

trait.name: Inspired Mind

action.name: Multiattack

action.name: Choriaster Wand
