action.name: Stinging Swarm (5th Level Spell, Concentration) {@recharge 5}
entries: Melusine conjures a swarm of spectral jellyfish in a 20 foot radius centered on a point she can see within 120 feet.

A creature that starts its turn in the area or enters it for the first time on a turn must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) poison damage, or half as much on a success.
At the beginning of Melusine's turn, the swarm moves up to 10 feet in a direction of her choice.

action.name: Mollifying Song (Concentration)
entries: Melusine begins to sing a magical melody. A creature that can hear the song and starts its turn within 60 feet of her must make a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save, the creature gains 5 temporary hit points that last for a minute. While a creature has any of these temporary hit points, it cannot take hostile action against Melusine.

reaction.name: Deepen Harmony
entries: As a reaction when a friendly lemurian within 30 feet uses its song ability, Melusine uses her Mollifying Song.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The merfolk can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Elusive
entries: The merfolk may {@action Disengage} or {@action Hide} as a Bonus Action while submerged in water.

action.name: Tail Slap
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 ft. away.

action.name: Tidal Rupture {@recharge 5}
entries: The merfolk sends a 30 ft. wide cone of cavitating watery force out. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) thunder damage and be pushed up to 20 ft. away, or take half as much damage on a success. Then, each creature still in the area must repeat the save or take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) bludgeoning damage and be dragged 20 ft. toward the merfolk.

action.name: Seas Phenomenal (1/Year, Concentration)
entries: The merfolk calls up a terrible storm in 10 mile radius a that gradually worsens, reaching its peak over the course of 4 hours. Waves on the surface reach 45 ft. high, and strong currents beneath the surface topple boulders and scour exposed surfaces.

reaction.name: Merfolk Curiosity

reaction.name: Slap Away

reaction.name: Scintillating Scales

On a critical hit, the weapon breaks in the wound. Until a creature takes an action to remove it, the target takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage at the start of each of its turns for the next minute.

action.name: Deft Pluck

A creature that starts its turn {@condition grappled} by the mind flayer must succeed on a {@dc 15} Intelligence saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Extract Brain
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition incapacitated} humanoid {@condition grappled} by the mind flayer. {@h}The target takes 55 ({@damage 10d10}) piercing damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the mind flayer begins to extract and devour the target's brain. At the beginning of the mind flayer's next turn if the target is still {@condition unconscious} and {@condition grappled}, the target dies and the mind flayer gains 40 temporary hit points.

action.name: Dominate (Concentration) {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature within 30 ft. that the mind flayer can see must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be magically {@condition charmed} and under the mind flayer's telepathic control. Whenever the {@condition charmed} target takes damage, the target can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Insensate Mind Blast (Recharges when the mind flayer uses its Extract Brain)
entries: The mind flayer magically emits psychic energy in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 15} Intelligence saving throw or take 31 ({@damage 6d8 + 4}) psychic damage and be {@condition blinded} for the next minute. A creature that fails by 5 or more is additionally {@condition deafened} until the end of its next turn.
An affected creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Plane Shift (6th Level Spell, 1/day)
entries: The mind flayer teleports to another plane of existence.

reaction.name: Telekinetic Shove
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the mind flayer forces the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be pushed 15 feet away.

reaction.name: Telekinetic Deflection
entries: As a reaction to being hit with an attack, the mind flayer halves the attack's damage against it.

trait.name: Telepathic Hub
entries: When the mindwitness receives a telepathic message, each other creature within 600 ft. receives the same message.

trait.name: Psychic Tether Cone
entries: The mindwitness' central eye creates an area of psychic intermingling in a 150-foot cone. Whenever the mindwitness makes an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma saving throw against a magical effect, each creature in the cone must make the same saving throw against the effect. At the start of each of its turns, the mindwitness decides which way the cone faces and whether the cone is active.

trait.name: Eyestalks
entries: When the mindwitness is dealt a critical hit, the mindwitness must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or lose the use of an eye ray of the attacker's choice that it has seen the mindwitness use.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mindwitness makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite, or uses three of its its eye rays, chosen at random (reroll duplicates).

action.name: Oral Disk Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition grappled} target. {@h}16 ({@damage 4d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Tentacles
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}). A creature {@condition grappled} in this way takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) psychic damage at the start of each of its turns and has its Intelligence score reduced by the same amount until the grapple ends. A creature with an Intelligence of 0 is {@condition stunned}.

action.name: Eye Rays
entries: The mindwitness shoots one of its eye rays, choosing a target it can see within 120 ft.:

items.name: 1. Telekinetic Ray (Opalescent White)
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be moved up to 30 ft. in any direction. An object weighing 300 lbs or less is moved 30 ft. in any direction.

items.name: 2. Apathy Ray (Fuzzy Grey)
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity Saving Throw. On a failed save, the target's speed is halved until the end of its next turn. In addition, the creature can't take reactions, and it can take either an action or a bonus action on its turn, not both.

items.name: 3. Stunning Ray (Pulsing Maroon)
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of its next turn.

items.name: 4. Psychic Disruption Ray (Pale Silver)
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Intelligence saving throw or take 27 ({@damage 6d8}) psychic damage and lose {@status concentration}, if it was holding it.

items.name: 5. Paranoia Ray (Wavy Purple.)
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} of one of its allies until the end of its next turn. While {@condition frightened} in this way, it cannot willingly accept assistance from that ally.

items.name: 6. Aversion Ray (Sickly Yellow)
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Charisma saving throw or be unable to use an object it carries of the mindwitness' choice without mental anguish for the next minute. If the mindwitness chooses a weapon or spell focus, whenever the creature uses the object to cast a spell or make an attack, the creature takes {@damage 1d6} psychic damage. If the mindwitness chose a shield, whenever an attack misses the creature, the creature takes {@damage 1d6} psychic damage.

trait.name: Stoneglide
entries: The myrmidon can burrow through nonmagical stone. While doing so, the myrmidon doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The myrmiddon makes three melee attacks, one of which it may replace with its Fool's Greed, if available.

action.name: Sparkling Greataxe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d12 + 4}) slashing damage. This attack deals an additional 6 ({@damage 1d12}) damage to a {@condition charmed} creature.

action.name: Fool's Greed {@recharge 5}
entries: The myrmidon holds out a worthless gem. Each creature within 5 feet that can see it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by the myrmidon until the end of the myrmidon's next turn, or until the creature takes damage. While {@condition charmed} in this way, a creature can do nothing but stare greedily at the gem.

reaction.name: Elemental Riposte
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack, the myrmidon unleashes a burst of minerals. The attacker succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 5 ({@damage 2d4}) slashing damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Scratchproof Facing
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a weapon attack that deals piercing damage, the myrmidon may gain a +5 bonus to AC against the triggering attack, potentially blocking it.

trait.name: Stoneglide
entries: The mephit can burrow through nonmagical stone, and doesn't disturb any material it burrows through.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a 5 foot radius burst of sparkling minerals.
Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or take 5 ({@damage 2d4}) slashing damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Sparkling Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) slashing damage.
This attack deals an additional 3 ({@damage 1d6}) damage to a {@condition charmed} creature.

action.name: Fool's Greed {@recharge}
entries: The mephit holds out a worthless gem. Each creature within 5 feet that can see it must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} until the end of the mephit's next turn.

A creature {@condition charmed} in this way must use its action to attempt to snatch the gem away with a {@dc 13} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check, ending the effect for each affected creature on a success.

reaction.name: Scratchproof Facing
entries: When the mephit is targeted with an attack that deals piercing damage, it can add +5 to its AC against the triggering attack.

trait.name: Labyrinthine Recall
entries: The minotaur can perfectly recall any path it has traveled.

trait.name: Reckless Follow-Through
entries: At the beginning of the minotaur's turn, it can gain advantage on all melee attacks until the beginning of its next turn.
If one of these attacks misses, the minotaur falls {@condition prone} and is {@condition stunned} until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Goring Charge

If the minotaur moved at least 10 feet directly toward the target this turn, the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or take 9 ({@dice 2d8}) additional piercing damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.

On a failed saving throw, a creature takes 18 ({@damage 4d8}) piercing damage and is pushed 5 feet away, or takes half as much damage on a success.

A creature that marks its path with breadcrumbs, yarn, or something similar gains advantage on this saving throw, and becomes immune to this effect for 24 hours on a success.

trait.name: Rattle
entries: A creature that hits the mohrg with a melee attack that deals bludgeoning damage must succeed a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn as it feels its own skeleton twitch slightly.

trait.name: Writhing Innards
entries: When a creature that can see the mohrg starts its turn within 30 feet of it, the morgh can force the creature to succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mohrg makes two attacks with its Bony Grasp.

entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@dice 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}).

action.name: Clawed Tongue
entries: The mohrg attempts to shove its clawed tongue into a creature's mouth. One {@condition grappled} or {@condition incapacitated} creature within 15 feet must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 55 ({@damage 10d10}) piercing damage and be unable to speak or breathe on its following turn, or take half as much damage on a success.
A creature killed by this damage rises on the mohrg's following turn as a {@creature Zombie Rotter|ConfC} under the mohrg's control.

reaction.name: Visceral Caress
entries: When the mohrg is missed with a melee attack by a {@condition poisoned} or {@condition frightened} creature, it can force the creature to succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} until the end of the mohrg's next turn.

trait.name: Bonded at Creation
entries: A {@creature serpentine overseer|confc|Serpentine Overseer} is {@condition attached|confc|attached} to the molydeus, shares its space, and cannot be removed while the overseer lives.

The molydeus cannot see or take hostile action against the overseer attached to it. If its overseer is killed, the molydeus must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw at the beginning of each of its turns or gain a level of {@condition exhaustion}.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the molydeus may spend half of its movement to attempt a {@dc 17} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the molydeus. While climbing on the molydeus, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the molydeus, and the molydeus has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

trait.name: Magic Resistance

Each structure and unattended object within 5 feet of the target is destroyed.

legendary.name: Voice of the Master

legendary.name: Crushing Pulse (2nd Level Spell)

legendary.name: Cleaving Charge (Costs 2 Actions)

trait.name: Prone Deficiency

entries: If the monodrone takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the monodrone takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

trait.name: Clockwork Repetition
entries: The monodrone may choose to treat any {@dice d20} roll as a 10, instead of rolling.

trait.name: Perfect Synchrony
entries: If the monodrone is within 30 feet of a duodrone, it uses the duodrone's attack bonus instead of its own. If the duodrone is using a tridrone's attack bonus, the monodrone uses that instead, and so on.

action.name: Bladed Ruler (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk m} {@hit 1} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 piercing damage.

action.name: Measure Cuts
entries: The modron assesses the wounds of a creature it can see within 5 feet, learning how many hit points it is missing.

reaction.name: Upgrade
entries: As a reaction to seeing a duodrone within 60 feet die or transform, the monodrone may transform into a duodrone, retaining its current hit points. No more than one monodrone may take this reaction.

monster.name: Moon Wraith

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

languages: The languages it knew in life

trait.name: Lunar Wrath
entries: While in moonlight or starlight, the wraith's attacks are made at advantage and its Crescent Arc recharges on a 4-6.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The wraith can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wraith makes two melee attacks, one of which it may replace with its crescent arc, if available.

action.name: Touch of Lunacy
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}13 ({@dice 2d8 + 4}) radiant plus 5 ({@damage 1d10}) psychic damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be forced to take the attack action targeting a creature it can see on its following turn.

action.name: Crescent Arc {@recharge}
entries: The wraith moves up to its speed. Each creature whose space the wraith passes through with this movement takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage and must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be unable to see the wraith until the end of the wraith's next turn.

action.name: Create Wraith
entries: The wraith targets a humanoid within 10 feet of it that has been dead for no longer than 1 minute and died violently. The target's spirit rises as a Wisp Wraith under the wraith's control.

reaction.name: Moon Glide
entries: When the wraith takes damage of a type it is resistant to, it can move up to half its speed without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the moose moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with an antler rush attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Antler Rush
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage and the target is pushed 5 ft. away.

action.name: Rearing Kick
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition prone} creature. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) slashing damage. A {@condition prone} target takes an additional 9 ({@damage 2d8}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Daunting Bellow (1/Day)
entries: The moose lets out a menacing roar. Each hostile creature within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} of the moose until the end of the moose's next turn.

reaction.name: Elusive Sidle
entries: As a reaction to a creature ending its movement within 5 ft. of the moose, the moose moves up to half its speed in any direction other than directly away from the creature without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

reaction.name: Twist Antlers
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a melee weapon attack, the moose forces the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or drop its weapon. If it cannot, the creature is instead knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Multiple Heads
entries: The hydra has five heads. While it has more than one head, the hydra has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition blinded}, {@condition charmed}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition frightened}, {@condition stunned}, and knocked {@condition unconscious}.

Whenever the hydra takes 25 or more damage in a single turn, one of its heads dies. If all its heads die, the hydra dies. A creature can attempt to avoid harming the heads, bypassing this trait. If it does, the hydra has resistance to any damage it deals.

At the beginning of its turn, the hydra makes a {@dc 13} Constitution save for each head that died since the beginning of its last turn. On a success, it grows two new heads. It makes one of these saving throws at disadvantage for each source of fire damage it took since its last turn. The hydra regains 10 hit points for each head regrown in this way.

trait.name: Reactive Heads
entries: For each head the hydra has beyond one, it gets an extra reaction that can be used only for {@action opportunity attack||opportunity attacks}.

trait.name: Wakeful
entries: While the hydra sleeps, at least one of its heads is awake.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hydra makes as many attacks as it has heads. If it is grappling a creature at the start of its turn, it may replace one of its bite attacks with a swallow.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@dice 1d10 + 5}) piercing plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) acid damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}). While a head grapples a target, the head can attack only that target.

action.name: Acid Spit
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 7} to hit, range 30 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d8}) acid damage.

action.name: Swallow
entries: The hydra makes one bite attack against a Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, that creature takes the bite's damage and is swallowed, and the grapple ends.

While swallowed, the creature is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained} in the hydra's craw, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the hydra, and it takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) acid damage at the start of each of the hydra's turns. One swallowed creature is freed whenever the hydra loses a head.

action.name: Worry
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by at least two of the hydra's heads must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution throw or take 55 ({@damage 10d10}) piercing damage and 14 ({@damage 4d6}) acid damage, or half as much on a success. A creature makes this save at disadvantage if it is {@condition grappled} by three or more heads.

reaction.name: Shed Head
entries: As a reaction when the hydra fails a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the hydra may choose to succeed. If it does, one of its heads dies and tears away from the main body.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Mordenkainen has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Arbiter of the Balance (Mythic Trait, 2/Day)
entries: When Mordenkainen is reduced to 0 hit points, he doesn't die or fall {@condition unconscious}. Instead, he resets to 157 hit points and each condition affecting him ends.
For the next hour, his Mordenkainen's Balanced Blade grows in size and deals a cumulative additional 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage on a hit.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Mordenkainen fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Mordenkainen makes two attacks with his Mordenkainen's Balanced Blade.

action.name: Mordenkainen's Balanced Blade
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}33 ({@damage 5d10 + 6}) force damage.

A creation of magical force hit with this weapon explodes, forcing each creature within 15 feet of it to succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 4d10}) Force damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Mordenkainen's Arcing Fingertips (5th Level Spell)
entries: A bolt of lightning leaps from each of Mordenkainen's splayed fingertips, forcing up to ten creatures of his choice in a 90 foot cone to make a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw.
A target takes 28 ({@damage 8d6}) lightning damage on a failed saving throw, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Mordenkainen's Involuntary Wizardry (5th Level Spell)
entries: Mordenkainen calls forth a magical spasm from a creature he can see within range, forcing it to succeed on a {@dc 21} Charisma saving throw or use its highest level unexpended spell slot to cast {@spell Magic Missile} at that level.
The missiles produced by it are divided evenly between other creatures within 30 feet of the target, with any extras hitting the creature that produced them.

action.name: Mordenkainen's Ultimate Cogitation (8th Level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: Mordenkainen casts any wizard spell of 6th level or lower that has a casting time of 1 action.

reaction.name: Mordenkainen's Instant Opposition (7th Level Spell)
entries: When a creature Mordenkainen can see within 60 feet casts a spell, Mordenkainen can attempt to neutralize it with a tailored blend of opposing cosmic energies.
The spell caster must succeed on a {@dc 21} Intelligence saving throw or have its spell fail. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more instead has its spell rebound upon it.
If the spell targets one or more creatures, it instead targets only the spell caster. If the spell targets an area, it instead targets an area centered on the spell caster.

reaction.name: Mordenkainen's Faithful Phantoms (2/Day, 6th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: When Mordenkainen's Mythic trait becomes active, he can sculpt raw magical force into two {@creature faithful phantom|confc|Faithful Phantoms}.
Each Faithful Phantom appears in an unoccupied space Mordenkainen can see within 15 feet and acts under his control on initiative 0.

legendary.name: Magician's Step
entries: Mordenkainen moves up to half his speed. Then, if no hostile creature within 30 feet can clearly see him, he can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space.

legendary.name: Dancing Slash
entries: Mordenkainen's sword flies up to 30 feet and makes a Mordenkainen's Balanced Blade attack against a creature within 5 feet of it.
At the beginning of Mordenkainen's turn, it returns to his hand.

legendary.name: Hasty Ward (Concentration)
entries: Mordenkainen quickly improvises a protective spell, chosen at random from the Hasty Ward table.

mythic.name: Mordenkainen's Focused Disjunction (1/Round, 9th Level Spell)
entries: Mordenkainen attempts to sunder a spell or nonartifact magic item he can see within 60 feet.
A creature {@status concentration||concentrating} on the spell or attuned to the magic item can make a {@dc 21} Charisma saving throw, preventing its destruction on a success.

trait.name: Underfoot
entries: The monkey can take the {@action Dodge} or {@action Hide} action as a bonus action if it is within 5 feet of at least two Medium or larger hostile creatures, even if it is not obscured.

trait.name: Undersized
entries: While carrying mortar shell or another similarly heavy object, the monkey's speed is reduced by half and it can't take bonus actions.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 1} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d6 - 1}) piercing damage.

action.name: Mortar Shell Bowl
entries: The monkey rolls a mortar shell it is carrying up to 30 feet. Each creature in the shell's path must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}, leaping over the shot on a success.

action.name: Operate Mortar
entries: The monkey interacts with a Monkey Mortar within 5 feet, choosing one of the following options:

items.name: Load Mortar
entries: The monkey loads a mortar shell it is carrying into the Monkey Mortar.

items.name: Adjust Aim
entries: The monkey chooses a direction for the mortar to point, and a number of d6s for the shell to scatter when it fires.

items.name: Light Fuse
entries: The monkey sets a fuse and lights it. At the beginning of the monkey's next turn, the mortar fires.

trait.name: Keen Sight and Smell
entries: The owlbear has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight or smell.

trait.name: Concussive Strength
entries: A creature knocked {@condition prone} by the owlbear must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be unable to stand on its following turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The owlbear makes two attacks, one of which may be with its beak. A medium or smaller creature hit with two claw attacks in a turn is knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d10 + 5}) piercing damage. This attack does an additional 5 ({@damage 1d10}) damage to a {@condition prone} creature.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) slashing damage and the target is pushed 5 ft. away.

reaction.name: Roaring Screech
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 47 hit points, the owlbear lets out an ear-piercing screech.

Each creature within 10 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be disoriented, making attacks at disadvantage until the end of its next turn. Additionally, a creature that fails this save falls {@condition prone} if it misses with a melee attack on its following turn.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a bonus action, the mozgriken can polymorph into any Small beast or transform one of its limbs into a natural weapon. If it does, the mozgriken takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) necrotic damage. This altered form lasts for one minute, or until the mozgriken dies.

trait.name: Psychic Eavesdropper
entries: The mozgriken can hear the surface thoughts of creatures within 30 ft. of it, and is aware of what they see.

trait.name: Shadow Stealth
entries: While in Dim Light or Darkness, the mozgriken can take the {@action Hide} action as a Bonus Action.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The mozgriken has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Natural Weapon (Only when Shapechanged)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage (mozgriken's choice) plus 5 ({@damage 1d10}) psychic damage.

action.name: Brain Drain
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition unconscious} target. {@h}The target's intelligence score is reduced by 1 until it completes a Short or Long Rest, to a minimum of 6. A sleeping target then makes a {@dc 14} {@skill Perception} check at disadvantage, waking on a success.

reaction.name: Cower
entries: When the mozgriken is targeted with a melee attack, it can force the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or deal half as much damage with attacks made against the mozgriken this turn.

trait.name: Earthglide
entries: The myrmidon can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the myrmidon doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The myrmiddon makes three melee attacks, one of which it may replace with its Soften Earth, if available.

action.name: Muddy Maul
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target must make a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. A creature knocked {@condition prone} in this way must spend its full movement to stand.

action.name: Soften Earth (Concentration, Recharge 5-6)
entries: The ground in a 10 ft. radius around the myrmidon becomes difficult terrain for the next minute. This radius moves with the myrmidon.

reaction.name: Elemental Riposte
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack, the myrmidon unleashes a burst of sticky mud. The attacker must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition restrained} until the end of the attacker's next turn.

reaction.name: Non-Newtonian
entries: As a reaction to taking bludgeoning or slashing damage, the myrmidon increases its AC by 2 until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The mud lasher can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Caking Mud
entries: Whenever the mud lasher takes fire damage, its speed is reduced by 10 and its AC increases by 2 for the next minute. The mud lasher dies if its speed is reduced to 0 in this way.

action.name: Drowning Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}).

action.name: Mud Ball
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 30 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. A creature knocked {@condition prone} in this way must spend its full movement to stand.

reaction.name: Shifting Form
entries: As a reaction to being hit with an attack, the mud lasher moves up to 15 ft. without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

reaction.name: Stuff Face
entries: As a reaction to a creature it has {@condition grappled} attempting to speak or cast a spell, the mud lasher forces it to make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature's mouth and throat filled with mud, preventing it from speaking or breathing until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Earthglide
entries: The mephit can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone, and doesn't disturb any material it burrows through.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a 5 foot radius burst of sticky mud.
Each Medium or smaller creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 11} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition restrained} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Muddy Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 11} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.
A creature knocked {@condition prone} in this way must spend its full movement to stand.

action.name: Soften Earth (Concentration, Recharge 6)
entries: The ground in a 10 foot radius around the mephit softens, becoming difficult terrain for the next minute. This radius moves with the mephit.

reaction.name: Non-Newtonian
entries: When the mephit takes any bludgeoning or slashing damage, it can increase its AC by 2 until the beginning of its next turn.

monster.name: Mummy Guardian
languages: The languages it knew in life

trait.name: Final Curse
entries: A creature that reduces the mummy to 0 hit points must succeed on a {@dc 12} Charisma saving throw or suffer a curse of wilting. While cursed in this way, any magical healing the creature receives is reduced by half.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mummy attacks once with its Rotting Fist and uses its Dreadful Glare.

action.name: Rotting Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d6}) necrotic damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be infected with mummy rot.

action.name: Dreadful Glare
entries: One creature the mummy can see within 60 feet must succeed on a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of the mummy's next turn. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is additionally {@condition paralyzed} for the same duration.

reaction.name: Warding Hex
entries: When the mummy is hit with a melee attack, it can deal 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage to the creature.

monster.name: Mummy Lord
languages: The languages it knew in life

trait.name: Warding Hex
entries: A creature within 30 feet of the mummy that hits it with an attack must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage and be {@condition stunned} until the end of the mummy's next turn.

trait.name: Final Curse
entries: A creature that reduces the mummy to 0 hit points must succeed on a {@dc 16} Charisma saving throw or suffer a curse of wilting. While cursed in this way, any magical healing the creature receives is reduced by half.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The mummy lord has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: A destroyed mummy lord gains a new body in 24 hours if its heart is intact, regaining all its hit points and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of the mummy lord's heart.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mummy makes two attacks with its Rotting Fist and uses its Dreadful Glare.

action.name: Rotting Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be infected with Mummy Rot.

action.name: Dreadful Glare
entries: One creature the mummy can see within 60 feet must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of the mummy's next turn. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is additionally {@condition paralyzed} for the same duration.
A target that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to the Dreadful Glare of all mummies and mummy lords for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Plague Chant (6th Level Spell, Recharges when the mummy uses its Grave Terror)
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 90 ft., one target. Hit 28 ({@damage 8d6}) necrotic damage. If this attack hits, the plague chant leaps to another creature within 15 feet of the previous target.
The mummy lord makes a new attack roll against the new target, which could cause this ability to leap again. A creature can be targeted no more than once with each casting of this spell.

action.name: Grave Terror (8th Level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature the mummy lord can see within 15 feet must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or take 99 ({@damage 18d10}) psychic damage and be dragged up to 15 feet toward the mummy, or take half as much damage on a success.
A creature that isn't {@condition frightened} may use its reaction to move 15 feet directly away from the mummy. If it does, it gains advantage on this saving throw.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: The mummy lord makes one attack with its rotting fist or uses its Dreadful Glare.

legendary.name: Whirlwind of Sand
entries: The mummy lord magically transforms into a whirlwind of sand, moves up to 60 feet without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}, and reverts to its normal form.

legendary.name: Blinding Dust
entries: Blinding dust and sand swirls magically around the mummy lord. Each creature within 5 feet of the mummy lord must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the end of the creature's next turn.

legendary.name: Blasphemous Word (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The mummy lord utters a blasphemous word. Each non-undead creature within 10 feet of the mummy lord that can hear the magical utterance must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} and {@condition stunned} until the end of the mummy lord's next turn.

monster.name: Mummy Retainer
languages: The languages it knew in life

trait.name: To Dust
entries: A creature that reduces the mummy to 0 hit points with a melee attack must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be unable to speak or breathe until the end of its next turn as the mummy bursts into a spray of dust and sand.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the mummy takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the mummy takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

action.name: Trembling Grasp (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or be {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}). At the start of each of the creature's turns, it takes 1 necrotic damage for each Mummy Retainer grappling it.

trait.name: Sleek Coat Insulation
entries: While the bundaburra has more than half of its hit points, it has resistance to cold and fire damage.

trait.name: Gentleman's Composure
entries: If Mushen would fail a saving throw and has not yet taken a turn this round, he can lower his initiative by up to 5, to a minimum of 0, and add an equal amount to the result of his saving throw.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Mushen makes two attacks, one of which he can replace with a use of his Dogged Advance.

action.name: Oakwrought Belaying Pin
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 5 feet away.
On a critical hit, the target is pushed an additional 10 feet away and knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Flintlock Blunderbuss {@recharge 4}
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 8} to hit, range 30/60 ft., up to two targets. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) piercing damage.
This attack can target up to two creatures within 5 feet of each other.

action.name: Dogged Advance
entries: Mushen moves up to half his speed. Each other creature of his choice within 30 feet that can see him can use its reaction to move up to half its speed and gain advantage on the first attack it makes before the beginning of his next turn.

reaction.name: Belay That!
entries: When a friendly creature he can see within 30 feet misses with a melee attack, Mushen can cause the creature to reroll the attack, taking the second result.

reaction.name: Spur Stomp
entries: When a creature stands from {@condition prone} within 5 feet of him, Mushen can force it to succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.
Mushen can take two actions, choosing from the options below.

legendary.name: Belaying Bash
entries: Mushen moves up to 10 feet and makes an attack with his Oakwrought Belaying Pin.

legendary.name: Load Spare
entries: The next time Mushen uses his Flintlock Blunderbuss, he can make two attacks with it that turn.

legendary.name: Shipshape Command
entries: One friendly creature within 60 feet that can hear Mushen can use its reaction to do one of the following:
Restore 5 hit points to a ship's hull.
Load or aim a cannon or other piece of artillery.
Furl or unfurl a sail.
Use a ship's helm to change its heading.

trait.name: Distress Spores
entries: When the myconid takes damage, all other myconids within 240 feet of it can sense its pain.

trait.name: Sun Sickness
entries: While in sunlight, the myconid has disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws. The myconid dies if it spends more than 1 hour in direct sunlight.

trait.name: Pacifying Spores
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the one or more myconid adults must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the start of its next turn. While {@condition poisoned} in this way, a creature can't take hostile actions or reactions.

action.name: Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 2d4}) bludgeoning damage and 5 ({@damage 2d4}) poison damage. This attack is made with advantage if it targets a {@condition poisoned} creature.

action.name: Rapport Spores
entries: A 20-foot radius of spores extends from the myconid. These spores can go around corners and affect only creatures with an Intelligence of 2 or higher that aren't undead, constructs, or elementals. Affected creatures can communicate telepathically with one another while they are within 30 feet of each other. The effect lasts for 1 hour.

trait.name: Distress Spores
entries: When the myconid takes damage, all other myconids within 240 feet of it can sense its pain.

trait.name: Sun Sickness
entries: While in sunlight, the myconid has disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws. The myconid dies if it spends more than 1 hour in direct sunlight.

trait.name: Sovereign Spores
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of one or more myconid sovereigns must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or take 5 ({@damage 2d4}) poison damage and be {@condition poisoned} until the start of its next turn. While {@condition poisoned} in this way, a creature can't take hostile actions or reactions, and its movement speed is halved.

action.name: Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 3d4 + 1}) bludgeoning damage and 7 ({@damage 3d4}) poison damage. This attack is made with advantage if it targets a {@condition poisoned} creature.

action.name: Rapport Spores
entries: A 30-foot radius of spores extends from the myconid. These spores can go around corners and affect only creatures with an Intelligence of 2 or higher that aren't undead, constructs, or elementals. Affected creatures can communicate telepathically with one another while they are within 30 feet of each other. The effect lasts for 1 hour.

action.name: Animating Spores
entries: The myconid targets one corpse of a humanoid or a Large or smaller beast within 5 feet of it and releases spores at the corpse. At the beginning of the myconid's next turn, the corpse rises as a spore servant. The corpse stays animated for {@dice 1d4 + 1} weeks or until destroyed, and it can't be animated again in this way.

trait.name: Distress Spores
entries: When the myconid takes damage, all other myconids within 240 feet of it can sense its pain.

trait.name: Sun Sickness
entries: While in sunlight, the myconid has disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws. The myconid dies if it spends more than 1 hour in direct sunlight.

trait.name: Mollifying Spores
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of one or more myconid sprouts must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or become indifferent to each of them until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 1} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 ({@damage 1d4 - 1}) bludgeoning damage and 2 ({@damage 1d4}) poison damage. This attack is made with advantage if it targets a {@condition poisoned} creature.

action.name: Rapport Spores (3/Day)
entries: A 10-foot radius of spores extends from the myconid. These spores can go around corners and affect only creatures with an Intelligence of 2 or higher that aren't undead, constructs, or elementals. Affected creatures can communicate telepathically with one another while they are within 30 feet of each other. The effect lasts for 1 hour.

trait.name: Sharp-Eyed
entries: Creatures without full cover from Myogibo cannot be hidden from him, and his attacks ignore half and three-quarters cover.

trait.name: Feather Step
entries: Myogibo's high jump is up to 15 feet, or up to 30 feet with a running start. He may treat any surface, including leaves or falling snow, as solid ground.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Myogibo makes two attacks with his Tengu Fan.

action.name: Tengu Fan
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

On a hit or miss, the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be spun around and disoriented, giving it disadvantage on the next attack it makes before the beginning of Myogibo's next turn.

action.name: Gust of Five Winds {@recharge 5}
entries: Myogibo sweeps his fan, unleashing a torrent of wind. Each creature in a 15 foot cone must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 3d8}) bludgeoning damage and be pushed up to 15 feet away, or take half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Embrace Stillness
entries: As a reaction when Myogibo fails an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma saving throw, he may choose to succeed. If he does, he is {@condition stunned} until the beginning of his next turn.

monster.name: Myriad Pseudodragon
languages: but communicates only in images and ideas.

trait.name: Scent-Reading
entries: The pseudodragon has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check to determine the mental state of creatures it can smell.

trait.name: Solo Swarm
entries: The pseudodragon's attacks deal an additional {@damage 1d4} damage for each active duplicate in its space. If the pseudodragon would be hit with an attack, it may cause the attack to instead hit one of its duplicates.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The pseudodragon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Slinking Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) piercing damage.
Before or after making this attack, the pseudodragon may move up to 5 feet without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

action.name: Drowsy Sting
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for the next minute.

A creature {@condition poisoned} in this way repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success, or falling asleep until the beginning of its next turn on a failure. A creature wakes early if it takes any damage, or if a creature uses an action to shake it awake.

action.name: Myriad Duplication
entries: The pseudodragon creates a semi-real duplicate of itself in its space that moves with the pseudodragon and lasts for a minute.
The duplicate has 1 hit point and cannot take Actions. While the pseudodragon has one or more duplicates active, it may use this ability as a Bonus Action.

trait.name: Hateful Ichor
entries: A nonfiend creature that deals any piercing or slashing damage to the myrmyxicus is covered in its blood.
Until a creature takes an action to clear the blood, the affected creature takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) psychic damage whenever it ends its turn without dealing damage.

trait.name: Vulnerable Midsection
entries: If the myrmyxicus takes 30 or more piercing or slashing damage from a single source, it must make a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw.

On a failed save, the myrmyxicus takes 27 ({@dice 6d8}) additional slashing damage and is cut in half, losing the ability to make attacks with its Lamprey Bite and releasing each creature {@condition grappled} by it .

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The myrmyxicus has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Legendary Resistances (3/Day)
entries: If the myrmyxicus fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The myrmyxicus makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Lamprey Bite.

action.name: Lamprey Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}27 ({@damage 4d10 + 5}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 19}).

action.name: Blasphemous Scythes
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@dice 2d6 + 5}) slashing plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage.
This attack ignores enhancements to AC from spells or magic items. Damage from this attack bypasses temporary hit points and can't be reduced in any way.

action.name: Billowing Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: A torrent of dense black vapor pours from the myrmyxicus' mouth in a 30 foot cone, forcing each creature in the area to make a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw.
On a failes saving throw, a creature takes 28 ({@damage 8d6}) poison damage and is {@condition poisoned} for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn), or takes half as much damage on a success.
While {@condition poisoned} in this way, a creature is {@condition blinded} and {@condition choking|confc|choking}.

action.name: Chaos Immortal (1/Day, 9th Level Spell)
entries: One allied creature the myrmyxicus can see is wreathed in foul abyssal energies for the next minute, after which it must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw or be reduced to 0 hit points.
For the next minute, its melee attacks deal an additional 11 ({@dice 2d10}) fire and 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage, and it does not fall {@condition unconscious} when reduced to 0 hit points.
The creature makes death saving throws while at 0 hit points, even if it ordinarily would not, and regains 10 hit points at the beginning of each of its turns.

bonus.name: Unholy Enthrallment (4th Level Spell)
entries: One fiend or undead creature {@condition grappled} by the myrmyxicus must succeed on a {@dc 21} Charisma saving throw or be {@condition dominated|confc|dominated} by the myrmyxicus.
The creature repeats this saving throw whenever it takes damage, ending the effect on a success.

bonus.name: Shredling Infusion
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the myrmyxicus' Lamprey Bite must make a {@dc 22} Constitution saving throw.

On a failed save, the creature's Charisma score is reduced by 2 ({@dice 1d4}), to a minimum of 1, and numerous boils raise and burst from its body, expelling a {@creature ruin demon caricature|confc|Ruin Demon Caricature} in its space.
A creature that has its Charisma score reduced below 5 in this way counts as a fiend until the reduction ends.

legendary.name: Blasphemous Scythe
entries: The myrmyxicus makes an attack with its Blasphemous Scythes.

legendary.name: Breath of the Abyss (2nd Level Spell)
entries: One allied demon the myrmyxicus can see takes 15 slashing damage and a gout of burning toxic fumes emerges from its wound in a 15 foot cone.
Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw or take 10 ({@dice 3d6}) fire plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage, or half as much on a success.

legendary.name: Tendrilous Slither (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The myrmyxicus moves up to its speed.
Each creature whose space it moves within 5 feet of must succeed on a {@dc 21} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} and {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn.

While {@condition frightened} in this way, a creature can sense the nalfeshnee's surface thoughts and emotions.

trait.name: Fate of the Faithless
entries: Whenever the nalfeshnee kills a demon, it may shout a magically empowered command. Each other demon that can hear it must succeed on a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw or follow that command until the beginning of the nalfeshnee's next turn.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the nalfeshnee may spend half of its movement to attempt a {@dc 21} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the nalfeshnee. While climbing on the nalfeshnee, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the nalfeshnee, and the nalfeshnee has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The nalfeshnee makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Ravenous Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}40 ({@damage 6d10 + 7}) piercing damage. This attack scores a critical on an 18-20 against a {@condition prone} creature.

action.name: Claw Smash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 4d6 + 7}) slashing damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away.
Each other creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

action.name: Consume Fear {@recharge 5}
entries: The nalfeshnee tears the fear from a {@condition frightened} creature within 15 feet, forcing it to succeed on a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw or take 93 ({@damage 6d10 + 60}) psychic damage and cease being {@condition frightened}, or take half as much damage on a success.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more has its movement speed reduced by half and it can't make more than one attack until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Reckless Greed
entries: When a creature fails a saving throw against the nalfeshnee's Hungry Gaze by 5 or more, the nalfeshnee can move up to 10 feet toward the creature and make a Ravenous Bite attack against it.
If it does, attacks against the nalfeshnee have advantage until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Horrific Apparition
entries: When the nalfeshnee is hit with a ranged attack, it can teleport up to 120 feet directly toward the attacker to an unoccupied space it can see.
Then, each creature within 15 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Judge Worthy
entries: When a {@condition frightened} non-fiend creature the nalfeshnee can see within 60 feet dies, the nalfeshnee can force it to succeed on a {@dc 19} Charisma saving throw or transform into a demon of CR 5 or lower.

trait.name: Sleek Coat Insulation
entries: While the bundaburra has more than half of its hit points, it has resistance to cold and fire damage.

trait.name: Unshakeable Poise
entries: Namerin has advantage on checks and saving throws to avoid being pushed or knocked {@condition prone}.
If Namerin is knocked {@condition prone}, he can't use his Mid-Battle Tea Break until he completes a Short or Long Rest.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Namerin makes two attacks with his Naval Saber, each of which he can replace with a use of his Mid-Battle Tea Break.

action.name: Naval Saber
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) slashing damage.
Namerin can make this attack as a Bonus Action against an {@condition incapacitated} or non-creature target.

action.name: Paddle-Tail Smack
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

action.name: Mid-Battle Tea Break
entries: Namerin pours a cup of tea and sets it on a surface within 5 feet. A creature that drinks the tea as a bonus action gains 5 temporary hit points.
While it has any of these temporary hit points, a creature has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition frightened}.

reaction.name: Indignant Slap
entries: When a hostile creature within 10 feet begins to drink a cup of tea Namerin poured, Namerin can move up to 5 feet toward and make an attack against it with his Paddle-Tail Smack.
On a hit, the tea is spilled and the creature gains no benefit from it.

trait.name: Dreadnaught Shell
entries: If the beetle would take 10 or fewer bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage from a single source, it takes no damage instead.

trait.name: Spiracle Breathing
entries: The beetle has disadvantage on Constitution saving throws against inhaled toxins.

action.name: Tarsal Stomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) bludgeoning damage.
This attack has disadvantage against a target that is flying or climbing.

action.name: Crushing Advance
entries: The beetle uses all of its remaining movement to move in a straight line, and can attempt to push one Large or smaller creature in its path, which must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be pushed ahead of the beetle for the rest of this move.

A creature pushed into a solid surface in this way takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) bludgeoning damage and is {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 13}) until the beginning of the beetle's turn, or until the beetle moves.

reaction.name: Shivering Alarm {@recharge}
entries: When the beetle sees a creature take a hostile action, it can scrape its legs against its shell, producing a horrid squealing sound audible out to 300 feet.
Each creature within 15 feet that can hear it has disadvantage on the first attack it makes before the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Infernal Tack
entries: The Narzugon may mount any willing Large or larger creature. While riding a creature, the narzugon acts on its mount's initiative, rather than rolling its own.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The narzugon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Aura of Relentless Command
entries: A devil that starts its turn within 60 feet of the narzugon makes saving throws to end an ongoing effect at the beginning of its turn, rather than at the end.

action.name: Multiattack

action.name: Hellfire Lance
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d12 + 5}) piercing damage plus 16 ({@damage 3d10}) fire damage. If this damage kills a creature, the creature's soul rises from the River Styx as a lemure in Avernus in {@dice 1d4} hours.

action.name: Compel Honor
entries: One creature within 60 feet of the narzugon that can hear it must must succeed on a {@dc 17} Charisma saving throw or be cursed to face it in melee combat. An affected creature that attempts to target the narzugon with an attack or harmful spell from more than 10 feet away must first make a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature must choose a new target or lose the attack or spell.

action.name: Abjure the Unforsaken
entries: One non-fiend creature within 60 feet of the narzugon that can hear it must must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn. While {@condition frightened} in this way, the creature must spend its turn trying to move as far from the narzugon as it can.

action.name: Channel Death {@recharge 5}
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}90 ({@damage 20d8}) necrotic damage.

reaction.name: Punish Falsity
entries: As a reaction to a creature succeeding on a saving throw against the narzugon's Compel Honor ability, the narzugon and its mount may move up to it's (or its mount's) speed toward the creature. If it ends this movement within 10 ft. of the creature, the narzugon may make a hellfire lance attack.

trait.name: Trampling Charge
entries: If the nebelmare moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with a hooves attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Discorporate

trait.name: Coagulate
entries: If the necrichor takes any cold damage, is affected by healing magic, or gains any temporary hit points it coagulates until the end of its next turn. While coagulated, the necrichor may not use its spider climb trait, has its movement speed reduced by 10, and it deals an additional 3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage with its melee attacks.

trait.name: Blood Siphon
entries: Whenever a creature the necrichor is attached to takes any necrotic damage, the necrichor gains an equal number of temporary hit points.

A creature that cannot is instead {@condition paralyzed} until the start of the necrichor's next turn.

action.name: Wrench Blood
entries: One creature the necrichor can see within 60 feet must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 4d10}) necrotic damage and be pulled up to 15 feet toward the necrichor, or take half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Blood Puppeteering {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature within 5 feet that does not have all of its hit points must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the necrichor enters the target's space and attaches itself to the target. While attached, the necrichor takes only half the damage dealt to it and the target takes the remaining damage.

While the necrichor is attached to a creature, the necrichor can't use its multiattack and the creature acts under the necrichor's control. An affected creature repeats this saving throw whenever it takes damage, expelling the necrichor into an unoccupied adjacent space on a success.

reaction.name: Lose Cohesion
entries: When the necrichor fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, any creatures it is {@condition attached|confc|attached} to are freed and the necrichor moves to the nearest unoccupied space.

reaction.name: Bloody Retribution

trait.name: Eternal Tide

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Neifon makes three melee attacks, one of which may be with his Lighteater Bite, and uses his Whispered Thunder, if available.

action.name: Lighteater Bite (Bat form only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}23 ({@damage 3d10 + 7}) piercing damage.
On a hit or miss, each light source within 5 feet of the target is reduced by one level; from Bright Light to Dim Light, or from Dim Light to Darkness.

action.name: Tymor Du, the Blackthumb (Humanoid form only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d8 + 7}) piercing damage.
On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw or lose an eye.

action.name: Curling Grasp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d6 + 7}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 21}).
A {@condition grappled} creature hit by this attack takes an additional 7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage.

action.name: Whispered Thunder {@recharge 4}
entries: Neifon sends out a precisely targeted pulse of subsonic energy that converges on a creature he can see within 60 feet, choosing one of the following effects:

items.name: Shaking Eyes
entries: The creature must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the end of Neifon's next turn.

items.name: Quaking Heart
entries: The creature must succeed on a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of Neifon's next turn.

items.name: Shattered Arms
entries: The creature must succeed on a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw or have one nonartifact weapon or piece of armor it is carrying shatter. If the item is magical or named, this save is made at advantage.

bonus.name: Shift Form
entries: Neifon transforms into a form that resembles a Medium humanoid, or back into his true Large bat-like form. His statistics are the same in each form.

bonus.name: Bur-Bat
entries: A bat soars out from Neifon's retinue and crashes into a creature he can see within 60 feet, then bursts into a gnarled burr of hooked spines.
The creature must succeed on a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) piercing damage and have the bur stick to it (remove {@dc 20}).

bonus.name: Burst-Bat (Humanoid form only)
entries: Neifon detonates each bur created by his Bur-Bat that is attached to a creature. Each of those creatures must succeed on a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage and be pushed 10 feet in a direction of Neifon's choice for each bur attached to it.

reaction.name: Black Breath of the Earth (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction when Neifon is reduced below 148 hit points, up to six 50 foot long, 10 foot wide, 30 foot deep trenches split open in the earth within 300 feet of Neifon, disgorging a torrent of bats into the air for the next minute.

A creature other than Neifon in the trench's space is immediately launched up to 50 feet in the air, then must make a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw, landing on a side of the trench of its choice on a success, or a randomly selected side on a failure.

legendary.name: Bur-bat
entries: Neifon uses his Bur-bat.

legendary.name: Traveler's Dust (Humanoid form only)
entries: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn. While {@condition poisoned} in this way, a creature takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) psychic damage for each 5 feet it moves through Dim Light or Darkness.

legendary.name: Plunge into Night (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Neifon moves up to half his speed, then if he is in Darkness may teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space that is also in Darkness.

immune.note: from nonmagical attacks or from falling

trait.name: Soundless Stalk
entries: The nekomata counts as Hidden from any creature that cannot see it.

trait.name: Gnaw Through
entries: The nekomata can burrow a Small hole through one foot of nonmagical wood, stone, or steel in ten minutes.

trait.name: Retching Return
entries: When the nekomata fails a saving throw, it can regurgitate a creature swallowed by it in the last hour to succeed instead.
When the nekomata dies, it regurgitates each creature and object swallowed by it in the last week in the same condition they were swallowed in.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The nekomata makes two attacks with its Secret Needles, one of which it can replace with a use of its Bloodlap Bite or Stumbling Dance.

action.name: Bloodlap Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) piercing damage.
If the target has fewer than half its hit points after taking this damage, the nekomata gains 10 temporary hit points.

action.name: Secret Needles
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) piercing or slashing damage.
This attack has advantage against a Surprised target, or one the nekomata started its turn Hidden from.

action.name: Stumbling Dance (Cat Form Only, Concentration)
entries: Spectral flames wreath the nekomata's tails.
Whenever the nekomata leaves a creature's reach, it can force that creature to succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or begin {@condition burning|confc|burning} ({@dice 1d10}).

action.name: Deranged Yowl {@recharge 5}
entries: The nekomata lets out a horrid sound, forcing each creature that can hear it within 30 feet to succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or have its back violently bend for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn).
An affected creature has disadvantage on attacks and has its movement speed reduced by a cumulative 15 feet until the effect ends at the beginning of each of its turns.
A creature that has its speed reduced to 0 in this way is {@condition paralyzed}.

bonus.name: Death-Puppet Spring
entries: The nekomata leaps up to 10 feet without provoking {@action opportunity attack||opportunity attacks}.

Each humanoid corpse that has been dead fewer than 49 days that the nekomata leaps over in this way immediately rises as a {@creature horde ghoul|confc|Horde Ghoul} that acts on the nekomata's turn and under its control.

bonus.name: Devour the Sleeping
entries: The nekomata distends its mouth and begins to swallow a Large or smaller {@condition unconscious} creature or object within 5 feet whole.
At the beginning of the nekomata's next turn, the target is swallowed and disappears entirely.
This action is disrupted if the nekomata is knocked {@condition prone} or {@condition incapacitated}, or if the target regains consciousness.

bonus.name: Change Shape
entries: The nekomata assumes the form of a humanoid creature it has touched or that of a Large cat. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its cat form if it dies.

legendary.name: Secret Needles
entries: The nekomata makes an attack with its Secret Needles.

legendary.name: Devious Dance
entries: The nekomata uses its Stumbling Dance, then moves up to half its speed.

legendary.name: Slow Blink
entries: The nekomata locks eyes with a creature it can see within 30 feet, forcing it to succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or fall asleep for the next minute.
A sleeping creature wakes early if a creature takes an action to shake it awake, or if it takes any damage.

trait.name: Heavenly Abhorrence
entries: If the nemesis takes any fire or radiant damage, attacks against it are made at advantage until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Reckless Leap
entries: The nemesis's long jump is up to 20 with or without running start. If the nemesis jumps at least 20 feet, it may land in the space of any Medium or smaller creature.

A creature whose space the nemesis lands in must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. On a successful save, the nemesis falls {@condition prone} in the nearest unoccupied space.

trait.name: Stack Formation
entries: If the battlestack falls {@condition prone} and does not immediately stand, it splits into two nemesis motes, each with half the battlestack's current hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The battlestack makes three attacks; one with its heavy jian and two with its butterfly blades.

action.name: Heavy Jian
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage. On a critical hit, attacks against the target are made at advantage until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Butterfly Blades
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.
Instead of dealing damage, the nemesis may impose disadvantage on the next attack the target makes before the beginning of the nemesis' next turn.

reaction.name: Tumbling Strike
entries: As a reaction when the battlestack misses with a melee attack, the battlestack may make another melee attack. If it does, the battlestack falls {@condition prone}.

action.name: Seven Star Rod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) bludgeoning damage. A creature that is not wearing metal armor takes an additional 2 ({@damage 1d4}) damage.

action.name: Vicious Kick
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage. A {@condition prone} target takes an additional 3 ({@damage 1d6}) damage.

reaction.name: Tumbling Strike
entries: As a reaction when the nemesis misses with a melee attack, the nemesis may make another melee attack. If it does, the nemesis falls {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Flip Up
entries: As a reaction when a Medium or smaller allied creature falls {@condition prone} within 5 feet of it, the nemesis returns it to its feet.

variant.name: Variant Rule: Life Pool
entries: When the nemesis dies, up to one nemesis within 30 feet gains 11 ({@dice 2d10}) cumulative temporary hit points. Then, if it has 100 or more temporary hit points, the nemesis loses all temporary hit points and transforms into a Nemesis Warlord.
Wargear Options:

items.name: Chang Gun Vaultstaff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) bludgeoning damage. Before or after making this attack, the nemesis may jump up to 20 feet.

items.name: Guandao Polesword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d10 + 2}) slashing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the nemesis may force the target to succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or drop one item it is holding.

items.name: Oxtail Dao Broadsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) slashing damage. This attack is made at advantage if attacking from a higher elevation than the target.

items.name: Dual Goose-Quill Dao
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) slashing damage. If this attack hits, the nemesis may make an attack with this weapon as a Bonus Action this turn.

items.name: Heavy Jian
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage. On a critical hit, attacks against the target are made at advantage until the beginning of its next turn.

items.name: Jian Twinblades
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage. If this attack hits, the nemesis may make an attack with this weapon as a Bonus Action this turn.

items.name: Iron Slip Mace
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 ft. away.

items.name: Butterfly Blades
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage. trait.name: Turbulent Currents
entries: Ranged attacks against the nemesis from more than 30 feet away are made at disadvantage.

trait.name: Whirlwind
entries: The nemesis rides upon a 5-foot-radius whirlwind that extends ten feet below it. When a creature starts its turn in the area, the nemesis may force it to succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 13}) in the whirlwind's space and carried aloft, rising up 5 feet.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sealmage makes two attacks with its impure infusion.

action.name: Impure Infusion
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 60 ft., one target. {@h}The target loses 9 ({@dice 2d8}) hit points, then gains the same number of cumulative temporary hit points, which last for one minute.
For each 5 of these temporary hit points a creature has, its movement speed is reduced by 5 and it subtracts 1 from saving throws that it makes.

action.name: Cursed Seal {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature the sealmage can see that is affected by its Impure Infusion must succeed on a {@dc 13} Charisma saving throw or be sealed inside a paper sutra, which falls to the ground in the creature's space, until the seal is destroyed.
The seal is an object and can be destroyed (AC 10, 1 HP). The sealed creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns for the next minute, ending the effect on a success.
When the effect ends, the creature appears in the unoccupied space nearest to the seal on a success.

action.name: Unseal Nemesis (3/Day)
entries: The sealmage breaks a magic sutra, conjuring a nemesis mote in an unoccupied location it can see within 15 feet.

trait.name: Heavenly Abhorrence

trait.name: Reckless Leap
