trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the nemesis may spend half of its movement to attempt a {@dc 14} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the nemesis. While climbing on the nemesis, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the nemesis, and the nemesis has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

trait.name: Legendary Resistances (3/Day)
entries: If the nemesis fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The nemesis makes three attacks, one of which may with with its skewering jian.

action.name: Skewering Jian
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}25 ({@damage 3d12 + 6}) piercing damage and the target is pushed 15 feet away.

action.name: Executioner Dao
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d6 + 6}) slashing damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away.
Each creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

action.name: Crushing Grasp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 18}). A creature {@condition grappled} in this way cannot breathe.

action.name: Hurl Creature (Requires a Grappled creature)
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 10} to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d6 + 7}) bludgeoning damage. On a hit or miss, the thrown creature takes the attack's damage.

reaction.name: Tumbling Strike
entries: As a reaction when the nemesis misses with a melee attack, the nemesis makes an attack with its crushing grasp. If it does, the nemesis falls {@condition prone}.

legendary.name: Killing Intent
entries: The nemesis fixes a menacing gaze on a creature it can see within 30 feet. The creature must succeed on {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the beginning of the nemesis' next turn.

legendary.name: Carp Kick
entries: If the nemesis is {@condition prone}, it leaps to its feet. Each creature within 5 ft. is pushed 5 ft. away.

legendary.name: Invincible Body
entries: The nemesis gains immunity to the next source of damage that it is resistant to it receives before the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Spying Eye
entries: The otyugh has advantage on checks made to hide while submerged in filth.

trait.name: Horrid Stench
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the Otyugh must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Intrusive Presence
entries: The neo-otyugh can detect the surface thoughts of each creature within 120 feet. Affected creatures are aware of the otyugh's mental presence.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The otyugh makes three attacks, one of which may be with its diseased bite or its disgusting lure.

action.name: Diseased Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or contract {@disease filth fever|ConfC}.

action.name: Spined Tentacle
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d10 + 5}) bludgeoning damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}). The otyugh has two tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.

action.name: Tentacle Slam {@recharge 5}
entries: The otyugh slams up to two creatures {@condition grappled} by it into each other or a solid surface. Each creature must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or take 15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage and be {@condition stunned} until the end of the otyugh's next turn, or take half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Disgusting Lure
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with a ranged attack or harmful spell, the otyugh forces the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 12} Intelligence saving throw or use all of its remaining movement to approach the otyugh by the most direct path.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The neogi can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Pharyngeal Jaws
entries: When the neogi hits a creature with a bite attack, it may make another bite attack against the same creature as a bonus action. If it does, it latches on to the creature. While latched, the neogi moves with the target and cannot use its bite until it uses an action to free itself.

trait.name: Bloated Body

trait.name: Mind Sense
entries: The neothelid knows the number and direction of each creature with an Intelligence score of 4 or higher within 1 mile of it.

trait.name: Non-Euclidian
entries: The space in a 5 foot radius around the neothelid is difficult terrain for non-aberrations, as the neothelid's presence warps it into incomprehensible geometries.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The neothelid has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the neothelid fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The neothelid makes four attacks with its tentacles, one of which it may replace with a swallow.

action.name: Tentacles
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d8 + 8}) bludgeoning damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) psychic damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 21}).

action.name: Swallow
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by two or more tentacles must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or be swallowed by the neothelid. A swallowed creature is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the neothelid, and it takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) acid damage at the start of each of the neothelid's turns.

If the neothelid takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the neothelid must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall {@condition prone} in the nearest unoccupied spaces. If the neothelid dies, a swallowed creature is no longer {@condition restrained} by it and can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting {@condition prone}.

action.name: Brain-Stripper Enzyme Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The neothelid disgorges a torrent of acid in a 60 ft. cone that dissolves bone and flesh but leaves fat and nerves behind. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or be covered in the enzyme until a creature uses its action to scrape or wash it off. A creature covered in the enzyme takes 35 ({@damage 10d6}) acid damage at the start of each of its turns.

reaction.name: Telekinetic Draw
entries: As a reaction to passing a saving throw against a spell, the neothelid forces the spell's caster to succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be pulled 15 ft. toward the neothelid.

reaction.name: Wild Thrash
entries: As a reaction to taking 30 or more damage in a turn, the neothelid thrashes about. Each creature within 15 ft. of it is pushed up to 15 ft. away. A creature that cannot move the full 15 ft. additionally takes 18 ({@damage 4d8}) bludgeoning damage.

reaction.name: Psychic Crush
entries: As a reaction a creature reducing it below 80 hit points, the neothelid attempts to crush its mind with brute psionic force. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 16} Intelligence saving throw or drop to 0 hit points, or take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) psychic damage on a success.

trait.name: Blessings of the Sea
entries: The nereid's favor may be gained by casting offerings of blood, honey or libations into the sea. If the nereid finds the offering sufficient, it may bestow any of the following blessings upon a ship and its crew:

items.name: Impelled
entries: The ship's speed increases by 50% and its crew gains a swim speed equal to its movement speed for the duration of its journey.

items.name: Unerring
entries: Winds and currents will not push the ship from its course.

items.name: Unmistakeable
entries: The ship's crew has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks for the duration of the voyage.

items.name: Shoaling Host
entries: The ship is accompanied on its journey by waters teeming with fish.

trait.name: Nymph Magic Resistance
entries: On solstices and equinoxes, the nereid may add its Charisma bonus to saving throws against any spell or magical effect that targets only it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The nereid makes three attacks with its shucking knife, one of which it may replace with its parting touch, if available.

action.name: Shucking Knife
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a vehicle or is wearing heavy armor, this attack is made at advantage and deals an additional 4 ({@damage 1d8}) damage.

action.name: Parting Touch (concentration)
entries: One creature within 5 ft must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} for the next minute. While {@condition charmed} in this way, a creature takes 3 ({@dice 1d6}) nonlethal psychic damage at the start of each of its turn for each 5 ft. away from the nereid that it is.
A {@condition charmed} creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

reaction.name: Curse of Bounty (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 59 hit points, the nereid forces one creature it can see within 60 ft. to succeed on a {@dc 14} Charisma saving throw or be cursed. While cursed in this way, a creature that is at sea has its pockets continually fill with gold pieces.

If the creature is swimming, it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw at the beginning of each of its turns or descend 60 ft. If the creature is in a boat or ship, the ship instead continually fills with gold. A ship begins to capsize after {@dice 1d12} hours of harboring a cursed creature.
The gold turns to sand if this curse is removed, or if the cursed creature sets foot on land.

trait.name: Blessings of the Sea
entries: The nereid's favor may be gained by casting offerings of blood, honey or libations into the sea. If the nereid finds the offering sufficient, it may bestow any of the following blessings upon a ship and its crew:

items.name: Impelled
entries: The ship's speed increases by 50% and its crew gains a swim speed equal to its movement speed for the duration of its journey.

items.name: Unerring
entries: Winds and currents will not push the ship from its course.

items.name: Unmistakeable
entries: The ship's crew has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks for the duration of the voyage.

items.name: Shoaling Host
entries: The ship is accompanied on its journey by waters teeming with fish.

trait.name: Nymph Magic Resistance
entries: On solstices and equinoxes, the nereid may add its Charisma bonus to saving throws against any spell or magical effect that targets only it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The nereid makes three attacks with its shucking knife, one of which it may replace with its parting touch, if available.

action.name: Shucking Knife
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d4 + 5}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a vehicle or is wearing heavy armor, this attack is made at advantage and deals an additional 18 ({@damage 4d8}) damage.

action.name: Parting Touch
entries: One creature within 5 ft must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} for the next minute. While {@condition charmed} in this way, a creature takes 7 ({@dice 2d6}) nonlethal psychic damage at the start of each of its turn for each 5 ft. away from the nereid that it is.
A {@condition charmed} creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Conjure Tempest
entries: The nereid summons a storm to follow a ship. The storm begins mild and gradually worsens every hour until the boat either reaches dry land, capsizes, or its crew makes offerings to the nereid sufficient to appease it. If the nereid is killed, the storm abates only once the ship has sunk.

reaction.name: Curse of Bounty (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 98 hit points, the nereid forces one creature it can see within 60 ft. to succeed on a {@dc 16} Charisma saving throw or be cursed. While cursed in this way, a creature that is at sea has its pockets continually fill with gold pieces.

If the creature is swimming, it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw at the beginning of each of its turns or descend 60 ft. If the creature is in a boat or ship, the ship instead continually fills with gold. A ship begins to capsize after {@dice 1d12} hours of harboring a cursed creature.
The gold turns to sand if this curse is removed, or if the cursed creature sets foot on land.

trait.name: Delicate Wings
entries: If Neria takes any fire damage, her fly speed is reduced by 10 feet until she completes a Short or Long Rest.

trait.name: Doctrine of the Mean
entries: Whenever Neria makes a saving throw, she can treat the result rolled as a 10. If this reduces the actual result rolled, Neria gains 5 ({@dice 1d10}) temporary hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Neria makes two attacks with her Dancing Claymore, one of which she can replace with a use of her Fortress Defense.

action.name: Dancing Claymore
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@dice 2d6 + 5}) slashing plus 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage.

action.name: Strike Spell
entries: Neria swings her blade through a magical effect produced by a spell of 3rd level or lower within 10 feet, ending it and absorbing its energy.
For the next minute, attacks made with her Dancing Claymore deal an additional 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage.

action.name: Fortress Defense
entries: Until the beginning of her next turn, Neria can take a reaction on each turn in combat.

reaction.name: Sweeping Rebuff
entries: When a creature enters her reach, Neria can make a Dancing Claymore attack against it with advantage. On a hit, the target is additionally pushed 5 feet away.

reaction.name: Mothdream Dust
entries: When Neria is hit with a melee attack, she can shed soporific scales from her wings.
The attacker must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or fall asleep for the next minute, or until a creature wakes it as an action or by dealing damage to it.

trait.name: Manflesh Appetite
entries: When the manticore reduces a humanoid creature to 0 hit points, each other humanoid creature within 15 feet of the manticore must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of the manticore's next turn.

trait.name: Relish Terror
entries: At the beginning of each of its turns, the manticore gains 5 temporary hit points for each {@condition frightened} creature it can see within 30 feet of it.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The manticore has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Legendary Resistances (2/Day)
entries: If the manticore fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The manticore makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Three-Grins Bite.

action.name: Three-Grins Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d10 + 5}) piercing damage.
A Large or smaller creature killed by this attack is swallowed whole.

action.name: Tormenting Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) slashing damage.
This attack deals an additional 3 ({@damage 1d6}) piercing damage for each spine embedded in the target.

action.name: Fling Spines
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 8} to hit, range 100 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) piercing damage and the spine embeds in the target's flesh.
Until a creature removes the spine as an action or bonus action, the target's speed is reduced by 5 feet for each spine embedded in it.

action.name: Bulrush Tail Sting {@recharge 5}
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) piercing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage.
At the end of the target's next turn, if the creature has a Constitution score of 16 or lower it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or drop to 0 hit points.

reaction.name: Cruel Jest
entries: As a reaction when a creature attempts to leave the manticore's reach, the manticore forces it to make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw.
On a failed save, the target takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) slashing damage, is dragged 5 feet toward the manticore, and the manticore regains its reaction.

reaction.name: Roared Laughter
entries: As a reaction when the manticore succeeds on a saving throw it lets out a terrifying roar of bestial laughter.
Each creature within 30 feet that can hear it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of the manticore's next turn.

legendary.name: Fling Spines
entries: The manticore makes an attack with its Fling Spines.

legendary.name: Pouncing Swipe
entries: The manticore leaps up to 20 feet, then may force one creature within 5 feet of it to succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) slashing damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.

legendary.name: Ironspine Tail Sweep
entries: The manticore sweeps its bristling tail in a 15 foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) piercing damage and be pushed up to 10 feet away.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: While out of water, Niba can hold her breath for 1 hour.

trait.name: Underwater Camouflage
entries: Niba has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks and {@skill Deception} (Charisma) checks made to impersonate natural terrain or another aquatic creature.

trait.name: Boneless
entries: Niba can move through a space as narrow as 1 feet wide without squeezing.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Niba makes two attacks, one of which she may replace with her Quaff Rum, if available.

action.name: Rigging Blade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Tentacles
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}).

action.name: Quaff Rum
entries: If Niba has not used her Throw Bottle, she gains 5 temporary hit points that last a minute, then must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the beginning of her next turn.

action.name: Throw Bottle (1/Day)
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@dice 1d4 + 4}) bludgeoning plus 2 ({@damage 1d4}) slashing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Guardian Parry
entries: As a reaction when Niba or a creature she is riding on is targeted with a melee attack, she adds +2 to the target's AC against that attack.

reaction.name: Ink Cloud (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 33 hit points while underwater, Niba exudes a 20-foot-radius cloud of ink, then moves up to half her speed and attempts to {@action Hide}.
The area is heavily obscured for 1 minute, although a significant current can disperse the ink.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The hag has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Illusory Mimicry
entries: The hag can mimic the voice or appearance of any animal or humanoid it knows the name of. A creature can discern the nature of these illusions with a successful {@dc 14} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check.

trait.name: Debt Keeper
entries: A creature that is indebted to the hag is psychically connected to it. The hag can telepathically communicate with it over any distance and can choose to perceive through its senses. Once per day, the hag can force an indebted creature to reroll an attack, ability check, or saving throw, taking the second result.

trait.name: Soultaker Coven
entries: Humanoid creatures within 100 miles of a coven of night hags feel drawn to the coven's location in times of desperation. While part of a coven, the hag's hellish portal does not close when a creature falls into it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hag makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Fiendish Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}). While {@condition grappled} in this way, the creature has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.

action.name: Hellish Portal (concentration) {@recharge 5}
entries: The hag opens a rift to a hellish demplane, 10 ft. long and 5 ft. wide, on a surface within 60 ft. A creature standing in the rift's space when it appears or that enters it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone} in an unoccupied space adjacent to the rift. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more falls in. If one or more creatures fall into the rift, the rift closes.

A creature that falls into the rift takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) psychic damage, 21 ({@damage 6d6}) fire damage, and ages 21 ({@dice 6d6}) years, and is {@condition incapacitated} until the beginning of its next turn, when it reappears in the space it left. The aging Effect can be reversed with a {@spell Greater Restoration} spell.

action.name: Etherealness
entries: The hag magically enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa. To do so, the hag must have a heartstone in her possession.

action.name: Nightmare Haunting (1/Day)
entries: While on the Ethereal Plane, the hag magically touches a sleeping humanoid on the Material Plane, afflicting it with dreadful nightmares. If this contact persists for an hour, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or gain no benefit from its rest, and its hit point maximum is reduced by 5 ({@dice 1d10}).

If this effect reduces the target's hit point maximum to 0, the target dies, and if the target was indebted to the hag, its soul is trapped in the hag's soul bag. The reduction to the target's hit point maximum lasts until removed by the {@spell greater restoration} spell or similar magic.

A creature that is wearing a silver protective talsiman, or one that has had a Protection From Good And Evil spell cast on it in the last 8 hours makes this save at advantage. A creature that succeeds on this saving throw by 5 or more awakes, dragging the hag into the waking world with it. The hag appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the target, and cannot use its Etherealness ability for the next minute.

reaction.name: Offer Bargain
entries: As a reaction to a creature it can see failing a saving throw, the hag grants it the ability to choose to succeed instead. A creature that does is Indebted to the hag.

reaction.name: True Magic (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to a creature it can see wihthin 60 ft. casting a spell, the hag disrupts the magic. The spell fails, and the spell caster takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage per level of the spell and must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned}.

trait.name: Instinctive Hibernation
entries: Whenever the scavver takes cold damage, if it has fewer than 10 hit points remaining it falls asleep for the next minute.

trait.name: Electrosensitive
entries: If the scavver takes any lightning damage, it has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Obdurate
entries: If forced to move from a space, the night scavver always returns to the space it was moved from on its following turn, or to the nearest unoccupied space it can reach.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}27 ({@damage 4d10 + 5}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}). This attack is made at advantage against a creature that is missing any of its hit points.

action.name: Broadside Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 4d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 ft. away.
If the target is a ship, each creature on board must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Push Back
entries: As a reaction when a creature fails at an attempt to shove the scavver, the scavver forces the creature to succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away.

trait.name: Annihilating Aura
entries: A living creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the nightcrawler must make a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage, or 21 ({@dice 6d6}) if it inside the nightcrawler.

trait.name: Light Eater
entries: The area in a 1 mile radius around the nightcrawler is illuminated with dim light. Nonmagical sources of bright light are instantly extinguished in this area, as are areas of light created by a spell of 3rd level or lower. Celestial bodies appear to be eclipsed. If the nightcrawler starts its turn in Bright Light, it takes 25 radiant damage.

trait.name: Anti-Life Nature
entries: If the nightcrawler would receive magical healing, it instead must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the spellcaster's save DC or take an equal amount of radiant damage, or half as much on a success. On a success or failure, attacks made against the nightcrawler have advantage until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The nightcrawler can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

trait.name: Gargantuan Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the nightcrawler may spend its full movement to attempt a {@dc 16} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the nightcrawler. While climbing on the nightcrawler, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the nightcrawler.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the nightcrawler fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The nightcrawler attacks twice with its Utterblack Bile.

action.name: Corpsechurn Maw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}30 ({@damage 4d10 + 8}) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed. A swallowed creature is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, and its attacks bypass the nightcrawler's damage resistances.

If the nightcrawler takes 20 or more radiant damage from a single source, it must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall {@condition prone} in a space within 10 feet of the nightcrawler. If the nightcrawler dies, a swallowed creature is no longer {@condition restrained} by it and can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting {@condition prone}.

action.name: Utterblack Bile
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 30 ft., one target. {@h}27 ({@damage 6d8}) necrotic damage and the target is coated in inky black bile. Until a creature takes an action to clear it, if the creature casts a spell, the spell doesn't take effect until the beginning of its following turn.

action.name: Terror From the Deep (Recharges when the Nightcrawler uses its Rotting Regurgitation)
entries: The nightcrawler moves up to its burrow speed, then bursts from underground thrashing in a flurry of debris. Each creature in a 15 foot radius must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or take 28 ({@damage 8d6}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}, or half damage on a success. As a Bonus Action, the nightcrawler may make a bite attack against a creature that failed this saving throw.

action.name: Rotting Regurgitation {@recharge 5}
entries: A tide of corpses spews forth from the nightcrawler in a 30 foot cone. The area becomes difficult terrain, and each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 5d8}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}, or take half as much damage on a success.
At initiative count 0, 10 ({@dice 3d6}) of the corpses rise as {@creature zombie rotter|ConfC|Zombie Rotters}.

monster.name: Nightmare Cursebearer
languages: understands Common and Infernal but can't speak

trait.name: Embrace of Flames
entries: A creature riding the nightmare has resistance to fire damage.

trait.name: Mourning Haunt
entries: The nightmare appears in the dreams of those who have recently lost a close companion, Cursing those who choose to mount the nightmare in their dreams.

A creature {@condition cursed|confc|cursed} in this way is plagued by terrible dreams, and the nightmare takes form on the Material Plane after {@dice 1d10} days, appearing to the creature at a moment when it is alone.
If this Curse is removed, the nightmare vanishes, returning to the Ethereal Plane.

action.name: Hellshod Hooves
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away.

action.name: Leech Sorrow (1/Day)
entries: One creature {@condition cursed|confc|cursed} by the nightmare takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) psychic damage, then both that creature and the nightmare gain an equal number of temporary hit points.

reaction.name: Gift of Wounds
entries: When the nightmare is hit with an attack, it can force a creature {@condition cursed|confc|cursed} by its Mourning Haunt ability to make a {@dc 12} Charisma saving throw.
On a failed save, the nightmare takes half as much damage from the attack and the creature takes the same amount.

reaction.name: Ashen Demise
entries: When the nightmare is reduced to 0 hit points, its flesh turns to toxic ash and bursts in a 15 foot radius, leaving only charred bones behind.

Each creature in the area when it appears must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage and begin {@condition choking|confc|choking} until the end of its next turn.

monster.name: Nightmare Hellsteed
languages: understands Common and Infernal but can't speak

trait.name: Embrace of Flames
entries: A creature riding the nightmare has resistance to fire damage.

action.name: Hellshod Hooves
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away.

action.name: Burning Trail {@recharge 5}
entries: The nightmare moves up to 60 feet in a straight line, leaving a trail of hellfire behind it. Each creature in its path must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}, moving to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.
Until the beginning of the nightmare's next turn, a creature that starts its turn in the affected area or enters it for the first time on a turn takes 16 ({@damage 3d10}) fire damage.

action.name: Ember-Way Break
entries: The nightmare lunges against the barrier between the Ethereal and Material plane, taking 11 ({@damage 2d10}) force damage and tearing open a ragged portal large enough for it to pass through that seals itself shut after a minute.

reaction.name: Offer Service
entries: When the nightmare is reduced to 0 hit points, before falling {@condition unconscious} it can kneel and offer its service to a creature it can see.
If the creature accepts, the creature loses half its current hit points and the nightmare regains an equal amount of hit points.

reaction.name: Burn Out
entries: When the nightmare is reduced to 0 hit points, before falling {@condition unconscious} the nightmare can begin to shake and squeal, its flesh cracking with flame.
At the beginning of the nightmare's next turn, it dies and explodes. Each creature within 20 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) fire damage.

trait.name: Annihilating Aura
entries: A living creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the nightwing must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) necrotic damage and grant the nightwalker advantage on attack rolls against it until the start of the creature's next turn.

trait.name: Light Eater
entries: The area in a 1 mile radius around the nightwalker is illuminated with dim light. Nonmagical sources of bright light are instantly extinguished in this area, as are areas of light created by a spell of 4th level or lower. Celestial bodies appear to be eclipsed. If the nightwalker starts its turn in Bright Light, it takes 25 radiant damage.

trait.name: Anti-Life Nature
entries: If the nightwalker would receive magical healing, it instead must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the spellcaster's save DC or take an equal amount of radiant damage, or half as much on a success. On a success or failure, attacks made against the nightwalker have advantage until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the nightwalker may spend half of its movement to attempt a {@dc 14} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the nightwalker. While climbing on the nightwalker, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the nightwalker.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The nightwalker makes two attacks with its enervating focus, one of which it may replace with a use of its Finger of Doom, if available.

action.name: Enervating Focus
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}28 ({@damage 5d8 + 6}) necrotic damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw or have its hit point maximum reduced by the same amount until it finishes a Long Rest.

action.name: Drown in Death (Concentration)
entries: One creature within 120 feet that is in Dim Light or Darkness must succeed on a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw or fall into its shadow (escape {@dc 21}). A creature that fails this save by 5 or more cannot hold its breath.

While in its shadow, a creature is {@condition blinded}, cannot breathe, and takes 45 ({@damage 10d8}) necrotic damage at the end of each of its turns. A creature that ends its turn in its shadow while afflicted with a Curse of Doom ceases to exist and can't be revived by any means short of a {@spell Wish} spell.

action.name: Finger of Doom {@recharge 5}
entries: The nightwalker points at one creature it can see within 300 feet. The target must succeed on a {@dc 21} Charisma saving throw or be afflicted with a Curse of Doom.

While cursed in this way, the creature acquires a Doom counter each time it takes necrotic damage. If the creature drops to 0 hit points while cursed, it immediately fails one Death Save for each Doom counter it has.

trait.name: Annihilating Aura
entries: A living creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the nightwing must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) necrotic damage.

trait.name: Light Eater
entries: The area in a 1 mile radius around the nightwing is illuminated with dim light. Nonmagical sources of bright light are instantly extinguished in this area, as are areas of light created by a spell of 2nd level or lower. Celestial bodies appear to be eclipsed. If the nightwing starts its turn in Bright Light, it takes 25 radiant damage.

trait.name: Darkness Made Flesh

A creature within the areas of two or more nupperibos makes the saving throw with disadvantage.

trait.name: Scent-Reliant
entries: The nupperibo is blind in the presence of an overpowering scent, such as that produced by the {@spell Stinking Cloud} spell.

trait.name: Weak-Minded
entries: The nupperibo follows the most recent telepathic command it was given, if it understands it.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Chef's Panache
entries: Once on her turn as part of an attack with her Sashimi Slice, Nurma may attempt a {@dc 15} {@skill Performance} check, gaining Panache until the beginning of her next turn on a success. While Nurma has panache, she makes attacks at advantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Nurma makes two attacks with her Sashimi Slice, one of which she may replace with a use of her Wheelbarrow Charge or Hurl Octopus, if available.

action.name: Sashimi Slice
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Mahuna Slap
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

action.name: Wheelbarrow Charge {@recharge 5}
entries: Nurma moves up to her speed in a straight line. If this movement is stopped by a creature, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or take 4 ({@damage 1d8}) damage and be pushed 5 feet away for each 10 feet Nurma moved as part of this action.

action.name: Hurl Octopus (1/Day)
entries: If Nurma has Panache, she flings a live octopus in a the face of a creature within 15 feet. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the octopus is removed as an Action with a successful {@dc 13} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.

reaction.name: Fling Seasoning (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction when a creature ends its movement within 5 feet of Nurma while she has Panache, Nurma flings a handful of secret seasonings in the creature's face.The creature must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the end of its turn, and aquatic creatures with an Intelligence score of 3 or lower become hostile to the creature until it completes a Short or Long Rest.

trait.name: Venal Nature
entries: The yugoloth is always willing to accept a bribe rather than fight. A yugoloth will usually accept a rate of the yugoloth's challenge rating times 25 gp, though it may accept less.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: The nycaloth can't be affected or detected by spells of 3rd level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The nycaloth's weapon attacks are magical.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The nycaloth makes a claw attack and uses its teleport, or it makes a greataxe attack and uses its invisibility.

action.name: Greataxe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d12 + 5}) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or lose half its current HP. A creature that fails this save repeats it at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success or losing half its current HP on a failure.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled}.

action.name: Invisibility
entries: The Nycaloth magically turns {@condition invisible} until it attacks or until its {@status concentration} ends (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell).

action.name: Teleport
entries: The nycaloth magically teleports, along with any creatures it is grappling, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

trait.name: Captivating Visage
entries: A creature that can see the nymph treats all other creatures and objects as {@condition invisible}.

A creature that isn't {@condition charmed} or Surprised by the nymph can avert its eyes to avoid this effect at the beginning of its turn, instead treating the nymph as {@condition invisible} until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Nymph Magic Resistance
entries: On solstices and equinoxes, the nymph may add its Charisma bonus to saving throws against any spell or magical effect that targets only it.

action.name: Parting Touch (Concentration)
entries: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn).
A creature {@condition charmed} in this way takes 3 ({@dice 1d6}) nonlethal psychic damage at the start of each of its turn for each 5 feet away from the nymph that it is.

action.name: Entreat
entries: One creature {@condition charmed} by the nymph must use its reaction to move up to its speed toward and make an attack against a target of the nymph's choice.

action.name: Ensnare (1/Day)
entries: The nymph sets a faintly visible magical trap that lasts for a minute in a 5 foot radius centered on herself, which triggers the first time a nonfey creature enters the area.
The creature must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or fall {@condition unconscious} until it takes any damage or a creature uses its action to wake it.

reaction.name: Blinding Beauty (1/Day)
entries: When a creature that can see the nymph hits it with a melee attack, the nymph may force the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until it completes a Short or Long Rest.

trait.name: Captivating Visage

A creature that isn't {@condition charmed} or Surprised by the nymph can avert its eyes to avoid this effect at the beginning of its turn, instead treating the nymph as {@condition invisible} until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Eldritch Grace
entries: While the nymph is moving on her turn, she becomes indistinct and insubstantial, gaining resistance to all damage.

trait.name: Nymph Magic Resistance
entries: On solstices and equinoxes, the nymph may add its Charisma bonus to saving throws against any spell or magical effect that targets only it.

action.name: Whisper Game
entries: One creature within 10 feet of the nymph must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by her for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn).
Whenever a {@condition charmed} creature succeeds on a saving throw to end this effect, the nymph may force one creature within 10 feet of it to make a saving throw against the same effect.

action.name: Borrow Dreams
entries: One {@condition unconscious} creature within 5 feet of the nymph must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or take 21 ({@dice 6d6}) nonlethal psychic damage.
If the creature fails this saving throw by 5 or more, this damage does not wake it, and the nymph gains a number of temporary hit points equal to the damage dealt.
If the {@condition unconscious} creature awakes, the nymph loses any of these temporary hit points that it has and the creature gains an equal number of temporary hit points.

action.name: Ensnare (1/Day)

The creature must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or fall {@condition unconscious} until it takes any damage or a creature uses its action to wake it.

bonus.name: Parting Touch
entries: The nymph touches a {@condition charmed} creature within 5 feet. Until the {@condition charmed} effect ends for it, the creature takes 7 ({@dice 2d6}) nonlethal psychic damage at the beginning of each of its turns for each 5 feet away from the nymph that it is.

bonus.name: Entreat
entries: One creature {@condition charmed} by the nymph must use its reaction to move up to its speed toward and make an attack against a target of the nymph's choice.

trait.name: Tempered Soul
entries: If the acolyte ends its turn without dealing damage, it gains resistance to the first source of damage it takes before the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The acolyte makes two attacks with its Arming Sword, each of which it can replace with a use of its Valorous Aid or Guard Back.

action.name: Arming Sword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Valorous Aid
entries: The acolyte assists a creature within 5 feet, granting it advantage on the first attack or saving throw it makes before the end of its next turn.

action.name: Guard Back
entries: The acolyte shields a creature within 5 feet.
Until the beginning of the acolyte's next turn, attacks against the target can't gain advantage while it is within 5 feet of the acolyte.

reaction.name: Student of Arms
entries: When a friendly humanoid creature of CR 5 or greater that the acolyte can see within 30 feet hits a creature with a weapon attack, the acolyte can move up to half its speed and make an attack against the same target.

trait.name: Tempered Soul
entries: If the arbiter ends its turn without dealing damage, it gains resistance to the first source of damage it takes before the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Unyielding Will
entries: At the beginning of the arbiter's turn, each {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened} creature within 10 feet of it can make a saving throw to end the condition.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The arbiter makes two attacks with its Oathglow Partisan, each of which it can replace with a use of its Valorous Aid or Render Judgement.

action.name: Oathglow Partisan
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@dice 2d10 + 4}) piercing plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) radiant damage.

action.name: Valorous Aid
entries: The arbiter assists a creature within 5 feet, granting it advantage on the first attack or saving throw it makes before the end of its next turn.

action.name: Render Judgement (3rd Level Spell) {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature the arbiter can see within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 14} Charisma saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 3d8}) radiant damage and be {@condition cursed|confc|cursed}.
Whenever the cursed creature takes any damage, it takes an additional 4 ({@damage 1d8}) radiant damage if it reduced a creature to 0 hit points in the last hour.

reaction.name: Measured Mercy
entries: When the arbiter reduces a creature to 0 hit points, it can allow the target to yield.
If the target does, it is instead reduced to 1 hit point, and each of the target's allies within 30 feet gains disadvantage on attacks and Wisdom saving throws until the end of their next turn.

trait.name: Tempered Soul
entries: If the guardian ends its turn without dealing damage, it gains resistance to the first source of damage it takes before the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Unyielding Will
entries: At the beginning of the guardian's turn, each {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened} creature within 20 feet of it can make a saving throw to end the condition.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The guardian makes two attacks with its Guardian's Blade, one of which it can replace with a use of its Beacon of Valor.

action.name: Guardian's Blade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@dice 2d12 + 5}) piercing plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) radiant damage.
While this weapon is drawn, hostile creatures within 5 feet of its wielder have disadvantage on attacks that don't target a creature wielding this weapon.

action.name: Beacon of Valor (1st Level Spell)
entries: Each other friendly creature within 30 feet that can see the guardian gains advantage on the first attack or saving throw it makes before the end of its next turn.

action.name: Render Judgement (3rd Level Spell)
entries: One creature the guardian can see within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 16} Charisma saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 3d8}) radiant damage and be {@condition cursed|confc|cursed}.
Whenever the cursed creature takes any damage, it takes an additional 4 ({@damage 1d8}) radiant damage if it reduced a creature to 0 hit points in the last hour.

action.name: Peaceshroud (1/Day, 4th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: A stilling glow exudes from the guardian in a 30 foot radius for the next hour.

A creature that starts its turn in the area or enters it for the first time on a turn must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be unable to take hostile actions until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Measured Mercy

If the target does, it is instead reduced to 1 hit point, and each of the target's allies within 30 feet gain disadvantage on attacks and Wisdom saving throws until the end of their next turn.

reaction.name: Release the Blade (1/Day)
entries: When the guardian draws its blade for the first time that day, it can force each humanoid creature of its choice within 30 feet to succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition turned|confc|turned} for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn).

trait.name: Unyielding Will

trait.name: Fulcrum of the Balance
entries: Whenever the seneschal makes a saving throw against a spell or magical effect that imposes a condition, it can force a creature it can see within 30 feet to make a saving throw against the same effect.
Whenever a condition affecting the seneschal ends, it can end the same condition on a creature it can see within 30 feet.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The seneschal makes three attacks with its Guardian's Blade and uses its Beacon of Valor.

action.name: Guardian's Blade

While this weapon is drawn, hostile creatures within 5 feet of its wielder have disadvantage on attacks that don't target a creature wielding this weapon.

legendary.name: Quell Fury
entries: The seneschal places a hand on a creature within 5 feet, granting it advantage on Wisdom saving throws and disadvantage on attacks until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Render Judgement (3rd Level Spell)
entries: One creature the seneschal can see within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 18} Charisma saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 3d8}) radiant damage and be {@condition cursed|confc|cursed}.
Whenever the cursed creature takes any damage, it takes an additional 4 ({@damage 1d8}) radiant damage if it reduced a creature to 0 hit points in the last hour.

legendary.name: Guardian's Blade (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The seneschal moves up to half its speed and makes an attack with its Guardian's Blade.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a Bonus Action, the mimic can polymorph into a Medium object or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: False Appearance (Object Form Only)
entries: While the mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary object.

action.name: Ravening Maw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) acid damage.
This attack is made at advantage against a creature {@condition grappled} by the mimic.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}).

action.name: Sudden Lunge {@recharge 5}
entries: The mimic jumps up to 20 feet and may land in the space of any Medium or smaller creature. A creature whose space the mimic lands in must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone} and {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}).
A creature {@condition grappled} in this way is {@condition blinded}, can't speak or breathe, and takes 9 ({@dice 2d8}) acid damge at the start of each of its turns.

reaction.name: Adhesive Secretion
entries: As a reaction when a creature touches the mimic or hits it with an unarmed attack, the mimic grapples the creature (escape {@dc 13}).

reaction.name: Blinding Spray
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 46 hit points, the mimic launches a spray of blinding acid. Each creature within 20 feet must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or take 4 ({@damage 1d8}) acid damage and be {@condition blinded} until the end of the mimic's next turn.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The Oblex can move through a space as small as 1 inch without squeezing or slowing down.

trait.name: Aversion to Fire
entries: If the oblex takes fire damage, it has disadvantage on the next attack it makes before the end of its next turn.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) bludgeoning damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d4}) psychic damage.

reaction.name: Secret Mouth
entries: When a creature misses the oblex with a melee attack, it may use its reaction to make a pseudopod attack against the attacker.

trait.name: Oozing Master
entries: The jelly can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. It can occupy another creature's space and vice-versa.
Oozes within 500 feet with an intelligence score of 4 or lower act under the jelly's telepathic control, and have their movement speed increased by 10 feet.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The jelly can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Impelled Spawning
entries: When the jelly would be dealt any lightning or slashing damage, it can spawn an {@creature ochre jelly plurible|confc|Ochre Jelly Plurible} that acts on its initiative in an unoccupied space within 5 feet. If it does, the jelly loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The jelly makes two attacks with its Sloshing Pseudopod, each of which it can replace with a use of its Fleshfueled Regeneration.

action.name: Sloshing Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@dice 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) acid damage.
This attack has advantage against a target in the ooze's space.

action.name: Fleshfueled Regeneration
entries: The jelly dissolves the flesh from an intact corpse in its space, regaining 15 hit points.

action.name: Crawling Sparks (3rd Level Spell)
entries: A pulse of electricity spreads across a surface the jelly is touching, shocking each creature of the jelly's choice within 30 feet of the jelly and within 5 feet of that surface.

Each affected creature must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) lightning damage and be {@condition dazed|confc|dazed} until the end of its next turn, or take half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Vent Fumes {@recharge 5}
entries: The jelly spews dense, toxic fumes in a 20 foot radius, Heavily Obscuring the area until they dissipate at the end of its next turn.

A creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or take 7 ({@dice 2d6}) acid plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) poison damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Engulfing Wave
entries: When a creature moves within 10 feet of the jelly, it can lurch up to 10 feet, then force each creature whose space it entered in this way to succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}).

trait.name: Oozing Mass
entries: The jelly can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. It can occupy another creature's space and vice-versa.

entries: When the jelly is targeted with a spell of 1st level or above, it can deal 2 ({@damage 1d4}) lightning damage to itself and to each other creature in its space.
If it does, the spell instead targets one of the Ochre Jelly Pluribles created by its Impelled Division.

trait.name: Clockwork Repetition
entries: The octon may choose to treat any {@dice d20} roll as a 10, instead of rolling.

trait.name: Perfect Synchrony
entries: If the octon is within 30 feet of a septon, it uses the septon's attack bonus instead of its own. If the septon is using a hexton's attack bonus, the octon uses that instead, and so on.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The octon makes four attacks with its Teetering Tubes.

action.name: Teetering Tubes
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 bludgeoning damage.
On a roll of 1, the octon falls {@condition prone}. This attack is made at disadvantage if the octon is flying.

action.name: Spinlift Collar
entries: The octon extends its tubes and begins to rapidly spin its collar, gaining a fly speed equal to its movement speed until the end of its next turn.
Each creature within 10 feet of the octon must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take 24 slashing damage and be pushed 5 feet away, or take half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Cut Ribbon (1/Day)
entries: The octon reveals a set of magical, springloaded scissors that emerge from a door in its chest, cutting open a portal through which twelve monodrones immediately tumble forth, falling {@condition prone} in the nearest unoccupied spaces before the portal seals itself shut.

reaction.name: Upgrade
entries: As a reaction to seeing a septon within 60 feet die or transform, the octon may transform into a septon, retaining its current hit points. No more than one octon may take this reaction.

trait.name: Juggernaut
entries: The ogre may attempt to shove a creature as a bonus action. If it moves 20 feet before attempting to shove a creature, the ogre has advantage on the contested check, and on a success the target is knocked {@condition prone} and pushed 10 feet back.

trait.name: Reckless Follow-Through
entries: At the start of its turn, the ogre can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn. If it misses with an attack this turn, it falls {@condition prone} and is {@condition stunned} until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Spell Resistant Hide
entries: The ogre has resistance to damage from spells of third level or below.

action.name: Multiattack

action.name: Haymaker

action.name: Juggernaut Charge {@recharge 5}
entries: The ogre attempts to shove a creature. If it succeeds, it may make another shove attempt against the same target, and continue doing so until it fails or runs out of movement. The target then takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) bludgeoning damage for each 5 feet it was pushed.

trait.name: Jostling Horde
entries: A creature that starts its turn adjacent to one or more ogre chaff must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be pushed 5 ft. for each ogre it is adjacent to. A creature pushed 20 or more feet in this way falls {@condition prone}, additionally.

entries: One creature within 30 ft. summoned by the ogre's terrorbreach ironfist may use its reaction to move up to 30 ft. and make a melee attack.

action.name: Juggernaut Charge {@recharge 5}
entries: The ogre attempts to shove a creature. If it succeeds, it may make another shove attempt against the same target, and continue doing so until it fails or runs out of movement. The target then takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) bludgeoning damage for each 5 feet it was pushed.

reaction.name: Thousand Terrors Roar (Concentration, 1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 67 hit points, the ogre loses its immunity to the {@condition frightened} condition and manifests two of its own worst fears, each of which act on its turn and use the statistics of a {@creature common feyr|ConfC}.

trait.name: Juggernaut
entries: The ogre may attempt to shove a creature as a bonus action. If it moves 20 feet before attempting to shove a creature, the ogre has advantage on the contested check, and on a success the target is knocked {@condition prone} and pushed 10 feet back.

trait.name: Spell Resistant Hide
entries: The ogre has resistance to damage from spells of third level or below.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ogre makes three attacks with its manpulper flail.

action.name: Manpulper Flail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d10 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.
A creature hit twice by this attack in a turn must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or fall {@condition prone} and be unable to stand on its following turn.

action.name: Bullrend Charge
entries: The ogre attempts to shove a creature. If it succeeds, it may make another shove attempt against the same target, and continue doing so until it fails or runs out of movement. The target then takes 6 ({@damage 1d12}) bludgeoning damage for each 5 feet it was pushed.

action.name: Bellowsbreath {@recharge 5}
entries: The ogre swallows a volatile mixture of arcane ingredients, then belches out a torrent of flame. Each creature in a 30 ft. cone must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 28 ({@damage 8d6}) fire damage, or half as much on a success. The ogre takes half the effect's damage.

reaction.name: Trollguts Gorging
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 85 hit points, the ogre eats a mess of troll guts and must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for the next minute.

On a success or failure, the ogre regains 10 hit points at the start of each of its turns for the next minute. The ogre does not regenerate if it took fire or acid damage since the end of its last turn.

monster.name: Ogre Zombie Fleshsiege
languages: understands Common and Giant but can't speak

trait.name: Gatebreaker
entries: The zombie deals double damage to objects and structures.
If it reduces a Medium or larger object to 0 hit points, each creature in a 15 foot cone extending from the object takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) slashing damage from shrapnel.

trait.name: Undead Fortitude
entries: If the zombie starts its turn with 0 hit points, it makes a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw, unless it was dealt radiant damage or a critical hit since the end of its last turn. On a success, the zombie regains 1 hit point.

action.name: Manthresher Morningstar
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d10 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw.
On a failed save, the target is pushed 10 feet away, knocked {@condition prone}, and cannot stand for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn.)

action.name: Crushing Stomp
entries: One {@condition prone} creature within 5 feet of the ogre must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 3d8}) bludgeoning damage and be {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}) until the ogre moves.

A creature wearing metal armor that fails this saving throw has its armor deform. Until it doffs its armor, the creature is {@condition choking|confc|choking} and may use a Bonus Action to ignore this effect until the end of its turn.

reaction.name: Stumbling Sweep
entries: As a reaction when the zombie misses with a melee attack, it may make a second attack at disadvantage against another target in its reach. If the second attack misses, the zombie falls {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Titanic Stature
entries: Ogrémoch body is divided into several connected zones; a creature {@condition attached|confc|attached} to a zone has advantage on attacks that target Ogrémoch, and can use its full movement to make a {@dc 16} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) or Dexterity ({@skill Athletics}) check, climbing to an adjacent zone on a success.

items.name: Base
entries: A creature {@condition attached|confc|attached} to Ogremoch's base has advantage on saving throws against its Skyblot Slam, and takes no damage on a success.

items.name: Trunk
entries: A creature that hits Ogrémoch with a critical hit while attached to its trunk breaks open a crevice that a Medium creature can squeeze through, becoming {@condition swallowed|confc|swallowed}.

items.name: Arms
entries: A creature that succeeds on a saving throw against Ogrémoch's Skyblot Slam can use its reaction to attempt to climb onto Ogrémoch arms.

items.name: Head
entries: When Ogrémoch uses its Skyblot Slam, a creature {@condition attached|confc|attached} to Ogrémoch's head can use its action to shift the target by 25 ({@dice 1d10 * 5}) feet.

trait.name: Weathering Weakness
entries: If Ogrémoch is doused in water or takes any acid damage, the next attack that hits it ignores its damage resistances.

trait.name: Gemheart Core
entries: A creature {@condition swallowed|confc|swallowed} by Ogrémoch can access it's pulsing diamond heart; the heart has AC 25 and any hit against it becomes a critical against Ogrémoch.

trait.name: The Earth Unceasing (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
entries: When Ogrémoch is reduced to 0 hit points, it doesn't die or fall {@condition unconscious}. Instead, it resets to 253 hit points and the earth in a 500 foot radius around it becomes difficult terrain for the next hour.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If Ogrémoch fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Skyblot Slam
entries: Ogrémoch begins to swing a titanic fist at a 15 foot radius centered on a point within 60 feet.

At the beginning of Ogrémoch's next turn, each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 22} Constitution saving throw or take 101 ({@damage 2d100}) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Tectonic Wade
entries: Ogrémoch moves or burrows up to 50 feet in a straight line, tearing through the earth as it does.
Each creature and object in its path is pushed ahead of it, then must succeed on a {@dc 22} Strength saving throw or take 28 ({@damage 8d6}) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Boulderfall Cascade
entries: Each creature within 15 feet of Ogrémoch that isn't {@condition attached|confc|attached} to its Head must succeed on a {@dc 22} Dexterity saving throw or take 33 ({@damage 6d10}) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is knocked {@condition prone}.

legendary.name: Scrape Off
entries: Ogrémoch forces one creature within 60 feet of it to succeed on a {@dc 22} Dexterity saving throw or take 26 ({@damage 4d12}) bludgeoning damage, be knocked {@condition prone}, and be pushed up to 20 feet away.
On a success, the target takes no damage and Ogrémoch takes half the effect's damage.

legendary.name: Raise Spire
entries: A 10 foot radius pillar of stone rises 60 feet from the earth, centered on a point Ogrémoch can see within 300 feet.

legendary.name: Metamorphic Awakening
entries: Ogrémoch creates up to two earth elementals from his flesh with a total CR of up to 2 ({@dice 1d4}), or of up to 5 ({@dice 2d4}) if Ogrémoch's Mythic Trait is active.
The elementals act on initiative count 0, and Ogrémoch loses 10 hit points per CR of elemental created this way.

mythic.name: Earthcrest Quakewave
entries: A wave of earth ripples out from Ogrémoch in a 500 foot radius, forcing each creature on the ground in the area to succeed on a {@dc 22} Strength saving throw or be launched 20 feet into the air.

mythic.name: Creepstone Blight {@recharge 4}
entries: Each creature {@condition attached|confc|attached} to or {@condition swallowed|confc|swallowed} by Ogrémoch must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or gain 25 temporary hit points.

While it has any of these temporary hit points, a creature is {@condition restrained} and must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns or become {@condition petrified} until it loses them.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The yagnoloth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Venal Nature
entries: The yugoloth is always willing to accept a bribe rather than fight. An oinoloth will usually accept a rate of its challenge rating times 25 gp, or half as much for a creature willing to pledge a future service.

trait.name: Bringer of Plagues
entries: The Oinoloth is immune to the effects of disease. A creature that starts its turn within 30 ft. of the oinoloth must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or be infected with {@disease wastegash|ConfC}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The oinoloth makes two claw attacks and uses its Teleport or its Transfixing Gaze, if available.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) slashing damage plus 22 ({@damage 4d10}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Teleport (spell, 3rd level)
entries: The yagnoloth magically teleports up to 60 ft. to an unoccupied space it can see.

action.name: Transfixing Gaze {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature within 60 ft. that is infected with wasterot must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by the oinoloth for the next minute, or until its disease is cured. While {@condition charmed} in this way, the target does its best to follow the commands of the oinoloth, and repeats this save whenever it takes damage, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Wall of Vermin (1/Day)
entries: The oinoloth summons a wall of writhing vermin on a solid surface it can see within 60 feet of it. The wall counts as difficult terrrain, is 5 ft. thick and comprised of six contiguous segments each up to 10 feet long and 10 feet high. A creature that begins its turn in the wall or enters it for the first time on a turn must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or take 23 ({@damage 5d8}) piercing damage, or half as much on a success. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is infected with {@disease filth fever|ConfC}.

reaction.name: Dark Escape
entries: As a reaction to taking 20 or more damage from a single source, the oinoloth may shroud itself in a 20 foot radius cloud of magical darkness until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Corrupted Healing
entries: As a reaction to a creature within 30 ft. reciving magical healing, the oinoloth forces the creature to make a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw. A creature infected with a disease makes this save at disadvantage. On a failure, the creature has vulnerability to all damage for the next minute, and repeats this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The oni's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The oni regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point.

action.name: Multiattack (Oni Form Only)
entries: The oni uses makes one glaive attack and uses its creeping sleep ability.

action.name: Hidden Glaive
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d10 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away.

action.name: Creeping Sleep
entries: One creature within 15 feet must make a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the creature falls asleep until the end of its next turn. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more instead falls asleep for the next minute. A creature wakes up early if it takes damage or another creature uses its action to wake it.

action.name: Change Shape
entries: The oni magically polymorphs into a Small or Medium humanoid, into a cloud of black mist, or back into its true form. In its mist form, it cannot make attacks, has resistance to weapon damage, and can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. The only equipment that is transformed is its glaive, which shrinks so that it can be wielded in humanoid form. If the oni dies, it reverts to its true form, and its glaive reverts to its normal size.

action.name: Invisibility
entries: The oni becomes {@condition invisible} until it takes another action.

reaction.name: Mutable Form

Its statistics remain the same, except that as a head it has an AC of 18, and cannot use its multiattack. If the oni has 38 or more hit points, it may reattach its head as a bonus action.

action.name: Freezing Blast (1/Day, 5th level spell)
entries: Each creature in a 60 ft cone must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 41 ({@damage 9d8}) cold damage, or half damage on a success.

action.name: Lightning Strike
entries: Creatures in a 5 ft radius of a point within 60 feet must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 28 ({@damage 8d6}) lightning damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Creeping Sleep
entries: Up to two creatures within 15 feet must make a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the creature falls asleep until the end of its next turn. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more instead falls asleep for the next minute. A creature wakes up early if it takes damage or another creature uses its action to wake it.

action.name: Devour Soul
entries: One sleeping creature within 5 feet of the oni must make succeed on a {@dc 15} Intelligence saving throw or take 49 ({@damage 14d6}) psychic damage. This damage does not wake the creature. A creature that succeeds takes half damage, and does wake up.
