trait.name: Cultivated Blade
entries: Onimaru acts on its wielder's initiative in combat, instead of rolling its own.
If it is reduced to 0 hit points while not using its Spirit Manifestation, Onimaru falls {@condition unconscious} but is not destroyed unless targeted with an effect that can destroy magic items.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: The tsukumogami can't be affected or detected by cantrips unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Onimaru makes two attacks with its Seeking Slash, or three attacks if it has a spectral body manifested with its Demon-Spirit Draught.

action.name: Seeking Slash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) slashing damage.
If this attack targets a fiend, it scores a critical on a 17-20.

action.name: Steel-Flash Ring
entries: Each creature within 5 feet of Onimaru must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 11 ({@damage 2d10}) slashing damage.

reaction.name: Sailing Deflection
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of it is targeted with an attack, Onimaru can increase the target's AC by +3 against that attack.

reaction.name: Demon-Spirit Draught
entries: When Onimaru reduces or is used to reduce a fiend to 0 hit points, it can drink down the fiend's essence, gaining temporary hit points equal to the fiend's number of unexpended hit dice.
If Onimaru gains at least 20 temporary hit points in this way, it can manifest a spectral body to wield it that lasts for a minute.

trait.name: Bred Timidity
entries: The oortling has disadvantage on saving throws against being {@condition frightened}. Whenever the oortling starts its turn {@condition frightened}, it takes {@damage 1d8} psychic damage.

trait.name: Ice-Sculptor
entries: The oortling can manipulate and burrow through ice as though it were soft clay.

action.name: Toothless Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Suck Ice
entries: The oortling comforts itself by sucking some of the mineral-rich ice chips it carries with it. For the next minute, the oortling has resistance to psychic damage.
If the oortling takes any psychic damage, it cannot use this ability until it replenishes its ice supply.

reaction.name: Psychic Awakening
entries: As a reaction when the oortling fails a saving throw by 10 or more, roll a {@dice d100}. On a roll of 10 or below, the oortling undergoes a psychic awakening, gaining the Awakened Oortling trait.

variant.name: Note: Awakened Oortling
entries: As a Bonus Action, the oortling gains one of the following benefits until the beginning of its next turn.

items.name: Psychic Mirror
entries: Until the beginning of the Oortling's next turn, whenever it would take any psychic damage, the oortling takes no psychic damage and each non-oortling within 15 feet takes that amount of psychic damage instead.

items.name: Telekinetic Trip
entries: One creature within 20 feet that the oortling can see must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The myrmidon can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The myrmiddon makes three melee attacks, one of which it may replace with its Sticky Lunge, if available.

action.name: Clinging Cosh
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) slashing damage. This attack is made at advantage against a {@condition grappled} creature.

action.name: Sticky Lunge {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature within 5 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be {@condition grappled}. While {@condition grappled} by the myrmidon in this way, the target takes 5 ({@damage 2d4}) acid damage at the start of each of its turns.

reaction.name: Elemental Riposte
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack, the myrmidon unleashes a wave of ooze. The attacker must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 5 ({@damage 2d4}) acid damage and be covered in acid until a creature uses its action to scrape or wash the acid off. A creature covered in the acid takes 2 ({@damage 1d4}) acid damage at end of each of its turns.

reaction.name: Split
entries: When a myrmidon that is small or larger is subjected to slashing damage, it splits into two new mepits one size smaller than the original. Each new myrmidon has hit points equal to half the original myrmidon's, rounded down.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The mephit can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a 5 foot radius wave of acrid ooze. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 11} Dexterity saving throw or take 5 ({@damage 2d4}) acid damage and be covered in acid
Until a creature removes the acid as an action, a creature covered in it takes 2 ({@damage 1d4}) acid damage at end of each of its turns.

action.name: Gooey Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) slashing damage.
This attack is made with advantage against a {@condition grappled} creature.

reaction.name: Stick {@recharge}
entries: When the mephit is hit with a melee attack by a Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet, the mephit forces the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 11} Strength saving throw or be {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 11}).
A creature {@condition grappled} in this way takes 5 ({@damage 2d4}) acid damage at the beginning of each of its turns.

reaction.name: Split
entries: When the mephit takes any slashing damage, it splits into two new mephits that act on its initiative.
Each new mephit has hit points equal to half the original mephit's, rounded down, and can't take reactions.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The ooze scion can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Formless Grace
entries: If the ooze scion would take half damage due to succeeding on a saving throw while within 120 feet of Juiblex, it takes no damage instead.

trait.name: Acrimony of the Faceless Lord
entries: A creature that takes acid damage while within 5 feet of one or more ooze scions takes an additional 4 ({@damage 1d8}) acid damage for each ooze scion within 5 feet of it.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, the ooze scion can grapple the target (escape {@dc 13}).

reaction.name: Mitotic Division
entries: When the ooze scion takes damage of a type it is resistant to, it can create another

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The grung's long jump is up to 25 feet and its high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

trait.name: Toe Pads
entries: The grung can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, if it uses both hands and feet to climb.

trait.name: Poisonous Skin
entries: A creature that comes into contact with the grung's skin must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn. While {@condition poisoned} in this way, a creature is {@condition frightened} of its Allies.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The grung makes two attacks, one of which it may replace with its Aposematic Repulsion, if available.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage plus 5 ({@damage 2d4}) poison damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be affected by the grung's Poisonous Skin.

action.name: Vinewood Shortbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage plus 5 ({@damage 2d4}) poison damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be affected by the grung's Poisonous Skin.

action.name: Aposematic Repulsion {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature within 30 ft. that can see the grung and is not immune to the {@condition poisoned} condition must make a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature must use all of its movement on its following turn to move away from the grung.

reaction.name: Spring Away
entries: As a reaction to being missed with an attack, the grung moves up to its speed without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

trait.name: Aggressive
entries: As a Bonus Action, the orc can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature that it can see.

trait.name: Powerful Strikes
entries: If the orc moved at least 10 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a melee weapon attack, the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Greataxe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d12 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Javelin
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Savage Demise
entries: When the orc drops to 0 hit points, it may use its reaction to make a single attack before falling {@condition unconscious}.

trait.name: Aggressive
entries: As a Bonus Action, the orc can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature that it can see.

action.name: Orcish Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) piercing damage (The Orcish Longbow adds Strength and Dexterity to damage)

action.name: Mallet

reaction.name: Snap Shot
entries: As a reaction to a creature ending its movement closer to the orc than it started, the orc makes a longbow attack at disadvantage against it.

entries: When the orc drops to 0 hit points, it may use its reaction to make a single attack before falling {@condition unconscious}.

trait.name: Aggressive
entries: As a Bonus Action, the orc can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature that it can see.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the orc takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the orc takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

action.name: Hacking Flurry (Group Attack)

action.name: Dimension Door (1/Day, 4th level spell)

When a creature enters its reach
When a creature leaves its reach
When a creature within 5 feet of makes an attack against a target other than it.
If the attack hits, the creature's movement speed is reduced to 0 until the end of the turn.

reaction.name: Soul of Vengeance
entries: As a reaction, the Paladin may make a Halberd attack against a creature under the effect of its Vow of Enmity when that creature makes an attack.

variant.name: Note: Paladins are Complex
entries: Something I discovered putting this project together is that of all the classes, Paladins are the most irreducible. Which is to say, on any given turn in combat they have the most viable options for how to use their Action, Bonus Action, and Reaction. I really didn't expect that, to be honest. Even more so, if you take into account Find Greater Steed.

variant.name: Note: Find Greater Steed
entries: A high level paladin should always be riding something cool. Give them whatever CR 2 creature fits thematically to ride, then have it act on their turn. If you were already going to be using a more powerful monster in the encounter, have them riding that instead and have them act on the same turn in initiative.

trait.name: Evangel of the Four Winds
entries: Creatures with a fly speed within 300 feet of Pazuzu may {@action Dash} or {@action Disengage} as a Bonus Action, and have disadvantage on attacks made against him.

trait.name: Perfidious Aid
entries: When another creature that Pazuzu can see fails a saving throw, he may allow it to reroll the save, taking the second result.
If it does, the creature takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage as a Mark of Corruption sears itself into the creature's flesh.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Pazuzu has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Madness of the Lower Aerie (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
entries: When Pazuzu is reduced to 0 hit points, he doesn't die or fall {@condition unconscious}. Instead, he resets to 291 hit points and each creature with a Mark of Corruption explosively sprouts a number of ragged, bloody wings, losing half its current hit points and gaining a fly speed equal to its movement speed.

trait.name: Legendary Resistances (5/Day)
entries: If Pazuzu fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Pazuzu makes three attacks with his Spear of the Stolen Winds.

action.name: Spear of the Stolen Winds
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d10 + 6}) piercing damage and the target suffers one of the following effects:

items.name: Wind of Dreams
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 22} Strength saving throw or be launched up to 30 feet in any direction, and be magically unaffected by gravity until the beginning of its next turn.

items.name: Wind of Awakening
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 22} Charisma saving throw or gain vulnerability to damage from falling until the end of the turn and have each spell and magical effect on it end.

action.name: Heartrot Tail Sting
entries: One creature within 10 feet of Pazuzu must succeed on a {@dc 24} Constitution saving throw or take 54 ({@dice 12d8}) necrotic plus 42 ({@damage 12d6}) poison damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Pestilent Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: Pazuzu exhales a plague of abyssal locusts in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in the area loses {@status concentration}, if it was holding it, and must succeed on a {@dc 22} Constitution saving throw or take 36 ({@dice 8d8}) piercing plus 28 ({@damage 8d6}) poison damage, or half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Devouring Rain (9th Level Spell, Concentration) (Recharges when Pazuzu uses his Pestilent Breath)
entries: An acrid rain begins to fall in a 15 foot radius, 300 foot tall cylinder centered on a point Pazuzu can see within 300 feet.

A creature that starts its turn in the area, or that enters it for the first time on a turn, must succeed on a {@dc 22} Constitution saving throw or take 44 ({@damage 8d10}) acid damage, or half as much on a success. A creature killed by this damage melts and is disintegrated.

reaction.name: Feign Weakness (Recharges when Pazuzu voluntarily fails a saving throw)
entries: When Pazuzu fails a saving throw, he can fall {@condition prone}.
If a creature enters his reach before the beginning of his next turn, Pazuzu may immediately stand from {@condition prone} and make a melee attack against it.

reaction.name: Bloodied Corruption (1/Day, 6th Level Spell)
entries: When Pazuzu's mythic trait becomes active, he can force one creature he can see with a Mark of Corruption to succeed on a {@dc 22} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition dominated|confc|dominated} by him.
The {@condition dominated|confc|dominated} creature repeats this saving throw whenever it takes damage, ending the effect on a success.

legendary.name: Favorable Currents
entries: One creature with a fly speed that Pazuzu can see can use its reaction to move up to half its speed and make a melee attack.

legendary.name: Traveling Storm
entries: Pazuzu moves the effect of his Devouring Rain up to 30 feet.

legendary.name: Wind of Folly
entries: One creature Pazuzu can see must succeed on a {@dc 22} Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 30 feet in any direction.
A creature with a Mark of Corruption has disadvantage on this saving throw.

mythic.name: Wind of the Amorites (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Pazuzu moves up to his speed and uses his multiattack.

monster.name: Pegasus
languages: Elvish and Sylvan but can't speak

trait.name: Diving Overrun
entries: If the pegasus is flying and dives at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a melee weapon attack, the target must make a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Pristine Presence
entries: If the pegasus has taken no hostile action in the last minute, a creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the pegasus must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or be unable to take hostile action against the pegasus until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Hooves
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 10 feet back. This attack deals an additional 3 ({@damage 1d6}) damage to a {@condition prone} creature.

trait.name: Sovereign of the Wind
entries: While the peng is flying, each other other flying creature within 30 feet of it treats any movement toward it as being over difficult terrain

trait.name: Sage of the Mirror-Lake
entries: While the peng is submerged in water, it has telepathy to a range of 30 feet and resistance to damage from spells cast by creatures in that area.

trait.name: Endless Gaze (3/Day)
entries: If the peng fails a saving throw against an effect that does not deal damage, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Monkspoon Beak (Bird Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}24 ({@damage 4d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 19}).
This attack has advantage against a submerged creature without a swim speed or an airborne creature without a fly speed.

action.name: Suction Gulp (Fish Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 4d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage.
If the target was {@condition grappled} by the peng and size Medium or smaller, the peng can swallow it. (escape {@dc 19}).
While swallowed, the creature is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, and takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) bludgeoning damage at the beginning of each of the peng's turns.

action.name: Bufetting Thrash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage.
Before or after making this attack, the peng can move up to half of one of its speeds.

action.name: Six-Month Gale (1/Day, Bird Form Only, Concentration)
entries: Black clouds boil from the sky as the peng conjures a mighty storm in a 300 foot radius centered on itself.

When a creature starts its turn in the area, the peng can force it to succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 3d8}) bludgeoning damage and be pushed up to 15 feet in a direction of the peng's choice.

action.name: Celestial Jet (Fish Form Only) {@recharge 5}
entries: The peng gulps down a mouthful of water, then spits it forth in a 120 foot jet that is 5 feet wide.
Each creature in the area is cured of any poison or diseases, then must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or take 35 ({@damage 10d8}) bludgeoning damage and be pushed up to 30 feet away.
On a success, a creature takes half as much damage and is pushed up to 15 feet away.

bonus.name: Pile the Wind (Bird Form Only)
entries: The peng beats its wings, creating a dense cushion of air beneath it.
For the next minute, the peng gains 40 foot fly speed, and creatures within 300 feet of it do not fall if unsupported.

bonus.name: Heavenward Leap (Fish Form Only)
entries: The peng moves up to its speed. Until the end of its turn, it can swim through air as though it were water.
The peng can take two legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

legendary.name: Buffeting Thrash
entries: The peng uses its buffeting thrash.

legendary.name: K'un Reversion
entries: The peng transforms into a Huge fish with a 60 foot swim speed, or back into its Huge bird form, then can roll to recharge its Celestial Jet.

trait.name: Clockwork Repetition
entries: The pentadrone may choose to treat any {@dice d20} roll as a 10, instead of rolling.

trait.name: Perfect Synchrony
entries: If the pentadrone is within 30 feet of a decaton, it uses the decaton's attack bonus instead of its own. If the decaton is using a nonaton's attack bonus, the pentadrone uses that instead, and so on.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The pentadrone makes five attacks with its Spinning Slap.

action.name: Spinning Slap
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Chaos Alert!
entries: The modron loudly lists the violations of the laws of cosmic order it can see. Until the beginning of its next turn, friendly quadrones that can hear it have advantage on attacks against any creature that is {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell.

action.name: Pyschosoma Ether {@recharge 5}
entries: The pentadrone exhales a desensitizing gas in a 30 foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Restrain Chaos (3rd Level Spell)
entries: As a reaction when a creature the pentadrone can see within 30 feet makes an attack or casts a damaging spell, the pentadrone causes the attack or spell to deal minimum damage.

reaction.name: Upgrade
entries: As a reaction to seeing a decaton within 60 feet die or transform, the pentadrone may transform into a decaton, retaining its current hit points. No more than one pentadrone may take this reaction.

monster.name: Peryton Heart-Plucker
languages: understands Common and Elvish but can't speak

trait.name: Brutal Dive
entries: If the peryton is flying and dives at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a melee attack, the attack scores a critical on an 18-20.

trait.name: Shadow Scent
entries: The peryton knows the direction and distance to each creature on the same plane of existence that has been affected by its Shadow Mark.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The peryton makes two attacks; one with its Gory Bite and one with its Vicious Talons.

action.name: Gory Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage.
A humanoid creature killed by this attack has its heart torn out and devoured.

action.name: Vicious Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) piercing damage.
On a critical hit, the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}).

action.name: Ironbeam  Antlers
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d10 + 3}) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be pushed 5 feet away and knocked {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Shadow Mark
entries: As a reaction when the peryton flies directly over a humanoid creature it can see, it changes its shadow to mimic that creature's shadow.

A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of a peryton mimicking its shadow in this way must succeed on a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the beginning of its next turn.

monster.name: Peryton Nog Hind

resist.note: damage from weapons that aren't named

languages: Common and Elvish but can't speak except with its Thought Mimicry trait

trait.name: Brutal Dive
entries: If the peryton is flying and dives at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a melee attack, the attack scores a critical on an 18-20.

trait.name: Thought Mimicry
entries: The peryton can speak the current surface thoughts of any creature whose heart it carries, using that creature's voice. It cannot otherwise read thoughts.

trait.name: Shadow Scent
entries: The peryton knows the direction and distance to each creature on the same plane of existence that has been affected by its Shadow Mark.

trait.name: Hidden Hearts (3/Day)
entries: Tucked beneath the peryton's feathers are several still-beating hearts stolen from living creatures. If the peryton fails a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, it can choose to have a creature whose heart it carries affected in its stead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The peryton makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Gory Bite, and uses its Ironbeam Antler Rush, if available.

action.name: Shadowtaker Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage.
A humanoid creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage is cursed. A creature cursed in this way casts no shadow or reflection.

action.name: Vicious Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) piercing damage.
On a critical hit, the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}).

action.name: Ironbeam  Antler Rush {@recharge 4}
entries: The peryton lunges up to 15 feet directly towards a creature within 20 feet with antlers lowered, forcing it to make a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw.
On a failed save, the creature takes 16 ({@damage 3d10}) piercing damage, is pushed up to 15 feet away, and is knocked {@condition prone}. On a success, a creature takes half as much damage.

action.name: Collect Heart
entries: The peryton magically and nonlethally scoops the heart from the chest of an {@condition unconscious} creature within 5 feet of it, regaining a use of its Hidden Hearts ability and leaving a ragged yet bloodless void in the creature's chest.

A creature with its heart removed in this way cannot gain class levels until its heart is returned or replaced, and dies if its heart is destroyed. While a creature has its heart replaced with that of another creature, it uses that creature's class levels, rather than its own.

bonus.name: Shrill Scream
entries: The peryton lets out a mocking, melodramatic scream, imitating an injured humanoid.
Each {@condition frightened} creature within 30 feet that can hear it must use its reaction to move half its speed away from the peryton.

bonus.name: Wingbeat Gust
entries: The peryton beats its wings mightily, kicking up a powerful wind in a 15 foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away.

reaction.name: Shadow Mark
entries: As a reaction when the peryton flies directly over a humanoid creature it can see, it changes its shadow to mimic that creature's shadow.

A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of a peryton mimicking its shadow in this way must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Thunderous Screech (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 93 hit points, the peryton lets out a thunderous screech. Each creature within 20 feet of it must must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitiution saving throw or take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) thunder damage, or half as much damage on a success.
If a creature that fails this save misses with an attack on its following turn, it immediately falls {@condition prone}.

monster.name: Peryton Unblooded
languages: understands Common and Elvish but can't speak

trait.name: Brutal Dive
entries: If the peryton is flying and dives at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a melee attack, the attack scores a critical on an 18-20.

trait.name: Shed Velvet
entries: If the peryton eats the heart of a humanoid creature, the velvet covering its antlers splits and begins to peel, and the peryton becomes a

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The peryton makes two attacks, one of which may be with its Gory Bite.

action.name: Gory Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage.
A humanoid creature killed by this attack has its heart torn out and devoured.

action.name: Talon Slash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) slashing damage.

reaction.name: Velveted Skittishness
entries: As a reaction when the peryton is hit with a melee attack, it flies up to 15 feet without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

reaction.name: Pluck Heart
entries: As a reaction when the peryton scores a critical hit with its Gory Bite, it makes another Gory Bite attack against the same target.

trait.name: Toxic Cloud
entries: The living spell can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and can move through any space that air can pass through without squeezing. Its space is heavily obscured.
A creature that begins its turn in the living spell's space must succeeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 5d8}) poison damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Living Magic
entries: If the living spell is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as {@spell Dispel Magic}, it must make a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC.
On a failure, the living spell is {@condition stunned} (Save Ends at end of turn).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The living spell makes two attacks with its Poison Snare.

action.name: Poison Snare
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d8}) poison damage and the target is dragged up to 10 feet toward the living spell's center.

action.name: Boil Out (Concentration) {@recharge 5}
entries: The living spell grows, expanding to fill a 20 foot radius. While {@status concentration||concentrating} on this ability, the living spell's speed is reduced to 10 feet.

monster.name: Phaerimm
languages: understands Common but can't speak it

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The phaerimm has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Desiccating Dweomer
entries: A creature that fails a saving throw against a spell or magical effect of the phaerimm's has any potions or other liquids it is carrying dry up, becoming unusable until rehydrated.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The phaerimm makes five attacks, one of which may be with its bite or its stinger.

action.name: Grinding Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition grappled} target. {@h}46 ({@damage 8d10 + 2}) piercing damage. A creature killed by this damage has its corpse utterly destroyed.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, the phaerimm can grapple the target (escape {@dc 14}).

action.name: Stinger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d8 + 2}) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for the next minute. A {@condition poisoned} creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Implant Egg
entries: The phaerimm makes a stinger attack against a {@condition poisoned} creature. If the attack hits, the phaerimm deposits an egg in the wound. The creature is {@condition paralyzed} and levitates 3 ft. off the ground until a creature makes a {@dc 17} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check to remove the egg, or until the egg hatches in {@dice 2d20} hours, killing the host. Each attempt (successful or not) deals {@dice 1d4} points of damage to the host.

reaction.name: Absorption
entries: As a reaction to succeeding on a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the phaerimm gains temporary hit points equal to 10 times the level of the spell.

reaction.name: Reflection
entries: As a reaction to succeeding on a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the phaerimm changes the spell's target to a creature of its choice that it can see within 30 ft.

legendary.name: Tortuous Compulsion (4th Level Spell)
entries: One creature within 60 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) psychic damage. A creature that takes 10 or more psychic damage in this way acts under the phaerimm's control on its following turn.

legendary.name: Wrack (2nd Level Spell)
entries: One creature within 60 ft. is overwhelmed with indescribable pain. The target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or fall {@condition prone} and be unable to stand on its following turn. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more subtracts {@dice 1d4} from attacks and saving throws it makes for the next minute.

legendary.name: Drown in Blood (4th Level Spell, Concentration, Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Blood wells up in the mouth and lungs of a creature, suffocating it. One creature within 60 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) necrotic damage and be unable to speak or breathe for the next minute. An affected creature repeats this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The phalanx can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a medium creature. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

trait.name: Shield Wall
entries: While the phalanx has at least half of its hit points, it has advantage on Strength saving throws and grants half cover to friendly creatures within 5 feet of it that don't have this trait.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The phalanx makes two attacks with its longspear advance.

action.name: Longspear Advance
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., up to three targets. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage and the target is pushed 5 ft. away. Before or after making this attack, the phalanx moves 5 feet.

reaction.name: Brace
entries: As a reaction to a creature entering its reach, the phalanx forces the creature to succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or have its movement reduced to 0 until the end of its turn.

reaction.name: Raise Shields
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with a ranged attack, the phalanx raises its AC against ranged attacks by 5 and reduces its movement to 0 until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Glider
entries: When the phanaton uses its fly speed, it must end its movement closer to the ground than it started.

trait.name: Jumpy
entries: The phanaton adds its {@skill Perception} bonus to initiative checks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The phanaton makes one attack with its dagger and uses its opposable tail.

action.name: Flint Dagger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) slashing damage. On a critical hit, the phanaton may make an additional melee attack as a bonus action.

action.name: Opposable Tail
entries: The phanaton uses its tail to do any of the following.
Make a Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check to pickpocket a creature.

Give itself the {@action Help} action.

action.name: Multiattack

trait.name: Web-Dweller
entries: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty.
While in contact with a web, the spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

trait.name: Ethereal Ambusher
entries: When the spider rolls initiative or uses its Ethereal Jaunt, it gains advantage on the first attack it makes against a creature with a lower initiative.

action.name: Multiattack

While {@condition poisoned} in this way, the target shifts from the Material Plane to the Border Ethereal. It is faintly visible on the Material Plane while it is in the Border Ethereal, but can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The imp can use its action to polymorph into a beast form that resembles a rat (speed 20 ft.), a raven (20 ft., fly 60 ft.), or a spider (20 ft., climb 20 ft.), or back into its true form. Its statistics are the same in each form, except for the speed changes noted. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: Devil's Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the imp's {@sense darkvision}.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The imp has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Sting (Bite in Beast Form)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage, and the target must make a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw, taking 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Phlegmatic Imbalance {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or be slowed. An affected creature's speed is halved, it takes a -2 penalty to AC and Dexterity saving throws, and it can't use reactions. On its turn, it can use either an action or a bonus action, not both. Regardless of the creature's abilities or magic items, it can't make more than one melee or ranged attack during its turn.

action.name: Invisibility
entries: The imp magically turns {@condition invisible} until it attacks or until its {@status concentration} ends (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). Any equipment the imp wears or carries is {@condition invisible} with it.

trait.name: Gargantuan Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the phoenix may spend half of its movement to attempt a {@dc 17} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the phoenix. While climbing on the phoenix, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the phoenix, and the phoenix can't make melee attacks against it. A creature that isn't {@condition prone} may attempt this check as a reaction in place of an {@action opportunity attack||attack of opportunity}.

trait.name: Dampened Flames
entries: If the phoenix takes 10 or more cold damage from a single source, attacks against it are made at advantage until the beginning of its next turn. If the phoenix takes 20 or more cold damage from a single source, its Inner Fire trait ceases to function until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Fiery Rebirth
entries: When the phoenix is reduced to 0 hit points, it does not die. Instead, its body crumbles to ash, revealing a new phoenix fledgeling. This trait is suspended in an area infused with unholy power by the {@spell Hallow} spell. If the phoenix's body is completely destroyed while this trait is suspended, the phoenix dies.

trait.name: Inner Fire
entries: A creature that touches the phoenix or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it catches fire; until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the creature takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If the phoenix fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The phoenix makes two attacks, one of which may be with its beak.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}34 ({@damage 4d12 + 8}) piercing damage and 11 ({@damage 2d10}) fire damage.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}26 ({@damage 4d8 + 8}) slashing damage and 11 ({@damage 2d10}) fire damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 18}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the phoenix can't use its talons on another target.

action.name: Shake Off
entries: Each creature climbing on the phoenix must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength or Dexterity saving throw (target's choice) or lose its grip and fall. The phoenix may then make a talon attack targeting a creature that failed this save as it falls.

action.name: Wing Attack
entries: The phoenix beats its wings. Each creature within 20 feet of the phoenix that isn't climbing on it must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or take 36 ({@damage 8d6 + 8}) bludgeoning damage, be pushed 10 ft. away, and and be knocked {@condition prone}. The phoenix can then fly up to half its flying speed.

action.name: Eruption Wake {@recharge 5}
entries: The phoenix moves up to its fly speed, and a 20-foot wide section of the ground it passes over begins to shake violently. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

At the beginning of the phoenix's next turn, lava erupts in the area. For the next minute, each creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there takes 55 ({@damage 10d10}) fire damage.

reaction.name: Quickening Scream (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 158 hit points, the phoenix lets out a mighty screech. entries: If the plague brush takes fire damage, it catches fire. Until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the plague brush and all creatures {@condition grappled} by it take 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage at the start of each of the plague brush's turns. Whenever the plague brush takes fire damage, each creature {@condition grappled} by it may use its reaction to attempt to escape.

trait.name: Scoop
entries: The plague brush may move through the space of any Huge or smaller creature or object. A creature whose space the plague brush moves through must succeed on a {@dc 21} Strength saving throw or be {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 21}) and {@condition restrained}. Unsecured objects are {@condition grappled} automatically.

action.name: Shed Spores
entries: Each creature {@condition grappled} by the plague brush must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 3d8}) necrotic damage and 13 ({@damage 3d8}) poison damage, or half as much on a success. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is infected with {@disease greensickness|ConfC}.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the zombie takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes zombie from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

trait.name: Sudden Lunge
entries: The zombie's attacks have a reach of 10 feet for the purposes of making {@action opportunity attack||opportunity attacks}. When it makes an {@action opportunity attack}, it moves up to 5 feet towards its target as part of the attack.

action.name: Grasp of the Dead (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}The target must succeed on a {@dc 11} Strength saving throw or be {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}). This DC increases by 1 for each zombie that added to this attack beyond the first.

action.name: Plague Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition grappled} target. {@h}4 piercing damage the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or contract {@disease ravenous wasting|ConfC}.

variant.name: Author's Note
entries: This is an extremely punishing monster, especially at lower levels, and is probably not suited to the tone of most long-running D&D campaigns. Make sure your players understand the tone of a campaign that features these before implementing them.

trait.name: Angelic Weapons
entries: The planetar's weapons are manifestations of its innate divine magic, and appear only as the planetar is attacking with them.

trait.name: Divine Awareness
entries: The planetar knows if it hears a lie.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The planetar has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Cowing Presence
entries: If the planetar has at least 101 HP, a creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the planetar must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be unable to take hostile action against the planetar until the beginning of its next turn. A creature has advantage on this save if it took damage from the planetar since the end of its last turn.

trait.name: Wrathful Presence
entries: If the planetar has 100 HP or fewer, a creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the planetar must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} of the planetar until the beginning of its next turn. While {@condition frightened} in this way, the creature has vulnerability to radiant damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The planetar makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Sword of Wrath
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 4d6 + 7}) slashing damage plus 22 ({@damage 5d8}) radiant damage and the creature must make a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a target begins to turn to salt and is {@condition restrained}. The {@condition restrained} target must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a success, the effect ends on the target. On a failure, the target is {@condition petrified} until freed by the {@spell greater restoration} spell or other magic.

action.name: Plague of Locusts
entries: Each creature of the planetar's choice within 30 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or take 27 ({@damage 5d10}) piercing damage. Until the end of the planetar's next turn, the affected area is difficult terrain and heavily obscured for all other creatures.

action.name: Judgement of Heaven
entries: One creature within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw or be reduced to 0 Hit Points.

action.name: Healing Touch (3/Day)
entries: The planetar touches another creature that is alive, or has been dead for no more than a century. If the target was dead, it is restored to life with 1 HP. Then, the target magically regains 30 ({@dice 6d8 + 3}) hit points and is freed from any curse, disease, poison, blindness, deafness, or petrification.

trait.name: Air-Hungry
entries: If the plasmastrider takes any cold damage or is doused in a non-flammable substance, its flames diminish.
Until the end of its next turn, the plasmastrider can't take reactions, and its traits and abilities do not inflict the {@condition burning|confc|burning} condition.

trait.name: Plasma Conduit
entries: The plasmastrider has disadvantage on saving throws against effects that deal lightning damage, and attacks that deal lightning damage have advantage against it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The plasmastrider makes two attacks with its Blueflame Impact, one of which it can replace with a use of its Lob Fluxflame or Incinerating Embrace.

action.name: Blueflame Impact
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) fire damage and the target is pushed up to 5 feet away.
On a hit or miss, each {@condition burning|confc|burning} creature within 5 feet of the target takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage.

action.name: Lob Fluxflame
entries: The plasmastrider hurls a glob of crawling blue flames at a point within 60 feet where it explodes in a 5 foot radius, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage and begin {@condition burning|confc|burning} ({@dice 1d10}).
A creature that the {@condition burning|confc|burning} creature ends its turn within 5 feet of begins {@condition burning|confc|burning} ({@dice 1d10}).

action.name: Incinerating Embrace (Concentration)
entries: The plasmastrider lunges at a creature within 5 feet, forcing it to succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 15}) until the plasmastrider moves or loses {@status concentration}.
The {@condition restrained} creature takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage at the end of each creature's turn. A creature killed in this way is reduced to ash.

trait.name: Sleek Coat Insulation
entries: While the platypus has more than half of his hit points, it has resistance to cold and fire damage.

action.name: Bill Nip
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}No effect.

action.name: Paddle-Tail Smack
entries: One Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet must succeed on a {@dc 6} Strength saving throw or be pushed 5 feet away.

reaction.name: Crural Spur (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the platypus forces the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 9} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} until the beginning of the attacker's next turn.

trait.name: Serpentine Neck
entries: The plesiosaurus can move up to 10 feet into any space large enough for a Small creature without squeezing.

trait.name: Countershading
entries: The plesiosaurus has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide from creatures above it in open water.

action.name: Shellsplitter Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage.
This attack is made at advantage against a creature wearing Medium or Heavy armor.

action.name: Dark Water Ambush {@recharge}
entries: The plesiosaurus moves up to its speed in a straight line towards a creature it is hidden from and makes a bite attack against it.
If the attack hits, the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of the plesiosaurus' next turn.

reaction.name: Darting Snap
entries: When a creature enters its reach, the plesiosaurus can make a Shellsplitter Bite attack against it, then move up to 10 feet.

trait.name: Ice Walk
entries: The bear can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.

trait.name: Concussive Strength
entries: A creature knocked {@condition prone} by the bear must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be unable to stand on its following turn.

trait.name: Rear Up
entries: The bear may use 30 ft. of its movement to stand upright until the end of its turn. While standing, the bear has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks and attacks made with its claws, and cannot attack with its bite.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bear makes two claw attacks. If both attacks hit the same medium or smaller creature, it is knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) piercing damage. This attack does an additional 9 ({@damage 2d8}) damage to a {@condition prone} creature.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) slashing damage.

reaction.name: Run Down
entries: As a reaction to a hostile creature the bear can see ending its movement at least 20 ft. further from the bear than it started, the bear moves up to its speed towards the creature.
If the bear ends this movement within 5 ft. of the creature, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Transparent
entries: If the kraken has not eaten in the last week, it is {@condition invisible} to creatures more than 30 feet away from it, and can attempt to {@action Hide} as a Bonus Action.

trait.name: Freezing Grip
entries: A creature that starts its turn {@condition grappled} by the kraken loses two unexpended hit dice. If it cannot, it must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} until the beginnning of its next turn.

trait.name: Boneless
entries: The kraken can move through a space as narrow as 10 feet wide without squeezing, and its movement is not hindered by its Razor Lattice.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the kraken fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The kraken makes three attacks with its Tentacle Lash, each of which it can replace a use of its Fling.

action.name: Tentacle Lash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} and {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 18}).

action.name: Fling
entries: The kraken flings an object or creature {@condition grappled} by it up to 60 feet. If the creature collides with a creature or surface, it takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage for each 10 feet fewer than 60 that it traveled.
A creature hit by the projectile must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away and take the same amount of damage.

action.name: Cavernous Maw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one Huge or smaller target. {@h}19 ({@dice 3d8 + 6}) piercing plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) cold damage and the target is swallowed.
While swallowed, the creature's attacks bypass the kraken's damage resistances and it takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) cold damage at the start of each of the kraken's turns.
If it takes 40 damage or more in a single turn from a creature inside it, the kraken regurgitates all swallowed creatures, which fall {@condition prone} in an unoccupied space within 10 feet.

action.name: Razor Lattice (6th Level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: The kraken freezes the water in a 30 foot radius centered on a point it can see into an open latice of razor-sharp crystals, which last for a minute. The area becomes difficult terrain, and a creature pushed or flung into or through it takes an additional 10 ({@damage 3d6}) slashing damage.

reaction.name: Freeze Breath (2nd Level Spell)
entries: As a reaction when a creature the kraken can see within 60 feet attempts to cast a spell, the kraken forces the creature to make a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw.
On a failed save, the creature must use a spell slot of one level higher to cast the spell, or have the spell fail.

legendary.name: Tentacle Lash or Fling
entries: The kraken makes an attack with its Tentacle Lash or uses its Fling.

legendary.name: Glacier Shard (4th Level Spell, Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The kraken conjures a 10 foot radius shard of ice at a point it can see within 120 feet, which rockets to the surface, moving 15 feet toward the surface at the beginning of each creature's turn.

Whenever it moves, each creature whose space it enters must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) bludgeoning damage and be pushed 15 feet toward the surface, moving to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

legendary.name: Shatter Lattice (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The kraken shatters the matrix of crystals created by its razor lattice. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or take 21 ({@dice 4d6}) slashing plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) cold damage, or half as much damage on a success.

resist.special: damage other than the type that killed it

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The poltergeist can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Invisibility
entries: The poltergeist is {@condition invisible}. While {@condition invisible}, the poltergeist can attempt to {@action Hide} as a Bonus Action. If fine particles of silver are scattered in its space, it loses this invisibility for the next minute.

trait.name: Unfinished Business
entries: When the poltergeist is reduced to 0 HP, it does not die or fall {@condition unconscious}. Instead, it ceases to be {@condition invisible} and loses the ability to take actions, though it can still communicate. After {@dice 1d4} hours, the poltergeist recovers all of its hit points. While at 0 hit points, the poltergeist can be destroyed any of the following ways:
Resolving its unfinished business.
Subjecting it to the same conditions that killed it.
Interring its remains with the {@spell Ceremony|XGE} spell.

action.name: Telekinetic Thrust
entries: The poltergeist hurls a creature or object weighing up to 150 lbs. up to 30 feet. An unwilling creature makes a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw, resisting the effect on a success. If a thrown creature strikes a solid object surface, the creature takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Telekinetic Thrash {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature within 20 feet must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}, or take half as much damage on a success. The poltergeist ceases to be {@condition invisible} until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Drifting Apparition
entries: When the poltergeist is hit with a melee attack, it can move up to half its speed without provoking {@action opportunity attack||opportunity attacks}.

trait.name: Multiple Heads
entries: Polukranos has five heads. Whenever Polukranos takes 25 or more damage in a single turn, one of its heads dies. If all its heads die, Polukranos dies. A creature can attempt to avoid harming the heads, bypassing this trait. If it does, Polukranos has resistance to any damage it deals.

At the beginning of its turn, Polukranos makes a {@dc 17} Constitution save for each head that died since the beginning last turn. On a success, it grows two new heads. It makes one of these saving throws at disadvantage for each source of fire damage it took since its last turn.

trait.name: Reactive Heads
entries: For each head Polukranos has beyond one, it gets an extra reaction.

trait.name: Gargantuan Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to Polukranos may spend half of its movement to attempt a {@dc 21} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto Polukranos. While climbing on Polukranos, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against it.

trait.name: Shed Head
entries: When Polukranos fails a saving throw against a spell or magical effect it may choose to succeed instead. If it does, one of its heads dies and tears away from the main body.

trait.name: Escape from the Underworld (Mythic Trait; 1/Day)
entries: If Polukranos is reduced to 0 hit points, it doesn't die or fall {@condition unconscious}. Instead, it resets to 198 hit points, its creature type becomes undead, and any creature hit with an attack by Polukranos must expend two unexpended hit dice or else take an additional 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Polukranos makes as many bite attacks as it has heads. If it is grappling a creature at the start of its turn, it may replace one of its bite attacks with a swallow.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 1d12 + 8}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 21}) and pulled up to 10 ft. towards Polukranos. While a head grapples a target, the head can attack only that target.

action.name: Swallow
entries: Polukranos makes one bite attack against a Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, that creature takes the bite's damage and is swallowed, and the grapple ends.

While swallowed, the creature is {@condition blinded} and {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 21}) in Polukranos's craw, its attacks bypass Polukranos' damage resistances, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside Polukranos, and it takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) acid damage at the start of each of Polukranos's turns. One swallowed creature is freed whenever Polukranos loses a head.
Polukranos can take three legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

legendary.name: Trampling Charge
entries: Polukranos moves up to half its speed. Creatures in its path must succeed on a {@dc 21} Strength saving throw or fall {@condition prone}. On a success, the creature may use its reaction to move up to 10 ft. to an unoccupied space out of Polukranos' path.

legendary.name: Eat Head
entries: Polukranos eats one of its shed heads, gaining 10 temporary hit points. While it has these temporary hit points, it has advantage on Constitution saving throws.

legendary.name: Worry (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by at least two of Polukranos' heads must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution throw or take 55 ({@damage 10d10}) piercing damage, or half as much on a success. A creature makes this save at disadvantage if it is {@condition grappled} by three or more of Polukranos' heads. A creature killed by this damage is ripped into pieces.

mythic.name: Unchained (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Until the beginning of its next turn, whenever Polukranos is hit with an attack by a creature within its reach, it may move up to 10 ft. and make an attack as a reaction.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The frog can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The frog's long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) piercing damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 11}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the frog can't bite another target.

action.name: Tongue
entries: One Large or smaller creature within 15 ft must succeed on a {@dc 11} Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 10 ft towards the frog, which can use a bonus action to make a bite attack against it.

action.name: Swallow
entries: The frog makes one bite attack against a Small or smaller target it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. The swallowed target is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the frog, and it takes 5 ({@damage 2d4}) acid damage at the start of each of the frog's turns. The frog can have only one target swallowed at a time. If the frog dies, a swallowed creature is no longer {@condition restrained} by it and can escape from the corpse using 5 feet of movement, exiting {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Jumpy
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with a melee attack, the frog may impose disadvantage on the attack. If the attack misses, the frog may jump up to 20 ft. without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

trait.name: Bolting Reflex
entries: When initiative is rolled, the pony may move up to half its speed away from the nearest enemy without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.
A creature riding the pony may attempt a {@dc 12} Wisdom ({@skill Animal Handling}) check to instead control the direction of this movement, with disadvantage if the horse has taken any damage.

trait.name: Docile
entries: If the pony has all of its hit points, its attacks are made at disadvantage.

action.name: Hooves
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Cultured Colony
entries: If the ooze takes any Fire or Necrotic damage, it is {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

action.name: Lacto-Acid Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) acid damage.
On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or gain a point of {@condition exhaustion}.

reaction.name: Bubbling Rise (Concentration)
entries: When the ooze takes any damage of a type it is resistant to, it can begin to bubble and expand.
At the beginning of its next turn, the ooze splits into two new {@creature poolish ooze discard|confc|Poolish Ooze Discards} with full hit points that share its initiative.

trait.name: Cultured Colony
entries: If the ooze takes any Fire or Necrotic damage, it is {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

action.name: Lacto-Acid Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) acid damage.
On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or gain a point of {@condition exhaustion}.

action.name: Glutenous Grasp
entries: The ooze attempts to wrap around a creature within 5 feet, forcing it to succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}).
Until the beginning of the ooze's next turn, the creature can attempt to escape this grapple as a Bonus Action.

reaction.name: Tighten Bonds
entries: When a creature {@condition grappled} by the ooze takes an action, the ooze can tighten its grasp.
The {@condition grappled} creature takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage and is {@condition restrained} until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Bubbling Rise (Concentration)
entries: When the ooze takes any damage of a type it is resistant to, it can begin to bubble and expand.
At the beginning of its next turn, the ooze loses 5 hit points and spawns a {@creature poolish ooze discard|confc|Poolish Ooze Discard} that act on its initiative in the nearest unoccupied space.

trait.name: Cultured Colony
entries: If the ooze takes any Fire or Necrotic damage, it is {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Yeasty Quagmire
entries: When a creature hits the ooze with an unarmed melee attack or fails an attempt to free a creature {@condition grappled} by the ooze, the ooze can grapple it.
If any fine powder is thrown over the ooze, this trait is disabled until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Abandon Cohesion (2/Day)
entries: If the ooze fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
If it does, each creature {@condition grappled} by it is released and expelled in the nearest unoccupied space.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ooze makes two attacks with its Lacto-Acid Pseudopod, one of which it can replace with a use of its Tacky Roll.

action.name: Lacto-Acid Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) acid damage.
On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or gain a point of {@condition exhaustion}.

action.name: Tacky Roll
entries: The ooze moves up to 10 feet, and can enter the space of any Medium or smaller creature.
Each creature whose space the ooze enters in this way is pushed to the nearest unoccupied space, then must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}).

action.name: Knead {@recharge 4}
entries: Each creature {@condition grappled} by the ooze must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) bludgeoning damage and be {@condition restrained} until the grapple ends.
A creature that was already {@condition restrained} is additionally engulfed, gaining total cover from outside effects and becoming unable to speak or breathe until the grapple ends.

reaction.name: Bubbling Rise (Concentration)
entries: When the ooze takes any damage of a type it is resistant to, it can begin to bubble and expand.

At the beginning of its next turn, the ooze loses 10 hit points and spawns two {@creature poolish ooze discard|confc|Poolish Ooze Discards} that act on its initiative in the nearest unoccupied spaces.

legendary.name: Lacto-Acid Pseudopod
entries: The ooze makes an attack withits Lacto-Acid Pseudopod.

legendary.name: Tacky Roll
entries: The ooze uses its Tacky Roll.

legendary.name: Reincorporate
entries: The ooze kills and absorbs a Poolish Ooze Discard {@condition grappled} by it, gaining 10 temporary hit points.

trait.name: Aura of Terror
entries: A sleeping creature that starts its turn within 60 ft. of the feyr is accosted by its deepest fears, and takes 22 ({@damage 4d10}) psychic damage. This damage does not wake a sleeping creature. A creature reduced to 0 hit points in this way gains 1 hit point and rises on its turn under the feyr's control.
A creature under the feyr's control makes a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a succeess.

trait.name: Gargantuan Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the feyr may spend half of its movement to attempt a {@dc 18} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the feyr. While climbing on the feyr, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the feyr, and the feyr has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

trait.name: Light Sensitivity
entries: While the feyr is illuminated with bright light, attacks against the it are made at advantage.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If the feyr fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The feyr makes three melee attacks, one of which it may replace with The First Unknown, if available.

action.name: Gnashing Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 2d10 + 8}) piercing damage. This attack deals an additional 11 ({@damage 2d10}) psyschic damage to a {@condition frightened} creature.

action.name: Tendril Lash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d6 + 8}) slashing damage. Each creature within 5 ft of the target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

action.name: Scything Sweep
entries: Each creature in a 30 ft. cone must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or take 39 ({@damage 6d12}) slashing damage and be knocked {@condition prone}, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Torment Gaze
entries: Each creature in a line that is 300 ft. long and 5 ft. wide must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or be pushed 15 feet away and take 66 ({@damage 12d10}) psychic damage, or take half as much damage on as success. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more falls asleep for the next minute, additionally.
A creature wakes up early if it takes damage or another creature uses its action to wake it.

action.name: The First Unknown {@recharge 5}
entries: The feyr creates a 10-ft radius sphere of magical darkness that lasts until the end of its next turn. Creatures in the affected areas must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the darkness is dispelled. While {@condition frightened} in this way, a creature is {@condition paralyzed}.

reaction.name: Insubstantiate
entries: As a reaction to taking 20 or more damage from a single source, the feyr disappears into the border ethereal and loses one of its legendary resistances if it has any. At the beginning of its its next turn, the feyr teleports back into the material plane within 30 ft. of where it departed.

reaction.name: Deepest Dark (1/Day.)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 211 hit points, the feyr immediately recharges and uses The First Unknown three times.

legendary.name: Eye of Taking (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The feyr ends one magical effect on a creature it can see. If the effect did not require {@status concentration}, the feyr may replicate the effect, targeting itself.

legendary.name: Eye of Keeping
entries: One creature under the Feyr's control gains 14 ({@dice 4d6}) temporary hit points. While it has these temporary hit points, a creature has disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws.

legendary.name: Eye of Revelation
entries: One creature within 60 ft. that the feyr can see must succeed on a {@dc 18} Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the target has disadvantage on the next Wisdom saving throw it makes in the next minute.

legendary.name: To Ashes
entries: The feyr fouls the magic around a creature. The next time in the next turn that the creature would receive magical healing, the creature receives no healing and instead takes an equal amount of necrotic damage.

trait.name: Multiple Heads
entries: The hydra has four heads. While it has more than one head, the hydra has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition blinded}, {@condition charmed}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition frightened}, {@condition stunned}, and knocked {@condition unconscious}.

Whenever the hydra takes 25 or more damage in a single turn, one of its heads dies. If all its heads die, the hydra dies. A creature can attempt to avoid harming the heads, bypassing this trait. If it does, the hydra has resistance to any damage it deals.

At the beginning of its turn, the hydra makes a {@dc 14} Constitution save for each head that died since the beginning of its last turn. On a success, it grows two new heads. It makes one of these saving throws at disadvantage for each source of fire damage it took since its last turn. The hydra regains 10 hit points for each head regrown in this way.

trait.name: Reactive Heads
entries: For each head the hydra has beyond one, it gets an extra reaction that can be used only for {@action opportunity attack||opportunity attacks}.

trait.name: Wakeful
entries: While the hydra sleeps, at least one of its heads is awake.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hydra makes as many attacks as it has heads. If it is grappling a creature at the start of its turn, it may replace one of its bite attacks with a use of its swallow, or three bite attacks with a use of its worry ability.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@dice 1d10 + 6}) piercing plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) acid damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 19}). While a head grapples a target, the head can attack only that target.

action.name: Flaming Acid Spit
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 8} to hit, range 30 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d8}) acid damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Swallow
entries: The hydra makes one bite attack against a Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, that creature takes the bite's damage and is swallowed, and the grapple ends.

While swallowed, the creature is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained} in the hydra's craw, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the hydra, and it takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) acid damage at the start of each of the hydra's turns. One swallowed creature is freed whenever the hydra loses a head.

action.name: Worry
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by at least two of the hydra's heads must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution throw or take 55 ({@damage 10d10}) piercing damage and 14 ({@damage 4d6}) acid damage, or half as much on a success. A creature makes this save at disadvantage if it is {@condition grappled} by three or more heads.

reaction.name: Shed Head
entries: As a reaction when the hydra fails a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the hydra may choose to succeed. If it does, one of its heads dies and tears away from the main body.

reaction.name: Flaming Acid Bloodspurt
entries: As a reaction to losing a head to a melee attack, the hydra forces the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take 9 ({@dice 2d8}) acid plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Grasping Tendrils
entries: The roper can have up to six tendrils at a time. Each tendril can be attacked (AC 20; 10 hit points). Destroying a tendril deals no damage to the roper, which can extrude a replacement tendril on its next turn.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The roper can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Mesmeric Display
entries: A creature that can see the roper has disadvantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks made to perceive anything other than the roper, and on Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) checks made to perceive hostile intent in the roper if it has not yet attacked.

trait.name: Dweomer Scintilation
entries: Whenever the roper makes a saving throw against a spell or magical effect that does not deal damage, each creature within 30 ft. that can see the roper must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of the roper's next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The roper makes six attacks and uses its vision drain.

action.name: Mindlink Tendril
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 40 ft., one creature. {@h}{@h}6 ({@dice 1d6 + 3}) poison plus 5 ({@damage 1d10}) psychic damage. A medium or smaller target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}) and can hear the surface thoughts of each other creature {@condition grappled} by the roper.
Whenever a {@condition grappled} creature casts a spell, each other creature {@condition grappled} by the roper takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) psychic damage.

action.name: Vision Drain
entries: Each creature {@condition grappled} by the roper must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or have the range of its {@sense Darkvision} reduced by 15 ft. until it completes a Long Rest.
A creature without {@sense Darkvision} is instead {@condition blinded} while in Dim Light until it completes a Long Rest.

action.name: Nervebore Jolt {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the roper must succeed on a {@dc 15} Intelligence saving throw or take 35 ({@dice 10d6}) piercing plus 35 ({@damage 10d6}) psychic damage, or half the piercing and none of the psychic damage on a success.

reaction.name: Ichor Spray
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack that deals piercing or slashing damage, the roper releases a spray of ichor that flares with incandescence for an instant. The attacker must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the end of the roper's next turn.

trait.name: Single Minded Focus
entries: When initiative is rolled, the warforged marks a creature as its target. The first attack the warforged makes each turn against that creature is made at advantage.

trait.name: Deep Crystal Resonance
entries: As a Bonus Action, the psyforged gains one of the following benefits until it uses this ability again.

items.name: Dazeglow
entries: A creature hit by one of the psyforged's melee attacks must succeed on a {@dc 14} Intelligence saving throw or be unable to make more than one attack on its following turn.

items.name: Deceleration Field
entries: A creature hit by one of the psyforged's melee attacks loses its reaction and moves at half its speed until the beginning of the psyforged's next turn.

items.name: Inertial Armor
entries: The psyforged gains +2 AC.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The psyforged makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Augmented Battlefist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@dice 1d8 + 4}) bludgeoning plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) force damage.

action.name: Inflict Distress
entries: One creature the psyforged can see within 60 feet must succeed on a {@dc 14} Intelligence saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 4d10}) psychic damage and be {@condition frightened} and unable to concentrate until the beginning of the psyforged's next turn.

reaction.name: Recall Agony
