entries: As a reaction when a creature within 30 feet that is marked as the psyforged's target takes any damage, the psyforged forces it to succeed on a {@dc 14} Intelligence saving throw or take the same amount of psychic damage.

reaction.name: Rapid Assessment
entries: As a reaction when a creature marked as the psyforged's target begins to cast a spell, the warforged moves up to half its speed or makes a melee attack against it.

trait.name: Dive Attack
entries: If the pterafolk is flying and dives at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a melee weapon attack, the attack scores a critical on a 19-20.

trait.name: Attack Sequence
entries: If the pterafolk hits a creature with a melee attack and then leaves its reach, attacks by other pterafolk against that creature have advantage until the beginning of the pterafolk's next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The pterafolk makes two melee attacks, one of which may be with its Slipnoose.

action.name: Claw Rake
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) slashing damage. If this attack was made at advantage, the target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Slipnoose
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}The target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}). While a creature {@condition grappled} in this way is carried aloft by the pterafolk, it is {@condition restrained} and can't speak or breathe.

action.name: Battering Wings {@recharge 5}
entries: The pterafolk beats its wings, sending a flurry of air and debris forward in a 10 foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) bludgeoning damage and be pushed 5 feet away. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more falls {@condition prone}, additionally. The pterafolk's speed is reduced to 0 until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Sudden Drop
entries: As a reaction to being hit with an attack by a creature it has {@condition grappled}, the pterafolk releases the grapple. The attacker must reroll the attack, taking the lower of the two rolls.

reaction.name: Swoop
entries: When the pterafolk is targeted with a ranged attack by a creature it can see, it can impose disadvantage on the attack and move up to half its fly speed.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the creature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

trait.name: Dive Attack
entries: If the pterafolk is flying and dives at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a melee weapon attack, the attack scores a critical on a 19-20.

action.name: Scrabbleclaw Flurry (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}3 slashing damage.

reaction.name: Flocking Dart
entries: When the pterafolk is targeted with an attack by a creature it can see, it can change the attack's target to a different pterafolk within 5 feet of it.

trait.name: Dive Attack
entries: If the pterafolk is flying and dives at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a melee weapon attack, the attack scores a critical on a 19-20.

trait.name: Attack Sequence
entries: If the pterafolk hits a creature with a melee attack and then leaves its reach, attacks by other pterafolk against that creature have advantage until the beginning of the pterafolk's next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The pterafolk makes two attacks with its Claw Rake.

action.name: Claw Rake
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) slashing damage. If this attack was made at advantage, the target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Hurl Stone (Recharges when the pterafolk ends its turn on the ground)
entries: One creature directly beneath the pterafolk must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Battering Wings {@recharge 5}
entries: The pterafolk beats its wings, sending a flurry of air and debris forward in a 10 foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) bludgeoning damage and be pushed 5 feet away. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more falls {@condition prone}, additionally. The pterafolk's speed is reduced to 0 until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Swoop
entries: When the pterafolk is targeted with a ranged attack by a creature it can see, it can impose disadvantage on the attack and move up to half its fly speed.

trait.name: Dive Attack
entries: If the pterodactyl is flying and dives at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a melee weapon attack, the attack scores a critical on a 19-20.

trait.name: Throat Pouch
entries: A Medium or smaller creature {@condition grappled} by the pterodactyl is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained} in the pterodactyl's throat pouch.

action.name: Savage Peck
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d8 + 2}) piercing damage. On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone} and {@condition stunned} until the end of the pterodactyl's next turn.

action.name: Scoop
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}) if it's a Medium or smaller creature.

action.name: Battering Wings {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature in a 10 ft. cone must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) bludgeoning damage and be pushed 5 ft away. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more falls {@condition prone}, additionally. The pterodactyl's speed is reduced to 0 until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Flip Back
entries: As a reaction to a creature falling {@condition prone} within 10 ft. of it, the pterodactyl makes a Scoop attack against the creature.

trait.name: Springing Grace
entries: The pudu's high jump is up to 10 ft., or up to 15 ft. with a running start. It may treat any surface at least 1 inch across as solid ground to jump off of.

trait.name: Zig-Zag
entries: When the pudu takes the {@action Help} action, it may {@action Dodge} as a Bonus Action.

action.name: Nibble
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 0} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 piercing damage.

reaction.name: Skittish Sidle
entries: As a reaction to a creature ending its movement within 5 ft. of the hart, the pudu moves up to 10 ft. without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

trait.name: Aura of Unluck
entries: The pugwampi and each creature within 30 feet of it has disadvantage on all {@dice d20} rolls.
An affected creature that rolls a 1 on a {@dice d20} takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage and falls {@condition prone}.

action.name: Rib-Rattle Kick
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) bludgeoning damage.
This attack deals an additional 2 ({@damage 1d4}) damage to a {@condition prone} target.

action.name: Skipping Stone
entries: {@atk rw} +5, range 30 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) bludgeoning damage.
On a miss, the pugwampi makes a second attack roll against a random creature in range, ignoring the effects of disadvantage.

action.name: Mud Dive
entries: The pugwampi falls {@condition prone} with a splash as the ground beneath it briefly turns to slop.
Until the slunk stands, it becomes {@condition invisible} to creatures more than 5 feet away from it. Then, if no creature is within 5 feet of it, the pugwampi can attempt to {@action Hide}.

reaction.name: Barked Jeer
entries: When a creature within 30 feet of the pugwampi falls {@condition prone}, it can force each creature within 30 feet that it is hidden from to use its reaction to make a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check to search for the pugwampi.

trait.name: Aura of Unluck
entries: The pugwampi and each creature within 30 feet of it has disadvantage on all {@dice d20} rolls.
An affected creature that rolls a 1 on a {@dice d20} takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage and falls {@condition prone}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The pugwampi makes two attacks with its Rib-Rattle Kick, one of which it can replace with a use of its Invoke Misfortune, if available.

action.name: Rib-Rattle Kick
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) bludgeoning damage.
This attack deals an additional 2 ({@damage 1d4}) damage to a {@condition prone} target.

action.name: Drag Pit (Concentration)
entries: The pugwampi grasps the edge of a pit, trap, or other hazard no larger than 15 feet in any dimension. Until the pugwampi makes an attack, the pit and any creatures trapped in it move with the pugwampi.
A creature whose space the pit is dragged into for the first time on a turn must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or fall in.

action.name: Invoke Misfortune {@recharge 5}
entries: The pugwampi and each other creature within 30 feet of it must make a Charisma saving throw.
Each creature that rolls a 1 suffers a freak accident that inflicts two of the following effects, as determined by the DM:
The creature takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage of any one type.
The creature is {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn.
The creature begins {@condition burning|confc|burning} ({@dice 1d10}).
The creature is {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 12}).

action.name: Wasp Grenade (1/Day)
entries: The pugwampi hurls a jar of angry wasps at a point it can see within 30 feet.
Each creature within 10 feet takes 5 poison damage, then must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to move half its speed directly away from that point.

reaction.name: Wobble Apart
entries: When a creature the pugwampi can see misses with an attack with a weapon made of two or more pieces, the pugwampi can cause the weapon to fall apart, becoming an Improvised Weapon.
A creature may use its action or bonus action to repair the weapon with a successful {@dc 12} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check.

trait.name: Aura of Unluck
entries: The pugwampi and each creature within 30 feet of it has disadvantage on all {@dice d20} rolls.
A affected creature that rolls a 1 on a {@dice d20} takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage and falls {@condition prone}.

action.name: Rib-Rattle Kick
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) bludgeoning damage.
This attack deals an additional 2 ({@damage 1d4}) damage to a {@condition prone} target.

action.name: Hazardslash
entries: The pugwampi twirls and slashes its blade through the air madly, forcing itself and each other creature within 5 feet of it to make a Dexterity saving throw.
The target with the lowest result takes 5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) slashing damage, and each other target takes half as much.

reaction.name: Dodge-Roll
entries: When a Medium or larger non-{@condition prone} creature targets the pugwampi with a melee attack, the pugwampi can tumble through the attacker's legs to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of it.
The attacker must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or choose a new target for its attack.

monster.name: Puppeteer Parasite
languages: The languages of any creature it is attached to. telepathy 30 ft.

trait.name: Custom Mimicry
entries: The puppeteer can add its Intelligence modifier to Charisma checks made to mimic behavior it has observed in the last 24 hours.

trait.name: Psionic Backlash
entries: If a creature the parasite is {@condition attached|confc|attached} to succeeds on a saving throw against one of the parasite's abilities by 5 or more, the Parasite falls {@condition prone} and is {@condition stunned} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Clinging Flop
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 bludgeoning damage and the parasite becomes {@condition attached|confc|attached} to the target (remove {@dc 12}).

action.name: Drain Mind
entries: The parasite digs its ventral teeth into a humanoid creature it is attached to, connecting directly to the creature's nervous system. The creature takes 7 ({@dice 2d6}) piercing plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) psychic damage, then must make a {@dc 13} Intelligence saving throw.
On a failure, the creature loses all memory of the parasite and the parasite becomes undetectable to the creature until the parasite is removed or deals any damage to the creature.

action.name: Insidious Suggestion {@recharge 5}
entries: The parasite telepathically whispers a command to a creature it is attached to. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or follow that command for the next hour, or until the parasite uses this ability again.

action.name: Assume Control (1/Day, Concentration)
entries: The parasite attempts to directly take control of the body of a humanoid creature it is attached to, forcing it to succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition dominated|confc|dominated} by the parasite for the next 24 hours.
While {@condition dominated|confc|dominated} in this way, a creature can't cast spells and uses the parasite's knowledge, mental statistics and proficiencies in place of its own.

reaction.name: Slither
entries: When a creature the parasite can see targets it with an attack while it is attached to a creature, it crawls deeper into the creature's clothing or armor, gaining half cover against the attack.
If the attack misses the parasite, the attacker makes a new attack roll targeting the creature the parasite is attached to.

trait.name: Quick Squeeze
entries: The dragon may move through any space larger than its skull without squeezing.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The dragon can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Extinguishing Aura
entries: The dragon is surrounded by an aura of light-eating microbes. At the beginning of the dragon's turn, each light source within 5 ft. diminishes one level; from bright light to dim light, or from dim light to darkness.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d10 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Breath Weapons {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.

action.name: Nightmare Spore Breath
entries: The dragon exhales a cloud of spores in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) psychic damage and is covered in spores until a creature takes an action to remove them. While covered in these spores, a creature is {@condition frightened}.

action.name: Stone Tomb Breath
entries: The dragon exhales a burst of stone-softening magic in a 15-foot cone, turning the ground in the area into difficult terrain for the next minute. A creature that begins its turn on the ground in the area must succeed on a {@dc 11} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 11}) as it begins to sink into the stone.

variant.name: Note: Stone Tomb
entries: When the effect of the dragon's stone tomb breath ends, the stone hardens, increasing the escape DC to 25. The stone has an AC of 20, and the DC to escape is reduced by 1 whenever 10 or more damage is dealt to it from a single source.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The grung's long jump is up to 25 feet and its high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

trait.name: Toe Pads
entries: The grung can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, if it uses both hands and feet to climb.

trait.name: Poisonous Skin
entries: A creature that comes into contact with the grung's skin must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn. While {@condition poisoned} in this way, a creature that is not drenched in water must use its turn to move toward the nearest source of water and drench itself.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The grung makes two attacks, one of which it may replace with its Croaked Command.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage plus 5 ({@damage 2d4}) poison damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be affected by the grung's Poisonous Skin.

action.name: Blowgun
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 25/100 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1 + 2}) piercing damage plus 5 ({@damage 2d4}) poison damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be affected by the grung's Poisonous Skin.

action.name: Croaked Command
entries: Up to three creatures within 60 ft. of the grung's choice that can hear it may each use their reaction to attempt to Grapple or Shove a creature in range.

reaction.name: Spring Away
entries: As a reaction to being missed with an attack, the grung moves up to its speed without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

resist.special: weapon attacks not made from inside it

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The worm can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

trait.name: Earth Quaker
entries: When the worm burrows 30 feet or fewer below the surface, 10 foot wide, 10 foot deep fissures open at the surface above where it passes. Creatures in the space where a fissure opens must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone} in the trench, or move to the nearest unoccupied space outside the area on a success.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the worm fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

trait.name: Shock Sensitivity
entries: If the worm, or the ground within 30 feet of it is subjected to lightning damage, it cannot use its Terror From the Deep action on its next turn, and must use all of its movement to surface.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The worm makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its stinger.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d8 + 9}) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the worm. A swallowed creature is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the worm, and it takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) acid damage at the start of each of the worm's turns.

If the worm takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the worm must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall {@condition prone} in a space within 10 feet of the worm. If the worm dies, a swallowed creature is no longer {@condition restrained} by it and can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting {@condition prone}.

action.name: Tail Stinger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d6 + 9}) piercing damage, and the target must make a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw, taking 42 ({@damage 12d6}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Terror From the Deep {@recharge 5}
entries: The Worm moves up to its burrow speed, then bursts from underground thrashing in a flurry of debris. Each creature in a 15 foot radius must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or take 35 ({@damage 10d6}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}, or half damage on a success. As a bonus action, the worm may make a bite attack against a creature that failed this save.

reaction.name: Dweomersense
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with a spell of 4th level or above, the purple worm may move up to its burrow speed. If it is no longer a valid target for the spell, the spell slot is not expended and the spell caster may choose a different use for their action.

trait.name: Keen Sight and Smell
entries: The owlbear has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight or smell.

trait.name: Concussive Strength
entries: A creature knocked {@condition prone} by the owlbear must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be unable to stand on its following turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The owlbear makes two attacks, one of which may be with its beak. A medium or smaller creature hit with two claw attacks in a turn must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) piercing damage. This attack does an additional 5 ({@damage 1d10}) damage to a {@condition prone} creature.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage and the target is pushed 5 ft. away.

trait.name: Gnashing Throng
entries: Whenever the pyraja misses a creature with a melee attack, up to one other pyraja may use its reaction to make a melee attack against the same target.

trait.name: Packing Powder
entries: If the pyraja takes any fire damage from a source other than this ability, one of the pouches of black powder it is carrying explodes.
The pyraja and each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 11} Dexterity saving throw or take 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage.

action.name: Faulty Flintlocks (2 Shots)
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d10 + 2}) piercing damage.
If this attack misses, the pyraja makes a second attack roll against a creature within 5 feet of the original target.

action.name: Fumbling Reload
entries: The pyraja furiously attempts to reload its pistols. Up to one creature within 5 feet may use its reaction to make a melee weapon attack against the pyraja.

reaction.name: Stumbling Grace
entries: As a reaction when the pyraja fails a Strength or Dexterity saving throw, it halves any damage it would take from the effect and falls {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Gnashing Throng
entries: Whenever the pyraja misses a creature with a melee attack, up to one other pyraja may use its reaction to make a melee attack against the same target.

action.name: Jug Strike (Only if its jug is not smashed)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 1} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Jagged Jug (Only if its jug is smashed)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Smash Jug (1/Day)
entries: The pyraja smashes its jug over the head of a creature within 5 feet. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 9} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of the pyraja's next turn.

reaction.name: Stumbling Grace
entries: As a reaction when the pyraja fails a Strength or Dexterity saving throw, it halves any damage it would take from the effect and falls {@condition prone}.
Wargear Options

items.name: Ankle Shanker
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

items.name: Hook Slice
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage. The pyraja may make this attack as a reaction against a creature that misses it with a melee attack.

trait.name: Air-Hungry
entries: If the pyreling takes any cold damage or is doused in a non-flammable substance, its flames diminish.
Until the end of its next turn, the pyreling can't take reactions, and its traits and abilities do not inflict the {@condition burning|confc|burning} condition.

action.name: Spit Fire
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 15 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.
If the target has taken any other fire damage since the end of the pyreling's last turn, it begins {@condition burning|confc|burning} ({@dice 1d10}).

action.name: Devour Flames
entries: The pyreling ends the {@condition burning|confc|burning} condition on a creature within 15 feet, consuming the flames and gaining 5 ({@dice 1d10}) temporary hit points that last for a minute.
While it has any of these temporary hit points, it can make an attack with its Spit Fire as a Bonus Action.

reaction.name: Skitterflame Leap
entries: When the pyreling or a creature within 10 feet of it is dealt any fire damage, the pyreling can jump up to 15 feet without provoking {@action opportunity attack||opportunity attacks}.

trait.name: Fire Incarnate
entries: The vortex can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing, and can move through and stop in the space of other creatures.
A creature who has the vortex enter its space for the first time in a turn takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage and begins {@condition burning|confc|burning} ({@dice 1d10}).

trait.name: Raze-Winds
entries: A Large or smaller creature whose space the vortex enters for the first time on a turn, or that starts its turn in the vortex's space, must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or be carried aloft and {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 18}) in the vortex. {@condition burning|confc} creatures in the vortex's space take maximum damage from the condition, instead of rolling.

trait.name: Air-Hungry
entries: If the vortex takes any cold damage or is doused in a non-flammable substance, its flames diminish.
Until the end of its next turn, the vortex can't take reactions, and its traits and abilities do not inflict the {@condition burning|confc|burning} condition.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the vortex fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vortex makes four attacks with its Furnace-Gust Grasp, or makes two attacks and uses its {@condition burning|confc|burning} Whorl.

action.name: Furnace-Gust Grasp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@dice 1d8 + 5}) bludgeoning plus 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage and the target is dragged up to 10 feet toward the vortex's center.
A flammable object hit with this attack catches fire.

action.name: Burning Whorl
entries: Each creature in the vortex's space must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or take 9 ({@dice 2d8}) bludgeoning plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) fire damage, or half as much on a success.

A {@condition burning|confc|burning} creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more has its {@condition burning|confc|burning} value increase by a cumulative {@dice 1d10} until it leaves the vortex's space.

action.name: Fireburst {@recharge 5}
entries: The vortex flares explosively, searing each creature within 10 feet of it.
Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or take 28 ({@damage 8d8}) fire damage, or take half as much damage on a success.
On a success or failure, each creature {@condition restrained} in the vortex is hurled 30 feet in a random direction and takes an additional 14 ({@damage 4d6}) bludgeoning damage.

reaction.name: Guttering Revival
entries: When the vortex uses its Implacable trait, it can teleport up to 90 feet to a space that contains an open flame, then make two melee attacks.

reaction.name: Scorch Lungs
entries: When a creature in the vortex's space speaks or casting a spell with a verbal component, the vortex can force the creature to succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or take 11 ({@damage 2d10}) fire damage and begin {@condition suffocating|confc|suffocating} (Save Ends at end of turn).

trait.name: Light-Footed
entries: QianXia has a fly speed equal to her movement speed on her turn. Whenever a creature misses her with a melee attack, she may move up to 5 feet without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

trait.name: Slight-Bodied
entries: Whenever QianXia is hit with a melee attack, she is pushed 5 feet away from the attacker.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Qianxia makes two melee attacks, one of which she may replace with her whooping kick.

action.name: War Fans
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) slashing damage. Instead of dealing damage, QianXia can grapple the target (escape {@dc 15}).

action.name: Whooping Leap
entries: QianXia leaps into the air and drives down onto an opponent. One creature within 10 feet must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) bludgeoning damage and have QianXia land on top of it (escape {@dc 15}).

While QianXia is on a creature, the creature's speed is halved, she moves with it, and the creature has disadvantage on attacks that target her. On a successful saving throw or if the creature escapes, she lands in the nearest unoccupied space.

reaction.name: Twist Away
entries: As a reaction to being missed with an attack by a creature she has {@condition grappled}, QianXia forces the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or have one item it is holding wreched from its grasp and flung 15 feet away.

reaction.name: Drive Down
entries: As a reaction to being missed with an attack by a creature she is standing on, QianXia uses her Whooping Kick against it. On a failed save, the creature is additionally knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Clockwork Repetition
entries: The quadrone may choose to treat any {@dice d20} roll as a 10, instead of rolling.

trait.name: Perfect Synchrony
entries: If the quadrone is within 30 feet of a pentadrone, it uses the pentadrone's attack bonus instead of its own. If the pentadrone is using a decaton's attack bonus, the quadrone uses that instead, and so on.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The quadrone makes four attacks with its Springlock Shortbow, two of which it may replace with its Clanking Kick.

action.name: Clanking Kink
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Springlock Shortbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}5 piercing damage.

reaction.name: Troubleshoot
entries: As a reaction when a friendly modron within 5 feet fails a Constitution, Intelligence, or Wisdom saving throw, the quadrone adds 4 to its result.

reaction.name: Upgrade
entries: As a reaction to seeing a pentadrone within 60 feet die or transform, the quadrone may transform into a pentadrone, retaining its current hit points. No more than one quadrone may take this reaction.

trait.name: Wounded Fury
entries: While it has 10 hit points or fewer, the quaggoth has advantage on attack rolls. In addition, it deals an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage to any target it hits with a melee attack.

trait.name: Psychic Sensitivity
entries: If the quaggoth takes psychic damage, it must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Corpse Eater
entries: If the quaggoth hits a dead or {@condition unconscious} creature with its bite, it gains resistance to all damage until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The quaggoth makes two attacks; one its Claw and one with its Bite.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) slashing damage. If this attack was made at advantage, the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Clockwork Repetition
entries: The quarton may choose to treat any {@dice d20} roll as a 10, instead of rolling.

trait.name: Perfect Synchrony
entries: If the quarton is within 30 feet of a tertian, it uses the tertian's attack bonus instead of its own. If the tertian is using a secundus' attack bonus, the quarton uses that instead, and so on.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The quarton makes two attacks with its Reordering Strike.

action.name: Reordering Strike
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 90 ft., one target. {@h}15 bludgeoning damage plus 25 force damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 20} Charisma saving throw or be teleported up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space the quarton can see.

action.name: Command Chain {@recharge 4}
entries: One of each other type of modron within 60 feet of the quarton may use its reaction to make an attack.

reaction.name: Count the Cost
entries: As a reaction to seeing a modron under its command be destroyed, the quarton gains 10 temporary hit points. While it has any of these temporary hit points, the quarton's attacks deal an additional 10 force damage.

reaction.name: Upgrade
entries: As a reaction to seeing a tertian within 60 feet die or transform, the quarton may transform into a tertian, retaining its current hit points. No more than one quarton may take this reaction.

trait.name: Space-Time Lock
entries: Other creatures can't teleport to or from a space within 60 feet of the quarut. Any attempt to do so is wasted. If a creature within 60 ft. alters the flow of time for itself, either through Haste, Time Stop, Wish, or similar magic, the quarut is affected by the same magic.

trait.name: Unyielding Form
entries: The quarut is immune to any effect that would inapacitate it, immobilize it, or alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The quarut has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Time Sense
entries: The quarut knows the distance to and direction of each creature that has traveled through time or circumvented the restrictions of the {@spell Wish} spell, even if the creature and the quarut are on different planes of existence. If a creature being tracked by the quarut dies, the quarut knows.

action.name: Slow Time Bubble (6th Level Spell)
entries: The quarut creates a permanent 30 ft. diameter bubble of slowed time. A creature that starts its turn in the bubble, or enters it for the first time on a turn, must succeed on a {@dc 23} Wisdom saving throw or suffer the following effects until the end of its turn.
The creature's movement speed is reduced by half.
The creature cannot make more than a single attack on its turn.
If the creature casts a spell, the spell doesn't take effect until the beginning of its following turn.

action.name: Magics Undone
entries: The quarut ends each magical effect of the quarut's choice affecting one creature or object it can see within 60 ft.

action.name: Stasis Lock (9th Level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature in the quarut's slow time bubble must succeed on a {@dc 23} Wisdom saving throw or be unaffected by the passage of time until the quarut releases it. A stasis locked creature is incpacitated and immune to all damage and the effects of aging, and does not need to eat, drink, breathe, or sleep.

action.name: Temporal Purge (9th Level Spell, 1/day)
entries: One creature affected by the Quarut's stasis lock must make a {@dc 23} Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is removed from the flow of time. It ceases to exist and cannot be returned to life by any known magics, and the marks it left on the material plane fade and are forgotten.

action.name: Curse of Contemporality (9th Level Spell)
entries: One creature the quarut can see within 120 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 20} Charisma saving throw or be cursed to experience time conventionally, suffering the following effects:
The creature can no longer voluntarily be the target of spells of 8th level or above, or of equivalent effects.
If this curse is removed, another quarut is summoned in an unoccupied space within 60 ft.

action.name: Plane Shift (7th level spell)
entries: The quarut and up to eight willing creatures within 10 feet teleport to another plane of existence.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a Bonus Action, the quasit can transform into a form resembling any beast, or back into its true form. Its size and statistics are the same in each form, except that it gains a fly, climb, or swim speed equal to its movement speed if appropriate to the form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The quasit has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Sticky Claws (Bite in Beast Form)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@dice 1d4 + 3}) piercing plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage.
This attack has advantage if it targets a {@condition frightened} creature.

action.name: Invisibility (Concentration)
entries: The quasit magically turns {@condition invisible} until it attacks or uses its Scare.

action.name: Jump Scare {@recharge}
entries: One creature the quasit can see within 20 feet feet must succeed on a {@dc 10} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of the quasit's next turn and drop one item it is holding of the quasit's choice.

reaction.name: Panicked Hiss
entries: When a creature targets the quasit with a melee attack while the quasit is {@condition invisible}, the quasit can immediately recharge and use its Jump Scare.
If it does, the quasit is {@condition frightened} of the target until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a Bonus Action, the quasit can transform into a form resembling any beast, or back into its true form. Its size and statistics are the same in each form, except that it gains a fly, climb, or swim speed equal to its movement speed if appropriate to the form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The quasit has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Sticky Claws (Bite in Beast Form)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@dice 1d4 + 3}) piercing plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage.
This attack has advantage if it targets a {@condition frightened} creature.

action.name: Mastermind's Command
entries: The quasit chooses a creature it can see within 30 feet and shouts a shrill command.
The first attack made against that creature before the beginning of the quasit's next turn has advantage.

reaction.name: Protect Me, Mount!
entries: When the quasit is targeted with a melee attack while riding on a Medium or larger creature, it can change the attack's target to its mount.

reaction.name: Demonic Benediction (1/Day)
entries: When a creature it is riding on makes a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the quasit can grant the creature advantage on the saving throw.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a Bonus Action, the quasit can transform into a form resembling any beast, or back into its true form. Its size and statistics are the same in each form, except that it gains a fly, climb, or swim speed equal to its movement speed if appropriate to the form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The quasit has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Sticky Claws (Bite in Beast Form)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@dice 1d4 + 3}) piercing plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage.
This attack has advantage if it targets a {@condition frightened} creature.

action.name: Irritating Toxin (Recharges on a Short or Long Rest)
entries: The quasit secretes an itch-inducing toxin from glands near its shoulders and rubs it over its claws.
For the next minute, a creature hit by the quasit's Sticky Claws subtracts {@dice 1d4} from attack rolls and saving throws it makes until the beginning of the quasit's next turn.

reaction.name: Verminous Skitter
entries: When a creature targets the quasit with a melee attack, the quasit can use its Shapechanger ability and move up to 10 feet without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.
The attacker must choose a new target or lose the attack.

monster.name: Quell
languages: The languages it knew in life

trait.name: Spectral Weapons
entries: The quell's attacks treat all creatures as unarmored (an unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier.)

trait.name: Quelling Field
entries: If the quell is not in sunlight, the quell and each creature within 15 feet of it have advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects with a divine source, such as those cast by clerics or paladins, and resistance to damage dealt by such magic.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The quell makes two attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its Bitter Glare.

action.name: Wispy Clutch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@dice 3d6}) piercing plus 5 ({@damage 1d10}) necrotic damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 8}). A creature may attempt to escape this grapple as a Bonus Action.

action.name: Bitter Glare
entries: One creature the quell can see within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 3d8}) psychic damage as it experiences the true alienness and amorality that belies the gods' benevolent demeanor.
A cleric or paladin targeted with this ability has advantage on saving throws against this effect, but vulnerability to the damage dealt by it.

reaction.name: Intercession
entries: When a creature the quell can see within 60 feet casts a spell or produces a magical effect with a divine source, the quell can force the creature to succeed on a {@dc 12} Charisma saving throw or have the spell or magical effect fail.

monster.name: Questing Revenant
languages: the languages it knew in life

trait.name: Cursed Resilience
entries: When the revenant is reduced to 0 hit points, it does not die or fall {@condition unconscious}. Instead, it loses the ability to use its multiattack and releases all {@condition grappled} creatures, and must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns or die.
If the revenant takes radiant or fire damage while at 0 hit points, it is killed immediately.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: When the revenant's body is destroyed, its soul lingers. After 24 hours, the soul inhabits and animates another humanoid corpse on the same plane of existence and regains all its hit points. While the soul is bodiless, a {@spell wish} spell can be used to force the soul to go to the afterlife and not return.

trait.name: Vengeful Tracker
entries: The revenant knows the distance to and direction of any creature against which it seeks revenge, even if the creature and the revenant are on different planes of existence.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The revenant makes two fist attacks.

action.name: Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}). A target against which the revenant has sworn vengeance takes an extra 14 ({@damage 4d6}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Pronouncement of Guilt
entries: One creature that is {@condition grappled} by the revenant and against which it has sworn vengeance must succeed on a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw or be cursed.

While cursed in this way, its movement speed is halved, it can't teleport, and it has vulnerability to necrotic damage. When a cursed creature takes the dash action, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

monster.name: Questing Scarecrow
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the scarecrow remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary, inanimate scarecrow.

trait.name: Moved by Ill Intent
entries: If the scarecrow's creator dies, it must succeed on a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw or die as well. On a success, the scarecrow gains self-awareness.

trait.name: Volatile Spores
entries: If the scarecrow is killed by fire damage, it explodes. Each creature within 20 feet must must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take 28 ({@damage 8d6}) fire damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Relentless Tracker
entries: The scarecrow knows the distance to and direction of the creature whose clothes it wears as long as it is on the same plane of existence.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The scarecrow makes two attacks with its Harvest Blade, one of which it may replace with a use of its Paralyzing Glare.

action.name: Harvest Blade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) slashing damage. On a critical hit, this attack rolls its damage dice three times, instead of twice.

action.name: Paralyzing Glare
entries: One creature the scarecrow can see within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of the scarecrow's next turn. While {@condition frightened} in this way, the creature is {@condition paralyzed}.

reaction.name: Dread Shamble
entries: As a reaction when a creature the scarecrow can see fails a saving throw against being {@condition frightened}, the scarecrow moves up to half its speed directly toward the creature.

trait.name: Dive Attack
entries: If the quetzalcoatlus is flying and dives at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a melee weapon attack, the attack scores a critical on a 18-20.

trait.name: Throat Pouch
entries: A creature {@condition grappled} by the quetzalcoatlus is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained} in the quetzalcoatlus' throat pouch.

action.name: Savage Peck
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}22 ({@damage 4d8 + 4}) piercing damage. On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone} and {@condition stunned} until the end of the quetzalcoatlus' next turn.

action.name: Scoop
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}) if it's a Large or smaller creature.

action.name: Battering Wings
entries: Each creature in a 20 ft. cone must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or take 17 ({@damage 5d6}) bludgeoning damage and be pushed 5 ft away. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more falls {@condition prone}, additionally. The quetzalcoatlus' speed is reduced to 0 until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Flip Back
entries: As a reaction to a creature falling {@condition prone} within 10 ft. of it, the quetzalcoatlus makes a Scoop attack against the creature.

trait.name: Blurred Movement
entries: Attack rolls against the quickling have disadvantage unless the quickling is {@condition incapacitated} or has its movement speed reduced.

trait.name: Evasion
entries: If the quickling is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

trait.name: Small and Distant
entries: While at least 60 ft. from any hostile creature, the quickling can attempt to {@action Hide} as a bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The quickling makes three dagger attacks.

action.name: Cutpurse Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d4 + 6}) piercing damage. On a critical hit, the quickling steals a worn or carried item from the target.

reaction.name: Cackling Caprice
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack, the quickling may force the creature to succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Scent Metal
entries: The manticore can't be surprised by creatures wearing or wielding metal objects.

trait.name: Manflesh Appetite
entries: When the manticore reduces a humanoid creature to 0 hit points, each other humanoid creature within 15 feet of the manticore must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of the manticore's next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The manticore attacks once with its Three-Grins Bite and uses its Ironspine Tail Sweep.

action.name: Three-Grins Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) piercing damage.
A Medium or smaller creature killed by this attack is swallowed whole.

action.name: Ironspine Tail Sweep
entries: The manticore sweeps its bristling tail in a 15 foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage and be pushed up to 5 feet away.

reaction.name: Cruel Jest
entries: As a reaction when a creature attempts to leave the manticore's reach, the manticore forces it to make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw.
On a failed save, the target takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) slashing damage, is dragged 5 feet toward the manticore, and the manticore regains its reaction.

trait.name: Clockwork Repetition
entries: The quinton may choose to treat any {@dice d20} roll as a 10, instead of rolling.

trait.name: Perfect Synchrony
entries: If the quinton is within 30 feet of a quarton, it uses the quarton's attack bonus instead of its own. If the quarton is using a tertian's attack bonus, the quinton uses that instead, and so on.

trait.name: Keeper of the Ledger
entries: The quinton has advantage on saving throws against any spell that a modron has seen that spell's caster cast.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The quinton makes three attacks with its Axiomatic Bolt and uses its Stickler for Procedure.

action.name: Axiomatic Bolt
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 11} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}The target loses 1/5 of its maximum hit points.

action.name: Stickler for Procedure
entries: The quinton identifies some procedural error, invalidating one Declaration of Hostile Intent that it has seen in the last minute.

action.name: Convene Meeting (1/Day)
entries: The quinton teleports itself and any number of other modrons it can see within 60 feet to a private demiplane to discuss how to procede.
As an action, the quinton may end this effect, and each modron in the demiplane reappears in the nearest unoccupied space to where it departed.

reaction.name: Check Papers
entries: As a reaction when a creature the quinton can see within 30 feet makes an attack against a modron, the quinton demands a written Declaration of Hostile Intent.

An attacker with such a declaration on its person may use its reaction to reveal it. If the attacker does not, the attack fails. As a Bonus Action, a creature may write a Declaration of Hostile Intent.

reaction.name: Upgrade
entries: As a reaction to seeing a quarton within 60 feet die or transform, the quinton may transform into a quarton, retaining its current hit points. No more than one quinton may take this reaction.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The raccoon has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Rabid
entries: The raccoon has advantage on Charisma ({@skill Deception}) checks made to appear friendly. It may use its {@skill Deception} bonus in place of Initiative rolls.

trait.name: Nosy
entries: The racoon may use its natural weapons as Thieves Tools, and is considered proficient with them.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) piercing damage. On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or be infected with {@disease lyssavirus|ConfC}.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 piercing damage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The radiant idol has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Aura of False Divinity
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the radiant idol must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by the radiant idol until the beginning of its next turn. A creature that passes this save becomes immune to this radiant' idol's aura of false divinity for 24 hours.

trait.name: Wrathful Presence
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the radiant idol while immune to its aura of false divinity must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} of the radiant idol until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a bonus action, the radiant idol may transform into a humanoid or angelic form, or back into its true form. Its statistics are the same in any form, and it reverts to its true form if it dies. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (the deva's choice).

trait.name: Chained to the Earth
entries: Creatures and objects within 30 ft. of the radiant idol may not fly by any magical means.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The radiant idol makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Crippling Flail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) radiant damage and the target must make a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or be unable to make more than one attack on its next turn. On a critical hit, the target's shield is destroyed, if it is wearing one.

action.name: Radiant Strike (1/Day)
entries: The radiant idol chooses a point on the ground it can see within 60 feet of it. A 30-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder of bright light appears there until the start of the radiant idol's next turn. Each creature in the cylinder when it appears or that ends its turn there must make a DC: 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 36 ({@damage 8d8}) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reaction.name: Curse of Exalted Blood
entries: As a reaction to taking at least 15 points of piercing or slashing damage, the radiant idol forces one creature within 5 feet to succeed on a {@dc 17} Charisma saving throw or be cursed. A cursed creature takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) psychic damage the first time each turn it disobeys a command of the radiant idol.

trait.name: Pirate's Panache
entries: Once per turn, Ragas may spend half his movement to attempt a {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) or Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check, gaining Panache until the end of his turn on a success, or falling {@condition prone} on a failure.
While he has panache, Siduri's attacks are made at advantage and a creature he hits with an attack is pushed 5 feet away.

trait.name: Sleek Coat Insulation
entries: While Ragas has more than half of his hit points, he has resistance to cold and fire damage.

trait.name: Musiker's Dance
entries: If Ragas has panache, he may {@action Dodge} as a bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Ragas makes two Cutlass attacks.

action.name: Cutlass
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d6 + 2}) slashing damage.
On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or drop one item it is holding.

action.name: Battleshanty
entries: One friendly creature of Ragas' choice within 60 feet that can hear him may use its reaction to move up to half its speed and make an attack.
If Ragas has Panache, the target may instead use its reaction to move its full speed and take an action.

reaction.name: Dancing Lead
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack, the Ragas causes the attacker to move up to 5 feet and reroll the attack against another target in range of Ragas' choice.

reaction.name: Peg Stomp
entries: As a reaction when a creature attempts to leave his reach, Ragas forces the creature to succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or take 5 ({@damage 2d4}) bludgeoning damage and have its speed reduced to 0 until the end of the turn.

trait.name: Storm of Blades
entries: The ragewind may enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. A creature that starts its turn in the ragewind's space, or whose space the ragewind enters for the first time in a turn, must succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) slashing damage and be carried aloft and {@condition restrained} within the ragewind (escape {@dc 19}).

trait.name: Weapon Trove
entries: Whenever the ragewind misses a creature with a melee weapon attack, the creature may use its reaction to attempt a {@dc 19} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) or Dexterity ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature wrests the weapon from the ragewind's grasp.

trait.name: Conductive Array
entries: Attacks that deal lightning damage have advantage against the ragewind, and it has disadvantage on saving throws against effects that deal lightning damage.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the ragewind fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ragewind makes six attacks, no more than two of which may be with the same weapon.

action.name: Ragetouched Geistblade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d10 + 5}) slashing damage and the target must make a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature must attack the ragewind on its following turn or else take 5 ({@damage 1d10}) psychic damage.

action.name: Shieldcleaver Axe, +2
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 1d8 + 7}) slashing damage.
On a critical hit, the AC bonus granted by the target's armor or shield is permanently and cumulatively reduced by 2.

action.name: Bladeshaving Shrapnel
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d4 + 5}) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the beginning of the ragewind's next turn.

action.name: Cannonball {@recharge 5}
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}24 ({@damage 3d12 + 5}) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of the Ragewind's next turn.

action.name: Chipped Sword Flurry
entries: Each creature in the ragewind's space must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) slashing damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Thieving Wind
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack, the ragewind forces the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or have its weapon wrenched away.
The ragewind may wield any weapon dropped in this way as though it were both proficient with and attuned to the weapon.

trait.name: Bolt-Rider
entries: While at least 100 feet from any earthen surface, the raijū has a 60 foot fly speed.
Whenever a creature or object within 5 miles of the raijū takes or deals any lightning damage, the raijū knows and can teleport to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of it.

trait.name: Belly-Dweller
entries: A {@condition prone} creature in the raijū's space has disadvantage on saving throws against effects that deal lightning damage.
A creature that completes a Long Rest while in the raijū's space gains resistance to Lightning damage for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The raijū makes two attacks with its Barkbiter Claws, one of which it can replace with a use of its Drum-Thunder Cry, if available.

action.name: Barkbiter Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@dice 1d4 + 3}) slashing plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) lightning damage.
On a critical hit, the target begins {@condition burning|confc|burning} ({@dice 1d10}).

action.name: Drum-Thunder Cry {@recharge 5}
entries: The raijū barks out a concussive shockwave in a 15 foot cone, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be pushed up to 15 feet away.

bonus.name: Skyfire Leap
entries: If the raijū is climbing on a non-earthen surface, it can leap up to 20 feet, then the surface it leapt from ignites.

bonus.name: Drape in Lightning
entries: Sparks crackle through the raijū's fur, raising it on end.
The first time a creature hits the raijū with a melee attack before the beginning of the raijū's next turn, it takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) lightning damage and is pushed up to 10 feet away.

trait.name: Eternal Servitude
entries: A living creature that dies while under the rakshasa's control rises at the beginning of its next turn under the rakshasa's control with 30 hit points.
The creature's type becomes undead and its alignment becomes lawful evil, but its statistics otherwise remain unchanged and it retains its memories.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: The rakshasa can't be affected or detected by spells of 6th level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Sinister Heart
entries: Any hit scored against the rakshasa by a magical weapon that deals piercing damage and is wielded by a Good-aligned creature becomes a critical.
If the rakshasa is reduced to 0 hit points in this way, it is permanently killed and can't reform in the Abyss.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The rakshasa makes two attacks with its Reversed Claws and uses its Fiendish {@skill Insight}.

action.name: Reversed Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@dice 3d6 + 4}) slashing plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage, and the target is {@condition cursed|confc|cursed}.
A creature {@condition cursed|confc|cursed} in this way that would add any magical bonus to an attack, saving throw, or damage roll instead subtracts the same amount.

action.name: Fiendish Insight
entries: One player whose character the rakshasa can see must declare what action the character will take on their following turn, then that character must succeed on a {@dc 21} Charisma ({@skill Deception}) check or have the rakshasa learn that information.

action.name: Twist the Heart (7th Level Spell, Concentration) {@recharge 5}
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}44 ({@damage 8d10}) psychic damage and the target must make a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw.
On a failure, the creature is {@condition dominated|confc|dominated} by the rakshasa for the next hour, and repeats this saving throw whenever it takes damage, ending the effect on a success.
While {@condition dominated|confc|dominated} in this way, the creature takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) psychic damage whenever it deals damage to or is dealt damage by a former ally.

bonus.name: Master of Appearances
entries: The rakshasa assumes the illusory appearance and voice of any humanoid creature it has seen.

bonus.name: Sneering Command
entries: Up to two creatures the rakshasa can see within 60 feet may each use their reaction to move up to half their speed and make a melee attack.

reaction.name: Saw it Coming (Recharges when the rakshasa uses its Fiendish Insight)
entries: When a creature it can see begins to take an action, the rakshasa can move up to its speed and take an action or a bonus action.

reaction.name: Deceptive Demise (4th Level Spell, 1/Day)
entries: When the rakshasa takes any damage, it can teleport up to 30 feet to a location it can see, turn {@condition invisible} until the beginning of its next turn, and can attempt to {@action Hide}.
A corpse-like duplicate of the rakshasa is left in its place, which dissolves into mist at the end of the rakshasa's next turn, or if it takes any damage.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: The rakshasa can't be affected or detected by spells of 2nd level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Sinister Heart
entries: Any hit scored against the rakshasa by a magical weapon that deals piercing damage and is wielded by a Good-aligned creature becomes a critical.
If the rakshasa is reduced to 0 hit points in this way, it is permanently killed and can't reform in the Abyss.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The rakshasa makes two attacks with its Reversed Claws.

action.name: Reversed Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d6 + 3}) slashing damage, and the target is {@condition cursed|confc|cursed}.
A creature {@condition cursed|confc|cursed} in this way that would add any magical bonus to an attack, saving throw, or damage roll instead subtracts the same amount.

action.name: Death-Reservoir Dagger (1/Day)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) slashing damage and the target must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw.
On a failed save, the creature drops to 0 hit points and makes all saving throws with disadvantage for the next minute. On a success, the creature takes 35 ({@damage 10d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Fiendish Insight
entries: One player whose character the rakshasa can see must declare what action the character will take on their following turn, then that character must succeed on a {@dc 17} Charisma ({@skill Deception}) check or have the rakshasa learn that information.

bonus.name: Master of Appearances
entries: The rakshasa assumes the illusory appearance and voice of any humanoid creature it has seen.

bonus.name: Disappearing Act {@recharge 4}
entries: The rakshasa becomes {@condition invisible} until the beginning of its next turn, or until it takes any damage.

reaction.name: Saw it Coming (Recharges when the rakshasa uses its Fiendish Insight)
entries: When a creature it can see begins to take an action, the rakshasa can move up to its speed and take an action or a bonus action.

reaction.name: Alone (1/Day)
entries: When a creature ends its movement within 5 feet of the rakshasa, the rakshasa can throw a fistful of red powder in its eyes.

The creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn). While {@condition poisoned} in this way, a creature cannot distinguish friend from foe.

trait.name: Master of Treachery
entries: The rakshasa can sense the presence and nature of conflict between creatures it can see.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: The rakshasa can't be affected or detected by spells of 6th level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Sinister Heart
entries: Any hit scored against the rakshasa by a magical weapon that deals piercing damage and is wielded by a Good-aligned creature becomes a critical.
If the rakshasa is reduced to 0 hit points in this way, it is permanently killed and can't reform in the Abyss.

trait.name: Legendary Resistances (1/Day)
entries: If the rakshasa fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The rakshasa makes two attacks with its Reversed Claws and uses its Mastermind's {@skill Insight}, if available.

action.name: Reversed Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@dice 3d6 + 4}) slashing plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage, and the target is {@condition cursed|confc|cursed}.
A creature {@condition cursed|confc|cursed} in this way that would add any magical bonus to an attack, saving throw, or damage roll instead subtracts the same amount.

action.name: Sudden Spoiling (6th Level Spell)
entries: One creature the rakshasa can see within 15 feet must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or take 49 ({@damage 11d8}) necrotic damage, or half as much on a success.
If this spell was cast as a reaction on the target's turn, the target is additionally {@condition stunned} until the end of the rakshasa's next turn.

action.name: Mastermind's Insight {@recharge 5}
entries: Each player whose character the rakshasa can see must declare what action the character will take on their following turn, then each of those characters must succeed on a {@dc 24} Charisma ({@skill Deception}) check or have the rakshasa learn that information.

action.name: Displace Soul (1/Day, 9th Level Spell, Concentration.)
entries: One creature within 5 feet of the rakshasa must succeed on a {@dc 20} Charisma saving throw or fall {@condition unconscious} as its soul is forced out of its body and into the Border Ethereal (Save Ends at end of turn).

The affected creature can still see, hear, and speak faintly across the barrier. A creature that fails three consecutive saving throws against this effect is trapped outside its body until returned by a {@spell Wish} spell or similar magic.

bonus.name: Master of Appearances
entries: The rakshasa assumes the illusory appearance and voice of any humanoid creature it has seen.

bonus.name: Wreath With Flame (3rd Level Spell)
entries: Until the end of the rakshasa's turn, its melee attacks deal an additional 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.

bonus.name: Sneering Command
entries: Up to two creatures the rakshasa can see within 60 feet may each use their reaction to move up to half their speed and make a melee attack.

reaction.name: Saw it Coming (Recharges when the rakshasa uses its Mastermind's Insight)
entries: When a creature it can see begins to take an action, the rakshasa can move up to its speed and takes an action or a bonus action.

reaction.name: Deceptive Demise (4th Level Spell, 2/Day)
entries: When the rakshasa takes any damage, it can teleport up to 30 feet to a location it can see, turn {@condition invisible} until the beginning of its next turn, and can attempt to {@action Hide}.
A corpse-like duplicate of the rakshasa is left in its place, which dissolves into mist at the end of the rakshasa's next turn, or if it takes any damage.

legendary.name: Prepared Trap
entries: The rakshasa moves up to 10 feet, then activates a trap that it set earlier in anticipation of its enemies' actions, choosing one of the following effects. A creature targeted with one of these effects cannot be targeted with the same effect until it moves.

items.name: Spiked Pit
entries: A false floor over a 10 foot deep spiked pit drops away beneath a creature within 60 feet, which must succeed on a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw or fall in, taking 10 ({@damage 3d6}) piercing damage.

items.name: {@condition poisoned} Potion
entries: One creature within 60 feet that ingested a consumable magic item since the end of the rakshasa's last turn must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn).

items.name: Glyph Mine
entries: One creature within 60 feet and each other creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw or take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) damage of a type of the rakshasa's choice.

items.name: Tailored Bane
entries: Choose a spell in secret. The first time a creature within 60 feet casts that spell before the beginning of the rakshasa's next turn, the spell targets its caster.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: The rakshasa can't be affected or detected by spells of 1st level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Sinister Heart
entries: Any hit scored against the rakshasa by a magical weapon that deals piercing damage and is wielded by a Good-aligned creature becomes a critical.
If the rakshasa is reduced to 0 hit points in this way, it is permanently killed and can't reform in the Abyss.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The rakshasa makes three attacks with its Curseblade Khanda.

action.name: Curseblade Khanda
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) slashing damage, and the target is {@condition cursed|confc|cursed}.
A creature {@condition cursed|confc|cursed} in this way that would add any magical bonus to an attack, saving throw, or damage roll instead subtracts the same amount.

action.name: Gathra-Horn War Bow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 7} to hit, range:special, one target. {@h}10 ({@dice 2d8 + 4}) piercing plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) lightning damage.
This attack can target any creature the rakshasa can see. On a hit, the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away and knocked {@condition prone}.

bonus.name: Master of Appearances
entries: The rakshasa assumes the illusory appearance and voice of any humanoid creature it has seen.

reaction.name: Deceptive Feint
entries: When the rakshasa misses with a melee attack, it can make another melee attack against a different target in its reach.

trait.name: Dread Ambusher
entries: On its first turn each combat, the Ranger has +10 movement speed. If it Attacks on that turn, it can make one additional weapon attack as part of that action. If that attack hits, the target takes an extra {@damage 1d8} damage.

trait.name: Umbral Sight
entries: The Ranger is {@condition invisible} when in darkness.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Ranger makes two attacks with its longbow.

action.name: Longbow +1
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Snare, 2nd level spell (1/Day)
entries: The Ranger designates a 5 foot radius circle that it touches. The first time a creature steps into the circle, the trap is triggered. The triggering creature must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity Saving Throw or or fall {@condition prone} and be hoisted into the air where it hangs upside down 3 feet above the protected surface, where it is {@condition restrained}.
The {@condition restrained} creature can make a Dexterity saving throw with disadvantage at the end of each of its turns and ends the {@condition restrained} effect on a success.

bonus.name: Zephyr Strike, 1st level spell, concentration (4/Day)
entries: The Ranger makes its next attack at advantage, its next attack does an additional {@damage 1d8} damage, its speed increases by 30 feet, and it does not provoke {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity} this turn.

trait.name: Dread Ambusher
entries: On its first turn each combat, the Ranger has +10 movement speed. If it Attacks on that turn, it can make one additional weapon attack as part of that action. If that attack hits, the target takes an extra {@damage 1d8} damage.

trait.name: Sharpshooter
entries: The Ranger's attacks ignore half and three-quarters cover.

trait.name: Stalker's Flurry (1/Turn)
entries: When the Ranger misses with an attack, it can make another weapon attack as part of the same action.

trait.name: Umbral Sight
entries: The Ranger is {@condition invisible} when in darkness.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Ranger makes two attacks with its longbow.

action.name: Longbow, +2
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 600 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 1d8 + 17}) piercing damage.

bonus.name: Zephyr Strike, 1st level spell, concentration (9/Day)
entries: The Ranger makes its next attack at advantage, its next attack does an additional {@damage 1d8} damage, its speed increases by 30 feet, and it does not provoke {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity} this turn.

variant.name: Note: Ambushes
entries: Ambushes are a fun tool to use as a DM, but their primary use is in turning an easy encounter into a hard one. In a "fair" encounter using PC-like enemies, a successful ambush is very likely to TPK your party in a way that your players won't feel good about. If you still really want to do one, give Pass Without Trace to your Rangers and Druids.

trait.name: Dread Ambusher
entries: On its first turn each combat, the Ranger has +10 movement speed. If it Attacks on that turn, it can make one additional weapon attack as part of that action. If that attack hits, the target takes an extra {@damage 1d8} damage.

trait.name: Umbral Sight
entries: The Ranger is {@condition invisible} when in darkness.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d8 + {@dice 1d6} + 3}) piercing damage.

variant.name: Note: Ranger Spells
entries: Hunters Mark is fine, but its real value past level 5 is in conserving spell slots. Zephyr Strike is more generally useful for the kinds of situations a Ranger facing your party is going to have to deal with.

Ranger spells in general are really good, but at higher levels they either can't justify their complexity or they get severely outclassed by the raw power of just attacking. This is why the Ranger Legend only has a single spell prepared.

variant.name: Note: Why Longbow rather than Light Crossbow?
entries: The longbow is iconic, and a lot of the things that make a Ranger feel like a Ranger are bonus-action hungry.

trait.name: Dread Ambusher
entries: On its first turn each combat, the Ranger has +10 movement speed. If it Attacks on that turn, it can make one additional weapon attack as part of that action. If that attack hits, the target takes an extra {@damage 1d8} damage.

trait.name: Sharpshooter
entries: The Ranger's attacks ignore half and three-quarters cover, and don't suffer disadvantage for creatures being within 5 feet.

trait.name: Stalker's Flurry (1/Turn)
entries: When the Ranger misses with an attack, it can make another weapon attack as part of the same action.

trait.name: Umbral Sight
entries: The Ranger is {@condition invisible} when in darkness.
