entries: The Ranger makes two attacks with its longbow.

action.name: Longbow, +2
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 600 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 1d8 + 17}) piercing damage.

bonus.name: Swift Quiver, 5th level spell, concentration (2/Day)
entries: For the next minute, the Ranger can make two Longbow attacks as a bonus action.

bonus.name: Vanish
entries: The Ranger can {@action Hide} as a bonus action.

reaction.name: Shadowy Dodge
entries: Whenever a creature makes an attack roll against the Ranger and doesn't have advantage on the roll, it can use its reaction to impose disadvantage on it.

trait.name: Aquatic Renewal
entries: While submerged in water, Rasa may regain all of his hit points or regrow a lost limb over the course of an hour.

trait.name: Tempered by the Wastes
entries: Rasa has advantage on saving throws against effects that deal fire or radiant damage, or that cause {@condition exhaustion}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Rasa makes two attacks with his Mirage Strike, one of which he may replace with a use of his Raise Dune.

action.name: Mirage Strike (1st Level Spell)
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 60 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) slashing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Intelligence saving throw or lose its reaction.

action.name: Raise Dune (2nd Level Spell)
entries: Rasa raises a steep dune of loose sand beneath himself in a 15 foot radius that lasts for a minute, or until he uses this ability again. The dune is difficult terrain for creatures of his choice.

action.name: Flensing Sandblast (5th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: A continuous, tearing wind issues forth from Rasa's hand, whipping sands forward in a 30 foot cone. A creature that starts or ends its turn in the area must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) slashing damage, be pushed 10 feet away, and be {@condition blinded} until the beginning of its next turn.
As a Bonus Action on his turn, Rasa may change the direction of the cone.

reaction.name: Sandsnare
entries: As a reaction when a creature enters a space affected by his Raise Dune, Rasa forces it to succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Drop Limb
entries: As a reaction to taking 6 or more damage, Rasa drops one of its limbs, reducing the damage taken to 5.
A hanzaki that drops an arm makes one fewer attack with its multiattack. A hanzaki that drops a leg reduces its maximum speed by half.

trait.name: Keen Smell

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The reigar uses its Daring Juxtaposition twice, each of which it may replace with a use of its Transversal Beam.

action.name: Daring Juxtaposition (3rd Level Spell)
entries: Chaotic energy erupts between two creatures the reigar can see within 60 feet of it and within 15 feet of each other.

Each of the creatures must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or take 28 ({@damage 8d6}) damage, divided equally between any two damage types of the reigar's choice (round down), or take half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Transversal Beam (5th Level Spell)
entries: The reigar sweeps its arm and a 30 foot long, 5 foot wide line of shimmering light that lasts for a minute appears between two points the reigar can see within 120 feet.

When a creature attempts to exit the line's area for the first time on a turn, the reigar may teleport it to any unoccupied space within the line, or within any Transversal Beam contiguous with the line. An unwilling creature may make a {@dc 21} Charisma saving throw, resisting the effect on a success.

action.name: Conceptual Assault (7th Level Spell, Concentration) {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature the reigar can see within 60 feet must succeed on a {@dc 21} Intelligence saving throw or take 45 ({@damage 10d8}) psychic damage and be {@condition stunned} for the next minute as its mind is launched into an illusory reflection of the reigar's mind.

An affected creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success or learning one secret or weakness of the reigar's on a failure. A creature that learns one or more secrets or weaknesses in this way has advantage on attacks made against the reigar.

action.name: Masterstroke Pastiche (1/Day, 8th Level Spell)
entries: The reigar disintegrates all nonliving, nonmagical stone and earth in a 30 foot radius, 100 foot deep cylinder descending from a point it can see within 100 feet.

reaction.name: Excoriate Tedium
entries: As a reaction when a creature the reigar can see casts a spell that the reigar has seen a creature cast in the last minute, the reigar forces the creature to succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 3d8}) psychic damage as it is overcome with doubt and insecurity.

trait.name: Sense of the Sublime
entries: Whenever the reigar deals psychic damage, it gains an equal number of temporary hit points. While it has any of these temporary hit points, it adds its Charisma modifier to its AC.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The reigar makes two attacks with its Pandivergent Metatrident, one of which it may replace with its Epitaph to Modernity.

action.name: Pandivergent Metatrident
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., any number of targets. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) force damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) psychic damage.

action.name: Epitaph to Modernity (2nd Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: The reigar chooses a spell level or weapon type. Whenever a creature within 30 feet of the reigar casts a spell of the chosen level or makes an attack with the chosen weapon type, it takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) psychic damage.

action.name: Reflect the Real
entries: The reigar summons a construct duplicate of itself in an unoccupied space within 5 feet with one hit point that takes its turn immediately after the reigar and cannot create duplicates of itself or use its Multiattack.
The duplicate lasts for a minute, or until the reigar uses this ability again. When the duplicate is destroyed, it disappears in a shower of prismatic sparks.

reaction.name: Aesthetic Iteration (1/Day, 4th Level Spell)
entries: As a reaction when another creature the reigar can see casts a spell of 2nd level or below, the reigar casts a copy of that spell, using its own attack modifier ({@damage +8}) and its own Save DC ({@dc 16}).

If the spell deals damage, the reigar may change the damage type to a type of its choice. If the spell requires a saving throw, the reigar may change it to require a different saving throw of its choice.

immune.note: from nonmagical attacks not made with adamantine weapons

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The retriever can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Faultless Tracker
entries: The retriever is given a quarry by its master. The quarry can be a specific creature or object the master is personally acquainted with, or it can be a general type of creature or object the master has seen before. The retriever knows the direction and distance to its quarry as long as the two of them are on the same plane of existence. The retriever can have only one such quarry at a time. The retriever also always knows the location of its master.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The retriever has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The retriever makes two foreleg attacks, each of which it may replace with a use of its telekinetic beam.

action.name: Rending Forelegs
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}25 ({@damage 3d12 + 6}) slashing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. If the target is wearing nonmagical armor, it takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers. Armor reduced to an AC of 10 is destroyed.

action.name: Telekinetic Beam
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 8} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d10}) force damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or be dragged 30 ft. toward the retriever.

action.name: Force Beam {@recharge 5}
entries: The retriever emits a beam of transdimensional force in an 60-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in the line must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or take 77 ({@damage 14d10}) force damage, or half as much on a successful save. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is {@condition paralyzed} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Plane Shift (7th Level Spell, 2/Day)
entries: The retriever and up to four {@condition unconscious} or {@condition incapacitated} creatures on its back teleport to a location on this or another plane of existence. An unwilling creature makes a {@dc 18} Charisma saving throw, and is not teleported away on a success.

bonus.name: Bind
entries: The retriever restrains an {@condition incapacitated} or {@condition prone} target with steel netting (escape {@dc 18}). If the target is Large or smaller, the retreiver may then attach the creature to its back as part of this action. The netting can be attacked and destroyed (AC 18; HP 10; immunity to poison and psychic damage)

reaction.name: Scuttle
entries: As a reaction to being forced to make a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the retriever moves up to half its speed. If this movement puts the retriver out of range or area of the spell or magical effect, the retriever is unaffected.

reaction.name: Bloodied Beam (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 144 hit points, the retriever immediately recharges and uses its force beam.

monster.name: Revenant King
languages: the languages it knew in life

trait.name: Immortal Blood
entries: If the revenant is destroyed and its body is not interred in its ancestral crypt, its soul lingers. After {@dice 1d10} years, the soul inhabits and animates another humanoid corpse on the same plane of existence and regains all its hit points.

trait.name: Vengeful Tracker
entries: The revenant knows the distance to and direction of any creature against which it seeks revenge, even if the creature and the revenant are on different planes of existence. If the creature being tracked by the revenant dies, the revenant knows.

trait.name: Betrayer's Doom (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
entries: When the revenant is reduced to 0 hit points, it appears to die or fall {@condition unconscious} but does not. Instead, at the beginning of its next turn it resets to 136 hit points and rises once more, and immediately recharges its Revenant's Breath.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The revenant makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Thirsting Blade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) slashing damage. A target against which the revenant has sworn vengeance takes an extra 14 ({@damage 4d6}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Shield Bash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

action.name: Pronouncement of Guilt
entries: One creature within 30 ft. against which the revenant has sworn vengeance must succeed on a {@dc 17} Charisma saving throw or be cursed. While cursed in this way, the creature's movement speed is halved, it can't teleport, and it has vulnerability to necrotic damage. When a cursed creature takes the dash action, it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

action.name: Revenant's Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The revenant exhales a freezing mist that creeps across the ground in a 30 ft. cone, then is drawn into any humanoid corpses in the area. Each living creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or take 18 ({@dice 4d8}) cold plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) necrotic damage.
Humanoid corpses in the area rise as {@creature revenant retainer|confc|Revenant Retainers} under the revenant's control.

reaction.name: Vengeful Smash
entries: When a creature misses the revenant with a melee attack, the revenant can make a Shield Bash attack against it.
If it hits, the target must make a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of the revenant's next turn.

reaction.name: Swear Vengeance
entries: When the revenant is targeted with an attack or harmful spell, it swears vengeance against the attacker or spell caster.

legendary.name: Call Upon Oaths
entries: One allied creature that died since the end of the revenant's last turn returns to life with one hit point.

legendary.name: Seething Glare
entries: One creature within 60 feet the revenant can see must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of the revenant's next turn.

legendary.name: Betrayal's Debt
entries: One creature affected by the revenant's Pronouncement of Guilt must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or be dragged up to 15 feet directly toward the revenant. A {@condition frightened} creature that fails this save additionally takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) psychic damage.

mythicHeader: If the revenant's mythic trait is active, it can use the options below as legendary actions, as long as it has temporary hit points from its Betrayer's Doom.

mythic.name: Rend Flesh From Bone (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: One creature within 5 feet that the revenant has sworn vengeance against must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 4d10}) necrotic damage.
A creature reduced to 0 hit points in this way must immedietely succeed on an additional {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or have its flesh boil away, leaving only shattered and blackened bones.

monster.name: Revenant Retainer
languages: the languages it knew in life

trait.name: Cursed Resilience
entries: When the revenant is reduced to 0 hit points, it does not die or fall {@condition unconscious} immediately. Instead, it survives until the end of its next turn before dying. If the revenant takes radiant or fire damage while at 0 hit points, it is destroyed.

trait.name: Oathrisen
entries: If the revenant is released from its oaths, either through completion of its task, or by the assent or destruction of its liege lord, it is destroyed and crumbles to dust.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the revenant takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the revenant takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

action.name: Spiteful Shove
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 bludgeoning plus 2 necrotic damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Greaved Stomp (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition prone} target. {@h}6 bludgeoning plus 2 necrotic damage.

reaction.name: Pile On (Group Reaction)
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of the revenant attempts to stand from {@condition prone}, the revenant can fall {@condition prone} in the creature's space.

The creature must succeed on Strength saving throw with DC equal to 8 plus the number of revenants that took this reaction or stay {@condition prone} and be {@condition restrained} until the end of its next turn (escape {@dc 15}).

trait.name: Inspiring Obstinacy
entries: Friendly creatures within 10 ft. of the goat add {@dice 1d4} to saving throws against being {@condition charmed}.

trait.name: Pushy
entries: If the goat moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a ram attack on the same turn, the target is pushed 5 ft. away. If it is pushed into a wall or other solid surface, the creature takes an additional 5 ({@damage 2d4}) damage.

trait.name: Sure-Footed
entries: The goat has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws made against effects that would knock it {@condition prone}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The goat attacks once with its bite and once with its ram.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Ram
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Bolting Reflex
entries: When initiative is rolled, the horse may move up to half its speed away from the nearest enemy without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.
A creature riding the horse may attempt a {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Animal Handling}) check to instead control the direction of this movement, with disadvantage if the horse has taken any damage.

trait.name: Docile
entries: If the horse has all of its hit points, its attacks are made at disadvantage.

action.name: Hooves
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 ft. away.

reaction.name: Quick Kick
entries: As a reaction to a creature making an attack against the horse that benefits from flanking it, the horse makes a hooves attack.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The mastiff has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: Born Companion
entries: Creatures friendly to the mastiff that can see it add {@dice 1d4} to saving throws against being {@condition frightened}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mastiff makes one bite attack and takes the {@action Help} action, if available.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the mastiff can grapple the target (escape {@dc 12}).

action.name: Worry
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by both the mastiff and at least one of the mastiff's allies must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or fall {@condition prone} and take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The wyvern doesn't provoke {@action opportunity attack||opportunity attacks} when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Delicate Membrane
entries: If the wyvern takes 10 or more slashing or piercing damage in a turn, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or have its fly speed reduced to 0 until it completes a Short or Long Rest.

trait.name: Claw Rake
entries: While flying, the wyvern may make an attack with its claws as a Bonus Action.

action.name: Rending Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) piercing damage. If the target is wearing leather or cloth armor, it takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers. Armor reduced to an AC of 10 is destroyed.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) slashing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Stinger {@recharge}
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage. The target must make a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reaction.name: Jink
entries: When the wyvern is hit with a ranged attack while flying, it can reduce the attack's damage by half.

trait.name: Living Magic
entries: If the living spell is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as {@spell Dispel Magic}, it must make a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC.
On a failure, the living spell is {@condition stunned} (Save Ends at end of turn).

trait.name: Unfettered
entries: The living spell can move through any non-creature object or spell effect without resistance, leaving a Tiny hole in its wake.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The riftblade makes two attacks with its Transplanar Slice.

action.name: Transplanar Slice
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}26 ({@damage 4d12}) force damage.
This attack can target creatures in the Border Ethereal and scores a critical on an 18-20.

action.name: Carved Collapse
entries: A 10 foot radius section of floor or ceiling centered on a point that the riftblade moved through this turn collapses in a shower of rubble.
Each creature directly beneath it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Sever Magic
entries: When the living spell moves through a spell effect or hits a creature that is affected by an active spell with an attack, it can end that spell.

reaction.name: Through and Through
entries: When the living spell scores a critical hit against a creature, it can move up to an unoccupied space on the opposite side of the creature.
If it does, the creature takes 13 ({@dice 2d12}) additional piercing damage and begins {@condition bleeding|confc|bleeding} ({@dice 1d12}).

trait.name: Dweomersense Antennae
entries: Riodin can pinpoint, by scent, any magic items or active spells within 120 feet of it, and has advantage on Dexterity saving throws against spells and other magic effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Riodin makes three attacks with his Chitinblade Crashlance, one of which he may replace with a use of his Banking Twist.

action.name: Chitinblade Crashlance
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d12 + 5}) piercing damage.
A creature killed by this damage is sliced in half.

action.name: Banking Twist
entries: Riodin leans heavily, signaling a beetle he is riding. Until the beginning of Riodin's next turn, the beetle can change the direction of its flight as a bonus action.

action.name: Windblade Slash {@recharge 5}
entries: Riodin swings his lance with enormous force, sending a burst of bladed air in a 60 foot line that is 5 feet wide.
Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 2d12}) slashing damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Collision Strike
entries: When a beetle Riodin is mounted on uses its Tactical Collision, Riodin can make an attack with his Chitinblade Crashlance against the same target.
On a hit, the attack deals an additional 7 ({@damage 2d6}) slashing damage.

reaction.name: Mothdream Dust
entries: When Riodin is hit with a melee attack, he can shed soporific scales from his wings.
The attacker must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or fall asleep for the next minute, or until a creature wakes it as an action or by dealing damage to it.

trait.name: Ritual Combat
entries: The warrior conceives of combat in several distinct stages, and will not escalate to a stage before failing to resolve the fight with each previous stage, unless its opponents do so first.
1. {@skill Intimidation}; Shows of Strength and Martial Prowess.
2. Unarmed Combat, Striking Nonlethally
3. Armed Combat, Striking Nonlethally
4. Armed Combat, Striking Lethally
5. Armed Combat, Striking Lethally, Giving No Quarter

action.name: Unarmed Attack
entries: Melee Weapon {@action Attack}. {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) bludgeoning damage. This attack is made at advantage against a {@condition grappled} creature.

action.name: Knapped Shortspear
entries: Melee Weapon {@action Attack}. {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Submission Hold
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the warrior must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or lose 9 ({@dice 2d8}) hit points, or half as much on a success.
A creature that would be reduced to 0 hit points in this way may use its reaction to surrender. If it does, it is {@condition frightened} for the next minute.

monster.name: Roach Thrall
languages: telepathy 5 ft. (can only telepathically communicate with other roach thralls)

trait.name: Host Body
entries: The roach thrall is hidden in a Medium size humanoid host body (AC 10, 10 HP). While in its host body, the roach thrall can't attack or use its climb speed, and can emerge as a Bonus Action.

trait.name: Oxidizing Exoskeleton
entries: At the beginning of each of its turns after it emerges from its host body, the roach thrall's AC increases by 2, to a maximum of 18.
If the roach thrall is outside its host and has 14 or fewer AC, it has vulnerability to bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Versatile Movmement
entries: If the roach thrall does not use its multiattack, it may {@action Dash} or {@action Disengage} this turn as a Bonus Action, and gains a climb speed equal to its movement speed.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The roach thrall makes five attacks, one of which may be with its Clacking Mandibles.

action.name: Clacking Mandibles
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}).

action.name: Razor Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) piercing damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

action.name: Swallow Whole
entries: The roach thrall makes a bite attack at advantage against a Medium or smaller creature it has {@condition grappled}. On a hit, the creature is swallowed (escape {@dc 15}). It may have only one creature swallowed in this way.

The swallowed creature is {@condition blinded}, {@condition restrained}, and takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) acid damage at the start of each of the roach thrall's turns. A swallowed creature treats the roach thrall's AC as 14.

action.name: Snatch Weapons {@recharge 5}
entries: The roach thrall forces up to two creatures within 10 feet of it and within 5 feet of each other to make a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw.
On a failed save, the roach thrall snatches one object the target is carrying or wielding away from it and swallows it.

reaction.name: Emerge
entries: As a reaction to its host body taking damage, the roach thrall emerges, tearing its way out in spectacular fashion. Each creature within 15 feet must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Scuttle
entries: As a reaction to being forced to make a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the roach thrall moves up to half its speed. If it ends this movement out of the range or area of the spell or magical effect, the roach thrall is unaffected.

trait.name: Keen Sight
entries: The roc has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Gargantuan Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the roc may spend half of its movement to attempt a {@dc 17} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the roc. While climbing on the roc, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the roc, and the roc can't make melee attacks against it. A creature that isn't {@condition prone} may attempt this check as a reaction in place of an {@action opportunity attack||attack of opportunity}.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the roc fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The roc makes two attacks: one with its talons and one with either its beak or its shake off ability.

action.name: Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}27 ({@damage 4d8 + 9}) piercing damage.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 4d6 + 9}) slashing damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the roc can't use its talons on another target.

action.name: Shake Off
entries: Each creature climbing on the Roc must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength or Dexterity saving throw (target's choice) or lose its grip and fall. The roc may then make a talon attack to catch a creature that failed this save as it falls.

action.name: Wing Attack {@recharge 5}
entries: The roc beats its wings. Each creature within 10 feet of the roc that isn't climbing on it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take 37 ({@damage 8d6 + 9}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}. The roc can then fly up to half its flying speed.

reaction.name: Defiant Scream
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 124 HP, the Roc lets out a mighty screech. Each creature within 60 feet must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of the Roc's next turn.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 foot wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Soluble Form
entries: If the ooze is doused in at least one gallon of water, it takes 5 ({@damage 2d4}) acid damage at the beginning of each of its turns until a creature brushes the water off as an action.

trait.name: Shard Resorption
entries: If the ooze takes 10 or more bludgeoning or thunder damage, a shard (16 AC; 5 hit points; immunity to poison damage) of it breaks off and lands in an unoccupied space of the attacker's choice within 10 feet of the ooze.
When the ooze enters a space that contains one of these shards, it regains 10 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ooze makes two attacks with its Sugar-Gem Slam.

action.name: Sugar-Gem Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}).

action.name: Crystal Stasis
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the ooze must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 13}) as the ooze moves into its space and begins to engulf it.

A creature that starts its turn {@condition restrained} in this must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be engulfed and {@condition petrified} for as long as it remains {@condition restrained}. A creature {@condition petrified} in this way has total cover against outside effects.

action.name: Candy-Coated Control
entries: One creature {@condition petrified} by the ooze's Crystal Stasis moves up to its speed and takes an action under the ooze's control.

action.name: Sneak Attack
entries: The rogue makes a weapon attack. If the attack has advantage or targets a creature within 5 feet of one of the rogue's allies, it deals an additional 10 ({@damage 3d6}) damage.
The rogue can use this ability to make {@action opportunity attack||opportunity attacks}.

action.name: Shortbow
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

bonus.name: Cunnning Action
entries: The rogue Dashes, Disengages, or Hides.

reaction.name: Uncanny Dodge
entries: When a creature the rogue can see hits it with an attack, the rogue can halve the attack's damage.

reaction.name: Skirmisher
entries: When a hostile creature ends its movement within 5 feet of the rogue, the rogue can move up to half its speed without provoking {@action opportunity attack||opportunity attacks}.

trait.name: Evasion
entries: When the Rogue makes a Dexterity saving throw, it takes no damage on a success, and half damage if it fails.

action.name: Sneak Attack
entries: The rogue makes a weapon attack. If the attack has advantage or targets a creature within 5 feet of one of the rogue's allies, it deals an additional 21 ({@damage 6d6}) damage.
The rogue can use this ability to make {@action opportunity attack||opportunity attacks}.

action.name: Shortbow
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) piercing damage.

bonus.name: Cunnning Action
entries: The rogue Dashes, Disengages, or Hides.

reaction.name: Uncanny Dodge

trait.name: Hopping Movement

trait.name: Breath Sight

action.name: Multiattack

The target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}).
The target is pushed up to 5 feet away.
The target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Drain Vitality

reaction.name: Whip Around

trait.name: Moist Underside

trait.name: Rolystone Bearer
entries: The rolywere can tell, by touch, how long a plant or creature has been dead.

action.name: Prickly Antennae

The rolywere's AC is increased to 16
{@action opportunity attack||Attacks of opportunity} against the rolywere and checks made to grapple it are made at disadvantage.
The rolywere can't take actions other than to {@action Dash} or uncurl.

trait.name: Spider Climb

action.name: Multiattack

action.name: Ravening Maw

action.name: Tendril Snare

action.name: Wrench

action.name: Reel

trait.name: Fiendlight Pattern
entries: The flowers of the rotroots display a dancing pattern of colors visible only to fiends and those under the effects of the {@spell Detect Magic} spell.
A creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the rotroots that can see this pattern must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or use all of its movement to approach the rotroots.

trait.name: Corpsebed Fertilizer
entries: When first encountered, the roots of the rotroots are entwined among 4 ({@dice 1d4 + 2}) {@condition grappled} fiendish corpses.
While it has at least two corpses remaining among its roots, the rotroots has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Weaponized Cadavers
entries: The rotroots can't make attacks unless it has at least one corpse or creature {@condition grappled} with its roots. A corpse used to make an attack is destroyed on a roll of 1. A creature used to make an attack takes the attack's damage on a hit or miss.

action.name: Corpse-Club Bash (requires a corpse or Grappled creature)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}30 ({@damage 4d12 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Hurl Flesh (requires a corpse or Grappled creature)
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 8} to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d10 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.
A creature thrown with this attack falls {@condition prone} in the nearest unoccupied space to the target.

action.name: Crawling Root Snare
entries: One creature within 15 feet of the rotroots must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}, dragged up to 10 feet toward the rotroots, and {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}).
While {@condition grappled} in this way, a creature takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) necrotic damage at the end of each of its turns.

bonus.name: Devour Corpse
entries: The rotroots consumes one fiendish corpse entwined in its roots, which immediately softens and liquefies, produceing one effect of its choice:

items.name: Nourishing Rot
entries: The rotroots regains 10 hit points, and each other creature within 10 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or take an equal amount of necrotic damage.

items.name: Deathlurch
entries: Each other corpse entwined in the roots spasms and lurches, moving the rotroots up to 10 feet per remaining corpse.

trait.name: Undead Fortitude

trait.name: Abductor's Build

entries: If the rug is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as {@spell Dispel Magic}, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC or die.

trait.name: Damage Transfer
entries: While it is grappling a creature, the rug takes only half the damage dealt to it by creatures it is not grappling, and the creature {@condition grappled} by the rug takes the other half.

action.name: Smothering Wrap
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. {@h}The target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}).
While {@condition grappled} in this way, the target is {@condition blinded} and {@condition choking|confc|choking}.
If the rug has fewer than 28 hit points, the creature can attempt to escape this grapple as a Bonus Action.

action.name: Wild Thrash
entries: The rug thrashes wildly, lurching 15 feet in a random direction.
Then, the rug and each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) bludgeoning damage.

reaction.name: Rug Pull
entries: When initiative is rolled, the rug can force each creature that is standing on it to succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone} and reroll its initiative, taking the lower of the two rolls.

trait.name: Face of Ruin
entries: The caricature's faces resemble the creatures its members hatched from. A fiendish or humanoid creature killed by the caricature spawns a new {@creature ruin demon caricature|confc|Ruin Demon Caricature} from its corpse after {@dice 1d4} rounds.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The caricature can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and can move through any opening large enough for a tiny ruin demon. The caricature can't gain temporary hit points.

action.name: Gleeful Gnashing
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 0 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 4d4 + 2}) piercing damage, or 7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) piercing damage if the caricature has fewer than half its hit points.

action.name: Vile Infestation
entries: One creature in the caricature's space must make a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the caricature becomes {@condition attached|confc|attached} to the creature (remove {@dc 12}) and begins to force its way into the creature's mouth, eyes, ears, and wounds.

A creature the caricature is attached to must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) piercing damage and be {@condition blinded} and {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn.

bonus.name: Ruinous Meld
entries: If the caricature is in the space of another ruin demon, it may meld into that ruin demon, adding its current hit points to the target's current and maximum hit points.

Then, if the target is a {@creature ruin demon caricature|confc|Ruin Demon Caricature} with more than 110 hit points, it transforms into a {@creature ruin demon skyblight|confc|Ruin Demon Skyblight} with full hit points.

trait.name: Face of Ruin
entries: The shredling's face resembles the creature it hatched from. A fiendish or humanoid creature killed by the shredling spawns a new

action.name: Infest Wound
entries: The shredling lands on a creature in its space, becomes {@condition attached|confc|attached} to it (remove {@dc 12}), and attempts to burrow into its wounds.
If the creature does not have all of its hit points, the shredling deals 1 piercing damage to it at the end of each of the creature's turns.

trait.name: Face of Ruin
entries: The skyblight's faces resemble the creatures its members hatched from. A fiendish or humanoid creature killed by the skyblight spawns a new {@creature ruin demon caricature|confc|Ruin Demon Caricature} from its corpse after {@dice 1d4} rounds.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The skyblight can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the skyblight can move through any opening large enough for a tiny ruin demon. The skyblight can't gain temporary hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The skyblight makes a Gleeful Gnashing attack against each non-ruin-demon creature in its space.

action.name: Gleeful Gnashing
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 0 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 4d4 + 3}) piercing damage, or 8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) piercing damage if the skyblight has fewer than half its hit points.

action.name: Song of Ruin (4th Level Spell, 1/Day)
entries: Each non-ruin-demon creature within 60 feet that can hear the skyblight must succeed on {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or become hostile to a random creature within 15 feet of it and indifferent to all other creatures for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn).
This effect ends early if the affected creature takes damage from any source other than another affected creature, or if a creature takes an action to shake the affected creature out of its fury.

bonus.name: Split Off
entries: The skyblight loses 54 hit points and spawns a {@creature ruin demon caricature|confc|Ruin Demon Caricature} in its space that acts on its initiative.

trait.name: Undetectable Nature
entries: If a spell or ability would reveal the rukaryzyll's creature type or alignment, the rukaryzyll can choose for it to reveal false information.
If the rukaryzyll takes any fire damage, it must use its Shift Form on its following turn.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The rukaryzyll can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The rukaryzyll has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
entries: If the rukaryzyll fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The rukaryzyll makes three attacks with its Glowspore Bolt, one of which it can replace with a use of its Biting Touch or Earthblood Reclamation.

action.name: Glowspore Bolt (3rd Level Spell)
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 9} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@dice 3d6}) poison plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) radiant damage.
On a hit or miss, glowing spores linger in the air around the target in a 10 foot radius, shedding dim light in the area for the next minute.
Creatures in the area cannot benefit from Invisibility.

action.name: Biting Touch (5th Level Spell)
entries: The rukaryzyll drives two of its fingers into a wound of creature within 5 feet that does not have all of its hit points, sending scouring tendrils whipping through its veins.

The target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or take 45 ({@damage 10d8}) slashing damage and be {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn, or take half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Earthblood Reclamation (6th Level Spell) (Recharges when the rukaryzyll uses its Shift Form)
entries: The rukaryzyll touches a creature and sucks the life from the earth in a 5 foot radius around it, parching the ground and desiccating any corpses in the area.
The target regains 40 ({@dice 9d8}) hit points, or twice as many if a creature was reduced to 0 hit points in the affected area since the end of the rukaryzyll's last turn.

action.name: Essence Tunnel (6th Level Spell, Concentration) (Recharges when the rukaryzyll uses its Shift Form)
entries: The rukaryzyll creates a Large, rippling portal within a surface it can see within 30 feet, connecting it to a random point on an elemental, paraelemental, or quasi-elemental plane that it shares an affinity with.
For the next minute, a creature can use its action to push through the portal, taking 33 ({@damage 6d10}) damage of a type associated with the connected plane.

bonus.name: Gallseal (3rd Level Spell)
entries: The rukaryzyll touches a creature and suspends a condition affecting it, condensing the target's infirmity into a hardened knot of concentrated poison within its flesh that lasts for 24 hours before being regurgitated harmlessly.
If the creature takes 15 or more damage from a single source in that time, the knot bursts and the creature takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) poison damage.

bonus.name: Skittering Leap
entries: The rukaryzyll jumps up to 30 feet. {@action opportunity attack||Opportunity attacks} provoked by this movement have disadvantage.

bonus.name: Shift Form
entries: The rukaryzyll's flesh rends and boils as it begins to transform, gaining vulnerability to fire damage until the beginning of its next turn.
At the beginning of its next turn, it transforms into {@creature rukaryzyll rot-thing|confc|Rukaryzyll Rot-Thing}, retaining its current hit points and regaining an expended legendary resistance.

reaction.name: Uncanny Lunge
entries: When the rukaryzyll makes a saving throw against an effect that targets an area, it can move up to its speed.
If it ends this movement outside the affected area, the rukaryzyll is unaffected.

reaction.name: Split Flesh
entries: When the rukaryzyll takes any slashing damage, it can use its Shift Form.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The rukaryzyll can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The rukaryzyll can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Magic Resistance

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
entries: If the rukaryzyll fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

entries: The rukaryzyll makes four attacks, one of which can be with its Gurgling Maw.

action.name: Gurgling Maw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d6 + 6}) piercing damage plus one additional effect of the rukaryzyll's choice:

items.name: Acrid Froth
entries: The target takes 9 ({@dice 2d8}) additional acid damage.

items.name: Infesting Nest
entries: Blue fungal tendrils burrow into the wound, forcing the target to succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be infected with {@disease threadnest bluerot|ConfC}.

action.name: Scalehook Tendril
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d6 + 6}) slashing damage.

action.name: Ooze Ejection (Recharges when the rukaryzyll uses its Shift Form)
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 11} to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Hit 18 ({@dice 4d8}) bludgeoning plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) acid damage.

On a hit or miss, a {@creature gray ooze crevasse-crawler|confc|Gray Ooze Crevasse-Crawler} that acts on the rukaryzyll's initiative and dies after 1 minute appears in the nearest unoccupied space to the target.

At the beginning of its next turn, it transforms into {@creature rukaryzyll cursewright|confc|Rukaryzyll Cursewright}, retaining its current hit points and regaining an expended legendary resistance.

reaction.name: Thrashing Spasm
entries: When the rukaryzyll makes an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma saving throw, it can move up to half its speed in a random direction, moving through the space of any Medium or smaller creature.
Each creature it moves within 10 feet of in this way must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) slashing damage.

reaction.name: Spluttering Chorus (1/Day)
entries: When the rukaryzyll is reduced below 105 hit points, it can let out a chorus of wet screams from its many mouths.
Each creature within 10 feet takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) acid damage, then must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Land Vulnerability
entries: The rusalka takes 20 acid damage if it starts its turn outside of running water. For the week surrounding the Spring Equinox, this trait is suspended.

trait.name: Watery Rebirth
entries: If the rusalka dies while submerged in water, its body dissolves into water, reforming at the next dusk in the body of water where it lairs.

action.name: Strangling Locks
entries: Weapon {@action Attack}: {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}). A creature {@condition grappled} in this way is {@condition restrained} and cannot speak or breathe.

action.name: Comb of Needles
entries: Weapon {@action Attack}: {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) slashing damage and the target begins to bleed. At the beginning of each of a bleeding creature's turns, it must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw, losing {@dice 1d4} hit points on a failed save, or ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Luring Song (concentration)
entries: The rusalka sings a magical melody. One humanoid within 60 ft. that the rusalka can see must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} until the rusalka stops singing. The rusalka may continue the song as a bonus action on each of its turns.

A creature {@condition charmed} in this way uses its movement to approach the rusalka on its turn. A {@condition charmed} target repeats saving throw at the end of each of its turns and whenever it takes damage, ending the effect on a success.

reaction.name: Tickle
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack by a creature holding its breath, the rusalka forces the attacker to succeed on {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or release its held breath.

trait.name: Watery Rebirth
entries: If the rusalka dies while submerged in water, its body dissolves into water, reforming at the next dusk in the body of water where it lairs.

trait.name: Ecstatic Dance

A creature {@condition charmed} in this area uses its action to dance on its turn. If at least three creatures are {@condition charmed} by the rusalka, the area counts as difficult terrain for creatures that are not {@condition charmed}.

The rusalka may continue the song as a bonus action on each of its turns, and may choose a new target when it does so.

A creature {@condition charmed} in this way uses its movement to approach the rusalka on its turn, and repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns and whenever it takes damage, ending the effect on a success.

reaction.name: Ensnare
entries: As a reaction to a creature attempting to leave the range of its Ecstatic Dance while the rusalka is singing, the rusalka uses its Luring Song targeting the creature.

entries: The rust monster can pinpoint, by scent, the location of ferrous metal within 30 feet of it.

trait.name: Rust Metal
entries: Any nonmagical weapon made of metal that hits the rust monster corrodes. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to -5, the weapon is destroyed. Nonmagical ammunition made of metal that hits the rust monster is destroyed after dealing damage.

trait.name: Oxide Armor
entries: Whenever the Rust Monster takes any acid or lightning damage, its AC is reduced by 2 until the end of its next turn. Whenever the Rust Monster takes any fire damage, its AC is improved by 2 until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) piercing damage.

action.name: Antennae
entries: The rust monster corrodes a nonmagical ferrous metal object it can see within 5 feet of it. If the object isn't being worn or carried, the touch destroys a 1-foot cube of it. If the object is being worn or carried by a creature, the creature can make a {@dc 11} Dexterity saving throw to avoid the rust monster's touch.

If the object touched is either metal armor or a metal shield being worn or carried, it takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers. Armor reduced to an AC of 10 or a shield that drops to a +0 bonus is destroyed. If the object touched is a held metal weapon, it rusts as described in the Rust Metal trait.

variant.name: Note: Rust Monsters as Plot Hooks
entries: The lair of a rust monster glutton might contain a half-corroded magic weapon, prompting the party to seek out a great weaponsmith who can restore the weapon to its full glory.

trait.name: Dust Drinker
entries: The rust monster can pinpoint, by scent, the location of any creature within 1 mile that has been damaged by the antennae of it or another rust monster annihilator. A creature may shed this scent only by means of a {@spell Regenerate} spell or similar magic.

trait.name: Annihilating Wake
entries: The rust monster can burrow through any nonmagical, nonliving material at half its burrow speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

trait.name: Disintigrating Touch
entries: Any nonmagical weapon that hits the rust monster disintigrates after dealing damage. A creature that hits the rust monster with an unarmed attack must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or take 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage.

trait.name: Clinging Dust Armor
entries: Whenever the rust monster uses its Shed Detritus ability, its AC decreases by 1 to a minimum of 15. Whenever the rust monster hits a creature or object with its annihilating antennae its AC increases by 1 to a maximum of 20.
If the rust monster takes any lightning damage, its AC is reduced to 15.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The rust monster has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries: The rust monster makes two attacks with its annihilating antennae, one of which it may replace with a use of its Disrupt Magic, if available.

action.name: Annihilating Antennae

A nonmagical object or construct of magical force hit with this attack disintigrates. If the target is a nonmagical object that is worn or carried by a creature, the creature can make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw to avoid the rust monster's touch.

action.name: Disrupt Magic {@recharge 5}

reaction.name: Shed Detritus

entries: Whenever Saeno makes a melee attack, he can leap up to 15 feet without provoking {@action opportunity attack||opportunity attacks}. He suffers no negative effects from falling 30 feet or fewer.

trait.name: Warden at the Gate of Despair
entries: Saeno and creatures of his choice within 10 feet of him have advantage on saving throws against abilities controlled by fiends.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
entries: If Saeno fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Saeno makes three attacks with his Iron-Banded Fathom-Staff, one of which he can replace with a use of his Tumbling-Bell Toss, if available.

action.name: Iron Banded Fathom-Staff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage.
This damage can't be reduced in any way.

action.name: Tumbling-Bell Toss {@recharge 5}
entries: Saeno flings his staff, which bounces wildly between up to two creatures he can see within 30 feet before returning to his hand.
Each target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 3d8}) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.

bonus.name: Adjust Grip
entries: Saeno adjusts his grip on his Iron Banded Fathom-Staff, choosing one of the following effects, which lasts until he uses this ability again.

items.name: Palm-Driving Grip
entries: The staff gains a reach of 15 feet, and a creature hit by it is pushed up to 5 feet away.

items.name: Spinning Shield Grip
entries: Saeno increases his AC by +5 against attacks made by one creature he can see.

items.name: Iron Moat Grip
entries: Saeno climbs to the peak of his staff and balances there, 10 feet above the ground. A creature within 5 feet of the staff can attempt to topple the staff as an action or bonus action with a successful contested Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.

legendary.name: Unpredictable Shift
entries: Saeno moves up to half his speed and uses his Shift Grip.

legendary.name: Earth-Crumbling Strike
entries: Saeno makes an Iron Banded Fathom-Staff attack with advantage.
On a miss, the ground within 5 feet of the target becomes difficult terrain.

legendary.name: Swinging Kick
entries: One creature within 5 feet of Saeno must succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 15 feet away and knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Feather Step
entries: Sagamibo's high jump is up to 15 feet, or up to 30 feet with a running start. She may treat any surface, including leaves or falling snow, as solid ground.

trait.name: Harbinger of Strife
entries: When the daitengu or another creature within 30 feet makes an attack, it adds {@dice 1d4} to the result.

trait.name: Mirror Portals
entries: As a Bonus Action, Sagamibo can summon one a Mirror Portal at an unoccupied location she can see within 30 feet. Each mirror can be attacked (AC 16; 20 HP; Vulnerability to Bludgeoning damage)
She may spend 5 feet of movement to enter one mirror portal and emerge from another. If she can see any of her mirror portals, she may treat any of them as the origin of her attacks and spells.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Sagamibo makes four attacks with her Poison Needle, each of which she may replace with a use of her Gaze of Black Silence.

action.name: Poison Needle
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@dice 1d4 + 3}) piercing plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Gaze of Black Silence
entries: One creature that Sagamibo can see must succeed on a {@dc 17} Charisma saving throw or lose two unexpended hit dice and have its movement speed reduced by 10 until the end of Sagamibo's next turn.
A creature reduced to 0 hit dice in this way cannot speak or otherwise produce sound for the next minute, or until it destroys a Mirror Portal.

action.name: Spirit Knot Stasis {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature with 0 unexpended hit dice that Sagamibo can see must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} until the end of her next turn.

reaction.name: Reflect Strife
entries: As a reaction when a creature she can see misses a mirror portal with an attack, Sagamibo forces the attacker to make a new attack roll against a different target in range.

reaction.name: Enveloping Abduction
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack, Sagamibo forces the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or be tangled in the folds of her cloak, disappearing entirely.
At the beginning of the creature's turn, if Sagamibo has one or more mirror portals active, it reappears within 5 feet of one of them.

legendary.name: Poison Needle
entries: Sagamibo makes an attack with her Poison Needle.

legendary.name: Mirror Flicker
entries: Sagamibo and one Mirror Portal she can see teleport to trade locations.

legendary.name: Confounding Gust
entries: One creature Sagamibo can see must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or be spun around and disoriented, giving it disadvantage on the next attack it makes before the beginning of Sagamibo's next turn.

legendary.name: Equalize Energies (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: One creature Sagamibo can see must make a {@dc 17} Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the creature regains one hit die for each hit die it has expended, then takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) necrotic damage per hit die regained in this way.
