entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 ft. away.

action.name: Savage Thrash
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the dragon must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 3d8}) piercing damage, or half as much on a success. A creature that fails by 5 or more is {@condition stunned} until the end of the dragon's next turn and knocked {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Spell Turning
entries: As a reaction when the scalamagdrion succeeds on a saving throw against a spell of 7th level or lower that targets only it, the scalamagdrion avoids all effects from the spell and instead causes the spell to rebound, targeting its caster.

monster.name: Scarecrow Effigy
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Wicker Cage
entries: As a Bonus Action, the scarecrow may shove each Large or smaller creature {@condition grappled} by it into its chest cavity, which knits shut to seal the creature in.
A trapped creature that deals 10 or more slashing damage to the scarecrow in a turn cuts a hole through which a creature may attempt to escape by spending half its movement (escape {@dc 18}).

trait.name: Oil-Soaked Body
entries: If the scarecrow is exposed to fire, it is immediately engulfed in flame for the next minute. While the scarecrow is burning, a creature inside of climbing on the scarecrow takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage at the start of its turn, and the scarecrow's attacks deal an additional 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage.

trait.name: Volatile Spores
entries: If the scarecrow is killed while on fire, it explodes. Each creature within 30 feet must must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take 28 ({@damage 8d6}) fire damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the scarecrow may spend half of its movement to attempt a {@dc 18} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the scarecrow. While climbing on the scarecrow, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the scarecrow, and the scarecrow has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The scarecrow makes two melee attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its Paralyzing Glare or Knit Together.

action.name: Abductor Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 15 ft., each target in a 5 foot radius. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d4 + 6}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 18}).

action.name: Wrecking Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 15 ft., each target is a 5 foot radius. {@h}19 ({@dice 3d8 + 6}) bludgeoning plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage and each target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Paralyzing Glare
entries: One creature the scarecrow can see within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of the scarecrow's next turn. While {@condition frightened} in this way, the creature is {@condition paralyzed}.

action.name: Knit Together
entries: The effigy gains 22 ({@dice 4d10}) temporary hit points, and any holes that have been cut in its wicker cage close. Each creature in its Wicker Cage takes 22 ({@dice 4d10}) nonlethal psychic damage.

reaction.name: Dread Shamble
entries: As a reaction when a creature the scarecrow can see fails a saving throw against being {@condition frightened}, the scarecrow moves up to half its speed directly toward the creature.

monster.name: Scarecrow Haunter
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the scarecrow remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary, inanimate scarecrow.

trait.name: Moved by Ill Intent
entries: If the scarecrow's creator dies, it must succeed on a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw or die as well. On a success, the scarecrow gains self-awareness.

trait.name: Volatile Spores
entries: If the scarecrow is killed by fire damage, it explodes. Each creature within 20 feet must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The scarecrow makes two attacks with its Bramble Claws and uses its Horrid Glare.

action.name: Bramble Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) slashing damage. If the target is {@condition frightened}, it takes an additional 5 ({@damage 2d4}) psychic damage.

action.name: Horrid Glare
entries: One creature the scarecrow can see within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} for the next minute.
While {@condition frightened} in this way, the creature has its movement speed reduced by half, and must use its all of its movement to move directly away from the scarecrow on its turn.
A {@condition frightened} creature repeats this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

reaction.name: Dread Shamble
entries: As a reaction when a creature the scarecrow can see fails a saving throw against being {@condition frightened}, the scarecrow moves up to half its speed directly toward the creature.

monster.name: Scarecrow Shambler
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the scarecrow remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary, inanimate scarecrow.

trait.name: Moved by Ill Intent
entries: If the scarecrow's creator dies, it must succeed on a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw or die as well. On a success, the scarecrow gains self-awareness.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The scarecrow makes two attack with its Bramble Claws, one of which it may replace with a use of its Terrifying Glare.

action.name: Bramble Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 2d4 + 1}) slashing damage. If the target is {@condition frightened}, it takes an additional 5 ({@damage 2d4}) psychic damage.

action.name: Terrifying Glare
entries: One creature the scarecrow can see within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of the scarecrow's next turn.
While {@condition frightened} in this way, the creature has its movement speed reduced by half, and must use all of its movement to move directly away from the scarecrow on its turn.

reaction.name: Dread Shamble
entries: As a reaction when a creature the scarecrow can see fails a saving throw against being {@condition frightened}, the scarecrow moves up to half its speed directly toward the creature.

trait.name: Air-Hungry
entries: If the scorch-mort takes any cold damage, or is doused in a non-flammable substance, its flames diminish.
Until the end of its next turn, the scorch-mort can't take reactions, and its traits and abilities do not inflict the {@condition burning|confc|burning} condition.

action.name: Kindlescratch Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 fire damage.
If the target has taken any other fire damage since the end of the scorch-mort's last turn, it begins {@condition burning|confc|burning} ({@dice 1d10}).

reaction.name: Snuffsmoke Remnant
entries: When the scorch-mort is reduced to 0 hit points by a source it can see, it can turn into a wisp of dark smoke that dissipates at the end of its next turn.
If this smoke is dealt any fire damage, the scorch-mort returns to life with full hit points.

trait.name: Fey Magic Resistance
entries: The hag has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects imposed by a creature that does not know its name.

trait.name: Elusive
entries: The hag may {@action Disengage} or {@action Hide} as a Bonus Action while submerged in water.

trait.name: Illusory Mimicry
entries: The hag can perfectly mimic the voice or appearance of any animal or humanoid affected by its Steal Voice.

trait.name: Shipbreaker Coven
entries: The sea within 10 miles of a coven of sea hags is filled with dangerous riptides, jagged reefs, and vicious storms that raise with little warning. Creatures on a ship or shore have disadvantage on ability checks made to spot or assess these dangers.

action.name: Rotflesh Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) slashing damage and an illusory corruption begins to spread rapidly from the wound, giving the appearance of rotting, waterlogged flesh.
The creature must succeed on a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of the hag's next turn.

action.name: Stolen Spell (Coven Only)
entries: The sea hag casts a spell of third level or below known by a creature affected by its steal voice, using the creature's spell slots.

action.name: Steal Voice (Concentration, Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature within 30 ft. of the hag must succeed on a {@dc 11} Charisma saving throw or be unable to speak. If a creature fails this saving throw voluntarily, the hag does not require {@status concentration} to maintain the effect.

reaction.name: Courage to Dread
entries: As a reaction to a creature succeeding on a saving throw against its rotflesh claw, the hag makes the illusion real, dealing 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage to the creature.

trait.name: Vortex Trap
entries: The vortex can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.
Water revolves around the vortex in a 120 foot radius. Aquatic travel away from the vortex or against the direction of its spin costs three times as much movement.
A Gargantuan or smaller creature or vehicle that starts its turn in the area is dragged 10 feet toward its center and up to 30 feet in the direction of the vortex's spin.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the vortex fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vortex makes two attacks with its Swiftwater Crash, one of which it can replace with a use of its Maelstrom Grind.

action.name: Swiftwater Crash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 120 ft., one target. {@h}33 ({@damage 4d12 + 7}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet in a lateral direction of the vortex's choice.
A creature or vehicle the target is pushed into in this way must succeed on a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

action.name: Maelstrom Grind
entries: Each creature and vehicle in the area of the vortex's Vortex Trap must make a {@dc 21} Strength saving throw.
On a failure, a target takes 27 ({@damage 6d8}) bludgeoning damage and is dragged up to 5 feet in the direction of the vortex's spin for each point it failed by.

action.name: Yawning Void
entries: The vortex forces one creature or object within 10 feet of its center to succeed on a {@dc 21} Strength or Dexterity (target's choice) saving throw or be {@condition swallowed|confc|swallowed} (escape {@dc 21}).

At the beginning of each of the vortex's turns, each creature and vehicle {@condition swallowed|confc|swallowed} by it takes 18 ({@damage 4d8}) bludgeoning damage and descends 100 feet toward the seafloor.

reaction.name: Raging Reversal (1/Day)
entries: When the vortex is reduced below 180 hit points, it can suspend the effect of its Vortex Trap until the beginning of its next turn, at which point the vortex begins spinning in the opposite direction.
If it does, the vortex can use its Yawning Void as a Bonus Action on each of its turns for the next minute.

trait.name: Clockwork Repetition
entries: The secundus may choose to treat any {@dice d20} roll as a 10, instead of rolling.

trait.name: Perfect Synchrony
entries: If the secundus is within 30 feet of Primus, it uses Primus' attack bonus instead of its own.

trait.name: Iterative Order
entries: Whenever a creature deals damage to the secundus, the creature and the secundus each teleport up to 15 feet to unoccupied spaces the secundus can see.

action.name: Gaze of Purest Law
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}The target must succeed on a {@dc 22} Charisma saving throw or be {@condition incapacitated} if it is of non-lawful alignment.
As an Action, an affected creature may attempt a {@dc 22} Charisma ({@skill Deception}) check to feign a change of alignment, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Revolve the Cosmic Gears (Concentration)
entries: The secundus chooses one school of magic. Until it or another secundus uses this ability again, spells of that school fail, and magical effects of that school cease to function.

action.name: Voice of the One and the Prime (1/Day)
entries: The secundus relays the words of Primus, which though incomprehensible remain forever impressed upon the minds of those who hear them.

Each creature who can hear the secundus must succeed on a {@dc 22} Charisma saving throw or be {@condition cursed|confc|cursed}. While cursed in this way, a creature takes 25 psychic damage the first time each day that engages in non-lawful behavior.
This curse can be removed only by a {@spell Wish} spell or equivalent magic.

reaction.name: Upgrade
entries: As a reaction when Primus dies, the secundus may transform into Primus, retaining its current hit points. No more than one secundus may take this reaction.

trait.name: Clockwork Repetition
entries: The septon may choose to treat any {@dice d20} roll as a 10, instead of rolling.

trait.name: Perfect Synchrony
entries: If the septon is within 30 feet of a hexton, it uses the hexton's attack bonus instead of its own. If the hexton is using a quinton's attack bonus, the septon uses that instead, and so on.

trait.name: Safety Protocols
entries: Attacks and damaging spells that target the septon deal minimum damage, instead of rolling.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The septon makes four attacks with its Clockwork Clipboard.

action.name: Clockwork Clipboard
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Curse of Self-Reporting
entries: One creature the septon can see within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 16} Charisma saving throw or be cursed. While cursed in this way, a creature that engages in any non-Lawful behavior has disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws until it records and reports those transgressions to a figure of Lawful authority.

action.name: Stop Order (1/Day)
entries: The septon sends forth a pulse of temporal stasis in a 60 foot radius, ending each spell or magical effect of 8th level or below in the area.

Each creature in the area of the septon's choice must succeed on a {@dc 16} Charisma saving throw or be frozen in time until the end of the septon's next turn. While frozen, a creature is {@condition incapacitated} and immune to all damage.

reaction.name: Upgrade
entries: As a reaction to seeing a hexton within 60 feet die or transform, the septon may transform into a hexton, retaining its current hit points. No more than one septon may take this reaction.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: Shapechanger. As a Bonus Action, the lamia can take on the illusory appearance of any Small or Medium humanoid.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lamia makes two attacks, one of which may be with its Constrict, and uses its beguiling touch or its compel ability.

action.name: Constrict
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 15 ft., one Large or smaller creature. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}).

A creature {@condition grappled} in this way is {@condition restrained} and takes 14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns, and the lamia can't constrict another target.

action.name: Cursewright Dagger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) piercing damage and the target is magically {@condition cursed|confc|cursed} for 1 hour. Until the curse ends, the target has disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws and all Ability Checks.

action.name: Beguiling Touch
entries: One creature the lamia can see within 5 feet must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or have its Wisdom score reduced by 3 ({@dice 1d6}) until it completes a Short or Long rest, to a minimum of 1.
A creature that has its wisdom score reduced to 1 with this ability is {@condition charmed} by the lamia.

action.name: Compel
entries: One creature {@condition charmed} by the lamia must use its reaction to move up to half its speed and make a single weapon attack.

reaction.name: Torn Loyalty
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with a spell or attack, the lamia may force a creature within 5 feet that is cursed by it to make a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature becomes the new target of the spell or attack.

trait.name: Eyes of the Master
entries: Anything the overseer sees or hears is known to the demon lord that created it.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The overseer has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Serpent's Kiss
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@dice 2d8 + 7}) piercing plus 14 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage.

If this damage reduces a creature to 0 hit points, its body begins to bloat and distend until it regains any hit points, claws and faces appearing to strain within its flesh. An affected creature that dies bursts in a spray of gore, disgorging 5 ({@dice 2d4}) {@creature manes wretch|confc|Mane Wretches} that act on its initiative.

action.name: Voice of the Master
entries: The overseer's master speaks a dread command through it, producing one of the following effects.

items.name: Consuming Hatred
entries: If the molydeus can hear the overseer, the next attack it makes deals an additional 21 ({@damage 6d6}) fire damage on a hit.

items.name: Power Overwhelming
entries: If the molydeus can hear the overseer, it gains 15 temporary hit points. While it has any of these temporary hit points, attacks made by and against the molydeus are made at advantage.

items.name: Might of the Black Heavens
entries: A bolt of lightning leaps from the sky to strike a creature the overseer can see within 60 feet. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 23} Dexterity saving throw or take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) lightning damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Bonesense
entries: The serpentir can pinpoint, by scent, the location of any creature with bones within 20 ft. of it, and does not suffer disadvantage for attacking a creature with bones that it cannot see.

trait.name: Double Actions
entries: The serpentir rolls initiative twice, and acts on each of them.

trait.name: Churning Ribs
entries: A {@condition prone} creature that ends its turn {@condition grappled} by the serpentir is passed into its churning ribs. While there, a creature is {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 14}) and takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage at the start of each of the serpentir's turns.

action.name: Scrabbling Arms
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}).

action.name: Anklebite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

action.name: Scuttling Overrun {@recharge}
entries: The serpentir moves up to its speed in a straight line, and can move through the space of any Medium or smaller creature.

Each creature in its path must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone} and passed into the serpentir's Churning Ribs, ending the serpentir's movement on a success.

reaction.name: Spine Lash
entries: When a creature enters the serpentir's reach, it can force the creature to succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away.
A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is additionally knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Thousand-Layer Shell
entries: Whenever Sertap takes 25 or more damage from a single source, its AC is reduced by 1, to a minimum of 17. If its AC is reduced to 17 in this way, it loses its resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

trait.name: Tempest-Heralded
entries: Rough seas and gale-force winds always presage Sertap's arrival. While sertap is within a mile of the surface, the area in a five mile radius above him is plagued by terrible storms. At the beginning of Sertap's turn it chooses a direction. Each creature and vehicle in the area must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or be pushed 20 feet in that direction.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If Sertap fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Sertap makes three attacks with its Barbed Tendrils, one of which it may replace with a use of its Crushing Clamp, or with its Shell Ram if Sertap has used its Spike Volley Ejection.

action.name: Barbed Tendrils
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 4d6 + 7}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 21}).

action.name: Crushing Clamp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition grappled} target. {@h}36 ({@damage 5d12 + 7}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} and {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 21}). While {@condition restrained} in this way, a creature ignores Sertap's damage resistances.

action.name: Shell Ram
entries: Sertap moves up to 25 feet toward a creature or vehicle and slams into it. The target must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw or take ({@dice 10d10 + 7}) 62 bludgeoning damage and be {@condition stunned} until the end of Sertap's next turn, or take half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Bivalve Jet {@recharge 5}
entries: Sertap shoots jets of water in two 120-foot lines that are 10 feet wide. Each creature in one or more of the lines must succeed on a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw or take 49 ({@damage 14d6}) bludgeoning damage and be pushed up to 20 feet away, or take half the bludgeoning damage on a success. A creature in both lines that fails this save is pushed twice as far.

reaction.name: Synthesize Dweomer
entries: As a reaction when Sertap is targeted with a spell, it rolls to recharge its Bivalve Jet as the symbiotic organisms residing in its tissues absorb the magic's residue.
If the spell was cast by a creature {@condition grappled} by it, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 18} Charisma saving throw or lose its highest level unexpended spell slot.

reaction.name: Spike Volley Ejection (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction when Sertap is reduced below 215 hit points, it propels the spines from its shell, forcing each creature it can see within 60 feet to succeed on a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw or take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) piercing damage.
For the next minute, Sertap has advantage on Dexterity saving throws and can use its Shell Ram in place of its Crushing Clamp as part of its Multiattack.

legendary.name: Jet Intake
entries: One submerged creature that sertap can see must succeed on a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw or be pulled 20 feet toward Sertap.

legendary.name: Benthic Gaze
entries: Sertap turns its ancient gaze upon a creature within 30 feet that it can see, flooding the creature's mind with an eternity of incomprehensible memories of the cold and black. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 18} Intelligence saving throw or take 9 ({@dice 2d8}) cold plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) psychic damage.

legendary.name: Rock Boat (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Sertap rocks a boat or ship within 10 feet. Each unsecured creature on the vehicle's deck is pushed 15 feet in the same direction. If this movement would eject a creature from the vehicle, it makes a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw, catching itself on the edge on a success. A creature hanging from the edge of a ship is considered {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The rat has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Quick Squeeze
entries: The rat may move through any space larger than its skull without squeezing.

trait.name: Gnaw Through
entries: The rat can burrow a tiny hole through one foot of nonmagical wood in ten minutes, or through one foot of stone or soft metal in one hour.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or be infected with {@disease filth fever|ConfC}.

trait.name: Pain Focus
entries: While it has fewer than 103 hit points, the shadar-kai may dash or make a melee attack as a bonus action.

trait.name: Creeping Apathy
entries: If the shadar-kai ends its turn without dealing or receiving damage, its AC is reduced by 2 until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Deep Shadow
entries: Areas of dim light or darkness within 15 ft. of the shadar-kai count as difficult terrain for creatures of its choice. Hostile creatures that start their turn in the area, or enter the area for the first time on a turn, must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) necrotic damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shadar-kai makes two attacks with its Corrupting Blackfire and uses either its Curse of Beshadowed Mind or Curse of the Bloody Tongue.

action.name: Corrupting Blackfire
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage and 5 ({@damage 1d10}) necrotic damage and catch fire; until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the creature takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage at the start of each of its turns and can't benefit from healing magic.

action.name: Curse of Beshadowed Mind
entries: One creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 17} Charisma saving throw or be cursed. While cursed in this way, the range of the creature's {@sense darkvision}, if it has it, is reduced to 10 ft., and the creature has disadvantage on Dexterity and Wisdom saving throws while in bright light

action.name: Curse of the Bloody Tongue
entries: One creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 14} Charisma saving throw or be cursed. While cursed in this way, whenever the creature attempts to speak or cast a spell it must first succeed on a {@dc 16} Consitution saving throw or be unable to speak or breathe this turn.

reaction.name: Snuff
entries: As a reaction to a source of light entering the radius of its Deep Shadow trait, the shadar-kai extinguishes it.

trait.name: Pain Focus
entries: While it has fewer than 50 hit points, the shadar-kai may dash or make a melee attack as a bonus action.

trait.name: Creeping Apathy
entries: If the shadar-kai ends its turn without dealing or receiving damage, its AC is reduced by 4 until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Shadows of the Raven Queen
entries: The shadar-kai's attacks deal an additional 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage to a creature that can't see it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shadar-kai makes three attacks with its kukris. If at least two of these attacks hit the same creature, the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the end of the shadar-kai's next turn.

action.name: Shadestrike Kukris
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d6 + 4}) slashing damage.

reaction.name: Darkened Dodge
entries: As a reaction to being targeted by an attack while in dim light or darkness, the shadar-kai teleports up to 15 ft. to an unoccupied space it can see. If this movement makes it an invalid target for the triggering attack, the attack misses.

trait.name: Pain Focus
entries: While it has fewer than 96 hit points, the shadar-kai may dash or make a melee attack as a bonus action.

trait.name: Creeping Apathy
entries: If the shadar-kai ends its turn without dealing or receiving damage, its AC is reduced by 1 until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Umbral Weapon
entries: The shadar-kai treats its spear as arbitrarily long (up to 120 ft.), as long as the attack doesn't pass through or into any areas of bright light.

trait.name: Armor of Years
entries: A creature that hits the gloom weaver with a melee attack takes 25 necrotic damage and must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or age {@dice 1d4 x 5} years. This trait is then disrupted until the end of its next turn. The aging effect can be reversed with a {@spell greater restoration} spell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shadar-kai makes two attacks with its darkspear.

action.name: Darkspear
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage and 11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be disoriented, making attacks at disadvantage until the end of its next turn. Additionally, a creature that fail this save falls {@condition prone} if it misses with a melee attack on its next turn.

reaction.name: Shadow Jaunt
entries: As a reaction to taking damage, the shadar-kai magically teleports up to 30 ft. to an unoccupied space it can see. Both the space it teleports from and to must be in dim light or darkness. Until the beginning of its next turn, the shadar-kai has resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

trait.name: Pain Focus
entries: While it has fewer than 90 hit points, the shadar-kai may dash or make a melee attack as a bonus action.

trait.name: Creeping Apathy

entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) slashing damage. If this damage triggers a saving throw to maintain Concentration, the save is made at disadvantage.

action.name: Gloom Cage {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature within 30 ft. in dim light or darkness must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 12}) as wisps of darkness tether it in place for the next minute, or until it is exposed to bright light.

trait.name: Pain Focus
entries: While it has fewer than 65 hit points, the shadar-kai may dash or make a melee attack as a bonus action.

trait.name: Creeping Apathy
entries: If the shadar-kai ends its turn without dealing or receiving damage, its AC is reduced by 2 until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Deep Shadow
entries: Areas of dim light or darkness within 15 ft. of the shadar-kai count as difficult terrain for creatures of its choice.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shadar-kai makes two attacks with its blackfire touch and uses its Curse of Beshadowed Mind, if available.

action.name: Blackfire Touch
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage and 5 ({@damage 1d10}) necrotic damage. The target is unaffected by the next source of healing it receives before the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Curse of Beshadowed Mind {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 14} Charisma saving throw or be cursed. While cursed in this way, the range of the creature's {@sense darkvision}, if it has it, is reduced to 10 ft., and the creature has disadvantage on Dexterity and Wisdom saving throws while in bright light

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the demon takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the demon takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

trait.name: Fleeting Shadow
entries: While in Bright Light, the demon is {@condition blinded}. If it ends its turn in an area of Bright Light, it dies.

action.name: Lightsbane Assault (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}3 necrotic damage.
This attack can target an area of Bright Light in the demon's reach (AC 10, or equal to the spell caster's Save DC if the light is produced by a spell).
An area of light hit with this attack has the radius it projects from its source reduced by 5 feet.

action.name: Shadow Teleport
entries: The demon teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space of Dim Light or Darkness that it can see.

resist.note: while in dim light or darkness

trait.name: Dread Presence
entries: At the beginning of each of the demon's turns, it may reveal its presence to each creature within 60 feet that it is Hidden from.
If it does, each of those creatures must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the beginning of the demon's next turn.

trait.name: Light-Repulsed
entries: At the end of each creature's turn, if the demon is in Bright Light it takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) radiant damage, releases any creatures {@condition grappled} by it, and is pushed 10 feet away from the nearest source of Bright Light.

action.name: Multattack
entries: The demon makes two attacks with its Light-Rending Claws, one of which it may replace with a use of its Plunging Grasp.

action.name: Light-Rending Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) necrotic damage.
This attack can target an area of Bright Light in the demon's reach (AC 10, or equal to the spell caster's Save DC if the light is produced by a spell).
An area of light hit with this attack has the radius it projects from its source reduced by 5 feet.

action.name: Plunging Grasp
entries: One creature within 5 feet of the demon must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage and is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}) as the demon plunges its spectral claws into the creature's chest.
A creature that starts its turn {@condition grappled} in this way takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage and is {@condition frightened} until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Shredding Swoop {@recharge 5}
entries: Until the end of its turn, the demon can move through creatures and objects as though they were difficult terrain, and may make a Light-Rending Claws attack with advantage against each creature it passes through.

reaction.name: Shifting Shadows
entries: When a fiend it can see dies within 60 feet, the demon can summon three {@creature shadow demon scrabbler|confc|Shadow Demon Scrabblers} in unoccupied spaces it can see within 20 feet of the fallen fiend.

reaction.name: Sudden Disappearance
entries: When the demon ends its turn in Dim Light or Darkness, it can attempt to {@action Hide} and may do so without obscurement.

immune.special: one other type determined by the dragon's former type

trait.name: Shadow Form
entries: The shadow dragon's traits change depending on lighting.
In darkness, the dragon treats all creatures as unarmored (an unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier.)
In dim light or darkness it can hide as a bonus action without obscurement, submerging itself in pools of shadow.
In bright light, attacks against the dragon have advantage.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Shadow Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon exhales writhing shadow in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw, taking 24 ({@damage 7d6}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature with a shadow reduced to 0 by this damage falls into its shadow, and its shadow climbs into the material plane to replace it, with the following attributes:
The creature's shadow has the same statistics and abilities as the creature and has one hit point. It acts on the dragon's initiative and is under the dragon's control.
The creature remains conscious, but may only target its shadow with spells and abilities.
A creature can wrestle the shadow back into the shadow realm with a successful {@dc 12} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. If it does, the creature returns to the material plane with one hit point.
If the creature's shadow receives any healing, the shadow is banished to the shadow realm. The creature returns to the material plane with one hit point.
If the creature's shadow dies, the creature is lost forever to the realm of shadow.

reaction.name: Shadow Glide (Dim light only)
entries: As a reaction to taking damage of a type it is resistant to, the dragon may teleport up to 20 feet and turn {@condition invisible} until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The shadow mastiff has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: Light Dependance
entries: While in darkness, the shadow mastiff is {@condition invisible} and has a 50 ft. climb speed. While in bright light, attack rolls against the shadow have advantage.

action.name: Multiattack (Darkness only)
entries: The shadow mastiff makes two bite attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) piercing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the shadow mastiff can grapple the target (escape {@dc 13}). If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Worry (Dim light or darkness only)
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by both the shadow mastiff and at least one of the shadow mastiff's allies must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or take 31 ({@damage 9d6}) piercing damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Bay {@recharge 5}
entries: As a reaction to being illuminated by a source of bright light for the first time this turn, the shadow mastiff lets out a terrifying prolonged howl. Each creature within 60 ft. that can hear it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} of the hound for the next minute and drop what it's holding. Any light sources dropped in this way are extinguished. A {@condition frightened} creature repeats this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The shadow can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Shadow Stealth
entries: While in dim light or darkness, the shadow can take the {@action Hide} action as a Bonus Action.

trait.name: Light Dependance
entries: While in darkness, the shadow is {@condition invisible} and can use its strength drain. While in bright light, the shadow has advantage on attack rolls, but loses its damage resistances.

action.name: Rend Strength (Darkness only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d6 + 4}) necrotic damage and the target's Strength score is reduced by 3 ({@dice 1d6}) until it completes a Short or Long Rest.
The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0. A humanoid killed by this attack has its shadow rise as a {@creature shadow stalker|confc} at the beginning of its following turn.

action.name: Puppeteer
entries: One creature within 5 feet of the shadow must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or have the shadow attach itself to it (escape {@dc 12}), displacing the creature's natural shadow.

While the shadow is attached in this way, it moves with the creature, and at the beginning of each of the creature's turns the shadow can force it to succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or act under the shadow's control this turn.

reaction.name: Shadow Glide (Dim Light only)
entries: When the shadow takes damage of a type it is resistant to, it can teleport up to 60 feet and turn {@condition invisible} until the end of its next turn, or until it makes an attack.

trait.name: Destroyed by Light
entries: If the shadow starts its turn in bright light, it may not take actions that turn other than to {@action Dash} or {@action Hide}. A shadow that ends its turn in bright light is destroyed.

trait.name: Minion

entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}3 bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 6} Strength saving throw or take an additional 1 bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Strength Siphon
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}The target's Strength score is reduced by 1, to a minimum of 1, until it completes a Short or Long Rest, and the shadow is destroyed.
A creature whose Strength is reduced to 1 in this way cannot stand from {@condition prone} without a creature using an Action to assist it.

action.name: Douse
entries: The shadow reduces a source of bright light it can see within 60 feet to dim light, or extinguishes a source of dim light it can see in the area. If the shadow is hidden, this action does not reveal its position.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The shadow can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

entries: While in dim light or darkness, the shadow can take the {@action Hide} action as a Bonus Action.

trait.name: Light Dependance

action.name: Shadow Choke (Dim or Bright Light only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}17 ({@damage 4d6 + 3}) necrotic damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} and cannot breathe (escape {@dc 10}). This grapple is broken if the shadow is in darkness.
If the target was already {@condition grappled}, the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or lose its held breath and begin to suffocate.

action.name: Strength Drain (Darkness only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}The target's Strength score is reduced by 2 ({@dice 1d4}) until it completes a Short or Long Rest.
The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0. A humanoid killed by this attack has its shadow rise as a {@creature shadow stalker|confc} at the beginning of its following turn.

reaction.name: Shadow Glide (Dim Light only)
entries: When the shadow takes damage of a type it is resistant to, it can teleport up to 60 feet and turn {@condition invisible} until the end of its next turn, or until it makes an attack.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The wisp can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Reactive Illumination
entries: The wisp sheds dim light in a 20-foot radius while illuminated by no other sources. While illuminated by a source of dim light other than itself, the wisp is {@condition invisible}. While illuminated by a source of bright light other than itself, the wisp shines twice as bright, casting dark shadows.

action.name: Lure
entries: One creature that can see the wisp must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by the wisp until the end of the wisp's next turn. While {@condition charmed} in this way, a creature must use all of its movement to approach the wisp.

action.name: Shadow Betrayal
entries: The wisp briefly flares with light and incites the shadows of each creature within its illumination to attack the creatures that cast them.

Each creature within 20 feet of the wisp must succeed on a {@dc 13} Charisma saving throw or take 9 ({@damage 2d6 + 2}) necrotic damage and have its Strength score reduced by 2 ({@dice 1d4}) until it completes a Short or Long Rest. The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0.

variant.name: Design Note
entries: Wisps can struggle to present compelling combat threats on their own, and are instead generally meant to enhance other encounters, leading the party into danger and then using their lure to split some of them away from the melee, or moving in and attacking once the party are engaged with the greater foe.

trait.name: Damage Transfer
entries: While grappling at least one creature, the shadowcloak elder takes only half the damage dealt to it (rounded down), and a creature {@condition grappled} by it of the shadowcloak elder's choice takes the other half.

trait.name: Light Sensitivity
entries: While in bright light, the shadowcloak elder has disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight and can't use its Phantasms ability.

trait.name: Unceasing Moan
entries: While the shadowcloak elder has fewer than 95 hit points, it continuously releases an unsettling, breathless moan. Each non-aberration creature within 30 ft. of the cloaker subtracts {@dice 1d4} from any attack rolls it makes.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shadowcloak elder makes four attacks, one of which may be with its enveloping bite. It may replace its bite with a use of its Shadow Shift or Subsonic Moan.

action.name: Enveloping Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}19 ({@dice 4d6 + 5}) piercing plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}). While {@condition grappled}, the target is {@condition blinded} and can't breathe, and the cloaker has advantage on attacks against it. If this attack was made with advantage, the creature loses its breath if it was holding it.

action.name: Tail Lash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. {@h}9 ({@dice 1d10 + 5}) slashing plus 5 ({@damage 1d10}) necrotic damage and the target is pushed 5 ft. away.

action.name: Shadow Shift
entries: If the shadowcloak elder is in dim light or darkness, it and each creature it is grappling teleport to another area of dim light or darkness the shadowcloak elder can see within 60 ft.
An unwilling creature makes a {@dc 16} Charisma saving throw to resist this effect, and is left behind on a successful save.

action.name: Subsonic Moan
entries: The shadowcloak elder releases a thunderous blast of magically augmented, subonic energy in a 30 ft. cone, choosing one of the following effects. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or suffer the chosen effect.

items.name: Nausea
entries: The creature is {@condition poisoned} for the next minute. A {@condition poisoned} creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

items.name: Fear
entries: The creature is {@condition frightened} until the end of the shadowcloak elder's next turn.

items.name: Stupor
entries: The creature drops anything it is holding. If the creature was {@condition frightened}, it is additionally {@condition stunned} until the end of the shadowcloak elder's next turn.

reaction.name: Phantasms
entries: As a reaction to being hit with an attack or harmful spell, the cloaker rolls a {@dice D 20}. On a roll of 11-20, the attack or spell hits an illusory echo of the cloaker instead.

reaction.name: Dousing Hiss
entries: As a reaction to being hit with an attack or harmful spell, the shadowcloak elder reduces a source of light it can see within 60 ft. by one level, either reducing bright light to dim light, or extinguishing a source of dim light.

trait.name: Lightning Absorption
entries: Whenever the shambling mound is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and regains a number of hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shambling mound makes two slam attacks. If both attacks hit a Medium or smaller target, the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}), and the shambling mound uses its Engulf on it.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Boring Roots
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the mound must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw as the shambling mound attempts to bore roots through its flesh. On a failed save, the creature takes 27 ({@damage 6d8}) necrotic damage, and its HP maximum is reduced by the same amount.

action.name: Engulf
entries: The shambling mound engulfs a Medium or smaller creature {@condition grappled} by it. The engulfed target is {@condition blinded}, {@condition restrained}, and unable to breathe, and it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw at the start of each of the mound's turns or take 13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage. If the mound moves, the engulfed target moves with it. The mound can have only one creature engulfed at a time.

reaction.name: Entangling Hide
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the shambling mound can force the attacker to make a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition grappled}.

monster.name: Shardsoul Avatar
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Deranging Aura
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of one or more shardsouls must make a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save, the creature makes attacks at disadvantage and its attacks deal an extra die of damage until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Shardsoul Release
entries: When the shardsoul dies, up to one shardsoul within 30 feet gains 22 ({@dice 4d10}) temporary hit points.
While it has any of these temporary hit points, the shardsoul takes two actions on its turn, instead of one.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shardsoul makes three melee attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its Meteor Stomp.

action.name: Fell-Iron Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@dice 2d8 + 5}) slashing plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) radiant damage.
A creature hit by four or more of these attacks in a turn must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or gain a point of {@condition exhaustion}.

action.name: Meteor Stomp
entries: Each creature within 5 feet of the shardsoul must make a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw.
On a failed save, a creature takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) radiant damage, is pushed 10 feet away, and knocked {@condition prone}. On a success, a creature takes half as much damage.

action.name: Starsick Beam {@recharge 5}
entries: The shardwoul emits a beam of sickening starlight. Each creature in a 60 foot line that is 5 feet wide must make a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 42 ({@damage 12d6}) radiant damage and is {@condition poisoned} for the next minute, or takes half as much damage on a success.
A creature {@condition poisoned} in this way has its speed reduced by half, and repeats this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

reaction.name: Deranged Thrash
entries: As a reaction when it is missed with an attack by a creature affected by a Deranging Aura, the shardsoul causes the creature to make a new attack roll without disadvantage against another creature in range of the shardsoul's choice.

reaction.name: Bloodied Starshriek (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 100 hit points, the shardsoul forces each creature within 15 feet of it to succeed on a {@dc 15} Intelligence saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Psychic damage and be {@condition stunned} until the end of the Shardsoul's next turn.
