trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: While out of water, the sharktopus can hold its breath for 1 hour.

trait.name: Underwater Camouflage
entries: The sharktopus has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks and {@skill Deception} (Charisma) checks made to impersonate natural terrain or another aquatic creature.

trait.name: Test Bite
entries: If the sharktopus starts its turn with no hostile creatures within 5 ft. of it, it may {@action Dash} or {@action Disengage} as a bonus action this turn.

trait.name: Blood Frenzy
entries: The sharktopus has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sharktopus makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite. It may replace one attack with a use of its Fling.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d10 + 6}) piercing damage and the target begins to bleed. At the beginning of each of its turns, the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or lose 5 ({@dice 2d4}) hit points, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Tentacles
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}.

action.name: Fling
entries: Each creature {@condition grappled} by the sharktopus is thrown up to 30 feet. If a thrown target strikes a solid surface, the target takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage.

action.name: Blanket (underwater only) {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature in a 15 ft. radius sphere must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}) and pulled up to 5 ft. toward the sharktopus. Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}. A creature without a swim speed makes this save at disadvantage.

reaction.name: Circle
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 64 hit points, the sharktopus moves up to half its speed without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}. Each creature of its choice within 50 ft. that has fewer than 20 hit points must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Ink Cloud (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 87 hit points while underwater, the sharktopus exudes a 20-foot-radius cloud of ink around itself. The area is heavily obscured for 1 minute, although a significant current can disperse the ink. After releasing the ink, the sharktopus can use the {@action Dash} or {@action Hide} action as a bonus action.

monster.name: Shield Guardian
languages: understands commands given in any language but can't speak

trait.name: Bound
entries: The shield guardian is magically bound to an amulet. As long as the guardian and its amulet are on the same plane of existence, the amulet's wearer can telepathically call the guardian to travel to it, and the guardian knows the distance and direction to the amulet. If the guardian is within 60 feet of the amulet's wearer, half of any damage the wearer takes (rounded up) is transferred to the guardian.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The guardian makes two fist attacks.

action.name: Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage. The target must then make a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or take 11 ({@damage 2d10}) force damage and be pushed 10 ft. away.

action.name: Protective Wall
entries: The shield guardian can fold into a whirling wall of grinding metal, comprised of three contiguous 10 ft x 10 ft x 1 ft segments. Creatures in the wall's space when it appears must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 28 ({@damage 8d6}) slashing damage and be pushed to a side of the guardian's choice. The shield guardian cannot move or take actions while in this form except to resume its normal form as a bonus action.

action.name: Death Ward
entries: One creature within 5 feet of the shield guardian is granted a measure of protection from death. The first time in the next minute that the creature would drop to 0 hit points, it instead drops to 1 hit point.

reaction.name: Interpose
entries: As a reaction to a creature within 5 feet targeting the wearer of the guardian's amulet with an attack, the guardian may impose disadvantage on the roll.

trait.name: Duck and Leap
entries: When the guanghan takes the {@action Dodge} action, it may jump up to 10 feet whenever it is missed with a melee attack.

trait.name: Courtly Grace
entries: If the guanghan would make a Dexterity saving throw, it may choose to instead make a Charisma ({@skill Performance}) check against the same DC.

action.name: Lute Bash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) bludgeoning damage. On a critical hit, the lute breaks and becomes unusable.

action.name: Captivating Performance (Concentration)
entries: Shining Wave begins a complex and virtuosic performance of a traditional guanghan melody.
If he begins his turn {@status concentration||concentrating} on a performance, each creature that can hear him within 30 feet gains one of the following benefits until the beginning of his next turn:

items.name: "Crows Berate the Dragon"
entries: Each affected creature adds {@dice 1d4} to attack rolls it makes against one Large or larger creature Shining Wave can see.

items.name: "Bitter Cure Beneath the Snow"
entries: Each affected creature gains advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) checks.

items.name: "Sunrise Pierces the Fog"
entries: Each affected creature may make checks to investigate illusions as a bonus action.

items.name: "Ambush on Ten Sides"
entries: Each affected creature may use its reaction to make a melee attack whenever it is missed with an attack.

reaction.name: Improvised Recovery
entries: When Shining Wave fails a saving throw to maintain {@status concentration}, he adds his Charisma modifier to his result.
If this causes the saving throw to succeed, he gains 10 temporary hit points.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a Bonus Action, the mimic can polymorph into a Huge vehicle or structure or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

trait.name: False Appearance (Vehicle or Structure Form Only)
entries: While the mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary vehicle or structure.

trait.name: Grappler
entries: The mimic has advantage on attack rolls against any creature {@condition grappled} by it.

trait.name: Explorable
entries: The mimic may allow other creatures to enter or exit its space without hinderance. It may suspend this property as a Bonus action.

If the mimic takes 30 or more damge in a turn, each creature trapped inside it may use its reaction to attempt a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw, escaping into an unoccupied adjacent space on a success.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mimic makes three Psuedopod attacks, one of which it may replace with its Ravening Maw. It makes one fewer attack for each mimic under its control.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, the mimic may grapple the target (escape {@dc 17}).

action.name: Engulfing Maw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target not in the mimic's space. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) piercing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) acid damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or be pulled into the mimic's space.

action.name: Digest {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature in the mimic's space must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or take 27 ({@damage 6d8}) acid damage, or half as much on a success.

legendary.name: Treasure Lure
entries: The mimic offers a glimpse of fantastic treasure deep within it. One nonhostile creature within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} for the next minute.
While {@condition charmed}, a creature uses its turn to try to try to enter the mimic's space and convince others to do the same. This effect ends early if the creature takes any damage.

legendary.name: Blinding Spray
entries: One creature within 20 feet of the mimic must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the end of the mimic's next turn.
While the mimic is submerged, this ability can only target creatures in the mimic's space.

legendary.name: Absorb Vestige
entries: The mimic absorbs a friendly ooze in its space, destroying it and gaining 30 temporary hit points.

legendary.name: Spawn Mimic (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Part of the mimic splits off, becoming an {@creature object mimic|confc|Object Mimic} under the ship mimic's control for the next hour, after which it withers and dies. The ship mimic loses 30 hit points.

trait.name: Sodden Hull
entries: If the golem takes 10 or more fire damage from a single source, it loses its resistance to fire damage until it is submerged in water.
If it takes 25 or more fire damage from a single source, it additionally gains vulnerability to fire damage for the same duration.

trait.name: Galley-Torn Deadwood
entries: If the golem is pushed into a Large or larger solid object or surface, it takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Giant Stature
entries: Attacks made against the golem by a creature {@condition attached|confc|attached} to it have advantage, and the golem has disadvantage on attacks it makes against creatures {@condition attached|confc|attached} to it.

trait.name: Limited Magic Resistance
entries: The golem has disadvantage on saving throws to resist being pushed by wind or water, and has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes two attacks with its Sharpened Anchor, one of which it can replace with a use of its Keelhaul Crush or its Rotary Carronade Six-Pounder, if available.

action.name: Sharpened Anchor
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}28 ({@damage 4d10 + 7}) piercing damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away.
This attack deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Keelhaul Crush
entries: The golem slams a massive timber down on a creature it can see within 10 feet, forcing it to succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or take 21 ({@damage 4d6 + 7}) bludgeoning damage, or half as much damage on a success.

A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is additionally knocked {@condition prone} and {@condition grappled} until the end of the golem's turn, and takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage for each 5 feet it is dragged by the golem this turn.

action.name: Rotary Carronade Six-Pounder {@recharge 4}
entries: The golem sends forth a volley of cannonfire, forcing up to three targets it can see within 120 feet to succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) bludgeoning damage.
The golem can choose the same target multiple times.

reaction.name: Point-Blank Volley (1/Day)
entries: When the golem is reduced below 101 hit points, it can roll to recharge its Rotary Cannonade, then immediately use it if available, targeting a single creature within 10 feet.

trait.name: Rampage
entries: When the shoosuva reduces a creature to 0 hit points on its turn, the shoosuva can take a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make a bite attack.

trait.name: Opportunist
entries: The shoosuva has advantage on attack rolls against a creature unless that creature hit it with a melee attack since the end of the shoosuva's last turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shoosuva makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail stinger.

action.name: Latching Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}25 ({@damage 4d10 + 4}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}).

action.name: Tail Stinger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for the next minute. While {@condition poisoned} in this way, the target has disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws and repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Crush Bones
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the shoosuva takes 52 ({@damage 8d12}) piercing damage and must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or suffer disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws that use Strength until it completes a short or long rest.

reaction.name: Abyssal Cackle
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the shoosuva moves up to 20 ft. without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}, emitting an maddening laugh. The attacker and each other creature within 10 ft. of the it must make a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw. Each creature (other than shoosuvas, gnolls, or hyenas) that failed the save must move up to half its speed and make a melee attack against the nearest creature (or against itself if there are no other creatures in range), starting with the attacker and progressing in initiative order.

trait.name: Deceptive Neck
entries: When a creature the heron can see scores a critical against it, roll a {@dice d20}. On an 11-20, the critical becomes a miss.

trait.name: Mudstrider
entries: The heron ignores negative effects from moving over terrain composed of mud or shallow water.

action.name: Dagger-Sharp Bill
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Chest Slam
entries: The heron collides with a creature within 5 feet, forcing it to succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Death Blow (Recharges when the heron uses its Extend Neck)
entries: The heron strikes a {@condition prone} creature with blinding speed, making a Dagger-Sharp Bill attack against it. If the attack hits, it scores a critical.

action.name: Rasped Bark (1/Day)
entries: The heron croaks out a dreadful sound. Each creature within 30 feet that can hear, but not see the heron must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the beginning of the Heron's next turn.

bonus.name: Taloned Pin
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition prone} target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}) until the heron moves.

bonus.name: Extend Neck
entries: The heron extends its neck, raising up to its full height and making a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check to detect any hidden creatures nearby.

trait.name: Rampage
entries: When the hyena reduces a creature to 0 hit points on its turn, the hyena can take a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make a bite attack.

trait.name: Opportunist
entries: The hyena has advantage on attack rolls against a creature unless that creature hit it with a melee attack since the end of the hyena's last turn.

action.name: Latching Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) piercing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the hyena can grapple the target (escape {@dc 13}).

action.name: Crush Bones
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the hyena takes 17 ({@damage 5d6}) piercing damage and must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or suffer disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws that use Strength until it completes a short or long rest.

reaction.name: Giggling Retreat
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the hyena moves up to 10 ft. without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}, emitting an unsettling laugh. The attacker must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or be unable to move closer to the hyena this turn.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

trait.name: Damage Transfer
entries: While attached to a creature, the shrapnyl takes only half the damage dealt to it (rounded down), and that creature takes the other half.

trait.name: Jagged Encasement
entries: A creature the shrapnyl is attached to has its AC increased to 18, if it was lower, and takes an additional 7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage whenever it or the shrapnyl is hit with an attack.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shrapnyl makes two attacks with its Clinging Slam, each of which it may replace with a use of its Refit.

action.name: Encasing Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one Huge or smaller creature. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) slashing damage and the shrapnyl wraps around the creature, attaching itself to it (escape {@dc 15}).

action.name: Persistent Refit
entries: One creature the shrapnyl is attached to must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or have its Wisdom score reduced by 5 ({@dice 2d4}), to a minimum of 1, until it completes a Short or Long Rest without the shrapnyl attached to it.

A creature reduced below 10 Wisdom in this way has disadvantage on Strength checks and saving throws. A creature reduced to 1 Wisdom in this way acts under the shrapnyl's telepathic control while the shrapnyl is attached to it.

action.name: Cloud of Steel {@recharge 5}
entries: The shrapnyl explodes outward in a spray of metal. Each creature within 10 feet of the shrapnyl that it is not attached to must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 27 ({@damage 6d8}) piercing damage, or half as much on a success, then each creature it was attached to is freed and the shrapnyl reforms in the nearest unoccupied space.

trait.name: Spidersac Incubator
entries: If the shunned takes 10 or more radiant damage from a single source or ends its turn in Sunlight, it loses a use of its Disgorge Spiders.

trait.name: Fruitless Devotion
entries: If a creature the shunned can see uses its action to brandish a holy symbol of Lolth, the shunned must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} and {@condition frightened} by it until the beginning of the creature's next turn.

action.name: Lurching Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}10 ({@dice 2d6 + 3}) piercing plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage.
A creature reduced to 10 or fewer hit points by this damage falls [{@condition unconscious}](https://homebrewery.naturalcrit.com/share/uDYpiTxHncTE) until the end of the shunned's next turn.

action.name: Disgorge Spiders (3/Day, Recharge 5-6)
entries: The shunned loses 5 hit points as one of its growths bursts, disgorging a

reaction.name: Blacken Magic (3rd Level Spell)
entries: When a spell or magical effect targets an area the shunned can see within 30 feet, it can fill that area with Magical Darkness for the spell's duration.

reaction.name: Sickening Wail (1/Day)
entries: When the shunned takes any radiant damage, it can loose a horrid wail.
Each creature within 30 feet that can hear it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of the shunned's next turn.

trait.name: Form of Corruption
entries: A non-obyrith creature that starts its turn within 120 feet of the sibriex and can see it must succeed on a {@dc 21} Wisdom saving throw or have its Wisdom score rediced by 2 ({@dice 1d4}), to a minimum of 1, until it succeeds on this saving throw or leaves the affected area, as it begins to find its own body to be intolerably misshapen and corrupted.
On a successful saving throw, a creature becomes immune to this effect for 24 hours.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The sibriex has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Legendary Resistances (3/Day)
entries: If the sibriex fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sibriex makes three attacks with its Flailing Chains.

action.name: Flailing Chains
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d6 + 7}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 21}). A creature {@condition grappled} by two or more chains is additionally {@condition restrained}.
Each chain can be attacked (AC 20; 10 hit points; immunity to psychic damage and damage not from attacks). Destroying a chain deals no damage to the sibriex.

action.name: Abyssal Graft
entries: The sibriex attempts to surgically implant a mass of abyssal matter in a willing or {@condition restrained} creature within 15 feet, forcing it to make a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw.
On a failed saving throw, a creature takes 55 ({@damage 10d10}) piercing damage and is afflicted with Flesh Warp, or takes half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Black Bile Slick {@recharge 5}
entries: The sibriex spews black bile in a 30 foot cone, forceing each creature in the area to succeed on a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw or take 36 ({@damage 8d8}) poison damage and fall {@condition prone}, or take half as much damage on a success. A {@condition grappled} creature makes this saving throw with disadvantage.

reaction.name: Breeder of Horrors (Concentration)
entries: When the sibreix is reduced below 163 hit points, it can animate its own spilled blood and bile, causing it to rise in the nearest unoccupied space as an
If the sibriex loses {@status concentration} within the next minute, the alkalith dies.

legendary.name: Chain Lash
entries: The sibriex makes a flailing chains attack or animates a new chain, to a maximum of three.

legendary.name: Gaze of Perfection (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: One creature the sibriex can see within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 21} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by it until the end of the creature's next turn.
While {@condition charmed} in this way, a creature believes that the sibriex is the most perfect and beautiful form of life.

legendary.name: Contaminate Wounds (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: One creature within 30 feet of the sibriex that does not have all of its hit points must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution save or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of the creature's next turn.
A creature that has fewer than half of its hit points makes this saving throw with disadvantage.

trait.name: Pirate's Panache
entries: Once per turn, Siduri may spend half her movement to attempt a {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) or Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check, gaining Panache until the end of her turn on a success, or falling {@condition prone} on a failure.
While she has panache, Siduri's attacks are made at advantage and a creature she hits with an attack is pushed 5 feet away.

trait.name: Sleek Coat Insulation
entries: While Siduri has more than half of her hit points, she has resistance to cold and fire damage.

trait.name: Fearsome Glint
entries: At the beginning of each of her turns, one creature of Siduri's choice within 30 feet that can see her must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the beginning of her next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Siduri makes three attacks with her cutlass. Then, if she has Panache, she may use her Inspiring Advance or Fire Up.

action.name: Cutlass
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) slashing damage.
On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or drop one item it is holding.

action.name: Flintlock Pistol {@recharge 4}
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 9} to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Inspiring Advance
entries: Siduri moves up to half her speed. Each other creature of her choice within 30 feet that can see her may use its reaction to move up to half its speed and gain advantage on Strength and Dexterity based checks and saving throws until the beginning of her next turn.

action.name: Fire Up
entries: Siduri shouts a fiery speech, full of alliteration and lofty literary allusions. Each creature of her choice within 30 feet that can hear her deals an additional 2 ({@damage 1d4}) damage with melee attacks until the beginning of her next turn.

reaction.name: Belay That!
entries: As a reaction when a friendly creature she can see within 30 feet misses with a melee attack, the Siduri causes the creature to reroll the attack, taking the second result.

reaction.name: Riposte
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack, Siduri makes a melee attack against the attacker.

trait.name: Mirror Dweller
entries: The nerra may spend half its movement to pass through a Medium or larger reflective surface within 5 feet, entering or exiting an extradimensional mirrorspace resembling the space reflected in the surface.
If a mirrored surface containing the nerra ceases to be reflective, the nerra is expelled into the nearest unoccupied space.

trait.name: Reflective Rampart
entries: Whenever a nerra within 60 feet of the silit nerra is missed with a spell attack, the nerra may force the attacker to make a new attack roll for the spell against a target of the silit nerra's choice.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The nerra makes three attacks with its Quicksilver Helix, one of which it may replace with a use of its Fractalize.

action.name: Quicksilver Helix
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@dice 4d8}) slashing plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage.
The nerra may choose for this attack's source to be any reflective surface it can see within 100 feet.

action.name: Fractalize
entries: The nerra shatters one non-minion nerra it can see within 60 feet. Each creature within 5 feet of it takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) slashing damage, then three new

action.name: Steal Reflection (Concentration)
entries: One creature the nerra can see within 60 feet must make a {@dc 19} Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the nerra changes its appearance to match the creature, and whenever the nerra takes damage, the creature takes half as much damage of the same type.

action.name: Mirrorspace Banishment {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature the nerra can see within 60 feet that is within 5 feet of a reflective object must succeed on a {@dc 19} Charisma save or be dragged into that object's mirrorspace and trapped there.
The creature may repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, and is expelled into the nearest unoccupied space on a success, or when the object ceases to be reflective.

bonus.name: Mirror Portal
entries: The nerra teleports itself or a creature it can see up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see within 5 feet of a reflective surface. An unwilling creature may make a {@dc 19} Charisma saving throw, resisting the effect on a success.
If the nerra is inside a mirrorspace, it instead may teleport into another mirrorspace reflected by a surface it can see within 30 feet.

reaction.name: Mirrorweave Symmetry
entries: As a reaction when a creature the nerra can see casts a spell, the nerra casts the same spell, choosing new targets (Spell Attack Bonus +11, Save {@dc 19}).

reaction.name: Infinite Reflections (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 127 hit points, the nerra causes up to four 10 foot by 10 foot flat surfaces that it can see within 100 feet to smooth and shimmer, reaching a mirror polish.

trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The anteater has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Prehensile Tail
entries: If the anteater falls {@condition prone} while climbing, it may make a {@dc 10} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the anteater catches itself and does not fall.

action.name: Nestripper Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 slashing damage.

action.name: Sticky Tongue Pluck
entries: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw or have one item it is carrying that weighs 1 lb or less stolen by the anteater.

reaction.name: Clumsy Tumble
entries: As a reaction when a creature hits the anteater with a melee attack, the anteater forces the creature to reroll the attack, taking the second result, then falls {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The silthilar has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Grafter
entries: Over the course of an hour, the silthilar can warp a willing or {@condition incapacitated} creature's body, reducing either its Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution by two, to a minimum of 8, and increasing its Strength or Dexterity by the same amount.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The silthilar makes four attacks, no more than three of which may target the same creature.

action.name: Impaling Spike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}) until the silthilar uses its multiattack again or Disperses.
An {@condition unconscious} creature {@condition grappled} in this way stabilizes automatically and cannot regain hit points.

action.name: Ankle Slice
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d4 + 5}) slashing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

bonus.name: Disperse
entries: The silthilar regains all of its hit points and transforms into a Huge swarm of Tiny aberrations. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is tucked into a pocket dimension. It reverts to its swarm form if it dies.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The silthilar has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Dispersed Vulnerability
entries: If the silthilar takes at least 10 thunder damage from a single source or is exposed to a strong wind, it cannot coalesce on its following turn.

trait.name: Infesting Swarm
entries: The silthilar can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and can can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny aberration.

A creature that starts its turn in the silthilar's space must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or take 3 ({@damage 1d6}) piercing damage and be {@condition poisoned} until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Warp Flesh
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 0 ft., one target. {@h}The target has its Charisma score reduced by {@dice 1d4} until it completes a Short or Long Rest. A creature that has its Charisma score reduced to 0 in this way is polymorphed into a form of the silthilar's choice until cured by Greater Restoration or simlar magic.

The new form can by any Small or Medium creature the silthilar is familiar with of CR 4 or lower. The creature adopts the new form's statistics, but retains its alignment, personality, proficiencies, hit points, and class levels.

bonus.name: Coalesce
entries: The silthilar regains all of its hit points and transforms into a Medium swarm of aberration. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is tucked into a pocket dimension. It reverts to its swarm form if it dies.

trait.name: Ice Walk
entries: The dragon can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.

trait.name: Flattery Vulnerability
entries: When subjected to flattery by a medium or smaller creature, the dragon must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by the creature until it takes hostile action against the dragon or its allies. A dragon that succeeds on this save becomes immune to flattery from that creature for the next minute.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Breath Weapons {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.

action.name: Freezing Breath
entries: The dragon exhales an icy blast in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw, taking 18 ({@damage 4d8}) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Hypothermic Breath
entries: The dragon exhales a burst of chilling gas in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature is {@condition paralyzed} outside of its own turn, and repeats this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more must use its action to doff its armor or shield.

reaction.name: Shield the Weak
entries: As a reaction to a friendly creature it can see being targeted with an attack, the dragon moves up to half its speed without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}. If it ends that movement within 5 feet of the creature, the creature gains +2 to its AC (including against the triggering attack) and has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn, or until it moves further away.

monster.name: Sixty-Spears Ceronyr, Beast of the Heorot

resist.note: from attacks with weapons that aren't named

trait.name: Feather Step
entries: Ceronyr's high jump is up to 15 ft., or up to 30 ft. with a running start. He may treat any surface, including leaves or falling snow, as solid ground.

trait.name: Path of the Forest-Crowned (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
entries: When Ceronyr is reduced to 0 hit points, he doesn't die or fall {@condition unconscious}. Instead, he resets to 126 hit points and all of his wounds appear to heal.

For the next hour, he can use 5 feet of movement to step magically into one living tree within 5 ft. and emerge from a point at the same height on a second living tree within 60 feet of the first tree.

trait.name: Legendary Resistances (3/Day)
entries: If Ceronyr fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Ceronyr makes three melee attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its Golden Wind.

action.name: Bone-Crown Rush
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 5d6 + 5}) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. On a hit or miss, the target is pushed 10 ft. away.

action.name: Rearing Kick
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) slashing damage. A {@condition prone} target takes an additional 9 ({@damage 2d8}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Golden Wind (Concentration)
entries: One creature within 15 ft. of a patch of wildflowers created by Ceronyr's Wildflower Tread is enveloped by swirling winds, dense with pollen, that heavily obscure the area beyond them.
The creature may spend half its movement to make a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw. On a success, the creature escapes, coated in pollen. On a failure, the creature falls {@condition prone}.

action.name: Falling Slam {@recharge 5}
entries: Ceronyr leaps up to 30 ft. in the air, then falls to the ground. Each creature in the space where he lands must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone} and take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) bludgeoning damage for each 10 ft. that Ceronyr fell, or take half as much and be pushed into the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

reaction.name: Elusive Sidle
entries: As a reaction to a creature ending its movement within 5 ft. of Ceronyr, he moves up to half his speed in any direction other than directly away from the creature without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

reaction.name: Burgeoning
entries: As a reaction when a creature covered in pollen from its Golden Wind falls {@condition prone}, Ceronyrm magically causes tiny roots to sprout from its flesh and anchor it to the ground, restraining it (escape {@dc 18}).

reaction.name: Punishing Charge
entries: As a reaction to a creature picking up an object dropped due to Ceronyr's hard stare, Ceronyr moves up to half his speed toward the creature and makes a melee attack against it.

legendary.name: Wildflower Tread
entries: The ground beneath Ceronyr's feet blooms with magical wildflowers that last for an hour before withering. A creature that starts its turn standing in the flowers gains 11 ({@dice 2d10}) temporary hit points.

legendary.name: Hard Stare
entries: One creature within 30 ft. that Ceronyr can see must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or drop one item it is holding.

legendary.name: Unearthly Scream (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Ceronyr releases a haunting sound. Each creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be unable to take hostile action on its following turn.

monster.name: Skeletal Liberator
languages: understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Bonesense
entries: The liberator can pinpoint, by scent, the location of any creature with bones within 20 feet of it, and does not suffer disadvantage for attacking a creature with bones that it cannot see.

trait.name: Rattle
entries: A creature that hits the liberator with a melee attack that deals bludgeoning damage must succeed a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn as it feels its own skeleton twitch slightly.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The liberator makes two attacks with its Fleshstripper Blade.

action.name: Fleshstripper Blade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@dice 1d8 + 3}) slashing plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage.
On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or fall {@condition prone} as its bones spasm within its body.

action.name: Wake the Bones {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature within 30 feet that the skeleton can see must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or have its skeleton rattle within its flesh, taking 21 ({@dice 6d6}) points of bludgeoning damage and being dragged up to 10 feet in a direction of the skeleton's choice on a failure, or taking half as much damage on a success.

An creature with 0 hit points that fails this saving throw dies. At the begining of its following turn, the creature's skeleton tears itself out of the creature's body, rising as an independant {@creature Skeleton Warrior|ConfC}.

reaction.name: Dark Martyr
entries: When the skeleton is reduced to 0 hit points, it may use its Wake the Bones ability if available, targeting an {@condition unconscious} creature within range, before being destroyed.

reaction.name: Hate the Living
entries: When a creature the skeleton can see reduces an undead ally of the skeleton's to 0 hit points, the skeleton can move up to 10 feet towards the creature.

monster.name: Skeleton Warrior
languages: understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Unliving Warriors
entries: The skeleton has proficiency in all martial weapons and armor.

trait.name: Bonesense
entries: The skeleton can pinpoint, by scent, the location of any creature with bones within 20 ft. of it, and does not suffer disadvantage for attacking a creature with bones that it cannot see.

trait.name: Rattle
entries: A creature that hits the skeleton with a melee attack that deals bludgeoning damage must succeed a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn as it feels its own skeleton twitch slightly.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Shortbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Hate the Living
entries: When a creature the skeleton can see reduces an undead ally of the skeleton's to 0 hit points, the skeleton can move up to 10 feet towards the creature.

trait.name: Damage Transfer
entries: While it is wrapped around a creature, the skin kite takes only half the damage dealt to it by creatures it is not grappling, and the creature {@condition grappled} by the skin kite takes the other half.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The skin kite can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

action.name: Clinging Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) bludgeoning damage and the skin kite wraps itself around the target (escape {@dc 13}). While the skin kite is wrapped around it, a creature cannot speak or breathe, and the skin kite moves with the target.

action.name: Steal Skin
entries: One creature the skin kite is wrapped around must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving score or have its Charisma score reduced by {@dice 1d4}, to a minimum of 1, until it completes a Long Rest.
The skin kite gains a cumulative 5 temporary hit points for each point of Charisma lost in this way. A creature reduced to 1 Charisma in this way immediately drops to 0 hit points.

action.name: Launch Kite
entries: The skin kite tears itself in two, losing all of its temporary hit points and creating a new skin kite in an adjacent space with maximum hit points equal to the temporary hit points lost.

trait.name: Zig-Zag
entries: The first time each turn that a creature ends its movement within 5 feet of the skiurid, it may move up to 10 feet without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

trait.name: Skittish
entries: A creature within 30 feet of the skiurid that is hidden from it must make a new stealth check at the beginning of each of its turns to remain hidden from it.

action.name: Shadow Gnaw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage. If the skurid is in dim light or darkness, it may teleport up to 20 feet before or after making this attack.

action.name: Scolding Alarm
entries: The skiurid chirps forth a complex alarm signal. Each creature that the squirrel can see ceases to be hidden from any creature that can hear the squirrel.

action.name: Apocrine Shadowglyph (1/Day)
entries: The skiurid rubs its cheeks on a surface, magically leaving a faintly visible mark upon it. Nonmagical lights and lights produced by spells of 2nd level or below within 30 feet of this glyph produce only dim light, and the light they produce extends no further than 15 feet form its source.

trait.name: Lost in the Mob
entries: If the sovereign starts its turn within 10 feet of one or more other skiurids, it becomes hidden from each creature with a Passive {@skill Perception} lower than 20 until the beginning of its next turn, or until it makes an attack.

trait.name: Avoidance
entries: If the sovereign is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sovereign makes four attacks with its Shadow Gnaw.

action.name: Shadow Gnaw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d4 + 6}) piercing damage. If the skurid is in dim light or darkness, it may teleport up to 20 feet before or after making this attack.

action.name: Rite of the Nugget-Keeper
entries: One creature the sovereign can see must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or take 2 ({@damage 1d4}) necrotic damage for each sciurid scurrier within 5 feet of it, plus 10 ({@damage 4d4}) necrotic damage for each skiurrid swarm within 5 feet of it.

action.name: Echoing Chitter
entries: The sovereign fills the air with sourceless, menacing chittering and red eyes gleam from every shadow. Each creature of the sovereign's choice within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Skittering Shadows
entries: As a reaction when a creature the skiurid can see makes an {@action opportunity attack||attack of opportunity}, the skiurid forces the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or instead make an attack against a creature of the skiurid's choice.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny skiurid.

trait.name: Umbral Aura
entries: Nonmagical lights and lights produced by spells of 2nd level or below within 30 feet of the swarm produce only dim light, and the light they produce extends no further than 15 feet form its source.

trait.name: Skittish
entries: A creature within 30 feet of the swarm that is hidden from it must make a new stealth check at the beginning of each of its turns to remain hidden from it.

action.name: Strip Flesh
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. {@h}30 ({@damage 12d4}) piercing damage, or 15 ({@damage 6d4}) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.

action.name: Skeletonize
entries: One creature with 0 hit points in the swarm's space must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or die and have its flesh stripped away, leaving only a skeleton.
On a successful save, the creature fails one death save.

reaction.name: Shadow Scamper
entries: As a reaction when the swarm takes damage while in dim light or darkness, it teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

monster.name: Skull Lord
languages: The languages it knew in life

trait.name: Triple Skulls
entries: The skull lord has three skulls, each of which anchor one of its abilities. A creature that reduces the skull lord to 0 hit points chooses one of its remaining skulls to destroy. Then, if the skull lord has any skulls remaining, it regains all of its hit points.

items.name: Skull of Death's Tranquility
entries: While it has this skull, the skull lord and its undead allies within 30 ft. make attacks and saving throws against magical effects at advantage, and take no damage on a successful Constitution save.

items.name: Skull of Bonechilling Fear
entries: While it has this skull, a living creature that starts its turn within 15 ft. of the Skull lord must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the beginning of its next turn. A creature that fails by 5 or more is instead {@condition paralyzed} until the beginning of its next turn.

items.name: Skull of the Grave Master
entries: While it has this skull, at the start of each of the skull lord's turns one destroyed undead creature of CR 3 or below within 30 feet is returned to undeath with full hit points.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the skull lord fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The skull lord casts a spell with a casting time of 1 action and makes two bone staff attacks.

action.name: Bone Staff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) bludgeoning damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Clutch of Terror (3rd Level Spell)
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}33 ({@damage 6d10}) necrotic damage and the target is dragged up to 15 feet toward the skull lord, then must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn).

action.name: Corrupt Marrow (5th Level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: Each creature in a 15 foot radius centered on a point within 60 feet must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 4d10}) necrotic damage.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is {@condition paralyzed} until the end of the skull lord's next turn.

action.name: Finger of Death (1/Day, 7th Level Spell)
entries: One creature the skull lord can see within 60 feet must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or take 62 ({@damage 7d8 + 30}) necrotic damage, or half damage on a success.
A humanoid creature killed by this damage rises as a {@creature Zombie Rotter|ConfC} under the skull lord's control at the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Shield of Bones (1st Level Spell)
entries: When the skull lord or a friendly undead creature is targeted with a ranged attack, the skull lord can raise a shield of bones and earth, granting the target 3/4 cover against ranged attacks until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Heartstop (1/Day, 8th Level Spell)
entries: When a creature destroys its second-to-last skull, the skull lord can attempt to crush the creature's heart within its chest.
The creature must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or drop to 0 hit points. A creature with no unexpended hit dice makes this saving throw at disadvantage.

legendary.name: Grave Step
entries: The skull lord moves up to half its speed. A creature that hits the skull lord with an {@action opportunity attack||attack of opportunity} provoked by this movement takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) necrotic damage.

legendary.name: Death's Command
entries: If the skull lord still has its Skull of Death's Tranquility, one friendly undead creature of CR 3 or below within 30 feet may use its reaction to make a melee attack.

legendary.name: Bonechilling Fear
entries: One creature {@condition frightened} by the skull lord's Skull of Bonechilling Fear must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) cold damage and 7 ({@damage 2d6}) psychic damage.

legendary.name: Gravelord's Excavation
entries: The skull lord excavates a grave 10 ft long, 10 ft. deep, and 5 ft wide centered on a point within 30 ft. Each creature standing in the area must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or fall in, moving to the nearest unoccupied space outside the area on a success.

legendary.name: Bone Staff (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The skull lord makes an attack with its bone staff.

trait.name: Shallows Lurker
entries: The skulvyn has advantage on attacks made against a partially or completely submerged creature without a swim speed.

trait.name: Slowing Aura
entries: A non-skulvyn creature that starts its turn within 20 feet of one or more skulvyn must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or have its movement speed reduced by half until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The skulvyn has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The skulvyn makes two attacks: one with its Razor Lash Flurry and one with its Vicious Bite.

action.name: Vicious Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}). On a critical hit, the target takes an additional 5 ({@damage 1d10}) damage.

action.name: Razor Lash Flurry
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d6 + 4}) slashing damage and the target begins{@condition bleeding|confc|bleeding} ({@dice 2d4}, Save Ends at end of turn).
This attack deals an additional 7 ({@damage 2d6}) slashing damage to a creature that is already{@condition bleeding|confc|bleeding}.

trait.name: Desiccation Weakness
entries: Whenever the centipede takes any fire or necrotic damage, it gains a point of {@condition exhaustion}.

trait.name: Hundred-Legged Writhe
entries: The centipede ignores the effects of difficult terrain, and has advantage on attacks made against a creature that it is {@condition attached|confc|attached} to, grappling, or {@condition grappled} by.

action.name: Mandible Slice
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d6 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Fleshgripper Toxicognaths
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}).
If the target is Large or larger, the centipede can become {@condition attached|confc|attached} to the target (remove {@dc 13}) instead of grappling it.

bonus.name: Spasmodic Venom
entries: The centipede pumps venom into a creature it is grappling or {@condition attached|confc|attached} to, forcing it to succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or take 17 ({@damage 5d6}) poison damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is {@condition paralyzed} until the beginning of its next turn.

bonus.name: Caudal Grip
entries: The centipede anchors itself with its pincer-like rear legs and coils up, gaining the following effects until the end of its next turn:
The centipede's speed is reduced to 0.
The centipede has advantage on ability checks and saving throws that use Strength.
The centipede's melee attacks have a reach of 20 feet and advantage.

trait.name: Rapid Evolution
entries: Each hour it survives, the tadpole adds 10 hit points to its current and maximum hit points. Every 4 hours, the tadpole's size category increases by one step.
After 13 hours, the tadpole transforms into a full grown slaad.

trait.name: Bloody Trail
entries: For the first hour after it emerges, the tadpole leaves a clear trail of blood that creatures have advantage on {@skill Survival} (Wisdom) checks made to track.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The slaad has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Goreslick Scuttle
entries: The tadpole takes the dodge action. Until the beginning of its next turn, whenever the tadpole is missed with an attack, it may move up to 10 ft. without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

action.name: Emerge
entries: The tadpole bursts forth from its host's chest in a spray of gore. Each creature that can see it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of the tadpole's next turn. A creature that fails by 5 or more is instead {@condition stunned} until the end of the tadpole's next turn.

monster.name: Slaughter Wight

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

languages: The languages it knew in life

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the wight has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight. A wight that takes radiant damage can't use its Soul Harvest on its following turn.

trait.name: Rampage
entries: When the wight reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on its turn, the wight can take a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make a bite attack.

trait.name: Death Wail
entries: When the wight dies, each creature within 10 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or take 11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wight makes three claw attacks, each of which it may replace with its Life Drain.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) piercing damage. On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or die.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) slashing damage and 4 ({@damage 1d8}) necrotic damage. The wight regains hit points equal to the amount of necrotic damage dealt.

action.name: Life Drain
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be forced to expend two of its hit dice. If the creature can't, it instead drops to 0 hit points.
A humanoid slain by this attack rises on the wight's next turn as a zombie under the wight's control. The wight can have no more than twelve zombies under its control at one time.

trait.name: Weathering Weakness
entries: If the blocklet is doused in water or takes any acid damage, the next attack that hits it ignores its damage resistances.

trait.name: Living Weapon
entries: The blocklet counts as a Simple Melee Weapon with the Thrown Property (range 20/60, {@dice 2d4} bludgeoning).

action.name: Hurl Self
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 2d4 + 1}) bludgeoning damage.
On a hit or miss, the blocklet lands {@condition prone} in the target's space.

action.name: Stub-Toe Hazard
entries: The blocklet plants itself firmly and ends its turn.
Until the beginning of its next turn, creatures in the blocklet's space fall {@condition prone} if they fail a Strength or Dexterity-based check or saving throw, in addition to any other effects.

reaction.name: Skipping Tumble
entries: When the blocklet takes any damage that would not reduce it to 0 hit points, it can reduce that damage to 1.
If it does, the blocklet is pushed up to 20 feet away from the damage's source and falls {@condition prone}.

variant.name: Design Note: Living Weapon and Hurl Self
entries: The blocklet is not intended to take damage when using its Hurl Self action or Living Weapon trait in most typical circumstances.

trait.name: Pull Together (1/Day)
entries: When the myrmidon is reduced to 0 hit points, it may turn to smoke and disipate instead of dying. At the beginning of its next turn, it appears within 15 feet of the space it left with 1 Hit Point.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The myrmiddon makes three melee attacks, one of which it may replace with its Billow, if available.

action.name: Sooty Garotte
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled}. If this attack was made at advantage, it deals an additional 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Billow (Concentration, Recharge 5-6)
entries: The myrmidon wreaths itself in a 10 ft. radius cloud of dense smoke that travels with it. The smoke spreads around corners, and its area is heavily obscured.

reaction.name: Elemental Riposte
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack, the myrmidon unleashes a burst of choking smoke. Each creature within 5 feet of it must then succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be unable to speak or breathe for the next minute. A creature may repeat this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

reaction.name: In the Wind
entries: As a reaction to taking slashing or bludgeoning damage, the myrmidon may teleport up to 30 feet to a location it can see.

trait.name: Pull Together (1/Day)
entries: When the mephit is reduced to 0 hit points, it may turn to smoke and disipate instead of dying. At the beginning of its next turn, it reappears within 15 feet of the space it disappeared with 1 hit point.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a 5 foot radius burst of smoke.
Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 9} Constitution saving throw or begin {@condition choking|confc|choking} for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn)

action.name: Sootclaw Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.
If this attack was made with advantage, it deals an additonal 2 ({@damage 1d4}) fire damage.

action.name: Billow (Concentration, Recharge 6)
entries: The mephit wreaths itself in a 10 foot radius cloud of dense smoke that travels with it, heavily obscuring the area.

reaction.name: In the Wind
entries: If the mephit takes any slashing or bludgeoning damage, it can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space.

trait.name: Inflexible
entries: The turtle cannot attack a creature that is grappling it.

trait.name: Cold Blooded
entries: If the turtle takes any cold damage, its speed is reduced by 10 until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Clamping Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}).
A creature that attempts to escape this grapple takes 2 ({@damage 1d4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Obstinate Plant
entries: Until the beginning of its next turn, the turtle gains advantage on Strength checks and saving throws, and a Medium or Large creature that attempts to move through its space must succeed on {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Snap
entries: As a reaction when a creature fails an attempt to grapple it, the turtle makes a melee attack against the creature.

reaction.name: Sudden Dive
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack while swimming, the turtle moves up to half its speed directly downward without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

trait.name: Bushpilot
entries: A bush or shrub that contains one or more snipes gains the statistics of an

trait.name: Corner of Your Eye
entries: The snipe is {@condition invisible} to any creature with less than 20 Passive {@skill Perception}. Whenever the snipe is hit with an attack or {@condition grappled}, this trait is disabled for the next minute, or until it is missed with an attack.

action.name: Curious Nip
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 piercing damage and the target may use its reaction to attempt to grapple the snipe.

action.name: Tuck and Roll
entries: The snipe retracts all of its limbs and moves up to twice its speed. {@action opportunity attack||Attacks of opportunity} provoked by this movement are made at disadvantage.

reaction.name: Panic
entries: As a reaction when it realizes a creature can see it, the snipe lets out a gurgling scream and uses its Tuck and Roll to move in a random direction, bouncing if it hits a creature or solid object.

trait.name: Refreeze
entries: If the golem takes any fire damage, it loses its immunities to cold damage and cantrips until the beginning of its next turn.
If the golem takes any cold damage, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or freeze solid and be {@condition petrified}.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: The golem can't be affected or detected by cantrips unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes two attacks, or takes the {@action Dash} action and uses its Snowslide.

action.name: Ice-Packed Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@dice 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) cold damage.
On a critical hit, the target has disadvantge on Dexterity saving throws until the end of the golem's next turn.

action.name: Snowball
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 0} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 3d6}) cold damage.

action.name: Snowslide {@recharge 5}
entries: The snow golem falls {@condition prone} in the space of a Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet and ends its turn. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or be engulfed and {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 12}), or move to an adjacent space on a success.

A creature {@condition restrained} in this way can't speak or breathe, and must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw at the start of each of its turns or lose one unexpended hit die, or drop to 0 hit points if it cannot.

trait.name: Feather Step
entries: Sojobo's high jump is up to 15 feet, or up to 30 feet with a running start. She may treat any surface, including leaves or falling snow, as solid ground.

trait.name: Harbinger of Strife
entries: When the daitengu or another creature within 30 feet makes an attack, it adds {@dice 1d4} to the result.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Sojobo makes two attacks with her Gunbai Fan, one of which she may replace with a use of her Looming Gaze.

action.name: Gunbai Fan
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 15 feet away.
A creature that ends this movement early due to being pushed into a solid surface takes an additional 11 ({@damage 2d10}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Looming Gaze
entries: Sojobo leans menacingly over a Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet, which must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the beginning of Sojobo's next turn.
A creature that fails this save by 5 or more falls {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Launching Gust
entries: As a reaction when a creature within 15 feet falls {@condition prone}, Sojobo forces it to make a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw.
On a failed save, the creature is flung 20 feet in the air, where it levitates until the beginning of Sojobo's next turn.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The solamith has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Soulfire
entries: Damage dealt by the solamith to other fiends ignores resistance to fire damage, and treats immunity to fire damage as resistance.

action.name: Heavy Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 3d12 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away.

action.name: Lob Flesh
entries: The solamith tears off a chunk of its own flesh and hurls it to a point it can see within 60 feet where it explodes in a 20 foot radius of soulfire.

The solamith loses 5 hit points, and each creature in the explosion's area must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage and be knocked {@condition prone}, or take half as much damage on a success.
The solamith may choose to lose up to 15 additional hit points when it uses this ability. For each 5 hit points it loses in this way, it adds one additional effect of its choice:
The explosion's radius increases by 10 feet.
The explosion's damage increases by {@dice 1d6}.

reaction.name: Soulfire Eruption
entries: When the solamith takes 15 or more damage from a melee attack, it can release a gout of soulfire from the wound, dealing 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage to the attacker.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The solamith has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Soulfire
entries: Damage dealt by the solamith to other fiends ignores resistance to fire damage, and treats immunity to fire damage as resistance.

trait.name: Spiteful Detonation
entries: When the solamith is reduced to 0 hit points, its body begins to bloat and glow with a terrible red light. At the beginning of its next turn, its corpse explodes.
Each creature within 15 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or take 28 ({@damage 8d6}) fire damage, or take half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The solamith makes three melee attacks or uses its Lob Flesh twice, then may use its Swallow Whole, if available.

action.name: Heavy Slam

The explosion's radius increases by 10 feet.
The explosion's damage increases by {@dice 1d6}.

action.name: Swallow Whole {@recharge 5}
entries: The solamith begins to swallow a Medium or smaller creature within 10 feet that is dead or {@condition incapacitated}.

At the beginning of the solamith's next turn, the target is swallowed and dies, becoming a face in the solamith's belly, and the solamith regains hit points equal to half the target's hit point maximum.
This action is disrupted if the solamith is knocked {@condition prone} or takes any cold damage.

reaction.name: Soulfire Eruption
entries: When the solamith takes 15 or more damage from a melee attack, it can release a gout of soulfire from the wound, dealing 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage to the attacker.

reaction.name: Call of the Damned
entries: When the solamith loses 10 or more hit points from its Lob Flesh ability, it can force one demon within 20 feet of it to succeed on a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw or be magically {@condition stunned} until the end of the solamith's next turn.

trait.name: Angelic Weapons
entries: The solar's weapons are manifestations of its innate divine magic, and appear only as the Solar is attacking with them.

trait.name: Divine Awareness
entries: The solar knows if it hears a lie.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The solar has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Cowing Presence
entries: If the solar has at least 122 HP, a creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the solar must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be unable to take hostile action against the solar until the beginning of its next turn. A creature has advantage on this save if it took damage from the solar since the end of its last turn.

trait.name: Wrathful Presence
entries: If the solar has 121 HP or fewer, a creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the solar must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} of the solar until the beginning of its next turn. While {@condition frightened} in this way, the creature has vulnerability to radiant damage.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the solar fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The solar attacks with its sword twice, one of which it may replace with a longbow attack.

action.name: Sword of Ruin
entries: The solar slashes with its sword and a line of incandescent light 5 feet wide and 30 feet long appears within 120 feet and lasts for a minute. A creature that starts its turn in one or more such lines, or enters one for the first time on a turn, must succeed on a {@dc 22} Dexterity saving throw or take 36 ({@damage 8d8}) radiant damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Lifeburst Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 13} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) piercing damage and the target is pushed back 10 feet. The target must succeed on a {@dc 22} Constitution saving throw or take an additional 9 ({@damage 2d8}) radiant damage per unexpended hit die it has, then regains one hit die.

action.name: Healing Touch (4/Day)
entries: The solar touches another creature that is alive, or has been dead for no more than a century. If the target was dead, it is restored to life with 1 HP. Then, the target magically regains 40 ({@dice 8d8 + 4}) hit points and is freed from any curse, disease, poison, blindness, or deafness. If the target is a corpse that died in the last century, it is restored to life.

legendary.name: Teleport
entries: The solar magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

legendary.name: Searing Burst (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The solar emits magical, divine energy. Each creature of its choice in a 10-foot radius centered on the solar must make a {@dc 23} Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary.name: Blinding Gaze (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The solar targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see it, the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until magic such as the {@spell lesser restoration} spell removes the blindness.

immune.note: damage from weapons that aren't named

trait.name: Oppressive Fog
entries: The area within 5 miles of Solodovnika is filled with a heavy, shifting fog. Creatures other than her treat anything greater than 20 feet away as heavily obscured.

trait.name: Feast of Terror (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
entries: When Solodovnika is reduced to 0 hit points, she doesn't die or fall {@condition unconscious}. Instead, she resets to 252 hit points and her chest splits open, revealing the roiling void within.

For the next hour, a {@condition frightened} creature that ends its turn within 60 feet of Solodovnika must succeed on a {@dc 22} Constitution saving throw or lose two unexpended hit dice, or gain a point of {@condition exhaustion} if it cannot. For each hit die lost in this way, Solodovnika regains 10 hit points.

trait.name: Unliving Hair
entries: Solodovnika can have up to six locks of hair active at a time. Each lock can be attacked (AC 17; 20 HP). Destroying a lock deals no damage to Solodovnika, who can extrude any number of replacement locks on her turn.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If Solodovnika would fail a saving throw, she may choose to succeed.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Solodovnika makes makes three melee attacks, or makes one attack and uses her Terror Unbound, if available.

action.name: Erdblack Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}29 ({@damage 4d10 + 7}) slashing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 22} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of Solodovnika's next turn.

action.name: Slithering Locks
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 20 ft., one creature. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d8 + 7}) bludgeoning damage and the target suffers one additional effect of Solodovnika's choice.

items.name: Bind
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 22} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 22}).

items.name: Snare
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 22} Dexterity saving or be knocked {@condition prone}.

items.name: Reel
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 22} Strength saving throw or be dragged up to 20 feet directly toward Solodovinka.

items.name: Wick
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 22} Charisma saving throw or have one spell affecting it end.

action.name: Terror Unbound {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature that has seen Solodovnika in the last minute becomes {@condition frightened} until the end of her next turn, then must succeed on a {@dc 22} Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to move its speed directly away from her, or take 44 ({@damage 8d10}) psychic damage if it cannot.

action.name: Horrific Lament (1/Day, Concentration)
entries: Each {@condition frightened} creature within 60 feet of Solodovnika begins to uncontrollably weep acrid black tears, becoming {@condition poisoned} for the next minute.

At the end of each affected creature's turn, it must make a {@dc 22} Constitution saving throw, taking 22 ({@damage 4d10}) necrotic damage and being {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn on a failure, or ending the effect for itself on a success.

reaction.name: Wraithdrift
entries: When she is hit with an attack, Solodovnika can turn briefly insubstantial, gaining resistance to the attack's damage and moving up to her fly speed.

reaction.name: Bloodied Terror (1/Day)
entries: When her mythic trait becomes active, Solodovnika can recharge and immediately use her Terror Unbound.

legendary.name: Slithering Locks
entries: Solodovnika makes an attack with her Slithering Locks.

legendary.name: Strangle
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by Solodovnika must succeed on a {@dc 22} Constitution saving throw or be unable to speak or breathe for as long as it remains {@condition grappled}.

legendary.name: Elude
entries: Solodovnika moves up to her fly speed and regains her reaction.

mythic.name: Consuming Void (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: One {@condition grappled} creature within 5 feet of Solodovnika must succeed on a {@dc 22} Strength saving throw or be forced into the endless void within her (escape {@dc 22}).
A creature in the void can take no actions other than to attempt to escape, and loses 2 unexpended hit dice at the end of each of its turns, or dies if it cannot.

action.name: Casting Rod

entries: The jow and one other creature within 5 feet must each succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of the jow's next turn.

reaction.name: Hook Set
entries: As a reaction when the jow hits a creature with its Casting Rod, it embeds the hook in the target.

While the hook is embedded, the jow cannot attack another creature with its Casting Rod, and the first time the target moves away from the jow, it takes 5 ({@damage 2d4}) slashing damage and the hook is freed.
A creature may remove the hook as an action with a successful {@dc 12} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check, or sever the line (AC 15; 8 HP) to end this effect.

variant.name: Note: Tracking Resources
entries: With shared pools of limited resources, like Ki and Metamagic, I've tried to allocate them based on typical usage in a 3-6 round fight. Once the stat blocks get to a level where they're not likely to run out, I stop bothering to track them, because you should only take on more bookkeeping load when and if it benefits your game.

action.name: Power Word: Stun (1/Day, 8th level spell)
entries: 60 ft range, 1 target. If the target has 150 hit points or fewer, it is {@condition stunned}. Otherwise, the spell has no effect. The {@condition stunned} target must make a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
