monster.name: Spawn of Kyuss
languages: understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Infested Flesh
entries: If the spawn is targeted by an effect that cures disease or removes a curse, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or die.
On a success, it loses its Burrowing Worm action, and for the next minute regains twice as many hit points with its Regeneration, after which it dies.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The spawn regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the spawn takes acid, fire, or radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the spawn's next turn. The spawn is destroyed only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spawn makes two melee attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its Noxious Breath, if available.

action.name: Writhing Embrace
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@dice 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}).
A creature that starts its turn {@condition grappled} in this way must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be infected with the {@disease touch of kyuss|ConfC}.

action.name: Burrowing Worm
entries: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or take 1 piercing damage as a worm (AC 6; 1 HP) latches on and begins to burrow into its flesh. At the beginning of the spawn's next turn, the worm slithers into the creature, infecting it with a Worm of Kyuss.
The spawn may use this ability as a Bonus Action against a {@condition grappled} or {@condition incapacitated} target.

action.name: Noxious Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The spawn exudes the scent of its worm-riddled innards in a 15 foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of the spawn's next turn.

reaction.name: Plead for Death
entries: When a creature {@condition grappled} by the spawn targets it with a melee attack, the spawn can allow the attack to hit it without a roll.
The attacker must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} for as long as it remains {@condition grappled}.

reaction.name: Worm of Kyuss
entries: A creature infected by one or more Worms of Kyuss takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage at the end of each of its turns for each worm infesting it. A creature killed by this damage rises on its next turn as a Wretch of Kyuss.

A burrowing worm may be located and destroyed with a successful {@dc 14} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check, or by a friendly creature dealing 10 or more damage to the infected creature with a weapon that deals piercing damage. Any magical effect that cures disease destroys all worms infesting a creature.
A creature cured of this disease must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until it completes a Short or Long Rest.

entries: The spectator speaks only the truth, makes only promises that it intends to keep, and kills only in self-defense.

trait.name: Budding Demise
entries: When the spectator dies, each of its peripheral eyes tears free and levitates away as a newborn spectator (size Tiny, AC 12, 4 hit points) with only a single eye ray that acts on its parent's initiative.

trait.name: Eyestalks
entries: When the spectator is dealt a critical hit, the spectator must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or lose the use of an eye ray of the attacker's choice that it has seen the spectator use.

entries: As a reaction to succeeding on a saving throw against a spell that targets only it, the spectator avoids all effects from the spell and instead causes the spell to target the caster.

monster.name: Specter
languages: understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Radiance Sensitivity
entries: If the specter takes radiant damage, it loses its damage resistances and it is temporarily made corporeal until the beginning of its next turn .

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The specter can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Spectral Weapons
entries: The specter's attacks treat all creatures as unarmored (an unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier.)

action.name: Inflict Weakness
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or deal only half damage with weapon attacks that use Strength until the beginning of the specter's next turn.

action.name: Invisibility (Concentration)
entries: the specter becomes {@condition invisible} until it makes an attack.

reaction.name: Shadow Glide
entries: When the specter takes damage of a type it is resistant to, it can teleport up to 60 feet to a location it can see and turn {@condition invisible} until the end of its next turn, or until it makes an attack.

monster.name: Spectral Wraith

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

languages: The languages it knew in life

trait.name: Radiance Sensitivity
entries: If the wraith takes radiant damage, it loses its damage resistances and it is temporarily made corporeal until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The wraith can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Spectral Weapons
entries: The wraith's attacks treat all creatures as unarmored (an unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier.)

action.name: Life Drain
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}21 ({@damage 4d8 + 3}) necrotic damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be forced to expend two of its hit dice. If the creature can't, it instead drops to 0 HP.

action.name: Invisibility (Concentration)
entries: the wraith becomes {@condition invisible} until it makes an attack.

action.name: Create Specter
entries: The wraith targets a humanoid within 10 feet of it that has been dead for no longer than 1 minute and died violently. The target's spirit rises as a Specter under the wraith's control.

reaction.name: Shadow Glide
entries: When the wraith takes damage of a type it is resistant to, it can teleport up to 60 feet and turn {@condition invisible} until the end of its next turn, or until it makes an attack.

trait.name: Chromatic Disk
entries: At the beginning of each of its turns, the spellweaver rolls a {@dice d6}. On a 5-6, it regains a use of one of its expended spells of 4th level or above

trait.name: Incomprehensible Mind
entries: A creature that attempts to read the spellweaver's mind must make a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature suffers disadvantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws until it completes a short or long rest.

trait.name: Planar Impenetrability
entries: The area within 30 ft. of the spellweaver is inimical to interplanar magic, causing the following effects:
Creatures in the area have resistance to Force damage.
Interplanar teleportation magic in or out of the area fails.
Divination magic that targets a creature or object in the area fails.

action.name: Spellweaving
entries: The spellweaver casts any number of spells of 1st level or above with a total spell level of no more than 6.

action.name: Magic Misile (1st Level Spell)
entries: Three darts of magical force hit a creature within 120 ft., each dealing 3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) force damage.

action.name: Blindness (2nd Level Spell)
entries: One creature theat the spellweaver can see within 60 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} for 1 minute. A {@condition blinded} creature repeats this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Hold Person (2nd Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: One creature within 60 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} for 1 minute. A {@condition paralyzed} creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Invisibility (2nd Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: The spellweaver turns {@condition invisible} for the next hour, or until it casts another spell.

action.name: Dispel Magic (3rd Level Spell)
entries: The spellweaver ends one magical effect of 3rd level or below on a creature it can see within 60 ft.

action.name: Thunder Step (3rd Level Spell)
entries: The spellweaver teleports up to 90 ft. to an unoccupied location it can see. Each creature within 10 ft. of the space it left must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or take 16 ({@damage 3d10}) thunder damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Ice Storm (1/Day, 4th Level Spell)
entries: Each creature in a 20 ft. radius, 400 ft. high cylinder centered on a point within 300 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexgterity saving throw or take 9 ({@dice 2d8}) bludgeoning and 14 ({@damage 4d6}) cold damage, or half as much on a success. The affected area becomes difficult terrain until the end of the spellweaver's next turn.

action.name: Wall of Fire (1/Day, 4th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: The giant creates up to six contiguous panels of fire within 120 feet, each of which is 20 feet tall, 10 feet wide, and 1 foot thick. A creature that passes through a panel, or is in its space when the wall appears, must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take 23 ({@damage 5d8}) fire damage, or half as much on a success. The wall lasts 1 minute.

action.name: Cone of Cold (1/Day, 5th Level Spell)
entries: Each creature in a 60 ft. cone must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or take 36 ({@damage 8d8}) cold damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Counterspell (3rd Level Spell)
entries: As a reaction to seeing a creature cast a spell within 60 feet, the spellweaver may make an Intelligence check with DC equal to 10 plus the spell's level, negating the spell on a success. If the spell is 3rd level or below, the spellweaver succeeds automatically.

reaction.name: Shield (1st Level Spell)
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with an attack, the Spellweaver may add 5 to its AC until the beginning of its next turn.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

trait.name: Epicure of Pain
entries: Whenever the devil takes damage from an ability it controls, it gains resistance to all damage until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Limited Magic Resistance
entries: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects that are not gastromancy spells.

action.name: Chili Spray
entries: The spice devil flings a spray of caustic pepper from its hands in a 15 foot cone.
Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or take 5 ({@damage 2d4}) acid damage and be {@condition blinded} until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Gastrointestinal Distress (1/Day, 1st level spell)
entries: One creature the devil can see within 60 feet must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) acid damage, fall {@condition prone} and be unable to stand for the next minute.
The creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

reaction.name: Devour Spell
entries: As a reaction when the devil succeeds on a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the devil devours the spell's remaining energy, negating its effects.
The devil takes {@damage 1d10} force damage per level of the negated spell, then regains a use of its Gastrointestinal Distress.

trait.name: Chemoreception
entries: While submerged in a body of water, the crab can detect the presence and location of creatures in that water within 60 ft.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 11}).

action.name: Crush
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the crab must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) bludgeoning damage and suffer disadvantage on attack rolls that use Strength until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Scuttle
entries: As a reaction to being forced to make a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the crab moves up to 10 ft. If this movement puts the crab out of range or area of the spell or magical effect, the crab is unaffected.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

trait.name: Devil's Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the devil's {@sense darkvision}.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The devil doesn't provoke an {@action opportunity attack} when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Limited Spines
entries: The devil has twelve tail spines. Used spines regrow by the time the devil finishes a long rest. If the devil has no spines remaining, it may dash as a bonus action.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The devil makes two attacks with its tail spines.

action.name: Fork
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d6}) piercing damage.

action.name: Tail Spine
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 20/80 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) piercing damage and the spine embeds in the target's flesh. The target's speed is reduced by 5 ft. for each spine embedded in it. The spines may be removed as an action with a successful {@dc 12} medicine check, or by taking an additional {@damage 1d6} damage per spine removed.

action.name: Detonate Spines
entries: Each creature with one or more of the devil's spines lodged in it takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage per spine, after which the spines crumble to ash.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If it dies, the naga returns to life in {@dice 1d6} days and regains all its hit points. Only a {@spell wish} spell can prevent this trait from functioning.

action.name: Beguiling Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or take 31 ({@damage 7d8}) poison damage and be {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn, or half as much damage on a successful one. While {@condition poisoned} in this way, a creature is {@condition charmed} and follows the mental commands of the naga.

action.name: Lightning Bolt
entries: A bolt of lightning 100 ft. long and 5 ft. wide extends from the naga. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or take 28 ({@damage 8d6}) lightning damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Mana Drain {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 14} Charisma saving throw or have its highest level unexpended spell slot expended. If the naga expends a spell slot of 3rd level or above in this way, the next time it uses its lightning bolt it deals maximum damage, instead of rolling.

reaction.name: Shunt Pain
entries: As a reaction when a creature hits it with an attack and a {@condition charmed} creature is within 10 feet, the naga gains resistance to the attacks damage types until the beginning of its next turn, and the {@condition charmed} creature takes the same amount of damage as psychic damage.

trait.name: Troll Healing
entries: The troll regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the troll takes 10 or more acid or fire damage from a single source, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Budding
entries: When the troll suffers a critical hit that deals piercing or slashing damage, one of its limbs is severed, giving it disadvantage on attack rolls and Dexterity saving throws.

At the end of each of its turns, the troll makes a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw. On a success, this condition ends, and the severed piece grows into a {@creature troll budling|confc|Troll Budling} that acts on initiative count 0. The severed limb is destroyed if it takes acid or fire damage.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The troll can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Spectral Weapons
entries: The troll's attacks treat all creatures as unarmored (an unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier.)

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The troll makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Confounding Bite.

action.name: Confounding Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d10 + 3}) psychic damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be disoriented until the end of the troll's next turn.
A disoriented creature that misses with a melee attack must make a new attack roll against a friendly creature in its reach, if available.

action.name: Ephemeral Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d10 + 3}) psychic damage.

action.name: Strangling Grasp
entries: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}). While {@condition grappled} in this way, a creature cannot speak or breathe.
A creature that fails this save by 5 or more cannot hold its breath. A creature that cannot see the troll makes this save at disadvantage.

reaction.name: Wraithform (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 67 hit points, the troll becomes {@condition invisible} until it makes an attack or regains all of its hit points.

When the troll becomes {@condition invisible}, each hostile creature within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or use all of its movement on its following turn to move away from the troll.

trait.name: Adamantine Shell
entries: The spirrax has a shell of pure adamantine that protects it from most harm. If it has fewer than 163 hit points, the spirrax cannot use its fly speed while encased in its shell and attacks against it are made at advantage while encased in its shell. While encased in its shell, the spirrax has the following traits:

items.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: The spirrax can't be affected or detected by spells of 3rd level or lower. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

items.name: Critical Immunity
entries: Any critical hit against the spirax becomes a normal hit.

items.name: Increased AC
entries: The spirrax gains +6 to its AC (included).

items.name: Impenetrable Flank
entries: A creature receives no benefit from flanking the spirrax.

items.name: Constrained
entries: The spirrax makes four fewer attacks with its multiattack.

trait.name: Aura of Indifference
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 120 ft. of the spirrax must succeed on a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw or become indifferent to the spirrax's presence until the beginning of its next turn. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more retains no memory of the affected period after the spirrax leaves.

trait.name: Implosion
entries: When the spirrax dies, the dimensional gate contained within it implodes. Each creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or be sucked in and transported to a random plane. A creature that succeeds on this save may use its reaction to repeat the save to rescue a creature that failed.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spirrax makes two attacks with its lashing tendrils, or makes six attacks and takes the {@action Dash} action if it is out of its shell.

action.name: Lashing Tendril
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 4d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 20}). Instead of grappling a creature, the spirrax may force it to succeed on a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 ft. away and knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Fling
entries: One Large or smaller creature {@condition grappled} by the spirax is thrown up to 60 feet and knocked {@condition prone}. If a thrown target strikes a solid surface, the target takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Void Blast {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature, object or creation of magical force within 60 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 75 ({@damage 10d6 + 40}) force damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, it is disintegrated.

reaction.name: Foul Emergance (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to taking damage while below 163 hit points, the spirax surges out of its shell in a tide of whirling tentacles. As part of this reaction, the spirrax may move up to its speed and use its multiattack. Each creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of the spirax's next turn.

variant.name: Note: Adamantine Shell
entries: The shell of a spirrax contains roughly 16,000 gp worth of adamantine.

trait.name: Air-Hungry
entries: If the crawler takes any cold damage or is doused in a non-flammable substance, its flames diminish.
Until the end of its next turn, the crawler can't take reactions, and its traits and abilities do not inflict the {@condition burning|confc|burning} condition.

trait.name: Blazing Trail
entries: When the crawler moves through a space, each flammable object and surface in that space begins {@condition burning|confc|burning}.
Until extinguished, a creature that enters that space for the first time on a turn takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage.

action.name: Pureflame Slash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@dice 3d10 + 6}) fire plus 16 ({@damage 3d10}) force damage.
This attack has advantage against any creature not resistant or immune to fire damage.

action.name: Spitefire Flare
entries: A towering plume of baleful flame erupts from the ground beneath on a creature the crawler can see within 60 feet.
Each creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 16 ({@damage 3d10}) fire damage and begin {@condition burning|confc|burning} ({@dice 1d10}).

bonus.name: Razing Rush
entries: The crawler moves up to its speed in a straight line and can move through the space of any Large or smaller creature.

Each creature whose space it enters in this way must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or take 11 ({@damage 2d10}) fire damage and be knocked {@condition prone}, or move to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

bonus.name: Spitefire Eruption {@recharge 4}
entries: The crawler uses its Spitefire Flare three times, choosing targets at random from hostile creatures it can see.

trait.name: Deadwood Core
entries: Whenever the treant deals bludgeoning damage with a melee attack, it loses an equal amount of hit points. The treant cannot recover hit points by any means.

trait.name: Wooden Body
entries: If the treant takes any fire damage, it begins {@condition burning|confc|burning} ({@dice 1d10}).
While it is {@condition burning|confc|burning}, attacks against the treant are made at advantage, the treant's melee attacks deal an additional 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage.

action.name: Splintering Swing
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@dice 2d8 + 5}) bludgeoning plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Slivered Shrapnel
entries: When the treant is hit with a melee attack that deals slashing damage, it can force the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the end of the treant's next turn.

reaction.name: Toppling Vengeance
entries: When the treant drops to 0 hit points, it can fall onto a creature within 10 feet before dying.

The creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone} and be {@condition restrained} under the treant's corpse (escape {@dc 15}), or move to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The living spell can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Living Magic
entries: If the living spell is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as {@spell Dispel Magic}, it must make a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC.
On a failure, the living spell is {@condition stunned} (Save Ends at end of turn).

action.name: Spluttering Sparks
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 15 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage.
A flammable object hit with this attack ignites.

action.name: Spew Flames (Concentration, Recharge 5-6)
entries: A thin, continuous sheet of flames issues forth from the living spell in a 15 foot cone.

Each creature that starts its turn in the area, or that enters it for the first time on a turn, must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage, or half as much on a success.
While {@status concentration||concentrating} on this ability, the living spell can use its action to repeat this effect on each of its turns.

reaction.name: Blowback
entries: When the living spell loses {@status concentration} on its Spew Flames, it can send forth a concussive shock of flame.
Each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or take 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Host-Seeking
entries: Whenever a nonplant creature within 60 feet of the globe starts its turn, the globe may move up to 5 feet towards it.

action.name: Toxic Effluvia
entries: Each creature within 5 feet of the globe must succeed on a {@dc 9} Constitution saving throw or take 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage.
A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is infected with {@disease burrow-diver mycosis|ConfC}.

trait.name: Greater Spore Host
entries: When the behemoth dies, {@dice 2d4 + 1} {@creature spore globe|confc|Spore Globes} that act on initiative count 0 emerge from its wounds.

trait.name: Creature of the Dark
entries: Attacks that deal acid, fire or radiant damage are made at advantage against the behemoth.

If the behemoth takes 10 or more acid, fire, or radiant damage from a single source, a hole is burned in it. Until it completes a long rest, a creature engulfed by the behemoth may escape it as an action with a successful {@dc 14} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the behemoth may spend half of its movement to attempt a {@dc 14} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the behemoth. While climbing on the behemoth, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the behemoth, and the behemoth has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the behemoth fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The behemoth makes two attacks with its Stalk Slam, one of which it may replace with a use of its Engulf, and uses its Spore Breath, if available.

action.name: Stalk Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 18}).
Each other creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Engulf
entries: The behemoth engulfs a Medium or smaller creature {@condition grappled} by it.

While engulfed, the creature is {@condition blinded}, {@condition restrained}, its attacks bypass the behemoth's damage resistances, and it takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage at the start of each of the behemoth's turns.

action.name: Spore Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The behemoth releases a spray of toxic spores in a 30 foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage and be infected with {@disease burrow-diver mycosis|ConfC}, or take half as much damage on success.

legendary.name: Roil
entries: A tidal wave of thrashing mycelia spill out from the behemoth in a 20 foot radius. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) bludgeoning damage and be pushed up to 10 feet away.

legendary.name: Burgeoning
entries: The Behemoth rapidly buds and splits off {@dice 1d4 + 1} {@creature spore globe|confc|Spore Globes}, which appear in its space and may each immediately move up to 10 feet.

legendary.name: Dream of the Azure Abyss
entries: One creature infected with {@disease burrow-diver mycosis|ConfC} that the behemoth can see within 60 feet must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to move up to its speed directly toward the behemoth, then fall {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Spore Host
entries: When the spore servant dies, {@dice 1d4 - 1} {@creature spore globe|confc|Spore Globes} that act on initiative count 0 emerge from its wounds.

trait.name: Sudden Lunge
entries: The spore servant's attacks have a reach of 10 feet for the purposes of making {@action opportunity attack||opportunity attacks}.
When it makes an {@action opportunity attack||attack of opportunity} against a creature more than 5 feet away, the spore servant moves 5 feet towards its target as part of the attack.

action.name: Shambling Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}).

action.name: Death Grip
entries: The spore servant dies, and one creature {@condition grappled} by it must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 12}) as fungal shoots burst from the spore servant's body.
A creature {@condition restrained} in this way takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage at the end of each of its turns.

trait.name: Opportunist
entries: The hyena has advantage on attack rolls against a creature unless that creature hit it with a melee attack since the end of the hyena's last turn.

action.name: Latching Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) piercing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the hyena can grapple the target (escape {@dc 11}).

action.name: Crush Bones
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the hyena takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) piercing damage and must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or suffer disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws that use Strength until it completes a short or long rest.

reaction.name: Giggling Retreat
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the hyena moves up to 10 ft. without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}, emitting an unsettling laugh. The attacker must succeed on a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw or be unable to move closer to the hyena this turn.

trait.name: Water Form
entries: The elemental can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Hard Freeze
entries: If the elemental takes any cold damage, it freezes solid, becoming {@condition paralyzed} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Brineswipe Dive
entries: The spraylark flies up to 10 feet in a straight line without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

A creature whose space it enters in this way must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) cold damage and be {@condition blinded} until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Frigid Cascade
entries: The spraylark begins to shed a spray of chilling droplets in a 5 foot radius.

Until the beginning of its next turn, creatures in the area add {@dice 1d4} to saving throws against effects that deal fire damage, and subtract {@dice 1d4} from saving throws against effects that deal cold damage.

trait.name: Giant Distention {@recharge 5}
entries: As a Bonus Action, the spriggan grows to size Large until the end of its turn. While enlarged, the spriggan makes melee attacks at advantage, and it makes one fewer attack with its multiattack.

trait.name: Blood Slide
entries: The spriggan can {@action Disengage} as a Bonus Action while adjacent to one or more creatures that are bleeding.

trait.name: Fey Confusion
entries: The spriggan has disadvantage on attack rolls that target a creature wearing inside-out clothing.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spriggan makes three melee attacks, or two melee attacks if it is enlarged.

action.name: Skin Peeler (Small Size Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) slashing damage and the target begins to bleed, losing {@dice 1d4} hit points at the start of each of its turns. This effect ends when a creature succeeds on a {@dc 12} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check as an action, or when the bleeding creature receives magical healing.

action.name: Skin Shredder (Large Size Only)
