A creature {@condition restrained} in this way takes 22 ({@damage 5d8}) necrotic damage at the start of each of the larva mage's turns.

reaction.name: Feed on Weakness
entries: When a creature within 20 feet of the larva mage fails a saving throw, the larva mage regains an expended legendary action.

reaction.name: Sprouting Flesh (1/Day)
entries: When the larva mage is reduced below 106 hit points, it can force each other creature within 30 feet that has fewer than half of its hit points to succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) necrotic damage as writhing grubs sprout from its wounds.
The larva mage gains temporary hit points equal to the total damage dealt this way.

legendary.name: Boil Out
entries: The larva mage teleports to the space of a corpse within 60 feet or that of a creature {@condition restrained} by its Plague of Worms.

legendary.name: Detritus Feeding
entries: The larva mage reduces one corpse in its space to bones. If it does, it gains advantage on saving throws until the beginning of its next turn.

legendary.name: Squirming Touch
entries: The larva mage uses its Squirming Touch.

legendary.name: Conquer Life (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The mage forces one creature with 0 hit points within 15 feet to make a Death saving throw.
On a failure, the larva mage gains 18 ({@dice 4d8}) temporary hit points and the creature does not reset that failure until it completes a Long Rest.

trait.name: Echoing Doom of Khirad
entries: When the doomsayer is reduced below 83 hit points, Khirad flares in the sky overhead, becoming visible even in daylight.
For the next minute, it and each other creature within 1 mile of it subtract {@dice 1d4} from any attacks or saving throws they make.

action.name: Starlight Lance
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 6} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}27 ({@damage 5d10}) radiant damage.
If this attack hits, the doomsayer may make a second attack roll against another creature in range that is directly behind the first target.

action.name: Stammered Whisper
entries: The doomsayer clutches at a creature within 5 feet and attempts to share a fragment of its unbearable knowledge.
If the creature can hear and understand the doomsayer, it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Intelligence saving throw or gain 10 ({@dice 3d6}) temporary hit points.
While it has any of these temporary hit points, a creature is {@condition dominated|confc|dominated} by the doomsayer and takes {@damage 1d6} psychic damage at the end of each of its turns.

action.name: Summons of the Radiant King
entries: A pillar of blue starfire pours down upon one creature the doomsayer can see within 120 feet, forcing it to succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or begin {@condition burning|confc|burning} ({@dice 3d10}).
At the beginning of each of the {@condition burning|confc|burning} creature's turns, the doomsayer may teleport it up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space the doomsayer can see.

action.name: Gruesome Illumination (Concentration)
entries: A blue flame flares upon the brow of the doomsayer, casting a Dim Light in a 30 foot radius that uncovers and awakens old wounds.
When a creature starts its turn in the area, the doomsayer may deal necrotic damage equal to the creature's level or challenge rating to it.

trait.name: Blessed Sight of the Guidestar
entries: The emissary knows the precise location of each creature that can see the night sky.

trait.name: Visions of the Final Hour
entries: While it is {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell or magical effect that targets the emissary, a creature is {@condition blinded} with visions of an unfamiliar constellation.

action.name: Touch of Creeping Despair (4th Level Spell)
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d8}) psychic damage and the target is {@condition cursed|confc|cursed}.
The first time a creature {@condition cursed|confc|cursed} in this way fails a saving throw, this curse ends and the creature takes 18 ({@damage 4d8}) psychic damage.

action.name: Fevered Certainty of Caiphon (Concentration, 3rd Level Spell)
entries: The emissary foretells the impending doom of a creature it can see within 60 feet.
When the target makes a saving throw, it does not add any modifiers to its rolled result. When the target fails a saving throw, this effect ends.
The emissary has disadvantage on saving throws made to Concentrate on this spell.

action.name: Release of Dreams {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature the emissary can see within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or regain its highest level expended spell slot, then take 13 ({@damage 3d8}) psychic damage per level of the spell slot regained.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more becomes hostile to all other creatures until the end of its next turn.

bonus.name: Steps Upon the Purple Stair (4th Level Spell)
entries: The emissary steps into a fleeting echo plane and disappears, taking 13 ({@damage 3d8}) psychic damage and emerging in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of where it departed at the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Stilling Glow
entries: Colors fade and motion stills within 20 feet of the glare.
Spells and ranged weapon attacks that target a creature or point in the area deal half as much damage.

trait.name: Unseasonable Flare
entries: When the glare loses {@status concentration} on a spell, it flares with freezing light.
Each other creature within 20 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) cold damage and be {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Boreal Gaze
entries: The glare turns its impassive gaze upon a creature it can see within 30 feet and an evil chill begins to creep through the creature's veins.
The target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or take 45 ({@damage 10d8}) cold damage and have its movement reduced by half until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Hateful Silence (6th Level Spell, Concentration, Recharge 5-6)
entries: A horrid magical silence descends in a 30 foot radius extending from the glare, stifling all sound but that of a creature's own thunderous heartbeat.

A non-aberration creature that starts its turn in the area must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) psychic damage and be {@condition frightened} until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Doom of Delban (9th Level Spell, Concentration, 1/Day)
entries: The glare calls down a shaft of freezing starlight on a a 5 foot radius space it can see. Each creature in the space when it appears, or that enters it for the first time on a turn, must make a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw

On a failed save, a creature takes 66 ({@dice 8d8 + 30}) cold plus 33 ({@damage 6d10}) radiant damage and is {@condition paralyzed} until the end of the glare's next turn, or take half as much damage on a success.

While {@status concentration||concentrating} on this spell, the glare takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage at the beginning of each of its turns, then may use its action to move the effect up to 120 feet.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the grue takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the grue takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

trait.name: Waning Light
entries: At initiative count 0, each light source within 30 feet of at least three grues is diminished by one level; from bright light to dim light, or from dim light to darkness.
Each light source within 30 feet of at least ten grues is instead extinguished.

action.name: Gleaming Bite (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 piercing damage. This attack deals an additional 4 piercing damage if no non-aberration creature can see the grue.

action.name: Pitch Dark
entries: The grue fills a 10 foot radius centered on a point in darkness it can see within 60 feet with a magical darkness that lasts until the end of the grue's next turn.

When the magical darkness appears, each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to make a melee attack against a randomly selected creature in its reach.

trait.name: Dread Shadows
entries: Areas within 30 feet of the herald that are not illuminated by Bright Light have their shadows thicken and twist into unsettling shapes, becoming difficult terrain.

trait.name: Cloak of Embers (1/Day)
entries: If the herald fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it begins {@condition burning|confc|burning} ({@dice 1d10}).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The herald makes two attacks with its Claws of Frenzied Dark, or makes one attack against each creature in the area of its Dread Shadows.

action.name: Claws of Frenzied Dark
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage.
This attack treats each creature in an area affected by the herald's Dread Shadows as though they were within 5 feet of the herald.

action.name: Hunger of Hadar (3rd Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: The herald opens a path to the unknowable horrors that lair in the dark between the stars, filling a 20 foot radius centered on a point it can see within 150 feet with chittering, tendrilous blackness for the next minute.
The area is heavily obscured and difficult terrain, and a creature that starts its turn in the area takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) cold damage.
A creature that ends its turn in the area must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) acid damage.

action.name: Call to the Ebon Brood (4th level Spell) {@recharge 5}
entries: The herald sings to the darkness concealed in the body of a creature it can see within 30 feet, awakening its hunger.
The creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 10 ({@dice 3d6}) slashing plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) psychic damage, or half as much on a success.

A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more has 5 ({@dice 2d4}) {@creature star spawn grue|confc|Star Spawn Grues} spill forth from its eyes and mouth, appearing in the nearest unoccupied spaces. The grues act on the herald's initiative and under its control.

reaction.name: Breath of a Dying Star (1/Day)
entries: When the herald is reduced below 83 hit points for the first time, it can cast forth a stream of swirling, incandescent embers in a 15 foot cone that blacken and burn the very air around them.
Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 9 ({@dice 2d8}) radiant plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage.
Until the beginning of the herald's next turn, the area is filled with Magical Darkness, and creatures in the area can't regain hit points.

trait.name: Puppet of the Radiant Void
entries: When the hollowed is reduced to 0 hit points, it does not die or fall {@condition unconscious}. Instead, it moves up to half its speed and makes a single attack with its Hammer Sanity on each of its turns, taking no other actions.
If it ends its turn while at 0 hit points without dealing damage, the hollowed dies.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hollowed makes three attacks with its Hammer Sanity.

action.name: Hammer Sanity (4th Level Spell)
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d8}) psychic damage.
If the damage dealt by this spell is greater than the target's Wisdom score, the target becomes indifferent to the hollowed and hostile to each other creature until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Visions of the Endless End (6th Level Spell)
entries: One creature within 60 feet must succeed on a {@dc 15} Intelligence saving throw or take 45 ({@damage 10d8}) psychic damage and be {@condition blinded} until the end of the hollowed's next turn with visions of the infinite timeless void at the end of all things.

If the target is reduced to 0 hit points by this damage, it is instead {@condition blinded} until cured by Lesser Restoration or similar magic, and permanently gains {@sense Blindsight} with a range of 5 feet.

action.name: Corpse-Light of Zhudun (7th Level Spell) {@recharge 5}
entries: The hollowed manifests a blank and flickering visage of the evershining absence left where Zhudun once burned, sending forth its screaming light in a 30 foot cone.

Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or take 18 ({@dice 4d8}) psychic plus 22 ({@damage 4d10}) radiant damage and be {@condition frightened} until the end of the hollowed's next turn, or take half as much damage on a success.

trait.name: Psychic Mirror
entries: A creature that attempts to read the hulk's mind instead reads deeply into its own, its deepest fears, insecurities and repressed memories laid bare before it.

trait.name: Freed From Will
entries: Whenever the hulk voluntarily fails a saving throw, it gains 11 ({@dice 2d10}) temporary hit points. While it has these temporary hit points, the hulk's attacks are made at advantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hulk makes two melee attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its Hurl ability.

action.name: Pallid Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit. reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@dice 2d8 + 5}) slashing plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) psychic damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}).

action.name: Hurl
entries: The hulk hurls a {@condition grappled} creature up to 30 feet. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take 28 ({@damage 8d6}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}, or take half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Ragdoll Slam {@recharge 5}
entries: The hulk slams a {@condition grappled} creature into the ground repeatedly, forcing it to make three {@dc 17} Constitution saving throws.
For each save it failed, the creature takes 21 ({@damage 3d10 + 5}) bludgeoning damage, and half as much damage for each save on which it succeeded.
A creature that fails two or more of these saving throws in a turn is {@condition stunned} until the end of the hulk's next turn.

reaction.name: Psychic Dispersal
entries: When the hulk takes any psychic damage, it may force each creature within 10 feet of it to succeed on a {@dc 17} Intelligence saving throw or take the same damage, or half as much damage on a success.

trait.name: Aura of Hysteria
entries: Creatures within 30 feet of one or more manglers have disadvantage on saving throws against being {@condition frightened}.
Each {@condition frightened} creature in the area takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) psychic damage at the beginning of each of the mangler's turns.

trait.name: Crawler
entries: The mangler is not slowed by being {@condition prone} or by difficult terrain, and while {@condition prone} may {@action Dash} as a bonus action and stand from {@condition prone} by spending 5 feet of movement.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mangler makes three attacks, one of which can be with its Skullbreaker Bite

action.name: Skullbreaker Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) slashing damage.
Any hit with this attack against a {@condition restrained} or {@condition incapacitated} target becomes a critical.

action.name: Mangling Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) slashing damage.
A creature affected by the mangler's Weaken Flesh ability takes an additional 3 ({@damage 1d6}) psychic damage.

action.name: Flurry of Claws {@recharge 4}
entries: The mangler makes six attacks with its Mangling Claw.

reaction.name: Weaken Flesh
entries: When the mangler is reduced below 50 hit points, it may force one creature it can see within 30 feet to succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or have its flesh soften and sag.
For the next minute, whenever the affected creature takes bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, it takes an additional 3 ({@damage 1d6}) slashing damage.

trait.name: Rim of the Void
entries: The maw projects Dim Light in a 5 foot radius, blocking out all other light sources.
Creatures in the area are immune to Radiant damage, and a creature must spend 20 additional feet of movement to leave the area.

action.name: Devouring Touch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}33 ({@damage 6d10}) force damage.

action.name: Endless Hunger of Acamar {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature in the area of the maw's Rim of the Void aura must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 22 ({@dice 4d10}) force plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) psychic damage.

bonus.name: Corpse-Star's Grip
entries: Each creature within 30 feet of the maw's Rim of the Void aura must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be drawn up to 15 feet directly toward the maw.

bonus.name: Feed the Void
entries: The maw draws a Medium or Large corpse or other nonmagical object within 5 feet into its body, destroying it utterly.
For the next minute, the radius of its Rim of the Void aura increases by 10 feet.

reaction.name: Distort Time (1/Day, Concentration)
entries: The first time the maw is reduced below 90 hit points, it may warp the passage of time in the area affected by its Rim of the Void ability.

For the next minute, each creature in the area cannot make more than a single attack on its turn, and each creature in the area has advantage on saving throws against effects originating outside of it.

trait.name: Shroud of Cosmic Revulsion
entries: A creature with a Wisdom score of 10 or higher must avert its gaze from the scion if it is more than 10 feet away, treating the scion as {@condition invisible}.

trait.name: Invoker of the Vengeful Endless
entries: The scion must maintain Concentration to avoid recalling what dwells in Gibbeth.

When it loses Concentration on this effect or ends its turn while not Concentrating on this effect, formless limbs spring from the scion's body to lash at it, dealing 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage to it and restraining it until it regains Concentration on this ability.

trait.name: Knowledge of the Coming Hour
entries: At the end of each creature's turn, the scion may take 4 ({@damage 1d8}) psychic damage.
If it does, the scion immediately makes a saving throw to end each effect on it that ends on a successful saving throw.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The scion makes two attacks with its Unbearable Touch and uses its Dread Fascination or Mind-Splinter, if available.

action.name: Unbearable Touch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit. reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}27 ({@damage 6d8}) psychic damage and the target must use its reaction to move 15 feet directly away from the scion, if available.

action.name: Dread Fascination
entries: One creature the scion can see within 120 feet must make a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save, the creature must use all of its movement on its following turn to approach the scion by the most direct route available.

action.name: Mind-Splinter {@recharge 5}
entries: Each other creature within 10 feet of the scion must succeed on a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to make a melee weapon attack against itself, if available.
On a hit, this attack deals an additional 13 ({@damage 3d8}) psychic damage.

bonus.name: Squamous Lurch
entries: The scion moves up to its speed, then each creature within 10 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 19} Intelligence saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 3d8}) psychic damage and be {@condition frightened} until the end of the scion's next turn.
While {@condition frightened} in this way, a creature makes Intelligence and Wisdom saving throws at disadvantage.

bonus.name: Suppress Memories
entries: The scion hastily attempts to clear thoughts of Gibbeth from its mind, making a {@dc 10} Intelligence check. On a success, the scion regains Concentration on its Invoker of the Endless ability.
Glimpses of Gibbeth
When the scion loses {@status concentration} on its Invoker of the Endless ability, it causes one of the following effects, which lasts until it regains {@status concentration} or dies:

bonus.name: Unmaking Gaze
entries: The scion assaults the mind of one creature that can see it, revealing a fragmentary vision of infinite possible futures converging unerringly toward the moment of Gibbeth's inevitable birth.
The creature must succeed on a {@dc 19} Intelligence saving throw or become hostile toward each creature it can see (Save Ends at end of turn).

bonus.name: Embrace of Ancient Hate
entries: Slivers of a being outside of time violently extrude through reality, squirming across a 10 foot radius column that is 60 feet high and centered on a point the scion can see within 120 feet.

A creature that starts its turn in the area or that enters it for the first time on a turn must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or take 21 ({@dice 6d6}) bludgeoning plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) psychic damage and be pushed to the nearest unoccupied space outside the area.

bonus.name: Veil of the Clinging Void
entries: An obscuring wall of starry void crashes into existence within 120 feet of the scion. The wall is 60 feet long, 10 feet wide, and arbitrarily high.

A creature that starts its turn in the wall or enters its space for the first time on a turn takes 18 ({@damage 6d8}) cold damage, and is {@condition blinded} and {@condition choking|confc|choking} until the beginning of its next turn as clinging tendrils of black nothing envelop it.

trait.name: Out-of-Phase Movement
entries: The seer can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. Each creature it moves through takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) psychic damage; no creature can take this damage more than once per turn. The seer takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Mind Colonizer
entries: When the seer casts a spell that requires {@status concentration}, it may have a willing aberration within 30 feet of it maintain {@status concentration} in its stead.

trait.name: Fractal Demise
entries: When the star spawn is reduced to 0 hit points, if one or more friendly aberrations are within 30 ft. it casts Astral Maelstrom before it dies centered on itself, its body tearing apart into a ragged spiral.

action.name: Untether Mind (5th level Spell)
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 11} to hit. reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@dice 3d10}) force plus 39 ({@damage 6d12}) psychic damage and the target must make a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw.

On a failure, the creature is {@condition frightened} and {@condition blinded} until the end of the seer's next turn as its field of perception expands and expands and expands until it encompasses the entirety of the multiverse.
A creature that fails by 10 or more is additionally {@condition paralyzed} until the end of the seer's next turn.

action.name: Astral Maelstrom (5th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: The seer creates a 5-ft. radius disk of unimaginable density in an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet that lasts for a minute; raw voidstuff compressed until it glows with a searing light that does not reflect or illuminate.
A creature that begins its turn within 10 ft. of the sphere must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or take 33 ({@damage 6d10}) radiant damage.

action.name: Crumple Space (6th Level Spell) {@recharge 5}
entries: The seer chooses a point along a 5 ft. wide line that is 30 ft. long and wholly within 120 feet.

Each creature in the line's area must succeed on a {@dc 19} Charisma saving throw or be teleported to the nearest unoccupied space to the point chosen by the seer, then take 22 ({@dice 4d10}) force plus 13 ({@damage 2d12}) psychic damage.

legendary.name: Warp (1st Level Spell)
entries: A 10 ft. radius of space centered on a point the seer can see within 60 ft. becomes difficult terrain for non-aberrations until the beginning of the seer's turn.

legendary.name: Music of the Spheres (3rd Level Spell)
entries: The seer chooses two creatures or objects it can see within 120 ft. The first creature or object is levitated off the ground and revolves up to 30 ft. clockwise around the second, maintaining the same distance. A creature levitated in this way makes a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw, resisting the effect on a success.

legendary.name: Beckoning of the Expanse (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Each creature within 30 ft. of the seer's Astral Maelstrom must succeed on a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to move 10 ft. towards it.

trait.name: Weightless
entries: Whenever the myrmidon takes damage, it is pushed 10 feet away from the source of the damage.

trait.name: Condense
entries: If the steam myrmidon takes cold damage, it is reduced to size Small and has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The myrmiddon makes three melee attacks, one of which it may replace with its Heavy Air

action.name: Hazy Pike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) slashing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away. This attack is made at advantage against a creature with lower than 12 Passive {@skill Perception}.

action.name: Heavy Air {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be slowed by its labored breaths for the next minute. An affected creature cannot make more than a single attack in a turn, and repeats this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

reaction.name: Elemental Riposte
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack, the myrmidon unleashes a burst of steam, shrouding itself in a cloud that fills a 15-foot-diameter sphere centered on its space, heavily obscuring the area until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Misty Advance
entries: As a reaction to a creature targeting the myrmidon with a ranged attack, the myrmidon may teleport up to 30 ft. toward the attacker. If it ends this teleportation within 5 feet of the attacker, it may impose disadvantage on the triggering attack.

trait.name: Weightless
entries: Whenever the mephit takes damage, it is pushed 10 feet away from the source of the damage.

trait.name: Condense
entries: If the steam mephit takes any cold damage, it shrinks to size Tiny and has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a 15 foot radius burst of steam, leaving behind a cloud that heavily obscures the area for the next minute.

action.name: Hazy Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 10} Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away.
This attack is made with advantage against a creature with a Passive {@skill Perception} of 12 or lower.

action.name: Burden Breath {@recharge}
entries: The mephit weighs down the air in the lungs of a creature within 5 feet, forcing it to make a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw.
On a failed save, the creature can't make more than one attack in a turn or cast a spell of 3rd level or above for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn).

reaction.name: Misty Advance
entries: When the mephit is targeted with a ranged attack, it can teleport up to 30 feet directly toward the attacker.
If the mephit teleports to a space within 5 feet of the attacker, the triggering attack has disadvantage.

trait.name: Iconoclast
entries: The dragon may spend 5 ft. of movement to free itself from any restraints.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The dragon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d10 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Breath Weapons {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.

action.name: Toxic Breath
entries: The dragon exhales a poisonous cloud in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for the next minute. A {@condition poisoned} creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success or taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage on a failure.

action.name: Acid Trench Breath
entries: The dragon exhales acid in a 15-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a {@dc 11} Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 ({@damage 5d8}) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Additionally, rock and earth in the area are disolved to a depth of 5 ft.

reaction.name: Bat Away
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the dragon forces the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 10} Strength saving throw or have one object it is holding knocked out of its hands and 10 t. away.

trait.name: Trampling Charge
entries: If the kow moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. If the target is {@condition prone}, the kow can make one attack with its hooves against it as a bonus action.

trait.name: Stench
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the kow must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Reckless Thrash
entries: At the start of its turn, the kow can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn. If it misses with an attack this turn, it falls {@condition prone} and is {@condition stunned} until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Gore
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Hooves
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Breath Sight
entries: A creature that does not need to breathe is {@condition invisible} to the stirge, and a creature that holds its breath has advantage on checks made to hide from the stirge.

trait.name: Weakness Seeker
entries: The stirge's attacks have advantage against creatures afflicted with a disease.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the stirge takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the stirge takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

action.name: Pierce Vein (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}2 piercing damage and the stirge becomes {@condition attached|confc|attached} to the target (remove {@dc 13}).

action.name: Draw Blood
entries: One creature the stirge is {@condition attached|confc|attached} to loses 2 hit points. Then, if the creature has lost 6 or more hit points in this way this turn, it must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or be infected with Redding Ague.

trait.name: Skull Symbiote
entries: The hive tender's skull is fused with and houses a parasitic monstrosity, which can be targeted with attacks (AC 16, HP 40, vulnerability to fire damage). If the parasite dies, the hive tender dies.

trait.name: Weakness Seeker
entries: The hive tender's attacks have advantage against creatures afflicted with a disease.

action.name: Lunging Grasp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage, the hive tender moves up to 5 feet toward the target, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13})

action.name: Needle's Kiss {@recharge 5}
entries: If the hive tender's proboscis is extended, it slams its head repeatedly into a creature {@condition grappled} by it.
The creature must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) piercing damage and be infected with Redding Ague, or take half as much damage on a success.

bonus.name: Extend Proboscis
entries: A needle-like proboscis extends from the hive tender's mouth until it retracts it as a bonus action.
While extended, attacks against the hive tender's Skull Symbiote are made with advantage.

trait.name: Breath Sight
entries: A creature that does not need to breathe is {@condition invisible} to the stirge queen, and a creature that holds its breath has advantage on checks made to hide from the stirge queen.

trait.name: Weakness-Seeker
entries: The stirge queen has advantage on attacks that target creatures afflicted with a disease.

trait.name: Miasmatic Hemorrhaging
entries: A non-stirge creature that has fewer than half its hit points and starts its turn within 30 feet of the stirge queen must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or begin {@condition bleeding|confc|bleeding} ({@dice 1d4}, Save Ends at end of turn).

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
entries: If the stirge queen fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The stirge queen makes two attacks with her Pinning Talons.

action.name: Pinning Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d8 + 4}) piercing damage.
Instead of dealing damage, the stirge queen can knock the target {@condition prone} and grapple it until she moves (escape {@dc 15}).

action.name: Blood Spear:
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 6} to hit, range 30 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) piercing damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

action.name: Plague Blood Torrent {@recharge 5}
entries: The stirge queen spews forth a torrent of contaminated blood in a 30 foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 17 ({@damage 5d6}) poison damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is infected with Redding Ague.

reaction.name: Awaken Their Hunger (1/Day)
entries: When the stirge queen is reduced below 62 hit points, she can let out a frantic hypersonic signal.
Each other stirge within 30 feet that can hear her can use its reaction to make a melee attack.

legendary.name: Fend Off
entries: One creature within 10 feet must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be pushed 5 feet away and knocked {@condition prone}.

legendary.name: Feed Your Queen
entries: The stirge queen consumes one stirge in her reach that has fed in the last minute, killing it and gaining 14 ({@dice 4d6}) temporary hit points.

trait.name: Breath Sight
entries: A creature that does not need to breathe is {@condition invisible} to the stirge, and a creature that holds its breath has advantage on checks made to hide from the stirge.

trait.name: Weakness Seeker
entries: The stirge's attacks have advantage against creatures afflicted with a disease.

action.name: Pierce Vein
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) piercing damage and the stirge becomes {@condition attached|confc|attached} to the target (remove {@dc 14}).

action.name: Draw Blood
entries: One creature the stirge is {@condition attached|confc|attached} to loses 5 hit points, then must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be infected with Redding Ague.

action.name: Essence Transfusion (Recharges when the stirge uses its Draw Blood)
entries: The stirge revitalizes itself or a creature it is attached to with stored blood, restoring 5 hit points.

reaction.name: Pierce Skull
entries: When a humanoid creature the stirge is {@condition attached|confc|attached} to drops to 0 hit points, the stirge can repositions itself, piercing the creature's head and gaining control of its body.
The creature is not {@condition incapacitated} while at 0 hit points, and fails death saving throws automatically.
On each of the creature's turns, it moves under the stirge's control and takes the {@action Attack} action against a target of the stirge's choice.

monster.name: Stone Cursed
languages: The languages it knew in life

trait.name: Lithified
entries: If the stone cursed would take 15 or fewer damage from a single source, it instead takes no damage.

trait.name: Tormented Echoes
entries: A creature that kills the stone cursed must succeed on a {@dc 10} Intelligence saving throw or fall {@condition prone} and be {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn as it relives one of the stone cursed's memories.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the stone cursed remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal statue.

action.name: Stony Grasp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}).

action.name: Petrifying Sludge
entries: The stone cursed covers one {@condition grappled} creature in petrifying sludge. The creature's speed is reduced to 10, and at the end of each of its turns the creature must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constituiton saving throw or be {@condition petrified} for 24 hours, or until it takes 10 or more bludgeoning damage.
This effect ends when a creature clears the sludge away as an action with a successful {@dc 12} Strength ({@skill Survival}) check.

reaction.name: Shambling Pursuit
entries: As a reaction when a creature the stone cursed can see makes a ranged attack, the stone cursed moves up to its speed directly toward the creature.

trait.name: Stone Camouflage
entries: The giant has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

trait.name: Stone Shaper
entries: The giant can scoop and mold solid earth and stone with its hands as though it were soft clay.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the giant may spend half of its movement to attempt a {@dc 17} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the giant. While climbing on the giant, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the giant, and the giant has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The stone giant makes two attacks with its sculpted greatclub, one of which it may replace with a use of its sweeping club ability.

action.name: Sculpted Greatclub
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and the creature is pushed 5 feet away.
Each other creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

action.name: Hurl Rock
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 9} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}28 ({@damage 4d10 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Rolling Rock
entries: Each creature in a 60-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 4d10}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}, or take half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Sweeping Club {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature in a 15 foot cone must make a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) bludgeoning damage and be pushed 10 feet away. A creature may fall {@condition prone} as a reaction to gain advantage on this saving throw.

reaction.name: Fling Pest
entries: As a reaction to being attacked by a creature that is climbing on it, the giant may force the creature to succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or be hurled 20 feet away, take 14 ({@damage 2d6}) bludgeoning damage and fall {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Dreamwalker's Fugue
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 30 ft. of the dreamwalker perceives its reality as though in a dream, and must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or suffer one of the following effects at random. A creature that failed at least one of these saves retains no memory of events that transpired while in the affected area.

items.name: Frightening Apparition
entries: The earth boils, twisted faces and grasping hands surfacing and crying out before turning to stone. The creature is {@condition frightened} until the beginning of its next turn.

items.name: Incomprehensible Babbling
entries: The creature babbles incoherently and cannot speak or perform the verbal components of spells until the beginning of its next turn.

items.name: Endless Loops
entries: The creature must perform the same action this turn that it did on its previous turn. If it cannot, the creature teleports 40 ft. into the air and immediately falls.

items.name: Change Unending
entries: Colors and textures blur and run together, flowing like oil before rapidly sharpening into new focus. The area in a 10 ft. radius around the creature becomes difficult terrain.

trait.name: Stone Shaper
entries: The giant can scoop and mold solid earth and stone with its hands as though it were soft clay.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the giant may spend half of its movement to attempt a {@dc 17} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the giant. While climbing on the giant, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the giant, and the giant has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The stone giant makes two attacks with its surreality grasp, one of which it may replace with a use of its absorb dreamer ability, if available.

action.name: Surreality Grasp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@dice 2d8 + 6}) bludgeoning plus 16 ({@damage 3d10}) psychic damage and the creature is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 18}). While {@condition grappled}, a creature's flesh takes on the appearance of stone.

action.name: Sculpt Creature
entries: The dreamwalker sculpts a {@condition grappled} creature like clay, imposing a new artistic form onto it. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or take 66 ({@damage 12d10}) psychic damage and be {@condition restrained} until it leaves the area of the dreamwalker's fugue.

action.name: Absorb Dreamer
entries: One {@condition grappled} creature affected by the giant's sculpt creature ability must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} and partially absorbed into the giant's body until the giant dies or releases it. The creature can still perceive and speak.

reaction.name: Across the Veil
entries: As a reaction to being targeted by a ranged attack or harmful spell from outside the area of its dreamwalker's fugue, the giant turns the attack or spell into a shower of petals or a splash of water as it enters the area.

variant.name: Note: Dreams Made Real
entries: The effects of the Dreamwalker's Fugue are persistent and remain in the dreamwalker's wake unless otherwise noted.

trait.name: Stone Camouflage
entries: The giant has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

trait.name: Stone Shaper
entries: The giant can scoop and mold solid earth and stone with its hands as though it were soft clay.

trait.name: Runesong
entries: Over the course of an hour, the giant can sculpt a natural cavern to channel wind into beautiful and haunting melodies. Stone giants in the cavern have advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the giant may spend half of its movement to attempt a {@dc 17} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the giant. While climbing on the giant, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the giant, and the giant has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The stone giant makes two attacks with its Launch Quakestone.

action.name: Enruned War-Chisel
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@dice 2d10 + 6}) slashing plus 22 ({@damage 4d10}) force damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Charisma saving throw or have a rune inscribed upon its flesh, imposing one of the following effects. The creature may repeat this saving throw whenever it receives magical healing, ending the effect on a success.
Until the creature receives magical healing, it suffers one of the following effects of the giant's choice.

items.name: Rune of Stony Sleep
entries: Whenever the creature regains hit points, it turns partially to stone and is {@condition restrained} until the end of its next turn. While asleep, the creature appears to be {@condition petrified}, and wakes only if a creature takes an action to wake it.

items.name: Rune of Thundering Echo
entries: Whenever the creature takes bludgeoning damage, it and each other creature within 5 ft. of it takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) thunder damage.

items.name: Rune of Grasping Stone
entries: The creature treats surfaces of solid stone as difficult terrain, as hands continuously reach from the stone to slow its passage.

action.name: Launch Quakestone
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 9} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}28 ({@damage 4d10 + 6}) bludgeoning damage. On a hit or miss, each creature within 15 ft. of the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Grounding Stance
entries: As a reaction to taking 20 or more damage from a single source, the giant forces each Large or smaller creature within 30 ft. to succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Stone Camouflage
entries: The giant has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

trait.name: Stone Shaper
entries: The giant can scoop and mold solid earth and stone with its hands as though it were soft clay.

trait.name: Earth Glide
entries: The giant can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the giant doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the giant may spend half of its movement to attempt a {@dc 17} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the giant. While climbing on the giant, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the giant, and the giant has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

trait.name: Ordning of Artistry
entries: When initiative is rolled, time stops for each creature other than the giant. The giant may take three turns to inspect its surroundings and use its stone shaper ability to alter them. This effect ends early if the giant interacts with another creature in any way.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant makes two attacks with its crushing grasp, one of which it may replace with its stillness of stone ability, if available.

action.name: Crushing Grasp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and the creature is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 18}). While {@condition grappled} in this way, a creature takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) bludgeoning damage at the beginning of each of its turns.

action.name: Hurl Rock
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 9} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}28 ({@damage 4d10 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Living Burial
entries: The giant scoops out a hollow in the earth and attempts to seal a creature in it. One {@condition grappled} creature must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or be {@condition blinded}, {@condition restrained}, and unable to breathe, sealed in a shallow grave of solid stone. The stone covering the creature is an object and can be destroyed (AC 20; HP 30; Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage)

action.name: Stillness of Stone (Concentration) {@recharge 5}
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}33 ({@damage 6d10}) thunder damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition petrified}.

legendary.name: Fling Pest
entries: The giant forces one creature that is climbing on it to succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or be hurled 20 feet away, take 14 ({@damage 2d6}) bludgeoning damage and fall {@condition prone}.

legendary.name: Shelter of Stone
entries: If no creatures are currently climbing on it, the giant moves up to half its burrow speed.

legendary.name: Seal Wounds (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The stone giant seals its wounds with stone, gaining 22 ({@dice 4d10}) temporary hit points.

monster.name: Stone Golem

immune.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

languages: understands The Languages Of Its Creator but can't speak

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: The golem can't be affected or detected by spells of 2nd level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Brittle Body
entries: If the golem takes 20 or more bludgeoning damage from a single source, it can no longer use its multiattack until it completes a short or long rest. If it takes 20 or more bludgeoning damage from a single source a second time, it falls {@condition prone} and cannot stand until it completes a short or long rest.

trait.name: Implacable Advance
entries: At the beginning of its turn, the golem may end all effects that would reduce its speed or incapacitate it. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

trait.name: Richochet
entries: A ranged weapon attack that misses the golem by 5 or more instead targets another creature within 15 ft., making a new attack roll.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes two slam attacks. If both attacks hit the same Large or smaller creature, the creature has its movement speed halved and is unable to make more than a single attack in a turn until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 18}).

action.name: Crush
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the golem must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or take 66 ({@damage 12d10}) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success. A creature killed by this damage has its skull crushed.

reaction.name: Hurl
entries: As a reaction to being damaged by a creature it is grappling, the golem hurls the creature up to 30 feet. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) bludgeoning damage on be knocked {@condition prone}, or half as much on a success. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.

immune.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

trait.name: Deathroller
entries: The juggernaut is equipped with a series of stone rollers, granting it the following traits:

items.name: Facing
entries: The juggernaut has a facing, and can only move in a straight line in the direction it is facing.

items.name: Turning
entries: The juggernaut may spend 10 feet of movement to make a turn of up to 90 degrees, and cannot turn otherwise.

items.name: {@condition prone} Vulnerability
entries: While {@condition prone}, the juggernaut is {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Rear Hatch
entries: The juggernaut is hollow, and can be entered through a locked hatch in its rear, which can be opened with a successful {@dc 18} Dexterity (Thieves' Tools) or {@dc 24} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. A creature in the juggernaut moves with it, and its attacks bypass the juggernaut's Damage Resistances and Damage Threshold.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The juggernaut makes two Piston Fist attacks, each of which must be against a different target, and uses its Flattening Charge.

action.name: Piston Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}24 ({@damage 3d10 + 8}) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away and knocked {@condition prone}.
The juggernaut has six fists, and can use each of them once before it must use its Vent Hydraulics to retract them.

action.name: Flattening Charge
entries: The juggernaut moves up to its speed in a straight line and can move through the space of any creature smaller than Huge.
The first time it enters a creature's space during this move, the creature takes 18 ({@damage 4d8}) bludgeoning damage and is knocked {@condition prone}.
A creature that is already {@condition prone} takes an additional 9 ({@damage 2d8}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Vent Hydraulics {@recharge 5}
entries: The juggernaut retracts each of its fists, and vents boiling steam into its interior. Each creature inside of it must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or take 28 ({@damage 8d6}) fire damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The giant can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Crackling Power
entries: Whenever the storm giant is subjected to lightning damage, its speed doubles until the end of its next turn, and the next attack it makes before the end of its next turn deals an extra 21 ({@damage 6d6}) lightning damage.

trait.name: Shifting Omens
entries: The giant relies on reading omens to predict its opponents next move, making it vulnerable to rapid, {@condition unconscious} decisions.
A player that declares what they are doing on their turn within five seconds of being told that their turn has started makes attacks at advantage against the giant.

action.name: Multiattack

action.name: Howling Winds
entries: Each creature within 30 feet of the giant must make a {@dc 22} Strength saving throw or be pushed 15 feet away and knocked {@condition prone}. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is instead blown 30 feet away and knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Lightning Strike {@recharge 5}

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant makes three attacks with its iron beads, one of which it may replace with a use of its mark the omens ability.

action.name: Iron Bead
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 15 ft. or range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}27 ({@damage 5d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

While outdoors, the giant may fling the bead high into the air instead of targeting a creature with it. At the end of any creature's turn before the end of the giant's next turn, the giant may force the creature to succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or take the attack's damage.

action.name: Mark the Omens
entries: The giant rolls two D20s and assigns each of them in secret to a creature it can see within 30 ft. The next time that creature makes an attack within the next minute, it uses the value rolled by the giant, instead of rolling.

action.name: Oracle's Curse
entries: One creature within 15 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or take 44 ({@damage 8d10}) psychic damage and be {@condition blinded} with overlapping visions of possible futures until the end of the giant's next turn, or take half as much damage on a success.
A creature that succeeds by 5 or more instead gains advantage on all attacks and saving throws until the end of the giant's next turn.

reaction.name: Alter Fate
entries: As a reaction to a creature within 30 ft. making a saving throw, the giant adds or subtracts a {@dice d4} from the creature's result.
