trait.name: Ordning of Prophecy
entries: When initiative is rolled, each friendly giant within 60 ft. gains resistance to the paramount's choice of Acid, Fire, Force, Necrotic, or Radiant damage for the next minute, representing ritual magics cast earlier in the day in response to cryptic omens.
This effect ends early if the paramount dies, or if the paramount is subjected to a successful {@spell Dispel Magic} (dispel {@dc 18}).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant makes two attacks with its gildspine greatbow.

action.name: Gildspine Greatbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 10} to hit, range 300/1200 ft., one target. {@h}40 ({@damage 8d8 + 4}) piercing damage and the target is knocked {@condition prone}. On a hit or miss, a twelve foot spike of gilded iron is planted in the target's location, and the target is pushed 5 ft. away.
Each other creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a {@dc 22} Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage as slashing damage and be pushed 5 feet away.

action.name: Impaling Slam
entries: The giant slams a {@condition grappled} creature onto one of the spikes of gilded iron planted by its greatbow within 15 ft. The creature must make a {@dc 23} Constitution saving throw or take 99 ({@damage 18d10}) piercing damage and be {@condition restrained} on the spike (escape {@dc 23}), or take half as much damage on a success.
Whenever an impaled creature takes damage, it may attempt to escape as a reaction.

action.name: Arcing Bolt {@recharge 5}
entries: The giant hurls a magical lightning bolt in a 500-foot line that is 10 feet wide. Whenever the bolt contacts one of the giant's iron spines, the giant may change its direction by up to 90 degrees. Each creature in the bolt's area must make a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw, taking 63 ({@damage 14d8}) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reaction.name: Sparkstep
entries: As a reaction to a creature the giant can see within 60 ft. taking lightning damage, the giant teleports to an unoccupied space within 15 ft. of it. {@condition grappled} creatures are not teleported with it.

legendary.name: Sweeping Grasp
entries: One creature within 15 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 23} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition grappled} in one of the giant's hands (escape {@dc 23}). While the giant has a creature {@condition grappled}, it cannot use its greatbow.

legendary.name: Hurl
entries: One {@condition grappled} creature is thrown up to 30 ft., and must succeed on a {@dc 23} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone} and take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) damage.

legendary.name: Galvanize
entries: The giant deals 9 ({@damage 2d8}) lightning damage to itself that bypasses its damage immunity.

legendary.name: Thunderous Leap (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The giant leaps up to 50 feet. If the giant ends this movement in mid-air, it does not fall until the beginning of its next turn, at which point each creature within 15 ft. of it must succeed on a {@dc 23} Constitution saving throw or take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) thunder damage and be pushed 15 ft. away.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The giant can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Storm-Followed
entries: Stormy weather always accompanies the giant's presence. At the beginning of the giant's turn, a randomly determined creature within 60 feet of it is struck by lightning, and must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or take 17 ({@damage 3d10}) lightning damage. If the giant is struck by lightning, each creature climbing on it must also make this save.

trait.name: Crackling Power
entries: Whenever the storm giant is subjected to lightning damage, its speed doubles until the end of its next turn, and the next attack it makes before the end of its next turn deals an extra 21 ({@damage 6d6}) lightning damage.

trait.name: Shifting Omens
entries: The giant relies on reading omens to predict its opponents next move, making it vulnerable to rapid, {@condition unconscious} decisions.
A player that declares what they are doing on their turn within five seconds of being told that their turn has started makes attacks at advantage against the giant.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the giant may spend half of its movement to attempt a {@dc 22} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the giant. While climbing on the giant, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the giant, and the giant has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant uses its bolt barrage twice, one of which it may replace with a use of its Traveling Thundercloud.

action.name: Bolt Barrage
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 14} to hit, range 120 ft., up to three targets. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d8}) lightning damage.

action.name: Traveling Thundercloud (Concentration)
entries: The giant becomes insubstantial until the end of its next turn, gaining a 50 ft. fly speed and resistance to all damage. While in this form, the giant cannot use its multiattack.

action.name: Lightning Strike {@recharge 5}
entries: The giant hurls a magical lightning bolt at a point it can see within 500 feet of it. Each creature within 10 feet of that point must make a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw, taking 54 ({@damage 12d8}) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reaction.name: Fury of the Storm
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 115 HP, the giant may call down a bolt of lightning on each creature in range, per its Storm-Followed ability.

trait.name: Thunderous Charge
entries: If the gorgon moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, the target and each Medium or smaller creature within 20 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Reckless Follow-Through
entries: At the start of its turn, the gorgon can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn. If it misses with an attack this turn, it is {@condition stunned} until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gorgon makes two attacks with its Skycrusher Hooves, one of which it may replace with a use of its Charged Gore or Thrashing Horns.

action.name: Charged Gore
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@dice 2d12 + 5}) piercing plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) lightning damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away.

action.name: Skycrusher Hooves
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) thunder damage.

action.name: Thrashing Horns
entries: Two creatures on opposite sides of the gorgon must each succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 19 ({@damage 3d12}) piercing damage and be pushed 10 feet away, or take half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Storming Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The gorgon exhales billowing clouds that crackle with thunder and lightning in a 30-foot cone, heavily obsucring the area until the start of its next turn.
Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) lightning damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature that ends its turn within 10 feet of the area must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) thunder damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Lightning Absorption
entries: Whenever the shambler is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and regains a number of hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt. The shambler cannot trigger this with its own abilities.

trait.name: Lightning Aura
entries: A creature that ends its turn within 5 feet of the shambler takes {@damage 1d6} lightning damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shambling mound makes two slam attacks. If both attacks hit a Medium or smaller target, the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}), and the shambling mound uses its Engulf on it.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Lightning Blast {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature in a 15 foot cone must succeed on a {@dc 15} dexterity saving throw or take 28 ({@damage 8d6}) lightning damage, or half as much on a success. A {@condition grappled} creature makes this save at disadvantage.

action.name: Engulf
entries: The shambling mound engulfs a Medium or smaller creature {@condition grappled} by it. The engulfed target is {@condition blinded}, {@condition restrained}, and unable to breathe, and it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw at the start of each of the mound's turns or take 14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage. If the mound moves, the engulfed target moves with it.

reaction.name: Entangling Hide
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the shambling mound can force the attacker to make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition grappled}.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks made with ranged weapons

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the storoper remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal cave formation, such as a stalagmite.

trait.name: Grasping Tendrils
entries: The storoper can have up to six tendrils at a time. Each tendril can be attacked (AC 20; 10 hit points). Destroying a tendril deals no damage to the storoper, which can extrude a replacement tendril on its next turn.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The storoper can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The storoper makes six attacks, up to one of which may be with its stonetooth bite, and uses its whipping reel, if available.

action.name: Stonetooth Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}26 ({@damage 4d10 + 4}) piercing damage. This attack is made with advantage against a {@condition grappled} creature.

action.name: Numbing Tendril
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 50 ft., one creature. {@h}The target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}). Until the grapple ends, the target subtracts {@dice 1d6} from its Dexterity score for each tendril attached to it. A creature reduced to 0 Dexterity in this way is {@condition paralyzed} and has its skin take on a stony grey pallor until it is freed.

action.name: Wrench
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by at least two tendrils must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 36 ({@damage 8d8}) bludgeoning damage, or half as much damage on a success. A creature that succeeds on this save by 5 or more may use its reaction to attempt to escape the grapples.

action.name: Whipping Reel {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature {@condition grappled} by the storoper must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) bludgeoning damage and be moved up to 30 ft. in a direction of the storoper's choice, or take half as much damage on a success

monster.name: Strahd Van Zarovich
languages: the languages it knew in life

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: If the vampire isn't in sunlight or running water, it can use its action to polymorph into a Tiny bat or back into its true form. While polymorphed, the vampire has a 20 ft. fly speed and can't take actions.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the vampire fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Misty Escape
entries: When it drops to 0 hit points, the vampire transforms into a cloud of mist instead of falling {@condition unconscious}, provided that it isn't in sunlight or running water. If it can't transform, it is destroyed. While it has 0 hit points, it is immune to all damage and can do nothing other than return to its resting place. Once in its resting place, it reverts to its vampire form. It is then {@condition paralyzed} until it regains at least 1 hit point. At the next sunset, it regains 1 hit point.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The vampire regains 20 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the vampire takes radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Vampire Weaknesses
entries: The vampire has the following flaws:

items.name: Forbiddance
entries: The vampire can't enter a residence without an invitation from one of the occupants.

items.name: Harmed by Running Water
entries: The vampire takes 20 acid damage if it ends its turn in running water.

items.name: Stake to the Heart
entries: If a piercing weapon made of wood is driven into the vampire's heart while the vampire is {@condition incapacitated} in its resting place, the vampire is killed.

items.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
entries: The vampire takes 20 radiant damage when it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vampire makes three attacks, only one of which can be a bite attack. It may replace its bite attack with a use of its Charm ability.

action.name: Exsanguinating Blade
entries: {@hit 9} to hit, {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage. Then, if the target has 15 HP or fewer it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or drop to 0 HP and fall {@condition unconscious}.

action.name: Unarmed Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled}.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one willing creature, or a creature that is {@condition grappled} by the vampire, {@condition incapacitated}, or {@condition restrained}. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage plus 17 ({@damage 5d6}) necrotic damage. A humanoid slain in this way rises the following night as a vampire spawn under the vampire's control.

action.name: Charm
entries: The vampire targets one humanoid it can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see the vampire, the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by the vampire.

Each time the vampire or the vampire's companions do anything harmful to the target, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until the vampire is destroyed.

legendary.name: Leaping Strike
entries: The vampire move up to half its speed without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity} and makes an unarmed strike.

legendary.name: Children of the Night
entries: The vampire conjures a swarm of bats or rats in a space of dim light or darkness within 30 feet.

legendary.name: Misty Shroud
entries: The vampire is engulfed in a 20 foot radius cloud of fog that disipates at the end of its next turn. The area is heavily obscured.

legendary.name: Rend Magic (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The vampire ends one spell or magical effect within 60 feet. If the magical effect was produced by an item, the item may not be activated again until the end of the wielder's next turn.

legendary.name: Bite (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The vampire makes one bite attack.

trait.name: Weakness-Seeker
entries: The strigoi has advantage on attacks that target creatures afflicted with a disease.

trait.name: Bursting Flock
entries: When the strigoi dies, 7 ({@dice 2d6}) {@creature stirge harrier|confc|Stirge Harriers} burst from its corpse.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The strigoi makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Dripping Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@dice 1d8 + 3}) slashing plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) acid damage.
Instead of dealing damage, the strigoi may grapple the target (escape {@dc 13})

action.name: Malformed Proboscis
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition grappled} target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage, plus one additional effect of the strigoi's choice:

items.name: Liquefying Regurgitation
entries: The target takes an additional 7 ({@damage 2d6}) acid damage and gains vulnerability to the next source of necrotic damage it takes before the end of the strigoi's next turn.

items.name: Drain Innards
entries: The target takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage and the strigoi regains an equal number of hit points. A creature killed by this damage has its bones and soft tissues liquefied and extracted, leaving only its skin behind.

reaction.name: Hacking Birth
entries: As a reaction when a creature takes 15 or more necrotic damage from the strigoi's Drain Innards, the strigoi releases each creature {@condition grappled} by it and violently coughs up a {@creature stirge harrier|confc|Stirge Harrier} in the nearest unoccupied space.

trait.name: Weakness-Seeker
entries: The strigoi has advantage on attacks that target creatures afflicted with a disease.

trait.name: Bursting Flock
entries: When the strigoi dies, 10 ({@dice 3d6}) {@creature stirge harrier|confc|Stirge Harriers} burst from its corpse.

trait.name: Lord of the Swarm
entries: Stirges within 120 feet of the strigoi may use its attack bonus, rather than their own.

trait.name: Oppressive Mastery
entries: If the strigoi fails a saving throw against a spell or magical effect that targets it, it can choose to cause that effect to target a stirge within 15 feet of it instead.

Then, if the strigoi has used this ability two or more times since its last long rest, it must succeed on a {@dc 10} Charisma saving throw or have each stirge that can see it become hostile to it and indifferent to each other creature for the next minute.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The strigoi makes three attacks, up to two of which may be with its Malformed Proboscis.

action.name: Dripping Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@dice 1d8 + 3}) slashing plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) acid damage.
Instead of dealing damage, the strigoi may grapple the target (escape {@dc 15})

action.name: Malformed Proboscis
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition grappled} target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) piercing damage, plus one additional effect of the strigoi's choice:

items.name: Liquefying Regurgitation
entries: The target takes an additional 7 ({@damage 2d6}) acid damage and gains vulnerability to the next source of necrotic damage it takes before the end of the strigoi's next turn.

items.name: Drain Innards
entries: The target takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage and the strigoi regains an equal number of hit points. A creature killed by this damage has its bones and soft tissues liquefied and extracted, leaving only its skin behind.

reaction.name: Hacking Birth
entries: As a reaction when a creature takes 15 or more necrotic damage from the strigoi's Drain Innards, the strigoi releases each creature {@condition grappled} by it and violently coughs up a {@creature stirge harrier|confc|Stirge Harrier} in the nearest unoccupied space.

legendary.name: Precipitous Drop
entries: The strigoi flies up to half its speed, then may drop each creature {@condition grappled} by it.

legendary.name: Incite Frenzy
entries: The strigoi chooses a creature it can see that has one or more stirges attached to it. Each stirge not attached to that creature within 120 feet of the strigoi may use its reaction to move up to half its speed toward that creature or make an attack against it.

legendary.name: Bloodsucker's Command
entries: Up to 3 {@creature stirge harrier|confc|Stirge Harriers} or {@creature stirge skullpiercer|confc|Stirge Skullpiercers} within 120 feet of the strigoi may each use their reactions to use their Draw Blood ability.

trait.name: Giant Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the treant may spend half of its movement to attempt a {@dc 16} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check, climbing onto it on a success. A creature climbing on the treant has advantage on melee attacks against the treant, and the treant has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

trait.name: Greenweald Vitality
entries: At the end of each of its turns, nomagical fires within 10 feet of the treant are doused and each condition affecting it ends.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The treant makes two attacks with its Earthshaking Slam and uses its Sprite Mischief.

action.name: Earthshaking Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Sprite Mischief
entries: The sprites that lair in the treant scamper invisibly, targeting a creature within 30 feet of the treant with one of the following effects:

items.name: Trick Trinket
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Charisma saving throw or become unattuned from one magic item is carrying.

items.name: Slip from Mind
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Intelligence saving throw or forget the last spell it cast until it completes a short or long rest.

items.name: Distracting Tickle
entries: The creature has disadvantage on the first attack it makes on its following turn.

action.name: Safeguard Soul (1/Day)
entries: The treant secures a portion of the life essence of a willing fey creature within 5 feet inside of its trunk. Whenever the creature takes damage, it reduces that damage by 10, and the treant loses hit points equal to the damage prevented.
When the treant dies, each creature whose essence it carries must succeed on a {@dc 17} Charisma saving throw or take {@dice 2d6} points of {@condition exhaustion}, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Butting Rush
entries: If the dracorex moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target, attacks it makes against that target this turn are at advantage.

action.name: Flank Ram
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage. If this attack was made at advantage, it deals an additional 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Bully Charge {@recharge 5}
entries: The stygimoloch attempts to shove a creature. If it succeeds, it may make another shove attempt against the same target, and continue doing so until it fails or runs out of movement. The target then takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) damage for each 5 feet it was pushed.

reaction.name: Tail Lash
entries: As a reaction to a creature hitting it with an {@action opportunity attack||attack of opportunity}, the stygimoloch makes a tail attack.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a bonus action, the succubus transforms into a Small or Medium humanoid without a fly speed, or back to its true fiendish form. Its statistics are otherwise the same in each form.

trait.name: Telepathic Bond
entries: The fiend can communicate with a creature {@condition charmed} by it over any distance.

trait.name: Untouchable Poise
entries: Attacks made against the succubus do not add the attacker's proficiency bonus.

action.name: Barbed Command
entries: Up to two creatures {@condition charmed} by the succubus each take 16 ({@damage 3d10}) psychic damage, then must use their reaction to move up to their speed and take an Action.

action.name: Devouring Charm
entries: One humanoid the succubus can see within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be magically {@condition dominated|confc|dominated} by the succubus.

At the beginning of each of its turns, if the {@condition dominated|confc|dominated} creature has any unexpended hit dice it repeats this saving throw, losing three unexpended hit dice on a failure or ending the effect on a success.
When this effect ends, the creature takes 33 ({@damage 6d10}) psychic damage and becomes immune to this effect for the next 24 hours.

reaction.name: Withering Glare
entries: When a creature the succubus can see targets it with an attack or harmful spell, the succubus' eyes flash with power and disdain.
The attacker must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or fall {@condition prone} and have the triggering attack or spell fail.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a bonus action, the succubus transforms into a Small or Medium humanoid without a fly speed, or back to its true fiendish form. Its statistics are otherwise the same in each form.

trait.name: Telepathic Bond
entries: The fiend can communicate with a creature {@condition charmed} by it over any distance.

trait.name: Slink Away
entries: While it has fewer than 34 hit points, the fiend can {@action Disengage} or {@action Hide} as a bonus action.

action.name: Profane Claw (Fiend Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) slashing damage and the target makes Wisdom saving throws at disadvantage until the end of the succubus' next turn.

action.name: Compel
entries: One creature {@condition charmed} by the succubus must use its reaction to move up to half its speed and make a weapon attack.

action.name: Enticing Charm (Concentration)
entries: One humanoid the succubus can see within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be magically {@condition dominated|confc|dominated} by the succubus.
When this effect ends, the creature takes 33 ({@damage 6d10}) psychic damage and becomes immune to this effect for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Draining Kiss
entries: One {@condition dominated|confc|dominated} or willing creature within 5 feet of the succubus must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or lose two unexpended hit dice.
If it cannot, the creature falls fully under the succubus's sway, and the succubus no longer requires {@status concentration} to maintain its Enticing Charm on the creature.

action.name: Etherealness
entries: The succubus enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa.

trait.name: Retract Head
entries: As a Bonus Action, the tortoise may retract its limbs and head into its shell and end its turn. Until the beginning of its next turn, the tortoise's AC is increased to 18 and it can't take reactions.

trait.name: Helpless Inflexibility
entries: While {@condition prone} or {@condition grappled} by a Small or larger creature, the tortoise cannot take Actions other than Bonus Actions.

action.name: Obstinate Plant
entries: Until the beginning of its next turn, the tortoise gains advantage on Strength checks and saving throws, and a Medium or Large creature that attempts to move through its space must succeed on {@dc 11} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: The elf has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed}, and magic can't put the elf to sleep.

trait.name: Heritor of Corellon
entries: While in sunlight, spell attack rolls made by the elf are made at advantage.

trait.name: Perfected Form
entries: The elf's spells cannot be affected or detected by magic of a lower level.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The elf makes two attacks with its Gleaming Zephyr.

action.name: Gleaming Zephyr (3rd Level Spell)
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 11} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 4d10}) radiant damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet in a direction of the elf's choice.

action.name: Knell of Despair (5th Level Spell)
entries: Each creature of the elf's choice within 60 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw or fall {@condition prone} and be unable to stand on its following turn.

action.name: Scouring Bloom (6th Level Spell)
entries: The elf causes whirling petals of light to unfurl in a 20 foot radius centered on a point it can see within 300 feet in an effect that lasts a minute.

A creature that starts its turn in the area or enters it for the first time on a turn must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or take 33 ({@damage 6d10}) radiant damage and be {@condition blinded} until the beginning of its next turn, or take half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Couragous Surge (7th Level Spell) {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature of the elf's choice within 60 feet of it gains 10 temporary hit points.
While a creature has any of these temporary hit points, it has advantage on Wisdom saving throws and its attacks deal an additional 7 ({@damage 2d6}) radiant damage.

action.name: Ancestral Shelter (1/Day, 9th Level Spell)
entries: The elf raises a spectral barrier that extends a distance of the elf's choice, is centered on itself, and lasts for an hour.

The barrier blocks all incoming spells and ranged attacks, though creatures may pass through without resistance, and whenever the barrier takes damage the elf must make a saving throw to maintain {@status concentration} as if it had taken the same damage.

action.name: Create Mythal (1/Year, 10th Level Spell)
entries: The elf creates an extraordinary, long-lasting change to the way magic behaves in a 5 mile radius centered on a point it can see, then must succeed on a {@dc 19} Charisma saving throw or die. A creature that dies in this way cannot be resurrected by any means.

reaction.name: Step Outside Time (4th Level Spell, 3/Day)
entries: As a reaction when the sun elf would fail a saving throw, it instead teleports to a harmless demiplane and suffers none of the saving throw's effects.
After {@dice 1d4} turns, the elf teleports back to the nearest unoccupied space to where it departed.

reaction.name: Possible Mythals
entries: A mythal may produce any of the following effects in the affected area, or something comparable at DM's discretion. 5 or more high mages working in concert may produce a similar effect affecting an entire plane:
Magic of a particular school or source is empowered, disempowered, or entirely ineffective.
Magical or extraplanar creatures of a particular type are weakened or barred from entering or exiting the area.
Resurrective magic has different requirements and limitations.
Divine influence is limited or expanded.
The affected area immediately teleports to another location.
The affected area begins to fly.

trait.name: Keeper of the Old Lore
entries: The elf and each of its allies within 30 feet score a critical hit on a 19-20 against non-elves.

trait.name: Heritor of Corellon
entries: While in sunlight, spell attack rolls made by the elf are made at advantage.

trait.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: The elf has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed}, and magic can't put the elf to sleep.

action.name: Multitattack
entries: The elf makes two attacks with its Branchgold Stave.

action.name: Branchgold Stave
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@dice 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) radiant damage and the target is teleported up to 10 feet to an unoccupied location the elf can see.

action.name: Memory Torrent (3rd Level Spell)
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 7} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d10}) psychic damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Intelligence saving throw or be {@condition blinded} and {@condition deafened} until the end of the elf's next turn as it relives a long-past memory.

action.name: Ancient Valor's Echoes (4th Level Spell, Recharge 5-6, Concentration)
entries: The loremaster summons 5 spectral {@creature sun elf outrider|confc|Sun Elf Outriders} in unoccupied spaces it can see within 30 feet that act initiative count 0 under the loremaster's control.

reaction.name: Consign to Myth (3rd Level Spell)
entries: As a reaction when a creature the elf can see within 60 feet drops to 0 hit points, the elf banishes it to a harmless demiplane where it immediately stabilizes.
As an action, the creature may attempt a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw, returning to the nearest unoccupied space to where it departed on a success.

trait.name: Mastercraft Tack
entries: While mounted, the elf's mount acts on its initiative, instead of rolling its own, and can disengage as a bonus action.

trait.name: Fey Ancestry

If this movement is arrested by a solid object or surface, the creature falls {@condition prone} and ends its turn.

action.name: Excruciating Sting
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature. {@h}1 poison damage and the target is {@condition stunned} until the beginning of its next turn.
A target with a Constitution score of 13 or lower is instead {@condition paralyzed} until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Diminutive Dodge
entries: When the wasp is missed with an attack, it can cause the attack to target another creature in the wasp's space, using the same attack roll.

trait.name: Opportunistic Feeder
entries: The tarbosaurus' attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20 when targeting a {@condition stunned} creature.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tarbosaurus makes two attacks against different targets, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}25 ({@damage 3d12 + 6}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the tarbosaurus can't bite another target.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage.

reaction.name: Thrash
entries: As a reaction to a creature failing an attempt to escape its grapple, the tarbosaurus forces the {@condition grappled} creature to succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of the tarbosaurus' next turn. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is instead {@condition paralyzed} for the same duration.

immune.note: from nonmagical attacks and from attacks made without advantage.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If the tarrasque fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The tarrasque has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Invulnerable Hide
entries: Any time the tarrasque is targeted by a {@spell magic missile} spell, a line spell, or a spell that requires a ranged attack roll, the tarrasque is unaffected. Instead, the next weapon attack that targets the tarrasque has advantage.

trait.name: Eternal Threat
entries: When the Tarrasque is reduced to 0 HP, it does not die or fall {@condition unconscious}. Instead, it cannot take actions other than to dash. While at 0 HP, it can be killed with a {@spell Wish} spell.

trait.name: Slow to Wrath
entries: When the Tarrasque is reduced to 400 HP, it gains a fourth legendary action and immediately regains all spent actions.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tarrasque can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes five attacks: one with its bite, two with its claws, one with its horns, and one with its tail. It can use its Swallow instead of its bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 19} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}36 ({@damage 4d12 + 10}) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 20}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the tarrasque can't bite another target.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 19} to hit, reach 15ft., one target. {@h}28 ({@damage 4d8 + 10}) slashing damage.

action.name: Horns
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 19} to hit, reach 10ft., one target. {@h}32 ({@damage 4d10 + 10}) piercing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 19} to hit, reach 20ft., one target. {@h}24 ({@damage 4d6 + 10}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of the tarrasque's choice within 120 feet of it and aware of it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, with disadvantage if the tarrasque is within line of sight, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the tarrasque's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Swallow
entries: The tarrasque makes one bite attack against a Large or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target takes the bite's damage, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the tarrasque, and it takes 56 ({@damage 16d6}) acid damage at the start of each of the tarrasque's turns.

If the tarrasque takes 60 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the tarrasque must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall {@condition prone} in a space within 10 feet of the tarrasque. If the tarrasque dies, a swallowed creature is no longer {@condition restrained} by it and can escape from the corpse by using 30 feet of movement, exiting {@condition prone}.

action.name: Erupt
entries: The Tarrasque bursts out of the ground. Each creature in a 60 foot radius must make a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 42 ({@damage 12d6}) bludgeoning damage and is {@condition stunned} until the end of the Tarrasque's next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition stunned}.

reaction.name: Reflective
entries: As a reaction, the tarrasque may reflect a spell that targets it back at the caster as though it originated from the tarrasque, turning the caster into the target.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: The tarrasque makes one claw attack or tail attack.

legendary.name: Move
entries: The tarrasque moves up to half its speed.

legendary.name: Chomp (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The tarrasque makes one bite attack or uses its Swallow.

legendary.name: Bone-Shattering Roar (Costs 4 Actions)
entries: The tarrasque emits a titanic roar in a 600-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw, taking 135 ({@damage 30d8}) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is permanently {@condition deafened}.

trait.name: Damage Transfer
entries: While attached to a creature, the tatterdemanimal takes only half the damage dealt to it (rounded down), and that creature takes the other half.

trait.name: Handsome Attire
entries: A non-humanoid creature under the tatterdemanimal's control has advantage on Charisma checks.

action.name: Clinging Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one Small or smaller creature. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, the tatterdemanimal may wrap around the creature, attaching itself to it (escape {@dc 14}).

action.name: Refit
entries: One creature the tatterdemanimal is attached to must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or have its Wisdom score reduced by 5 ({@dice 2d4}), to a minimum of 1, until the tatterdemanimal is removed.
A creature reduced below 10 Wisdom in this way has disadvantage on Strength checks and saving throws. A creature reduced to 1 Wisdom in this way acts under the tatterdemanimal's telepathic control.

trait.name: Earth Scenting
entries: The pig has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell. It can sense the type, number, and direction of underground plants and animals within 25 feet of it.

action.name: Distracting Nudge
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 0} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}The target subtracts {@dice 1d4} from the next Dexterity or Wisdom saving throw it makes before the beginning of the pig's next turn.

trait.name: Cold Blooded
entries: If the tegu takes Cold damage, its speed is reduced by 10 until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Poison Sensitivity
entries: If the tegu has a creature {@condition grappled} and takes Poison damage, it immediately releases its grapple.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}).

action.name: Tail Thrash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) bludgeoning damage. On a hit or miss, if the tegu has a creature {@condition grappled}, the creature takes 1 piercing damage.

reaction.name: Drop Tail (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being hit with an attack, the tegu reduces the attack's damage to 0.

trait.name: Sleek Coat Insulation
entries: While Temen has more than half of his hit points, he has resistance to cold and fire damage.

trait.name: Guiding Star
entries: While Temen can see the sun or stars, he has advantage on Intelligence and Wisdom saving throws, and on checks made to plot a course.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Temen makes two melee attacks, one of which may be with his Anchor Slam.

action.name: Anchor Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 3d12 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Paddle-Tail Smack
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

action.name: Anchor Sweep {@recharge 5}
entries: Temen sweeps his anchor in a huge arc. Each creature within 5 feet must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 19 ({@damage 3d12}) bludgeoning damage and be pushed 10 feet away, or take half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Spur Stomp
entries: As a reaction when a creature attempts to stand from {@condition prone} within 5 feet of him, Temen forces the creature to succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage and be knocked {@condition prone} once more.

trait.name: Water Dancer
entries: The lemurian does not provoke {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity} from creatures without a swim speed.

trait.name: Battle Anchor
entries: While she can hear the song of one or more other lemurians within 60 feet, Tereis is immune to the {@condition frightened} condition.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Tereis makes two attacks with her Aragonite Lantha.

action.name: Aragonite Lantha
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d10 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Palytoxin Zoa {@recharge 5}
entries: Tereis coaxes out a venomous polyp from her Aragonite Lantha, then makes an attack with it.
If the attack hits, it deals an additional 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for the next minute.
While {@condition poisoned} in this way, a creature has disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws, and repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Ethereal Song (Concentration)
entries: The lemurian begins to sing a magical melody. A creature that can hear the song and starts its turn within 60 feet of the lemurian must make a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save, until the beginning of its next turn the creature subtracts 1 from any attack rolls it makes against a lemurian for each lemurian within 60 feet of it whose song it can hear.

reaction.name: Deepen Harmony
entries: As a reaction when a friendly lemurian within 30 feet uses its song ability, Tereis uses her Ethereal Song.

trait.name: Clockwork Repetition
entries: The tertian may choose to treat any {@dice d20} roll as a 10, instead of rolling.

trait.name: Perfect Synchrony
entries: If the tertian is within 30 feet of a secundus, it uses the secundus' attack bonus instead of its own. If the secundus is using Primus' attack bonus, the tertian uses that instead.

action.name: Tertian Gavel
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}The target is pushed up to 30 feet away and must make three {@dc 21} Constitution saving throws.
For each save it fails, the creature takes force damage equal to a third of its maximum hit points.

action.name: Impose Order
entries: Each spell effect with a duration other than Until Dispelled within 30 feet of the tertian ends. Each harmful condition affecting a creature in the area ends. Each creature with 0 hit points in the area stabilizes.

action.name: Inescapable Judgement (8th Level Spell, Concentration) {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature the tertian can see within 60 feet is bound in an opaque cocoon of force. While bound in this way, the creature is {@condition blinded}, {@condition restrained} and has full cover from all outside effects.
As a Bonus Action on each of its turns, the tertian may move the coccoon up to 60 feet.

reaction.name: Upgrade
entries: As a reaction to seeing a secundus within 60 feet die or transform, the tertian may transform into a secundus, retaining its current hit points. No more than one tertian may take this reaction.

resist.note: while in dim light or darkness

trait.name: Two Heads
entries: The angry has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks and on saving throws against being {@condition blinded}, {@condition charmed}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition frightened}, {@condition stunned}, and knocked {@condition unconscious}.

trait.name: Pacifism Weakness
entries: If a creature within 15 feet of the angry that is not {@condition incapacitated} ends its turn without taking any hostile action, the angry takes 19 ({@damage 3d12}) psychic damage.

trait.name: Rising Fury
entries: Whenever the angry takes damage from a source other than its Pacifism Weakness, its fury increases by one level. Whenever the angry deals damage, its fury decreases by one level.

items.name: 0. Seething
entries: The angry has disadvantage on attacks made against creatures other than itself.

items.name: 1. Enraged
entries: The angry's attacks have advantage.

items.name: 2. Maddened
entries: The angry's attacks have advantage. On a hit, its attacks deal an additional 19 ({@damage 3d12}) psychic damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The angry makes two attacks with its Hook.

action.name: Hook
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d12 + 3}) slashing damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

action.name: Shrieking Charge {@recharge 5}
entries: The angry moves up to its speed toward the creature that most recently took hostile action against it and makes a melee attack.
Each creature within 30 feet that can hear it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be forced to take the attack action on its following turn.

reaction.name: Vicious Outburst
entries: When the angry becomes Maddened, it can move up to half its speed and make a melee attack.

resist.note: damage from weapons that aren't named

trait.name: Fey Magic Resistance
entries: The green man has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects imposed by a creature that does not know its name.

trait.name: Tree Stride
entries: Once on his turn, the green man can use 10 feet of his movement to step magically into one living tree within his reach and emerge from a second living tree within 60 feet of the first tree, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the second tree. Both trees must be Large or bigger.

trait.name: Wilding Pollen
entries: A non-fey, non-plant creature that starts its turn within 15 ft. of the green man must make a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or be beset on all sides by illusory foes. Until the beginning of its next turn attack rolls of odd numbers (after modifiers) made by an affected creature always miss.

trait.name: Stormshield
entries: Whenever the green man would take lightning damage, he can channel and direct the lightning through his shield. One creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or take the lightning damage in his stead.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the green man would fail a saving throw, he may speak a secret name of the forest to succeed. If he uses his third legendary resistance, the forest ceases to aid him until the next dawn.
Will, Will, Weald
You Who Know The Gate
The Everclosing All and One

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The archfey makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Gáe Dearg, The Reddened Root
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d6 + 7}) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or have rootlike tendrils sprout from the wound, preventing its closure.

Magical healing that the creature receives is halved until a creature uses its action to remove the roots with a successful {@dc 18} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) or Intelligence ({@skill Nature}) check.

action.name: Briar Tomb {@recharge 5}
entries: The green man creates a 20 ft. radius, 1 ft thick hemisphere of thorny vines centered on a point within 60 feet. Creatures on the other side of the barrier are considered to have half-cover.

A creature whose space is intersected by the thorns when they appear must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity save or take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) slashing damage, moving to a side of its choice on a success. A creature may push through the vines by spending 20 feet of movement and taking 18 ({@damage 4d8}) slashing damage.
The vines are an object that can be damaged and thus breached. They have AC 18 and 30 hit points, and are vulnerable to fire damage.

reaction.name: Thorny Retort
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the green man may cause the attacker's weapon to sprout thorns, dealing 9 ({@damage 2d8}) piercing damage to the attacker. The attacker must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or drop their weapon. If the attacker picks up its weapon this turn, the green man may immediately make a melee attack against it at advantage.

legendary.name: Spear
entries: The green man makes a melee attack.

legendary.name: Call Lightning (costs 2 actions)
entries: The green man is struck with a bolt of lightning. He and each creature within 5 ft. of him must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or take 16 ({@damage 3d10}) lightning damage, or half as much on a success.

legendary.name: Nourish the Earth (costs 2 actions)
entries: Rootlike tendrils worm out of the green man's briar tomb, piercing the flesh of those within it. Each creature inside the briar tomb must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) necrotic damage and be forced to expend two of its hit dice. If the creature can't, its maximum hit points are reduced to its current hit points. The nearest plant creature friendly to the green man gains 5 temporary hit points for each hit die expended this way.

resist.note: while in dim light or darkness

trait.name: Life Hunger
entries: If a creature the hungry can see regains hit points, the hungry gains advantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn. The hungry has disadvantage on attack rolls made against creatures with no unexpended hit dice.

trait.name: Ruinous Consumption
entries: A creature that starts its turn {@condition grappled} by the hungry must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature loses {@dice 2d4} unexpended hit dice, then drops to 0 hit points if it has no unexpended hit dice remaining. The hungry gains 5 temporary hit points for each hit die expended in this way.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hungry makes two attacks with its Claws.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d6 + 4}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} and {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 16}).
While grappling a creature, the hungry can't attack another creature with its claws.

action.name: Swallow Whole
entries: The hungry begins to swallow a Large or smaller creature that is {@condition incapacitated} and {@condition grappled} by it.
At the beginning of the hungry's next turn, the target is swallowed and its body is destroyed, and the hungry regains 30 hit points.

This action is disrupted if the hungry takes any radiant damage, suffers a critical hit, is knocked {@condition prone}, or is {@condition incapacitated}, or if the creature it is swallowing regains any hit points.

reaction.name: Wave of Exhaustion (1/Day)
entries: When the hungry is reduced below 83 hit points, it can force each creature within 30 feet to succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or fall {@condition prone} and be unable to stand on its following turn.

trait.name: Opportunistic Feeder
entries: The King of Feathers' attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20 when targeting a {@condition stunned} creature.

trait.name: Mystic Fog
entries: The area in a 100 foot radius around the King of Feathers is lightly obscured by a sourceless, roiling fog. Ranged weapon attacks made by creatures within the fog automatically miss a target beyond the weapon's normal range.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the King of Feathers fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The King of Feathers makes two attacks against different targets, one of which may be with its bite. It can't make both attacks against the same target.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}33 ({@damage 4d12 + 7}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the King of Feathers can't bite another target.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d8 + 7}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 10 ft. away.

action.name: Swarm Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The King of Feathers exhales a torrent of angry bees in a 30 foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or take 14 ({@dice 4d6}) piercing and 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage, or half as much on a success.
Additionally, a {@creature swarm of bees|confc|Swarm of Bees} that acts on the King of Feathers' turn and under its control appears in an unoccupied space in the area.

reaction.name: Thunderous Roar (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 101 hit points, the King of Feathers emits a thunderous roar in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of the King of Feathers' next turn. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is also {@condition stunned} for the same duration.

legendary.name: Shuddering Step
entries: The King of Feathers shakes the earth with a step, cocks its head and pauses to listen, gaining 30 ft. of {@sense Blindsight} until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Through the Mist
entries: The King of Feathers turns to mist and disappears. The next time another creature ends its turn within 60 feet of where the King of Feathers departed, the King of Feathers reappears in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of the creature.

legendary.name: Thrash (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the King of Feathers must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution Saving Throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of the King of Feathers' next turn.
A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is instead {@condition paralyzed} until the end of the King of Feathers' next turn.

trait.name: Tentacles
entries: The kraken has 10 tentacles, each of which behaves as a seperate creature that acts on the kraken's initiative and have the following properties:

items.name: Length
entries: Each tentacle is 100 feet long.

items.name: Hit Points
entries: Each tentacle has AC 18 and 75 hit points. When reduced to 0 hit points, the tentacle drops anything it is grappling and retreats to the kraken's body.

items.name: Resistances and Immunities
entries: Each tentacle has Immunity to Lightning damage and Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing From Nonmagical Attacks

items.name: Movement
entries: Each tentacle has a speed of 15 feet.

items.name: Senses
entries: Each tentacle has {@sense blindsight} 5 ft. (blind beyond that radius).

items.name: Grappling
entries: The tentacle may grapple one creature or object each turn (escape {@dc 18}). A creature may make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw to avoid this grapple. A tentacle may grapple multiple creatures or objects. If the tentacle crosses the full deck of a ship or encounters a mast, it may grapple the ship.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the kraken fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

trait.name: Eternal Titan
entries: When the kraken is reduced to 0 HP, it does not die or fall {@condition unconscious}. Instead, it cannot take actions other than to dash unless it is in its lair. While at 0 HP and in its lair, it can killed by collapsing its lair with an {@spell Earthquake} spell or equivalent magic.

action.name: Surface
entries: The kraken surfaces, creating an enormous tidal wave. Each creature without cover must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity save or take 11 ({@damage 2d10}) bludgeoning damage and be pushed overboard.
A creature that is not surprised may use its reaction to clutch onto something sturdy and gain advantage on this saving throw.

action.name: Clutch
entries: The kraken grips a ship, reducing its movement to 0. While it has a ship clutched in this way, it is has full cover from creatures on the ship.

action.name: Crush
entries: Each creature and object the kraken's tentacles have {@condition grappled} takes 20 ({@damage 3d6 + 10}) bludgeoning damage. A ship {@condition grappled} by two or more tentacles must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw (a typical sailing ship has +3 to this roll) or begin to split.

action.name: Capsize
entries: The kraken capsizes a ship that has begun to split. Each creature on board or {@condition grappled} by the tentacles must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or fall into the kraken's mouth and be swallowed as the ship is ripped apart.

action.name: Submerge
entries: The kraken descends up to 60 feet, leaving a massive whirlpool in its wake that lasts for a minute, 250 feet wide and 25 feet deep.

A creature or object that starts its turn in the vortex must make a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or be pulled 20 feet towards the vortex's center, take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) bludgeoning damage, and be unable to move away from the vortex's center until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Camouflage
entries: While the kraken remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from natural terrain to observers more than 30 feet away.

trait.name: Boneless
entries: The kraken can move through a space as narrow as 10 feet wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the kraken fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

trait.name: Eternal Titan
entries: When the kraken is reduced to 0 hit points, it does not die or fall {@condition unconscious}. Instead, it cannot take actions other than to dash unless it is in its lair.
While at 0 hit points and in its lair, it can killed by collapsing its lair with an {@spell Earthquake} spell or equivalent magic.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The kraken makes three attacks with its Tentacle Lash, each of which it can replace a use of its Fling, and attacks once with its Cavernous Maw.

action.name: Tentacle Lash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 17} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d6 + 10}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} and {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 25}).

action.name: Fling
entries: The kraken flings an object or creature {@condition grappled} by it up to 60 feet. If the creature collides with a creature or surface, it takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage for each 10 feet fewer than 60 that it traveled.
A creature hit by the projectile must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away and take the same amount of damage.

action.name: Cavernous Maw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 17} to hit, reach 5 ft., one Huge or smaller target. {@h}23 ({@damage 3d8 + 10}) piercing damage and the target is swallowed.

While swallowed, the creature is {@condition blinded}, its attacks bypass the kraken's damage resistances, and it takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the kraken's turns.
If it takes 50 damage or more in a single turn from a creature inside it, the kraken regurgitates all swallowed creatures, which fall {@condition prone} in an unoccupied space within 10 feet.

action.name: Tentacle Whirlwind {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature in a 30 foot radius around the kraken must succeed on a {@dc 25} Dexterity Saving Throw or take 91 ({@damage 26d6}) bludgeoning damage and be shoved 20 feet away, or take half as much damage on a success.

legendary.name: Tentacle Lash or Fling
entries: The kraken makes an attack with its Tentacle Lash or uses its Fling.

legendary.name: Blanket
entries: Each creature within 50 feet of the kraken must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition grappled} by one of its tentacles.

legendary.name: Ink Cloud (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The kraken expels a cloud of toxic ink, heavily obscuring the area in a 60-foot radius centered on itself until the end of its next turn.
Each other creature that ends its turn in the area must succeed on a {@dc 22} Constitution saving throw or take 16 ({@damage 3d10}) poison damage, or half as much damage on a success.

resist.note: while in dim light or darkness

trait.name: Psychic Leech
entries: At the start of each of the lonely's turns, each creature either {@condition grappled} by it or within 5 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) psychic damage.

trait.name: Thrives on Company
entries: The lonely has advantage on attack rolls while it is within 30 feet of at least two other creatures. The first time each turn that a creature leaves the lonely's reach, the lonely takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) psychic damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lonely makes two attacks with its Harpoon Arms, each of which it may replace with a use of its Sorrowful Embrace.

action.name: Harpoon Arms
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 4d8 + 3}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}).
The lonely's harpoon arms can be attacked (AC 16; 15 hit points). Destroying an arm deals no damage to the lonely, which can grow a replacement on its next turn.

action.name: Sorrowful Embrace
entries: Each creature {@condition grappled} by the lonely takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) psychic damage and is pulled up to 15 feet towards it.

action.name: Branching Barbs {@recharge 5}
entries: The lonely causes its harpoon arms to grow branching barbs of jagged bone. Each creature {@condition grappled} by it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 27 ({@damage 6d8}) piercing damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Wretched Sobbing
entries: When a creature attempts to leave its reach, the lonely can let out a wretched sob.
Each creature within 60 feet that can hear it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be unable to move away from the lonely until the beginning of the lonely's next turn.

resist.note: while in dim light or darkness

trait.name: Disorienting Wail
entries: Creatures within 500 ft. of the lost that can hear it wailing have disadvantage on ability checks and saving throws that use Wisdom as their vision blurs and sounds become distorted and unintelligible.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lost makes five attacks with its arm spikes and uses its embedding embrace. It makes one fewer attack for each arm spike that is grappling a creature.

action.name: Arm Spike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}). A creature {@condition grappled} by three or more of the lost's arms is {@condition restrained}. The lost has five arm spikes, but may grapple only a single creature at a time, and cannot release a creature voluntarily.

action.name: Embedding Embrace
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the lost takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage for each arm grappling it and must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the beginning of the lost's next turn.
If a creature succeeds on this saving throw by 5 or more the lost is {@condition stunned} until the end of its next turn and releases any creature {@condition grappled} by it.

reaction.name: Psychic Flood
entries: When the lost takes any damage while it has a creature {@condition grappled}, it can force the {@condition grappled} creature to succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or take an equal amount of psychic damage.

monster.name: The Sun That Empties Hell, Anathema Ascendant

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The anathema has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Multiple Heads
entries: The anathema has six heads. Whenever the anathema takes 30 or more damage from a single source, one of its heads dies. If all its heads die, the anathema dies.

trait.name: Blessed and Chosen
entries: When the anathema dies, its remaining heads each tear away from the body and immediately travel 15 feet. They act on the anathema's initiative, have AC 17 and 1 HP, and can't take actions other than to dash. If any remain alive after 24 hours, one reforms into a new body for the anathema, regaining all its hit points and becoming active again.

trait.name: Ascended Soul (Mythic Trait, 1/Day)
entries: When the anathema is reduced to 0 hit points, it doesn't die or fall {@condition unconscious}. Instead, it gains 231 temporary hit points and sprouts wings of light, gaining an 80 foot fly speed, a fourth legendary action each round, and it immediately regains all spent legendary actions.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The anathema makes as many bite attacks as it has heads. If it is grappling a creature at the start of its turn, it may replace one of its bite attacks with a Swallow, or two of its attacks with a Worry.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d10 + 6}) piercing damage and 5 ({@damage 1d10}) poison damage and the target is {@condition grappled}. While a head grapples a target, the head can attack only that target.

action.name: Swallow
entries: The anathema makes one bite attack against a Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, that creature takes the bite's damage and is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is {@condition blinded} and {@condition grappled} in the anathema's craw, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the anathema, and takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) acid damage at the start of each of the anathema's turns. One swallowed creature is freed whenever the anathema loses a head.

action.name: Worry
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by at least two heads of the anathema must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution throw or take 77 ({@damage 14d10}) piercing damage, or half as much on a success. If this damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, the target loses a limb.

action.name: Drain Essence
entries: One target creature within 10 feet must make a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 55 ({@damage 10d10}) necrotic damage, or half as much on a success. A target reduced 0 hit points by this damage has its Constitution score reduced by {@dice 3d6} until restored by Greater Restoration or similar magic. A Yuan Ti makes this saving throw at disadvantage.

action.name: Compel Submission (1/Day)
entries: Each creature within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} and compelled to kneel before the anathema for the next minute. This effect ends if the anathema or its allies takes any hostile action toward a {@condition charmed} creature or if a creature uses an action to shake the {@condition charmed} creature out of its stupor.

reaction.name: Divine Backlash
entries: When the anathema passes a saving throw against a magical effect, it may use its reaction to deal 7 ({@damage 2d6}) radiant damage to the spellcaster.

legendary.name: Secrete Acid:
entries: The anathema coats itself in acid. The next creature to start its turn {@condition grappled} by the anathema must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or suffer vulnerability to the next source of radiant damage it takes in the next minute.

legendary.name: Burst with Light (2 Actions):
entries: Each creature within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or be take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) radiant damage and be {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn. A {@condition grappled} creature has disadvantage on this save.

legendary.name: Solar Flare (2 Actions):
entries: Each creature in a 5 foot wide, 60 foot long line must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 5d8}) radiant damage and be {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn, or half as much damage on a success.

legendary.name: Divine Utterance (3 actions):
entries: Each creature of the anathema's choice that can hear it must succeed on a {@dc 19} Charisma save or be knocked {@condition prone} and {@condition deafened} for one minute. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is also {@condition blinded} and {@condition frightened} for the next minute. A creature that fails this save by 10 or more also drops to 0 hit points.

legendary.name: Breath of Dawn: (4 actions):
entries: A number of 5 foot wide, 60 foot long lines equal to the number of the anathema's heads emanate from the anathema. Each creature in the area of at least one of them must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or suffer 42 ({@damage 12d6}) radiant damage and be {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn, or half as much damage on a success.

trait.name: Silver Tongue
entries: The usurer has advantage on Charisma based skill checks to interact with guards or other figures of authority.

trait.name: Consummate Heel (2/Day)
entries: If the usurer begins its turn with no friendly creatures within 30 feet, it can gain 10 temporary hit points and end one condition affecting it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The usurer makes two attacks with its Gold Sack Smack, each of which it can replace with a Grapple or Shove attempt.

action.name: Gold Sack Smack
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.
On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone} and {@condition stunned} until the end of the usurer's next turn.

action.name: Chokeslam
entries: The usurer slams a {@condition grappled} creature to the ground by its throat, releasing the creature and knocking it {@condition prone}.

The creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 36 ({@damage 8d8}) bludgeoning damage and be unable to speak or breathe until the end of the usurer's next turn, or take half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Don't Spend it All in One Place (5th Level Spell, Concentration) {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or have the usurer palm it a sack of gold and be {@condition dominated|confc|dominated} by the usurer for as long as it carries it.

action.name: Special Pile Driver: Financial Ruin (1/Day)
entries: The noble slams a {@condition grappled} creature down on its head, releasing the creature and knocking it {@condition prone}.

All money and magic items the target is carrying are scattered in a 15 foot radius, then the creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or drop to 0 hit points, or take 44 ({@damage 8d10}) bludgeoning damage on a success.

bonus.name: Flash Cash (2nd Level Spell)
entries: The usurer scatters coins across the ground at the feet of a humanoid creature within 5 feet.
The creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to fall {@condition prone} and collect the coins.

bonus.name: Banker's Brawl
entries: The usurer attempts to Grapple or Shove a creature within 5 feet.
If the target is carrying fewer than 1,000 gp, the usurer has advantage on the contested check.

reaction.name: Human Shield
entries: When the usurer is hit with an attack while it has a creature {@condition grappled}, the noble can raise its AC by 3.
If this causes the attack to miss, the attack instead hits the {@condition grappled} creature.

reaction.name: Clothesline
entries: When a creature enters its reach, the usurer can attempt to shove it {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Bon Mot
entries: When the usurer is missed with a melee attack, it can make a cutting remark.
The attacker must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or suffer disadvantage on the next attack it makes against the usurer before the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the wretched takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the wretched takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

trait.name: Swarming Overrun
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 5 ft. of three or more of the wretched must succeed on {@dc 10} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.
A creature within 5 ft. of five or more of the wretched makes this saving throw at disadvantage, and cannot stand from {@condition prone} this turn if it fails.

action.name: Latching Bite (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}4 piercing damage and the wretched attaches to the target.
While attached, the wretched can't attack, and at the start of each of the wretched's turns, the target takes 5 necrotic damage. The wretched can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement.

trait.name: Titan Clasher
entries: The therazinosaur scores a critical on a 19-20 against a Huge or larger creature with no adjacent allies. It may attempt to Shove a Huge or larger creature as a Bonus Action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The therazinosaurus makes two attacks: one with its rending claws and one with its stomp. It may replace its rending claws with a use of its scything sweep, if available.

action.name: Rending Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}25 ({@damage 4d8 + 7}) piercing damage. If the target has Natural Armor, it takes a cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers until the target completes a short or long rest.

action.name: Stomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d10 + 7}) bludgeoning damage. This attack deals an additional 5 ({@damage 1d10}) damage to a {@condition prone} creature.

action.name: Scything Sweep {@recharge 5}
entries: The therazinosaurus sweeps its claws in a 20-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or be take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) slashing damage. A creature may use its reaction to fall {@condition prone} and gain advantage on this saving throw.

reaction.name: Impale
entries: As a reaction to a creature falling {@condition prone} within 15 ft. of it, the therazinosaurus makes a rending claws attack against it.

reaction.name: Puff Up
entries: As a reaction to taking cold damage, the therazinasaurus puffs its plumage, gaining resistance against the triggering damage.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: Thousand Teeth can hold his breath for 30 minutes.

trait.name: Poison Sensitivity
entries: If Thousand Teeth has a creature {@condition grappled} and takes 10 or more Poison damage from a single source, he immediately releases his grapple.

trait.name: Grapple Vulnerability
entries: Thousand Teeth can be {@condition grappled} by a creature up to two sizes smaller than him.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
entries: If Thousand Teeth fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Thousand Teeth makes two attacks, one of which may be with his bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d10 + 5}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the crocodile can't bite another target.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target not {@condition grappled} by the crocodile. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}

action.name: Death Roll {@recharge 4}
entries: A creature {@condition grappled} by Thousand Teeth must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or take 36 ({@damage 8d8}) slashing damage and be {@condition stunned} until the end of the crocodile's next turn, or half as much damage on a success. A creature reduced to 0 HP by this ability loses a limb (Thousand Teeth's choice). The crocodile may not use this ability if it is {@condition grappled}.

legendary.name: Lunge
entries: Thousand Teeth moves up to half his speed. Each creature its path must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be pushed ahead of it. On a successful save, a creature is instead pushed to an unoccupied space on either side of it.

legendary.name: Thrash
entries: Each creature within 5 ft. of Thousand Teeth must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 ft. away.

legendary.name: Terror Dive
entries: If Thousand Teeth is underwater, he may attempt to hide. If he succeeds, each creature within 60 feet that he is hidden from must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of his next turn.

monster.name: Thousand-Year Jiangshi
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak them

trait.name: Hopping Movement
entries: When initiative is rolled, the jiangshi selects a cardinal direction to face.
The jiangshi may move only in the direction it is facing, and may spend 5 feet of movement to turn up to 90 degrees or to stand from {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Graceless Rigor
entries: If the jiangshi is hit with a melee attack from a direction it is not facing, it is pushed 5 feet away and must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Flammable
