entries: If the jiangshi takes any fire damage, it begins {@condition burning|confc|burning} ({@dice 1d10}).
While it is {@condition burning|confc|burning}, the jiangshi's melee attacks deal an additional 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage.

trait.name: Drought-Demon
entries: Any nonmagical liquid exposed to air within 5 miles of the jiangshi turns instantly to dust.
A creature that completes a Long Rest in the area gains a point of {@condition exhaustion}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The jiangshi makes three attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its Grave Breath.

action.name: Crooked Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature in the direction the jiangshi is facing. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) slashing damage plus one of the following effects:
The target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 19}).
The target is pushed up to 10 feet away.
The target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Piercing Finger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature in the direction the jiangshi is facing. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d4 + 6}) piercing damage and the target begins {@condition bleeding|confc|bleeding} ({@dice 1d10}).

action.name: Grave Breath
entries: The jiangshi's long, prehensile tongue slithers into the mouth of an {@condition unconscious} creature within 5 feet and a foul green vapor pours down it, forcing the creature to succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition cursed|confc|cursed}.

A creature {@condition cursed|confc|cursed} in this way is {@condition poisoned}, and at each dusk must succeed on a {@dc 18} Charisma saving throw or die and immediately rise as a {@creature rogue jiangshi|confc|Rogue Jiangshi} under the DM's control.

bonus.name: Dry Lightning
entries: A bolt of lightning spears down from above to strike a creature or corpse the jiangshi can see within 120 feet, which must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or take 14 ({@dice 4d6}) lightning plus 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage.
A humanoid corpse struck by this lightning immediately rises as a {@creature homebound jiangshi|confc|Homebound Jiangshi} under the jiangshi's control that dies after one minute.

bonus.name: Drain Vitality
entries: The jiangshi draws the life force out from the forehead of a creature {@condition grappled} by it.
The creature takes 22 ({@damage 5d8}) necrotic damage, then must succeed on a {@dc 18} Charisma saving throw or lose three unexpended hit dice, or drop to 0 hit points if it cannot.
Until the end of its next turn, the jiangshi gains a 40 foot fly speed and can turn without spending movement.

reaction.name: Whip Around
entries: When a creature the jiangshi is not facing misses it with a melee attack, the jiangshi turns to face it and makes a Crooked Claws attack.

reaction.name: Parch
entries: When a creature the jiangshi can see within 30 feet attempts to use an item made of liquid (such as holy water or a potion), or casts a spell that produces liquid (such as Acid Splash) the jiangshi turns the liquid to dust, negating its effects.

legendary.name: Hop
entries: The jiangshi jumps up to 10 feet, turns up to 90 degrees, or stands from {@condition prone}.

legendary.name: Crooked Swipe (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The jiangshi makes an attack with its Crooked Claws against a creature it is not grappling.

legendary.name: Break Restraints (Costs 4 Actions)
entries: The jiangshi destroys one physical restraint or ends a magical effect affecting either it or a space within 5 feet of it.
It may use this ability even while {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Camouflage
entries: The thri-kreen is {@condition invisible} to creatures more than 30 feet away from it.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The thri-kreen's long jump is up to 30 feet and its high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

trait.name: Predatory Grappler
entries: The thri-kreen has advantage on attack rolls against any creature {@condition grappled} by it. If it has a creature {@condition grappled}, it may make a bite attack as a bonus action.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. While {@condition poisoned} in this way, the target suffers a critical hit on a roll of 11-20. The {@condition poisoned} target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 2d4 + 1}) slashing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the thri-kreen can grapple the target (escape {@dc 11}) and pull the target 5 ft. towards it.

trait.name: Hireling
entries: The thug is often willing to accept a bribe rather than fight. A group of thugs will usually accept a rate of 10 gp per thug, though it may accept less.

trait.name: Ruffian's Code
entries: Unless it has a compelling reason to do otherwise, the thug makes melee attacks nonlethally.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The thug makes two melee attacks, either of which it may replace with a shove or grapple attempt.

action.name: Knuckle Dusters
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage. On a critical hit, the target is knocked {@condition prone} and must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of the thug's next turn.

action.name: Heavy Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 2} to hit, reach 100/400 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d10}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Beat Down
entries: As a reaction to a creature standing from {@condition prone} within 5 ft. of the thug, the thug may make a melee attack against it. If the attack hits, the creature is knocked {@condition prone} again.

trait.name: Hireling
entries: The thug is often willing to accept a bribe rather than fight. A group of thugs will usually accept a rate of 10 gp per thug, though it may accept less.

trait.name: Ruffian's Code
entries: Unless it has a compelling reason to do otherwise, the thug makes melee attacks nonlethally.

trait.name: Dirty Fighting
entries: Whenevever the thug makes a successful grapple or shove attempt, it may make a melee attack at advantage as a bonus action this turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The thug makes two melee attacks, either of which it may replace with a shove or grapple attempt.

action.name: Blackjack
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) bludgeoning damage. On a critical hit, the target is knocked {@condition prone} and must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of the thug's next turn.

action.name: Heavy Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 100/400 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d10 + 2}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Beat Down
entries: As a reaction to a creature standing from {@condition prone} within 5 ft. of the thug, the thug may make a melee attack against it. If the attack hits, the creature is knocked {@condition prone} again.

trait.name: Ritual Combat
entries: The warrior conceives of combat in several distinct stages, and will not escalate to a stage before failing to resolve the fight with each previous stage, unless its opponents do so first.
1. {@skill Intimidation}; Shows of Strength and Martial Prowess.
2. Unarmed Combat, Striking Nonlethally
3. Armed Combat, Striking Nonlethally
4. Armed Combat, Striking Lethally
5. Armed Combat, Striking Lethally, Giving No Quarter

trait.name: Righting Reflex
entries: The warrior has resistance to damage from falling if it falls from a height of 30 ft. or greater.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The warrior's long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

trait.name: Pounce
entries: If the warrior moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with a melee attack on the same turn, it may make another melee attack against the same creature as a Bonus Action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The warrior makes two attacks.

action.name: Unarmed Attack
entries: Melee Weapon {@action Attack}. {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) bludgeoning damage. This attack is made at advantage against a {@condition grappled} creature.

action.name: Bladed Mace
entries: Melee Weapon {@action Attack}. {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@dice 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) slashing damage.

action.name: Submission Hold
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the warrior must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or lose 13 ({@dice 3d8}) hit points, or half as much on a success.
A creature that would be reduced to 0 hit points in this way may use its reaction to surrender. If it does, it is {@condition frightened} for the next minute.

trait.name: Awkward Waddle
entries: If the nurasa walks more than 15 feet on its turn, it falls {@condition prone} at the end of its turn.

trait.name: Insubordinate
entries: While Tilmun is {@condition charmed}, he can repeat the saving throw to end the effect whenever a creature he is {@condition charmed} by issues him a direction.

action.name: Flipper Whack
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) bludgeoning damage.
On a critical hit, the target is knocked {@condition prone} if it is medium or smaller.

action.name: Detect Depth
entries: Tilmun intuitively measures the minute eddies at the edge of an effect he can see, such as fog or deep water, that obscures an area.
Until the beginning of his next turn, Tilmun and creatures within 30 feet that can hear him treat the area as if it were not obscured.

action.name: Hunching Charge {@recharge 5}
entries: Tilmun moves up to his speed and can make two attacks with his Flipper Whack against different targets.

reaction.name: Derisive Squawk
entries: When a creature Tilmun can see misses with an attack, he can let out a mocking laugh.
The next attack that creature makes this turn has disadvantage.

reaction.name: Belly Slide
entries: When the nurasa falls {@condition prone}, it can slide up to 10 feet across level ground, or up to 30 feet across downward-sloped ground.

trait.name: Water Camouflage
entries: The snake has advantage on stealth checks while submerged.

trait.name: Cold Blooded
entries: If the titanoboa takes 10 or more Cold damage in a turn, its speed is reduced by 10 until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Braille
entries: The titanoboa's eyes are covered by transparent scales that protect them from harm. It has disadvantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight, and advantage on saving throws to avoid being {@condition blinded}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The titanoboa makes two attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d8 + 5}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}). A Huge or smaller creature already {@condition grappled} in this way is instead swallowed, is {@condition restrained}, {@condition blinded}, and takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns for as long as the grapple lasts.

action.name: Constrict
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d10 + 5}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Huge or smaller, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}.

reaction.name: Crush
entries: As a reaction to a creature the titanoboa has {@condition grappled} with its Constrict ability speaking or casting a spell with a verbal component, the titanoboa crushes the air out of its lungs. The creature cannot breathe until the grapple ends and immediately begins to suffocate.

trait.name: Careening Flight
entries: When the beetle begins flying, it must choose a direction to fly in, and must use all of its movement on each of its turns to fly in that direction until it lands or collides with a creature or object.

trait.name: Spiracle Breathing
entries: The beetle has disadvantage on Constitution saving throws against inhaled toxins.

action.name: Clearcutter Mandibles
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., up to two targets within 10 ft. of one another. {@h}24 ({@damage 4d8 + 6}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}).

action.name: Titanstrength Launch
entries: The beetle attempts to grasp a creature within 10 feet in its horns and fling it upward, forcing it to make a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw.
On a failed save, a creature is thrown 100 feet into the air and does not fall until the beginning of its next turn.
A creature launched into a ceiling or other solid object takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Topple Mountain {@recharge 5}
entries: The beetle pries at an object, structure, or terrain feature no larger than 40 feet to a side with its horns and rolls it over, pushing it up to 40 feet.

Each creature in the area it is pushed into must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) bludgeoning damage and be {@condition restrained} beneath rubble (escape {@dc 17}), or take half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Redeploy Wings
entries: When the beetle begins to fall, it can make a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw. On a success, the beetle falls only 15 feet before catching itself in the air.

trait.name: Dune-Eater
entries: The tlincalli ignores the effects of up to 3 points of {@condition exhaustion} and cannot be forced to expend hit dice or have its maximum hit points reduced.

trait.name: Brittle Barb
entries: If the tlincalli is dealt a critical hit with a weapon that deals bludgeoning damage, it can't make attacks with its Tail Stinger until it completes a Short or Long rest.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tlincalli makes two attacks with its Limbtaker Greatscythe, one of which it may replace with a use of its Tail Stinger.

action.name: Limbtaker Greatscythe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d12 + 5}) slashing damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away. On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or lose a limb.

action.name: Tail Stinger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@dice 2d10 + 5}) piercing plus 22 ({@damage 4d10}) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be infected with Wandering Eye Neurotoxemia.

action.name: Reaping Sweep {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature within 10 feet of the tlincalli must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 39 ({@damage 6d12}) slashing damage and be pushed up to 10 feet away.
A creature may use its reaction to drop {@condition prone} and gain advantage on this saving throw.

reaction.name: Tarsal Stomp
entries: When a Medium or smaller creature within 15 feet falls {@condition prone}, the tlincalli can move up to 10 feet toward the creature and force it to make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw.
On a failed save, the creature takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) piercing damage and is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}) until the tlincalli moves.

trait.name: Dune-Eater
entries: The tlincalli ignores the effects of up to 3 points of {@condition exhaustion} and cannot be forced to expend hit dice or have its maximum hit points reduced.

trait.name: Brittle Barb
entries: If the tlincalli is dealt a critical hit with a weapon that deals bludgeoning damage, it can't make attacks with its Tail Stinger until it completes a Short or Long rest.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tlincalli makes two attacks with its Thousand-Needles Strike, one of which it may replace with a use of its Tail Stinger.

action.name: Thousand-Needles Strike
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}20 ({@damage 8d4}) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Tail Stinger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@dice 2d10 + 3}) piercing plus 22 ({@damage 4d10}) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be infected with Wandering Eye Neurotoxemia.

action.name: Flensing Sandblast (7th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: A continuous, tearing wind issues forth from the tlincalli's hand, whipping sands forward in a 30 foot cone. A creature that starts or ends its turn in the area must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) slashing damage, be pushed 10 feet away, and be {@condition blinded} until the beginning of its next turn.
As a Bonus Action on its turn, the tlincalli may change the direction of the cone.

action.name: Vent Noonsun (1/Day)
entries: The tlincalli expels stored sunlight from its exoskeleton, flaring with light and heat. Each other creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or take 21 ({@dice 6d6}) fire plus 27 ({@damage 6d8}) radiant damage, or half as much on a success.
For the next minute, the tlincalli gains vulnerability to fire and radiant damage.

bonus.name: Bolthole Burial
entries: One creature the tlincalli can see within 60 feet is teleported up to 10 feet directly downward through loose sand or earth to a snug cavity magically excavated for it.

An unwilling creature may make a {@dc 18} Charisma saving throw, avoiding the effect on a success. A creature may dig the buried creature out as an action with a successful {@dc 18} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.

reaction.name: Shimmering Lure
entries: When a friendly creature the Tlincalli can see moves or teleports, the tlincalli can cause that creature to become {@condition invisible} and Hidden until the end of the creature's next turn, or until it makes an attack.

An illusory replica of that creature that lasts for a minute appears in the space vacated by it. If the replica takes any damage, it explodes in a burst of light, dealing 5 ({@damage 1d10}) radiant damage to each creature within 5 feet of it.

trait.name: Dune-Eater
entries: The tlincalli ignores the effects of up to 3 points of {@condition exhaustion} and cannot be forced to expend hit dice or have its maximum hit points reduced.

trait.name: Brittle Barb
entries: If the tlincalli is dealt a critical hit with a weapon that deals bludgeoning damage, it can't make attacks with its Tail Stinger until it completes a Short or Long rest.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tlincalli makes three attacks with its Shellcracker Pryblade, one of which it may replace with its Ironbur Meteor Hammer.

action.name: Pryblade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) slashing damage.
This attack is made at advantage against a creature with Natural Armor.

action.name: Ironbur Meteor Hammer
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Tail Stinger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@dice 2d10 + 3}) piercing plus 22 ({@damage 4d10}) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be infected with Wandering Eye Neurotoxemia.

reaction.name: Tarsal Stomp
entries: When a Medium or smaller creature within 15 feet falls {@condition prone}, the tlincalli can move up to 10 feet toward the creature and force it to make a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw.
On a failed save, the creature takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage and is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}) until the tlincalli moves.

trait.name: Poisonous
entries: A creature that hits the toad with a melee attack using Natural Weapons takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) poison damage. If this damage reduces the toad to 0 hit points, the attacker must succeed on a {@dc 9} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The toad can breathe air and water

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the toad remains motionless, it resembles a rock and may attempt to hide without obscurement.

monster.name: Tomb Guard
languages: understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Bonesense
entries: The tomb guard can pinpoint, by scent, the location of any creature with bones within 20 feet of it, and does not suffer disadvantage for attacking a creature with bones that it cannot see.

trait.name: Rattle
entries: A creature that hits the tomb guard with a melee attack that deals bludgeoning damage must succeed a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn as it feels its own skeleton twitch slightly.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tomb guard makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Ancient Blade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@dice 1d6 + 4}) piercing plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Cascade of Steel {@recharge 5}
entries: The tomb guard makes four melee attacks. If all of them miss, the tomb guard falls {@condition prone} and ends its turn.

reaction.name: Parrying Flurry
entries: When the tomb guard is targeted with a melee attack by a creature it can see, it increases its AC by 2 against the triggering attack. If this causes the attack to miss, the tomb guard regains its reaction.

trait.name: Curious Climber
entries: The mote may climb onto any adjacent Medium or larger creature by spending 15 feet of movement. An unwilling creature may prevent this with a successful {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw. While climbing on a creature, the creature has disadvantage on attacks that target the mote.

trait.name: Hateful Helper
entries: When the mote uses the help action to grant an attack advantage, the attack deals an additional 3 ({@damage 1d6}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Shin Kick
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@dice 1d8 + 2}) nonlethal bludgeoning damage. On a critical hit, the target falls {@condition prone} if it is Large or smaller.

action.name: Yank Ear
entries: One creature the tomb mote is crawling on must make a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature has disadvantage on attacks it makes before the end of the mote's next turn.

reaction.name: Mischievous Trip
entries: When a creature leaves its reach, the tomb mote can force the creature to succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Lie Dormant
entries: The tomb scarab can go an indefinite period of time without food or water, so long as it has somewhere dry and dark to hibernate.

action.name: Tunneling Bite
entries: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or have the scarab tunnel under its flesh. At the start of each of its turns, the creature takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) piercing damage per scarab infesting it.
Applying fire to the bite wound before the end of the target's next turn deals 1 fire damage to the target and kills the tomb scarab.

After this time, the tomb scarab can only be extricated with a {@dc 12} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check, dealing 3 ({@dice 1d6}) points of piercing damage to the afflicted creature as it is removed. Any effect that cures disease destroys all tomb scarabs infesting the target.

trait.name: Web-Dweller
entries: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty. While in contact with a web, the spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

trait.name: Tomb Tainted
entries: If the spider would receive any magical healing, it receives no healing and instead loses an equal number of hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spider makes three attacks, one of which may be with its tainted bite.

action.name: Tainted Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}13 ({@dice 2d8 + 4}) piercing plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of the spider's next turn.
If a creature {@condition poisoned} in this way would receive any magical healing, it receives no healing and instead loses an equal number of hit points.

action.name: Legs
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hits: 11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}).

action.name: Web {@recharge 5}
entries: The spider launches webbing in a 10 foot radius centered on a point within 60 feet. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition restrained} by webbing (escape {@dc 15}). The webbing can attacked and destroyed (AC 10; HP 5).

bonus.name: Bind
entries: The spider uses its webbing to restrain a {@condition prone} or {@condition grappled} creature within 5 feet (escape {@dc 15}). If the target is Medium or smaller, the spider may then attach the creature to its back as part of this action.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The broodswarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the broodswarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny creature. The broodswarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

trait.name: Web-Dweller
entries: The broodswarm can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty. While in contact with a web, the broodswarm knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

trait.name: Tomb Tainted
entries: If the broodswarm would receive any magical healing, it receives no healing and instead loses an equal number of hit points.

action.name: Flurry of Bites
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 0 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 2d4 + 1}) piercing damage, or 3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) piercing damage if the swarm has fewer than half its hit points.

reaction.name: Scuttle
entries: When the broodswarm would make a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, it can move up to 10 feet.
If this movement puts the broodswarm out of range or area of the spell or magical effect, the broodswarm is unaffected.

trait.name: Web-Dweller
entries: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and across webs, without penalty. While in contact with a web, the spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

trait.name: Swarm-Filled
entries: The husk has advantage on saving throws against effects that target it.
If the husk fails a saving throw against a damaging effect that did not target it, the effect deals maximum damage to it.

trait.name: Husk Marionette
entries: The husk may move up to 10 feet or make an attack with its jerking legs at the end of each enemy creature's turn in combat.

action.name: Jerking Legs
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hits: 11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}).

action.name: Infest Host
entries: Innumerable spiders attempt to burrow into and lair within a creature {@condition grappled} by the husk, forcing it to make a {@dc 17} Constituiton saving throw.

On a failed save, the creature's Constitution score is reduced by {@dice 2d4}, to a miniumum of 1, until it completes a Long Rest. A creature that has its Constitution score reduced to 1 in this way contracts Necrohive Parasitosis.

action.name: Flood of Spiders {@recharge 5}
entries: A wave of spiders flows from every crevice of the husk, carpeting the ground around it.

The husk loses up to 25 hit points, then each creature within 15 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or take an amount of poison damage equal to the hit points lost, or half that much on a success.

reaction.name: Scuttling Young
entries: As a reaction when the husk takes piercing or slashing damage, a torrent of angry spiders spill forth from the wound, producing one of the following effects:

items.name: Web Repair
entries: The husk gains 15 temporary hit points.

items.name: Chittering Vengeance
entries: One creature within 5 feet of the husk must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or take 7 ({@dice 2d6}) piercing plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage.

reaction.name: Abandon Husk (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction when the husk is forced to make a saving throw while it has fewer than 50 hit points, it recharges and immediately uses its Flood of Spiders.

reaction.name: Necrohive Parasitosis
entries: A colony of spiders, charged with negative energy and sharing a hive mind, has burrowed within the creature, keeping it alive with foul magics as they gradually hollow it out. The infested creature gains immunity to poison and necrotic damage.

When the creature is infected, the disease has {@dice 2d8} hit points, and gains an additional {@dice 2d8} current and maximum hit points whenever the creature completes a long rest. While the disease has more current hit points than the infected creature, the infected creature acts under the disease's control. If the disease has more maximum hit points than the infected creature, the creature dies and becomes a {@creature web mummy|confc|Web Mummy}.
The disease is immune to most forms of damage, but any effect which would cure disease instead reduces its current and maximum hit points by {@dice 4d8}.

monster.name: Tomb Tapper
languages: understands Common and Undercommon but can't speak

trait.name: Petrified Death
entries: A tomb tapper reduced to 0 hit points turns into a lifeless stone statue. Obects it is wearing or carrying are not transformed.

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The tomb tapper can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

trait.name: Echolocation
entries: If the tomb tapper takes any thunder damage, it is {@condition deafened} until the end of its next turn. While {@condition deafened}, the tomb tapper is also {@condition blinded}.

trait.name: Magic Sense
entries: The tomb tapper knows the precise location of each source of magic within 240 ft. of it.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the tomb tapper may spend half of its movement to attempt a {@dc 18} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the tomb tapper. While climbing on the tomb tapper, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the tomb tapper, and the tomb tapper has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tomb tapper makes two melee attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its stoneshock hammer drive.

action.name: Arenite Sledgehammer
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 15 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}27 ({@damage 6d6 + 6}) force damage and the creature is pushed 5 feet away. Creatures within 5 feet of the target must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw, taking half the attack's damage on a failed save. As a bonus action, the tomb tapper can return the hammer to its hand.

action.name: Sweeping Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and the creature is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 18}). A creature that attempts to cast a spell while {@condition grappled} in this way must succeed on a {@dc 18} saving throw using its spellcasting modifier or have its spell fail.

action.name: Swallow Whole
entries: One Large or smaller creature {@condition grappled} by the tomb tapper must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or take 66 ({@damage 12d10}) piercing damage, or half as much on a success. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage is swallowed whole. A creature with proficiency in {@skill Perception} can see and target the swallowed creature with ranged abilities. As an action, a creature can pry the tomb tapper's mouth open with a successful {@dc 18} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.

action.name: Stoneshock Hammer Drive {@recharge 5}
entries: The giant throws its hammer. Each creature in a 10 foot wide, 120 ft. long line must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or take 32 ({@damage 5d12}) bludgeoning damage, be knocked {@condition prone}, and be pushed 10 feet away, or take half as much damage on a success. Walls of Wood or Stone up to 10 ft. thick in the area are destroyed.

reaction.name: Hunt Magic
entries: As a reaction to a creature within 15 ft. casting a spell, using a psionic ability, or activating a magic item, the tomb tapper makes a melee attack against it.

monster.name: Tomb Tapper Hulkdriver
languages: understands Common and Undercommon but can't speak

trait.name: Hulk Driver
entries: While not {@condition incapacitated}, the tomb tapper telepathically controls each umber hulk within 60 ft. At the beginning of each of the tomb tapper's turns, each umber hulk within 60 ft. may use its reaction to move up to its burrow speed.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the tomb tapper may spend half of its movement to attempt a {@dc 19} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the tomb tapper. While climbing on the tomb tapper, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the tomb tapper, and the tomb tapper has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

Creatures within 5 feet of the target must make a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw, taking half the attack's damage on a failed save. As a bonus action, the tomb tapper can return the hammer to its hand.

A creature that attempts to cast a spell while {@condition grappled} in this way must succeed on a {@dc 19} saving throw using its spellcasting modifier or have its spell fail.

entries: One Large or smaller creature {@condition grappled} by the tomb tapper must succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or take 66 ({@damage 12d10}) piercing damage, or half as much on a success. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage is swallowed whole. A creature with proficiency in {@skill Perception} can see and target the swallowed creature with ranged abilities. As an action, a creature can pry the tomb tapper's mouth open with a successful {@dc 18} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.

entries: The giant throws its hammer. Each creature in a 10 foot wide, 120 ft. long line must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or take 39 ({@damage 6d12}) bludgeoning damage, be knocked {@condition prone}, and be pushed 10 feet away, or take half as much damage on a success. Walls of Wood or Stone up to 10 ft. thick in the area are destroyed.

reaction.name: Hunt Magic
entries: As a reaction to a creature within 15 ft. casting a spell, using a psionic ability, or activating a magic item, the tomb tapper makes a melee attack against it.

reaction.name: Telepathic Shriek (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 119 hit points, the tomb tapper lets out a telepathic shriek. Each creature within 60 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 18} Intelligence saving throw or fall {@condition prone} and lose {@status concentration}, if it was holding it. Each umber hulk in the area is freed from the tomb tapper's control until the end of its following turn.

monster.name: Tombstone Golem

immune.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the golem may spend half of its movement to attempt a {@dc 19} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the golem. While climbing on the gome, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the golem, and the golem has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: The golem can't be affected or detected by spells of 2nd level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the golem fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes three attacks with its Slab Slam, one of which it may replace with its Golem's Gravemark.

action.name: Slab Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d10 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone} and unable to stand on its following turn.

action.name: Golem's Gravemark
entries: One creature the golem can see must succeed on a {@dc 17} Charisma saving throw or be cursed for the next minute. Whenever the golem hits a cursed creature with a melee attack, the creature takes an additional 11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Smash to Dust {@recharge 5}
entries: The golem throws itself {@condition prone} onto a {@condition prone} creature within 10 feet and ends its turn. If the creature has fewer than 100 hit points, it drops to 0 hit points and must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or immediately fail two death Saving Throws.

reaction.name: Stonecrack Epitaph
entries: When the golem takes 30 or more damage from a single source, an ominous crack rings out from deep within the golem.
Each living creature within 30 feet that can hear it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or take 16 ({@damage 3d10}) necrotic damage.

trait.name: Blinding Flock
entries: A creature within 5 feet of three or more hostile yosuzume has disadvantage on attacks and Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks.

trait.name: Yugiri Justice Squadron
entries: At the beginning of its turn, the yosuzume gains 5 temporary hit points for each other friendly creature within 30 feet that is {@status concentration||concentrating} on a Heroic Pose.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Ishi makes three attacks with her Chirp-Chitter Slash, one of which she can replace with a use of her Special Technique: Sleeve Perch! or her Heroic Pose.

action.name: Chirp-Chitter Slash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) slashing damage.
A creature hit by two or more of these attacks in a turn must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or be unable to concentrate until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Special Technique: Sleeve Perch!
entries: Tome grasps a loose bit of clothing worn by a creature within 5 feet. Until she releases it as a Bonus Action, the creature's speed is halved and she is dragged with it when it moves.
As an action, the creature can attempt a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw, shaking Tome off on a success.

action.name: Heroic Pose (Concentration)
entries: Tome displays her heroic endurance with an extended pose. Until she moves or is knocked {@condition prone}, Tome reduces any damage she takes by 2 and can't be {@condition frightened}.

reaction.name: War-Hat Tumble
entries: When Tome is targeted with a melee attack by a creature she can see, she lurches her war-hat forward to block it, increasing her AC against the triggering attack by 2.
If the attack hits, Tome is knocked {@condition prone}.

monster.name: Tormenting Ghost

resist.special: damage other than the type that killed it

languages: Any languages it knew in life

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The ghost can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Spectral Weapons
entries: The ghost's attacks treat all creatures as unarmored (an unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier.)

trait.name: Unfinished Business
entries: When the ghost is reduced to 0 hit points, it does not die or fall {@condition unconscious}. Instead, it loses the ability to take actions. After {@dice 1d4} hours, the ghost recovers all of its hit points.
While at 0 hit points, the ghost can be destroyed any of the following ways:
Resolving its unfinished business.
Subjecting it to the same conditions that killed it.
Interring its remains with the {@spell Ceremony|XGE} spell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ghost uses its Withering Touch twice, one of which it may replace with a use of its Etherealization.

action.name: Withering Touch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}26 ({@damage 6d6 + 5}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Etherealization
entries: The ghost or a creature within 5 feet of it magically shifts into the Border Ethereal from the Material Plane, or vice versa. At the end of each of its turns, an unwilling creature makes a {@dc 17} Charisma saving throw, returning to the material plane on a success.
Creatures in the Border Ethereal can be seen from the Material Plane and vice versa, but can't affect or be affected by creatures on the Material Plane.

action.name: Horrifying Visage {@recharge 5}
entries: Each living creature within 60 feet of the ghost that can see it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or take 28 ({@damage 8d6}) Psychic damage and be {@condition frightened} until the end of the ghost's next turn, or take half as much damage on a success.
A creature that fails this save by 5 or more also ages by {@dice 1d4 x 10}% of its natural lifespan until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

reaction.name: Drifting Apparition
entries: When the ghost is hit with a melee attack, it can move up to half its speed without provoking {@action opportunity attack||opportunity attacks}.

reaction.name: Consuming Possession (1/Day)
entries: When the ghost is reduced below 62 hit points, it can force one creature it can see within 15 feet to succeed on a {@dc 17} Charisma saving throw or be {@condition possessed|confc|possessed}.

While {@condition possessed|confc|possessed} in this way, a creature has its Charisma score reduced by {@dice 1d4}, to a minimum of 1, at the beginning of each of its turns, and repeats this saving throw whenever it takes damage, expelling the ghost on a success.
This reduction lasts until the creature completes a Short or Long Rest.

trait.name: Trampling Charge
entries: If the torosaurus moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with a goring horns attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Bony Frill
entries: While the torosaurus is not {@condition flanked|confc|flanked}, it has resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage dealt by melee attacks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The torosaurus makes up to two attacks; one with its gore and one with its stomp, if available.

action.name: Goring Horns
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}24 ({@damage 4d8 + 6}) piercing damage and the target is pushed 5 ft. away.

action.name: Stomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition prone} creature. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d10 + 6}) bludgeoning damage.

reaction.name: Dominance Display
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a ranged attack by a creature within 30 ft., the torosaurus shakes its horns. The attacker may use its reaction to drop {@condition prone}; if the creature does not, or if it stands before the end of its turn, the torosaurus may move up to 30 ft. towards it and make a gore attack.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The hikiga's long jump is up to 30 feet and its high jump is up to 20 feet, with or without a running start.

trait.name: Trapped Bindings
entries: A creature that dispels or destroys a magical effect or creation of Tozen's must succeed on a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) force damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Borrowed Clout
entries: Whenever Tozen makes a Wisdom saving throw or Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) check, he may use the bonus of a friendly creature within 30 feet that he can see, rather than his own.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Tozen makes two attacks with his Spirit Needles, one of which he may replace with a use of his Anchor Spirit or Lilysmoke Snare, if available.

action.name: Spirit Needles
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@dice 1d4 + 4}) piercing plus 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage.
A creature hit by this attack twice in a turn must succeed on a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw or have Tozen control its movement on its following turn.

action.name: Anchor Spirit (2nd Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: Tozen forces a creature he can see within 60 feet to succeed on a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw or be bound to an {@condition invisible} spiritual anchor in its space that lasts for a minute.
At the end of each of that creature's turns, it takes {@damage 1d6} psychic damage for each 5 feet away from that anchor that it ends its turn.

action.name: Lilysmoke Snare {@recharge 5}
entries: Tozen breathes a stream of smoke through his loom, weaving it into a delicate haze that binds to a creature within 5 feet.

The first time that creature is hit with a melee attack, the haze boils outward. The target and each other creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} and {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn, >

monster.name: Trap Haunt

resist.special: damage other than the type that killed it

languages: The languages it knew in life

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The haunt can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Spectral Weapons
entries: The haunt's attacks treat all creatures as unarmored (an unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier.)

trait.name: Unfinished Business
entries: When the haunt is reduced to 0 hit points, it does not die or fall {@condition unconscious}. Instead, it loses the ability to take actions. After {@dice 1d4} hours, the haunt recovers all of its hit points.
While at 0 hit points, the ghost can be destroyed any of the following ways:
Resolving its unfinished business.
Subjecting it to the same conditions that killed it.
Interring its remains with the {@spell Ceremony|XGE} spell.

action.name: Withering Touch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 4d6 + 3}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Horrifying Visage {@recharge 5}
entries: Each living creature within 60 feet of the haunt that can see it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Psychic damage and be {@condition frightened} until the end of the haunt's next turn,or take half as much damage on a success.
A creature that fails this save by 5 or more also ages by {@dice 1d4 x 10}% of its natural lifespan until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

reaction.name: Drifting Apparition
entries: When the haunt is hit with a melee attack, it can move up to half its speed without provoking {@action opportunity attack||opportunity attacks}.

reaction.name: Possession (1/Day)
entries: When the haunt is reduced below 37 hit points, it can force one creature it can see within 15 feet to succeed on a {@dc 13} Charisma saving throw or be {@condition possessed|confc|possessed} until it is reduced to 0 hit points.

trait.name: Sand Burrower
entries: While partially buried in sand, the turtle has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks.

trait.name: Inflexible
entries: The turtle cannot attack a creature that is grappling or riding it.

trait.name: Cold Blooded
entries: If the turtle takes 10 or more cold damage from a single source, its speed is reduced by 10 until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Clamping Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}31 ({@damage 4d12 + 5}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} and {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 16}).
A creature that attempts to escape this grapple takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage.

action.name: Drag Down
entries: The turtle moves up to its burrow speed, then a creature {@condition grappled} by it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or lose its breath, if it was holding it.

action.name: Tongue Lure
entries: The turtle shifts a shiny organ at the tip of its tongue slightly. Each creature within 30 feet that the turtle is hidden from notices what looks like something metallic partially buried in sand.

reaction.name: Snap
entries: As a reaction when a creature fails an attempt to grapple it or grab its tongue, the turtle makes a Clamping Bite attack against the creature.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the treant remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal tree.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the treant may spend half of its movement to attempt a {@dc 18} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the treant. While climbing on the treant, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the treant, and the treant has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

trait.name: Wooden Body
entries: If the treant takes fire damage, it catches fire. Until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the treant and all creatures climbing on it take 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage at the start of each of the treant's turns, and all attacks against the treant are made at advantage. While on fire, the treant's melee attacks deal an additional 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The treant makes two earthshaking slam attacks, one of which it may replace with a rock or a use of its grasping roots, if availale.

action.name: Earthshaking Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and the target is knocked {@condition prone}. Non-treant creatures within 5 feet of the target must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw, taking half the attack's damage and being knocked {@condition prone} on a failed save.

action.name: Rock
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 10} to hit, range 60/180 ft., one target. {@h}28 ({@damage 4d10 + 6}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Grasping Roots {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature within 15 feet of the treant must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or take 20 ({@damage 3d12}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone} and {@condition restrained} until the end of the treant's next turn (escape {@dc 18}). A creature that was already {@condition prone} makes this save at disadvantage.

reaction.name: Forest Allies
entries: As a reaction to a creature that is within 10 feet of a mundane tree targeting the treant with an attack, the treant may cause the tree to make an earthshaking slam attack against the attacker, using the treant's statistics.

trait.name: Bony Frill
entries: While the triceratops is not {@condition flanked|confc|flanked}, it has resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage dealt by melee attacks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The triceratops makes up to two attacks; one with its gore and one with its stomp, if available.

action.name: Goring Horns
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}24 ({@damage 4d8 + 6}) piercing damage and the target is pushed 10 ft. away and must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Stomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition prone} creature. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d10 + 6}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Wrecking Charge {@recharge 5}
entries: The triceratops moves up to its speed, and can move through the space of any creature larger than huge, making a gore attack against each creature whose space it passes through.

reaction.name: Dominance Display
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a ranged attack by a creature within 30 ft., the triceratops shakes its horns. The attacker may use its reaction to drop {@condition prone}; if the creature does not, or if it stands before the end of its turn, the triceratops may move up to 30 ft. towards it and make a gore attack.

trait.name: Clockwork Repetition
entries: The tridrone may choose to treat any {@dice d20} roll as a 10, instead of rolling.

trait.name: Perfect Synchrony
entries: If the tridrone is within 30 feet of a quadrone, it uses the quadrone's attack bonus instead of its own. If the quadrone is using a pentadrone's attack bonus, the tridrone uses that instead, and so on.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tridrone makes three attacks with its Equitempered Javelins and uses its Recall Javelins, if available.

action.name: Equitempered Javelin
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}4 piercing damage.
The tridrone has three javelins.

action.name: Recall Javelins {@recharge 4}
entries: Each of the tridrone's thrown javelins grow dozens of slender legs and crawls up to 30 feet toward the tridrone before retracting them.

reaction.name: Supervise Work
entries: As a reaction when a duodrone within 30 feet that the tridrone can see misses with an attack against a creature, the tridrone makes a note.
Duodrones under the tridrone's control add +1 to their attack rolls for each note the tridrone has made in the last minute.

reaction.name: Upgrade
entries: As a reaction to seeing a quadrone within 60 feet die or transform, the tridrone may transform into a quadrone, retaining its current hit points. No more than one tridrone may take this reaction.

trait.name: Chameleon Skin
entries: The troglodyte has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide from creatures more than 30 feet away.

trait.name: Stench
entries: Any creature other than a troglodyte that starts its turn within 5 feet of the troglodyte must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the start of the creature's next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the stench of all troglodytes for 1 hour.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the troglodyte has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The troglodyte makes two attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage and the target can't benefit from magical healing until the start of the troglodyte's next turn.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) slashing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the troglodyte can grapple the target (escape {@dc 12}).

action.name: Blood Shot {@recharge 5}
entries: The troglodyte releases a gout of blood from one of its eyes. One creature within 15 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or take take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage and be {@condition poisoned} until the end of the troglodyte's next turn, or take half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Puff Up
entries: As a reaction to a creature ending its movement within 5 ft. of the troglodyte, the troglodyte gulps air, making itself appear larger. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Chameleon Skin
entries: The troglodyte has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide from creatures more than 30 feet away.

trait.name: Stench
entries: Any creature other than a troglodyte that starts its turn within 5 feet of the troglodyte must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the start of the creature's next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the stench of all troglodytes for 1 hour.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the troglodyte has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The troglodyte makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage and the target can't benefit from magical healing until the start of the troglodyte's next turn.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) slashing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the troglodyte can grapple the target (escape {@dc 12}).

trait.name: Oversized Limb
entries: The troll can grapple as if it were once size larger, and acts on initiative count 0 instead of rolling.

trait.name: Clone Merger
entries: An injured troll that starts its turn within 5 feet of a budling merges with it, partial absorbing the budling into its body. A merged budling's speed is 0, it moves with its host troll, and uses its host troll's AC.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the troll takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the troll takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

action.name: Flailing Strikes (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Ossifying Gaze
entries: When a creature that can see the basilisk (or its reflection) starts its turn within 30 feet of it, the basilisk can force it to succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition restrained} until the beginning of its next turn as its flesh begins to turn to stone.
Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes at the beginning of its turn to avoid this effect, treating the basilisk as {@condition invisible} until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Gravelchewer Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage.
This attack ignores any resistance to piercing damage.

action.name: Petrify
entries: One creature affected by the basilisk's Ossifying Gaze must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition petrified} for the next 24 hours. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is {@condition petrified} until cured with a Greater Restoration or similar magic.

reaction.name: Darting Snap
entries: When a creature that is averting its eyes from the basilisk misses it with a melee attack, the basilisk can make a Gravelchewer Bite attack against it.

trait.name: Rallying Presence
entries: If the archon has fewer than 85 hit points, creatures within 60 feet that can hear the archon have advantage on Wisdom saving throws, and regain the maximum number of hit points possible from any healing.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The archon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The archon makes three attacks with its trumpet blade, one of which it may replace with its Clarion Call, if available.

action.name: Trumpet Blade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) slashing damage and 9 ({@damage 2d8}) radiant damage. Before or after this attack, the archon's trumpet may become a greatsword, or vice versa.

action.name: Clarion Call {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature within 60 ft. that can hear the archon has its life essence bolstered. Non-undead creatures affected by this ability cannot be reduced below 1 HP until the beginning of the archon's next turn. Fiends have disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws until the beginning of the archon's next turn.

action.name: Plane Shift (7th Level Spell)
entries: The archon teleports to a location it is familiar with on this or another plane.

reaction.name: Trumpet Blast
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the archon forces the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) thunder damage and be {@condition deafened} for the next minute. A Celestial or Fiend that fails this save by 5 or more is banished to its home plane.

trait.name: Slitherer
entries: Outside of a host, the tsochar always counts as {@condition prone}. It can enter or move through the space of any creature without spending additional movement.

trait.name: Dweomerbarbed Grip
entries: If a creature that it is grappling teleports, the tsochar teleports with it.

trait.name: Mindsight
entries: The tsochar knows the exact location of each creature with an Intelligence score of at least 2 within 120 feet. It has disadvantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks made to perceive anything else.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tsochar makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Leaping Clutch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}The tsochar moves up to 15 ft. toward the target. If it ends this space in the target's space, the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}).

A creature that starts its turn {@condition grappled} by the tsochar must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or take 36 ({@dice 8d8}) nonlethal poison damage and be {@condition poisoned} until the beginning of its next turn, or half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Crush
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 0 ft., one {@condition grappled} target. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition restrained} until the end of the tsochar's next turn.

action.name: Silence (2nd Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: The tsochar is surrounded by a 5 ft. radius sphere of silence for the next minute. Creatures inside the sphere are immune to thunder damage and cannot perform the verbal components of spells.

action.name: Greater Invisibility (1/Day, 4th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: The tsochar and its host become {@condition invisible} for the next minute.

action.name: Phantasmal Killer (1/Day, 4th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: One creature within 120 ft. that the tsochar can see must succeed on a {@dc 16} Intelligence saving throw or be {@condition frightened} for the next minute as it hallucinates an illusory manifestation of its deepest fears. An affected creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, taking 22 ({@damage 4d10}) psychic damage on a failure or ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Memory Slip (1/Day 5th Level Spell)
entries: One creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or forget one event that occurred in the last minute. On a success, the creature knows it was targeted with a spell.

action.name: Wear Flesh
entries: One {@condition incapacitated} humanoid {@condition grappled} by the tsochar must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or have the tsochar begin to invade and take control of its body. At the beginning of the tsochar's next turn, the tsochar enters the {@condition grappled} creature's body, bores into its nerve centers and takes control.

reaction.name: Counterspell (3rd Level Spell)
entries: As a reaction to seeing a creature cast a spell within 60 feet, the tsochar may make an Charisma check with DC equal to 10 plus the spell's level, negating the spell on a success. If the spell is 3rd level or below, the tsochar succeeds automatically.

trait.name: Slitherer
entries: Outside of a host, the tsochar always counts as {@condition prone}. It can enter or move through the space of any creature without spending additional movement.

trait.name: Mindsight
entries: The tsochar knows the exact location of each creature with an Intelligence score of at least 2 within 120 feet. It has disadvantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks made to perceive anything else.

action.name: Leaping Clutch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}The tsochar moves up to 10 ft. toward the target. If it ends this space in the target's space, the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}).

A creature that starts its turn {@condition grappled} by the tsochar must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or take 22 ({@dice 5d8}) nonlethal poison damage and be {@condition poisoned} until the beginning of its next turn, or half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Crush
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 0 ft., one {@condition grappled} target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition restrained} until the end of the tsochar's next turn.

action.name: Silence (2nd Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: The tsochar is surrounded by a 5 ft. radius sphere of silence for the next minute. Creatures inside the sphere are immune to thunder damage and cannot perform the verbal components of spells.

action.name: Wear Flesh
entries: One {@condition incapacitated} humanoid {@condition grappled} by the tsochar must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or have the tsochar begin to invade and take control of its body. At the beginning of the tsochar's next turn, the tsochar enters the {@condition grappled} creature's body, bores into its nerve centers and takes control.

action.name: Tsochar Parasitism
entries: When the tsochar takes control of a host, it may choose to leave the brain intact or destroy it. If it chooses to leave the brain intact, it can access the creature's stored memories, though doing so takes visible effort for the first several weeks after taking control of a new host.

Tsochar continuously absorb nutrients from their host. At the end of each month, a tsochar host has its Constiution score reduced by a cumulative and permanent {@dice 1d4}, until restored by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

If its host takes any fire damage, the tsochar must make a Constitution saving throw with DC equal to 10, or half the damage dealt, whichever is higher. On a failure, the tsochar is expelled into the nearest unoccupied space. If a host dies, the tsochar exits the host automatically at the beginning of its next turn.

When a tsochar exits its host, the host begins to bleed profusely, losing 10 ({@dice 3d6}) hit points at the start of each of its turns until a creature stanches the bleeding as an action with a successful {@dc 17} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check.

action.name: Fleshclad Template
entries: A fleshclad creature has:

items.name: Creature Type
entries: The creature's type becomes Aberration.

items.name: Ability Scores
entries: The creature's Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores become the higher of its own or its tsochar's.

items.name: Telepathy
entries: The creature gains Telepathy 120 ft.

items.name: Whispercast
entries: The creature ignores any verbal or somatic components for spells it casts.

items.name: Spellcasting
entries: The creature knows and can cast any spells its tsochar knows, in addition to its own.

items.name: Flesh Exchange
entries: As an action, the fleshclad expels its Tsochar controller onto a creature {@condition grappled} by the fleshclad. The tsochar parasite exits into the {@condition grappled} creature's space and immediately makes a Leaping Clutch attack.

trait.name: Dream Invader
entries: The quori may spend half its movement to enter the dreams of an adjacent {@condition unconscious} creature. While invading the creature's dreams, the quori has total cover from outside effects and can leave the creature's dream as a bonus action, appearing in an adjacent space.
Whenever it takes damage or a creature uses an action to shake it, the creature may attempt a {@dc 14} Charisma saving throw, waking and expelling the quori on a success.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The quori makes two melee attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its flickering psychoport.

action.name: Mind Blades
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d8 + 3}) nonlethealpsychic damage.

action.name: Flickering Psychoport
entries: The quori teleports up to 30 ft. to an unoccupied space it can see within 5 ft. of a creature. Until the end of its turn, attacks against the quori are made at disadvantage.

action.name: Mindslice Frenzy {@recharge 5}
entries: The quori makes four melee attacks.

A creature hit by two or more of these attacks in a turn must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} for the next minute. This effect ends if the creature ends its turn 20 ft. or more away from the quori.

action.name: Waking Nightmare
entries: The quori attempts to take control of an {@condition unconscious} creature whose dreams it is invading.

The creature takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) psychic damage, then must succeed on a {@dc 14} Charisma saving throw or gain temporary hit points equal to half its maximum hit points and rise under the quori's control. While the creature has these temporary hit points, it automatically fails Charisma saving throws.

trait.name: Dream Invader
entries: The quori may spend half its movement to enter the dreams of an adjacent {@condition unconscious} creature. While invading the creature's dreams, the quori has total cover from outside effects and can leave the creature's dream as a bonus action, appearing in an adjacent space.
Whenever it takes damage or a creature uses an action to shake it, the creature makes a {@dc 14} Charisma saving throw, waking and expelling the quori on a success.

trait.name: Grasping Flesh
entries: A creature that leaves the quori's reach must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The quori makes three melee attacks, one of which may be with its mindrot sting. It may replace its sting attack with a use of its Overwhelm Mind, if available.

action.name: Witripper Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) piercing damage. This attack deals an additional 5 ({@damage 1d10}) psyschic damage to a {@condition frightened} creature.

action.name: Mindrot Sting
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} for the next minute. This effect ends if the creature ends its turn 20 ft. or more away from the quori.

action.name: Overwhelm Mind {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature within 30 ft. that the quori can see must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or fall asleep for the next next minute. A creature wakes up early if it takes damage or another creature uses its action to wake it.

action.name: Waking Nightmare
entries: The quori attempts to take control of an {@condition unconscious} creature whose dreams it is invading.

The creature takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) psychic damage, then must succeed on a {@dc 14} Charisma saving throw or gain temporary hit points equal to half its maximum hit points and rise under the quori's control. While the creature has these temporary hit points, it automatically fails Charisma saving throws.

trait.name: Feather Step
entries: Tsukibo's high jump is up to 15 feet, or up to 30 feet with a running start. She may treat any surface, including leaves or falling snow, as solid ground.

trait.name: Harbinger of Strife
entries: When the daitengu or another creature within 30 feet makes an attack, it adds {@dice 1d4} to the result.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Tsukibo makes four attacks, or makes two attacks and uses her Suppressing Fire, if available.

action.name: Daikyu Bow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 7} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) piercing damage.
This attack is made at disadvantage if Tsukibo is not mounted.

action.name: Arrow Stab
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Suppressing Fire {@recharge 5}
entries: Tsukibo rains a barrage of arrows down in a 15 foot radius centered on a point she can see within 120 feet. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity Saving Throw or have its movement speed reduced by 10 and suffer disadvantage on ranged attacks until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Mounted Defender
entries: As a reaction when a creature hits her mount with an attack, Tsukibo makes an attack against the attacker.

trait.name: Retract Head
entries: As a Bonus Action, the turtle may retract its limbs and head into its shell and end its turn. Until the beginning of its next turn, the turtle's AC is increased to 17 and it can't take reactions.

trait.name: Helpless Inflexibility
entries: While {@condition prone} or {@condition grappled} by a Small or larger creature, the turtle cannot take Actions other than Bonus Actions.

action.name: Gentle Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit -2} to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medum or smaller target. {@h}The turtle attaches itself to one of the target's limbs.
Melee attacks made with that limb are at disadvantage until the creature uses a Bonus Action to remove the turtle.

reaction.name: Sudden Dive
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack while swimming, the turtle moves up to half its speed directly downward without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the blight remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a dead shrub.

trait.name: Rooted
entries: The blight makes saving throws and ability checks to resist being forced to move or be knocked {@condition prone} at advantage. If the blight is forced to move or knocked {@condition prone}, it loses 3 ({@dice 1d6}) hit points.

trait.name: Splinter
entries: If the blight takes bludgeoning damage, each creature within 5 feet of it must make a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw or take 2 ({@damage 1d4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Opportunistic Feeder
entries: The tyrannosaurus's attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20 when targeting a {@condition stunned} creature.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tyrannosaurus makes two attacks against different targets, one of which may be with its bite. It may replace its bite with a use of its Thunderous Roar, if available.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}33 ({@damage 4d12 + 7}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the tyrannosaurus can't bite another target.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d8 + 7}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Thunderous Roar {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature in a 30 ft. cone must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of the tyrannosaurus' next turn. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is also {@condition stunned} for the same duration.

reaction.name: Thrash
entries: As a reaction to a creature failing an attempt to escape its grapple, the tyrannosaur forces the {@condition grappled} creature to succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of the tyrannosaurus' next turn. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is instead {@condition paralyzed} for the same duration.

trait.name: Cold Blooded
entries: If the tzakandi takes cold damage, it cannot make more than one attack on its next turn.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The tzakandi has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tzakandi makes three attacks, one of which may be with its tentacles.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Tentacles
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) psychic damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}).

action.name: Hooked Pike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d10 + 2}) slashing damage. If the target is mounted, it must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or be dragged from its mount and take an additional 3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Extract Brain
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition incapacitated} humanoid {@condition grappled} by the tzakandi. {@h}The target takes 33 ({@damage 6d10}) piercing damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the tzakandi begins to extract and devour the target's brain. At the beginning of the tzakandi's next turn, the target dies and the tzakandi gains 20 temporary hit points.

action.name: Haywire Spit {@recharge 5}
entries: The tzakandi spits a globule of psychoactive acid. One creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) acid damage and be {@condition stunned} until the end of the tzakandi's next turn.

reaction.name: Telekinetic Outburst
entries: When the tzakandi is reduced below 49 hit points, it can lashe out telekinetically, forcing each creature within 20 feet to succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The uchuulon can breathe air and water

trait.name: Sense Magic
entries: The uchuulon senses magic within 120 feet of it. It can't be surprised by creatures carrying magic items.

trait.name: Translucent Shell
entries: While the uchuulon is illuminated in bright light, attacks made against the uchuulon score a critical hit on an 18-20.

trait.name: Paralytic Mucous
entries: A creature that hits the uchuulon with a melee attack must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or have its movement speed reduced by 10 ft. for the next minute A creature that has its movement speed reduced to 0 in this way is {@condition paralyzed} for the next minute.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chuul makes two melee attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its Tentacles.

action.name: Seizer Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}) and dragged up to 5 feet towards the uchuulon. The uchuulon can grapple only a single target at a time.

action.name: Crusher Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d6 + 3}) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or suffer disadvantage on attack rolls that use Strength until it completes a short or long rest.

action.name: Tentacles
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the chuul must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute.
