While {@condition poisoned} in this way, the target has its movement speed reduced by 10 and repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

reaction.name: Slippery Deflection
entries: When the uchuulon is hit with melee attack that deals piercing or slashing damage, it can halve the attack's damage.

reaction.name: Psychic Static (1/Day)
entries: When the uchuulon is reduced below 49 hit points, it can force each creature within 10 feet of it to succeed on a {@dc 12} Intelligence saving throw or take 11 ({@damage 2d10}) psychic damage. A creature with telepathy makes this saving throw at disadvantage.

monster.name: Ulgurstasta
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Cloying Mucous
entries: The ulgurstasta is covered in distended pores that weep a foul smelling mucous. A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the ulgurstasta must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the beginning of its next turn. On a success, a creature becomes immune to this effect for the next 24 hours.

trait.name: Suffocating Bulk
entries: The ulgurstasta may enter the space of any {@condition prone} creature. A creature whose space the ulgurstasta enters is {@condition blinded}, {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 18}), and can't speak or breathe.

trait.name: Necromantic Acid
entries: A creature killed by acid damage dealt by the ulgurstasta has its flesh slough off and rises at the beginning of the ulgurstasta's next turn as a

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ulgurstasta makes two attacks with its Body Slam, one of which it may replace with its Swallow Whole or Storm of Tendrils.

action.name: Swallow Whole
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d8 + 6}) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed. A swallowed creature is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the ulgurstasta, and it takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) acid damage at the start of each of the worm's turns.

If the ulgurstasta takes 25 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, an opening in its side large enough to permit escape is created. Until the ulgurstasta completes a Short or Long Rest, each creature in the ulgurstasta's stomach may attempt to escape (escape {@dc 18}) by spending its full movement.

action.name: Body Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage.
On a hit or miss, the target and each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Storm of Tendrils (Concentration)
entries: The ulgurstasta unfurls millions of hair-thin 40 foot long tendrils coiled within its pores that whip about in a frenzy.

For the next minute, or until it take any radiant damage, attacks made by living creatures within 40 feet are made at disadvantage, and ranged attacks against the ulgurstasta made from outside that area roll three dice and take the lowest result.

action.name: Skeletonizer Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The ugurstasta forcefully expels the contents of its stomach in a 30 foot cone.

Each living creature in the ulgurstasta's stomach and 5 ({@dice 2d4}) {@creature decrepit skeleton|confc|Decrepit Skeletons} are expelled in the area, then each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or be coated in the ulgurstasta's necromantic acid, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) acid damage at the start of each of its turns until a creature takes an action to scrape it off.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The ulitharid has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Psychic Overload
entries: Whenever the ulitharid takes psychic damage from a source other than this ability, each friendly mind flayer and {@condition charmed} creature within 60 ft. takes half as much psychic damage.

trait.name: Non-Euclidian
entries: The space in a 5 foot radius around the ulitharid is difficult terrain for non-aberrations, as the ulitharid's presence warps it into incomprehensible geometries.

trait.name: Thrall-Master Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the ulitharid fails a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, it can choose to transfer the saving throw's effect to a friendly or {@condition charmed} creature within 60 ft.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ulitharid makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Tentacles
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}27 ({@damage 4d10 + 5}) psychic damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}).
A creature that starts its turn {@condition grappled} by the ulitharid must succeed on a {@dc 17} Intelligence saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Skulltap Staff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}14 ({@dice 2d8 + 5}) bludgeoning plus 22 ({@damage 4d10}) psychic damage. On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or die as the staff splits its skull open and extracts its brain.

action.name: Extract Brain
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition incapacitated} humanoid {@condition grappled} by the ulitharid. {@h}The target takes 55 ({@damage 10d10}) piercing damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the ulitharid begins to extract and devour the target's brain. At the beginning of the ulitharid's next turn if the target is still {@condition unconscious} and {@condition grappled}, the target dies and the mind flayer gains 40 temporary hit points.

action.name: Enthralling Mind Blast (Concentration, Recharge 5-6)
entries: The mind flayer magically emits psychic energy in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 17} Intelligence saving throw or take 44 ({@damage 6d12 + 5}) psychic damage. A creature that fails by 5 or more is magically {@condition charmed} and under the ulitharid's telepathic control. Whenever the {@condition charmed} target takes damage, the target can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Break Will
entries: One creature {@condition charmed} by the ulitharid must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom Saving Throw or take 11 ({@damage 2d10}) psychic damage and have its Wisdom score reduced by the same amount, to a minimum of 1, until it completes a Short or Long Rest. If this reduces the {@condition charmed} creature to 0 Wisdom, the ulitharid no longer requires Concentration to Charm it.

action.name: Plane Shift (7th Level Spell, 1/day)
entries: The ulitharid and up to eight willing creatures within 10 feet teleport to another plane of existence.

reaction.name: Telekinetic Shove
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the ulitharid forces the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or be pushed 15 feet away.

reaction.name: Telekinetic Deflection
entries: As a reaction to being hit with an attack, the ulitharid halves the attack's damage against it.

trait.name: Confusing Gaze
entries: When a creature starts its turn within 30 feet of the umber hulk and is able to see the umber hulk's eyes, the umber hulk can magically force it to make a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw, unless the umber hulk is {@condition incapacitated}. On a failed saving throw, until the beginning of its next turn any movement the creature makes is made in a direction of the umber hulk's choice.

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The umber hulk can burrow through solid rock at half its burrowing speed and leaves a 5 foot-wide, 8-foot-high tunnel in its wake.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The umber hulk makes three attacks: two with its claws and one with its mandibles.

action.name: Frenetic Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) slashing damage. If the target is affected by the umber hulk's confusing gaze, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to move its full speed.

action.name: Mandibles
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) slashing damage.

reaction.name: Disorient
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with an attack, the umber hulk can impose disadvantage on the attack. If the attack misses, the attacker falls {@condition prone} and can't stand this turn.

monster.name: Umbral Blot
languages: understands Supernal but does not speak

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: The umbral blot is nearly indistinguishable from a Sphere of Annihilation. A creature may attempt a {@dc 22} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check to determine that it is not what it appears.

trait.name: Planar Portal Vulnerability
entries: If the blot contacts a planar portal, such as an active {@spell Gate} spell or a portable hole, both the blot and the portal are destroyed.

trait.name: Hostile Void
entries: A creature that touches the blot, or whose space the blot enters for the first time on a turn must succeed on a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 4d10}) force damage. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage is disintegrated.
Unattended nonartifact objects whose space the blot enters are disintegrated.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The blot uses its Vortex and makes one attack with its disintegrating touch.

action.name: Disintegrating Touch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 17} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}110 ({@damage 20d10}) force damage. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage is disintegrated.

action.name: Vortex
entries: The blot briefly suspends the field that protects the air around it from destruction. Each creature within 60 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw or be pulled 30 ft. toward the blot. Until the beginning of the blot's next turn, a creature must use 2 ft. of movement for every 1 ft. it moves away from the blot.

action.name: Plane Shift
entries: The blot teleports to a location on this or another plane that it is familiar with.

reaction.name: Deceptive Response
entries: As a reaction to a creature attempting to mentally control it, the blot moves up to half its speed in the direction indicated by the creature.

reaction.name: Pure Entropy
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a nonartifact weapon, the blot forces the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw or have the weapon wrenched from its grip and destroyed.

trait.name: Ghoulish Host
entries: If the pirate takes any radiant damage, it cannot make more than one attack on its following turn.

trait.name: Damned Crew
entries: If the pirate's captain is destroyed, the pirate gains one point of {@condition exhaustion} at the end of each of its turns.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The pirate makes two melee attacks, one of which may be with its festering bite.

action.name: Festering Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., targets one {@condition grappled} creature. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage and 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Sodden Grasp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, the pirate may grapple the target (escape {@dc 12}).

reaction.name: Slippery
entries: As a reaction to being missed by a melee attack, the hanzaki can move up to 10 feet without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

reaction.name: Drop Limb
entries: As a reaction to taking 6 or more damage, the hanzaki drops one of its limbs, reducing the damage taken to 5.
A hanzaki that drops an arm makes one fewer attack with its multiattack. A hanzaki that drops a leg reduces its maximum speed by half.

trait.name: Numinous Presence
entries: If the unicorn has at least 34 HP, a creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the unicorn must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be unable to take hostile action against the unicorn until the beginning of its next turn. A creature passes this save automatically if it took damage from the unicorn since the end of its last turn.

trait.name: Elusive
entries: The unicorn has advantage on stealth checks to hide from non-good-aligned creatures.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the unicorn moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a horn attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 ({@damage 2d8}) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The unicorn has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The unicorn's weapon attacks are magical.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The unicorn makes two attacks: one with its hooves and one with its horn. If it has 33 or fewer HP, it instead makes three attacks with its hooves and one with its horn.

action.name: Hooves
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 10 feet back. This attack deals an additional 3 ({@damage 1d6}) damage to a {@condition prone} creature.

action.name: Horn
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Healing Touch (3/Day)
entries: The unicorn magically restores 11 ({@dice 2d8 + 2}) hit points to a creature within 5 feet. In addition, the touch removes all diseases and neutralizes all poisons afflicting the target.

action.name: Teleport (1/Day)
entries: The unicorn magically teleports itself and up to three willing creatures it can see within 5 feet of it, along with any equipment they are wearing or carrying, to a location the unicorn is familiar with, up to 1 mile away.

reaction.name: Shimmering Shield
entries: As a reaction to seeing a creature make an attack, the unicorn creates a shimmering, magical field around itself or another creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target gains a +2 bonus to AC until the end of the unicorn's next turn.

trait.name: Numinous Presence
entries: If the unicorn has at least 86 HP, a creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the unicorn must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be unable to take hostile action against the unicorn until the beginning of its next turn. A creature passes this save automatically if it took damage from the unicorn since the end of its last turn.

trait.name: Elusive
entries: The unicorn has advantage on stealth checks to hide from non-good-aligned creatures.

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the unicorn moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a horn attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 ({@damage 2d8}) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The unicorn has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The unicorn's weapon attacks are magical.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The unicorn makes two attacks: one with its hooves and one with its horn. If it has 85 or fewer HP, it instead makes three attacks with its hooves and one with its horn.

action.name: Hooves
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 10 feet back. This attack deals an additional 3 ({@damage 1d6}) damage to a {@condition prone} creature.

action.name: Horn
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Healing Touch
entries: The unicorn magically restores 22 ({@dice 4d8 + 4}) hit points to a creature within 5 feet. In addition, the touch removes all diseases and neutralizes all poisons afflicting the target.

action.name: Teleport (1/Day)
entries: The unicorn magically teleports itself and up to three willing creatures it can see within 5 feet of it, along with any equipment they are wearing or carrying, to a location the unicorn is familiar with, up to 1 mile away.

reaction.name: Shimmering Shield
entries: As a reaction to seeing a creature make an attack, the unicorn creates a shimmering, magical field around itself or another creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target gains a +3 bonus to AC until the end of the unicorn's next turn.

legendary.name: Hooves
entries: The unicorn makes one attack with its hooves.

legendary.name: Skittish Dash (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The unicorn moves up to half its speed. {@action opportunity attack||Opportunity attacks} it provokes with this movement are made at disadvantage.

legendary.name: Healing Touch (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The unicorn uses its healing touch.

trait.name: Elemental Balance
entries: Whenever the unraveler takes damage of a type it is resistant to, its elemental balance is disrupted, granting the following effects until it takes damage of another type it is resistant to, or until it uses its Restore Balance action:
The unraveler's attacks deal an additional {@dice 2d6} of the triggering damage type.
The unraveler becomes immune to the triggering damage type.
The unraveler cannot use its Disjoin action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The disjoiner makes two attacks, each of which it may replace with a use of its Disjoin or Restore Balance, if available.

action.name: Omnimental Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 7 ({@dice 2d6}) bludgeoning plus 7 ({@dice 2d6}) cold plus 7 ({@dice 2d6}) fire plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) lightning damage.

action.name: Disjoin
entries: One creature within 10 feet that the unraveler can see must succeed on a {@dc 17} Charisma saving throw or be {@condition cursed|confc|cursed}.

A creature {@condition cursed|confc|cursed} in this way begins to unravel into its raw elemental components, and must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns or take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) force damage.

A creature that succeeds on 3 of these saving throws has the effect abate for 24 hours, after which it returns and the creature must save against it anew. A creature killed by this damage collapses into a loose pile of water and minerals.

action.name: Restore Balance {@recharge 5}
entries: The unraveler restores itself to perfect order, ending any spells or magical affect on itself, and any ongoing effects from its Elemental Balance trait.

reaction.name: Disjoin Weapon
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a nonmagical melee weapon attack, the unraveler forces the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or have the weapon disintegrate in its grasp as it separates into its component elements.

trait.name: Pushy
entries: If Uri moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a ram attack on the same turn, the target is pushed 5 feet away. If it is pushed into a wall or other solid surface, the creature takes an additional 5 ({@damage 2d4}) damage.

trait.name: Sure-Footed
entries: The goat has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws made against effects that would knock it {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Shot Cart
entries: Uri is pulling a wooden cart bearing three 9-pound cannonballs. While connected to it, Uri's speed is reduced by half, and he may struggle free from the cart as an action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Uri makes two attacks, one with his Bite and one with his Ram.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) piercing damage.

action.name: Ram
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Buck Shot
entries: Uri kicks his cart, knocking a cannonball free which lands in an adjacent space of Uri's choice. If a creature other than Gesi is in that space, it must succeed on a {@dc 11} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone} as the cannonball lands on its toes.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the urophion remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal cave formation, such as a stalagmite.

trait.name: Grasping Tendrils
entries: The urophion can have up to six tendrils at a time. Each tendril can be attacked (AC 20; 10 hit points; immunity to poison and psychic damage). Destroying a tendril deals no damage to the urophion, which can extrude a replacement tendril on its next turn. A tendril can also be broken as an action with a successful {@dc 15} Strength check.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The urophion can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Voice of Many Mouths
entries: The urophion's mouth is incapable of speech. When it speaks, it does so through the mouths of each creature it has {@condition grappled}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The urophion makes six stupefying tendril attacks, up to one of which it may replace with its Bite, Reel, or Extract Brain.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 4d8 + 4}) piercing damage. This attack is made with advantage against a {@condition grappled} creature. On a critical hit, the target is {@condition stunned} until the end of the urophion's next turn.

action.name: Stupefying Tendril
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 50 ft., one creature. {@h}The target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}). A creature that starts its turn {@condition grappled} by one or more tendrils has its Intelligence score reduced by 7 ({@dice 2d6}) until the grapple is released. A creature that has its Intelligence reduced to 0 in this way is {@condition stunned} until the grapple is released.

action.name: Reel
entries: The urophion pulls each creature {@condition grappled} by it up to 25 feet straight toward it.

action.name: Extract Brain
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition incapacitated} humanoid {@condition grappled} by the urophion. {@h}The target takes 55 ({@damage 10d10}) piercing damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the urophion begins to extract and devour the target's brain. At the beginning of the urophion's next turn, the target dies and the urophion gains 40 temporary hit points.

action.name: Haywire Mind Blast (Recharges when the urophion uses its Extract Brain)
entries: The urophion magically emits psychic energy in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 14} Intelligence saving throw or take 21 ({@damage 4d8 + 3}) psychic damage and subtract {@dice 1d6} from attack rolls and saving throws it makes for the next minute.
An affected creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

trait.name: Feather Step
entries: Usagibo's high jump is up to 15 feet, or up to 30 feet with a running start. She may treat any surface, including leaves or falling snow, as solid ground.

trait.name: Harbinger of Strife
entries: When the daitengu or another creature within 30 feet makes an attack, it adds {@dice 1d4} to the result.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Usagibo makes four attacks, each of which she can replace with a use of her Yugiri Strike.

action.name: Iron Geta Kick
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d4 + 6}) bludgeoning damage.
Before or after attacking, Usagibo may jump up to 10 feet without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

action.name: Painter's Blade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) slashing damage.

action.name: Yugiri Strike
entries: One friendly daitengu may use its reaction to move up to half its speed and make a melee attack or take the {@action Hide} action.

bonus.name: Yokai Mischief
entries: Usagibo's yokai scamper around a creature she can see within 20 feet, causing one of the following effects:

items.name: Misstep
entries: The creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

items.name: Misplace
entries: The creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or have one item it is carrying magically replaced with a stick or rock of similar dimensions. The missing object is hidden at a spot within 20 feet (find {@dc 15}).

items.name: Misfortune
entries: Until the beginning of Usagibo's next turn, the creature has disadvantage on all attack rolls. On a roll of 1, the creature hits itself with the attack.

trait.name: Sleek Coat Insulation
entries: While Ushar has more than half of her hit points, she has resistance to cold and fire damage.

trait.name: Bucket Howdah
entries: Ushar carries a bucket of seawater in which one Medium or smaller creature may ride. A creature riding on Ushar acts on her initiative instead of its own.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Ushar attacks twice with her Sporting Jab, one of which she may replace with the {@action Help} action.

action.name: Sporting Jab
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target that isn't {@condition prone}. {@h}3 nonlethal bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Paddle-Tail Smack
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

trait.name: Exposed Brain
entries: The ustilagor has a telepathic field that grants it resistace to all damage but psychic, which it must concentrate on as though {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell. If it loses {@status concentration}, until the beginning of its next turn it loses its damage resistances and gains vulnerability to all damage but psychic.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The ustilagor can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide.

action.name: Acidic Tendril
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) acid damage. For the next minute, or until a creature takes an action to clear the acid, the target takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) acid damage at the beginning of each of its turns.

action.name: Telempathic Assault
entries: One creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 11} Intelligence saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by the ustilagor for the next minute, or until it takes damage. While {@condition charmed} in this way, a creature subtracts {@dice 1d4} from Wisdom saving throws it makes.

trait.name: Leaping Pounce
entries: The utahraptor's long jump is up to 30 feet and its high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start. If the deinonychus jumps at least 15 ft. then hits a creature with a claw attack, the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Foe-Climber
entries: If the utahraptor hits a Huge or larger creature with a claw attack, instead of grappling it climbs on to the creature. While climbing on a creature, the creature has disadvantage on attack rolls that target the utahraptor.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The utahraptor makes two attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Crushing Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) slashing damage. This attack scores a critical on a 17-20 against a {@condition prone} creature.

action.name: Terrible Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}).

reaction.name: Mantle
entries: As a reaction to a {@condition prone} creature within 5 ft. attempting to stand, the utahraptor makes a claw attack against it. On a hit, the target fails to stand.

trait.name: Dream Invader
entries: The quori may spend half its movement to enter the dreams of an adjacent {@condition unconscious} creature. While invading the creature's dreams, the quori has total cover from outside effects and can leave the creature's dream as a bonus action, appearing in an adjacent space.
Whenever it takes damage or a creature uses an action to shake it, the creature may attempt a {@dc 16} Charisma saving throw, waking and expelling the quori on a success.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The quori makes four melee attacks, or makes two melee attacks and uses its tear apart ability, if available.

action.name: Armored Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d8 + 4}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}).
On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or have one object it is carrying wrested from its grasp and flung up to 30 ft. away.

action.name: Tear Apart
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by all four of the quori's claws must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or take 33 ({@damage 6d10}) piercing damage, or half as much on a success. A creature reduced to 0 hit points in this way is ripped into pieces and dies.

action.name: Greater Psychoport
entries: The quori teleports up to 120 ft. to an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of a creature, or up to a mile to an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of a creature it has used its dream invader ability on.

action.name: Thoughtscour Shriek {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature within 10 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or fall asleep for the next next minute. A creature wakes up early if it takes damage or another creature uses its action to wake it.
When the creature wakes, it experiences the time since it encountered the quori as though it were a dream.

action.name: Waking Nightmare
entries: The quori attempts to take control of an {@condition unconscious} creature whose dreams it is invading.

The creature takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) psychic damage, then must succeed on a {@dc 16} Charisma saving throw or gain temporary hit points equal to half its maximum hit points and rise under the quori's control. While the creature has these temporary hit points, it automatically fails Charisma saving throws.

reaction.name: Bloodied Shriek
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 115 hit points, the quori immediately recharges and uses its thoughtscour shriek.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The uvuudaum has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The uvuudaum can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Non-Euclidian
entries: The space in a 10 foot radius around the uvuudaum is difficult terrain, as the uvuudaum's presence warps it into incomprehensible geometries.

trait.name: Four Dimensional
entries: Time does not seem to pass during the Uvuudaum's turn. It does not provoke {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}, and its melee attacks are made at advantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The uvuudaum makes three attacks with its head spike.

action.name: Head Spike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) piercing damage and the target has its Wisdom score reduced by {@dice 1d6}, to a minimum of 1. If this reduces the target below 10 Wisdom, the target suffers one additional effect of the uvuudaum's choice. The uvuudaum may not choose the same effect twice in a turn:

items.name: Amnesia
entries: The target loses a chunk of memory, reducing its proficiency bonus by 1 for the next minute.

items.name: Anoxia
entries: If the target cast a spell since the end of the uvuudaum's previous turn, it loses the ability to cast that spell until it completes a long rest.

items.name: Apnea
entries: The target forgets how to breathe. At the end of each of its turns, it may make a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw, remembering how to breathe on a success.

items.name: Mania
entries: On the target's next turn, it may make one melee attack as a bonus action, but its targets are selected at random from those it can reach with its movement.

items.name: Paranoia
entries: The target becomes {@condition frightened} of one of its allies until the end of its next turn. While {@condition frightened} in this way, it cannot willingly accept assistance from that ally.

items.name: Seizure
entries: If the target casts a spell on its following turn, it must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or fall {@condition prone} and end its turn.

reaction.name: Ruin Mind
entries: As a reaction to a creature within 15 ft. hitting it with an attack, the uvuudaum uses its multiattack, targeting the attacker with each attack.

reaction.name: Scuttle
entries: As a reaction to being forced to make a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the uvuudaum moves up to half of its speed. If this movement puts the uvuudaum out of range or area of the spell or magical effect, the uvuudaum is unaffected.

reaction.name: Psychic Storm
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 115 hit points, the uvuudaum lets out a telepathic shriek. Each creature within 60 ft. that has a Wisdom score of 1 is {@condition stunned} until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The uzollru has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Colossal Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the uzollru may spend its full movement to attempt to climb onto it with a successful a {@dc 20} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. While climbing on the uzollru, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against it.

trait.name: Form of Madness
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 120 feet of the uzollru is staggered by the magnitude of its insignificance, and must make a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw.

On a failed saving throw, a creature loses all sense of self preservation. Until the beginning of its next turn, attacks against the affected creature have advantage, and the creature cannot voluntarily move away from the uzollru.
On a successful saving throw, a creature becomes immune to this effect for 1 hour.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the uzollru fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The uzollru makes two melee attacks; one with its Seizer Claw and one with its Crusher Claw.

action.name: Seizer Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}29 ({@damage 4d10 + 7}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 20}) and dragged up to 25 feet towards the uzollru. A creature {@condition grappled} in this way takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns.

action.name: Crusher Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}51 ({@damage 8d10 + 7}) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or suffer disadvantage on attack rolls that use Strength until it completes a Short or Long Rest.

action.name: Feeder Tendrils
entries: The uzollru's feeder tendrils burrow into the body of a creature {@condition grappled} by it, injecting digestive enzymes.
The creature must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or have its Constitution score reduced by 10 ({@dice 3d6}) until it completes a Short or Long Rest.
The target's maximum hit points are not affected by this reduction, and it dies if this reduces its Constitution score to 0.

legendary.name: Searing Gaze
entries: One creature affected by the uzollru's Form of Madness must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of the uzollru's next turn.

legendary.name: Angle Armor Plating
entries: The uzollru chooses a direction, adding +5 to its AC against attacks made from that direction by creatures that are not climbing on it until the beginning of its next turn.

legendary.name: Sudden Revelation (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: One creature immune to the uzollru's Form of Madness must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn and lose any immunity it has to the uzollru's Form of Madness.

legendary.name: Design Intent: Angles of Attack
entries: The direction as indicated by the Angle Armor Plating legendary action behaves as a cone of arbitrary size extending from the center of the uzollru's space.
The intent is that creatures trying to keep their distance should have difficulty repositioning to avoid it, but creatures that are close should be able to see and play around it without issue.

monster.name: Vampire
languages: the languages it knew in life

trait.name: Blood Eternal
entries: If the vampire is reduced to 0 hit points, it does not die or fall {@condition unconscious}. Instead, it loses the ability to take actions other than Bonus Actions, and cannot regain any hit points until it completes a Long Rest in its resting place. If it does not return to its resting place by the following dawn, the vampire is destroyed.

trait.name: Vampiric Traits
entries: The vampire has two traits from the Common Weaknesses table, two traits from the Uncommon Weaknesses table, and four traits from the vampiric powers table. Its weaknesses must include a method of destruction.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the vampire fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vampire makes three melee attacks, one of which may be with its Blood Drain.

action.name: Grasping Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}).

action.name: Blood Drain
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition grappled}, {@condition incapacitated}, {@condition restrained}, or willing creature. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage plus 17 ({@damage 5d6}) necrotic damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or lose three unexpended hit dice, or drop to 0 hit points if it cannot.
A creature killed by this attack rises as a Vampire Spawn at the next sunset.

action.name: Charm
entries: One creature within 30 feet that can see the vampire must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by the vampire and its allies for 24 hours. A {@condition charmed} creature repeats this save whenever it takes damage, ending the effect on a success.

legendary.name: Leaping Strike
entries: The vampire move up to half its speed without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity} and makes a Grasping Strike attack.

legendary.name: Children of the Night
entries: The vampire conjures a swarm of spectral vermin that envelop a creature it can see within 30 feet, heavily obscuring the area in a 5 foot radius around it until the vampire uses this ability again.

legendary.name: Blood Drain (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The vampire makes a Blood Drain attack.

monster.name: Vampire Blood Exarch
languages: the languages it knew in life

trait.name: Vital Tithe
entries: Whenever a creature takes necrotic damage within 15 feet of the vampire, the vampire gains an equal number of temporary hit points.

trait.name: Blood Eternal

Instead, it loses the ability to take actions other than Bonus Actions, and cannot regain any hit points until it completes a Long Rest in its resting place. If it does not return to its resting place by the following dawn, the vampire is destroyed.

entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) piercing damage plus 17 ({@damage 5d6}) necrotic damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or lose three unexpended hit dice, or drop to 0 hit points if it cannot.

action.name: Enchain Essence (5th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: One creature within 60 feet that the vampire can see must make a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is {@condition restrained} and has vulnerability to all damage for the next minute. The creature repeats this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Lacerating Rain (6th Level Spell)
entries: A hail of jagged blades formed from blood rain down in a 15 foot radius centered on a point the vampire can see. Each creature in the area make a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 31 ({@damage 7d8}) slashing damage and begins to bleed, losing 10 hit points at the start of each of its turns for the next minute, or until it receives any magical healing. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much slashing damage.

action.name: Blood Puppeteering (6th Level Spell, Concentration) {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature within 60 feet that the vampire can see must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or have its body controlled by the vampire for the next minute.

On each of the creature's turns, the creature takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage, then moves up to its speed and takes the attack action. An affected creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

reaction.name: Bestow Wound (2nd Level Spell)
entries: When the vampire is hit with an attack, it can force a creature it can see within 30 feet to succeed on a {@dc 20} Charisma saving throw.
On a failure, the vampire takes half as much damage from the attack and the target takes the same amount.

reaction.name: Command Ichor (2nd Level Spell)
entries: When a creature the vampire can see within 60 feet takes piercing or slashing damage, the vampire can force the creature to succeed on a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 30 feet in a direction of the vampire's choice.

legendary.name: Reaping Glide
entries: The vampire moves up to its fly speed. Each creature that makes an {@action opportunity attack||attack of opportunity} provoked by this movement takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) necrotic damage.

legendary.name: Dweomer Rupture (0th Level Spell)
entries: One creature the vampire can see within 60 feet must make a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage the next time it casts a spell before the end of the vampire's next turn.

legendary.name: Blood Drain (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The vampire makes an attack with its Blood Drain.

legendary.name: Rend Magic (3rd Level Spell, Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The controller of one spell or magical effect the vampire can see within 60 feet must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or have the spell or effect end.
If the magical effect was produced by an item, the item may not be activated again until the end of the wielder's next turn.

action.name: Crush Throat {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the vampire must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or take 77 ({@damage 14d10}) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success. A creature reduced to 0 hit points in this way cannot be stabilized until it regains at least 1 hit point.

legendary.name: Leaping Strike
entries: The vampire move up to half its speed without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity} and makes a Grasping Strike attack.

legendary.name: Hurl
entries: The vampire launches a {@condition grappled} or {@condition incapacitated} creature within 5 feet up to 30 feet away. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.

legendary.name: Blood Drain (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The vampire makes a Blood Drain attack.

monster.name: Vampire Spawn Bloodletter

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks not made with wooden weapons

languages: the languages it knew in life

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Uncanny Speed
entries: {@action opportunity attack||Attacks of opportunity} made against the vampire are made at disadvantage.

trait.name: Inherited Weaknesses
entries: The vampire has each of its creator's weaknesses.

action.name: Bloodletter Blade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) slashing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or lose 10 ({@dice 3d6}) hit points.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition grappled}, {@condition incapacitated}, {@condition restrained}, or willing creature. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or lose one unexpended hit die, or drop to 0 hit points if it cannot.

action.name: Blood Channeling (3rd Level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: The vampire loses 16 ({@dice 3d10}) hit points and another vampire that it can see within 30 feet gains that many temporary hit points.

While it has any of these temporary hit points, the target's attacks are made at advantage, and once per turn it may impose disadvantage on a saving throw a creature makes against one of its spells or abilities.

monster.name: Vampire Spawn Starveling
languages: the languages it knew in life

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Blood-Starved
entries: If the vampire has not fed on humanoid blood in the last 24 hours, it cannot use its multiattack.

trait.name: Inherited Weaknesses
entries: The vampire has each of its creator's weaknesses.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vampire makes two attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) slashing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the vampire can grapple the target (escape {@dc 13}).

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition grappled}, {@condition incapacitated}, {@condition restrained}, or willing creature. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or lose one unexpended hit die, or drop to 0 hit points if it cannot.

If the creature expends a hit die in this way, the vampire spawn gains resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks Not Made With Wooden Weapons until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Blood-Crazed Advance
entries: When a creature within 30 feet takes piercing or slashing damage, the vampire can move up to half its speed directly toward the creature.

trait.name: Confounding Circling
entries: While adjacent to two or more ixitxachitl, a creature has disadvantage on {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity} that target one of them.

trait.name: Segmented Brain
entries: The ixitxachitl may continue to make {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity} with its whiptail barb for up to a minute after being {@condition incapacitated} or killed.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ixitxachitl makes two attacks; one with its vampiric bite and one with its whiptail sting.

action.name: Vampiric Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or lose one unexpended hit die.
If the target expends a hit die in this way, the ixitxachitl gains 10 temporary hit points.

action.name: Whiptail Sting
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@dice 1d6 + 4}) piercing plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage.

reaction.name: Bleed for the Deep Father
entries: When a creature within 5 feet dies or fails a death saving throw, the ixitxachitl can create a searing symbol above the creature's body that lasts until the end of the ixitxachitl's next turn.
Each non-fiend creature within 30 feet that can see the symbol must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of the ixitxachitl's next turn.

trait.name: Enveloping Mists
entries: The mist can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and can move through any space that air can pass through without squeezing.
A creatrure that starts its turn in the mist must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or have its movement speed halved until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Destroyed by Sunlight
entries: A mist that starts its turn in sunlight may take only the {@action Dash} action. A mist that ends its turn in sunlight is destroyed.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mist makes one (Medium), two (Large), or three (Huge or Larger) attacks with its shred lungs, depending on its size.

action.name: Hemorrhaging Call
entries: Each creature within 5 ft. of the mist must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or lose an unexpended hit die, or drop to 0 hit points if it is unable to. If at least one hit die was expended in this way, the mist gains 20 temporary hit points, increases in size by one category to a maximum of Gargantuan, and loses its damage resistances until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Shred Lungs
entries: One creature in the mist's space must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or take 16 ({@damage 3d10}) necrotic damage and be unable to speak or breathe for the next minute.

reaction.name: Shifting Mists
entries: When the mist takes damage of a type it is not resistant to, it can move up to half its speed without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

trait.name: Dimensional Lock
entries: Other creatures can't teleport to or from a space within 60 feet of the varakhut. Any attempt to do so is wasted. The varakhut's own abilities are not subject to this trait.

trait.name: Unyielding Form
entries: The varakhut is immune to any effect that would inapacitate it, immobilize it, or alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The varakhut has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Implacable Tracker
entries: The varakhut knows the distance to and direction of each creature that has exceeded its natural lifespan, even if the creature and the varakhut are on different planes of existence. If a creature being tracked by the varakhut dies, the varakhut knows.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The varakhut uses its disintegration ray twice, one of which it may replace with its disjunctive blast or curse of diminished ambition, if available.

action.name: Disintegration Ray (6th Level Spell)
entries: One creature or object the varakhut can see within 60 ft. must make a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 50 force damage and each nonmagical item it is wearing or carrying turns to dust. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage is also reduced to dust.

action.name: Disjunctive Blast (8th Level Spell)
entries: One creature or object the varakhut can see within 60 ft. must make a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, all spells of 8th level or below affecting the target end, and one magic item that the target is carrying (target's choice) becomes inert and nonmagical for the next minute.

action.name: Purge Mind (6th Level Spell)
entries: One creature the varakhut can see within 60 ft. must make a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the varakhut removes one piece of knowledge related to process of ascending to divinity from the creature's mind.

action.name: Curse of Diminished Ambition (9th Level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: One creature the varakhut can see within 120 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 20} Charisma saving throw or be cursed to be barred from divinity, suffering the following effects:
While a cursed creature is outside its home plane, it must succeed on a {@dc 20} Charisma saving throw at the beginning of each of its turns or be returned to its home plane.
While a cursed creature is {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell or ritual, it takes one psychic damage at the beginning of each of its turns.

action.name: Plane Shift (7th level spell)
entries: The Varakhut and up to eight willing creatures within 10 feet teleport to another plane of existence.

trait.name: Screeching Flock
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of three or more vargouilles must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the beginning of its next turn, or become immune to this ability for 24 hours on a success.

trait.name: Poor Vision
entries: The swarm has disadvantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight. As an action, a creature may attempt a {@dc 8} Charisma ({@skill Deception}) check to convince the vargouille that something inedible is edible.

action.name: Locking Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@dice 1d6 + 2}) plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage and the vargouille becomes {@condition attached|confc|attached} to the target (remove {@dc 12}).

action.name: Cursed Kiss
entries: The vargouille kisses an {@condition incapacitated} creature within 5 feet, forcing it to succeed on a {@dc 12} Charisma saving throw or be {@condition cursed|confc|cursed}.

While {@condition cursed|confc|cursed} in this way, a creature loses 1 point of Charisma for each hour it spends in dim light or darkness. A creature that has its Charisma reduced to 0 in this way has its head tear free of its body and sprout wings, becoming a vargouille.

action.name: Manic Shrieking {@recharge 5}
entries: The vargouille unleashes a piercing shriek in a 15 foot cone, forcing each creature in the area that can hear it to succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) psychic damage.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is {@condition stunned} until the end of the Vargouille's next turn. A {@condition frightened} creature makes this saving throw with disadvantage.

monster.name: Vargouille Swarm
languages: and Infernal but is unable to speak

trait.name: Screeching Flock
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 60 ft. of the swarm must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the beginning of its next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to this ability for 24 hours.

trait.name: Poor Vision
entries: The swarm has disadvantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight. As an action, a creature may attempt a {@dc 8} Charisma ({@skill Deception}) check to convince the swarm that something inedible is edible.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a small creature. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

action.name: Locking Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@dice 4d6 + 2}) piercing plus 21 ({@damage 6d6}) poison damage, or 9 ({@dice 2d6 + 2}) piercing plus 10 ({@dice 3d6}) poison if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer, and the swarm attaches to the target.
While attached, the swarm can't attack another target, and may free itself as an Action or Bonus Action.

action.name: Manic Shrieking {@recharge 5}
entries: The swarm unleashes a cacophony of piercing shrieks, forcing each creature within 20 feet that can hear it to succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) psychic damage.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is {@condition stunned} until the end of the Vargouille's next turn. A {@condition frightened} creature makes this saving throw with disadvantage.

bonus.name: Cursed Kiss
entries: The swarm showers an {@condition incapacitated} creature in its space with kisses, forcing it to succeed on a {@dc 12} Charisma saving throw or be {@condition cursed|confc|cursed}.

While {@condition cursed|confc|cursed} in this way, a creature loses 1 point of Charisma for each hour it spends in dim light or darkness. A creature that has its Charisma reduced to 0 in this way has its head tear free of its body and sprout wings, becoming a vargouille.

trait.name: Mirror Dweller
entries: The nerra may spend half its movement to pass through a Medium or larger reflective surface within 5 feet, entering or exiting an extradimensional mirrorspace resembling the space reflected in the surface.
If a mirrored surface containing the nerra ceases to be reflective, the nerra is expelled into the nearest unoccupied space.

trait.name: Reflected Assassin
entries: While inside of a mirrorspace, the nerra treats any creature reflected in that mirrorspace as adjacent to it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The nerra makes two attacks with its Honed Shard, one of which it may replace with a use of its Mirror Grasp.

action.name: Honed Shard
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) slashing damage and the target begins {@condition bleeding|confc|bleeding} ({@dice 2d6}).
This attack deals an additional 7 ({@damage 2d6}) slashing damage to a{@condition bleeding|confc|bleeding} target.

action.name: Mirror Grasp
entries: One creature the nerra can see within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or have one object it is holding or carrying teleport into the nerra's hands.

bonus.name: Mirror Step
entries: The nerra teleports up to thirty feet to an unoccupied space it can see within 5 feet of a reflective surface.
If the nerra is inside a mirrorspace, it instead may teleport into another mirrorspace reflected by a surface it can see within 30 feet.

trait.name: Plant Camouflage
entries: The vegepygmy has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks it makes in any terrain with ample obscuring plant life.

trait.name: Vegepygmy Fission
entries: When the vegepygmy dies, three vegepygmy scavengers that act on its initiative emerges from the corpse at the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Moldy Fury
entries: Allied vegepygmies within 30 ft. can make a ranged or melee attack each turn as a bonus action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vegepygmy makes two melee attacks, one of which it may replace with its Mucid Command, if available.

action.name: Livewood Spear
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage. On a critical hit, the target is knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Mucid Command {@recharge 5}
entries: Each other friendly plant creature within 15 ft. may use its reaction to make a melee attack.

reaction.name: Chest Tendril Lash
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the vegepygmy forces the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) bludgeoning damage and be pushed 10 ft. away.

reaction.name: Recolonize (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 60 hit points, the vegepygmy releases a cloud of infectious spores. Each non-plant creature within 15 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be infected with {@disease russet mold contagion|ConfC}.

trait.name: Vegepygmy Fission

action.name: Claws

action.name: Braining Sling
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the beginning of the target's next turn.

trait.name: Plant Camouflage
entries: The vegepygmy has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks it makes in any terrain with ample obscuring plant life.

trait.name: Spore Burst
entries: When the vegepygmy dies, it releases a cloud of infectious spores. Each non-plant creature within 5 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or be infected with {@disease russet mold contagion|ConfC}.
