trait.name: Vegepygmy Fission
entries: When the vegepygmy dies, two vegepygmy scavengers that act on its initiative emerges from the corpse at the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vegepygmy makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Livewood Spear
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage. On a critical hit, the target is knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Rampant Growth
entries: A 10 ft. radius of ground centered on a point within 60 ft. becomes difficult terrain. Non-plant creatures in the area must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. Plant creatures in the area regain 7 ({@dice 2d6}) hit points.

action.name: Lashing Vine (4th level spell, concentration)
entries: The vegepygmy conjures a thorny vine that sprouts from the ground in space within 30 ft. One creature within 30 ft of the vine must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take 11 ({@damage 2d10}) piercing damage and be pulled 20 feet directly toward the vine.
The vegepygmy can direct the vine to lash out at the same creature or another one as a bonus action each turn.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The velociraptor has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the velociraptor's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Grasslands Hunter
entries: The velociraptor can attempt to {@action Hide} as a bonus action in dense foliage.

action.name: Ripping Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) slashing damage. On a critical hit, the target is knocked {@condition prone} if it is Medium or smaller.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage. This attack scores a critical on a 19 or 20 against a {@condition prone} creature.

trait.name: Unequaled Cruelty
entries: When the black dragon reduces a creature to 0 hit points, each {@condition frightened} creature that can see it must use its reaction, if available, to move its speed directly away from it.

trait.name: Sensitivity Aura
entries: Attacks against creatures within 10 feet of the dragon that do not have resistance or immunity to acid damage score a critical on an 18-20.

trait.name: Bloodbathed Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw while a{@condition bleeding|confc|bleeding} or {@condition unconscious} creature is within 30 feet of it, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three attacks, one of which can be with its Steelrot Bite, and uses its Frightful Presence.

action.name: Steelrot Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@dice 2d10 + 7}) piercing plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) acid damage.
On a critical hit, one weapon or piece of armor of Uncommon or lesser rarity that the target is wearing or wielding is destroyed (target's choice).

action.name: Subduing Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d6 + 7}) slashing damage.
Instead of dealing damage, the dragon can knock the target {@condition prone} and grapple it (escape {@dc 21}).

action.name: Tailbarb Stab
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d6 + 7}) piercing damage and the target begins {@condition bleeding|confc|bleeding} ({@dice 1d10}).
Any hit against a {@condition prone} creature with this attack becomes a critical.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of the dragon's choice within 120 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the beginning of the dragon's next turn, becoming immune to this effect for the next 24 hours on a success.

action.name: Hacked-Tar Sputum (Recharges when the dragon uses its Flesh-Melting Breath)
entries: The dragon hacks up a glob of spent acid and dead flesh at a point it can see within 60 feet, where it splashes in a 10 foot radius, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw or be drenched in sticky sludge (remove {@dc 20}).

A sludge-drenched creature is {@condition blinded}, has its movement reduced by half, and is protected from decay if it dies, extending the time limit of effects that would raise the target from the dead by up to a year.

action.name: Flesh-Melting Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon spews a jet of caustic acid in a 60-foot long, 10-foot wide line, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw or take 54 ({@damage 12d8}) acid damage, or half as much damage on a success.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more suffers a Vitriolic Disfigurement until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic. A creature killed by this damage disintegrates.

reaction.name: Bloodied Breath (1/Day
entries: When the dragon is reduced below 154 hit points, it can roll to recharge its Flesh-Melting Breath, then immediately use it, if available.

reaction.name: Cruel Jest
entries: When a creature smaller than the dragon leaves its reach, the dragon can force it to make a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw.
On a failure, the target is dragged up to 10 feet toward the dragon and the dragon regains its reaction.

legendary.name: Mire Dive
entries: The dragon moves up to half its speed. If it ends this movement submerged in murky water, it can attempt to {@action Hide}.

legendary.name: Drooling Torment
entries: Acid drips from the dragon's jaws toward a creature {@condition grappled} by it, dealing 9 ({@damage 2d8}) acid damage to the creature.
The target can use its reaction to attempt to escape the grapple, avoiding the damage on a success.

legendary.name: Peel Nerve (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon makes a Subduing Claw attack.
If this attack hits a creature {@condition grappled} by the dragon, the target has one spell affect on it end, or gains vulnerability to acid damage until it regains any hit points if it cannot.

trait.name: Skyfire Splendor
entries: While the dragon is flying, it has advantage on Dexterity saving throws and {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity} made against it have disadvantage.

trait.name: Rising Charge
entries: When the dragon rolls to recharge its Scourgebolt Breath, each creature within 10 feet of it takes lightning damage equal to the number rolled.

trait.name: Reserved Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. Its save DCs are reduced by 1 for each expended use of this ability.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three attacks, one of which can be with its Sparking Bite, and uses its Frightful Presence.

action.name: Sparking Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 2d10 + 8}) piercing damage plus 5 ({@damage 1d10}) lightning damage.

action.name: Sandhoned Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d6 + 8}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 22}).

action.name: Ridgetail Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d8 + 8}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 15 feet away.
Each other creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a {@dc 22} Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of the dragon's choice within 120 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the beginning of the dragon's next turn, becoming immune to this effect for the next 24 hours on a success.

action.name: Shattered Heavens Roar (Concentration)
entries: The dragon roars a challenge to the sky above, carving a rift through which boiling thunderclouds spill.
At the beginning of the dragon's next turn, a cascade of lightning bolts arc down, striking up to four creatures the dragon can see within 90 feet that are not beneath full cover.
Each target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or take 38 ({@damage 7d10}) lightning damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Scourgebolt Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: A stream of crackling energy issues forth from the dragon's mouth in a 90 foot long, 10 foot wide line, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw or take 77 ({@damage 14d10}) lightning damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is {@condition paralyzed} until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Battle of Wits
entries: When the dragon is targeted with a ranged attack by a creature it can see, it can throw a creature {@condition grappled} by it up to 10 feet into the attack's path.
The attacker must succeed on a contested Intelligence ({@skill Insight}) check against the dragon or have its attack instead target the thrown creature.

reaction.name: Bloodied Breath (1/Day
entries: When the dragon is reduced below 184 hit points, it can roll to recharge its Scourgebolt Breath, then immediately use it, if available.

legendary.name: Sand Dive
entries: The dragon moves up to half its burrow speed. Then, if it started this movement submerged in earth, it can make a Sandhoned Claw attack.

legendary.name: Wither
entries: The dragon inhales, draining the moisture from a creature {@condition grappled} by it. The creature takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) necrotic damage, and each potion and other liquid the target is carrying turns to dust until rehydrated.

legendary.name: Skyfury Drop (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon flies up to half its fly speed, then can drop up to 60 feet into an unoccupied space.

If it does, each other creature within 10 feet is pushed up to 10 feet away and must succeed on a {@dc 22} Dexterity saving throw or take 3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage for each 5 feet the dragon descended.

trait.name: Advanced Telepathy
entries: The flumph can perceive the content of any telepathic communication used within 60 feet of it, and it can't be surprised by creatures with any form of telepathy. It is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as all divination spells.

trait.name: Prone Deficiency
entries: If the flumph is knocked {@condition prone}, it must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition incapacitated}. At the end of each of its turns, the flumph can repeat this save, righting itself and ending the {@condition incapacitated} condition if it succeeds.

trait.name: Empathic Aura
entries: Creatures within 30 ft. of the flumph have advantage on {@skill Insight} checks to determine emotional states.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The flumph makes three attacks with its tendril prod.

action.name: Tendril Prod
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}The target is pushed 5 ft. away. On a critical hit, the target is knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Spiny Drop
entries: One creature that the Flumph is flying over must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) bludgeoning damage and be {@condition poisoned} for the next minute. While {@condition poisoned} in this way, the creature takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) acid damage at the start of each of its turns. A creature that passes the initial save by 5 or more knocks the flumph {@condition prone} in an adjacent space. A {@condition poisoned} creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Stench Spray (1/Day)
entries: Each creature in a 30-foot cone originating from the flumph must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or be coated in a foul-smelling liquid. A coated creature exudes a horrible stench for {@dice 1d4} hours. A creature can remove the stench on itself by using a short rest to bathe in water, alcohol, or vinegar.

trait.name: Forestborn
entries: The dragon's movement is not impeded by natural or magical foliage, and while in a wooded area can attempt to {@action Hide} while only Lightly Obscured.

trait.name: Slithering Shadow
entries: The first time each turn that the dragon is missed with an attack, it can move up to 10 feet without provoking {@action opportunity attack||opportunity attacks}. f

trait.name: Fuming Wounds
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 15 feet of the dragon takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage, or 7 ({@dice 2d6}) if it has fewer than half its hit points.

trait.name: Greenleech Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, plants within 30 feet of it wither and shrivel away.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes two attacks, one of which can be with its Venomtongue Bite, and uses its Frightful Presence.

action.name: Venomtongue Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@dice 2d10 + 7}) piercing plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage.
If the target is resistant or immune to poison damage, it must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or lose its resistance or immunity to poison damage for the next minute.

action.name: Hooked Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d6 + 7}) slashing damage.
Instead of dealing damage, the dragon may grapple the target (escape {@dc 21}).

action.name: Lash Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d8 + 7}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of the dragon's choice within 120 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the beginning of the dragon's next turn, becoming immune to this effect for the next 24 hours on a success.

action.name: Rampant Growth
entries: The dragon calls a burst of barbed vines forth from the earth in a 20 foot radius centered on a point it can see within 60 feet, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 18}).
Until the dragon uses this ability again, the area is difficult terrain, and a creature that moves into or within the area takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) piercing damage for every 5 feet it travels.

action.name: Lungripper Miasma Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon exhales a poisonous cloud in a 60-foot cone.
Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or take 52 ({@damage 15d6}) poison damage, or half as much damage on a success.
A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is {@condition blinded} and {@condition choking|confc|choking} until the end of the dragon's next turn.

reaction.name: Adapt Camouflage
entries: When a creature more than 30 feet from the dragon hits it with a ranged attack, it can alter its patterning to match its surroundings.
Until it moves, the dragon becomes {@condition invisible} to creatures more than 30 feet away from it.

reaction.name: Vindictive Snap
entries: When a creature affected by the green dragon's Lungripper Miasma Breath takes fewer than 27 damage from it, the dragon can move up to 30 feet toward the creature and make a Venomtongue Bite attack against it.

reaction.name: Bloodied Breath (1/Day
entries: When the dragon is reduced below 163 hit points, it can roll to recharge its Lungripper Miasma Breath, then immediately use it, if available.

legendary.name: Spit Venom
entries: The dragon spits a gob of concentrated venom at a creature it can see within 30 feet, forcing it to succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Poison damage and be {@condition blinded} until it clears its eyes as a Bonus Action.

legendary.name: Silent Snatch
entries: The dragon moves up to 30 feet, then can grapple one creature (escape {@dc 19}) it is hidden from and force it to make a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw.
On a failure, the target is {@condition stunned} and hidden from its allies until the beginning of the dragon's next turn, and the dragon remains hidden from each other creature.

legendary.name: Slink Away (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon moves up to 30 feet. If it ends this movement at least 30 feet from any hostile creature, it may immediately attempt to {@action Hide}.

trait.name: Ethereal Body
entries: The vast majority of the lock lurker's body, including its stinger and vital organs, extends into the ethereal plane, it is normally hidden. A creature that can see {@condition invisible} creatures, or one that can see into the etheral plane, can see the full creature. Only a Tiny portion of it extends into the material plane.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the lock lurker's legs are folded in, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary coin.

trait.name: Creeping Vermin
entries: The lock lurker can enter the space of any small or larger creature and climb onto it with the portion of itself that extends into the material plane. While doing so, the lock lurker moves with the creature.

action.name: Abductor Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) piercing damage. On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Charisma saving throw or be teleported into the lock lurker's stomach in the ethereal plane.

A living creature in the lock lurker's stomach is {@condition incapacitated} and repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, returning to the space it left or the nearest unoccupied space on a success, or taking 28 ({@damage 8d6}) acid damage on a failure.

action.name: Hidden Stinger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for the next minute. A {@condition poisoned} creature repeats this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success or being {@condition paralyzed} until the beginning of its next turn on a failure.
This attack is made at advantage against any creature that cannot see the stinger.

reaction.name: Scuttle
entries: As a reaction to being forced to make a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, the lock lurker moves up to 10 ft. If this movement puts the lock lurker out of range or area of the spell or magical effect, the lock lurker is unaffected.

trait.name: Vainglorious Strength
entries: If the dragon succeeds on a Strength saving throw, the next attack it makes before the end of its next turn has advantage.
If the dragon fails a Strength saving throw, it has disadvantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws for the next minute.

trait.name: Whorlflare Landing
entries: The first time each turn that the dragon lands on a solid surface after descending at least 20 feet, each creature within 20 feet of it is pushed up to 5 feet away and begins {@condition burning|confc|burning} ({@dice 1d10}).

trait.name: Flamegorge Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, each flame within 30 feet of it is extinguished.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Searing Bite, and uses its Frightful Presence.

action.name: Searing Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 15} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@dice 2d10 + 9}) piercing plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Irongouge Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 15} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d6 + 9}) slashing damage.
Instead of dealing damage, the dragon may grapple the target (escape {@dc 23}).

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of the dragon's choice within 120 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the beginning of the dragon's next turn, becoming immune to this effect for the next 24 hours on a success.

action.name: Slagflame Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon exhales rippling flames in a 60-foot cone, turning each surface in the area to molten slag.
Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 22} Dexterity or take 59 ({@damage 17d6}) fire damage, or half as much on a success.
For the next minute, the ground in the area becomes difficult terrain, and a creature that ends its turn on the ground in the area takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Stoke Malice (1/Day)
entries: The dragon breathes evil life into an an area of slag or magma within 60 feet, creating two {@creature magmin pyroclast|confc|Magmin Pyroclasts} that emerge from the ground into unoccupied spaces in the area.

reaction.name: Billowing Wings
entries: When the dragon takes 30 or more damage from a single source, it may shroud itself in smoke, heavily obscuring the area in a 20 foot radius until the end of its next turn, then immediately move up to half its speed.

reaction.name: Bloodied Breath (1/Day.)
entries: When the dragon is reduced below 196 hit points, it can roll to recharge its Slagflame Breath, then immediately use it, if available.

legendary.name: Lunging Swipe
entries: The dragon moves up to 20 feet, then makes an attack with its Irongouge Claws.

legendary.name: Leaping Flames
entries: The dragon causes the flames surrounding a burning creature or object it can see within 90 feet to flare and leap to a creature within 30 feet of them.
The creature must succeed on a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw or take 11 ({@damage 2d10}) fire damage and begin {@condition burning|confc|burning} ({@dice 1d10}).

legendary.name: Phalanx-Tail Sweep (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon sweeps its tail in a 15 foot cone, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a {@dc 23} Dexterity saving throw or take 17 ({@damage 5d6}) bludgeoning damage and be pushed up to 10 feet away from the dragon.

trait.name: Tundraborn
entries: The dragon ignores negative effects from moving over terrain composed of ice or snow, and has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition blinded}.

trait.name: Heavy Chill
entries: A creature that begins its turn within 20 feet of the dragon has disadvantage on each attack it makes on its turn beyond the first, unless it is resistant or immune to cold damage.
A creature can lose one unexpended hit die to ignore this effect until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Frostblessed Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw against an effect that does not deal fire damage, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three Barbed Claw attacks, one of which it can replace with its Bitter Bite or Icecarve Tail, and uses its Frightful Presence.

action.name: Bitter Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@dice 2d10 + 7}) piercing plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) cold damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 21}).
A creature {@condition grappled} in this way has disadvantage on saving throws against the dragon's Winterglass Breath.

action.name: Barbed Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d6 + 7}) slashing damage.
If the target is Gargantuan or smaller, the dragon can knock the target {@condition prone} instead of dealing damage.

action.name: Icecarve Tail
entries: The dragon sweeps its tail, flinging a spray of ice and snow in a 15 foot cone.

Each creature in the area is pushed 5 feet away and must succeed on a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw or take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) cold damage and be {@condition blinded} until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of the dragon's choice within 120 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the beginning of the dragon's next turn, becoming immune to this effect for the next 24 hours on a success.

action.name: Raise Hackles
entries: The dragon extends its spined frill and a deep, booming rumble ripples through the air around it in a 20 foot radius.

Each creature in the area that is immune to the dragon's Frightful Presence or the {@condition frightened} condition must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or lose that immunity for the next minute.

action.name: Winterglass Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon exhales an icy blast in a 60-foot cone, covering the area in ice and forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw or take 54 ({@damage 12d8}) cold damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 10 or more contracts Frostbite.
A creature that moves more than 10 feet through the area in a turn must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Sudden Pounce
entries: When a creature the dragon can see within 80 feet moves at least 15 feet away from it or fails an attempt to {@action Hide} from it, the dragon can leap up to 80 feet directly toward the creature and make a Barbed Claw attack against it.

reaction.name: Bloodied Breath (1/Day
entries: When the dragon is reduced below 163 hit points, it can roll to recharge its Winterglass Breath, then immediately use it, if available.

legendary.name: Terrorize
entries: One creature the dragon can see within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to move its speed directly away from the dragon, or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) psychic damage if it can't.

legendary.name: Ice Tomb
entries: The dragon breathes a layer of dense, translucent ice that encrusts a {@condition prone} creature within 10 feet, forcing it to succeed on a {@dc 21} Strength saving throw or gain 15 temporary hit points, or half as many on a success.

A creature that has any of these temporary hit points is {@condition restrained} and loses two unexpended hit dice at the end of each of its turns, or gains a point of {@condition exhaustion} if it can't.

legendary.name: Uttercold (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon draws on its deepest reserves. Until the end of its next turn, cold damage the dragon deals ignores damage resistance, and it can reroll any of the damage dice of its Winterglass Breath once, taking the second result.

trait.name: Troll Healing
entries: The troll regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the troll takes 10 or more acid or fire damage from a single source, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Budding
entries: When the troll suffers a critical hit that deals piercing or slashing damage, one of its limbs is severed, giving it disadvantage on attack rolls and Dexterity saving throws.

At the end of each of its turns, the troll makes a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw. On a success, this condition ends, and the severed piece grows into a {@creature troll budling|confc|Troll Budling} that acts on initiative count 0. The severed limb is destroyed if it takes acid or fire damage.

trait.name: Poison Splash
entries: When the troll takes damage of any type but psychic, each creature within 5 feet of the troll takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) poison damage.

trait.name: Poison Reliance
entries: If it would be subjected to an effect that would neutralize poison, the venom troll instead must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or die, taking 36 ({@damage 8d8}) necrotic damage on a success.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The troll makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

action.name: Slavering Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) poison damage.

action.name: Claw Bash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away and knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Reckless Thrash {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature within 10 feet of the troll must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 17 ({@damage 5d6}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}. Until the beginning of its next turn, attacks that target the troll are made at advantage.

reaction.name: Venom Spray (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 74 hit points, the troll slices itself with a claw, releasing a spray of poison in a 20-foot cone. The troll takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) slashing damage.

Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or take 27 ({@damage 6d8}) poison damage and be {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn. On a success, the creature takes half as much damage.

trait.name: Venomous Gaze
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of one or more venom-eye basilisks takes 1 poison damage for each of those basilisks it can see, then must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the beginning of its next turn.
Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes at the beginning of its turn to avoid this effect, treating the basilisk as {@condition invisible} until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the basilisk takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the basilisk takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

action.name: Snapping Bites (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 piercing damage.

trait.name: Hidden-Stepper
entries: The verbeeg may hide in any cover large enough to hide a Small or larger creature.

trait.name: Word-Twister
entries: As long as the verbeeg tells no direct lies, it has advantage on Charisma ({@skill Deception}) checks.

trait.name: Speak with Beasts and Plants
entries: The verbeeg can communicate with beasts and plants as if they shared a language.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The verbeeg makes two attacks with its spear.

action.name: Kingfisher Spear
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage. If the target is {@condition prone}, it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or have one object it is carrying but not wielding cut loose and flung 15 ft. in a direction of the verbeeg's choice.

action.name: Vine Snare {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature within 30 ft. that the verbeeg can see must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}, hoisted 15 ft. into the air by vines and {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 13}).
The vines are an object that can be destroyed (AC 12, HP 10, Vulnerability to Fire).

action.name: Concealing Mists (Concentration)
entries: The verbeeg conjures thick and shifting mists in a 100 ft. radius centered on a point within 60 ft. Creatures in the area can see no further than 30 ft., and verbeegs in the area may {@action Hide} as a Bonus Action.

If the target is {@condition prone}, it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or have one object it is carrying but not wielding cut loose and flung 15 ft. in a direction of the verbeeg's choice.

action.name: Distracting Greatbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d8 + 3}) piercing damage. On a miss, up to one creature within range may use its reaction to make a melee attack against the target.

action.name: Get 'Em!
entries: Up to three friendly creatures within 60 ft. may each move up to half their speed toward a creature of the verbeeg's choice.

reaction.name: Shin Kick
entries: As a reaction to a creature ending its movement within 5 feet of the verbeeg, the verbeeg forces it to succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Sweeping Trip {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature in a 15 ft. cone must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) bludgeoning damage and fall {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Stay Down
entries: As a reaction to a creature standing from {@condition prone} within 15 ft. of the verbeeg, the verbeeg may make a melee attack against it. If the attack hits, the creature is knocked {@condition prone} again and cannot stand this turn.

trait.name: Tree Stride
entries: Once on its turn, the prince can use 10 feet of its movement to step magically into one living tree within its reach and emerge from a second living tree within 500 feet of the first tree, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the second tree. Both trees must be Large or larger.

trait.name: Lifeblood Conduit
entries: Whenever a creature targets the prince with a spell, it must expend two hit dice, or three hit dice if the prince knows its name. If it cannot, the prince regains its reaction.

trait.name: Fey Magic Resistance
entries: The prince has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects imposed by a creature that does not know its name.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The prince casts one of its lesser works and one greater work.

entries: * The prince touches a weapon, attuning it to the blood of a creature whose name it knows. The next time the enchanted weapon hits the named creature, it deals maximum damage, instead of rolling.

items.name: Misty Step (2nd level spell)
entries: * The prince teleports up to 30 ft. to a location it can see.

items.name: Lifesight (2nd level spell)
entries: * The prince learns the current hit points of each creature it can see.

items.name: Reveal True Name (3rd level spell)
entries: * One creature within 60 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 17} Charisma saving throw or be compelled to reveal its true name on its following turn.

items.name: {@spell Dispel Magic} (3rd level spell)

items.name: Fly (3rd level spell, Concentration)
entries: * The prince gains a 60 ft. fly speed for the next 10 minutes.

items.name: Line of Light (5th level spell, {@status concentration})
entries: The prince raises a 60 ft. long, 5 ft. wide, 10 ft. high opaque wall of light. A creature that starts its turn in the wall or passes through must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) radiant damage and be {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn, or half as much damage on a success.

items.name: Ossify (6th level spell, 1/day)
entries: One creature within 60 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw take 75 ({@damage 10d6 + 40}) necrotic damage, or half as much on a success. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage has all of its soft tissues turn to bone and is {@condition petrified}.

items.name: Bone Burst (7th level spell, 1/day)
entries: The prince flings a chip of bone that erupts into a huge, sea urchin-like ball of jagged bone spikes. Each creature in a 20 ft. radius within 120 ft. is pushed up to 20 ft. out of the area and must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take 42 ({@damage 12d6}) piercing damage, or half as much on a succeess.

action.name: Oath Bond (1/Day)
entries: The verdant prince seals an agreement between itself and another creature with powerful magic. The bargain can be nearly anything, but must involve an exchange of goods or services. A creature that fails to perform its duties under the bargain has disadvantage on any ability check not made to remedy its debt, and its failure and location is known to the other party.

reaction.name: Shield
entries: As a reaction to being hit with an attack, the prince raises its AC by 5 until the beginning of its next turn, including against the triggering attack.

reaction.name: Counterspell (Spell, 3rd level)
entries: As a reaction to seeing a creature cast a spell within 60 feet, the prince makes an Intelligence check with DC equal to 10 plus the spell's level, negating the spell on a success. If the spell is 3rd level or below, the prince succeeds automatically.

entries: As a reaction to a creature the prince can see within 60 ft. being targeted with magical healing, the prince changes the target to itself.

If the creature is a debtor to the prince and the prince maintains {@status concentration} for one minute, the transformation instead lasts until the creature's debt is made good or forgiven.

items.name: Repel Metal (5th level spell)
entries: Each creature wielding a metal weapon or shield or wearing metal armor within 30 ft. of the prince must succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or take 35 ({@damage 10d6}) bludgeoning damage and be hurled up to 30 ft. away, or take half as much damage and be pushed 15 ft. on a success.

reaction.name: Thorny Retort
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the prince causes the attacker's weapon to sprout thorns, dealing 9 ({@damage 2d8}) piercing damage to the attacker. The attacker must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or drop its weapon. If the attacker picks up its weapon this turn, the prince may immediately make a club attack against it.

reaction.name: Lightning Deflection
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a ranged attack or spell that targets only it, the prince makes an unchallengable blade attack roll against an AC of 20. On a hit, the attack or spell fails.

trait.name: Battle-Honed Reflexes
entries: The veteran adds its Wisdom modifier to initiative rolls. At initiative count 20 on the first round of combat it may move up to half its speed and take the dodge action or drop {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Advantageous Position
entries: The veteran's attacks are made at advantage if it is in cover or an elevated position, as long as it is not {@condition flanked|confc|flanked}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The veteran makes two longsword attacks, or makes one crossbow attack and takes the {@action Dash} or {@action Disengage} action.

action.name: Longsword

action.name: Heavy Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 100/400 ft., one target. {@h}({@dice 1d10 + 1}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Pommel Bash

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the blight remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a dead shrub.

trait.name: Rooted
