action.name: Constrict
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage, and a Large or smaller target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}) . Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the blight can't constrict another target.

action.name: Entangling Plants {@recharge 5}
entries: Grasping roots and vines sprout in a 15-foot radius centered on the blight, withering away after 1 minute. For the duration, that area is difficult terrain for nonplant creatures. In addition, each creature of the blight's choice in that area when the plants appear must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or become {@condition restrained}. A creature can use its action to make a {@dc 12} Strength check, freeing it self or another entangled creature within reach on a success.

reaction.name: Alarm Pollen
entries: As a reaction to taking fire damage, the blight may release a pollen that agitates plant creatures within 30 feet, giving them advantage on their next attack roll made in the next minute.

trait.name: Eyes Everywhere
entries: The area in a 500 ft. radius around the drinker is surveilled from above by a murder of spectral crows. The drinker can see everything seen by any of the crows, and by any creature affected by its Curse of Stolen Sight.

trait.name: Piercing Gaze
entries: The drinker can read the surface thoughts of any creature it can see.

trait.name: Blind Weakness
entries: If the drinker fails a saving throw against an effect that would blind it, it may choose to succeed instead. If it does, the creature most recently affected by its Curse of Stolen Sight is freed from the effect.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The drinker makes two melee attacks, one of which it may replace with its Curse of Stolen Sight.

action.name: Lashing Tongue
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@dice 3d6 + 4}) slashing plus 22 ({@damage 4d10}) necrotic damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}).

action.name: Curse of Stolen Sight
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the drinker must succeed on a {@dc 16} Charisma saving throw or be {@condition cursed|confc|cursed}, causing one of its eyes cloud over and giving it disadvantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks.

action.name: Descent of Crows {@recharge}
entries: One creature within 500 ft. that the vitrous drinker can see is mobbed by spectral crows. The creature is {@condition blinded} until it moves at least 5 ft., and must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 28 ({@damage 8d6}) piercing damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Dimension Door (3/Day, 4th level spell)
entries: The drinker teleports up to 500 feet.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: If Vlaakith's phylactery is intact, when destroyed she gains a new body in {@dice 1d10} days, regaining all her hit points and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of her phylactery.

trait.name: Banishing Backlash
entries: A creature within 30 feet of vlaakith that fails a saving throw against one of her spells or abilities by 5 or more takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) force damage and is banished to the depths of the astral void, returning to the nearest unoccupied space to where it departed at the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If Vlaakith fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Vlaakith makes three attacks, one of which she may replace with her Gravity Gash, if available.

action.name: Grasp of the Lich Queen
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}21 ({@damage 6d6}) cold damage and the target loses two unexpended hit dice.
If the target has no unexpended hit dice, it instead must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw or die and crumble into a fine dust.

action.name: Dancing Silver Greatblade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) slashing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) psychic damage.

action.name: Crippling Barrage
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 60 ft., one creature. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d8}) necrotic damage and the target's movement speed is reduced by 5 feet until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

action.name: Gravity Gash (5th Level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: A 60 foot line of concentrated gravity that is 5 feet wide extends from Vlaakith. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw or take 27 ({@damage 6d8}) force damage and fall {@condition prone}, or take half as much damage on a success.

action.name: Necropulse Salvo (9th Level Spell, Recharges when Vlaakith uses her Gravity Burst)
entries: The veil is rent and three torrents of negative energy spill forth in 20 foot cones emerging from points within 120 feet that Vlaakith can see.

For each of these areas a creature is in, it must succeed on a 21 Dexterity saving throw or take 35 ({@damage 10d6}) necrotic damage and be knocked {@condition prone}, or take half as much damage on a success.

bonus.name: Psionic Empowerment
entries: Vlaakith gains one of the following benefits until she uses this ability again.

items.name: Share Pain
entries: Vlaakith forges a psychic bond to a friendly creature she can see within 30 feet. Whenever she would be dealt damage, she instead takes half as much damage and the bonded creature takes the other half.

items.name: Warp Space
entries: Ranged attacks against Vlaakith are made at disadvantage, and the area in a 10 foot radius around her is difficult terrain for creatures of her choice.

items.name: Shadow in the Weave
entries: When a creature casts a spell of 1st level or higher while within 30 feet of Vlaakith, it must succeed on a {@dc 18} Charisma saving throw or take 3 ({@damage 1d6}) psychic damage per level of the spell.

reaction.name: Repulsion Burst
entries: When Vlaakith is hit with a melee attack while her Warp Space is active, she can end the effect and force the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or be pushed up to 20 feet away and {@condition stunned} until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Twist Spell (6th Level Spell)
entries: When a creature fails its saving throw against her Shadow in the Weave, Vlaakith can choose new targets for the spell.

legendary.name: Psionic Shift
entries: Vlaakith uses her Psionic Empowerment and regains her reaction.

legendary.name: Susurration of the Damned
entries: Each creature of Vlaakith's choice within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 21} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened}. A creature that fails by 5 or more must use its reaction to move its full speed away from her, if available.

legendary.name: Consume the Faithful (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: One willing creature Vlaakith can see within 30 feet dies, and Vlaakith gains temporary hit points equal to half its current hit points. While she has these temporary hit points, Vlaakith has advantage on attack rolls.

legendary.name: Ethereal Shuffle (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Up to four creatures within 60 feet are each teleported up to 30 feet to an unoccupied location that Vlaakith can see. An unwilling creature may make a {@dc 21} Charisma saving throw, resisting the effect on a success.

trait.name: Cursed Resilience
entries: When Vladimir is reduced to 0 hit points, he does not die or fall {@condition unconscious}. Instead, he loses the ability to use his multiattack and releases all {@condition grappled} creatures, and must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of his turns or die.
If Vladimir takes radiant or fire damage while at 0 hit points, he is killed immediately.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: When vladimir's body is destroyed, his soul lingers. After 24 hours, the soul inhabits and animates another humanoid corpse on the same plane of existence and regains all its hit points.

trait.name: Fear Eater
entries: Vladimir scores a critical hit on a roll of 17-20 on attacks made against a creature that is {@condition frightened}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Vladimir makes two melee attacks and uses his Fearsome Gaze.

action.name: Unrelenting Advance (Greatsword +3)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d6 + 8}) slashing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Gauntlet Strike
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) necrotic damage and the target is pushed 5 ft away.

action.name: Fearsome Gaze
entries: One creature within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Shake Bones {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or have its skeleton rattle within its flesh, taking 42 ({@dice 12d6}) points of bludgeoning damage and moving up to 10 feet in a direction of vladimir's choice on a failure, or taking half damage on a success.
A creature with 0 hit points that fails this save dies. At the begining of its next turn, its skeleton tears itself out of the creature's body, acting on the creature's initiative.

reaction.name: Counterattack
entries: Vladimir adds 3 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. If this causes the attack to miss, vladimir may make a melee attack as part of this reaction.

reaction.name: Turn The Living (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 90 hit points, the Vladimir forces each living creature within 30 feet to succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} of him for the next minute. While {@condition frightened} in this way, a creature must use its action to dash away from vladimir, and repeats this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

variant.name: Note: Unrelenting Advance
entries: This blackened silver greatsword gains a cumulative +1 magic bonus at the conclusion of each combat encounter its wielder emerges victorious from, resetting to +0 whenever the wielder completes a Long Rest.

trait.name: Weightless
entries: Whenever the myrmidon takes damage, it is pushed 10 feet away from the source of the damage.

trait.name: Void Aura
entries: A creature within 5 feet of the myrmidon cannot speak or breathe.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The myrmiddon makes three melee attacks, one of which it may replace with its Cavitate, if available.

action.name: Dragging Lash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be pulled 10 feet towards the myrmidon. This attack has advantage against a levitating or flying creature.

action.name: Cavitate (Concentration, Recharge 5-6)
entries: For the next minute, the myrmidon is surrounded by sucking winds. A creature that start its turn within 5 feet of the myrmidon must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be unable to move away from it until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Elemental Riposte
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack, the myrmidon briefly implodes. Each creature within 15 feet of it must then succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or take 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Thunder damage and be pulled 10 feet towards the myrmidon.

reaction.name: Vaccuum Channel
entries: As a reaction to an allied creature within 15 feet being targeted with an attack, the myrmidon may pull the allied creature 10 feet closer. If the allied creature ends this movement out of range of the triggering attack, the attack misses.

trait.name: Weightless
entries: Whenever the mephit takes damage, it is pushed 10 feet away from the source of the damage.

trait.name: Void Aura
entries: While within 5 feet of the mephit, a creature is {@condition choking|confc|choking}.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the mephit dies, it violently implodes. Each creature within 15 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 10} Strength saving throw or take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) thunder damage and be pulled up to 10 feet towards the mephit.

action.name: Dragging Winds
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 10} Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 10 feet towards the mephit.
This attack has advantage against a creature that is flying or {@condition levitating|confc|levitating}.

action.name: Cavitate (Concentration, Recharge 6)
entries: The mephit surrounds itself with sucking winds in a 5 foot for the next minute.
A creature that start its turn within 5 feet of the mephit must succeed on a {@dc 10} Strength saving throw or be unable to move away from it until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Vaccuum Channel
entries: When a friendly creature the mephit can see within 15 feet is targeted with an attack, the mephit may pull the target creature up to 10 feet towards it.
If the creature ends this movement out of the triggering attack's reach, the attack misses.

trait.name: Instinctive Hibernation
entries: Whenever the scavver takes cold damage, if it has fewer than 10 hit points remaining it falls asleep for the next minute.

trait.name: Electrosensitive
entries: If the scavver takes any lightning damage, it has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The scavver makes two attacks with its Broadside Slam and uses its Fear Gaze, if available.

action.name: Swallowing Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}45 ({@damage 6d12 + 6}) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the scavver (escape {@dc 17}).

While swallowed, a creature is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the scavver, and takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) acid damage at the start of each of the scavver's turns.

action.name: Broadside Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}24 ({@damage 4d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 10 ft. away.
If the target is a ship, each creature on board must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away and fall {@condition prone}.

action.name: Fear Gaze {@recharge 4}
entries: One creature within 60 feet the scavver can see must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of the scavver's next turn.

reaction.name: Hypercompetitive
entries: If the void scavver is within 10 feet of a hostile creature and another scavver ends its movement within 10 ft. of the void scavver, the void scavver must use its reaction to make a broadside slame attack against it.

trait.name: Light Eater
entries: The void slaad reflects no light, and is {@condition invisible} in darkness. At the beginning of its turn, each light source within 20 ft. of it is extinguished.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The slaad has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Chaotic Resilience
entries: The slaad has resistance to the damage type of the last source of damage it received.

trait.name: Annihilating Collapse
entries: When the slaad dies, it condenses to a sphere of annihilating energy. Until the beginning of its next turn, a creature that starts its turn within 60 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or be pulled 20 ft. towards the sphere.

Then, each creature within 5 ft. of the sphere takes 22 ({@damage 4d10}) force damage. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or disintegrate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The slaad makes three attacks, one of which may be with its havoc bite, and uses its Void Leap.

action.name: Havoc Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@dice 2d8 + 6}) piercing plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage. Additionally on a hit, the first 10 ft. of movement the target takes on its following turn is made in a random direction.

action.name: Vaccuum Slash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) force damage and the target is dragged 10 ft. toward the slaad.

action.name: Void Leap
entries: The slaad leaps up to 20 ft., and can land in the space of any Medium or smaller creature. Each creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 15 ft. toward the slaad, then each creature within 5 ft. of the slaad falls {@condition prone} and takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) force damage.

action.name: Pandemoniac Ideal (Concentration)
entries: The slaad creates the image of an object, creature, or pheneomenon no larger than a 30-foot cube. It seems real to all senses, though a successful {@dc 16} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check reveals its illusory nature. The slaad may interact with the illusion physically as though it were real.

As a Bonus Action on each of its turns, the slaad can move the illusion up to 30 ft. and force one creature within 5 ft. of it to succeed on a {@dc 19} Intelligence saving throw or take 39 ({@damage 6d12}) damage of a type appropriate to the illusion. A creature that has investigated the illusion makes this save with advantage.

action.name: Void Croak {@recharge 5}
entries: The slaadi lets out a horrible, atonal croak that destroys all matter. Each nonmagical object and surface within 20 ft. that is not worn or carried disintegrates, leaving a circular crater.

Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or take 66 ({@damage 8d10}) force damage, or half as much on a success. A creature that fails this saving throw and is reduced to 0 hit points by the damage disintegrates.

action.name: Plane Shift (1/Day)
entries: The slaad and any number of slaadi adjacent to it teleport to a different plane of existence.

monster.name: Voidsoul Specter
languages: understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the specter takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the creature takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

trait.name: Spectral Chill
entries: A living creature that starts its turn within 15 feet of three or more voidsoul specters takes 4 cold damage.

trait.name: Spectral Weapons
entries: The specter's attacks treat all creatures as unarmored (an unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier.)

action.name: Inflict Weakness (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}6 necrotic damage.

If three or more voidsoul specters contributed to this attack, the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or deal only half damage with weapon attacks that use Strength until the beginning of the specter's next turn.

action.name: Invisibility (Concentration)
entries: The specter becomes {@condition invisible} until it makes an attack.

trait.name: Airless Aura
entries: Creatures within 15 feet of the voidwraith can't speak or breathe, and the voidwraith's movement makes no sound.

trait.name: Voidform
entries: It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. While fully obscured, the voidwraith may attempt to {@action Hide} as a Bonus Action.

trait.name: Shifting Nothingness
entries: If the voidwraith would roll at the end of its turn to end a magical effect, it may roll at the beginning of its turn to end the effect as well.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The void wraith makes two attacks with its void intrusion.

action.name: Void Intrusion
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 8 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) slashing damage.
A creature hit by this attack that is out of breath must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or drop to 0 hit points.

action.name: Wheezing Reclamation {@recharge 5}
entries: The voidwraith attempts to wrench forth the air from the lungs of creatures nearby. Each creature within 15 feet of the voidwraith that is holding its breath must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or take 16 ({@damage 3d10}) necrotic damage and lose its held breath, or take half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Howling Void
entries: When the voidwraith fails a saving throw, it can briefly intensify the sucking winds that surround it.
Each creature within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 15 feet toward the voidwraith.
Until the beginning of its next turn, the area within 30 feet of the voidwraith is difficult terrain for creatures attempting to move away from it.

monster.name: Volenta Popofsky
languages: the languages it knew in life

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The vampire regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has fed today, has at least 1 hit point, and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the vampire takes radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Vampire Weaknesses
entries: The vampire has the following flaws:

items.name: Forbiddance
entries: The vampire can't enter a residence without an invitation from one of the occupants.

items.name: Harmed by Running Water
entries: The vampire takes 20 acid damage if it ends its turn in running water.

items.name: Stake to the Heart
entries: If a piercing weapon made of wood is driven into the vampire's heart while the vampire is {@condition incapacitated} in its resting place, the vampire is killed.

items.name: Destroyed by Sunlight
entries: A vampire that starts its turn in sunlight may take only the {@action Dash} action. A vampire that ends its turn in sunlight is destroyed.

items.name: Blood-Starved
entries: A vampire spawn that has not fed on humanoid blood in the last 24 hours cannot use its multiattack, and does not regenerate.

trait.name: Precision Strike (4/Day)
entries: When the vampire misses an attack roll, it may add a {@dice d10} to the attack roll.

trait.name: Indomitable (1/Day)
entries: When the vampire fails a saving throw, it may reroll it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vampire makes two attacks, one of which can be a bite attack.

action.name: Hook Sword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) slashing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the vampire can grapple the target (escape {@dc 13}). On a critical hit, the target drops one item it is holding.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one willing creature, or a creature that is {@condition grappled} by the vampire, {@condition incapacitated}, or {@condition restrained}. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be forced to expend a hit die.

If the creature expends a hit die in this way, the vampire spawn gains resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage from weapons that aren't wooden until the beginning of its next turn. If the creature is unable to, it drops to 0 hit points.

action.name: Action Surge (1/Day)
entries: The vampire immediately takes two additonal actions other than this one. It may take the same action twice.

reaction.name: Riposte (2/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack, the Vampire may make melee weaon attack. If it hits, the attack does an extra 5 ({@damage 1d10}) damage.

trait.name: Fleshgorger Rampage
entries: When the vrock reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on its turn, the vrock gains 11 ({@dice 2d10}) temporary hit points.
If the creature was a demon, the vrock instead gains twice as many temporary hit points and can take a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make an attack with its Burning Beak.

trait.name: Inevitable Betrayal
entries: The vrock has advantage on the first attack it makes each turn against an allied creature.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The vrock has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vrock makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Burning Beak.

action.name: Burning Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@dice 4d6 + 4}) piercing plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.
This attack scores a critical on an 18-20.

action.name: Gnarled Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) slashing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Felloil Rain (3rd level Spell) {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature in a 5 foot radius column extending beneath the vrock is doused in a fine mist of glistening oil, and must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or take 28 ({@damage 8d6}) poison damage, or half as much on a success.

If an affected creature takes any fire damage in the next minute, it ignites. Until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the target takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage at the end of each of its turns.

action.name: Wheel of Ruin (1/Day, 6th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: The vrock conjures an abyssal storm that lasts for a minute and follows its movement as it flies.

On each of the vrock's turns, it may call down demonic lightning as a bonus action. The vrock and each creature encircled by the movement the vrock took this turn must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 21 ({@dice 6d6}) lightning plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Fiendripper Mites
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a melee attack, the vrock scatters a hail of venomous, biting parasites from its feathers, covering the attacker.

Until a creature takes an action to remove them, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw and the beginning of each of its turns or take {@damage 1d10} poison damage and be {@condition poisoned} until the start of its next turn.

reaction.name: Stunning Screech (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 100 hit points, the vrock emits a horrific screech. Each other creature within 20 feet of it that can hear it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of the vrock's next turn.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the vrock takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the vrock takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

trait.name: Winds of Conflict
entries: A non-vrock creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of 3 or more vrock kettlers must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or take 3 bludgeoning damage and be pushed up to 10 feet toward the nearest non-vrock creature.

action.name: Flocking Rake (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 slashing damage.
If at least two other vrocks added to this attack, {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity} the target makes this turn have disadvantage.

trait.name: Fleshgorger Rampage
entries: When the vrock reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on its turn, the vrock gains 11 ({@dice 2d10}) temporary hit points.
If the creature was a demon, the vrock instead gains twice as many temporary hit points and can take a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make an attack with its Serrated Beak.

trait.name: Inevitable Betrayal
entries: The vrock has advantage on the first attack it makes each turn against an allied creature.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The vrock has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vrock makes two attacks, one of which may be with its Serrated Beak.

action.name: Serrated Beak
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 4d6 + 3}) piercing damage.
This attack scores a critical on an 18-20.

action.name: Gnarled Talons
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d10 + 3}) slashing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Stunning Screech (1/Day)
entries: The vrock emits a horrific screech. Each other creature within 20 feet of it that can hear it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of the vrock's next turn.

reaction.name: Fiendripper Mites
entries: When the vrock is hit with a melee attack, it can scatter a hail of venomous, biting parasites from its feathers, covering the attacker.

Until a creature takes an action to remove them, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw at the beginning of each of its turns or take 5 ({@damage 1d10}) poison damage and be {@condition poisoned} until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Metalbound
entries: If one or more creatures within the living spell's reach are wearing metal armor, the living spell's attacks have advantage against those creatures and disadvantage against other creatures.

trait.name: Living Magic
entries: If the living spell is targeted with a spell-nullifying effect, such as {@spell Dispel Magic}, it must make a Constitution saving throw against the caster's Spell Save DC.
On a failure, the living spell is {@condition stunned} (Save Ends at end of turn).

action.name: Spark Pulse
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 6d6}) lightning damage.

action.name: Resonance Coil (Concentration)
entries: The living spell winds itself into a tight coil and begins humming with the sound of rising energy.
Until the beginning of its next turn, whenever the living spell takes damage, each creature within 15 feet of it takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) lightning damage.
At the beginning of its next turn, the living spell can use its action to make a Spark Pulse attack against each creature within range.

action.name: Crackling Drive {@recharge 5}
entries: The living spell moves up to 100 feet in a straight line, passing through creatures without resistance and without provoking {@action opportunity attack||opportunity attacks}.
Each creature it moves through in this way must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 28 ({@damage 8d6}) lightning damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Trampling Charge
entries: The elephant may move through the space of a Large or smaller creature without penalty. When the elephant enters a creature's space, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Spear Maddened
entries: Whenever the elephant takes damage from a spear, glaive, pike, or similar long, bladed weapon, it must make a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save the elephant attacks a random creature in range on its following turn.

trait.name: Howdah
entries: Up to four Medium or Small creatures may ride the elephant.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The elephant makes two attacks; one with its bladed tusks and one with its stomp, if available.

action.name: Bladed Tusks
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 4d8 + 6}) slashing damage and the target is pushed 10 ft. away.

action.name: Stomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition prone} creature. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d10 + 6}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Tusk Sweep {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature in a 15 ft. cone must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or take 23 ({@damage 4d8 + 6}) slashing damage be pushed 10 ft. away, or take half as much damage on a success.

trait.name: Menacing Presence
entries: If the archon has fewer than 69 hit points, a creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the archon must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} of the archon until the beginning of the archon's next turn. A creature that passes this save is immune to the Menacing Presence of this archon for the next 24 hours.

trait.name: Far-Seeing
entries: The archon cannot be surprised. If it would otherwise be surprised, it acts on initiative count 20 this combat, instead of rolling initiative.

trait.name: Concussive Strength
entries: A creature knocked {@condition prone} by the archon must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be unable to stand on its following turn.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The archon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The archon makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) piercing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) radiant damage. This attack does an additional 9 ({@damage 2d8}) piercing damage to a {@condition prone} creature.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) slashing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Bear Hug
entries: One creature within 5 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 45 ({@damage 9d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage and be {@condition grappled}. While the archon has a creature {@condition grappled} in this way, it cannot use its multiattack.

action.name: Plane Shift (1/Day, 7th Level Spell)
entries: The archon teleports to a location it is familiar with on this or another plane.

reaction.name: Crush
entries: As a reaction to a creature the archon has {@condition grappled} speaking or casting a spell with a verbal component, the archon crushes the air out of its lungs. The creature immediately begins to suffocate.

trait.name: Single Minded Focus
entries: When initiative is rolled, the warforged marks a creature as its target. The first attack the warforged makes each turn against that creature is made at advantage.

trait.name: Light-Bending Alloy
entries: The greenshadow is {@condition invisible} to creatures more than 30 feet away from it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The warforged makes three attacks with its Greenshadow Armbow.

action.name: Battlefist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

action.name: Greenshadow Armbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Rapid Assessment
entries: As a reaction when a creature marked as the warforged's target begins to cast a spell, the warforged moves up to half its speed or makes a melee attack against it.

trait.name: Single Minded Focus
entries: When initiative is rolled, the warforged marks a creature as its target. The first attack the warforged makes each turn against that creature is made at advantage.

trait.name: Constructed Perfection
entries: The warforged has advantage on saving throws against any effect that would incapacitate it, and any critical hit against it becomes a normal hit.

trait.name: Bladed Body
entries: If the juggernaut moves at least 20 feet in a straight line on its turn, each creature within 5 feet of where it ends its turn takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) slashing damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The warforged makes three attacks with its Chainclaw Flail, one of which it may replace with its War-Door Shield Smash or Inferno Oil Atomizer.

action.name: Chainclaw Flail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d12 + 5}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 10 feet in a direction of the warforged's choice.
If this attack misses, the warforged may make a second attack roll against another creature in range as part of this attack.

action.name: War-Door Shield Smash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone} and unable to stand on its following turn.

action.name: Inferno Oil Atomizer {@recharge 5}
entries: Until the end of the warforged's next turn, attacks made with its Chainclaw Flail deal an additional 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.

reaction.name: Rapid Assessment
entries: As a reaction when a creature marked as the warforged's target begins to cast a spell, the warforged moves up to half its speed or makes a melee attack against it.

reaction.name: Alchemical Failsafe (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction when the warforged is reduced below 30 hit points, it activates a violent alchemical reaction within itself.

The warforged begins to glow and shake, and at the beginning of its next turn the warforged explodes. Each creature within 20 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 35 ({@damage 10d6}) fire damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Single Minded Focus
entries: When initiative is rolled, the warforged marks a creature as its target. The first attack the warforged makes each turn against that creature is made at advantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The warforged makes two attacks, one of which may be with its Grapplebolt Launcher.

action.name: Retractable Armblade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Grapplebolt Launcher
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 3} to hit, range 40/80 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage and the bolt embeds itself in the target.

Until a creature removes the bolt as an action with a successful {@dc 13} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check, the target cannot move away from the warforged, the warforged can't attack with this weapon, and the warforged may spend 5 feet of its movement to drag the creature 5 feet towards it.

reaction.name: Rapid Assessment
entries: As a reaction when a creature marked as the warforged's target begins to cast a spell, the warforged moves up to half its speed or makes a melee attack against it.

trait.name: Bolting Reflex
entries: When initiative is rolled, the warhorse moves up to half its speed away from the nearest enemy without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.
A creature riding the warhorse may attempt a {@dc 14} Wisdom ({@skill Animal Handling}) check to instead control the direction of this movement.

trait.name: Trampling Charge
entries: If the warhorse moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with a hooves attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Hooves
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 ft. away. The warhorse may make this attack as a bonus action against a {@condition prone} creature.

reaction.name: Quick Kick
entries: When a creature makes an attack against the warhorse that benefits from flanking it, the warhorse can make an Hooves attack against the attacker.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Warlock uses its Repelling Blast once and its Eldritch Blast once.

action.name: Repelling Blast
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 120 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) force damage and the target is pushed back 10 feet.

action.name: Eldritch Blast
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 120 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) force damage.

action.name: Fear (1/Day, 3rd level spell, concentration)
entries: 30 ft cone, {@dc 15} WIS save. On a failed save, the target is {@condition frightened} and must use its action to dash away. Target repeats the save at the end of its turn if it can't see the Warlock, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Hold Person (1/Day, 3rd level spell, concentration)
entries: 60 ft range, 2 targets, {@dc 15} WIS save. On a failed save, the target is {@condition paralyzed} for 1 minute. Target repeats the save at the end of its turn, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Warlock attacks once with its Repelling Blast and twice with its Eldritch Blast

action.name: Repelling Blast
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 120 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d10 + 5}) force damage and the target is pushed back 10 feet.

action.name: Eldritch Blast
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 120 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d10 + 5}) force damage.

action.name: Mental Prison (1/Day, 6th level spell, concentration)
entries: 60 ft range, 1 target, {@dc 17} INT save. On a success, the target takes {@damage 5d10} psychic damage. On a failure, the target takes 28 ({@damage 5d10}) psychic damage, and perceives itself surrounded by fire. The target can't see or hear anything beyond it and is {@condition restrained} for the spell's duration. If the target is moved out of the illusion, makes a melee attack through it, or reaches any part of its body through it, the target takes 55 ({@damage 10d10}) psychic damage, and the spell ends.

action.name: Synaptic Static (1/Day, 5th level spell)
entries: 120 ft range, 20 ft radius sphere, {@dc 17} INT save. On a failed save, the target takes 28 ({@damage 8d6}) psychic damage, or half damage on a success. Also on a failed save, the target subtracts a {@dice d6} from all their attack rolls and {@status concentration} checks. A target makes a {@dc 17} INT save at the end of their turn to end this effect.

action.name: Dimension Door (1/Day, 5th level spell)
entries: The Warlock and one willing creature within 5 feet teleport up to 500 ft.

action.name: Repelling Blast
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 120 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) force damage and the target is pushed back 10 feet.

action.name: Scorching Ray (2/Day, 2nd level spell)
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 5} to hit, 3 attacks. Each attack deals 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage on a hit.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Warlock attacks once with its Repelling Blast and three times with its Eldritch Blast

action.name: Repelling Blast
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 120 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d10 + 5}) force damage and the target is pushed back 10 feet.

action.name: Eldritch Blast
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 120 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d10 + 5}) force damage.

action.name: Psychic Scream (1/Day, 9th level spell)
entries: 60 ft range, 10 targets, {@dc 19} INT save. On a failed save, a target takes 49 ({@damage 14d6}) psychic damage and is {@condition stunned}. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition stunned}. A {@condition stunned} target makes a {@dc 19} INT save at the end of its turn, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Power Word: Stun (1/Day, 8th level spell)
entries: 60 ft range, 1 target. If the target has 150 hit points or fewer, it is {@condition stunned}. Otherwise, the spell has no effect. The {@condition stunned} target must make a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Finger of Death (1/Day, 7th level spell)
entries: 60 ft range, 1 target. {@dc 19} CON save. 62 ({@damage 7d8 + 30}) necrotic damage on a failure, or 1/2 damage on a success.

action.name: Mental Prison (1/Day, 6th level spell, concentration)
entries: 60 ft range, 1 target, {@dc 19} INT save. On a success, the target takes {@damage 5d10} psychic damage. On a failure, the target takes 28 ({@damage 5d10}) psychic damage, and perceives itself surrounded by fire. The target can't see or hear anything beyond it and is {@condition restrained} for the spell's duration. If the target is moved out of the illusion, makes a melee attack through it, or reaches any part of its body through it, the target takes 55 ({@damage 10d10}) psychic damage, and the spell ends.

action.name: Dimension Door (2/Day, 5th level spell)
entries: The Warlock and one willing creature within 5 feet teleport up to 500 ft.

trait.name: Carpet of Thorns
entries: Each creature of the battlebriar's choice that is not riding it treats the area within 5 ft. of the battlebriar as difficult terrain, and takes 5 ({@damage 2d4}) damage for each 5 ft. the creature moves through that area.

trait.name: Enraged By Fire
entries: If the battlebriar takes any fire damage, it must succeed on a {@dc 10} Wisdom saving throw or be unable to distinguish friend from foe until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The battlebriar makes two attacks, one of which may be with its goring tusks.

action.name: Goring Tusks
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Spined Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Thorn Burst {@recharge}
entries: Each creature in a 15 ft. cone must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) piercing damage and have its movement speed reduced by 5 until a creature takes an action to remove the embedded thorns.

trait.name: Smoke Torpor
entries: If exposed to smoke, the swarm of bees becomes indifferent to all hostile creatures.

trait.name: Dimunitive
entries: The bee can occupy another creature's space and vice versa.

trait.name: Apiphobia
entries: A creature that starts its turn in the bee's space must succeed on a {@dc 10} Wisdom saving throw or use all of its movement to move in a straight line before taking an action. If this movement is arrested by a solid surface, the creature falls {@condition prone} and ends its turn.

action.name: Sting
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. {@h}1 piercing damage plus 2 ({@damage 1d4}) poison damage. If this damage causes a creature to make a saving throw to maintain {@status concentration}, it does so at disadvantage.

reaction.name: Dimunitive Dodge
entries: As a reaction to being missed with an attack, the bee causes the attack to hit another creature in its space, using the same attack roll.

trait.name: Smoke Torpor
entries: If the swarm starts its turn in a cloud of smoke or similar vapor, its speed is reduced by half and it is {@condition incapacitated} until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Apiphobia Aura
entries: A creature that starts its turn in the swarm's space must succeed on a {@dc 9} Wisdom saving throw or use all of its movement to move in a straight line before taking an action.
If this movement is arrested by a solid object or surface, the creature falls {@condition prone} and ends its turn.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny wasp. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

action.name: Rancorous Stings
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. {@h}5 ({@damage 2d4}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage, or 2 ({@dice 1d4}) piercing plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.
If this damage causes the target to make a saving throw to maintain {@status concentration}, the creature makes it with disadvantage.

action.name: Pheromonal Vengeance
entries: When the swarm is hit with a melee attack, it can cover the attacker in a fine pheromonal mist.
Until the target takes a Short Rest to clean itself, each wasp within 500 feet of it can pinpoint its location by scent and has advantage on attacks that target it.

trait.name: Form of Madness
entries: A non-obyrith creature that starts its turn within 120 feet of the wastrilith and can see it must succeed on a {@dc 21} Wisdom saving throw or lose the ability to feel compassion or empathy.

An affected creature cannot target a friendly creature with a spell or magical effect, and any friendly creature that attempts to cast healing magic within 10 feet of the affected creature must succeed on a Dexterity check contested by the affected creature or have the affected creature become the magic's new target.
An affected creature can repeat this saving throw as an Action, ending the effect and becoming immune to it for 24 hours on a success.

trait.name: Villiform Teeth
entries: The wastrilith does not automatically release creatures {@condition grappled} by its Bonescraper Bite when {@condition incapacitated}.

A creature {@condition grappled} in this way that attempts to escape takes 13 ({@damage 2d12}) piercing damage, and a creature freed from this grapple by forced movement takes 26 ({@damage 4d12}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The wastrilith has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the wastrilith fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wastrilith makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Bonescraper Bite. It may replace any number of attacks with uses of its Gulp Down.

action.name: Bonescraper Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}46 ({@damage 6d12 + 7}) piercing damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 22}).

action.name: Carcass Hooks
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}25 ({@damage 4d8 + 7}) slashing damage.

action.name: Gulp Down
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the wastrilith takes 13 ({@damage 2d12}) piercing damage and must succeed on a {@dc 22} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} for as long as it remains {@condition grappled}.

A {@condition restrained} creature that fails this saving throw instead takes 26 ({@damage 4d12}) piercing damage and becomes {@condition swallowed|confc|swallowed} for as long as it remains {@condition grappled}.

action.name: Polluted Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The wastrilith breathes forth a torrent of black bile in a 60 foot cone, heavily obscuring the area until the beginning of its next turn.

Each creature swallowed by the wastrilith and each creature in the area when it appears must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw or take 27 ({@dice 6d8}) acid plus 21 ({@damage 6d6}) poison damage, or half as much on a success.

Each creature that ends its turn in the area must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn. While {@condition poisoned} in this way, a creature is {@condition stunned}.

legendary.name: Gulp Down
entries: The wastrilith uses its Gulp Down.

legendary.name: Pressure Pulse
entries: Each creature within 15 feet of the wastrilith must succeed on a {@dc 21} Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 15 feet away.

legendary.name: Sinuous Slice (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The wastrilith moves up to half its swim speed and makes two attacks with its Carcass Hooks.

trait.name: Corrupt Water
entries: At the start of each of the wastrilith's turns, exposed water within 30 feet of it is corrupted. Underwater, this effect lightly obscures the area until a current clears it away.

A creature that starts its turn in the area or enters it for the first time on a turn must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or be unable to distinguish friend from foe until the beginning of its next turn.
On a success, a creature becomes immune to the effect for 24 hours.

trait.name: Villiform Teeth
entries: The wastrilith does not automatically release creatures {@condition grappled} by its Bonescraper Bite when {@condition incapacitated}.

A creature {@condition grappled} in this way that attempts to escape takes 6 ({@damage 1d12}) piercing damage, and a creature freed from this grapple by forced movement takes 13 ({@damage 2d12}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The wastrilith has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wastrilith uses its Grasping Spout and makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Bonescraper Bite.

action.name: Bonescraper Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}30 ({@damage 4d12 + 4}) piercing damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}).

action.name: Carcass Hooks
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d6 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Grasping Spout (2nd Level Spell)
entries: The wastrilith launches a spout of water at one creature it can see within 60 feet, which must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 4d8 + 4}) acid damage and be pulled up to 30 feet toward the wastrilith.

action.name: Boiling Breath (6th Level Spell, Recharge 5-6)
entries: The wastrilith exhales a torrent of boiling water in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or take 42 ({@damage 12d6}) fire damage, or half as much damage on a success.
Each Medium or smaller creature in the area is pushed up to 15 feet away.

action.name: Oceanic Assault (1/Day, 7th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: The wastrilith transforms an unoccupied 5 foot radius space filled with water that it can see within 30 feet into a {@creature water weird|confc|Water Weird} that lasts for a minute and acts on the wastrilith's initiative and under its control.
On each of its turns for the next minute, the wastrilith may repeat this action, summoning an additional Water Weird.
While the wastrilith has three or more summoned water weirds active at a time, it has disadvantage on saving throws to maintain {@status concentration}.

reaction.name: Rime Sphere (5th Level Spell)
entries: When the wastrilith is reduced below 111 hit points, it can raise a 30 foot radius spherical barrier of ice centered on a point it can see within 60 feet, pushing each creature in the barrier's space to a side of the creature's choice.

The barrier can be damaged and destroyed (AC 10, 100 hit points, vulnerability to fire damage), and whenever a creature deals 25 or more damage to the barrier in a turn it may open a breach large enough for a Medium creature to squeeze through at a point in the attack's reach or range.

trait.name: Water Form
entries: The elemental can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.
Large or smaller air-breathing creatures in the elemental's space are {@condition choking|confc|choking}.

trait.name: Creeping Freeze
entries: If the elemental takes any cold damage, it partially freezes; until the end of its next turn, damage dealt to the elemental ignores its damage resistances and its speeds are reduced to 10 feet.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The elemental makes two attacks with its Crashing Slam, one of which it can replace with a use of its Whelm.

action.name: Crashing Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.
A target that is holding its breath must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or lose its breath and begin {@condition suffocating|confc|suffocating}.

action.name: Whelm {@recharge 4}
entries: The elemental lurches up to 10 feet, then can force each creature in its space to succeed on {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) bludgeoning damage, or be pushed to the nearest unoccupied space on a success.
A Large or smaller creature that fails this saving throw is additionally {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}), and is {@condition restrained} while {@condition grappled} in this way.

reaction.name: Vengeful Surge
entries: When the elemental is missed with a melee attack, it can use its Whelm, if available.

trait.name: Freeze
entries: Whenever the myrmidon takes cold damage, its speed is reduced by 10 and it loses its damage resistances until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Crashing Tide
entries: If the myrmidon moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with an attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 3 ({@damage 1d6}) cold damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The myrmiddon makes three melee attacks, one of which it may replace a use of its Drench, if available.

action.name: Geyser Blade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) slashing damage and 3 ({@damage 1d6}) cold damage. This attack has advantage against a creature submerged in water.

action.name: Drench {@recharge 5}
entries: The myrmidon spews a stream of cold water in a 15 foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}. If this damage causes a creature to make a {@status concentration} check, it makes it at disadvantage.

reaction.name: Elemental Riposte
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack, the myrmidon unleashes a torrent of crashing water. The attacker must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) bludgeoning damage, be pushed 10 ft. away, and be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Freeze
entries: Whenever the mephit takes cold damage, its speed is reduced by 10 and it gains vulnerability to bludgeoning damage until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: When the mephit dies, it explodes in a wave of crashing water. Each creature within 5 feet of it must then succeed on a {@dc 10} Strength saving throw or take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Watery Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage.
Instead of dealing damage, the mephit can grapple the target (escape {@dc 12}).
This attack has advantage against a creature at least partially submerged in water.

action.name: Drench {@recharge}
entries: The mephit spews a stream of cold water in a 15 foot cone, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a {@dc 10} Strength saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.
Savings throws to maintain {@status concentration} caused by this damage are made with disadvantage.

reaction.name: Crashing Wave
entries: When the mephit is missed with a melee attack, it can make a Watery Slam attack against the atatcker. On a hit, the target is additionally knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Water-Bound
entries: The weird dies if it begins or ends its turn more than 5 feet away from a body of water.

trait.name: Creeping Freeze
entries: If the weird takes any cold damage, it partially freezes; until the end of its next turn, damage dealt to the weird ignores its damage resistances and its speeds are reduced to 10 feet.

action.name: Slithering Coil
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage.
A Medium or smaller creature hit with this attack is pulled into the weird's space and {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}) until the weird uses this attack again.

action.name: Lung Gush
entries: The weird blasts a burst of water into the lungs of an air-breathing creature {@condition grappled} by it, forcing it to succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or take 28 ({@damage 8d6}) bludgeoning damage and immediately begin {@condition suffocating|confc|suffocating}.
As an action, it or a creature within 5 feet can allow it to repeat this saving throw, expelling the water and ending the effect on a success.

bonus.name: Twisting Arc
entries: The weird leaps up to 30 feet through the air from one space of open water to another.
At any point in this jump, the weird can use its action to make an attack with its Slithering Coils.

bonus.name: Laminar Shimmer
entries: If the weird is fully submerged in clear water and doesn't have a creature {@condition grappled}, it can become {@condition invisible} until the beginning of its next turn.
This Invisibility ends early if the weird makes an attack or takes any cold damage.

trait.name: Whelming Wave
entries: The assassin can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

A Huge or smaller creature whose space the assassin enters for the first time on a turn, or that starts its turn in the assassin's space, must succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw or be {@condition grappled} and {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 19}).

trait.name: Creeping Freeze
entries: If the assassin takes any cold damage, it partially freezes; until the end of its next turn, damage dealt to the assassin ignores its damage resistances and its speeds are reduced to 10 feet.

action.name: Shipbreaker Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}84 ({@damage 12d12 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and the target is knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Tumbling Churn
entries: Each creature in the assassin's space must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or take 36 ({@damage 8d8}) bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success.
A target that was holding its breath and fails this saving throw by 5 or more loses its breath and begins {@condition suffocating|confc|suffocating}.

reaction.name: Surge Wave
entries: When the assassin is missed with a melee attack, it can move up to 10 feet directly toward the attacker.

reaction.name: Liquid Dodge
entries: When the assassin would make a saving throw, it can make a Dexterity saving throw of the same DC instead. On a success, the assassin suffers no harmful effects.

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the mummy takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the mummy takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The mummy can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Tomb Spider Hatchery
entries: When the web mummy's hit points are reduced to 0 by a damage type other than fire or radiant, a Tomb Spider Broodling Swarm emerges in its space.

action.name: Adhesive Grasp (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 bludgeoning damage and the mummy sticks to the target (escape {@dc 11}). While stuck, the mummy moves with the target, and the target has its movement speed reduced by 10 for each mummy stuck to it.

reaction.name: Broodrage
entries: When the tomb spider that created the mummy is killed, the mummy can a melee attack with advantage. If the attack hits, it deals an additional 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage and the mummy dies.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a Bonus Action, the wereape can transform into a Huge ape-giant hybrid or into a Huge ape, or back into its true form, which is giant. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its humanoid form if it dies.

trait.name: Reckless
entries: At the start of its turn, the wereape can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls it makes during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Juggernaut Leap
entries: The wereape's long jump is up to 40 feet and its high jump is up to 20 feet when it has a running start. If the wereape jumps at least 20 feet, it may land in the space of any large or smaller creature. Each of those creatures must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. On a successful save, is instead pushed 5 feet out of the wereape's space into an unoccupied space of the creature's choice.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the wereape may spend half of its movement to attempt a {@dc 17} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the wereape. While climbing on the wereape, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the wereape, and the wereape has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

trait.name: Cursed Resilience
entries: When the wereape is reduced to 0 hit points, it does not die or fall {@condition unconscious}. Instead, it loses the ability to take actions other than to {@action Dash}. If it takes damage from a silvered weapon while at 0 hit points, it is killed.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wereape makes two attacks, one of which it may replace with a use of its Brutal Shove, if available.

action.name: Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d10 + 6}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Tree Trunk
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and be pushed 5 feet away. Creatures within 5 feet of the target must make a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw, taking half the attack's damage on a failed save.

action.name: Rock
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 9} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}28 ({@damage 4d10 + 6}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Body Slam
entries: The wereape throws itself {@condition prone} in a 15 foot square. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take 28 ({@damage 8d6}) bludgeoning damage. A creature that is climbing on the wereape has disadvantage on the save, and takes maximum damage if it fails. A creature that succeeds takes half damage, but may use its reaction to move up to ten feet, taking no damage if it ends this movement outside the area of effect. The wereape can't stand from {@condition prone} this turn.

action.name: Brutal Shove {@recharge 5}
entries: Up to two creatures within 15 feet of the giant and 15 feet of each other must make a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take 20 ({@damage 3d12}) bludgeoning damage and be pushed 10 feet away. A creature may fall {@condition prone} as a reaction to gain advantage on this save.

reaction.name: Kick Away
entries: As a reaction to a creature ending its movement within 5 feet of the wereape, the wereape forces it to succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}, pushed 10 feet away, and lose {@status concentration} if it was holding it.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a Bonus Action, the werebadger can transform into a badger-humanoid hybrid, into a Large badger, or back into its humanoid form. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its humanoid form if it dies.

trait.name: Poppy Weakness
entries: If hit with a weapon coated in poppy oil, the werebadger must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be forced to revert to its humanoid form and be {@condition poisoned} for the next minute. While {@condition poisoned}, the werebadger cannot use its shapechanger trait.

trait.name: Ornery
entries: If the werebadger drops to 0 hit points, it makes a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. On a success, it gains 1 hit point. The werebadger makes this save at advantage if at least one hostile creature is adjacent to it.

trait.name: Cursed Resilience
entries: When the werebadger is reduced to 0 hit points, it does not die or fall {@condition unconscious}. Instead, it loses the ability to take actions other than to {@action Dash}. If it takes damage from a silvered weapon while at 0 hit points, it is killed.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The werebadger makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Snarling Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Scything Shovelclaws (Badger or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}10 ({@damage 3d4 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Warhammer
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) slashing damage.

reaction.name: Loosen Skin
entries: As a reaction when the werebadger would make an attack with disadvantage due to being {@condition restrained}, it instead makes an attack at advantage.

reaction.name: Relentless Assault
entries: As a reaction to a creature attempting to leave its reach, the werebadger makes a claw attack. If the attack hits, the target is {@condition grappled}.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a Bonus Action, the werebear can transform into a Large bear-humanoid hybrid, into a Large bear, or back into its humanoid form. Its statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its humanoid form if it dies.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell

trait.name: Concussive Strength
entries: A creature knocked {@condition prone} by the werebear must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be unable to stand on its following turn.

trait.name: Cursed Resilience
entries: When the werebear is reduced to 0 hit points, it does not die or fall {@condition unconscious}. Instead, it loses the ability to take actions other than to {@action Dash}. If it takes damage from a silvered weapon while at 0 hit points, it is killed.

action.name: Multiattack

The target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}) and {@condition restrained}.
The target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away and knocked {@condition prone}.
The target must succeeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or have one item it is holding knocked out of its grip and flung 10 feet away.

action.name: Tusk Gore (Boar or Hybrid Form Only)

A {@condition prone} target takes an additional 7 ({@damage 2d6}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Foaming Defiance (Boar or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: As a reaction to taking damage that would reduce it to 0 hit points, the wereboar makes a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw. On a success, the wereboar is instead reduced to 1 hit point. If triggered by piercing damage or a critical hit, this saving throw is made at disadvantage.

trait.name: Grapple Vulnerability

trait.name: Cursed Resilience

action.name: Multiattack

action.name: Vicegrip Bite (Hybrid or Crocodile Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the crocodile can't bite another target.

action.name: Khopesh (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) slashing damage and the creature gains no benefit from wielding a shield until the beginning of its next turn.

action.name: Tail Lash (Hybrid or Crocodile Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target not {@condition grappled} by the werecrocodile. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Death Roll (Crocodile Form Only, Recharge 5-6)
entries: A creature {@condition grappled} by the crocodile must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 45 ({@damage 10d8}) slashing damage and be {@condition stunned} until the end of the crocodile's next turn, or half as much damage on a success.
A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this ability loses a limb (werecrocodile's choice). The werecrocodile may not use this ability if it is {@condition grappled}.

trait.name: Shapechanger

trait.name: Quick Squeeze
entries: The wererat may move through any space larger than its skull without squeezing.

trait.name: Cursed Resilience
entries: When the wererat is reduced to 0 hit points, it does not die or fall {@condition unconscious}. Instead, it loses the ability to take actions other than to {@action Dash}. If it takes damage from a silvered weapon while at 0 hit points, it is killed.

action.name: Multiattack

action.name: Gnawing Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Scrabbling Claws (Rat or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage and the target must succeed on on a {@dc 11} Constituton saving throw or be infected with {@disease filth fever|ConfC}.

action.name: Hand Crossbow (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

walk.condition: (fly 30 ft. in raven and hybrid forms)

trait.name: Aerobat
entries: At the beginning of each other creature's turn, the wereraven may move up to 10 feet without provoking attacks of upportunity.

trait.name: Cursed Resilience
entries: When the wereraven is reduced to 0 hit points, it does not die or fall {@condition unconscious}. Instead, it loses the ability to take actions other than to {@action Dash}. If it takes damage from a silvered weapon while at 0 hit points, it is killed.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wereraven makes two attacks.

action.name: Gouging Peck (Raven or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 piercing damage in raven form, or 4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage in hybrid form.
On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constituiton saving throw or be {@condition blinded} in one eye until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

action.name: Shortsword (Human or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Hand Crossbow (Human or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Croaked Omen (1/Day)
entries: One creature within 30 feet that can hear the raven must succeed on a {@dc 12} Charisma saving throw or be {@condition cursed|confc|cursed} until it completes a Long Rest.
While cursed in this way, a creature has disadvantage on Death saving throws and on saving throws against being {@condition frightened}.

trait.name: Braille
entries: While in hybrid or snake form, the wereserpent's eyes are covered by transparent scales that protect them from harm. It has disadvantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight, and advantage on saving throws to avoid being {@condition blinded}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wereserpent makes two attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Venomous Bite (Hybrid or Snake Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Recurve Longbow (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage.

reaction.name: Crush (Hybrid or Snake Form Only)
entries: As a reaction to a creature the wereserpent has {@condition grappled} with its Constrict ability speaking or casting a spell with a verbal component, the wereserpent crushes the air out of its lungs. The creature cannot breathe until the grapple ends and immediately begins to suffocate.

action.name: Claw (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}).

action.name: Ram {@recharge 5}

If the attack hits, the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of the wereshark's next turn.

reaction.name: Circle (1/Day)
