entries: The heron collides with a creature within 5 feet, forcing it to succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Death Blow (Recharges when the heron uses its Extend Neck)
entries: The heron strikes a {@condition prone} creature with blinding speed, making a Whalebore Bill attack against it. If the attack hits, it scores a critical.

action.name: Rasped Bark (1/Day)
entries: The heron croaks out a dreadful sound. Each creature within 30 feet that can hear the heron must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the beginning of the Heron's next turn.

bonus.name: Taloned Pin
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition prone} target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}) until the heron moves.

bonus.name: Extend Neck
entries: The heron extends its neck, raising up to its full height and making a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check to detect any hidden creatures nearby.

trait.name: Ceaseless Wail
entries: At the start of each of the wheep's turns if it is not {@condition incapacitated}, each creature within 60 ft. that can hear it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or have its Wisdom score reduced by 2 ({@dice 1d4}), to a minimum of 1, until the wheep is destroyed or the creature completes a Short or Long Rest.

trait.name: Weep Black Bile
entries: When the wheep fails a saving throw, poisonous black bile gushes from its empty eye sockets and over its face and body.

Until the beginning of its next turn, a creature that hits the wheep with a melee attack must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} until the end of the wheep's next turn.

trait.name: Turning Resistance
entries: The wheep has advantage on saving throws against effects that turn undead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wheep makes two melee attacks, one of which may be with its shrieking bite.

action.name: Shrieking Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition grappled} target. {@h}7 ({@dice 2d6 + 5}) piercing plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage and the wheep latches onto the target (escape {@dc 17}).

While the wheep is latched onto a creature, its ceaseless wail ends, and the target cannot speak or breathe as a breathless, endless scream of horror tears out of it. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns or drop to 0 hit points.

action.name: Broken Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@dice 3d8 + 5}) slashing plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}).

trait.name: Desiccation Weakness
entries: Whenever the centipede takes any fire or necrotic damage, it gains a point of {@condition exhaustion}.

trait.name: Hundred-Legged Writhe
entries: The centipede ignores the effects of difficult terrain, and has advantage on attacks made against a creature that it is {@condition attached|confc|attached} to, grappling, or {@condition grappled} by.

action.name: Fleshgripper Toxicognaths
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}1 piercing damage and the centipede becomes {@condition attached|confc|attached} to the target (remove {@dc 12}) until it uses this attack again.

action.name: Excruciating Venom
entries: One creature the centipede is {@condition attached|confc|attached} to must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or take 2 ({@damage 1d4}) poison damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is {@condition stunned} until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Horrid Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny centipede.

A creature whose space the swarm enters for the first time on a turn must succeed on a {@dc 11} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}. On a successful saving throw, the creature can use its reaction to move up to half its speed.

action.name: Thrash of Mandibles
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. {@h}11 ({@damage 4d4 + 1}) piercing damage, or 6 ({@dice 2d4 + 1} ) piercing damage if the swarm has half its hit points or fewer.

action.name: Mass Envenomation
entries: One creature in the swarm's space must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Poison damage, or half as much if the swarm has half its hit points or fewer.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is {@condition stunned} until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Skittering Clutch
entries: When a Medium or larger creature leaves the swarm's space, the swarm can force it to succeed on a {@dc 11} Strength saving throw or have the swarm become {@condition attached|confc|attached} to it (remove {@dc 11}) until the beginning of the swarm's next turn.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The demon can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Spectral Weapons
entries: The demon's attacks treat all creatures as unarmored (an unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier.)

action.name: Multitattack
entries: The demon makes two attacks with its maddening touch and uses its whispers of madness, if available.

action.name: Maddening Touch
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 4d6 + 2}) psychic damage and the target's Wisdom is reduced by 2 ({@dice 1d4}) until it completes a short or long rest. A creature reduced to 0 Wisdom in this way becomes hostile to all living creatures, including itself, until it recovers.

action.name: Whispers of Madness {@recharge 5}
entries: Each non-fiend, non-undead creature within 30 ft. must make a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature uses its reaction to move up to make a melee attack against a living creature in range.

action.name: Create Allip
entries: One {@condition unconscious} humanoid creature within 10 ft. of the demon must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or make a melee attack against itself. If the attack hits, the creature dies and rises as an allip at the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Shadow Glide (Dim Light Only)
entries: As a reaction to taking damage of a type it is resistant to, the wraith may teleport up to 60 feet and turn {@condition invisible} until the end of its next turn, or until it makes an attack.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

trait.name: Devil's Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the abishai's {@sense darkvision}.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The abishai has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Numbing Chill
entries: A creature that is not cold resistant and starts its turn within 10 ft. of the abishai has its speed reduced by 10 ft.

trait.name: Reckless
entries: At the start of its turn, the abishai can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The abishai makes two attacks: one with its longsword and one with its claw.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) slashing damage. If the target is a medium or smaller creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) cold damage. This attack deals an additional 10 ({@damage 3d6}) damage to a {@condition prone} creature.

reaction.name: Dragonspawn Exhultation
entries: As a reaction to a friendly dragon within 30 ft. using its breath weapon, the abishai may move up to half its speed and make a bite attack.

reaction.name: Tyrant's Strike
entries: As a reaction to a creature standing from {@condition prone} within 5 ft. of it, the abishai makes a claw attack against it.

trait.name: Tundraborn
entries: The dragon ignores negative effects from moving over terrain composed of ice or snow, and has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition blinded}.

trait.name: Heavy Chill
entries: A creature that begins its turn within 10 feet of the dragon has disadvantage on each attack it makes on its turn beyond the first, unless it is resistant or immune to cold damage.
A creature can lose one unexpended hit die to ignore this effect until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Frostblessed Resistance (1/Day)
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw against an effect that does not deal fire damage, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three attacks, one of which can be with its Bitter Bite.

action.name: Bitter Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@dice 2d10 + 5}) piercing plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) cold damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}).
A creature {@condition grappled} in this way has disadvantage on saving throws against the dragon's Winterglass Breath.

action.name: Barbed Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) slashing damage.
If the target is Large or smaller, the dragon can knock the target {@condition prone} instead of dealing damage.

action.name: Winterglass Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon exhales an icy blast in a 30-foot cone, covering the area in ice and forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or take 31 ({@damage 7d8}) cold damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 10 or more contracts Frostbite.
A creature that moves more than 10 feet through the area in a turn must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Sudden Pounce
entries: When a creature the dragon can see within 60 feet moves at least 15 feet away from it or fails an attempt to {@action Hide} from it, the dragon can leap up to 60 feet directly toward the creature and make a Barbed Claw attack against it.

reaction.name: Roar of Triumph
entries: When the dragon reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack, it can let out a terrifying roar.
Each creature within 30 feet that can hear it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Terrorize
entries: One creature the dragon can see within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or use its reaction to move its speed directly away from the dragon, or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) psychic damage if it can't.

legendary.name: Ice Tomb
entries: The dragon breathes a layer of dense, translucent ice that encrusts a {@condition prone} creature within 10 feet, forcing it to succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or gain 15 temporary hit points, or half as many on a success.

A creature that has any of these temporary hit points is {@condition restrained} and loses two unexpended hit dice at the end of each of its turns, or gains a point of {@condition exhaustion} if it can't.

trait.name: Tundraborn
entries: The dragon ignores negative effects from moving over terrain composed of ice or snow, and has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition blinded}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes two attacks, one of which can be with its Bitter Bite.

action.name: Bitter Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@dice 1d10 + 3}) piercing plus 2 ({@damage 1d4}) cold damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}).
A creature {@condition grappled} in this way has disadvantage on saving throws against the dragon's Winterglass Breath.

action.name: Barbed Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Winterglass Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon exhales an icy blast in a 30-foot cone, covering the area in ice and forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 5d8}) cold damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 10 or more contracts Frostbite.
A creature that moves more than 10 feet through the area in a turn must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Roar of Triumph
entries: When the dragon reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack, it can let out a terrifying roar.
Each creature within 30 feet that can hear it must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Tundraborn
entries: The dragon ignores negative effects from moving over terrain composed of ice or snow, and has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition blinded}.

action.name: Bitter Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@dice 1d10 + 2}) piercing plus 2 ({@damage 1d4}) cold damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}).
A creature {@condition grappled} in this way has disadvantage on saving throws against the dragon's Freezing Breath.

action.name: Freezing Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon exhales an icy blast in a 15-foot cone, covering the area in ice and forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 5d8}) cold damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 10 or more contracts Frostbite.
A creature that moves more than 10 feet through the area in a turn must succeed on a {@dc 11} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Roar of Triumph (1/Day)
entries: When the dragon reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack, it can let out a terrifying roar.
Each creature within 30 feet that can hear it must succeed on a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Blood Scent
entries: The drake can pinpoint, by scent, the location of any creature within 120 ft. that does not have all of its hit points.

trait.name: Dweomer Chill
entries: A creature that casts a spell within 15 feet of the drake takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) cold damage per level of the spell. A creature that starts its turn in the area while {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell must make a Concentration check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The drake attacks twice, once with its bite and once with its tail.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage and 4 ({@damage 1d8}) cold damage. Instead of dealing damage, the drake can grapple the target (escape {@dc 13}).

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 ft. away.

action.name: Worry
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by both the drake and at least one of the drake's allies must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or take 28 ({@damage 8d6}) piercing damage, or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Bluff Strike
entries: As a reaction to a creature entering the drake's reach, it may force the creature to succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be forced to immediately move 10 ft. away from the drake, if it can.

trait.name: Ocean Camouflage
entries: The shark can attempt to hide without obscurement while in open water.

trait.name: Test Bite
entries: If the shark starts its turn with no hostile creatures within 5 ft. of it, it may {@action Dash} or {@action Disengage} as a bonus action this turn.

trait.name: Blood Frenzy
entries: The shark has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

trait.name: Electrosensitive
entries: If the shark takes lightning damage, it has disadvantage on attacks on its following turn.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) piercing damage and the target begins to bleed. At the beginning of each of its turns, the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or lose 2 ({@dice 1d4}) hit points, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: Ram {@recharge 5}
entries: The shark moves at least 20 feet in a straight line towards a creature that does not have all its hit points and makes a bite attack against it. If the attack hits, the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of the shark's next turn.

trait.name: Rootspeech
entries: While in its home forest, the treant knows the number, type, and approximate location of each creature within 10 miles of it.

trait.name: Flammable Crown
entries: If the treant takes 20 or more fire damage from a source that could reach its lower canopy (40 feet above the ground), it begins {@condition burning|confc|burning} ({@dice 1d10}). If the treant was already {@condition burning|confc|burning}, the {@condition burning|confc|burning} damage increases by {@dice 1d10}.
While it is {@condition burning|confc|burning}, attacks against the treant are made at advantage, and the treant's melee attacks deal an additional 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage.

trait.name: Bark Titan
entries: A creature adjacent to the treant may spend half its movmeent to attempt a {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check, climbing 15 feet up the treant on a success.
While climbing on the treant at least 40 feet above the ground, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the treant, and the treant can't target the creature with its Timber Stomp.

trait.name: Strength of Ages
entries: If the treant fails a saving throw against any effect that would inapacitate it, immobilize it, alter its form, or reduce its speed, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The treant makes two attacks with its Timber Stomp, each of which it may replace with a use of its Drop Widowmaker.

action.name: Timber Stomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}25 ({@damage 4d8 + 7}) bludgeoning damage, plus an additional 9 ({@damage 2d8}) bludgeoning damage if the target was {@condition prone}.
On a hit or miss, the target and each other creature within 10 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Drop Widowmaker
entries: The treant drops an enormous seedcone from one of its high branches.
One creature within 20 feet of the treant must succeed on a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw or take 28 ({@damage 8d6}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Sonorous Growth (Concentration) {@recharge}
entries: The treant begins a slow and groaning chant in old treeish. When the treant uses this ability and at the beginning of each of its turns for the next minute, it may cause a size Huge nonmagical tree to burst from the earth at a point it can see within 120 feet.
Each creature in the tree's space is pushed 80 feet into the air, then may make a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw to catch hold of the tree's canopy and avoid falling.

bonus.name: Crumple Iron
entries: One creature wearing nonmagical metal armor that the treant hit with two Timber Stomp attacks this turn must make a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw.
On a failed save, the creature's armor takes a permanent and cumulative penalty to the AC it offers equal to amount the creature failed by. Armor reduced to an AC of 10 in this way is destroyed.

bonus.name: Tear Stone
entries: The treant smashes through a barrier of nonmagical stone or softer material of up to 15 feet thick.
Each creature on the other side of the barrier within 20 feet of the treant takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) bludgeoning damage.

bonus.name: Chittering Throng
entries: A mass of angry squirrels swarms over the treant's branches, forcing each creature climbing on the treant to succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or fall off.

reaction.name: The Boughs Shake
entries: When the treant takes 15 or more damage from a single source, it can use its Drop Widowmaker.

monster.name: Wight

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

languages: The languages it knew in life

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the wight has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight. A wight that takes radiant damage can't use its Life Drain on its following turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wight makes two attacks with its longsword or longbow, one of which it may replace with a use of its Life Drain.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d10 + 2}) slashing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Life Drain
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be forced to expend two of its hit dice. If the creature can't, it instead drops to 0 hit points.
A humanoid slain by this attack rises on the wight's next turn as a zombie under the wight's control. The wight can have no more than twelve zombies under its control at one time.

trait.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries: As long as it wields its shield, the rider is unaffected by spells of 2nd level or below. Whenever it negates a spell in this way, the next attack roll against the rider has advantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The rider makes two attacks; one with its crushing maul and one with its shield bash. If it doesn't have its shield, it instead makes three attacks with its maul.

action.name: Crushing Maul
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@dice 2d12 + 4}) bludgeoning plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) radiant damage.

action.name: Shield Bash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away.

action.name: Ponderous Strike {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature in a 10-foot cube originating from the rider must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 39 ({@damage 6d12}) bludgeoning damage. Until the end of its next turn, attacks against the rider are made at advantage.

reaction.name: Vengeful Smash
entries: As a reaction to a creature missing it with a melee attack, the rider makes an attack with its Shield Bash. If it hits, the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of the rider's next turn.

reaction.name: Flickering Rampage (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 95 hit points, the rider hurls its shield at a creature within 20 feet. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 4d10}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.
For the next minute, whenever the rider makes an attack it may teleport up to 15 feet as part of the attack, and it loses all damage resistances and its Limited Magic Immunity.

trait.name: Dread Revels
entries: The rider has advantage on attack rolls against creatures that are {@condition frightened}.

action.name: Clutch of Terror
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}55 ({@damage 10d10}) necrotic damage and the target is dragged up to 15 feet toward the rider, then must make a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} for the next minute.

If a creature is reduced to 0 hit points by this damage and fails the save, it immediately regains one hit point and acts under the rider's control for as long as it remains {@condition frightened}. A creature may repeat this save at the end of its turn, ending the effect on a success.

bonus.name: Steal Away
entries: The rider ends one spell of 3rd level or below affecting a friendly creature, or duplicates a spell affecting an enemy it can see, choosing new targets for the spell.

reaction.name: Echoing Chuckle
entries: As a reaction when the rider succeeds on a saving throw, the rider teleports up to 60 feet. Each creature within 5 feet of the space it teleports to must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of the rider's next turn.

reaction.name: Fade Away
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 85 hit points, the rider becomes insubstantial while it is in dim light or darkness for the next minute. While in this misty state, attacks against the rider are made at disadvantage.

trait.name: Never There
entries: When the rider succeeds on a saving throw made against a spell or magical effect that allows it to make a saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The rider has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The rider casts Slithermist and uses one of its Moon Virtues. If its Mist Reflections trait is active, it instead uses a number of Moon Virtues equal to its current number of Mist Reflections.

action.name: Slithermist (4th Level Spell)
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 8} to hit, ranged 60 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 6d6}) necrotic damage and the rider may make another attack against a creature within 15 feet of the previous target. A creature may be the target of this spell only once per turn.

action.name: Moon Virtues
entries: The rider targets a creature it can see within 60 feet, choosing one of the following effects:

items.name: Confounding Lurch
entries: The creature must succeed on a {@dc 16} Charisma saving throw or be teleported up to 30 feet.

items.name: Hazy Transposition
entries: One target creature within 60 feet must make a {@dc 16} Charisma saving throw or switch positions with one of the rider's Mist Reflections.

items.name: Shifting Silhouettes
entries: A stark silver light reduces everyone to shadowy silhouettes for the creature. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 16} Intelligence saving throw or treat all creatures as hostile until the end of the rider's next turn.

items.name: Treacherous Footing
entries: The creature must succeed on {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 18}) until the end of the rider's next turn as the ground beneath it becomes briefly insubstantial.

items.name: Moonstruck
entries: The creature must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be disoriented by the dancing moonlight, suffering disadvantage on its next attack roll. If the attack misses, the creature falls {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Vaporize
entries: As a reaction to being hit with a ranged attack, the rider reduces the projectile to wisps of vapor, reducing the attack's damage to 0.

reaction.name: Mist Reflections (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 55 hit points, the rider gains 55 temporary hit points, splits into five Mist Reflections that each appear at an unoccupied location within 60 feet, and gains resistance to all damage as long as it has at least two Mist Forms.

A Mist Reflection dissipates when it is dealt damage, and when only one remeains it becomes corporeal and this effect ends. If all remaining Mist Reflections are dealt damage simultaneously, the rider is slain.

trait.name: Duck and Leap
entries: When the guanghan takes the {@action Dodge} action, it may jump up to 10 feet whenever it is missed with a melee attack.

trait.name: Courtly Grace
entries: If the guanghan would make a Dexterity saving throw, it may choose to instead make a Charisma ({@skill Performance}) check against the same DC.

action.name: Humbling Wind
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d4} bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or be pushed 5 feet away and knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Imperious Demand
entries: Wild Swan brashly expresses a command. Up to one friendly creature within 30 feet that can hear her may use its reaction to move up to its speed or make a melee attack.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks with weapons that aren't named

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The wisp can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Variable Illumination
entries: The wisp sheds bright light in a 5- to 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional number of feet equal to the chosen radius. The will-o'-wisp can alter the radius as a Bonus Action.

action.name: Lure
entries: One creature that can see the wisp must succeed a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by the wisp until the end of the wisp's next turn. While {@condition charmed} in this way, a creature must use all of its movement to approach the wisp.

action.name: Borrow Life
entries: One creature within 5 feet of the wisp that has 0 hit points must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or die. If the target dies, the will-o'-wisp creates another will-o'-wisp in the creature's space.
If the created wisp dies within the next minute, the creature it was created from returns to life with 1 hit point.

action.name: Invisibility (Concentration)
entries: The wisp and its light magically become {@condition invisible} until it attacks or uses its Borrow Life.

reaction.name: Blink Out

action.name: Worry

reaction.name: Drag Down

At the beginning of the elf's next turn, the corpse is destroyed as a {@creature vine blight|confc|Vine Blight} bursts forth from it, acting on the elf's turn and under its control.

reaction.name: Enrich the Soil
entries: As a reaction when a creature the elf can see within 30 feet falls {@condition prone}, the elf forces it to make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw.
On a failed save, the creature loses 5 ({@dice 2d4}) hit points and each plant creature within 30 feet gains advantage on the first attack it makes on its following turn.

trait.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: The elf has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed}, and magic can't put the elf to sleep.

action.name: Lacquered Blade

On a roll of 1 against a target wearing metal armor, the blade snaps, reducing the damage it deals by {@dice 2d6}.

{@action opportunity attack||Attacks of opportunity} provoked by this movement are made at disadvantage.

reaction.name: Skydrop Strike
entries: As a reaction when its mount flies over a creature, the wood elf drops from its mount and makes a melee attack at advantage.
If the attack hits, the elf takes no fall damage, and the target takes any fall damage the elf would have otherwise taken, to a maximum of {@dice 4d6}.

action.name: Grow Arrow
entries: The next attack the elf makes with its Lorekeeper Greatbow in the next minute gains one additional effect on a hit of the elf's choice:

items.name: Moonglove Resin
entries: The target takes an additional 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage.

items.name: Bramble Trail
entries: The target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} as brambles wrap around it (escape {@dc 15}). While {@condition restrained}, the creature takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) piercing damage at the end of each of its turns.

items.name: Alarm Pheremone

trait.name: Ancestral Memory
entries: The wood woad remembers each wrong and trespass its home forest has ever suffered. It can recognize those who have wronged the forest and their descendants, but has difficulty distinguishing between the two.

trait.name: Tree Stride
entries: Once on its turn, the wood wad can use 10 feet of her movement to step magically into one living tree within her reach and emerge from a second living tree within 60 feet of the first tree, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the second tree. Both trees must be Large or bigger.

trait.name: Nourishing Roots
entries: If the wood woad ends its turn without spending more than half of its movement, it gains 10 temporary hit points.

trait.name: Wooden Body
entries: If the wood woad takes fire damage, it catches fire. Until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the wood woad takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wood woad makes two attacks with its cudgel, one of which it may replace with a use of its {@skill Nature}'s Judgement, if available.

action.name: Cudgel
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d4 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Nature's Judgement (Concentration, Recharge 5-6)
entries: One humanoid creature within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} for the next minute. A creature proficient in {@skill Nature} checks makes this save at advantage.

While {@condition restrained}, the creature takes 5 ({@damage 2d4}) piercing damage at the start of each of its turns, and the nearest Fey or Plant creature friendly to the wood woad recovers the same amount of hit points. A creature can repeat this save as an action, ending the effect on a success.

trait.name: Pounce
entries: If the worg moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. If the target is {@condition prone}, the worg can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

trait.name: Baying Pack
entries: A group of three or more worgs has disadvantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) piercing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the worg can grapple the target (escape {@dc 13}).

action.name: Worry
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by both the worg and at least one of the worg's allies must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or take 17 ({@damage 5d6}) piercing damage, or half as much on a success.

trait.name: Worm-Bonded
entries: The worm-shadow is bonded to a golothoma, granting it the following traits:

The worm-shadow is {@condition attached|confc|attached} to its golothoma and cannot move or be moved more than 5 feet away from it. If the worm-shadow starts its turn more than 5 feet away from the golothoma, it teleports to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the golothoma and takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) force damage.
While in Dim Light or Darkness, the worm-shadow may move any distance at any time with no action required.
Whenever the worm-shadow would take any non-radiant damage, it may have the golothoma take that damage in its stead.

trait.name: Ephemeral Presence
entries: The worm-shadow can move through and occupy the space of other creatures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The worm-shadow makes two attacks with its Shadow Barbs.

action.name: Shadow Barbs
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d6 + 7}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Shadow Feeding
entries: Thrashing umbral spines lash upward from the worm-shadow.
Each creature of its choice within 5 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) piercing damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Corpse Consumption
entries: Each corpse in the worm-shadow's space slips into it and is devoured utterly. The worm-shadow and its golothoma (if still alive) each regain 10 hit points for each corpse consumed in this way.
If the worm-shadow devours its golothoma in this way, it regains all of its hit points and loses its Worm-Bonded trait.

monster.name: Wretch of Kyuss
languages: understands all languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Minion
entries: If the wretch takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, its hit points are reduced to 0. If the wretch takes damage from another effect, it dies if the damage equals or exceeds its hit point maximum, otherwise it takes no damage.

trait.name: Worm-Riddled
entries: If the wretch is targeted by an effect that cures disease or removes a curse, it dies.

trait.name: Tortured Cries
entries: The wretch screams raggedly and calls for help as it attacks. A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of 3 or more wretches that can hear them must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened}.

action.name: Frantic Clawing (Group Attack)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 slashing damage.

reaction.name: Wretched Plea
entries: When the wretch is targeted with a melee attack by a creature within 5 feet, it can allow the attack to hit it without a roll.
The attacker must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or be infected with the {@disease touch of kyuss|ConfC}.

trait.name: Unequaled Cruelty
entries: When the black dragon reduces a creature to 0 hit points, each {@condition frightened} creature that can see it must use its reaction, if available, to move its speed directly away from it.

trait.name: Sensitivity Aura
entries: Attacks against creatures within 15 feet of the dragon that do not have resistance or immunity to acid damage score a critical on an 18-20.

trait.name: Bloodbathed Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw while a{@condition bleeding|confc|bleeding} or {@condition unconscious} creature is within 30 feet of it, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three attacks, one of which can be with its Steelrot Bite, and uses its Frightful Presence.

action.name: Steelrot Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@dice 2d10 + 9}) piercing plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) acid damage.
On a critical hit, one weapon or piece of armor of Rare or lesser rarity that the target is wearing or wielding is destroyed (target's choice).

action.name: Subduing Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d6 + 9}) slashing damage.
Instead of dealing damage, the dragon can knock the target {@condition prone} and grapple it (escape {@dc 24}).

action.name: Tailbarb Stab
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d6 + 9}) piercing damage and the target begins {@condition bleeding|confc|bleeding} ({@dice 1d10}).
Any hit against a {@condition prone} creature with this attack becomes a critical.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of the dragon's choice within 120 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the beginning of the dragon's next turn, becoming immune to this effect for the next 24 hours on a success.

action.name: Hacked-Tar Sputum (Recharges when the dragon uses its Flesh-Melting Breath)
entries: The dragon hacks up a glob of spent acid and dead flesh at a point it can see within 120 feet, where it splashes in a 15 foot radius, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a {@dc 23} Dexterity saving throw or be drenched in sticky sludge (remove {@dc 23}).

A sludge-drenched creature is {@condition blinded}, has its movement reduced by half, and is protected from decay if it dies, extending the time limit of effects that would raise the target from the dead by up to a year.

action.name: Flesh-Melting Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon spews a jet of caustic acid in a 120-foot long, 10-foot wide line, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a {@dc 23} Dexterity saving throw or take 81 ({@damage 18d8}) acid damage, or half as much damage on a success.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more suffers a Vitriolic Disfigurement until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic. A creature killed by this damage disintegrates.

reaction.name: Bloodied Breath (1/Day
entries: When the dragon is reduced below 278 hit points, it can roll to recharge its Flesh-Melting Breath, then immediately use it, if available.

reaction.name: Cruel Jest
entries: When a creature smaller than the dragon leaves its reach, the dragon can force it to make a {@dc 24} Dexterity saving throw.
On a failure, the target is dragged up to 10 feet toward the dragon and the dragon regains its reaction.

legendary.name: Mire Dive
entries: The dragon moves up to half its speed. If it ends this movement submerged in murky water, it can attempt to {@action Hide}.

legendary.name: Drooling Torment
entries: Acid drips from the dragon's jaws toward a creature {@condition grappled} by it, dealing 18 ({@damage 4d8}) acid damage to the creature.
The target can use its reaction to attempt to escape the grapple, avoiding the damage on a success.

legendary.name: Peel Nerve
entries: The dragon makes a Subduing Claw attack.
If this attack hits a creature {@condition grappled} by the dragon, the target has one spell affect on it end, or gains vulnerability to acid damage until it regains any hit points if it cannot.

trait.name: Skyfire Splendor
entries: While the dragon is flying, it has advantage on Dexterity saving throws and {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity} made against it have disadvantage.

trait.name: Rising Charge
entries: When the dragon rolls to recharge its Scourgebolt Breath, each creature within 15 feet of it takes lightning damage equal to twice the number rolled.

trait.name: Reserved Resistance (4/Day)
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. Its save DCs are reduced by 1 for each expended use of this ability.

action.name: Multiattack

action.name: Sparking Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 18} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 2d10 + 10}) piercing damage plus 16 ({@damage 4d6}) lightning damage.

action.name: Sandhoned Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 18} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d6 + 10}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 26}).

action.name: Ridgetail Sweep
entries: The dragon sweeps its tail in a 20 foot cone, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a {@dc 26} Dexterity saving throw or take 24 ({@damage 7d6}) bludgeoning damage and be pushed up to 20 feet away from the dragon, or take half as much damage and be pushed up to 10 feet on a success.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of the dragon's choice within 120 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 22} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the beginning of the dragon's next turn, becoming immune to this effect for the next 24 hours on a success.

action.name: Shattered Heavens Roar (Concentration)
entries: The dragon roars a challenge to the sky above, carving a rift through which boiling thunderclouds spill.
At the beginning of the dragon's next turn, a cascade of lightning bolts arc down, striking up to four creatures the dragon can see within 120 feet that are not beneath full cover.
Each target must succeed on a {@dc 22} Dexterity saving throw or take 49 ({@damage 9d10}) lightning damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Scourgebolt Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: A stream of crackling energy issues forth from the dragon's mouth in a 120 foot long, 10 foot wide line, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a {@dc 25} Dexterity saving throw or take 99 ({@damage 18d10}) lightning damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is {@condition paralyzed} until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Battle of Wits
entries: When the dragon is targeted with a ranged attack by a creature it can see, it can throw a creature {@condition grappled} by it up to 15 feet into the attack's path.
The attacker must succeed on a contested Intelligence ({@skill Insight}) check against the dragon or have its attack instead target the thrown creature.

reaction.name: Bloodied Breath (1/Day
entries: When the dragon is reduced below 278 hit points, it can roll to recharge its Scourgebolt Breath, then immediately use it, if available.

legendary.name: Sand Dive
entries: The dragon moves up to half its burrow speed. Then, if it started this movement submerged in earth, it can make a Sandhoned Claw attack.

legendary.name: Wither
entries: The dragon inhales, draining the moisture from a creature {@condition grappled} by it. The creature takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) necrotic damage, and each potion and other liquid the target is carrying turns to dust until rehydrated.

legendary.name: Ridgetail Sweep (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon uses its Ridgetail Sweep.

legendary.name: Skyfury Drop (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon flies up to half its fly speed, then can drop up to 60 feet into an unoccupied space.

If it does, each other creature within 15 feet is pushed up to 15 feet away and must succeed on a {@dc 26} Dexterity saving throw or take 3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage for each 5 feet the dragon descended.

trait.name: Forestborn
entries: The dragon's movement is not impeded by natural or magical foliage, and while in a wooded area can attempt to {@action Hide} while only Lightly Obscured.

trait.name: Slithering Shadow
entries: The first time each turn that the dragon is missed with an attack, it can move up to 10 feet without provoking {@action opportunity attack||opportunity attacks}.

trait.name: Poison Wounds
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 15 feet of the dragon takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage, or 14 ({@dice 4d6}) if the creature has fewer than half its hit points.

trait.name: Greenleech Resistance (4/Day)
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, plants within 30 feet of it wither and shrivel away.

action.name: Multiattack

Until the dragon uses this ability again, the area is difficult terrain, and a creature that moves into or within the area takes 18 ({@damage 4d8}) piercing damage for every 5 feet it travels.

action.name: Lungripper Miasma Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon exhales a poisonous cloud in a 120-foot cone.
Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 23} Constitution saving throw or take 84 ({@damage 24d6}) poison damage, or half as much damage on a success.
A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is {@condition blinded} and {@condition choking|confc|choking} until the end of the dragon's next turn.

reaction.name: Adapt Camouflage
entries: When a creature more than 30 feet from the dragon hits it with a ranged attack, it can alter its patterning to match its surroundings.
Until it moves, the dragon becomes {@condition invisible} to creatures more than 30 feet away from it.

reaction.name: Vindictive Snap
entries: When a creature affected by the green dragon's Lungripper Miasma Breath takes fewer than 43 damage from it, the dragon can move up to 30 feet toward the creature and make a Venomtongue Bite attack against it.

reaction.name: Bloodied Breath (1/Day
entries: When the dragon is reduced below 265 hit points, it can roll to recharge its Lungripper Miasma Breath, then immediately use it, if available.

legendary.name: Spit Venom
entries: The dragon spits a gob of concentrated venom at a creature it can see within 30 feet, forcing it to succeed on a {@dc 23} Constitution saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Poison damage and be {@condition blinded} until it clears its eyes as a Bonus Action.

legendary.name: Silent Snatch
entries: The dragon moves up to 30 feet, then can grapple one creature (escape {@dc 24}) it is hidden from and force it to make a {@dc 24} Constitution saving throw.
On a failure, the target is {@condition stunned} and hidden from its allies until the beginning of the dragon's next turn, and the dragon remains hidden from each other creature.

legendary.name: Slink Away (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon moves up to 30 feet. If it ends this movement at least 30 feet from any hostile creature, it may immediately attempt to {@action Hide}.

trait.name: Vainglorious Strength

If the dragon fails a Strength saving throw, it has disadvantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws for the next minute.

trait.name: Whorlflare Landing
entries: The first time each turn that the dragon lands on a solid surface after descending at least 20 feet, each creature within 20 feet of it is pushed up to 10 feet away and begins {@condition burning|confc|burning} ({@dice 1d10}).

trait.name: Flamegorge Resistance (4/Day)

action.name: Phalanx-Tail Sweep
entries: The dragon sweeps its tail in a 20 foot cone, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a {@dc 26} Dexterity saving throw or take 24 ({@damage 7d6}) bludgeoning damage and be pushed up to 20 feet away from the dragon, or take half as much damage and be pushed half as far success.

action.name: Slagflame Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon exhales rippling flames in a 120-foot cone, turning each surface in the area to molten slag.

For the next minute, the ground in the area becomes difficult terrain, and a creature that ends its turn on the ground in the area takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Stoke Malice (1/Day)
entries: The dragon breathes evil life into an an area of slag or magma within 90 feet, creating three {@creature magmin pyroclast|confc|Magmin Pyroclasts} that emerge from the ground into unoccupied spaces in the area.

reaction.name: Billowing Wings
entries: When the dragon takes 30 or more damage from a single source, it may shroud itself in smoke, heavily obscuring the area in a 40 foot radius until the end of its next turn, then immediately move up to half its speed.

reaction.name: Bloodied Breath (1/Day.)
entries: When the dragon is reduced below 313 hit points, it can roll to recharge its Slagflame Breath, then immediately use it, if available.

legendary.name: Lunging Swipe

legendary.name: Leaping Flames

The creature must succeed on a {@dc 23} Dexterity saving throw or take 16 ({@damage 3d10}) fire damage and begin {@condition burning|confc|burning} ({@dice 1d10}).

legendary.name: Burn Away

trait.name: Tundraborn
entries: The dragon ignores negative effects from moving over terrain composed of ice or snow, and has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition blinded}.

trait.name: Heavy Chill
entries: A creature that begins its turn within 30 feet of the dragon has disadvantage on each attack it makes on its turn beyond the first, unless it is resistant or immune to cold damage.
A creature can lose one unexpended hit die to ignore this effect until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Frostblessed Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw against an effect that does not deal fire damage, it can choose to succeed instead.

entries: Up to three gnolls within 60 feet may each use their reaction to move up to their speed toward a creature of Yeenoghu's choice without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

legendary.name: Wake Bones
entries: One friendly gnoll within 60 feet becomes suffused with negative energy, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) necrotic damage. If the target dies in the next minute, its flesh sloughs off and it immediately rises as a

trait.name: Smoke Torpor
entries: If the wasp starts its turn in a cloud of smoke or similar vapor, its speed is reduced by half and it is {@condition incapacitated} until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Apiphobia Aura
entries: A creature that starts its turn in the wasp's space must succeed on a {@dc 9} Wisdom saving throw or immediately use all of its movement to move directly away from the wasp.
If this movement is arrested by a solid object or surface, the creature falls {@condition prone} and ends its turn.

action.name: Vespid Sting
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature. {@h}1 poison damage.
If this damage causes the target to make a saving throw to maintain {@status concentration}, the creature makes it with disadvantage.

reaction.name: Diminutive Dodge
entries: When the wasp is missed with an attack, it can cause the attack to target another creature in the wasp's space, using the same attack roll.

reaction.name: Pheromonal Alarm
entries: When the wasp is reduced to 0 hit points by a melee attack, it may cover the attacker in a fine pheromonal mist.
Until the target takes a Short Rest to clean itself, each wasp within 500 feet of it can pinpoint its location by scent.

monster.name: Yeth Hound

immune.note: from nonmagical attacks not made with silvered weapons

languages: Elvish and Sylvan but can't speak

trait.name: Beasts of Nightmare
entries: A {@condition frightened} creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of one or more yeth hounds has its speed reduced by half until the beginning of its next turn.
A creature affected by this ability that Dashes must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Banished by Sunlight
entries: If the hound ends its turn in sunlight, it dissolves into smoke and dies.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hound makes two attacks with its Heel Snap, one of which it may replace with a use of its Ghastly Baying, if available.

action.name: Heel Snap
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition frightened} target. {@h}14 ({@damage 4d6}) psychic damage.
A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or suffer a failed saving throw.

action.name: Ghastly Baying {@recharge 5}
entries: The hound lets out a shrieking, exultant howl. Each enemy within 300 feet that can hear the hound must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of the hound's next turn.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more must use its action to {@action Dash} on its following turn.

reaction.name: Sooted Slip
entries: When the yeth hound is targeted with a spell that targets only it, it can turn briefly to smoke, making a contested Dexterity check against the spell's caster. On a success, the spell passes through it without effect.

trait.name: Frostsquall Herald
entries: The yeti is engulfed in a permanent snowstorm. Creatures within 50 miles of the yeti treat any distance greater than 15 feet away as Heavily Obscured.

trait.name: Heat-Strained
entries: If the yeti takes 10 or more fire damage from a single source, attacks against it are made with advantage until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Snow-Dweller
entries: The yeti has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in snowy terrain, and can see in areas Heavily Obscured due to falling snow as though they were Lightly Obscured.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the yeti may spend half of its movement to attempt a {@dc 20} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the yet. While climbing on the yeti, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the yeti, and the yeti has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

trait.name: Implacable
entries: If the yeti fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. If it does, it loses 25 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The yeti makes three attacks with its Crushing Grasp, one of which it may replace with a use of its Flash-Freeze Gaze.

action.name: Crushing Grasp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d8 + 7}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 20}).
A creature already {@condition grappled} in this way takes an additional 9 ({@damage 2d8}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Flash-Freeze Gaze
entries: One creature the yeti can see within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) cold damage, then gain an equal number of temporary hit points as it is encased in a shell of ice.

While a creature has any of these temporary hit points, it is {@condition paralyzed}. A creature freed from this effect by bludgeoning damage immediately takes 14 ({@dice 4d6}) additional slashing damage.

action.name: Frigid Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The yeti exhales a 30-foot cone of frigid air. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw, taking 21 ({@dice 6d6}) cold plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) thunder damage on a failed save, or take half as much damage on a success.
Additionally, the area becomes difficult terrain as spines of jagged ice grow forth. A creature that moves into or within the area takes 5 ({@damage 2d4}) piercing damage for every 5 feet it travels.

reaction.name: Freezing Howl
entries: As a reaction when a creature climbing on the yeti hits it with an attack, the yeti howls furiously.
The attacker must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or take 9 ({@dice 2d8}) cold plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) thunder damage and be {@condition stunned} until the end of the yeti's next turn.
The yeti does not roll to recharge its frigid breath on its following turn.

reaction.name: Invoke Avalanche (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 50 hit points, the yeti falls {@condition prone} and begins to pound the earth, screaming with wild fury.
At the beginning of its next turn, if the yeti is not {@condition incapacitated} an avalanche begins to slide down the nearest slope.

variant.name: Design Note: Invoke Avalanche
entries: The Invoke Avalanche ability is likely to deal between 30-80 damage to each PC that doesn't have a high Strength score or magical tools to evade or otherwise defend against it.

If necessary, you can soften the effect by calling for fewer saving throws against the Powder torrent and by skipping the Tumbling Slabs, thus modeling a smaller avalanche than the one described below.

trait.name: Heat Intolerance
entries: If the yeti takes any fire damage, it must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or gain a level of {@condition exhaustion}.

trait.name: Snow-Dweller
entries: The yeti has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in snowy terrain, and can see in areas Heavily Obscured due to falling snow as though they were Lightly Obscured.

trait.name: Shrine-Watcher
entries: The yeti may cast any cleric or paladin spell of 3rd level or below that it saw another creature cast since the end of its last turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The yeti makes three attacks with its Crushing Grasp, one of which it may replace with the {@action Hide} action or its Chilling Gaze, if available.

action.name: Crushing Grasp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}).
A creature already {@condition grappled} in this way takes an additional 4 ({@damage 1d8}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Chilling Gaze
entries: One creature the yeti can see within 40 feet must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) cold damage, then gain an equal number of temporary hit points as a crust of ice crawls over it.

While a creature has any of these temporary hit points, it is {@condition restrained}. A creature freed from this effect by bludgeoning damage immediately takes 10 ({@dice 3d6}) additional slashing damage.

action.name: Spiritrend Screech {@recharge 5}
entries: The yeti calls out a deafening screech that reverberates across the ethereal plane. Each creature within 15 feet must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or take 9 ({@dice 2d8}) thunder plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) psychic damage and be pushed up to 10 feet away.
Incorporeal undead creatures have disadvantage on this saving throw, and take maximum damage on a failed save.

trait.name: Heat Intolerance
entries: If the yeti takes any fire damage, it must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or gain a level of {@condition exhaustion}.

trait.name: Snow-Dweller
entries: The yeti has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in snowy terrain, and can see in areas Heavily Obscured due to falling snow as though they were Lightly Obscured.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The yeti makes two attacks with its Frostbreaker Fist and uses its Chilling Gaze, if available.

action.name: Frostbreaker Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.
Instead of dealing damage, the yeti may grapple the target (escape {@dc 14}).

action.name: Chilling Gaze (Recharges when the yeti takes the Hide action)
entries: One creature the yeti can see within 40 feet must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) cold damage, then gain an equal number of temporary hit points as a crust of ice crawls over it.

While a creature has any of these temporary hit points, it is {@condition restrained}. A creature freed from this effect by bludgeoning damage immediately takes 10 ({@dice 3d6}) additional slashing damage.

reaction.name: Eerie Whistle (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction when the yeti takes damage, it lets out an echoing whistle, and each other yeti within 1 mile may also take this reaction.

Each non-yeti creature within 1 mile of three or more yetis that took this reaction must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} by each of them for the next minute (Save Ends at end of turn).

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The yochlol can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The yochlol has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack (Spider Form Only)
entries: The yochlol makes two attacks with its Venomous Bite.

action.name: Venomous Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft. (10 ft. in demon form), one target. {@h}6 ({@dice 1d6 + 3}) piercing in spider form damage plus 18 ({@damage 5d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Demonweb Metamorphosis (Demon Form Only)
entries: The yochlol breathes a foul miasma into the lungs of a {@condition charmed} creature within 5 feet.

The target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or have its Constitution score reduced by 4 ({@dice 1d8}) for the next minute, to a minimum of 1. A creature whose Constitution is reduced to 1 in this way transforms into a Drider.

action.name: Charm (Drow Form Only, Concentration)
entries: One humanoid the yochlol can see within 30 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be magically {@condition dominated|confc|dominated} by it.
The {@condition dominated|confc|dominated} creature repeats this saving throw whenever it takes damage, ending the effect on a success.
When this effect ends on a creature, the creature takes 44 ({@damage 8d10}) psychic damage and is immune to this yochlol's Charm for the next 24 hours.

bonus.name: Compel
entries: One creature {@condition charmed} by the yochlol must use its reaction to move up to its speed and make a melee attack.

bonus.name: Shift Form
entries: The yochlol transforms into a Medium or Large form that resembles a female drow, a giant spider, or back into its true demonic form. Its statistics are otherwise the same in each form.

reaction.name: Secret Mouth (Demon or Drow Form Only)
entries: When the yochlol is missed with a melee attack, it can make a Venomous Bite attack against the attacker.

reaction.name: Toxic Dissolution (1/Day)
entries: When the yochlol is reduced below 111 hit points, it can dissolve into a cloud of poisonous gas until the beginning of its next turn and move up to its speed without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.
A creature whose space it moves through in this way must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The dragon can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Crushing Field
entries: The area in a 15 foot radius around the dragon is difficult terrain for creatures with a Strength score lower than 15.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) piercing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) force damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}).

action.name: Breath Weapons {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.

action.name: Shattergem Breath
entries: The dragon breathes forth a hail of luminous crystals in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. The area becomes difficult terrain, and each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) slashing damage, or half as much on a success.

At the end of the dragon's next turn, the gems detonate. Each creature within 10 feet of the line must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or take 33 ({@damage 6d10}) force damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Singularity Breath
entries: The dragon creates a shining bead of gravitational force in its mouth, then releases the energy in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw.

On a failed save, the creature takes 36 ({@damage 8d8}) force damage, and its speed becomes 0 until the start of the dragon's next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage, and its speed isn't reduced.

bonus.name: Psionic Empowerment
entries: The dragon produces one of the following effects:

items.name: Psychokinetic Hurl
entries: One creature the dragon can see within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw or be flung up to 20 feet in a direction of the dragon's choice and take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Mind-Blind
entries: The dragon becomes {@condition invisible} to one creature it can see until the beginning of its next turn.

items.name: Psychic Step
entries: The dragon teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of a creature that it can telepathically communicate with.

reaction.name: Psychoport Inversion
entries: As a reaction when a creature teleports to or away from a space the dragon can see, the dragon forces it to succeed on a {@dc 20} Charisma saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 4d10}) force damage and immediately teleport back.

trait.name: Unequaled Cruelty
entries: When the black dragon reduces a creature to 0 hit points, each {@condition frightened} creature that can see it must use its reaction, if available, to move its speed directly away from it.

trait.name: Sensitivity Aura
entries: Attacks against creatures within 10 feet of the dragon that do not have resistance or immunity to acid damage score a critical on an 19-20.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes two attacks, one of which can be with its Steelrot Bite.

action.name: Steelrot Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@dice 2d10 + 4}) piercing plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) acid damage.
On a critical hit, one nonmagical weapon or piece of armor that the target is wearing or wielding is destroyed (target's choice).

action.name: Subduing Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage.
Instead of dealing damage, the dragon can knock the target {@condition prone} or grapple it (escape {@dc 15}).

action.name: Tailbarb Stab
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage and the target begins {@condition bleeding|confc|bleeding} ({@dice 1d10}).
Any hit against a {@condition prone} creature with this attack becomes a critical.

action.name: Hacked-Tar Sputum (Recharges when the dragon uses its Flesh-Melting Breath)
entries: The dragon hacks up a glob of spent acid and dead flesh at a point it can see within 30 feet, where it splashes in a 5 foot radius, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or be drenched in sticky sludge (remove {@dc 14}).

A sludge-drenched creature is {@condition blinded}, has its movement reduced by half, and is protected from decay if it dies, extending the time limit of effects that would raise the target from the dead by up to a year.

action.name: Flesh-Melting Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon spews a jet of caustic acid in a 30-foot long, 5-foot wide line, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or take 49 ({@damage 11d8}) acid damage, or half as much damage on a success.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more suffers a Vitriolic Disfigurement until cured by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

reaction.name: Cruel Jest
entries: When a creature smaller than the dragon leaves its reach, the dragon can force it to make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw.
On a failure, the target is dragged up to 10 feet toward the dragon and the dragon regains its reaction.

reaction.name: Swipe
entries: When a flying creature enters its reach, the dragon can make a Subduing Claw attack against it.

trait.name: Skyfire Splendor
entries: While the dragon is flying, it has advantage on Dexterity saving throws and {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity} made against it have disadvantage.

trait.name: Rising Charge
entries: When the dragon rolls to recharge its Scourgebolt Breath, each creature within 10 feet of it takes lightning damage equal to the number rolled.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three attacks, one of which can be with its Sparking Bite.

action.name: Sparking Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) piercing damage plus 5 ({@damage 1d10}) lightning damage.

action.name: Sandhoned Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) slashing damage.
Instead of dealing damage, the dragon may grapple the target (escape {@dc 17}).

action.name: Ridgetail Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away.

action.name: Shattered Heavens Roar (Concentration)
entries: The dragon roars a challenge to the sky above, carving a rift through which boiling thunderclouds spill.
At the beginning of the dragon's next turn, a cascade of lightning bolts arc down, striking up to three creatures the dragon can see within 60 feet that are not beneath full cover.
Each target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 4d10}) lightning damage, or half as much on a success.

action.name: Scourgebolt Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: A stream of crackling energy issues forth from the dragon's mouth in a 60 foot long, 5 foot wide line, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 44 ({@damage 8d10}) lightning damage, or half as much on a success.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is {@condition paralyzed} until the beginning of its next turn.

reaction.name: Battle of Wits
entries: When the dragon is targeted with a ranged attack by a creature it can see, it can throw a creature {@condition grappled} by it up to 10 feet into the attack's path.
The attacker must succeed on a contested Intelligence ({@skill Insight}) check against the dragon or have its attack instead target the thrown creature.

trait.name: Burning Aura
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 5 ft. of the dragon takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) fire damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}).

action.name: This Reminds Me...
entries: The dragon begins telling a story that lasts until the end of its next turn. While the dragon is telling a story, it cannot use its breath weapons, and a creature that can hear the dragon and attempts to target the dragon with an attack or harmful spell must first make a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature must choose a new target or lose the attack or spell.

action.name: Breath Weapons {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.

action.name: Breath of Lingering Flames
entries: The dragon exhales fire in an 40-foot line that is 5 feet wide and persists until the end of its next turn. Each creature that starts its turn in that line, or enters it for the first time on a turn, must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or take 42 ({@damage 12d6}) fire damage, or half as much on a successful save.

action.name: Breath of Deepening Sleep
entries: The dragon exhales sleep gas in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or fall {@condition unconscious} for 1 minute and gain 10 ({@dice 3d6}) temporary hit points, or 21 ({@dice 6d6}) temporary hit points if it failed the save by 5 or more. This effect ends for a creature if it loses any non-temporary hit points.

reaction.name: I Wasn't Finished!
entries: As a reaction to a creature hitting the dragon with a melee attack while the dragon is telling a story, the dragon ends the story and uses one of its breath weapons, if available.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The dragon can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Battle Analyst
entries: The dragon has advantage on saving throws against any spells or abilities it has been affected by in the last 24 hours.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite

entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}).

entries: The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.

action.name: Arcing Helix Breath
entries: The dragon exhales lightning in a 60- foot line that is 5 feet wide and may make a turn of up to 90 degrees whenever it passes over a creature or metal object. Each creature in that line must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 55 ({@damage 10d10}) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Repulsion Breath
entries: The dragon exhales repulsion energy in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is pushed 40 feet away from the dragon. A creature wearing metal armor makes this saving throw at disadvantage.

reaction.name: Correct Form (3rd Level Spell)
entries: As a reaction to seeing a creature cast a spell within 30 feet, the dragon forces the spell caster to cast the spell at a level one higher than it intended. If the spell caster cannot, the spell fails.

trait.name: Outshine the Eager
entries: At initiative count 20, the dragon may force one creature within 60 ft. that it can see to make a {@dc 14} Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the dragon trades initiatives with it.

trait.name: Jester's Fury
entries: Whenever one or more creatures fail to laugh at a humorous comment or pun made by the dragon, it rolls to recharge its breath weapon.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}).

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 10 feet away from the dragon.

action.name: Breath Weapons {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.

action.name: Aqua Regia Breath
entries: The dragon exhales acid in an 40-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw, taking 40 ({@damage 9d8}) acid damage and losing 20% of the gold and platinum it is carrying on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Unattended gold and platinum in the area dissolves entirely.

action.name: Slowing Breath
entries: The dragon exhales gas in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature can't use reactions, its speed is halved, and it can't make more than one attack on its turn. In addition, the creature can use either an action or a bonus action on its turn, but not both. These effects last for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself with a successful save.

reaction.name: Banter
entries: As a reaction when a creature the dragon can see ends its turn within 60 ft. of it, the dragon offers a humorous comment or pun on an action the creature took this turn. The creature may use its reaction to reply with a humorous comment or salient pun of its own. If it does, both the creature and the dragon have advantage on the next attack or saving throw they make in the next minute. If it fails to do so, the creature has disadvantage on the next attack or saving throw it makes in the next minute.

trait.name: Snowy Camouflage
entries: The dragon may attempt to hide in snowy terrain without being obscured.

trait.name: Lifechannel Aura
entries: At the beginning of each of the dragon's turns, each creature within 5 feet of it gains 5 temporary hit points. While a creature has any of these temporary hit points, it regains the maximum number of hit points possible from any healing.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite.
