entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d10 + 3}) piercing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) radiant damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}).

action.name: Breath Weapons {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.

action.name: Breath of Life Overflowing
entries: The dragon exhales a burst of pure life energy in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw, taking 27 ({@damage 6d8}) radiant damage and regaining 2 ({@dice 1d4}) expended hit dice on a failure, or taking half as much damage on a success.

Then, if the creature has no unexpended hit dice, it incandesces, losing each of its unexpended hit dice, rolling a number of d8s equal to the number of hit dice lost in this way, and taking additional radiant damage equal to the result.

action.name: Breath of Inner Dawn
entries: The dragon blows a mighty breath in a 30 foot long, 5 foot wide line that stokes a blinding glow within all it touches.

The dragon and each creature and object in the area begins to emit sunlight in a 30 foot radius for the next minute, and a creature without resistance to radiant damage that targets an affected creature with an attack or spell must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the beginning of its next turn.

bonus.name: Psionic Empowerment
entries: The dragon produces one of the following effects:

items.name: Wind Scythe
entries: One creature within 60 feet that the dragon can see must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) slashing damage and be pushed up to 10 feet in a direction of the dragon's choice.

items.name: Pacify (Concentration)
entries: One creature within 120 feet that the dragon can see must make a {@dc 14} Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, for the next minute the creature takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) psychic damage whenever it deals damage.

items.name: Psychic Intrusion (Concentration)
entries: One creature within 120 feet that the dragon can see must succeed on a {@dc 14} Intelligence saving throw or gain disadvantage on attacks made against the dragon.

trait.name: Illusory Passage
entries: The dragon can move through natural and magical foliage as though it were illusory.

trait.name: Capricious Jest
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the dragon and attempts to move must first make a {@dc 14} Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, the dragon controls its movement this turn.

trait.name: Displacement
entries: The dragon has an illusory double that mirrors its movements imperfectly, causing attack rolls against it to have disadvantage. If it is hit by an attack, this trait is disrupted until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Tendril
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}) and pulled up to 5 feet towards the dragon.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away from the dragon.

action.name: Derealization Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon exhales an shimmering aurora of existential crises in a 30 ft. cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw, taking 42 ({@damage 12d6}) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more becomes convinced that it is an illusion. An affected creature cannot concentrate on spells, loses {@status concentration} if it was holding it, and makes a {@dc 14} Intelligence saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A creature that targets itself with an attack or spell immediately ends this effect.

reaction.name: Hurl
entries: As a reaction to being damaged by a creature it has {@condition grappled}, the dragon throws a creature it has {@condition grappled} up to 30 feet. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) bludgeoning damage, in addition to any damage from falling.

reaction.name: Slam
entries: As a reaction to a {@condition grappled} creature casting a spell, the dragon lifts the creature up and slams it into the ground, releasing the grapple. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) bludgeoning damage and be unable to stand this turn, or take half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Slink
entries: As a reaction to being missed with a melee attack, the dragon moves up to half its speed without provoking {@action opportunity attack||attacks of opportunity}.

trait.name: Magnanimous
entries: When a hostile creature the dragon can see falls {@condition prone}, the dragon treats its as friendly until the creature stands, deals damage to the dragon, or forces the dragon to make a saving throw.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d10 + 6}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}).

action.name: Bow Before Me!
entries: Each creature within 10 ft. of the dragon must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom or fall {@condition prone} and be unable to stand for the next minute. This effect ends early if the affected creature deals damage to the dragon or forces it to make a saving throw.

action.name: Breath Weapons {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.

action.name: Slithering Fire Breath
entries: The dragon exhales fire in an 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide and can make as many as two turns of up to 90 degrees at any point along its length. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw, taking 55 ({@damage 10d10}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Weakening Breath
entries: The dragon exhales gas in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or have disadvantage on Strength-based attack rolls, Strength checks, and Strength saving throws for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

reaction.name: Lead the Foolish
entries: As a reaction when another creature it can see within 60 ft. makes an attack, the dragon imposes its choice of advantage or disadvantage on the roll.

trait.name: Forestborn
entries: The dragon's movement is not impeded by natural or magical foliage, and while in a wooded area can attempt to {@action Hide} while only Lightly Obscured.

trait.name: Slithering Shadow
entries: The first time each turn that the dragon is missed with an attack, it can move up to 10 feet without provoking {@action opportunity attack||opportunity attacks}.

trait.name: Fuming Wounds
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the dragon takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage if it has fewer than half its hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes two attacks, one of which can be with its Venomtongue Bite.

action.name: Venomtongue Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@dice 2d10 + 4}) piercing plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage.
If the target is resistant to poison damage, it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or lose its resistance to poison damage for the next minute.

action.name: Hooked Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage.
Instead of dealing damage, the dragon can grapple the target (escape {@dc 15}).

action.name: Lash Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed up to 5 feet away.

action.name: Rampant Growth
entries: The dragon calls a burst of barbed vines forth from the earth in a 10 foot radius centered on a point it can see within 30 feet, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 13}).
Until the dragon uses this ability again, the area is difficult terrain, and a creature that moves into or within the area takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) piercing damage for every 5 feet it travels.

action.name: Lungripper Miasma Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon exhales a poisonous cloud in a 30-foot cone.
Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or take 31 ({@damage 9d6}) poison damage, or half as much damage on a success.
A creature that fails this save by 5 or more is {@condition blinded} and {@condition choking|confc|choking} until the end of the dragon's next turn.

reaction.name: Adapt Camouflage
entries: When a creature more than 30 feet from the dragon hits it with a ranged attack, it can alter its patterning to match its surroundings.
Until it moves, the dragon becomes {@condition invisible} to creatures more than 30 feet away from it.

reaction.name: Vindictive Snap
entries: When a creature affected by the green dragon's Lungripper Miasma Breath takes fewer than 16 damage from it, the dragon can move up to 30 feet toward the creature and make a Venomtongue Bite attack against it.

reaction.name: Silent Snatch
entries: When a creature the dragon is hidden from enters its reach, the dragon can grapple the creature (escape {@dc 15}) and force it to make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw.
On a failure, the target is {@condition stunned} and hidden from its allies until the beginning of the dragon's next turn, and the dragon remains hidden from each other creature.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The kruthik has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the kruthik's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The kruthik can burrow through solid rock at half its burrowing speed and leaves a 2 1/2-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

trait.name: Gnashing Horde
entries: Any creature other than a kruthic that starts its turn adjacent to one or more kruthiks takes 1 piercing damage per adjacent kruthik.

action.name: Stab
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Quick Squeeze
entries: The dragon may move through any space larger than its skull without squeezing.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The dragon can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Extinguishing Aura
entries: The dragon is surrounded by an aura of light-eating microbes. At the beginning of the dragon's turn, each light source within 15 ft. diminishes one level; from bright light to dim light, or from dim light to darkness.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three attacks, one of which may be with its bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) slashing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the dragon may grapple the target (escape {@dc 15}).

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 5 feet away from the dragon.

action.name: Nightmare Spore Breath

On a failed save, the creature takes 22 ({@damage 4d10}) psychic damage and is covered in spores until a creature takes an action to remove them. While covered in these spores, a creature is {@condition frightened}.

action.name: Stone Tomb Breath
entries: The dragon exhales a burst of stone-softening magic in a 30-foot cone, turning the ground in the area into difficult terrain for the next minute. A creature that begins its turn on the ground in the area must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 14}) as it begins to sink into the stone.
A creature already affected by this ability that fails the saving throw sinks entirely beneath the surface, and is {@condition blinded} and cannot speak or breathe until it escapes.

reaction.name: Phantasmagoria
entries: As a reaction when a {@condition frightened} creature fails a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check to detect it, the dragon forces the creature to succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or move up to half its speed and make a melee attack against a creature of the dragon's choice.

trait.name: Vainglorious Strength
entries: If the dragon succeeds on a Strength saving throw, the next attack it makes before the end of its next turn has advantage.
If the dragon fails a Strength saving throw, it has disadvantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws for the next minute.

trait.name: Whorlflare Landing
entries: The first time each turn that the dragon lands on a solid surface after descending at least 20 feet, each creature within 15 feet of it is pushed up to 5 feet away and begins {@condition burning|confc|burning} ({@dice 1d10}).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three attacks, one of which may be with its Searing Bite.

action.name: Searing Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@dice 2d10 + 6}) piercing plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Irongouge Claws

action.name: Slagflame Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon exhales rippling flames in a 30-foot cone, turning each surface in the area to molten slag.
Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity or take 38 ({@damage 11d6}) fire damage, or half as much on a success.
For the next minute, the ground in the area becomes difficult terrain, and a creature that ends its turn on the ground in the area takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Stoke Malice (1/Day)
entries: The dragon breathes evil life into an an area of slag or magma within 60 feet, creating two {@creature magmin pyroclast|confc|Magmin Pyroclasts} that emerge from the ground into unoccupied spaces in the area.

reaction.name: Leaping Flames
entries: When the dragon is targeted with a spell by a creature it can see that is within 20 feet of a burning creature or object, the dragon may cause those flames to flare and leap toward the spellcaster.
The spellcaster must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 11 ({@damage 2d10}) fire damage and begin {@condition burning|confc|burning} ({@dice 1d10}).

trait.name: Heated Body

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d10 + 4}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.

action.name: Terror From the Deep (1/Day)
entries: The Remorhaz moves up to its burrow speed, then bursts from underground thrashing in a flurry of debris. Each creature in a 10 foot radius must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}, or half damage on a success.

trait.name: Shadow Form
entries: The shadow dragon's traits change depending on lighting.
In darkness, the dragon treats all creatures as unarmored (an unarmored creature's AC is usually 10 plus its Dexterity modifier.)
In dim light or darkness it can hide as a bonus action without obscurement, submerging itself in pools of shadow.
In bright light, attacks against the dragon have advantage.

action.name: Shadow Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon exhales writhing shadow in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw, taking 49 ({@damage 14d6}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature with a shadow reduced to 0 by this damage falls into its shadow, and its shadow climbs into the material plane to replace it, with the following attributes:
The creature's shadow has the same statistics and abilities as the creature and has one hit point. It acts on the dragon's initiative and is under the dragon's control.
The creature remains conscious, but may only target its shadow with spells and abilities.
A creature can wrestle the shadow back into the shadow realm with a successful {@dc 14} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. If it does, the creature returns to the material plane with one hit point.
If the creature's shadow receives any healing, the shadow is banished to the shadow realm. The creature returns to the material plane with one hit point.
If the creature's shadow dies, the creature is lost forever to the realm of shadow.

reaction.name: Shadow Glide (Dim light only)
entries: As a reaction to taking damage of a type it is resistant to, the dragon may teleport up to 60 feet and turn {@condition invisible} until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Ice Walk
entries: The dragon can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.

trait.name: Flattery Vulnerability
entries: When subjected to flattery by a medium or smaller creature, the dragon must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by the creature until it takes hostile action against the dragon or its allies. A dragon that succeeds on this save becomes immune to flattery from that creature for the next minute.

action.name: Hypothermic Breath

On a failure, a creature is {@condition paralyzed} outside of its own turn, and repeats this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more must use its action to doff its armor or shield.

reaction.name: Shield the Weak

If it ends that movement within 5 feet of the creature, the creature gains +3 to its AC (including against the triggering attack) and has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn, or until it moves further away.

reaction.name: Bat Away

trait.name: Tundraborn
entries: The dragon ignores negative effects from moving over terrain composed of ice or snow, and has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition blinded}.

trait.name: Heavy Chill
entries: A creature that begins its turn within 5 feet of the dragon has disadvantage on each attack it makes on its turn beyond the first, unless it is resistant or immune to cold damage.

A creature that moves more than 10 feet through the area in a turn must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Sudden Pounce
entries: When a creature the dragon can see within 60 feet moves at least 15 feet away from it or fails an attempt to {@action Hide} from it, the dragon can leap up to 60 feet directly toward the creature and make a Barbed Claw attack against it.

reaction.name: Roar of Triumph
entries: When the dragon reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack, it can let out a terrifying roar.
Each creature within 30 feet that can hear it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Deteriorating Form
entries: Absent its innate draconic magics, mere necromancy is unable to sustain the zombie for long. Whenever the zombie makes an attack, it loses 5 hit points. Whenever the zombie uses its breath weapon, it loses 20 hit points.

trait.name: Putrid Stench
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the zombie must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack

items.name: Broken Limb

items.name: Dislocated Jaw
entries: The zombie cannot use its Festering Bite after this turn.

reaction.name: Swoop

entries: {@atk mw} automatic hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}27 ({@damage 5d10}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} and {@condition restrained} (escape {@dc 19}). The zelekhut has two chains, each of which can grapple one target.

action.name: Subduing Shock
entries: Each creature {@condition grappled} by the zelekhut must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or take 36 ({@damage 8d8}) lightning damage. This damage can't reduce the target's hit points below 1.

action.name: Curse of Inevitable Justice (5th Level Spell)
entries: One creature the zelekhut can see within 120 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 18} Charisma saving throw or be cursed with a mark of judgement, suffering the following effects:
Any creature that can see the cursed creature knows what laws it has broken.
If this curse is removed, another zelekhut is summoned in an unoccupied space within 60 ft.

action.name: Justify (7th Level Spell)
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by the zelekhut and affected by its Curse of Inevitable Justice must succeed on a {@dc 18} Charisma saving throw or be teleported to a teleportation circle in the Hall of Concordance in Sigil. A target fails automatically if it has 1 or fewer hit points. If the target is teleported in this way, the zelekhut teleports with it to the circle.

action.name: Plane Shift (7th Level Spell)
entries: The zelekhut and up to eight willing creatures within 10 feet teleport to another plane of existence.

trait.name: Feather Step
entries: Zenkibo's high jump is up to 15 feet, or up to 30 feet with a running start. He may treat any surface, including leaves or falling snow, as solid ground.

trait.name: Harbinger of Strife
entries: When the daitengu or another creature within 30 feet makes an attack, it adds {@dice 1d4} to the result.

trait.name: Deliberate
entries: If Zenkibo does not make any attacks on his turn, he may use his Multiattack whenever he would make an attack with his reaction.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Zenkibo makes two attacks; one with his Humongous Tetsubo and one with his Studded Fist.

action.name: Humongous Tetsubo
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}31 ({@damage 4d12 + 5}) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away and knocked {@condition prone}.
If this attack misses, Zenkibo may immediately make a second attack roll against a different target in range.

action.name: Studded Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

reaction.name: Grab Scruff
entries: As a reaction when a creature within 5 feet makes an attack against a creature other than him, Zenkibo attempts to grapple the creature.
While {@condition grappled} in this way, a creature has disadvantage on attack rolls that target any creature other than Zenkibo.

trait.name: Third Eye Insight
entries: Zhang has advantage on Wisdom checks made to determine a creature's relative strength, depth of reserves, and killing intent.

trait.name: Inexorable Current
entries: Whenever Zhang is missed with a melee attack, he may move the attacker 5 feet in any direction.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Zhang makes two attacks with his flowing fist.

action.name: Flowing Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) cold damage, and Zhang may expend two hit dice to add one additional effect to the attack.

items.name: Breaking the Water's Surface
entries: The target's AC is reduced by 1 until the beginning of its next turn.

items.name: Freezing Tide
entries: The target is pushed 5 feet away, and its movement speed is reduced by 5 until the end of its next turn.

items.name: Crushing Stone
entries: The target takes an additional 3 ({@damage 1d6}) bludgeoning damage if it is positioned between Zhang and a solid object, such as a wall.

reaction.name: Iron Resistance
entries: As a reaction when he is hit with a melee attack, Zhang reduces the attack's damage by 5.

trait.name: Bosun's Panache
entries: If Zigan makes a successful {@dc 15} {@skill Intimidation} check as part of his movement, Zigan and one friendly creature he can see gain Panache until the beginning of his next turn. While a creature has panache, it makes attacks at advantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Zigan makes two attacks with his cutlass, one of which he may replace with his Belch Smoke ability, if available. Then, if Zigan has Panache, he may use its Split the Shares ability.

action.name: Cutlass
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage. On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or drop one item is is holding.

action.name: Split the Shares
entries: Each friendly pirate within 30 feet that has fewer than half its maximum hit points gains 10 temporary hit points.

action.name: Belch Smoke {@recharge 5}
entries: One creature within 5 feet must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of Zigan's next turn.
A creature that fails this save by 5 or more enters an uncontrollable coughing fit and can't take actions on its following turn.

reaction.name: Belay That!
entries: As a reaction to a creature within 30 ft. making an attack, the pirate causes the creature to reroll the attack, taking the second result.

reaction.name: Flatten Feathers
entries: As a reaction to being targeted with a melee attack, Zigan flattens his feathers, significantly shrinking his profile and reducing the attack roll by 5.
If the attack hits regardless, it deals an additional 5 damage.

trait.name: Sulphureous Strikes
entries: A creature struck by the zmey has a shock of its hair turn white.

trait.name: Gargantuan Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the zmey may spend its full movement to attempt a {@dc 21} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the zmey. While climbing on the zmey, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the zmey.

trait.name: Multiple Heads
entries: The zmey has twelve heads. While it has more than one head, the zmey has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition blinded}, {@condition charmed}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition frightened}, {@condition stunned}, and knocked {@condition unconscious}.
Whenever the zmey takes 30 or more damage from a single source, one of its heads dies. If all its heads die, the zmey dies.

trait.name: Death Curse
entries: The blood of a slain zmey pools upon the ground and resists being absorbed. If the ground is not blessed by a Ceremony or other means within 10 days, the Zmey returns to life with a new body and three additional heads at the site of its death.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If the zmey fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The zmey makes as many bite attacks as it has heads. If it is grappling a creature at the start of its turn, it may replace one of its bite attacks with a swallow.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 1d10 + 8}) piercing damage and the target is {@condition grappled}. While a head grapples a target, the head can attack only that target.

action.name: Swallow
entries: The zmey makes one bite attack against a Large or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, that creature takes the bite's damage and is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is {@condition blinded} and {@condition grappled} in the zmey's craw, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the zmey, its attacks ignore the zmey's damage resistances, and it takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) acid damage at the start of each of the zmey's turns. One swallowed creature is freed whenever the zmey loses a head.

action.name: Worry
entries: One creature {@condition grappled} by at least two zmey heads must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution throw or take 188 ({@damage 16d10 + 100}) piercing damage, or half as much on a success. A creature makes this save at disadvantage if it is {@condition grappled} by three or more zmey heads.

action.name: Fire Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The zmey exhales fire in a number of 300-foot long, 15-foot wide lines equal to the number of heads that it has. Each creature in one or more lines must make a {@dc 23} Dexterity saving throw, taking 63 ({@damage 18d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reaction.name: Bloodied Breath (1/Day)
entries: As a reaction to being reduced below 260 hit points, the zmey immediately recharges and uses its fire breath.

legendary.name: Bite
entries: The zmey makes a bite attack.

legendary.name: Inhale
entries: The zmey rolls to recharge its breath weapon.

legendary.name: Mountain Drop
entries: The dragon folds its wings and drops to the ground. Each creature beneath it must succeed on a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone} and {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 21}). This grapple ends if the dragon moves.

legendary.name: 7-Tailed Sweep (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Each creature within 15 feet of the dragon must succeed on a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw or take 25 ({@damage 7d4 + 8}) bludgeoning damage, be knocked {@condition prone}, and pushed up to 15 feet away from the dragon.

entries: If the zombie takes at least 10 points of slashing or piercing damage in a turn, a gout of toxic gas erupts from it. Each creature within 10 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage.

trait.name: Volatile
entries: If the zombie takes any fire damage, it must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or explode. Each creature within 20 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage and be knocked {@condition prone}, or take half as much on a success.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The zombie makes two attacks with its grasp of the dead.

action.name: Grasp of the Dead
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) bludgeoning damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 12}).

action.name: Festering Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., targets one {@condition grappled} creature. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d6 + 2}) piercing damage and 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage.

trait.name: Deathly Stench
entries: Living creatures within 10 feet of the clot are {@condition poisoned}, and those within 60 feet have disadvantage on saving throws to resist being {@condition poisoned}.

trait.name: Undead Mass
entries: If the zombie takes 10 or more damage that isn't fire or radiant from a single source, it makes a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw, reducing the damage to 10 on a success.

trait.name: Huge Stature
entries: A creature adjacent to the clot may spend half of its movement to attempt a {@dc 16} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, the creature climbs onto the clot. While climbing on the clot, a creature has advantage on melee attacks against the clot, and the clot has disadvantage on melee attacks against it.

action.name: Crush of Bodies
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}33 ({@damage 8d6 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.
Each other creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take half the attack's damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Engulf
entries: The clot engulfs a humanoid creature {@condition grappled} by it. The engulfed target is {@condition blinded}, {@condition restrained}, and unable to breathe (escape {@dc 16}), and it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw at the start of each of the clot's turns or take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) necrotic damage. If the creature is killed by this damage, the clot gains 13 ({@dice 2d12}) temporary hit points.

action.name: Shackles of Flesh {@recharge 5}
entries: The clot flings a detached clump of corpses at a creature it can see within 30 feet, which must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 33 ({@damage 6d10}) bludgeoning damage, is knocked {@condition prone}, and three {@condition prone}

reaction.name: Grasping Mass
entries: When the clot is hit with a melee attack, it can force the attacker to succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}).

trait.name: Deteriorating Form
entries: Absent its innate draconic magics, mere necromancy is unable to sustain the zombie for long. Whenever the zombie makes an attack, it loses 5 hit points. Whenever the zombie uses its breath weapon, it loses 20 hit points.

trait.name: Putrid Stench
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the zombie must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the start of its next turn.

action.name: Festering Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@dice 1d10 + 3}) piercing plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Rotgrasp Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}).

action.name: Gore Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon exudes a torrent of its own liquefied viscera in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or take 9 ({@dice 2d8}) bludgeoning plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage and be knocked {@condition prone}, or take half as much damage on a success.

reaction.name: Perilous Thrash
entries: When the zombie misses with a melee attack, it may permanently suffer one of the following effects of its choice that it has not yet suffered. If it does, it rerolls the attack with advantage:

items.name: Torn Wing
entries: While flying, the zombie must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw at the end of each of its turns or fall {@condition prone}.

items.name: Dislocated Jaw
entries: The zombie cannot use its Festering Bite after this turn.

trait.name: Undead Fortitude
entries: If the zombie starts its turn with 0 hit points, it makes a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw, unless it took radiant damage or a critical hit since its last turn. On a success, the zombie gains 1 hit point. A zombie with 0 hit points is killed instantly if it is attacked.

trait.name: Sudden Lunge
entries: The zombie's attacks have a reach of 10 feet for the purposes of making {@action opportunity attack||opportunity attacks}. When it makes an {@action opportunity attack}, it moves up to 5 feet towards its target as part of the attack.

action.name: Grasp of the Dead
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, the zombie may grapple the target (escape {@dc 11}).

action.name: Festering Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., targets one {@condition grappled} creature. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) piercing damage and 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage.

trait.name: Creeping Mycelia
entries: When a creature ends its turn within 10 feet of Zuggtmoy, she may extend a tendril of mycelia from the ground, forcing the creature to succeed on a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition grappled} in place (escape {@dc 21}).
While {@condition grappled} in this way, a creature is {@condition charmed} by Zuggtmoy and takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) poison damage at the start of each of its turns.

trait.name: Demonrot Toxin
entries: A creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of Zuggtmoy must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw or lose any Resistance or Immunity to poison or disease that it has for the next 24 hours and be unable to gain Resistance or Immunity to poison or disease until the beginning of its next turn.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Zuggtmoy has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Legendary Resistances (5/Day)
entries: If Zuggtmoy fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Zuggtmoy makes two attacks with her Queen's Caress, one of which she may replace with her Sprouting Doom or Rotted Regenesis.

action.name: Queen's Caress
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}22 ({@dice 4d10}) necrotic plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) poison damage and the target has disadvantage on Constitution saving throws until the end of Zuggtmoy's next turn.

action.name: Sprouting Doom
entries: A roiling growth of multifarious fungus that lasts for a minute bursts forth in a 5 foot radius centered on a point Zuggtmoy can see within 120 feet.

The area is difficult terrain for nonplant creatures, and a nonplant creature that starts its turn in the area takes 20 poison damage. This effect ends if the area is dealt 20 or more fire or radiant damage from a single source.

action.name: Rotted Regenesis
entries: Zuggtmoy's body rapidly blackens and withers, then explodes in a cloud of spores. Each nonplant creature within 10 feet of her must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw or take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) poison damage, or half as much on a success.
Zuggtmoy reappears in an unoccupied space affected by Sprouting Doom, forming a new body from the fungi there.

action.name: Burrowing Sporeflood {@recharge 5}
entries: Zuggtmoy's torso distends and splits, expelling a torrent of flesh-burrowing spores in a 60 foot cone. Each nonplant creature in the area must make a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw.
On a failed save, the creature takes 35 ({@dice 10d6}) piercing plus 27 ({@damage 6d8}) poison damage and is infected with Brittle Lung, or takes half as much damage on a successful save.

action.name: Garden of Rot and Ruin (1/Day, 9th Level Spell, Concentration)
entries: Each area affected by Sprouting Doom within 120 feet of Zuggtmoy releases a cloud of hallucinogenic spores in a 30 foot radius centered on itself that lasts until the area is destroyed or Zuggtmoy loses {@status concentration}.

The area is heavily obscured, and each nonplant creature that starts its turn in the area must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the start of its next turn. While {@condition poisoned} in this way, a creature treats all creatures it is not {@condition charmed} by as hostile.

reaction.name: Rot Mother's Rebirth
entries: When one or more creatures die within 60 feet of Zuggtmoy, she can raise each of them under her control with 20 hit points. The creatures' type becomes plant/undead.

reaction.name: Consumptive Bloom
entries: When Zuggtmoy is targeted with an attack or spell, she can kill one friendly plant creature within 30 feet of her. If she does, she immediately uses her Rotted Regenesis.

legendary.name: Sprouting Doom
entries: Zuggtmoy uses her Sprouting Doom.

legendary.name: Feast on the Fallen
entries: A carpet of fungal growths spreads over one {@condition prone} creature Zuggtmoy can see within 30 feet and takes root in its flesh.
Until a creature clears them as an action, whenever the affected creature would receive any amount magical healing it instead receives half as much.

legendary.name: Cultivator's Reap
entries: Zuggtmoy moves up to half her speed. If she ends this movement within 10 feet of a friendly plant creature, it loses half its current hit points and Zuggtmoy gains temporary hit points equal to the hit points lost.

entries: Zuggtmoy creates a

trait.name: Desiccation Weakness
entries: If the ōmukade takes any fire or necrotic damage, it loses an unspent Legendary Action, or takes a point of {@condition exhaustion} if it can't.

trait.name: Saliva-Pierced
entries: Attacks against the ōmukade with weapons coated in the saliva of a humanoid creature have advantage, and the ōmukade has vulnerability to damage dealt by them.

trait.name: Segment Titan
entries: The ōmukade's body is divided into 15 contiguous sements, each of which fills a 15-foot cube and has the following properties.

items.name: Movement
entries: When one of the ōmukade's segments moves, each connected segment is dragged behind it to the nearest unoccupied space. Its movement can originate from any of its segments.

items.name: Reach
entries: The ōmukade's Headclipper Mandibles and Mountain-Metal Toxicognaths attacks originate from the segment that contains its head. Its Stomp of Nine Agonies can originate from any segment.

items.name: Climbing
entries: A creature within 5 feet of a segment can spend half of its movement to attempt a {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check, becoming {@condition attached|confc|attached} to that segment or moving from one segment to another on a success.

trait.name: Reflexive Molt (1/Day)
entries: When the ōmukade fails a saving throw or takes any damage, it can choose to succeed on the saving throw or reduce that damage to 0 by rapidly shedding its exoskeleton, disgorging its soft inner body through its mouth into the nearest unoccupied spaces.
The exoskeleton can be attacked and destroyed (AC 18; 60 HP). Until it completes a Long Rest or uses its Devour Chitin, attacks against the ōmukade have advantage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ōmukade makes four attacks, one of which can be with either its Headclipper Mandibles or Mountain-Metal Toxicognaths.

action.name: Mountain-Metal Toxicognaths
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}25 ({@dice 4d8 + 7}) piercing plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) poison damage and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 22}).

action.name: Headclipper Mandibles
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 10 ft., one {@condition grappled} target. {@h}33 ({@damage 4d12 + 7}) slashing damage.
A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage must succeed on a {@dc 22} Constitution saving throw or be beheaded.

action.name: Stomp of Nine Agonies
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d6 + 7}) piercing damage.
A creature that takes 20 or more damage from this attack is {@condition stunned} until the beginning of its next turn.

bonus.name: Caudal Thrash
entries: The ōmukade anchors its final segment to the ground and thrashes its body into the air, forcing each creature climbing on it to succeed on a {@dc 22} Strength saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) bludgeoning damage and fall {@condition prone} in the nearest unoccupied space.
Until the end of its turn, the ōmukade's melee attacks have a reach of 200 feet and advantage.

bonus.name: Devour Chitin
entries: The ōmukade gorges itself upon its shed exoskeleton, consuming it.
Until it takes a Long Rest, the ōmukade's AC is increased by a cumulative +2, to a maximum of 24.

bonus.name: Impure Infusion
entries: The ōmukade pumps venom into a creature it is grappling, forcing it to succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or take 35 ({@damage 10d6}) poison damage, or half as much on a success.
Then, if the creature has 30 or fewer hit points, it drops to 0 hit points and fails two death saving throws.
A creature that succeeds on this saving throw permanently gains resistance to poison damage from other sources.

reaction.name: Scalding Vent
entries: When the ōmukade takes any fire or necrotic damage, it can vent boiling steam through the spiracles that run down its body, dealing 7 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage to each creature within 5 feet of it.

legendary.name: Skittering Stampede
entries: Each creature within 10 feet of the ōmukade that is not climbing on or {@condition grappled} by it must succeed on a {@dc 22} Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away, then the ōmukade moves up to half its speed.

legendary.name: Two-Hundred-Torch Gaze
entries: Blinding light blazes from the ōmukade's eyes in a 60 foot cone, forcing each creature in the area to succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the end of the ōmukade's next turn.

legendary.name: Agonizing Trample (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The ōmukade makes an attack with its Stomp of Nine Agonies against each creature in its reach that is not climbing on it.

items: A creature that is Attached to an object or another creature is moved with that object or creature whenever it moves. Any effect that could be used to {@condition grapple} a creature can be used to Attach to a creature too large for the Grappler to grapple.

entries.name: Ending the Attached Condition.
entries: Any effect that ends the {@condition Grappled} condition can also end the Attached condition. The DC to remove an Attached creature is noted as its Remove DC.

entries.name: Releasing an Attachment.
entries: A creature that imposes the Attached condition may end that condition as a Bonus Action.

items: A Bleeding creature loses the specified amount of hit points at the beginning of each of its turns, i.e a creature that is "Bleeding ({@damage 1d4})" loses {@dice 1d4} hit points at the beginning of each of its turns.

entries.name: Hit Point Loss.
entries: Hit point loss represents loss of vital fluids, and is distinct from damage. Unless otherwise specified, it can't be resisted or reduced in any way. It has no effect on creatures with 0 hit points.

entries.name: Creatures Without Blood.
entries: Creatures that do not have blood or some equivalent vital fluid are immune to any effect that directly causes Hit Point Loss.

entries.name: Separate Sources of Wounds.
entries: If a creature that is already Bleeding would suffer a wound from a different source, the wound with the higher Hit Point Loss value overrides that with the lesser value.

entries.name: Stacking Bleed.
entries: Rarely, some effects may cause a creature to accrue multiple instances of the Bleeding condition, and will specify if this is the case. Stacking wounds of the same value count as a single instance of the Bleeding condition with a Hit Point Loss value equal to their total cumulative Hit Point Loss value.

entries.name: Ending the Bleeding Condition.
entries: The Bleeding condition ends for a creature that regains any hit points.
Additionally, as an action, a creature may attempt a {@dc 12} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check to stanch the wounds of a Bleeding creature, ending the effect on a success.

items: A Burning creature is on fire, and takes the specified amount of fire damage at the beginning of each of its turns, i.e. "Burning ({@damage 1d10})."

entries.name: Separate Sources of Burning
entries: If a creature that is already Burning would gain the Burning condition from another source, the condition with the higher Burning value overrides that with the lesser value.

entries.name: Ending the Burning Condition
entries: The creature or a creature that can reach it may smother the flames as an action, ending the Burning condition for that creature. A Burning creature that is doused in water, that takes any cold damage, or that is in an airless environment, such as a bag of holding, has the condition immediately end for it.

items: A Choking creature can't breathe. When a Choking creature runs out of breath, or if becomes is unable to hold its breath, it begins {condition suffocating|confc|Suffocating}.

entries.name: Holding Breath.
entries: A creature that is not {@condition unconscious} can hold its breath for a number of minutes equal to 1 + its Constitution modifier (minimum of 30 seconds). Unless otherwise specified, a creature that begins Choking is assumed to reflexively hold its breath.

entries.name: Speaking and Casting Spells With Verbal Components.
entries: A creature that speaks or casts a spell while holding its breath loses its held breath and immediately begins Suffocating.

entries.name: Ending the Choking Condition.
entries: The Choking condition is often imposed by another ongoing effect, such as the {@condition grappled} or {@condition poisoned} conditions, or by an environmental effect, such as being submerged in water. In these instances, the Choking condition persists until the effect causing it ends. When a creature suffers the Choking condition without an ongoing effect imposing it, spells such as Lesser Restoration, Greater Restoration, or Power Word: Heal, and class features such as the Paladin's Lay On Hands ability can end the Choking condition on a creature.

items: A confused creature acts in an uncontrolled manner. It is unable to take reactions, and must roll a {@dice d10} at the start of each of its turns to determine its behavior for that turn.

entries.caption: Confusion Behavior
rows: The creature uses all its movement to move in a random direction. To determine the direction, roll a {@dice d8} and assign a direction to each die face. The creature doesn't take an action this turn.
The creature doesn't move or take actions this turn.
The creature uses its action to make a melee attack against a randomly determined creature within its reach. If there is no creature within its reach, the creature does nothing this turn.
The creature can act and move normally.

entries.name: Variant: Chaotic Confusion.
entries: RAW confusion is mostly just a very slow, bookeeping-heavy way to skip a creature's turn. At DM discretion, the following table may be used instead of the one above:

entries.caption: Confusion Behavior
rows: The creature falls {@condition prone} and ends its turn without taking an action.

The creature uses its action to fling a weapon or spell focus it is wielding, making an Improvised Ranged Weapon Attack against a creature of its choice in range. A creature not wielding a weapon or spell focus may instead throw any item it is carrying.
Before taking an action, the creature falls {@condition prone} and must use all its movement to crawl in a random direction.
Before taking an action, the creature must use all its movement to run in a random direction.
Before taking an action, the creature must use half of its movement to run in a random direction.
The creature does not add its proficiency bonus to attacks it makes this turn, and cannot cast spells of 1st level or above.

If the creature chooses targets for an attack or effect, the targets are determined at random from those in range. If the creature casts a spell that affects an area centered on a point, the spell's area scatters {@dice 1d6 * 5} feet in a random direction before taking effect.
The creature has disadvantage on Intelligence and Wisdom saving throws until the beginning of its next turn.
The creature can act and move normally.

items: A Cursed creature suffers the effects of the curse it is afflicted with. Unless specified otherwise, curses typically last until removed, and do not end on a creature that dies. A creature may be afflicted with multiple different curses simultaneously. Some curses have an additional effect that happens when the curse is removed.

entries.name: Ending the Cursed Condition.
entries: Spells such as Remove Curse and Greater Restoration can end one curse affecting a creature.

entries.name: Variant: Persistent Curses.
entries: At DM discretion, a curse may require magic of a specific level to remove, require a skill check against a set DC in a manner similar to the Dispel Magic Spell, or require a specific procedure to remove the curse.

items: A dazed creature can only do one of the following things on their turn: move, use an action, or use a bonus action. If a creature becomes dazed during their turn, their turn ends.

entries.name: Extra Actions while Dazed.
entries: When a dazed creature is affected by a spell or effect that gives them an extra action on their turn (like the {@spell haste} spell or the fighter's Action Surge feature), they can still take this extra action, in addition to the movement, action, or bonus action allowed by the dazed condition.

entries.name: Immunity to the Dazed Condition.
entries: A creature that is immune to the {@condition paralyzed} or {@condition stunned} condition also has immunity to the dazed condition.

entries.name: Ending the Dazed Condition.
entries: Any effect that ends the {@condition Paralyzed} or {@condition Stunned} condition can also end the Dazed condition.

items: A creature that is Dominated is {@condition charmed} and must follow the verbal or telepathic commands of the creature Dominating it to the best of its ability. If given no commands, the Dominated creature attempts to protect itself and the creature Dominating it. Any ability that allows a creature to resist or ignore the effects of the {@condition Charmed} condition also applies to the Dominated condition.

entries.name: Ending the Dominated Condition.
entries: Any effect that ends the {@condition Charmed} condition can also end the Dominated condition.

items: A creature is Flanked if two enemies that can see it are adjacent to it and positioned on opposite sides of it. The two enemies are described as Flanking the Flanked creature. An {@condition incapacitated} creature cannot flank.

Typically, this condition has no mechanical impact on its own and can be safely ignored, but some abilities may interact with it, and there are variant rules available for making it more prominent in your games.

entries.name: Why Use Flanking?
entries: The design intent of the variant flanking rules presented here is to incentivize tactical movement and positioning; this can be valuable if your games feature dynamic combats with lots of movement, but will likely add little if your combats tend toward static dogpiles, or if you primarily run Theater of the Mind combat.

entries.name: Variant: Flanking for Advantage.
entries: Under this rule found in the 2014 D&D 5e DMG, Flanking creatures have advantage on attacks against creatures Flanked by them.

entries.name: Design Notes:
entries: Don't use this. Advantage is the primary reward mechanic in D&D 5e, and this rule undermines the players' incentive to use their own abilities and to engage with the world.

entries.name: Variant: Flanking for +1.
entries: Under this rule, Flanking creatures gain +1 to attack rolls made against a creature they are Flanking.

entries.name: Design Notes:
entries: This has the advantage of not being game-warping in the way that Flanking for Advantage can be, with the downside of introducing a static modifier, which has some friction with the design aesthetics of 5e.

items: A levitating creature is suspended weightlessly; it does not fall if unsupported, and cannot use its speed to walk, but can use special movement types available to it such as flying, and can drag itself as though it were climbing along any surface or object it can reach.

entries.name: Ending the Levitating Condition.
entries: The Levitating condition is typically imposed by a spell or environmental effect, and typically ends when the spell or environmental effect ends for the creature, or when the creature leaves the spell or effect's area of influence.

items: When a creature or object becomes Possessed, the possessing creature (hereafter referred to as a "spirit") is removed from play; it can't be affected or harmed by any means unless otherwise stated, and it can't take actions, bonus actions, or reactions.

entries.name: Possessing a Creature.
entries: The body of a Possessed creature or object is controlled by the spirit possessing it, and can use any of the abilities normally available to the creature. Unless otherwise stated, the possessing spirit gains no special insight into a Possessed creature's thoughts or memories.

entries.name: Ending the Possessed Condition.
entries: In addition to any other means specific to a given spirit, the following means can be used to end the Possessed condition on a creature or object. When a creature or object ceases to be Possessed, the possessing spirit is expelled into the nearest unoccupied space.

items: The Ceremony spell may be used to perform an exorcism on a Possessed creature or object the spell caster can see within 15 feet. Upon casting, the spirit must succeed on a Charisma saving throw against the spell caster's Save DC or be expelled from the Possessed creature or object.

The Banishment spell may target a spirit Possessing a creature or object in its range. A spirit that fails a saving throw against it immediately ends any Possession it is imposing, in addition to the spells other effects.
The Dispel Good and Evil spell expels any spirit Possessing its target.

Any effect that imposes the {@condition turned|confc|Turned} condition affects possessing spirits as though they were in the space of the creature or object Possessed by them. A spirit that is Turned is immediately expelled from any creature or object it is Possessing.

entries.name: Releasing a Possessed Creature or Object.
entries: Unless otherwise stated, a possessing spirit may release a creature or object Possessed by it at any time, with no action required.

items: When a creature that is {@condition choking|confc|Choking} runs out of breath or loses its held breath, it begins Suffocating. A Suffocating creature can survive for a number of rounds equal to its Constitution modifier (minimum of 1 round). At the start of its next turn, it drops to 0 hit points and begins Dying, and it can't regain hit points or be stabilized until it can breathe again.
For example, a creature with a Constitution of 14 can hold its breath for 3 minutes. If it starts suffocating, it has 2 rounds to reach air before it drops to 0 hit points.
A swallowed creature is trapped inside the creature or effect that swallowed it. Its movement becomes 0, it moves with the creature swallowing it.

entries.name: Vision While Swallowed.
entries: The space inside a Swallowing effect is typically dark unless illuminated by some internal source.

entries.name: Restraint While Swallowed.
entries: A creature Swallowed by a creature or effect less than three size categories larger than it is {@condition restrained}.

entries.name: Damage From Inside.
entries: Damage a creature is dealt from an effect that originates inside of it ignores the creature's damage resistances and immunities.

entries.name: Saving Throws From Inside.
entries: A creature automatically fails any Dexterity saving throw from an effect that originates inside of it, and has disadvantage on any Constitution saving throws from such an effect.

entries.name: Ending the Swallowed Condition.
entries: If an escape DC is noted, it indicates that some portion of the creature is within reach of some means of exiting the space it is Swallowed in.

In such cases, a creature may end the Swallowed condition on itself or on a creature Swallowed by a creature or effect within 5 feet as an Action with a successful Strength ({@skill Athletics}) or Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check.
When the Swallowed condition ends for a creature, it emerges prone in the nearest unoccupied space.

entries.name: Teleportation.
entries: A swallowed creature that teleports out of the space it is swallowed in has the condition end for it.

entries.name: Releasing a Swallowed Creature.
entries: As a Reaction when a creature is dealt damage by a creature Swallowed by it, it may regurgitate each creature Swallowed by it.

items: A Turned creature must spend its action and movement on each of its turns trying to move as far away as possible from the creature or effect that turned it, can't willingly move to a space within 30 feet of that creature or effect, and can't take reactions. If there's nowhere to move, the creature can use the {@action Dodge} action.

entries.name: Ending the Turned Condition.
entries: A Turned creature that takes any damage has the condition end for it.

disease.name: Burrow-Diver Mycosis
entries: An infected creature loses all appetite, and dusty blue lesions open on its skin as the disease progresses. An infected creature that attempts to move away from the nearest hostile creature it can see must first make a {@dc 10} Wisdom saving throw, using all of its movement to approach the nearest hostile creature on a failure.

An infected creature must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw at each dawn or have its Wisdom score reduced by {@dice 1d4} until the disease is cured, ending the disease on a success. A creature reduced to 0 Wisdom in this way dies.

disease.name: Charnel Lung
entries: An infected creature cannot hold its breath and has disadvantage on Constitution saving throws made to resist breathable toxins.

disease.name: Fading Ague
entries: An infected creature takes on a slightly translucent pallor, which intensifies as the disease progresses. Whenever an infected creature drops to 0 HP, its Constitution score is reduced by {@dice 1d4} until the disease is cured. If the creature's Constitution is reduced to 0 it dies and a Specter rises from its corpse.

disease.name: Festering Necrosis
entries: An infected creature gains vulnerability to necrotic damage. Whenever an infected creature would fail one death save, it instead fails two death saves.

disease.name: Filth Fever
entries: A raging fever sweeps through the creature's body, giving it disadvantage on Strength-based attacks, saving throws and checks. Every 24 hours, the target make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw, reducing its hit point maximum by 5 ({@dice 1d10}) until the disease is cured on a failure, or curing the disease on a success. The target dies if the disease reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

disease.name: Fungal Phantasmagoria
entries: An aura of {@condition invisible} hallucinogenic spores extends from the basidirond in a 60 foot radius.
A nonplant creature that starts its turn in the area must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be infected with Fungal Phantasmagoria (Save Ends at end of turn).

disease.name: Greensickness
entries: A creature infected with Greensickness has disadvantage on attacks, ability checks, and saving throws that use Strength. Tiny roots grow out of the creature's wounds, reducing the effect of healing magic that targets the creature by half.

disease.name: Leprosy
entries: A creature infected with leprosy devolops disfiguring sores and lesions across its body, giving it disadvantage on Charisma checks. At the end of each week of infection, an afflicted creature makes a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw, ending the disease on a success or reducing its maximum hit points by {@dice 2d10} on a failure. A creature that has its maximum hit points reduced by 16 or more at once in this way loses the use of a limb.

disease.name: Lockjaw
entries: An infection stiffens the creature's joints, impeding its ability to speak well. The creature's movement speed is reduced by 5, it has disadvantage on Charisma skill checks, and it must first succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw to perform the verbal components of a spell. On a failed save, the action is wasted.

disease.name: Lyssavirus
entries: An infected creature must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw at each dawn, or have its Constitution score reduced to the number rolled. A creature that has its Constitution score reduced to 9 or lower in this way is {@condition frightened}. A creature that has its Constitution score reduced to 0 dies.

disease.name: Marrowrot
entries: Attacks against a creature afflicted with marrowrot score a critical on an 18-20.

disease.name: Necrotizing Fasciitis
entries: A creature infected with necrotizing fasciitis develops a festering sore at the site of a wound.
At each dawn, an infected creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or have its hit point maximum reduced by 11 ({@dice 2d10}), or ending the effect on a success.
A creature that has its current hit point maximum reduced by more than half in this way loses the use of the limb closest to the wound.

disease.name: Pestilent Lepidopterism
entries: An infected creature's skin develops a dry, powdery texture and it loses all apetite. Each dawn, the creature's Charisma score is reduced by 1, to a minimum of 1. A creature whose Charisma score is reduced to 1 in this way is enveloped in a cocoon, and over the course of a week has its body dissolve and reform into something new, wondrous and terrible.

A creature that emerges from this cocoon cannot distinguish friend from foe. Once the disease has progressed to this point, curing the disease returns the creature's ability to distinguish friend from foe, but the mutations remain.
If the infected creature is a noctuoidea, these changes are less extreme and can be guided and controlled to a certain extent through the application of secret medicines and meditation.

disease.name: Pthisis
entries: A creature infected with Pthisis cannot hold its breath. Nupperibos in a one mile radius can detect an infected creature by scent.

disease.name: Ravenous Wasting
entries: Before an infected creature begins showing symptoms, Ravenous Wasting may be cured by any ordinary means, such as Lesser Restoration or Lay on Hands. After symptoms begin to show, it may be cured only by healing magic of 5th level or above, or by removing the appendage that the infection site occurred on. Once the symptoms have fully progressed, the disease may be cured only by a {@spell Wish} spell, or by killing and resurrecting the creature.
Every 4 hours after infection, the infected must make a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the disease progresses to the next level.
Level 1:* No symptoms.
Level 2:* Disadvantage on Dexterity and Wisdom checks. The creature has an insatiable hunger that cannot be alleviated.
Level 3:* Whenever the infected creature takes damage, it treats all non-undead creatures as hostile for the next minute.
Level 4:* The creature convulses for 1 minute and then dies. After {@dice 1d4} rounds, the creature rises as a Plague Zombie.

disease.name: Russet Mold Contagion
entries: An infected creature has vulnerability to Acid and Radiant damage. Upon completing a long rest, the creature's AC is reduced by 2 until this disease is cured; to a minimum of 10 if the creature is not wearing heavy armor, or to 14 if it is.

disease.name: Threadnest Bluerot
entries: The infected creature's veins bulge and darken as delicate, fungal threads spread through its bloodstream, eventually turning the sclera of its eyes a vivid blue.

If the creature takes any poison or necrotic damage, some of the threads break loose, forcing the creature to succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or fall {@condition prone} and be {@condition paralyzed} until the beginning of its next turn.
A creature that fails this saving throw by 10 or more drops to 0 hit points and the disease ends for it.

disease.name: Touch of Kyuss
entries: A creature infected by the touch of kyuss suffers from bouts of memory loss and waves of overwhelming nausea.

Whenever the infected creature fails a saving throw against being {@condition frightened} or {@condition poisoned} by 5 or more, it is additionally {@condition stunned} until the end of its next turn. Whenever the creature fails one or more Death Saving Throws, its Proficiency Bonus is reduced by 1, to a minimum of 0, until this disease is cured.

disease.name: Walking Sepsis
entries: An infected creature cannot benefit from resistance or immunity to poison damage or the {@condition poisoned} condition.
Whenever the infected creature takes poison damage, it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn.

disease.name: Wandering Eye Neurotoxemia
entries: An infected creature suffers periodic eye and finger spasms, and has disadvantage on ranged attack rolls and skill checks involving fine motor control, such as picking a lock or disarming a trap.
An infected creature makes a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw after each hour, taking 5 ({@damage 1d10}) poison damage on a failure or ending the disease on a success.
This disease can be cured by any effect which cures the {@condition poisoned} condition.

disease.name: Wastegash
entries: Whenever an infected creature takes damage, it gains a level of {@condition exhaustion}. When an infected creature dies, each creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or be infected. This disease persists through death and resurrection, and can be cured only through a Greater Restoration or similar magic.
